'''Miscellaneous quests''' are minor quests. Completing objectives for miscellaneous quests increases the "Misc Objectives Completed" statistic in your journal and counts toward the [[#Achievements|Hero of the People]] [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]]. Miscellaneous quests are usually started and completed entirely within a single hold or area.

Miscellaneous quests are listed together in the "Miscellaneous" section in your journal. The actual name of each miscellaneous quest is not visible in game (the names used on this site are the names assigned to the quests in the [[Skyrim Mod:Creation Kit|Creation Kit]]). Only the current objective associated with each miscellaneous quest can be seen; completed objectives are not displayed, nor is any additional information about the current quest stage. Miscellaneous quests are different from [[Skyrim:Side Quests|side quests]], as the latter are full quests with complete entries in your journal.

Many miscellaneous quests use the [[Skyrim:Radiant|Radiant]] quest system to add dynamic elements; therefore, details of the objectives for such quests (who assigns the quest, where to go, etc.) are likely to vary from one player to another. Radiant quests that can be obtained from multiple people are listed multiple times. Other radiant events you may encounter while exploring Skyrim for which no information is displayed in your journal are described separately on the [[Skyrim:World Interactions|World Interactions]] page.

This page '''does not''' list all of the miscellaneous quests available in the game. Faction-related miscellaneous quests, including those relevant to the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]], [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood#Quests|Dark Brotherhood]], and [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Quests|Thieves Guild]], as well as miscellaneous quests related to [[Skyrim:Creation Club Quests|Creation Club]] content, are listed on their own pages. The three pages linked below include other miscellaneous quests which are not listed here:

* [[Skyrim:Bounty Quests|Bounty Quests]]
* [[Skyrim:Dungeon Quests#Dungeon Miscellaneous Quests|Dungeon Miscellaneous Quests]]
* [[Skyrim:Tutorials|Tutorials]]

Most of the quests listed here are also [[Skyrim:Favors|Favors]] (highlighted in the tables below). Favors additionally include certain [[Skyrim:Activities|Activities]] for which no information is displayed in your journal.

==Achievements==
One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is obtained by completing miscellaneous quests:
* {{achievement|Hero of the People}}
** The game counts objectives completed, not quests completed; miscellaneous quests which have more than one objective count more heavily. It also counts all objectives completed, not just those that are part of the miscellaneous quests on this page. For example, if you join the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] and get the objective "Talk to the Companions leaders for work", completing that objective counts toward the achievement.
** The game also counts completing the same exact objective multiple times. For example, during the quest to retrieve 20 Deathbell, 20 Nightshade, and 20 Nirnroot for Ingun in Riften, every time you update your personal inventory from fewer than 20 to greater than or equal to 20 of any of the three ingredients, you will receive a quest objective update. You can therefore remain in a container menu and repeatedly shift these items back and forth in order to quickly unlock this achievement.
** You can track your progress toward the achievement using the "Misc Objectives Completed" statistic on the "Quest" page of your journal's "General Stats".

Speak with [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] and ask if there is anything new that he can teach you. He tells you that he has been working on a new spell but, to complete his research, he needs [[Skyrim:Dragon Heartscales|heartscales]]. These must be cut from a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]]'s skeleton and can only be done using a dagger called [[Skyrim:Kahvozein's Fang|Kahvozein's Fang]]. Once you have the scales, bring them back to Tolfdir. He will reward you with the [[Skyrim:Dragonhide|Dragonhide]] spell tome, and will now sell the [[Skyrim:Mass Paralysis|Mass Paralysis]] spell tome. ==Notes== *It is possible to find Kahvozein's Fang in a dungeon and collect heartscales from a dragon's corpse before the quest is given. *You can harvest heartscales even if the dragon disintegrates. *Once the quest is complete, you can continue to use the Fang to collect a heartscale from each dragon corpse, in addition to the standard dragon loot. Although the [[Skyrim:Skeletal Dragon|Skeletal Dragon]] can be found and defeated beforehand, it does not yield scales of any kind. Heartscales cannot be harvested from [[Skyrim:Krosulhah|Krosulhah]]{{DB}} either, nor can they be collected from [[Skyrim:Mirmulnir|Mirmulnir]]. An exception to the last point can happen if a Draugr Overlord is lured near one of the Blackreach lifts, using Dread Zombie to get it inside. Once inside, it can be attacked and its Unrelenting Force Shout will release [[Skyrim:Vulthuryol|Vulthuryol]], whose soul will be absorbed and its heartscales looted. *Resetting your Alteration skill level after accepting the quest will prevent you from turning in the heartscales until you reach Alteration level 90 again. ==Bugs== {{Bug|In your quest log, this quest is mistakenly decorated with the [[Skyrim:Side Quests|Side Quests]] knotwork (as displayed in the quest header), instead of the correct [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]] knotwork that is shown on all other college quests. Skyrim:A Return To Your Roots.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=[[User:Beezer1029|Beezer1029]] |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=[[User:Beezer1029|Beezer1029]] }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Sinderion's Field Journal|Sinderion's Field Journal]] in his Field Laboratory, Blackreach ''or'' picking up a Crimson Nirnroot. |Reward=[[Skyrim:Sinderion's Serendipity|Sinderion's Serendipity]] ability, ''[[Skyrim:The_Nirnroot_Missive|The Nirnroot Missive]]'' |Disp= |Rep= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]], [[Skyrim:Sarethi Farm|Sarethi Farm]] |Image=SR-quest-A Return To Your Roots 02.jpg |ImgDesc=A Crimson Nirnroot plant in [[Skyrim:Sinderion's Field Laboratory|Sinderion's Field Laboratory]] |description=Go where a [[Skyrim:Sinderion|famous alchemist]] could not in order to aid ground-breaking research. |ID=NN01 |Icon= |SuggLevel=18 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Collect thirty samples of the mysterious [[Skyrim:Crimson Nirnroot|Crimson Nirnroot]]. # Take these samples to [[Skyrim:Sinderion|Sinderion]]'s colleague [[Skyrim:Avrusa Sarethi|Avrusa Sarethi]] so that Sinderion's research may continue. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-A Return To Your Roots.jpg|thumb|right|Seemingly unreachable Crimson Nirnroot, which can be harvested with a [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]].]] ===The "Noisy Red Weed"=== Sinderion had been obsessed with [[Skyrim:Crimson Nirnroot|Crimson Nirnroot]] since purchasing a plant from a passing adventurer wanting to get something for the "noisy red weed" he found. Sinderion compensated the man, and then left [[Oblivion:Skingrad|Skingrad]] to set up a laboratory in [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]], the only known habitat of Crimson Nirnroot. ===Continue the Research=== The quest begins upon the collection of a sample crimson nirnroot in Blackreach. Your journal will update to reflect your part in finding out the significance of this plant. In order to get started, begin at the beginning in [[Skyrim:Sinderion's Field Laboratory|Sinderion's Field Laboratory]]. The research facility is located in Blackreach, right across from the gates of [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand Cathedral]]. Inside you will find Sinderion's remains still clutching his field journal. After reading the journal, the quest will update requesting that you collect thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples from Blackreach - a difficult but rewarding task. ===Locating the Samples=== There are forty-four samples of Crimson Nirnroot within Blackreach (including some inside Blackreach's buildings). Unlike the more common [[Skyrim:Nirnroot|garden variety Nirnroot]], the Crimson Nirnroot does not solely grow near bodies of water. Many plants are found near patches of mushrooms, Dwemer pipes or along the sides of the cavern. Since there are forty-four plants, all required samples can be collected at one time if you thoroughly explore Blackreach (see the [[Skyrim:Crimson Nirnroot|Crimson Nirnroot]] article for more details on plant locations). Alternatively, if you are having a hard time finding enough plants, they will respawn. Leaving Blackreach for ten days allows you to collect another sample from any previously-harvested plants. ===A Job Well Done=== After collecting the required number of plants, the quest will update again and you will be asked to deliver them to [[Skyrim:Avrusa Sarethi|Avrusa Sarethi]], Sinderion's former colleague. She is currently residing at [[Skyrim:Sarethi Farm|Sarethi Farm]], between [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] and [[Skyrim:Ivarstead| Ivarstead]]. Give Avrusa the thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples to complete the quest and receive ''[[Skyrim:The_Nirnroot Missive|The Nirnroot Missive]]''. You will also be provided with [[Skyrim:Sinderion's Serendipity|Sinderion's Serendipity]], an [[Skyrim:Abilities|ability]] which provides a 25% chance to mix two potions instead of one. ==Notes== * The [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] perk [[Skyrim:Green Thumb|Green Thumb]] does not affect Nirnroot and therefore cannot be used to decrease the number of plants needed to be harvested. * The quest is a sequel to the [[Oblivion:Oblivion|Oblivion]] quest, [[Oblivion: Seeking Your Roots|Seeking Your Roots]]. * While this quest is active and toggled on in the quests log, the spell [[Skyrim:Clairvoyance|Clairvoyance]] will determine that the Dragonborn is the closest quest marker, making Clairvoyance less useful. Toggling the quest off mitigates this issue. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The counter for the number of Crimson Nirnroots in your inventory may not function properly, resulting in a number of related issues:|USKP|1.3.2}} **if you consume all the Crimson Nirnroot in your inventory, not only will that amount be redacted from the quest counter, but the counter will even count the removed roots twice, potentially causing the counter to go into the negatives. **The quest may update telling you to return the nirnroot and stating you have found 30 samples when you have actually found less. Once you have the required amount, you will be able to return it and the quest should continue as normal. **Once all thirty Crimson Nirnroots have been collected the option to give them to Avrusa is not there, thus freezing the quest. ***Simply drop one and pick it back up to continue the quest. **If you place Crimson Nirnroot in a container or follower's inventory, or otherwise remove it from your inventory, the appropriate number may or may not be removed from the quest log. *** To complete the quest even if the quest log does not represent the actual amount of Crimson Nirnroot you have in inventory simply go to Avrusa with thirty in your inventory, and the quest will complete itself without updating in the journal. *** The number of Crimson Nirnroot in the quest log is thrown off if you transfer them to or from a container in groups. If you place more than one in a container at one time the quest log will think you only moved one. The quest log number can be corrected by placing them in a container and pulling them out individually (e.g., it says you have nine but you have ten: place two in a container at one time, and then pull them out one at a time). You can also get the quest log up to 30/30 with this method, but you cannot complete the quest without thirty in your inventory. *** {{Pc22}} To fix the count directly, use the console commands: set NN01Count to ''amount'' and UpdateQuestInstanceGlobal NN01 NN01Count . Note that this will not cause the quest to advance if set directly to 30. To do so, drop one and pick it up again. {{Bug|Certain samples of the Crimson Nirnroot can in very rare cases be impossible to pick up and added to your inventory.|vn=1}} **This bug can be fixed by reloading a previous save. If reloading does not work, you can try picking up other samples of the Crimson Nirnroot. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |15||I've discovered an unusual ingredient called Crimson Nirnroot. {{Quest Objective|5|Discover the significance of Crimson Nirnroot}} |20||I've discovered the remains of Sinderion, an alchemist from Skingrad in Cyrodiil. He was exploring Blackreach in search of the Crimson Nirnroot, and appeared to be on the brink of an amazing discovery. {{Quest Objective|10|Collect Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach (/30)}} |||{{Quest Comment|Upon collecting the thirtieth Crimson Nirnroot}} {{Quest Objective|20|Bring 30 Crimson Nirnroot to Avrusa Sarethi}} |200|fin|I have brought my Crimson Nirnroot to Avrusa Sarethi, a former student of Sinderion. She was overjoyed that I was able to complete Sinderion's field work and pledged to continue his research in his memory. |missing=10 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]] {{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Anska|Anska]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Conjure Flaming Familiar|Spell Tome: Conjure Flaming Familiar]],

Word for the [[Skyrim:Storm Call|Storm Call]] shout,
[[Skyrim:Vokun (item)|Vokun]] |Disp= |Rep= |Loc=[[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]] |Image=SR-quest-A_Scroll_For_Anska_02.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]] |description=Help [[Skyrim:Anska|Anska]] trace her roots in [[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]]. |ID=dunHighGateRuinsQST |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |SuggLevel=24 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Meet and talk to [[Skyrim:Anska|Anska]] in [[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]] and agree to help her. # Protect Anska as you fight through the ruins. # Defeat [[Skyrim:Vokun (creature)|Vokun]]. # Retrieve Anska's [[Skyrim:Sealed Scroll|scroll]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Anska=== [[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]] is a remote [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]] on the snowy tundra east of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], near the shores of the [[Skyrim:Sea of Ghosts|Sea of Ghosts]]. When you enter, it soon becomes clear that someone visited the ruin recently, as the residing [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] have already been killed. Proceed into the first room and you will meet the person responsible, a [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] [[Skyrim:Bandit Wizard|wizard]] named [[Skyrim:Anska|Anska]]. When approached she will introduce herself and ask if you are there to help her as she has finally located [[Skyrim:Vokun (creature)|Vokun's]] Crypt. She then explains her goal, namely to locate a special scroll that could link her family blood all the way back to the legendary [[Lore:Ysgramor|Ysgramor]]. She will also briefly describe Vokun as ''"Some old priest buried here long ago."'', hinting at her lack of research and explaining her need for help. She fears the old priest could awaken and prove too powerful a foe, so she wants you to lead her through the ruin and help her fight the opposition. Accept her request and the quest will start. ===High Gate Ruins=== [[File:SR-quest-A Scroll For Anska_03.jpg|thumb|right|''"Sometimes I just like to watch them burn."'']] Anska is not your average [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] and you will have to escort her safely through the ruin; she is, however, capable of taking care of herself using a variety of leveled wizard spells, so keep an eye out and stay upfront as you proceed into the dungeon. Take the northern tunnel to a huge chamber infested with leveled draugr. Claim some minor loot from the chest in the alcove, then head upstairs and locate the iron door leading north where three more draugr will attack. Go through the room with the [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] and a few useful potions. The next tunnel contains a [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] triggering a [[Skyrim:Spike Wall|spike wall]], so make sure Anska gets through unharmed. A lever puzzle awaits in the next room, so take a thorough look at the [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Puzzle Doors|symbols]] above the southern ledge. From left to right, they are: '''Eagle—Whale—Fox—Snake'''. Look around the room for the levers, all of them on pedestals with corresponding symbols. The two first levers are upstairs while the last two are on the ground floor. When all four levers are pulled in the right order, the grate in the middle of the room will disappear, so head downstairs and enter the [[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins Catacombs|catacombs]] through the door. Only one draugr will attack you in the first section of the catacombs and a slide will lead you down to another catacomb area with more draugr. A chest can be found in an alcove, but watch out for the pressure plate and the corresponding [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|darts]]. Before long, you will reach a room with a leveled [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gem]] resting on a [[Skyrim:Weight Sensitive Plate|weight sensitive plate]], which releases two draugr from the adjacent coffins if triggered. The locked door to the right contains a chest behind it. Continue into a hallway filled with ancient carvings and numerous pressure plates on the floor, triggering darts or [[Skyrim:Spear Trap|spear traps]], then proceed into another puzzle room. Facing the lever, two stone walls cover hidden doors, so pull the lever and watch the wall to the right disappear, then fight the boss-leveled draugr guarding another lever. Pull that lever and the door to the left will open and release yet another boss-leveled draugr. Pull the lever behind him, then head through the now-opened entrance to the east and into [[Skyrim:Vokun's Throne Room|Vokun's throne room]]. ===Vokun=== [[File:SR-quest-A Scroll For Anska.jpg|thumb|right|Anska vs. [[Skyrim:Vokun (creature)|Vokun]]]] Before the throne room, a hallway offers a few potions. As soon as you open the next door, the [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] Vokun will burst out of his sarcophagus and use his [[Skyrim:Staff of Fireballs|staff of fireballs]] to attack you from a distance. Anska will keep her distance from Vokun, but will use her ranged attacks to help out. Defeat the priest and claim his unique [[Skyrim:Vokun (item)|mask]] and his staff from the remains. Proceed to the chamber to the east, where you will find a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] with a word for the [[Skyrim:Storm Call|Storm Call]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|Shout]]. The nearby table holds the [[Skyrim:Sealed Scroll|sealed scroll]] for Anska, so pick it up and hand it to her. She will be overwhelmed with joy and hand you the unique spell tome for learning the spell [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Conjure Flaming Familiar|Conjure Flaming Familiar]] as a reward. Additionally, a boss-leveled chest can be found on the upper level to the north, in an alcove right next to the shortcut back to the first zone of the ruin. Anska will stay behind and try to decipher the scroll indefinitely. ==Notes== * Be careful about bringing other followers with you, since Anska's use of [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] magic can cause them to attack her if she hits them by mistake, or if they hit her. * This quest only counts towards the [[Skyrim:Sideways|Sideways]] [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] if Anska survives. * Should you choose not to hand over the scroll to Anska right away, she'll continue to follow you around, but only within close proximity to the ruins. In other words, she can't be used as a "free" follower. If you withhold the scroll from her and head outside, then later give her the scroll, she will return to the ruins and remain in Vokun's throne room indefinitely. * It is possible to clear the dungeon without [[Skyrim:Anska|Anska]]'s help. To do this, avoid talking to her when you enter the dungeon. Once Vokun is dead, she will run up to you and allow for the quest to finish normally. *Anska is not considered an essential NPC, and can be killed prior to starting the quest. This prevents the start of the quest and the acquisition of the [[Skyrim:Flaming Familiar|Flaming Familiar]] spell. * Area of effect spells such as [[Skyrim:Fire Storm|Fire Storm]] or [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] can cause objects, including the scroll, to fly around the room, potentially becoming lost. ==Bugs== {{Bug|On entering the Catacombs, Anska will comment on the soul gem well before you reach it, and before it is in your line of sight.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|Similarly, she may comment on Vokun's presence and the scroll beyond him ("There it is! On the table!"), before the door to his throne room is even open.}} {{Bug|You may be stuck with the sealed scroll, should you pick it up after failing the quest.|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|Upon killing Vokun, Anska may just stand in battle pose, not finishing the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} This can be fixed by opening the console, targeting Anska, and using the recycleactor command. She will then vanish, re-enter the room, run toward Vokun's tomb, and you can now speak to her. {{Bug|The scroll may be left in your inventory after you complete the quest (you can remove it at that stage though, since it is no longer a quest item).|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|Leaving the reward room without taking the scroll will lead you to be locked out of the room. Even if you return to the throne room, the gates will be locked and cannot be opened anymore since the priest is already dead.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If Anska is killed, the quest does not fail.|USKP|1.3.3}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries|id=dunHighGateRuinsQST |10||Find Anska's scroll and return it to her for a reward. |20||Help Anska retrieve the scroll from High Gate Ruins. |90||I have the scroll, I should return it to Anska for my reward. |100|fin|High Gate Ruins is clear and Anska has rewarded me with a powerful new fire spell. |150|fail|I have failed to protect Anska, now I'll never know what her scroll was for. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|10|Find And Return Anska's Scroll To Her}} {{Quest Objective|20|Help Anska Retrieve Her Scroll}} {{Quest Objective|90|Return The Scroll To Anska}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 30, 80, 110 }}{{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Golldir|Golldir]] outside [[Skyrim:Hillgrund's_Tomb|Hillgrund's Tomb]].
# Accompany him as he tries to rescue his aunt [[Skyrim:Agna|Agna]] from [[Skyrim:Vals Veran|Vals Veran]].
# Find a way into the room where Vals Veran is hiding.
# Kill Vals Veran.
# *''(Optional)'' Protect Golldir.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Necromancer in the Barrow===
Within the antechamber of [[Skyrim:Hillgrund's Tomb|Hillgrund's Tomb]], you'll encounter a [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] named [[Skyrim:Golldir|Golldir]]. He explains that a necromancer named [[Skyrim:Vals Veran|Vals Veran]] is inside his ancestral barrow, defiling it. His aunt [[Skyrim:Agna|Agna]] went in to put a stop to this, but Golldir was too scared to go with her. If pressed, he will explain that he has been terrified of the barrow ever since his father locked him in it as a child. If you accept, he will accompany you into the barrow to help rescue his aunt and kill Veran.

===Rescuing Agna===
The tomb is very linear and any offshoots are only small, dead-end rooms. As you continue down the stairs, [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] will attack in small waves. Several varieties will be present in each wave. Like all normal barrows, exploration into the burial sites will lead to more attacks as entombed draugr come to life. Golldir may raise a vocal objection to you looting his ancestors, but concedes to allowing it since you are helping him. There is no chance of successfully rescuing Aunt Agna; at the bottom of the room you'll find her corpse. The door to the burial chamber where Veran is located is barred shut.

===Reaching Vals Veran===
With more resolve, Golldir will lead you through the abandoned section of the barrow to find a secret way into the chamber where Veran is hiding. This section is full of his disgraced ancestors and the draugr numbers are larger here. Stronger varieties of draugr are entombed in the walls, but should only appear singly. After passing through a room with a single spider ambush, a simple puzzle will present itself. Before you leave the spider room look for a Sanctified Mace behind the web on the left of the room. In order to pass the puzzle the plaque with a bear on it must be located. A chain hanging from that plaque will open a secret door that leads to the main chamber.

===Confronting Vals Veran===
If you've had problems up until now, this next area may prove very troublesome. The room is a large tiered burial chamber with sarcophagi all around. As you approach the top, Vals Veran will come out and start speaking of death's beauty. Whether you try to talk to him, attack him, or let him finish his speech, he will eventually disappear and teleport across the room. Attacking him at this juncture is futile as he will simply teleport across the room and heal. If you are quick, you can kill him with a single power attack before he teleports, but you will still need to fight off the waves of draugr. You can also kill him using a sneak attack almost as soon as you enter the room, if your [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] and [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]] skills are high enough—but once again, you'll still have to deal with all the draugr. A goal is also to keep Golldir alive through the battle, to earn the gold reward.

If you don't manage to kill Veran instantly, you'll need to focus instead on the waves of draugr. They can quickly swarm you and any followers while Veran casts [[Skyrim:Frost Damage|damaging Frost magic]] from afar. The third wave of draugr will contain a boss-level draugr that must be dealt with. After dispatching it, Veran will continue to summon more draugr (but in lesser numbers), but most importantly, will stop teleporting. He can now be hunted down and killed. Golldir will thank you for your help and state that he will remain close by the tomb and spend his time hunting.

===Reward===
Killing Vals Veran will grant you the [[Skyrim:Hillgrund's Tomb Crypt Key|Hillgrund's Tomb Crypt Key]], which can be found on Veran's body. The highest reward is only granted if Golldir is kept alive. If he survives, he will give you a large leveled amount of gold and a [[Skyrim:Hillgrund's Chest Key|Hillgrund's Chest Key]], which opens an augmented loot chest, located just beyond the main burial chamber (where the battle with Veran took place), through the door at the top of the stairs. Beyond the chest is the barred door leading to the room in which Aunt Agna's body was found. If you do not receive this key, you can loot it from Golldir's corpse or just pick the expert-leveled lock on the chest. After you exit the tomb you can speak to Golldir again (if he's alive) about becoming a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]]. This dialogue option will not open up until after you leave the tomb.
{{SRLeveledReward|large}}

==Notes==
* If you are a [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]], Golldir will comment "''No offense, I mean...I'm sure you aren't into any of that kind of stuff''" after he speaks of Dark Elf necromancy when explaining what is going on in the tombs.
* If Golldir sees you looting items from his family tomb, he will say ''"Hey! Those belong to my family! Sigh... fine, take whatever you want, so long as you help me get rid of Vals."''
* If you are having trouble dealing with the draugr swarms during the final battle, you can lure them back to the secret door and pick them off one at a time, since the draugr are unable to pass through the door.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|After reaching Vals Veran and after the brief dialogues between Veran and Golldir, Veran disappears with an invisibility spell but may never come back. If so, then only the initial attack from the draugr will take place. Something may trigger his appearance script again, but once again he becomes invisible forever.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|If Golldir is killed, the quest will still act as if it's active and that you can still "talk to Golldir" to finish the quest. The quest marker will even hover over his dead body.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|It is possible that Golldir may drop his war axe and shield in the battle before entering the main chamber, if a Draugr Deathlord uses the "Unrelenting Force" shout on him (or if you do accidentally). If this occurs, he will not pick them up again, even if you drop a weapon and shield in front of him, although he may pick up a different weapon in the battle with the Draugr in the main burial chamber.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|When Vals Veran teleports away he goes to a small room east of the main chamber (reachable by turning off clipping with the console). If he is killed while teleporting then his body can end up stuck there.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|The ''[[Skyrim:Note from Agna|Note from Agna]]'' says that Golldir was locked in the tomb by his brother, but in dialogue Golldir says it was his father who locked him in.|USKP|2.0.8}}

''"It is? Well that's different."'']] The innkeeper will then tell you that the courier just left, so you could go after them, or you can wait for the courier to come back. It's better to find the courier in the wilderness because you will get a bounty for killing them. The courier may be far from town, so you it might be better to wait for them to come back and then follow them out of the town. Once you find the courier, saying you want the documents will make the courier attack you immediately.You may also pickpocket the documents off of the courier. The courier may also get into a fight with Stormcloaks or wild animals. Stormcloaks and hostile bandits often frequent the courier's route. ===Delivering the documents=== Once you have the documents, head back to the Stormcloak camp and give them to Galmar. He will then forge false information and will then tell you to take them to the [[Skyrim:Legate Taurinus Duilis|Legate]] in Morthal. Head to Morthal and enter the [[Skyrim:Highmoon Hall|Highmoon Hall]], the Legate is through the doorway, under the stairs, to the left. Talk to him and give him the documents, if you are not wearing a Legion uniform he will ask about it, but upon explaining yourself he will take the documents and give you five gold. Now report back to Galmar to prepare for [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Snowhawk (Stormcloaks)|the Battle for Fort Snowhawk]]. ==Notes== *This quest and [[Skyrim:A False Front (Imperial)|A False Front (Imperial)]] are different radiant versions of the same quest. * Since Rorikstead is in Whiterun hold, which has already been conquered by the Stormcloaks, you can simply wait for him to show up there and watch the Stormcloak guards slaughter him. * When you speak to the courier demanding the documents he will become hostile and attack you, but killing him will still count as a murder. The easiest way to avoid the murder charge is to get a little in front of him on the road and trigger the bandits hostilities at Robber's Gorge. They usually capably dispose of him. Without your character triggering the bandit ambush he usually makes his trips unharmed. * If you are wanted in Hjaalmarch, you will be unable to complete this quest until your bounty is resolved, as the Imperial Legate will try to arrest you when you speak with him. ==Bugs== *Be careful about entering Frostfruit Inn to confront the courier while he is in there. He will usually be sleeping in the right hand room when you enter, and when he rises will stand up on the wrong side of the bed causing him to clip through the wall and even fall off the map. :*To fix this, wait 1 hour in the inn. The courier will then jump to the other side of the bed allowing you to continue with the game as normal. {{Bug|Killing the Imperial courier will count as murder, even if he attacks you first. If a nearby NPC witnesses your "murder", you will incur a bounty in Hjaalmarch, Haafingar, or Whiterun Hold.|USKP|2.0.4}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Galmar Stone-Fist has sent me to intercept the Imperial Courier passing through the area and relieve him of his documents. {{Featured Article}}{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Dragon Guard |reward=Gideon Dragontongue |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=Automatic upon acquiring the [[SR:Elder Scroll (Dragon)|Elder Scroll]] during [[SR:Elder Knowledge|Elder Knowledge]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Dragonrend|Dragonrend]] shout |Disp= =0 (Delphine)
=0 (Esbern) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Elder Knowledge|Elder Knowledge]] |Next=[[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]] |Loc=[[SR:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]] |Image=SR-quest-Alduin's Bane.jpg |ImgDesc=The Nord heroes battling Alduin in a vision produced by an Elder Scroll |description=Exploit the Time-Wound to learn [[Skyrim:Dragonrend|Dragonrend]] and defeat [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] at the [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]]. |ID=MQ206 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Read the [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll|Elder Scroll]] at the Throat of the World. # Learn how to use the [[Skyrim:Dragonrend|Dragonrend]] shout. # Defeat [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Time-Wound=== As soon as you claim the [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll|Elder Scroll]] from the [[Skyrim:Tower of Mzark|Tower of Mzark]], this quest starts and points you back to the [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]] where [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax_(dragon)|Paarthurnax]] awaits. Exit the tower by using the lift to the east and pull the handle on the surface, thus providing yet another shortcut to [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]]. You will find yourself a long way from [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand]] where you initially entered and may wish to loot the abandoned camp just outside the tower entrance. Travel back to the Throat of the World and Paarthurnax will be quite impressed with your efforts: ''"You have it. The Kel - the Elder Scroll. {{hover|Time bends... touch|Tiid kreh... qalos}}. Time shudders at its touch. There is no question. You are doom-driven. {{hover|Blessing (of) Akatosh|Kogaan Akatosh}}. The very [[Lore:Earth Bones|bones of the earth]]s are at your disposal. Go then. Fulfill your destiny. Take the Scroll to the Time-Wound. Do not delay. [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] will be coming. He cannot miss the signs."'' Make your way a few feet to the northwest and you will see the Time-Wound, an unnatural ripple of air that distorts light passing through it. Go into the middle, find the Elder Scroll in your inventory, and read it: {{Multiple Images |align=center |direction=horizontal |width=150 |image1=SR-quest-Alduin's Bane_03.jpg |image2=SR-quest-Alduin's Bane_04.jpg |image3=SR-quest-Alduin's Bane_05.jpg |image4=SR-quest-Alduin's Bane_06.jpg }} ===A Glimpse into the Past=== [[File:SR-quest-Alduin's Bane 08.jpg|thumb|right|''"Know that Gormlaith sent you down to death!"'']] [[File:SR-quest-Alduin's Bane 09.jpg|thumb|clear=none|''"Which is why I brought the Elder Scroll."'']] [[File:SR-quest-Alduin's Bane 10.jpg|thumb|right|''"Alduin approaches!"'']] [[File:SR-quest-Alduin's Bane 12.jpg|thumb|right|''"Begone, World-Eater!"'']] [[File:SR-quest-Alduin's Bane 13.jpg|thumb|right|''"You are banished!"'']] After a temporary blindness, you will regain your vision and find yourself in the [[Lore:Merethic_Era|Merethic Era]], unable to move and forced to watch past events. The strange carvings on the Elder Scroll will still be visible and your vision blurred and tinted red. You will watch as the ancient Nords, [[Skyrim:Hakon_One-Eye|Hakon One-Eye]] and [[Skyrim:Gormlaith_Golden-Hilt|Gormlaith Golden-Hilt]], fight a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] atop the Throat of the World. The battle will begin with Hakon on his own, until Gormlaith comes rushing in and jumps on top of the dragon: '''Hakon''': ''"Gormlaith! We're running out of time! The battle..."''
'''Dragon''': ''"{{hover|This day Overlord(ship) of Alduin restore|Daar sul thur se Alduin vokrii}}. Today Alduin's lordship will be restored. But I honor your courage. {{hover|(You) fight with courage|Krif voth ahkrin}}. Die now, in vain."''
'''Hakon''': (attacks) ''"For Skyrim!"''
'''Gormlaith''': (joins the attack and kills the dragon) ''"Know that Gormlaith sent you down to death!"'' After killing the dragon they will sheathe their swords and walk past a [[Skyrim:Containers#Desecrated_Corpse|desecrated corpse]], talking about their victory: '''Gormlaith''': ''"Hakon! A glorious day, is it not!"''
'''Hakon''': ''"Have you no thought beyond the blooding of your blade?"''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"What else is there?"''
'''Hakon''': ''"The battle below goes ill. If Alduin does not rise to our challenge, I fear all may be lost."''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"You worry too much, brother. Victory will be ours."'' At this point, [[Skyrim:Felldir the Old|Felldir the Old]] will emerge from behind you and join the conversation: '''Hakon''': (To Felldir) ''"Why does Alduin hang back? We've staked everything on this plan of yours, old man."''
'''Felldir''': ''"He will come. He cannot ignore our defiance. And why should he fear us, even now?"''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"We've bloodied him well. Four of his kin have fallen to my blade alone this day."''
'''Felldir''': ''"But none have yet stood against Alduin himself. Galthor, Sorri, Birkir..."''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"They did not have Dragonrend. Once we bring him down, I promise I will have his head."''
'''Felldir''': ''"You do not understand. Alduin cannot be slain like a lesser dragon. He is beyond our strength. Which is why I brought the Elder Scroll."'' Felldir will then pull out the ancient [[Lore:Elder Scroll|Elder Scroll]], much to the surprise of Hakon: '''Hakon''': ''"Felldir! We agreed not to use it!"''
'''Felldir''': ''"I never agreed. And if you are right, I will not need it."''
'''Hakon''': ''"No. We will deal with Alduin ourselves, here and now."''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"We shall see soon enough. Alduin approaches!"''
'''Hakon''': ''"So be it."'' While the Nords draw their weapons, Alduin will land atop the word wall and speak: '''Alduin''': ''"{{hover|Fools!|Meyye!}} {{hover|Treacherous slaves!|Tahrodiis aanne!}} {{hover|Your hopes (are) all withered!|Him hinde pah liiv!}} {{hover|I (am) your doom!|Zu'u hin daan!}}"''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"Let those that watch from Sovngarde envy us this day!"'' At this point, the Nords will release the [[Skyrim:Dragonrend|Dragonrend]] shout. When they shout, you will automatically learn the shout. In the skies, Alduin will feel mortality rise through his body and will immediately be forced to land: '''Alduin''': ''"{{hover|Cowardly mortals!|Nivahriin joorre!}} What have you done? What twisted Words have you created?! {{hover|Treacherous|Tahrodiis}} Paarthurnax! My teeth to his neck! But first... {{hover|die in terror|dir ko maar}}. You will die in terror, knowing your final fate... To feed my power when I come for you in Sovngarde!"''
'''Gormlaith''': ''"If I die today, it will not be in terror. You feel fear for the first time, worm. I see it in your eyes. Skyrim will be free!"'' The three Nords will then proceed to attack the World-Eater, but to no avail. Alduin will pick up Gormlaith between his teeth and fling her to the right, killing her: '''Hakon''': ''"No, damn you! It's no use! Use the Scroll, Felldir! Now!"''
'''Felldir''': ''"Hold, Alduin on the Wing! [[Lore:Kyne|Sister Hawk]], grant us your sacred breath to make this contract heard! Begone, World-Eater! By words with older bones than your own we break your perch on this age and send you out! You are banished! Alduin, we shout you out from all our endings unto the last!"''
'''Alduin''': ''"{{hover|The (Elder) Scroll...?! Cowards...|Faal Kel...?! Nikriinne...}}"'' A surprised Alduin will futilely breathe fire at Felldir before disappearing into the flow of time, to an unknown era. Felldir, however, knows that the defeat was only temporary: '''Felldir''': ''"You are banished!"''
'''Hakon''': ''"It worked... you did it..."''
'''Felldir''': ''"Yes, the World-Eater is gone... may the spirits have mercy on our souls."'' ===Alduin=== Directly after the cutscene, when you arrive back in the present, Alduin will appear at the Throat of the World, shouting: ''"{{hover|My hunger has been fed by mortal souls.|Bahloki nahkip sillesejoor.}} My belly is full of the souls of your fellow mortals, Dovahkiin. Die now and await your fate in Sovngarde!"'' Paarthurnax will then interfere, saying: ''"{{hover|You fail.|Lost funt.}} You are too late, Alduin! Dovahkiin! Use Dragonrend, if you know it!"'' [[File:SR-quest-Alduin's Bane 02.jpg|thumb|Alduin battles Paarthurnax at the Throat of the World.]] Paarthurnax and Alduin will take flight, attacking each other in the air. Paarthurnax tells you to use your Dragonrend shout if you can, and indeed, when the chance arises, use Dragonrend on Alduin, forcing him to the ground. It can be rather difficult distinguishing between the two dragons if the battle is done at night or while it is snowing. The quest arrow on your compass always points to Alduin, so use that to distinguish between them. During the battle, Alduin may say some of the following taunts: ''"Dovahkiin, you call yourself? Arrogant mortal."'', ''"Bahloki nahkip sillesejoor."'', ''"I will feast on your soul in Sovngarde!"'', ''"You are no match for me, {{hover|mortal!|joor!}}"'', ''"Paarthurnax is weak. I am strong."'', ''"My time has come again."'', ''"{{hover|Terror awaits in Sovngarde|Maar saraan ko Sovngarde.}}"'', ''"I have feasted on many greater than you."'', or ''"You will pay for your defiance!"'' When Alduin is grounded, he may say: ''"My teeth to your neck, Dovahkiin!"'' When he is grounded, you must attack him as much as you can before he takes flight again. This may take a few tries, since he has a huge health pool and does reasonable damage. Be wary of Alduin's "Dragon Storm Call" shout, which causes fiery meteors to rain from the sky, causing both fire and physical damage. Note that [[Skyrim:Clear Skies|Clear Skies]] will cancel the meteor shower, and has such a short recharge time that it won't interfere with using Dragonrend on him. In particular, using Dragonrend immediately when it recharges will keep Alduin grounded for the whole fight. When Alduin's health drops to zero, he says: ''"{{hover|You've become strong, Dragonborn.|Meyz mul, Dovahkiin.}} You have become strong. But I am {{hover|Destroyer-Devour-Master|Al-du-in}}, Firstborn of Akatosh! {{hover|My strength is the greatest!|Mulaagi zok lot!}} I cannot be slain here, by you or anyone else! You cannot prevail against me. I will outlast you... mortal!"'' He will then fly off, completing the quest. ==Notes== *Having a follower stand within the Time-Wound when you read the Elder Scroll may prevent Alduin from landing on the word wall in the cutscene.{{vn|plain}} *It is not possible to harm Alduin while he's in the air. He is immune to all forms of damage except when he's under the Dragonrend shout effect (i.e. grounded). Therefore, you cannot defeat Alduin without using Dragonrend on him, regardless of how powerful your weapons and spells might be. *Inadvertently using Dragonrend on Paarthurnax and therefore grounding him often makes Alduin hover in one place in the air while attacking Paarthurnax, thus making it easier to strike him with Dragonrend, although it is better to ground Alduin alone. *Alduin may remark ''"You may have picked up the weapons of my ancient foes, but you are not their equal!"'' when you use Dragonrend against him. *Even after completing this quest, the Elder Scroll will still be marked as a quest item, making it impossible for you to drop it or place it in a container, though it will remain weightless. The only way to remove it from your inventory is to sell it to [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] library, although if you do, and you install the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard add-on]], you will have to buy it back from him for another quest. *Reading the Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound removes all active blessings, including the [[Skyrim:Blessing of Talos|Blessing of Talos]]. To shorten your shout cooldown for the fight with Alduin, you need to wear either an [[Skyrim:Amulet of Talos|Amulet of Talos]] or [[Skyrim:Storm-Bear Armor|Storm-Bear Armor]]{{CC|Civil War Champions}}. *During the cutscene Gormlaith, Hakon or Felldir may look at you, as if you were there. *If [[Skyrim:Survival Mode|Survival mode]] is active, you may wish to save the game before reading the Elder Scroll, as it is possible to die immediately after exiting the cutscene due to cold. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Alduin may become invincible during the fight.|confirmed=1}} **According to the patch notes, this bug was supposed to have been fixed by version 1.9.26.0.8 of the [[Skyrim:Patch|Skyrim Official Patch]]. However, there have still been confirmed reports of this bug occurring, specifically if you exit dialogue with Alduin prematurely after returning from the vision in the Time Wound, or if you die during the fight with Alduin and reload the game. **{{Pc22}} Open the [[Skyrim:Console|console]], click on Alduin, then use the command disable followed by enable. This may allow Alduin to be damaged normally. **Saving immediately before combat starts, then fast-traveling away and returning, may fix this. **As of 1.9.32.0, the game creates an autosave after exiting the Merethic-era cutscene, right before the conversation with Alduin. {{Bug|The cutscene in the Merethic era may not trigger or complete, leaving you stuck there.|confirmed=1}} **Doing other quests and then returning may fix this. **{{Pc22}} If Gormlaith gets stuck and is unable reach the first dragon to kill it, you can manually kill the dragon using the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] by clicking on it and entering kill. This will allow the cutscene to progress. **{{Pc22}} If Alduin does not land, use the console commands prid 4377e followed by moveto cda03 to move Alduin to the landing position. **{{Pc22}} Another possible fix after getting stuck is to open the console and enter setstage mq206 32. This should let you regain control of the camera and a dragon should land, enabling the cutscene to continue. You could also enter setstage mq206 70 to learn the Dragonrend shout directly, then enter setstage mq206 100 to end the cutscene and begin the fight with Alduin. {{Bug|Fixing the stuck cutscene bug may leave you with blurred vision.|confirmed=1}} **This can be fixed by using vision altering effects. Examples of these include visiting a new dragon wall and learning a new shout or using the [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]] perk [[Skyrim:Eagle Eye|Eagle Eye]]. **{{pc22}} This can be fixed by opening the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] and entering sisme 0. {{Bug|Fixing the stuck cutscene bug may bring the Merethic Alduin out with you, resulting in two Alduins: the real one flying above you which starts talking, and the Merethic one still crippled on the ground which starts fighting instantly.|confirmed=0}} **{{pc22}} This can be fixed by opening the [[Skyrim:Console|console]], clicking on the Merethic Alduin on the ground (or entering prid 4377e), then entering disable. This should be done before defeating the real Alduin and progressing the quest, or the Merethic Alduin will keep regaining strength and start fighting again after you walk down the Throat of the World. {{Bug|The music track for reading the Elder Scroll during the Alduin flashback at the Throat of the World may not play during the day due to invalid conditions being placed on the track record. Blood eclipses with the Dawnguard add-on are also known to prevent it from playing.|USSEP|4.3.9}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've located the Elder Scroll that was used to cast Alduin forward into our time by the Nord heroes of old. Skyrim:Alduin's Wall.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Gideon Dragontongue |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Gideon Dragontongue |rewardChecked=72.161.219.157 }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=[[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Dragonbane|Dragonbane]] |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:A Cornered Rat|A Cornered Rat]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:The Throat of the World|The Throat of the World]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:The Ratway|The Ratway]], [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]], [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]] |Image=SR-quest-Alduin's Wall.jpg |ImgDesc=Alduin's Wall |description=Locate the prophecy within [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]]. |ID=MQ203 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Escort [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] to [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. # Talk to Esbern. # Gain entrance to [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]]. # Learn the secret of Alduin's Wall. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Blades Reunited=== From [[Skyrim:The Ratway|The Ratway]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], you need to travel with Esbern back to [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]] so he can meet with [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]]. Make your way out of the Ratway by backtracking the way you came in, avoiding or defeating the Thalmor agents and various underworld criminals you may encounter along the way. The Esbern dialogue option "Do you know the way out of here?" will cause Esbern to lead the way through the Ratway rather than follow you (however, this can be glitched). Once outside, travel back to Riverwood and into the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]]. Upon arriving at the inn, you will be greeted by Delphine, who is surprised to see Esbern alive. After a brief reunion between the two former [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]], Delphine will wish to speak to the two of you in private. Delphine will lead you to the secret cellar, where Esbern announces that his intention is to find an ancient Blades prophecy. He will go on to say the group must leave for [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]], a Blades headquarters built up around an ancient [[Lore:Akavir|Akaviri]] military camp in [[Skyrim:The Reach|the Reach]]. Of particular importance within that location is a structure from the [[Lore:First Era|First Era]] known as Alduin's Wall, which may tell how to defeat [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]]. Delphine soon realizes that Esbern's description of the temple's location matches her knowledge of the [[Skyrim:Karthspire|Karthspire]], and the Blades agree to set out for that location. Delphine tells [[Skyrim:Orgnar|Orgnar]] that the Inn is now his and bids him farewell. At this point, you can choose to either travel with the Blades or alone, heading towards the marker Delphine placed on your map. If you choose to travel alone, it may be easier to take a carriage to [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] and then head east, as Delphine recommends. You can also take the longer route through [[Skyrim:Falkreath_Hold|Falkreath Hold]], though this is generally easier if you have the Blades with you. ===The Karthspire=== Whether you went as a group or solo, when you arrive at the [[Skyrim:Karthspire Camp|Karthspire Camp]] you will find yourself up against a horde of [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]], and possibly a [[Skyrim:Hagraven|hagraven]]. Both Delphine and Esbern will arrive and assist you (and probably aggravate the entire camp in the process: if you want to make sure they don't do that, you may have to ask them to "wait here" a considerable distance away.) Though you can stand and fight, if the battle begins to overwhelm you, it is simple to retreat into the Karthspire caverns themselves (but see the [[#Bugs|Bugs]] section). You will now need to journey through the interior of the Karthspire, defeating the three Forsworn, including a [[Skyrim:Forsworn Briarheart|Forsworn Briarheart]], and making your way to the beginning of the Akaviri ruins. ===Sky Haven Temple=== Heading up the stone steps on the right you will be confronted with a trio of three-sided pillars, each side inscribed with a symbol. According to Esbern, they are of Akaviri origin, but the one that matters most to you is the symbol meaning 'Dragonborn'. This symbol resembles two dragon heads facing each other and an arrow pointing down. Activate all three pillars until this symbol is facing you. This will lower the bridge to your left, allowing you and the Blades to continue. In the next chamber you will be confronted with a floor of pressure plates, inscribed with the same three symbols as the pillars. Once again the Dragonborn symbol is the key; stepping only on these tiles to reach the other side. Stepping off of the route will cause a fireball to be launched, so moving slowly is advisable. If you prefer, you can use the [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] shout to move across without triggering the trap. Once safely on the other side, pull the chain to allow the Blades to cross, and exit the chamber. You will need to travel across a pair of bridges, and then into the entrance chamber of Sky Haven Temple. Esbern heads for a large stone head built into the far wall, which, according to Esbern, is the visage of [[Lore:Reman Cyrodiil|Reman Cyrodiil]]. In fact, the entire temple is some sort of shrine to him. In front of the head is a large carved circle, which Esbern declares to be a "blood seal", requiring the blood of a Dragonborn to function. Activating the circle prompts you to cut your hand, dripping blood on the circle. The stone head then retracts, and an opening is revealed. Delphine and Esbern take a few moments in the following tunnel to inspect the Akaviri carvings and light the braziers, but you may wish to run ahead and view the temple proper. Upon arriving, Esbern is immediately attracted to a large relief on the far wall, Alduin's Wall. He moves over to inspect it, taking several moments to fully identify it. The wall depicts the history of [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] and the [[Skyrim:Dragon Cult|Dragon Cult]], and details a prophecy regarding their defeat. Ultimately, he proclaims that the ancient Nords actually used a shout to defeat Alduin, and Delphine turns to you asking if you know of such a shout. [[File:SR-misc-Alduin's Wall.jpg|center|thumb|900px|Alduin's Wall relief]] At this point, your best source of information is likely the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]], however much Delphine may dislike them. Esbern will go on to explain that the last panel speaks of Alduin's return and his contending with the last Dragonborn at the end of time. From here, take a moment to explore the Temple to locate the leveled sword [[Skyrim:Dragonbane|Dragonbane]] found in a room almost straight opposite Alduin's Wall. Bid farewell to the two Blades, both of them enraptured by Sky Haven Temple, and leave the building. Your next destination is [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]], home of the Greybeards. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{Achievement|Alduin's Wall (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *Dragonbane is a [[Skyrim:Leveled Items|leveled item]], so it's better not to enter Sky Haven Temple until level 46 if you want the best version of the weapon. *The one-handed skill book ''[[Skyrim:Mace Etiquette|Mace Etiquette]]'' can be found in the same room as Dragonbane. *After reaching stage 60 of this quest, [[Skyrim:Nahagliiv|Nahagliiv]] will be resurrected by Alduin at a dragon mound west of Rorikstead. *Esbern and Delphine can follow you as companions in addition to any other followers you may have. They are high level and [[Skyrim:Essential_NPCs|essential]]. However, Esbern and Delphine will constantly tell you to take them to the quest destination, and Esbern has a fondness for area-effect spells that may cause fights with other followers. *It is possible to encounter an Elder Dragon or stronger at Karthspire, even if you aren't high enough level to encounter them elsewhere. Also, once you start the quest, the Forsworn at Karthspire Camp will be much more dangerous. *[[Lore:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]] prophesied the events of ''[[Arena:Arena|Arena]]'', ''[[Daggerfall:Daggerfall|Daggerfall]]'', ''[[Morrowind:Morrowind|Morrowind]]'', ''[[Oblivion:Oblivion|Oblivion]]'', and ''[[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]]''. ==Bugs== {{Bug|A tripwire in The Ratway Vaults may reset and block your way out.|USKP|2.0.0}} **Use Unrelenting Force through Esbern to activate the trap. {{Bug|Esbern may get stuck in the book animation at the beginning of the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Running into him or hitting him with [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] may fix this. **{{Pc22}} setstage MQ203 60 can be used as a partial solution for this and will advance the quest to stage 60 ("Gain entrance to Sky Haven Temple"). {{Bug|If Esbern is leading you out of the Ratway, he may freeze in the large central room due to a pathfinding loop.}} ** This is apparently recoverable only by loading an earlier save. {{Bug|Even if you say that you wish to travel together, if you take too long or go in a direction that isn't towards Karthspire, Delphine and Esbern may go off on their own anyways as if you'd asked to travel separately.}} {{Bug|If you have already explored the temple entrance and lowered the bridge when this quest is started, the quest might get stuck. After activating the Blood Seal, instead of following you into the Temple, Delphine and Esbern will run back to the first puzzle and wait for you to complete it; however, it has already been completed, thus making the NPCs wait indefinitely.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Open the command console and type setstage MQ203 140. This will get the NPCs to move across the bridge. It is also possible to use the moveto player function to move both of them to your location once you're at the top. **{{Pc22}} If the above still doesn't work, open the console and type setstage MQ203 280. This finishes the quest for you and starts the next one. **The position of Delphine and Esbern when you enter Sky Haven Temple appears to matter when this bug is encountered. Basically, both Delphine and Esbern must be past the area previously closed off by the face when you advance into Sky Haven Temple. To achieve this, load a saved file (or auto-save) before activation of the Blood Seal. Once you activate the Blood Seal, while Esbern talks and you are able to move after activating the Blood Seal, immediately "equip" the three-word version of [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] and move directly next to either Delphine or Esbern looking at the now opened entrance. Both Delphine and Esbern can be "shouted" into the entrance area, will not attack when shouted, and will follow you into Sky Haven Temple advancing the quest. **If the "shout method" above doesn't work, use this workaround: Just before the three of you leave the Inn at Riverwood, choose the option to travel together. Go outside, and then fast travel directly to Sky Haven Temple. You will land outside the skull entrance along with the two of them. Let them go through the motions, and then slice your hand when the time comes. Once the door opens, let them go through their dialogue sequence. Walk first up the stairs—and they will follow you. {{Bug|Esbern and Delphine may get stuck in combat mode if you do not kill all of the Forsworn at Karthspire Camp.|confirmed=1}} **If you wait for a long time (10+ hours), this may reset their stance and they will continue up the stairs, however it does not appear to work every time. **Instead of waiting, leaving the cave with Sky Haven Temple and then fast traveling back to Sky Haven Temple also should continue the quest. **Killing all of the Forsworn before entering Sky Haven Temple should avoid this entirely. {{Bug|Esbern may not complete examination of Alduin's Wall.|confirmed=1}} **If you have a follower with you when you enter the interior of the Karthspire, they will not follow you, but they may reappear when you enter Sky Haven Temple proper. If this happens, Delphine may fail to follow Esbern up the steps or engage Esbern in dialogue, preventing the quest from completing. Reloading a save and telling your follower to wait outside Karthspire or simply go home should avoid this. **It is scripted that Delphine and Esbern equip torches and light basins. If Delphine does not equip her torch, she may not follow Esbern up the stairs, and Esbern will not examine the wall when spoken to. Force Delphine to equip her torch by opening the command console, clicking Delphine to get her ID, and typing equipitem 0001D4EC 1 left. Delphine should then move to light a basin and the scripting will continue. **You can also try to move the NPCs inside Sky Haven Temple manually. Open the command console and click on Esbern to get his ID. Walk into the temple and up to the wall, and enter the command moveto player to teleport Esbern to you. Repeat this process with Delphine. Once you teleport an NPC it will start walking to where it is supposed to be, and it should fix the issue. **If that fails, make sure both Esbern and Delphine are on the landing next to the wall, then check the current stage of the quest with getstage mq203. If it is at 250, advance to 260 with setstage mq203 260. You will know it worked if Delphine then proceeds with the dialogue asking about a shout that can bring a dragon down out of the sky. **You can try to going up the stairs and taking the door to Skyrim. Fast travel across the map then back to Sky Haven Temple. Delphine should be standing next to Esbern at the wall and the quest will continue. **If all else fails, you can use setstage MQ203 280 to finish the quest {{Bug|Delphine may not light all the braziers that she's supposed to.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've gotten to the Blades loremaster Esbern ahead of the Thalmor. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Xyzzy |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=[[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] |Reward=None |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], [[Skyrim:The Ratway|The Ratway]] |Image=SR-quest-A Cornered Rat.jpg |ImgDesc=Esbern in his room in the Warrens |description=Locate [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]]. |ID=MQ202 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png |SuggLevel=8 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] in [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] or talk to [[Skyrim:Keerava|Keerava]] in [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|The Bee and Barb]]. # Search the [[Skyrim:The Ratway|Ratway]] for [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]]'s hideout. # Find Esbern in the Ratway Warrens. # Talk to Esbern. # Bring Esbern back to [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] at [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]] in [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Finding the Rat=== After infiltrating the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Embassy|Thalmor Embassy]], return to [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]] and inform [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] of what you learned from the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] records. Delphine is surprised to know her old colleague and fellow [[Skyrim:Blades|Blade]], [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]], is reportedly still alive. She tasks you with finding the archivist from his hiding place in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. Due to the clandestine nature of the Blades, Delphine gives you a secret phrase to deliver to Esbern to secure his trust when you locate him. Depending on your standing with the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], the journal will direct you to talk to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]], or search the [[Skyrim:The Ratway|Ratway]] for Esbern. If you are directed to find Brynjolf, you may speak to him, [[Skyrim:Dirge|Dirge]], or [[Skyrim:Vekel the Man|Vekel the Man]] inside [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|the Ragged Flagon]]. All three have an option to [[Skyrim:Persuade|persuade]] or bribe them for information on Esbern's location. '''Failed''': Brawl |} If you have already joined the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], the Ratway is accessible and you can locate Esbern directly. Speaking with [[Skyrim:Keerava|Keerava]], the Riften innkeeper, also advances the quest. ===The Ratway=== The Ratway and the Ratway Vaults beneath Riften are inhabited by a number of [[Skyrim:Lowlife|lowlifes]], [[Skyrim:Vagrant|vagrants]], and three or four Thalmor warriors searching for Esbern. When you reach the door to Esbern's room in the Ratway Warrens, he is cautious of Thalmor agents and initially refuses you entry. You may persuade him by saying Delphine sent you, you can tell him the password Delphine gave you: ''"Where were you on the 30th of Frostfall?"'', or you may explain that you are the [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dragonborn]]. ===The Dragon's Return=== Once Esbern lets you in, he shares his dire predictions about the world: [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin the World-Eater]]'s return has apocalyptic implications, and Esbern's warnings of this threat have been ignored. He makes it clear that there was no hope until you arrived and that he believed the world was going to end. He agrees to follow you to Delphine's base in Riverwood. Before leaving, Esbern will quickly search his room for any sensitive information the Thalmor might find. He will also gather some supplies from the chest at the foot of his bed and then be ready to leave. The quest ends here, and the next quest, [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]], begins. ==Notes== * If any follower is hired before or during the quest, they will not be forced to return to their original location when [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] joins as a second follower. * If he survives [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], [[Skyrim:Gissur|Gissur]] will be seated at a table in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|the Ragged Flagon]] when you get Esbern's whereabouts from [[Skyrim:Vekel the Man|Vekel the Man]]. After you end conversation with Vekel, Gissur will get up from the table and leave the Flagon. If you are a member of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], Vekel will suddenly say ''"That one, right there, walking out the door! He was one of them asking about that old man you were looking for."'' If confronted, Gissur will only rebuff your attempts at conversation, but the [[Skyrim:Gissur's Note|note]] he carries reveals his true intentions. He can be attacked and killed with no repercussions, and other Thieves Guild members will join the fight on your side if you are a guild member, which may make your escape with Esbern easier. If you choose to follow Gissur to his assigned contact instead of killing him, he will head into the [[Skyrim:The Ratway|Ratway]]. He meets up with two [[Skyrim:Thalmor Soldier|Thalmor soldiers]] and a [[Skyrim:Thalmor Wizard|Thalmor wizard]] and informs them about you: ::'''Gissur''': ''"He's/She's in the Flagon right now. Get ready."'' ::'''Thalmor Wizard''': ''"You're sure?"'' ::'''Gissur''': ''"Of course I'm sure! He/She was asking about Esbern."'' ::'''Thalmor Wizard''': ''"Doesn't matter. We'll kill them either way."'' :At this point they'll all make their way back to the Flagon and accost Vekel (or [[Skyrim:Dirge|Dirge]], if Vekel's dead), demanding to know where you are: ::'''Thalmor Wizard''': ''"Where is he? The one who was asking about the fugitive hiding in the Ratway?"'' ::'''Vekel''': ''"You're in the wrong place to be asking those kind of questions, pal."'' ::(The Thalmor soldiers draw their weapons.) ::'''Thalmor Wizard''': ''"No. Not yet."'' ::(The Thalmor soldiers sheathe their weapons.) ::'''Vekel''': ''"You'd better clear out before someone gets hurt."'' ::'''Thalmor Wizard''': ''"Your lack of cooperation has been noted. We'll be back if we require further information. You won't get a second chance."'' ::'''Vekel''': ''"The answer ain't gonna be any different the next time. Arrogant elven bastard."'' :The Thalmor will then leave the Ragged Flagon and go back into the Ratway to wait for you, while Gissur will return to his seat in the Flagon. They will be hostile on sight, so you will only hear the above conversations if you remain hidden throughout. * If [[Skyrim:A Chance Arrangement|A Chance Arrangement]] has been started, Brynjolf cannot be talked to. * It is possible to proceed directly to Esbern without returning to Delphine first. Esbern will unlock his door if you tell him you are Dragonborn. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The quest may fail to start after completing [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], and even trying manually start or end it with the console will not work.|USKP|1.2}} **{{pc22}} You may have to skip forward to the start of the next quest, [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]], by using the console and typing in setstage MQ203 5, which will allow you to continue. **{{pc22}} Use console command setstage MQ202 (stage #) to force Esbern to open the door and talk again. Stage 160 makes Esbern open the door, if bugged. Stage 170 makes Esbern talk again, if bugged. Another easier way to avoid bugs is to type in CompleteQuest MQ202, which would work for any quest value. {{Bug|If following Gissur, the Thalmor may never return to the Ragged Flagon or they may be hostile when you get there, causing the second dialogue to be skipped.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you have already become a member of the Thieves Guild, Gissur will attempt to get to his Thalmor contact through the Ragged Flagon - Cistern, through the Crypt Secret Entrance (will not get stuck unless you actively follow him through this roundabout path), and back into the Ratway via the river entrance, resulting in an extremely delayed arrival to his contact. The Thalmor and Gissur will then follow the same path in reverse; all the way through the Crypt, Cistern, and back into the Flagon.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you leave the Ratway immediately after convincing Esbern to come back and immediately fast travel to Riverwood, the quest marker may not move from Delphine, and you'll be stuck.|confirmed=0}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||The Thalmor are just as puzzled as we are about why dragons are returning.
