Skyrim:A Blade in the Dark.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Gideon Dragontongue |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Kiz |rewardChecked=Gideon Dragontongue }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=[[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] |Reward= |Disp= =3 (Delphine) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]], [[Skyrim:Kynesgrove|Kynesgrove]] |Image=SR-quest-A Blade in the Dark.jpg |ImgDesc=Alduin resurrecting Sahloknir |description=Prove you are Dragonborn to [[SR:Delphine|Delphine]] by slaying the dragon [[SR:Sahloknir|Sahloknir]]. |ID=MQ106 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]]. # Locate the dragon burial site. # Kill the dragon [[SR:Sahloknir|Sahloknir]]. # Talk to Delphine. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Harmless Innkeeper=== Now that you know that the [[Skyrim:Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|Horn of Jurgen Windcaller]] has been pilfered from [[Skyrim:Ustengrav|Ustengrav]], follow the instructions in the [[Skyrim:Mysterious Note (Delphine)|mysterious note]] left in its place. This will lead you to [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]] and the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]]. Speak with the innkeeper, [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]], about renting the attic room. She will tell you that there is no such room, but you can take the room on the left. Delphine will follow you to the sparse room she indicated, where she will address you as Dragonborn and give you the Horn. She cryptically tells you that you and she need to talk and asks you to follow her. ===The Problem with Dragons=== Delphine will lead you to a room across the inn. She will ask you to close the door to the room before both you and she can proceed any further. Do it, and she will open a secret passage in the back of a wardrobe that leads down to a subterranean room. Here Delphine will reveal that she took the Horn to attract the attention of the Dragonborn. The note was a safeguard to protect against trickery by the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]]. She also tells you that the dragons are not just coming back, but are actually coming back to life, resurrected from their burial mounds. Only the Dragonborn can permanently kill dragons by absorbing their souls. But she is not quite ready to accept you as Dragonborn, despite the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards']] interest in you. Luckily, she has a task to prove your authenticity. According to the [[Skyrim:Dragonstone|Dragonstone]] map taken from [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]], the next dragon will rise from a burial mound in [[Skyrim:Kynesgrove|Kynesgrove]]. She wants you to accompany her to the burial site and kill the dragon; only then will she accept you as Dragonborn. If you tell her you're ready to leave, she will put on her gear and leave the inn. You are free to follow Delphine to Kynesgrove, and she will briefly talk to you at waypoints about her concerns. Or you can go at your own pace and possibly beat her there. ===Kynesgrove=== As soon as you get to Kynesgrove, [[Skyrim:Iddra|Iddra]], the innkeeper, will run up to you and tell you that a dragon was sighted flying over the burial mound and that you should get out of town. If you traveled with Delphine, she will run up ahead of you to the burial mound, fearing it may be too late. If you arrived ahead of her, she will appear shortly thereafter on the mound behind you. ===Speaking with Dragons=== Upon arriving at the site, you and Delphine will witness the dragon, [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]], using his [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|Thu'um]] to resurrect a dead dragon. Alduin cannot be killed or injured at this time. When the dragon, [[Skyrim:Sahloknir|Sahloknir]], is whole once more, he has a conversation in the [[Lore:Dragon Language|dragon language]] with Alduin. *Alduin: ''Sahloknir, ziil gro dovah ulse! '' **Sahloknir! Your soul is bound to me for eternity! *Alduin: ''Slen tiid vo!'' **(Flesh Time Opposite Of) *Sahloknir: ''Alduin, thuri! Boaan tiid vokriiha suleyksejun kruziik?'' **Alduin, my king (overlord)! Has the time arrived (flown) to restore (unkill) your ancient dominion (power-of-king)? *Alduin: ''Geh, Sahloknir, kaali mir.'' **Yes, Sahloknir, my loyal champion. Here, Alduin attempts to speak to you, addressing you as [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dovahkiin]]. *Alduin: ''Ful, losei Dovahkiin? Zu'u koraav nid nol dov do hi.'' **So, you're the Dragonborn? I see nothing of the dragon about you. (So, you are Dragonborn? I recognize no from dragon of you.) *Alduin: ''You do not even know our tongue, do you? Such arrogance, to dare take for yourself the name of Dovah.'' *Alduin: ''Sahloknir, krii daar joorre.'' **Sahloknir, kill these mortals. After ordering Sahloknir to kill you, Alduin flies away. Delphine will help you kill Sahloknir, and upon his death, when you absorb his soul, Delphine will be quick to acknowledge you as Dragonborn. ===Paranoia=== Speak to her, and she will reveal that she is one of the last members of the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]]. She will also tell you about her suspicions that the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] are responsible for the return of the dragons. Since the Thalmor are part of the [[Lore:Aldmeri Dominion|Aldmeri Dominion]] and nearly destroyed the Empire during the [[Lore:Great War|Great War]] only 30 years ago, they have a motive for rescuing [[Skyrim:Ulfric_Stormcloak|Ulfric]] in [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]], simply in order to keep the war raging. The Thalmor stand to benefit most from damage to the Empire by the dragons. Finally, she will reveal her plan to infiltrate the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Embassy|Thalmor Embassy]] to search for evidence of their connection with the dragons. She has no idea how to get past embassy security, and asks you to meet her back in [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. This quest concludes, and the [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]] quest starts. ==Notes== *While A Blade in the Dark is active, random dragon encounters are eliminated, and dragon locations will be limited to [[Skyrim:Dragon Lairs|Dragon Lairs]], allowing for controlled access to dragon fights. *Despite it saying you need gold to rent the "attic room" (and Delphine taking said gold if you do), you do not actually need the gold on you to progress the quest. *When Delphine goes to put her traveling gear on at the start of the quest in Riverwood, she will stand next to the chest, although the chest beforehand states that it is empty. *Delphine will not acknowledge your status as Dragonborn if you slay a dragon that is not Sahloknir, despite any soul absorption. *You can happen upon the burial site any time after Delphine leaves Riverwood. The quest will progress once you arrive. *Standing too close to the burial mound when Alduin revives Sahloknir may cause you to be thrown aside in a manner similar to the Unrelenting Force shout. Though you can likely pick yourself back up before Alduin's and Sahloknir's conversation ends and the battle begins, you can be thrown off the hill and take fall damage, so be careful. *The other named NPCs of Kynesgrove will all take shelter in [[Skyrim:Steamscorch_Mine|Steamscorch Mine]] while the dragons are present. You can check in on them on your way up the hill from the inn and speak to them to hear quest-specific dialogue. *If you rent a regular room at the Sleeping Giant first, then ask for the attic room, Delphine will comment on this, with "Why didn't you say so the first time?" *If you have married either [[Skyrim:Dravynea_the_Stoneweaver|Dravynea the Stoneweaver]] or [[Skyrim:Roggi_Knot-Beard|Roggi Knot-Beard]] (providing Roggi is not your active follower) and moved them to another house before starting this quest, they will be teleported to Steamscorch Mine as soon as A Blade in the Dark is started, and will remain there until it is completed. *If the ''[[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]]'' add-on is installed and the quest [[Skyrim:At the Summit of Apocrypha|At the Summit of Apocrypha]] isn't done yet, you may not be able to absorb the dragon soul after killing it (as [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]] wishes steal it). If he does absorb the dragon soul, Delphine may still give you credit for it. **{{Pc22}} You can use the commands setstage MQ106 155, and setstage MQ106 160, and then speak to Delphine. Once the quest is finished, fast travel to Kynesgrove before walking back to the dragon skeleton to see the Miraak soul theft animation. == Bugs == {{Bug|After renting the "attic room", Delphine may enter your room but not speak, breaking the rest of the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Make sure you have shut the door behind you before talking to Delphine - she asks you to do this. **{{Pc22}} This can be fixed by typing setstage mq106 30 in the console, depositing the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller in your inventory and skipping to Delphine's 'we need to talk' dialogue. {{Bug|Sometimes when you reach the dragon burial mound, Sahloknir will not fully emerge from the ground, and does not die when his health reaches zero.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you kill Sahloknir before he gets his skin the quest is broken|confirmed=0}} ** This can be fixed by walking far enough out of the dragon's range, which extends as far as Kynesgrove, and walking back. {{Bug|Talking to Delphine after slaying Sahloknir and absorbing his soul may not trigger the quest update.|confirmed=1}} **This can be fixed by reloading a save and before going to Kynesgrove, make sure to first complete the "Horn of Jurgen Windcaller" Quest by going to the Grey Beards and returning the Horn to them. Also, make sure that you have learned the shout "Become Ethereal" in Ustengrav, and activated the altar where you found the note from Delphine to gain a Dragon Soul. Use that Dragon Soul to activate "Become Ethereal". Then go meet Delphine in Kynesgrove and slay the Dragon. **Uninstall/Disable the mod "View Yourself VR" if you have it, because it has been reported to cause this bug. **{{Pc22}} Using the console command SetObjectiveCompleted MQ106 40 1 can correct this so that the player will progress to the point where Delphine will offer to tell all. **{{Pc22}} Using the console command setstage MQ106 155 can correct this. Follow up with setstage MQ106 160. **{{Pc22}} If Delphine is still not responding, the main questline can be forwarded to the beginning of the [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]] quest by using completequest MQ106 followed by setstage MQ201 30. This will cause Delphine to run back to the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]] in [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]], where her dialogue will be reset for the new quest. It will also add [[Skyrim:Delphine's Secret Door Key|Delphine's Secret Door Key]] to your inventory. **{{Pc22}} If this also doesn't work, you can load your last saved game, slay Sahloknir, absorb the soul and then move very slowly to Delphine. Don't talk to her, wait until she finished all her lines and repeats the last one - then talk to her. {{Bug|Sometimes, you may not be able to absorb the dragon soul until you complete the quest.|confirmed=0}} {{Bug|Sometimes, when Sahloknir emerges he may have his skin already attached. The effect of his skin returning still plays.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|On Xbox One and PS4, while traveling with Delphine when you reach [[Skyrim:Valtheim Towers|Valtheim Towers]], Delphine will notice and comment about the bandit place if you had not raided it yet, and she will immediately disappear.}} {{Bug|She will appear about 100 meters up the path.}} {{Bug|If Roggi Knot-Beard is your follower when Delphine tells you about the impending Kynesgrove dragon attack, he may cower and say lines as though he were hiding in Steamscorch Mine with the other Kynesgrove residents, although he will still leave the Sleeping Giant of his own accord and run in the direction of home.|confirmed=0}} {{Bug|Approaching Kynesgrove on a [[Skyrim:Horses|horse]] can block quest progression.|OSP|1.9}} {{Bug|After you finish the quest, Kynesgrove guards may comment on a dragon attack there as though it took place somewhere else.|USSEP|4.3.8}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |30||Delphine, the innkeeper in Riverwood, is more than she seems. She was the one that left me the note in Ustengrav. She gave me back the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. She went to a lot of trouble to get my attention. I should find out what she wants. {{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Delphine}} |50||Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that the next one will resurrect near the town of Kynesgrove. Near Kynesgrove, we saw a dragon Shouting another one back to life. That dragon is dead, and now it's time for Delphine to give me some answers. {{Quest Objective|40|Talk to Delphine}} |200|fin|Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that only the Dragonborn can stop them. After we killed the dragon and I absorbed its power, Delphine accepted that I was Dragonborn as she had hoped, and revealed that she is one of the last members of the Blades, an organization dedicated to protecting the Dragonborn and stopping the dragons. |missing=0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 25, 32, 35, 40, 42, 45, 47, 48, 55, 58, 60, 65, 70, 72, 75, 80, 90, 100, 105, 110, 120, 155, 160, 170 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Main Quest|Main Quest]]}}

Is he right? |description= Find your lost friend, [[Skyrim:Sam Guevenne|Sam]], as you recover from a bad hangover. |ID=DA14Start and DA14 |Icon=SR-qico-Daedric.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Meet [[Skyrim:Sam Guevenne|Sam Guevenne]] and accept the drinking contest. # Help clean up the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]]. # Ask about Sam and the staff in [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Ysolda|Ysolda]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] about the staff. # Head to [[Skyrim:Morvunskar|Morvunskar]]. # Search Morvunskar for Sam and the staff. # Receive your reward from the Daedric Lord [[Skyrim:Sanguine|Sanguine]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Drinking Competition=== Once you reach level 14, you may meet [[Skyrim:Sam Guevenne|Sam Guevenne]] in any [[Skyrim:Inns|inn or tavern]]. He will challenge you to a drinking contest, offering to award you a staff if you win. Sam reaches his limit after his second drink. You can win by taking a third drink, after which a drunken Sam declares you the winner. However, before awarding the staff, Sam wants to take his new drinking buddy to "a place where the wine flows like water". At this point your mental blackout begins and the screen fades to black until the next day. ===The Hangover=== [[File:SR-quest-A Night To Remember_03.jpg|thumb|right|''"Wake up! That's right, it's time to wake up, you drunken blasphemer!"'']] You will be woken by [[Skyrim:Senna|Senna]], a priestess, in the temple of [[Lore:Dibella|Dibella]] in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. When you ask about what happened, she states you were blathering about a wedding and a goat, or blaspheming the statuaries by fondling. You apparently made quite a mess of the temple, so she asks you to clean up the temple and make amends. {|class=wikitable |- !width=25%|Option !Dialogue |- | Was a man named Sam with me?||Dibella teaches love and compassion, but that doesn't mean we're just going to tell you what you want to know and let you walk away from this. Pick up your mess, then apologize, and if we think you're sincere we'll consider lending you aid. |- | I'm sorry, I don't even remember how I got here. '''(Persuade)'''||'''Passed''': Well, you were deep in your cups when you got here. You were ranting but most of it was slurred. You said something about Rorikstead.
'''Failed''': Oh, I'd love to help you figure it out, but I'm so busy cleaning up the mess you made of our temple... Now if you were to help tidy up and perhaps apologize afterwards... I might be able to help you. |- | Tell me how I got here and I'll pay for the damages. '''(Bribe)'''||'''Passed''': Well, we can always use contributions. You were ranting when you got here but most of it was slurred. You did say something about Rorikstead . Maybe you should take a look there.
'''Failed''': Oh you must be nobility of some sort. Running around partying and paying others to clean it up. I don't think so. Clean up your own mess. |} If you apologize, you will learn a little bit more information about what happened. You will have to pick up several seemingly meaningless items, namely, a giant's toe, two bottles of Alto Wine, and a confusing [[Skyrim:Repair Supplies|note]] from Sam. According to the note, you need these items, now marked as quest items, and a Hagraven Feather to fix the staff you were promised. You can skip the cleanup through [[Skyrim:Persuasion|persuasion (Average, Speech Skill 50) or bribe]]. Note that the [[Skyrim:Shrines#Shrine_of_Dibella|Shrine of Dibella]] in the same room will grant you a +10 Speechcraft blessing for 8 hours, which can potentially help you for all stages of this quest. If you avoid cleaning up, you need not worry about trying to get the items. After you clean up the temple, the priestess tells you that when you got there you were saying something about [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. {{NewLine}} ===Grok and a Goat=== [[File:SR-quest-A Night To Remember_04.jpg|thumb|right|Grok won't let go of Gleda ...]] Head on to Rorikstead and when you arrive, look for [[Skyrim:Ennis|Ennis]]. He will indignantly rebuke you for stealing his prized goat, named [[Skyrim:Gleda the Goat|Gleda]], and selling her to a giant. To get the information you need about Sam and the staff, you can pay Ennis 1000 gold for the goat, persuade him, intimidate him, or simply retrieve his goat. {|class=wikitable |- !width=25%|Option !Dialogue |- | What happened with Gleda again? I'm a little fuzzy on that.||You really don't remember stealing a goat and selling her to a Giant? Are you thick? Go get her! At least she's bound to follow you back - you smell just like the fermented feed she likes. |- | Did I say anything about where I left a staff?||You mentioned something like that... when you were running off with my goat! Tell you what - you bring back my goat, and maybe I'll give a damn about your staff. |- | Help me retrace my steps and I'll pay you for the goat. '''(1000 gold)'''||'''Passed''': Fine, but I'll still be missing my Gleda. Doubt I'll ever have a prize winning goat again. Most of what you said was gibberish but you left a note. The only bit I could read was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
'''Failed''': There's not enough money in the world to replace Gleda. |- | Tell me everything and you won't end up like your goat. '''(Intimidate)'''||'''Passed''': Okay, okay. Most of what you said didn't make sense but you left a note. The only bit that I could read said "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun." That's all I know.
'''Failed''': Do what you have to do, I'm not giving up on Gleda. |- | I need to find Sam and the staff, in order to get Gleda back. '''(Persuade)'''||'''Passed''': I suppose that makes sense. You didn't mention a Sam and nothing you said about the staff made sense. You left a note but it was mostly gibberish, the only bit I could make out was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
'''Failed''': You didn't seem to need either to sell Gleda to the Giant in the first place. I think you'll figure it out. |} To get Gleda, head south to find the goat wandering around near a giant named [[Skyrim:Grok|Grok]]. The giant is non-hostile, but once you get the goat to follow you, Grok will decide to attack. It is possible to steal Gleda without incurring Grok's wrath if you sneak up and "talk" to Gleda and then immediately run before Grok notices you, or yield to Grok if he does attack you. Gleda will follow you no matter how fast you run. Another option is to cast [[Skyrim:Calm|Calm]] on Grok before engaging with Gleda. Grok will not care that you have taken Gleda for the duration of the spell. If you are skilled enough, you can kill Grok. Lead the goat back to Ennis to learn that you mentioned something about paying [[Skyrim:Ysolda|Ysolda]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] for a wedding ring. {{NewLine}} ===The Blushing Bride=== [[File:SR-quest-A Night To Remember_05.jpg|thumb|right|... and Moira won't let go of the wedding ring]] Go to Whiterun and find Ysolda. She says that you bought a wedding ring on credit from her, but since there isn't going to be a wedding, she wants the ring back. Your options are much the same as earlier conversations: you can persuade or intimidate her to get the information about Sam, pay her 2000 gold for the ring, or find the ring. {|class=wikitable |- !width=25%|Option !Dialogue |- | Seriously, let me pay you for the ring. '''(2000 gold)'''||'''Passed''': Decided to go through with it then? I knew you couldn't have forgotten about your {{sic|fiance|fiancée}}. You spoke of her so glowingly. I don't know much about Morvunskar but it sounded like a lovely place for the ceremony. Congratulations.
'''Failed''': I think I would prefer my ring back. I put a lot of time into making it and you just gave {{sic|is|it}} away as a joke. |- | I just need to get to the wedding. Please. '''(Persuade)'''||'''Passed''': You must have had a wild night if you can't remember that. But I suppose everyone gets the jitters before their wedding. And I did say you could take a bit of time paying me back. You said the ceremony was going to be at Morvunskar. Don't forget you still owe me!
'''Failed''': I'm sure your bride-to-be will tell you {{sic|when you|description=extra phrase}} where the ceremony will be. If she still wants to marry you when you tell her you can't afford the ring. |- | I don't care about the ring! Tell me what else I said! '''(Intimidate)'''||'''Passed''': All right, all right. You're mean when you're sober. You said {{sic|you|description=extra word}} the ceremony was going to be in Morvunskar. You said your friend Sam was going to be your best man.
'''Failed''': You think you can bully me. I grew up with five brothers. Go... get...my...ring. |- | What was that story about my {{sic|fiancee|fiancée}}?||How could you forget? It was the sweetest story I'd ever heard. You met at the full moon, under the biggest tree in Witchmist Grove, surrounded by fireflies. It was straight out of a storybook. |} If you choose to get the ring, find your "fiancée", [[Skyrim:Moira|Moira]] the [[Skyrim:Hagraven|hagraven]], who awaits you at her hut in [[Skyrim:Witchmist Grove|Witchmist Grove]]: ''"Darling! I've been waiting for you to return, to consummate our love!"'' Your only option is to ask for the ring back. Moira gets mad and turns hostile: ''"What? You want it for that hussy Esmerelda, with the dark feathers – don't you? I won't let her have you!"'' Kill her and take the [[Skyrim:Quest Items#Wedding Ring|wedding ring]] from her inventory. Once you have the ring, return to Whiterun and give it to Ysolda to learn where you were going to have the ceremony: [[Skyrim:Morvunskar|Morvunskar]]. {{NewLine}} ===The "Perfect" Wedding Location=== [[File:SR-quest-A Night To Remember.jpg|thumb|left|Entering the Misty Grove]] [[File:SR-quest-A Night To Remember_06.jpg|thumb|right|''"You're here! I was beginning to think you might not make it."'']] Having learned of the wedding's location, head over to Morvunskar. You will find a lot of hostile mages both outside and inside there. Fight your way into the fort. Eventually, after descending one, then ascending another stairway, a ball of blue light will appear. Enter the light and you will be transported to [[Skyrim:Misty Grove|Misty Grove]]. Follow the path and you will find a party already in full swing, including your drinking buddy Sam. Sam will eventually reveal that he is actually the [[Lore:Daedric Princes|Daedric Prince of Debauchery]], [[Skyrim:Sanguine|Sanguine]]. He will tell you that he was introducing some merriment and subversion into the world and was encouraging you to go out and "have fun". The items he had you bring to repair the staff, it turns out, are pointless, and will no longer be quest items. Sanguine will reward your efforts to track him down with the [[Skyrim:Sanguine Rose|Sanguine Rose]] and will teleport you back to the pub where you met him. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * If you bypass Rorikstead in this quest, thus never seeing Ennis between cleaning up the Temple of Dibella and speaking to Ysolda, Ennis will not push the issue of Gleda if you talk to him later. Gameplay-wise, this is because he has nothing to offer that you don't already know. * [[Skyrim:Patch#Version 1.5|Patch 1.5]] sets Senna, Ennis, and Ysolda as essential. Although the patch notes the change as essential "until [their] part in A Night To Remember is completed", they are simply set as essential for the entirety of the game. * Once the scenes with Senna, Ennis, and Ysolda are finished, they will go back to addressing you as they did before the quest began, and no more mention of the latter will be made. * After the quest is completed, you may have a random encounter with an Argonian called [[Skyrim:Deep-In-His-Cups|Deep-In-His-Cups]] who, according to him, was a part of the debauchery with you and Sam. He states that you and Sam owe him 10,000 gold for a bet because he ran into a bandit camp and almost died. If you say that you don't have 10,000 gold, he will attack you unless you pass an easy [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]]. If you pass the speech check, he will lower your debt to 750 coins. If you pay the debt (either 10,000 or 750 coins), he will go back to Black Marsh. * Sam can spawn at any of the [[Skyrim:Inns|inns]] across Skyrim, including those in [[Skyrim:Towns|towns]], not just the ones in [[Skyrim:Cities|hold capitals]]. This includes [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|The Retching Netch]] in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] with the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on. ** If Sam was present at the Retching Netch when the drinking contest took place, you'll be sent back there once the quest is finished. * All of the items in Sam's note are indirectly related to the quest: the giant's toe is a reference to Grok, holy water is a reference to Dibella Shrine's well, and a Hagraven feather is a reference to Moira. ** Even if you never picked up Sam's note (for instance, by using persuasion or payment at the temple of Dibella) and thus never learned about the items supposedly necessary to repair the staff, dialogue options with Sanguine will still refer to you bringing along those items. * Teleporting to the temple will not count as "discovering" Markarth; if you have not been to Markarth before and fast travel away immediately upon exiting the temple, you will not be able to fast travel back. Instead, you may want to head to the city gates, which ''will'' initiate discovering the city. You can also discover [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] before Markarth. * Only the [[Skyrim:Alto Wine|Alto Wine]] variant with the basket on the bottom counts as a quest item; the one that lacks it doesn't. Likewise, [[Skyrim:Wine|regular wine]], [[Skyrim:Spiced Wine|Spiced Wine]], and [[Skyrim:Empty Wine Bottle|empty wine bottles]] also do not count. * The blue light is on a platform at the top of a stairway, but if you enter the small storeroom below the platform you may be transported to Misty Grove prematurely from there, curtailing collection of loot. * The items on Sanguine's dining table are unowned, and therefore, free to take. * If you have already cleared Morvunskar before starting the quest, enemies will respawn in its exterior cell, but the fort's interiors will stay empty. Loot will also not respawn. * Anything you pick up while in Misty Grove will transfer with you to the real world once the quest is complete. * Neither Ysolda's, nor Senna's dialogue will change if you are married to them. Regardless of where she may be currently living, Senna will still be at the temple of Dibella when you wake up. Ysolda will retain her location if moved somewhere other than Whiterun, and you will need to speak to her there. * Many pieces of cut content related to this quest can still be found in the files: ** You and Sam would not get to drinking straight away, as you could have bribed or intimated him in order to get a drink. Bribing would result in him saying ''"That amount should allow me to readily acquire a drink."'' and intimadation would result in him saying: ''"You should try that bit on the barkeep. Maybe get yourself a free drink."'' ** Similarly, it seems like Sam would have started the quest off by talking to you about something he's seen, while also talking about the staff. Four player-only topics remain of this, but Sam's lines are not present: '''So... you were telling me a tale?''', '''I give up. What did you see?''', '''I'll bet a drunk like you sees a lot of strange things.''', '''I could sure use a staff like that...'''. ** The "Holy Water" mentioned in Sam's list, actually exists as an [[Skyrim:Holy Water|unused item]]. Despite its mention in the note, generic Alto Wine appears in its stead. ** The giant's toe found in the temple was originally meant to be a [[Skyrim:Giant Club|Giant's club]], the ref of the former still refers to it as the latter. ** The priestess [[Skyrim:Orla|Orla]] was originally also meant to be present when you woke up in the temple. A marker for her is defined, but the code meant to move her to it is commented out in the quest script. ** Priestessess Orla and [[Skyrim:Anwen|Anwen]] both have dialogue related to this quest which can ''technically'' be heard, but it needs extreme conditions in order to succeed. You would have to break into the expert-locked inner sanctum of the temple in order to find them and then speak to them before their dialogue gets overridden by the generic trespassing dialogue. Also, while Orla's dialogue is technically linked to the correct stage 30, Anwen's is linked to stage 40, at which point it would've already been cleaned up. Their lines are also conditioned to play before stage 2000 and 5000, respectively, which don't exist. It's possible that Anwen's dialogue was deliberately conditioned to not play, as it erroneously has her mentioning herself in third person, instead of Senna. ** The developer message DA14TempFadeInMessage also mentions multiple priestesses being present when you awaken, and they would've all spoken to you. ** There's a list called DA14NPCs which contains all NPCs (supposedly) related to this quest. In addition to the other two Dibella priestessess mentioned above, [[Skyrim:Rorik|Rorik]] and [[Skyrim:Reldith|Reldith]] are also listed, but it's unclear what their role could've been, as they have no other leftovers at all. ** Grok the giant was meant to have a line of unique attack dialogue, but as Giants can't talk in the final game, it goes unused: ''"You cannot eat Gleda! Gleda is protected by Grok!"'' ** An NPC called [[Skyrim:Drunk_Cultist|Drunk Cultist]] was meant to be part of this quest, and she is still placed in Morvunskar, near the base of the portal to Misty Grove, but her ref is never activated. Since she doesn't have any dialogue leftover, it's unknown what purpose she would've served. ** There is dialogue present in three different voice types which was meant for (apparent) bandits that you would've encountered in another random encounter after completion of the quest. The bandits would've been familiar with you, and it seems that you and Sam wronged them in some way, as they would apparently attack after saying the following lines: ''"Once you leave the party you can't just come back."'', ''"{{sic|Lets|Let's|description=missing apostrophe}} see how tough you are without Sam keeping an eye on you."'', ''"No Sam, no protection. Time to die."'' *Version 4.1.2 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch]] replaces the 2 bottles of Alto Wine in the Temple of Dibella with Holy Water. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you return to Misty Grove after the quest you will be permanently stuck there.|OSP|1.4}} **Reload a save from before you entered. {{Bug|It is possible that you will not blackout after the third drink. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Sergius Turrianus|Sergius Turrianus]] in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]].
# Collect the item he wants.
# Return to Sergius.

==Detailed Walkthrough==

Sergius will request that you pick up an item to be enchanted from a customer, located somewhere in Skyrim. The NPC will be in a city, won't be part of either the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] or the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]], and will have one of the following voicetypes: [[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-FemaleElfHaughty|FemaleElfHaughty]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-FemaleDarkElf|FemaleDarkElf]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-FemaleEvenToned|FemaleEvenToned]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-MaleElfHaughty|MaleElfHaughty]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-MaleDarkElf|MaleDarkElf]], or [[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-MaleEvenToned|MaleEvenToned]]. Most of the possible NPCs are elves, but not all. In total, there are 57 possible NPCs. Locate the NPC and speak with them to obtain the item required, which will be a piece of [[Skyrim:Jewelry|jewelry]]. Return to Sergius to complete the quest and be rewarded. You will be rewarded with a leveled amount of gold for the delivery of the item.

==Notes==
*After the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] quest [[Skyrim:Hard Answers|Hard Answers]], [[Skyrim:Aicantar|Aicantar]] may stay in [[Skyrim:Calcelmo's Tower|Calcelmo's Tower]] and not leave. In this case, the dialogue option to accept the item from him will not be available. If you try and pickpocket him, he is not carrying the item. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Travel to [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] to speak with [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] about work.
# Clear out the beast invading a citizen of Skyrim's home or shop.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Job===
Once you have completed the  [[Skyrim:Take Up Arms|Take Up Arms]] quest, you can begin work as a Companion. As one of the group's leaders, Aela the Huntress will allocate jobs to those looking for work. When you approach Aela she will inform you that: ''"A citizen of <a location in Skyrim> has asked for our help. It seems a predator has invaded their <home, shop, farm>, and someone needs to clear the beast out."''
Accept the job and your journal will be updated with the location and the type of predator you need to exterminate.

Skyrim:A Chance Arrangement.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=SerCenKing |checkedBy=Socratides |reward=SerCenKing |rewardChecked=Socratides }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] |Reward=100 Gold |Disp= |Rep= |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Taking Care of Business|Taking Care of Business]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] |Image=SR-quest-A_Chance_Arrangement.jpg |ImgDesc=Brynjolf trying to sell his elixir |description=Help teach [[Skyrim:Brand-Shei|a merchant]] to mind his own business. |ID=TG00 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]]. #Steal [[Skyrim:Madesi's Silver Ring|Madesi's Silver Ring]]. #Plant Madesi's Silver Ring ''or'' drop Madesi's Ring and speak to Brynjolf. #Speak to Brynjolf. ==Detailed Walkthrough== When you come across a merchant named [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] at the [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] bazaar during the day or in [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|The Bee and Barb]] at night, he will propose that you frame a vendor by planting a stolen ring on his person. The intended victim, [[Skyrim:Brand-Shei|Brand-Shei]], has apparently become aware that someone is doing something wrong, and that someone wants him in jail where he can't interfere. If you accept, Brynjolf will tell you that he will create a distraction in the bazaar. While this draws people's attention, you are to steal a ring from [[Skyrim:Madesi|Madesi]]. Madesi keeps the ring in a strongbox inside the cabinet under the counter of his stall, both of which are locked. You can unlock the cabinet and strongbox at night for an easier theft, or simply pickpocket Madesi's key off of him. Then, wait until after 4pm to actually steal the ring. Note that the ring you must steal will specifically say "Madesi's Silver Ring," rather than just any silver ring. After stealing the ring, sneak up to Brand-Shei and position yourself behind the crates he is sitting on. [[Skyrim:Pickpocket#2|Pickpocket]] him and place the ring in his inventory. If you wish to spare Brand-Shei, you can drop the ring instead and tell Brynjolf you lost it. He won't be very happy, but you will be able to proceed to the next quest nonetheless. This quest can also be completed without stealing and pickpocketing by simply waiting while Brynjolf distracts the crowd. If you do attempt the theft and are caught by a wandering guard, you will be arrested. In either case, you will still be able to progress to the next quest. Speak to Brynjolf to receive a reward of 100 septims and a chance to join the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]]. ==Notes== *No matter what you do, Brynjolf will still approach you, meaning that if you do not intend to do the Thieves Guild, the quest will always be in your journal. **Using the forge next to the market before Brynjolf approaches you will cause him to ask you his opening question a few times while you are in the smithing animation and then walk away, after which he will not approach you again, which will prevent the quest from being added to your journal. *As soon as Brynjolf informs you of his plan you will receive a hidden perk increasing your pickpocketing chances by 30%, which makes planting the ring significantly easier. The perk will be removed once the quest is complete. *If you are caught, Madesi's Silver Ring can be found afterwards in the evidence chest in Riften Jail. *After this quest is completed successfully, you may find Brand-Shei in the castle dungeon. You can talk to him and receive his [[Skyrim:Distant Memories|identity quest]] from there if you did not receive it before. *After this quest is completed, there is a 20% chance of encountering a thief in [[SR:Riverwood|Riverwood]] and [[SR:Riften|Riften]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Leaving Riften during this quest could prevent the quest from progressing.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|Brand-Shei becomes imprisoned in Riften Jail forever, instead of just for a week.|USKP|1.0}} **{{Pc22}} Fixed by entering the following in the console: set TG00BrandSheiJail to 0. The next time Brand-Shei's schedule is updated, he will leave jail and resume his original schedule. Force him to update his schedule right away by selecting him in the console (or entering prid 19DDC) and then entering evp. {{Bug|If you speak to Maul after speaking to Brynjolf and pick the conversational option ''"Know anything about the Thieves Guild?"'', the miscellaneous quest ''"Talk to Brynjolf about joining the Thieves Guild"'' may become stuck in your quest list.|USKP|1.3.2}} **{{Pc22}} In the console, enter setstage TG00MaulHandler 200 to remove the entry. {{Bug|Brynjolf can comment about you sniffing out his scheme at the north Riften gate even if you never actually entered the city that way.|USKP|2.0.9}} {{Bug|If you steal Madesi's Silver Ring from the strongbox before speaking to Brynjolf to initiate the quest, the ring may disappear from the strongbox without appearing in your inventory. But if you then return to the strongbox during the distraction Brynjolf makes, both the door concealing the box and the box itself will still be unlocked, and the ring will again be in the box, allowing you to steal it once more and proceed with the quest.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=TG00 Maul Handler |id=TG00MaulHandler |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Brynjolf about joining the Thieves Guild}} |!|A Chance Arrangement|TG00 |8||Brynjolf in Riften seems to be involved in some nefarious activities and has convinced me to take part in one of his schemes. {{Quest Objective|8|Meet Brynjolf during daytime}} |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Steal Madesi's Ring}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Plant Madesi's Ring}} |30||{{Quest Comment|reverse pickpocket succeeded}} {{Quest Objective|30|Speak to Brynjolf}} |35||{{Quest Comment|reverse pickpocket failed}} {{Quest Objective|30|Speak to Brynjolf}} |40||{{Quest Comment|player took too long/left area}} {{Quest Objective|30|Speak to Brynjolf}} |200|fin|Brynjolf's scheme in Riften has ended and the promise of more coin has been made. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=58.163.175.170 |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Trail2|Quests|Daedric|link2=Daedric Quests}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Barbas|Barbas]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:The Rueful Axe|The Rueful Axe]] or
[[Skyrim:Masque of Clavicus Vile|The Masque of Clavicus Vile]] |Disp= |Prev= |Conc= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], [[Skyrim:Haemar's Shame|Haemar's Shame]], [[Skyrim:Rimerock Burrow|Rimerock Burrow]] |Image=SR-quest-A Daedra's Best Friend.jpg |ImgDesc=The Shrine of Clavicus Vile |description=Help [[Skyrim:Barbas|Barbas]] reunite with his [[Lore:Clavicus Vile|master]]. |ReqLevel=10 |ID=DA03 |Icon=SR-qico-Daedric.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Lod|Lod]] in [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. #Track down [[Skyrim:Barbas|Barbas]]. #Travel with Barbas to [[Skyrim:Haemar's Shame|Haemar's Shame]]. #Retrieve the [[Skyrim:The Rueful Axe|Rueful Axe]] for [[Skyrim:Clavicus Vile|Clavicus Vile]]. #Give the Rueful Axe to Clavicus Vile ''or'' kill Barbas. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Man's Best Friend=== [[File:SR-quest-A Daedra's Best Friend 05.jpg|thumb|right|A stray dog outside Falkreath]] Once you reach the required level, a trip to [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]] will net you an encounter with a [[Skyrim:Falkreath Guard|guard]] asking a rather unusual question, namely if you have seen a stray dog running around outside town. Regardless of your answer, he will then point you to the local blacksmith, [[Skyrim:Lod|Lod]], who can be found working his smithy during the day. When approached Lod will only show interest in one specific dog, a 'fine, strong creature that's been wandering near town', that he would like for you to catch for him. You can either accept his request to chase down the dog or pass an always successful [[Skyrim:Speech#Impossible_to_Fail|Speech check]] to persuade him to pay you part of the gold up-front for your efforts. In either case, Lod will give you some [[Skyrim:Food#Fresh Meat|fresh meat]] for bait. Travel along the road a short distance southwest of town. A dog will approach and enthusiastically address you, saying ''"You are exactly what I was looking for"''. He will introduce himself as [[Skyrim:Barbas|Barbas]] and will ask for your help. Choose the second dialogue option for a bit of background explanation. Barbas will describe a falling-out that he had with his master, and says that he needs someone who can settle the disagreement. Taunting Barbas will make him reveal his master to be Daedric Prince [[Skyrim:Clavicus Vile|Clavicus Vile]], who governs over bargains. You agree to arbitrate this disagreement and Barbas tells you that Vile is probably close to a cult of worshippers living near [[Skyrim:Haemar's Shame|Haemar's Shame]]. Barbas will then be on his way towards this cavern, and you will have to follow him on a long journey. Note that traveling with Barbas can be avoided by postponing his request during the second set of dialogue responses; select "You were looking for me?" followed by "I've got things to do". This will make Barbas travel to Haemar's Shame alone. You can then make your way to the shrine when you are ready. If you haven't discovered Haemar's Shame, you can travel to [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]] and head east for a relatively uneventful trip. If you choose this option, you can [[#Haemar's Shame|skip the next section]]. ===A Long Journey=== Haemar's Shame is located a long way from [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], at the foot of the [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]], straight east from the ruined town of [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]]. Following Barbas can be difficult as Barbas tends to get lost on occasion, so keep an eye on the map marker. The first distraction comes when you and Barbas face an unmarked bridge guarded by [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]], just west of Falkreath. Barbas cannot be killed because he is invulnerable, so just fight the opposition and keep an eye on the dog, who may wander off. Follow Barbas past [[Skyrim:Pinewatch|Pinewatch]] and up the mountain towards Helgen. The trip goes through the destroyed town, now occupied by bandits, so help Barbas fight them. When all is said and done, Barbas will open the eastern gate himself and continue towards the Throat of the World. When you finally reach Haemar's Shame, Barbas will enter right away so follow him inside. ===Haemar's Shame=== Clavicus Vile obviously suffered the same fate as many other daedric princes, and his shrine is now hidden away in a damp tomb. His worshipers consist of leveled [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampires]] who will protect the shrine with their lives. The first room offers an enemy guarding the wooden structure and a chest. Barbas will run ahead, so you will likely be on your own. Take the eastern tunnel and beware of the [[Skyrim:Traps#Spike_Wall|spike wall]] trap ahead. The next chamber contains a campfire and a charred [[Skyrim:Creatures#Skeever|skeever]] guarded by two vampires. Dispose of them and investigate the wooden structure for an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] and another chest. Take the only available tunnel to a chamber in two levels, with several enemies to fight. Take a detour to the southern chamber for some loot, and examine the table on your way down for the [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Response to Bero's Speech|Response to Bero's Speech]]'', then pick the northern tunnel and exit Haemar's Cavern. [[File:SR-quest-A Daedra's Best Friend 02.jpg|thumb|right|Barbas curing vampirism!]] In the next zone, Haemar's Shame, head through the tunnel and kill the residing [[Skyrim:Creatures#Frostbite Spider|frostbite spider]]. An [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] can be found in the next room, along with a soul gem and common books. Head downstream and fight the opposition until you reach the Shrine of [[Skyrim:Clavicus Vile|Clavicus Vile]], guarded by a boss-leveled vampire. Evident by his barking, Barbas will already be there, busy fighting the boss. After the fight, Barbas will sit in front of the statue with nothing to say but the occasional ''"Woof"''. Head up to the statue, activate it, and ask Clavicus Vile if you can make a request. He'll agree to hear it by saying, ::Clavicus Vile: ''"By all means, let's hear it. It's the least I could do, since you already helped me grant one final wish for my last worshipers... They were suffering so from vampirism, and begged me for a cure. Then you came and ended their misery! I couldn't have planned it better myself. So, what's your heart's desire? What kind of deal can we strike?"'' If you mention Barbas, he will deny the request but then equivocate. ::Clavicus Vile:''"Ugh. That insufferable pup? Forget it. Request denied. No deal. I'm glad to be rid of him. Even if it does mean I'm stuck in this pitiful shrine, in the back end of... nowhere. Well... perhaps there is a way he could earn his place back at my side. Maybe. But no promises."'' You can also ask for an end to the Civil War in Skyrim to which Clavicus will reply, ''"Oh, if I had my full power, granting that would be trivial. I'd simply snap my fingers, and everyone in Skyrim would die. War resolved."'' You can also ask for power to which Clavicus will reply, ''"Really? Power? You're a dragonborn; you already have more power than most people who aren't immense fire-breathing monsters."'' or ''"Really? Power? Haven't you already killed enough of your foes using the more mundane means at your disposal? Swords, magic, etc.? How...uninspired."'', depending on whether or not you have completed [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]]. Clavicus will conclude the last two options with: ''"As much as I hate to say it, you're almost as powerful as I am right now. But that's just because half of my power resides in that mutt, Barbas. Come to think of it, I know of a win-win situation for both of us."'' Whatever option you pick, Clavicus is only interested in one thing, the [[Skyrim:The Rueful Axe|Rueful Axe]], an axe powerful enough for Clavicus to have ''"quite a bit of fun"''. Clavicus will reveal that the axe is located in [[Skyrim:Rimerock Burrow|Rimerock Burrow]] and will ask you to take Barbas with you. Talking to Barbas will provide a bit of background information on the axe: ::Barbas: ''"One of Clavicus's little jests. A wizard named [[Skyrim:Sebastian Lort|Sebastian Lort]] had a daughter who worshiped Hircine. When the daughter became a werewolf it drove Sebastian over the edge. He couldn't stand to see his little girl take on such a bestial form. The wizard wished for the ability to end his daughter's curse. Clavicus gave him an axe."'' ===Rimerock Burrow=== [[File:SR-quest-A Daedra's Best Friend 04.jpg|thumb|right|Barbas throws himself at Sebastian Lort]] Rimerock Burrow is located on the hillside in the northwest corner of the map and can be tricky to find, especially if you approach it from the wrong angle. Take the road leading south from [[Skyrim:Lost Echo Cave|Lost Echo Cave]] and follow it as it twists and turns. At the crossroads, take the snowy path leading northwest and you will get straight to the entrance. You can also take the ferry from [[Sr:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] to [[Sr:Icewater Jetty|Icewater Jetty]], then travel southeast and scale the cliff side until you reach the entrance. Once inside, you will encounter a hostile [[Skyrim:Daedra|leveled atronach]], presumably created by [[Skyrim:Sebastian Lort|Sebastian Lort]] as an extra guardian. Sebastian himself can be found in the next room, equally hostile and will not hesitate to use his [[Skyrim:Conjuration|conjuration]] spells. After the battle, claim the [[Skyrim:The Rueful Axe|Rueful Axe]] from the table and examine the room for a bit of loot, an [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] and the Conjuration [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:2920,_Hearth_Fire,_v9|2920, Hearth Fire, v9]]'' on Sebastian's nightstand in the following room. It is now time to return to Clavicus Vile in Haemar's Shame. ===Put Him Out of Our Misery!=== [[File:SR-quest-A Daedra's Best Friend 03.jpg|thumb|right|Barbas at Clavicus Vile's statue]] Back at Haemar's Shame, the map marker will point towards the cavern entrance, which will force you to travel through the entire cave system once again. To circumvent this, from the fast travel point, head west up the road until the path bends. A pine is growing on the left, against the mountain wall; the back entrance is behind this tree below the top of the tree. Reaching the back entrance is fairly easy. If you reach the first piled-up set of rocks on the left, you've gone too far. Note that this only works if you previously opened the spike gate by pulling the chain behind Clavicus Vile's statue. Otherwise, the gate will be closed and you will not be able to access the room. Inside the cavern, Barbas will once again sit in front of his master. When approached, Clavicus Vile has one final prank to play and will give you a choice: you can keep the Rueful Axe if you use it to kill Barbas. The dog will understandably jump up and try to tell you that it is not the only option available. Speak to Barbas and Clavicus Vile for further elaboration and make a decision. Kill Barbas and keep the Rueful Axe, or hand the axe to Clavicus Vile and receive his true daedric artifact, namely the [[Skyrim:Masque of Clavicus Vile|Masque of Clavicus Vile]]. Note that both items are unique, but only the Masque of Clavicus Vile counts towards the [[Skyrim:Achievements|Oblivion Walker]] achievement, so it is recommended to keep Barbas alive. Regardless of your choice, Barbas and Clavicus Vile will be reunited and you will receive your reward. Finally, return to [[Skyrim:Lod|Lod]] in Falkreath for a small amount of gold and his gratitude. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * You may choose not to complete this quest in order to instead keep Barbas as an invincible follower. * Alternatively, you can complete the quest without ever traveling with Barbas. To do this, don't follow him to Haemar's Shame but let him get there on his own. After accepting the task from Vile, tell Barbas to stop following you. * If you go through Haemar's Shame without Barbas following you, he will have teleported in, and will already be waiting in front of the Shrine of Clavicus Vile by the time you get there. * You can receive the gold reward from Lod after speaking with Barbas for the first time, rather than waiting until the quest is finished. * Prior to the quest, a leveled conjurer will inhabit [[Skyrim:Rimerock Burrow|Rimerock Burrow]]. When the quest is started, that conjurer will be renamed Sebastian Lort. * With the appropriate dialogue choices, Clavicus Vile will begrudgingly admit that without Barbas, he would be no more powerful than the Dragonborn, adding that giving you more power would be redundant. * If you spare Barbas, Clavicus will comment on the request you made with him. ** If your request was to reunite him with Barbas, Clavicus's response will be ''"It's a shame you wished for something so dull as me taking back the mutt. Quite the lack of imagination on your part. A lack of ambition like that really ought to be punished. Perhaps by turning you into a worm, or a few decades of..."'' ** If your request was to end the war, Clavicus's response will be ''"Now, as for your wish... An end to the war, was it? I'll make sure this war ends, all right. Just as soon as dragons swarm across Skyrim and wipe out all of you puny..."'' ** If your request was for power, Clavicus's response will be ''"Now, as for your wish... Power, was it? You can be part of a tremendous power - all you have to do is let your soul be absorbed by this axe. I never said it would be your power..."'' *** Regardless of your request, Clavicus gives you the Masque and says ''"Oh, fine. Have my boon and be done with it. Got more interesting deals to make, anyway."'' * It is possible to obtain both artifacts. Near the boss chest above the shrine, activate the shrine and begin the ending dialogue. When it comes time to choose between the items, choose to forfeit the Axe and get the Masque. Exit dialogue immediately and race behind you to the cave exit. It is highly recommended that [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] be used to increase your odds of success. Once outside, quickly fast travel to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and enter [[Skyrim:Breezehome|Breezehome]], placing the Axe on a weapon rack. You'll soon receive the Masque and the quest will be completed, and the Rueful Axe will also be available. * If you and Barbas encounter any [[Skyrim:Vigilant of Stendarr|Vigilants of Stendarr]], they will attack him on sight. Unfortunately, since Barbas is invulnerable, they will perish. *The quest is reminiscent of Oblivion’s [[Oblivion:Clavicus Vile|Clavicus Vile]] Daedric Quest, during which you can get either a powerful weapon or his visage as a reward. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Returning to Haemar's Shame after finishing the quest can cause the game to crash.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|If Lod is dead, guards may still direct you to speak with him.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|If you decide not to kill Barbas, and talk to him before he gets turned into stone, the whole statue of Clavicus Vile will disappear and Barbas will remain in the room forever. He will no longer follow you or respond to you in any way but remains stuck in your party restricting your ability to recruit any dog companions thereafter.|confirmed=1|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|If you spare Barbas, the prompt to activate the shrine may still be present after the quest is finished, though activating it will do nothing.}} {{Bug|Telling Barbas to wait inside Rimerock Barrow may cause him to disappear the moment you take the axe. Use the axe to kill him and the quest will proceed as normal.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you tell Barbas to stop following you and then fast travel, he may disappear and not be where he was supposed to be when you return. This will occur even if you simply tell him to stay while at a landmark then immediately open the map and fast travel to that landmark.|confirmed=1}} ** The best way to avoid this is to simply make sure Barbas is following you before you fast travel anywhere. {{Bug|If you don't travel to Haemar's Shame with Barbas, then when you get there, he will be in the final room where Clavicus is. If the fighting causes them to go past the trigger point where the game moves you outside, you'll have to use projectiles to kill the vampires.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Persuading Lod to pay you up front does not grant experience to Speech, nor does it increase the statistics counter for successful persuasions.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Introduction |id=DA03Start |5||{{Journal Hidden|A guard outside Falkreath mentioned the Blacksmith Lod is looking for a Dog and offering a reward.}} {{Quest Objective|5|Speak to Lod}} |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Find the Dog outside Falkreath}} |20|fin| |!|A Daedra's Best Friend|DA03 |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Talk with Barbas}} |25||I ran in to a talking dog named Barbas who said he wanted my help. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Riliane |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Riliane }}{{About|the Imperial version of this mission|the Stormcloak version|A False Front (Stormcloaks)}} {{Quest Header |type=Imperial Legion |Giver=[[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] |Reward=5 gold and [[#Reward|Leveled gold]] |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)|Battle for Whiterun]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]]—Umbrella quest |Next=[[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Dunstad (Imperial)|The Battle for Fort Dunstad]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Pale Imperial Camp|Pale Imperial Camp]], [[Skyrim:Nightgate Inn|Nightgate Inn]], [[Skyrim:Candlehearth Hall|Candlehearth Hall]], [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] |Image=SR-quest-A False Front (Imperial).jpg |ImgDesc=A Stormcloak courier leaving an inn |description=Find and deliver some forged [[Skyrim:StormCloak_Documents|documents]] to the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]. |ID=CWMission03 |Icon=SR-qico-Imperial Legion.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at the [[Skyrim:Pale_Imperial_Camp|Pale Imperial Camp]]. # Find a [[Skyrim:Stormcloak_Courier|Stormcloak courier]] and take his [[Skyrim:StormCloak_Documents|documents]]. # Take the documents back to Legate Rikke. # Take the modified documents to [[Skyrim:Frorkmar Banner-Torn|Frorkmar Banner-Torn]] in [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]]. # Return to Legate Rikke. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Pale=== [[File:SR-npc-Legate_Rikke_4.jpg|thumb|right|''"One way or another, get me those documents."'']] After successfully defending [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] on behalf of the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]], the umbrella quest [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]] will start, as it is high time to conquer all remaining holds currently controlled by the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] and once and for all rid Skyrim of [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]]. Unless you used it for negotiations during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], your very first target will be to claim [[Skyrim:The Pale|the Pale]] to the north. As [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] puts it: ''"You'd be wasted as a regular soldier. I have special plans for you. You'll be of greater use to me with greater flexibility. Make your way to our hidden military camp in the Pale. Rikke will have important tasks for you, and will need you when we reclaim the capital."'' When Tullius asks you to [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim#Regain the Pale|regain the Pale]], your commander-in-chief [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] will relocate to the snowy [[Skyrim:Pale Imperial Camp|Pale Imperial Camp]] east of hold capital [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]]. Rikke will be located in the easternmost tent, busy studying a huge regional map of Skyrim. When you report for duty she will let you in on her plan to conquer the Pale: ''"I need you to deliver some false orders to the Stormcloak commander in Dawnstar. But first we need to get our hands on some rebel orders to make the forgeries."'' She will then explain that a [[Skyrim:Stormcloak Courier|Stormcloak courier]] will travel back and forth between [[Skyrim:Candlehearth Hall|Candlehearth Hall]] in Ulfric's home city [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], and [[Skyrim:Nightgate Inn|Nightgate Inn]], a remote inn between Dawnstar and Windhelm. She will then task you: ''"See if you can't 'convince' one of those innkeepers to help you. One way or another, get me those documents. But don't do anything rash if you go to Windhelm."'' Obviously, Rikke recommends the Nightgate Inn due to its remote location, but leaves the decision and strategy to you. ===The Stormcloak Courier=== Your first objective is to find the busy courier. He is quite hard to corner in the wilderness, as he will run back and forth between Candlehearth and Nightgate, and your map markers will only point to the taverns, making it hard to know where the courier is. You will have to either meet him by accident, or ask the innkeepers for his whereabouts. Some useful knowledge is displayed below: * The courier will never stay long at the inns, and will leave soon after your arrival. * The only settlement the courier passes through is [[Skyrim:Anga's Mill|Anga's Mill]]. It is possible to wait for the courier there and get the more accurate map marker. * The courier owns the second room on the left inside both inns, and will reside there if he is present. * The courier may be killed by wild animals or [[Skyrim:Viinturuth|Viinturuth]] while traveling, so if he fails to show up after a while, you'll probably have to go out and look for him yourself. As an alternative to meeting the courier and getting the map marker by chance, you can follow Rikke's advice and ask the innkeepers. Both the innkeeper of Candlehearth Hall, [[Skyrim:Elda Early-Dawn|Elda Early-Dawn]], and Nightgate's [[Skyrim:Hadring|Hadring]] have the same dialogue and they will have to be persuaded, bribed, or intimidated as they will both say: ''"I tend to keep my patrons' privacy."'' Note that you will need a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill level of 50 or above to successfully persuade the innkeepers, and that you will always get your answer when intimidating, as it is not possible to fail: {| class=wikitable ! Option ! Dialogue ! Reaction |- | ''"His life is in danger."''
'''(Persuade)'''|| '''Passed''': ''"It is? Well that's different."''
'''Failed''': ''"Yeah, sure it is. You don't fool me."''|| '''Passed''': Map marker
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | ''"Maybe some gold will help?"''
'''(Bribe)'''|| '''Passed''': ''"Well, if you insist..."''
'''Failed''': ''"Seems your purse is lighter than you thought."''|| '''Passed''': Map marker

That won't be necessary."''|| '''Passed''': Map marker |- | ''"Never mind."''|| ''"Hmph."''|| Nothing |} When you have successfully finished the persuasion, both innkeepers will now say: ''"He's in the inn. Look around. I'm sure you'll find him."'', if the courier is present, or ''"He was here, but he left. If you leave now, you can probably catch him. Or, you can just wait here. He'll be back soon enough."'' ===Retrieve the Intelligence=== [[File:SR-quest-A_False_Front_(Imperial)_03.jpg|thumb|right|The courier attacks.]] Regardless of your method of locating the courier, the map marker will now point directly to him. Regardless of what you say, or what uniform you are wearing, the Stormcloak courier will not give up the [[Skyrim:StormCloak_Documents|documents]] without a fight, with the inevitable result. When you approach the courier, you will have no options but to say: ''"I'm not here to talk. I'm here for those documents."'', and the courier will respond: ''"Is that so?"'' or ''"We'll see about that."'' The courier will then proceed to attack, leading to his inevitable death. There is only one way to avoid bloodshed: * Pickpocket the documents from the courier. This is easily done when the courier relaxes in his room at Candlehearth Hall, as no witnesses will be present. Killing the courier will always count as murder, even when done with no witnesses around (see Bugs section). However, there are a few ways to make the courier die: * When he leaves an inn, follow him into the wilderness and wait for the wildlife to kill him. * Insult him and make him follow you into the wilderness and locate some wildlife that can finish him off. Lastly, you can kill him yourself. The goal is to do it when no witnesses are around to avoid a bounty. The two methods above will always lead him into seclusion in the wilderness and work perfectly. Additionally, the courier can be stealthily killed inside his room at Candlehearth, especially if he decided to sleep. It goes without saying that Nightgate is the safest spot to achieve your goal, as Windhelm guards will be all over you if you cause a racket in their city. When the courier is dead, claim the documents from the body and head back to Legate Rikke in the camp. ===The Commander of Dawnstar=== [[File:SR-quest-A_False_Front_(Imperial)_02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Frorkmar_Banner-Torn|Frorkmar Banner-Torn]]]] When you return to Legate Rikke and hand her the documents, she will immediately start forging the documents, saying: ''"Very good... Let's see what you have here. Interesting... They know more of our plans than I expected... It would seem Fort Dunstad is in need of reinforcements... We'll make sure they won't be getting those... One moment while I 'correct' some of these documents... That should do it. Make sure those forged documents get to the Stormcloak commander in Dawnstar. It'll throw him off our trail, allowing us to maneuver more freely."'' When you arrive at [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]], follow the map marker to [[Skyrim:Frorkmar_Banner-Torn|Frorkmar Banner-Torn]], who will most likely stand near the Skyrim map inside [[Skyrim:The White Hall|The White Hall]]. When you approach him, his dialogue will differ depending on your choice of armor. If you are wearing anything but [[Skyrim:Specialty Gear#Stormcloak Equipment|Stormcloak armor]], he will get suspicious: ''"Is that so? I don't recognize you. Why aren't you wearing your Stormcloak colors?"'' You will then have to tell him it is easier to sneak past the enemy without the uniform, and he will admit: ''"I suppose it would be. Good thinking."'' He will then continue on, saying the same thing as if you were wearing Stormcloak armor: ''"All right. Let's take a look... Ah, good. Looks like the reinforcements for the fort are on the way. And we have some information about enemy troop movements as well. Excellent. It's not easy running messages, what with Imperials scouts crawling all over the place. Well done. Why don't you grab yourself a drink at the Windpeak before heading back?"'' He then hands you 5 gold as a small token of his appreciation, and the quest will end. Back in the Pale Imperial Camp, Rikke will reward you with a [[#Reward|leveled amount of gold]]. Inspired by the false information you gave to Frorkmar, she will brief you on your next mission: [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Dunstad (Imperial)|The Battle for Fort Dunstad]]. ===Reward=== {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Notes== *This quest and [[Skyrim:A False Front (Stormcloaks)|A False Front (Stormcloaks)]] are different radiant versions of the same quest. *If [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] is given to the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] then this quest will not be given to you. *After completion of this quest, like any Civil War quest under [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]], unmarked by in-game references, you can approach Legate Rikke for a [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Gold Rewards|medium leveled gold reward]]; this is not always recommended, as entering her cell sets up the next quest in the series and, if triggered improperly, causes the missing ''"Reporting for duty."'' dialogue option (see [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim#Bugs|this]] bug section). Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her. Don't approach Rikke between quests of different holds. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Killing the Stormcloak courier will count as murder, even if he attacks you first. If a nearby NPC witnesses your "murder", you will incur a bounty in the Pale or Eastmarch.|USKP|2.0.4}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Legate Rikke has sent me to intercept the Stormcloak Courier passing through the area and relieve him of his documents. I am then to return to base camp where I will receive forged documents that I, posing as an enemy courier, will deliver to the enemy commander in Dawnstar. {{Quest Objective|10|Find the Stormcloak Courier}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Retrieve the Stormcloak Courier's package}} |21||{{Quest Objective|20|Retrieve the Stormcloak Courier's package}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Bring the documents to Legate Rikke}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Bring the forged documents to Frorkmar Banner-Torn}} |50|fin| |200|fin|I have successfully intercepted Stormcloak Courier and turned in false documents to the enemy commander in Dawnstar |205|fail| |missing=0, 15, 31, 39, 51, 100, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

However, all that matters is her daughter [[Skyrim:Mila Valentia|Mila]] and no man's going to get between them. The bard [[Skyrim:Mikael|Mikael]] keeps going on about her and says he'll ''"conquer her as a true Nord conquers any harsh beast."'' You can talk to Mikael and help her deal with the trouble. Mikael can be found at the [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|Bannered Mare]], performing or resting. You may tell him to leave Carlotta Valentia alone. Then she will thank you and reward you with some gold. ====Reward==== {{SRLeveledReward|small}} ===Haran and Ranmir=== [[Skyrim:Haran|Haran]] runs [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|The Frozen Hearth]] with her husband [[Skyrim:Dagur|Dagur]] in [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. You can find her working there all day long. As a frequent visitor to the tavern, [[Skyrim:Ranmir|Ranmir]] isn't so welcome. Haran may complain to her husband: ''"How long are we going to let Ranmir drink himself into a stupor? When will enough be enough?"'' If you talk to her about Ranmir, she will tell you ''"Ranmir beg a drink from you, yet? That's gold wasted, friend."'' Although she can understand he's had some [[Skyrim:Drowned Sorrows|troubles]] in his life, she can't have him drinking here without at least paying back some of the coin he owes. Ranmir spends almost all his days drinking right in the tavern, explaining ''"Nothing to do here but drink till you forget you got nothing to do."'' If you ask him to pay Haran back for his drinks, he will be unhappy: ''"Who are you to say what I should do? I'll pay her back when I'm ready."'' Then you can choose between three options. You must pass an easy [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to persuade him. {|class=wikitable !Option !Dialogue !Reaction |- | You owe her gold. Pay it. Then she will give you a weapon and a piece of armor in return. ===Iddra and Roggi Knot-Beard=== [[Skyrim:Iddra|Iddra]] is the innkeeper of the [[Skyrim:Braidwood Inn|Braidwood Inn]] in [[Skyrim:Kynesgrove|Kynesgrove]]. She thinks highly of [[Skyrim:Roggi Knot-Beard|Roggi Knot-Beard]] as a storyteller and comments that he can keep everyone's spirits up. Although he owes Iddra a lot of coin for drinks, she keeps telling him not to worry about it. However, his "stubborn Nord blood" doesn't allow him to do so. She will eventually tell you ''"Damn fool doesn't have the coin to pay me back, so he just beats himself up over it, and then he gets thirsty, and it cycles all over again."'' If you can talk to Roggi, she'd feel better. Roggi is a miner and he can be found inside Braidwood Inn or in the mining camp nearby. If you tell him to forget about all the coin he owes, he will get a little angry: ''"What do you think I am, a beggar? My family has always paid back every single coin we owed, going back to [[Lore:Tiber Septim|Tiber Septim]]'s time."'' You need to choose between three options and must pass an easy [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to persuade him. If you have helped him before by [[Skyrim:Dungeon Delving (Caves)|retrieving his ancestral shield]] from a dungeon, he will agree with you: ''"I guess if you're telling me to stop worrying about it, maybe I should just let it go. He and his clansmen can be seen working around the Windhelm docks. Although race prejudice is quite common in this city, he wishes the Nords, Argonians and Dunmer here got along better. If you talk to him about his trouble, he will tell you something about their boss, [[Skyrim:Torbjorn Shatter-Shield|Torbjorn Shatter-Shield]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Dengeir of Stuhn===
[[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]] was once the Jarl of Falkreath but has since stepped down and is now a Thane. He is a paranoid and patriotic supporter of the Stormcloaks. He believes that [[Skyrim:Lod|Lod]] the blacksmith is writing a treasonous letter and wants you to steal it for him.

The letter is on Lod's bedside table. It is simply a note requesting extra iron. Steal it and return it to Dengeir. Dengeir will at first be confused, and then realize Lod is probably not up to treason, even if he is making extra weapons for the Empire. He will then give you a reward of leveled gold.

Completion of this quest opens up another radiant quest, [[Skyrim:Dark Ancestor|Dark Ancestor]].

===Malur Seloth===
Talking to [[Skyrim:Malur Seloth|Malur Seloth]] and asking him what he does prompts him to reveal that he doesn't really do anything. He wants to appear more mage-like when in the jarl's presence, and wishes to acquire [[Skyrim:Staff of Arcane Authority|a staff]]. 

The one he wants belongs to [[Skyrim:Nelacar|Nelacar]] who resides in the [[SR:The Frozen Hearth|inn]]. The staff is located in the shop counter in Nelacar's room. Steal it and return to Malur. He will reward you with one skill point in [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]].

===Stands-In-Shallows===
When speaking to [[Skyrim:Stands-In-Shallows|Stands-In-Shallows]], he mentions that he overheard sailors talking about their stashed [[Skyrim:Double-Distilled Skooma|extra powerful Skooma]], and he would like to get it.

The bottle is located in the [[SR:New Gnisis Cornerclub|New Gnisis Cornerclub]] in Windhelm, underneath the second set of stairs. Steal it and return to Stands-in-Shallows, who will reward you with a skill point in [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]].

==Notes==
* Only one radiant quest of a similar type can be assigned at any given time. You must clear the radiant quest from your miscellaneous quests in order to be eligible to receive another of the same type.
* Because this is a favor quest which affects the quest giver's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the [[Skyrim:Thane|thane]] quest for the quest giver's hold.
* This quest requires you to commit a [[Skyrim:Crime|crime]]; see that page for details about criminal activity.
* Malur's and Shallows' items are available to retrieve from the start of the game, while the letter Dengeir requests only gets enabled once he has mentioned it.

Due to the roving nature of his occupation he can be difficult to track down, but keep in mind that Ahkari's caravan makes stops just outside of [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] and [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. The amulet was given to him by his mother when he was a cub, and is the only thing to keep him warm in this cold land. Track down, and either slay or sneak past its bandit inhabitants to take the amulet from the boss chest at the end of the dungeon. Return to Kharjo, but be aware that he may have moved or could be on the road while you are looking for him. ===Your Reward=== Once you find him, Kharjo will be most pleased to have the Moon Amulet again. He will give you a leveled amount of gold and becomes a potential [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]]. {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Notes== *When looking for Kharjo, a good strategy is to simply use the "Wait" function outside of one of the cities where his caravan stops until he arrives. *The Moon Amulet can be safely pickpocketed, looted, or traded from Kharjo after the quest. == Bugs == {{Bug|If the quest directs you to [[Skyrim:Broken Oar Grotto|Broken Oar Grotto]], [[Skyrim:Cracked_Tusk_Keep|Cracked Tusk Keep]], or [[Skyrim:Frostmere_Crypt|Frostmere Crypt]], check to see if you have already visited these locations on your map. These locations do not respawn, so if you have been there before, the Amulet cannot spawn there and you cannot complete the quest.|USKP|2.1.0|However, there are reports that the bug may still occur even with the fix.}} **You will need to reload a previous save to get a different location from Kharjo. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Find the Moon Amulet inside }} |15||{{Quest Objective|15|Return the Moon Amulet to Kharjo}} |20|fin| |missing=200 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}
