{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Dreamshadow |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=[[User:Alphabetface|Alphabetface]] (game) |rewardChecked=[[User:RobinHood70|RobinHood70]] (CK) }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Angeline Morrard|Angeline Morrard]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Angeline's Aromatics|Angeline's Aromatics]], [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] |Reward= |Difficulty=Easy |Image=SR-quest-No News is Good News.jpg |Imgdesc=''"Have you been to Whiterun?"'' |description=Find out about the fate of [[Skyrim:Angeline Morrard|Angeline Morrard]]'s daughter from [[Skyrim:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]]. |ID=SolitudeFreeform01 |Disp= =1 ([[SR:Angeline Morrard|Angeline Morrard]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Angeline Morrard|Angeline Morrard]] in [[Skyrim:Angeline's Aromatics|Angeline's Aromatics]]. #Get some news from [[Skyrim:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]]. #Return to Angeline Morrard. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Mother's Request=== [[Skyrim:Angeline Morrard|Angeline Morrard]] is the shopkeeper of [[Skyrim:Angeline's Aromatics|Angeline's Aromatics]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. In your conversation with her, she will ask you if you have been to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. If you tell her that you haven't been there before, she will be understanding and you can talk to her about it later. If you tell her that you have indeed been to Whiterun, she will become very animated. It seems her daughter, Fura, was assigned to Whiterun after she joined the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Army]] and Angeline was hoping to get some recent news about her. Although Angeline has tried contacting [[Skyrim:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]], she didn't get any information from him. If you are willing to help her get more information about her daughter, anything you can find out would be welcome. ===A Need To Know Basis=== Captain Aldis can be found training the guards in the courtyard of [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] during the day. When you tell him that Angeline sent you for information about her daughter, Aldis will respond, ''"Generally posting information is need to know only"''. Several options are available for you to continue the conversation, the fourth option is only available if you have been promoted to [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion#Ranks|Praefect]] rank in [[SR:Civil_War|Civil War]] imperial side. An easy [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] is required if you wanna persuade him to reveal Fura's fate. {|class=wikitable |- !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | I think {{sic|Angela|Angeline}} needs to know. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': I... I've been trying to find the time and place to let her know.
'''Failed''': I'm sorry, I can't help you.||'''Passed''': Return to Angeline
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Well, I'm making it "need to know." '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': If you want to know that bad then fine.
'''Failed''': I'm afraid that kind of thing doesn't work on Captains in the Imperial Army.||'''Passed''': Return to Angeline
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Fine. If that's the way you want it.||colspan=4|That's the way it is.||Nothing |- | Tell me about her daughter. That's an order, Captain.||colspan=4|Yes, Sir. Although I'm not sure you'll be happy to know.||Return to Angeline |} ===The Casualty List=== [[File:SR-quest-No News is Good News 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"She needs to be told."'']] The captain will then give you the news: ''"Her daughter was sent to Whiterun, the skirmishes there have been violent. The {{sic|whiterun|Whiterun|description=lowercase letter}} legate, he needed to know the Stormcloak positions. He sent out a party to scout the area. They happened upon a large force... I'm told none of them made it back. Private Morrard... {{sic|Angela's|Angeline's}} daughter was in that scouting party. She needs to be told"''. ===The Bearer of Bad News=== Return to Angeline Morrard with the news. Angeline is eager to hear about her daughter. She is understandably grief-stricken when you tell her the bad news: ''"I told her. I told her the {{sic|imperial|Imperial|description=lowercase letter}} army would kill her. That this was a war of Jarls and Imperial Generals and we had no part in it. She just wouldn't hear it"''. Angeline can't thank you for the news, ''"not for this"'', but she acknowledges that you have done her a service. You get no reward from her, but she will have a more friendly [[Skyrim:Disposition|disposition]] towards you and allow you to freely take many low-value items in her shop. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you have already accepted this quest before speaking with [[Skyrim:Sorex Vinius|Sorex Vinius]] he will not offer his favor quest, [[Skyrim:Delivery (Sorex)|Delivery (Sorex)]].|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|If you have completed the Stormcloak missions, especially [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], before speaking with Aldis, this quest will be impossible to finish as it would lead you to a bare area where Aldis once stood. Because of this, it is highly recommended this quest is done before finishing the Stormcloak missions.|USKP|1.0}} **{{pc22}}This can also be fixed by entering the following in the console: setstage SolitudeFreeform01 20. This will set the stage of the quest to where you have to return to Angeline, and will allow you to complete the quest. {{Bug|Captain Aldis will incorrectly refer to female characters as "sir" when he is asked about Angeline's daughter.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|You can order Captain Aldis to give you the information even if you're not of the proper rank in the Imperial Legion, or if you're not a member of the Legion at all.|USKP|2.1.2}} {{Bug|You can exit the dialogue with Captain Aldis right after Persuade/Intimidate check before advancing quest stage. Therefore it can be repeated for leveling Speech up.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Ask Aldis for information about Angeline's daughter.}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Tell Angeline what Aldis said.}} |30||{{Quest Comment|Completes quest successfully}} |200|fin|{{Quest Comment|Fails quest if stage 30 not complete}} |missing=0, 5 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

# Ask for permission to use the alchemy lab.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Recipe===
Ask any of the quest givers if you can use the [[Skyrim:Alchemy|alchemy]] lab located in their shop or inn, as the case may be. They will all consent with the same reply, ''"Long as you clean up. You know how to use it right? Mix a couple of ingredients together, see what happens. A little [[Skyrim:Wheat|Wheat]] and [[Skyrim:Blisterwort|Blisterwort]] makes a healing potion, if you didn't know. We have plenty of ingredients for sale, too."'' 
This is just a suggestion, crafting any potion will complete the quest objective, you can buy [[Skyrim:Ingredients|ingredients]] directly from the quest giver.

===Crafting the Potion===
Once your ingredients are collected, approach the alchemy lab and select at least two of them. Note that to succeed in crafting a potion, there must be at least one [[Skyrim:Alchemy Effects|alchemical effect]]  shared by at least two of the ingredients. Confirm the crafting and create a potion to complete the quest. After this, the effect will be added to the Alchemy menu if you don't have it already.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Meet [[Skyrim:Brenuin|Brenuin]] on the streets of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]].
# Go to [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] and acquire the [[Skyrim:Argonian Ale|Argonian Ale]].
# Return to Brenuin to be rewarded.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
After you give [[Skyrim:Brenuin|Brenuin]] a gold coin on the streets of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], the option to ask him if he is always drunk will become available. Ask him, and he will reply ''"Only if I can help it."'' He then asks you to bring him a special bottle of ale: ''"In [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|the Bannered Mare]], there's this bottle of [[Skyrim:Argonian Ale|Argonian Ale]]. The good stuff. Get it for me."''

The inn is in the market area of Whiterun's Plains District, where Brenuin usually pesters the stall owners outside the inn or customers inside. The ale is in the inn's kitchen (to the left from the main entrance), on the cupboard opposite the [[Skyrim:Cooking Pot|cooking spit]].

After acquiring the ale, return to Brenuin. He will thank you and reward you with a [[Skyrim:Potion of Vigorous Healing|Potion of Vigorous Healing]] that he had recently "obtained" from the [[Skyrim:Temple of Kynareth|Temple of Kynareth]], or as he puts it: ''"I, er, "found" it in the temple."''

==Notes==
* You can refuse to feed his habit when he asks you to steal the ale, though this does not lock you out of the quest as the option still remains to discuss his sobriety later.
* Alternatively, the ale can be obtained by raising the disposition of the innkeeper [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]]. This can be done by chopping wood outside the inn and selling it to her. Her disposition will then be high enough that she allows you to take low-value items from the inn without it being theft. This includes the bottle of Argonian Ale. The amount of wood given to Hulda does not matter; her disposition will be raised even if you sold just one piece.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Andurs|Andurs]] in the Hall of the Dead.
# Retrieve [[Skyrim:Andurs' Amulet of Arkay|Andurs' Amulet of Arkay]].
# Return the amulet to Andurs.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===His Badge of Office===
[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun's]] [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Whiterun)|Hall of the Dead]] is overseen by [[Skyrim:Andurs|Andurs]], priest of [[Lore:Arkay|Arkay]]. When you first meet Andurs he will ask if you believe in Arkay and his sway over life and death. This is an opening gambit which he uses to determine how best to persuade you to retrieve his [[Skyrim:Andurs' Amulet of Arkay|amulet]], which he left behind in the [[Skyrim:Whiterun Catacombs|catacombs]]. Andurs assures you that he would get it himself, however, strange noises are now coming from the catacombs and he fears the restless dead.

===The Restless Dead===
Ready yourself for a fight and enter the catacombs. You will encounter a few [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]], who are immune to poison and paralysis, and resistant to frost. When you move forward, quickly turn to your right, as the first skeleton stands in wait here. Dispatch it as quickly as you can, because a second skeleton, who stands at the bottom of the stairs here, will rush to its aid. After this, there is a third and final skeleton behind the closed door to the left of the entrance. If you were unable to quickly kill the first two, then it may have already detected you and emerged to try and flank you. 

===Amulet of Arkay===
Follow the stairs down by the second skeleton and go through the door; the amulet lies next to a wreath on the right-hand table. Before you leave, head to the base of the other set of stairs, and locate the [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|Unusual Gem]] in one of the alcoves. This gem is related to the quest [[Skyrim:No Stone Unturned|No Stone Unturned]]. Ascend the stairs and enter the room where the third skeleton stood; a copy of the [[Skyrim:Block|Block]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Death Blow of Abernanit|Death Blow of Abernanit]]'' can be found on one of the tables.

Return to Andurs and hand him the amulet. He will be very grateful... and reward you with 15 gold.

==Notes== 
* If you don't have the amulet when you speak to Andurs to return it, e.g. because it's still in the inventory of your (former) follower, you can still finish the quest. The amulet will disappear from the follower's inventory and appear in Andurs'.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|If you already have an Amulet of Arkay when you begin the quest, you will not be able to complete it. To avoid triggering the bug, make sure you drop any existing Amulets of Arkay before you pick up the quest version. Just complete the quest and go back to where you dropped them and pick them back up again.|OSP|1.5}}
{{Bug|Even if you finish the quest, everything in the Hall of the Dead may still be marked as owned.}}

Skyrim:The Straw that Broke.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Likelolwhat }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]] |Reward=Random rare [[Skyrim:Ingredients|Ingredients]] |Image=SR-quest-The Straw that Broke.jpg |Imgdesc=''"You live among the clouds now, dear Reyda!"'' |description=Discover what is plaguing [[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]]'s mind. |ID=FreeformIvarstead02 |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Discover what is plaguing [[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]]'s mind. # Find [[Skyrim:Reyda's Necklace|Reyda's Necklace]]. # Return the necklace to Narfi. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Grief=== When you visit [[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]] in [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], you will quickly find that all is not well with him. Narfi lives in his parents' broken-down house across the river from the lumber mill. When speaking to him, you will notice that he has a mental disability and is very distraught over the disappearance of his sister, Reyda. He will mention that [[Skyrim:Wilhelm|Wilhelm]], the innkeeper at [[Skyrim:Vilemyr Inn|Vilemyr Inn]], told him Reyda would come back, and that he needs to say goodbye to his sister like he did his mother and father. ===Pity=== When speaking to Wilhelm, he will tell you that Narfi is harmless, but in a state since his sister disappeared. Wilhelm, meaning well, told Narfi his sister would return one day, but actually fears Reyda was killed while searching for [[Skyrim:Ingredients|ingredients]] from the river. He will point you in the direction of the small island to the east of Ivarstead, where you can then go look for Narfi's sister. There is a small barrow dungeon on that island, [[Skyrim:Geirmund's Hall|Geirmund's Hall]], and it seems like the obvious place to start. ===Truth=== Though Wilhelm's supposition about Reyda's fate turns out to be correct his directions are inaccurate. Reyda's remains are not at the island, but can be found underwater just east of the southern bridge into town. Due to the current they may be difficult to access. Next to her remains are [[Skyrim:Reyda's Necklace|her necklace]] and a [[Skyrim:Satchel|satchel]]; the satchel contains some gold and several random alchemical ingredients. Return the necklace to Narfi. You can tell him the truth about what happened to Reyda, or assure him she will come back. In either case, you will receive three random, rare ingredients, and Narfi will, for the most part, remain the same. ==Notes== * Narfi is the victim of the Dark Brotherhood quest [[Skyrim:Kill Narfi|Kill Narfi]]. Once you accept the assassin quest, it will be impossible to complete the Reyda quest successfully. ** To complete both the Dark Brotherhood quest and the miscellaneous quest after accepting the contract from Nazir, you can use the console command "setstage DBsidecontract01 20" to be able to speak to Narfi about his sister. This will mark that you have killed Narfi while he is still alive, but you can simply kill him after completing his side quest to set you back on track, or use the console command "setstage DBsidecontract01 10" to set you back to the step where you have access to the relevant dialogue and must kill Narfi to continue. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you show Reyda's necklace to Wilhelm, his reaction is exactly the same as Narfi's: ''"Reyda! You saw Reyda? Did you tell her Narfi cries? Did you tell her Narfi never said goodbye like mother and father?"''|USKP|1.2.5}} **Special Edition seems to have patched this. The dialogue option is no longer present. This might only apply to Xbox. {{Bug|If you take the necklace from Reyda's satchel before asking Wilhelm about Narfi, the quest will not update beyond the stage requiring you to find her remains even if you search the satchel again.|USKP|1.3.2}} ** {{pc22}} The command setstage FreeformIvarstead02 40 will do the work. ** Dropping and retaking the necklace using the console command player.drop 663da 1 while standing over the underwater satchel causes a quest update, fixing the quest. {{Bug|Narfi may quit dialogue without giving you a chance to tell him about Reyda's fate and finish the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Going straight to Reyda's corpse after accepting the quest instead of talking to Wilhelm will leave the log entry about asking Wilhelm in your miscellaneous quests tab even after the quest, and Wilhelm will have no topic about Reyda should you visit later. The only way to fix this is by returning the quest to an earlier stage by using the command setstage FreeformIvarstead02 20 and redoing the quest in proper sequence.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|[[File:Flag Germany.png|22px]] Reyda's name is frequently misspelled as Rayda in the German translations of Narfi's dialogue.}} {{Bug|Completing this quest would make Narfi unavailable to become a [[SR:farmhand|farmhand]]{{CC|Farming}}.|confirmed=1}} ** Recruiting him to be a farmhand first is a workaround. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Ask Wilhelm about Reyda}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Locate Reyda's remains}} |40||{{Quest Objective|30|Bring Reyda's Necklace to Narfi}} |200|fin| |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

=-1 ([[Skyrim:Sven|Sven]]), =2 ([[Skyrim:Faendal|Faendal]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # ''(Optional)'' Learn about the love triangle from the townspeople. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Sven|Sven]] or [[Skyrim:Faendal|Faendal]] about the love triangle. #* ''(Optional)'' Talk to the other man involved in the love triangle (Sven if you talked to Faendal first or vice versa). # Give the letter to [[Skyrim:Camilla Valerius|Camilla Valerius]]. # Return to the man you decided to help to finish the quest. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Triangle=== When you visit the small town of Riverwood, the local beauty, Camilla Valerius, has sparked the interest of two bachelors in town. The local bard, Sven, and the Wood Elf hunter Faendal, are both vying for Camilla's favor; and will resort to slander and libel to win it. ===What a Tangled Web We Weave=== If you approach Sven first, at the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]], you will come to know of his love for Camilla, and about his suspicions about Faendal's involvement in her life. Sven will then ask you for a favor: deliver a [[Skyrim:Sven's Fake Letter from Faendal|fake letter]] supposedly written by Faendal to Camilla, seemingly breaking things off with her due to her being an Imperial, and him a proud Bosmer. You may also speak to Faendal first. He can be found chopping wood near the lumber mill or wandering the village. Faendal also has feelings for Camilla and a desire to see Sven out of the picture. He asks you to deliver his own [[Skyrim: Faendal's Fake Letter from Sven|fake letter]] designed to disrupt Sven's wooing by outlining out the household chores he has planned for Camilla. With either letter, you can go straight to Camilla, or show the supposed letter to the other man, prompting them to hand over their own forged letter for you to deliver. ===When We Practice to Deceive=== When you decide who you want to help, either Sven or Faendal, deliver the letter to Camilla. Camilla is usually at the [[Skyrim:Riverwood Trader|Riverwood Trader]], but at night she can sometimes be found at the Sleeping Giant Inn. When you talk to Camilla, you have two ways of proceeding. You can lie to her and give her the forged letter as is, or tell her the truth about the ruse. In either case, she will effectively break off her interactions with the loser. Speak with the winner to collect your reward. ==Notes== *It is not possible to complete this quest in a manner that has both Sven and Faendal become available as followers and have their dispositions friendly towards you. *Despite the events of this quest, Camilla is also a [[Skyrim:Marriage|marriage candidate]] for you, and can be married once her disposition is increased, such as by completing the quest [[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|The Golden Claw]]. However, this does not in any way alter the events or dialogue of this quest, and all participants will act as if Camilla is still available. If Camilla relocates to one of your houses, and you helped one man win her over, his programming will still have him seek her out even at your house. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If this quest is still running when marrying Camilla, it is still possible to finish it by delivering the letter on behalf of one or the other even though this scene no longer makes sense to allow.|USLEEP|3.0.1|Marrying Camilla while the quest is still active will now cause it to fail.}} {{Bug|Orgnar may still mention the love triangle after the quest is finished.|USSEP|4.2.6}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Deliver Faendal's letter to Camilla}} {{Quest Objective|20|(Optional) Tell Sven about Faendal's letter}} |20||{{Quest Objective|110|Deliver Sven's letter to Camilla}} |110||{{Quest Objective|110|Deliver Sven's letter to Camilla}} {{Quest Objective|120|(Optional) Tell Faendal about Sven's letter}} |120||{{Quest Objective|10|Deliver Faendal's letter to Camilla}} |210||{{Quest Objective|210|Talk to Faendal}} |220||{{Quest Objective|220|Talk to Sven}} |230||{{Quest Objective|220|Talk to Sven}} |240||{{Quest Objective|210|Talk to Faendal}} |missing=0, 5, 7, 105, 107, 200, 310, 320 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

The Companions tradition of service dates back to the mercenary aid given to [[Skyrim:Ysgramor|Ysgramor]] by the Five Hundred Companions. Since then the Companions have served as a group of impartial and independent contractors, helping out commoner and jarl alike in matters of might, but taking no sides nor making any alliances themselves. ===The Extermination Job=== Locate Aela in [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]]. She has received a request from one of the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarls]] that an [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Animal Dens|animal den]] in their Hold be cleared of nuisance beasts. When you speak to Aela to ask for work she will reply, ''"The Jarl of has asked for our help. It seems that predators have taken up residence and have been attacking farmers and travelers. Someone's got to head out there and take care of the beasts."'' When you reply that you can take care of it, Aela will respond with either words of encouragement or caution: ''"I knew we could count on you. Get it taken care of right away. Nobody wants an animal left roaming around in their place."'' '''or''' ''"Be cautious. Beasts are not nearly as predictable as men. Give the thing a quick death."'' As she sends you on your way your journal will reflect your new quest and your map will update with the beast den location. As this is a radiant quest, the boss-type beast will be in any of these 17 locations: {{Hold List |eastmarch={{LinkList|Cragslane Cavern|Gallows Rock|Lost Knife Hideout|Stony Creek Cave|Uttering Hills Camp|Cronvangr Cave|Refugees' Rest||sep=

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Enter [[Skyrim:Angarvunde|Angarvunde]] and speak to [[Skyrim:Medresi Dran|Medresi Dran]].
#Kill three [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] in the main chamber.
#Return to Medresi.
#Follow Medresi.
#Enter Angarvunde Catacombs to open the gate.
#Enter Angarvunde Ruins to open the gate.
#Follow Medresi into the treasure chamber.
#Discover Angarvunde's treasure.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Angarvunde===

Upon entering [[Skyrim:Angarvunde|Angarvunde]], you will encounter [[Skyrim:Medresi Dran|Medresi Dran]] complaining about her cowardly work force who fled as soon as they encountered some [[Skyrim:Undead|undead]]. Until the path is clear, Medresi is unable to reach the treasure she seeks. If you offer to assist her, she will in turn offer to split the treasure with you. 

First, Medresi needs the three leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] cleared from the main chamber. Head down the ramp from Medresi and follow a short corridor; the main chamber is the first large room you come across. Kill the three draugr here and make your way back to Medresi, who will be walking down towards you.

Tell her that the draugr are dead, and she will race off to the main chamber. Follow her to the locked gate at the far side of the chamber. Talk to her, and she will give you a key that will open the doors to the sides of the main chamber.

Head up the ramp on the southeast wall of the chamber and open the door to the Catacombs.

===Angarvunde Catacombs===
Follow the path downwards until you reach a broken spiral staircase leading further down. Drop down here, listen to a patrolling draugr to time it when he isn't right there. There is a burial urn next to a broken chair. Follow the path still further down and you will encounter another Draugr in the wide corridor. There is also a trapped chest up the stairs to the left.

Another draugr awaits when you turn the corner to the left. There is a bookcase on your left with clutter and a burial urn. You will then encounter a group of four as you follow the corridor into the burial crypt, one is roaming and the other three are upright in alcoves asleep. There is also a locked chest and a random potion. The corridor will open out into an overgrown cavern containing a single draugr, four giant Canis Roots and an unlocked chest, behind the first Canis Root on your left as you enter you will find a Corundun vein as part of the wall. Exit this cavern to the left, in front of you is a random potion, continue following the path. Watch for the [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart trap]] on the floor halfway up the stairs, past a burial urn on your left. There is another dart trap halfway up the second set of stairs. Both traps are easily avoided by waiting for the darts to stop and neither seemed to reset. You can use the second trap to your advantage dealing with the draugr which is patrolling here.

You will emerge in yet another overgrown cavern containing two draugr. after turning the corner to the right on the top alcove of the second set of alcoves on the left is a petty soul gem, and just after this on the same side are three burial urns. Turn to the left and the last alcove on the left before the stairs is another burial urn. Half way up the stairs there are a couple more burial urns. Several draugr may awake from their slumber here, so be careful. Make your way through the next two large burial chambers and you will reach the door back to Angarvunde. Just before the door there is an urn on the right and a corner table on the left with a random potion and Wraith's Wedding Dowry book. 

Head straight to the end of the corridor, past a couple of urns and an unlocked chest and pull the lever. The spikes to your left will lower, allowing you back into the main chamber and opening the first gate. Head up the stairs on the northwest side of the main chamber to access Angarvunde Ruins.

===Angarvunde Ruins===
Follow the winding corridor down two flights of stairs. Directly at the foot of these stairs is a corridor containing four [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|trap triggers]] on the floor, which will release [[SR:Swinging Blades|swinging blades]] if activated. The next room contains a solitary draugr, and iron door concealing a couple of standard burial urns, and a number of paths blocked off by spikes. There is also a copy of the [[SR:Illusion|Illusion]] [[SR:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Before the Ages of Man|Before the Ages of Man]]'' on the table. There is also a locked chest behind the table in the corner.

Continue through the only available path into a two-leveled chamber containing two draugr. Follow the upper pathway around to the right and jump across the crumbled bridge to reach a [[Skyrim:Weak Magicka Poison|magicka poison]] on a [[Skyrim:Weight Sensitive Plate|pedestal]]—be warned, though, that this will release a [[Skyrim:Spear Trap|spike trap]] from the ceiling. Heading downstairs and up the path will bring you face-to-face with yet another draugr, and eventually will lead you to the other side of one of the blocked paths encountered earlier. Pull the lever here to release two sets of spikes—one containing a locked chest, the other leading you back into the first room. 

Directly opposite, you will see that the third set of spikes has also retracted. Head down the pathway they have revealed. At the foot of the stairs and round the corner to the left, there is a floor trigger for a [[SR:Battering Ram|battering ram]] overhead, and another two draugr.

Two more draugr will spring from the upright coffins on your left as you enter the next three-leveled chamber. Claim the [[Skyrim:Potion of Minor Healing|healing potions]] between them if you wish. On the opposite side of the room there is an unlocked chest, an urn and a burial urn. Veer right and up the stairs to find a path that will bring you to the third tier of this chamber. One draugr awaits in the center of the bridge. 

In the room directly beyond the bridge, there is a bookcase to the right containing some potions and leveled armor and three burial urns. Further down the stairs and along the corridor, there is also a leveled weapon, some coins, a ruby (maybe random gem) and a coin purse beneath three black statues in an alcove. Deal with the final draugr on the stairs to the right, at the top of the stairs there is another burial urn next to a brazier. The door leads back to Angarvunde. Once through the door there are a couple of burial urns, and magicka potions on your right, then walking towards the lever to lower the spikes you will pass an urn and an unlocked chest on your left.

===Medresi's End===
[[File:SR-word wall-Angarvunde.jpg|thumb|right|The word wall at Angarvunde]] 
Head left to the end of the corridor to find a chest and a lever. Pull the lever to lower the spikes to your right and open the final gate. Jump down and walk towards Medresi, who will excitedly run through the open door, only to be killed by a crushing spike trap. Luckily for you, her activation of the trap also reveals a pathway down. 

The chest contains a coin purse and a broken steel sword handle. Head down the revealed stairway to find the real prize—a [[Skyrim:Word_Wall|word wall]] for the [[Skyrim:Animal_Allegiance|Animal Allegiance]] [[SR:Shout|shout]], a boss-level chest, and an enchanted two-handed weapon.

==Notes==
*If you have a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]], they may not follow you all the way down the spiral wood staircase within Angarvunde Catacombs.  Because the staircase has broken away at the bottom, you must drop down a few feet to reach the ground below, and your follower may remain stuck on the staircase. In this case, you will be forced to clear this area alone, and your follower can be found back in the main chamber when you return to open the gate.
**This can be solved by waiting, as all followers are loaded next to you afterwards. 
**You can also use the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting_Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout to push them down.
*You can tackle the Catacombs or the Ruins in either order once you receive the key from Medresi; however both levers must be activated before the final chamber can be reached.
*If Medresi Dran's body gets stuck on top of the trap, climb on top of one of the carvings with a face and jump to her, or use the unrelenting force shout to knock her off.
*Only Medresi can trigger the final trap. If you beat her to it, you and your followers cannot trigger it before she arrives. There is therefore no way to complete the dungeon without letting her die (or using console commands).

== Bugs ==
{{Bug|If you pickpocket the key from Medresi and explore the Catacombs and Ruins sections without the relevant quest, Medresi will stand in front of the open gates, insisting that they need to be opened.|USKP|1.3.1}}
** To fix this, talk to Medresi so that she "gives" you the key, then re-enter both the Catacombs and Ruins by their exit doors, and re-trigger both levers.
** Killing Medresi will also trigger the final trap and advance the quest.
{{Bug|The Questmarker is on Medresi, the Journal tells you to talk to her after opening the big gate, but she still tells you that there is only one door left to open.|vn=1}}
** {{pc22}} To fix this use ''setstage dunAngarvundeQST 71'' to advance the quest, and she will run ahead and get crushed, opening the entry for you.

Skyrim:Ansilvund (quest).wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=[[User:The Silencer|The Silencer]] |checkedBy=Krusty |reward=[[User:The Silencer|The Silencer]] |rewardChecked=Gideon Dragontongue }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]] {{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ansilvund|Ansilvund]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Ghostblade|Ghostblade]] |Image=SR-quest-Ansilvund.jpg |Imgdesc=Lu'ah Al-Skaven in the Ansilvund Burial Chambers |description=Kill [[Skyrim:Lu'ah Al-Skaven|Lu'ah Al-Skaven]] in [[Skyrim:Ansilvund|Ansilvund]]. |ID=dunAnsilvundQST |SuggLevel=8 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Enter [[Skyrim:Ansilvund|Ansilvund]]. # Make your way through the ruin. # Kill [[Skyrim:Lu'ah Al-Skaven|Lu'ah Al-Skaven]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Fjori and Holgeir=== During your adventures, you may come across the rare book ''[[Skyrim:Of_Fjori_and_Holgeir|Of Fjori and Holgeir]]'', the tragic tale of a huntress and a warlord who fell in love fighting each other during a battle between forest clans. They fought to a standstill until her sword broke his axe and his shield dulled her blade, and their love was so obvious that the battle instantly ended and brought peace to the forest. When winter came, a snake bit [[Skyrim:Holgeir|Holgeir]], and [[Skyrim:Fjori|Fjori]] obtained an elixir from [[Lore:Akavir|Akavir]] to cure the poison. While she was giving the healing elixir to her loved one, instantly curing him, the snake bit her as well, and Holgeir couldn't save her. Out of grief, he built an ancient tomb and took his own life, hoping to rejoin Fjori in [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]]. The Nordic ruin of Ansilvund is hidden in the [[Skyrim: Velothi_Mountains|Velothi Mountains]], far north of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], and can be reached by following an unmarked path east of [[Skyrim:Cragslane Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]]. Near the entrance you will find the book about Fjori and Holgeir on a table, protected by a hostile [[Skyrim:Conjurer|conjurer]], hinting at unsolved mysteries inside. ===The Excavation Site=== [[File:SR-quest-Ansilvund_03.jpg|thumb|right|Enslaved Draugr]] The first area of Ansilvund is an excavation site, complete with mining equipment, wooden structures, and narrow tunnels. Unfortunately, the site is guarded by hordes of hostile [[Skyrim:Warlock#Conjurers|conjurers]], [[Skyrim:Warlock#Necromancers|necromancers]], and [[Skyrim:Fire_Mage#Fire_Mages|mages]] accompanied by a huge number of leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] enemies, so be prepared for a long trek. Through the cobwebbed room, if you are undetected, you will witness the unusual sight of two draugr [[Skyrim:Mining|mining]] the blocked path with a seated warlock overseeing their efforts. Obviously enslaved by the warlock, the two draugr will keep hammering on the wall, for reasons unknown. You can either sneak past them or use the [[Skyrim:Oil Slick|oil]] on the floor to your advantage, even if it will alert all enemies lurking in the surrounding areas. Regardless of your choice, proceed forward through the door. In the third room, a disembodied voice will echo through the tunnels with a warning: '''''"I am Lu'ah Al-Skaven. Who are you to disrupt my work? Begone, or I will add you to my army of the dead!"''''' At the top of the planks, there is another patrolling warlock, and after that is a room with three seated warlocks having a discussion beside a cooking pot and an [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanters|arcane enchanter]]. Their conversation provides a bit of explanation on the hard-working draugr enemies you encountered in the previous room: '''Female''': ''"I think it's sweet Lu'ah is so worked up over her dead soldier..."''
'''Male''': ''"Yeah, but raising Draugr to take on both the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] and the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]? That's just crazy."''
'''Female''': ''"True, but I'm not going to be the one to try to oppose her..."''
If the three warlocks detect you, you will have no choice but to battle them. Proceed forward to the third room, where a beam of blue light will shine down at the corpses, immediately reanimating them. The voice will once again be heard, saying, ''"Rise from your graves to defeat this worm!"'' Defeat the four draugr enemies and proceed to the next room, but beware the [[Skyrim:Ceiling_Spikes|ceiling spike]] trap. Head to the upper level and take the western path through more narrow tunnels until you reach a room with a conjurer and a [[Skyrim:Flame Atronach|flame atronach]]. Defeat the foes and examine the area to the north where you will find four rotating pillars and a handle. For a bit of investigation, search the table below the pillars for the unique book ''[[Skyrim:Lu-ah's Journal|Lu-ah's Journal]]''. ===Lu'ah and Saeel=== The journal tells the story of yet another tragic love affair, this time between a conjurer named [[Skyrim:Lu'ah Al-Skaven|Lu'ah Al-Skaven]] and her husband Saeel. According to the journal, Saeel died fighting for the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Empire]] against the [[Lore:Thalmor|Thalmor]] twenty-five years ago. During her grieving period, Lu'ah learned the story of Fjori and Holgeir, which led her to Ansilvund, hoping to transfer Saeel's soul to Holgeir's body. In order to reach the burial chamber, she started reanimating the dead, using them as vessels to clear the way. The puzzle in front of you can be solved in two ways, as it is based on the story of Fjori and Holgeir. The book is conveniently placed next to Lu'ah's Journal and, when examined closely, will reveal the following sentences related to the puzzle: ''As the '''Eagle''' finds its mates, so too did Fjori find hers in Holgeir, and a time of peace came to the clans of the forest.''
''But the '''Snake''' came and bit Holgeir, its venom seeping deep into the wound.''
''A '''Whale''' greeted Fjori's view as she came over the snow-covered mountains to the coast.''
''But the '''Snake''' bit Fjori as she poured the last drop into Holgeir's mouth, and fatigued from her journey, she joined the ancestors immediately.'' From left to right, turn the pillars to match the words in the book. Alternatively, an easier solution is available, as the correct symbols can be found behind the table, mostly overgrown but still visible. With the pillars in place, pull the handle and the door to [[Skyrim:Ansilvund#Ansilvund Burial Chambers|Ansilvund Burial Chambers]] will be accessible. ===Burial Chambers=== [[File:SR-quest-Ansilvund_04.jpg|thumb|right|''"Rise from your graves to defeat this worm!"'']] The Chambers area starts off with a crypt filled to the brink with traps, all triggered by [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plates]], so navigate your way to the intersection. Behind the locked gate sits a locked boss-leveled chest and a chain that controls all traps in the area, including the [[Skyrim:Swinging_Blades|swinging blades]] you may encounter in the southern tunnel. The next room is large and is divided into two levels. Make sure to read the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:2920, Sun's Dawn, v2|2920, Sun's Dawn, v2]]'' found on a booby-trapped pedestal across the room from the entrance, then locate the four sarcophagi in the southeastern area and claim the [[Skyrim:Ansilvund Key|Ansilvund Key]] from the pedestal. As soon as you take the key, a [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart trap]] will trigger, and five draugr enemies will burst out of their coffins while Lu'ah Al-Skaven speaks once again: ''"I shall have vengeance for the death of my husband. Rise!"'' Defeat the enemies, then head upstairs and use the key to unlock several gates until you reach a wooden door. The next area sees another enslaved draugr hacking away on a wall, overseen by another warlock. Make your way up and through a door until you end up on a narrow bridge with more pressure plates, designed purely to push you off the ledge. Beware of the attacking draugr and make your way into a crypt where another ray of blue light will reanimate another wave of undead enemies while Lu'ah will speak once again: '''''"I could not raise him, but I will raise an army to avenge his defilement!"''''' Proceed forward and beware of even more traps until you reach a large iron door, the very entrance to the main burial hall, the location sought out by Lu'ah, and the place where she hoped to reanimate her husband through the body of Holgeir. Apparently, she failed. ===Showdown=== [[File:SR-quest-Ansilvund_06.jpg|thumb|right|Fjori and Holgeir]] [[File:SR-quest-Ansilvund_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Thank you for releasing us from her spell."'']] The burial chamber is large and has a dead draugr lying on an altar, right in front of two closed sarcophagi, as well as a dead skeleton on the floor and several [[Skyrim:Traps#Oil Slicks/Oil Lanterns|oil lanterns]] hanging from the ceiling. As you approach the altar, Lu'ah Al-Skaven will appear from the shadows, saying: '''''"They burned his body before I could raise him... it should have been returned to me... You will not stop me from killing those who wage this pointless war!"''''' With these words the two sarcophagi will burst open and the mummified remains of Fjori and Holgeir will come rushing out, now slaves for the residing, vengeful conjurer. At the same time, Lu'ah Al-Skaven will re-animate the skeleton on the floor, so you will face four enemies at once. Fjori and Holgeir are both strong draugr enemies, and Lu'ah will shower you with a wide array of spells, including [[Skyrim:Ice Storm|Ice Storm]] and [[Skyrim:Ice Spike|Ice Spike]] along with the expected conjurer spells and a [[Skyrim:Grand Healing|Grand Healing]] spell for restoration. If you kill either Fjori and Holgeir, Lu'ah will immediately revive them, so go directly after Lu'ah. When she is dead, Fjori and Holgeir will fall to the ground, and blue rays of light will emerge from their bodies. With the curse finally broken, the ghosts of the two lovers will emerge behind the altar, and they will wholeheartedly thank you: '''Fjori''': ''"Thank you for releasing us from her spell."''
'''Holgeir''': ''"Now we can rest in peace once again. Come Fjori, my love..."''
'''Fjori''': ''"Take this with our gratitude."'' They will both disappear and your reward will be ready on the table behind them: the unique sword [[Skyrim:Ghostblade|Ghostblade]]. Make sure to pick up the [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|Unusual Gem]], then loot Lu'ah Al-Skaven for [[Skyrim:Lu'ah's Key|her key]] and unlock the northern door. Inside you'll find a boss-leveled chest, the spell tome ''[[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Transmute Mineral Ore|Transmute Mineral Ore]]'', and a hefty amount of [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]]. Lastly, find the ''[[Skyrim:Imperial Condolences|Imperial Condolences]]'' letter on the table for a final explanation on what drove Lu'ah Al-Skaven into insanity and why she formed her army of undead allies. {{NewLine}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |1||{{Quest Objective|5|Kill Lu'ah Al-Skaven in Ansilvund}} |6||{{Quest Objective|5|Kill Lu'ah Al-Skaven in Ansilvund}} |100|fin| |missing=0, 5, 10, 19, 20, 30, 50, 51, 52, 55, 56, 57, 80, 90, 95 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

He'll state that it's nothing official, but he is working on a "project". He refuses to say anything about it, but he asks you to bring him ten [[Skyrim:Dwemer Cog|Dwemer cogs]]. They can be found randomly throughout any and all Dwarven ruins. If you have not already found a Dwarven ruin, [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand]] is near the [[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(place)|College of Winterhold]], and the ruin under [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] is easy to find and lower-level friendly. There are plenty of Dwemer cogs inside [[Skyrim:Dwemer Museum|Dwemer Museum]] in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]], specifically in the closest right corner from the entrance; with [[Skyrim:Sneak|stealthy]] movement, all cogs can be obtained without any repercussions, making this the easiest and quickest method. The main College quest line will take you to [[Skyrim:Mzulft|Mzulft]], which also has more than ten Dwemer cogs. Depending on the ruins and your carry capacity (cogs weigh 10 each) you may end up needing two or three trips to get all the cogs. Once you have obtained the ten Dwemer cogs, return to Arniel and he will reward you with a [[Skyrim:Leveled_Lists#Gold_Rewards|small amount of gold]]. ===Part 2=== Arniel needs a very specific item for his project and is having trouble getting Enthir to give it to him. He'd like you to speak to Enthir and return to him with the item. Speaking to Enthir reveals that the item Arniel wants never belonged to him and is Enthir's property. He agrees to relinquish it, though—if you'll retrieve the [[Skyrim:Staff_of_Tandil|Staff of Tandil]] he sold to an unscrupulous character. The character is a boss level caster in a radiantly assigned dungeon. Depending on which one you get the quest may be increasingly more or less difficult. Some of the dungeons, such as [[Skyrim:Boulderfall Cave|Boulderfall Cave]] and [[Skyrim:Cragwallow Slope|Cragwallow Slope]], are extremely small while others might be rather involved or of a difficult nature. The staff should be either on the boss level caster, somewhere nearby, or in the boss level chest. Once you have the staff, return to Enthir. He'll give you the [[Skyrim:Warped_Soul_Gem|warped soul gem]], which can then be returned to Arniel to proceed with the quest. ====Radiant Options==== Possible values of <Dungeon> are: {{Hold List |eastmarch={{LinkList|sep=
|Ansilvund|Cragwallow Slope|Morvunskar}} |falkreath={{LinkList|sep=
|Brittleshin Pass|Falkreath Watchtower|Ilinalta's Deep|Southfringe Sanctum|Sunderstone Gorge}} |haafingar={{LinkList|sep=
|Northwatch Keep|Wolfskull Cave}} |reach={{LinkList|sep=
|Harmugstahl}} |rift={{LinkList|sep=
|Boulderfall Cave|Darklight Tower}} |whiterun={{LinkList|sep=
|Fellglow Keep|Rannveig's Fast}} |winterhold={{LinkList|sep=
|Hob's Fall Cave|Yngvild}} }} ===Part 3=== [[File:SR-quest-Arniel's Endeavor (C).jpg|thumb|right|A Dwemer Convector heated by Arniel's spell]] Begin this quest by asking [[Skyrim:Arniel Gane|Arniel]] about the progress of his project. He will say that it is going terribly. He reveals that he is trying to simulate the disappearance of the [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] but the warped soul gem that you acquired for him needs to be charged. Unfortunately, the apparatus he was using to charge it was destroyed in the process and he has no time to build another. Thus, he is only too happy to accept your generous offer to charge it for him. Arniel tells you that the Dwemer used to use convectors to charge their soul gems and that some of these devices probably still exist among Dwarven ruins. He needs two more charges after his own initial charge to power the gem. Due to the nature of the warped soul gem, it will destroy the convector it is charged in. What you need to do is find a few Dwemer convectors and place the warped soul gem inside. He will teach you a spell called [[Skyrim:Arniel's Convection|Arniel's Convection]] that must be channeled onto the Dwemer convector until the stone is charged. Keep channeling the convector until the quest updates. You will then have to find a new convector and repeat this process up to two times. There seems to be some variance on whether it takes one to three times to fully charge the stone and use of dual casting can complicate the matter. There are six Dwemer convectors in all of [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]]: *[[Skyrim:Druadach Redoubt|Druadach Redoubt]]: Across the river from it in an unmarked ruin, east-northeast of the map marker. *[[Skyrim:Deep Folk Crossing|Deep Folk Crossing]]: Across the bridge from it at an unmarked ruin, just north of the map marker. *[[Skyrim:Dwarven Storeroom|Dwarven Storeroom]]: Simple freestanding Dwarven structure near Mzulft. No enemies. *[[Skyrim:Mzulft|Mzulft]]: Near the entrance in the first rooms after the hall, just before the second incline. Must have started [[Skyrim:Revealing the Unseen|Revealing the Unseen]]. *[[Skyrim:Ruins of Bthalft|Ruins of Bthalft]]: Exterior only ruins, [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] here. *[[Skyrim:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]]: Southwest of the village at an unmarked ruin with a single [[Skyrim:Warlock|warlock]]. Two are northward of [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]], one south of [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], one southwest of [[Skyrim:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]], and two among the ruins of Mzulft. The two northwest of Karthwasten are probably the easiest to use since no enemies spawn at their locations (wild animals may be a nuisance however) and they are relatively close together. One is directly north of Karthwasten, northeast and across the river from Druadach Redoubt. It is at the base of the unmarked Dwemer pillar. If you cross the river and follow it upstream you will come to Deep Folk Crossing. Cross the bridge and the second Dwemer convector will be in front of you. The one south of Ivarstead is at the Ruins of Bthalft and has bandits. The one southwest of Shor's Stone is between there and [[Skyrim:Autumnshade Clearing|Autumnshade Clearing]] and has a rogue mage. At Mzulft, one is inside the storeroom (a separate building to the right of the ruin entrance when you arrive) and the other is within the ruins proper. ===Part 4=== [[File:SR-quest-Arniel's Endeavor 03.jpg|thumb|right|The dead courier]] [[File:SR-quest-Arniel's_Endeavor_02.jpg|thumb|right|Arniel disappearing in a flash of light]] Unlike previous parts of the quest, about two or three days must pass before continuing. Thereafter, talk to Arniel again. He is often to be found on the upper floor of the [[Skyrim:Hall of Attainment|Hall of Attainment]], but may also be in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Countenance|Hall of Countenance]]. Once more, he's used Enthir's services, and once more, you have to pick up the pieces. Talk to Enthir, who is almost always in his room in the Hall of Attainment. He's quite annoyed since he has no idea where the item is—or even what it is, for that matter. He was only tasked with providing transport for it from [[Lore:Morrowind|Morrowind]] and it simply hasn't arrived. Enthir tells you to go look for the [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] somewhere in the east, and marks a location on your map. The precise location of the courier varies. When you finally do locate him, it's immediately apparent why he didn't complete the delivery. Retrieve the blade "[[Skyrim:Keening|Keening]]" from his body and return it to Arniel. He is outraged that it wasn't wrapped properly and amazed that you didn't die when you touched it. By way of explanation, he relates something of the background of [[Lore:Keening|Keening]] and [[Lore:Sunder|Sunder]], the [[Lore:Kagrenac's Tools|legendary tools]] of the Dwemer Tonal Architect [[Lore:Kagrenac|Lord Kagrenac]]. Arniel now conducts his experiment in an attempt to figure out how and why the Dwemer disappeared. Striking the warped soul gem with Keening, he finds that it does nothing. He strikes again, gaining no apparent result once more. Having lost his temper, he curses, lashes out a third time... and disappears in a flash of light, never to be seen again. The quest is then unceremoniously updated as complete. Pick up Keening from the floor if you wish (although it seems to have come down in the world somewhat since the Third Era). [[Skyrim:Summon Arniel's Shade|Summon Arniel's Shade]] will be added to your spell list automatically. ====Radiant Options==== Possible values of <Dungeon> are: {{Hold List |eastmarch={{LinkList|sep=

It is possible to be sent to the same location in both quests. *No matter how many times you use Keening to strike the warped soul gem, you will not disappear in a blinding flash. *Enthir will have slightly different dialogue during this quest if you are the arch-mage or completed [[Skyrim:Hard_Answers|Hard Answers]]. *After providing Keening to Arniel, he will comment on the absence of Sunder. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Kill an NPC.
# Receive a letter from a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]].
# ''(Conditional)'' Visit the letter's sender for a reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
When you kill a person, it is possible you will be given a message from a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] from that person's enemy, claiming that they hated the person too and are glad you took care of them. If the [[Skyrim:Disposition|relationship]] between the enemy and the victim was foe or worse, the person thanking you will request that you visit them for a reward through a [[Skyrim:WIKill04RewardLetter|reward letter]]. Otherwise, they'll just send you a [[Skyrim:WIKill04ThanksLetter|letter of thanks]].

The reward is 50 gold for each [[Skyrim:Disposition#Relationship Rank|relationship rank]] below zero.

==Notes==
* Rich enemies were supposed to give a reward of 200 gold per rank, but no NPCs in the game are flagged as rich.
* Version 4.3.7 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch]] changes the letter's font to the handwritten font.

==Bugs==
{{bug|It is possible for the Dragonborn to receive a letter from themselves, rendering it impossible to complete the quest normally.|USSEP|4.2.3|trackerid=28980}}
{{bug|It is possible for the person giving the reward to be killed and thus cause the quest to get stuck because you can no longer collect.|USSEP|4.2.4|trackerid=29128}}
{{bug|If the relationship between enemy and victim is -3 (enemy) or worse, the reward letter will be delivered, but the objective to collect the reward will not be given.|USKP|2.0.5}}
{{bug|If letter is placed on a bookshelf may become blank and render the reward unobtainable.|confirmed=1}}
{{bug|It's possible to get the letter even if you killed the enemy "in disguise", such as being transformed into a Werewolf or Vampire Lord, where NPCs aren't supposed to recognize you.}}

==Walkthrough==
If you talk to one of the quest givers while having alcohol in your inventory, you will have the option to share a drink with them. This then makes them your friend, meaning that you can take low value items that belong to them and that they may occasionally give you a gift. 

==Notes==
* This quest does not have any stages or objectives.
* This quest can be repeated indefinitely.
* Certain expensive drinks will not give you the option to share a drink.
** Version 1.3.3 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] partially fixes this bug.
* Because this is a favor quest which affects the quest giver's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the [[Skyrim:Thane|thane]] quest for the quest giver's hold.
* Because this quest is unmarked, completing it won't help with progress towards the "[[Skyrim:Hero of the People|Hero of the People]]" [[Skyrim:Achievements|Achievement]].
* Only drunks with the "[[:Category:Skyrim-Voice-MaleDrunk|MaleDrunk]]" voicetype can be quest givers for this quest.

Hunter radiant quests become available
Dawnguard Membership |Prev=[[Skyrim:Bloodline|Bloodline]] (reject Lord Harkon's offer) |Next=[[Skyrim:Prophet (Dawnguard)|Prophet]] |Image=SR-quest-A New Order.jpg |Imgdesc=[[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] checking to make sure no one is a vampire |description=Recruit [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]]'s old allies for the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]]. |ID=DLC1HunterBaseIntro |radiant=yes |SuggLevel=48 (2, 6, 10, 30) |Difficulty=Medium }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak with [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]]. # Find [[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]] and help him defeat the [[Skyrim:Bear|bear]]. # Find [[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]] and get her to come to [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]]. # Return to Fort Dawnguard and listen to Isran's speech. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Reinforcements=== [[File:SR-quest-Bloodline 03.jpg|thumb|right|The attack on [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]]]] When you have declined [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]]'s offer at [[Skyrim:Volkihar Keep|Castle Volkihar]], you are told to return to [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] at [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] and provide information about [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]. Upon arriving in the courtyard, you will find Isran, [[Skyrim:Celann|Celann]], [[Skyrim:Durak|Durak]], and newcomer [[Skyrim:Vori|Vori]] doing their best to fight a group of attacking [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampires]]. Help them defeat the vampires, then report back to Isran who will be waiting at the main gate, showing great anger that his hidden fortress was exposed so soon. When you tell him that the vampires were looking for a woman trapped inside [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]], he will say: ''"A woman? Trapped in there? That doesn't make any sense. Who is she? More importantly, where is she?"'' However, he will forget about the woman once you tell him the vampires claimed an Elder Scroll: ''"By the Divines, this couldn't get much worse. This is more than you and I can handle."'' He will then realize it is time to bring in some powerful reinforcements to Fort Dawnguard: ''"If they're bold enough to attack us here, then this may be bigger than I thought. I have good men here, but... There are people I've met and worked with over the years. We need their skills, their talents, if we're going to survive this. If you can find them, we might have a chance."'' He will then tell you about the two persons, namely [[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]] and [[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]]: ''"I think we'll want Sorine Jurard. Breton girl, whip-smart and good with tinkering. Fascination with the Dwemer. Weapons in particular. Last I knew, she was out in the Reach, convinced she was about to find the biggest dwarven ruins yet. You'll also want to find Gunmar. Big brute of a Nord, hates vampires almost as much as I do. Got it into his head years back that his experience with animals would help. Trolls in particular, from what I hear."'' He will then send you on your way, and you will have to convince Sorine and Gunmar to join the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]], and use their special skills to help out against the vampire menace. ===Gunmar=== [[File:SR-npc-Gunmar 02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]] fighting the bear]] Gunmar will show up randomly in the wilderness in Skyrim or, if you have installed [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]], on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]], or somewhere else with [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation Club]] content (see [[#Notes|notes]]). Follow your map marker to his location, and you will find the huge [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] in [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneaking]] position, seemingly on the hunt for game, warning you: ''"Mind yourself. There's a vicious bear on the loose."'' He then explains that he has chased a bear for two weeks, and that he finally managed to corner it. Keep in mind, if there is not a map marker in mainland Skyrim, check Solstheim. When you tell him that Isran needs his help, he will forget the bear for a while: ''"Isran? Needing someone else's help? Never thought I'd hear that. I'm afraid he's a few years too late. I've moved on. I have more important business to attend to. Besides, he can handle anything alone! He assured me so himself. What could he possibly need my help with?"'' When you tell him about the vampire threat and the Elder Scroll, he will reconsider, although he wants you to help him track down the bear and kill it. He will then lead you to a cave near his initial starting point: '''Possible locations''': {{LinkList|Bonechill Passage|Bronze Water Cave|Brood Cavern|Clearspring Tarn|Cronvangr Cave|Crystaldrift Cave|Fallowstone Cave|Honeystrand Cave|[[Skyrim:Horker Island|Horker Island]]{{DB}}|Pinepeak Cavern|[[Skyrim:White Ridge Barrow|White Ridge Barrow]]{{DB}}|sep= • |ns_base=Skyrim}} There is always one specific bear you will have to kill, although you will often get in battle with several creatures at once. When the bear is dead, a journal update will tell you to speak with Gunmar, who will thank you for the assistance, and agree to help against the vampires: ''"You've helped me, so I suppose the least I can do is find out what Isran wants. He's still at that fort near Stendarr's Beacon, I assume?"'' He will then be on his way to Fort Dawnguard. ===Sorine Jurard=== [[File:SR-npc-Sorine Jurard 02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]]]] Sorine Jurard will turn up in the wilderness near an unmarked [[Skyrim:Dwemer Convector|Dwemer convector]], just south of [[Skyrim:Mor Khazgur|Mor Khazgur]]. She will be drifting around, obviously looking for something, mumbling: ''"What would mudcrabs want with my satchel, anyway?"'' and ''"Just one gyro. One, and I can get back to work. Where are they?"'' When you talk to her, she will ask if you have seen a sack full of [[Skyrim:Dwemer Gyro|Dwemer gyro]]s and will proceed to tell you that a [[Skyrim:Mudcrab|mudcrab]] may have taken it. When you tell her that Isran needs her help, she will respond: ''"Isran? Wants me? No, you must be mistaken. He made it exceedingly clear the last time we spoke that he had no interest in my help. I find it hard to believe he's changed his mind. He said some very hurtful things to me before I left."'' When told about the vampire threat and the Elder Scroll, she will change her mind, although she will not do anything before she gets a Dwemer gyro. You can now choose between two options, although the second option will differ if you already have a Dwemer gyro in your inventory. If you do, you can hand it to her and she will be on her way to Fort Dawnguard. You can also choose to persuade her, although you need a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill of 50+ to be successful. If everything else fails, you can look around for her satchel. To find it, starting at Sorine, first face southeast. In this direction, you can see a tree near the water. Travel to the tree. After reaching it, face west. From here, you can see the satchel on the ground a few feet away. When you return to her with one of the gyros she will finally be convinced and walk all the way to Fort Dawnguard for an encounter with Isran. ===Isran's Speech=== When you return to Fort Dawnguard, you will see that Isran has tightened security and made several changes to the exterior, including a gate and more wooden barricades. Enter the fort and you will find Gunmar and Sorine in the main hall, with Isran looking down at them from the balcony above. Before long, Isran will seal off the chamber, trapping the two new recruits, and shower them both with concentrated sunlight as a test. The following conversation will take place: '''Gunmar''': ''"All right Isran, you've got us all here. Now what do you want?"''
'''Isran''': ''"Hold it right there."''
'''Sorine''': ''"What are you doing?"''
'''Isran''': ''"Making sure you're not vampires. Can't be too careful. So, welcome to Fort Dawnguard. I'm sure you've heard a bit of what we're up against. Powerful vampires, unlike anything we've seen before. And they have an Elder Scroll. If anyone is going to stand in their way, it's going to be us."''
'''Sorine''': ''"This is all well and good, but do we actually know anything about what they're doing? What do we do now?"''
'''Isran''': ''"We'll get to that. For now, get acquainted with the space. Sorine, you'll find room to start your tinkering on that crossbow design you've been working on. Gunmar, there's an area large enough for you to pen up some trolls, get them armored up and ready for use. In the meantime, we're going to get to the bottom of why a vampire showed up here looking for you. Let's go have a little chat with it, shall we?"'' Once Isran has removed the barrier, the quest will end and the next quest, [[Skyrim:Prophet (Dawnguard)|Prophet]], will initiate. Gunmar and Sorine will then find their respective spots in the western area of Fort Dawnguard. Their presence will net you several benefits. Sorine is a master trainer in [[Skyrim:Marksman|Marksman]], and will also sell and buy items. She will also hand you several [[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard#Related Quests|quests]], while Gunmar is a master trainer in [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]], will sell and buy weapons and armor, and will sell you an [[Skyrim:Armored Troll|armored troll]] to aid you in battle. The next time you visit Fort Dawnguard, Sorine and Gunmar will change into their Dawnguard armor, a blacksmith's forge and arcane enchanter will be found near the smithing area, and armored trolls can be found in the pen across from the smelter. Exiting to [[Skyrim:Dayspring Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]] (including all 3 balconies) and re-entering from there will suffice. ==Notes== *As they are not [[Skyrim:Protected NPCs|protected]], both Durak and Celann may be slain in the vampire attack at the beginning of the quest. *If there is no quest marker for Gunmar and ''[[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]]'' is installed, the radiant location might be in [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. If so, traveling to Solstheim will result in the marker appearing normally at that location if the quest is active. The same can happen if you install [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation Club]] content, depending upon what it is. *Sorine makes a comment that she saw a mudcrab the other day while discussing where her gyros have gone. This is likely a subtle reference to the previous installment, ''[[Oblivion:Oblivion|Oblivion]]'', where "I saw a mudcrab the other day" was a sentence commonly uttered by many NPCs. *If you are a vampire, Isran will stop his speech and ask you to get yourself cured before anything else happens. This means that Sorine and Gunmar will wait in the main hall until you have completed [[Skyrim:Rising at Dawn|Rising at Dawn]]. *During the quest, you can freely roam inside [[Skyrim:Volkihar Keep|Volkihar Keep]] without danger to yourself. You can ask [[Skyrim:Feran Sadri|Feran Sadri]], [[Skyrim:Hestla|Hestla]], and [[Skyrim:Ronthil|Ronthil]] what they have for sale, and you can ask Ronthil and [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]] for training. The portcullis will be down though, and you'll have to [[Skyrim:Glitches#Clipping|clip]] through it or the diagonal walls around it to gain access. In addition, everything inside will be owned, and will need to be stolen. To add insult to injury, everyone inside will be hostile once you finish the quest. *You may [[Skyrim:World Interactions|randomly encounter]] a [[Skyrim:Vampire Assassin|vampire assassin]] at any point after completing this quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The quest may fail to start after refusing Harkon's gift and being returned to the landing.|dlc=DG|confirmed=1}}{{vn|needs more details/further testing to determine the reason}} **{{Pc22}} You can fix this by entering either setstage DLC1HunterBaseIntro 20 or setstage DLC1HunterBaseIntro 30, followed by setobjectivedisplayed DLC1HunterBaseIntro 20 1 or 30 1 into the console. **{{Pc22}} If the above does not work, it may be because you encountered a living Vigilant Tolan in Dimhollow Crypt, and he died. He needs to be alive before the above commands will work. To fix this, you can resurrect him. Open the console and enter prid 02003532 to select him, then enter resurrect. Close the console and wait 5 seconds. Then reopen the console and attempt the above fix. **{{Pc22}} If neither the above work, then ''playerfollowercount'''s value may be the issue. To fix this load a save from BEFORE you open Serana's sarcophagus. Dismiss any current followers, using set playerfollowercount to 0 if necessary (may as well to be safe) then proceed through the quest as normal. {{Bug|After rejecting Harkon's "gift" in Bloodline, there may be no indication that you completed that quest, which can lead to confusion upon finishing this one.}} {{Bug|If you clear the bear den before talking to Gunmar, he will just stand there telling you to slay the (dead) bear.|UDGP|1.1.1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|The bear that Gunmar wants you to help him eliminate may be missing due to being deleted by the game's cleanup script.|UDGP|1.1.3}} {{Bug|Upon entering the fort, Gunmar and/or Sorine may end up behind the instantly-closing gate, making it impossible to continue the quest.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **Exiting and reentering the fort or using the wait function will sometimes fix this and trigger the quest completion. **{{pc22}}Open the console, click on each NPC and type moveto player one at a time to bring them to your side of the gate. {{Bug|Upon completing the quest, the gate may not reopen.|confirmed=0|dlc=DG}} **Leave Fort Dawnguard, and immediately re-enter. The gate should now be open. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||I've rejected Harkon's offer to be turned into a vampire. Now I should return to Isran and help him formulate a plan of attack. {{Quest Objective|60|Return to Isran}} |200|fin|After rejecting Harkon's offer to become a vampire, I returned to Isran and informed him of what I've learned. I helped him recruit several people into the Dawnguard who can help us fight the vampires. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|10|Meet Tolan at Stendarr's Beacon}} {{Quest Objective|47|Speak to Gunmar}} {{Quest Objective|50|Recruit Florentius Baenius}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 10, 40, 50, 60, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Bloodline|Bloodline]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Prophet (Dawnguard)|Prophet]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)#Quests|Dawnguard]]}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Feran Sadri|Feran Sadri]].
# Retrieve both of the Amulets of Night Power.
# Return to Feran.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Talk to [[Skyrim:Feran Sadri|Feran Sadri]] in [[Skyrim:Volkihar Keep|Volkihar Keep]] and he will tell you of two amulets which will augment your powers as a [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|Vampire Lord]]. He will direct you to two random locations, one containing the [[Skyrim:Amulet of Bats|Amulet of Bats]] and the other containing the [[Skyrim:Amulet of The Gargoyle|Amulet of The Gargoyle]]. The amulet may be in possession of a boss or in the chest at the end of a dungeon. Head to the two dungeons shown on your map, retrieve the amulets, and return to Feran, who will give you several [[Skyrim:Potion of Blood|potions of blood]] as a reward.

==Notes==
* It appears that two additional amulets, the [[Skyrim:Amulet of Draining Grip|Amulet of Draining Grip]] and the [[Skyrim:Amulet of Drain Magicka|Amulet of Drain Magicka]], may have been planned for this quest, but were later abandoned.

==Bugs==

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-icon-misc-Schematic.png|thumb|right|One of the schematics]]
===Find the Schematic===
Speak to Sorine Jurard in [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] and ask "''What can I do to help?''" to receive this quest. She will instruct you to travel to a random [[Skyrim:Dwarven Ruins|Dwarven ruin]] or [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Bandit_Camps|bandit hideout]] (this includes locations added by [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]]) and retrieve the Dwemer schematic specifying a new [[Skyrim:Crossbow|crossbow]] design. The schematic will be located in the boss chest in the location. If it is a bandit area, the note [[Skyrim:Dwarven Haul|Dwarven Haul]] will be found in the chest as well. 

Once you have the schematic, return to Sorine to receive your reward of a leveled enchanted item. In addition, she will also teach you how to craft an [[Skyrim:Enhanced Crossbow|Enhanced Crossbow]] at a forge (as long as you possess the [[Skyrim:Steel Smithing|Steel Smithing]] perk).

This quest can be completed a further five times (six in total). In addition to a leveled enchanted item, each time Sorine will teach you how to craft a different item. After the [[Skyrim:Enhanced Crossbow|Enhanced Crossbow]], these will be [[Skyrim:Exploding Steel Bolt of Fire|Exploding Steel Bolts of Fire]], [[Skyrim:Exploding Steel Bolt of Ice|Ice]] and [[Skyrim:Exploding Steel Bolt of Shock|Shock]]. After the fifth run you will be able to craft a [[Skyrim:Dwarven Crossbow|Dwarven Crossbow]] and [[Skyrim:Dwarven Bolt|Dwarven Bolts]] (as long as you possess the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Smithing|Dwarven Smithing]] perk), and Sorine will also begin selling [[Skyrim:Exploding Dwarven Bolt of Fire|Exploding Dwarven Bolts of Fire]], [[Skyrim:Exploding Dwarven Bolt of Ice|Ice]] and [[Skyrim:Exploding Dwarven Bolt of Shock|Shock]]. After the final run, you will be able to craft an [[Skyrim:Enhanced Dwarven Crossbow|Enhanced Dwarven Crossbow]]. For more details on the required components for each time see [[Skyrim:Steel Smithing|Steel]] and [[Skyrim:Dwarven Smithing|Dwarven Smithing]].

{{NewRight}}
==Notes==
*This quest is not available if you sided with the Volkihar, or if you are in the Dawnguard ranks but are currently a vampire.
*With the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on, if the item happens to be found on Solstheim, there will be no quest marker. Traveling to Solstheim will make the marker appear in the relevant location.
*You cannot craft standard Steel Bolts unless you ask Sorine how to craft a crossbow, and you also cannot craft Dwarven Bolts until you have done the part of the quest where you find the Dwarven Crossbow Schematics and return them to her. You can craft both Dwarven and Steel elemental bolts of each element after you turn the schematics in for them.

Skyrim:A Jarl's Justice.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Spmckinney |checkedBy=SerCenKing |reward=Spmckinney |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Dawnguard|link3=Dawnguard (faction)}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Icon=SR-qico-Dawnguard Dawnguard.png |Giver=[[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] |Loc=Radiant |Reward=Leveled enchanted item |Prev= |Next= |Image=SR-quest-A Jarl's Justice.jpg |Imgdesc=Visiting Advisor at the White Hall in Dawnstar |description= Kill a [[Skyrim:vampire|vampire]] masquerading as a [[Skyrim:Visiting Advisor|Visiting Advisor]]. |ID=DLC1RH07 |radiant=yes |difficulty=Hard }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak with [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]]. # Warn the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] of the [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] threat. # Find and take [[Skyrim:Orders_(DG)|evidence]] to the jarl. #*''(Alternate)'' Discreetly kill the [[Skyrim:Visiting Advisor|Visiting Advisor]] and return to Isran. # Kill the Visiting Advisor. # Report back to Isran. ==Detailed Walkthrough== After speaking with [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]], you will be sent to inform a random [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] of a [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] threat within their court. The jarl will note the seriousness of your allegation, and ask for evidence. This can be obtained by pickpocketing the [[Skyrim:Visiting Advisor|Visiting Advisor]], who can usually be found in the main court room of the jarl's hall, for his [[Skyrim:Orders_(DG)|orders]]. Note that if your pickpocket attempt fails he will attack you, often leading to confrontation with nearby NPCs and likely death. This method is particularly effective when you are a [[Skyrim:Thane|Thane]] of the relevant hold, as you will then be able to tell the guards to disregard your crime. Return to the jarl with the note and they will grant you leave to kill the vampire with no retaliation from the hold's guards. Note that despite nominally being a vampire, the Adviser is immune to the [[Skyrim:Sun Fire|Sun Fire]] spell {{vn}}. Alternatively, you can skip the evidence gathering stage and instead discreetly eliminate the Visiting Advisor through either stealth or using a [[Skyrim:Frenzy (spell)|Frenzy]] spell while hidden. Once the vampire lies dead, return to Isran. ==Notes== *If the Jarl you were to report to is deposed, including via [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], this quest will automatically be completed. *It is impossible for the advisor to be at the court of [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]] or [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]], due to their unique voice types. *Unlike other [[Skyrim:Dawnguard Quests#Dawnguard Quests|Dawnguard radiant quests]], this one can only occur every twelve days at best. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Isran will only assign Dawnstar or Riften as target locations for this quest.|UDGP|2.0.0}} {{Bug|The advisor is supposed to stay within a certain distance of the jarl, but in locations like Understone Keep and occasionally others, this can leave the advisor inside a locked room or in other unintuitive locations.|confirmed=1}} ** Save and reload the game, or exit the building and re-enter; the advisor may show up in a different location. ** Wait until the jarl goes to bed or wakes up; this will typically cause the advisor to follow or, if locked in a room, to teleport close to the jarl. (This may require you to leave and re-enter or save and reload.) ** {{Pc22}} Use the following console commands to move directly to the advisor: sqv DLC1RH07. Look for the line that starts with {{Tt|Ref 'Vampire'}} and note the ID in parentheses at the end of that line. Then use player.moveto ''ID'' and you should be taken directly to the advisor. {{Bug|It is not considered a crime to attack the disguised vampire despite being warned by Isran that it would be if you're caught.|USLEEP|3.0.7}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Isran has sent me to to warn of a vampire masquerading as a visiting advisor to court. I am to destroy the beast. If I fail to secure 's permission first, the guards will consider it a murder. {{Quest Objective|10|Warn about the vampire threat}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Find evidence linked to the vampire}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Bring evidence to }} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Destroy the vampire masquerading as a Visiting Advisor}} |100||{{Quest Objective|40|Destroy the vampire masquerading as a Visiting Advisor}} {{Quest Objective|100|Return to }} |255|fin|I've destroyed the vampire in masquerading as a visiting advisor to 's court. |300|fin| is no longer the Jarl of and the vampire no longer poses a threat. |missing=0 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}
