{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked= }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Deor Woodcutter|Deor Woodcutter]] |Reward=Ability to craft [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] armor and weapons, map marker for the [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source |Stalhrim Source]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Fate of the Skaal|The Fate of the Skaal]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Sell Stalhrim Armor and Weapons to Ancarion|Sell Stalhrim Armor and Weapons to Ancarion]], [[Skyrim:Lost Legacy|Lost Legacy]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Abandoned Lodge|Abandoned Lodge]],
[[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]] |Image=SR-place-Stalhrim Source.jpg |ImgDesc=The [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source |Stalhrim Source]] |description=Find a [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|blacksmith]] missing from [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. |ID=DLC2SV02/DLC2SV02Misc |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |SuggLevel=10 |notrail=1 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Speak to [[Skyrim:Deor Woodcutter|Deor Woodcutter]] in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. # Find [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|Baldor Iron-Shaper]] at the [[Skyrim:Abandoned Lodge|abandoned lodge]]. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source Map|map]] from [[Skyrim:Ancarion|Ancarion]] at [[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]]. # Return to Baldor in Skaal Village. == Detailed Walkthrough == === Finding Baldor === If you return to [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] after the quest [[Skyrim:The Fate of the Skaal|The Fate of the Skaal]], you will overhear a conversation between [[Skyrim:Fanari Strong-Voice|Fanari]] and [[Skyrim:Deor Woodcutter|Deor]]: ::'''NOTE: Do not talk to anyone until they finish their conversation—see [[#Bugs|bugs]].''' [[File:SR-quest-A New Source of Stalhrim.jpg|thumb|right|''"Something isn't right, Fanari."'']] '''Fanari''': ''"Deor, you must be calm. I'm sure there's a good reason Baldor left us."''
'''Deor''': ''"Something isn't right, Fanari. I feel it in my bones and I smell it in the air. Baldor wouldn't leave without telling someone."''
'''Fanari''': ''"Don't worry yourself over nothing, Deor. Do you want a head full of gray hairs before you've seen forty winters?"''
'''Deor''': ''"It makes my heart heavy that you don't believe me, Fanari. Baldor could be in danger, and you will do nothing. If you won't help me, then I'll ask the All-Maker to send someone else who can."'' If you ask Fanari about the missing person, she will just brush it off as another of Deor's crazy ideas, but Deor is quite serious. He will tell you that local blacksmith [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|Baldor Iron-Shaper]] went missing in the middle of the night. Deor suspects a kidnapping motivated by Baldor's valuable expertise in [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] smithing. On the night of his disappearance Deor also saw two elves dragging something away to the ''"south and west"'', so start your search in that direction. ===Abandoned Lodge=== [[File:SR-npc-Baldor Iron-Shaper 02.jpg|thumb|right|The abducted [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|blacksmith]]]] While Deor's directions could lead you more-or-less anywhere on Solstheim, your compass objective marker will point you directly to an [[Skyrim:Abandoned Lodge|Abandoned Lodge]] southwest of the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]]. The lodge is normally empty, but once you arrive, you'll be attacked by four hostile members of the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]]. Dispose of them and loot their bodies for a [[Skyrim:Hand-written Note|note]] from their commander and the [[Skyrim:Key to Abandoned Lodge|key]] to the lodge. Inside, head into the basement where you will find the scared, tied-up smith in a corner, weeping: ''"Help! Somebody! Please, someone, help me!"'' and ''"I have been taken against my will! I am in need of rescue!"'' When you talk to Baldor, he will remember you as the hero who rescued the people of Skaal Village. Despite his wounds, he'll claim he's not hurt. When you ask why the Thalmor abducted him, he'll reply: ''"I do not know this word Thalmor, but if you mean the elves, they were trying to learn the secrets of forging Stalhrim. Their leader, an elf named Ancarion, has a map. He says that it shows the location of a hidden source of Stalhrim."'' He will then explain what stalhrim is: ''"Enchanted ice as hard as iron and cold as death. Stalhrim can be forged into deadly weapons, but the art is known only to smiths of the Skaal."'' He will then point you towards a Thalmor ship at the northwestern coast where [[Skyrim:Ancarion|Ancarion]] resides. He asks you to retrieve the [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source Map|map]] as it belongs to the Skaal people. Leave the wounded smith behind and make your way northwest to [[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]]. ===Northshore Landing=== [[File:SR-place-Northshore Landing 02.jpg|thumb|Ancarion's ship at the dock.]] When you arrive, a Thalmor soldier will warn you to be careful. Make your way to the ship, and talk to Ancarion. :'''I'm here about the Stalhrim map.''' :''"So you know my purpose here, then? I suppose you must have found that dullard of a blacksmith. Unfortunately for you, my mission here is also a secret. To protect it, I have no choice but to silence you. Now, give me one good reason that I should not kill you where you stand."'' Three dialogue options will now be available. Successfully completing the third option will require a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill of at least 75: {| class="wikitable" !Option !Response !Result |- |'''The blacksmith won't talk. You're wasting your time (Persuade)''' |'''Pass''': ''"I admit, we are not making the progress I'd hoped. Perhaps you are right, this venture might be more trouble than it's worth. Very well, you have convinced me. We will depart the island shortly and seek our weapons elsewhere."''
'''Fail''': ''"You dare to question me? That insult will be your last!"'' |'''Pass''': Receive map
'''Fail''': Combat |- |'''Leave this island now, or your life is forfeit. (Intimidate)''' |'''Pass''': ''"I can see that is no idle threat. Very well, we will depart the island once we have loaded the ship. No weapon is worth dying for, not even a weapon forged from Stalhrim. Here, give this map to the blacksmith. I have no further need of it."''
'''Fail''': ''"You dare threaten me? For that insolence, I will flay the flesh from your bones!"'' |'''Pass''': Receive map
'''Fail''': Combat |- |'''You want Stalhrim weapons, and I think I can help you get them.'''
''Ancarion: "Here to make me an offer, then? Very well, what do you have in mind?"''
'''The smith said he'd teach me how to make Stalhrim weapons.'''
''Ancarion: "And you will sell them to me. I suppose I'll have to give you the map first?"''
'''Yes, otherwise he'll teach me nothing. You can trust me. (Persuade)''' |'''Pass''': ''"I might not trust you, but I will trust your greed. Very well, take the map. Return here with Stalhrim weapons and armor, and I will pay you a fair price for them. Tell the blacksmith whatever lie you will. We have no further need of him."''
'''Fail''': ''"You expect me to just hand you the map, so you can deliver it to the blacksmith and laugh at the foolish Thalmor you so easily outwitted? You have made a grave miscalculation, and now you will pay the price!"'' |'''Pass''': Receive map and [[Skyrim:Sell Stalhrim Armor and Weapons to Ancarion|a new quest]]
'''Fail''': Combat |} If the Thalmor soldiers at the dock engage you in combat, you'll need to kill Ancarion and loot the map from his corpse. Regardless if he gave you the map, if you pickpocketed it from him, or if you killed him and looted it from his corpse, your final step is to return to Skaal Village and give it to Baldor. He will be quite pleased, and will teach you how to smith Stalhrim. This quest is now complete, and the next two will start when you return to Skaal Village. == Notes == * The [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source|stalhrim source]] that the Thalmor are seeking is in the mountains to the south of Northshore Landing, and its marker will be added to your game map if you read the [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source Map|Stalhrim Source Map]], or upon finishing the quest if you don't. There are another two stalhrim deposits just east of the ship, on a small [[Skyrim:Unmarked Places#Horker Stalhrim Island|unmarked island]] surrounded by [[Skyrim:Horker|horkers]]. * If [[Skyrim:Deor Woodcutter|Deor Woodcutter]] or [[Skyrim:Fanari Strong-Voice|Fanari Strong-Voice]] are killed prior to completing the quest, you will never be able to learn to forge stalhrim yourself. In addition, you will have to discover the Stalhrim Source's location on your own. * If you have completed [[Skyrim:The Gardener of Men|The Gardener of Men]], all the villagers including Baldor will be "busy" until you complete [[Skyrim:At the Summit of Apocrypha|At the Summit of Apocrypha]]. Make sure to talk to Baldor before you talk to Storn if you wish to complete this first. * Although you must finish this quest before you can craft stalhrim, there is another requirement that must be met: your [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]] skill must be at least level 80, and the Ebony Smithing perk must be active. * After you finish the quest, Ancarion will remain docked at Northshore Landing if you successfully made a deal to sell him stalhrim equipment. You cannot invest with Ancarion, though if the Merchant perk is active, you'll also be able to sell him weapons and armor that aren't made out of stahrim. ** With version 2.0.3 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Dragonborn Patch|Unofficial Dragonborn Patch]], Ancarion's shop will benefit from the [[Skyrim:Master Trader|Master Trader]] perk as well. * After you finish the quest, the Thalmor soldiers you encountered outside the Abandoned Lodge will eventually respawn, though the new ones won't be hostile. == Bugs == {{Bug|If you talk to the two Skaal villagers discussing the disappearance of the village blacksmith before they have finished talking, you will be unable to interact with the male villager, Deor Woodcutter, thus making the quest unattainable.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} If the quest fails to start, use Setstage DLC2SV02 10 to kick it off. {{Bug|There is a chance that the Thalmor Soldiers at the Abandoned Lodge will not be named, rendering them unlootable, thus making it impossible to obtain the key.|UDBP|1.0.3}} **This can be fixed by typing player.additem xx027e00 1 into the console where "xx" is the load order number of the Dragonborn add-on. {{Bug|There is a chance that after you speak with Deor your compass marker will point you to the furthest southwest point on the map, rather than the abandoned lodge.|confirmed=1}} **This can be fixed by waiting 48 hours outside of the abandoned lodge. The compass marker will move to the correct location and Baldor will spawn inside the lodge. {{Bug|If you successfully make a deal to sell Ancarion stalhrim equipment, he may eventually run out of gold, leaving him with nothing.}} {{Bug|Since Deor and Fanari are only marked as Protected, they can be killed by the player (for example, accidentally during the battle with the Lurker after the Wind Stone is freed). This will prevent the quest from starting.|UDBP|1.0.4|It resurrects them if necessary, and marks them as Essential until the quest has started.}} **You can force the quest to start by using Setstage DLC2SV02 10.{{Vn|plain}} {{Bug|If you interrupt the conversation between Deor and Fanari by talking to other villagers, the quest may fail to start, and talking to Deor may give you no dialogue options in order to start it.|USSEP|4.3.9|A possible workaround has been added to the conversation scene to try and keep you from derailing it.}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |id=DLC2SV02 |10||Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, has gone missing. They were heading southwest. {{Quest Objective|10|Search for Baldor Iron-Shaper}} |20||Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, was abducted by the Thalmor. Baldor told me that the Thalmor leader, Ancarion, had a map that showed the location of a new source of Stalhrim, and he asked me to retrieve it. {{Quest Objective|30|Retrieve the Stalhrim Source Map}} |30||Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, was abducted by the Thalmor. Skyrim:A New Debt.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=multiple |checkedBy=MolagBallet |reward=Secunda |rewardChecked=UnknownG }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Mogrul (Dragonborn)|Mogrul]] |Reward=None |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Reluctant Steward|Reluctant Steward]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] |Image=SR-quest-A New Debt.jpg |ImgDesc=A New Debt |description=Help [[Skyrim:Drovas Relvi|Drovas Relvi]] with his debt to [[Skyrim:Mogrul (Dragonborn)|Mogrul]]. |ID=DLC2TT1b |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png }} == Quick Walkthrough == #Be informed of your inherited debt by [[Skyrim:Mogrul (Dragonborn)|Mogrul]]. #Pay the debt or kill Mogrul. == Detailed Walkthrough == After the completion of the quest [[Skyrim:Reluctant Steward|Reluctant Steward]] you will be made aware of a debt that [[Skyrim:Drovas Relvi|Drovas Relvi]] owed to a money lender by the name of [[Skyrim:Mogrul (Dragonborn)|Mogrul]] operating out of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]]. Now that Drovas is under the protection of [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] and out of Mogrul's reach, Mogrul expects you to make good on Drovas' debt. To help entice you to pay the debt, Mogrul will send his [[Skyrim:Mogrul's Thug|thugs]] after you until the debt is paid. Mogrul will approach you while you are in Raven Rock: :''"It seems you've inherited a situation."'' ::'''Situation? What kind of situation?''' ::''"Drovas {{sic|Revli|Relvi}} owes me 1000 septims. At least he did until you set him up with that [[Lore:Telvanni|Telvanni]] wizard. Now he's untouchable. The way I figure it, it's your fault he can't pay me. So I guess I'm going to have to collect it from you."'' You will then be presented with several dialogue options: {|class=wikitable |- !width=23%|Option !Dialogue !width=13%|Reaction |- |'''I'm so sorry! Here, take the money.''' |''"See, that wasn't so hard, now was it. Now get outta here."'' |Pay 1000 gold |- |'''And if I don't pay you?''' |''"Nothing for now. But watch your back. I'll be sending collectors to find you. They won't ask so nicely. One way or the other, I'll get my money."'' |Nothing |- |'''Or I could just kill you now.''' |''"Take your best shot, fetcher! But if you draw on me, the guards will put the bounty on your head, not mine."'' |Nothing |- |'''Please be patient. I'll get you your money.''' |''"Patience is for fools. When you are tired of looking over your shoulder, you'll pay me."'' |Nothing |- |'''How about you take half? (Intimidate)''' |'''Passed''': ''"Uh... yeah. That sounds good. Half. I think that will work."''
'''Failed''': ''"How about I don't. You don't scare me."'' |'''Passed''': Pay 500 gold
'''Failed''': Nothing |} If you decide to pay him later: :'''About that money Drovas owes you...''' :''"Tired of running? I knew you were weak. Now pay me."'' At this point, you will have the same dialogue options as above. {{newline}} [[File:SR-quest-A New Debt 02.jpg|thumb|right|Mogrul's Thugs want all your money!]] If you don't want to pay Mogrul, your only alternative is to kill him, with the risk of the [[Skyrim:Redoran Guard|Redoran Guard]] intervening to stop you. However, if you are observant of your surroundings while you are in Raven Rock, you can detect Mogrul and his bodyguard [[Skyrim:Slitter|Slitter]] approaching you to demand that you pay up if you haven't been informed of your debt yet. He will follow you out of town if you are patient and don't run too far ahead, allowing you to discreetly dispatch him without drawing the guards' ire. You can also visit Drovas and inform him of Mogrul's harassment. While he will not be willing to pay the debt on his own initiative, you can persuade him to provide you with whatever money he can to help you pay off the debt. You must pass a hard [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] check to successfully persuade Drovas to give you the money. If you succeed, he will give you 250 gold, but that won't be enough to cover the debt. The rest is up to you. Note that you need a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill of 75 to successfully persuade him: {|class=wikitable |- !width=23%|Option !width=23%|Dialogue !width=13%|Reaction |- |'''You should pay me what you can. (Persuade)''' |'''Passed''': ''"Well... I... Oh, fine. Here. This is all I have."''
'''Failed''': ''"I don't see why. He's your problem now."'' |'''Passed''': Get 250 gold
'''Failed''': Nothing |} ==Notes== *When Mogrul first approaches you for the initial conversation, exiting the conversation without picking a dialogue option will not start the quest. == Quick Walkthrough ==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Glover Mallory|Glover Mallory]] in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]].
# Retrieve his [[Skyrim:Ancient Nordic Pickaxe|ancient Nordic pickaxe]] from [[Skyrim:Crescius Caerellius|Crescius Caerellius]].
# Return to Glover Mallory.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
=== That Foolish Old Man ===
The blacksmith of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], [[Skyrim:Glover Mallory|Glover Mallory]], has plenty of problems, both with his affiliation with the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] and his messy [[Skyrim:Paid in Full#One Last Thing|family affairs]]. Additionally, he's got a problem with an eighty year old ex-miner who borrowed his [[Skyrim:Ancient Nordic Pickaxe|ancient Nordic pickaxe]] and forgot to give it back. Locate Glover Mallory near his smithy in the center of town and he will ask, ''"You haven't seen [[Skyrim:Crescius Caerellius| Crescius Caerellius]] have you? That foolish old man's taken my pickaxe again!"'' He will then explain that it's not an ordinary pickaxe, but a rarity in [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. Since Glover has some shady business going on he will refuse to call the guards and will tell you, ''"Um, I prefer to handle these things on my own. Look, if you see Crescius, tell him to give me that pickaxe back and I'll pay you for the trouble."'' You can then ask what the pickaxe is good for and he will readily explain that it's the only tool able to crack [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] and that he traded that pickaxe with residents from [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. 

=== The Damn Fool ===
Seek out Crescius Caerellius. If you have yet to finish [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]] you can find him around the clock inside [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]] and you will have to initiate said quest before he will discuss the pickaxe. Otherwise, he will have returned to his daily routine and can be found either at home or in the mine. When you mention the pickaxe, he will immediately say, ''"The damn fool doesn't even deserve to have it! The pickaxe was made for mining, not selling. I'll bet he stole it from the Skaal in the first place."'' 

Note: If you already have an Ancient Nordic Pickaxe in your inventory, you may not be able to open any dialogue with Crescius about it, preventing you from advancing the quest. If this happens, simply drop, store or sell the one in your inventory until after you have gotten beyond the above dialogue with him.

Once Crescius has enabled the dialogue about the pickaxe and responded to your inquiry as outlined above, you will have three reply options available, and the reward will differ depending on your decision: 

{|class=wikitable
|-
!width=20%|Option
!colspan=4|Dialogue
!width=20%|Result
|-
| ''"It doesn't belong to you."'' ||colspan=4| ''"Oh, very well. Here. Tell him I hope he drops the thing on his foot."''||Return to Glover Mallory with the axe.
|-
| ''"Fine, you keep it."''||colspan=4| ''"Now you're finally talking some sense. A mining tool belongs in a mining family. Just tell him I lost it or something."''||Return to Glover Mallory and lie.
|-
| ''"Let me think about this."''||colspan=4| ''"Good. Now let me get back to what I was doing."''||Nothing.
|}

=== The Two Rewards ===
If you chose the first option, return to Glover and tell him you have his pickaxe, which he will then let you keep as a reward: ''"So you finally tracked down old Crescius, eh? Quite a character, isn't he. Tell you what. Since you went through all the trouble of finding it for me and all, you keep it."'' He will then tell you why: ''"I just wanted to remind that codger you can't just go around taking things from other people. Now that you've delivered the message, I'm satisfied. Besides, that pickaxe hasn't done me any good in years. Maybe you can put it to good use."'' If you chose the second option, he will be quite bitter about the whole thing but will still hand you a leveled amount of gold: ''"Blast! That careless old fool. Well, thanks for trying anyway. Here you go... for your trouble."''

{{SRLeveledReward|Small}}

== Notes ==
*The quest name is a play on the phrase "[[wiktionary:ax to grind|ax to grind]]".
*The Ancient Nordic Pickaxe you gain access to during this quest has a unique base ID ({{ID|xx0206F2}}).
*Although Glover lets you keep the pickaxe as a reward for finishing the quest, you can choose not to return the pickaxe and keep it that way instead. It will remain in your inventory as a quest item, making it a useful, weightless pickaxe.
*If you return the pickaxe, Glover explains that he only wanted to teach Crescuis a lesson that stealing is wrong. This, however, is ironic due to his own connections with the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]].
*If you haven't triggered the quest [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]] beforehand, talking to Crescius will start it, making it unavoidable.
*If you let Crescius keep the pickaxe, you'll need to either buy one from [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|Baldor Iron-Shaper]] in the [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] or find one as random treasure on Solstheim before you can mine Stalhrim.

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Enter the Ratway and follow the [[SR:Ghostly Apparition|Ghostly Apparition]].
#Investigate the [[SR:The Guardian Vault|Vault]].
#Defeat [[Skyrim:The Guardian|The Guardian]] and see if it has affected the shield.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
As soon as you install the Dawnfang and Duskfang Creation, head to [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. Townsfolk are talking about a ghost hiding in the Ratway and guards have [[Skyrim:Public Notice|warned them]] not to approach the area. As you begin your search, a ghostly apparition appears to guide you throughout the Ratway to the Guardian Vault. She then disappears in front of the [[SR:The Guardian Vault|Guardian Vault]], leaving you to your investigation.

In the chamber, you find a long dead skeleton and a sword. Upon inspecting the latter, the Vault Guardian tries to stop you and you have to defeat him. His death seems to have weakened the shield protecting the sword, and a door opens to the north. Head there to find once more the Vault Guardian and weaken the shield. Before leaving the northern room, be sure to open the cages to the left of the upper platform. Behind the gate there sits the skeleton of Verrick Tilwald, which will reanimate and attack you as you enter. Once the skeleton is dispatched, take [[Sr:Verrick's Note|Verrick's Note]], which is pinned beneath a dagger on the table next to [[sr:Of Crossed Daggers|Of Crossed Daggers]]. Reading this will initiate the [[Skyrim:Bloodthirst (quest)|Bloodthirst]] quest.
Return to the sword chamber and head to the east, defeat the Vault Guardian for the last time.

The Guardian and the Ghostly Apparition, in life Lorant and Emma Bouchard, will be reunited and you'll be free to take [[Skyrim:Dawnfang|Dawnfang and Duskfang]].

==Notes==
* For historical information on Dawnfang & Duskfang, see the [[Lore:Dawnfang and Duskfang|lore article]].
* It is possible to yield to Lorant's final form once he appears non-magical, at which time he simply stands in place peaceably with arms outstretched, effectively pausing the battle.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Ancient Ice 02.jpg|thumb|right|Your icy reward]]
===Cold Blooded Murder===
Travel to a camp south of [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]], just across from [[Skyrim:Thirsk Mead Hall|Thirsk Mead Hall]] on the island of [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. There you will come upon the body of a dead [[SR:Skaal Villager|Skaal villager]]. The murderer's name is [[SR:Skjol the Tongueless|Skjol the Tongueless]], as revealed by the [[SR:Skjol's Journal|journal]] left at the scene of the crime. Skjol does not appear to be too bright, and killed the villager after learning the location of a [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] deposit north of [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag|Castle Karstaag]].

The deposit in question is on an [[Skyrim:Unmarked Places Solstheim#Horker Iceberg|unnamed island]] just northeast of [[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]] {{Map Link|x=28333|y=99959|zoom=16|map=DB}}. Usually home to angry [[SR:Horker|horker]]s, you will instead find it to be occupied by a much angrier Skjol wielding an enchanted battleaxe. He will attack on sight, so put him down and claim the hoard for yourself: a rare deposit of [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] and a full set of [[SR:Stalhrim Fur Armor|Stalhrim Fur armor]] lying in a sarcophagus. Take the set to complete the quest; you will now begin to see Stalhrim Fur items showing up as random loot in the world.
{{NewLeft}}

==Notes==
* The location is not on the map. To find the camp, travel north from Thirsk Mead Hall, along the lake.  
* Stalhrim Fur armor uses the same model as [[Blades:Stalhrim|Stalhrim armor]] in ''[[Blades:Blades|Blades]]''.
* The island where Skjol makes his last stand can be difficult to climb onto from the water. If you use [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking|Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking]], found in [[Skyrim:Kolbjorn Barrow|Kolbjorn Barrow]] elsewhere on Solstheim, you can attack Skjol with ranged attacks while avoiding his battleaxe, or jump from the water's surface onto the shore and avoid being attacked while in the water as you struggle to climb out. 
* Stalhrim Fur Armor will appear in leveled lists once the quest has been completed, sometimes being worn by [[SR:Reaver Lord|Reaver Lord]]s.

==Detailed Walkthrough==

After defeating [[Skyrim:Thoron|Thoron]] for [[Skyrim:Restoring Order|Restoring Order]] (or by sneaking to avoid his detection while he is still alive), you can loot the items on his work table. The note ''[[Skyrim:Note on Amber and Madness Ore|Note on Amber and Madness Ore]]'' will give you a [[Skyrim:Miscellaneous Quests|miscellaneous quest]] to investigate the area north of Mistwatch.

Travel to Mistwatch, a tower just east of the Atronach Stone. In the geyser fields just north of the tower, you'll find a stone altar and the camp of the mad blacksmith [[Skyrim:Evethra|Evethra]]. Approach her and the objective will update to "Kill Evethra". Do so, then loot [[Skyrim:Evethra's Journal|her journal]] along with the unique [[Skyrim:Arcane Blacksmith's Apron|Arcane Blacksmith's Apron]].

Read the journal to complete the quest and gain the ability to craft Amber/Madness items using the [[Skyrim:Glass Smithing|Glass Smithing]] and [[Skyrim:Ebony Smithing|Ebony Smithing]] perks respectively.

==Notes==
* The [[Skyrim:Shadowrend|Shadowrend]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|creation]] takes place to the west in close proximity to this quest's location.
* Due to the large number of hostiles in the area, Evethra may leave her camp to fight [[Skyrim:Bear|bears]], [[Skyrim:Mudcrab|mudcrabs]], or a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]]. She is marked [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] until you receive the objective to kill her, but can be difficult to locate because of this.
* Although when you read the journal there is a message "You can now create new equipment with Glass Smithing" and a similar one for Ebony Smithing, to forge the new items you need to use the "Misc" section of the menu, not the Glass or Ebony section.

There they will need to speak with [[Skyrim:Viriya|Viriya]] and [[Skyrim:Swims-In-Deep-Water|Swims-In-Deep-Water]], the two experienced fishermen. Speaking with the two will start the [[Skyrim:In A Pinch|In A Pinch]] and [[Skyrim:Catch of the Day|Catch of the Day]] quests, respectively.

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy= |checkedBy= |reward= |rewardChecked= }}{{CC Header|Goldbrand}}{{Trail2|Goldbrand|Quests|nocat=1}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Giver=Reading [[Skyrim:Eranya's Journal|Eranya's Journal]] or [[Skyrim:Eranya's Research Notes|Eranya's Research Notes]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]], [[Skyrim:Sivdur's Respite|Sivdur's Respite]], [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]], [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Goldbrand (item)|Goldbrand]] |Image=SR-quest-A Matter of Pride.jpg |Imgdesc=A Matter of Pride |description=Obtain the legendary katana [[SR:Goldbrand (item)|Goldbrand]]. |ID=ccBGSSSE005_MainQuest |Mod=[[Skyrim:Goldbrand|Goldbrand]] }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]][[Category:Skyrim-Goldbrand]][[Category:Skyrim-Creation Club-Quests]] ==Quick Walkthrough== # Go to the [[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]] to find a copy of [[Skyrim:Eranya's Journal|Eranya's Journal]] # Travel to [[Skyrim:Sivdur's Respite|Sivdur's Respite]] and read [[Skyrim:Eranya%27s_Notes_on_Sivdur%27s_Tomb|Eranya's Notes on Sivdur's Tomb]] # Go to the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] and read a copy of [[Skyrim:Eranya's Research Notes|Eranya's Research Notes]] # Go to Whiterun to fetch Sivdur's Amulet # Go to [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]] to fetch Magrathi's skull # Travel to [[Skyrim:Sivdur's Respite|Sivdur's Respite]] and enter the warrior's tomb # Locate Goldbrand ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-npc-Eranya.jpg|right|thumb|150px|Body of Eranya]] There are two locations to start the quest: the [[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]] and the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. At the Sacellum of Boethiah in the fenced-in fighting area, you will find [[SR:Eranya|Eranya]], an imperial researcher investigating the legendary [[SR:Goldbrand (item)|Goldbrand]]. She isn't very eager to tell you the location of it, on account of being dead, but by reading [[Skyrim:Eranya's Journal|her journal]] you will find out the katana rests in [[Skyrim:Sivdur's Respite|Sivdur's Respite]]. Go to [[Skyrim:Sivdur's Respite|Sivdur's Respite]], located to the north of Windhelm and you will be attacked by a few [[SR:Boethiah Cultist|cultists of Boethiah]], one of which will have a [[SR:Cultist's Note|note detailing their ambitions]]. There is a gate with two pedestals on either side of it. Both pedestals have etched tablets. The left one states: "I, Sivdur, warrior and defender of dragons, lie in rest here My amulet, the symbol of my valor Place it here so that I may have proof of my deeds in Sovngarde" While the right one states: "Forever my nemesis, Magrathi, high priest and slayer of my brother His skull, the symbol of his betrayal Place it here, away from his kinsman, so that he may never find peace" On a table to the right of the pedestals lie [[Skyrim:Eranya's Notes on Sivdur's Tomb|Eranya's Notes on Sivdur's Tomb]], which will tell you that her research notes were left at the Arcanaeum at the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. Go there and you will find [[Skyrim:Eranya's Research Notes|Eranya's Research Notes]] located on the floor to the right of Urag gro-Shub's desk among some other books. Alternatively, you can go straight to the Arcanaeum at the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] (or go there after reading [[Skyrim:Eranya's Journal|Eranya's journal]]) and read the copy of [[Skyrim:Eranya's Research Notes|Eranya's Research Notes]]. Once you've read Eranya's Research Notes, you will be attacked by two invisible [[SR:Boethiah Cultist|Boethiah Cultists]]. Each of them will have a potion of invisibility. You will then need to find two artifacts to complete the quest: Sivdur's Amulet and Magrathi's Skull. They can be found in any order. ===Acquiring Sivdur's Amulet === Visit Whiterun and convince [[Skyrim:Lars_Battle-Born|Lars Battle-Born]] to give you Sivdur's amulet: :'''I heard your dad gave you a very old, special amulet. Is that true?''' :''"Ahh... yeah."'' :'''I need it. Would you give it to me?''' :''"Go away."'' {|class=wikitable !width=26%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue |- | '''Hand over the amulet, or you won't like what comes next.'''
'''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': ''"Don't hurt me! You win."'' |- | '''I was going to use it to find a magic sword. Isn't that exciting?'''
'''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': ''"How can I argue with that?"'' |- | '''Would a few shiny septims change your mind?'''
'''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': ''"For that price? Sure."'' |- |} ===Acquiring Magrathi's Skull=== Magrathi's Skull is a little bit more complicated than the amulet. Travel to [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]] and enter [[Skyrim:Shroud_Hearth_Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]]. If you have not cleared out the barrow beforehand, to the right of you, behind a gate, will be [[SR:Wyndelius Gatharian|a ghost]]. That ghost is not related to this quest and you do not have to deal with him, but what self-respecting adventurer would pass up [[SR:Lifting the Shroud|a chance for fame, riches and a word wall]]? Magrathi will be in the claw door chamber, past several traps, a copy of the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Before the Ages of Man|Before the Ages of Man]]'' and [[SR:Wyndelius Gatharian|the ghost]], and, unlike [[Skyrim:Lars_Battle-Born|Lars Battle-Born]] will be reticent in giving you what you seek. He is a maskless [[Skyrim:Dragon_Priest|Dragon Priest]] and will be just as powerful as any of the others no matter your level, so make sure you are prepared for the difficult fight ahead. After defeating him make sure to take [[Skyrim:Magrathi's Skull|his skull]]. ===Sivdur's Respite=== [[File:SR-interior-Sivdur's Respite.jpg|right|thumb|The two tablets and holders]] You will now need to head back to [[Skyrim:Sivdur's Respite|Sivdur's Respite]]. Place Sivdur's amulet on the pedestal to the left of the door and Magrathi's skull on the pedestal to the right of the door in order to proceed. The dungeon has some leveled draugr enemies and loot, but it is all of little note except for Sivdur's Tomb, where you will find [[SR:Goldbrand (item)|Goldbrand]] on a pedestal and a chest near the entrance. When you pick up Goldbrand, two Honor Guards of Sivdur will get out of their sarcophagi, so be ready to fight them or run away; killing them is not necessary for the completion of the quest. [[File:SR-quest-A Matter of Pride 02.jpg|right|thumb|Sivdur's honor guards]] {{NewLine}} == Notes == * Reading Eranya's Journal at Sivdur's Respite will initiate the miscellaneous journal entry to visit the College of Winterhold if you have not previously been told to visit the College before. * It is not possible to fail the speech checks for aquiring Sivdur's Amulet from [[Skyrim:Lars_Battle-Born|Lars Battle-Born]]. If the player does not have enough gold to bribe him the option to do so will not appear in dialogue. * If this quest is done concurrently with [[Skyrim:Lifting_the_Shroud|investigating Shroud Hearth Barrow]], you will be dealing with a Dragon Priest in the first zone on top of the insane mage [[Skyrim:Wyndelius_Gatharian|Wyndelius Gatharian]] before you can even reach the claw door and the Word of Power within. ==Bugs== {{Bug|It appears that the Boethiah Cultists will respawn in the Arcanaeum whenever the cell resets. From there, they stalk you wherever you go, and they can appear anywhere, including inside player homes. They only follow at walking speed, so having them catch up to you may be fairly infrequent and appear to be arbitrary.|confirmed=1|OSSEP|1.6.629.0}} {{Bug|Entering Sivdur's Respite before starting the quest may set the quest to Stage 400 and prevent the quest from starting normally.|confirmed=0}} **{{pc22}}This can be fixed by using the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command resetquest ccBGSSSE005_MainQuest to reset the quest. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |100||I've heard a rumor that a historian researching the whereabouts of lost daedric artifacts has recently gone missing. She was last seen in the mountains east of Windhelm. {{Quest Objective|0|Locate the missing historian}} |200||I've found the body of the historian rumored to be researching daedric artifacts at the Sacellum of Boethiah. She appears to have been killed at the hands of Boethiah cultists. I should read her journal to learn more. {{Quest Objective|20|Read Eranya's journal}} |300||The historian Eranya was researching Goldbrand, a daedric artifact in the shape of a golden katana. Her notes indicate that she was on her way to discover the burial site of an ancient Nord warrior hidden in the mountains north of Windhelm. I should follow in her footsteps and investigate the burial site myself. {{Quest Objective|30|Locate the ancient warrior's tomb}} |400||I've discovered the tomb mentioned in Eranya's journal. I should find a way to gain entrance to the tomb. {{Quest Objective|35|Find a way to open the tomb}} |400||I've discovered the tomb mentioned in Eranya's journal. I now need to find the two artifacts mentioned in Eranya's research notes. |400||I've discovered the tomb mentioned in Eranya's research notes. I now need to find the two artifacts she detailed that will open the entrance of the tomb. |450||I discovered another journal left behind by Eranya, the Imperial historian. In them, they detail that the key to opening the tomb lies in understanding the meaning of the two inscriptions in front of the tomb. Her research notes were left in the Arcanaeum in the College of Winterhold, which should have more details on how the tomb can be opened. {{Quest Objective|36|Read Eranya's research notes in the {{sic|Collge|College}} of Winterhold Arcanaeum}} {{Quest Objective|37|Investigate the tomb entrance}} |450||I discovered another journal left behind by Eranya, the Imperial historian that was rumored to have gone missing. In them, they detail that the key to opening the tomb lies in understanding the meaning of the two inscriptions in front of the tomb. Her research notes were left in the Arcanaeum in the College of Winterhold, which should have more details on how the tomb can be opened. |470||I have discovered Eranya's research notes in the College of Winterhold Arcanaeum. In her notes, she detailed the means to open Sivdur's Respite, the tomb that the artifact Goldbrand is rumored to be within. I must obtain Sivdur's amulet and the skull of Sivdur's nemesis, Magrathi. The amulet has been passed down for generations in the Battle-Born family and is now possessed by Lars Battle-Born. Magrathi was entombed within Shroud Hearth Barrow, a Nordic ruin near Ivarstead. I should place it on the pedestal near the entrance of the tomb in Sivdur's Respite. {{Quest Objective|43|Place the amulet on the pedestal near Sivdur's tomb}} |520||I've placed Sivdur's amulet on the pedestal near his tomb. When I did so, one of the doors of the tomb seemed to open. I now need to place Magrathi's skull on the other pedestal. {{Quest Objective|50|Find Sivdur's betrayer in Shroud Hearth Barrow}} |710||I located Magrathi, a powerful dragon priest. I should place it on the pedestal near the entrance of the tomb in Sivdur's Respite. {{Quest Objective|53|Place Magrathi's skull on the pedestal near Sivdur's tomb}} |740||I've placed Magrathi's skull on the pedestal near his tomb. The quest will continue. # Locate a Ferryman to take you to Giant's Tooth. # Recover the Iron Wood Fruit. # Return to where you left from. # Cook soup from Ironwood Fruit (Ironwood Fruit, Charred Skeever Hide, Salt Pile). # Travel to Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun. # Give soup to priestess. # Wait a day to speak with Rulnik. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===The Choice=== [[File:SR-quest-A Dying Wish.jpg|right|thumb|Mysterious Altar note]] In [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], go to the [[Skyrim:Dead Man's Drink|Dead Man's Drink]] and into the owner's room where you will find a note entitled ''[[Skyrim:Mysterious Altar|Mysterious Altar]]''. Read it to start the quest. Once read, you will be sent on to the [[Skyrim:Roadside Ruins|Roadside Ruins]]. There, you will find several dead bandits and a [[Skyrim:Spriggan|Spriggan]] waiting for you. Deal with the Spriggan and in the center of the ruins there is a leveled chest and the strange altar with three cups on it. * If you chose Fortune, find a bed and sleep. This quest will end and [[Skyrim:Fortunate Son|Fortunate Son]] will begin. * If you chose Power, this quest will end and [[Skyrim:The Pit (quest)|The Pit]] will begin. * If you choose Nothing, this quest will continue and you need to head back to town. {{NewLine}} ===Path of Nothing=== [[File:SR-flora-Ironwood Tree.jpg|thumb|right|Find an Ironwood tree]] Upon returning to civilization, you will be approached by a courier with a ''[[Skyrim:Note_from_the_Temple_of_Kynareth|Note from the Temple of Kynareth]]''. The note instructs you to find a ferryman to take you to the location of the Iron Wood Tree to get the fruit, [[Skyrim:Giant%27s_Tooth|Giant's Tooth]]. Only [[SR:Harlaug|Harlaug]] in [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] will agree to bring you. On arrival, there is a giant camp with two giants. You can sneak by them to the path behind the camp or kill them. Once done with the giants, follow the path to the [[Skyrim:Iron_Tusk_Cave|Iron Tusk Cave]]. Find the Iron Wood tree and harvest the fruit from it. You will then be attacked by several Spriggans. Defeat them and head back the way you came. Three [[Skyrim:Ice_Wraith|Ice Wraiths]] will spawn in the giant camp when you emerge and you will need to fight your way back to the boat to return to Dawnstar. Arriving back at Dawnstar, you will need to prepare a bowl of [[SR:Ironwood Soup|Ironwood Soup]] using three ingredients: the ironwood fruit, [[Skyrim:Charred Skeever Hide|charred skeever hide]], and a [[Skyrim:Salt Pile|salt pile]]. The nearest cooking station is in [[Skyrim:Silus_Vesuius%27s_House|Silus Vesuius's house]]. You will already have been given a charred skeever hide when you received the letter from the [[Skyrim:Temple_of_Kynareth|Temple of Kynareth]], so all you need to find is some salt. Look in the Fish Barrels outside the cave on Giant's Tooth, and you should find some. Once you have the soup, head for [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and the Temple of Kynareth. [[File:SR-quest-A Dying Wish 02.jpg|right|thumb|Acolyte Aldren and Rulnik]] At the temple, give the soup to [[SR:Acolyte Aldren|Acolyte Aldren]] who sent you the note. If you demand payment, you receive 75 gold. She will give the soup to [[Skyrim:Rulnik Wind-Strider|Rulnik Wind-Strider]] and you will be told to wait a full day before checking in on him. Wait a day and come back. Talk to Rulnik and you will receive your rewards: [[SR:Rulnik's Dagger|Rulnik's Dagger]], the [[SR:Bittercup (item)|Bittercup]], and a note titled ''[[Skyrim:On the Bittercup|On the Bittercup]]''. The Bittercup acts as a [[SR:Potions|potion]] and will raise your highest [[Skyrim:Attributes|attribute]] by 20 points at the cost of 20 points from your lowest. For choosing the path of nothing, you will also gain Rulnik as a follower. He is a powerful mage with a level cap of 75, and he can also be appointed as a [[SR:Personal Steward|personal steward]]. Rulnik's Dagger does the same damage as an Elven dagger, but weighs slightly less. It can be improved with a quicksilver ingot. ==Notes== * After quest completion, you can return to Giant's Tooth island via the same ferryman and go back in the Iron Tusk Cave where the fruit will respawn. If [[Skyrim:Survival Mode|Survival Mode]] is active, you'll be able to make Hot Ironwood Soup as well. No matter which path is chosen, Ironwood Fruit will become available from [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders|Khajiit caravans]]. {{NewLine}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |0||In my travels, I've heard strange tales about hagravens performing rituals near Falkreath. After dealing with the ash zombie attack, speak to the Matriarch:

She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Matriarch Drevlan's Note|note]]. After reading it you will have to head to the armory and pick up and read ''[[Skyrim:Priest Arthamis' Note|Priest Arthamis' Note]]''.

===Armory Puzzle===
[[File:SR-quest-Ashen Heart 02.jpg|right|thumb|Correct order]]
The solution for the armory puzzle can be deduced from the banner above the locked gate. The solution (left to right) is: Mask of Sotha Sil, Mask of Almalexia, Mask of Vivec. The other mannequins are irrelevant. 

Open the chest to find [[Skyrim:Hopesfire|Hopesfire]] and ''[[Skyrim:Erden Relvel's Note|Erden Relvel's Note]]'', read the note and you will have to then travel to the graveyard of [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn|Tel Mithryn]].

You will have to kill the ash zombies and Erden Relvel, you can then loot his body for the [[Skyrim:Mask of Dagoth Ur|Mask of Dagoth Ur]], the [[Skyrim:Robe of the Lich|Robe of the Lich]] and a [[Skyrim:Fahlbtharz Forge Gem|Fahlbtharz Forge Gem]].

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Plant 10 crops. ''(Any [[Skyrim:Fertile Soil|plantable food or ingredient]])''
# Recruit a [[Skyrim:Personal Steward|Personal Steward]] for your plantation.
# Recruit [[Skyrim:Farmhand|farmhands]] to help you with the tasks. ''You can ask your steward to hire them.''
# Build an [[SR:Farming_Construction|animal pen]].
# Talk to your steward about purchasing livestock.
# Wait a few days before the Goldenhills plantation starts to pay off.
# Talk to your steward to collect the day's income.
# Collect the products of the harvest in the pantry.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Farming===
Once you have completed [[SR:The Unquiet Dead|The Unquiet Dead]], [[SR:Goldenhills Plantation|Goldenhills Plantation]] is now yours. You will be given this quest to walk you through the various farming activities needed to get the place up and running.

Your first step will be to plant 10 crops in any of the plots of [[Skyrim:Fertile Soil|Fertile Soil]] around the property. There are plenty of plots on the property, and you can change your selection of crops at a later date if you so choose. Once this is complete, you will be prompted to hire a [[Skyrim:Personal Steward|personal steward]]. Many potential [[SR:Followers|followers]] will be willing to work as your steward if you bring them to the farm. You can also move your [[Skyrim:Spouse|spouse]] to Goldenhills and ask them to take over as steward instead.

===Stewardship===
With your choice of steward in place, the next step will be to hire some manual labor for the farm. You can speak to your steward about this and they will hire two generic [[Skyrim:Farmhand|farmhand]]s. Alternatively, if you wish to provide your own hires, you can recruit [[SR:Angrenor Once-Honored|Angrenor Once-Honored]], [[SR:Brenuin|Brenuin]], [[SR:Embry|Embry]], or [[SR:Narfi|Narfi]].

Once you have hired two farmhands, you will be prompted to [[Skyrim:Farming Construction|construct]] an animal pen. This will require you to use the [[SR:Farmer's Workbench|Farmer's Workbench]] near the entrance to the farmhouse. There are several construction options available, but for the animal pens all you will need is three [[SR:Firewood|firewood]] and a set of [[SR:Nails|nails]]. Build it and you will be prompted to purchase some livestock via your steward. They will arrange for the purchase of [[SR:cow|cow]]s, [[SR:goat|goat]]s, and [[SR:chicken|chicken]]s for the farm.

===Harvest===
With all this in place, you now have a fully operational farm. You will have to wait a few days for the plantation to begin turning a profit. When your first income is available, you will be prompted to collect payment from your steward. Your farm will continue to generate revenue passively, which you can collect from your steward at your leisure.

The final step to complete this quest will be to investigate the Pantry Cupboard inside the farmhouse, down the stairs. Open it and you will receive the following tutorial message:
:''Crops, milk, and eggs produced by the farm will be automatically stored in this cupboard.''
Within the cupboard you should find the first few samples of auto-harvested crops. This cupboard will continue to be filled passively over time, depending on what you choose to grow on the farm.

Congratulations, you have completed setting up your farm! There are plenty of other upgrades and activities to do at Goldenhills to develop it into a truly profitable enterprise.

==Notes==
*If you hire Narfi, you may still have to kill him later for an early Dark Brotherhood writ. It is possible to hire another farmhand to replace him if this occurs.

Permission to buy [[Skyrim:Breezehome|Breezehome]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout |Disp==2 (Balgruuf) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Before the Storm|Before the Storm]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|The Golden Claw]] |Loc=[[SR:Riverwood|Riverwood]], [[SR:Bleak Falls Barrow (place)|Bleak Falls Barrow]],
[[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] |Image=SR-place-Bleak Falls Barrow.jpg |ImgDesc=Bleak Falls Barrow |ID=MQ103 |description=Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Dragonstone|Dragonstone]]. |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]]. # Start the quest [[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|The Golden Claw]]. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Dragonstone|Dragonstone]] from [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (place)|Bleak Falls Barrow]]. # Return to Farengar. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Meet the Court Wizard=== During the final stages of the quest [[Skyrim:Before the Storm|Before the Storm]], you will be tasked with a trip from [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]] to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] to tell [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf]] about what happened in [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]]. Make your way to the [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] palace, where you will be stopped by the housecarl [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]], who will demand a good reason to interrupt the jarl. You can either tell her about the dragon or report that Riverwood calls for the jarl's aid, both of which will grant you an immediate audience. Deliver the news to Balgruuf, who will order troops to be sent to Riverwood at once and then present you with a reward. He will then remember a job suitable for an adventurer such as yourself and lead you to the court wizard [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]], who has been researching dragons. Farengar wants you to fetch the unique [[Skyrim:Dragonstone|Dragonstone]] from [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (place)|Bleak Falls Barrow]], an ancient Nordic tomb near Riverwood. When you question him on what he knows about the quest, he will keep his information sources secret. '''Note:''' If you already cleared Bleak Falls Barrow and retrieved the Dragonstone during the quest [[Skyrim:The_Golden_Claw|The Golden Claw]], Farengar will prompt you to hand it over immediately and complete the quest. See the [[#Notes|notes section]] for what you may have missed. ===Bleak Falls Barrow=== As the concurrent quest [[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|The Golden Claw]] runs simultaneously with this quest, travel to Riverwood and enter the [[Skyrim:Riverwood Trader|Riverwood Trader]]. Talk to the proprietor, who will tell you that a precious item was stolen from the main trading room, which will trigger the quest. Locate the ancient barrow and fight the bandits protecting the entrance. Bleak Falls Temple starts with a giant chamber with dead [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]] scattered about and the voices of two [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandit]] inhabitants audible from the back of the room, discussing something of great importance. If you have not yet triggered [[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|The Golden Claw]], it will begin now, due to the subject of the conversation: [[File:SR-quest-Bleak_Falls_Barrow_04.jpg|thumb|right|Bandits in Bleak Falls Temple]] '''Bandit #1''': ''"So we're just supposed to sit here while Arvel runs off with that golden claw?"''
'''Bandit #2''': ''"That dark elf wants to go on ahead, let him. Better than us risking our necks."''
'''Bandit #1''': ''"What if Arvel doesn't come back? I want my share from that claw!"''
'''Bandit #2''': ''"Just shut it and keep an eye out for trouble."'' Either use ranged attacks on them from afar, battle them up-close and personally, or sneak around them and search the area for loot, including the contents of a locked chest. Proceed through the empty tunnels until you arrive in a puzzle room where another bandit is attempting to pull a handle. You can attack him yourself, or allow him to be killed by [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|darts]] that he accidentally triggers. To avoid the same fate, look around the room and towards the upper level to see the correct combination for the movable pillars. Two symbols are up on the ledge above, while the middle one has fallen to the ground level next to the lever. They should be read from left to right, using the one on the ground as the middle symbol, in order to find the combination: '''Snake—Snake—Whale'''. Activate the movable pillars to position them. You can now pull the handle without being killed. The iron gate will swing open, allowing access to a room with a [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gem]], a potion, a chest, and a copy of the [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pickpocket]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Thief (book)|Thief]]''. Locate the spiral staircase, head underground, and beware of a few skeevers lurking on the steps. ===Arvel the Swift=== [[File:SR-quest-Bleak_Falls_Barrow_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Get it away from me. Get it away!"'']] At the foot of the stairs, everything is covered in cobwebs, hinting at the next major room's inhabitant. As you move around, you will notice a voice calling out from somewhere: ''"Is... is someone coming? Is that you Harknir? Bjorn? Soling? I know I ran ahead with the claw, but I need help!"'' Follow the sound and you will end up in a large chamber guarded by a [[Skyrim:Wounded Frostbite Spider|wounded frostbite spider]]. After the battle, examine the western tunnel where [[Skyrim:Arvel the Swift|Arvel the Swift]] is hanging in the webs, completely unable to move and obviously being kept for a later meal. Talk to him and he will reveal that he knows how to use the golden claw and makes great promises to you if you free him from the web: ''"You did it. You killed it. Now cut me down before anything else shows up."''
'''Where's the golden claw?'''
''"Yes, the claw. I know how it works. The claw, the markings, the door in the Hall of Stories. I know how they all fit together! Help me down, and I'll show you. You won't believe the power the Nords have hidden there."'' Attack the webs surrounding Arvel and he will be free; unfortunately, he will also betray you and take off running deeper into Bleak Falls Barrow. You can either give chase or let him run, as he is too weak to survive the upcoming [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]-infested catacombs. Run past two rooms and gather a small amount of loot along the way, including a soul gem. When the dead start to rise, dispose of them and beware the [[Skyrim:Pressure_Plate|pressure plate]] and the corresponding [[Skyrim:Spike Wall|spike wall]]. Be on the lookout for Arvel the Swift, who will likely fall prey to either the spiked wall or the following leveled draugr enemy. When you find his body, loot the [[Skyrim:Golden_Claw|golden claw]] and, for a bit of help on how to solve upcoming puzzles in the barrow, his [[Skyrim:Arvel's Journal|journal]]. When you claim the claw, you will receive a quest update for the [[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|corresponding quest]], and will be told to discover the 'secret of Bleak Falls Barrow'. Proceed forward and kill the three draugr in the next room. To the right of the [[Skyrim:Swinging_Blades|swinging blades]] is a short staircase that ends in rubble. There is a chest containing minor loot at the top of the stairs. Dodge the [[Skyrim:Swinging_Blades|swinging blades]] in the eastern tunnel. In the catacombs ahead, use the [[Skyrim:Oil Slicks|oil slick]] on the floor to your advantage or kill the attacking draugr normally. Follow the path until you arrive in a large chamber with a waterfall and one more draugr enemy, as well as a chest with minor loot. Activate the chain, head downstream along the underground creek, and beware the long fall where the creek turns into a waterfall through a hole in the eastern wall. If you search this area, you will find a pick and can learn how to mine ore. There is minor loot in the area and plants/mushrooms to gather. By the waterfall and entrance to the narrow tunnel, there is a chest to loot. Take the narrow tunnel leading south. You will emerge on a bridge halfway down the waterfall for a fight against another draugr (note that if you are a higher level you may find a [[Skyrim: Frost Troll|frost troll]] instead of a draugr). Head all the way down to the bottom for some minor loot in a locked chest, then return to the bridge and head north. The final room is protected by a leveled draugr. Upon its defeat, loot yet another locked chest in the room and then head through the door to Bleak Falls Sanctum. ===The Secret of Bleak Falls Barrow=== [[File:SR-quest-Bleak Falls Barrow.jpg|thumb|right|A mysterious wall]] In the beginning, the Sanctum is rather quiet with a set of swinging blades as the only obstacle. The next room, however, sees three draugr enemies and another helpful oil slick, if needed. Climb the wooden structure and proceed over the bridge to open the iron door. You will now face a puzzle door with three rotating rings. Following Arvel's advice from his journal, take a closer look at the golden claw in your inventory for the right combination. Rotate the rings to achieve the combination of '''Bear—Moth—Owl''' (bear on top, owl on bottom), then place the claw in the keyhole and watch as the door lowers. It opens to a huge chamber, complete with waterfalls, bats, and a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|Word Wall]]. Before entering the area with the wall, investigate the rocks to the right for a hidden, locked chest. Take a look opposite the word wall for a suspicious-looking sarcophagus and a chest with a good number of valuable items. Approach the word wall to learn the secret of the barrow, a word for the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout. After learning the word, the sarcophagus will burst open and a boss-level draugr overlord will step out and attack. Fight him and then examine his corpse for the [[Skyrim:Dragonstone|Dragonstone]], the item requested by [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]]. Before leaving, look to the south; behind the smaller waterfall is another chest. Finally, climb up the stairs and activate the handle, which will elevate the stone wall and bring you to an alternative exit from Bleak Falls Barrow. ===A Stranger=== In his quarters inside [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]], provided you started this quest before clearing out Bleak Falls Barrow (see [[#Notes|notes]]), Farengar Secret-Fire will be accompanied by [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]], the innkeeper from the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]] in Riverwood. She is obviously his 'reliable source', as the conversation reveals quite an extensive knowledge about the dragon situation. [[File:SR-quest-Bleak_Falls_Barrow_03.jpg|thumb|right|Delphine and Farengar Secret-Fire]] '''Farengar''': ''"You see? The terminology is clearly First Era or even earlier. I'm convinced this is a copy of a much older text. Perhaps dating to just after the Dragon War. If so, I could use this to cross-reference the names with other later texts."''
'''Delphine''': ''"Good. I'm glad you're making progress. My employers are anxious to have some tangible answers."''
'''Farengar''': ''"Oh, have no fear. The Jarl himself has finally taken an interest, so I'm now able to devote most of my time to this research."''
'''Delphine''': ''"Time is running, Farengar, don't forget. This isn't some theoretical question. Dragons have come back."''
'''Farengar''': ''"Yes, yes. Don't worry. Although the chance to see a living dragon up close would be tremendously valuable... Now, let me show you something else I found... very intriguing... I think your employers may be interested as well..."''
'''Delphine''': ''"You have a visitor."''
'''Farengar''': ''"Hmm? Ah, yes, the Jarl's protege! Back from Bleak Falls Barrow? You didn't die, it seems."'' At this point, Farengar will notice your presence and lift the Dragonstone from your inventory with his thanks. While not as grateful as Farengar, Delphine is quite impressed with your efforts. After this acknowledgment, Delphine will return to studying the copy of ''[[Skyrim:Holdings_of_Jarl_Gjalund|Holdings of Jarl Gjalund]]'' while Farengar will direct you to Jarl Balgruuf for your reward. After this, the quest [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] will initiate and you will have to wait a few moments for your reward... ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{Achievement|Bleak Falls Barrow (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *If you manage to race ahead of Arvel and clear the draugr, he will stop at the first swinging axe trap. If he spots you after the first draugr area, he will become hostile and attack you. * By going directly to Bleak Falls Barrow before visiting Jarl Balgruuf, it is possible to completely circumvent this quest, as [[Skyrim:The Golden Claw|The Golden Claw]] quest will take over. This doesn't really affect the game, but there are some changes: ** Farengar and Jarl Balgruuf's conversation will be limited to a short introduction as the jarl leaves right away. ** You will not get to experience Farengar and [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]]'s conversation, and the book ''[[Skyrim:Holdings of Jarl Gjalund|Holdings of Jarl Gjalund]]'' will never turn up on Farengar's desk. ** Farengar will be somewhat impressed by the fact that you already have the Dragonstone in your possession and give slightly different dialogue. *After you hand in the Dragonstone, the Axe of Whiterun, a leveled axe with a random enchantment, is generated and placed in Jarl Balgruuf's inventory. Reloading will cause it to have a different enchantment. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If the puzzle door or rotating pillars do not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Farengar's goodbye dialogue plays over the top of Balgruuf's closing parts of the same scene, making it difficult or impossible to tell what either one of them are saying.}} **Activating subtitles and moving back and forth between them can help. {{Bug|Delphine's scene dialogue with Farengar overlaps when she points out he has a visitor. This causes Farengar's line to be truncated and his next one to begin, creating an awkward transition.|USSEP|4.3}} {{Bug|You may find that once you have killed the draugr boss, he does not register as a container, in which case you cannot retrieve the Dragonstone and therefore cannot complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Bethesda technical support recommends reverting to a save prior to you entering the dungeon, raising your level, and then returning to the Dragonstone quest. This problem occurs if you are hidden when reading the word on the wall. Reloading prior to reading this and letting the draugr spot you as he comes out solves the issue. Simply save on a new file after killing the draugr overlord and then load that save. The overlord will now be "lootable". **{{pc22}} You can use the resurrect command in the console and kill him again. After it dies or the effect wears off, he will stand where he is and engage in the normal dialogue with you. You still have to go cut the webs, and after you do so, he will begin his sprint down the hall like normal.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After completing the quest, Irileth may not come in and start Dragon Rising.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Jarl Balgruuf thinks I may be able to help Farengar, his court wizard, with something related to dragons. {{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Farengar}} |50||Farengar Secret-Fire, Jarl Balgruuf's court wizard, has asked me to retrieve a Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow, a stone tablet that he believes contains a map of ancient dragon burial sites. Bleak Falls Barrow."'']] As you head out from the dungeon with either [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]] or [[Skyrim:Ralof|Ralof]], the dragon that attacked [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]] will travel over your head. Hadvar or Ralof will advise you to get down, but you're free to stand up and watch the dragon fly away. Hadvar or Ralof will comment on the dragon and continue on the path. You can now explore the area and advance to [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]] at your own pace or follow whoever is accompanying you down the path. Following Hadvar or Ralof does not grant any special bonuses, but you do get to listen to your companion comment on the world around you, and they will point out the [[Skyrim:The_Guardian_Stones|Guardian Stones]] and let you pick one that suits you. He will comment differently depending which stone you choose. {| class="hiddentable" | *The Warrior Stone (Hadvar): ''"Warrior, good! I knew you shouldn't have been on that cart the minute I laid eyes on you."'' *The Warrior Stone (Ralof): ''"Warrior, good! Those stars will guide you to honor and glory."'' *The Mage Stone: ''"Mage, eh? Well, to each his own. It's not for me to judge."'' *The Thief Stone: ''"Thief, eh? It's never too late to take charge of your own fate, you know."'' |} ===A Friend of a Friend=== [[File:SR-quest-Before the Storm 04.jpg|thumb|right|Hadvar recounting the events at Helgen to Alvor's family]] [[File:SR-quest-Before the Storm.jpg|thumb|left|Ralof telling Gerdur and Hod what happened in Helgen]] Once you arrive at the village of [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]], you will be directed to speak to [[Skyrim:Alvor|Alvor]], the local smith (if you chose to follow [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]] during the flight from Helgen) or [[Skyrim:Gerdur|Gerdur]], the woodmill owner (if you chose to follow [[Skyrim:Ralof|Ralof]]). Explain your situation and he or she will recommend you seek out the jarl of the region, Jarl [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Balgruuf the Greater]] at his [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|palace]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. They will also offer you what assistance they can (in the form of some low level food, potions, and jewelry) to get you started. Only Gerdur will give a key to her house. If you arrive in Riverwood very late, then the person you're directed to meet won't immediately offer you assistance. If you ask whether you can take any supplies, you will be allowed to take some things, and be directed to see the jarl. {{NewLeft}} ===To Whiterun=== Head out over the bridge out of town and follow the path north to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. Upon arrival at the main gate, a guard will tell you the city is closed to visitors. Any one of the dialogue options you are presented with will have him let you in the city, except for trying to intimidate the guard. Once inside, follow the path up to [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] and enter. When you approach Jarl Balgruuf, his housecarl, [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]], will ask you why you are interrupting the meeting; any dialogue option will gain you an audience. Speak with Jarl Balgruuf to complete the quest and begin the next. He will reward you with a piece of leveled armor. Whether you receive light or heavy is governed by your aptitude in those skills. If they are equal, Balgruuf will give you heavy armor. ==Notes== * If you accompanied Hadvar out of Helgen, you will have free access to the low-value items at Alvor's smithy, including the stacks of ingots (useful for learning smithing), and also the low-value items inside [[Skyrim:Alvor and Sigrid's House|their house]]. If you accompanied Ralof, you will be given a [[Skyrim:Key to Gerdur's House|key]] to [[Skyrim:Hod and Gerdur's House|Hod and Gerdur's House]], and be able to take low-value items inside. * No matter what choice you have made, you can also barter with Alvor and [[Skyrim:Blacksmithing Tutorial|help him]] around his shop for some [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]] experience, and Gerdur's husband [[Skyrim:Hod|Hod]] will [[Skyrim:Chop Wood|pay]] you for any firewood. * It is possible to become friends with both Alvor and Hod during this quest. The first thing you need to do is to side with Hadvar during Unbound, then escort him to Riverwood and talk to Alvor. After that, your final step is to sell firewood to Hod. If done correctly, both men will treat you as a friend before the quest is finished. * You can talk to Hadvar or Ralof (depending on who you sided with) on the way to Riverwood and ask them about various topics, including dragons, Ulfric Stormcloak, the war, Talos worship, and how to join their respective sides. * Meeting with Alvor or Gerdur is completely optional as they only direct you to Whiterun and offer you a few items. ** If Alvor or Gerdur die before you speak with them, the objective "Talk to Alvor"/"Talk to Gerdur" will fail; however the quest can be continued by visiting Dragonsreach as normal. * Progressing to Stage 30 of this quest ("Talk to the Jarl of Whiterun") is a trigger to enable [[Skyrim:Falkreath Stormcloak Camp|Falkreath Stormcloak Camp]] if all other required conditions are met. * Once Alvor or Gerdur are spoken to, you'll be able to freely search the barrels inside [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]] and use the double bed in Helgen. * While on your way to Whiterun, you may encounter some of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] fighting a giant. [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] will approach you once the fight is finished. * With version 3.0.1 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Legendary Edition Patch|Unofficial Legendary Edition Patch]], the Whiterun Guard will no longer perform endless forcegreets if you decide to "come back later" when trying to enter Whiterun. * It is never actually possible to intimidate the Whiterun Guard to let you in to the city, even if your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill is 100. * It is possible to enter Whiterun without ever speaking to the gate guard who stops the player by pick-pocketing the key from him, although it is very difficult to get into pick-pocket range without ever speaking to him. ** The most consistent way to prevent talking to the guard is to pick-pocket him from behind the gate in out-of-bounds Whiterun, which happens to also be the fastest way to enter Whiterun during this quest. *After you finish the quest, 3 Whiterun Guards will be present in Riverwood. The pile of logs outside of Riverwood will also be converted into a campfire with two bed rolls and a [[Skyrim:Cooking|cooking pot]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Sometimes Gerdur will not have an option to ask about the dragon, causing the main quest to be frozen.|confirmed=1}} ** Ask Alvor for supplies. After you look through his inventory, he will start by saying ''"The Jarl needs to know if there's a dragon on the loose. Riverwood is defenseless..."'' Listen to him speak and he will mention that you should inform [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|the jarl]]. After that, the quest will update. {{Bug|Similarly, Alvor may not have an option about the dragon, and the quest will not be able to progress.|confirmed=1}} ** Go to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and talk to the jarl to advance the quest. {{Bug|The real time timer for entering Alvor's home to trigger the scene is very short, potentially causing the overall scene to fail. |confirmed=1 |USKP|1.3.0}} ** Talk to Alvor to continue the quest regularly. The scene is skipped. {{Bug|The double bed in the destroyed Helgen inn is considered "owned" when you start the quest.|confirmed=1}} ** Escaping with Hadvar and becoming friends with his uncle Alvor (by speaking with him or finishing the quest) should allow you to use it properly. {{Bug|The quartermaster at [[Skyrim:Falkreath Stormcloak Camp|Falkreath Stormcloak Camp]] may be present before Alvor or Gerdur are spoken to.}} {{Bug|If you go straight to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and speak to [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf]], despite never meeting [[Skyrim:Alvor|Alvor]], you still have the dialogue option as you spoke to him.}} {{Bug|The bribe option for the guard at the Whiterun city gates has no proper conditions in place. Although you'll gain access to Whiterun, the guard doesn't take the gold, and it isn't removed from your inventory.|USSEP|4.2.7}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10:2||Hadvar suggested that I head to the nearby town of Riverwood.
