Skyrim:Boethiah's Calling.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=cf |reward=MrMcFluffy |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Trail2|Quests|Daedric|link2=Daedric Quests}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=Book: ''[[Skyrim:Boethiah's Proving|Boethiah's Proving]]'' or Automatic after visiting [[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Ebony Mail|Ebony Mail]] |Disp= |Prev= |ReqLevel=30 |SuggLevel=37 |Loc=[[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]], [[Skyrim:Knifepoint Ridge|Knifepoint Ridge]] |Image=SR-quest-Boethiah's Calling.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Adelaisa Vendicci|Adelaisa Vendicci]] being sacrificed to Boethiah |description=Become [[Lore:Boethiah|Boethiah]]'s new champion. |ID=DA02 |Difficulty=Hard |Icon=SR-qico-Daedric.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # ''(Optional)'' Read ''[[Skyrim:Boethiah's Proving|Boethiah's Proving]]''. # Travel to the [[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]] and speak to the [[Skyrim:Priestess of Boethiah|Priestess of Boethiah]]. # Sacrifice a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] on the Altar of Sacrifice. # Kill all the cult members. # Go to [[Skyrim:Knifepoint Ridge|Knifepoint Ridge]] and kill Boethiah's [[Skyrim:Champion of Boethiah|current champion]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Starting the Quest=== You can start the quest any time after reaching level 30, either by reading a copy of ''[[Skyrim:Boethiah's Proving|Boethiah's Proving]]'' or traveling directly to the [[Skyrim:Sacellum_of_Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]] and talking to the Priestess of Boethiah or killing every one of the cultists. If you wait, you may be attacked randomly in the world by Boethiah cultists, who will have a copy of ''Boethiah's Proving'' on their corpse. :''Note:'' See ''[[Skyrim:Boethiah%27s_Proving|Boethiah's Proving]]'' for other locations of the book. The various copies of the book appear once you reach level 30. ===The Shrine of Boethiah=== First, you will have to make your way to the [[Skyrim:Sacellum of Boethiah|Sacellum of Boethiah]]. Follow the road northeast from the [[Skyrim:Windhelm Stables|Windhelm Stables]] up to [[Skyrim:Traitor's Post|Traitor's Post]]. Nearby is a road that leads into the mountains, up to the Sacellum. When you arrive at the Sacellum you will find two cultists fighting in a small arena. There are some more cultists and a Priestess of Boethiah watching them. Speak to the priestess. She will tell you that you need to prove that "your tongue can wield a lie". If you kill the followers of Boethiah, the Daedric Prince will appear and give the quest instructions herself; this will only change the order in which you complete the tasks. If you approach the shrine at level 29 or below, the quest won't start, and there will be no one there. ===The Sacrifice=== The priestess will tell you that you need to gain someone's trust and then sacrifice them before Boethiah. She will give you the [[Skyrim:Blade of Sacrifice|Blade of Sacrifice]] to use for the deed. Lead any ''non-[[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]]'' [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] to the shrine and activate command mode (holding 'use' or via the "I need you to do something" conversation option). Highlight the pillar and you should see "Use the Pillar of Sacrifice". Tell them to do this and they will move towards it and be pulled in and stuck to it. If the follower is essential, the pillar will not be triggered. Kill the follower using any means (despite what the Priestess says, you do not have to use the Blade of Sacrifice). Once your follower is dead, Boethiah will use the body as a conduit to tell you and all of the cultists that she has a task for whomever is left standing after a battle to the death. This results in all the cultists attacking one another (and you). Be prepared for a tough fight, as they can be formidable opponents. Alternatively, you can leave your follower on the Pillar of Sacrifice, kill all of the cultists until one is left, lead the last cultist to the Pillar of Sacrifice, get the last cultist's health to low, then kill your follower and the last cultist simultaneously. If done correctly, your follower will survive, their services should be available once again, and Boethiah will take the form of the last cultist instead. If you have already killed all the followers of Boethiah, she will then possess the corpse of the last follower you slew and the quest proceeds as normal. See [[#Notes|Notes]]. ===The New Champion=== [[File:SR-item-Ebony Mail.jpg|thumb|right|The Ebony Mail]] After making the sacrifice and killing all the cultists, Boethiah will again use a body as a conduit (it may not be the same one) and tell you she needs a new champion. To become the new champion you must kill the old champion and his bandits at [[Skyrim:Knifepoint Ridge|Knifepoint Ridge]], northwest of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. Despite Boethiah's order to kill them stealthily, being detected does not result in quest failure or any other penalty. Nonetheless, most of the bandits inside the mine are busy with their backs to you and can be assassinated. A few are standing in pools of flammable liquid that can be ignited with fire spells. It's difficult to sneak up on Boethiah's Champion because of the direction he faces when sitting, but if you climb on top of his shack, you can drop down behind him. Once you defeat Boethiah's Champion, you must equip his [[Skyrim:Ebony_Mail|Ebony Mail]]. Boethiah will then speak to you one last time, telling you that you are her new champion and giving you the Ebony Mail as your reward. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== *[[Lore:Boethiah|Boethiah]] would have either given you a second [[SR:Daedric Quests|Daedric Quest]], or a second part to this one, in which you would have killed [[SR:Solitude|Solitude]]'s Jarl [[SR:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]]. The quest is (mostly, see [[#Bugs|Bugs]]) inaccessible in the final game, but data for it can still be found [[SR:Boethiah's Bidding|in the game files]]. *One or more of the bandits in Knifepoint Ridge might start a fight with the old Champion if they get close enough to him to be hurt by the poison damage done by the Ebony Mail when they are searching for you. *If your follower survives using the alternate method, they will revert to their original equipment, and anything you gave them may be lost. To avoid this, remove everything from their inventory except for their original weapons and armor. *While killing your follower as a sacrifice does not result in any bounties, faction-specific reactions, such as [[Skyrim:Rejoining the College|Rejoining the College]] if you kill any of the apprentice followers, may still get triggered. *If [[Skyrim:Champion_of_Boethiah|Champion of Boethiah]] is calmed down, unique dialogue with him will become available. == Bugs == {{cleanup|overlong bugs section needs testing}} {{Bug|Clearing out Knifepoint Ridge before this quest has begun may prevent the latter from starting at all.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|Should you attack [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Jarl Elisif the Fair]] under any circumstances during this quest, she will flee combat and all of the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]]'s guards will turn permanently hostile to you. This is caused by leftover code tied to removed content. (see [[#Notes|Notes]])|USKP|1.2.7}} {{Bug|If you refuse the quest and kill the cultists or something happens to cause Boethiah's current body to enter combat mode (such as a dragon attack), she will be stuck in the same conversational loop repeating the line ''"You've gotten my attention mortal, that is most unwise"'' when approached.|vn=1}} ** To get around this, kill all the cultists and priests. {{Bug|This quest can break all future radiant quests which would take place at Knifepoint Ridge after the Champion has been enabled.|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|Offering a follower up to sacrifice to Boethiah before the appropriate stage can leave the quest in a jammed state.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|When Boethiah's conduit is killed after she's done using it, a bounty may be placed on your head due to the script command being set up improperly.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|Completing this quest can trap you inside Knifepoint Ridge.|USKP|2.0.5|There were invalid conditions on the event that was supposed to reset the dungeon after leaving.}} {{Bug|The quest can become stuck if the player kills the Priestess before talking to Boethiah.|USSEP|4.3.4}} {{Bug|If you sacrifice a [[Skyrim:The Circle|Companion leader]] at the Pillar, the game may not register them as killed, breaking the radiant quests from the Companions. Though the follower dies and the quest for Boethiah proceeds as normal, the other Companion leaders don't acknowledge the death, and they still respond with "''Aren't you already running a job for (name)?''" when asked about work.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you kill the priestess before talking to Boethiah, one or two of the current fighters may become unkillable.|confirmed=1}} ** {{pc22}} Open the console and for each fighter that's unkillable, click on them and then type kill. The quest will proceed as normal once all the fighters are dead. If that does not work, open the console and type damageactorvalue health 500. {{Bug|On entering Knifepoint Ridge, possibly due to having been there before beginning the quest, you may be presented with a wall of iron ore veins blocking your path to the remaining bandits and the Boethiah Cultist, making the quest impossible to complete.|USKP|2.0.1}} ** A known workaround is to look at the bottom right corner of the iron vein wall, where the option to mine a corundum vein will be presented. Mining this vein will pull you through the wall, allowing you to continue with the quest as intended. This will only work for as many times as you can continue to trigger the mining animation, so you should either cancel the animation before the vein is completely emptied or make sure you have completed everything before heading back up this path — as soon as you have walked through the location of the wall the iron vein will reappear, making the rest of the mine unreachable. {{Bug|The Miscellaneous Quest objective "Investigate the Boethiah cultist" may not ever be marked as completed, even after completing the main Boethiah's Calling mission.|confirmed=1|USLEEP|3.0.10}} ** Looting the book from the body '''before''' reading it will prevent this. {{Bug|The [[Skyrim:Champion of Boethiah|Champion of Boethiah]] will re-equip his armor if he is killed and revived with [[Skyrim:Dead Thrall|Dead Thrall]], which can be exploited for infinite gold and powerful armor for your followers.|OSP|1.5}} {{Bug|Upon talking with Boethiah your vision field may be stuck in the distorted oval it creates when talking to the daedric prince.|confirmed=1}} ** Completing the quest might fix this. ** {{pc22}} Opening the console and typing rimod 00106a73 or rimodcf might also fix it. {{Bug|Your follower's inventory will be reset upon being used by Boethiah, and any items you gave them will be removed.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The Champion of Boethiah may disappear after being killed. His body passes through the ground beyond the wall, making it impossible reach it and retrieve the Ebony Mail.|confirmed=1}} ** {{pc22}} By using the console commands prid 000834FF followed by resurrect the champion will be resurrected but still be stuck in the ground. He will eventually free himself and can then be killed again (e.g. with the console command kill). {{Bug|When Boethiah's conduit is killed after she's done "using it", you may incur a bounty.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|If you use beast form and eat the Champion of Boethiah the game may glitch making it impossible to collect the Ebony Mail.|vn=1}} {{Bug|During the step of Retrieving and Equipping the Ebony Mail, if you equip it right away from the body of the Champion, or have it sent to secondary storage after looting and then get the armor from there, the quest will not proceed.|confirmed=1}} ** If you are using mods with secondary storage disable them temporarily. Once you have, drop the Ebony Mail on the floor, then pick it up again and equip it. Afterwards the quest will proceed. {{Bug|After sacrificing your follower, upon being asked to slay the other cultists, one of the markers may appear inside the ground or the mountain. A cultist may have spawned underground and the quest cannot be completed past this point.|confirmed=1}} ** One possible fix is reloading to a save prior to the fight and affixing your follower to the Altar of Sacrifice. The cultists will all gather around the altar waiting for you to strike the killing blow. Engaging the cultists before killing your follower in this manner is a possible fix. ** {{pc22}} Another possible fix is to use the resurrect console command on one of the cultists and kill them again. This should trigger the next step of the quest and Boethiah should talk to you through the cultist's corpse and continue the quest as normal. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=DA02 Hook |id=WEDA02 |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|10|Investigate the Boethiah cultist}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |!|Boethiah's Calling|DA02 |1||I found a book that mentioned a cult of Boethiah in the mountains near Windhelm. {{Quest Objective|1|Find the shrine of Boethiah}} |5||I have discovered a shrine to Boethiah in the mountains near Windhelm. {{Quest Objective|5|Find the cult of Boethiah}} |10||I am to lead someone to the Shrine of Boethiah, instruct them to touch the Pillar of Sacrifice, and once trapped by {{sic|it's|its|description=erroneous apostrophe}} magic, slay them. DA08 |Icon=SR-qico-Daedric.png |ReqLevel=20 |Difficulty=Medium |ReqItem=[[Skyrim:Whispering Door Key|Whispering Door Key]] }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to the innkeeper of [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] in Whiterun. # Ask Jarl [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Balgruuf the Greater]] about his children. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Nelkir|Nelkir]]. # Investigate the old wooden door in the basement. # Talk to Nelkir again. # Acquire the key from Balgruuf the Greater or [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]]. # Open the door. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Ebony Blade|Ebony Blade]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Disturbed Youth=== Speaking with the publican at [[Skyrim:The_Bannered_Mare|The Bannered Mare]] about rumors can have them reveal to you that there is trouble in the Jarl's family. :''Been hearing some strange tales of the Jarl's children. Say the one's turning wicked, and the others have an ill-favored look to them. Best to keep clear."'' You can ask the Jarl himself, [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Balgruuf the Greater]], about it. Initially, he is situated within Dragonsreach, but if the player sided with the Stormcloaks in the Civil War, he will be in the Blue Palace basement. He will eventually express concerns that his youngest son, [[Skyrim:Nelkir|Nelkir]], has become exceptionally brooding: ''"Yes, my youngest son. He's a dark child. I don't know what to do with him. He was always a quiet lad, but lately... something has changed. He's become brooding. Violent. He won't say a word to me, but I don't know how I upset him. If you could speak to him. Draw out the truth. I would be immensely grateful."'' Nelkir (who is always in Dragonsreach, regardless of where his father is), will be surprisingly forthcoming if you speak to him. :'''Your father said to speak to you.''' :''"So the disgusting pig sent you to bother me? One day, I'll tear his face apart so he can leave me alone. My father doesn't know anything about me. But I know about him. And about the war. More than he might think."'' :'''What sorts of things?''' :''"I know that he still worships Talos. That he hates the Thalmor almost as much as the Stormcloaks do. That he worries about being chased from Whiterun. That he... that I'm... that I don't have the same mother as my brother and sister."'' :'''How do you know these things?''' :''"This castle is old. Lots of places nobody's been in a long while. Places where you can overhear things. See things. And the Whispering Lady."'' :'''Who's the Whispering Lady?''' :''"She won't tell me her name. I've gotten good at listening to keyholes. At the door in the basement, I hear her talking to me. I thought I was caught, but she started telling me even more secrets. But I can't open the door."'' :'''Where is this door?''' :''"In the basement. Trust me, you'll see it. I bet she'll talk to you, too."'' ===The Whispering Lady=== [[File:SR-item-Ebony_Blade.jpg|thumb|right|The Ebony Blade]] The door is actually well hidden in plain sight off the main hall of Dragonsreach. In order to find it, go into the kitchen. Proceed down the stairs and open the closet door in the small servant's room. At the back of the closet is a locked door which seems to be covered in blood. Activate the door, and the disembodied voice of the [[Skyrim:Whispering Lady|Whispering Lady]] will begin talking to you. :'''(Listen at the door)''' :''"At last. I've been waiting for someone more fit to carry out my will. The child is spirited, but lacks... agency. :'''Is there someone behind the door?''' :''"Regrettably, I cannot reach your plane so directly. But I forgive you for not knowing who I am. Few hear my whispers anymore. I am Mephala, the Lady of Whispers. I tug at the web of connections between mortals. Love, hatred, loyalty, betrayal. The boy was good at sussing out secrets. You, I expect to take a more active role." :'''What could the boy not do?''' :''"The boy is good at sussing out secrets, but the corruptibility of children is ultimately too limited for my purposes. You, though, I expect will prove far more malleable."'' If you had asked her the latter question, there will be another stage of dialogue before the dialogue paths merge together again. :'''Who are you to expect anything?''' :''"I forgive your not knowing my name. Few can hear my whispers anymore. I am Mephala, the Lady of Whispers. I tug at the web of connections between mortals. Love, hatred, loyalty, betrayal."'' :'''I'm not so easily molded.''' :''"You may think so. But in the end, you mortals will always flit like fire with the winds of your desires and conveniences. And those winds issue from my whispers."'' At this point you will either confirm you are willing to help, or refuse to. :'''What do you want me to do?''' :''"First, you must open this door. A piece of my power has been locked away behind it, and even my eyes cannot see past the seals. I'd much rather it be in the hands of an ambitious and talented person such as yourself."'' :'''I don't want to help you.''' :''"Suit yourself. But those who listen at doors always wonder what is beyond them. Eventually your curiosity will drive you back to me."'' Regardless of your previous choice, you will now only have one option if you continue to speak to the door. :'''How do I open the door?''' :''"The whole of Whiterun is {{sic|ripe|rife}} with paranoia and tensions. The Jarl's court is right to fear the power I hold behind this door. The Jarl trusts few, and they will be his undoing. The dark child knows of what I speak. Let him guide your path."'' Return to Nelkir to learn how you can go about getting the key to the door. :'''Do you know how to open the Whispering Door?''' :''"I told you, I know everything about this castle. For some reason that door is special. Only two people can open it, Balgruuf and Farengar, the court wizard. How you get it from them is up to you. Nobody would notice if Farengar went missing, I promise you."'' ===Opening the Door=== Nelkir will tell you that only the Jarl and the court mage, [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]], possess a key to the Whispering Door, and suggests that Farengar will not be missed should he disappear. You can either track down the Jarl, who is either in his quarters or in the Blue Palace, or his wizard. Farengar will always be situated in Dragonsreach, even if the Jarl is now a prisoner of the Civil War. As for the key itself, you can pickpocket the [[Skyrim:Whispering Door Key|Whispering Door key]] off either Farengar or Balgruuf, or you can follow Nelkir's advice to kill Farengar and take it from his corpse. When you have the key, head down to the basement and open the door, which reveals a small room with a sword and a book resting on a table. The book, ''[[Skyrim:Admonition Against Ebony|Admonition Against Ebony]]'', warns you against taking the sword lying next to it; however, to complete the quest, simply ignore the warning and pick up the sword. Mephala will speak to you again. :''"Excellent work. Now, I trust you're sharp enough to see that the sword doesn't match the description of the Ebony Blade you may know. It has languished too long outside the winds of alliance and betrayal. To return to its past glory, it must first drink the blood of deceit. To return to its past glory, it must reacquaint itself with the hatred of this world. Your world is admirably seeped in lies and inclinations. My blade is a darling leech that feeds on deceptions, and nourishes its master. Seek out those closest to you. The final pluck of their misguided heartstrings will accompany my blade in the song of your grandeur."'' If you choose to restore the blade, it requires staining with the blood of treachery. However, the blade's restoration is not necessary to complete the quest, simply its retrieval. Also, while you do not receive any further information on Nelkir's condition, if there are any subsequent interactions there seems to be an improvement in disposition. If you do choose to use the blade as Mephala has instructed, she will speak to you again each time you kill a friend. :''"Excellent work, child."'' :''"I can feel their heartbreak swelling in my blade."'' :''"Their tears shine the ebony to a sharpest gleam."'' :''"Ah, the blood of deceit is a nourishing flow."'' After you perform the final needed kill, Mephala will speak to you a final time to congratulate you. :''"At last, my blade is returned to its full glory. Now go forth, child. Continue your tiny subversions against the orders of trust and intimacy."'' ==Notes== *Several leftover elements in the [[Skyrim Mod:Creation Kit|Creation Kit]] show that a portion of the quest was omitted from the final game. Originally, Jarl Balgruuf's children were all supposed to fall under Mephala's influence one by one, kill [[Skyrim:Karinda|Dagny's pet horse]], and then finally culminating in them killing Balgruuf in an act of patricide. His brother [[Skyrim:Hrongar|Hrongar]] would have replaced him as jarl upon death, given that he has unused dialogue mirroring Balgruuf's for several quests, and some citizens of Whiterun, like [[Skyrim:Ulfberth War-Bear|Ulfberth War-Bear]] have unused dialogue referring to Hrongar as jarl. **[[File:Flag Poland.png|22px]] While the original English dialogue for the unused portions of the quest was seemingly overwritten, the Polish localization still has all unused dialogue for Proventus, Nelkir, Frothar, and Dagny intact, shedding light on how their corruption and the buildup to Balgruuf's death would've transpired. *The quest is still available if you have completed [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun]] for the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]. Jarl Balgruuf will move from Dragonsreach to the basement of the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]], but his dialogue will not change and the quest can still be completed normally. *Despite Farengar allegedly being aware of the blade, you can still sell it to him. *Should Farengar have died before the quest starts, then you can only get the key from Balgruuf. *If you attempt to enter the room behind the Old Wooden Door using the "Platter Exploit" before you have completed the necessary steps in the quest, you will find a floating end table blocking your entry into the room; this is the source of Mephala's voice before unlocking the door. The sword, however, can still be seen on top of the table where it usually sits. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Hulda is necessary for this rumor to unlock. Ysolda can take over as publican of The Bannered Mare if Hulda dies, but she will not give the rumor.|USKP|1.2|[[Skyrim:Mikael|Mikael]] will replace Hulda instead of Ysolda, as he has dialogue to give the quest.}} ** Speaking to the jarl and asking about his kids will not activate this quest. ** You must have completed the [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] quest to receive the rumor from Hulda. {{Bug|Hulda may not show any new rumors available after you are level 20. The rumor from Hulda should come up in queue after picking up those bounties. If this does not work, the console command setstage DA08 10 will initiate the quest and give you a quest marker to speak to Nelkir.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|There may not be a dialogue option with the jarl after receiving the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]] and [[Skyrim:Ysolda|Ysolda]] both die, you cannot get this quest.|OSP|1.5|Ysolda is now marked as [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]].}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Ask about Balgruuf's strange children |id=DA08RumorPointer |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Ask about Balgruuf's strange children}} |!|The Whispering Door|DA08 |10||Balgruuf the Greater, Jarl of Whiterun, has a troubled child. Skyrim:Blindsighted.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Chezburgar |reward=multiple |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] |Reward= [[Skyrim:Nightingale Bow|Nightingale Bow]], [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]], [[Skyrim:Right Eye of the Falmer|Right Eye]] and [[Skyrim:Left Eye of the Falmer|Left Eye of the Falmer]] |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Trinity Restored|Trinity Restored]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Darkness Returns|Darkness Returns]] |Loc= [[Skyrim:Irkngthand|Irkngthand]] |Image=SR-quest-Blindsighted.jpg |ImgDesc=Mercer stealing the eyes from the great Falmer statue |description= Stop [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]]. |ID=TG08B |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |SuggLevel=12 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Travel to [[Skyrim:Irkngthand|Irkngthand]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]]. # Locate [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]]. # Slay Mercer Frey. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]]. # Escape from Irkngthand. # Speak with Karliah. ==Detailed Walkthrough== After becoming a Nightingale, speak to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]]. You learn that he and [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] decided that you should be the one to replace Mercer once you deal with him. After you accept, he tells you to meet them at [[Skyrim:Irkngthand|Irkngthand]] to stop Mercer Frey from stealing the Eyes of the Falmer and escaping with the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]] of Nocturnal. There are some bandits camped outside Irkngthand, but they're okay to kill or sneak past. The entrance is at the very top of the ruins. If you have a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]], they won't be able to accompany you. It's a winding path to get to the top; you may wish to come during the day so as to see it better. This dungeon is generally wide and allows enough space to sneak past most enemies. The [[Skyrim:Throw Voice|Throw Voice]] shout could well come in handy to distract the numerous Falmer you'll encounter within so you can sneak past them. ===Irkngthand Arcanex=== Once inside, it is recommended you sneak everywhere because there are [[Skyrim:Dwarven Scuttle|irises]] on the walls which will drop out [[Skyrim:Dwarven Sphere|Dwarven sphere guardians]] (masters if you are at a high level) that you'll have to fight. Right into the first room, you'll notice an expert-locked chest next to the dead bandits. There is another chest with an adept-level lock at your left, near the crumbled columns. There is also a master-level chest next to the wall by the crumbled columns on your right. Two bear traps are set into the stone of the platform about halfway up the stairs so that the traps are completely hidden until sprung. Defeat the Dwarven sphere inside the room with a shallow pool and proceed through the open gate. The next room has three more Dwarven spheres. Before going down the stairs, turn right and follow the path in the upper floor to find a chest. There's another chest close to the wall, on the lower floor. Continue to the next room and you'll come across several spinning [[Skyrim:Flamethrower Statues|flamethrower traps]]. Just follow in the same direction they're spinning, and you can make it through without being hurt. You can also use your [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout to get across easily. A couple of [[Skyrim:Dwarven Spider|Dwarven spiders]] will attack you on the way. Enter the corridor and you'll find an apprentice-locked chest straight ahead. At the end of the corridor, there is a Dwarven spider and another chest. There is also an apprentice-locked chest on the wall to your right just before the lift to Irkngthand Grand Cavern; it is next to a stone table with a built-in alchemy lab. There are a couple of potions, two Falmer ears and some scrap metal on the same table. When you are done, enter the lift area and activate the lever to descend to Irkngthand Grand Cavern. ===Irkngthand Grand Cavern=== Karliah and Brynjolf will follow you now. Karliah believes Mercer knows that you're following and plans to ambush you down here. There is a trap on the left side of the door. After deactivating the trap wire, go through the door and continue down the hall. There is a chest behind an expert-locked gate, at your left. T In the same room there are a couple of potions, some gems, scrap metal and various ingots. There are bear traps throughout this part of Irkngthand, especially in the corridors that connect the chambers, so watch where you step. In the large room, you will see a scene of Mercer sneak attacking a [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]], but you're unable to get to him. To open the door in the next room, you have to activate the levers on either side of the room overlooking the camp - these levers activate gears to either side of the gate, so once you have pulled the first lever, you must reach and pull the second lever before the gears activated by the first lever stop turning. The [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] shout can help here. The two levers can be pulled in either order to proceed. Be careful while crossing the chamber as there are spinning blade traps set in the floor that activate when you or your allies get close. There are two chests on the path to the east lever: one is next to a Falmer tent and the other one is next to the lever itself. The next chamber is in ruins and is full of Falmer. Take the ramp along the south side of the chamber to find a chest behind a tent. At the west end of the chamber, near the collapsed tower, a set of stairs leading down is blocked by rubble. A chest with an adept-level lock can be found among the rubble. Take the ramp next to the rubble-filled steps; it goes north and then curves back toward the south wall to a door. Enter and you will reach a room with a dead Falmer inside. Behind an open gate you'll find some empty chests, scrolls of detect life (which will come in handy when fighting Mercer) and a mirrored message from Mercer. The message reads "One step ahead - Mercer" There is a bear trap in the first part of the corridor leading out of the room. In the next room, shoot the [[Skyrim:Dwarven_Centurion|Dwarven centurion]] with an arrow while still standing on the steps - the Falmer will then fight and destroy him (it can also be activated via a button located on the side of the steps, if you drop down on the southwest side). Take the stairs on the east side of the chamber next to the skeever pen, and work your way up and around to the south end of the chamber. There are three bear traps in the walled corridor. There is a [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|Frostbite Spider]] nest with a few living spiders and a single egg sac. Moving ahead, you'll find a door leading to Irkngthand Slave Pens, with a Falmer chest to its right, and a Dwemer chest to its left. ===Irkngthand Slave Pens=== The pens are used as a hive by the Falmer. There are 100 [[Skyrim:Chaurus_Eggs|Chaurus egg sacs]] in the slave pens, the fourth highest concentration in Skyrim. Defeat the Dwarven spider and head up the stairs to the west to find a couple of ingots behind an apprentice-locked gate. As you come back out of the gate, turn right to harvest some [[Skyrim:Glowing_Mushroom|glowing mushrooms]] along the south wall. In the southeast corner of the room, a chest is hidden behind some rubble. Down the stairs, you'll find a torture chamber with two Falmer and a dead [[Skyrim:Thief (Irkngthand)|thief]] inside. You can kill both Falmer by sneaking through the grid and activating the trap lever. The corridor heading north and east has three pressure plate traps. Karliah will tell you that you have a choice between sneaking or fighting the Falmer in the large chamber beyond. There is a chest located inside the third Falmer tent on the right. There is also a chest in the tent across from the third on the right. The next room has a simple pipe maze. Kill the Falmer and head up the ramp along the west wall to find another chest with an apprentice-level lock. Further down the room you'll face more Falmer and [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]] through the path that leads to Irkngthand Sanctuary. On the east wall, a nook covered with spiderwebs has an egg sac with a spider egg. Go down the ramp on the west wall, and there is an expert-locked chest in the easternmost tent. If you wish to bypass the enemies here, you may also sneak across the overhead pipes. Just before entering the corridor that leads to the Sanctuary, there's a master-locked chest next to the Falmer door. ===Irkngthand Sanctuary=== In the sanctuary, you'll see a short scene of Mercer prying out the eyes of the Falmer statue. Mercer will then collapse the ledge you're standing on, and after a short conversation, you will have to fight him. During the fight, he will use his [[Skyrim:Agent of Subterfuge|Agent of Subterfuge]] power on Brynjolf, causing him to attack Karliah. This will keep Brynjolf and Karliah out of the fight. Mercer will turn [[Skyrim:Invisibility (effect)|invisible]] occasionally during the fight (position yourself on the stairs and let Mercer come to you; for whatever reason, he doesn't sneak up behind you). Use the [[Skyrim:Detect Life (effect)|Detect Life]] scrolls (or the [[Skyrim:Detect Life (spell)|Detect Life spell]] if you have it) to see him; if you have the [[Skyrim:Aura Whisper|Aura Whisper]] shout, this can also be used to reveal his location. If you have the [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] shout, use this when he appears in front of you and he can be taken easily if you are leveled high enough. Once Mercer dies, a pipe at the top of the room will burst, flooding the room. Take the Skeleton Key and the Eyes from Mercer's body, and wait for the water to rise. Once it gets high enough, a hole will appear in the roof above the statue's head. Run out through the short passage to escape. This takes you to [[Skyrim:Bronze Water Cave|Bronze Water Cave]]; if you had a follower, this is where they will be waiting for you. You can give the [[Skyrim:Left Eye of the Falmer|left eye]] to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin]] for gold as part of [[Skyrim:The Litany of Larceny|The Litany of Larceny]]; the [[Skyrim:Right Eye of the Falmer|right eye]] can be kept or sold to a merchant. Talk to Karliah to complete the quest, and she will give you her [[Skyrim:Nightingale_Bow|Nightingale bow]]. == Notes == *In the room after you have to choose the "high road or low road", after descending the ramp with the bear traps you can find an open door on the right side. There are three empty chests of the two different dwemer chest types (marked with the "empty" shadowmark), a few scrolls to pick up, and a note scratched into the metal door. Written backwards, the message reads "one step ahead -Mercer". *One easy way to end the battle quickly and effortlessly is to climb up to the ledge behind the statue. When Mercer comes to you, use Unrelenting Force to blow him off the ledge; a fall from this height will kill him instantly. Using a spell effect such as fire will make him easier to see while invisible. *Karliah was stripped of her Nightingale status and special power(s) for failing to keep the Skeleton Key secured, yet Mercer Frey keeps his [[Skyrim:Agent of Subterfuge|Agent of Subterfuge]] despite "stealing" the Key. == Bugs == {{Bug|If asked to stop following you, Karliah and Brynjolf may not automatically start following you again. When you enter the sanctuary, they will appear.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|While the water is filling in Irkngthand, when you touch the water the game may freeze.|confirmed=1}} ** Reloading a previous save from before entering that zone should resolve this. {{Bug|Before leaving the sanctuary, be sure to talk to Karliah or both she and Brynjolf may become stuck underwater. At this point you will not be able to talk to her, essentially breaking the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console commands prid 58F1A and then moveto player. This way you can talk to her and continue the quest. **Alternatively, you can try swimming and bumping into Karliah repeatedly to knock her into the correct path and out of the water, at which point she will continue normally. This may take a while, so it is a good idea to have a waterbreathing enchanted item with you to prevent drowning (if you are not playing as an Argonian). **Another option is to shoot her with arrows when she is in sight from the land. She will run up at you. If you have a potion of paralysis, paralyze her when she is on land. Exit and come back. {{Bug|You may be unable to loot the Skeleton Key and one of the eyes from Mercer's body.|confirmed=1}} **To solve this, go out to one of the beds at the start of the dungeon, "sleep" in it, and the game will ask ''"Serve your time in jail?"'' Click yes and you'll appear outside of the prison you broke out of. Now you can return and loot the corpse. {{Bug|Where you enter the room with the statue where Mercer is, you may freeze and the game does nothing after Mercer says ''"Karliah, When will you ever learn you cannot get a drop on me?"''|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console command setstage TG08B 40 to fix this. **{{Pc22}} You can also use command prid 00022651 and then moveto player to move Mercer to your position and fall down off the ledge, then he will automatically go back to his correct position on top of the statue. He will then continue to cast a spell making the ledge crumble and will speak to you. {{Bug|If you beat Mercer behind the statue's head, he might fall through the ground, making you unable to loot him, thus preventing the quest from advancing. Simply reload to fix this.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console command setstage TG08B 50 to fix this. {{Bug|Brynjolf or Karliah may leave their posts and walk to Riften as soon as you enter Irkngthand, rendering the quest non-completable. Their dialogue may say that they are still in Irkngthand. You can find them on the path to Riften from Irkngthand by following your quest marker. You will be able to then start the quest with Karliah, although a short run back to Irkngthand will be required. Make sure to keep Brynjolf and Karliah close during your advance back up to Irkngthand as not zoning into Irkngthand means that you are not guaranteed any followers.|vn=1}} ** To fix this, simply go through the dungeon yourself, and they will appear in the Sanctuary once you get there. {{Bug|The game will freeze or lag in the middle of Irkngthand.|confirmed=1}} ** One known fix is to restart the console and reload your last save. {{Bug|If you speak to Karliah again after escaping from the water and after the dialogue she initiates, the game will display dialogue options that should only become available at the end of the quest [[Skyrim:Darkness Returns|Darkness Returns]].|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you enter the Sanctuary while sneaking, Karliah and Brynjolf may not enter and Mercer will be unable to climb down the statue.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|In the Irkngthand Grand Cavern, Brynjolf will ask you to choose the between the high or low road. You may see a Falmer stuck inside of one of the tents. If you kill the Falmer in the tent and enter the tent to loot, you may become stuck as well.|USKP|2.0.2}} {{Bug|The bodies of the two Falmer you observe being killed by Mercer in Irkngthand Grand Cavern may not be there when you reach their location.}} ** Leaving the zone and returning will respawn their bodies. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I'm on my way to Irkngthand, a vast dwarven ruin that supposedly contains the legendary "Eyes of the Falmer." Skyrim:Blood on the Ice.wikitext: {{Protection|semi}}{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Windhelm Guard|Windhelm Guard]] (see [[#How to Start the Quest|this section]] for details) |Reward=Allows decoration of [[Skyrim:Hjerim|Hjerim]] when purchased, optional [[Skyrim:Necromancer Amulet|Necromancer Amulet]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev= |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] |Image=SR-quest-Blood on the Ice2.jpg |ImgDesc=A serial killer is on the loose in Windhelm |description=[[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] is plagued by a shadowy killer. |ID=MS11, MS11b |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Go to the murder scene in Windhelm's graveyard and talk to the guard. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Jorleif|Jorleif]] in the Palace of Kings in Windhelm. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Helgird|Helgird]] in Windhelm's [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Windhelm)|Hall of the Dead]]. # Follow the trail of blood to [[Skyrim:Hjerim|Hjerim]] and obtain the key. # Search Hjerim for evidence. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Viola Giordano|Viola Giordano]] and [[Skyrim:Calixto Corrium|Calixto Corrium]]. # Make an important [[#Follow Your Instincts|choice]]. # Patrol the Stone Quarter at night and catch the murderer. # Report back to Jorleif. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Killer on the Loose=== When you first visit Windhelm, a few of the citizens and guards will mention a serial killer on the loose. A general fear is noticeable, but nobody will really talk about the killings, and it remains nothing but a rumor. When the right conditions have been met (see [[#How to Start the Quest|this section]] on how to trigger), the body of the [[Skyrim:Candlehearth Hall|Candlehearth Hall]] barmaid, [[Skyrim:Susanna the Wicked|Susanna the Wicked]], will appear, surrounded by witnesses, in the graveyard. If you approach the scene, a [[Skyrim:Windhelm Guard|guard]] will stop you and explain a bit about the murders. The guard also explains about the local guards being too busy with the war to do any real investigation, and they would gladly accept some help from you. For starters, he tasks you with questioning the three townsfolk gathered around the body. ===Investigator of Windhelm=== On a rare venture outside the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Windhelm)|Hall of the Dead]], [[Skyrim:Helgird|Helgird]] will be little help at the moment, but will point out that Susanna's coin purse is still intact. [[Skyrim:Calixto Corrium|Calixto Corrium]] claims he 'saw a fellow running away, but didn't get a good look at him', while local beggar [[Skyrim:Silda the Unseen|Silda the Unseen]] didn't make it to the scene before Susanna was dead and the killer gone. The guard will not be particularly surprised with the lack of hard evidence or witnesses, and will point you towards Castle Steward [[Skyrim:Jorleif|Jorleif]] for assistance and helpful advice. [[File:SR-quest-Blood on the Ice 06.jpg|thumb|right|''"Large diagonal cut from left shoulder..."'']] In the [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]], Jorleif will be shocked to hear about the third killing, and will gladly accept your help. He will promise you assistance from himself and all the town guards during the investigation. A map marker will now always point towards him, but he will rarely have anything helpful to add. Now it's time to investigate the crime scene without interference from the guard. Susanna's body will have been removed from the crime scene, and only the spatters of blood remain. The guard has noticed the blood as well, and hints that this evidence possibly holds a clue; however, for now you are urged to talk to [[Skyrim:Helgird|Helgird]] in the Hall of the Dead. Due to her profession and life-long experience with dead bodies, she may be able to come up with some answers. Enter the Hall of the Dead and find Helgird busy examining Susanna's dead body, obviously puzzled by the large diagonal cuts she finds. When asked, she will reveal the shape of the cuts to be somewhat unusual, like they were made with a curved blade designed for embalming, the exact tools she uses. You can choose to indicate her involvement in the killings or simply to leave the conversation, but the results are the same. Helgird will refuse to speak to you further and will ask to be left in peace so she can prepare the body for the funeral. Because both [[Skyrim:Jorleif|Jorleif]] and the guard are unable to do anything at the moment, your only hope for finding a clue is in the graveyard. The remaining evidence seems to be a trail of blood leading from the graveyard. Follow the bloody trail around the corner and up the stairs, where it ends at the entrance to [[Skyrim:Hjerim|Hjerim]], a huge manor opposite the [[Skyrim:House of Clan Cruel-Sea|House of Clan Cruel-Sea]]. (If you chose to follow the bloody trail before speaking to Helgird, the map marker pointing toward her will now be gone.) ===Hjerim=== The front door is locked, so either pick the lock or ask Jorleif and/or any guard in town about access to Hjerim. They will briefly tell you about how the house used to belong to the now deceased Friga Shatter-Shield, and it has been abandoned ever since her untimely death. They will also point you towards her mother, [[Skyrim:Tova Shatter-Shield|Tova Shatter-Shield]]. Wait for Tova to leave her house. She will be browsing the market between 11am and 3pm, while she spends her afternoons at Candlehearth Hall. When you approach the grieving mother, it becomes apparent that Friga was one of the victims of the killer. Naturally, Tova will be more than willing to hand you the [[Skyrim:Key to Hjerim|key]] so you can go take a look inside. If you cannot find her, she may be in her home dead after committing suicide (if you have previously committed a certain murder for the Dark Brotherhood) and you can simply take the key off her body. [[File:SR-quest-Blood_on_the_Ice.jpg|thumb|right|The secret chamber]] When entering Hjerim, a [[#Journal. Entries|quest update]] will immediately tell you to look for clues, so take a look around. The blood trail leads to a chest in the southeastern corner, so investigate it and pry it open. Within, you will find eleven pamphlets called ''[[Skyrim:Beware the Butcher!|Beware the Butcher!]]'' along with the ''[[Skyrim:Butcher Journal 1|Butcher's Journal #1]]''. Even though your quest journal now encourages you to follow up on these clues, keep looking around the house. Ignore the mead scattered on the floor and proceed to the two wardrobes in the western alcove. The wardrobe to the right is nailed to the wall, so open it and remove the false back panel. This will reveal the killer's hideout, a room filled with bones, bloody remains and the suspected embalming instruments. Investigate the altar and pick up the ''[[Skyrim:Butcher Journal 2|Butcher's Journal #2]]'' for more evidence. Leave the room, and look at the small shelf between the wardrobes. It contains even more pamphlets, but also a [[Skyrim:Strange Amulet|strange amulet]]. This is the last item of evidence, so make sure to pick it up. Read the pamphlet to learn about a Windhelm citizen named [[Skyrim:Viola Giordano|Viola Giordano]]. Before leaving, if you want to avoid investigating Hjerim with Viola later on, pick up ''[[SR:Butcher Journal 2|Butcher's Journal #2]]'', if you want to experience the full quest scene, just taking ''[[SR:Beware the Butcher!|Beware the Butcher!]]'' and [[SR:Strange Amulet|Strange Amulet]] is enough, ''[[Skyrim:Butcher Journal 1|Butcher's Journal #1]]'' has nothing to do with progressing the quest stage. ===Follow up on the Clues=== Pay a quick visit to the helpful Jorleif (or a guard) for advice on how to proceed. When you show him the amulet, he will be quite puzzled but will point you to Calixto at the [[Skyrim:Calixto's House of Curiosities|House of Curiosities]] for an opinion. When asked about the term 'the Butcher' he will spitefully refer you to Viola Giordano, the author of the pamphlets and the one to seek out for background information on the killings. At this point, map markers will point to both Viola and Calixto, but it is recommended to visit Calixto first. ====Calixto Corrium==== Calixto had opened up his small museum with his now-deceased sister, showcasing the various items they found during the adventures they shared back in the day. These days, Calixto spends most of his time sitting in a chair doing absolutely nothing but mourning the loss of his sister and rambling about how happy she'd have been seeing all the curious items under one roof. Not surprisingly, Calixto will, for a small fee, offer a guided tour around the small House of Curiosities and explain the background for a few of the items. It is a good idea to accept this tour, just for the investigation. When you present him with the strange amulet, he will tell you that it's the Wheelstone, traditionally carried by court mages. He will then offer to take it off your hands for 500 gold. Due to a [[#Bugs|bug]] with the amulet, it is recommended to accept this offer. ====Viola Giordano==== Viola is an [[Skyrim:Imperial|Imperial]] who tends to wander the streets of Windhelm during the day and hang out at [[Skyrim:Candlehearth Hall|Candlehearth Hall]] in the evening. Track her down (with a "Beware the Butcher!" flyer from Hjerim in your inventory) and question her. She is understandably upset about the presence of a serial killer and the apathy of the town guards. If you failed to pick up the journal in the hidden chamber back in Hjerim, Viola will immediately take interest in the old house and set off at a running pace to help with the investigation. If you already have the journal, Viola will point to [[Skyrim:Wuunferth the Unliving|Wuunferth]], the court mage in the Palace of the Kings, as the most likely person to be experimenting with Necromancy. If you chose to speak to Viola before Calixto, the map marker pointing toward him will now be gone. Still, go sell him the strange amulet before going anywhere near the Palace of the Kings. This will net you 500 gold and one less [[#Bugs|bug]] to worry about. {{SkyrimBox|main-color=#FBEFD5|text-color=black|text= '''At this point, your next decision will affect how the quest proceeds, and whether the killer is able to strike again.''' Even if the map marker now points you towards the Palace and your journal tells you to confront Jorleif with the evidence against the court mage, talking to Jorleif can be fatal for the townsfolk of Windhelm. Another option is available, although it's unsaid. You can go directly to the accused [[Skyrim:Wuunferth the Unliving|Wuunferth]] and confront him yourself, without ever talking to Jorleif. * See [[#Wuunferth|this section]] if you choose to confront '''Wuunferth'''. * See [[#Jorleif|this section]] if you choose to speak to '''Jorleif'''. Your reward will remain the same regardless of your choice. }} ===Follow Your Instincts=== ====Wuunferth==== Wuunferth the Unliving lives a secluded life in the Palace of the Kings, but you are free to go visit him at any time. During the day, he will be in his quarters (first door on the left on entering, upstairs, at the far end). He spends his nights wandering around downstairs. Confront him with the rumors about him performing necromancy. He will be quite insulted and will retort that he's a member in good standing of the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]]. When you mention the journals and describe the amulet he will immediately identify it as the legendary [[Skyrim:Necromancer Amulet|Necromancer Amulet]], and dismiss Calixto's theories about it being the Wheelstone. He reveals that he's also been investigating the killings in Windhelm for quite some time. Noting a pattern with their location and timing, he predicts the killer will strike again the next day in the Stone Quarter, and asks you to keep watch. Now leave Wuunferth alone, ignore the map marker still pointing towards Jorleif, and head to the Stone Quarter and wait until nighttime. Proceed with the walkthrough in [[#Catch the Killer!|this section]]. ====Jorleif==== [[File:SR-quest-Blood_on_the_Ice_02.jpg|thumb|left|''"Has the whole city lost their brains?"'']] When you tell Jorleif that Wuunferth is the main suspect, and about the necromancer lair in Hjerim, he will be shocked at first; he will, however, find the evidence convincing enough to take action. After thanking you for making the streets of Windhelm safe again, he will set off towards the guard patrolling the palace entrance and order him to come along for an arrest. At this point, the quest will end and you will be left behind in the main hall, without any reward whatsoever. If you follow Jorleif and the guard into Wuunferth's chambers and eavesdrop during the arrest, a frustrated Wuunferth will claim that he was investigating the murders as well, and will shout that this isn't over when the guard drags him to the [[Skyrim:Windhelm Barracks|barracks]]. At this point, it will be impossible to discuss the subject with any of the characters. [[File:SR-quest-Blood on the Ice 04.jpg|thumb|right|''"Looks like you aren't such a sharp investigator after all."'']] After three full calendar days spent outside Windhelm, you will see a familiar scene upon your return. A guard will be standing next to yet another slain victim (she is on the right of Candlehearth Hall when approaching from the Palace of the Kings): an [[Skyrim:High Elf|Altmer]] named [[Skyrim:Arivanya|Arivanya]] from [[Skyrim:Windhelm Stables|Windhelm Stables]]. The guard will be devastated and quick to inform you of your failure. A new quest with the same name will pop up in your journal, and the guard will suggest you remedy your mistake by talking to the imprisoned Wuunferth. Head to the barracks underneath the Palace and speak to the wizard. When you tell him that the Butcher has claimed yet another victim, he will point out that he's behind bars, and make a jab at your abilities as an investigator. When you tell him about the journal and the amulet, he will deny any knowledge of a journal and ask you to describe the shape of the amulet. He will then identify it as the rare and legendary [[Skyrim:Necromancer Amulet|Necromancer Amulet]]. While he rejects Calixto's Wheelstone theory on the spot, he will reveal that he has noted a pattern in the location and timing of the killings, and asks you to keep watch in the Stone Quarter at night, as he predicts the killer will strike again. ===Catch the Killer!=== [[File:SR-quest-Blood_on_the_Ice_03.jpg|thumb|right|The killer strikes again.]] When you head outside, the Stone Quarter will be incredibly quiet. The entire market is usually devoid of people at night, with the exception of a guard that may be present. You can spot the murderer following his final potential victim through the graveyard and the alley, up to the steps into the market from the west. As they enter the market, you will witness elderly museum owner [[Skyrim:Calixto Corrium|Calixto Corrium]] sneak up behind a female citizen (normally [[Skyrim:Arivanya|Arivanya]], but another woman will be randomly chosen if she is already dead), with his knife drawn for the next kill. You can attack Calixto or use a spell on him to save his would-be victim. If you fail to dispose of him before he slits her throat, or if you attack Calixto and save her, he will panic and take off at a running pace towards his necromancer chamber in Hjerim. Follow him and be ready for a fight, although he shouldn't pose much of a problem. Once dead, loot him for the now-restored Necromancer Amulet (if you sold it to him) and a few other valuable items. Make sure to pick up his [[Skyrim:Calixto's Key|key]], as it will help you reveal the truth behind the murders. If you managed to slay him outside, guards will arrive and point you towards Jorleif for one final conversation. If you slay him outside with a ranged attack, the guards will not approach even after you loot the body, instead continuing to patrol the area. When you speak to Jorleif, he will thank you and say that the city guard will be more cordial to you in the future. While optional, it is worth your time to pay a visit to Calixto's now abandoned museum of curiosities to find out the motive behind his murders. In the upstairs area, you will find his chest, unlocked with the key you claimed from his body. Inside are all of his embalming tools, along with the first part of his ''[[Skyrim:Butcher Journal|Journal]]''. When reading through it, it becomes apparent that the untimely death of his sister Lucilla drove him to madness and that the murders, body parts, and necromancer rituals were all part of a desperate attempt to bring her back to life. After completing the quest, Windhelm guards will sometimes say, ''"You did this city a great service by catching that killer. Well done."'' or ''"I was this close to catching that killer. I swear it."'' ==How to Start the Quest== There's a global variable counter that will increase each time you enter Windhelm or the immediate surrounding area, either by walking or fast-traveling. It need reach at least 4 to make the quest available. When arriving [[SR:Windhelm Stables|Windhelm Stables]], You can use the console command show MS11EnteringWindhelmCount to check it, it must be 1 if you arrive the first time, and then you can use console command tb to show the border of Windhelm immediate surrounding area, the nearest border is just the main rode west of the [[SR:Alfarinn|Alfarinn]]'s carriage a bit. Then walk back and forth the border twice to make the MS11EnteringWindhelmCount increased to 3. Then make sure the time is between 7pm and 7am, if not, wait until the time meets. Then walk back and forth the border one more time to make the MS11EnteringWindhelmCount increased to 4, then enter Windhelm. If MS11EnteringWindhelmCount is increased to 4 but the time isn't between 7pm and 7am, the quest will not be available, you'll have to enter one more time in the right time, which will increase MS11EnteringWindhelmCount to 5 or greater. [[Skyrim:Tova Shatter-Shield|Tova Shatter-Shield]] and [[Skyrim:Arivanya|Arivanya]] also need to be alive (see [[#Bugs|bugs section]]). When the quest becomes available, besides the dead [[SR:Susanna the Wicked|Susanna the Wicked]], the lock to [[Skyrim:Hjerim|Hjerim]] will also change from a "key required"-lock to a Master-level lock. If you prefer to start the quest before MS11EnteringWindhelmCount reaches 4, you can manage to obtain [[SR:Keys#Key_to_Hjerim|Key to Hjerim]] from [[SR:Tova Shatter-Shield|Tova Shatter-Shield]], then enter Hjerim and pick up one of the Beware the Butcher! pamphlets to trigger the quest. The quest can't be triggered if the unofficial patch is installed. However, the quest will not start in the same way as outlined in the walkthrough above; you will have to figure out what to do on your own without help from Jorleif, however all of the same options will be open to you except that none of the witnesses will be present in the graveyard; you can sell Calixto the Strange Amulet, you can have Wuunferth arrested or talk to him to catch Calixto, and you will have to talk to Viola in order to continue on with the quest after picking up a pamphlet. ==Notes== * Either civil war side is joined, this quest has nothing to do with [[Skyrim:Thane of Eastmarch|Thane of Eastmarch]] without unofficial patch, and this quest must be completed if unofficial patch is installed. * There are three known murder victims prior to those encountered on the quest: Friga Shatter-Shield, the twin sister of [[Skyrim:Nilsine Shatter-Shield|Nilsine]]; Isabella, as mentioned by [[Skyrim:Adonato Leotelli|Adonato Leotelli]]; and Fjotli Cruel-Sea, as mentioned by both her father [[Skyrim:Torsten Cruel-Sea|Torsten]] and [[Skyrim:Niranye|Niranye]] during the quest [[Skyrim:Summerset Shadows|Summerset Shadows]]. Since Hjerim's hidden room contains several peoples' remains, these hint that the killer was also either a grave robber, or committed even more murders. ** Despite there being (at least) three victims prior to Susanna, the guard near her body will claim that she is the third victim. * If you've killed [[Skyrim:Nilsine Shatter-Shield|Nilsine]] in order to get a bonus reward in the quest [[Skyrim:Mourning Never Comes|Mourning Never Comes]], Tova will be dead inside her house, and you must retrieve the key to Hjerim from her corpse in time or it will disappear after several days. * When Arivanya is killed by the Butcher, she may show the same type of wounds as Susanna did. * Sometimes, on completion of this quest, the message that the quest is completed will be displayed twice. This is because two quests with the same name are running simultaneously. The second instance of quest completion occurs due to Wuunferth being absolved of guilt. ==Bugs== === Initiating the Quest === {{Bug|Although most of the NPCs needed for the quest to initiate are marked as essential, another quest, namely the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] quest [[Skyrim:Mourning Never Comes|Mourning Never Comes]], will encourage you to kill [[Skyrim:Nilsine Shatter-Shield|Nilsine Shatter-Shield]]. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]].
# Collect a [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch|Glenmoril Witch]]'s head.
# (Optional) Wipe out the [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch|Glenmoril Witches]]. 
# Return to [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Price of Power===
After completing two radiant quests for the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] (one of which must be for [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela]]), your next major assignment will be available, courtesy of the elderly Harbinger himself, [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]]. He will chastise you for your actions against the [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]], and will then tell you the true story about how the Companions contracted [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|Lycanthropy]]. Apparently, one of his predecessors made a pact with the [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch|Glenmoril Witches]] to gain more power, not knowing the true price of his actions: an afterlife spent in [[Lore:Hircine|Hircine]]'s [[Lore:Hunting Grounds|Hunting Grounds]], not in [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]]. It is this fate which compels Kodlak to seek a cure. He then sends you off by yourself, in search of the Glenmoril Witches.

===The Coven===
[[Skyrim:Glenmoril Coven|Glenmoril Coven]] is located in the northwest reaches of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], southeast of [[Skyrim:Lost Valley Redoubt|Lost Valley Redoubt]]. Upon entering, proceed to the main chamber where you will encounter the first Glenmoril Witch, a powerful variety of [[Skyrim:Hagraven|Hagraven]]. She will attack you on sight, accompanied by a [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|Frostbite Spider]] or [[Skyrim:Skeever|Skeever]]. After the battle, claim her [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch Head |head]]. The chamber functions as a nexus to four smaller chambers, each with a witch and some valuable loot. The [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Horror of Castle Xyr|The Horror of Castle Xyr]]'' is in a tent in the northwestern chamber and the [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:A Tragedy in Black|A Tragedy in Black]]'' is in the northernmost chamber. While it is optional to kill all five witches, killing at least four is recommended if you want to [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy#Curing Lycanthropy|cure yourself of lycanthropy]] later on. Despite the described weight of the heads, no weight penalty is added when you pick them up as quest items.

===Jorrvaskr  Attacked!===
When you return to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], things will be different and you will notice several citizens gathered around near the stairs leading to [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]]. Halfway up the stairs, you will find both [[Skyrim:Torvar|Torvar]] and Aela the Huntress next to dead Silver Hand members. When you enter the building, [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] will seek you out and ask you where you were in the time of need. In your absence, the Silver Hand attacked Jorrvaskr, managing to kill old Kodlak and take off with all the fragments of [[Skyrim:Wuuthrad|Wuuthrad]]. You will find Kodlak's dead body near the central fireplace, with [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] and [[Skyrim:Njada Stonearm|Njada Stonearm]] kneeling next to him; both unresponsive. Vilkas will claim that his death will be avenged, which will end the quest and immediately start the next one, [[Skyrim:Purity of Revenge|Purity of Revenge]].

==Notes==
*You won't be able to ask Farkas or Vilkas for work once this quest becomes available. They will both decline, and advise you to stick with Aela instead. Farkas will say ''"Aela said you were hers, and I wasn't supposed to interfere. She scares me."'' and Vilkas will say ''"Aela's laid claim to your services, and I've learned the hard way not to upset her. Best you stick to her for now."'' Neither of them will be available for work until you finish the Companions questline. The same thing goes for Aela once this quest is finished.
*If you are a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolf]] when you attack the Glenmoril Witches, they will say "So the beast returns" during combat. This happens regardless of if you are in Beast Form.
*If you have a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] prior to completing this quest, he/she will be replaced by Vilkas once you enter Jorrvaskr at the end of this quest.  This will cause your previous follower to "reset", meaning they will return to their respective origin, and will appear again as they did when you first met.  However, any items that were given to them will still be in their inventory if you return later to regain them as a follower.
*Kodlak's body cannot be interacted with or searched, as the quest script makes it uninteractable.
*Regardless of whether you kill all the Glemoril Witches or not, the [[Skyrim:Guards|guards]] will praise you upon the completion of Blood's Honor.

= -1 ([[SR:Dagny|Dagny]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Message to Whiterun]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] |Image=SR-quest-Battle_for_Whiterun.jpg |ImgDesc=The Stormcloaks begin their advance on the city of Whiterun |description=Take [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] in the name of the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]. |ID=CWSiegeObj |Icon=SR-qico-Stormcloaks.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Get your orders from [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric]]. #Meet the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] preparing for the attack. #Storm [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. #Defeat [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf the Greater]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Making it to the Gates=== [[File:SR-quest-Battle_for_Whiterun4.jpg|thumb|left|The Whiterun guard have stationed themselves atop the walls in order to defend the city...]] After finishing the previous quest, Jarl [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] will tell you that you are going to help take [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. Report to [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] for orders, who will direct you to meet him outside the city. At this point, the Whiterun and Dragonsreach icons will disappear from the map and the city will not be reachable via fast travel for the duration of this quest, even if a house is owned or if you have a spouse in Whiterun. Only the surroundings of the city can be reached via fast travel, or you can use a [[Skyrim:Transport#Carriage|Carriage]] from [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] to get there by asking [[Skyrim:Alfarinn|Alfarinn]], it will cost you 20 gold, however if you choose this option. Head to the [[Skyrim:Whiterun Military Camp|Whiterun Military Camp]], southwest of Whiterun, and you will notice that the besieging of Whiterun has already begun. Head to where Galmar is briefing the men on the attack and listen in. He will say your destination is the drawbridge that has been raised to keep the attackers out. Once the rallying of the troops is done, charge in with Galmar and the troops. Don't worry too much about killing all the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]], as more spawn. When you reach the first set of wooden barricades is also when you meet the first enemies. Breaking through the barricades is easy. Hit them a few times with a weapon and they break. Your journal will then tell you to lower the drawbridge. Move up the path to the small wooden bridge with the stone walls to your side, head up there, and go up the walkway. You will see two drawbridge levers over the drawbridge. Pull one. The bridge will fall, and the soldiers will run into the city. {{NewLine}} ===Inside the City=== [[File:SR-quest-Battle_for_Whiterun2.jpg|thumb|right|...which is quickly overwhelmed by the Stormcloaks.]] Head into the city. Your destination now is [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] (It may be safer to stay with Galmar and the soldiers). Several barriers block the entrance to the plains district, which are destroyed after 3 blows from any weapon (power attacks make no difference). Upon entering Dragonsreach, three soldiers will charge at you, but they will die easily. Continue up the stairs, where [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Balgruuf]] will shout about not letting you take the city without fighting back. Then he, three guards, and his Housecarl, [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]], will attack you. Kill the soldiers. After the jarl is reduced to 25% health, he will stop the fight and surrender. [[Skyrim:Vignar Gray-Mane|Vignar Gray-Mane]] will approach the jarl and they will have a short conversation. Galmar will stop the conversation after a while, Vignar will walk off after a few more words and Balgruuf will address you for a minute. With Balgruuf stepping down, Vignar takes the throne as the new Jarl of Whiterun. The quest will end there and the next quest, [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]], will begin. When you return to Ulfric Stormcloak in Windhelm, he commends you for the victory and rewards you with an enchanted leveled weapon and gives you the title "Ice-Veins". ==Notes== *The Whiterun Guards faced in this battle are significantly lower level than those normally patrolling the city. *Bodies will quite often disappear during this quest - this is intentional to reduce lag and is not a bug. *After the battle, if you have an outstanding bounty in the Whiterun Hold, it will be erased. *This quest, [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)|Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], and [[Skyrim:Battle for Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]] are all different radiant versions of the same quest. *From here on, Stormcloak Soldiers will take over as guards of the Whiterun Hold, though Whiterun Guards will continue to patrol [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. Whether this is intentional or not is unknown. **There is another exception. After the battle, the [[Skyrim:Wounded Soldier|Wounded Soldier]] won't be replaced with a Stormcloak one, and will continue to wear his yellow Whiterun guard's armor. Again, whether this is intentional or not is unknown. *Taking the carriage directly to Whiterun automatically skips the objective to "Break through the Enemy Barricade". *After getting your orders at the Whiterun Military camp, you can head straight to Windhelm. The battle will be won in your absence, but Ulfric Stormcloak will be disappointed that you ran away. *[[Skyrim:Severio Pelagia|Severio Pelagia]] dies at the beginning of this quest. *Even before this quest has begun, Whiterun Guards and Stormcloak soldiers can be seen engaging each other in combat. *If you previously befriended [[Skyrim:Alfhild Battle-Born|Alfhild Battle-Born]], [[Skyrim:Idolaf Battle-Born|Idolaf Battle-Born]], or [[Skyrim:Lars Battle-Born|Lars Battle-Born]], they will remain friendly after the Stormcloaks gain control of Whiterun. *If you previously told [[Skyrim:Idolaf Battle-Born|Idolaf Battle-Born]] that you support the Battle-Borns, Idolaf will remain friendly after the Stormcloaks gain control of Whiterun. *If [[Skyrim:Lucia|Lucia]]{{HF}} has been adopted, she will be transferred to the Bannered Mare until after the battle is over. This happens because her editor location is there and CWCitizensFlee will pick her up in one of the aliases. * [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] will have a barricade across the main entrance and both doors will be expert-locked, however if you pick the lock, both [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]] and [[Skyrim:Saadia|Saadia]] will have their normal speech options, welcoming you and are willing to trade. * [[Skyrim:Breezehome|Breezehome]] becomes locked again, key required. * [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]] is apprentice-locked during this battle, however if you pick the lock [[Skyrim:Sabjorn|Sabjorn]] will be back in charge with both him and [[Skyrim:Mallus Maccius|Mallus Maccius]] telling you to get out and treating you as if they don't know you. You are unable to trade with either of them. * You will be unable to enter [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] during or after the battle as all the doors require a key. * Your horse can easily be killed if it's waiting by the stables, as it does if you fast-traveled here. * Unused files suggest Jarl Balgruuf the Greater was intended to flee the battle through a secret passage located behind the throne rather than stay and fight. * Stealing items causes a bounty to be applied to Eastmarch rather than Whiterun. * After this quest [[Skyrim:Fort Greymoor|Fort Greymoor]] will be garrisoned by Stormcloak rebels. Additionally, [[Skyrim:Whiterun Imperial Camp|Whiterun Imperial Camp]] will finally be set up, though the soldiers there will be hostile. [[Skyrim:Whiterun Stormcloak Camp|Whiterun Stormcloak Camp]] will now be abandoned, and a hunter's camp will be there instead. The default banners at [[Skyrim:Western Watchtower|Western Watchtower]] and [[Skyrim:Whitewatch Tower|Whitewatch Tower]] will be replaced with blue Stormcloak ones. The Imperial swords at Whitewatch Tower will be replaced as well. ==Bugs== {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] may fail to greet you properly after the battle is finished.|OSP|1.9}} {{Bug|Random [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] attacks may occur in and around the city of Whiterun during this quest.|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} {{Bug|After defeating the Jarl and getting him to surrender, the quest pointer may continue to point to him, but no interaction is possible and the quest does not update.|confirmed=1}} **Striking the Jarl and then paying off the bounty may fix this. **Using Unrelenting Force to knock down both Vignar Gray-Mane and Balgruuf at the same time may also fix this. {{Bug|The doors to Jorrvaskr and the Underforge will become locked during this mission, and may not unlock after it's completed.
