{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Eddie the head |checkedBy= |reward=Eddie the head |rewardChecked= }}{{Quest Header |type=Stormcloaks |Giver=[[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] |Reward=Leveled enchanted sword and Shrine of Talos in Solitude restored |Disp= = -1 ([[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]])
= -1 ([[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Hraggstad|The Battle for Fort Hraggstad]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]] |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] |Image=SR-quest-Battle_for_Solitude.jpg |ImgDesc=The Stormcloaks mount their final offensive |description=Conquer the [[SR:Imperial Legion|Imperial]] [[Skyrim:Solitude|capital]] and free Skyrim from the Empire! |ID=CWSiegeObj |Icon=SR-qico-Stormcloaks.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Get your orders from [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]]. #Go to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and listen to [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]]'s speech. #Fight your way to [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]]. #Make [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] surrender. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Assaulting the city=== After taking [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]] and returning to [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]], you will be told to meet [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] and help take [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. Make your way to the gates to Solitude to hear Ulfric's speech. After the speech, everyone will run into Solitude. Follow them in and fight your way to [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]]. If facing problems coping with the Imperial soldiers, it would be a good idea to stick with Ulfric. There will be several wooden barricades littering the city—three hits or less from a weapon or [[SR:Destruction|Destruction]] spell will break them. The gate to the courtyard will be closed, so you will have to go around the city to get to Castle Dour. ===Negotiation at its finest=== Once you've had enough fighting, enter Castle Dour. Galmar and Ulfric will appear inside with you. You will be put in a cutscene mode for a few seconds while Ulfric tells Galmar to secure the door. Head through the doorway with Galmar and Ulfric to confront [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] and [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]]. A lengthy dialogue commences, and despite Ulfric's pleas that she surrender, Rikke insists on standing her ground and engages in combat. Kill Rikke and beat Tullius into submission. Once Rikke is dead and Tullius is on the floor, the fighting will stop, and a short conversation will occur. After some talking, Galmar and Ulfric will offer to give you the honor of finishing Tullius. Choose whether to accept their offer or decline and allow Ulfric to kill the General. If you choose to kill Tullius then Ulfric will give you a leveled sword with which to do the deed. If you decline then he will reward you with a leveled sword after he kills Tullius. This will complete the quest and begin the final stage of the [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim.]] ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest: * {{achievement|Hero of Skyrim}} ==Notes== * This quest, [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)|Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)]], and [[Skyrim:Battle for Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]] are all different radiant versions of the same quest. * The map marker for Solitude will disappear during the quest, so you will have to fast-travel to [[Skyrim:Katla's Farm|Katla's Farm]] or some other nearby destination and walk from there to the gates of Solitude. * To minimize game lag, bodies disappear soon after they have been killed. * Even after you finish the quest, you'll still be able to craft Imperial armor at [[Skyrim:Forge|blacksmith forges]]. * If you're currently doing the Dark Brotherhood quest [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|Bound Until Death]], the Battle for Solitude will be delayed until that quest is complete. Ulfric will stay in his palace, and if spoken to, will tell you, ''"We're ready to march on Solitude, but the Emperor's cousin is getting married! If royal blood was spilt, all of Cyrodiil would be up in arms. We can't afford an all out war with the Empire. So we'll bide our time for now."'' * If you're currently doing Dark Brotherhood quests to assassinate the Emperor like [[Skyrim:To Kill an Empire|To Kill an Empire]], the Battle for Solitude will be delayed. After [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Hraggstad|The Battle for Fort Hraggstad]], quest mark still remains on [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] and he says ''"We're ready to launch our attack on Solitude. But the Emperor's visiting! We can't risk attacking now. So we'll bide our time."'' * If you complete this quest before finishing the main quest, you can [[Skyrim:Legate_Rikke#Sovngarde|encounter]] Legate Rikke in the mists of [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]]. * Finishing the quest will clear any bounty currently held by the player in the [[SR:Haafingar|Haafingar]] Hold. * After you finish the quest, the [[Skyrim:Shrines#Shrine of Talos|Shrine of Talos]] at the [[Skyrim:Temple of the Divines|Temple of the Divines]] will be restored. * Contrary to post-quest dialogue indicating that you can raid [[Skyrim:Imperial Camps|Imperial Camps]] to further help the Stormcloaks, the commanders of these camps will still be marked as essential after the quest. * Completing this quest will harm the relationship you have with outspoken Imperial supporters across Skyrim, giving you quite a number of hostile greetings. NPC functionality like trading or quest stages will not be affected though. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After entering Castle Dour, you may get stuck in cutscene mode permanently without Ulfric or Galmar joining you. You can get arrested inside the East Empire Company Warehouse and then serve your time in jail. You can then access Castle Dour and Solitude.|vn=1}} {{Bug|When you're about to enter Solitude, you may get locked out of the city and say it requires a key to open the door, leaving you unable to finish the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Open the [[Skyrim:Console|console]], click on the door, and type unlock. The door will be unlocked and you can continue with the quest. *The final confrontation with Legate Rikke and General Tullius is particularly buggy. Reports indicate a number of different things going wrong once you enter Castle Dour with Galmar and Ulfric, including: *{{Bug|Rikke and Tullius may leave combat mode. It is possible to carry on a conversation with General Tullius about how the war is going while Ulfric is standing right next to him with his axe drawn. It becomes impossible to end the quest.|confirmed=1}} *{{Bug|Rikke may become invincible; attacking her until she has zero health will force her to the ground, but she will simply stand up moments later and recover full health. She is not always hostile upon standing up; it may be possible to hold a normal conversation without quest-specific dialogue.|confirmed=1}} ***{{pc22}} Opening the console and entering setstage CWFinale 330 while Rikke, Ulfric, and Galmar are talking will progress to the next stage of the quest. Rikke and Tullius may still become hostile and need to be subdued after speaking however their deaths will no longer be required. *{{Bug|General Tullius may also become invincible, as the scripted conversation that results in his death may not be triggered by beating him to the ground. Although the "Talk to General Tullius" dialogue option may still appear, the option cannot be activated, and the quest cannot be completed as a result.|confirmed=1}} ***Striking Tullius with the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout may fix this. ***One solution is to go complete the quest [[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]] and then complete 'The Battle for Solitude'. ***Or simply reload a save from before this fight and redo the fight. *{{Bug|Tullius may be paralyzed accidentally when fighting is first initiated. He will fall to the ground as if dead, but proceed to talk and blink until Rikke is killed and Ulfric gives you the honor of killing him. Though he appears dead and cannot move, the slightest damage will kill him, allowing the quest to continue.|confirmed=1}} *{{Bug|Additionally, you may find yourself permanently locked in the room with Rikke, Tullius, Galmar, and Ulfric, unable to leave as the only exit door requires a key that you don't have (and can't get anywhere within the room). The only option is reload an earlier save.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you have a bounty in [[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]] and are caught by a guard prior to arrival at Solitude, you can submit to paying a fine and find yourself just outside Castle Dour, effectively skipping the entire battle.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|When you enter Solitude the city may be in its normal state with citizens and city guards wandering around instead of Imperial soldiers. This will cause guards to attack Ulfric, Galmar, and you if you attack guards in Castle Dour along with the [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] Legate. The quest can still be finished if you attack Ulfric. However, there will be no speech or cutscenes, and it is recommended that you leave the city soon after. Your bounty will not be reset until you fast travel somewhere else and then back to Solitude.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you enter Solitude for the first time for this quest, you will find [[Skyrim:Jaree-Ra|Jaree-Ra]] casually standing around while the battle rages around him, waiting for you to speak to him so that he can start his [[Skyrim:Lights Out!|related quest]]. He is essential at this point, so he cannot be killed, but speaking to him will prevent you from defending yourself until you exit conversation with him.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you enter the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] during the battle, [[Skyrim:Bolgeir Bearclaw|Bolgeir Bearclaw]] will have his weapon drawn, and [[Skyrim:Elisif|Elisif]] will be in her quarters, making it impossible to talk to them.}} {{Bug|If you have never visited Solitude prior to the battle, it can break this quest.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|If you have completed the quest [[Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!|Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!]], then once you have liberated Haafingar, Ulfric will respond, "We're ready to march on Solitude, but the Emperor's cousin is getting married." and the questline will not advance.}} {{Bug|After killing General Tullius and Ulfric's second speech, Solitude may stay in war mode.|confirmed=1}} **An easy solution is to fast travel to Windhelm and talk to Ulfric in the Palace of the Kings, where he will offer you to be Thane of Eastmarch. This should reset Solitude back to normal, with Stormcloak soldiers instead of Haafingar guards. {{Bug|After the battle, the covering over the well in the market topples over. This can block multiple characters' pathing.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After the battle, the [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Outpost|Penitus Oculatus Outpost]] will remain active in [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]], which can result in [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus|Penitus Oculatus agents]] and Stormcloak soldiers engaging each other in combat.|USKP|2.0.6|If this quest and the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] questline are finished, the Penitus Oculatus Outpost will be cleared out.}} {{Bug|After the battle, Imperial soldiers can still be [[Skyrim:World Interactions|randomly seen]] with Stormcloak prisoners, even though Tullius and Rikke are now dead meaning the Imperial soldiers won't have someone to report to anymore.|USKP|2.1.0|This random encounter will now be disabled once Solitude has fallen.}} ==Quest Stages== Only the quest stages and objectives that are possibly relevant to this radiant version of the quest are shown. {{Journal Entries |name=Battle for Solitude |1||I am to join Ulfric Stormcloak in the final attack on Solitude, putting an end to the Imperial Legion in Skyrim, once and for all. |8999|fail| |9000|fin|We have captured Solitude, killed General Tullius, and destroyed the final bastion of Imperial influence in Skyrim. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|1000|Get your Orders from Ulfric Stormcloak}} {{Quest Objective|4002|Force General Tullius to surrender}} {{Quest Objective|4102|Execute General Tullius}}{{vn|Are these the only three? }} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=9999 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

CWPostWhiterunObj |Icon=SR-qico-Imperial Legion.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Meet with [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]]. # Defend [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. # Destroy the attacking force of [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]. # Talk to Jarl [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Balgruuf the Greater]] after his speech. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Battle for Whiterun=== ====The Burning City==== [[File:SR-quest-Battle for Whiterun (Imperial) 03.jpg|thumb|right|The Burning City]] At the end of [[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Imperial)|Message to Whiterun]], report to [[Skyrim:Legate Quentin Cipius|Legate Quentin Cipius]] and he will tell you the latest news about the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] and give you your new orders: ''"The Stormcloaks are here. In force. Get down to the front line. This is it. We must hold the city. Move it!"'' Upon leaving [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]], you will find [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] under siege by Stormcloak catapults. Along the city wall of the Plains District, the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] will be returning fire with their own catapults. The streets will be busy with citizens running back to their houses and city guards making ready to fight the enemy. Whiterun will suffer great destruction during the battle. [[Skyrim:Severio Pelagia|Severio Pelagia]] will be killed and his [[Skyrim:Severio Pelagia's House|home]], as well as [[Skyrim:Heimskr's House|Heimskr's]], will be destroyed. ====The Bleeding Battlefield==== Just outside the city gates, you will find [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] on the strategically important main entryway, busy addressing a crowd of fully-armed Imperial Soldiers: ''"This is it men! This is an important day for the Empire and for the Legion. And for all of Skyrim. This is the day we send a message to Ulfric Stormcloak and the rebel Jarls who support him. But make no mistake. What we do here today, we do for Skyrim and her people. By cutting out the disease of this rebellion, we will make this country whole again! Ready now! Everyone, with me! For the Empire! For the Legion! Rrrrrraaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!"'' Soon after Rikke finishes her speech, the Stormcloaks will start their attack. Their archers will provide suppression fire from a distance outside the gate, while the main force will move up the main road in groups. First, you need to defend the barricades, then the drawbridge. Finally, you need to kill attacking soldiers until the percentage of attackers remaining drops to zero. Legate Rikke and [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]], both of whom are [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] and cannot be killed, will give you a hand during the defense, so stay close to one or both of them if you are having difficulty. The united force of Whiterun guards and Imperial soldiers will take advantage of the fortifications and draw the attention of many enemies. Don't worry if you are unable to defend the barricades or drawbridge. It does not affect the ending of the quest or your reward. When the percentage of remaining attackers drops to zero, the battle will be over and this quest will be complete. Any surviving Stormcloaks will lose heart and flee the battlefield. This starts an unnamed miscellaneous quest with the objective ''[[#Report to the Jarl of Whiterun|Report to the Jarl of Whiterun]]''. Also, completion of [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)|Battle for Whiterun]] automatically starts the next quest [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]]. ===Report to the Jarl of Whiterun=== ====The Inspiring Speech==== [[File:SR-quest-Battle for Whiterun (Imperial) 04.jpg|thumb|right|The Inspiring Speech]] [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]] will tell everyone to follow her, as [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf the Greater]] wishes to speak. You may listen to his speech after the combat: ''"Revel in your victory here today, even as the gods revel in your honor! They already sing of your valor and skill! The halls of Sovngarde are no doubt ringing with your praises! In defeating these Stormcloak traitors, you have proven the hollowness of their cause and the fullness of your hearts. The citizens of Whiterun are forever in your debt! But Ulfric will not stop here. No, he will continue to strike out against any true Nord who remains faithful to the Empire. He will continue to sow discord and chaos wherever he can. And so, we must each one of us, continue to fight this insurrection, lest our fallen brothers have died for naught! Lest our honor be lessened should we allow these bloodthirsty beasts to prowl our lands! Carry on men, my gratitude and blessings go with you! For Whiterun! For the Empire!"'' At the end of his speech, you may talk to him. The jarl will thank you and grant you the privilege of buying a house in his city, if you haven't already: ''"Thank you for your role in all of this. It'd be my honor should you decide to make Whiterun your home. Speak with Proventus. He'll make the necessary arrangements."''. This completes the miscellaneous quest. ===Reward=== As part of the next quest, [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]], when you return to General Tullius in Solitude, he commends you for the victory and gives you the rank of [[Skyrim:Imperial_Legion#Ranks|Quaestor]], along with a [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Enchanted Weapons|leveled enchanted weapon]]. ==Notes== [[File:SR-quest-Battle for Whiterun (Imperial).jpg|thumb|right|The soldiers muster a defense of the city]] * This quest, [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], and [[Skyrim:Battle for Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]] are all different radiant versions of the same quest. * After Balgruuf finishes his speech, you can ask him why he chose to side with the Imperials and what it will take to win the war. ** His response for why he sided with the Imperials will be ''"Mutual advantage! Any fool can see that. For centuries, we have benefitted from the Empire's protection, and prosperous trade with the south. In exchange, the people of [[Lore:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]] sleep peacefully, knowing that their northern border is guarded by the fiercest warriors in all Tamriel."'' ** His response for what it will take to win the war will be ''"Ulfric Stormcloak's head on a pike. Do you think Ulfric really cares about Skyrim's independence, or the welfare of its people? I promise you, he doesn't. He's nothing more than a barbarian renegade, whose lust for power has cost the lives of countless innocents."'' * Even before this quest has begun, Whiterun Guards and Stormcloak soldiers can be seen engaging each other in combat. * If you previously befriended [[Skyrim:Fralia Gray-Mane|Fralia Gray-Mane]], Fralia will remain friendly after the Empire gains control of Whiterun. * If you previously told [[Skyrim:Idolaf Battle-Born|Idolaf Battle-Born]] that you support the Gray-Manes, Idolaf will remain hostile after the Empire gains control of Whiterun. * If [[Skyrim:Lucia|Lucia]]{{HF}} has been adopted, she will be transferred to the Bannered Mare until after the battle is over. This happens because her editor location is there and CWCitizensFlee will pick her up in one of the aliases. * [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] will have a barricade across the main entrance and both doors will be expert-locked, however if you pick the lock, both [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]] and [[Skyrim:Saadia|Saadia]] will have their normal speech options, welcoming you and are willing to trade. * [[Skyrim:Breezehome|Breezehome]] becomes locked again, key required. * [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]] is apprentice-locked during this battle, however if you pick the lock [[Skyrim:Sabjorn|Sabjorn]] will be back in charge with both him and [[Skyrim:Mallus Maccius|Mallus Maccius]] telling you to get out and treating you as if they don't know you. You are unable to trade with either of them. * You will be unable to enter [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] during or after the battle as all the doors require a key. * Your horse can easily be killed if it's waiting by the stables, as it does if you fast-traveled here. * Followers who are accompanying you when receiving this quest cannot exit the Whiterun city gates with you, and instead stay inside the walls until you return. ** Select the "part ways" dialogue before leaving the city gates and recruit them again on the other side. This does not work for followers who return to Whiterun when dismissed, such as [[Skyrim:Lydia|Lydia]] or [[Skyrim:Jenassa|Jenassa]]. ** During the previous quest [[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Imperial)|Message to Whiterun]], tell your follower to wait just outside the city gates before returning Balgruuf's war axe to the jarl. *It can be somewhat difficult to keep the barricade intact because your own archers will shoot at it while trying to shoot the enemies. To get around this, you can run past the stable and into the field. This is essentially the spawn point. You will have to kill about 50 enemies by yourself, but they will prioritize attacking you over the town. **In fact, defending the city becomes much easier when exactly one of the barricades is down, as the gap will form a bottleneck and the Stormcloaks will ignore the other barricade. *There is a temporary Stormcloak camp outside the city next to the Meadery. If you run to it directly after the battle, there will be one Stormcloak Soldier in the large tent looking at the map, but no other inhabitants. *After this quest [[Skyrim:Fort Greymoor|Fort Greymoor]] will be garrisoned by Imperial Soldiers. Additionally, due to the destruction of [[Skyrim:Heimskr's House|his house]], [[Skyrim:Heimskr|Heimskr]] will preach outside the Shrine of Talos 24/7. **Heimskr was supposed to be arrested and sent to the Dragonsreach dungeon due to the Empire having control of Whiterun, but that never happens. In addition, the Shrine of Talos isn't affected in any way. ==Bugs== {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] may fail to greet you properly after the battle is finished.|OSP|1.9}} {{Bug|Random [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] attacks may occur in and around the city of Whiterun during this quest.|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Legate Quentin Cipius|Legate Quentin Cipius]] may not start this quest, instead giving only generic greetings.|confirmed=1}} ** This bug is caused by quest aliases for the CWSiege quest failing to fill if they are missing. {{Bug|After this quest, Heimskr doesn't get arrested and instead simply preaches in front of the [[Skyrim:Shrines#Shrine of Talos|Shrine of Talos]] nonstop.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After you finish this quest, [...] may appear in your journal instead of the name of the next quest and the quest marker will disappear.|confirmed=1}} ** Do not stand next to Balgruuf when he's running up the ramp to deliver his speech. Go stand in among the soldiers he will be addressing below him. Then you will be within the trigger area and the quest will correctly update. ** Sometimes the bug is caused because the trigger area isn't spawning precisely in the correct location (it sometimes spawns too high, you can't hit it by walking through it). So, another thing that often helps is after you deliver the axe to Ulfric, don't go straight back to Whiterun. Spend time doing other things and other quests, away from the Whiterun cell, until the area has time to respawn '''with the quest flags set.''' Otherwise, the area is all respawned with all the quest updates and alterations to the area all happening at once, the moment you enter the cell - and this sometimes glitches, ending up with the master quest being labeled [...]. This helps insure that by the time you DO go back to Whiterun, the trigger area will have spawned in the right spot (down around where the soldiers gather, in the grassy area near the entrance gate) and will update the quest correctly. {{Bug|NPCs such as Aela, Lydia, Lucia (if adopted), and your hired bard may appear as soon as you leave Whiterun and be attacked by the Whiterun guards. Additionally, no Stormcloak guards will spawn.|confirmed=1}} ** Be sure to dismiss all followers before exiting the city gates, Additionally, move your family to a different city before you start this quest. ** {{Pc22}}Use the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command setstage CWSiegeObj 9000 to complete the quest instead. {{Bug|Legate Rikke may not complete her speech, making the battle unwinnable. Balgruuf may also fail to give his speech at the end of the quest.|confirmed=1}} ** Re-entering Whiterun's main gate may update the quest objective from "Meet with Legate Rikke" to "Defend the Barricades". ** It is possible to attack Rikke until she becomes hostile, and then to yield to her, to move the quest forward. Balgruuf's speech may be bypassed simply by travelling away from the area after the battle. Both will prevent you from watching the entire scene, but will allow you to continue play. ** This bug seems to be related to guards failing to travel to the mustering point prior to the battle, and therefore the speech scene being unable to proceed until those actors are in their correct positions -- possibly related to the locking main gate that prevents your followers from joining you for the battle. {{Bug|If you report to General Tullius before reporting to the Jarl of Whiterun, the miscellaneous quest ''[[#Report to the Jarl of Whiterun|Report to the Jarl of Whiterun]]'' will be stuck in your journal with no way to complete it.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}}The console command CompleteAllObjectives CWPostWhiterunObj can be used to complete the related quest. {{Bug|Upon reaching the barricades, the Stormcloaks may run away but the quest will not update, leaving the quest marker at the barricades}} **Reloading the autosave from exiting Whiterun fixes this issue {{Bug|Rarely, after exiting Dragonsreach, the quest will update to 'Speak with General Tullius' and the battle will be skipped. NPCs will react as if you fought in the battle.}} {{Bug|When defending the barricades, if you destroy both of them yourself before the enemy does, the Stormcloaks will be unable to find the barricades and you will end up fighting on the field alone.|vn=1}} {{Bug|There is a rare situation where you and the enemies will not be able to destroy the barricades.|vn=1}} ** Restarting the game will fix this. {{Bug|If you manage to keep the barricades intact, the drawbridge will not open. People then take the ramp and walk around the drawbridge ''towards'' Whiterun but drop off the wall moving ''away from'' Whiterun. The latter may result in people with low health dying due to the drop.|vn=1}} ** Restarting the battle and letting the Stormcloaks destroy at least one barricade will fix this. ** The drawbridge may be reenabled using console commands prid 6a167, then disable, then again prid 17055 and enable reopening the path for the player. For the Legion!=== Arrive at [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] for the battle to begin. You will find [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] at the gates, giving a speech to a group of [[Skyrim:Imperial Soldier|Imperial Soldiers]]: {| class=hiddentable width="100%" |- |style="width:5%"|[[File:SR-quest-Battle for Windhelm.jpg|''For the Empire! For the Legion!''|thumb|center]]||style="width:50%"|'''''"All right. It's time to deliver the final blow to the Stormcloak rebellion. You have all fought bravely, and sacrificed much to bring us to this point. Ulfric thinks he can hide behind the walls of his castle. But we will fight our way in and drag him out through the rubble to face justice. Because this is the end for them, the Stormcloaks will fight like cornered rats. They will be fierce and crafty. But they are no match for Legionnaires. You are the best and the brightest warriors in Tamriel. Professional soldiers, fearless and devastating. The Emperor will be paying close attention to what happens here today. Men who distinguish themselves will be well rewarded. Ready now! Everyone, with me! For the Empire! For the Legion! Rrrrrraaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!"''''' |} When he finishes his speech, he and his soldiers will charge into the city. Follow them through the main gates. ===Battle for Windhelm=== Once inside, you will be met by wave after wave of infinitely respawning [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloak]] Soldiers. Your task now will be to fight your way through the opposition to reach the [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]]. Debris will block the direct route to the palace, forcing you to find another way. After entering the city, take an immediate left and head west to the market square. Upon reaching the square, turn right past the blacksmith's [[Skyrim:Forge|forge]] and travel north to the cemetery. Once there, take a left down the steps, then take the steps north past the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Windhelm)|Hall of the Dead]]. Upon reaching the top of the steps and smashing the barricade, march through Valunstrad and head east down the alley. Once you reach the end of the alley, turn left and head north up the steps, destroy the barricade, and proceed to the Palace of the Kings, where [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric]] and his second in command, [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]], are waiting for you. ===Palace of the Kings=== When you enter the palace, Ulfric will be sitting on his throne with Galmar standing by his side. General Tullius and Legate Rikke will enter, and Tullius will demand Ulfric's surrender, stating that Ulfric is the only one standing between Skyrim and peace and that he needs to be killed to regain the peace. After they're done talking, Ulfric and Galmar will become hostile and attack the three of you. Kill Galmar and force Ulfric to his knees (Ulfric is still [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] at this point). If you are having trouble with this battle, you can allow Tullius and Rikke to do most of the fighting, as they are both essential. General Tullius will then prepare to kill Ulfric, but Ulfric will request that his death be at your hands. You will then be given the choice of executing Ulfric or making Tullius do it himself. If you choose to kill Ulfric, Tullius will hand you a leveled enchanted sword for the task, though you don't need to use the sword to kill Ulfric. If you choose to let the general kill Ulfric he will still give you the sword afterwards. After Ulfric is dead, Tullius and Rikke will head outside. Follow them out and watch as Tullius gives a speech to the assembled Imperial soldiers, thanking them for their service. After the completion of this quest, the Imperials will install a new Jarl, [[Skyrim:Brunwulf_Free-Winter|Brunwulf Free-Winter]]. If you later approach him, he will grant you the privilege of buying property in Windhelm and, if you speak to him, the opportunity to become [[Skyrim:Thane_of_Eastmarch|Thane of Eastmarch]]. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest if you sided with the Imperials: * {{achievement|Hero of Skyrim}} - If you sided with the Stormcloaks, Windhelm is only the first step, and the achievement is instead obtained with the [[Skyrim:Battle_for_Solitude|Battle for Solitude]]. ==Notes== * This quest, [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)|Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)]] and [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]] are all different radiant versions of the same quest. * During and after the siege of [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], three catapults are present in nearby [[Skyrim:Windhelm Military Camp|Windhelm Military Camp]]. They can be activated to fire projectiles into Windhelm, though this has no effect on the siege. * To minimize game lag, bodies disappear soon after they have been killed. * If you complete this quest before finishing the main quest, you can encounter both [[Skyrim:Ulfric_Stormcloak#Sovngarde|Ulfric]]'s and [[Skyrim:Galmar_Stone-Fist#Sovngarde|Galmar]]'s spirits in [[Skyrim:Sovngarde_(place)|Sovngarde]], lost in [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]]'s soul-ensnaring mist. Ulfric expresses dismay at how all his war did was feed Alduin, while Galmar is incensed that even in Sovngarde the Dragonborn still dogs his steps. After the defeat of Alduin, Galmar will state that an eternity is too long to hold a grudge and praise you for defeating Alduin. * Finishing the quest will clear any bounty currently held by the player in [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]]. * Even after you finish the quest, the [[Skyrim:Temple of Talos|Temple of Talos]] will remain free for Talos worship, and the [[Skyrim:Shrines#Shrine of Talos|Shrine of Talos]] there won't be removed. * Contrary to post-quest dialogue indicating that you can raid [[Skyrim:Stormcloak Camps|Stormcloak Camps]] to further help the Legion, the commanders of these camps will still be marked as essential after the quest. * Completing this quest will harm the relationship you have with outspoken Stormcloak supporters across Skyrim, giving you quite a number of hostile greetings. NPC functionality like trading or quest stages will not be affected though. == Bugs == {{cleanup|There's an awful lot of guesswork here; needs cleanup}} {{Bug|After killing Ulfric and Galmar, their corpses will not disappear and will remain in the palace permanently, even after Brunwulf has been made Jarl.|USKP|1.0}} {{Bug|If the Imperials take Windhelm when [[Skyrim:Blood on the Ice|Blood on the Ice]] is also active, the guard is never swapped out properly to allow the quest to be completed once the city has changed ownership.|USKP|1.2.4}} {{Bug|After the Imperials take Windhelm, [[Skyrim:Captain Lonely-Gale|Captain Lonely-Gale]] is supposed to take over as steward but never does because [[Skyrim:Jorleif|Jorleif]] is never exiled.|USKP|1.3.2}} {{Bug|After the battle is finished, Brunwulf Free-Winter may lack the "Jarl" prefix to his name when most other new Jarls get it automatically.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|After finishing the battle outside and entering the Jarl's palace, General Tullius will speak to Ulfric and initiate combat, but Ulfric and Galmar may ignore Legate Rikke and Tullius and attack only you, while the Legate and General simply draw their swords and watch. Both NPCs can then be forced into the recovery state but will not die, as they are still marked as essential.|confirmed=1}} ** This may be caused by advancing through the Civil War questline far enough that the [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] quest can't be started, resulting in Ulfric and Galmar mistakenly maintaining their essential status. If you have this bug, going back to a save before the start of the liberate Eastmarch quest will not help. What triggers this bug is currently unknown, but some unknown previous interaction with the city seems the probable culprit.|confirmed=1}} ** {{pc22}} You can use console commands to complete the quest, but Ulfric will continue to rule Windhelm and the house there will be inaccessible. A workaround to complete the quest with full imperial occupation of Eastmarch is to continue with General Tullius and [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] into the Palace, confront and defeat Ulfric, and then leave the city for thirty days until it resets. ** This is possibly because General Tullius will follow his showdown scripting once you get him into the palace. Skyrim:Making Friends and Influencing Pe.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Nephele |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]] {{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Thane |Giver= |Reward=Progress towards becoming [[Skyrim:Thane|Thane]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev= |Conc= |Next= |Loc= |Image= |ImgDesc= |description=Assist the people of the hold. |ID=FavorJarlsMakeFriends |Icon= |radiant=yes }} == Radiant Options == This is a radiant quest which you can receive in any of the nine [[Skyrim:holds|holds]] of Skyrim. The name of the objective appearing in your journal will be one of the following, depending upon the hold: * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of Eastmarch|Eastmarch]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of Falkreath|Falkreath]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of Haafingar|Haafingar]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of Hjaalmarch|Hjaalmarch]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of the Pale|the Pale]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of the Reach|the Reach]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of the Rift|the Rift]] (see [[#Notes|notes]]) * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of Whiterun|Whiterun]] * Assist the people of [[Skyrim:Thane of Winterhold|Winterhold]] ==Quick Walkthrough== Before starting this quest, you must first befriend the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] of the hold. # Speak to the jarl to receive the quest. # Improve the [[Skyrim:Disposition|disposition]] of three or five people of that hold, usually by doing [[Skyrim:Favors|favor quests]] for them. # Return to the jarl. ==Detailed Walkthrough== You will need to improve the disposition of three people for the minor holds Falkreath, Hjaalmarch, the Pale, and Winterhold. For the major holds Eastmarch, Haafingar, the Reach, the Rift, and Whiterun, you will need to help five people. The people you help must be ordinary citizens of the hold; members of [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders|Khajiit caravans]] and Orcs living in [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|strongholds]] do not count, and neither does befriending the hold's [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] (as that is a prerequisite to being given the objective). Disposition can be improved in any of the following ways: * by performing [[Skyrim:Favors|favor quests]] on their behalf * by completing certain [[Skyrim:Side Quests|side quests]] * investing 500 gold in stores, if you have the [[Skyrim:Investor|investor perk]] * dropping some armor pieces in front of citizens and [[Skyrim:World Interactions#Reactions|allowing them to keep it]] * [[Skyrim:Rescue Mission|rescuing]] kidnapped citizens Citizens that you befriend before starting this quest also count towards your total, and as such, it is possible to complete this objective for a particular hold immediately after starting the Thane quest. Also, citizens that you befriended which then died still count towards your total. (Usually in those cases, you will have received an [[Skyrim:Inheritance|Inheritance]].) Note that if you befriend the same citizen twice, it only counts once for this quest. ==Notes== *While [[Skyrim:I Done Got Thaned!|the Rift thane quest]] is active, most of its objectives do not show up in your journal. The Rift thane quest uses its own code to replace the functions of this quest, so Objective 20 is never assigned. The requirement to assist citizens of the Rift is replaced by an invisible requirement to complete [[Skyrim:Riften#Miscellaneous|miscellaneous objectives in Riften]], which starts automatically after completing [[Skyrim:Supply and Demand|Supply and Demand]]. The game will track the number of Riften quests you complete, unlike in other holds where you are required to ask the jarl if there is something you can do to help first. Once you have completed enough miscellaneous quests, you will be given an objective to return to the Jarl of Riften. *If Balgruuf is Jarl of Whiterun, you cannot receive this quest from him. He will make you Thane as a quest reward for completing [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]], which is early in the main quest. Only if you side with the Stormcloaks and remove him from power is this quest available in Whiterun. ==Bugs== {{Bug|"Assist the people of Haafingar" may not be cleared from your quest log by Solitude's jarl once completed, though you are able to become a thane and gain a housecarl in your home (once purchased). The concern may be complicated by having already helped five people before talking to the jarl for the first time.|USKP|1.2}} **{{Pc22}} Entering the console command setobjectivecompleted FavorJarlsMakeFriends 30 1 after becoming a thane may resolve this. ** Continuing to assist the people of Haafingar can cause the counter to update to 6/5, at which point the objective is completed and cleared from the quest log. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Assist the people of the Reach (/5)}} |15||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for the Reach}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Assist the people of the Rift (/5)}} |25||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for the Rift}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Assist the people of Haafingar (/5)}} |35||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for Haafingar}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Assist the people of Whiterun (/5)}} |45||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for Whiterun}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Assist the people of Eastmarch (/5)}} |55||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for Eastmarch}} |60||{{Quest Objective|60|Assist the people of Hjaalmarch (/3)}} |65||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for Hjaalmarch}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Assist the people of the Pale (/3)}} |75||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for the Pale}} |80||{{Quest Objective|80|Assist the people of Winterhold (/3)}} |85||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for Winterhold}} |90||{{Quest Objective|90|Assist the people of Falkreath (/3)}} |95||{{Quest Comment|Quest Completed for Falkreath}} }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

==Radiant Options==

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Forge an [[Skyrim:Iron Dagger|iron dagger]] at the [[Skyrim:Forge|forge]].
# Temper the iron dagger at the [[Skyrim:Grindstone|grindstone]].
# Craft [[Skyrim:Leather|leather]] at the [[Skyrim:Tanning Rack|tanning rack]].
# Craft a [[Skyrim:Hide Helmet|hide helmet]] at the forge.
# Temper the hide helmet at the [[Skyrim:Workbench|workbench]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Craft a Dagger===
Take the [[Skyrim:Iron Ingot|iron ingot]] and the [[Skyrim:Leather Strips|leather strips]] from the quest giver and then use the [[Skyrim:Forge|forge]] to create an [[Skyrim:Iron Dagger|iron dagger]]. As soon as the dagger is crafted, return it to the quest giver. Now they will ask you to sharpen the dagger with another iron ingot. Go to the [[Skyrim:Grindstone|grindstone]] and sharpen the iron dagger, and present it to the smith.

===Craft a Helmet===
Secondly, they will ask you to craft some [[Skyrim:Leather|leather]]. Go to the [[Skyrim:Tanning Rack|tanning rack]] and craft leather, and again speak to the quest giver. Now you have to create a [[Skyrim:Hide Helmet|hide helmet]] at the forge. Take the supplies you are given and use the forge to create the helmet, and then return to the smith.

Lastly, you have to temper the helmet. Use the [[Skyrim:Workbench|workbench]] to improve the hide helmet further, and return to the quest giver to complete the quest. They will allow you to keep the helmet and dagger that you have created as a reward.

==Notes==
* Because this quest has a lot of objectives that can be completed very quickly, it is very useful if you are trying to earn the [[Skyrim:Hero of the People|Hero of the People]] achievement.
* You can only initiate this quest during the day, when the quest giver is at work.

{{Bug|[[Skyrim:Lod|Lod]] was supposed to be able to offer this quest as well, but he was left out of the quest condition formlist.|USKP|2.0.7|trackerid=17707}}

}} }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak with an innkeeper, jarl, or steward to receive the bounty. # Kill the [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] at the indicated location. # Speak with the jarl or steward of the hold to receive your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Here There Be Dragons=== After your adventures at [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun's]] [[Skyrim:Western_Watchtower|Western Watchtower]] during [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]], a proliferation of dragons are about. In your travels, ask an innkeep, jarl or steward for some work. You may learn that a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] has been harassing travelers and citizens around its [[Skyrim:Dragon Lairs|lair]], and the jarl of the hold has put out a bounty on the dragon. You are an enterprising sort, with newly acquired [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|dragon soul absorbing powers]] and [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shouts]], so take up the job. ===The Dragon Hunter=== Seek out the offending dragon in its lair. There is a [[Skyrim:Dragon#Abilities|wide variety of dragon]] that you may encounter in each lair you visit. Once defeated, and the dragon soul is absorbed, be sure to remove the [[Skyrim:Dragon Bone|dragon bones]] and [[Skyrim:Dragon Scales|dragon scales]]. These are quite valuable in the local shops, and can be used to make and improve [[Skyrim:Dragon Armor|dragonbone and dragonscale armor]]. ===The Bounty=== Once the dragon is dead, you will be directed to the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] or [[Skyrim:Steward|steward]] of the hold to receive your payment. ==Notes== *If you are tasked to kill a dragon at a lair that you have already cleared, the dragon there will respawn. However, killing a respawned dragon (whether it has respawned because of this quest, or naturally after 10 or 30 days) will probably result in not getting a dragon soul. *You need to have completed [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] first before receiving this quest. == Bugs == {{Bug|The dragon at Mount Anthor may not spawn, and the quest target will point to an incorrect location.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Use the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command setstage BQ04 100 to skip to the next stage, or setstage BQ04 200 to jump directly to quest completion. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Kill the dragon located at }} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Collect bounty from }} {{Quest Objective|101|Collect bounty from }} |missing=0, 200 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Talk to him about the dangers of living outside the walls, which will lead to him boasting about being the strongest brawler in Skyrim. Make a 100 gold bet with him that you can beat him. This [[Skyrim:Brawl|brawl]] is like any other, and the usual rules apply: no weapons, and no offensive magic. Beware, as he is much tougher than most other brawlers. ===Claiming your reward=== After winning the brawl, talk to Hofgrir and he will give you your 100 gold back, as well as another 100 gold for winning the bet. ==Notes== * Hofgrir brawls like other NPCs, though the one difference is that he does a lot more damage per hit than other characters. This isn't quite as notable on the lesser difficulties (Novice, Apprentice, Adept), but it is very notable on the higher ones (Expert, Master and especially Legendary). If you are a lower level/health or are wearing clothes instead of armor when doing this quest on those higher difficulties, it would be advisable to heal during the encounter or you'll be swiftly beaten. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Brawling Hofgrir for this quest while wearing the [[Skyrim:Ebony Mail|Ebony Mail]] can inflict the armor's poison damage effect on him, leading to an assault bounty.|USKP|1.2.4}} {{Bug|If you don't have 200 gold when you attempt the brawl the quest may be uncompletable.|USKP|2.0.7}} **{{Pc22}} This can be fixed using setstage FreeformRiften19 200 followed by resetquest FreeformRiften19. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Defeat Hofgrir in an unarmed brawl}} |missing=10, 30, 40, 200, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Awakening.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Waltz |checkedBy=Likelolwhat |reward=Likelolwhat |rewardChecked=SerCenKing }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Main Quest|link3=Dawnguard Quests#Main Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |icon=SR-qico-Dawnguard_Dawnguard.png |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:Dawnguard (quest)|Dawnguard]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Bloodline|Bloodline]] |Image=SR-quest-Awakening 02.jpg |Imgdesc=Awakening |Reward= |description=Find out what the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Vampire Clan|vampires]] are looking for. |ID=DLC1VQ01 |SuggLevel=6 |Difficulty=Easy }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]]. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]] to find out what the vampires are after. # Solve the puzzle. # Speak to the [[Skyrim:Mysterious Woman|Mysterious Woman]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[file:SR-quest-Awakening.jpg|thumb|right|Activating the button]] === Dimhollow Crypt === :''For a more detailed walkthrough of Dimhollow Crypt, see the [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt#Dimhollow Crypt|place page]].'' After speaking to Isran, make your way across Skyrim to [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]], which lies high in the mountains east of [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]]. To reach it, head directly east of [[Skyrim:Frostmere Crypt|Frostmere Crypt]] until you reach a southbound path up the mountain or alternatively start at the [[Skyrim:Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon|Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon]] and follow the dirt path that skirts the cliff face east. As you enter the first room you will overhear two [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampires]] conversing over the body of [[Skyrim:Vigilant Tolan|Vigilant Tolan]] and two of their kin. '''Vampire 1''': ''"These Vigilants never know when to give up. I thought we'd taught them enough of a lesson at their [[Skyrim:Hall of the Vigilant|hall]]."''
'''Vampire 2''': ''"To come in here alone... a fool like all the rest of them."''
'''Vampire 1''': ''"He fought well though. Jeron and Bresoth were no match for him."''
'''Vampire 2''': ''"Ha. Those two deserved what they got. Their arrogance had become insufferable."''
'''Vampire 1''': ''"All this talk is making me thirsty. Perhaps another Vigilant will wander in soon."''
'''Vampire 2''': ''"I wish [[Skyrim:Lokil|Lokil]] would hurry it up. I have half a mind to return to the [[Skyrim:Castle Volkihar|castle]] and tell [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Harkon]] what a fool he's entrusted this mission to."''
'''Vampire 1''': ''"And I have half a mind to tell Lokil of your disloyalty."''
'''Vampire 2''': ''"You wouldn't dare. Now shut up and keep on watch."''
Eliminate the vampires and their accompanying [[Skyrim:Death Hound|death hound]], then head inside the ruined tower to the southwest, where you will find a pull-chain. This opens the gate near the bodies and allows you to progress further. Make your way through the ruins, battling vampires and [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]] as you go along. You will eventually arrive in a larger room where a vampire and its death hound are battling some [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]. Mop up the survivors and head to the westernmost of the four pull-chain-opened gates in the room. In the next chamber, a vampire is sat high up on a stone ledge and three skeletons will rise up from the water in the middle of the room. Navigate the honeycomb crypts further beyond, which contain the corpses of a few [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] as well as two very much alive vampires and their death hounds. In the final section of the crypt you will find a vampire fighting a [[Skyrim:Wounded Frostbite Spider|wounded frostbite spider]] behind a closed gate. Wait for one to prevail before opening the gate by pulling the lever nearby, dispatching the victor and heading into ''[[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt#Dimhollow Cavern|Dimhollow Cavern]]''. === Awakening === [[File:SR-quest-Awakening 03.jpg|thumb|right|The puzzle solved]] As you enter Dimhollow Cavern you will overhear the vampire [[Skyrim:Lokil|Lokil]] interrogating [[Skyrim:Vigilant Adalvald|Vigilant Adalvald]], who will die before revealing anything to his captor, he leaves [[SR:Notes on Dimhollow Crypt, Vol. 3|Notes on Dimhollow Crypt, Vol. 3]] near him. '''Adalvald''': ''"I'll never tell you anything, vampire. My oath to Stendarr is stronger than any suffering you can inflict on me."''
'''Lokil''': ''"I believe you, Vigilant. And I don't think you even know what you've found here. So go and meet your beloved Stendarr."''
'''[Lokil draws his sword and kills Adalvald.]'''
'''Vampire''': ''"Are you sure that was wise, Lokil? He still might have told us something. We haven't gotten anywhere ourselves with..."''
'''Lokil''': ''"He knew nothing. He served his purpose by leading us to this place. Now it is up to us to bring Harkon the [[Skyrim:Serana|prize]]. And we will not return without it. [[Skyrim:Vingalmo|Vingalmo]] and [[Skyrim:Orthjolf|Orthjolf]] will make way for me after this."''
'''Vampire''': ''"Yes, of course Lokil. Do not forget who brought you news of the Vigilants' discovery."''
'''Lokil''': ''"I never forget who my friends are. Or my enemies."''
After Adalvald dies, Lokil, his thrall, and an accompanying vampire will become hostile towards you as soon as they detect you. Use your starting position on a balcony overlooking the vampires to snipe down at them. You can also close the gate to the balcony behind you by pulling a lever inside, giving you some respite from the fight if needed. There is a [[Skyrim:Scroll of Fire Storm|Scroll of Fire Storm]] on a stone pillar in the same room, which can also help you get rid of them. After killing the vampires, make your way to the circular stone structure that dominates this chamber. Pressing the button atop the pedestal in the center will cause a spike to emerge, impaling your hand as a purple light shines up from troughs in the floor. Push each of the movable braziers into or away from the center of the circle so that they touch the end of the purple light within their path, causing the pattern to expand towards the next brazier, until you connect them all. The center of the structure will then ascend to reveal a stone monolith beneath the pedestal, which contains a mysterious woman carrying an [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll|Elder Scroll]]. Upon speaking to the woman, she will tell you that her name is [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] and that she is a vampire. She will ask you to take her to her family home, [[Skyrim:Volkihar_Keep|Castle Volkihar]], northwest of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. Asking her a few questions will reveal that she is not very trusting of you, but she does reveal that she has been imprisoned for a very long time, since even before the rise of the [[Lore:Alessian Empire|First Empire]] of Cyrodiil (i.e., about 4,200 years before current events). Once you finish your conversation with her, the quest completes and the [[Skyrim:Bloodline|next one]] begins. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|Awakening (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *This quest cannot be started, if you have a bounty more 1000 in The Rift. **Pay your bounty before finishing Dawnguard, and this quest should begin like normal. *Before you head to Dimhollow, [[Skyrim:Agmaer|Agmaer]] will fire steel bolts nonstop, allowing you to retrieve them. Isran will periodically comment on his performance with: **''"That's it."'' **''"You'll get the hang of it.''" **''"Take a deep breath and let it out as you fire."'' **''"Watch the recoil. Takes some getting used to."'' **''"You need to concentrate, boy. Try it again."'' *You can talk to Vigilant Tolan before he leaves Fort Dawnguard, though you must act quickly. *Serana will have unique dialogue if you are a vampire. She will assume that her father sent you, and if told that you were sent by the Dawnguard will remark that it doesn't sound like the name of a group of vampires. She will also note that the Dawnguard will eventually figure out what you are and turn on you. *If you free Serana without killing the other vampires first, she will turn hostile towards them. This can be useful if you're too weak to take them on yourself. Lure the vampires away or use hit-and-run tactics on the pillars, saving often, until Serana is free. *Once freed, Serana will follow you indefinitely until the quest is completed. Because she is part of a quest, she will not count as a follower. This allows the possibility to use her as a second follower. *After Vigilant Tolan is found dead in Dimhollow Crypt during this quest, you can tell Isran about it during [[Skyrim:Bloodline|Bloodline]]. Isran will be irritated with the news, calling Tolan a "fool", claiming that he told him not to go there and that the Vigilants "always had more bravery than sense". *If you received a crossbow from [[Skyrim:Durak|Durak]] during the Dawnguard quest, you can drop it, give it to a follower, or store it in a container before talking to Isran. He will then give you a second crossbow and 45 more steel bolts. You can also retrieve any steel bolts Agmaer fires. *Starting this quest will not add the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Vigilant|Hall of the Vigilant]] to your map. *It is possible to join the Dawnguard even if you are already a vampire yourself. *You can start this quest while bypassing the Dawnguard quest completely. See [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (quest)#Notes|here]] for details on what needs to be done. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Upon pressing the button in the center of the room, the initial bit of purple fire will appear, but the quest arrow above the button will not disappear. The columns will move and there will still be vibration and whatnot when it's in the right place, but the purple fire will not respond. When all columns are in place, nothing happens.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|When pressing the button in the center of the room, you may get stuck in a continuous loop of pressing the button. The purple fire does not appear and the columns cannot be moved.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **This may happen when being attacked while pressing the button. Reload a previous save and make sure you kill everyone first. {{Bug|This quest may not start after finishing the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (quest)|Dawnguard quest]].|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **A possible solution is to enter the console before talking to Isran, and issue the commands stopquest DLC1NPCMentalModel followed by startquest DLC1NPCMentalModel {{Bug|If you have a vampire [[Skyrim:Dead Thrall|thrall]] with you when you activate the button atop the pedestal that impales your hand, the thrall will attack you. The thrall will become friendly again if you sheathe their weapons/spells.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|Sometimes you will be unable to speak to Serana.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **Saving and reloading the save appears to fix this. {{Bug|For unknown reasons, Vigilant Tolan may appear alive in the entrance chamber, watching the vampires while another Vigilant Tolan is dead in front of them. The living Tolan will have the same dialogue he had at Fort Dawnguard, but won't do anything else.}} {{Bug|On rare occasions, Serana will not be in the monolith, and will only appear if you wait. Upon talking to her, she will begin walking away to an unknown location. This may be related to an issue with the [[Skyrim:Castle Volkihar#Bugs|Castle Volkihar]] entrance.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|Having a follower when opening Serana's sarcophagus may lead to a bug preventing [[Skyrim:A_New_Order|A New Order]] from starting. It is advised to make a save before doing so and should the bug occur, dismissing any current followers as well as entering set playerfollowercount to 0 into the console, then proceeding as normal.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've met Isran, the leader of a group of vampire hunters known as the Dawnguard. The vampires that attacked the Hall of the Vigilants may have been after something in a place called Dimhollow Crypt. Isran has asked me to find out what the vampires are looking for. {{Quest Objective|30|Find out what the vampires are seeking}} |20||{{Quest Objective|40|Speak to the mysterious woman}} |40||Isran, the leader of a group of vampire hunters known as the Dawnguard, asked me to find out what the vampires were seeking in a place called Dimhollow Crypt. Deep in the crypt, I freed a mysterious young woman named Serana from an ancient sarcophagus. |200|fin|Isran, the leader of a group of vampire hunters known as the Dawnguard, asked me to find out what the vampires were seeking in a place called Dimhollow Crypt. Deep in the crypt, I freed a mysterious young woman named Serana from an ancient sarcophagus. |missing=0, 5, 12, 15, 17, 18, 19, 30, 999 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Dawnguard (quest)|Dawnguard]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Bloodline|Bloodline]]}}

[[File:SR-quest-Awakening 02.jpg|thumb|right|Serana in her sarcophagus]][[File:SR-npc-Serana 03.jpg|Serana stumbles out of her sarcophagus|thumb|right]] Once you've found [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] and opened her sarcophagus at the end of [[Skyrim:Awakening|Awakening]], she will stumble out; disorientated after being asleep for a very long time. She asks you to take her to her father at [[Skyrim:Volkihar_Keep|Castle Volkihar]], but before this you can ask her some questions after she initiates a conversation. This exchange will be different depending on whether or not you're a vampire: ====If You're Not a Vampire==== Serana initiates the conversation. :''"Unh... where is... who sent you here?"'' You have three lines of conversation, all of which lead to Serana commenting on you not being "like her." :{|class="wikitable compress" |- !Who were you expecting? !A man named [[SR:Isran|Isran]]. !That's not your concern. |- | ''I was expecting someone... like me, at least.'' | ''I... don't know who that is. Is he... like me?'' | ''I think it is, actually. Why would someone who isn't... like me... come all the way down here?'' |} It continues with: :{|class="wikitable compress" |- !What do you mean, "like you"? !Are you a... |- | ''A... can't you tell just from looking at me? A vampire.'' | ''Vampire, yes.'' |} You can either deliver a notice of hostility or ignore her vampirism. :{|class="wikitable compress" |- !The Dawnguard would want me to kill you. !Why were you locked away like this?{{intnote|RepeatableQuestion1}} |- | ''Not fond of vampires, are they? Well, look. Kill me, you've killed one vampire. But if people are after me, there is something bigger going on. I can help you find out what that is.'' | ''That's... complicated. If you get lost during the escape, Serana will comment on this with a few remarks: * ''"So I'm thinking that wasn't the right way."'' * ''"All right, so obviously not this way, either."'' * ''"Well, we're definitely not going to find our way out from here. The gate to the next room is opened by a lever which also releases a number of [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]] and [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]. Through the gate is a large amphitheater room with several leveled undead (including a boss-level draugr, or an unnamed [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|Dragon Priest]] if above level 45), a boss chest and the ''[[Skyrim:Drain Vitality|Drain Vitality]]'' [[Skyrim:Word Wall|Word Wall]]. Behind the Word Wall is an altar with a few coin purses and two random enchanted weapons. Head out through the gated door at the opposite end of the room from where you came in and exit [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]]. When you finally escape Dimhollow Crypt, Serana will say: : ''"Ah, it's so good to breathe again!"'' As you travel with Serana to her castle, she will comment on the weather occasionally: * ''"Even in this weather, it's better than the cave."'' (cloudy, fog, overcast or storm) * ''"This weather is incredible."'' (anything else) If you try to bring her to Fort Dawnguard, she will comment: ''"I don't like the feel of this place. I'll wait for you back by the entrance."''. ===Castle Volkihar=== The castle is in the northwest corner of the map. The fastest way to reach the castle is to take the boat at [[Skyrim:Icewater_Jetty|Icewater Jetty]], which is reachable on foot or fast traveling to [[Skyrim:Northwatch Keep|Northwatch Keep]] and walking the remaining distance to the boat. It's also possible to hire a [[Skyrim:Transport#Ferrymen|ferryman]], but when asking to be taken to the island, they all reply with: ''"The one with the ruined castle? Don't you know that place is cursed? Even seasoned sailors steer far around that place. I'll take you as far as I can, but I'm not hanging around and it's gonna cost you extra.''" and drop you off at the jetty. They part with a few cautionary words: ''"They say anyone who steps foot on that island will meet an early death... hope you know what you're doing."'' Once you are near the castle, Serana will say: :''"That's it, out there to the north. We used to keep a boat around here to get there and back."'' Once you arrive at Icewater Jetty she will say: :''"Umm... this is the part where we usually get in the boat. You with me?"'' Activate the boat and you will arrive at a small dock with Castle Volkihar looming in the background. [[Skyrim:Bone Hawk|Bone hawks]] circle overhead and a stone bridge lined with gargoyles leads to the main gate. And so I have defeated mortality itself."'' {{SkyrimBox/End}} [[File:SR-qico-Dawnguard Dawnguard.png|right]] === Choosing Dawnguard === [[File:SR-quest-Bloodline 03.jpg|thumb|right|A skirmish between the Dawnguard and the vampires]] If you decide to stick with the Dawnguard and refuse his offer, Lord Harkon will cast a spell that will teleport you outside the Castle gate. He also "advises" you to never return. With the castle locked behind you, your only remaining option is to return to [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] and report this new discovery to the Dawnguard. Once you arrive, you will find the fortress under attack by a band of vampires. After defeating the vampire attackers, you should speak to [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] and tell him what you discovered. Following this report, he will give you the duty of seeking out some of his old allies to create [[Skyrim:A New Order|A New Order]]. Following the Dawnguard side of the questline will cause Fort Dawnguard to be rebuilt and refurnished. You will also have access to [[Skyrim:Ancient Technology|Crossbow upgrades]] and [[Skyrim:Armored Troll|Armored Trolls]]. {{NewLine}} ==Notes== *While in the castle during this quest, you can't draw your weapon, cast spells, shout or do anything aggressive. However, you are free to take anything in the keep without it being identified as thievery, although many of the doors are locked (they can't be picked), and there is very little time to do so – just two gaps in the forced dialogue (see below for a workaround). *You can still become a Vampire Lord if you choose to side with the Dawnguard, though it will not be possible until [[Skyrim:Chasing Echoes|later in Dawnguard's main questline]]. If you do, your allegiance to the Dawnguard remains unchanged, though many of the Dawnguard will treat you with hostility and not offer services until you're cured. *If you choose to become a Vampire Lord and get yourself cured later on, your alliance to the Volkihar family remains unchanged, though many of the Volkihar Keep residents will treat you with hostility and not offer services until your vampirism is restored. **Either way, parts of the Dawnguard questline will remain on hold indefinitely until you fix the corresponding alliance error. *By delaying the completion of the quest, you'll be able to retain Serana as an extra follower for as long as you like. *After the quest, you'll come across [[Skyrim:World Interactions|random encounters]] with either vampires or Dawnguard members, depending on which side you chose. If they see you, they'll immediately become hostile and attack on sight. *Siding with the Dawnguard allows access to some unique rewards. Specifically, the [[Skyrim:Ancient Technology|Ancient Technology]] quests allow you to smith crossbows and crossbow bolts, both steel and dwarven, and [[Skyrim:Lost Relic|Lost Relic]] quests allow you to recover three unique magic items. Similarly, if you join the Volkihar side, the [[Skyrim:Ancient Power|Ancient Power]], [[Skyrim:Amulets of Night Power|Amulets of Night Power]] and [[Skyrim:Rings of Blood Magic|Rings of Blood Magic]] quests help you enhance your Vampire Lord abilities. *If you exit the conversation when Lord Harkon tells you to make your choice or take too long to give an answer, he will banish you from the castle as if you chose to refuse his gift. However, you can do this before that with no consequences whatsoever. *If you accept Lord Harkon's "gift" and [[Skyrim:Survival Mode|Survival Mode]] is active, you'll be able to keep your [[Skyrim:Hunger|Hunger]] under control by feeding on the [[Skyrim:Vampire Cattle|Vampire Cattle]]. [[Skyrim:Potion of Blood|Potions of Blood]] can also be used to restore Hunger with version 1.6 of the [[Skyrim:Special Edition Patch|Official Skyrim Special Edition Patch]]. *If you accept Lord Harkon's "gift", you can freely roam around [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] while "[[Skyrim:The Bloodstone Chalice|The Bloodstone Chalice]]" is active. You'll be able to ask [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] for information about the Dawnguard, ask [[Skyrim:Agmaer|Agmaer]] and [[Skyrim:Durak|Durak]] why they joined the Dawnguard, and ask [[Skyrim:Celann|Celann]] about his history with Isran. Be warned, however, that everyone inside and the patrols in [[Skyrim:Dayspring Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]] will be hostile once you finish "The Bloodstone Chalice". *If you reject Lord Harkon's "gift", you can freely roam inside Castle Vokihar Keep while "[[Skyrim:A New Order|A New Order]]" is active. You'll be able barter with [[Skyrim:Feran Sadri|Feran Sadri]], [[Skyrim:Hestla|Hestla]], and [[Skyrim:Ronthil|Ronthil]], as well as ask Ronthil and [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]] for training. The portcullis will be down, though, and you'll have to [[Skyrim:Glitches#Clipping|clip]] through it or the diagonal walls around it to gain access. In addition, everything inside will be owned, and will need to be stolen. To add insult to injury, everyone inside will be hostile once you finish "A New Order". *If you are a werewolf, siding with Lord Harkon will cure your lycanthropy. However, you can become a werewolf again by asking [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela]] (which will cure your vampirism), and any lycanthropy perks which you had will be restored. You can restore your lycanthropy this way only once. You cannot advance in the Volkihar questline or use any of the vampire clan's services except when you are a vampire. Contrariwise, you can only advance through the second half of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] questline if you're a werewolf. *If you try to bring Serana to Fort Dawnguard, she will refuse to go inside it, having "a bad feeling about this place".
