(Misc. objective) ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===My Mother's Keeper=== [[File:SR-quest-Beyond Death 02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] fighting a [[Skyrim:Keeper|Keeper]]]] Upon your arrival in the [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]], follow the quest marker to the Boneyard and find [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]'s mother [[Skyrim:Valerica|Valerica]] standing near the entrance. She is initially surprised to find her daughter in the Cairn, before turning her focus on you and your motives for accompanying Serana. Once Serana has interceded for you, Valerica reveals she is still in possession of the [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll (Blood)|''Blood'' Elder Scroll]]. However, she is trapped in the Boneyard by an invisible barrier after fighting with the [[Lore:Ideal Masters|Ideal Masters]] and their minions when first arriving in the Cairn. To release her, she directs you to defeat the three [[Skyrim:Keeper|Boneyard Keepers]] located across the Cairn. The Keepers each live in separate towers, set apart from the main Boneyard and relatively far apart. The easiest way to navigate to them is by following the three quest markers. Alternatively, if you already killed all 3 Keepers before meeting Valerica, she explains what their purpose was, and will thank you for lifting the barrier. Each of the Keepers is accompanied by 1-4 minions ([[Skyrim:Boneman|bonemen]], [[Skyrim:Mistman|mistmen]] or [[Skyrim:Wrathman|wrathmen]]) that will attack you, usually ahead of your encounter with the Keeper. The Keepers themselves may prove quite a challenge to lower level players, so make full use of Serana's fighting capabilities. One possible strategy for the bow-wielding Keeper is to use [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] to blast it off the edge of the tower. ===Dealing with the Dragon=== Once the final Keeper is defeated, return to Valerica. The invisible barrier has now been removed, allowing her to lead you into the Boneyard itself. Once inside, the dragon [[Skyrim:Durnehviir (dragon)|Durnehviir]] will appear and immediately attack you, supported by a host of bonemen. Once he has been defeated, head to the alcove in the southeast corner, where you will find the Elder Scroll surrounded by a number of potions, ingredients and books. Once you leave the Boneyard from the southwest gate, Durnehviir will rematerialize on top of a nearby stone arch and speak to you, starting [[Skyrim:Durnehviir (quest)|his quest]]. If you tell him you have more pressing matters to attend to, his quest will not begin and you will need to return to him at a later time to initiate it. If you are a vampire, simply head southwest back to the portal; if you are not, see the section below. ===Scattered Soul=== If you are not a vampire and allowed Serana to partially soul trap you in order to enter the Soul Cairn, you will first need to retrieve your soul from a [[Skyrim:Soul Essence Gem|Soul Essence Gem]]. As Valerica explains, this is located at an offering altar not far away. After exiting the Boneyard from the southwest gate, head west-northwest until you reach a fort-like structure with an entrance on the south side. Follow the winding corridor, dispatching the odd [[Skyrim:Wrathman|wrathman]] before emerging into an exterior area. From here head south and east back inside the fort and follow the corridor due north. At the second junction leading east you will find a portal, which takes you outside on the top of the fort. On a raised platform you will find the Soul Essence Gem; once you take it a [[Skyrim:Black Soul Gem|Black Soul Gem]] will be added to your inventory and you will start emanating a shaft of bright blue light. Alternatively, you can retrieve the Essence Gem before meeting Valerica, which will immediately result in the negative effect being removed. You can now exit the fort, head south towards the breach in the Cairn walls and then southwest to the portal back to [[Skyrim:Castle Volkihar|Castle Volkihar]]. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|Beyond Death (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *During this quest, a makeshift camp in [[Skyrim:Dayspring Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]] will be set up, with [[Skyrim:Alvide|Alvide]], [[Skyrim:Barknar (Dawnguard)|Barknar]], [[Skyrim:Jayri|Jayri]], and [[Skyrim:Sern|Sern]] occupying it. *While this quest or [[Skyrim:Chasing Echoes|Chasing Echoes]] are active, you will be unable to dismiss Serana from your party. If you are on the Dawnguard side and a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy |werewolf]], it can be challenging to use Beast Form and have the Savage Feeding perk as Serana tends to raise corpses in battle. This prevents you from feeding unless you manage to feed on raised corpses after they die again but before they turn into a pile of ash. *If you defeated [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] and finished [[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]] before starting this quest, Durnehviir will be impressed and say ''"Even in the Soul Cairn, the defeat of the World Eater has reached my ears, Dovahkiin. You may not be dovah, but the defeat of Alduin earns you the right of title."'' *Given the vastness of the Soul Cairn, [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn Horse Quest|learning]] how to [[Skyrim:Summon Arvak|summon Arvak]] is recommended. *While Valerica instructs you to retrieve the Soul Gem Essence if you are not a vampire, it is also possible to simply exit the Cairn and complete this quest, which will result in the [[Skyrim:Weakened Soul|Weakened Soul]] effect being removed. *The soul essence gem can be retrieved before talking to Valerica. If you do so, she won't talk about it. *It is possible to kill the Keepers before talking to Valerica the first time which unlocks a new line of dialogue from her about it. In order to find the Keepers it is a good idea to look at the top of the buildings until you spot ones with debris swirling around the top of them; the only other building that has this look is Valerica's prison. *If you sided with the Volkihar, but cured yourself of vampirism before entering the Soul Cairn, Valerica will still refer to you as a vampire. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After you kill Durnehviir, there will be a prompt to search him but it is impossible to do so.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG|USSEP}} {{Bug|Sometimes after you retrieve your fragmented soul, the stairs leading back to Volkihar Castle on the return trip will be unusable and be part pixelated and you will walk right through them. Re-load a previous save to correct.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|Immediately upon leaving the Boneyard, it is possible to attack Durnehviir before he begins dialogue with you. This may make him hostile or at least prevent dialogue from occurring, making it impossible to obtain the "Summon Durnehviir" shout and by extension the "Soul Tear" shout.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|Valerica will sometimes not move when you return to her after killing the Boneyard Keepers.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} Enter the Boneyard and defeat Durnehviir, press the "~" key to open console, and type tcl then press enter. You should be able to fly and move through objects; go to the Elder Scroll case and enter the container to pick up the scroll. This will trigger the next stage of the quest, and solve the bug without creating the later bug in the quest [[Skyrim:Unseen Visions|Unseen Visions]]. **{{Pc22}} Another way of solving this is to go into Boneyard and type prid [[Skyrim:Form ID#xx and Add-Ons|xx]]003B8E first and then moveto player . This will teleport Valerica next to you, and she will resume to her correct pathing. As for Serana, just repeat the process but type prid xx002B74 instead. {{Bug|Valerica will not give the dialogue to help you find the soul essence gem if you have already slain one or more of the keepers before talking to her. It is in a building near the westernmost keeper, the one that uses a one-handed weapon and a shield.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}}The chest that contains the soul essence gem can be reached by typing player.moveto [[Skyrim:Form ID#xx and Add-Ons|xx]]00EA8D . Beware that the chest is directly under one of the health-draining crystals, so this should not be done while low on health. {{Bug|The mission can break if you go after the pages of Jiub's Opus and Arvak's Skull causing Serana to disappear and prevent you from furthering and completing the Dawnguard quest line. It is advised to complete the main quests in the Soul Cairn before going after them or walking everywhere in there so as not to lose Serana.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **To get Serana back, simply go back through the portal to Volkihar. She should appear with you again, and you can then return to the Soul Cairn. **If Serana does not reappear in Castle Volkihar Ruins then exit through the door to Castle Volkihar Balcony, open the map and fast travel to Castle Volkihar Blacony again. She should appear next to you. **{{Pc22}} The console commands prid xx002B74 and moveto player will teleport Serana to you. {{Bug|Serana may not give you the Elder Scroll.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Serana and I have entered the Soul Cairn in pursuit of her estranged mother, Valerica, and the Elder Scroll she took when she fled Castle Volkihar. {{Quest Objective|10|Locate Valerica}} |25||{{Quest Objective|20|Speak to Valerica}} |30||Serana and I have located Valerica imprisoned within a massive ruin. When confronted by us, Valerica revealed that Serana's blood is an integral part of the Tyranny of the Sun. After the reconciliation between the two of them, Valerica confessed to having the Elder Scroll hidden in her ramshackle living space. In order to free her from the prison, Serana and I will have to locate and slay the Keepers who maintain the barrier around the ruins. {{Quest Objective|30|Kill the Boneyard Keepers (/3) {{Quest Comment|only if any are still alive}}}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Speak to Valerica}} |50||Serana and I have slain all three of the Keepers and the barrier around Valerica's prison has faded. We rejoined Valerica, who has agreed to take us to the location where the Elder Scroll is hidden. {{Quest Objective|50|Follow Valerica}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Slay Durnehviir}} |80||As Valerica was leading us to the Elder Scroll, an ancient dragon named Durnehviir swooped into the ruins and attacked. It proved to be a challenging battle, but we've emerged unscathed. {{Quest Objective|90|Speak to Valerica}} |110||{{Quest Objective|95|Follow Valerica}} |120||{{Quest Objective|100|Retrieve the Elder Scroll}} |130||{{Quest Objective|110|Speak to Valerica}} |140||{{Quest Objective|120|Return to Tamriel}} |200:2|fin|We've exited the Soul Cairn with the Elder Scroll in hand. Serana's mother, Valerica, is unwilling to return with us to Tamriel until we've dealt with her husband and thwarted the Tyranny of the Sun. |^|fin|We've exited the Soul Cairn with the Elder Scroll in hand. Serana's mother, Valerica, is unwilling to return with us to Tamriel until we've dealt with her husband and completed the Tyranny of the Sun using our own methods. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|60|Retrieve the Elder Scroll}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |!|Beyond Death Soul Gem Handler|DLC1VQ05SoulGemHandler |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the Soul Essence Gem}} |200|fin| |missing= ** DLC1VQ05: 0, 20, 28, 29. ** DLC1VQ05SoulGemHandler: 10, 30 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Chasing Echoes|Chasing Echoes]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)#Quests|Dawnguard]] or

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=SerCenKing |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=SerCenKing }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Dawnguard|link3=Dawnguard (faction)}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Icon=SR-qico-Dawnguard Dawnguard.png |Giver=[[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ruunvald Excavation|Ruunvald]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Staff of Ruunvald|Staff of Ruunvald]]
Master trainer in [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] |Image=SR-quest-Bolstering the Ranks.jpg |Imgdesc=Rescue [[Skyrim:Florentius_Baenius|Florentius Baenius]]! |description=Find [[Skyrim:Florentius_Baenius|Florentius Baenius]] and recruit him into the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard_(faction)|Dawnguard]]. |ID=DLC1HunterBaseStage2 |Prereq=Reach [[Skyrim:Prophet_(Dawnguard)#Quest_Stages|stage 60]] of [[Skyrim:Prophet (Dawnguard)|Prophet]]. }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak with [[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]]. # Speak with [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]]. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Ruunvald Excavation|Ruunvald Excavation]]. # Find [[Skyrim:Florentius_Baenius|Florentius Baenius]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Secret Request=== [[File:SR-quest-Bolstering the Ranks 07.jpg|thumb|''"Gunmar and I have been talking"'']] After recruiting [[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]] and [[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]] into the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard_(faction)|Dawnguard]] during the quest [[Skyrim:A New Order|A New Order]], [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] will send you on a hunt for [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Dexion Evicus]], a [[Lore:Cult_of_the_Ancestor_Moth|Moth priest]] traveling around Skyrim, starting the quest [[Skyrim:Prophet_(Dawnguard)|Prophet]]. During your search for the priest, you will find that [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampires]] have taken Dexion hostage inside [[Skyrim:Forebears' Holdout|Forebears' Holdout]]. At that point in the quest ([[Skyrim:Prophet_(Dawnguard)#Quest_Stages|stage 60]]), Sorine and Gunmar will have settled down in [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]]'s western area, and while keeping up appearances, they have secretly discussed the vampire threat. Sorine will ask you directly: ''"Do you have a moment? Gunmar and I have been talking and, well, we're slightly worried. We both realized that if Isran's even allowed us in here, he must be really concerned. And if he's that concerned, the situation must be pretty bad. Make sense?"'' She then admits that she and Gunmar agreed that they could use the help of one 'Florentius', a former priest of [[Lore:Arkay|Arkay]] and quite eccentric. The problem is Isran and Florentius have a past, and Isran obviously dislikes the priest. Another problem is that Isran is the only one who knows the location of Florentius, and she leaves it to you to get the information. This starts the quest and you will have to seek out Isran, although Sorine encourages you to keep her involvement a secret. When confronted with the request, Isran will immediately guess the persons responsible: ''"Who said something, Sorine or Gunmar? I thought they'd have learned their lesson by now. I don't trust that man, and I don't want him here."'' He then reckons the Dawnguard can use all the help they can get and will point you towards [[Skyrim:Ruunvald Excavation|Ruunvald]], an excavation site recently explored by [[Skyrim:Vigilant of Stendarr|Vigilants of Stendarr]], including Florentius, with the comment: ''"If he can maintain some appearance of normalcy, I'll allow him to stay."'' ===The Charmed Vigilants=== [[File:SR-quest-Bolstering_the_Ranks_02.jpg|thumb|A [[Skyrim:Charmed Vigilant|Charmed Vigilant]]]] The [[Skyrim:Ruunvald Excavation|Ruunvald Excavation]] is located on the mountainside east of [[Skyrim:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]] and consists of a tent and what appears to be a mine entrance. Examine the tent for a [[Skyrim:Volk's Journal|journal]], the personal observations of a Vigilant named [[Skyrim:Volk|Volk]]. The journal mentions that Volk and Florentius both had the tiresome job of guarding the entrance, until they were finally invited to join the dig by a Vigilant named Apa. Although the two guards were beginning to find the whole situation suspicious, they clearly ventured into the mines as ordered, and you will have to do the same. '''''I am certain we are digging in the right place. I can feel it in my bones, and I dream of finding Ruunvald at night. Even in my waking hours, I can almost hear a reassuring voice telling me we are going the right way.''''' Upon entering, you can hear digging noises from below, so head down the slope to the woodworks set up by the Vigilants and notice the person standing on the adjacent platform, without moving at all. As you get closer you will see an odd red fog covering his face, and when he notices you he will immediately attack and identify himself as a [[Skyrim:Charmed Vigilant|Charmed Vigilant]]. From the chamber behind you, another Vigilant will rush to his aid, so dispose of them both and examine the first chamber for a locked chest with minor loot and, on a crate next to the northern tunnel, ''[[Skyrim:Discovering_Ruunvald,_Vol._I|Discovering Ruunvald, Vol. I]]'', a detailed journal written by [[Skyrim:Moric Sidrey|Moric Sidrey]], the Vigilant who discovered the place. ===Dream of Ruunvald=== [[File:SR-quest-Bolstering_the_Ranks_06.jpg|thumb|left|[[Skyrim:Husky|Husky]] attacks!]] Proceed through the northern tunnel until you reach an intersection with a patrolling Vigilant and a [[Skyrim:Tripwire|booby-trapped]] [[Skyrim:Oil Slick|oil slick]]. Use the oil to your advantage or pick the fight and beware of another Vigilant near the [[Skyrim:Malachite Ore Vein|malachite vein]] to the northwest. Head down the southern tunnel and claim the contents of a minor loot chest. Proceed forward until you reach a large room with two Vigilants and a [[Skyrim:Husky|husky]]. Take them all down and examine the southwestern corner for several useful potions near a bedroll. In the center of the room, on a crate near another bedroll, sits ''[[Skyrim:Discovering_Ruunvald,_Vol._II|Discovering Ruunvald, Vol. II]]'' with more of Moric Sidrey's detailed observations on the dig, along with some unsettling personal issues. '''''It must have something to do with the cramped spaces, but I have found myself prone to aches in my head. While these hardly deter me from my leadership role, I have found myself distracted at times. I have had many a conversation with the workers where I drift off, only to have them call me back to reality. Sometimes I lose small amounts of time and can't remember what I've done.''''' Locate the narrow tunnel to the east and proceed forward as it twists and turns. A locked chest can be found under the woodworks ahead, and, further down the tunnel, yet another Vigilant accompanied by a husky. A huge wooden scaffold leads down into the next chamber, obviously used by the hardworking Vigilants as storage, as several crates and barrels are stacked up, along with a bookshelf with common books. On the table near the shelf, guarded by a Vigilant, is [[Skyrim:Discovering_Ruunvald,_Vol._III|volume III]] of the journal, detailing not only his own recurring headaches, but headaches among his crew of Vigilants as well. However, despite the pain and blackouts, the dig continued, even if Moric Sidrey's attention turned away from Ruunwald towards something else in the depths of the mine. '''''I dream we'll finally reach Ruunvald, and I can't help but reflect on what this will mean to my reputation! My family will be so proud, especially my father, Minorne. He and mother have always been interested in my studies, even if my sister Minorne was not. But I'm most excited to reveal my findings to my colleagues, Minorne and Minorne, and perhaps my mentor Minorne. Oh, won't they all be pleased?''''' ===Discovering Ruunvald=== [[File:SR-quest-Bolstering_the_Ranks_03.jpg|thumb|The entrance to [[Skyrim:Ruunvald Temple|Ruunvald Temple]]]] The next area contains more crates and barrels, along with three [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plates]] triggering [[Skyrim:Crossbow Mount|mounted crossbows]], so dodge the plates and proceed through the northern tunnel into a huge chamber filled with Nordic architecture, a hanging bridge, and several Charmed Vigilants. After fighting your way over the bridge, one of the attackers will have a familiar name, specifically [[Skyrim:Volk|Volk]], who initially guarded the entrance with Florentius but was charmed along with his colleagues. Before heading downstairs, examine the enclosed western room for a chest. At the bottom of the large chamber, examine the northeastern corner for an owned bed, a chest, and some food. This chamber also marks the spot where Moric and his crew finally broke through the right wall and found the entrance to [[Skyrim:Ruunvald Temple|Ruunvald Temple]]. However, the [[Skyrim:Discovering_Ruunvald,_Vol._IV|fourth and final volume]] of Moric Sidrey's journal, which can be found on a barrel near the entrance to the Temple, reveals that Moric and his workers were all led to the Temple by a strange voice that slowly seduced them all. '''''I have found my muse and her name is [[Skyrim:Minorne|Minorne]]. Reading back over old journals, I realize she has called to me from deep inside Ruunvald. She is the voice I've been hearing, the one who has called me ever downwards into the mountain. The Vigilants, the workers, they hear her too! What joy to learn that I am not alone in her love! Oh, Minorne, how would we have ever found this place without you!''''' As expected, Ruunvald Temple is a typical [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]], although no draugr enemies can be found here. Proceed down the first hallway to a table holding the book ''[[Skyrim:Minorne_(book)|Minorne]]'', the ramblings of former Vigilant of Stendarr [[Skyrim:Moric Sidrey|Moric Sidrey]], and a love letter to his new mistress in the depths of the ruin, [[Skyrim:Minorne|Minorne]]. It details his eternal love and how he managed to lure even more Vigilants into the ruin, simply by lying. It also contains a clue to the whereabouts on your target, [[Skyrim:Florentius_Baenius|Florentius Baenius]], and his hatred towards anyone who would harm his mistress: ''"There are fools in this world that do not heed to her beautiful voice. The guard, Florentius, sent from the Beacon, he still prays to [[Lore:Arkay|Arkay]], an absentee god who pales in comparison to Minorne! I will pray to the goddess I can see! May he rot in his cage!"'' ===The Mistress=== [[File:SR-quest-Bolstering_the_Ranks_04.jpg|thumb|left|Minorne attacks]] Proceed down the available path until you reach a large chamber, with stairs leading up to an altar and a cage, and three shadowy figures wandering around. They turn out to be another Charmed Vigilant, Moric Sidrey himself, and his godly mistress Minorne, who is actually just an ordinary [[Skyrim:High Elf|Altmer]] [[Skyrim:Warlock|warlock]], who is busy torturing the imprisoned Florentius for no apparent reason, using her leveled [[Skyrim:Spells#Destruction_Spells|Destruction spells]]. All three will attack you on sight, so take them down and loot Minorne's corpse for the unique [[Skyrim:Staff of Ruunvald|Staff of Ruunvald]] and the [[Skyrim:Ruunvald Key|Ruunvald Key]]. [[File:SR-quest-Bolstering_the_Ranks_05.jpg|thumb|''"Isran? My help? Is this... some kind of a joke?"'']] Inside the cage, Priest of Arkay Florentius Baenius will show little of the normalcy requested by [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] when he shows his gratitude: ''"I knew you had it in you! Arkay wasn't so sure. Between you and me, I think he didn't expect you to make it. But not me! I knew it all along!"'' He will then ask how he can repay you, so ask him to meet you at [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] and he will ask why. When you explain Isran needs his help he will be quite surprised: ''"Isran? My help? Is this... some kind of a joke? Did Arkay put you up to this? Isran's done nothing but mock me. He's never given me the respect I deserve."'' After you beg for his help, he will finally agree, but only due to strange voices in his head: ''"Look, I've just gotten myself out of quite a mess here, in case you haven't noticed, and while I appreciate your help, I... What's that? No, that's not what I... Yes, but... Are you sure? Really? Fine. Arkay says it's a good idea for me to go. I don't agree, but he's not the sort of fellow you can just ignore. I'll see you at Fort Dawnguard, then. Don't worry, Arkay will show me the way."'' He will then leave the ruin and the quest will finish. While Florentius takes the long way back through the mine, locate the southern door and unlock it with the key. It leads to the deceased warlock's private quarters and contains a boss-leveled chest, the [[Skyrim:Lost to the Ages|quest-related]] book ''[[Skyrim:The_Aetherium_Wars|The Aetherium Wars]]'', an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], and a handle which reveals a hidden pathway back to Skyrim. The next time you visit Fort Dawnguard, Florentius will have changed into Dawnguard armor, opened up his shop as an alchemist, will be available as a master trainer in [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]], and an alchemy lab will be found across from the arcane enchanter. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * If you have access to [[Skyrim:Invisibility|invisibility]] (potions or spells), and/or the [[Skyrim:Throw Voice|Throw Voice]] [[Skyrim:Shouts|shout]], you may be able to bypass all of the Charmed Vigilants and only kill Minorne if your [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] skill is high enough. * Any Charmed Vigilants that are still alive when Minorne dies will also die instantly; this also counts for the ones that are raised with the [[Skyrim:Dead Thrall|Dead Thrall]] spell. * Completing this quest unlocks the radiant quests [[Skyrim:Rescue|Rescue]] and [[Skyrim:Lost Relic|Lost Relic]]. See the quest articles for more information. * If you finish this quest while [[Skyrim:Prophet (Dawnguard)|Prophet]] is still active, Florentius may also be present when [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Dexion Evicus]] reads [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]'s [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll (Sun)|Elder Scroll]]. * This quest can be completed at any time, even after finishing the main quest line for the Dawnguard. * If you talk to Florentius through the gate without unlocking it, he will still show up at Fort Dawnguard later, making good on his parting words of "''Don't worry, Arkay will show me the way.''" {{vn|confirmed=1}} ==Bugs== {{Bug|Florentius may sometimes turn hostile and attack you, thus not letting you initiate conversation with him.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ** Possible fixes include loading a previous save and waiting outside the cave for 24 hours before going back in, using a [[Skyrim:Pacify_(effect)|Pacify]] spell or the [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]]{{DB}} shout to calm him long enough to initiate conversation, or trying to initiate conversation when he is kneeling in recovery. ** One of the possible causes is having a high bounty in the Reach (possibly in other holds as well). {{Bug|The Dawnguard may try to kill you if you fail to rescue Florentius.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|If you have already completed [[Skyrim:Touching_the_Sky|Touching the Sky]], talking to Isran will automatically trigger the start of [[Skyrim:Kindred_Judgment|Kindred Judgment]]. You will not be able to get information on Florentius.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} ** {{Pc22}} You can circumvent having to talk to Isran using the command setstage DLC1HunterBaseStage2 20. Note that Florentius is spawned during stage 10 of the quest, so you need to complete that first, or use setstage DLC1HunterBaseStage2 10. Don't skip straight to stage 20. {{Bug|If you feed on Charmed Vigilants while in werewolf form, you will get a red aura around your head. The red aura will not leave you even if you change to human form, and will cause laggy graphics on weaker systems.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Florentius may not follow you to Fort Dawnguard after he is rescued.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||It's been suggested that the Dawnguard could use the help of a man named Florentius, a former Priest of Arkay. I need to speak with Isran to find out if he knows where Florentius might be. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak with Isran}} |20||I've been asked to find a man named Florentius in the hopes that he can assist the Dawnguard. I've learned that he was last seen helping the Vigilants of Stendarr in Ruunvald. {{Quest Objective|20|Find Florentius}} |200|fin|I've rescued Florentius Baenius from Ruunvald, where he was being held captive. He's agreed to return to Fort Dawnguard and aid our cause. }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} [[Category:Skyrim-Dawnguard]] [[Category:Skyrim-Dawnguard-Quests]]

Word for the [[Skyrim:Dragon Aspect|Dragon Aspect]] shout |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Gardener of Men|The Gardener of Men]], [[Skyrim:Cleansing the Stones|Cleansing the Stones]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Apocrypha (Waking Dreams)|Apocrypha]] |Image=SR-quest-At the Summit of Apocrypha.jpg |ImgDesc=The summit of Apocrypha |ID=DLC2MQ06 |description=Confront [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]] at the summit of [[Skyrim:Apocrypha|Apocrypha]] and defeat him once and for all. |SuggLevel=25 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Unlock the [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] and read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Waking Dreams (book)|Waking Dreams]]''. # Traverse Chapters I to VI. # Use the Bend Will shout to tame [[Skyrim:Sahrotaar|Sahrotaar]]. # Reach the summit of [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (Waking Dreams)|Apocrypha]]. # Confront [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]] and kill him. == Detailed Walkthrough == === Chapter I: The Word of Lore === With the complete [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] at your disposal, it is now time to face [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]]. Using dragon souls, unlock the remaining words of the Bend Will shout and read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Waking Dreams (book)|Waking Dreams]]'', where Miraak was first encountered during the quest [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|The Temple of Miraak]]. You will be transported to [[Skyrim:Apocrypha|Apocrypha]], [[Skyrim:Hermaeus Mora|Hermaeus Mora]]'s [[Lore:Planes_of_Oblivion|plane of Oblivion]]. Though this area is large, there's little of interest here now that Miraak has departed, only a few pods and tables along the walls. Walk down the path and up the staircase, where Chapter II will be accessible from a pedestal. === Chapter II: Preferred Reading—Boneless Limbs === Ascend the stairs and defeat the two [[Skyrim:Seeker|seekers]]. If you make enough noise, you can attract the attention of enemies far above you, but it is unlikely that you will be able to attack each other, so if you need to leave combat, just sneak until they stop looking for you. At the top of the stairs, a copy of the [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Heavy Armor Forging|Heavy Armor Forging]]'' is on a table to the right. When you get across the bridge, you can turn right and walk back along the narrow ledge to reach a pod. On the top landing, grab the book ''[[Skyrim:On Apocrypha: Boneless Limbs|On Apocrypha: Boneless Limbs]]'' and go up the now-accessible staircase to reach Chapter III. === Chapter III: Preferred Reading—Delving Pincers and Prying Orbs=== This next area may be a bit tricky to navigate, due to its maze-like structure. Defeat any seeker you encounter and make your way to the other end of the room, where the book ''[[Skyrim:On Apocrypha: Delving Pincers|Delving Pincers]]'' and a copy of the [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Song of the Alchemists|Song of the Alchemists]]'' lie. There is a pod across from the book pedestal and another down the stairs past it. After picking up Delving Pincers, return to the entrance, where the (previously closed) gate is now open. Activate the scrye and travel down the hall, where you can pick up a copy of the [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments|Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments]]'' from the table. Be careful in the next room, where it is easy to fall off of the edge. If you activate the scrye in this room, a door will open off to the north, revealing a vessel with a bit of loot (there are also pods by the scrye and book pedestal here). Kill the seeker and traverse the narrow walkways to pick up the book ''[[Skyrim:On Apocrypha: Prying Orbs|Prying Orbs]]''. With the book in your possession, the gate will open, and you can now continue onward to Chapter IV. [Possible spoiler] - For those that want to speed run this chapter (either for fun or to avoid combat) it is easy enough. Good magic resistances allow you to run past the Seekers and an atronach spell or staff will distract them. : Instructions below : 1.You need to get the books ' Delving Pincers' and 'Prying Orbs', both to open gates and for the next chapter. From the chapter start, there is a corridor in front of you facing roughly East. Just in front you on the right wall (South) of the corridor is a closed gate [1] that you need to open. : 2. Get 'Delving Pincers' - Follow the corridor (E) to a T junction. Two Seekers will appear. Go right(S), left(E), right, left (passing a poison pools with tentacles and a blue Magicka font). There is a poison pool to your front right and steps up to platform on your left. Go up the steps to a raised platform. On the right is a table with some loot. More importantly, on the left is the book 'Delving Pincers'. Taking this opens gate [1]. There are further steps down to a dead end and a pod (not essential, if you want to run). : 3. Run back the way you came. Just before the start, now on your left is the gate [1] open. Go through, activate a scrye which opens a corridor directly in front of you (S). Run down a slope, then up to a table with some loot and a font of stamina. : 4. Get 'Prying Orbs' - Turn right and a gate opens to a huge open area with narrow walkways and drops to the chamber below (Chapter 2). It is patrolled by (one or two) Seekers. To your left is a scrye. To your right is a small gated room with loot. The scrye opens the room but neither are essential. Prying orbs is across the entire chamber. It is to your SW, beside a bright blue font. To get to it turn right and take the first (left) path to the middle of the open area. Then take the first left path towards the blue font. and take the book. : 5. As you take the book, you are facing NW and you will see a gate open (right in front of you on the other side of the open area. Run over to it across the pathways (dodging the Seeker shots) and down a short corridor is the book to the next chapter. === Chapter IV: Preferred Reading—Gnashing Blades=== Eliminate the seekers and walk down the stairs to either side of you. There is a pod on a ledge to your right. At the bottom, you will enter a hallway that has a fork to the right. Walking into either hallway will cause it to compress and summon a group of seekers. After you find that both hallways are a dead end, you can turn around and see that, where you had entered, there is a hallway that had not been there previously. Follow it to the next room. Climb the stairs and pick up the book ''[[Skyrim:On Apocrypha: Gnashing Blades|Gnashing Blades]]''. This will open a second path to the right, directly across from where you entered. Continue down the hallway as it extends outward and take a left turn at its end. In this next room, follow the path until you reach a scrye. Activate it and go back to the same hallway you came from—it has shifted and leads to a room with a small pool of poisonous water. From the pool will rise a [[Skyrim:Lurker|lurker]]. When the room is clear, activate the scrye to the left of the closed gate and go around a corner at the far end of the room (across from the previously mentioned closed gate). Here, activate the second scrye and examine the room next to it, which had been opened by the first scrye, for any valuables. You can find Chapter V through the gate opened by the second scrye. === Chapter V: The Penultimate Chapter=== The hallway will lead you to a large open room with a pillar in the middle emitting a green light. Defeat the seekers. Surrounding the central pillar are four pedestals with inscriptions. On the walls near the eye and tentacle pillars, there are three pods. Place the four books that were collected in the previous Chapters on the appropriate pedestal: * ''Boneless Limbs'' is placed on the 'tentacle' symbol (NE) * ''Delving Pincers'' is placed on the 'pincer' symbol (SE) * ''Prying Orbs'' is placed on the 'eye' symbol (NW) * ''Gnashing Blades'' is placed on the 'fangs' symbol (SW) Once all four books are placed correctly, the book located in front of the central pillar will glow. This will take you to Chapter VI. === Chapter VI: Bending the Will of Sahrotaar, First and Last and Always=== A copy of the [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Art of War Magic|The Art of War Magic]]'' is located to the right of the entrance, while at the left, there is a pod with some valuable loot. The path will take you to a large open area surrounded by water. Kill the two seekers and approach the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]], which teaches a word for the [[Skyrim:Dragon Aspect|Dragon Aspect]] shout. [[Skyrim:Sahrotaar|Sahrotaar]], a [[Skyrim:Serpentine Dragon|serpentine dragon]], will attack you; however, you are tasked with taming it using Bend Will. Using the full shout on Sahrotaar (be sure to unlock all three words) will instantly tame him. He will land and offer to take you to Miraak. Mount Sahrotaar and fly to the large tower circled by dragons, but not before forcing you to fight enemies on another platform. After you kill the two Seekers and the Lurker, Sahrotaar will fly towards Miraak's Tower. As you reach the top, Miraak will chide Sahrotaar for being so easily swayed by your thu'um. Once you land, approach Miraak, who will explain that his time in Apocrypha is done, and that although you are powerful, you are still subject to Miraak's power. Miraak will then conclude that the final key for his escape is your soul, and with it he will be strong enough to return to Solstheim. [[File:SR-quest-At the Summit of Apocrypha 02.jpg|thumb|right|The death of Miraak]][[File:SR-quest-At the Summit of Apocrypha 03.jpg|thumb|left|Miraak absorbing a dragon soul]] The conversation will quickly end and the battle will commence. It is completely up to you as to how you would like to battle, either on the back of Sahrotaar or on foot. However, be careful of the other dragons trying to attack you. As Miraak's health is weakened, he will enter an invulnerable state and return to full health. Each time he regenerates, he will sacrifice a dragon: first [[Skyrim:Kruziikrel|Kruziikrel]], then [[Skyrim:Relonikiv|Relonikiv]]. The third regeneration will lead to Sahrotaar's demise, as Miraak absorbs his soul, too. With all three dragons eliminated, you can deal the final blows to Miraak. When his health is low enough, he will move to the center of the area in an attempt to escape. At this point, Hermaeus Mora will intervene, claiming that Miraak can hide nothing from him in his realm. The Daedric Prince then impales Miraak with a tentacle, and explains to Miraak that his death is insignificant, as he has found a new Dragonborn to 'serve' him. As Miraak dies, he wishes upon you the same fate he is about to suffer, and then disintegrates into nothing but bones as his soul departs from his body and is absorbed by you. For Miraak's death, you will be rewarded with at least six dragon souls (additional number of dragon souls is equal to the number of dragons you've killed in the plug-in, regardless of whether their souls are stolen by Miraak or not) and you may loot his body for his equipment, as well as the bodies of the dragons. Reading the Black Book ''Waking Dreams'' will allow you to gain access to your skill trees (see the notes section). Read the book once more to exit Apocrypha. Once exit, Approaching Frea will trigger several conversations automatically. If you didn't take ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Epistolary Acumen (book)|Epistolary Acumen]]'' from [[Skyrim: Storn Crag-Strider|Storn Crag-Strider's]] body before entering Apocrypha, talk to Frea again and she will give it to you and says ''"Here is the foul book that killed Storn. Take it away from here. Throw it into the sea. It is evil"''. {{NewLeft}} ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{Achievement|At the Summit of Apocrypha (achievement)|descr=no}} Reaching the end of ''Waking Dreams'' counts as one of the five black books for this achievement: * {{Achievement|Hidden Knowledge|descr=no}} If this is the first time you've fully traversed ''Waking Dreams'' you may earn the last word of the Dragon Aspect shout and thus this achievement: * {{Achievement|Dragon Aspect (achievement)|descr=no}} == Notes == * If you fully traversed ''Waking Dreams'' before this quest, you will be returned to Chapter VI, where Sahrotaar will be waiting for you. You must then use Bend Will to tame him and continue the quest, as above. * At the end of the quest, you will have access to different portals (one for each skill) which allow you to clear and regain any perks in that skill tree, at the cost of one dragon soul. You remove all perks from a single skill perk tree and can use these reclaimed perks on unlocking any perks you wish, including perks taken from said perk tree. By reading the Black Book ''Waking Dreams'', you can return to Apocrypha and alter the skill trees whenever you wish. * Completing this quest also cleanses the [[Skyrim:Tree Stone|Tree Stone]], granting you access to its [[Skyrim:Root of Power|power]]. * If you are defeated during this quest, before confronting Miraak, you will be transported back to where you initially read ''Waking Dreams''. You will return to the chapter you last accessed when re-entering Apocrypha. * If you defeated [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] and finished [[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]] before starting this quest, Miraak will be impressed and say ''"Felling Alduin was a mighty deed, and I thank you for it. He would have proved troublesome to me."'' * If you return to [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] after completing this quest, [[Skyrim:Frea|Frea]] will inform you that the Oneness of the land has been restored, and that the [[Skyrim:Tree Stone|Tree Stone]] is now free. She will also warn you not to become involved further with Hermaeus Mora. * If you return to [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]] after completing this quest, [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] will check that you have no indications of Hermaeus Mora's permanent influence. After satisfying himself that you don't, he will direct you to [[Skyrim:Lost Knowledge|find more Black Books]], if you have not found them all already. * In order to travel to Apocrypha by reading ''Waking Dreams'', you '''must''' be on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. If you try to read the Black Book in Skyrim mainland, nothing will happen and a message will pop up, saying: ''"A vision of Solstheim swims before your eyes and then is gone."'' The same situation also occurs with the other Black Books. * Unlike the other sections of Apocrypha accessed through Black Books, you can never return to the first five chapters of Waking Dreams after you defeat Miraak, so be sure to pick up any items you don't wish to leave behind before mounting Sahrotaar. ** If you previously read Waking Dreams and advanced to Chapter 6 before starting this quest, you will proceed directly from there. * You cannot land on the area where you order Sahrotaar to attack the Lurkers during the dragon flying tutorial; you also cannot jump off from the summit of the tower after you defeat Miraak and swim to it, as no matter how much health you have - even if it is in the thousands - you will still die from a tentacle explosion half way there. * Even after the quest is finished, all Black Books will permanently remain as quest items with no way to remove them from your inventory. * If you attempt to search Miraak's skeleton while your character absorbs the dragon souls he stole, a "This person is busy." message will appear on the top left of the screen. * Miraak's equipment is [[Skyrim:Leveled_Items|leveled]], but these items' level is only determined after the corpse of [[Skyrim:Form ID|xx]]01fb99 appears. * Depending on luck, it may be extremely difficult to gather the last two dragon souls needed to complete the Bend Will shout due to Miraak stealing them. He will always appear at dragon lair dragons, named dragons, elemental dragons and legendary dragons. Dragons that are simply named "Dragon" will give you the best chance of absorbing it's soul. Make sure to always have a healthy stock of dragon souls at hand to avoid this. If you try to absorb the souls of the two dragons found in the Forgotten Vale frozen lake - Miraak will absorb both their souls. == Bugs == {{Bug|After you teleport into Chapter VI, the platform on which you are supposed walk to the Word Wall and then fight and tame Sahrotaar does not appear, and attempting to walk forward results in swimming through nothingness for a moment and then falling a short distance to a normally-hidden stone floor below the normally-visible platforms of the level. Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (quest.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=178.235.103.47 |rewardChecked= }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}} {{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=The Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (book)|Untold Legends]]'' |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Reward=[[Skyrim:Bardic Knowledge|Bardic Knowledge]], [[Skyrim:Black Market|Black Market]], or [[Skyrim:Secret Servant|Secret Servant]] power |Prev= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Benkongerike Great Hall|Benkongerike Great Hall]], [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (Untold Legends)|Apocrypha‎]] |Image=SR-quest-Black Book Untold Legends.jpg |ImgDesc=The Black Book in Benkongerike |ID=DLC2BlackBook03Quest |description=Learn the [[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (book)|Black Book]]'s hidden knowledge. |SuggLevel=25 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (book)|Untold Legends]]'' in [[Skyrim:Benkongerike Great Hall|Benkongerike Great Hall]]. # Make your way through [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (Untold Legends)|Apocrypha‎]]. # Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge. # Choose your reward. == Detailed Walkthrough == There are five chapters: Chapter I is basically a corridor that leads to Chapter II, containing no enemies and only three [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]] in the way of loot. These can be found at the very end of the chapter, at the final bend just before the book that leads to Chapter II. Chapter II has exits to both Chapter III and Chapter IV, enabling you to bypass Chapter III if you wish. There is a leveled [[Skyrim:Lurker|lurker]] to battle before reaching either exit. The lurker is standing near a Font of Stamina and a Font of Magicka. There is another Font of Magicka by the exit to Chapter IV. The exit to Chapter IV can be found by taking the corridor south and then west; whereas the exit for Chapter III is taking the corridor north. Chapter III contains a [[Skyrim:Seeker|seeker]], a [[Skyrim:Conjure Seeker|spell tome of Conjure Seeker]] if your Conjuration skill is at least 65, and a container of loot. These are all in the same enclosed starting area, so that the Seeker will attack you just as you enter the Chapter; the spell tome is in the beginning area as well. There is no direct path from Chapter III to Chapter IV, so you do have to return to Chapter II. Chapter IV contains the most loot including four stealth based [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill books]], two soul gems and four containers of loot as well as three seekers to battle. It starts off on an open platform with two Fonts of Stamina; walking down the corridor will take you past a well-lit Font of Magicka. You will head south into another open area; all the Seekers are here together. There are various landings here going in roughly the eight cardinal directions; the northeast one contains a locked treasure pod, a soul gem, and the four skill books. East is another locked pod and another Scrye which opens the middle. Southeast goes nowhere. South is initially unclimbable. Southwest contains another locked treasure pod. By the west gate is a Scrye which opens said gate. Inside is another Scrye which opens the east landing. There is a pod to the northwest. North returns you to the corridor to Chapter II. The middle Scrye opens out the southern stairs, allowing exit to Chapter V. Chapter V contains a corridor that initially points towards the final reward, but may bend to the left or right whenever you move down the corridor. If it does, you'll be directed towards a room with a leveled lurker. Kill the lurker and a door will open behind it, allowing you to return to the central room. Once any side areas have been dealt with, the corridor should return to its original position, leading to the [[Skyrim:Black Book (book)|Black Book]]: ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (book)|Untold Legends]]''. === Rewards === Your choice of one of three lesser powers: * [[Skyrim:Bardic Knowledge|Bardic Knowledge]] — Summons a spectral drum that plays for you, increasing [[Skyrim:Regenerate_Stamina|stamina regeneration]] for you and nearby allies for 300 secs. * [[Skyrim:Black Market|Black Market]] — Summons a [[Skyrim:Dremora Merchant|Dremora merchant]] to trade with you for 15 secs. * [[Skyrim:Secret Servant|Secret Servant]] — Summons a [[Skyrim:Dremora Butler|Dremora butler]] to carry your excess items for 15 secs. (Max carry weight 148) ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is related to this quest: * {{Achievement|Hidden Knowledge|descr=no}} ==Notes== *There is a table in Chapter IV that has the four skill books [[Skyrim:The Gold Ribbon of Merit|The Gold Ribbon of Merit]], [[Skyrim:Advances in Lockpicking|Advances in Lockpicking]], [[Skyrim:Beggar (book)|Beggar]], and [[Skyrim:The Rear Guard|The Rear Guard]], which train archery, lockpicking, pickpocket and light armor, respectively. * You can change the reward at any time by traveling to Solstheim and re-reading the book. This will transport you to Apocrypha near the reward location and you can select a different one. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Sometimes after defeating one of the lurkers in Chapter V, the nearby door will open and then shut before you have a chance to pass through.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Use the tcl console command to clip through the door. {{Bug|If you return to Chapter III, the hallway configuration may change, leaving any dropped items in the previous configuration permanently inaccessible.}} ** {{Pc22}} Use the tcl console command to clip through the door(s) and regain your items. {{Bug|Although it appears that the corridor in Chapter V was always supposed to move to the left, right, or possibly each in sequence, it will often fail to do so.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes after completing the book, you will have a false combat signature, preventing you from exiting.}} ** Reload the game. == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||I read the Black Book called "Untold Legends", and found myself in Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha. I should uncover the knowledge hidden here, or read the book again to escape. {{Quest Objective|10|Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge}} |20|fin|I uncovered the hidden knowledge contained in the Black Book "Untold Legends". }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Black Book: The Winds of Change (.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Quantheory |reward=Alphabetface |rewardChecked=Quantheory }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]] {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=The Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Winds of Change (book)|The Winds of Change]]'' |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Reward=[[Skyrim:Companion's Insight|Companion's Insight]], [[Skyrim:Lover's Insight|Lover's Insight]], or [[Skyrim:Scholar's Insight|Scholar's Insight]] ability |Prev=Start [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]] |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]], [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (The Winds of Change)|Apocrypha‎]] |Image=SR-quest-Black Book The Winds of Change.jpg |ImgDesc=The Black Book, located in the depths of Raven Rock Mine |ID=DLC2BlackBook04Quest |description=Learn the [[Skyrim:Black Book: The Winds of Change (book)|Black Book]]'s hidden knowledge. }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Winds of Change (book)|The Winds of Change]]'' in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]]. # Make your way through [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (The Winds of Change)|Apocrypha‎]]. # Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge. # Choose your reward. == Detailed Walkthrough == After reading the black book, you'll find yourself on a low path surrounded by water. Walk forward quickly to avoid the tentacles on either side. Up the stairs, you'll encounter a [[Skyrim:Seeker|Seeker]]. If you take too long, or fight too far forward, you may attract the attention of another Seeker farther ahead. At the top of the stairs is a pool of poisonous water, which contains another tentacle, a Font of Stamina, and a Scrye. If your [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] skill is above 40, you will also find a spell tome for the [[Skyrim:Conjure Seeker|Conjure Seeker]] spell here. Activating the Scrye will open a gate to your left, into a series of tunnels with fenced walls. Here there are two tables with soul gems, and a pod filled with loot. You will come to a second Scrye by one of these tables and a Font of Stamina. Activate it and a gate will open to the next chamber, which has a pool with a tentacle and another Seeker (if you did not have to fight it before). This small room contains a third Scrye, which opens up a larger room containing some green fog. Entering the fog will cause a leveled [[Skyrim:Lurker|Lurker]] to emerge from a pool in the center of this room. Defeat it, then climb the ramp to find a table and two pedestals with soul gems, scrolls, and the two-handed skill book [[Skyrim:Words and Philosophy|Words and Philosophy]], as well as the fourth Scrye. If you haven't read the skill book already, you may want to get Scholar's Insight before doing so. Activate the Scrye to open the final door, then return down the ramp and activate the final Scrye on your left, which will extend a staircase leading to the door you just opened. Ascend the stairs to find a loot-filled vessel and the Black Book: Winds of Change. You may pick one reward, and after that, read the book again to return to Solstheim. === Rewards === Your choice of one of three abilities: * [[Skyrim:Companion's Insight|Companion's Insight]] — Your attacks, [[Skyrim:Dragon_Shouts|shouts]], and [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] spells do no damage to your [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] when in combat. * [[Skyrim:Lover's Insight|Lover's Insight]] — Do 10% more {{sic|damage|damage to|description=missing word}} and get 10% better prices from people of the opposite sex. * [[Skyrim:Scholar's Insight|Scholar's Insight]] — Reading [[Skyrim:Skill_Books|skill books]] gives you an extra skill point. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is related to this quest: * {{Achievement|Hidden Knowledge|descr=no}} == Notes == * You can change the reward at any time by traveling to Solstheim and re-reading the book. This will transport you to Apocrypha near the reward location and you can select a different one. * Companion's Insight does not apply to your mount, summoned Atronachs, or vampire followers. * Companion's Insight does not affect area effects like Fireball and Chain Lightning. == Bugs == {{Bug|You may be unable to go back to Solstheim using the activator at the end, instead receiving the message "You are unable to concentrate on what you're reading."|confirmed=1}} ** Step into the black water in Apocrypha. When you lose all your health in the game, you'll be transported out of the book. **{{Pc22}} Use the coc command to another location, (e.g., coc WindhelmDocksExterior01). **{{Pc22}} Any mods that interfere with fast travel have been known to trigger this. Disabling them may allow you to return. == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||I read the Black Book called "The Winds of Change", and found myself in Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha. I should uncover the knowledge hidden here, or read the book again to escape. {{Quest Objective|10|Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge}} |20|fin|I uncovered the hidden knowledge contained in the Black Book "The Winds of Change". }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

== Quick Walkthrough ==
# Read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Sallow Regent (book)|The Sallow Regent]]'' in [[Skyrim:White Ridge Barrow|White Ridge Barrow]].
# Travel through [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (The Sallow Regent)|Apocrypha‎]].
# Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge.
# Choose your reward.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
[[File:SR-place-Apocrypha-The Sallow Regent.jpg|thumb|The darkness inside]]
<!-- Instructions: The detailed walkthrough should provide full information about the quest, organized into paragraphs.  Spoilers belong in this section.--> <!-- Added by arcanearcher -->
After reading The Sallow Regent you will enter a considerably darker region of Apocrypha than most others. Quickly light a torch or cast a spell of Candlelight as entering the darkness will quickly drain your health. Upon entering you will encounter a small poisoned pool with a pod next to it containing a few books, some gold, and possibly a spell tome. If you are low on potions or health after the long trek through the Barrow, it is wise to avoid this pod as the tentacle will inevitably strike you. It may be possible to access it without injury using the [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] shout.

Visibility is poor in this section of Apocrypha. Fog combined with abstruse darkness makes for a haunting environment. A hovering light which you can follow in the absence of a torch or light spell will mark the way forward. After passing under a curved lamp you will find a circular pool with an amorphous eye protruding from the depths, next to another pod. Watch for the tentacle here as well, though this one is easier to access safely than the first.

Following the hovering lamp you will make a right turn at the next curved lamp and ascend a hallway leading to an open area where you will encounter two or three seekers. The fog and absence of lighting makes it difficult to ascertain their location while they are still invisible (as normally they leave a faint, black aura where they float), so be prepared for a fight as soon as you climb the ramp. With the [[Skyrim:Eagle Eye|Eagle Eye]] and [[Skyrim:Steady Hand|Steady Hand]] Archery skills it is possible to snipe them through the fog through careful observation.  The arena in front of you will be lit spontaneously by waves of light drifting through the black mist.

After dispatching the seekers return to the lamp that marks the entry way to this area. Turn to your left and move along the wall to encounter a pod containing some minor loot. Go back to the lamp and turn right, following the right hand wall until you find a two shelves set upon stone carved pillars. You will find there the speech skill book [[Skyrim:2920, Second Seed, v5|2920, Second Seed, v5]] along with the alteration spell book [[Skyrim: Detect Undead|Detect Undead]], among numerous ruined books. You may also find a few scrolls or a soul gem. Between the pillars sits another pod. Continue following the right hand wall until you come across a semi-spherical object with a large claw like formation extending forth from its top. Around the corner to the right you will find an altar containing the spell tome [[Skyrim: Conjure Seeker| Conjure Seeker]] with several soul gems amid some ruined books.

Turn east and make way toward the light hovering around two curved street lamps, above which flies a green and yellow banner. There is a pod to the left of the portal containing a few books and possibly an Atronach Forge Recipe. Pass through the lamps and up a ramp until you reach a winding path with no boundaries. Be careful here as you can easily fall off either side. The pathways that connect each pillar expand and contract with the motion of the overhead lights, so be aware of their presence or you will fall to your death. 

You will notice a Lurker shambling down the ramp one level higher, potentially coming your way. Casting a spell of Magelight towards any object in his vicinity will divert his attention. It is possible to cause the Lurker to fall off the platform by using Magelight repeatedly so that he follows the light up the ramp until he meets a pathway that is not lit. If you don't know Magelight then ranged attacks are your best bet here, as the pathways are narrow and you can easily be thrown off by the force of the Lurker's attacks. It may be possible to use [[Skyrim: Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] to shove the Lurker off the ramps as well. 

Ascending the ramps you will encounter another altar with a spell tome and one or more soul crystals. Your final encounter may be with a Lurker Guardian, so be prepared for a fight when you reach the main platform just before ascending the stairs to the end of Apocrypha. After you have defeated it, you will find to the right of ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Sallow Regent (book)|The Sallow Regent]]'' a scroll of Summon Storm Atronach and a [[Skyrim:Flame Thrall|Flame Thrall]] spell tome. To the left another you will find another altar containing several soul gems and a vessel. Read the book to exit Apocrypha and return to [[Skyrim:White Ridge Barrow|White Ridge Barrow]], thus finishing the quest.

=== Rewards ===
Your choice of one of three abilities:
* [[Skyrim:Seeker of Might|Seeker of Might]] — [[Skyrim:Combat|Combat]] skills are all 10% more effective.
* [[Skyrim:Seeker of Sorcery|Seeker of Sorcery]] — All [[Skyrim:Spells|spells]] cost 10% less [[Skyrim:Magicka|magicka]]. Enchantments are 10% more powerful.
* [[Skyrim:Seeker of Shadows|Seeker of Shadows]] — [[Skyrim:Stealth|Stealth]] skills are all 10% more effective.

===Achievements===
One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is related to this quest:
* {{Achievement|Hidden Knowledge|descr=no}}

== Notes ==
*The section of Apocrypha‎ that you land in here is perhaps one of the more difficult areas. Besides the typical dangers encountered in this realm, the environment is badly lit (pitch black in areas), and the dark areas will quickly eat away at your health. Using spells such as [[Skyrim:Candlelight|Candlelight]] or [[Skyrim:Magelight|Magelight]], or carrying a [[Skyrim:Torch|torch]] is an effective way to avoid health damage. Alternatively, you may attempt to remain in the illuminated area under the floating eye lamps, or simply sprint through the stage using potions as needed. If you enter this area already in need of healing, it would be prudent to heal yourself immediately before moving on. Damage is dealt even if you have 100% immunity to poison, 100% resistant to magic, or use the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout. 
* This section has a [[Skyrim:Seeker|Seeker]], a High Seeker, a [[Skyrim:Lurker|Lurker]], and a Lurker Vindicator. Knowing the Candlelight spell and attacking from long range and/or using sneak attacks can be particularly effective.
* You can change the reward at any time by traveling to Solstheim and re-reading the book. This will transport you to Apocrypha near the reward location and you can select a different one.
* The quest rewards apply to all skills under their respective categories.  Therefore Seeker of Might makes Smithing 10% more effective, and Seeker of Shadows makes created potions 10% more powerful.

== Bugs ==
{{Bug|Upon returning to Solstheim, the sound effect of the health drain may continue to play indefinitely, or your health might continue to deplete as if you're still in the shadows of Apocrypha.|confirmed=1}}
** Exiting to the main menu might solve this issue. If not, clearing the game cache should.
** After you exit Apocrypha, load a different save then reload the auto-save that was just made and this will stop.
** Transforming into a werewolf or a vampire lord and back will cause the sound to stop.
** This can be corrected by saving current progress in a new file, quitting to the Main Menu, then returning to the game without loss of progress.
** Reading the book again and returning to Apocrypha, and then rereading it to return to Solstheim solved the problem as well.
** Another way to fix this is leaving Apocrypha by committing suicide rather than using the books to escape as dying in Apocrypha teleports you back to Nirn.
{{Bug|Upon returning to Solstheim, a second copy of The Sallow Regent may appear in your inventory and both copies become unreadable.|confirmed=1}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Hidden Twilight (book)|The Hidden Twilight]]'' in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]].
# Make your way through [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (The Hidden Twilight)|Apocrypha‎]].
# Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge.
# Choose your reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
There are eight chapters/zones here, so be prepared for a trek. You'll materialize in a room with a platform and two fonts of magicka. A scrye is past the platform, straight ahead. Activate the scrye and the door behind it will open, revealing a book on a pedestal: the next chapter. Before going in, search behind and below the pedestal to find a pod containing loot.

Chapter II starts out as a corridor twisting past fonts of magicka built into the walls of books. When the path opens up, beware two [[Skyrim:Seeker|seekers]] wandering the room ahead. Dispose of them and grab the [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gem]] on an altar, then head east where a ramp leads up. At the end of the ramp is another scrye. Upon activating the scrye, the bridge below you will curve upwards and peak before receding again and will repeat this cycle indefinitely. The goal is to sprint to the edge of the bridge as it reaches its peak before leaping to the next ledge before it begins its descent. The timing is delicate but if you fall you will land on a grated path that will lead you back up to where you were before. There are two such bridges before reaching the other side. 

When you reach solid ground there will be two paths forward. The passage to the left leads to a dead end containing a Font of Stamina near a pod. Just beside there is an altar with at two soul gems. If your [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] skill is above 40 a [[Skyrim:Conjure Seeker|Conjure Seeker]] spell tome will be present as well. Head back to the top of the ramp and travel down the right hand passage to find the portal to Chapter III.

Chapter III begins at the base of a book pillar. You can go either way but by taking the left route you can temporarily evade the nearby Seeker. Hugging the left wall will bring you to a Font of Stamina along the southeast edge of the book barricade just before the opening into the main chamber. Turn left and round the corner to find a pod in an alcove with some minor loot. Exit the alcove and turn west. Do not try to head for the platform yet as the stairs have to be released by activating the scrye situated above where you stand presently. Face west and turn right. Just outside the entry arch there is a ramp. Climb the ramp until you reach the roof of the entryway where you will find the scrye at the edge of the lattice beneath a floating lantern. Activate it and descend the ramp back down towards the main path. 

Dispatch the Seeker as you cross the abyssal waters. Take care as tentacles will lash at you as you cross. There are three soul gems on the platform along the way to the other side.

When you reach the end of the crossing you will find an enclosure with a set of stairs directly to the left of a font of stamina. Dispatch the [[Skyrim:Lurker|lurker]] and walk past the font of stamina and up the stairs through the arch facing directly south. From there you can climb a ramp that leads to the scyre which opens the gates to the enclosure. Before moving to the next area, take a right at the bottom of the stairs when you come back down the ramp. You should see two curved tendril-shaped lamps. Pass between them, take a sharp left and then turn south again. You should notice another font of stamina inside a book crevice. Walk towards it and you will find the gate to chapter IV. There is a seeker on the other side so be ready for a fight. 

Chapter IV consists of only one small room with nothing but the seeker and a scrye. Activating it opens a gate in chapter V that provides access to a set of five [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill books]], one for each school of [[Skyrim:Magic|magic]]. 
 
Go back to Chapter III and retrace your steps to the gate you opened before entering Chapter IV. The next gate can be opened by a scrye up the ramp to the south-southwest. A seeker is in the maze-like section ahead, so kill it and go east. There is what looks like a dead end up ahead, but as you approach the rest of the corridor telescopically expands outward. There is a pod on the north side just before the newly-visible section of corridor. At the end are Chapter V and Chapter VI.

[[File:SR-quest-Black Book The Hidden Twilight 02.jpg|thumb|right|Choose your new power.]]
Entering chapter V lands you in front of another seeker. Defeat it and activate the scrye which opens a gate in the northwest corner of the chamber. There you will find ''[[Skyrim:A Hypothetical Treachery|A Hypothetical Treachery]]'', ''[[Skyrim:Racial Phylogeny|Racial Phylogeny]]'', ''[[Skyrim:Breathing Water|Breathing Water]]'', ''[[Skyrim:Before the Ages of Man|Before the Ages of Man]]'', and ''[[Skyrim:2920, Hearth Fire, v9|2920 Hearth Fire v9]]'' resting on an altar next to a pod. Return to Chapter III, turn right, and enter Chapter VI. This area is very small, but leads to both Chapter VII and Chapter VIII. Enter Chapter VII, kill the seeker, and activate yet another scrye to raise a bridge in Chapter VIII. Return to Chapter VI, turn to your left, and enter Chapter VIII. 

Upon arrival you will be ambushed by another seeker. Just before you reach the bridge, take a left to find another altar with a few soul gems. Loot the area and return to the crossing. Make preparations here as a lurker will burst from a pool on the left side of the platform opposite where you are standing as you cross the bridge. Depending on your current level, a second lurker may appear from the right pool as well.

Crossing one last bridge lands you at ''The Hidden Twilight'', your final destination. Other loot is scattered around the same area, including a vessel, four soul gems (two black and two grand), and three scrolls (a [[Skyrim:Scroll of Ebonyflesh|Scroll of Ebonyflesh]], a [[Skyrim:Scroll of Grand Healing|Scroll of Grand Healing]], and a [[Skyrim:Scroll of Paralyze|Scroll of Paralyze]]). Upon opening the book, three green orbs will appear in front of you, one for each [[#Reward|reward]]. Choose one, then activate the open book to travel back to Tel Mithryn.

If at a later time you want to change your reward, reread the book and you will be transported to this location again. You will not have to trek through the previous chapters.

===Reward===
Your choice of one of three [[Skyrim:Powers#Greater Powers|greater powers]]:
* [[Skyrim:Mora's Agony|Mora's Agony]] — Summons a field of writhing tentacles that poisons foes.
* [[Skyrim:Mora's Grasp|Mora's Grasp]] — Freezes the target between Oblivion and Tamriel for 30 seconds, making them immune to all damage.
* [[Skyrim:Mora's Boon|Mora's Boon]] — Fully restores your [[Skyrim:Health|health]], [[Skyrim:Magicka|magicka]], and [[Skyrim:Stamina|stamina]].

* {{Achievement|Hidden Knowledge|descr=no}}

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
Asking [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] if you can aid him in his research may have him make a more personal request. He will explain his fascination with the staffs of [[Lore:Azra Nightwielder|Azra Nightwielder]], the original Shadowmage, and will reveal that he has located one such staff in a random dungeon. The location is [[Skyrim:Radiant|radiant]], and can include dungeons both on [[Skyrim:Dragonborn Places|Solstheim]] and in [[Skyrim:Skyrim (place)|Skyrim]]. Skyrim is far more likely, as there are considerably more potential locations there. Retrieve the staff from the specified dungeon and return it to Neloth. He will reward you with a random generic staff from his own collection.

*Azra's Staff of Vanquishment

*Azra's Grand Staff of Turning

* The quest can be done multiple times. At lower levels, it is one of the only side quests you will get from Neloth.
* The location of the staff will be a [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Bandit_Camps|bandit camp]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Dragon Lairs|dragon lair]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Dragon Priest Lairs|dragon priest lair]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Draugr Crypts|draugr crypt]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Falmer Hives|Falmer hive]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Forsworn Camps|Forsworn camp]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Hagraven Nests|hagraven nest]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Vampire Lairs|vampire lair]], or [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Warlock Lairs|warlock lair]]; only locations which have a boss container will be chosen.

Continue building your home to your liking. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-place-Lakeview Manor 15.jpg|thumb|right|Laying the foundations]] Once you've obtained the favor of the Jarl of [[Skyrim:Falkreath Hold|Falkreath Hold]], [[Skyrim:Hjaalmarch|Hjaalmarch]], or [[Skyrim:The Pale|the Pale]], usually by doing quests for them, you will be given the right to purchase a piece of land in the hold. In Morthal and Falkreath, you will need to see the steward about obtaining permission; in Dawnstar, it is the jarl who grants permission. After receiving permission, you may purchase the land from the relevant steward for 5,000 gold. The plot will then be marked on your map. Upon arriving at your new property, you will be instructed to use the [[Skyrim:Drafting Table|drafting table]] to begin building your house. Your only option will be the [[Skyrim:Small House Layout|Small House Layout]]. After selecting the plans, you will be instructed to use the [[Skyrim:Carpenter's Workbench|carpenter's workbench]] to build the foundation of your house and, if this is your purchased land, a misc objective to buy lumber will appear in your journal. It directs you to [[Skyrim:Hert|Hert]] but it can be completed by speaking to any lumberjack. To start off the building you need one [[Skyrim:Sawn Log|sawn log]] and ten [[Skyrim:Quarried Stone|quarried stone]] for the foundations. There will be a [[SR:Stone Quarry|stone quarry]] somewhere on the site, so you won't need to go far to find some. Having done this, the quest concludes. However, there are many more construction and furnishing options to choose from. See the [[Skyrim:Construction|construction article]] for more information. ==Achievements== Two [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievements]] are unlocked while completing the three versions of this quest: * {{achievement|Landowner}} * {{achievement|Land Baron}} ==Notes== * If you reach level 9, and have not yet started the quest, one of the jarls will send you a letter by courier. If you're friends with the jarl of Falkreath or Hjaalmarch, the steward will send you [[Skyrim:Letter from Steward (Steward name) of (hold name)|this letter]]; for the Pale, it will instead be [[Skyrim:Letter from Jarl (Jarl's Name)|this letter]], straight from the jarl. If you haven't made friends with any of them yet, [[Skyrim:Letter from Jarl (Jarl's Name) of (Jarl's City)|this letter]] will be sent to you from the current Jarl of Falkreath. Regardless of who sends which letter, reading it will give you the objective to speak to the jarl and advance the quest. * If not yet friends with any jarl, and [[Skyrim:Rare Gifts|Rare Gifts]] is still in your journal when the courier sets out to find you, it will be failed and removed from your journal in favor of this quest. * It is advisable to purchase the land for [[Skyrim:Lakeview Manor|Lakeview Manor]] in Falkreath hold before completing [[Skyrim:Contract: Kill Helvard|Contract: Kill Helvard]], as you may not be able to regain Siddgeir's favor afterwards. ** {{Pc22}} If you use the console, you can click on Siddgeir and use setrelationshiprank player 2 to fix this. ** Alternatively if you side with the Stormcloaks and take Falkreath, [[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]] replaces Siddgeir as the Jarl, bypassing this issue. * If Hert is dead, the misc quest doesn't fail but will have no marker and can be completed by speaking to any other lumberjack as normal. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Once you are eligible to start this quest in one of the other two holds by having befriended their jarl, Siddgeir possibly may not offer Rare Gifts or [[Skyrim:Kill the Bandit Leader (Jarl)|Kill the Bandit Leader]], which will make the house unavailable in Falkreath.|confirmed=1|dlc=HF}} ** {{Pc22}} Once you are level 9 or above and are certain that the courier isn't coming, enter Siddgeir's Longhouse and then use the following console commands.
