Loot the Champion's body to complete the quest. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Become a Champion=== [[File:SR-quest-Battle of the Champions 02.jpg|thumb|right|You may have to take out the competition...]] '''Note: This stage of the quest is only available if you install the [[Skyrim:Civil War Champions|Civil War Champions]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]] on a character that has not yet sided with the [[SR:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] or the [[SR:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]].''' Go to [[Skyrim:The Drunken Huntsman|The Drunken Huntsman]] in [[SR:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. On the counter inside, you will find a note called ''[[SR:Battle of Champions|Battle of Champions]]'', which describes an upcoming battle between the Legion and the Stormcloaks in the ongoing [[SR:Civil War|Civil War]]. Both sides intend to nominate a Champion, but nobody has been chosen as of yet. If you wish to side with the Legion, you must journey to [[SR:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] in [[SR:Solitude|Solitude]] to speak with [[SR:Legate Adventus Caesennius|Legate Adventus Caesennius]]. You can wear 3 imperial pieces(armor, boot and bracer, referring details to [[SR:Steel|Steel]]) to pose as an imperial soldier, if don't, you will have to pass a [[SR:Speech#Average|Persuasion check (Speech 50)]] to convince him to let you act as the Legion Champion. If your [[SR:Speech|Speech]] skill is not particularly high, it would be wise to bring a [[SR:Fortify Persuasion|Fortify Persuasion]] potion with you. Once you persuade him, you will be handed the [[SR:Imperial Armory Key|Imperial Armory Key]] to unlock a chest in the nearby equipment room. If you instead wish to fight for the Stormcloaks, you must bring five [[SR:Snow Bear Pelt|snow bear pelt]]s to [[SR:Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced|Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced]] in the [[SR:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]] in [[SR:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. These can be taken from [[SR:Snow Bear|snow bear]]s or purchased from hunters and general goods merchants starting at level 10, although at low levels you may have difficulty with this task. Luckily there is an alternative and more underhanded approach: the note mentions a prospective Champion named [[SR:Klija Wolf-Claw|Klija Wolf-Claw]] who wishes to fight for the Stormcloaks. She has already gathered the pelts and can be found at the small settlement of [[SR:Kynesgrove|Kynesgrove]] just south of Windhelm. She can be found at all hours at the [[Skyrim:Steamscorch_Mine|Steamscorch Mine]] Camp and carries an item named [[SR:Klija's Snow Bear Pelts|Klija's Snow Bear Pelts]] on her person. It can be a challenge to [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|pickpocket]] the item from her, but be warned that killing her counts as murder and will land you with a significant [[Skyrim:Crime#Bounties|bounty]] if you are caught. Whichever way you go about obtaining enough pelts, speak with Yrsarald to receive the [[SR:Storm-Bear Chest Key|Storm-Bear Chest Key]] unlocking a chest in the Palace's war room. ===Answer the Call=== '''Note: This stage of the quest is only available if you install the Creation on a character which has already joined the Legion or the Stormcloaks.''' If you're already a member of the Legion or the Stormcloaks, you will receive a letter by [[SR:Courier|courier]] {{vn|section=Letter from the Empire / Stormcloaks when?}} from your commanding officer, advising you that a challenge has been issued by the Stormcloaks and requesting your assistance in dealing with it. If you are a member of the Legion, you will receive a ''[[SR:Letter from the Empire|Letter from the Empire]]'' requesting that you speak with Legate Adventus Caesennius in Castle Dour to receive your custom forged equipment for this task. If you are a Stormcloak, you will instead receive a ''[[SR:Letter from the Stormcloaks|Letter from the Stormcloaks]]'' asking you to meet with Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced in the Palace of the Kings. Meet with your commanding officer to receive a key to a nearby chest. ===Prepare for Battle=== [[File:SR-quest-Battle of the Champions 03.jpg|thumb|right|Approach your fellow Champion]] Whichever path you take, once you are named Champion you will need to unlock the relevant chest and loot every item within. The quest will not progress unless you take everything, so be sure to pick up both weapons even if you only mean to use one. The chest also contains the [[SR:Map of Battle Location|Map of Battle Location]], which can be examined in your inventory if you wish. The quest marker will direct you to the battle location in any case, a clearing on the plains of [[SR:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun Hold]] directly west of [[SR:Shimmermist Cave|Shimmermist Cave]]. When you arrive, you will find five soldiers from both sides facing off against each other, with the other Champion patiently waiting for you in the center. If you side with the Legion, the Champion will be Klija Wolf-Claw if you didn't steal her pelts, but if you stole her pelts you will face a generic [[SR:Stormcloak Champion|Stormcloak Champion]] instead. If you side with the Stormcloaks you will face a generic [[SR:Imperial Champion|Imperial Champion]]. Speak with the other Champion to begin the battle. You will need to slaughter all enemy combatants and loot the fallen Champion for their gear in order to complete the quest. You may have issues with [[Skyrim:Encumbrance|encumbrance]] at this stage if you intend to bring all this equipment away with you. Both sets of items are extremely powerful and make for a worthy reward. After the completion of the quest, you will receive a ''Letter of Commendation'' (either the [[SR:Letter of Commendation (Imperial Legion)|Legion version]] or [[SR:Letter of Commendation (Stormcloak)|Stormcloak version]]) via courier from your commanding officer to congratulate you on your victory. ==Notes== *If you install Civil War Champions on a character who has already chosen a side in the Civil War, Klija Wolf-Claw will not appear at Kynesgrove. *If you decide to steal Klija's pelts but side with the Legion anyway, you will face a generic [[SR:Stormcloak Champion|Stormcloak Champion]] at the battle. * If over-encumberance occurs from taking the gear of both factions it would be helpful to have either Arvak or the Daedric horse to summon, mount and fast-travel away. * [[Skyrim:Bits and Pieces|Bits and Pieces]] has a snow bear pelt on display that respawns every 10 days, making it easy to obtain the powerful Storm-Bear set even at level 1. * Whichever side you choose, surviving soldiers will make their way to the inn in the capital and remain for a short time before you receive Letter of Commendation, Imperial soldiers to [[SR:The_Winking_Skeever|The Winking Skeever]], Stormcloak soldiers to [[SR:Candlehearth Hall|Candlehearth Hall]]. ==Bugs== {{bug|Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced will not actually take the five snow bear pelts from you if you choose to go that route.|OSSEP|1.6}} {{bug|If Klija Wolf-Claw appears at Kynesgrove and you side with the Legion, two versions of her will exist at once. Killing her at the battle site will not disable the version at Kynesgrove.}} {{bug|After the associated armor is picked up, the game may crash.|OSSEP|1.6.1130}} {{bug|After the AE update patch, completing this quest can cause the following with great frequency: graphics issues, loading screens that fail to end, and crashes. Reloading a save before the battle portion of this quest can fix this, but completing the quest will cause it to happen again.|confirmed=1}} **This bug may be fixed by storing the armor somewhere (i.e. a chest or display). You will then learn the location of their leaders. #Track down both [[SR:Kinthal|Kinthal]] and [[SR:Svarig|Svarig]] to their respective camps, kill them, and read their journals to begin the mission [[SR:Restoring Order|Restoring Order]]. #Return to Ri'saad for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Balance of Power 02.jpg|thumb|right|There are a total of four bandit camps to track down]] To begin the quest, locate the Khajiit trader [[SR:Ri'saad|Ri'saad]]. He and his caravan often travel through Skyrim, but will stop for several days outside major cities such as Whiterun or Markarth. Upon locating him, you will have a new dialogue option to ask about the trouble his caravan has been running into. Wishing to remain discreet, he will give you [[SR:Ri'saad's Note on Bandit Attacks|a note]], which explains the situation. As the note states, recently his caravan has been beset by strange new bandits at two locations: one near [[SR:North Brittleshin Pass|North Brittleshin Pass]] and another near [[SR:Fort Kastav|Fort Kastav]]. The only other information he can provide is that one group wears gleaming golden armor while the other wears dark armor. Tracking down the two camps, you will find each location containing 3-4 bandits and a cage. Each group's leader will have a journal indicating the location of the leader of their respective gang, along with a [[Skyrim:Saints Bandit's Cage Key|key]] to the camp's cage. Inside each cage is an [[SR:Elytra Nymph|Elytra Nymph]] that you can talk to and obtain as a pet. Obtaining both pets will complete their respective miscellaneous quests. At the first Saints bandit camp, be sure to loot and read the ''[[Skyrim:Notes on the Blacksmith|Notes on the Blacksmith]]'' off the corpse of the [[Skyrim:Saints Bandit Leader|Saints Bandit Leader]] to begin a quest to unlock [[Skyrim:Golden|Golden]] and [[Skyrim:Dark|Dark]] smithing. At the first Seducers bandit camp is a knapsack containing the ''[[SR:Bandit's Note on Hidden Treasure|Bandit's Note on Hidden Treasure]]''; reading it will start the [[Skyrim:Nerveshatter (quest)|miscellaneous quest]] to unlock a [[Skyrim:Nerveshatter|Daedric artifact]]. Using the information from the bandit leader journals, locate and kill the true gang leaders: [[SR:Kinthal|Kinthal]] for the Saints and [[SR:Svarig|Svarig]] for the Seducers. Be sure to loot the two unique soul gems at the altar where Kinthal is located. Combining the information from both journals will explain that the bandit gangs were funded by a wizard named [[Skyrim:Thoron|Thoron]], and that he seems to be hiding out in the sewers beneath Solitude. Reading either of the leader's journals will start the next quest, [[SR:Restoring Order|Restoring Order]], although you must read both journals to discover Thoron's exact location. With this information in hand, return to Ri'saad and let him know the two groups are no longer a danger. He will thank you and reward you with 300 gold, thus completing the quest. ==Notes== *The camp near Fort Kastav is next to the soldiers that will aid during [[Skyrim:Rescue from Fort Kastav|Rescue from Fort Kastav]]. They will aid in the fight and start this quest if not already obtained. *After you've killed Kinthal or Svarig (or both), you may be randomly attacked by bandits from either group, or both at the same time. One of the bandits will have a note from Thoron commanding them to kill you as revenge for their leader's death. *With [[Skyrim:Sunder & Wraithguard|Sunder & Wraithguard]]{{CC}} also installed, a destroyed caravan loaded with Dwemer artifacts will appear right next to Svarig's camp whether you have started that creation's [[Skyrim:Legends Lost|main quest]] or not. Reading the [[Skyrim:Carriage Driver's Note|Carriage Driver's Note]], which is found among the wreckage, will start that quest with the first stages skipped. * This quest can also be triggered when stumbling upon a Seducer's camp by accident. * If you trigger this quest without speaking to Ri'Saad first, you may have to find him (along the road between Whiterun and Markarth) and speak to him for the quest to complete. In some cases, you must do this in order to be able to continue the next quest, Restoring Order. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After defeating Svarig, the quest to defeat him will not show as completed.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After defeating the Saints bandit leader in Whiterun, the objective to defeat them may not be marked as completed.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After defeating Kinthal, the quest to defeat him will not show as completed.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After reading both journals, the next quest, Restoring Order, does not appear.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|When one of the leaders is killed before getting the quest from Ri'saad, the quest will start without pointing to the other leader. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Read ''[[SR:Letter to Clexius|Letter to Clexius]]'' at [[SR:The Bee and Barb|the Bee and Barb]].
#Enter [[SR:Gromm's Pass|Gromm's Pass]] and kill the [[SR:Blue God|Blue God]].
#Read his [[SR:Blue God's Journal|journal]] and free [[SR:Gogh|Gogh]] from the fighting pit.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Creatures from the South===
Upon installing the [[Skyrim:Goblins|Goblins]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]], you can go to [[SR:The Bee and Barb|the Bee and Barb]] in [[SR:Riften|Riften]], where in a room upstairs you will find a ''[[SR:Letter to Clexius|Letter to Clexius]]''. This piece of personal correspondence describes a tribe of Cyrodilic [[SR:Goblin|Goblin]]s who have invaded a cave known as [[SR:Gromm's Pass|Gromm's Pass]]. By all accounts, they seem to be led by the "Blue God", an aspect of [[Skyrim:Malacath|Malacath]] worshipped by Goblins. You'll have to head there to investigate.

===Cave Crawling===
[[File:SR-quest-Blue in the Face.jpg|A Goblin heretic fighting back|thumb|right]]
Gromm's Pass is a new cave added by this Creation. The entrance can be found in the valley directly south of [[SR:Forelhost|Forelhost]]. It is notable for being filled with hostile Goblins as well as a unique type of mushroom called [[SR:Steel-Blue Entoloma‎‎|Steel-Blue Entoloma‎‎]]. This plant is added by the Creation and cannot be found elsewhere, although it can be grown in [[SR:Fertile Soil|Fertile Soil]] so it would be advisable to harvest a few samples while you're there. While exploring the cave, you will soon come across the body of [[SR:Avanessa Calladius|Avanessa Calladius]], the mage whose letter you found. On her corpse you will find a copy of ''[[SR:The Posting of the Hunt|The Posting of the Hunt]]'', a book which describes the legendary [[SR:Spear of Bitter Mercy|Spear of Bitter Mercy]]. The relevance of this will soon become apparent, once you set foot inside the cave's central chamber where a Goblin wielding this legendary Spear is currently battling for his life inside an enclosed fighting pit.

You likely won't have time to watch the fight, as the chamber also serves as a throne room for the [[SR:Blue God|Blue God]]. Kill him and his Goblin minions in order to loot the powerful [[SR:Goblin Totem Staff|Goblin Totem Staff]] from his corpse. You will also have to read his [[SR:Blue God's Journal|journal]], which reveals that this supposed manifestation of the Blue God was actually just a hapless tribal [[SR:Orc|Orc]] who covered himself in Steel-Blue Entoloma‎‎ paste to trick the invading Goblins into following him. Unfortunately, the underground passage to Cyrodiil has since collapsed.

===A Grateful Goblin===
Once you've had a chance to read the journal, you will be directed to free the surviving Goblin in the fighting pit, where he was thrown after figuring out the Orc's trickery. His name is [[SR:Gogh|Gogh]], and he will be more than happy to join you as a [[SR:Followers|follower]] for saving him from the pit. He acts similarly to the [[Skyrim:Riekling Warrior|Riekling Warrior]] follower from [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] and can be spoken to at length despite his rather lacking vocabulary. You have the option to change his outfit visually, but you cannot take the Spear of Bitter Mercy. It is left unclear as to why exactly a Goblin is in possession of a powerful Daedric artifact, but he will use it to great effect as a follower, using it to perform attacks and summon [[SR:Storm Atronach|storm atronach]]s.

Gogh cannot be commanded to stay at any of your [[SR:Houses|houses]]. If he leaves your service, he will return to the throne area in Gromm's Pass.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|The ''Letter to Clexius'' frequently falls through the top of the shelf below, making it difficult to find. The letter will also be permanently inaccessible when it falls through the shelf, no shouts or use of Telekinesis will get it out.|confirmed=1}}
**You can circumvent this step by going straight to Gromm's Pass, which is just south of Forelhost.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Read [[Skyrim:Verrick's Note|Verrick's Note]]. The note is located in the green room inside the Guardian Vault, on a table to the left of the torture devices.
# Go to [[Skyrim:Faldar's Tooth|Faldar's Tooth]], and find a note on one of the bodies after the fight there.
# Read [[Skyrim:Cage Bandit's Note|Cage Bandit's Note]].
# Go to [[Skyrim:Broken Fang Cave|Broken Fang Cave]], defeat the denizens there and find the sword [[Skyrim:Bloodthirst|Bloodthirst]] among the loot there.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Halfway through [[Skyrim:The_Guardian_Vault|The Guardian Vault]] during the  [[Skyrim:A_Soul_Divided|Dawnfang/Duskfang Quest]], in the green room on a table to the left of the torture devices, there is a note with a dagger through it. On reading  [[Skyrim:Verrick's Note|Verrick's Note]], a miscellaneous side quest is added, 'Investigate Faldar's Tooth.' Leave the Ratway and travel there.

Arriving at [[Skyrim:Faldar's_Tooth|Faldar's Tooth]], there is a bandit labeled 'Bouncer' and 2 pit wolves outside. As you enter, there is another bandit labeled 'Bouncer' immediately inside. Straight ahead through the narrow passageway, turn right into the main room. You come out on a wooden deck, with barrels and sacks to your left, and stairs down to your right. The room has a cage in the middle, with 2 fighting wolves inside. There are 2 gamblers and a barkeep who will all become hostile to you as you enter. As the fighting starts, a leveled bandit labeled 'the butcher' will come out from the back room. This enemy has strong leveled gear, so be careful. Along the wall, there is a gambler cage, which has inside gold, many coin purses, skooma, a healing potion, a leveled chest, and the [[Skyrim:Cage_Bandit's_Note|Cage Bandit's Note]], giving you a new miscellaneous objective to 'Retrieve [[Skyrim:Bloodthirst|Bloodthirst]] from [[Skyrim:Broken_Fang_Cave|Broken Fang Cave]]'.

As you get to [[Skyrim:Broken_Fang_Cave|Broken Fang Cave]], you will enter into a small corridor, with a staircase leading down into a large room. There are many raised platforms with empty crypts along the walls, and a cafe and chains hanging from the ceiling. As you walk down, there is a [[Skyrim:Vampire|Vampire]] sitting in the room who will attack. If you have [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]] installed, this may be a [[Skyrim:Volkihar_Vampire_Clan|Volkihar Vampire]]. There are 3 [[Skyrim:skeleton|skeletons]] to the left of the room who will join the attack. Once you deal with the enemies, you can continue forward through the room. There is an adept-locked chest in the southeast corner.

From here, the western raised platform has a doorway leading to a narrow walkway. You come out into a nicer looking small room with a high leveled Vampire. The room has an [[Skyrim:Alchemy_Labs|alchemy lab]] to the right, a  [[Skyrim:Bandit_(dead)|dead bandit]] and a cage in front of you, a large table with platters along the wall to your left, and a small table with 3 chairs in the middle. As you walk in you'll see 2 beds to the side, an [[Skyrim:Arcane_Enchanters|enchanter]] in an alcove next to the cage, and a double bed with a bookshelf to the right of it and a boss chest on its left. This chest contains [[Skyrim:Bloodthirst|Bloodthirst]] and some leveled loot. As you collect Bloodthirst the objective will complete, and you're free to leave back the way you came in.

Kill [[Skyrim:Crowstooth|Crowstooth]]. #Search the tower and find the body of [[Skyrim:Bjormund Wind-Strider|Bjormund Wind-Strider]]. #''(Optional)'' Read ''[[Skyrim:Bjormund's Diary|Bjormund's Diary]]''. #Take Bjormund's [[Skyrim:Dragonbone Mail|Dragonbone Mail]] and other [[Skyrim:Dragon_Items#Dragonplate_Insulated|Dragonplate Insulated]] armor pieces to complete the quest. ==Detailed Walkthrough== To begin this quest, speak to an innkeeper for work and receive the ''[[Skyrim:Bounty for Crowstooth|Bounty for Crowstooth]]''. This bounty states that [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] raiding parties have been pushing further and further east, along the Jerall Mountains. It also states that Crowstooth has been separated from her forces, and that she is believed to have fled with considerable spoils. In an effort to put an end to this threat, anyone killing Crowstooth may claim her stolen loot. Head to [[Skyrim:Crowstooth's Camp|Crowstooth's Camp]], south of [[Skyrim:Largashbur|Largashbur]]. Here you will have to fight two Forsworn, a witch and [[Skyrim:Linelle|Linelle]], a hagraven. Search Linelle's body to find her [[Skyrim:Linelle's Note|note]], which reveals that Crowstooth has headed to [[Skyrim:Arcwind Point|Arcwind Point]]. Travel to Arcwind Point, and head up to the tower, where you will have to fight Forsworn. Inside the tower on the ground floor is [[Skyrim:Alvasorr the Rat|Alvasorr the Rat]], a Namira-worshipping Khajiit. Loot Alvasorr after defeating him for the [[Skyrim:Dismal Visage|Dismal Visage]] and [[Skyrim:Namira's Itch|Namira's Itch]]. At the upper part of the tower is Crowstooth, who wields [[Skyrim:Tyrant's Bane|Tyrant's Bane]]. After killing her, go to the very top of the tower to find the body of [[Skyrim:Bjormund Wind-Strider|Bjormund Wind-Strider]] who wears the [[Skyrim:Dragonbone Mail|Dragonbone Mail]], [[Skyrim:Dragonplate Insulated Boots|Dragonplate Insulated Boots]], [[Skyrim:Dragonplate Insulated Gauntlets|Dragonplate Insulated Gauntlets]] and a [[Skyrim:Dragonplate Insulated Helmet|Dragonplate Insulated Helmet]]. He also has [[Skyrim:Nord Mead|Nord Mead]], an [[Skyrim:Amulet of Akatosh|Amulet of Akatosh]], a random selection of loot, and ''[[Skyrim:Bjormund's Diary|Bjormund's Diary]]'', which recounts the origin of the dragon bone armor. An additional item can be found within [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] in Solitude. ''[[Skyrim:Guard's Dossier: Bjormund Wind-Strider|Guard's Dossier: Bjormund Wind-Strider]]'' is on a table in a side room off of the War Room. ==Notes== *An easy way to reach [[Skyrim:Crowstooth's Camp|Crowstooth's Camp]] is to travel through [[Skyrim:Darklight Tower|Darklight Tower]]. After making it to the tower apex, pull the lever and head right over to the camp. *The [[Skyrim:Dragonbone Mail|Dragonbone Mail]] found in this quest has 100% fire resistance. It is impossible to induce this perk onto a torso piece via enchanting. This is no accident, though. [[Skyrim:Bjormund's Diary|According to Nordic legends]], the original Bjormund, who wore a dragonbone cuirass, strode through fire as if it was wind. *Crowstooth may detect you before you reach the tower and descend to attack you. She can join forces with the high-level draugr at the top of the stairs, making for a difficult fight. ==Bugs== {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Bjormund Wind-Strider|Bjormund Wind-Strider]]'s body might not be found atop the tower. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Travel to Bronze Water Cave.
#Read the fisherman's journal.
#Find the Dwarven fishing rod schematic in Alftand Ruined Tower.
#Bring the Dwarven fishing rod schematic to Calcelmo.
#Use the dwarven fishing rod to catch two aetherium dynamo cores near Bronze Water Cave.
#Insert the aetherium dynamo cores into the dynamo actuators.
==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Beneath Bronze Waters 02.jpg|right|thumb|The schematics]]
This quest can be started after [[Skyrim:The Ultimate Feast|The Ultimate Feast]] has been completed by talking to Viriya:
:'''Know of anyone in need of fishing work around Skyrim?'''
:''"Of course. It's all in this note."''

She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Bounty: Dwarven Investigation|bounty]] that asks you to investigate the outside of Bronze Water Cave. As you arrive at the cave, you will have to pick up and read the [[Skyrim:Fisherman's Journal (Fishing)|journal]] that is on a plank of wood. The journal mentions a fishing rod of Dwarven make that might be found in [[Skyrim:Alftand Ruined Tower|Alftand Ruined Tower]].

Travel to Alftand Ruined Tower and after a short while inside you will find the dead body of [[Skyrim:Jorid|Jorid]], the fisherman mentioned in the journal. Press the button on the desk near the body, but be careful as it will activate flamethrowers ahead of you while opening the door. 

Head through the now open door, but be wary of the pressure plates on the floor as they will activate spears. You will find the [[Skyrim:Fishing Items#Miscellaneous Items|Dwarven Fishing Rod Schematic]] on a desk. Once obtained you will need to take the schematics to Calcelmo and speak to him:
:'''I investigated Bronze Water Cave and discovered a dormant Dwarven mechanism.'''
:''"Yes..."''
:'''Fishermen saw glowing objects that may activate it, but couldn't retrieve them.'''
:''"Hmmm... No, that's probably not of any use."''
:'''They believed using a Dwarven fishing rod might help. Here are the schematics.'''
:''"Ah, yes! There it is! Thank you so much."''
:'''In exchange for the schematic, could you build a Dwarven fishing rod for me?'''
:''"Of course."''

You will then need to wait 24 hours and return to Calcelmo:
:'''I've returned. Is the Dwarven fishing rod complete?'''
:''"I've been holding onto this for you. Here! I hope you like it."''
:'''Consider the bounty paid in full. I'll try using this near Bronze Water Cave.'''
:''"Oh, now, do be careful..."''

At this point you will not only acquire a [[Skyrim:Dwarven Fishing Rod|Dwarven Fishing Rod]] but unlock the ability to create Dwarven Fishing Rods yourself, just in case you misplace the first one.
[[File:SR-quest-Beneath Bronze Waters 03.jpg|right|thumb|The chest rises.]]
Head back to Bronze Water Cave where you will have to fish in two spots for the [[Skyrim:Fishing Items#Miscellaneous Items|Aetherium Dynamo Cores]]. Once you have fished them up, place them into the dynamo actuators. This will cause a chest to rise from the water, but will also activate some dwarven spider workers by the cave entrance. Once the dwarven spider workers have been dealt with, open the chest to find the pair of enchanted axes [[Skyrim:Irkngthand War Axe of Fire|Irkngthand War Axe of Fire]] and [[Skyrim:Irkngthand War Axe of Freezing|Irkngthand War Axe of Freezing]], as well as other typical random chest treasure.

It will also unlock the ability to craft the [[Skyrim:Irkngthand War Axe|Irkngthand War Axe]], a slightly superior brand of one-handed Dwarven War Axe, which appears to be basically as strong as a Glass War Axe but only requires the Dwarven Smithing perk. This is the base item of which you just received the two enchanted examples.

They will hand you a [[Skyrim:Letter from Shogarz gra-Batul|letter]] that explains that remnants of a group of bandits called the Greencap Bandits have stolen the Headman's Cleaver of the {{Lore Link|Bloodfall Kingdom}}. The Bloodfall Queen wants vengeance and will grant the Headman's Cleaver to whoever eliminates the Greencap Bandits. Once you have read the letter, travel to [[Skyrim:Lost Knife Hideout|Lost Knife Hideout]]. There are two parts to the cave system - Lost Knife Cave and Lost Knife Hideout. In Lost Knife Cave, there will be several Greencap Bandits you will have to fight to find the entrance to Lost Knife Hideout. You will have to defeat more Greencap Bandits inside, until you reach the area with cages. This is where the thief, known as the 'Darkwater Snake', will be located, as well as several Greencap Bandits. Defeat the Darkwater Snake and loot his body for the stolen cleaver, as well as a full set of unenchanted Orcish armor. [[Skyrim:Shogarz gro-Batul|Shogarz gro-Batul's]] dead body will be lying in another cage, and looting him will give you [[Skyrim:Shogarz's Journal|Shogarz's Journal]]. [[Skyrim:Urzog's Journal|Urzog's Journal]] will also be sitting on one of the tables. == Bugs == {{Bug|It is possible that the [[Skyrim:Letter from Shogarz gra-Batul|letter]] from Shogarz doesn't appear in your inventory after getting the quest. ==Detailed Walkthrough==
You can begin this quest by going into the [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach#Dragonsreach_Dungeon|Dragonsreach Dungeon]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. On a table just within the jail area find a journal called ''[[Skyrim:Death of a Crimson Dirk|Death of a Crimson Dirk]]''. Following the directions given in the journal, travel to [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]] in search of the grave of Edward. Your search can be slightly accelerated by looking for the dug up grave with a dead Khajiit nearby. Retrieve the ''[[Skyrim:Khajiit's Note|Khajiit's Note]]'' from his corpse to determine your next destination, [[Skyrim:Knifepoint Ridge|Knifepoint Ridge]]. The local bandits of the exterior camp will be hostile to you, and will protect your final target for this quest, the "bounty hunter" figure wearing the [[Skyrim:Daedric Plate Armor|Daedric Plate Armor]] mentioned in the note. Defeat him and any bandits that get in your way to retrieve the set. Read the ''[[Skyrim:Bounty Hunter's Note|Bounty Hunter's Note]]'' you can find on the body for confirmation of Edward's scheme.

Skyrim:Brelyna's Practice.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=Nephele |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)|Favors|link3=Favors}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Brelyna Maryon|Brelyna Maryon]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Resist Magic|Resist Magic]] necklace, Brelyna Maryon as a follower |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Brelyna Maryon|Brelyna Maryon]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] |Image=SR-quest-Brelyna's Practice 05.jpg |ImgDesc=Brelyna casting a spell |description=Help [[Skyrim:Brelyna Maryon|Brelyna Maryon]] by allowing her to practice her spells on you. |ID=MGRAppBrelyna01 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Brelyna Maryon|Brelyna Maryon]]. #Let her cast a spell on you. #Wait a few in-game hours to let the effects wear off. #Let Brelyna try again. #Wait for her to finish. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Helping Out A Friend=== [[Skyrim:Brelyna Maryon|Brelyna Maryon]] is a serious student at the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. After completing [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]], you can find her back at the College (likely in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Attainment|Hall of Attainment]]). When you speak to her, she'll request your help: ''"We're all trying to become better mages, right? Well, I need someone I can practice a few spells on. Nothing dangerous, really. Would you be willing to assist me?"'' If you agree to help her for a price, she will offer an amulet in return. Apparently, she has developed a type of [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] spell that she needs to cast onto someone else, and she will be relieved that she won't have to ask [[Skyrim:J'zargo|J'zargo]] for help. ===It's Not Easy Being Green=== When you are ready, Brelyna will instruct you: ''"Please hold still, and don't move."'' As the spell is cast, a tiny flaw becomes apparent: your vision is now green. Alarmingly, Brelyna will exclaim, ''"Oh dear. That wasn't supposed to happen."'' Then she will ask, ''"Do you... do you feel all right? You look very, umm, green."'' She will apologize profusely, assuring you that the green effect is temporary. It will fade after a few in-game hours. ===Altered States=== After the effects of the first attempt fade, and if you are being a good sport about it all, return to Brelyna and she will ask you to help her again. She confidently asserts that she has everything worked out. You can also express your doubts about proceeding, but in the end, agree to her ministrations. She will cast several more spells which will turn you into a horse, a cow, and a dog. {{Multiple Images | align= center | direction= horizontal | image1= SR-quest-Brelyna's Practice.jpg | caption1= The results of the second spell | image2= SR-quest-Brelyna's Practice 02.jpg | caption2= The results of the third spell | image3= SR-quest-Brelyna's Practice 03.jpg |caption3= Brelyna casting her fourth spell | image4= SR-quest-Brelyna's Practice 04.jpg | caption4= The results of the fourth spell }} {{NewLine}} With each mishap, Brelyna bolsters her resolve: ''"Oh my. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Speak with [[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]] in the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]].
#Travel to [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]].
#''(Optional)'' Steal [[Skyrim:Gaius Maro|Gaius Maro]]'s travel schedule.
#Kill Gaius Maro and plant the [[SR:Incriminating Letter (DB)|incriminating letter]]. For a bonus, kill him in a [[Skyrim:Cities|major city]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Sins of the Father===
When you return from your fateful visit to [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|Vittoria Vici's wedding]], you will find a gleeful [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] ready to move onto the next phase of the plan. She instructs you to visit with [[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]] for the next mission. Gabriella informs you that with the Emperor traveling to Skyrim, the [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus|Penitus Oculatus]] will be securing the way. In order to disrupt the security surrounding the Emperor, you will need to cripple its head, [[Skyrim:Commander Maro|Commander Maro]]. The Brotherhood's plan to accomplish this is to kill [[Skyrim:Gaius Maro|Gaius Maro]], the commander's son, and plant a [[Skyrim:Incriminating Letter (DB)|letter]] implicating him in a plot against the Emperor.

===Dragon Bridge===
Gabriella has instructions on how to locate Gaius Maro, as well as how to earn a special bonus for this contract. To begin, travel to the town of [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] and, if you choose, steal Gaius' [[Skyrim:Gaius Maro's Schedule|travel schedule]]. This makes things much easier, and you really have no reason not to do it. Additionally, killing Gaius in any city other than Dragon Bridge will grant you the "reading of your future", according to Gabriella, but this is optional. To obtain the schedule, simply [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneak]] into the building where the schedule is located and nab it. Even if you are detected, with weapons sheathed and without casualties, a soldier will only yell, ''"Hey, you won't get away with that!"'', one [[Skyrim:Crime#BountiesBounty|bounty]] is incurred and they do follow you. (To avoid a bounty, wait until the door shows as being unlocked to go inside. Then, once inside, look to see how many guards are inside. Usually there is only one awake and walking around. Wait for him to go outside and you can now take Gaius Maro's Schedule with no bounty, because the other guard(s) are asleep. Just to be safe, you can always sneak to take it.) Once outside, check what day of the week it is in-game, then read the schedule and travel to the appropriate city.
This is the schedule as it appears in game that you steal from the [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Outpost|Penitus Oculatus Outpost]]:

===The Stalker===
Don't be afraid to simply wait for a day and follow Gaius around. There is no time limit on this quest, and when Gaius has completed his schedule, he will repeat the same schedule next week. It is much easier to assassinate him on the road when he is alone, but you forfeit your bonus reward by doing so. Wherever you kill him, loot his corpse and plant the incriminating letter on his body, then return to the Sanctuary. Alternatively, you can reverse-pickpocket the note prior to killing him.
Some strategies for completing the contract are to wait until he stays at the [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|Bannered Mare]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. He will go to sleep in a room alone around midnight, allowing for an easy sneak attack. He might also be alone while he's eating in the [[Skyrim:Windhelm Barracks|Windhelm barracks]]. Conversely, his notes suggest that he doesn't actually sleep in any of the inns or the barracks in Riften, and seems to spend most of his time in the main hall with plenty of watchful eyes, so it might be wiser not to bother him there.  As with all the other targets from Nazir, you can alternatively speak to Gaius and provoke him into attacking you; this allows you to kill him in self-defense without a crime being registered.

==General Strategies==
===Solitude===
Should it be Morndas as per Gaius' schedule seen in the Penitus Oculatus Outpost, he will be in Solitude overlooking Castle Dour's courtyard and the Emperor's Tower during the day. By evening, he will retire to the barracks below where [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] and [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] are normally found. This is a good spot to attempt to stealth kill him as he normally sits at the table just around the corner from the stairs. The guards will be asleep, and thus unaware of any attempt on Gaius, unless it is around 8:00 AM or 8:00 PM. Both these times are when the changing of the guard normally occurs, and the area will be full of guards retiring for some sleep while their relief gets up to head out on patrol. This is especially so if [[Skyrim:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]] is himself resting for the night, in which case he might see the murder and trigger a bounty. The chances of this happening are higher if sitting with Gaius when he is killed. A bow or crossbow may be the best option here by hiding in the shadows near the barrels in the kitchen area.

A good opening is when Aldis stands up to walk to the far end of the beds. With his back turned, an opening is made to stealth kill Gaius. Even if Aldis or the guards hear it, with a high enough Sneak, you will generally remain undetected. However, if Gaius is spoken to and made hostile, the guards will awaken and come to your aid, since they'll consider Gaius the criminal for attacking you first. In this case, you will need to deliver the final blow before Gaius becomes non-hostile again, risking a bounty should he not be killed and regains his health. Alternatively, the [[Skyrim:Ebony Mail|Ebony Mail]] acquired from [[Skyrim:Boethiah's Calling|Boethiah's Calling]] can be used to suck his health away with its [[Skyrim:Poison Damage|poison enchantment]].

===Riften===
In this particular city, if Gaius is there to do his rounds on Middas, the alleyway to the left provides an opportunity (the lock on the gate may need to be picked unless the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]] has been collected). As Maro leaves (around 1:00 A.M.), sniping him with an arrow will avoid detection and any bounty. If the archery skill is at a low level and/or the player does not have the appropriate perks, he may not die with one sneak attack, so there may be a prolonged fight. Another option is to wait in the corner of Riften Castle's courtyard, behind the small grouping of trees, and when he leaves (he exits that side every time at around 11:30 A.M., although the actual times may vary), he will be alone and far enough away from any guards to allow him to be killed without any worry about a crime.

===Palace of the Kings or Other Guard Barracks===
Gaius will sleep in the barracks with the guards in Windhelm while there for his rounds on Tirdas. This can be one of the hardest places to get him without being detected. Around 10:00 P.M., in the corner by the sleeping guard, he can be sniped with a bow or crossbow (preferably after having coated the arrows with [[Skyrim:Poisons|poison]]). Each time he is shot, he will get up and look around the room. He can be continually attacked without being discovered. The guards in the beds will sometimes get up and look as well, but with some luck and stealth, will ignore you, who should be in the shadows. After Maro is dead, once the guards settle down it is possible to creep over to his body and plant the Incriminating Letter. Sneaking back to the corner, then jumping over the beds with the guards in them until the doorway is reached, allows you to sneak out to freedom. Just as it is in Solitude, if Gaius is made hostile by speaking to him, the guards will awaken and support you since Gaius just made himself a criminal in their eyes by initiating an attack.

===The Bannered Mare===
In Whiterun when he is there on Turdas, it is extremely easy to sneak into his bedroom in The Bannered Mare, as it seems to be the only time he is not bunking in a castle or in barracks. He can be killed in his sleep with the door shut, and then the letter planted. This does not result in a bounty.

However, there is a high chance that Maro might fall behind on his itinerary schedule and therefore only make a brief stop at The Bannered Mare, for some drinks, before continuing on to Markarth. In this case he normally arrives alone on Turdas evening (10:00–11:00 P.M.) and heads straight to the hearth in the middle of the inn for a drink, while enjoying the bard's performances.

With a high level of Sneak and the Ebony Mail, while sneaking he can be shot using a ranged weapon from the balcony of the room overlooking the hearth (it is the same room rented from [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]]). Since this balcony is full of shadowy spots it is possible to hide in one of those and wait for Gaius Maro to charge upstairs looking for his assailant. Once he has touched the shadowy tendrils of poison emitted by the Ebony Mail, it is just a matter of waiting for him to fall lifeless. Then the Incriminating Letter can be planted and the scene left with no alarm raised.

Obviously, this technique can also be used in other dark locations as well. A word of caution though: killing him in public usually leads to collateral damage, so there will be some bodies on the way out of the inn. 

Sometimes, he can be killed in full view of guards and citizens. The guards will do their normal "What was that?" routine, but will not see him actually being slaughtered, even though they see you plainly. Citizens, however, will scold you and sometimes turn hostile when they see Gaius Maro killed.

===A Direct Provocation===
Another alternative method is for you to approach Maro and use the option of telling him how he will be killed, and then the Emperor. After this, Gaius will begin to attack. Letting him strike the first blow, then fighting back and killing him will not cause a bounty. This method can be used in any major city in order to receive the bonus. If using this method, it is best to confront him in view of a guard – so that it is seen that Gaius attacks first, and the guards come to your defense. However, if a guard wanders into view of the fight as it is proceeding and the first blow he sees is struck by you, a bounty will be earned.

If you are a member of the Thieves Guild and happen to encounter Maro in Riften, he can be provoked, and fellow [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] members (and even [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]]) will come to your defense. They will finish him off. This can also be done in Whiterun, where the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] are available, or similarly, in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]], where the mages will ally themselves with you, should you be part of their guild. More generally, if Maro is attacked in a town or city where friends are present, they will help to kill him. If he happens to enter your house or homestead, the [[Skyrim:Housecarl|Housecarls]] can also be immensely valuable, since they will fight him off too.

Alternatively, if he is killed anywhere in a city where you are Thane, your position as Thane can be used to remove the bounty.

===Dragon Attacks===
The bonus can also be received just outside a city. If a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] attacks just outside a city, he can be killed while the guards are fighting the dragon, resulting in no bounty. The bonus will still be counted.

===Dragonsreach===
An easy way to kill Gaius without good combat skills is when he is in Dragonsreach, in Whiterun. He can be approached and provoked. Once he attacks, the entire court of Whiterun will assault him. However, they will not kill him, but rather, will lower his health down to the point that he falls to one knee. This allows you to slaughter him with an extra attack or two.

===Pickpocket===
With a high enough [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pickpocket]] skill, it is possible to plant the Incriminating Letter on Gaius before killing him. This allows him to be killed at range and in the open, and the quest completed without approaching his body. With the pickpocket perk [[Skyrim:Poisoned|Poisoned]], poison can also be placed in his pocket along with the note. The stronger the poison the better.

===Beast Form or Vampirism===
While in Whiterun, after planting the Incriminating Letter on Gaius, he can be murdered using [[Skyrim:Beast Form|Beast Form]] or [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|Vampire Lord]] form. Afterwards, escaping to The Companions' Underforge, it is possible to wait until returning to normal appearance.

===Immediate Hostility===
Gaius can be attacked while outside a major city but not killed, by running away and losing him. Once he has entered a major hold, he will attack you on sight. Since he attacked first, he can be killed with impunity. The guards will either help you or ignore the scene.

===Markarth===
At some point while in town on Fredas, Gaius will go to the guard tower in Markarth. Once he is back out of the tower, [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] (preferably all three words) will launch him off of the high point that the guard tower is on. The player can augment this with [[Skyrim:Force Without Effort|Force Without Effort]] and/or [[Skyrim:Dragonborn Force|Dragonborn Force]] to enhance its effects. After following him down, Gaius will attack once he is back on his feet, causing the guards to see this as a crime and attack him until he yields. He can then be simply finished off, and the Incriminating Letter planted.

===Change of Schedule===
Whenever Gaius sees you he begins taking an alternate route. This can make the quest quite hard as he will turn away from a city if he sees you anywhere near it. If this happens, waiting in a tavern in a city on his route will allow him to eventually resume his normal journey.

===Reward===
For this assault on the emperor's security, you will be rewarded with leveled gold. Gaius himself carries a set of rare [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Armor|Penitus Oculatus armor]]. If Gaius died in a city, you will also receive [[Skyrim:Olava's Token|Olava's Token]]. The token will give you a [[Skyrim:Locate the Assassin of Old|miscellaneous quest]] to find an "assassin of old", which will lead you to a dead Dark Brotherhood member in a cave equipped with the [[Skyrim:Ancient Shrouded Armor|Ancient Shrouded Armor]] set. This set is the best Dark Brotherhood armor that you can acquire. It has a higher armor rating, higher gold value, lower weight, as well as having a superior enchantment to the base Shrouded set.
{{SRLeveledReward|Large}}

==Notes==
* Since Dragon Bridge is part of [[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]], the guards there will try to arrest you if you earned a [[Skyrim:Crime#Bounties|bounty]] in Solitude during the previous quest, which will interfere with this quest. If this is the case, make sure to clear your bounty first.

For a bonus, kill her during her speech. #Return to [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Let the Festivities Begin=== [[File:SR-quest-Bound_Until_Death_02.jpg|thumb|right|Vittoria and Asgeir at the wedding]] After the [[Skyrim:The Silence Has Been Broken|Silence Has Been Broken]] quest, the first part of the Dark Brotherhood's biggest contract is set in motion. At Astrid's behest, travel to the courtyard of the [[Skyrim:Temple of the Divines|Temple of the Divines]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. Here you will find the small wedding reception you were directed to attend. Your target is the bride, [[Skyrim:Vittoria Vici|Vittoria Vici]]. If you approach Vittoria before she addresses the reception, she will exclaim: ''"What an amazing day this has been. I hope you're enjoying the festivities. I'm... I'm just so overwhelmed. Such kindness... for me."'' You can choose one of three dialogue options in response: :'''The Stormcloaks say hello!''' :''"Oh! Well, you tell your Stormcloak friends "hello" right back at them! This is a day of healing! Legion, Stormcloaks - all are welcome here!"'' :'''Hail the Imperial Legion!''' :''"Ha ha ha ha! Yes, yes indeed! Hail the Imperial Legion! Hail the Stormcloaks! Hail Solitude and the Eight Divines! On this glorious day, we honor everyone! Ha ha ha ha!"'' :'''(Remain silent)''' :''"Oh, no need to be shy! My day is your day! Please - eat, drink, make merry! We're all friends here!"'' During the reception, she will also tell the guests: ''"Please, enjoy the festivities! This is a day of peace and happiness, when Imperials and Stormcloaks join together, as equals!"'' or ''"Please, enjoy yourself!"'' She will then stand up with her fiancé, [[Skyrim:Asgeir Snow-Shod|Asgeir Snow-Shod]], and enter a door to reach the balcony, where she will begin addressing her guests. Assassinate her while she speaks to earn the bonus reward. There are several ways you can choose to accomplish the goal (see [[#Strategies|this section]] for more details). ====Strategies==== [[File:SR-quest-Bound_Until_Death_03.jpg|thumb|right|A loose gargoyle hanging over the balcony]][[File:SR-quest-Bound_Until_Death_04.jpg|thumb|right|A sniping spot opposite the balcony]] There are many strategies you can use to kill Vittoria at her wedding. If you chose to speak to some of your fellow family members, they will give you advice on ways to kill her and what may happen afterwards: *If you speak to [[Skyrim:Babette|Babette]], she will tell you about a loose gargoyle statue above the balcony: ''"It's no fair. I love weddings. [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] should have given this contract to me. Instead, she's got me visiting cities, assessing security. How boring. But listen, I think I can help you. The wedding reception is outside the Temple of the Divines, right? In Solitude? If so, the bride will probably address the crowd from the balcony. It overlooks the courtyard. Well, there's an old statue there. I've seen it. Hanging right over where she'll be standing. Old means weak. Weak means it could fall. Hmmm?"'' If you travel to the wall above the balcony, you can push a loose gargoyle statue when Vittoria makes her address to the wedding guests. To access this balcony, enter the Temple of the Divines, then go up the stairs to the right and through the door at the end of the corridor. You can also access this balcony by going up the stairs located to the right of [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]]. The gargoyle is there whether you talk to Babette or not.
*If you speak to [[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]], she will tell you: ''"I hope you don't mind, but I took the liberty of surveying the site of the reception. There's a small parapet, just opposite the balcony, that would prove an excellent spot for a long-range kill. I left something there for you. If you're inclined to take that approach."'' If you take the door to the northwest of the temple entrance, you will end up on a ledge located opposite the balcony where Vittoria addresses the reception. On the ledge are six arrows, an [[Skyrim:Elixir of True Shot|Elixir of True Shot]], and the unique magical bow [[Skyrim:Firiniel's End|Firiniel's End]]. You can simply shoot the bride from this spot; she is easily killed with a single sneak attack from the magic bow you are given. It is best to use these free items now to be sure she is killed immediately. This is especially important if you have a low [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]] skill and are planning a ranged attack. Like the gargoyle, the bow is there even if you haven't talked to Gabriella.
*[[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] will warn you about the possible outcome of murdering Vittoria: ''"Slaughtering the Emperor's cousin? At her wedding? Those guards will be out for blood. Wouldn't surprise me if the crowd jumped in too."''
*[[Skyrim:Veezara|Veezara]] will advise you to plan your escape route beforehand: ''"Your contract sounds simple, which means it certainly will not be. Getting into that reception will be easy, but have you thought about getting out?"'' Other strategies for killing Vittoria include the following: *Pickpocket a [[Skyrim:Frenzy (effect)|Frenzy]] poison into [[Skyrim:Asgeir Snow-Shod|the groom]]'s inventory as Vittoria addresses the crowd. He will immediately drink it, turn, and kill her, provided that the poison is of sufficient strength. Casting a spell of Frenzy will achieve the same effect, though the [[Skyrim:Quiet Casting|Quiet Casting]] perk may be needed to avoid detection. To kill with a particular poison, you will need a poison of better than Weak strength and the [[Skyrim:Poisoned|Poisoned]] perk. *Turn into a [[Skyrim:Werewolf|werewolf]] or a [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|vampire lord]]{{DG}} (without being seen and therefore incurring no bounty), and then use the door to the overhead balcony where she is located and kill her. A good spot to transform while Vittoria is speaking is the small nook behind the loose gargoyle. By crouching (sneaking) inside this nook, you can avoid incurring a bounty for transforming, and you can swiftly jump down on the bride before the crowd notices what's happening. *Follow the happy couple to the balcony where the bride gives her speech. If you crouch down behind the couple you will not be seen by them or the guests. You can kill the bride and, by killing the groom as your last witness, you will get rid of the bounty as both are joined in death. *Drop onto the balcony, crouch, and use Unrelenting Force. *Purchase an invisibility potion and use it when killing Vittoria, guards shouldn't know that you did it. ==='Til Death Do Us Part=== [[File:SR-quest-Bound_Until_Death_05.jpg|thumb|right|Veezara coming to your aid]] Once Vittoria is killed, pandemonium will break loose. Veezara will then appear, sent by Astrid to offer a distraction while you escape. Even if you weren't detected and got away with the assassination undiscovered, Veezara will still charge in and initiate combat with everyone, drawing attention away from you so you can simply walk out. Sometimes, the guests will still give chase, in which case you can escape the city quickly by using a stairwell under the [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] tower bridge, near the market. One way of avoiding a bounty is to fast travel to the Sanctuary to collect your reward as soon as Vittoria is killed and before the guests turn hostile. ===Summoning a Legend of the Brotherhood=== Upon your arrival back to the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Sanctuary]], Astrid will congratulate you on your success: ''"With Vici's murder, you've started us down a path the Dark Brotherhood hasn't traveled in centuries. The assassination of an Emperor. And now, your reward. A [[Skyrim:Summon Spectral Assassin|unique spell]] to summon a legend of the Dark Brotherhood. His soul serves us now in death, as his body once did in life"''. This spell will allow you to summon the powerful spirit of an assassin to fight by your side. If you fulfilled the bonus requirements, she will also say ''"Ah, and of course, a bonus, for killing Vici while she addressed her guests, as instructed. Gold... simple and pure. Spend it as you will."'', and give you a leveled amount of gold. Astrid will then carry on: ''"Now then. Time to proceed to the next stage of the plan. Go and speak with Gabriella. She's been helping me arrange your next contract."'' When you approach her again, she will tell you: ''"As I said, go speak with Gabriella. She's been assisting me with your next contract. This Emperor business, well... it does involve everyone."'' The next quest, [[Skyrim:Breaching Security|Breaching Security]], will now begin. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest: * {{achievement|Bound Until Death (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *Completion of this quest will make another minor [[Skyrim:The Spiced Wine|quest]] unavailable, unless you completed that one first. *Some of the guests at the wedding include [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]], [[Skyrim:Alexia Vici|Alexia Vici]], [[Skyrim:Vulwulf Snow-Shod|Vulwulf Snow-Shod]], [[Skyrim:Nura Snow-Shod|Nura Snow-Shod]], [[Skyrim:Vivienne Onis|Vivienne Onis]], [[Skyrim:Kayd|Kayd]], [[Skyrim:Rorlund|Rorlund]], [[Skyrim:Pantea Ateia|Pantea Ateia]], [[Skyrim:Lodi|Lodi]], [[Skyrim:Noster Eagle-Eye|Noster Eagle-Eye]], and a [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Agent|Penitus Oculatus agent]]. *After Veezara appears, if you are not being pursued, you can talk to all of the wedding guests to hear their individual reactions to Vittoria's murder. *Even if you are not detected when killing the bride, the guests will still turn hostile, and attacking them will incur a bounty. Raising and lowering arms will count as yielding and will not earn you a bounty. *[[Skyrim:Plautis Carvain|Plautis Carvain]] and [[Skyrim:Salonia Carvain|his wife]] can be found traveling in the wilderness during a random encounter, and claim to be heading towards the wedding, although they will never appear there and are not mentioned by any of the other guests. After completing the quest, you may once more run into Plautis and Salonia, where they explain that they were robbed by bandits and missed the wedding. *Using an [[Skyrim:Invisibility (effect)|Invisibility]] potion, power, or spell may help you avoid a bounty if it is used right after the murder, although the guards may still locate and attack you, causing the bounty to be incurred. *Vittoria can be looted for her unique [[Skyrim:Wedding Dress|wedding dress]], [[Skyrim:Wedding Sandals|wedding sandals]], [[Skyrim:Wedding Wreath|wedding wreath]], and [[Skyrim:Vittoria's Wedding Band|her wedding band]] before it disappears. If the body is gone, you can find Vittoria's remains in the [[Skyrim:Solitude Catacombs|Catacombs]], in a coffin on the northeastern side of the longest tunnel. *Killing Vittoria by casting a Frenzy spell at her can cause her to leave the balcony, which would cause your bonus to be forfeit as she is no longer considered "speaking to the guests". ==Bugs== {{Bug|After the disastrous wedding, the northwestern entrance to the temple courtyard remains closed for the rest of the game. == Walkthrough ==
===Easy Money===
If you talk to one of the quest givers, they will offer to pay you for chopped [[Skyrim:firewood|firewood]]. Alternatively, you can also chop the firewood first and then sell the firewood to a quest giver later. You are paid five gold per unit of firewood.

===Find a Chopping Block===

===Get Chopping===
To chop wood you must have a [[Skyrim:Woodcutter's Axe|woodcutter's axe]] in your inventory (one can usually be found near the wood pile). In addition to standard woodcutter's axes, the [[Skyrim:Poacher's Axe|Poacher's Axe]] can be used to chop firewood. Activating a wood chopping block will then cause you to produce firewood at a rate of two units every eight seconds, with a limit of six units per activation. After you have produced six units, you must activate the block again or leave the woodcutting session. You can leave partially through, in which you'll either cut two or four units instead.

It is also possible to have a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] chop firewood for you, even if they don't have an axe. By having someone else do the chopping, you can perform other tasks such as smithing and selling items. By multitasking and restarting their orders every few moments, you can earn several hundred gold on the side while performing bartering. 

If a second wood chopping block is nearby, you can chop wood simultaneously to double production while only adding an extra couple of seconds to the equation. This can be done early on in [[Skyrim: Riverwood|Riverwood]] by getting [[Skyrim:Faendal|Faendal]] as a follower and then using the two chopping blocks near the mill. Use the command feature to command Faendal from afar and maximize efficiency. After twenty or so minutes of woodcutting, you can earn a few thousand gold at the beginning of the game without gaining any XP.

== Achievements ==
An [[Skyrim:Achievements|Achievement]] is related to chopping wood:
* {{achievement|Hard Worker}}
** To obtain this achievement you do not need to sell the firewood, or even talk to any of the quest givers. Simply activating the wood chopping block is sufficient.

==Notes==
* This quest does not have any stages or objectives.
* This quest can be repeated indefinitely.
* There is no limit to the amount of firewood you can chop at each wood chopping block and then sell. One (painfully slow) way to get the money to purchase a house is to chop the required amount of wood. For the house in Whiterun, for example, you will get 5000 gold if you accumulate 1000 pieces of firewood. This takes approximately 24 hours of game time when the time scale is set around 10, or 25 minutes in real time. At the standard time scale, it is possible to chop 150 pieces of firewood in 15 real-time minutes, which is a pay rate of 3000 gold per real-time hour.
* You can also ask a follower to chop wood for you, by entering [[Skyrim:Followers#Commands|command]] mode and selecting a valid chopping block. The follower does not need to be carrying a woodcutter's axe to perform this. They will begin a single cycle of the chopping animation (3 chops gaining 6 wood) before returning to standing idle. They can continue to chop even when they are overencumbered.
** As an augmented way to make money, you can find a location which has two chopping blocks nearby, command your follower to use one, and use the other yourself. This will nearly double your output and allow earning a sizable amount of gold in less time. 
*** [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]] is the easiest location to do this, as it has two blocks, is accessible immediately at the start of the game, and even provides [[Skyrim:Faendal|Faendal]] as an easy-to-get follower to help you chop wood. Note that the follower will need to be reinstructed to chop wood each time they finish, so there is a bit of micromanagement involved. When your character finishes his/her own chopping cycle, return to the follower and repeat the process.
* A less tedious method of earning passive gold is simply telling your follower to chop wood while you are in a city or settlement, checking in every once in a while as you go about your business.
* Money you earn from chopping wood is fixed and is not affected by your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill. This makes the quest one of the few ways to [[Skyrim:Making Money|make money]] without increasing any skills, which will help control your level. This is useful when wanting to [[Skyrim:Trainers|train]] in a certain skill as many times as possible. It is also one of the few ways to earn money without doing any questing, merchanting, or crafting.
* With the [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] add-on, doing this quest for [[Skyrim:Aeri|Aeri]], [[Skyrim:Gilfre|Gilfre]], [[Skyrim:Grosta|Grosta]], [[Skyrim:Hert|Hert]], or [[Skyrim:Hod|Hod]] will increase their disposition such that you'll be able to [[Skyrim:Cutting Lumber|cut your own lumber]] for [[Skyrim:Construction|construction]] purposes.
* Because this is a favor quest which affects the quest giver's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the [[Skyrim:Thane|thane]] quest for the quest giver's hold.
* Each unit of firewood weighs 5, and a full use of the chopping block gives 6 wood, for a total weight of 30. If you become overencumbered, which will happen rather quickly, you can drop the entire stack of wood and pick it up by holding the "grab" button to be able to run over to the person to whom you wish to sell it.
* Swinging the woodcutter's axe at a chopping block won't produce firewood; you must activate the animation sequence.
* Firewood samples found in the wilderness can also be used. Despite the abundance of wood piles which use the same model, these standalone samples can be quite rare. [[Skyrim:Autumnwatch Tower|Autumnwatch Tower]] has three firewood scattered over the floors of the tallest tower. Given the sheer weight of the wood and the fact that only a handful of NPCs will buy firewood at-cost, it is probably not worth the effort to grab these scattered pieces, unless you have a follower to bear the burden.
** Like other [[Skyrim:Gather_Wheat|gathering quests]], NPCs do not care if the firewood is stolen.
* Some objects in the game world look like wood chopping blocks, but aren't. If it lacks one or both piles of wood along the sides of it, it is not a wood chopping block. When scrolling over a usable block, the "Activate" prompt will appear.
* {{pc22}} Version 1.2.4 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] adds woodcutter's axes next to the wood piles in Whiterun, Riften, and Windhelm so that being asked to chop wood won't result in you needing to exit the city and travel to a nearby village just to get an axe.
** {{pc22}} Version 2.1.2 of the Unofficial Skyrim Patch adds woodcutter's axes next to the wood piles in Kynesgrove, Dragon Bridge, Ivarstead, and Half-Moon Mill for essentially the same reason.
* Time doesn't stop while chopping wood so magicka, health, and stamina regenerate while using a chopping block.
* Chopped wood can be sold to general goods merchants, though at a much lower price than someone on the list above.

The quest marker may indicate that you should enter his house, the door of which may be unlocked, but if you enter you may be treated as a trespasser with no option to tell Torbjorn or his wife what your errand is. Meet him on the street during the day instead. ===Black-Briar Mead=== [[Skyrim:Black-Briar_Mead|Black-Briar Mead]] can be found in large quantities or bought at the [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Meadery|Black-Briar Meadery]], and are guaranteed in other locations as well, most closely in [[Skyrim:Lod's_House|Lod's House]] (on the table with the [[Skyrim:Private_Letter|private letter]] required by [[Skyrim:Dengeir_of_Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]]'s quest [[Skyrim:Some_Light_Theft|Some Light Theft]]). They may also be bought from most innkeeper merchants. There is also one at the end of the cave in [[Skyrim:Unbound|Unbound]], right where you are told to sneak past the bear. ===Mammoth Tusk=== If you are willing to steal, you can find a [[Skyrim:Mammoth_Tusk|mammoth tusk]] in several places in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]: *[[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach Jarl's Quarters]] — go upstairs and into the main room then head into the room to your right; the tusk is atop the bookcases to the right of the door *[[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] — on the table in the left room *[[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] — located on top of a bookshelf right behind the counter; jump on the rafters from the room for rent and pluck it off the shelf If you'd prefer not to steal one and are unable or unwilling to kill a [[Skyrim:mammoth|mammoth]], [[Skyrim:Halted_Stream_Camp|Halted Stream Camp]] just north of Whiterun contains several mammoth tusks. [[Skyrim:Belethor|Belethor]], the general goods merchant, has a chance of stocking one if you're willing to pay for it. With [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]], a free one can be found in the [[Skyrim:Main Hall#Main Hall|Main Hall]] of your home, if you build one. With [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]], one can be found in [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]], and is free to take after you take ownership. ===''The Mirror''=== After accepting this quest, a copy of ''[[Skyrim:The_Mirror|The Mirror]]'' can be found in [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Windhelm's Palace of Kings]]. This is where your quest marker will point you, but it will count as stealing unless you are [[Skyrim:Thane of Eastmarch|Thane of Eastmarch]]. [[Skyrim:Captain_Aldis|Captain Aldis]] ''will'' accept a stolen copy. Copies may also be found on the bookshelf in the sleeping area of [[Skyrim:Broken_Tower_Redoubt|Broken Tower Redoubt]] in [[Skyrim:The Reach|the Reach]], or in [[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]] in [[Skyrim:The Pale|the Pale]], over a table in the first tomb's zone. With [[Skyrim:Hendraheim|Hendraheim]], another copy can be found on the table towards right side end of the hall of the [[Skyrim:Hendraheim (place)|house]]. ===''Night Falls on Sentinel''=== A copy of ''[[Skyrim:Night_Falls_on_Sentinel|Night Falls on Sentinel]]'' will spawn on a crate in [[Skyrim:Swindler's_Den|Swindler's Den]] after accepting the quest. Copies may also be found in a bandit camp near [[Skyrim:The_Guardian_Stones|The Guardian Stones]], and in [[Skyrim:Volunruud|Volunruud]] during the quest [[Skyrim:Silenced_Tongues|Silenced Tongues]]. ===''Song of the Alchemists''=== Unfortunately, ''[[Skyrim:Song_of_the_Alchemists|Song of the Alchemists]]'' cannot be obtained without stealing in the base game. After activating this quest, a copy spawns in the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]] on the main floor, to the right from the entrance on the counter (a blue book). It is not marked as stolen, but you will still incur the penalties of stealing if you are caught taking it. The book can also be stolen from [[Skyrim:Anise's Cabin|Anise's Cabin]] near [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. If you have the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] expansion, a copy which does not require stealing can be found in [[Skyrim:Apocrypha|Apocrypha]], inside the Black Book called ''[[Skyrim:Apocrypha (Waking Dreams)|Waking Dreams]]'', in Chapter III. A copy of the book can also be found in the hidden alchemy laboratory of [[Skyrim:Goldenhills Plantation|Goldenhills Plantation]]. ==Notes== * [[Skyrim:Halted Stream Camp|Halted Stream Camp]] is the location of a [[Skyrim:Bounty:_Bandit_Boss|bounty quest]], possible location of a [[Skyrim:Dungeon_Delving_(Bandits)|Dungeon Delving]] quest from [[Skyrim:Amren|Amren]], and possible location of the [[Skyrim:Amulet of the Moon|Amulet of the Moon]] quest, making it easy to complete multiple quests at once if you choose to find your mammoth tusk there. It is also one of only two locations where the [[Skyrim:Transmute|Transmute]] spell tome may be found. * If Hearthfire is installed, then the Jarl of Falkreath will send you a [[Skyrim:Letter from Jarl (Jarl's Name) of (Jarl's City)|message via courier]] once you have become level 9, as long as you have not yet started the Falkreath thane quest. If Rare Gifts is in your journal when the courier is given the message, you will fail the quest and it will be removed from your journal. Reading the note the courier gives you will start the quest [[Skyrim:Build Your Own Home|Build Your Own Home]]. * You must have the item in your inventory for the quest giver's quest pointer and dialogue to display. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you complete the Stormcloaks quest [[Skyrim:Battle_for_Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], Captain Aldis will no longer be part of the city and the indication arrow for you to follow will lead to a blank floor, where Aldis previously stood.|USKP|1.0|This quest will fail as soon as Battle for Solitude is started.}} **{{pc22}} Captain Aldis can be spawned again using the console command player.placeatme 00041FB8. Afterwards, you can speak with him about quests like normal. **{{pc22}} An alternative is to type SetObjectiveCompleted Favor110 10 1 in the console to complete the quest and then to remove ''The Mirror'' from your inventory by typing player.additem 0001AFDE -1. {{Bug|It seems likely that Siddgeir was intended to give a leveled piece of armor as a reward, however he gives potions instead. ==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Keeping the Mine Safe===
[[Skyrim:Dravynea the Stoneweaver|Dravynea the Stoneweaver]] is a [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dark Elf]] [[Skyrim:TrainerAlterationExpert|alteration expert]] living in [[Skyrim:Kynesgrove|Kynesgrove]]. When she is not working in the [[Skyrim:Steamscorch Mine|Steamscorch Mine]], you can find her wandering the town or in the [[Skyrim:Braidwood Inn|Braidwood Inn]].  Should you be in the market for some free [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] training, ask her about her business in Kynesgrove. She will explain that she uses her powers as a mage to keep the mine safe. She is able to make a potion using [[Skyrim:Frost Salts|frost salts]] to keep the temperature in the mine bearable, but is out of frost salts at the moment. Tell her that you can get some for her. She will off-handedly offer you free training if you actually bring her the salts.
===Finding Frost Salts===
The quest will update to "Bring some Frost Salts to Dravynea". While the term "some" is rather ambiguous, only one bowl of frost salts is required to fulfill the objective. If you do not have a sample in your inventory already, there are many ways to obtain a sample: from the corpse of a [[Skyrim:Frost_Atronach|frost atronach]], purchasing one from an apothecary merchant, creating a sample at the [[Skyrim:Atronach_Forge|Atronach Forge]], or placed randomly on shelves. If you are a member of the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold_(faction)|College of Winterhold]], you have access to two free samples in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Countenance|Hall of Countenance]] alchemy lab. 

===The Reward===
When you have your sample, take it to Dravynea to complete the quest. She will seem surprised that you actually came through, and will give you a free training session equaling one level of Alteration as a reward.


== Notes ==
* Because this is a favor quest which affects Dravynea's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the [[Skyrim:Thane of Eastmarch|Thane of Eastmarch]] quest.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Obtain the [[Skyrim:Stallion's Potion|potion]] from [[Skyrim:Bothela|Bothela]].
# Go to [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] (or the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]], see below).
# Deliver the potion to [[Skyrim:Raerek|Raerek]] or [[Skyrim:Reburrus Quintilius|Reburrus]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[Skyrim:Bothela|Bothela]], an elderly Breton alchemist, can be found in her shop, [[Skyrim:The Hag's Cure|The Hag's Cure]], located in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] just west of [[Skyrim:Cidhna Mine|Cidhna Mine]]. When asked about her shop, Bothela will say that the people of Markarth will often come to her, secretly, for cures. Bothela will go on to explain that she has [[Skyrim:Stallion's Potion|a potion]] for the Jarl's steward, which she asks you to deliver.
	
''"Still, a little knowledge of plants and potions can get you by. Not that anyone likes to admit buying things from you. See? I even have a little potion for the Steward. Mind handing it over to him? Just say it should solve that problem he has."''
	
After accepting this task, the Stallion's Potion will be placed in your inventory. If declined, however, selecting the initiating dialogue will prompt the conversation again, giving you another opportunity to accept the quest.

The steward can be found in [[Skyrim:Understone_Keep|Understone Keep]] (or the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] if the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] control the Reach and the potion is for Raerek). Approaching and informing him of Bothela's delivery will prompt this line from him:

''"Oh... yes... um... thank you. Here you go. Some gold for your assistance and your, discretion."''

After speaking with him, the Stallion's Potion will be removed from your inventory and Raerek will reward you with a leveled amount of gold. Bothela does not give you a reward, unless a friendly disposition counts.

===Reward===
{{SRLeveledReward|small}}

==Notes==
*In most cases, Raerek will be the target of this quest. But it is possible, although highly unusual, to be directed to [[Skyrim:Reburrus_Quintilius|Reburrus Quintilius]] once he's the steward. In order to do so, however, you must have handed The Reach over to the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] without ever having entered Markarth or the immediate vicinity. If you've already entered the area around Markarth, Bothela will still refer to Raerek as the steward and expect you to deliver the potion to him. Note that [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)|Compelling Tribute]] forces you to enter Markarth to talk to Raerek, so Season Unending is the only way to get Reburrus.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
When visiting her shop during business hours, you can hear [[Skyrim:Ghorza gra-Bagol|Ghorza gra-Bagol]] berating the smithing skills of her hapless apprentice, [[Skyrim:Tacitus Sallustius|Tacitus Sallustius]]. She mentions a skill book, ''[[Skyrim:Last Scabbard of Akrash|Last Scabbard of Akrash]]'', that might teach him something. 

The marker points to [[Skyrim:Fort Sungard|Fort Sungard]], which is south of [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. The fort is well guarded by [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] and the book is in [[Skyrim:Fort Sungard Muster|Fort Sungard Muster]]. However, you do not need to retrieve this exact copy of the book; any copy will do. The other two locations are [[Skyrim:Gallows Rock|Gallows Rock]] and an unmarked area south-southeast of [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Lodge|Black-Briar Lodge]]. With the [[Skyrim:Bloodchill Manor|Bloodchill Manor]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]] installed, a copy can also be found on a shelf to the right of the [[Skyrim:Bloodchill Cavern|Manor]]'s smithing area. 

For retrieving the book, she will reward you with a free smithing lesson and will tell you that she is advising the [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc Strongholds]] that you can be trusted and that you should now be welcome in them.
