Skyrim:The Ghost of Old Hroldan.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Legoless }}{{About|the quest|the character|Ghost of Old Hroldan}} {{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors/Radiant |Giver=[[Skyrim:Eydis|Eydis]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Old Hroldan Inn|Old Hroldan Inn]], random dungeon |Reward=+1 in [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] and [[Skyrim:Block|Block]] |Image=SR-place-Old_Hroldan.jpg |Imgdesc=''"I've been waiting for you."'' |description=Put an [[Skyrim:Ghost of Old Hroldan|ancient ghost]] to rest. |ID=FreeformOldHroldanB |radiant=yes |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Eydis|Eydis]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Sleep at the [[Skyrim:Old Hroldan Inn|Old Hroldan Inn]]. #Speak to the ghost that appears. #Speak with [[Skyrim:Eydis|Eydis]]. #Go to the random dungeon and recover [[Skyrim:Hjalti's Sword|Hjalti's Sword]]. #Return the sword to the ghost for free training in [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] and [[Skyrim:Block|Block]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== '''''"Hjalti was a shrewd tactician, and his small band of Colovian troops and Nord berserkers broke the Reachman line, forcing them back beyond the gates of Old Hrol'dan. A siege seemed impossible, as Hjalti could expect no reinforcements from Falkreath."''''' ===Tiber Septim's Bed=== [[Skyrim:Old Hroldan Inn|Old Hroldan Inn]], the remote inn along the shores of [[Skyrim:Karth_River|Karth River]] in [[Skyrim:The Reach|the Reach]], holds an important place in history, at least according to innkeeper, [[Skyrim:Eydis|Eydis]]. As soon as you enter the taproom she will claim, ''"Old Hroldan is the stone that the Empire's history is built on"'' and will then ask if you want to rent [[Lore:Tiber Septim|Tiber Septim]]'s bed. When asked to elaborate Eydis will provide a lengthy description on the historical importance of Old Hroldan. She will explain the location marks Tiber Septim's first victorious battle when he liberated the area from barbarians during the Second Era. According to history, the victorious general then spent the night at the inn and his bed is still there, as good as new. Eydis charges a meager ten gold for renting out the venerable bed, so accept the offer and follow her to the room. Note the [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Battle of Sancre Tor|The Battle of Sancre Tor]]'' on the nightstand, then go to bed. ===Ghost of Old Hroldan=== [[File:SR-quest-The Ghost of Old Hroldan.jpg|thumb|right|''"You promised me, Hjalti."'']] When you wake up, you will hear Eydis scream in terror as the inn has received an unexpected visitor, namely the [[Skyrim:Ghost of Old Hroldan|Ghost of Old Hroldan]]. An alarmed Eydis will tell tales about Old Hroldan being haunted, but will not have definitive answers about the ghost or his purpose. Instead, go talk to the ghost who will confuse you with someone else: ''"Hjalti? Is that you? I've been waiting."''
''"I fought by your side. To take back the Reach from the savages."''
''"Do you remember me now, Hjalti?"'' When asked about why he is referring to you as 'Hjalti' he will remind you that the two of you fought together to free Hroldan, and that you promised to be his sworn brother. He then explains that he has waited an eternity for the sword that will fulfill the promise, but will not reveal anything else. ===Hjalti's Sword=== Ask Eydis about the sword, and once again, she knows her history. She will recall a legend about Tiber Septim attacking a camp right before heading to Hroldan. Her guess is that the sword will be at the camp. She will then mark a random location on your map, choosing from the following list: '''Possible Locations''': {{LinkList|Broken Tower Redoubt|Bruca's Leap Redoubt|Deepwood Redoubt|Dragon Bridge Overlook|Druadach Redoubt|Hag Rock Redoubt|Red Eagle Redoubt|Serpent's Bluff Redoubt|sep= • |ns_base=Skyrim}} If asked further, Eydis will speculate on the name 'Hjalti' and guess that it was one of the many names of Tiber Septim. She suggests that the ghost is one of Tiber Septim's dead soldiers. ===Sworn Brothers=== Luckily, Eydis' map marker will show you all the way to the boss-leveled chest in the depths of the random location. Once you have [[Skyrim:Hjalti's Sword|Hjalti's Sword]] return to Old Hroldan Inn and present the sword to the ghost. He will be most honored to become your 'sworn brother' after hundreds of years and reward you with a few lessons from the sword masters of [[Lore:Alcaire|Alcaire]]: a one-point bonus to your [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] and [[Skyrim:Block|Block]] skills. He will then disappear into thin air, confident that you travel along with him. '''''"That night a storm came and visited Hjalti's camp. It spoke with him in his tent. At dawn, Hjalti went up to the gates, and the storm followed just above his head. Arrows could not penetrate the winds around him. He shouted down the walls of Old Hrol'dan, and his men poured in. After their victory, the Nords called Hjalti Talos, or Stormcrown."''''' ==Notes== * A single internal name for a dialogue topic with Eydis, called FreeformOldHroldanBCuhlecainBranch, implies that at one point, the Ghost might've been meant to see you as [[Lore:Cuhlecain|Cuhlecain]], rather than Hjalti Early-Beard. * It is possible to acquire Hjalti's Sword in one of the potential spawn zones even before sleeping at Old Hroldan and starting the quest. The sword is flagged as a quest item until it is turned in. * After the quest is finished, Eydis will comment on the ghost's disappearance. * For more information about Hjalti and the Battle of Old Hrol'dan, see ''[[Lore: The_Arcturian_Heresy|The Arcturian Heresy]]''. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Eydis may still behave as though she has seen the ghost even after the quest has been completed.|USKP|2.0.3}} {{Bug|Despite the "Say Once" flag, Eydis may repeat her initial line about being frightened by the ghost even after the quest is finished.|USSEP|4.3.4}} {{Bug|If [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|With Friends Like These...]] is set to transport you to the [[Skyrim:Abandoned Shack|Abandoned Shack]] while this one is about to begin, this quest may be interrupted and potentially broken by the kidnapping scene.|USSEP|4.3.7|The fact that these happen to be the only two quests in the vanilla game that require you to sleep is likely why this went unnoticed for so long.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Bring Hjalti's Sword to the Ghost of Old Hroldan}} |missing=5, 10, 15, 100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]]

Skyrim:Climb the Steps.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Manic |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=The Silencer |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Klimmek|Klimmek]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:The Way of the Voice|The Way of the Voice]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]] |Reward=Leveled gold |Image=SR-quest-Climb The Steps.jpg |Imgdesc=The chest in front of the monastery |description=Deliver a load of goods up to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]] for [[Skyrim:Klimmek|Klimmek]]. |ID=FreeformIvarstead04 |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Klimmek|Klimmek]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak with Klimmek about his trips to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]. #Receive [[Skyrim:Klimmek's Supplies|Klimmek's Supplies]], and climb the steps to High Hrothgar. #Place supplies in indicated chest. #Return to Klimmek for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Klimmek's Problem=== [[File:SR-quest-Climb_the_Steps_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"I'm just not ready to make the climb to High Hrothgar."'']] When you arrive in [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]] for the first time, you will find [[Skyrim:Klimmek|Klimmek]] and [[Skyrim:Gwilin|Gwilin]] having a conversation on the bridge: '''Gwilin''': ''"On your way up the 7,000 Steps again, Klimmek?"''
'''Klimmek''': ''"Not today. I'm just not ready to make the climb to High Hrothgar. The path isn't safe."''
'''Gwilin''': ''"Aren't the Greybeards expecting some supplies?"''
'''Klimmek''': ''"Honestly, I'm not certain. I've yet to be allowed into the monastery. Perhaps one day."'' Apparently Klimmek makes a trip every few weeks up the 7,000 steps to High Hrothgar to deliver supplies to the [[Lore:Greybeards|Greybeards]], though he has never actually seen them in person. Unfortunately, he is now older, and finds the climb more difficult. You can choose to help him, with the promise of a reward. He will give you a bag of supplies and ask you to place them in a chest outside the High Hrothgar monastery. You can also ask Klimmek for advice on what to expect on the way, and he'll tell you that he's only had to deal with [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolves]]. He will, however, also tell you to watch your step, as the snow-capped stairs can be dangerous. ===Deliver the Goods=== If you have already discovered High Hrothgar, you may simply travel there. If not, you must climb the 7,000 steps leading out of Ivarstead and up the mountainside, encountering some [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolves]] and a [[Skyrim:Frost Troll|frost troll]] along the way. Once at the top of the 7,000 steps, you will see the monastery with a chest located in the center of a pair of stairwells that lead up to the building itself. Now just open the chest and place the supplies inside. Klimmek's supplies are found in the ''Misc'' section of the inventory. ===There and Back Again=== Once you have placed the supplies in the chest, return to Klimmek, who will compensate you for your leg work. He will give you a level-dependent amount of gold as a reward. {{SRLeveledReward|large}} ==Notes== *Klimmek's supplies will remain in the chest indefinitely. They can be taken and returned at any time, however doing so will not grant you any further reward. The supplies are also always persistent; placing them in the inventory of a corpse keeps them from despawning. *There are only about 700 steps on the way up to High Hrothgar, not 7,000. When walking, it takes approximately 2,400 footsteps from High Hrothgar to reach the base of the path. Walking 7,000 footsteps from High Hrothgar will actually bring you to the town center of Whiterun. *[[General:Todd Howard|Todd Howard]] jokingly mentioned in an interview that he would count all the steps leading up to High Hrothgar to make sure it's 7,000. *Gwilin can sometimes be killed by nearby bears. In that case, Klimmek will no longer be on the bridge and you will have to track him down in order to start the quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you drop Klimmek's supplies after completing the quest, they will hover in the air and can be used as a platform of sorts.|USKP|2.0.5}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Bring the supplies to High Hrothgar}} |200|fin| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|20|Return to Klimmek}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Talk to him and he will tell you about his stolen family heirloom, a bow. A few days ago, some thieves from Riften broke into his house and stole it. He is quite sure those [[Skyrim:Lowlife|lowlifes]] took the bow with them back to [[Skyrim:The Ratway|The Ratway]]. If you can head into the Ratway and get his bow back, he would pay you what he can. The Ratway is somewhere under Riften, these sewers and tunnels are inhabited by some [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]] and thugs. Pay attention to the traps at the same time. In order to retrieve the bow, you have to get into The Ratway Vaults. The only way to get to the vaults is through [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]] — the door is to the right of the bar. It's not necessary to join the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] to get access to the entrance. However, it would be a good choice to do this quest during [[Skyrim:Taking Care of Business|Taking Care of Business]]. You can find the bow in a chest in a room near the stairs, guarded by a Vagrant and a Lowlife. Return to Dravin after you get his bow. He will be very excited and reward you with five leveled gems. ''"I don't know how you got it back, and I don't want to know. Frankly, I don't even care... I'm just so glad to see it again."'' ==Notes== * Several side quests require a certain type of gem(s) so it may be worth making a save point just before talking to him. Loading a previous save will change the gems rewarded thus allowing you to choose, as long as you meet the level requirement for gems. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you enchant (and possibly also rename, confirmation needed) the bow, it may lose its quest item tag, and thus you can drop it normally.}} **This might only apply to Special Edition. {{Bug|If you enchant and rename the bow, its name may revert back to "Dravin's Bow." The enchantment remains unaffected.}} **This might only apply to Special Edition. {{Bug|If you find Dravin's Bow before being assigned the quest, you may be unable to return it to him even if he tells you about his stolen bow after you have found it.|USKP|1.2.1|You may need to save and reload to get the fix to work—using "Continue" from the main menu may not work.}} **{{Pc22}} If this occurs, you can use the console command setstage FreeformMerryfairFarm 30 to advance the quest to the correct stage, allowing you to complete it. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve Dravin's Bow}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Return Dravin's Bow}} |200|fin| |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak with [[SR:Balimund|Balimund]].
# Gather [[SR:Fire Salts|fire salts]].
# Return to Balimund.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
If you speak to [[Skyrim:Balimund|Balimund]] at his forge in the center of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] and ask him about how proud he is of his work, he will tell you that the forge is not as good as it used to be. It is supposed to run on [[Skyrim:Fire Salts|fire salts]], but they seem to be wearing off. He estimates that he needs ten fire salts to get the forge back to its original strength:

:'''You seem quite proud of your work.'''
:''"Smithing's been in my blood for generations. I owe my success to my forefathers and their recipe for flame. The secret is my forge. It consumes fire salts, a strange mineral that burns as hot as Red Mountain lava."''
:'''Impressive.'''
:''"Well, it was. Sadly, this forge is dying and I've used the last of my fire salts. If I can't feed it soon, it may grow cold."''
:'''I'll get some for you.'''
:''"You will? Thank you! Ten pinches of fire salts should give me all I need to bring this forge back to life."''
:'''Where can I find fire salts?'''
:''"A flame atronach's body might provide fire salt. They're dangerous creatures that can be summoned by wizards. Of course, it would be much easier to check with an alchemist. They occasionally have them for sale."''

Details on where to find fire salts are provided on the [[Skyrim:Fire Salts|ingredient page]]. 

Once you have ten salts, return to Balimund and receive a leveled amount of gold:
:'''I've found the fire salts for your forge.'''
:''"Amazing! These must have been very hard to come by. You've saved my business and warmed an old smith's heart. For that, I thank you."''

==Notes==
* Even though Balimund says that "only genuine" fire salts will work, they are not like the bloodgrass for the [[Oblivion:Vampire Cure|Vampirism Cure Quest in Oblivion]] (e.g. where bloodgrass purchased in a shop doesn't count). Instead, fire salts from any combination of sources will work—from [[Skyrim:Flame Atronach|flame atronach]]s, purchased from [[Skyrim:Merchants|merchants]], stolen, and/or crafted at the [[Skyrim:Atronach Forge|Atronach Forge]].
* Even though the in-game story is that the fire salts make the forge stronger, neither Balimund's merchant inventory nor the things you can craft at his forge receive any upgrade in quality after completing this quest. The amount of money in his store does increase, as if you had invested in his store (if you have already invested in it, or if you invest later, the two effects do not stack).

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Dreamshadow |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Dreamshadow |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Svana Far-Shield|Svana Far-Shield]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Haelga's Bunkhouse|Haelga's Bunkhouse]] |Reward=Enchanted Heavy Armor, Leveled Scroll |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Svana Far-Shield|Svana Far-Shield]]) |Image=SR-quest-Caught Red Handed.jpg |Imgdesc=''"My dear aunt, I'm ready to catch you."'' |description=Gather three marks of Dibella to help [[Skyrim:Svana_Far-Shield|Svana Far-Shield]] against [[Skyrim:Haelga|Haelga]]. |ID=FreeformRiften11 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Svana_Far-Shield|Svana Far-Shield]] in [[Skyrim:Haelga's Bunkhouse|Haelga's Bunkhouse]]. # Obtain the [[Skyrim:Mark of Dibella|Marks of Dibella]] from [[Skyrim:Bolli|Bolli]], [[Skyrim:Indaryn|Indaryn]], and [[Skyrim:Hofgrir_Horse-Crusher|Hofgrir]]. # Confront [[Skyrim:Haelga|Haelga]]. # Return to Svana. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Worshipper=== If you visit [[Skyrim:Haelga's Bunkhouse|Haelga's Bunkhouse]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], you may see [[Skyrim:Svana Far-Shield|Svana Far-Shield]] busy doing some cleaning there. The work is difficult and endless, and she prefers to call it slavery. Ever since her parents died and [[Skyrim:Haelga|Haelga]] took her in, it's been a nightmare. She was surprised to learn that Haelga is such a wretched woman. ''"So now I'm stuck living here while those pigs she calls customers grope me and say the most awful things."'' In her opinion, Haelga is disgusting and she takes her worship of [[Lore:Dibella|Dibella]] a bit too seriously. According to Svana, Haelga slept with three different men in the last month. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Alessandra|Alessandra]].

# Return to Alessandra.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Daughter's Path===
Alessandra is the priestess of [[Lore:Arkay|Arkay]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. She tends the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Riften)|Hall of the Dead]], located beneath the [[Skyrim:Temple of Mara|Temple of Mara]], by herself. When you speak with her, you will note a certain bitterness about her position: ''"I didn't ask for this job, I got stuck with it thanks to my father."'' Her father was a Priest of Arkay and it was his desire that she follow his footsteps. As a result, her entire life has been spent around the dead, learning the proper burial rituals and prayers. While she seems to have accepted her lot in life, albeit reluctantly, she feels the need to make peace with her father. Unfortunately, her father did not live to see his daughter become a priest. Alessandra holds her father's ceremonial dagger as well as the one she received when she did complete the training. She asks you to journey to the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Whiterun)|Hall of the Dead]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] (see [[#Bugs|Bugs]]) to place her ceremonial dagger with her father's remains, fulfilling her honor-bound obligation to him and making peace with his memory. The dagger needs to be delivered to [[Skyrim:Andurs|Andurs]], the caretaker at the Whiterun Hall of the Dead, who will inter it with her father's remains. If you agree to help her deliver the dagger, she'll appreciate your help and entrust you with it.

===The Pilgrimage===
Travel to Whiterun and talk to Andurs in the Hall of the Dead. Hand [[Skyrim:Alessandra's Dagger|Alessandra's dagger]] to him and he will be delighted to see she finally decided to return it to her father: ''"I will make sure this finds its way to his tomb as soon as possible. Thank you for bringing it, my child."''

Return to Alessandra and tell her that you have fulfilled her request. She will tell you she felt a caress on her cheek some time ago and she thinks it was a message from her father: ''"We've made peace with one another without even uttering a single word and I'm content for the first time in my life."'' She will then thank you for your selfless act, and tell you that you are welcome to come back and speak to her anytime.

The reward for this quest is one of the following five adept [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] spell tomes: [[Skyrim:Close Wounds|Close Wounds]], [[Skyrim:Greater Ward|Greater Ward]], [[Skyrim:Heal Other|Heal Other]], [[Skyrim:Repel Lesser Undead|Repel Lesser Undead]], and [[Skyrim:Turn Undead (spell)|Turn Undead]], though there are some [[Skyrim:Pilgrimage#Bugs|bugs]] with the quest reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Slain Wall===
Harrald is the son of Jarl [[Skyrim:Laila Law-Giver|Laila Law-Giver]] and lives in [[Skyrim:Mistveil Keep|Mistveil Keep]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. Take a look at him and you may find something strange. As the son of the jarl, he has only a dagger. If you ask him, he will tell you why: ''"I was practicing in the yard when the guard I was sparring with feinted when I specifically told him to duck! My blade bit right into the stonework next to the keep and needed serious repairs."'' He'd like you to fetch his blade from [[Skyrim:Balimund|Balimund]].

Talk to Balimund right outside [[Skyrim:The Scorched Hammer|The Scorched Hammer]], "a stone's throw" from the keep. He will give the sword to you and comment on Harrald's laziness and carelessness.

Hand over the sword to Harrald and he will be rather ungrateful. ''"Took your sweet time getting it to me. Here you go, for your trouble."'' He will then reward you with two [[Skyrim:Gems#Valuable Gems|leveled]] gems.

==Notes==
* Although this is not a [[Skyrim:Favors|favor quest]], it does count towards [[Skyrim:I Done Got Thaned!|becoming thane]].

==Quick Walkthrough==

#Induct these followers into the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Help Wanted===
[[File:SR-npc-Delphine 35.jpg|thumb|right|Delphine inducting [[Skyrim:Lydia|Lydia]] into the Blades]]
After completing [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]], you may notice that the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades']] mission of ridding Skyrim of [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]] may be rather daunting for just two people. Ask [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] about her apparent staffing shortage and she will reply, ''"The [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] hunted us down, remember? It wasn't exactly great for recruitment. But we have a headquarters of a sort now. We'll rebuild the Blades. Someday."'' As you are the [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dragonborn]], and the Blades are sworn to protect you, you might be inclined to help Delphine find new recruits. When you offer, she will say, ''"If you find anyone you think would make a good recruit, I can certainly take a look at them. Remember, though, being a Blade is a lifelong commitment. Their loyalty has to be with us once they're in."''

===Recruiting===
To recruit a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] into the Blades, simply bring your new recruit to Delphine in [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]] for introductions. Since being a Blade is binding, Delphine will ask you for confirmation: ''"Are you sure? I'll need to ask them to take an oath to leave their old life behind and stay here from now on."'' Confirm your selection and Delphine will agree. She will then give the oath to your first recruit:
{|class="hiddentable"
|- valign="top"
| '''Delphine''':  || ''"You there. The Dragonborn wishes to give you the chance to join the lost guardians of Tamriel. The dragon slayers. The Blades. Do you wish to become a Blade?"''
|-
| '''Follower''': || ''"I do."''
|- valign="top"
| '''Delphine''': || ''"Are you willing to trade away all claims and titles of your former life? To live here and devote yourself to protecting Tamriel from danger?"''
|-
| '''Follower''': || ''"I do."''
|- valign="top"
| '''Delphine''': || ''"Then by my right as acting grandmaster, I name you a Blade, with all the privileges, rights, and burdens that brings. Godspeed."''
|}

===Happy Hunting===
You can bring two more recruits to Delphine for the oath taking. After the third, she will say ''"That's enough recruits for now. Ask Esbern about the dragon lairs he's been studying. We'll have the recruits do some hunting with you."'' Speak to Esbern to complete the quest and begin the [[Skyrim:Dragon Hunting|Dragon Hunting]] repeatable quest.

==Notes==
*You can still ask recruited Blades to follow you, but they will be situated at Sky Haven Temple rather than their place of usual residence.
**If you induct your spouse into the Blades, then you can still move your spouse to a house you own. If you choose to live at your spouse's home, you will be directed to Sky Haven Temple.
*All [[Skyrim:Followers#Permanent_Followers|permanent followers]] are eligible to join the Blades except [[SR:Serana|Serana]] and those from the [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]].
*When a new recruit joins the Blades, they automatically leave your service, so a new follower can be recruited. Bugs affecting your ability to obtain new followers may be solved in this manner.
*Hirelings that join the Blades can be hired for free after they move to the temple.
*If one of the new recruits dies for whatever reason, they cannot be replaced by inducting another follower. As a mitigating factor, every recruit becomes a [[Skyrim:Protected NPCs|Protected NPC]]. To solve this issue, it is a strong strategic option to recruit [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential characters]], e.g. [[Skyrim:Frea|Frea]]{{DB}}, [[Skyrim:Mjoll the Lioness|Mjoll]], [[Skyrim:Erandur|Erandur]], etc.
*If the optional quest [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|Paarthurnax]] has started, you can still recruit followers for Delphine. When it comes time to talk to Esbern however, he will not finish this quest or start the Dragon Hunting quest until Paarthurnax is slain.
*Blades are forced to use [[Skyrim:Heavy_Armor|Heavy Armor]], [[Skyrim:Block|Block]], and [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]], so recruits who do not favor these skills will be at a disadvantage.
** With or without the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]], most of the player's [[Skyrim:Housecarl|Housecarls]] are good Blades candidates, specializing in the required skills with a level cap of 50 which is higher than most other followers. 
*** However recruiting them does effectively overwrite their role, leading to things such as the [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] Housecarls no longer defending their associated homes.
*** It's possible that [[Skyrim:Rayya|Rayya]] may lose her ability to [[Skyrim:Combat#Dual-wielding_2|dual wield]], but her class still includes Block as a skill. 
*** Without the patch [[Skyrim:Valdimar|Valdimar]] only lacks the Block skill, and may still be worth considering for his level cap and access to magic, with the patch he's changed to specialize in [[Skyrim:Light_Armor|Light Armor]] instead of Heavy Armor making him less suitable.
** With or without the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]], other good candidates with their listed level caps are [[SR:Borgakh the Steel Heart|Borgakh the Steel Heart]] (30), [[SR:Celann|Celann]] (No Level Cap), [[SR:Golldir|Golldir]] (30), [[SR:Kharjo|Kharjo]] (30), [[SR:Ogol|Ogol]] (30), [[SR:Ria|Ria]] (25), and [[SR:Torvar|Torvar]] (25).
*** Without the patch: [[SR:Athis|Athis]] (25), [[SR:Cosnach|Cosnach]] (30), [[SR:Uthgerd the Unbroken|Uthgerd the Unbroken]] (30), and [[SR:Vorstag|Vorstag]] (40).
*** With the patch: [[SR:Adelaisa Vendicci|Adelaisa Vendicci]] (25), [[SR:Erik the Slayer|Erik the Slayer]] (40), and [[SR:Ghorbash the Iron Hand|Ghorbash the Iron Hand]] (30).
** With or without the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]], the [[SR:Ghosts of the Tribunal|Ghosts of the Tribunal]] [[SR:Creation Club|Creation]] add three very ideal Blades candidates, having level caps of 100 with the required skills: [[Skyrim:Hand_Ethra_Mavandas|Hand Ethra Mavandas]], [[Skyrim:Hand_Kydren_Indobar|Hand Kydren Indobar]], and [[Skyrim:Vesparth_the_Toe|Vesparth the Toe]].

Skyrim:Dragon Research.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=125.79.102.141 |checkedBy= |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]] {{Quest Header |Giver= |Loc= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Dragon Hunting|Dragon Hunting]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Esbern's Potion|Esbern's Potion]] |Image=SR-creature-Dragon Dead.jpg |Imgdesc=Now for the harvest |description=Help [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] complete his research on [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]]. |ID=FreeformSkyHavenTempleD }} ==Quick Walkthrough== * Speak with [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]]. * Acquire a [[Skyrim:Dragon_Bone|dragon bone]] and a [[Skyrim:Dragon_Scales|dragon scale]]. * Return to Esbern. * Drink the [[Skyrim:Esbern's Potion|potion]]. * Speak with Esbern once more to complete the quest. ==Detailed Walkthrough== Once you have three followers recruited as [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]], you can ask [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] for [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]] to kill. Once you agree to kill one, Esbern will send you to a random place where you'll find a dragon. After you kill the dragon, you'll get the update to the quest stating "Return to Esbern". Return and speak to him; he'll ask for a [[Skyrim:Dragon_Bone|dragon bone]] and a [[Skyrim:Dragon_Scales|dragon scale]]. Give him the dragon bone and scale and he'll give you a [[Skyrim:Esbern's Potion|potion]]. Drink the potion to gain the [[Skyrim:Dragon Infusion|Dragon Infusion]] perk. Speak with him once more to complete the quest. The potion adds the permanent perk of 25% less melee damage from dragons. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You do not gain the perk after drinking the potion and it is not obtainable via normal gameplay means.|OSP|1.9}} {{Bug|The quest journal entry won't update after quest completion.|USKP|1.0}} **{{Ps22}}{{Xbox22}} If you don't want an uncompleted quest stuck in their quest log, you have the opportunity to back out of dialogue with Esbern after the 'Talk to Esbern' objective but before you inquire about a dragon location. Note: This bug does not appear to be present in the Anniversary Edition.{{VN|how is this affected by the [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax_(quest)|Paarthurnax]] quest?}} **{{Pc22}} '''Workaround''' - Basically, you must ''not'' give the dragon's bone and scale to Esbern; use console commands instead. There are three contexts to consider, each with its own solution: the first one is before returning to Esbern, the second one is before turning-in the dragon's scale and bone asked by Esbern, and the third one is after getting the potion (after giving the dragon's scale and bone). ***'''Before returning to Esbern''' - You killed the dragon and got a new journal entry stating "Return to Esbern". Use the console to add the perk : player.addspell 000F5FFA. From then on, you won't be asked to retrieve a dragon's scale and bones and thus won't receive the resulting potion (it seems that one condition for triggering the quest is set by detecting that you don't have the perk yet). ***'''Before turning-in a dragon's scale and bone (recommended)''' - You've returned to Esbern and told him that the dragon is dead, which triggered a new quest requiring a dragon's bone and scale. In the console, type: ***:{{Pre|width=auto|player.addspell 000F5FFA SetObjectiveCompleted FreeFormSkyHavenTempleD 10 1}} ***'''After giving bone and scale to Esbern''' - The quest has already been started and it's supposed to be completed, but the journal entry is still there : you've given the dragon's bone and scale and thus received the potion, however without any effect after you drank it since it has a bug (no perk imbued). You must first reset the quest so as to start it over again, then add the perk to your powers, and finally clear the entry from your journal with the quest set as "completed". In the console, type: ***:{{Pre|width=auto|ResetQuest FreeFormSkyHavenTempleD SetStage FreeFormSkyHavenTempleD 10 player.addspell 000F5FFA SetObjectiveCompleted FreeFormSkyHavenTempleD 10 1}} ***'''How to fix/finish this quest?''' - Set quest as "completed". In the console, type: ***:{{Pre|width=auto|SetStage FreeFormSkyHavenTempleD 100 }} {{Bug|You can get Esbern's Potion quest line without recruiting any Blades. However, it will not be titled "Dragon Research" and is located in Miscellaneous Quests. After completing Alduin's Wall (also may happen before you even visit Esbern), killing a dragon at a defined radiant location (such as a word wall) will trigger the objective "Return to Esbern". Speaking to Esbern then triggers "Give a Dragon Scale and a Dragon Bone to Esbern". When you give them to him, he will give you Esbern's Potion.|USKP|1.2.5}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Bring a Dragon Scale and a Dragon Bone to Esbern}} |missing=100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

They each have an item which identifies them (e.g. [[Skyrim:Rundi's Dagger|Rundi's Dagger]]), which you would have had to bring to Phinis to prove their fate. The students' corpses and items appear and Phinis Gestor will talk about them, but bringing the items to him has no effect. {{Journal Entries |name=The Missing Apprentices |id=FreeformWinterholdCollegeB |200|fin| |missing=10, 20 }} ==Daedric== ===Boethiah's Bidding=== This would have been a second quest given to you by [[Lore:Boethiah|Boethiah]], which functioned more as a secondary task. The "quest" would start immediately after completing [[Skyrim:Boethiah's Calling|Boethiah's Calling]] by killing [[Skyrim:Champion of Boethiah|her previous champion]] and equipping the [[Skyrim:Ebony Mail|Ebony Mail]]. Instead of Boethiah congratulating you, she would instead inform you of your new objective, assassinating the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]] using stealth, deceit and guile. Boethiah would've spread rumors of an assassin coming for the jarl, and she would lock herself into her private chambers out of paranoia. The whole [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] would go on high alert. You would not be able to walk around inside without constant supervision. Due to this, a guard would constantly accompany you while walking around, unless you could convince a friend inside the Palace to escort you instead. Access to the jarl's private chambers could be granted in two ways. You could either get a key to the door from either [[Skyrim:Erdi|Erdi]] or [[Skyrim:Una|Una]], the two servants, or you could request help from a friend who would convince Elisif to let you inside her chamber in order to function as her personal bodyguard. Possible friends that could help you with the latter option include steward [[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]], court wizard [[Skyrim:Sybille Stentor|Sybille Stentor]], housecarl [[Skyrim:Bolgeir Bearclaw|Bolgeir Bearclaw]], thane [[Skyrim:Bryling|Bryling]], her personal guard [[Skyrim:Irnskar Ironhand|Irnskar Ironhand]], thane [[Skyrim:Erikur|Erikur]]'s personal guard [[Skyrim:Melaran|Melaran]], but also Erikur's sister [[Skyrim:Gisli|Gisli]] (who normally doesn't set foot in the Blue Palace under any circumstances) and the Palace's cook, [[Skyrim:Odar|Odar]]. Once Elisif was slain, Boethiah would use her body as a conduit in order to speak with you. She would tell you that you've earned her respect and will be allowed to keep the Ebony Mail. With Solitude's jarl dead, many events would be set in motion. Many of these events had dialogue already recorded for them and include:
*An alternate version of a scene between Bryling and Falk, discussing Erikur. *New comments for both Solitude guards and Stormcloak-aligned guards. *An alternate version of the scene where [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] and [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] discuss the Jagged Crown. *An alternate version of the conversation prior to killing [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] during [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], where [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] says that he has sent men to round up Erikur. *Erikur pledging allegiance to [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] during the final victory speech during [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]], in place of Elisif. The most important consequence to the act would've been the fact that a new jarl would need to be chosen. Thane Erikur would be the one to replace Elisif, with him gaining new dialogue related to this as well. He would also give you the ability to, for one time only, completely erase your bounty in Haafingar by just talking to him. In the final game, however, Elisif will always be essential, and Boethiah's quest will have no influence over her at all. ====Notes==== *It seems that at one point, Gisli was considered as a steward for Solitude, this may explain her inclusion as one of the possible "friends" who are almost always found at the Blue Palace. *Outside of the examples mentioned above, no replacement scenarios exist for other quests where Elisif would've been involved, for example [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]]. *Both Erdi and Una have dialogue in relation to the scene that would've played out if you took the bodyguard route, instead of their route. This is odd since they do not have recorded dialogue for the other dialogue options. *Script notes indicate that Erikur would've been aware that it was you who assassinated Elisif. You would've started this quest by talking to [[Skyrim:Chief Burguk|Chief Burguk]], who at this point was called Chief Yashnag instead: :'''Anything I can do for the Stronghold?''' :''"I finally have an idea that will make Shugurzbur a place to be feared. Have you heard of the {{sic|[[Skyrim:Forsworn Briarheart|Briar-Hearts]]|Briarhearts|description=inconsistent spelling}}? Strange magic created by [[Skyrim:Hagraven|Hagravens]]. I'm told that if you eat one, you gain the strength of ten Orcs. Bring me one. There is a nest nearby you can scavenge."'' :'''I've brought you a {{sic|Briar-Heart|Briarheart|description=inconsistent spelling}}.''' :''"Ugh. It looks sharp. Oh well, an idea is an idea. Tastes... chewy. Yuck. I've eaten real [[Skyrim:Human Heart|hearts]] better than this. Strange. I don't feel any stronger. I... I think I need to lie down. Oh, wait. Yes. For you. Here. The stronghold thanks you, outlander."'' ===FreeformWinterholdB=== The only remnant of this quest is a single script called FreeformWinterholdBScript. The script contains almost nothing of note, only a property to count books. Its exact function is unknown. ===MS01A=== MS01 is [[Skyrim:The Forsworn Conspiracy|The Forsworn Conspiracy]], and it seems like this quest originally had multiple sub-quests attached to it. As part of your investigation, you would've had to follow up on three different leads. This quest would've had you look into the involvement of the smelter worker Omluag. Very little actually remains of this particular quest. In the final game, there is a singular reference made to it, found in the name of the ref called MS01ASmelterPlansREF inside the [[Skyrim:Smelter Overseer's House|Smelter Overseer's House]]. Despite its name, this ref does not link to any smelter plans, but instead to the [[Skyrim:Sluice Gate Key|sluice gate key]], a useless key internally known as MS01OmluagKey. In the DialogueViews files, there exists one blank dialogue topic by the name of MS01AHathrasilGreetBranchTopic, implying [[Skyrim:Hathrasil|Hathrasil]], co-worker of Omluag, to be involved in the quest as well, but it's unknown to what end. ===FreeformMarkarthM1=== This quest, despite its name, is actually related to The Forsworn Conspiracy, and is not a freeform quest. In fact, it seems to be a more finalized version of quest MS01A, with most of its dialogue still intact. Originally, [[Skyrim:Eltrys|Eltrys]] was meant to give you the names of three people he suspected of having Forsworn ties, and Omluag would be among them. All three of these people could be investigated. If you went to investigate Omluag, you would come across a note in his room in the Warrens, which contained a plan to blow up the smelter at which he works. ===MS01B=== This quest would've started after witnessing a scene between Uaile and Nepos. The only leftover of it is a marker related to said scene, MS01BUaileNeposTrigger. In this quest, you would help Uaile to try and free her father, [[Skyrim:Uraccen|Uraccen]], from his false imprisonment in [[Skyrim:Cidhna Mine|Cidhna Mine]]. ===FreeformMarkarthM3=== Unlike the previous duo of quests, this quest does not seem like a finalized version of the previous Uaile-centric one. Instead, it is once again an investigation-related subquest for The Forsworn Conspiracy. If you went to investigate Uaile, you would come across her diary, which contained indications that she was planning to kill Nepos for the abuse he put her through. You could then confront her with her diary.£ ===MS01C=== Not much remains of this quest. In the final game's files, there are only two unused, empty containers which still bear its name; Rhiada's Wardrobe, internally known as MS01CRhiadasWardrobe, and Ildene's Wardrobe, internally known as MS01CIldenesWardrobe. In the DialogueViews files there are also three blank dialogue topics to be found. One for Eltrys: MS01CEltrysTalkBranch, and two for Nana Ildene: MS01CIldeneGreetBranch and MS01CIdleneQuestionsConspiracy. Besides this, there are no other leftovers to hint at what this quest would've been like. ===FreeformMarkarthM2=== With what little we do know of MS01C, we can assume that this quest is once again the more finalized version of the part where you had to investigate Nana Ildene. In the final game, there are two markers, FreeformMarkarthM2IldeneMarkerREF, FreeformMarkarthM2BothelaMarkerREF, and a trigger FreeformMarkarthM2BothelaSceneTrigger leftover. These are tied to either the scene that would've started this part, or more likely, a scene that would've played out near the start of your investigation, between Bothela and Ildene. If you went to investigate Ildene, you would come across her switching notes with Bothela. After you convinced Bothela to give you the note, you could then read it to find out that Ildene had plans of killing all the Silver-Bloods at the Treasury House. You could then confront her with your findings: ===V01=== The first of three apparent quests that were related to [[Skyrim:Vampirism|vampirism]]. In this quest, you would've had to steal an item known as the '''Bloodfire Amulet''' from somewhere. It's also implied that you would've awoken at [[Skyrim:Cronvangr Cave|Cronvangr Cave]], which at this point might've still been called '''Cronvangr Hall''', its earlier name. Possibly from a vampirism-induced dream, as implied by the [[Skyrim:Test Cells|vampire dream world]] leftover cells. ===V02=== In this quest, you would've gone to Solitude, in order to murder [[Skyrim:DomnaMagia|DomnaMagia]], another apparent vampire. She is still placed inside the Solitude world, but permanently disabled. ===V03=== In this apparent final quest, you would've had to take down one of the leaders of the two opposing clans, the Cronvangr and Quarra clans (the latter of which first appeared in ''[[Morrowind:Morrowind|Morrowind]]''). The Cronvangr vampires would've operated out of Cronvangr Cave and would've been led by someone called '''Vlkoslak'''. While the Quarra vampires' leader was called '''Jelkar''', and they called [[Skyrim:Pinemoon Cave|Pinemoon Cave]] their home. ===WE21=== A random quest of the "World Event" variation. In the final game, its only leftover is a script called WE21NPCScript. The script shows that you were meant to encounter an NPC in bleedout state (on their knees on the ground), and you would need to heal them through whatever means you had at your disposal. Relevant dialogue is present in the DialogueViews files only. ===WE26=== Nothing remains of this quest at all. It's only known of due to being missing from the finalized lineup. ===WE30=== In this event, you would've met a random [[Skyrim:Alchemist|alchemist]]. They still exist in NPC form with the Editor ID WE30Alchemist as the quest's only remnant. Nothing else is known about it. ==Unused Knotwork== The following quest knotwork is not used in the game. It is not possible to assign this knotwork to quests in the Creation Kit. {| |[[File:SR-qico-Favor.png|x40px]] || [[Skyrim:Favors|Favors]] |} {{Skyrim Cut Content}}

Hard (Dawnguard Side Only) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]. # Explore [[Skyrim:Castle Volkihar|Castle Volkihar]]. # Investigate the Moondial. # Explore Castle Volkihar's Ruined Tower. # Locate Valerica's Journal. # (If not a vampire) Become a [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|Vampire Lord]] or get partially soul trapped. # Enter the [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== {|class=hiddentable style="float:right; margin:0" |valign=top| {{Perk Tree Setup|width=200|mark_color=White|text_color=black|font_size=80|mark_width=22}}{{Perk Tree |label=Locations of the missing crests on a map of Castle Volkihar Courtyard |image=SR-map-Castle_Volkihar_Courtyard.jpg |float=right |perks= {{Image Mark|820|498|Half|position=on|}} {{Image Mark|251|342|Full|position=on|}} {{Image Mark|910|450|Cres|position=on|}} }} |} [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] will speak to you after the [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Moth Priest]] reads the Elder Scroll, saying she may know where to find one of the scrolls. She thinks her mother, [[Skyrim:Valerica|Valerica]], may have information on it, and may even possess it. Serana believes Valerica may have left a clue in the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Courtyard|courtyard]] at [[Skyrim:Castle Volkihar|Castle Volkihar]]. Though you will not be able to enter through the Keep, Serana knows of a secret entrance you can use. If you have a follower at this point, you must dismiss them. Simply telling them to wait is not enough: Serana won't accompany you unless you send your follower home. When you reach the castle, head northwest, along the coastline. When you reach the castle's old docks, you will be attacked by four high-powered [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]]. Use the secret entrance to the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Undercroft|undercroft]] and fight your way through [[Skyrim:Death Hound|death hounds]], [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]], skeletons, and a [[Skyrim:Feral Vampire|feral vampire]]. After dealing with the vampire, you will arrive at a stone archway with a raised drawbridge. Head up a set of stairs on the opposite corner of the room to find the lever needed to lower the bridge. Cross the bridge and take a left as instructed by Serana: this leads into an open area inhabited by death hounds. Climb the stairs in the southern section and pass through a tunnel leading to a room with a [[Skyrim:Giant Frostbite Spider|giant frostbite spider]]. You can snipe at the spider from the tunnel, as it's too large to enter the tunnel. Once you've dispatched it, pull a lever to lower another bridge, giving you access to the courtyard. The [[Skyrim:Volkihar Courtyard|courtyard]] itself is abandoned and derelict, and Serana will immediately tell you there is something wrong with the moon dial. You will need to find the three missing pieces and place them in the moon dial in order for a secret entrance to open. * The [[Skyrim:Half Moon Crest|Half Moon Crest]] is in the center of a pond lying against a rock in the northwest corner of the courtyard. * The [[Skyrim:Full Moon Crest|Full Moon Crest]] is behind a patch of nightshade lying against the castle's exterior wall in the fenced off area identified as Valerica's garden. * The [[Skyrim:Crescent Moon Crest|Crescent Moon Crest]] is up the stairs, to the right of the entrance to [[Skyrim:Volkihar North Tower|Volkihar North Tower]] lying on the floor beside a table and chairs. [[File:SR-quest-Chasing Echoes 05.jpg|thumb|right|Serana opening the portal to the Soul Cairn]] Once all pieces are back in place, the dial will swivel to reveal steps leading down to the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Ruins|ruins]] below the castle. Fight your way past more [[Skyrim:Gargoyle|gargoyles]] and skeletons until you reach a room with gargoyles and a fireplace. Serana will tell you there must be a secret entrance somewhere, and sure enough, you can either turn the candlestick near the fireplace or pull the chain behind the gargoyle to reveal a secret door. Note that pulling the chain will unleash the stone gargoyle. There is also a [[Skyrim:Vampire Royal Armor|vampire royal armor]] near the shelf to the right. Head through the secret door to [[Skyrim:Valerica's Study|Valerica's study]]. Here you will need to search for her [[Skyrim:Valerica's Journal|journal]], in the central bookcase west of where you entered. After Serana reads it, she will tell you to find certain ingredients in the laboratory: * The [[Skyrim:Finely Ground Bone Meal|Finely Ground Bone Meal]] is on the table by the entrance beneath the mammoth skull. * The [[Skyrim:Soul Gem Shards|Soul Gem Shards]] are on the first wardrobe up the stairs that lead east. * The [[Skyrim:Purified Void Salts|Purified Void Salts]] are on a shelf with other ingredients, near the farthest point of the raised area of the room, on the balcony above the entrance. All of these items are in silver bowls, and will be added to your miscellaneous inventory when you pick them up, as they are considered quest items. Note that "regular" [[Skyrim:Bonemeal|bonemeal]], [[Skyrim:Soul Gem Fragment|soul gem fragments]], and [[Skyrim:Void Salts|void salts]] will not work. Once you have all three, place them in the vessel in front of the portal, which Serana is typically standing next to. She will then add her blood to the mixture, opening a portal to the [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]]. If you are vampire (whether by siding with the Volkihar or through "regular" infection when siding with the Dawnguard), you will be able to enter straight away. If you are not a vampire, you will suffer some health damage when attempting to use the portal. Serana will explain that to enter the Soul Cairn you must be "dead" and then give you a choice: * Allow her to turn you into a [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|Vampire Lord]]. * Allow her to trap part of your soul in a soul gem. **This is the only way to enter the Soul Cairn without becoming a vampire and will add the [[Skyrim:Weakened Soul|Weakened Soul]] effect, which reduces your health, stamina, and magicka by 45 points (as well as their regeneration rates) while in the Soul Cairn ([[Skyrim:Beyond Death|click here]] or [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|here]] for workarounds). Choosing either will allow you to enter the Soul Cairn. ==Gallery== File:SR-quest-Chasing Echoes 02.jpg|Half Moon Crest File:SR-quest-Chasing Echoes 03.jpg|Full Moon Crest File:SR-quest-Chasing Echoes 04.jpg|Crescent Moon Crest ==Notes== *Before entering the Cairn, you can exit the laboratory through a door in the southern corner. This leads to the ''Castle Volkihar Balcony'', a small outside area from which you can fast-travel and then return to the Soul Cairn without having to traverse the castle ruins and courtyard again. A foot chest near the door also provides easy access to a container to stash loot while fast-travelling. **If you exit before deciding whether to be become a Vampire Lord or have your soul captured, Serana will remain in the study, even if you fast travel. This presents a small window of opportunity to acquire two followers: leave the castle grounds, recruit a follower and return. Though your new follower won't enter the Castle, they will not be dismissed, and once you complete [[Skyrim:Beyond Death|Beyond Death]] they will continue following you, as will Serana. This allows you to have two followers for the rest of the game. **If playing on [[Skyrim:Survival Mode|Survival Mode]] (which disables fast travel), the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] Shout can allow the balcony exit to remain a shortcut outside by jumping off the ledge. Otherwise you'll have to backtrack through the dungeons to go back outside. * Choosing to become a Vampire Lord and then returning to Fort Dawnguard will prompt [[Skyrim:Florentius Baenius|Florentius]], [[Skyrim:Sorine Jurard|Sorine]], or [[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]] to direct you to [[Skyrim:Falion|Falion]], thus beginning the quest [[Skyrim:Rising at Dawn|Rising at Dawn]]. Other Dawnguard members, including [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]], will regard you with caution and disgust. You will not be able to use the Dawnguard's services until you cure yourself. * While this quest or [[Skyrim:Beyond Death|Beyond Death]] are active, you will be unable to dismiss Serana from your party. If you are on the Dawnguard side and a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolf]], it can be challenging to use Beast Form and have the Savage Feeding perk as Serana tends to raise corpses in battle. This prevents you from feeding unless you manage to feed on raised corpses after they die again but before they turn into a pile of ash. * From the courtyard you have access to two more zones of the castle - the [[Skyrim:Volkihar East Tower|east]] and [[Skyrim:Volkihar North Tower|north]] towers - which contain further loot. * Serana may repeat dialogue about her mother being on the other side of the portal if you should decide to leave the ruins before entering the portal. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When asked to put the ingredients inside the vessel, they will be removed from your inventory, but the vessel will not be filled, and Serana will keep telling you to put the ingredients in, causing the quest to be unfinishable.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} It is possible to manually advance to the next stage of the quest by opening the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] and typing setstage DLC1VQ04 75 . **{{Pc22}} This can also be caused by multi-follower mods. Typing 'set playerfollowercount to 0' will let the quest continue normally. Once back out of the Soul Cairn set the value back to the number of followers you have. {{Bug|When asked to speak to Serana after putting the ingredients inside the vessel, speaking to Serana does not advance the quest.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} It is possible to manually advance to the next stage of the quest by returning to a previous save before the items were placed into the pedestal and enter the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] and typing setstage DLC1VQ04 80. {{Bug|Dead Thralls cannot enter the Volkihar Courtyard. Entering the Courtyard can cause the thrall(s) to vanish from the game after returning from the Soul Cairn. Kill and leave the bodies of the thrall(s) in a safe place before entering the Courtyard.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|When Serana asks for the journal, it might not be removed from your inventory.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ** It can be dropped or stored once you rescue her mother and return from the Soul Cairn. {{Bug|You may not be able to enter the Soul Cairn.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} Open the console and type set DLC1VQ04SoulTrapped to 1. {{Bug|It is possible to get stuck in a loop where Serana tries to turn you into a vampire if you had previously elected to become a vampire and then for some reason did not enter the Soul Cairn to advance the quest.|USSEP|4.3.6|The script call that actually performs the bite has been moved from Stage 110 into the dialogue topic itself, which will run whether you'd done this portion before or not.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Dexion's reading of the Elder Scroll has given rise to more questions than answers. The Moth Priest saw a vision of a weapon called Auriel's Bow, but Serana and I need to locate two more Elder Scrolls in order to unravel the rest of the prophecy. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak to Serana}} |20:2||Serana has indicated her desire to locate her estranged mother, Valerica, who had fled Castle Volkihar with one of the Elder Scrolls. She believes that Valerica may have left a clue to her whereabouts somewhere in the courtyard of the castle. In order to avoid detection by Harkon, we've decided to utilize a hidden entrance on the back side of the island. {{Quest Objective|20|Explore Castle Volkihar's Courtyard}} |^||Serana has indicated her desire to locate her estranged mother, Valerica, who had fled Castle Volkihar with one of the Elder Scrolls. She believes that Valerica may have left a clue to her whereabouts somewhere in the courtyard of the castle. In order to avoid detection by the castle's vampires, we've decided to utilize a hidden entrance on the back side of the island. {{Quest Objective|20|Explore Castle Volkihar's Courtyard}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Investigate the moondial}} |35||Serana and I are trying to locate her mother, Valerica, who may have one of the Elder Scrolls. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak with [[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]].
# Kill the boss at the [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] lair.
# Report back to Gunmar.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Gunmar will inform you that he has discovered a vampire lair and will task you with eliminating its head vampire. While you only need to kill the boss vampire in order to scatter its minions, he heartily recommends you thoroughly cleanse the lair of all vampires and thralls. He will then mark a random [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Vampire_Lairs|vampire lair]] on your map.

Travel to the location and dispose of the vampire boss and other enemies. Once you are done, return to Gunmar for your reward: a leveled enchanted item.

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Quantheory |reward=RobinHood70 |rewardChecked= }}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Miscellaneous}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Elder Othreloth|Elder Othreloth]] |Reward=Leveled gold |Disp= =1([[SR:Elder Othreloth|Elder Othreloth]]) |Rep= |Prev= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Temple|Raven Rock Temple]], [[Skyrim:Temple Ancestral Tomb|Temple Ancestral Tomb]] |Image=SR-quest-Clean Sweep.jpg |ImgDesc=An ash spawn emerging from an ash pit |description=Clear the [[Skyrim:Temple Ancestral Tomb|Temple Ancestral Tomb]] of [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]]. |ID=DLC2RRFavor03 |Icon= |SuggLevel=20 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Speak to [[Skyrim:Elder Othreloth|Elder Othreloth]] at [[Skyrim:Temple|Raven Rock Temple]]. # Clear the [[Skyrim:Temple Ancestral Tomb|Temple Ancestral Tomb]] of [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]]. # Return to Othreloth. == Detailed Walkthrough == === Elder Othreloth === In the [[Skyrim:Temple|Temple]] of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], the residing priest [[Skyrim:Elder Othreloth|Elder Othreloth]] has a huge problem with the [[Skyrim:Temple Ancestral Tomb|Ancestral Tomb]] underneath the temple. While patrolling around Raven Rock between 1pm and 7pm, Second Councilor [[Skyrim:Adril Arano|Adril Arano]] may visit the chapel and receive yet another complaint by the troubled priest: [[File:SR-quest-Clean Sweep 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"When are you going to do something about our central Ancestral Tomb?"'']] '''Adril''': ''"You wanted to speak to me, Elder?"''
'''Othreloth''': ''"I did indeed. When are you going to do something about our central Ancestral Tomb? I can't even go down there any longer. It's getting intolerable!"''
'''Adril''': ''"I'm sorry, Elder. I'm doing the best I can."''
'''Othreloth''': ''"I appreciate your problems, Adril, but I can't be expected to run a temple with those... things running around in there."''
'''Adril''': ''"With all due respect, those "things" aren't the only problem we have right now. Be patient, keep the door locked, and we'll get there when we can."''
'''Othreloth''': ''"Hmph. Very well. I'll just have to find someone else to assist us then."'' With the authorities too busy to help him out, Elder Othreloth will have no choice but to lure adventurers like you to help him. When he sees you he will ask: ''"Are you here to pray, or perhaps pay your respects at our Ancestral Tomb?"'' When you ask him what the tomb is, he will immediately request some assistance and provide some background information in the process: ''"They are where we inter our dead. They are sacred places, meant to honor their passing. Sadly, we've been unable to use the Ancestral Tomb beneath the Temple as of late, and have resorted to other locations to scatter the remains."'' He will then proceed to explain that [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]] have taken over the tomb, making it impossible to perform proper burial rituals. Offer to help him out and he will hand you the [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Tomb Key|key]] to the tomb and wish you the best of luck. === Cleanse the Tomb === Head downstairs and unlock the door to the tomb with the key. Once inside, the problem soon manifests itself, as a total of eleven hostile ash spawn will crawl out of the various huge ceremonial urns with the ashes of the ancestors. They will surface one by one at first, then two at a time. While most will be regular ash spawn, two of those that spawn near the end are leveled. Dispose of them all as quickly as possible, because they can easily gang up on you. If necessary, exit the tomb through any of the doors to restore your health; the ash spawn cannot follow you. Lower-level players will find the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout useful to avoid damage when carrying out hit-and-run attacks. When all is said and done, loot the ash piles as they have a chance of carrying valuable loot, then leave the tomb and return to Othreloth. When presented with the good news, Othreloth will exclaim: ''"Spirits be praised! I'm hoping you didn't suffer much at the hands of those foul beings. Please, accept this as a token of my thanks."'' He will then hand you a reward, a leveled amount of gold. === Reward === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; margin:0.5em 0;" ! Levels !! == Quick Walkthrough ==

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
===The Briarhearts===
When you ask [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] if you can help him with his research, he may respond: ''"I've been having difficulties with my heart stone experiments. Have you heard of the Briarhearts? They are fierce warriors of the Forsworn tribes. They actually remove their own hearts, and replace them with large briar seeds. It puts their lifesparks in direct connection to the natural forces. I need you to examine one of them. Just investigate as much as you can. I'm going to put this memory trace spell on you, so you won't have to worry about taking notes. I doubt you could know what was important anyway."'' He then reveals that he has been experimenting with similar theories but all his test subjects died in the process. Lastly, he will point you towards Skyrim and [[Skyrim:The Reach|The Reach]] to find a specimen in a [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] hideout. Before you leave, he will cast [[Skyrim:Neloth's Memory Spell|Neloth's Memory Spell]] so you can remember what you observe.

===Harvest a Heart===
You will have to travel all the way back to Skyrim, so hire the boat in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] or simply fast travel to [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. Then go west to the Reach, where hold capital [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] has its fair share of problems with the Forsworn. They can be found in most locations where the Forsworn have set up camp, such as [[Skyrim:Lost Valley Redoubt|Lost Valley Redoubt]], [[Skyrim:Broken Tower Redoubt|Broken Tower Redoubt]], or [[Skyrim:Hag Rock Redoubt|Hag Rock Redoubt]]. After you have killed a Forsworn Briarheart you will be given two options, either "Harvest" or "Search". Choose "Harvest" and the quest will update and tell you to return to Neloth on Solstheim.

===Extracting Memories===
Back in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]], a trio of [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]] will be waiting outside to attack upon your return.  Inside his [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|tower]], Neloth will be awaiting your arrival. When you tell him you examined the Briarheart warrior, he will comment: ''"Oh have you? Well, let me just extract those memories and I'll see if you found anything useful. I promise that any unrelated memories I run across will be kept in the strictest of confidences. Here, you deserve a bit of reward for your efforts... that was a lengthy trip for you, I'm sure!"'' He will then hand you 250 gold for all your hard work and the time you spent traveling back and forth.

==Notes==
*Pickpocketing a Forsworn Briarheart for its briar heart will not give you the option to "Harvest" when trying to loot its body. You must kill it in another way.

== Quick Walkthrough ==
# Use the [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] to cleanse the [[Skyrim:Beast Stone|Beast Stone]].
# Use the Bend Will shout to cleanse the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]].
# Use the Bend Will shout to cleanse the [[Skyrim:Sun Stone|Sun Stone]].
# Use the Bend Will shout to cleanse the [[Skyrim:Water Stone|Water Stone]].

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
With the [[Skyrim:Wind Stone|Wind Stone]] cleansed, return to [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] and tell [[Skyrim:Storn Crag-Strider|Storn Crag-Strider]] the good news. He will suggest you to do the same for the remaining four stones of Solstheim. He doubts it will fully stop whatever [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]] is doing, but it may slow his progress. Your map will be updated and show you the location of your targets: [[Skyrim:Beast Stone|Beast Stone]], [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]], [[Skyrim:Sun Stone|Sun Stone]], and [[Skyrim:Water Stone|Water Stone]].

=== Beast Stone ===
The Beast Stone is southwest of Skaal Village; this is the nearest stone you may find. Two entranced [[Skyrim:Riekling|Rieklings]] are working there. A leveled [[Skyrim:Cultist|cultist]] is patrolling around the stone and monitoring the work of Miraak's poor slaves. The cultist will attack you on sight, so defeat your enemy and use the [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]] shout to cleanse the stone. The structure around the stone will collapse and a leveled [[Skyrim:Lurker|lurker]] will raise from the water. The two Rieklings won't turn hostile to you. They will stay here for a short moment then return to their tribe at Thirsk Mead Hall.

=== Sun Stone ===
Keep traveling south and you'll find the Sun Stone in the north of [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]]. A group of [[Skyrim:Reaver|Reavers]] are focusing on their building. Shout at the stone and a leveled lurker will attack you. The fight will be much easier with the help of these Reavers. They won't attack you after the combat; they'll just wander around the stone and give you some generic, non-hostile responses. After you leave this area, they will be removed from the game.

=== Earth Stone ===
Travel to [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] and you should find the Earth Stone without much trouble. [[Skyrim:Bralsa Drel|Bralsa Drel]], [[Skyrim:Rirns Llervu|Rirns Llervu]], and three [[Skyrim:Redoran Guard|Redoran guards]] have lost themselves here, doing their work mindlessly. Cleanse the stone and two lurkers will appear this time. One is near the stone, the other one is near the coastline. The guards will try their best to give you a hand. Pay close attention to the safety of Bralsa as she gives a quest later on. They will return to the city soon after regaining their freedom.

=== Water Stone ===
Walk along the west coast of Solstheim to find the Water Stone. The shrine at this stone is being worked on by a group of sailors, and a cultist is monitoring their work. The cultist will attack you without hesitation. Defeat your enemy and do the same to the stone. A leveled lurker will rise from the water and try to kill you. In addition, a low-level [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] will fly in from the west. If you haven't already triggered the Rieklings hidden in barrels to the southeast, they'll also arrive shortly, which can make for a chaotic battle. Fortunately, you don't need to guarantee the safety of every sailor. They will return to their boat docked in the bay once they are freed. After you leave this area, they will sail back to Skyrim with their ship.

== Notes ==
* Before you cleanse the stones, the entranced people working there will repeat the following texts mechanically: ''"Here in his shrine.(Here in his temple.) That they have forgotten. Here do we toil. That we might remember. By night we reclaim.(Here we reclaim.) What by day was stolen.(What faithless minds have stolen.) Far from ourselves. He grows ever near to us. Our eyes once were blinded. Now through him do we see. Our hands once were idle. Now through them does he speak. And when the world shall listen. And when the world shall see. And when the world remembers. That world will cease to be."''
* If you activate the stones before cleansing them, you will be in an entranced state, and [[Skyrim:Miraak|Miraak]] will repeat the following texts mechanically:  ''"Here in my shrine. (Here in my temple.) That you have forgotten. Here do you toil. That you might remember. By night you reclaim. What faithless minds have stolen. Far from yourself. I grow ever near to you. Your eyes once were blinded. Now through me do you see. Your hands once were idle. Now through them do I speak. And when the world shall listen. And when the world shall see. And when the world remembers. That world will cease to be."''
* If you activate any of the stones before cleansing them, you will be put into the same state as the rest of the occupants. However, unlike everyone else, you can exert your will and break free from the trance.
* The entranced Rieklings around the Beast Stone will repeat some similar texts in their own language: ''"Wafoo athaaaal. Bertiflik a goroowala. Hra woong aba. Tika twafaara filik. Wilberk tikflaaar. Yuchaaa tungar cha tiweki. Bura warag faaanig. Tiri fuklik taaar aburak."''
* More people and Rieklings would appear at Beast Stone, Sun Stone, and Earth Stone during the night.
* Before you cleanse the stones, if you talk to someone who only works on the stones at night, they will say "The Master calls." as a reference to [[Skyrim:Miraak|Miraak]] when they head to the designated stone each night. They will use the same quotes as the entranced people until morning.
* All stones will be marked as "clear" on the map once you cleanse them.
* The [[Skyrim:Tree Stone|Tree Stone]] is the only All-Maker Stone that is not cleansed by the end of this quest.
* This quest must be completed to finish [[Skyrim:The Gardener of Men|The Gardener of Men]] and the rest of the expansion's main questline.
* Prior to completing this quest, there is a chance that you will wake up at one of the stones whenever you sleep outdoors or in a dwelling, as long as the selected stone is still tainted.
** The first time you sleep in an appropriate location, this random selection is guaranteed to occur, and as long as the selected stone has not already been cleansed, you will awake there. Thereafter, there is a 33% chance that a stone will be randomly selected for this purpose.
** The Water Stone is not included in the list of stones you can wake up at.
* Activating each stone after freeing them will give you the powers of [[Skyrim:Conjure Werebear|Conjure Werebear]] (Beast Stone), [[Skyrim:Bones of the Earth|Bones of the Earth]] (Earth Stone), [[Skyrim:Waters of Life|Waters of Life]] (Water Stone), and [[Skyrim:Sun Flare|Sun Flare]] (Sun Stone) until you use them. You can activate them to get the powers at most once per day. The powers granted by the stones work underwater.
* You can cleanse the stones before the quest has started. If you cleanse all of them before getting the Dragonborn quest, Storn will send you to find Frea at the Tree Stone, instantly completing Dragonborn and starting [[Skyrim:The Temple of Miraak|The Temple of Miraak]].

== Bugs ==
{{Bug|When attempting to use the [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]] shout on a corrupted stone, you may lose the ability to interact with it, but the event will not start, causing the quest to become stuck.|confirmed=1|dlc=db}}
**Travel to the Wind Stone and acquire its power to get the quest working properly. Stones you've already tried to cleanse will spawn Lurkers as soon as you near them but the shrines will not explode.
**Alternatively, simply leaving the cell and returning to it, or saving and reloading the saved game, may resolve the problem, with the Lurker(s) appearing and the quest updating after the fight.
{{Bug|As many as three lurkers may appear (rare). One or two may be a significant distance from the stone after cleansing it. (Even out in the ocean or falling off a cliff).|confirmed=1|dlc=db}}
{{Bug|If [[Skyrim:Reluctant Steward|Reluctant Steward]] is finished and the Sun Stone has been cleansed, [[Skyrim:Drovas Relvi|Drovas Relvi]]'s sleep package will always be active, and therefore he will be found sleeping indefinitely in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn Steward's House|Tel Mithryn Steward's House]].|UDBP|1.0.5}}
{{Bug|If Reluctant Steward is finished and the Sun Stone has been cleansed, Drovas Relvi's sleep package may still have him trying to sleep at the [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|Retching Netch]], even though he won't work there anymore.|USSEP|4.1.3}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
To begin this quest you need to speak to [[Skyrim:Swims-In-Deep-Water|Swims-In-Deep-Water]]:
:'''I'd like to improve my fishing skills. Could you teach me a few things?'''
:''"Of course."''
:'''An entire list of fish to catch? But I only just learned how to fish!'''
:''"That doesn't change anything."''

You then have three options:

:'''Should I cook them for you while I'm at it?'''
::''"What? Nooo!"''
:::'''Relax, I was just joking.'''
:::''"You expect me to believe that?"''
::::'''The fish you tend to at the Fishery must be very important to you.'''
::::''"It speaks the truth."''

:'''I'll bring them back soon.'''
::''"My thanks to you."''

:'''I'll do my best. No promises.'''
::''"Of course."''

He will hand you a [[Skyrim:List of Fair Weather Fish|list of fair weather fish]], which requests you to catch:
*[[Skyrim:Carp|Carp]]
*[[Skyrim:Glassfish|Glassfish]]
*[[Skyrim:Goldfish|Goldfish]]
*[[Skyrim:Pogfish|Pogfish]]

You can find a copy of ''[[Skyrim:Fishing Mastery, v1|Fishing Mastery, v1]]'' on a shelf in the room behind Swims. This book will inform you of where you can catch each of these fish. All of the fish can be found in temperate lakes and rivers, see [[Skyrim:Fishing (activity)#Fishing_Locations|this link]] for a list of fishing locations, but these fish can all be caught in the docks of Riften and along the river that leads to Ivarstead.

Once you have caught all the fish required, return to Swims:
:'''Here are the fish you asked for.'''
:''"You've done well."''
He will then reward you with 200 gold.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Buyer Beware 02.jpg|right|thumb|The Felsaad Tern]]
After reading ''[[Skyrim:Masks of the Tribunal|Masks of the Tribunal]]'', you will need to travel to Raven Rock, and head up the stairs near the front of the Temple to the top of the Bulwark. Face south towards [[Skyrim:Old Attius Farm|Old Attius Farm]] to see a lone [[Skyrim:Felsaad Tern|Felsaad Tern]] circling close by. As long as it's not too close to midnight (any time up to 11) this bird will appear and continuously circle around. If it's knocked out of the sky an objective prompt to "retrieve the note" will appear. Find the bird's body and loot it to find a [[Skyrim:Note on the Target|note]]. 

Locate the Redoran Guard marked with a quest objective. Follow him south to the Old Attius Farm site, and from there down through the trapdoor into the [[Skyrim:Old Attius Farm Cellar|Old Attius Farm Cellar]]. Kill the guard and the [[Skyrim:Buyer|Buyer]], and retrieve the [[Skyrim:Mask of Vivec|Mask of Vivec]] and a Fahlbtharz Forge Gem. Optionally loot the Redoran Guard for a [[Skyrim:Redoran Guard's Note|note]] describing his motivations.

Finishing this quest completes one of the three tasks of the goddess in the [[Skyrim:Ghosts of the Tribunal (quest)|Ghosts of the Tribunal]] quest. It also provides one of the four forge gems required to complete the [[Skyrim:Trueflame (quest)|Trueflame]] quest.
{{NewLine}}
