== Quick Walkthrough ==
#Speak with [[Skyrim:Phinis Gestor|Phinis Gestor]], after reaching level 90 Conjuration, and receive the spell,  [[Skyrim:Conjuration_Spells#Summon Unbound Dremora|Summon Unbound Dremora]].
#Go to the top of the [[Skyrim:Hall_of_Attainment|Hall of Attainment]] and cast Summon Unbound Dremora. Speak to it, then defeat it.
#Cast Summon Unbound Dremora again and speak to it.
#Defeat the [[Skyrim:Unbound Dremora|Unbound Dremora]] and summon it again. Talk to it and receive the [[Skyrim:Sigil Stone|Sigil Stone]]. 
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Phinis Gestor|Phinis Gestor]] and receive your reward of the Master Conjuration Spell, Flame Thrall.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
To start this quest, go to the [[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(place)|College of Winterhold]] when you have level 90 in [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]]. Talk to [[Skyrim:Phinis Gestor|Phinis Gestor]] and ask him if you can learn more about [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]]. He will need a [[Skyrim:Sigil Stone|Sigil Stone]]. He will give you the spell [[Skyrim:Conjuration Spells#Summon_Unbound_Dremora|Summon Unbound Dremora]]. Head to the top of the [[Skyrim:Hall_of_Attainment|Hall of Attainment]]. Note that you need to go outside. Stand in the circle and use the spell. This will summon an Unbound Dremora. 
Summoning the Unbound Dremora will initiate a conversation:

''"You dare bring me here? You will be punished."''.

At this point, two dialogue options will appear:

{| class=wikitable width="80%"
|-
|style="width:23%"|'''''"You will do as I say!"'''''||style="width:23%"|'''''"I summoned you. I control you now."'''''
|-
|''"I serve no mortal!"''||''"You control nothing, mortal!"''
|}
[[File:SR-quest-Conjuration Ritual Spell 02.jpg|thumb|The Unbound Dremora in combat|right]]
At this point it will engage in combat and you must kill him. After he is dead you must summon him in the circle again, and he will speak again:

''"I am not your plaything, worm!"''

At this point another two dialogue options will appear:

{| class=wikitable width="80%"
|-
|style="width:23%"|'''''"Are you ready to submit?"'''''||style="width:23%"|'''''"Admit that I control you."'''''
|-
|''"Never!"''||''"I'll tear your heart out first!"''
|}

At this time he will become hostile and you must kill him. Summon him again and speak to him:

''"I am not yours to toy with!"''

From here you can reply with:

{| class=wikitable width="80%"
|-
|style="width:23%"|'''''"Will you submit, or do I need to banish you again?"'''''||style="width:23%"|'''''"I can do this all day."'''''
|-
|''"I...I submit. What is your bidding, master."''||''"No, I... I submit. No more."''
''"What is your bidding?"''
|}

Both of these options will lead to you saying:

'''''"Bring me a Sigil Stone. Now."'''''

He will then say:

''"Yes, my lord/mistress. Summon me again, and I shall have your stone."''

At this point in the quest, he will banish himself and you must summon the Unbound Dremora once more. When you do it will say:

''"Your Sigil Stone. Lord Dagon is... less than pleased at its loss."''

The Sigil Stone will be added to your inventory and the Quest Objective, Deliver the stone to Phinis, is assigned. Bring the [[Skyrim:Sigil Stone|Sigil Stone]] to [[Skyrim:Phinis Gestor|Phinis Gestor]] and he will give you [[Skyrim:Conjuration_Spells#Flame Thrall|Flame Thrall]]. You will also, now have the option to buy the Master level Conjuration Spells; [[Skyrim:Conjuration_Spells#Frost Thrall|Frost Thrall]], [[Skyrim:Conjuration_Spells#Storm Thrall|Storm Thrall]], and [[Skyrim:Conjuration_Spells#Dead Thrall|Dead Thrall]].

== Notes ==
*The [[Skyrim:Sigil Stone|Sigil Stone]] you are rewarded in this quest is used to unlock the full potential of the [[Skyrim:Atronach Forge|Atronach Forge]]. Daedric Atronach Forge recipes, both with and without the Sigil Stone, will begin to show up in random loot after you receive the objective to "Report to Savos Aren" during [[Skyrim:Good Intentions|Good Intentions]], regardless of this quest.
*The final Unbound Dremora will remain until it is killed and can move outside of the circle in response to any threats or danger.
*If you have the [[Skyrim:Disarming Bash|Disarming Bash]] perk, you can disarm the Unbound Dremora and then pick up his weapon.
*If you cancel the dialogue and sneak behind it, it is possible to pickpocket its weapon with a high enough skill. It carries a random enchanted main weapon and an iron dagger. You may also attack it from behind to weaken it before talking to it and resuming dialogue. But if you kill it without resuming dialogue, you will not be able to summon it again.
*It is possible to defeat the Unbound Dremora and pick up his weapon before he has been banished.
*It is possible to get two Sigil Stones. Once the Sigil Stone has been received from the Unbound Dremora, it can be placed in the Atronach Forge. You can then go to Phinis Gestor and 'give' him the stone, when you talk to him again and ask "What did you see?" he will thank you and give you the second Sigil Stone and Flame Thrall.

{{Bug|The Unbound Dremora may be hostile towards [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]] members as well as [[Skyrim:Barbas|Barbas]], if they happened to be there when the spell is cast.|USSEP|4.1.5}}

{{Bug|Defeating the Unbound Dremora while it is paralyzed can cause it to die and leave a lootable corpse rather than simply be banished. This breaks the quest and requires you to reload a save to complete it.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|Disintegrating the Unbound Dremora will leave a lootable ash pile rather than banishing it. This also breaks the quest and you will need to reload.|vn=1}}
{{Bug|You might not be able to talk to Phinis if [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] quest is active.|confirmed=1}}

{{Bug|After receiving the Sigil Stone and taking it to Phinis Gestor, he will not acknowledge it. He will go through the first two lines of dialogue then begin to walk around.|confirmed=1}}

Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks).wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Eddie the head |checkedBy= |reward=Secunda |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }} {{Quest Header |type=Stormcloaks |Giver=[[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] |Reward=[[#Reward|Leveled gold]]; access to respawning loot in the wagon |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Rescue from Fort Neugrad|Rescue from Fort Neugrad]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Sungard (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Sungard]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], [[Skyrim:Reach Stormcloak Camp|Reach Stormcloak Camp]] |Image=SR-npc-Raerek.jpg |ImgDesc=Raerek |description=Blackmail a [[Skyrim:Raerek|Talos worshipper]] into helping the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]. |ID=CWMission07 |Icon=SR-qico-Stormcloaks.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Find evidence. # Blackmail [[SR:Raerek|Raerek]]. # Report to [[SR:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]]. # Meet the men. # Take over the caravan. # Report to [[SR:Ralof|Ralof]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Blackmail=== After reporting to [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]], you will be told that [[Skyrim:Raerek|Raerek]], the steward of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], is secretly a worshipper of Talos and that you will need to find some evidence of this, and then convince him to help the Stormcloaks. Head to Markarth and go into the [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]]. Find Raerek's quarters, located to the right as you walk towards the throne. There is a guard there who may or may not talk to you. Don't go up the stairs; instead, take a right and look left. Guards frequently patrol the halls at all hours, however Raerek will be attending to the Jarl throughout most of the day. Sneak in the room, you need to pick the lock, so make sure you have some lockpicks with you. In the dresser against the wall, directly in sight from the doorway, you will find an inscribed amulet of Talos. Show the amulet to Raerek and he will tell you to follow him, leading you to his quarters. When you get in his quarters he will immediately start dialogue, assuming you want to extort something from him. Asking him if you could come to some sort of agreement will have him mention a shipment of silver and weapons; selecting any topic except the "All right, it's a deal" one will give you the chance to use speech to gain a leveled amount of gold. After he tells you where the wagon is, he will take his amulet back and you will have to return to Galmar. {{SRLeveledReward|Large|title=Reward
(if Persuade
succeeded)}} ===Ambush=== Return to [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] at the Reach camp. After telling him that there is a shipment of coin heading to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], he will tell you to meet with some of his scouts that are situated along the road and ambush the wagon. Once you find them, speak with their leader [[Skyrim:Ralof|Ralof]]. He will inform you that the wagon had an accident and is stranded up the road. He will then tell you that he and his men will eliminate the sentry on top of the hill and that you should go in and distract the Imperials so that the Stormcloaks can shoot them. You can also tell them to stay there while you just go in and slaughter. If you decide to go with Ralof's plan, tell him you're ready and then creep along with him and his men until he stops at a rock. He will then command his men to fire, and they will kill the guard on the ledge and take up positions along it. Now you have to head down to the Imperials. When you approach them, they will pull out their swords and tell you to move along. Simply attack them and Ralof's men will begin shooting the Imperials. Kill all the Imperials and talk to Ralof. That will complete the quest and you will have to head back to Galmar. ===Reward=== Report back to Galmar Stone-Fist at the Reach Stormcloak Camp and get a gold reward. {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Notes== *If [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] is given to the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] then this quest will not be given to you. *The chest on the wagon is locked, but you are free to loot it. *This quest and [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Imperial)|Compelling Tribute (Imperial)]] are different radiant versions of the same quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You may find multiple copies of Raerek's Inscribed Amulet of Talos in the chest and Raerek will only take one back.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|You may not find an Amulet of Talos in the chest, making the quest impossible to complete. This will also make future quests with the Stormcloaks impossible to complete. To fix this bug, simply go complete other quests for a while and keep coming back to check inside of the drawer to see if the Inscribed Amulet of Talos is there.|vn=1}} {{Bug|{{pc22}} The horse that appears next to the broken wagon in the camp will disappear from the game world once Ralof thanks you for your help upon completion of the quest. If you are riding the horse when it disappears, the game will crash to desktop.|vn=1}} {{Bug|At the end of the ambush, Ralof doesn't respond to any conversation for some reason, freezing the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Using the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout on Ralof may work to resolve this. **The horse in the camp may be being treated as an enemy, causing Ralof to be in a combat state. Killing the horse or making it friendly by riding it may solve this. {{Bug|If you have the [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] bounty bug, you cannot enter Markarth or complete this quest.|vn=1}} **You are able to still do this quest if your bounty is too high. Hopefully if you have already been to the keep, you can fast travel there. Once inside you can kill the guards at the front and then sneak around and hope you aren't found by Faleen, since she can't die. Just reload if she finds you. Once you get to the door, open it and sneak over to the dresser to find the blackmail piece and the rest works like normal. Eventually, the Stormcloaks take over and your Reach bounty disappears. **{{pc22}} Use the console command tdetect to turn off AI detection while talking to Raerek, otherwise wait in his room until he goes there to sleep, and confront him there. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Galmar Stone-Fist has sent me to investigate the possibility of blackmailing Raerek. As Igmund's Steward, He might be able to provide important information and assets. {{Quest Objective|10|Find evidence}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Blackmail Raerek}} |30||Raerek gave me information about a delivery of weapons and coin headed toward the enemy capital. I should return to camp and inform Galmar Stone-Fist. {{Quest Objective|30|Report to Galmar Stone-Fist}} |40||Galmar Stone-Fist has sent me to meet with a scouting party that should be in the area of the enemy shipment. Together we will over power the enemy and secure the weapons and coin. {{Quest Objective|40|Meet the men}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Follow Ralof and ambush enemy scout}} |60||{{Quest Objective|60|Take over the caravan}} |65||{{Quest Objective|60|Take over the caravan}} |90||{{Quest Objective|90|Report to Ralof}} |200|fin|I have successfully blackmailed Raerek and captured a shipment of enemy weapons and coin. |205|fail| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|100|Report success to Galmar Stone-Fist}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 25, 41, 51, 55, 100, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Containment.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=Voltyraine |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[fr:Skyrim:État d'urgence]]{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= |Reward=[[Skyrim:Savos Aren's Amulet|Savos Aren's Amulet]] (+50 Magicka), [[Skyrim:Torc of Labyrinthian|Torc of Labyrinthian]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Revealing the Unseen|Revealing the Unseen]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]] |Image=SR-quest-Containment.jpg |ImgDesc=Magic anomalies created by the Eye's power surge |description=Deal with the aftermath of the Eye's power surge. |ID=MG05 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Find the [[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Arch-Mage]]. # Defeat the [[Skyrim:Magic Anomaly|magic anomalies]] attacking [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. # Report to [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Containment_02.jpg|right|thumb|College members mourning the death of the Arch-Mage]] ===Tragedy at the College=== As you regain consciousness after witnessing part of the battle between [[Skyrim:Ancano|Ancano]] and the Arch-Mage [[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Savos Aren]], Mirabelle Ervine will be standing above you, telling you to get on your feet. Gather your wits and find her visibly shaken and upset. Tell her you feel okay, and she will tell you that Ancano is doing something with the [[Lore: Eye of Magnus|Eye of Magnus]] and that the Arch-Mage is missing. This will begin the quest. Head to the College's central courtyard where you will find the Arch-Mage's body and a group of mages. [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] will approach you and inform you that whatever killed the Arch-Mage has also affected the town of [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. He asks you to go there and save the town. ===No Time for Grief=== Cross the bridge, where [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]] and [[Skyrim:Arniel_Gane|Arniel]] will be waiting. Faralda will inquire about the situation. Explain that Winterhold is in imminent danger and proceed to the town. Faralda and Arniel will follow and assist you in the battle that awaits. You will find the town has become infested with a swarm of [[Skyrim:Magic Anomaly|magic anomalies]]—fast moving balls of energy whose attacks deliver [[Skyrim:Frost Damage|frost]] damage. They explode upon defeat, leaving behind [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]] in their "ghostly remains". Faralda and Arniel prove valuable allies in this battle and, with their help, you defeat the ten anomalies and secure the town. Arniel will remain in the town while you return to the College to report back to Mirabelle. ===The Staff of Magnus=== When you find Mirabelle, she will tell you that she and Tolfdir are trying to keep the Eye contained, but are in dire need of the [[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]]. When you tell her that you must venture to [[Skyrim:Labyrinthian|Labyrinthian]] for the staff, she softens a bit from her concern and grief. She intimates that Savos Aren had just recently given her a mysterious [[Skyrim:Torc of Labyrinthian|torc]], cryptically telling her that she would know what to do with it when the time came, and she believes it was meant for you. She also gives you [[Skyrim:Savos Aren's Amulet|Savos Aren's amulet]] to aid you on your journey, believing that you will be better served by it. The [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]] quest begins here. ==Notes== *An unused NPC known as the "[[Skyrim:Unused NPCs|Dremora Messenger]]", internally referred to under the Editor ID of MG05Messenger, was once intended to play a role in this quest, although what exactly this role entailed, is unknown. * If your horse is stabled within the city, the anomalies can quickly surround it and kill it. Simply rush down there at the start of the quest, hop on your horse, ride it out of town, hop off, and then sprint back on foot and join the fray, unless you have [[Skyrim:Shadowmere|Shadowmere]], then he can probably stay with you in the fight. * At higher levels, the anomalies can be used to train [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] very effectively, due to their large numbers and low attack power. * The souls of magic anomalies are leveled. * All College NPCs will either disappear or lose all dialogue options until the next quest is finished, which temporarily prevents you from advancing certain quests or using College services. Any NPCs who have been made followers or [[Skyrim:Personal Steward|stewards]]{{HF}} will also lose their dialogue options until the quest is complete. * You cannot loot the Arch-Mage's body. * If you leave a follower somewhere away from the college or the town of Winterhold, when you go to speak with Mirabelle they may be there. * Enthir travels to Winterhold on Tirdas and Turdas at 10pm and stays there until midnight, even while this quest is active. This means that if the battle takes place during this timeframe, he may join in on the fighting and be a useful ally as an [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] character. * Even after finishing the quest and talking to Mirabelle, magic anomalies will appear in the town of Winterhold and attack the guards. * It is advisable to finish sub-quests involving the townsfolk before triggering the anomalies, as they are known to kill NPCs in town. ==Bugs== {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Korir|Korir]] can be found wandering between Windhelm and Winterhold after being exiled if this quest was running at the time. This is due to the quest giving him an AI package that makes him return to his editor location, this being Winterhold, even when in exile.|USKP|2.0.0|trackerid=13139}} {{Bug|You may not get the initiating quest once the Arch-Mage is dead, and there will not be a group of mages surrounding him. This problem may be solved by loading a save several quest stages before the Eye of Magnus explodes.|USKP|2.0.5}} **{{Pc22}} Entering the console command startquest MG05 will start the quest if talking to Savos Aren does not update the previous quest and Mirabelle does not give the quest. **{{ps22}} To get the quest to start, complete all Winterhold related quests that you have active including any under miscellaneous quests. {{Bug|One of the anomalies may not appear and is likely under the world or in a wall, and you may find that it has fallen to the bottom of the cliff near the city.|confirmed=1}} **Fast traveling back to the town may fix this. **Also, entering another cell such as the inn can cause it to move out of the wall. {{Bug|You may not receive the quest after the Eye of Magnus has been overloaded.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If a dragon appears while you are fighting the anomalies, the dead dragon will not give you a dragon soul, and when you kill the anomalies, the quest will mark as being moved on the next stage but you won't be able to enter the College, and people won't talk to you. It is recommended that you reload to a save from before the dragon appeared.|vn=1}} {{Bug|After killing the anomalies, the entrance to the Hall of the Elements may be inactive.|confirmed=1}} **Wait for an NPC to enter and fix the door for you; saving and reloading won't fix this. **It may also be possible to reset the door yourself by clicking around or near the edges of the door. {{Bug|If you go into the Arch-Mage's quarters before going outside, you may encounter him alive but without any dialogue when you try to speak to him.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Assess the damage to the Great Hall}} |20||Ancano has done something to the Eye of Magnus, causing the orb to release incredible amounts of energy, and possibly putting the area in danger. I need to find the Arch-Mage and make sure he's safe. {{Quest Objective|20|Find the Arch-Mage}} |30||Ancano has done something to the Eye of Magnus, causing the orb to release incredible amounts of energy, damaging the College and killing the Arch-Mage. The town of Winterhold may be affected as well, and needs to be secured. {{Quest Objective|30|Protect the town of Winterhold}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Defeat the creatures infesting Winterhold (/10)}} |50||Winterhold now appears to be safe from the creatures attacking it. Mirabelle needs to be informed of what's going on. {{Quest Objective|50|Report to Mirabelle Ervine}} |200|fin|The town of Winterhold has been secured for now, but the Eye of Magnus cannot be reached and continues to jeopardize the College. |missing=0, 1, 25 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Revealing the Unseen|Revealing the Unseen]]|Next=[[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]]|Up=[[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]]}}

Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Imperial).wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=JR |checkedBy= |reward=Kimi the Elf |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{About|the Imperial version of this mission|the Stormcloak version|Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)}} {{Quest Header |type=Imperial Legion |Giver=[[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] |Reward=[[#Reward|Leveled gold]]; access to respawning loot in the wagon |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Dunstad (Imperial)|The Battle for Fort Dunstad]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Reunification_of_Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]]—Umbrella quest |Next=[[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Greenwall (Imperial)|The Battle for Fort Greenwall]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Rift Imperial Camp|Rift Imperial Camp]], [[Skyrim:Mistveil Keep|Mistveil Keep]]. |Image=SR-quest-Compelling Tribute (Imperial).jpg |ImgDesc=The broken Stormcloak Wagon |description=Use a [[Skyrim:Anuriel|corrupt steward]] to gain intelligence on the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]]. |ID=CWMission07 |Icon=SR-qico-Imperial Legion.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Report to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at the Rift Imperial Camp. # Find evidence at [[Skyrim:Mistveil Keep|Mistveil Keep]]. # Search [[Skyrim:Anuriel|Anuriel]]'s room until you find the evidence. # Confront Anuriel about the evidence. # Report back to Rikke. # Attack the caravan. # Report to Hadvar. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Report for Duty=== At the Rift Imperial Camp, Legate Rikke will inform you that [[Skyrim:Anuriel|Anuriel]], steward to the [[Skyrim:Laila_Law-Giver|Jarl of Riften]], is involved with the Thieves Guild. She wants you to obtain evidence of this so that it can be used to leverage her into cooperating with the effort to regain the Rift for the Empire. She informs you that the mission will require ''"stealth and discretion".'' If asked, she will tell you that your destination is Riften and mark [[Skyrim:Mistveil_Keep|Mistveil Keep]] on your map. ===Find the Evidence=== The evidence is inside a dresser in Anuriel's room. You may prefer to do this quest midday, while she is in the main hall rather than in her room. Although not always necessary, you may wish to take some steps to [[Skyrim:Sneak#Remaining_Undetected|make yourself stealthy]] as you must evade a guard who patrols the hallway leading to Anuriel's room and then steal the item undetected. If this guard sees you, he will warn you a few times that you are trespassing and may then attack you if you remain in his presence. However, you may also avoid this guard by waiting until he walks to the other end of his beat. If you stand in front of the Jarl facing her, you will see an open door to a hallway behind. A guard patrols the interior of this hallway. Watch for him to pass. After he walks to the left, wait a second or two, then go in and take a right. Anuriel's room is just around a corner. Steal the [[Skyrim:Incriminating_Letter_(Anuriel)|incriminating letter]] from inside the dresser, making sure that you are not observed. As an extra precaution, you may wish to close the door before you take it. Once you've taken the letter, show it to Anuriel. ===Confront Anuriel=== Once you've shown Anuriel the letter, she'll lower her voice and ask you to follow her to discuss the matter privately. She informs you that if you stick closely to her, the guards won't bother you. She will lead you back into her room. Once in the room, any conversation you have with her will result in her offering to give you information about a large shipment of gold and weapons in exchange for your silence. A successful persuasion will also cause her to offer a leveled amount of gold in advance, albeit angrily. Anuriel will tell you that the valuables are being transported by a wagon caravan in the area of Windhelm. She will relate that the wagon is heavy, and thus will be slow-moving, but is also heavily guarded. {{SRLeveledReward|Large|title=Reward
(if Persuade
succeeded)}} ===Report back to Legate Rikke=== Inform Legate Rikke about the wagon. She will be pleased to learn of this, and will tell you that she has some scouts positioned in the area where the wagon is traveling. She will ask you to meet the men, overpower the rebels guarding it, and take possession of the valuables. She will mark your map with the rendezvous location, which is about halfway between Riften and Windhelm. ===Meet the Men=== Upon arriving you'll find an old ally, [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]], commanding the Imperial scout troops. He will acknowledge your past adventures and engage in some philosophizing about war and killing. You can skip this dialogue if you like. When you mention the wagon, Hadvar will inform you that he was tracking it already, and is curious how you know about its cargo. You can tell him or not. Depending on your dialogue choices, you may learn that the wagon is now stranded a short distance away, and that you are outnumbered by the rebels. ===Ambush the Rebels=== Hadvar will say that he has a plan. If asked about it, he will suggest that although you are outnumbered, you can even the odds by employing the following strategy: First, he says that ''"we"'' will take out the Stormcloak sentry and then he and his scouts will situate themselves overlooking the camp. Then, you are to infiltrate the Stormcloak's position and create a distraction, at which time the scouts will unleash an archery attack. You can agree to this or let him know that you'll handle it on your own. If you agree to work together with Hadvar, you can proceed immediately or tell him to wait. If it is daytime, you can suggest that you wait until nighttime, which he will think is a good idea. If you suggest waiting, you can let him know when you are ready. Once you do so, you will note in your journal that will now follow him and ambush the enemy scout. [[File:SR-quest-Compelling Tribute (Imperial)02.jpg|thumb|right|A vantage point for ambushing the sentry]] Hadvar will suggest that you follow him, keep low, and hold your fire. He will walk and then stop a short distance away and may say ''"We'll take care of the sentry when he makes his next round."'' He may also tell you ''"Fire on my word"''. Hadvar and his men will crouch in a sneaking position and face directly north with weapons drawn. From the plan he originally laid out, it may seem that you are to wait until Hadvar and his scouts take out the sentry; this will never happen. Apparently when Hadvar said "we" will take out the sentry, he meant that ''you'' will take out the sentry. The closest way to follow the plan is apparently to place yourself just in front of Hadvar, facing the same direction as the others. Sneaking, creep forward through the two trees in front of you. Ahead of you, the sentry pauses at the far right end of a patrol route, offering the best position for targeting with an arrow. You may need to move slightly ahead and to the left to see the place where the sentry pauses. When the sentry is killed, your objective updates to ''"Take over the caravan."'' While Hadvar will repeat the idea that you are to sneak into the camp while his team positions themselves above it, things will again go not quite according to plan: quite likely, only Hadvar will position himself above the camp and attack with arrows. The other two soldiers will run directly into the camp and begin fighting. You have no chance to "infiltrate the camp," as was suggested. Your allies will generally take care of the Stormcloaks with or without your help, and the battle should be quite easily won. After the last enemy falls, your objective will update to ''"Report to Hadvar."'' If you then merely approach Hadvar, he will remark that you "make quite a team." Your work here is done, and the quest will complete at this point. You can then loot the camp, including the chest of valuables in the back of the wagon, although this is supposed to be collected later to support the war effort. If you will continue to pursue The Reunification of Skyrim quest, report back to Legate Rikke at the Rift Imperial Camp to obtain orders for your final mission to regain the Rift. When you approach her, she will acknowledge your performance, reward you with leveled gold, and say that she ''"will send some men to collect the prize. We can use the weapons here, and I'll send the coin to Solitude."'' ===Reward=== {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Notes== *This quest and [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)|Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)]] are different radiant versions of the same quest. *If [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] is given to the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] then this quest will not be given to you. *You can later revisit the camp where you ambushed the rebels. The chest in the wagon will respawn and can be opened by lockpicking. *If you have completed [[Skyrim:Supply and Demand|Supply and Demand]] the guard will not challenge you. *After completion of this quest, like any Civil War quest under [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]], unmarked by in-game references, you can approach Legate Rikke for a [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Gold Rewards|medium leveled gold reward]]; this is not always recommended, as entering her cell sets up the next quest in the series and, if triggered improperly, causes the missing ''"Reporting for duty."'' dialogue option (see [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim#Bugs|this]] bug section). Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her. Don't approach Rikke between quests of different holds. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Hadvar occasionally will not allow you to report to him before the battle.}} **Simply attacking the caravan without help will cause the quest to skip to the next stage, and Hadvar will join the fight. {{Bug|Hadvar occasionally will not allow you to report to him after the battle, which will make it impossible to finish the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Leaving the area and waiting for a few in-game days before trying to talk to him again can allow you to finally report to him. {{Bug|This quest becomes available after completion of the previous one in the [[Skyrim:Civil War|Civil War Questline]] and activates (even if it doesn't appear in your journal) upon your next load of the cell of [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] (usually relocated to [[Skyrim:Rift Imperial Camp|Rift Imperial Camp]]). If you do so prior to reporting to [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] (for example to get the leveled gold reward for the previous quest) the game activates this quest incorrectly causing a bug by generating and extra non-quest item copy of the [[Skyrim:Incriminating Letter (Anuriel)|incriminating letter]].}} **After the completion of the previous quest, avoid Rift Imperial Camp and Legate Rikke, go straight to report to General Tullius instead. Upon your next approach to Legate Rikke, this quest will have set up correctly. This skips the leveled gold reward for the previous quest. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Legate Rikke has sent me to investigate the possibility of blackmailing Anuriel. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Use the [[Skyrim:Arcane_Enchanter|Arcane Enchanter]] in [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]], with [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]]'s guidance.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
<!-- Instructions: The detailed walkthrough should provide full information about the quest, organized into paragraphs.  Spoilers belong in this section.-->
===A Student of the Craft===
On top of his duties as court wizard, [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]] of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] also provides tips on the basics of [[Skyrim:Enchanting|enchanting]] to prospective mages. Find him at his research station in [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] and ask him how to enchant weapons and armor. Upon doing so, he will introduce you the basics of enchanting in Skyrim:

''"Ah, a student of the craft. You'll need to start by learning an [[Skyrim:Enchanting Effects|enchantment]]. Take an enchanted weapon or piece of armor, then use the Arcane Enchanter to learn its secrets. The item is destroyed in the process, so be wary. Once you know an enchantment, you'll need a filled [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gem]], and something to enchant. You'll use the Arcane Enchanter for that, too. Of course I have everything you need for sale, if you have the coin."'''

===Master in the Making===
Using this advice, you may walk over to his arcane enchanter and begin enchanting. The quest will complete upon activating the enchanter. It is not necessary to enchant or even disenchant an item to complete this quest.

==Notes==
* This quest will end with no failure message if you stray too far from Dragonsreach, either by fast travel or by simply walking down the steps outside. The quest remains active throughout nearly all of Dragonsreach including both the Great Porch and the castle grounds, but can disappear if you get too close to the secret escape to the Guard Barracks in the dungeons.{{vn|plain}}
* This quest is always available, even if you already have 100 Enchanting levels.

=-1 ([[Skyrim:Ragnar|Ragnar]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak with [[Skyrim:Ainethach|Ainethach]] about the troubles with [[Skyrim:Sanuarach Mine|Sanuarach Mine]]. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Atar|Atar]] about why he shut the mine down. # Convince Ainethach to sell the mine, or convince Atar to leave. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Miner Extortion=== When you first enter [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]], you will see the townsfolk squaring off against a group of [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood_Mercenary|mercenaries]] sent by the [[Skyrim:Thonar Silver-Blood|Silver-Blood]] family in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] to secure the mine after a [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] incident. [[Skyrim:Ainethach|Ainethach]], the owner of the mine, is arguing with [[Skyrim:Atar|Atar]], the leader of the mercenary band: '''Ainethach''': ''"I want you sellswords out of my mine."''
'''Atar''': ''"Watch your tongue, native. We'll leave when we're sure there's no Forsworn here."''
'''Ainethach''': ''"Oh, and when would that be, I wonder? When I sell my land to the Silver-Bloods?"''
'''Atar''': ''"The Silver-Bloods have made you a very generous offer for this pile of dirt. I suggest you take it."''
The Silver-Bloods are demanding that the mine be signed over to them in return for the protection they provided in the last attack. The mercenaries have been instructed to prevent anyone from returning to work in the Sauranach Mine until the rights to it are signed over to the Silver-Blood family. ===Deciding to Help Ainethach=== Ainethach should be standing on the porch of his house during the day, and once approached he will agree to let you help him, and will ask you to convince Atar to leave. Unless you catch up to the band before they go into the mine, you will need to enter the mine to find Atar in the far end, standing on a raised platform. ====Talking to Atar==== After agreeing to help Ainethach enter the mine and speak with Atar. When you ask him to leave you will be given three options. {|class=wikitable width="100%" |- !width=27%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=16%|Reaction |- | This whole town wants you out. Leave. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Dealing with a mob wouldn't be good for my coin purse. Fine. We're leaving.
'''Failed''': Let's see them make us.||'''Passed''': Return to Ainethach
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | You'll listen to gold, I take it? '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': That I will, stranger. This is more than the Silver-Bloods are paying us. We'll clear out.
'''Failed''': Don't think I'm being paid already? Get lost.||'''Passed''': Return to Ainethach
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | I think I'll just kill you. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Whoa. Wait a second. I was just kidding. We'll leave. We'll leave!
'''Failed''': I thought today was going to be boring.||'''Passed''': Return to Ainethach
'''Failed''': Attack |- | On second thought, I'll be leaving.||colspan=4|Milk drinker.||Nothing |} After successfully convincing him, you will have to run back to Ainethach to tell him the good news, whereupon he will give you your cut. Note that even after successfully persuading, bribing, or intimidating, the mercenaries will claim that the mine is theirs, and will warn against sudden movements. There is no bounty for killing the mercenaries even after they agree to leave. ====Strong Arm Tactics==== An alternative option is to not talk to Atar at all, but to simply kill all the mercenaries. There are no mages or archers in the group, just weak melee fighters and the somewhat more formidable Atar, who is equipped as a bandit chief with leveled heavy armor, heavy shield, and one-handed weapon. The mercenary outside the mine will still greet you with pleasantries even after taking this option. There is no bounty for killing the mercenaries inside the mine, even if you attack first. ===Selling Out=== You can also remedy the situation by speaking to Atar who will offer you a cut of the purchase price if you can convince Ainethach to sell. You have to talk to Ainethach, and will be given the usual persuade, bribe, intimidate options if you tell him "I think you should sell the mine". {|class=wikitable width="100%" |- !width=27%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | They won't stop until you do. '''Failed''': Nothing |- | You do or you get hurt. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Easy. I'll sell. Just don't hurt anyone.||'''Passed''': Return to Atar |- | Forget it, then.||colspan=4|Let's do that.||Nothing |} After successfully convincing him, you will have to run back to Atar to tell him the good news, whereupon he will give you your cut. ===Reward=== The reward is the same regardless of which path you choose to take, a medium amount of leveled gold. Don't miss the seven [[Skyrim:Silver|silver ore veins]] in the mine and the leveled shield that Atar carries (if you decide to kill the mercenaries). {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Notes== *Siding with Ainethach will cause Ainethach's, [[Skyrim:Lash gra-Dushnikh|Lash gra-Dushnikh]]'s and [[Skyrim:Ragnar|Ragnar]]'s dispositions towards you to rise to 1. **Siding with Atar will cause Ainethach's, Lash gra-Dushnikh's, and Ragnar's dispositions towards you to fall to -1. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When leaving Sanuarach Mine, a [[Skyrim:Hagraven|hagraven]] corpse may randomly appear in front of the mine left of the smelter.|USKP|2.0.7|The corpse will no longer appear in front of the mine.}} {{Bug|Ainethach's dialogue at the end of the quest does not exit with a goodbye flag.|USLEEP|3.0.9}} {{Bug|If you make Ainethach sell the mine by brawl, there's no further dialogue with him and you have no other choice but to help Ainethach.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Convince Atar to leave Sauranach Mine}} |25||{{Quest Objective|30|Tell Ainethach that Atar has been dealt with}} |30||{{Quest Objective|10|Convince Atar to leave {{sic|Sauranach|Sanuarach}} Mine|20|Convince Ainethach to sell {{sic|Saunaruch|Sanuarach}} Mine}} |35||{{Quest Objective|40|Tell Atar that Ainethach has been dealt with}} |missing=5, 7, 8, 10, 100, 200, 300 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

=1 ([[Skyrim:Gat gro-Shargakh|Gat gro-Shargakh]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to either [[Skyrim:Pavo Attius|Pavo Attius]] or [[Skyrim:Skaggi Scar-Face|Skaggi Scar-Face]]. #Clear out [[Skyrim:Kolskeggr Mine|Kolskeggr Mine]]. #Claim your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Two Survivors=== Upon arriving at [[Skyrim:Left Hand Mine|Left Hand Mine]] outside of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], you may overhear a discussion between [[Skyrim:Skaggi Scar-Face|Skaggi Scar-Face]], who is in charge of the mine, and [[Skyrim:Pavo Attius|Pavo Attius]]. Pavo and his fellow miner [[Skyrim:Gat gro-Shargakh|Gat gro-Shargakh]] are the only survivors of a [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] invasion of [[Skyrim:Kolskeggr Mine|Kolskeggr Mine]]. Skaggi is visibly upset by this news; he gives the two survivors permission to stay at Left Hand Mine, and vows to send word to the Jarl. If you speak with Skaggi, he expresses his concern over the increasing Forsworn threat and the timeliness of a response from the Jarl. If you agree to clear out the mine, he will be grateful, but skeptical about your ability to survive. Speaking with Pavo will also initiate the quest and he will also offer the same sentiments about the Jarl's response and your success in the mine. The quest may not start and dialogue options may not be available if [[Skyrim:The Forsworn Conspiracy|The Forsworn Conspiracy]] is not completed and your bounty in Markarth is high. Make your way to the mine, which will be marked on your map if you haven't previously discovered it. Several Forsworn will be standing guard at the mine's entrance, with more inside. Once you've killed them all, head back to Left Hand Mine. ===Reward=== Speak to Pavo with the news of your success. He will be suitably impressed at your accomplishment and reward you with a leveled amount of gold. He and Gat then return to work at Kolskeggr Mine. {{SRLeveledReward|large}} ==Notes== *Once Pavo returns to Kolskeggr Mine, he will offer to buy [[Skyrim:Gold Ore|gold ore]] from you. His services are of limited use, however (see [[#Bugs|bugs]] below). ==Bugs== {{Bug|Even after fulfilling the quest and letting the miners reclaim control of Kolskeggr Mine, the Forsworn will respawn the next time you visit the cell. They will kill the miners off if you aren't quick enough. It's possible to save them; just make sure that you quickly dispatch the two Forsworn near the bridge. The miners and a guard will easily dispatch the one at the top.|USKP|1.2.4}} {{Bug|You may be able to repeat this quest when the Forsworn there respawn, as long as you stay away from Kolskeggr Mine and avoid triggering the event in which the miners try to reclaim control.|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|Pavo stays inside the barracks, and will not talk as you are trespassing.|USSEP|4.1.8|After the quest is completed, he will sandbox outside 12 hours per day.}} {{Bug|Stronghold Orcs may fail to recognize you as Blood-Kin after completing this quest.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Clear the Forsworn from Kolskeggr Mine}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Tell Pavo that Kolskeggr Mine is cleared}} |missing=15, 100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Of Sulfur and Spiders===
[[Skyrim:Redbelly Mine|Redbelly Mine]] is a small [[Skyrim:Ebony|ebony]] [[Skyrim:Mining|mine]] located in [[Skyrim:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]]. The mine gets its name from the red mist filling the caverns and smelling like the sulfurous hot springs out in the volcanic tundra. The local blacksmith, [[Skyrim:Filnjar|Filnjar]], will tell you the mine is not producing right now. In fact, the mine is currently overrun with [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|spiders]]. Filnjar is worried that the invading arachnids will venture out of the mine looking for food soon. What's worse, the town guards are as useless as "a fifth wheel on a wagon" as they prefer to keep an eye out for enemy soldiers rather than trouble themselves protecting the town's major commodity. If you are willing to give Filnjar a hand, he will tell you, ''"Keep to your word, and I'll line your pockets with as much as I can scrape up."''

===Spider Extermination===
The mine is to the west, close to [[Skyrim:Filnjar's House|Filnjar's House]]. Get into the mine and you'll find some frostbite spiders soon. There are two groups of three spiders, with medium and small spiders attacking en masse. Remove every spider to complete the quest. You can also find the three ebony ore veins near the bottom level of the mine.

===Gold for Spiders===
Return to Filnjar and tell him the good news. ''"Gone? Every one of them? Why, that's incredible."'' Then he'll reward you with leveled gold for reopening the mine and putting Shor's Stone back on the map.
{{SRLeveledReward|3}}

==Notes==
* There is a [[Skyrim:Shor's Stone Guard|Shor's Stone Guard]] that sits outside the mine. You can utilize a common bug where they will follow you into the mine while dialogue is ongoing and they can then be used to help clear the mine, though it's not a difficult task unless attempted at a very low level.
* Killing all the frostbite spiders triggers the option to "Return to Filnjar" regardless of having talked to him or not.
* Filnjar's dialogue does not change even if the Civil War is over; he still says the guards are looking out for enemy soldiers.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|This quest does not display a quest pointer as intended due to checking the wrong conditions for the objective alias.|USKP|2.0.9}}
{{Bug|There are several desiccated corpses within the mine despite Filnjar stating that nobody had been harmed by the infestation.|USKP|1.2.6}}
{{Bug|After first completion, the spiders may respawn and the miners will continue to work in the newly infested mine, potentially causing harm to NPCs in the mine.|USKP|1.0}}
**If the spiders respawn and you have already completed the quest once, the quest will reset at the point where you have to return to Filnjar after killing some or all of the spiders, allowing you to repeat the quest as many times as you want.
**The miners leave the mine at night; entering the mine then should allow you to kill the spiders again without any harm coming to the miners.

=1 ([[Skyrim:Tuthul|Tuthul]]) |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Perth|Perth]] about the [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] infestation. # Clear [[Skyrim:Soljund's Sinkhole|Soljund's Sinkhole]] of draugr. ==Detailed Walkthrough== Outside the mine, Perth will stop you and say that the mine is closed until the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] sends a group to clear out the draugr that infest it, but has given up hope of that ever happening. To complete the quest, enter the sinkhole and clear out the draugr. Upon entering the mine, you'll come to a junction. The left branch leads to a dead end area with three draugr and two moonstone ore veins. Up a ramp is the [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Jornibret's Last Dance|Jornibret's Last Dance]]'', as well as some loose [[Skyrim:Moonstone Ore|moonstone ore]] on a table. Heading back to the junction and down the right-hand passage takes you to a large, unclimbable sinkhole. There is one moonstone vein located directly before the sinkhole as well. When dropping down the sinkhole, prepare for a tough fight, as three leveled draugr will converge on you upon reaching the bottom. A fourth draugr will arrive later as well. A few [[Skyrim:Magicka|magicka]] potions can be found along the passage leading to the next chamber, whose exit is blocked by a gate, and which contains three levers and another leveled draugr. Pull the left and right levers to open the gate and head up the spiral ramp; pulling the center lever will trigger a [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart trap]]. The next chamber is accessed through a set of doors; a pressure plate right before them triggers a [[Skyrim:Spear Trap|spear trap]]. Three leveled draugr inhabit this next chamber, the left side of which is floored with wooden planks covering a small pool containing an unlocked chest. Other loot in this room includes alchemical ingredients, some leveled armor, and two blocks of [[Skyrim:Refined Moonstone|refined moonstone]] in a bookcase. The passage behind the doors ascends a flight of stairs, then winds deeper into the dungeon. A small, dark passage at the top of the stairs leads to a small room containing a leveled chest. A pressure plate just past the doors has no apparent effect. The final chamber consists of a moderately-sized open room, with a stone bier flanked by two statues, and houses a boss-level draugr. The right-hand statue will periodically glow with a green hue, which will heal the boss draugr, while the left-hand statue will periodically glow red, then shoot a fireball at you. This behavior ceases upon the boss draugr's destruction. To the left of the bier is an opening leading to a balcony, which contains a small passage leading back to the sinkhole chamber. Treasure in this room includes some ingredients on the bier and a boss chest behind it. On the way out, there are some ingredients and a leveled weapon resting on a pedestal, as well as two moonstone veins, one to the right of the table and one on the opposite side of the room. Return to Perth for a cash reward and his gratitude. He will also buy any moonstone ore you have acquired, should you wish to sell it. ==Notes== * The boss level draugr in the final chamber can be quite a challenge, owing to his ability to heal himself and use magic to disarm any weapon that you may wield. However, he will not leave the chamber, which you can use to your advantage. While still in the access tunnel leading to the chamber, it's possible to sneak to the end of the tunnel and use a ranged attack to hit him in the back before he even knows you're there. Once he does turn around and head toward you, retreat back down the tunnel to a safe distance, firing at him the whole time. A useful tactic is to lure him toward you (while in the safety of the tunnel) and use a full [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] to knock him down, then pummel him with arrows. * At higher levels, the boss may be a dragon priest. * It is possible to enter the ruins through the passage which is used to leave the boss' chamber, not having to jump down the sinkhole. In order to do so, you have to climb the rocks surrounding the sinkhole and use [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] to reach the rock shelf, opening your way to the chamber where boss awaits. This leads to a possibility of defeating the boss without getting past the other enemies. If you do so, the quest will end and you'll receive a journal entry telling that the mine is clear, even though you didn't even see the rest of the draugr residing there. If you want to crawl through the whole dungeon, though, you have to use the sinkhole, as you would be unable to open the lever gate from the other side. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After beginning the quest, Perth will enter the nearby house and remain inside due to his post-quest start AI package. There is no way to complete the quest without trespassing. Upon trespassing Perth will begin to attack the player and will continue to do so until he is either killed or the 5 septim bounty has been paid, which will revert him back into the post-quest start package making it impossible to hand in the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The spear trap in front of the door at the top of the spiral ramp seems to be missing its graphic. Stepping on the pressure plate opens the door to the next chamber, the spear trap sound is heard (activating and resetting), you are damaged, but no visual spears are seen extending from the holes in the walls.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The draugr respawn, making the quest repeatable and possibly killing the miners should you enter while they're at work.|USKP|1.2.5}} {{Bug|On the PS3 version, when you decide to sell some moonstone ore to Perth, he won't speak at all, but will take the ore anyway and you will get your money still}} {{Bug|If the mine is cleared before starting the quest, Perth will be stuck engaging in conversation with the player, telling them about the mine being dangerous, and the quest never starts|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Clear Soljund's Sinkhole of Draugr}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Tell Perth that the Draugr are dead}} |missing=100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

You will usually be directed to either the local city's court mage or the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] itself. Asking about the college directly will result in a new map marker and also brings up a [[Skyrim:Quests#Miscellaneous|miscellaneous]] quest to visit the College of Winterhold. ===Arriving At The College=== After arriving in [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]], you can see the college and the bridge leading to it. When attempting to cross the bridge, [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]], a college mage guarding the bridge from unwanted visitors, will stop you and initiate the first college-related quest, [[Skyrim:First Lessons|First Lessons]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|This quest may be shown as incomplete if you successfully persuade [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]], the Gatekeeper.|USKP|1.1}} ** {{Pc22}} Use the console command setstage MG01Pointer 200 to complete it. {{Bug|The quest may also show as incomplete (and will point you to Nirya) if you tell Faralda that you are Dragonborn and show her your "shout".|USKP|1.1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Visit the College of Winterhold}} |200|fin| |missing=255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:First Lessons|First Lessons]]|Up=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]]}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=HoggyDog |checkedBy= |reward=69.111.77.79 |rewardChecked= }} {{Quest Header |Giver=[[Skyrim:Salma|Salma]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ironbind Barrow|Ironbind Barrow]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls|Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout |Image=SR-quest-Coming of Age.jpg |Imgdesc=Salma and Beem-Ja at the entrance to Ironbind Barrow |description= Help a [[Skyrim:Salma|daring adventurer]] and [[Skyrim:Beem-Ja|her companion]] retrieve their riches. |ID=dunIronbindQST |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note''': This quest does not appear in your journal. # Meet [[Skyrim:Salma|Salma]] and [[Skyrim:Beem-Ja|Beem-Ja]] outside [[Skyrim:Ironbind Barrow|Ironbind Barrow]] and speak with Salma. # Escort Salma and Beem-Ja through the ruins until a fight with [[Skyrim:Warlord Gathrik|Warlord Gathrik]] begins. # Kill Beem-Ja and speak with Salma. ==Detailed Walkthrough== The quest begins as soon as you arrive at [[Skyrim:Ironbind Barrow|Ironbind Barrow]] and witness an argument between [[Skyrim:Beem-Ja|Beem-Ja]] and [[Skyrim:Salma|Salma]] about venturing into the ruins. Speak with Salma and she will decide there's enough treasure for everyone and enter the ruins. Unfortunately, she and Beem-Ja must not really believe that there's enough to go around, because once inside they incessantly charge headlong into rooms full of leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]. Although they can't actually be killed by any of the mobs in the barrow, you can accidentally kill one or both of them as they may jump in front of you during the fights; frequent game saves are strongly advised in case they are killed. Salma and Beem-Ja will rush ahead and make short work of the [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|spiders]] in the first passage whether you help or not. When you arrive in a large room with a double staircase leading up to an east-west landing with a locked gate heading north, loot the chest on the east side of the landing before pulling the handle in the alcove on the west end to open the gate. Proceed north down the passage into a circular room with a floor grating, two leveled draugr, a chest on the west wall and some minor loot on and near the table. Salma and Beem-Ja will rush ahead. Take the exit in the northeast corner and follow the hall around and down to the west, where you will see a chest behind a [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] that activates a [[Skyrim:Spear Trap|spear trap]] in the alcove directly ahead. You can loot both the chest and the helm next to it without crossing the pressure plate. Go north from there to find the two friends trying to kill two more leveled draugr at the end of a short eastward-heading bridge. There's some minor loot on the floor and on the table and shelves to the south, plus an adept-locked chest in the southwest corner of the platform beside the wooden partition. Descend the log ramp southward from the end of the bridge and chase Salma and Beem-Ja through the gate and into the next room. Defeat the two draugr there, then collect the few potions around the room and follow your charges out to the east, into a wide passage with a helmet on a [[Skyrim:Weight Sensitive Plate|pedestal]] in front of a closed gate. Notice the ominous black holes in the floor around the pedestal, and stand back a bit to loot the helm so that the spear trap doesn't kill you as the gate opens. Alternatively, if you stand at the pedestal, turn around so your back is to it, and look at the ceiling, there is a chain you can pull to open the gate without triggering the trap. Follow the hall to the iron doors and save your game before opening them, for the boss fight against [[Skyrim:Warlord Gathrik|Warlord Gathrik]], at least one draugr or skeleton and possibly a [[Skyrim:Frost Atronach|frost atronach]], is next. Fight Gathrik as you would any Draugr or Dragon Priest. His tactics will vary based on his abilities. Beem-Ja is scripted to start walking away when you open the door to Gathrik's chamber, avoiding the final fight. He will wander around a safe distance until Gathrik is killed, at which point he will run back and reveal his true colors. To prevent this, you can body-block him until the approaching minions trigger his aggression, at which point he will become an asset like Salma. After Gathrik is defeated, a script restores Beej-Ja to full health when he betrays you. As soon as you defeat Gathrik, Beem-Ja thanks you for your help and asks you to hold still while he kills you for a blood sacrifice that he needs to perform in order to help him absorb Gathrik's power. Apparently, he's a necromancer. Killing him as soon as the dialogue releases you is highly recommended. Beem-Ja may [[Skyrim:Reanimate|reanimate]] Gathrik's body to fight for him. After Beem-Ja has been defeated, Salma will express her disbelief at his treachery but adds that her father never trusted him to begin with. She says that she now wants to be alone and decides to leave the ruins on her own, explaining that she no longer wants the treasure. Among Beem-Ja's loot is a [[Skyrim:Letter to Beem-Ja|letter from Salma's father]] threatening to expose whatever unspecified evil Beem-Ja did back in Black Marsh if he allows any harm to come to Salma. The [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] is behind Gathrik's throne at the north end of the upper level, and a boss-level unlocked chest is just to the west of the word wall. The exit is on the eastern side of the lower level, activated by a pull chain on the wall just to the right of the gate. Climb up the spiral stairway and exit to ''Ironbind Overlook'', then unbar the door in front of you and exit to find an unlocked chest. Be sure to continue past the chest around to the left and up the hill to find an unusual Dwarven monument with three pillars guarded by two Ice Wraiths; see [[Skyrim:Unmarked Places#Unmarked Ruins and Monuments|unmarked places]] for full details. ==Notes== * The [[Skyrim:Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls|Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls]] can be found mounted behind Gathrik's throne. It's the only weapon in the game that can be disenchanted to learn the [[Skyrim:Fiery Soul Trap|Fiery Soul Trap]] effect. * Beem-Ja is capable of reanimating Gathrik; if he succeeds, the battle may become much more difficult. However, if you are able to loot Gathrik before he is reanimated, he will be much easier to defeat the second time. * Although helping Salma is a quest-like activity, it does not function as a regular quest, providing no quest updates or rewards. * Warlord Gathrik is leveled based on your level when the quest starts, and he has a chance of spawning as a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] after you reach level 40. * If you are quick enough to loot Gathrik before Beem-Ja resurrects him, you can use one of Gathrik's black soul gems to soul trap Beem-Ja. Salma can be trapped in the other as killing her is consequence free. She disappears from the game after the quest is complete anyway. * At very low levels Beem-Ja will not have any offensive spells and will fight only using unarmed melee attacks. * Beem-Ja has a chance of having an enchanted circlet in his inventory. If he does, he will equip it and will be unable to wear his hooded robes. This will make him appear to be naked. * If Salma gets disarmed, she may equip the Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls. If this happens, it cannot be pickpocketed (at least not without the [[Skyrim:Pickpocket#Misdirection|Misdirection]] perk); you will have to kill her to retrieve it. To avoid this, run quickly to the back of the throne as soon you enter the chamber, and take the battleaxe yourself. ==Bugs== {{Bug|At a certain point in Ironbind Barrow, there is a gate that must be opened by a switch. When Beem-Ja arrives at this gate, he'll comment on how there must be a way through, but if you've already opened the gate when his dialogue triggers then he and Salma may just stand there.|confirmed=1}} ** Close and open the gate again so they notice you opened it. {{Bug|Salma and Beem-Ja are marked as Protected, not Essential, meaning that you can accidentally kill either of them during combat, at which point the other will start walking back to the entrance and return to their respective position at the campfire outside Ironbind Barrow.|confirmed=1}} ** {{pc22}}Resurrecting the killed NPC using the console does not correct this, but will result in both NPCs returning to the campfire. ** If Beem-Ja is killed and Salma returns to the campfire, she resumes her post-quest dialogue. ** If Salma is killed, Beem-Ja simply stays where he is. He may become hostile toward you, but will return to normal if you successfully hide from him. {{Bug|Arriving in the area may not initiate the quest, nor will speaking to either adventurer afterward.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Before opening the gate if you go back into the previous room and just past the short set of stairs turn to the left (would be the same side of the room as the chest is in, but back further) there is a corner in the rocks if you keep walking through it will turn light bluish and it drops you to a hall right before the chamber with the word wall.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|It appears to be possible for Salma to disappear or be lost during the quest. The quest will proceed correctly, and Beem-Ja will still attack upon reaching the Ironbind Barrow throne room.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Salma and Beem-Ja may both disappear from the game upon entering Ironbind Barrow. Since neither of them have a permanent RefID, it will be impossible to complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} ** {{pc22}} It might help to find the RefIDs for both of them in the output of console command sqv dunIronbindQST, which should be listed as REF 'Salma' and REF 'Beem-Ja'. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |200|fin| |missing=0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 45, 50, 60, 70, 79, 80, 81, 90, 100 }}{{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Non-Journal Quests]]

''"I know it must be hard for an adventurer such as you to understand this, but we Skaal live very boring lives."''
== Quick Walkthrough == # Talk to [[Skyrim:Edla|Edla]] about her son. # Convince [[Skyrim:Nikulas (Dragonborn)|Nikulas]] to stay in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. # Return to Edla. == Detailed Walkthrough == Return to [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] after the quest [[Skyrim:The Fate of the Skaal|The Fate of the Skaal]] and you can find [[Skyrim:Edla|Edla]] wandering around the village. She may tell you ''"My son's heart is restless. He wants to see the world beyond our lands, and nothing I say will change his mind."'' If you ask her about her son, she will provide you with more detailed information. His name is [[Skyrim:Nikulas (Dragonborn)|Nikulas]], and he is a good lad, a strong and loyal young man. However, Edla wishes her son wasn't so eager to leave the village. If you are willing to talk to him, she will be quite happy. ''"You would do that? I know he would listen to you. You've been out there in the wide world. You know its perils."'' She hopes you can convince him. You can find Nikulas sitting on a bench outside [[Skyrim:Edla's House|their house]]. You may talk to him about his mother and his dream. He will admit ''"That's right. I want to go out into the world and earn great glory. I want to hunt the deadliest creatures and claim vast riches."'' He is weary of the life in Skaal Village and he wants to do something with his life other than farm, fish, and hunt deer. You may choose various ways to convince him to stay at home or remind him to think about his mother before making the final decision. {|class=wikitable |- !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | I do understand. She will reward you with some herbs that are unique to the land, including five [[Skyrim:Ashen Grass Pod|Ashen Grass Pod]], five [[Skyrim:Emperor Parasol Moss|Emperor Parasol Moss]], and five [[Skyrim:Scathecraw|Scathecraw]]. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Go to [[SR:The Arcanaeum|the Arcanaeum]] and read [[Skyrim:Soran's Journal|''Soran's Journal'']].
#Locate and [[Skyrim:Horses#Tamable_HorsesCC|tame]] the [[SR:Unicorn|Unicorn]] just west of [[Skyrim:Lost Prospect Mine|Lost Prospect Mine]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===First Named, Last Tamed===
Upon installing the [[Skyrim:Wild Horses|Wild Horses]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]], you will be directed to [[SR:The Arcanaeum|the Arcanaeum]] in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] to learn more about reports of a recent [[SR:Unicorn|Unicorn]] sighting. Once there, you will find [[Skyrim:Soran's Journal|''Soran's Journal'']] sitting on [[SR:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]]'s desk. It details the research on Unicorns carried out by a wildlife scholar named Soran Hariksen, who sighted a Unicorn in the forests of [[SR:The Rift|the Rift]]. The creature is supposedly from the distant past and was brought forward in time by the [[SR:Psijic Order|Psijic Order]] after the [[OB:Unicorn|last living Unicorn]] was sacrificed to [[Lore:Hircine|Hircine]] during his [[OB:Hircine|quest]] in [[OB:Oblivion|''Oblivion'']].

Once you have read the journal, you will be directed to an area just west of the entrance to [[Skyrim:Lost Prospect Mine|Lost Prospect Mine]]. The Unicorn can be found right next to the nearby pond. It is a [[SR:Wild Horse|wild horse]] and will run away from you if approached. It must be [[Skyrim:Horses#Tamable_HorsesCC|tamed]], which is a mechanic added by the Creation. You must mount the Unicorn until it stops bucking in order to claim it as your own. You may be thrown off when it bucks, which will necessitate chasing it down again once you get back on your feet.

===Reward===
Once tamed, the Unicorn will become your mount. If you decide to switch to a different mount, it will make its way to the College of Winterhold courtyard and wait for you there.

==Notes==
* Like other horses, the Unicorn can be [[Skyrim:Horses#Horse_NamingCC|named]] and [[Skyrim:Horses#SaddlesCC|saddled]], which are two other mechanics added by this Creation. To do this, you must visit a [[SR:Stables|stable]] with the Unicorn as your active mount.

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Obtain a [[SR:Glassfish|glassfish]] for [[SR:Zaria|Zaria]] in [[SR:Falkreath|Falkreath]].
#Read Zaria's [[Skyrim:Zaria's Note from Jarl|note]] from the Jarl.
#Give the [[Skyrim:Disguised Invisibility Potion|Disguised Invisibility Potion]] to the guard in the [[Skyrim:Falkreath Barracks|Falkreath Barracks]].
#Return to Zaria.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This quest can be started after [[Skyrim:In A Pinch|In A Pinch]] by speaking to Viriya:
:'''Know of anyone in need of fishing work around Skyrim?'''
:''"You're headed to Falkreath. It's all in this note."''

She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Bounty: Glassfish|bounty]] for a glassfish for [[Skyrim:Zaria|Zaria]] in Falkreath. Once you obtain a glassfish, head to [[Skyrim:Grave Concoctions|Grave Concoctions]] in Falkreath to speak to Zaria:
:'''Here's the glassfish you requested in your bounty.'''
:''"I'm grateful for your efforts. Here, take this."''

She will then give you 200 gold and a [[Skyrim:Zaria's Note from Jarl|note]] from the Jarl.

:'''Thanks for the coin. And... a note from the Jarl?'''
:''"Maybe you can help me."''

The note from the Jarl states that a guard has been stealing skooma from the evidence chest, and that the Jarl would like for the guard to have an invisibility potion poured into an empty skooma bottle to scare the guard straight. Speak to Zaria to obtain the invisibility potion:
:'''I'll deliver the disguised potion in exchange for the Jarl's ring.'''
:''"Thank you. Here, this is for you."''
:'''I'll return when the deed is done. Hopefully he learns his lesson.'''
:''"Good luck out there."''

She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Disguised Invisibility Potion|Disguised Invisibility Potion]]. You will then need to head to the [[Skyrim:Falkreath Barracks|Falkreath Barracks]] to talk to the guard where you will have two options:

:'''Seems like you don't have any trouble keeping the edge off while on duty.'''
:''"I beg your pardon, sir. I don't know what you're getting at, but whatever it is, it's not appreciated."''
::'''Here, take this. My way of saying thanks.'''
::''"I understand. Now let's pledge never to speak of this again."''

:'''Here's a bottle of skooma I found laying about. I trust you'll lock it away?'''
:''"Of course."''

Either option leads to you needing to follow the guard into the jail, you can then overhear him say:
:''"Soon. I can almost taste it."''
He will then drink the potion, turn invisible and then shout:
:''"Oh, no! By the Gods! This can't be happening! Gods help us!"''

As you exit the jail, the guard will become visible again and say:
:''"I don't feel... right... I'm going to lay down... for awhile..."''

Head back to Zaria and speak to her:
:'''I don't think that guard will be using skooma any longer.'''
:''"Excellent. You've done us a great service. Here is your reward."''
You will then be rewarded with the [[Skyrim:Ring of Surroundings|Ring of Surroundings]].

==Notes==
* When the invisible guard reappears after a short amount of time his inventory can then be picked and the Disguised Invisibility Potion can be stolen back and kept.
* Killing the guard after he drinks the potion will still allow you to collect the reward from Viriya since the guard will not "be using skooma any longer." You will however almost certainly incur a bounty since other guards are nearby.
