DA13 |TOClimit=3 |description=Slay an apostate [[Skyrim:Orchendor|worshipper]] for the Daedra Lord [[Lore:Peryite|Peryite]]. |SuggLevel=16 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Meet with an [[Skyrim:Afflicted Refugee|Afflicted Refugee]]. # Find [[Skyrim:Kesh the Clean|Kesh the Clean]] at the [[Skyrim:Shrine to Peryite|Shrine to Peryite]]. # Gather items needed by Kesh to make incense. # Inhale the incense fumes and speak to Peryite's apparition. # Kill [[Skyrim:Orchendor|Orchendor]] in the Dwemer ruin [[Skyrim:Bthardamz|Bthardamz]]. # Return to the shrine for your [[Skyrim:Spellbreaker|reward]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Find Kesh at the Peryite Shrine=== ====Escaped Afflicted==== After reaching level 10, you may encounter an [[Skyrim:Afflicted Refugee|Afflicted Refugee]] during your travels, who asks you to stop "ogling the grotesque". He will say, when asked about his unhealthy appearance, that he suffers from the plague and would have died years ago without [[Lore:Peryite|Peryite]]'s protection. He will point you to [[Skyrim:Kesh the Clean|Kesh]] at the [[Skyrim:Shrine to Peryite|Shrine to Peryite]] for more information before continuing on his way to [[Lore:High Rock|High Rock]], adding an unnamed miscellaneous quest to your journal. The shrine is located in [[Skyrim:The Reach|The Reach]], far to the northeast of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], a short walk northwest of [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]], a little southwest of the [[Skyrim:Dragontooth Crater|Dragontooth Crater]] landmark. Speaking to the Khajiit will complete the miscellaneous objective and start the quest [[#The Only Cure|The Only Cure]]. You can also start the quest in a different manner detailed below. ===The Only Cure=== ====A Lonely Worshipper==== [[File:SR-npc-Kesh_the_Clean_02.jpg|thumb|right|Kesh the Clean preparing the incense]] You will arrive at the shrine after being directed by the Afflicted Refugee, or simply find the way on your own after level 12, and you will notice that the shrine is relatively humble, containing little more than a table holding the [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Buying Game|The Buying Game]]'', a cooking pot, an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|Alchemy Lab]], and an odd-looking golden cauldron. The only remaining worshipper of Peryite is a [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]] named [[Skyrim:Kesh the Clean|Kesh the Clean]] who wanders about the shrine. When you approach Kesh, he will be quite surprised to see another person at the remote shrine. When you ask for an audience with Peryite, Kesh will advise you that, to gain one, some incense is needed and creating this incense involves mixing four items in the cauldron, each of which you will need to supply. ====Crafting the Incense==== Specifically, Kesh needs one of each of the following: [[Skyrim:Vampire Dust|Vampire Dust]], a [[Skyrim:Silver Ingot|Silver Ingot]], a [[Skyrim:Flawless Ruby|Flawless Ruby]], and a [[Skyrim:Deathbell|Deathbell]] flower. He will recommend shops for the dust, mines for the silver and ruby, and the frozen tundra for the flower, though he will warn you that obtaining vampire dust from [[Skyrim:Vampire|Vampires]] can be very dangerous. Note that if you already have some or all of these items in your inventory, you will have to drop them after Kesh tells you to collect them, and then pick them back up. Otherwise, the quest objective will not tell you to deliver the ingredients to him. Alternatively, you can put them in a nearby unused cooking pot and collect them after. *'''Flawless Ruby''': This is probably the hardest of the items to obtain, as the standard way of doing so depends on randomly finding one while [[Skyrim:Mining|mining]]. Just southwest of the Shrine and directly east of Ragnvald (on the other side of the mountain) there is a small Dwemer ruin haunted by a whisp-mother. There is an unlocked chest embedded behind a concrete slab along the outer region of the mesa, amidst a dense layer of fog, which may contain a flawless ruby. You can dependably pick one up from inside [[Skyrim:Shriekwind Bastion|Shriekwind Bastion]]: Halfway through the dungeon, locate a blood-spattered room containing a single throne. Examine the floor near the unlit fire pit on the right for the ruby. The dungeon is inhabited by [[Skyrim:Vampire|Vampires]], so you can also obtain the Vampire Dust while there. Alternatively, you can find a Flawless Ruby on a remote boat wreck north of [[Skyrim:Reachwater Rock|Reachwater Rock]] at a bend in the river there {{Map Link|x=-145834|y=4272|zoom=17}}. The wreckage contains various gems (the ruby can be hidden under one of the seats, so look around at all angles to make sure that you find it). *'''Vampire Dust''': If you intend to get the ruby from Shriekwind Bastion, slay one of its vampires for its dust while there. Otherwise, any [[Skyrim:Vampire#Vampire Locations|vampire dungeon]] will do. * '''Silver Ingot''': To obtain this, follow Kesh's advice. Head east down the mountain from the shrine and locate the mining town of [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]]. Just outside the entrance to [[Skyrim:Fenn's Gulch Mine|Fenn's Gulch Mine]] is a [[Skyrim:Smelting|smelter]] with several silver ingots scattered around. * '''Deathbell Flower''': Deathbell can be found all over Skyrim, either as plants or as cuttings. The biggest concentration can be found in the [[Skyrim:Forelhost Refectory|Forelhost Refectory]]. The flowers appear in abundance in and around [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. They can be picked, or cuttings stolen, from the main trading room of [[Skyrim:Angeline's Aromatics|Angeline's Aromatics]] and the teachers' rooms in the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]]. Many of these flowers can also be harvested in the depths of [[Skyrim:Forsaken Crypt|Forsaken Crypt]], and the swampy marshes north of [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]] teem with them. A quick way to get a deathbell is to travel to the [[Skyrim:Abandoned Shack|Abandoned Shack]], where there is a sample just outside the front door. Once you have collected one of each item, a quest update will direct you to return to Kesh at the shrine. When you hand him the ingredients, he will head to the cauldron and prepare a mixture yielding fumes. He will then ask you to inhale deeply to summon Peryite. If you talk to Kesh before he finishes mixing, the next quest objective may fail to activate. ====Inhale Deeply==== [[File:SR-quest-The Only Cure.jpg|thumb|right|A surreal vision of Peryite's shrine]] As soon as you inhale the fumes, a quick flash will give way to a surreal experience, with the world around you painted in misty deeply-saturated colors, and a few ghostly [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]] will appear. Peryite will then speak thusly, ''"Breathe deep, mortal. I would have you hear me well, so let these vapors fill your lungs."'' Asking Peryite if you were poisoned will elicit, ''"In a sense, but no more poisoned than a fool after too much wine."'' When asked what he wants he will explain, ''"I have watched you for some time, you know. The decisions you've made intrigue me, and I wonder if you are a proper agent for a task of mine. I sent a blessing to [[Lore:Mundus|Mundus]], a wasting plague that infected a scattering of Breton villages. One of my monks, the elf [[Skyrim:Orchendor|Orchendor]], was sent to gather these Afflicted. He shepherded them into [[Skyrim:Bthardamz|Bthardamz]] for me, but has since lost his way. I will not stand for betrayal. I want you to go to Bthardamz and Kill Orchendor, in my name."'' He will then disappear and the cauldron will be deactivated. Back in the real world, both Kesh and your map marker will point you to the [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] ruin of [[Skyrim:Bthardamz|Bthardamz]], easily reached by foot from the shrine. The ruin is expansive; you may wish to stock up on supplies before the lengthy trek through it. ====Bthardamz==== [[File:SR-place-Bthardamz.jpg|thumb|right|The ruins of Bthardamz]] The exterior area of Bthardamz is as huge as the ruin itself. Watch out for patrolling [[Skyrim:Afflicted|Afflicted]] and their poisonous vomit attacks. Locate the entrance, pull the handle to release the iron bars and head inside the introductory room for a bit of treasure. Finally, take a deep breath and enter the ruin itself, Bthardamz Upper District. [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_02.jpg|thumb|left|An Afflicted praying to Peryite]] [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_03.jpg|thumb|right|An Afflicted vomiting poison]] Upon entering, notice the many cauldrons with green fumes similar to the one back at the shrine. While these pose no threat, the Afflicted inhabiting the entire ruin will attack you on sight. Though their illness renders them weak individually, they are dangerous in groups. At the first intersection, either pick the lock on the gate to the north, or take the long way through a sleeping area and fight the opposition. A locked cage in the northeastern room contains a chest. Further north there are three Afflicted praying in a large room. If you approach in sneak mode, you can overhear them and learn about the mixture of despair and fanaticism among the Afflicted: '''Afflicted (female)''': ''"Peryite, heed our call if you deem us worthy. Our leader, Orchendor, has led us here and for that we are thankful. He has shown us that our suffering is not a punishment, but a blessing."''
'''Afflicted (male)''': ''"Yes, a blessing. For many months we have sought your guidance, yet we have heard nothing from you. If we do not please you, give us a sign so that we may understand why."''
'''Afflicted (female)''': ''"Yes, a sign. We are lost without your guidance. On the ninth of Rain's Hand our prayers went unanswered, yet here we stand, not faltering in our belief that soon you will show yourself to us."''
'''Afflicted (male)''': ''"Yes, show yourself to us. Until that day, we will continue to devote our lives to you and suffer for you."''
'''Afflicted (female)''': ''"Yes, suffer for you."'' Keep heading west until you reach a large chamber with four Afflicted. Release them from their pain and pull the handle on the northern ledge. This will lower the bars blocking your progress to the south and provide access to a cave-like structure with a treasure chest hidden underneath the entrance. At the next intersection, consider examining the room to the east, but beware of a surprise attack from two [[Skyrim:Dwarven Sphere|Dwarven Spheres]]. Take the southern path, avoiding the [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] that activates two [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|swinging blade]] traps. The last room contains three Afflicted enemies and the entrance to the next zone, Bthardamz Workshop. {{newLeft}} ====Workshop==== The workshop contains three entrances back to the first zone, Bthardamz Upper District. You will arrive from the eastern entrance to living quarters with two Afflicted, a mage and a [[Skyrim:CombatWarrior1H|melee fighter]]. You may witness a scene in which the melee fighter wakes up the mage, bringing orders from Orchendor: [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_08.jpg|thumb|left|Two Afflicted discussing a delivery]] '''Afflicted (melee)''': ''"I'm sorry to wake you, my Brother. I have a request from Orchendor."''
'''Afflicted (mage)''': ''"Yes, what is it?"''
'''Afflicted (melee)''': ''"He requests more barrels of ichor to be delivered to the Arcanex tomorrow."''
'''Afflicted (mage)''': ''"This is the reason you wake me? I already have Orchendor's request taken care of."''
'''Afflicted (melee)''': ''"I'm sorry my Brother."''
'''Afflicted (mage)''': ''"Now leave me to my sleep. My strength and patience are waning."''
'''Afflicted (melee)''': ''"Yes, my Brother. Forgive me. May the blessing of Peryite be with you."''
'''Afflicted (mage)''': ''"Yes, yes, as with you. Now be off."'' {{NewLeft}} Further on you will have no choice but to go for one of the two southern entrances. Both of these are accessible from the huge southwestern chamber, which is guarded by three [[Skyrim:Dwarven Spider Worker|Dwarven Spider Workers]]. The door at the top of the stairs leads to a previously inaccessible area of the Upper District (you will be able to see the door you previously used from above), while the southernmost door (where the map marker leads you) takes you to the ground floor area of the previously inaccessible Upper District. Take a bit of time and explore the area and the rooftops, although only a limited amount of treasure can be found. [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_04.jpg|thumb|left|An Afflicted talking to her sleeping brother]] Optionally, you can locate the entrance to Bthardamz Dwelling. If you enter in sneak mode and wait a moment, you may hear the voice of a woman speaking softly. The Afflicted's monologue at her sleeping brother's bed will give you even more insight into the situation of Orchendor's followers: ''"Are you asleep? I know you can't hear me, brother. I don't like what we've become. We've been here so long and what do we have to show for it? Orchendor promised a place where we would be accepted and taken care of. He promised Peryite would be present at all times and give us comfort in our suffering. Forgive me for saying this, brother, but I have not felt Peryite's presence. I want out. I want to leave this place. I long for the fresh air of the Reach. This place only makes us sicker. But who am I kidding, I know you wouldn't let me leave, brother. You truly believe in Orchendor and his promises. I know this place will eventually kill us. I have come to accept that. But I will always regret that day I introduced you to Orchendor."'' Unlock the gate to access a chest and the [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Biography of the Wolf Queen|Biography of the Wolf Queen]]'' before continuing on to the Upper District. Locate the set of stairs just northeast of the Dwelling entrance and proceed upwards, all the way to the ceiling, then enter Bthardamz Lower District. {{NewLeft}} ====Lower District==== [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_05.jpg|thumb|left|Afflicted in the Lower District of Bthardamz]] [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_06.jpg|thumb|right|A Dwemer blade trap]] Proceed forward to the first room and examine the cage for some minor loot. Fight two Dwarven Spiders in the corridor and enter a huge arena-like chamber with three Afflicted guards. Pull the lever and use the trap in the center of the room to your advantage, then take out any remaining enemies. Proceed east through another tunnel until you arrive in a multi-level chamber featuring numerous platforms and a small underground lake. Start by exploring the ground floor area, killing enemies sequentially if possible, otherwise they can easily group up on you. Once you have crossed the river, move through the gate and then through a stone archway. The archway has a pressure plate witch activates a swinging bar trap above. There is also a lever on the right which will reset the trap. The stairs to the north lead to a circular pathway surrounding a waterfall. As you travel up the stairs, jump right onto the ledge north of the opening into the main chamber. Take an immediate right and down a narrow path to find a skeleton and an unlocked chest. Go back to the upper pathway then head back down stairs and travel east. There is a gold ore vein on the ground next to the wall beside the base of the staircase. Follow the path to the right, watching out for three patrolling Afflicted, and head up the stairs. On this platform you will find a Dwarven Spider and a Dwarven Spider Worker. Cross the winding path to the south to find the entrance to the Bthardamz Study. Upon entering the Study, open the gate to your left to enter an office-like room containing a chest with minor loot. Open the double doors to the south to find a set of stairs with a spinning blade trap. There is a large button at the base which activates it. As you progress to the upper level you will encounter a Dwarven Sphere. Take a moment before climbing the next staircase to loot the chest to the left of the altar on a dais beside some barrels of ichor. Turn west and continue up the second set of stairs to find the passage leading to the second level of the Bthardamz Lower District. A passage with tables on both sides opens up to a view of the entire Bthardamz Lower District. Observe the waterfall passing through the circular platform above where the chest was found, as four afflicted will pass through the sequence of archways which opens up directly behind the waterfall. Either snipe them as they pass by the falls or face them head on. Head down the short ramp to the north and turn right to find a gate to a room containing a chest with minor loot. To the right are two curved ramps leading to a landing containing three Afflicted and a chest on the wall near the tables, but which is otherwise a dead end. Head south and follow the path to the doors to Bthardamz Arcanex, where you will finally face [[Skyrim:Orchendor|Orchendor]]. {{NewLeft}} ====Showdown==== [[File:SR-quest-The_Only_Cure_07.jpg|thumb|left|A Dwarven Centurion emitting a blast of steam]][[File:SR-npc-Orchendor2.jpg|thumb|right|Orchendor attacking the player]] The Arcanex zone resembles the previous zone with its multiple levels, and is crawling with enemies, including Dwarven Spiders and Spheres. The water holds nothing of interest, so fight your way through the chamber and take the steep slope upstairs. Before entering the building-like structure below the ceiling, take a quick detour to the left for a bit of treasure, then face a [[Skyrim:Dwarven_Centurion|Dwarven Centurion]] and a few Spiders—the last guardians before the final showdown against the treacherous [[Skyrim:Wood Elf|Wood Elf]]. Orchendor is a powerful Spellsword who knows several protective spells and magical barriers that increase his magic defenses to as high as 80%, making him a hard opponent for mages. He also knows Invisibility, Teleportation, and Ice Storm spells, and as an Afflicted he can use the toxic vomit attack as well. Loot his body once it is over for the [[Skyrim:Key to Bthardamz Elevator|elevator key]], a boss-leveled amount of gold, the [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Reality & Other Falsehoods|Reality & Other Falsehoods]]'' and several other valuable items. Head to the upper level and locate the locked door, then enter for a chest and an elevator ride towards some much-needed fresh air. It's time to head back to Peryite for your reward. {{NewLeft}} ====Spellbreaker==== Back at the shrine, Kesh continues to wander around aimlessly. Asking his permission to take another breath of the fumes will gain you entrance once again into the surreal world of Peryite, who will say, ''"Well done, mortal. All things are in their order, and Orchendor roams [[Lore:The Pits|the Pits]]. His betrayal will be punished, and your obedience is rewarded."'' When you bid him farewell, he will hand you the [[Skyrim:Spellbreaker|Spellbreaker]], a unique shield capable of protecting from both magic and sword. The cauldron will then be empty and you can do nothing but leave Kesh the Clean to his lonely existence at the Shrine to Peryite. ==Notes== *Even after being re-animated, Orchendor will retain his immunity to fire, frost and shock magic and all of his spells. This, combined with his level cap, makes him one of the best targets for [[Skyrim:Dead Thrall|Dead Thrall]]. *If you have accidentally killed Kesh before first talking to him, you can still begin the quest by having the required items in your inventory and activating the Cauldron. The potion will automatically mix and the quest will begin. *After giving Kesh the ingredients, you can pickpocket him as he is stirring the cauldron to steal back the ingredients you just gave him. *After finishing this quest, you can randomly encounter two to three hostile Afflicted in the wilderness who will try to enact vengeance on you for killing Orchendor. *Even after the quest is finished, the items on Kesh's table at the shrine will remain as owned by him, and taking them will still count as theft. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Sometimes, after you kill Orchendor, the quest marker will still point at him and the quest cannot be advanced further.|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|If you talk to Kesh while he is creating the incense, you may not get the next quest update.|USKP|2.0.4}} **{{pc22}} Use the console command setstage da13 21 to bypass Kesh not creating the incense. **Try killing Kesh and looting the four ingredients from his body. Once Kesh is dead, you should be able to activate the cauldron yourself and continue the quest as normal. {{Bug|Several Afflicted don't spawn during this quest because the parent marker for them is never enabled.|USLEEP|3.0.7}} {{Bug|Canceling while talking to Peryite may cause you to get stuck when he is finished, as you cannot move or select anything once you have inhaled the incense.|USSEP|4.1.4|This was due to a script having a bad check on the heading angles when facing the fume pot.}} {{Bug|Orchendor's body may vanish before you have a chance to loot the key.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Peryite may not give you Spellbreaker upon completing the quest.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Introduction |id=Da13Intro |1||{{Quest Objective|0|Find Kesh at the Peryite Shrine}} |!|The Only Cure|DA13 |10||A Khajiit named Kesh has offered to help me commune with Peryite. He asked me to acquire a deathbell flower, flawless ruby, silver ingot and some vampire dust. {{Quest Objective|11|Obtain some Vampire Dust}} {{Quest Objective|12|Obtain a Deathbell Flower}} {{Quest Objective|13|Obtain a Silver Ingot}} {{Quest Objective|14|Obtain a Flawless Ruby}} |21||There is a fuming incense at the wilderness shrine to Peryite. Inhaling this is supposed to help me commune with the Daedric Prince. {{Quest Objective|20|Inhale the fumes}} |40||The Daedric Prince Peryite has solicited me to kill an elf named Orchendor. {{Quest Objective|40|Kill Orchendor}} |75||I have killed Orchendor, as instructed by Peryite. {{Quest Objective|75|Report Orchendor's death to Peryite}} |100|fin| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|15|Deliver the Ingredients}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing= ** Da13Intro: 0, 100. ** DA13: 0, 1, 5, 11, 15, 20, 30, 31, 45, 50, 80, 81 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes|ID=DA13}}

Skyrim:Kyne's Sacred Trials.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Bwross |checkedBy= |reward=Bwross |rewardChecked= }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Froki Whetted-Blade|Froki Whetted-Blade]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Kyne's Token|Kyne's Token]] |Disp= =1([[SR:Froki Whetted-Blade|Froki Whetted-Blade]]) |Rep= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Froki's Shack|Froki's Shack]] |Image=SR-quest-Kyne's_Sacred_Trials.jpg |ImgDesc=The Guardian Mudcrab |description=Participate in [[Lore:Kyne|Kyne]]'s Sacred Trials by hunting the guardian beasts of [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]]. |ID=dunHunterQST |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Difficulty=Medium |SuggLevel=20 |SuggSpell=[[Skyrim:Fire Damage|Fire Damage]] }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Froki Whetted-Blade|Froki Whetted-Blade]]. # Defeat the [[Skyrim:Mudcrab Guardian Spirit|Guardian Mudcrab]], [[Skyrim:Skeever Guardian Spirit|Guardian Skeever]] and [[Skyrim:Wolf Guardian Spirit|Guardian Wolf]]. # Return to Froki. # Defeat the [[Skyrim:Ursine Guardian|Guardian Bear]], [[Skyrim:Mammoth Guardian Spirit|Guardian Mammoth]] and [[Skyrim:Sabre Cat Guardian Spirit|Guardian Sabre Cat]]. # Return to Froki. # Defeat the [[Skyrim:Guardian Troll Spirit|Guardian Troll]]. # Return to Froki. ==Detailed Walkthrough== Visit [[Skyrim:Froki's Shack|Froki's Shack]] and speak to [[Skyrim:Froki Whetted-Blade|Froki]], a hunter. He will lament the worship of the [[Lore:Nine Divines|Divines]] and pine over the old Nordic traditions that honor [[Lore:Kyne|Kyne]]. If you agree, he'll grant you a blessing to seek out the guardian beasts of [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]] and perform the Sacred Trials of Kyne. All the guardian beasts are unseen until you engage in the quest and inhabit areas populated by normal creatures of their same species. You'll have to go out and hunt the lesser beasts first before he gives you the set of greater beasts to hunt. The final trial is to hunt and kill Kyne's troll champion. If you struggled with the guardian mammoth, this part is potentially even more difficult. The troll spirit is inside [[Skyrim:Graywinter Watch|Graywinter Watch]] and will almost immediately attack alongside two other normal [[Skyrim:Troll|trolls]] making this a tough fight for lower level players. It is a very small cave and if you sneak on entering, all three can be picked off from the entrance (fire bow recommended). Any sort of [[Skyrim:Fire Damage|fire damage]] is useful on all the creatures involved in this quest, especially the trolls. Two dead bandits have minor loot, alongside [[Skyrim:Froki's Bow|Froki's bow]] (on a barrel). Froki will reward you with [[Skyrim:Kyne's Token|Kyne's Token]] upon completion of the quest. ===Guardian Beast Locations=== * [[Skyrim:Mudcrab Guardian Spirit|Mudcrab Guardian Spirit]] - [[Skyrim:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun Hold]], just west of [[Skyrim:Broken Fang Cave|Broken Fang Cave]], and southeast of [[Skyrim:Gjukar's Monument|Gjukar's Monument]] {{Map Link|x=-58613|y=-13816.5|zoom=17}} * [[Skyrim:Skeever Guardian Spirit|Skeever Guardian Spirit]] - [[Skyrim:The Pale|The Pale]], around the [[Skyrim:Windward Ruins|Windward Ruins]] {{Map Link|x=19489.4|y=93000.4|zoom=17}} * [[Skyrim:Wolf Guardian Spirit|Wolf Guardian Spirit]] - [[Skyrim:Falkreath Hold|Falkreath Hold]], unmarked [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolf]] den southwest of [[Skyrim:The Guardian Stones|The Guardian Stones]] {{Map Link|x=-15479.3|y=-69390.9|zoom=17}} * [[Skyrim:Ursine Guardian|Ursine Guardian]] - [[Skyrim:Falkreath Hold|Falkreath Hold]], south of [[Skyrim:Knifepoint Ridge|Knifepoint Ridge]] {{Map Link|x=-69458.9|y=-76703.1|zoom=17}} * [[Skyrim:Mammoth Guardian Spirit|Mammoth Guardian Spirit]] - [[Skyrim:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun Hold]], unmarked Mammoth graveyard just west of [[Skyrim:Loreius Farm|Loreius Farm]] {{Map Link|x=25521.5|y=25468.9|zoom=17}} * [[Skyrim:Sabre Cat Guardian Spirit|Sabre Cat Guardian Spirit]] - [[Skyrim:Winterhold (region)|Winterhold]], just west of [[Skyrim:Bleakcoast Cave|Bleakcoast Cave]] {{Map Link|x=136245|y=88111|zoom=17}} * [[Skyrim:Guardian Troll Spirit|Guardian Troll Spirit]] - [[Skyrim:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun Hold]], inside [[Skyrim:Graywinter Watch|Graywinter Watch]] {{Map Link|x=49824.2|y=-2452.27|zoom=17}} ==Notes== * You can use the [[Skyrim:Animal Allegiance|Animal Allegiance]] shout on all the guardians, thus making them stand there while you kill them. * You can find [[Skyrim:Froki's Bow|Froki's bow]] inside Graywinter Watch. He'll allow you to keep it if you tell him you found it. * The Guardian Bear is located near two interesting features: **A fairy circle of [[Skyrim:White Cap|white caps]] with a copy of ''[[Skyrim:Father Of The Niben|Father Of The Niben]]'' and a random staff laying in it. **A [[Skyrim:Shrine of Akatosh|shrine of Akatosh]] with a copy of ''[[Skyrim:A Tragedy in Black|Tragedy in Black]]'' at its base. *From the guardian sabre cat follow the face of the ice wall southwest. A novice-locked chest and a copy of ''[[Skyrim:2920, Rain's Hand, v4|2920, Rain's Hand, v4]]'' can be found in a small alcove to the southeast. *Difficulty for this quest is based on the ability to kill a [[Skyrim:Mammoth|mammoth]]. If you're able to kill one in open combat you should be able to handle this quest. Alternatively, the mammoth can be killed by ranged attacks from the hill to the north. *Despite being spectral in appearance, the guardian spirits seem to retain all aspects of their represented species and are killable with normal weapons. They leave behind ghostly remains, but the loot table matches their represented species as well. *If you decline this quest, Froki will not offer it to you again, but the decline option remains in your dialogue choices. **If you back out before Froki offers the quest, it is as if you declined the quest. **{{pc22}} Using the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command setstage dunHunterQST 21 should allow you to do the quest if you are in this situation. *If you own Lakeview Manor, on your return it may be attacked by bandits, which can engage in combat and kill Guardian Wolf and his pack. Still, the quest will progress as normal. * Although Froki says "you can count me as a friend" upon completing the quest, there is no change to his disposition, and low-value items in his house are still marked as stolen. *An [[SR:Emperor Crab Guardian Spirit|Emperor Crab Guardian Spirit]] is added by the [[SR:Fishing|Fishing]] [[SR:Creation Club|Creation]], although it's unrelated to this quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When asking Froki "What should I do now" after being assigned to hunt the guardian troll, his response may loop indefinitely. Exiting the conversation breaks the loop.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|If you don't mention finding his bow before informing him you killed the Guardian Troll, there is no dialogue about it.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|Froki's Bow respawns, making it possible to own multiple copies of this unique weapon.|USKP|1.3.2}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||I met an old Nord named Froki who offered to guide me through the Sacred Trials of Kyne. |21||I met an old Nord hunter named Froki who told me about Kyne's Sacred Trials. He has marked me so that the guardian skeever, wolf and mudcrab should appear to me when I visit their lairs. {{Quest Objective|30|Defeat the Guardian Mudcrab}} {{Quest Objective|31|Defeat the Guardian Skeever}} {{Quest Objective|32|Defeat the Guardian Wolf}} |50||I met a hunter named Froki who sent me on Kyne's Sacred Trials. I have defeated the first three guardian beasts as instructed. {{Quest Objective|50|Return to Froki}} |51||The Nord hunter Froki is guiding me through the Sacred Trials of Kyne. I defeated the first group of guardians and have been tasked to seek out the guardian bear, sabrecat and mammoth spirits. {{Quest Objective|60|Defeat the Guardian Bear}} {{Quest Objective|61|Defeat the Guardian Mammoth}} {{Quest Objective|62|Defeat the Guardian Sabre Cat}} |70||The Nord hunter Froki is guiding me through Kyne's Sacred Trials. I have defeated several guardian spirits as instructed. {{Quest Objective|70|Return to Froki}} |71||The Nord hunter Froki is guiding me through the Sacred Trials of Kyne. I have defeated several spirit guardians and have now been asked to seek out the Troll guardian as my final challenge. {{Quest Objective|80|Defeat the Guardian Troll}} |80||The Nord hunter Froki guided me through the Sacred Trials of Kyne. I have defeated the final guardian, a troll spirit. {{Quest Objective|100|Return to Froki}} |100|fin|The Nord hunter Froki is guiding me through the Sacred Trials of Kyne. Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Baron |checkedBy=Sheeprin |reward=Sheeprin |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=Automatic after killing [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] |Reward=3,000 gold,
Word for the [[Skyrim:Marked for Death|Marked for Death]] shout |Disp= =3 ([[Skyrim:Commander Maro|Commander Maro]]) |Prev=Failing [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|With Friends Like These...]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Abandoned_Shack|Abandoned Shack]], [[Skyrim:Dragon_Bridge|Dragon Bridge]], [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood _Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]] |Image=SR-quest-Destroy_the_Darkbrotherhood.jpg |ImgDesc=Destroy the Dark Brotherhood! |description=Finish the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] and rid Skyrim of their kind. |ID=DBDestroy |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png |SuggLevel=8 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #While in the [[Skyrim:Abandoned Shack|Abandoned Shack]] during the quest [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|With Friends Like These...]], kill [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] instead of a hostage. #Travel to any city and talk to a [[Skyrim:Guards|guard]]. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Commander_Maro|Commander Maro]] in [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] southwest of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. #Travel to the [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood _Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]] and kill all [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] members inside. #Return to Commander Maro and collect your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== Complete [[Skyrim:Innocence Lost|Innocence Lost]] by killing [[Skyrim:Grelod the Kind|Grelod the Kind]]. When you are kidnapped by the Brotherhood and brought to the [[Skyrim:Abandoned Shack|Abandoned Shack]], kill [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] instead of a hostage and this quest will begin. Astrid has a rather lengthy animation when she jumps off the bookshelf, during which she is vulnerable and cannot retaliate. After Astrid's death, travel to any city and speak to a guard. Inform them that you killed the Dark Brotherhood's leader, and you will be directed to speak to [[Skyrim:Commander_Maro|Commander Maro]] in [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] southwest of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. He can be found in the [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Outpost|Penitus Oculatus Outpost]]. After speaking to Commander Maro, you will be given the passphrase ("Silence, my brother") to their hideout and directed to kill everyone inside. He says that you should "have the honor" of clearing out the place, meaning you'll be going in alone. Even your [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] do not enter the sanctuary with you. However, spectral entities such as [[Skyrim:Summon Arniel's Shade|Arniel's spirit]] and the [[Skyrim:Conjure Dragon Priest|ghostly Dragon Priest]] (summoned by the [[Skyrim:Konahrik|Konahrik mask]]) will enter with you, and they'll assist you in the assault. The task should be relatively simple, as this quest will have them spread out between each room (as opposed to them being gathered and chatting when you first enter as an actual member). [[Skyrim:Babette|Babette]], [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]], and the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]] won't be in the sanctuary during the attack. You don't need to kill the [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spider]] [[Skyrim:Lis|Lis]], but it will become hostile if it sees you. Loot what you please. You have access to an [[Skyrim:Iron Battleaxe of Chills|Iron Battleaxe of Chills]] on [[Skyrim:Arnbjorn|Arnbjorn]], one of the twenty-four "unusual gems" or Stones of Barenziah needed for the quest [[Skyrim:No Stone Unturned|No Stone Unturned]], the Alteration skill book [[Skyrim:Sithis|Sithis]], many poisons lying around, four different soul gems, part of the [[SR:Marked for Death|Marked for Death]] shout, and the Dark Brotherhood armor. ===Rewards and consequences=== Return to Commander Maro in Dragon Bridge, and he will be overjoyed and reward you with 3,000 gold, regardless of your level. He will also make sure that the [[Skyrim:Emperor Titus Mede II (real)|Emperor]] himself hears of your accomplishments. The quest also yields a good amount of valuable loot that you'd normally only be able to obtain by joining the Dark Brotherhood. All parts of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath will remain accessible and undamaged, as opposed to finishing the Dark Brotherhood questline, where a good chunk of it is destroyed. Destroying the Dark Brotherhood makes a number of rewards unavailable, namely [[Skyrim:Shadowmere|Shadowmere]], a minimum of 20,000 gold, the [[Skyrim:Summon Spectral Assassin|Summon Spectral Assassin]] power, access to the [[Skyrim:Dawnstar Sanctuary|Dawnstar Sanctuary]], the ability to marry [[Skyrim:Muiri|Muiri]], the [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|never-dying]] [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Initiate|Dark Brotherhood Initiate]] followers, the Master trainers for [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] (Babette) and [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]] (Nazir), [[Skyrim:Ancient Shrouded Armor|Ancient Shrouded Armor]], [[Skyrim:Windshear|Windshear]], and [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]]'s outfit ([[Skyrim:Cicero's Clothes|clothes]], [[Skyrim:Cicero's Boots|boots]], [[Skyrim:Cicero's Gloves|gloves]], [[Skyrim:Cicero's Hat|hat]]) and offer of being a follower. (See below for workarounds on marrying Muiri and access to Ancient Shrouded Armor.) ==Notes== *If you have the [[Skyrim:Misdirection|Misdirection]] perk, you can rob Astrid of her gear before you attack her, making her extremely easy to kill. *The key required to exit the Abandoned Shack will not appear in Astrid's inventory if you attempt to pick her pocket, but will only appear in her inventory if you kill her. *If you cast [[Skyrim:Calm|Calm]] on a member of the Dark Brotherhood, they will offer the same dialogue as if you had joined the Dark Brotherhood, with the exception of Nazir, who will not give contracts at all. *After you choose to kill Astrid, any or all of the three captives can be untied and released after her death, though they can also be killed with no consequences. *Don't store anything in the Abandoned Shack, as the building resets every 10 days. *Either joining the Dark Brotherhood or destroying it will prevent further [[Skyrim:World Interactions#Dark Brotherhood Assassin Sent to Kill the Player|assassination attempts against you]]. *After completing this quest, guards will occasionally comment on your accomplishment. See the [[Skyrim:Guard Dialogue#Dialogue added by Quests|Guard Dialogue]] page for specifics. *Even if you finish this quest, [[Skyrim:Aventus Aretino|Aventus Aretino]] will still view you as his savior for getting rid of [[Skyrim:Grelod the Kind|Grelod the Kind]]. *Even if you finish this quest, you can still marry Muiri if [[Skyrim:Bothela|Bothela]] is killed and you invest with Muiri after she takes over [[Skyrim:The Hag's Cure|The Hag's Cure]]. However, killing Bothela yourself will lower Muiri's disposition. *Even if you finish this quest, you can still gain access to the Ancient Shrouded Armor set in [[Skyrim:Hag's End|Hag's End]] by resurrecting the Assassin with [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] or via the [[Skyrim:The Ritual Stone|Ritual Stone]], or by clipping through the stone door. *{{pc22}} You may be able to reverse the events of this quest with [[Skyrim:Console Commands|console commands]], but doing so may cause the game to crash. Open the console and type setstage db02a 10. Then, go to the Abandoned Shack and enter; you'll find Astrid dead. Open the console, click on Astrid, and type resurrect. Wait until she walks outside. Follow her outside, and she will "fly" away. After this, go to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. Repeat the resurrection and following on all of the dead Dark Brotherhood members. *There is a similar quest that starts [[Morrowind:Morrowind|Morrowind]]'s ''[[Tribunal:Tribunal|Tribunal]]'' add-on, called "[[Tribunal:Hunt the Dark Brotherhood|Hunt the Dark Brotherhood]]." *Ironically, killing Astrid during "With Friends Like These..." causes her to say "Well done..." right before this quest begins. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The quest may not trigger upon Astrid's death.|vn=1}} **{{pc22}} Typing setstage dbdestroy 10 in the console resolves this problem, and starts this quest. {{Bug|You still might not be able to gain entrance to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary after speaking with Commander Maro.}} {{bug|Completing this quest may prevent the [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]] quest from progressing beyond the [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Snowhawk (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Fort Snowhawk]], with [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] repeatedly stating that they cannot move on Solitude while [[Skyrim:Vittoria Vici|Vittoria Vici]]'s [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|wedding]] is in progress.}} {{Bug|If you finish this quest, [[Skyrim:Maluril|Maluril]]'s [[Skyrim:Maluril's Journal|journal]] may still be present in [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]], even though he'll never be there himself.|USLEEP|3.0.3|His journal will no longer be present if he isn't there.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I have killed Astrid, the leader of the Dark Brotherhood. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[SKyrim:Nazir|Nazir]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This quest is received after attacking a member of the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]], accidentally or not. Pay a fine to Nazir to get back in the good graces of the family, which completes this quest. You cannot accept or complete any contracts until you pay the fine and Dark Brotherhood members will refuse to talk to you while suspended from the guild.

The fine will be 500 gold if you are a regular member, but if you have completed [[Skyrim:Hail Sithis!|Hail Sithis!]], the amount will be reduced to 300 gold.

== Notes ==

*The [[Skyrim:Spectral Assassin|Spectral Assassin]] is considered a member of the Dark Brotherhood, so if you attack him to the point that he turns hostile then you will have to pay a fine.

*Even if you are not a member of the Dark Brotherhood, this quest can still be triggered while completing the quest [[Skyrim:Destroy_the_Dark_Brotherhood!|Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!]] if you calm any of the assassins and talk to them before you kill them.  If calmed, Nazir can still be paid the 500 gold, after which he will repeatedly tell you to go back and speak with Astrid (even though the quest can only begin if she is already dead).

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Enter the [[SR:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Sanctuary]].
#Assist the survivors.
#Hide in the [[SR:Night Mother|Night Mother]]'s coffin.
#Kill the [[SR:Astrid|traitor]].
#Return to the Night Mother.

==Detailed Walkthrough==

===Welcome Home===
[[File:SR-quest-Death Incarnate 3.jpg|thumb|left|The Sanctuary is under attack!]]
There should be several guards outside the sanctuary when you approach it, along with the horses and carriages that they arrived in. Deal with them and head inside the sanctuary. [[Skyrim:Festus Krex|Festus Krex]] can be found dead outside, pinned against a tree by arrows. There are also several stacks of barrels holding oil, hinting at the way the Penitus Oculatus plans on destroying the sanctuary.

When you enter the Sanctuary, you will notice the entire place is on fire and structurally unsound. Close to the entrance, you will overhear two members of Penitus Oculatus discussing who among the Dark Brotherhood turned traitor. Next to them you will find the body of [[Skyrim:Veezara|Veezara]]. After their conversation, they will head towards you. Deal with them as you see fit. Astrid's and Arnbjorn's rooms are empty, so head down the stairs into the central room of the sanctuary. You will find [[Skyrim:Arnbjorn|Arnbjorn]] in his werewolf form fighting Penitus Oculatus agents. You can try to help him, but his death is scripted and he will die even if you kill the agents around him. There is no way for you to save him. The corpse of [[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]] lies in the next room, as does [[Skyrim:Lis|Lis]].
{{NewLeft}}

===The Burning Brotherhood===
[[File:SR-quest-Death Incarnate 4.jpg|thumb|right|Arnbjorn goes wild as a werewolf]]
Continue through the sanctuary, avoiding the flames until you find [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]]. When you find him, he is locked in a duel with one of the agents, [[Skyrim:Arcturus|Arcturus]]. Assist him by killing his attacker and talk to him. His concerns that you might be the traitor are erased when you save him. Follow him in his search for an escape. As you follow him while he searches for a way out, you should run past the room with the Night Mother. She will call out to you, telling you the only safe place is in her coffin. Make sure Nazir is out of combat, then run and open the Night Mother's coffin. Walk into it, and it will close around you.

In the darkness of the coffin you will hear explosions and sounds of the sanctuary coming down around you. After they end, you will hear the voices of [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] and [[Skyrim:Babette|Babette]] talking as Nazir tries to unearth you. When Nazir opens the coffin, you find yourself in the main room of the sanctuary. Apparently, in the explosions, the coffin was thrown through the stained glass window. After you step out of the coffin and talk to the two survivors, the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]] will talk to you once again and inform you that [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] is still alive. She will ask you to find her. Nazir and Babette will follow you after you inform them of what you've just heard. 

===Burned Beyond Recognition===
[[File:SR-quest-Death Incarnate 2.jpg|thumb|left|The Night Mother tells you to go find Astrid]]
Take the stairs up to Astrid's old chambers and you will see a horrifically burned Astrid stretched out on the floor in her hidden chamber with candles surrounding her. She has performed the Black Sacrament, prayed to the Night Mother and placed herself in the center of the ritual with the [[Skyrim:Blade of Woe|Blade of Woe]] (her symbol of status) beside her. Astrid reveals that she is the traitor. She betrayed you because she wanted things to go back to normal with the Dark Brotherhood. She was skeptical of Cicero and the Night Mother and envious of you for being named the Listener. With her last moments, burned and dying, she performed the Black Sacrament on herself and asked for a contract. When you arrived, her skepticism of the Night Mother disappeared, since she knows that her prayers were heard. 

She reveals that what she prayed for was a mercy killing. She wants to be put out of her misery. You can retrieve the Blade of Woe found next to the dying Astrid, as an optional step. Once you kill Astrid, she will thank you with her dying breath and the quest will update and direct you to return to the Night Mother (in her coffin). Nazir and Babette will comment on her death with anger and pity for their former leader. Once you return, the Night Mother will talk to you, instructing you to fulfill the Brotherhood's contract to kill the Emperor. She suggests talking to [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre|Amaund Motierre]] in Whiterun, but to let Nazir know of your plans first. Hence begins the next quest, [[Skyrim:Hail Sithis!|Hail Sithis!]].
{{NewLeft}}

==Notes==
*Even a non-offensive spell, such as Healing Hands, will kill Astrid after she performs the Black Sacrament. Non-offensive powers, such as Voice of the Emperor, will also work for this purpose.
*If you pickpocket Astrid before joining the Brotherhood and steal the Blade of Woe and then do this quest you can have two Blades of Woe.
*If you attempt to pickpocket Astrid and fail, she will stand up and attack, though she will remain in her burned down state and can still be eliminated.
*After killing Astrid, her body can be resurrected with spells or powers like any other body. She will not have any dialogue in this state.
*If you have any valuables stored in the sleeping area of the sanctuary, be sure to retrieve them after you save Nazir. Once you emerge from the Night Mother's coffin you will not be able to access that area again.

==Bugs==

**Reloading a previous save should fix this.

**Exiting and entering the Sanctuary will fix this.

{{Bug|A copy of the book ''[[Skyrim:A Kiss, Sweet Mother|A Kiss, Sweet Mother]]'' was also intended to be there with the [[Skyrim:Iron Dagger|iron dagger]] and [[Skyrim:Nightshade|nightshade]] sample when Astrid performs the Black Sacrament on herself. Unfortunately, the book disappears once the Sacrament scene is finished due to an improper enable parent setup.|USKP|2.0.4}}

=-2 ([[Skyrim:Eola|Eola]]) (if Verulus dies away from the shrine, failing the main quest)
=1 ([[Skyrim:Brother Verulus|Brother Verulus]]) (if favor quest completed) |Loc=[[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]], [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Markarth)|Hall of the Dead]], [[Skyrim:Reachcliff Cave|Reachcliff Cave]] |Image=SR-quest-The Taste of Death.jpg |ImgDesc=The dining hall in Reachcliff Cave |description=Prepare a [[Skyrim:Brother Verulus|feast]] for the [[Lore:Namira|Lady of Decay]]. |ID=DA11Intro, DA11 |Icon=SR-qico-Daedric.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Investigate the desecration of the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Markarth)|Hall of the Dead]] in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. #Clear Reachcliff Cave of [[Skyrim:Draugr|undead]]. #Bring a [[Skyrim:Brother Verulus|fresh kill]] to Namira's Shrine. #Do the unthinkable for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===City of Stone=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Taste_of_Death_04.jpg|thumb|right| ''"What are you hiding, priest?"'']] [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] is the capital city of [[Skyrim:The Reach|the Reach]], a place of misfortune and decay, and the denizens rarely talk to strangers about anything but the endless problems with the natives of the Reach, the [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]]. Fortunately, the innkeeper at the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] will happily share a few local rumors when asked, so enter the tavern near the main gate and find [[Skyrim:Kleppr|Kleppr]] (or [[Skyrim:Frabbi|Frabbi]] if her husband is dead) behind the bar. One of the rumors may reveal problems with the local [[Skyrim:Hall_of_the_Dead_(Markarth)|Hall of the Dead]], which has been closed for unknown reasons. You are told to see [[Skyrim:Brother Verulus|Brother Verulus]] for further information, thus starting the objective that eventually leads to this quest. If Kleppr or Frabbi refuse to talk about the hall, you can find Brother Verulus yourself, who will openly tell you about current events. Inside [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] you will witness a heated argument between Verulus and [[Skyrim:Thongvor Silver-Blood|Thongvor Silver-Blood]]: '''Thongvor''': ''"What are you hiding, priest?"''
'''Verulus''': ''"I'm not hiding anything. It's closed for a reason."''
'''Thongvor''': ''"Typical Imperial lies. First you take away Talos, now you're keeping us from seeing our honored dead? You and the Jarl will answer for any desecration of my ancestors' bodies."''
'''Verulus''': ''"That's enough, Thongvor. We're done."''
After the conversation, talk to Verulus and he will deny you access to the hall and will provide a standard explanation. You can attempt to bribe, persuade, or intimidate him, although only the first two options will get you anywhere. To succeed at bribery or persuasion, you will need to pass an easy [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]]. {|class=wikitable !width=21%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=20%|Reaction |- | I could help if you tell me. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': All right. I was going to suggest the Jarl hire someone to sort this mess out, anyway.||'''Passed''': Investigate the Hall of the Dead |- | Would some coin help? '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Well, the Priesthood of Arkay always accepts generous donations.
'''Failed''': That's not going to work.||'''Passed''': Investigate the Hall of the Dead
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | I don't like being ignored. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Failed''': Then my answer is the Hall of the Dead is closed. By order of the Jarl. Understand?||'''Failed''': Nothing |- | I'll come back later, then.||colspan=4|Arkay keep you and protect you.||Nothing |} He will then explain the macabre situation in the hall and reveal the truth: ''"We've discovered that some of the dead have been... eaten. Flesh has been chewed off, bones were snapped to get at the marrow inside."'' Verulus then proceeds to ask you to investigate the Hall of the Dead and hands you the [[Skyrim:Markarth Hall of the Dead Key|key]] to the hall. This is the beginning of the favor quest. Alternatively, you can completely ignore Verulus and pick the lock to the hall. Entering the hall this way will trigger the main quest; however, unless you persuade or bribe him, you will not be able to befriend him using the favor quest. ===Hall of the Dead=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Taste_of_Death_02.jpg|thumb|right|Eola in the Hall of the Dead]] Moments after entering, a female voice will echo through the hall, saying, ''"Not many would walk blindly into a crypt, smelling of steel and blood, but not fear. I feel the hunger inside of you. Gnawing at you. You see the dead and your mouth grows wet. Your stomach growls. It's all right. I will not shun you for what you are. Stay. I will tell you everything you have forgotten."'' After the speech, [[Skyrim:Eola|Eola]] will then run up to you and continue in the same vein, trying to seduce you with suggestions and accusations. When she is finished, three options are available. If you choose the third option, the quest will immediately fail, as she will attack you, with no option to yield. You can still complete the favor quest and receive your [[Skyrim:Amulet of Arkay|reward]] from Verulus, but will never get to experience The Taste of Death. If you instead pick any of the two other options, Eola will continue her seductive behavior, eventually mentioning the Lady of Decay, [[Lore:Namira|Namira]], and a so-called safe haven for cannibals like yourself. Regardless of your answer, the quest will start. If you ask her about the place, she will mark [[Skyrim:Reachcliff Cave|Reachcliff Cave]] on your map and reveal the truth about the desecration of the hall. Recently, the cave itself saw the dead rise from their graves, forcing Eola to flee and live in the hall and feast on its more passive inhabitants. She will task you with clearing the cave, and will then cast her [[Skyrim:Invisibility (spell)|invisibility spell]], asking you to meet her at the cave entrance. She will also assure you that the hall will see no further disturbances, and will then leave. Go talk to Brother Verulus and tell him the good news. He will be quite happy, hand you his [[Skyrim:Amulet of Arkay|Amulet of Arkay]] as a reward and return to his duties inside the hall. This completes the favor quest. ===Cave of the Dead=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Taste_of_Death_05.jpg|thumb|right|''"Bring Verulus here. The Lady of Decay will do the rest."'']] Reachcliff Cave is located east and slightly south of Markarth and can easily be reached by crossing the bridge to the south from [[Skyrim:Karthspire|Karthspire]]. As promised, Eola will be waiting for you near the entrance and will seek you out as you approach. She will reveal that the opposition inside the cave consists of [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] enemies and the whole cave has to be cleared. You can choose to have her as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]], so decide whether or not to accept her offer and head inside. Watch out for the higher-leveled draugr in the second chamber and carefully proceed forward. Eola is a powerful follower and will not hesitate to [[Skyrim:Conjuration|summon]] a [[Skyrim:Flame Atronach|flame atronach]] or revive defeated draugr for extra help. In the catacombs, take a left for a difficult jump to a chest on a small ledge. (Use Whirlwind Sprint for an effortless little zoom across the gap). After a short trek, you will arrive in a room with several draugr, including the boss, so dispose of them all and take a look around; the chamber consists of a huge dinner table, and, in the southern end, the very altar of Namira. Eola will now approach and thank you for reclaiming the Shrine, and will ask you to bring in a fresh kill for your initiation into the coven, specifically a priest filled with the taste of the easy life, [[Skyrim:Brother Verulus|Brother Verulus]]. She will then hand you 100 gold to cover expenses and show you the way out. A shortcut to the outside world will now have opened in the room next to the Shrine, so exit the cave and travel to Markarth. ===Champion of Namira=== Back in the Hall of the Dead, the unsuspecting priest has picked up his daily routines and spends most of his time sweeping or praying near the Shrine of Arkay, convinced that everything is all right. Talk to him and ask him for assistance during your travels. In order to get him to follow, you need to pass a speech check. As with the initial conversation with him about investigating the hall, only the first two options will get you anywhere. (However, persuading may be impossible, necessitating a bribe—see [[#Bugs|Bugs]].) {|class=wikitable !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=20%|Reaction |- | There would be treasure to share... '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Treasure, you say? I suppose the Jarl won't mind if I'm gone for a little while. Lead on.

'''Failed''': Nothing |- | I'm willing to pay. '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': That's no small amount of coin, friend. I suppose I can come with you for a short venture. Lead on.
'''Failed''': I'm just not up for it, sorry. I'd rather stay here, have a glass of wine, and perform my rites to Arkay in peace.||'''Passed''': Return to Namira's Shrine
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | You're coming with me. Now. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Failed''': I think you need to calm down before I summon the guards.||'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Never mind, then.||colspan=4|Arkay watch over you.||Nothing |} Leave the Hall of the Dead and fast travel to the secret back entrance to Reachcliff Cave. When you enter the dining hall, you will find several well-known Markarth citizens seated at the large table, all hungry and ready for the evening feast: [[Skyrim:Lisbet|Lisbet]], [[Skyrim:Banning|Banning]], [[Skyrim:Hogni Red-Arm|Hogni Red-Arm]], [[Skyrim:Sanyon|Sanyon]], and [[Skyrim:Nimphaneth|Nimphaneth]]. The table will be set with beverages, bread, cheese and two pieces of [[Skyrim:Human Flesh|human flesh]]. A confused Brother Verulus will approach the table, stuttering. Eola will immediately be over him and will use her seductive charms to make him forget where he is and feel incredibly tired. She will then proceed to invite him to take a rest on the altar in front of the Shrine of Namira, something he will do right away. Listening to the guests' private conversations makes it quite clear what they're all waiting for: the flesh of Verulus. Head to the altar where Eola will invite you to start carving the sleeping priest in front of you. [[File:SR-quest-The_Taste_of_Death_03.jpg|thumb|right|Death of a priest]] At this point, you can choose to kill Eola, which will net you a leveled amount of gold from a grateful Brother Verulus and a fight against all the dinner guests, including the quest-related Lisbet, dog seller Banning and Markarth market merchant Hogni Red-Arm. Killing Eola will cause the quest to fail. Slay the sleeping priest in cold blood, which will make an excited Eola invite you to have the very first bite. Examine the dead priest and choose the option 'eat'. You will then be treated to an animation of yourself feasting on the still warm body of Verulus, and Namira will finally speak to you from her realm. ''"Mortal. I am Namira, the Lady of Decay. Your consumption of the blood and bile of Arkay's own is pleasing to me. I give you my ring. Wear it, and when you feast on the flesh of the dead I will grant you my power."'' You will then receive the [[Skyrim:Ring of Namira|Ring of Namira]] which increases your stamina by 50 points and allows you to feed on corpses for increased health and health regeneration of 50 points for 5 minutes. Eola will then welcome you to the coven and will be available as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] should you ever need her. When all is said and done, leave the cannibals to their feast and head out into Skyrim. ==== Reward ==== {{SRLeveledReward|Large}} ==Notes== * If Thongvor is Jarl of Markarth before you enter Understone Keep for the first time, the argument between him and Verulus does not happen. This can happen if you have completed [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] or the Civil War quests (and sided with the Stormcloaks) before coming to Understone Keep. There is no change in Verulus' dialogue if you speak to him in this case. * After Verulus agrees to follow you to the cave, he will become a follower and will follow you anywhere until you enter the cave. Unlike nearly all other quest followers, if you already have a follower when he joins you, he won't replace them. * Though Namira makes no visible appearance, she's voiced by an unseen NPC named [[Skyrim:Voice of Namira|Voice of Namira]] located in an unreachable room east of Namira's shrine. * If you decide to save Brother Verulus, you can use a Calm spell on the other dinner guests after killing Eola to end the quest, but Banning and Hogni Red-Arm will never leave the feast to return to Markarth. Lisbet will return to her store, but she and Imedhnain will be hostile towards you. Use another calm spell on them and leave the shop. Wait at least a day before returning and Lisbet will be friendly again, acting as though the feast had been successful. * If you are a werewolf and have decided to save Brother Verulus by killing cannibals, be careful when you go in to beast form as it can cause issues. If you go into beast form, Verulus may wake up early in the middle of the fight and start the conversation with you as if he has already been saved. You will receive the same reward from him, but he may get killed or possibly stuck walking out the door and be unable to return to Markarth. If he sees you in beast form after the fight is over and has already paid you, he will attack you. * After killing Brother Verulus in Reachcliff Cave, you are able to search his body and get back your earlier bribe. * After completing the quest you can speak to the other guests, many of whom you might recognize from [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. If you meet the guests later, while they are at work, you can ask about the feast to which they will respond ''"Only the guests must know."'' You may also encounter [[Skyrim:Sigar|Sigar]] in the wilderness, feasting on a fresh corpse. * If you attack any guest after completing the quest, Eola becomes aggressive. Killing Eola, even after quest completion, causes your journal to show all quest objectives as failed, although you will retain the Ring if you had received it. * If you are wearing the Ring of Namira and receive the Cursed Ring of Hircine from Sinding during the quest [[Skyrim:Ill Met By Moonlight|Ill Met By Moonlight]], you will forever be able to feed off of bodies and obtain +50 health and +50% health regeneration. * Using the special ability of the Ring of Namira to feed on a corpse will make it impossible to feed on it in beast form if you're a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolf]]. The reverse is also true, corpses fed on in beast form cannot be cannibalized with the Ring of Namira. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you enter the Hall of the Dead too quickly after speaking with Verulus, he may follow you in and react as though you were trespassing.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you run through the Hall of the Dead and exit the door on the other side before Eola has finished her speech, then re-enter the hall, she will pick up where she left off but a new instance of the same speech will begin upon entry, causing an echo like effect. The quest progress appears unaffected by this glitch.|vn=1 }} {{Bug|If Eola dies sooner than intended, Brother Verulus may become glitched and will continually approach you for conversation whenever you enter the keep.|USKP|1.2.7}} {{Bug|If you have the miscellaneous objective to inform Verulus that you've cleared out the Hall of the Dead, be sure to speak to him about this first. Failure to do so can lead to him glitching and not following you.|USKP|1.2.7}} {{Bug|Verulus cannot be persuaded to follow the player to the cave without a bribe (or the [[Skyrim:Amulet of Articulation|Amulet of Articulation]]), because the Speech check is done to Verulus instead of the player.|USLEEP|2.0.9|trackerid=18667}} {{Bug|If Eola is told to wait outside Reachcliff Cave, she will continually forcegreet.|USKP|2.1.1|This is due to a missing stage to block this from happening.}} {{Bug|If you have Dawnguard installed, the game may crash every time you get near Reachcliff Cave.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} You can use the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command player.moveto to teleport in and out of the cave. {{Bug|Verulus may not be able to enter through the secret entrance, instead trying to take the long way around.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} You can use the console command player.moveto to teleport yourself to him. {{Bug|If Eola somehow dies in Reachcliff Cave, the quest will end. Your target will no longer be there and the quest will disappear from your journal. There is no trace of you ever having the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The shortcut exit from the chamber next to the shrine in Reachcliff Cave may fail to open, requiring you to take the long way out.
