{{Featured Article}} {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=[[User:Helenaannevalentine|Helenaannevalentine]] |checkedBy=[[User:Nocte_Canticum|Nocte]] |reward=[[User:Helenaannevalentine|Helenaannevalentine]] |rewardChecked=Chezburgar }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] |Reward=Nightingale Blessings |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Blindsighted|Blindsighted]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Under New Management|Under New Management]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Twilight Sepulcher]] |Image=SR-place-Twilight Sepulcher.jpg |ImgDesc=The entrance to the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Twilight Sepulcher]] |description=Walk the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Pilgrim's Path]] and return the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]] to its rightful place. |ID=TG09 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |SuggLevel=8 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Enter the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Twilight Sepulcher]]. # Speak to the [[Skyrim:Nightingale Sentinel|Nightingale Sentinel]]. #* ''(Optional)'' Find [[Skyrim:Nystrom's Journal|Nystrom's Journal]]. # Follow the Pilgrim's Path. # Unlock the Ebonmere with the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]]. # Listen to [[Skyrim:Nocturnal|Nocturnal]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]]. # Choose a Nightingale blessing. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Twilight Sepulcher=== [[File:SR-quest-Darkness Returns 09.jpg|thumb|right|Gallus's spirit guarding the entrance to the Twilight Sepulcher]] Once you enter the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Twilight Sepulcher]], you will come to a large hall where the spirit of a [[Skyrim:Nightingale Sentinel|Nightingale Sentinel]] stands watch. When you approach him, he will initiate a conversation: ''"I don't recognize you, but I sense that you're one of us. Who are you?"''
'''''"I'd ask the same question of you."''''':
''"The last of the Nightingale Sentinels, I'm afraid. I've defended the Sepulcher alone for what seems like an eternity."''
'''''"The last? What happened to the rest?"''''':
''"We were betrayed by one of our own kind. In fact, I'm to blame for what's happened here."''
'''''"How are you to blame?"''''':
''"I was blinded. Blinded by dark treachery masquerading as friendship. Perhaps if I had been more vigilant, then [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]] wouldn't have lured me to my fate and stolen the Skeleton Key."''
'''''"Wait a moment... You're [[Skyrim:Gallus|Gallus]]!"''''':
''"I haven't heard that name in a long time. How do you know of me?"''
'''''"I have the Key."''''':
''"The Key! You have the Skeleton Key! I never thought I'd see it again. And Mercer Frey?"''
'''''"Dead."''''':
''"Then... it's over and my death wasn't in vain. I owe you a great deal, Nightingale."'' From here, you will have the option of three replies: {| class=wikitable width="80%" |- |style="width:23%"|'''''"I did this for Nocturnal."'''''||style="width:23%"|'''''"I did this to honor the Guild."'''''||style="width:23%"|'''''"I did this to get rich."''''' |- |''"That's quite a noble sentiment for someone in our... well, in your line of work."''||''"You've done the Guild a great deed. And although they may not show it, I'm certain they appreciate your sacrifices."''||''"Were I able to provide it, I'd shower you in wealth for what you've done."'' |} No matter which option you choose to reply with, Gallus will have the same response: ''"My only regret is that you had to undertake this task alone."''
'''''"Karliah helped me."'''''
''"Karliah... she's still alive? I feared she'd befallen the same fate, ending up a victim of Mercer's betrayal."''
'''''"Then take the Key and right all the wrongs."'''''
''"Nothing would bring me more pride than to return the Key, but I'm afraid it's impossible. From the moment I arrived here, I've felt myself... well... dying."''
'''''"How can a spirit die?"'''''
''"The Sepulcher isn't merely a temple or a vault to house the Key. Within these walls is the Ebonmere... a conduit to Nocturnal's realm of [[Lore:Evergloam|Evergloam]]. When Mercer stole the Key, that conduit closed, severely limiting our ties to her."''
'''''"Then I'll have to proceed alone."'''''
''"I'm afraid so. I'm weakening, and I can feel myself slipping away. The years without restoration of my power have taken their toll. Whatever damage has been caused can only be corrected by following the Pilgrim's Path to the Ebonmere and replacing the Key."'' {{Anchor||Objective25}}If you inquire further about the Pilgrim's Path, Gallus will say ''"I wish I could help you, but I've been a prisoner in this very chamber for the last quarter century. The only possible help I've come across are the remains of some poor fellow who was trying to follow in your footsteps. Perhaps his journal can help?"'' This will present you with an optional goal to retrieve [[Skyrim:Nystrom's Journal|Nystrom's journal]], which contains clues about the five "tests" you will face along the way. The journal is found on [[Skyrim:Nystrom|Nystrom's remains]] on the east side of the chamber, along with a leveled, enchanted weapon. ===The First Test===
{|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="75%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black; text-align:center;"|'''''"Shadows of their former selves, sentinels of the dark. They wander ever more and deal swift death to defilers."''''' |}
[[File:SR-quest-Darkness_Returns_02.jpg|thumb|right|Nightingale Sentinels in the room of the first test]] Continue into the Sepulcher. In the first chamber, you will notice two Nightingale Sentinels reside here. One will be found in a room to the left, along with an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] and a secret chamber. The door to the secret chamber can be opened by pressing a button found behind the table. The other Sentinel can be found wandering near the steps in the main room. Starting a fight risks gaining the attention of both of them, so you can either choose to fight or try your luck in sneaking past them. Proceed onward into the next hallway, being mindful of the [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] in the hallway. On top of the stairs ahead, there is another Sentinel keeping watch. Note that the stairs themselves are pitch-black, but do not have any traps. Be careful however: if you use any form of light, it will likely attract the Sentinel. ===The Second Test===
{|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="75%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black; text-align:center;"| '''''"Above all they stand, vigilance everlasting. Beholden to the murk yet contentious of the glow."''''' |}
[[File:SR-quest-Darkness_Returns_03.jpg|thumb|right|The darkened room of the second test]] The next chamber (and the second test you will face) is a room with brightly lit areas and a shadowy path running through them. Stick to the shadows here, since stepping into the light will result in continuous health damage that can quickly kill you. Note that if you're trying to level [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]], this is a good place to do so; it is impossible to resist the damage (even with console commands or the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]]) as the damage caused by the light is scripted and will drain your health '''very''' rapidly (up to 100 points of damage per second) regardless of your level. The light damage is also affected by game difficulty, so be especially cautious if you are playing at higher difficulties. There are several [[Skyrim:Tripwire|tripwire]]-triggered [[Skyrim:Dart_Trap|dart traps]] along the shadowy path: the first one can be found as you make your way up the first flight of stairs, across the landing just ahead of you; the second tripwire is located just before you descend the second flight of stairs; the third tripwire is found just before you travel across a wooden bridge; the last one is located at the top of the last remaining stairs descending down. Once you reach the end of the chamber, proceed onward through the hallway until you reach the next room. {{NewLeft}} ===The Third Test===
{|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="75%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black; text-align:center;"| '''''"Offer what She desires most, but reject the material. For her greatest want is that which cannot be seen, felt or carried."''''' |}
[[File:SR-quest-Darkness_Returns_04.jpg|thumb|right|A statue of Nocturnal in the room of the third test]] The third chamber is located at the end of the hallway, and contains a statue of [[Skyrim:Nocturnal|Nocturnal]], a dead [[Skyrim:Bandit (dead)#Dunmer_Male|bandit]] found on the floor, and a wooden tray with an offering of gold and soul gems. The third test along the Pilgrim's Path requires you to give Nocturnal an offering she desires: ''Darkness''. In order to do so, find the chains hidden behind the stone torches on either side. Pulling both chains will put out the flames, creating darkness. This will cause a hidden passage to open from behind the statue, leading to a corridor and your fourth test. {{NewLine}} ===The Fourth Test===
{|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="75%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black; text-align:center;"| '''''"Direct and yet indirect. The path to salvation a route of cunning with fortune betraying the foolish."''''' |}
[[File:SR-quest-Darkness_Returns_05.jpg|thumb|right|The two paths in the room of the fourth test]] The corridor that lies ahead has a path leading directly through to a door. However, this path contains multiple traps, including two pressure plates (which both trigger darts to be released from the ceiling) and a [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|pendulum trap]]. If you choose to brave the pendulum trap, beware: at the end there is another pressure plate to the right which triggers a [[Skyrim:Spear Trap|spear trap]] from multiple sides of the room. Opening the door ahead releases a [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|battering ram]] from behind the door. You can also choose to avoid that path by going through a master-locked door (easily opened with use of the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]]), which is located to the left side just before the pendulum trap. This path leads to a small chamber which has two Nightingale Sentinels guarding the area. This area also contains a copy of the [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|Lockpicking]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Proper Lock Design|Proper Lock Design]]'' (on the table near the southeast corner of the room), some gold, several bottles of [[Skyrim:Poisons|poison]], and other minor loot. A copy of the [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Sacred Witness|Sacred Witness]]'' may be on the table near the altar on the northwest side (see [[#Bugs|bugs]]). You may now continue through the corridors until you reach the door leading into the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher Inner Sanctum|Twilight Sepulcher Inner Sanctum]]. ===The Final Test===
{|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="75%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black; text-align:center;"| '''''"The journey is complete, the Empress's embrace awaits the fallen. Hesitate not if you wish to gift her your eternal devotion."''''' |}
[[File:SR-quest-Darkness_Returns_06.jpg|thumb|left|Returning the Skeleton Key to its rightful place]] Proceed unopposed down a hallway and through a second set of doors, opening into a room with a well. It is advisable to save before jumping in due to a large number of potential [[#Bugs|bugs]]. You may suffer a small amount of health damage from the fall. Examine the skeletal remains of [[Skyrim:Anders|Anders]], the thief who is mentioned in Nystrom's [[Skyrim:Nystrom's Journal|journal]]. A cutscene is triggered shortly afterwards, and the floor of the well descends to reveal a room with three closed doors and a lock at your feet (which requires the Skeleton Key). Use the key to re-open the Ebonmere. Nocturnal will then emerge from the Ebonmere. [[File:SR-quest-Darkness_Returns_07.jpg|thumb|right|Nocturnal emerging from the Ebonmere]] '''Nocturnal:''' ''"My, my. What do we have here? It's been a number of years since I've set foot on your world. Or perhaps it's been moments. One tends to lose track. So... once again the Key has been stolen and a "champion" returns it to the Sepulcher. Now that Ebonmere has been restored, you stand before me awaiting your accolades; a pat on your head... a kiss on your cheek. What you fail to realize is your actions were expected and represent nothing more than the fulfillment of your agreement. Don't mistake my tone for displeasure, after all, you've obediently performed your duties to the letter. But we both know this has little to do with honor and oaths and loyalty. It's about the reward; the prize. Fear not. You'll have your trinkets, your desire for power, your hunger for wealth. I bid you to drink deeply from the Ebonmere, mortal. For this is where the Agent of Nocturnal is born. The Oath has been struck, the die has been cast and your fate awaits you in the Evergloam. Farewell, Nightingale. See to it the Key stays this time, won't you?"'' You are now directed to speak with [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]], who has appeared inside the Sepulcher. ''"I'm glad you were able to bring the Key back safely. Nocturnal seemed quite pleased with your efforts."''
'''''"Pleased? She sounded indifferent."''''':
''"I wouldn't take that to heart. It's her way. Think of her as a scolding mother continually pushing you harder to be successful; outwardly sounding angry but silently content. I assure you, had she been displeased with you, we wouldn't be having this conversation."''
'''''"What's this about becoming an Agent of Nocturnal?"''''':
''"The circles at the base of the Ebonmere imbue you with powers befitting a Nightingale Agent. The crescent moon represents the Agent of Shadow, the half moon for the Agent of Subterfuge and the full moon for the Agent of Strife."'' Now you are able to select either of the three Agents of Nocturnal: * '''[[Skyrim:Agent of Stealth|Agent of Shadow]]''' (Crescent Moon) - Use this power to be invisible for 2 minutes while sneaking. :''"The {{hover|An alternate name for the Agent of Shadow|Agent of Stealth}} is the master of remaining unseen. They are able to manipulate the darkness and use it to their advantage.
:''On moonlit nights or in darkened rooms, this agent literally becomes invisible."'' * '''[[Skyrim:Agent of Subterfuge|Agent of Subterfuge]]''' (Half Moon) - Use this power to cause all nearby enemies to fight each other for 30 seconds. :''"The Agent of Subterfuge utilizes shadow to cloud the judgement of those around him.
:''By weaving the darkness to their will, this agent can manipulate others into fighting for the Nightingale for a limited time."'' * '''[[Skyrim:Agent of Strife|Agent of Strife]]''' (Full Moon) - Use this power to invoke a powerful life-drain effect. :''"{{sic|This|The}} Agent of Strife can send forth a tendril of pure darkness into the heart of another, causing great injury to them.
:''At the same time, this tether will bolster the agent's own life force, making him stronger.""'' If you ask Karliah why you cannot be all three Agents at once, she will respond with ''"This is Nocturnal's way of maintaining balance. If you ever feel the need to change your abilities, you can return to the Sepulcher and step onto a different circle. Be warned that once you've chosen, you can't reselect for at least a day."'' '''''"So what now?"'''''
''"Now, your life as a Nightingale begins. Should the need arise, you'll be summoned to the Sepulcher in order to defend it."''
'''''"And you?"'''''
''"The Guild has welcomed me back with open arms. I feel like a void in my life has finally been filled. I only hope that this isn't an ending to things, but actually the beginning."''
'''''"The beginning of what?"'''''
''"Why, perhaps the greatest crime spree Skyrim's ever known. There are pockets brimming with coin and coffers overflowing with riches ripe for the picking. We may be Nightingales, but in our hearts we're still thieves and we're damn good at what we do."''
You can now return to the [[Skyrim:Nightingale Hall|Nightingale Hall]] and use it as a home if you wish. Karliah will also reside there. Before you leave the Twilight Sepulcher however, there is a short cutscene where Gallus appears and speaks to Karliah before entering the Evergloam. [[File:SR-quest-Darkness Returns 08.jpg|thumb|right|Karliah's final farewell to Gallus]] '''Gallus:''' ''"Karliah?"''
'''Karliah:''' ''"Gallus! I feared I would never see you again. I was afraid you'd become like the others."''
'''Gallus:''' ''"If it were not for the actions of this Nightingale, your fears would have come true. He/She honors us all."''
'''Karliah:''' ''"What will you do now, my love?"''
'''Gallus:''' ''"Nocturnal calls me to the Evergloam. My contract has been fulfilled."''
'''Karliah:''' ''"Will I ever see you again?"''
'''Gallus:''' ''"When your debt to Nocturnal has been paid, we'll embrace once again."''
'''Karliah:''' ''"Farewell, Gallus. Eyes open... walk with the shadows."''
'''Gallus:''' ''"Goodbye, Karliah."''
Approaching Karliah again and asking where Gallus went, she will respond by saying: ''"Gallus's Oath has been paid. His actions have satisfied the terms. Now his spirit becomes one with the Evergloam... the realm of perpetual twilight and the cradle of shadow."''
'''''"So, he's gone?"'''''
''"No, not gone... he's become one with the shadows. This is the greatest honor a Nightingale can possibly achieve. In death, he's become a part of that which we use to live."''
'''''"They're a part of the darkness around us?"'''''
''"Absolutely. When we say "walk with the shadows," we are asking those Nightingales who have passed on to protect us. It's believed that they are literally what guides our uncanny luck... by placing their hands in ours. That's why the Ebonmere needed to be reopened. Without it, there's no way Nocturnal was able to allow them through."''
'''''"How will I know if I'm needed here?"'''''
''"If this place is in danger ever again, the shadows will call. Should the need arise, a portal connects the Sepulcher and Nightingale Hall. Use it whenever you wish."'' To exit the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Sepulcher]], you can enter any of the three portals surrounding the Ebonmere. The portals will take you directly to the entrance of the Sepulcher, and if you look back, you will notice that the path that once led to the Pilgrim's Path now has a portal which will take you directly to the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher Inner Sanctum|Inner Sanctum]]. ===Returning Home=== Once you've returned to the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (place)|Thieves Guild]], [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] will greet you by remarking, ''"It's good to see you in one piece lad/lass!"'' He will then go on to say: ''"I just wanted to give you a proper thank you for everything you've done. The Guild is back on its feet again and on its way to a prosperous future."'' He will also ask about the Skeleton Key. When you say that you've returned it back to the Sepulcher, Brynjolf will reply: ''"That's it then. After all of those years of helplessly watching the Guild decline. But enough of that... I'm confident that with you in charge, we'll soon have more gold than we could possibly spend."'' Asking where he will be from now on will cause him to say: ''"I'll be down here, trying to coordinate everything with Delvin and Vex; to make sure the coin keeps flowing... and no one skims! If you still feel like doing some jobs, I'm sure Delvin and Vex have more than their fair share to give out. Either way, it's been a pleasure, my friend. Here's to the future of the Guild. May it last another thousand years!"'' If you have already completed the reputation quests, then you can now complete [[Skyrim:Under New Management|Under New Management]], the last main quest available for the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]]. However, you are still able to complete [[Skyrim:Thieves_Guild_(faction)#Special_Job_quests|jobs]] given by either [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin]] or [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]]. ==Achievements== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|Darkness Returns (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== * The completion of this quest will remove the [[Skyrim:Skeleton Key|Skeleton Key]] from your inventory permanently. * You cannot bring [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] into the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Twilight Sepulcher]] with you, though the standard reminder may fail to appear. * If you already have Nystrom's journal when you get the objective to retrieve it, re-read the book to complete the objective. * Because there is now a portal from the Sepulcher entrance to the Inner Sanctum, the Pilgrim's Path becomes permanently inaccessible after the quest is completed. ==Bugs== {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Gallus's Encoded Journal|Gallus's Encoded Journal]] cannot be removed from your inventory after the quest is completed.|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} ** {{pc22}} The following console command will fix this: player.removeitem CEDA6 1. ** {{pc22}} Alternatively, if you wish to keep it, using player.drop CEDA6 1 will drop the journal and not delete it. {{Bug|Entering the Twilight Sepulcher, hearing the first of Gallus's dialogue, and then leaving will cause the door to the Pilgrim's Path to stay closed and never open upon returning. This will be caused by "Nightingale Sentinel" being replaced with "Gallus" after exiting dialogue with him. Speaking with the "Gallus" version of the sentinel with all topics will ''not'' cause the door to open because he does not have the proper permissions.|vn=1}} **Solution: If you go to the right around the door of the Pilgrim's Path, you will see a glitched area that can appear blue. You will also see the inside of the Pilgrim's Path. Use the [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] shout to jump the gap and gain entrance to the path. Falling will either return you to the entrance area or kill you, depending on how you fall. The objective will not reappear until you talk to Nocturnal near the end of the quest. {{Bug|After going through the well and dropping into the main chamber, Karliah may not show up at all, show up and leave promptly, or show up late. It may help to wait a few hours before dropping into the well in order to have Karliah show up. It may also be helpful to NOT loot Anders upon dropping into the well. Karliah needs to be present for the whole conversation with Nocturnal, so ensure you save the game prior to dropping into the well and load up each time until it works properly. As the conversation ends, she may try to leave, so ensure that you are next to her and ready to speak as soon as Nocturnal goes away and your quest updates to "Speak with Karliah". If the quest doesn't update after Nocturnal tells you to drink from the Ebonmere, simply wait a few hours and the quest should update.|vn=1}} **{{pc22}} If Karliah is not showing up, it may be possible to finish the quest with the console, though the first course of action should always be to reload an earlier save. While Nocturnal speaks, move Karliah to you with the moveto player command: prid 1B07F then moveto player Never use the placeatme command, as that just spawns a duplicate, not the actual unique NPC, and it will likely result in issues and actual game breakage further along. When Nocturnal is finished, you may need to update the quest with setstage TG09 60. {{Bug|This quest may halt after you are able to receive one of the three abilities and Karliah has spoken to Gallus. Her dialogue says she will return to Nightingale Hall, but she stays there for 24 hours, then ends up in Snow Veil Sanctum. She also states that a portal will exist in Nightingale Hall, but none is there; in fact, nothing changes at all. Brynjolf shows up in the Thieves Guild (with his old Thieves Guild gear on, not the Nightingale gear) but just says "I'm busy, talk to me later."|vn=1}} {{Bug|{{xbox22}}{{ps22}} At the end of the quest, after Nocturnal speaks to you, you're instructed to speak to Karliah. However, in some cases all she says is "Yes, fellow Nightingale?" and gives no dialogue options.|vn=1}} ** This seems to be caused by completing [[Skyrim:Hard Answers|Hard Answers]] a second time. ** It helps to wait for a few hours after inserting the key. The game will reload upon completion of the wait with Karliah where she needs to be. {{Bug|Although Karliah says at the end of the quest that henceforth a portal connects the Sepulcher and Nightingale Hall, this portal is hard to find or nonexistent.}} {{Bug|When you pull the chain next to the Nocturnal Statue during the third test, the lights will go out but the door will remain shut.|vn=1}} {{Bug|The ''[[Skyrim:Sacred Witness|Sacred Witness]]'' skill book may not be present. If you read the book in either of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuaries, the one here will disappear.|USKP|2.0.4}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||With the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal safely in my possession, I'm bound for the Twilight Sepulcher to return it to its resting place. {{Quest Objective|10|Enter the Twilight Sepulcher}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Speak to the Nightingale Sentinel}} {{Quest Objective|25|(Optional) Retrieve Nystrom's Journal {{Quest Comment|if you followed the [[#Objective25|appropriate]] dialogue choices}}}} |30||Within the Twilight Sepulcher, I happened upon the spirit of Gallus, the Nightingale murdered by Mercer Frey. As a reward for my actions, she allowed me to become a true Nightingale Agent and imbued me with the appropriate ability befitting my station. |missing=0, 45 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Daedric]] {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Blindsighted|Blindsighted]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Under New Management|Under New Management]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Thieves_Guild_(faction)#Quests|Thieves Guild]]}}

Skyrim:Dampened Spirits.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=JR |checkedBy=SerCenKing |reward=multiple |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] |Reward=Enchanted leveled one-handed weapon; [[Skyrim:Mallus Maccius|Mallus Maccius]] becomes available as a [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Fences|fence]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Scoundrel's Folly|Scoundrel's Folly]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (place)|The Thieves Guild]], [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]], [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]] |Image=SR-quest-Dampened Spirits.jpg |ImgDesc=The vat containing Sabjorn's new mead |description=Put [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar's]] competition out of business. |ID=TG03 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |SuggLevel=8 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]]. #Meet [[Skyrim:Mallus Maccius|Mallus Maccius]] at [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]]. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Sabjorn|Sabjorn]] in the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]]. #Engage in some industrial sabotage and witness the mead tasting failure. #Acquire the promissory note and return to Maven. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Preparation=== As you will be battling [[Skyrim:Ataxia|Ataxia]]-bearing skeevers, [[Skyrim:Resist Disease|resist disease]] or [[Skyrim:Cure Disease|cure disease]] [[Skyrim:Potions|potions]] or [[Skyrim:Enchantments|enchantments]] are useful. Furthermore, given the vermin's speed, a fast, light melee weapon is advised. Given [[Skyrim:Hamelyn|Hamelyn]]'s magical ability, resist [[Skyrim:Resist Magic|magic]], [[Skyrim:Resist Shock|shock]], [[Skyrim:Resist Fire|fire]], and [[Skyrim:Resist Frost|frost]] spells or enchantments are useful. ===Black-Briar Business=== Now that you're a full member of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], you've been told that [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]] wants to see you. You are likely to find her on the second floor of [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|The Bee and Barb]]. After a condescending greeting, Maven will solicit your cooperation in putting her competitor, the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]], out of business. She will also ask you to perform some industrial espionage to understand how Honningbrew could have started up their operation and achieved success so quickly. She will direct you to meet [[Skyrim:Mallus Maccius|Mallus Maccius]] at [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] for further instructions. ===Meet Mallus Maccius=== Mallus will tell you that [[Skyrim:Sabjorn|Sabjorn]], Honningbrew's owner, is planning to hold a special tasting for an important personage, and that you must poison the mead for the occasion. He suggests that you approach Sabjorn and offer to help him with a pest infestation, then use the poison he will give you to accomplish the deed. He instructs you to access the mead vats through a tunnel leading there from the meadery's basement. Although he claims you could alternatively pick the lock on the brewery door, you can't, as it requires a key which is only found inside the boilery. His own motives are quite simple: he'll be given control of the meadery from Maven once Sabjorn is out of the way. ===Infestation Elimination=== Sabjorn will quickly accept your offer to help and provide you with the required poison as well as the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery Key|key]] to the Meadery. If you successfully [[Skyrim:Persuade|persuade]] him, he'll even give you half your pay upfront (500 gold) - although the way things turn out, this is all you'll get from him. {|class=wikitable width="100%" !width=25%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=14%|Reaction |- | That's the only way I operate. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Oh, very well. Here's half. You get the rest when the job's done.
'''Failed''': Well that's not how I operate, so forget it.||'''Passed''': Get 500 gold
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | You'd better, or I yell "skeever." '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Okay, okay. No need to make rash decisions. Here's half. You get the rest when the job's done.
'''Failed''': Yell all you want. It's not going to change my mind.||'''Passed''': Get 500 gold
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Just pay me when the job's done.||colspan=4|My only demand is that these vermin are permanently eliminated before my reputation is completely destroyed.||Nothing |} Sabjorn will also, if asked, talk about how he gets free labor from Maccius by trapping him into a debt he can't afford to repay. In the basement, you'll easily find the tunnel Maccius pointed as the infestation's source. Fight your way past the tough Venomfang [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]] as well as a few [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]], taking care to avoid bear traps and tripwire-activated swinging maces along the way. You'll emerge in a large chamber where a mad [[Skyrim:Bandit Wizard|bandit wizard]] named Hamelyn is guarded by several vermin. Try to use sneak to avoid fighting them all the same time, as Hamelyn can cast powerful destruction spells and is especially lethal if he catches you in a weakened condition. Poison the skeever nest next to Hamelyn's alchemy lab and don't miss the [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Three Thieves|Three Thieves]]'' lying atop a chest nearby. Press on, avoiding two bear traps, and you'll arrive at the door leading to [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Boilery|the boilery]]. ===Mellow Mead=== Head up the stairs to a balcony overlooking the room and head towards the lone brewing vat on the far side. Poison it and exit using the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Brewhouse Key|Honningbrew Brewhouse key]] hanging on a hook on the right side of the door. Head back inside the meadery and you'll meet either [[Skyrim:Commander Caius|Commander Caius]] or [[Skyrim:Sinmir|Sinmir]] (if the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] have taken Whiterun) tasting the mead - Sabjorn will not pay you what he owes you yet (citing the need to go through with the mead tasting first), so if you got your 500 gold earlier, that's as good as it gets. The taster will sense something wrong with the drink and blame it on poor sanitary conditions. For this perceived offense, he will place Mallus Maccius in charge of the meadery and haul Sabjorn to jail at swordpoint - so you never DO get the rest of the pay (or any of it, if you didn't talk him into giving half in advance). Once Sabjorn has departed, speak to Mallus about gathering business intelligence for Maven and he'll hand over the [[Skyrim:Sabjorn's Dresser Key|key]] to Sabjorn's dresser. Head upstairs and steal the [[Skyrim:Promissory Note|promissory note]] from the dresser. An expert-locked door nearby will open to reveal a room with some silver ingots, a silver necklace, some coin purses, and the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Decanter|Honningbrew Decanter]], a miscellaneous unique item that can be sold to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] for a fair price. Be sure to read the [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:A Game at Dinner|A Game at Dinner]]'', which is found on the table closest to the door. ===Mysterious Missive=== Head back to the Bee and Barb in Riften and report your success to Maven, who is frustrated by her inability to identify the note's author. When you point out the author's symbol is the same as that on the [[Skyrim:Goldenglow Bill of Sale (safe)|bill of sale]] previously found in the Goldenglow Estate safe she suggests taking it to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]]. Provided you didn't kill anyone but Hamelyn, she will then pay you with a leveled enchanted sword or dagger. Once you're back in the Cistern, Brynjolf will muse that the identical symbol points to someone attempting to drive a wedge between Maven and the guild, and will send you off to Mercer to continue your search. Mallus will now also be available as a [[Skyrim:Fence (merchant)|fence]]. ==Notes== *If you report back to Sabjorn while having a [[SR:Crime|bounty]] of at least 1000 gold in [[SR:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun]], the captain of the guard will try to arrest you on sight. Remaining out of sight and talking to Sabjorn is virtually impossible, so it's advised to bring the captain to his knees and quickly talk to Sabjorn, then remain undetected until the winetasting scene starts. It is then recommended to stay hidden until the captain leaves with Sabjorn. Alternatively, just pay off your bounty before you head back to the Meadery. *If you steal the Honningbrew Mead from the barrels in the back of the Meadery before the quest is finished and return there after finishing the quest, the barrels will refill themselves with Black-Briar Mead, allowing you to steal the mead again and make even more gold. *If you sneak past Hamelyn and don't kill him, Mallus will still talk as if you have killed him. Even if you return to Honningbrew Meadery Basement, after the quest is over, Hamelyn will be there. *If you bring [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]{{DG}} to the Meadery after the quest is finished, she will occasionally approach the barrel Commander Caius drank from, then pour and drink an invisible goblet of mead from it. *Despite Mallus suggesting it as an alternate point of entry, you can't enter the brewhouse until after you make your way through the tunnels for the first time. The front door is unpickable and can only be unlocked using the key that you find inside the boilery. *Right after the persuasion check, you can exit out of the conversation, allowing you to restart the conversation and it offers a chance to repeat the check indefinitely and train [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you break into [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]] before receiving this quest, it will not become available at the end of [[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]].|confirmed=1|OSP|1.4|However, if this bug has already been triggered on a prior version to Patch 1.4, then the quest will remain unavailable on that save file even with the patch installed.}} ** {{Pc22}} If you cannot obtain the quest, you can force it to start using the console with startquest TG03, followed by setstage TG03 10. {{Bug|If you approach the nest in the first person view, the "activate nest" button needed to poison the nest may fail to appear.|confirmed=1}} ** Changing to the third person view can sometimes resolve this. ** {{Pc22}} You can also advance this manually using the console command setstage TG03 45. {{Bug|After completing the quest [[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]], if you do not ask Brynjolf why Maven Black-Briar is requesting a meeting, the quest will not become available. Also Brynjolf will not speak to you, saying only that he has "important tasks to be doing".|OSP|1.4}} ** {{Pc22}} If you cannot obtain the quest, you can force it to start using the console with startquest TG03, followed by setstage TG03 10. {{Bug|If speaking to Maven outside of the Bee and Barb, while she is headed to the inn, she will simply stand in the same spot day and night until the quest is over.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Eimar has some lines at the Bannered Mare that don't make sense for him to use while he's there. One wasn't conditioned to the location he's in, and the other was using an incorrect function to check if this quest is finished or not.|USSEP|4.2.7}} *If Whiterun Hold has a Stormcloak government at the time you do this quest, then [[Skyrim:Sinmir|Sinmir]] is supposed to be present for the tasting rather than [[Skyrim:Commander Caius|Commander Caius]]. However, there are multiple bugs that can interfere with this. *{{Bug|Activating this quest but not finishing it before activating [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]] may cause Caius to be present for the tasting instead of Sinmir, where he will fail to drink the mead, causing the quest to stall.|USKP|2.0.8}} ***{{Pc22}} You can also transport Sinmir to the Meadery using the console commands prid 813ba and moveto player. ***{{Pc22}} You can also skip this scene using the console command setstage TG03 80. This will progress the quest to where you have to talk to Mallus Maccius again. *{{Bug|Another variation of this bug can sometimes place Caius at the tasting even if the Stormcloaks have already gained Whiterun before you activate this quest. Fortunately, this variation does not prevent the quest from progressing as intended.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you successfully destroy three beehives and complete the Loud and Clear quest, but go back to Goldenglow Estate and destroy more beehives before you speak to Maven Black-Briar, Maven will speak to you as if you failed the earlier quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After you finish the quest, the Honningbrew Mead barrels outside of the meadery may not be changed to Black-Briar Mead barrels.|USKP|2.1.1|Proper enable parents have been added to the existing barrels as well as the created replacement barrels. The barrels were also missing their ownership settings.}} *Mallus Maccius may not have the option to sell merchandise at the meadery after the quest is finished despite offering to provide fence services. Instead, at odd hours of the day, he may respond as if you're barred from entering the building. **A possible fix for this is entering the meadery through the basement. **If that doesn't work, you'll need to redo the quest stages 20 through 90 to fix his behavior (it won't affect your quest journal and/or save progress in any way). ***startquest tg03 then setstage tg03 20 ***Do the quest normally from here, ''being sure to go through the basement in the proper direction.'' You can skip poisoning the skeever nest, but make sure you poison the vat and leave the meadery building. ***Now setstage tg03 60 to get around the nest objective and report back to Sabjorn. ***Watch the cinematic scene, talk to Mallus again and retrieve the note from the dresser upstairs. ***At this point you can just setstage tg03 200 to finish the quest off. Mallus should be fixed. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've been sent to speak to Maven Black-Briar, head of the wealthiest most influential family in Riften. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]] on the road leading to [[Skyrim:Loreius Farm|Loreius Farm]].
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Vantus Loreius|Vantus Loreius]] at the Loreius Farm.
# Make your decision:
#* Persuade Vantus Loreius to fix the wheel.
#* Turn in Cicero to the wandering guard.

==Quest Conflicts==
Beginning [[Skyrim:Innocence Lost|Innocence Lost]] or [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|With Friends Like These...]] will create some minor restrictions on your options in this quest. Entering the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]] or starting  [[Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!|Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!]] will cause this quest to fail. However, none of these contingencies are of significant consequence to progression through the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] questline or through the game in general, as this quest is a relatively minor one.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Stranded Jester===
[[File:SR-quest-Delayed Burial_02.jpg|right|thumb|The Stranded Jester]]
On the road north of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and near [[Skyrim:Loreius Farm|Loreius Farm]], you will encounter a very odd jester named [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]]. He claims that he is from [[Lore:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]] and is moving to [[Lore:Skyrim|Skyrim]]. His wagon, which he says contains the remains of his mother, has broken down by the roadside. He asked [[Skyrim:Vantus_Loreius|Vantus Loreius]], the owner of the nearby farm, to help him fix his wheel but Loreius refused. Cicero will ask you to convince Loreius to help him so he can move on.

Speaking to Vantus Loreius will reveal that he was unwilling to help because of Cicero's odd behavior, and he speculates that Cicero's box likely contains [[Skyrim:Skooma|Skooma]] or other illegal cargo, and doesn't want to chance aiding him in any illicit activity. Vantus asks that you convince a patrolling guard—either a [[Skyrim:Roadside Guard|Roadside Guard]] or [[Skyrim:Pale Hold Guard|Pale Hold Guard]]—to arrest Cicero.

===Helping Cicero===
To help Cicero, you must pass a very easy level [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to persuade Vantus to do the right thing and fix the wagon wheel.  Vantus will reconsider and promise to help Cicero on his way. After you notify Cicero, he will thank you and give you a certain amount of gold depending on your current level.

===Turning in Cicero===
To turn in Cicero, you need to find the guard that patrols the roadway near the farm. He patrols very close to the wagon and is frequently within sight of the wagon. The guard will place Cicero under arrest. Cicero promises to make Loreius pay and chastises you for not being of assistance. After notifying Vantus, he thanks you for bringing him peace and gives you gold.

===Consequences===
[[File:SR-quest-Delayed Burial_03.jpg|right|thumb|''"So many knife wounds."'']]
Cicero is an [[Skyrim:Assassin|assassin]] and the Keeper of the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]. The coffin he is transporting contains the remains of the [[Lore:Night Mother|Night Mother]]. If you finish this quest then join the Brotherhood later on, he will tell you that he was transporting the Night Mother. Choosing to help Cicero will lead to him showing gratitude if you join the Brotherhood. If you turn him in and later return to the farm, you'll find that Vantus Loreius and his wife, [[Skyrim:Curwe|Curwe]], have been slaughtered (although if you wait too long the bodies will be gone). A passing guard will remark ''"You don't want to go up there, citizen. It's a terrible sight. The farmer and his wife murdered in the middle of the night. So many knife wounds."'' If you later join the Dark Brotherhood, Cicero will be slightly upset with you for not helping him. Whichever attitude he shows towards you will carry no practical implications if you join the Brotherhood. Your decision to help Cicero or turn him in also has no effect on whether you can make him a follower or not if you join the Brotherhood.

Regardless of how you resolve the quest, you get the same amount of gold:

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Speak to the residents of [[sr:Darkwater Crossing|Darkwater Crossing]].
#Travel to [[sr:Darkwater Pass|Darkwater Pass]].
#Search the cave for [[sr:Derkeethus|Derkeethus]].
#Free Derkeethus from his prison.
#Escort Derkeethus out of the cave.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Darkwater Crossing===
If you talk to the residents of [[Skyrim:Darkwater Crossing|Darkwater Crossing]] (for example [[Skyrim:Sondas Drenim|Sondas Drenim]], a miner in nearby [[Skyrim:Goldenrock Mine|Goldenrock Mine]]), you will soon hear of an Argonian named [[Skyrim:Derkeethus|Derkeethus]] who recently went to explore the pools around Darkwater - and who hasn't been seen in a long time. The residents will not be able to say for sure where Derkeethus is, but he has actually run into trouble inside [[Skyrim:Darkwater Pass|Darkwater Pass]].

Locating Darkwater Pass can be difficult. The easiest route from Darkwater Crossing is to cross the bridge that spans the river to the southwest of the settlement. At the crossing, take the right path. Just before you reach the second bridge and [[Skyrim:Fort Amol|Fort Amol]], a stone marker to the left of the road will indicate a dusty path heading west up the mountainside. Follow the path as it curves sharply south, and onward through the trees along the cliff's edge. Eventually you will come to a large pool fed by three large waterfalls. Drop into the pool and turn directly around to the north - an iron door in the cliff wall in front of you leads to Darkwater Pass.

===Darkwater Pass===
Follow the low tunnel past an unlocked chest, and you will reach a small cavern. Watch out - a [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] will drop out of a [[Skyrim:Falmer Hive|Falmer hive]] in the wall immediately to your right as you enter. Follow the path up into a larger cavern. A Falmer waits immediately ahead outside a tent, and yet another may drop from a hive above and to the left. In the north wall is an opening into a pillared chamber where three [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]] reside. Head past this chamber and up the stairs to reach a small room with a trap door in the center. Look down through the bars to see [[Skyrim:Derkeethus|Derkeethus]] pacing about in his cell below. Be mindful of the Falmer in the adjoining room with an [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] (step in here and two more Falmer will drop from the hives up near the ceiling).

Northeast from the center of the trap door, there is a lever on the wall. Pulling this lever lowers a section of wall, revealing a spiral staircase heading down. A corridor in the west wall leads south to a small circular room called Darkwater Pit. As soon as you approach, Derkeethus will engage you in conversation and ask you to help him escape. The [[Skyrim:Darkwater Pit Key|Darkwater Pit Key]] is in the left [[sr:Burial Urn|Burial Urn]] just inside the gate, but the gate is the standard barred prison cell door with sufficient gaps to allow you to reach through and take the key from the burial urn. If he has lockpicks in his inventory, Derkeethus may have already escaped his cell and be waiting somewhere in the corridor. If this has happened, it may alert the Falmer in the arcane enchanter room. 

Although there is still more of Darkwater Pass to explore, the easiest way to get Derkeethus out is to head straight back the way you came - particularly as he will not crouch into a sneaking stance when you do during this quest, and there are some nasty traps and Falmer further up the cave.

Once you have led Derkeethus to safety, he will thank you for saving him. You can now recruit him as a follower if you wish. If not, you can recruit him at any time from Darkwater Crossing.

==Notes==
*Derkeethus will only continue to follow you if you remain close to him. If you move too far away he will turn around and return to the pit he started in.
*On rare occasions Derkeethus may appear on the trail between the upper and lower entrances to Darkwater Pass, begging for help escaping the cave. Just lead him to the lower entrance. He will thank you and promptly vanish. He may then be found at Darkwater Crossing.
*This quest can sometimes clash with a [[Skyrim:Rescue Mission|Companions quest]] where an NPC needs to be rescued, potentially giving you two temporary followers.

Skyrim:Dark Ancestor.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Roger |rewardChecked= }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], [[Skyrim:Bloodlet Throne|Bloodlet Throne]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:Some Light Theft|Some Light Theft]] |Reward=200 [[Skyrim:Gold|Gold]] |Image=SR-quest-Dark Ancestor.jpg |Imgdesc=Vighar in Bloodlet Throne |description=Destroy [[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir]]'s risen ancestor, the [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] [[Skyrim:Vighar|Vighar]]. |ID=FreeformFalkreathQuest03 / FreeformFalkreathQuest03B |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]]) |ReqLevel=10 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]]. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Bloodlet Throne|Bloodlet Throne]]. # Battle through and kill [[Skyrim:Vighar|Vighar]]. # Return to Dengeir. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Dark Ancestry=== After stealing [[Skyrim:Lod|Lod]]'s [[Skyrim:Private Letter|letter]] for [[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir]], he'll trust you enough to handle an important matter. It is of great concern and embarrassment to him that his ancestor [[Skyrim:Vighar|Vighar]] is actually a [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]]. For years he was magically bound within his grave, but the magic energies weakened and allowed him to escape. When asked, he will tell his family secret: ''"You may have seen the open grave in our graveyard. Most of the townsfolk think it's the work of a corpse thief. The truth is less pleasant. It is...was, the grave of Vighar, my own ancestor, dead for centuries now. He is also a vampire. My family is entrusted with keeping him buried, but recently someone stole the wardstone, and Vighar escaped."'' However, he is not interested in the stone, he just wants Vighar destroyed. ''"No. It's too late for the wardstone. Vighar must be destroyed. If this gets out, my family will suffer great shame."'' Dengeir has tracked him down to the vampire lair [[Skyrim:Bloodlet Throne|Bloodlet Throne]] and wants you to head there and destroy him before anyone discovers his family's secret shame. ===Bloodlet Throne=== Bloodlet Throne is a military fort hidden in the mountains southwest of [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]]. Travel to Helgen and leave through the east gate, taking the path leading southeast. Keep an eye on your map marker and make sure to take the right turns; never stray off the path, as it will lead directly to the fort. The exterior of the fort is unguarded, so climb the steps and enter. Once inside, the sound of howling [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolves]] will meet you, along with a [[Skyrim:Traps#Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] triggering a [[Skyrim:Traps#Flame_Spout_Trap|flame trap]] right in front of you. Enter [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneak mode]] and proceed forward. Before long, you will encounter two leveled vampires; pick the fight and proceed down the stairs into a large chamber. Take the eastern path and fight another vampire, feasting on severed hands in the dining room. Follow the snowy tunnel to yet another huge chamber with big wooden structures and more vampires, along with the expected wolf. Climb the woodworks and use the [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|Arcane Enchanter]] and, in the next tunnel, the [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|Alchemy Lab]], then investigate the sleeping area for a bit of loot and a door leading to a room with the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Incident_at_Necrom|Incident at Necrom]]'' and a random enchanted dagger on the table. Proceed to the snowy tunnel leading south and cross the bridge leading to Vighar in the final chamber. ===The Next Act of the Show=== The final chamber is obviously some kind of arena built to satisfy Vighar. As you approach, you will observe him seated on the ledge above, having a brief conversation with one of the other inhabitants: '''Vampire''': ''"And who is this?"''
'''Vighar''': ''"It is no matter, this fool will be the next act of the show."'' With these words, Vighar will pull the handle by his side and cause several wolves to be released from their cells. He will coldly observe while you fight them. As soon as you manage to kill them, Vighar himself will jump down and attack, backed up by his companions. When all is said and done, locate the pull chain in the western alcove and head upstairs. Follow the path to a chest with some loot, then remove the door bar and gain access to the first huge chamber. Exit Bloodlet Throne and return to Dengeir for your reward. ==Notes== *Vighar is a very tough vampire, on par with [[Skyrim:Master Vampire|Master Vampires]] or [[Skyrim:Volkihar Master Vampire|Volkihar Master Vampires]]. He will replace the normal end boss of the dungeon. *This quest is not available if Dengeir is Jarl of Falkreath. *If the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]] add-on has been installed, Bloodlet Throne will have three hostile [[Skyrim:Gargoyle|gargoyle]] statues added and the wolves will be replaced with [[Skyrim:Death Hound|death hounds]]. *If you couldn't complete [[Skyrim:Some Light Theft|Some Light Theft]] (see Bugs section on the page), the dialogue option to start the quest will not be available. One solution is to raise Dengeir's [[Skyrim:Disposition|Disposition]]. Open the console, click on Dengeir and enter setrelationshiprank player 1. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Dawnguard may only add the gargoyles and not change the wolves to death hounds.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|At times, even if the quest has been started, Vighar may not appear. Instead, the final boss of the dungeon is the random high-level vampire who is supposed to be there if the mission has not been triggered. This does not seem to prevent the successful conclusion of the quest, since Dengeir will act just like you had killed his ancestor and not notice the difference.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |id=FreeformFalkreathQuest03 |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Tell Dengeir that Vighar is dead}} |200|fin| |!|Dark Ancestor|FreeformFalkreathQuest03B |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Destroy the vampire Vighar}} |200|fin| |missing= ** FreeformFalkreathQuest03: 0, 10. ** FreeformFalkreathQuest03B: 0, 20 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:For the Good of Morthal.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Bwross |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Robin Hood70 |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[sr:Gorm|Gorm]] |Loc=[[sr:Morthal|Morthal]], [[sr:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] |Reward=20 gold |Difficulty=Easy |Image=SR-npc-Captain Aldis.jpg |Imgdesc=Captain Aldis of the Imperial Legion |description=Deliver a letter to [[sr:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]] in [[sr:Solitude|Solitude]]. |ID=FreeformMorthalB |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Gorm|Gorm]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[sr:Gorm|Gorm]] when he's apart from the [[sr:Jarl|Jarl]]. #Deliver [[sr:Gorm's Letter|Gorm's letter]] to [[sr:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]] in [[sr:Solitude|Solitude]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Unfit to Lead=== [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] [[Skyrim:Idgrod Ravencrone|Idgrod Ravencrone]] governs [[Skyrim:Hjaalmarch|Hjaalmarch]] from her seat in [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]]. She is gifted with visions that seem to occupy most of her attention; she is less concerned with governing a people than she is with attending to her visions and passing on the wisdom she gleans. Her administration is under scrutiny as a result, as you will find out when visiting Morthal. If you speak to [[Skyrim:Gorm|Gorm]], Idgrod's [[Skyrim:Housecarl|housecarl]], inside of [[Skyrim:Highmoon Hall|Highmoon Hall]] he will be very solicitous of Ravencrone and her visions. However, if approached while away from the jarl he will reveal that his concerns are not just about her safety, but rather the condition her gift has left her in. He believes that she may no longer be able to adequately act as jarl of Hjaalmarch. Speak with Gorm while he is dining at [[Skyrim:Moorside Inn|Moorside Inn]] at 8pm., or while he is walking to and from Highmoon Hall: :''"My mind weighs heavy enough. Leave me to my food."'' :'''Is there something bothering you, Gorm?''' :''"She's so lost in her visions, and it's only getting worse. I've looked after her safety for so long... If she can't tell what's real and what's not, how will she continue to lead Hjaalmarch?"'' :'''Is there anything I can do?''' :''"Yes, I suppose there is. There is a letter, one I have had for some time now. I think it is time it gets delivered. I cannot leave Idgrod's side, so I must stay here. Could you see that it reaches Captain Aldis in Solitude?"'' :'''I'll see that your letter reaches Aldis.''' :''"Thank you. Please, do not open it. It is... private."'' He will give you a letter to deliver to an [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] officer, Captain Aldis. Aldis can be found in Solitude at [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]]. Reading Gorm's Letter reveals that there is seemingly a plan in the works to remove Idgrod from power. Aldis, however, seems far less sanguine at the prospect of removing a sitting Empire-loyal jarl during wartime; but, he will take the information under advisement: :'''I have a letter for you.''' :''"For me? From whom?"'' :'''It's from Gorm, in Morthal.''' :''"Well now, that is something. Hand it over, please.''" He will then read the letter, and continue, saying: :''"Oh, no. I hadn't heard from Gorm for a while, so I'd hoped he'd given up on his little scheme. The last time we'd discussed this issue was before this damnable war broke out. Things were different then. Now, what's he's asking, it's just impossible. Even if it worked, the questions and accusations it would cause... Well, I'll take it under advisement. Thank you."'' He gives you 20 gold for delivering the letter. ==Notes== * Counts for assisting people for [[Skyrim:Thane of Hjaalmarch|Thane of Hjaalmarch]]. * The only way Idgrod is actually removed from power in game is if the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] take over Morthal. * If siding with the Stormcloaks, this quest needs to be started before [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Hraggstad|The Battle for Fort Hraggstad]] and finished before the [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]] to avoid issues. Also, [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] can transfer Hjaalmarch to the Stormcloaks; if that happens, then this quest cannot be started until Hjaalmarch is reconquered for the Empire. *Unlike many quest items, reading or obtaining Gorm’s letter by looting or pickpocketing will not allow the quest to begin. The letter will remain a quest item in your inventory but Captain Aldis will not show the dialogue to receive the letter. ==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Mother's Pride===
Gharol is a [[Skyrim:Blacksmith|blacksmith]] living in [[Skyrim:Dushnikh Yal|Dushnikh Yal]], the [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc stronghold]] southeast of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. If you're permitted to enter the stronghold, you may talk to her about her weapon business. She will tell you that while she occasionally trades with the outside world, Orcs infuse their weapons with their private emotions: ''"An Orc blade is a very personal thing. Anger, regret, pride. All these things are put into our steel."'' In the conversation you will discover that Gharol's daughter, [[Skyrim:Lash gra-Dushnikh|Lash]], chose to leave the stronghold, breaking with [[Lore:Orc|Orc custom]] and bringing shame and grief to her mother. Gharol tells you that she has forged a sword to channel her feelings about her daughter's betrayal, and to send her daughter a message. Then she will ask you to honor her with a task: bring the sword to her daughter in [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]]; Lash will know what it means.

===Message Received===
Travel to Karthwasten and deliver the sword to Lash. She will reply, ''"So that's it, then. 'Don't come back.' Thank you. Here. You honored my mother's task and should be rewarded."'' The forsaken daughter will reward you with leveled gold and ask you to leave her alone.

[[Skyrim:Kerah|Kerah]] is the owner of the jewelry stall in the [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]'s marketplace. Talk to her and she will share some information about the city and her family with you: ''"My family came here centuries ago. We've made a good living smithing the silver that flows through the city."'' If you want to know more about the fancy carvings and stonework, she will recommend that you visit [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]], who knows the history of Markarth better than anyone. At the same time, she has a delivery she needs to make to him. Maybe you can do her a favor.

You can find Calcelmo in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]]. If it is your first time visiting him, he will initially be quite irritated, but will calm down quickly. Then you can tell him about the delivery from Kerah. He will understand why: ''"Oh, that's right. I keep forgetting to pick that up. Poor Kerah, such a patient woman."'' Then, he will reward you: ''"How about some gold? People seem to like that, I notice."''

DLC1VQ01MiscObjective }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Reach level 10 and be approached by [[Skyrim:Durak|Durak]]. # Hear about the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]] vampire hunters. # Locate [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] and [[Skyrim:Vigilant Tolan|Vigilant Tolan]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Find out about the Dawnguard=== [[File:SR-place-Hall of the Vigilant (destroyed).jpg|thumb|right|The destroyed Hall of the Vigilant]] If your level is 10 or above an [[Skyrim:Orc|Orc]] named [[Skyrim:Durak|Durak]] will find and approach you with a proposal to join the Dawnguard: ''"You there. The Dawnguard is looking for anyone willing to fight against the growing vampire menace. What do you say?"''. The miscellaneous journal objective "Find out about the Dawnguard" will appear, and if you ask him to explain, he'll tell you that they are a group of [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] hunters. He'll mention that the [[Skyrim:Hall_of_the_Vigilant|Hall of the Vigilants]] was destroyed by vampires because the [[Skyrim:Vigilants_of_Stendarr|Vigilants]] didn't take the vampire threat seriously. If you ask him what he's talking about, he'll tell you they got torn to pieces when they went up against the vampires, and that's why his leader [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] is reestablishing the Dawnguard. When you ask how to sign up, Durak will tell you to talk to Isran at Fort Dawnguard, southeast of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. If you didn't hear the rumor (see below) from a guard already, your map will now be updated, and the quest [[#Dawnguard|Dawnguard]] will officially appear in your journal, completing this short miscellaneous quest. If you happen to tell Durak you're not interested in being recruited, he'll say ''"That's what everybody says, right up until they find their throat being ripped out by a pack of hungry vampires."'' and the conversation will end. If you approach him a second time, he'll respond ''"Yeah, you change your mind? The Dawnguard could use somebody like you."'' and the other dialogue options are the same as the first time around. If you tell him you're not interested this time, he'll tell you to talk to Isran and give you the location of Fort Dawnguard anyway, in case you change your mind. Alternatively, you may start this quest in another manner, detailed below. ===Dawnguard=== ====Find Fort Dawnguard==== [[File:SR-place-Fort Dawnguard.jpg|thumb|right|Fort Dawnguard]] Upon installing the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard add-on]], you may hear a new rumor from city [[Skyrim:Guards|guards]] regarding [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|the Dawnguard]]: ''"Heard they're reforming the Dawnguard. Vampire hunters or something, in the old fort near Riften. Might consider joining up myself."'' If this is the first you've heard of the Dawnguard, your map will be updated with the location of [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]], and the quest will officially appear in your journal. Take the road that leads east from Riften. Right after the road turns southeast and you cross a small bridge, start watching the cliffs to your left. You'll find a small crack in the side of a cliff—the entrance to [[Skyrim:Dayspring Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]]. It's found between a hollow green log and a broken birch tree. A narrow, winding path leads you towards Fort Dawnguard. It is the only way to reach the fort until you discover the map marker. Along the way, you may catch up to [[Skyrim:Agmaer|Agmaer]], another new recruit to the Dawnguard. If you haven't yet heard about the Dawnguard, his greeting will trigger the quest to appear in your journal: ''"Oh, hey there! You here to join the Dawnguard, too?"'' He expresses his anxiety concerning entering the fort on his own, and accompanies you the remainder of the way. He asks you not to mention his nervousness to Isran, but will make several comments expressing his low self-confidence as you make the walk. Despite his expressed fear of going in on his own, he will run inside the fort without waiting for you if you don't enter immediately after reaching the front steps to the entrance. You may pass Durak just outside the fort, practicing his skill with a [[Skyrim:Crossbow|crossbow]]. If you ask him what he's using, he'll answer ''"Never seen a crossbow before? Not surprised. Kind of a Dawnguard specialty. Nothing better for putting down vampires."'' He will then give you your own crossbow, along with 45 [[Skyrim:Steel Bolt|steel bolts]] (see [[#Notes|notes]] below for how to get another crossbow and 45 more steel bolts). When you reach the steps to the fort, you'll find [[Skyrim:Celann|Celann]] guarding the entrance. If you choose to speak with him, he'll say he was surprised to hear from Isran at all, and comment that things must be pretty bad for Isran to request his help. If you ask Celann about working with Isran in the past, he'll tell you they were both members of the Vigilants of Stendarr, whose "hearts were in the right place" but left them both dissatisfied. The pair left together, but Celann didn't agree with Isran's "methods", so the partnership didn't last. On that note, he'll tell you ''"Go on inside, Isran will want to talk to you."'' ====Join the Dawnguard==== [[File:SR-quest-Dawnguard (quest) 02.jpg|thumb|right|Isran and Tolan discussing the vampire attacks]] [[File:SR-quest-Dawnguard (quest) 03.jpg|thumb|right|''"You need to concentrate, boy. Try it again."'']] Once inside, you'll find the Dawnguard leader, Isran, speaking to [[Skyrim:Vigilant Tolan|Tolan]], a priest of the Vigilant. :'''Isran''': ''"Why are you here, Tolan? The Vigilants and I were finished long ago."'' :'''Tolan''': ''"You know why I'm here, the Vigilants are under attack everywhere. The vampires are much more dangerous than we believed."'' :'''Isran''': ''"And now you want to come running to safety with the Dawnguard, is that it? I remember [[Skyrim:Keeper_Carcette|Keeper Carcette]] telling me repeatedly that Dawnguard is a crumbling ruin, not worth the expense and manpower to repair. And now that you've stirred up the vampires against you, you come begging for my protection?"'' :'''Tolan''': ''"Isran, Carcette is dead. The Hall of Vigilants... everyone... they're all dead. You were right, we were wrong. Isn't that enough for you?"'' :'''Isran''': ''"Yes, well... I never wanted any of this to happen. I tried to warn all of you... I am sorry, you know."'' At this point, Isran will turn to you, asking ''"So who are you, what do you want?"'' You can tell him you're just looking around and ask about the fort, to which he'll reply, ''"Why do I even post guards? This is the headquarters of the Dawnguard. Well, it used to be, a long time ago."'' If you tell him you've come to join the Dawnguard, or simply that you've heard about the vampire hunters, he'll be pleased that you're interested but comment that most of their work at the moment is going toward restoring the fort. If you are already a fully transformed into a vampire when engaging for the first time in the conversation with Isran and you respond, "I heard you were looking for vampire hunters" Isran will reply "You heard right, I'm glad the word is finally starting to get around. But that means it won't be long until vampires start to take notice as well." If you reply, "What exactly are you planning to do to these vampires?" then Isran responds, "First thing is to get this Fort back into shape. Right now a vampire could practically walk right into the front door. But I have something for you to do since you're asking" and he goes on to talk about Dimhollow Crypt. When you ask how you can help, he'll respond ''"I need someone out in the field, taking the fight to the damn vampires, while we're getting the fort back into shape. Tolan was telling me about a cave some of the Vigilants were poking around in. Seemed to think it was..."'' and ask Tolan to tell you about [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]]. Tolan will inform you that ''"[[Skyrim:Vigilant_Adalvald|Brother Adalvald]] was sure it held some long-lost vampire artifact of some kind. We didn't listen to him anymore than we did Isran. He was at the hall when it was attacked..."'' Isran will then assign your first task to you: ''"Go see what the vampires were looking for in this Dimhollow Crypt. With any luck, they'll still be there."'' Isran will then give you a crossbow and some steel bolts (if you haven't received them from Durak already), saying ''"Here, you should take a crossbow. Good for taking out those fiends before they get close."'' and then invite you to explore and take anything you need from Fort Dawnguard before sending you off on your mission. Before you leave, Tolan will offer to meet you at Dimhollow Crypt, saying ''"It's the least I can do to avenge my fallen comrades."'' Isran and Tolan will argue a bit, as Isran doesn't believe the Vigilants are trained for such a mission, and Tolan is offended at the implication that Isran thinks the Vigilants are soft, cowardly, and weak. He will stand by his decision, though, telling you ''"I'm going to Dimhollow Crypt. Perhaps I can be of some small assistance to you."'' The quest [[Skyrim:Awakening|Awakening]] begins immediately. ==Notes== *This quest cannot be started if you have a bounty in The Rift. **Pay your bounty, and the Dawnguard questline should begin like normal. *After beginning this quest, the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Vigilant|Hall of the Vigilant]] will be destroyed, regardless of your level. It also doesn't matter if you visited it beforehand or not. **{{Pc22}} The Hall can be reverted to its original form by opening the console and entering the code "xx003531".enable. *Several of the Dawnguard members are non-essential. If you wish to join the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Vampire Clan|Castle Volkihar Clan]], you can use it to advantage by quietly eliminating Agmaer and Durak early on. *You can bypass this quest completely and start [[Skyrim:Awakening|Awakening]] without this quest ever appearing in your quest journal. In order to do this, you must not have received information about the Dawnguard from a guard or Durak upon entering Dayspring Canyon. Then, be sure not to come within close range of Agmaer between entering Dayspring Canyon and approaching Fort Dawnguard, and don't talk to Durak. When you enter the fort, the quest-related events will still occur in the same manner, even without the quest being started. The Hall of the Vigilant will still be destroyed, though, and the conversation between Isran and Tolan will still take place. Agmaer will also finish his journey to Fort Dawnguard. *If you receive a crossbow from Durak, you can drop it, give it to a follower, or store it in a container before talking to Isran. He will then give you a second crossbow and 45 more steel bolts. You can also retrieve any steel bolts Durak fires. *Completing this quest will not add the Hall of the Vigilant to your map. *It is possible to join the Dawnguard even if you are already a vampire yourself. ==Bugs== {{Bug|On some occasions, the quest marker both on your map and on your compass will not point in the right direction. This is due to the marker being associated with the wrong door for Dayspring Canyon.|UDGP|1.2.2}} {{Bug|Killing Agmaer in Dayspring Canyon before this quest starts can break the entire Dawnguard questline.}} {{Bug|Members of the Dawnguard may attack you if you have lycanthropy.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ** Reload a previous save, use beast form, and wait until it expires. Then proceed to Fort Dawnguard. {{Bug|If you have attacked, and/or possibly killed, any Vigilants of Stendarr prior to entering Dayspring Canyon, all Dawnguard members might be hostile, preventing you from ever joining, as the Dawnguard and Vigil of Stendarr are allied factions.|confirmed=1}} **It may be possible to bypass this by avoiding any hostile interactions with Vigilants of Stendarr. {{Bug|The next quest, Awakening, may not trigger upon completion of this quest.|vn=1}} ** Waiting 15 minutes of real time may fix this. ** A commonly cited workaround is to skip the quest entirely. However, this causes quests later on to break. {{Bug|This quest may fail to work correctly (such as Agmaer not greeting you, Isran and Tolan not engaging in conversation upon entering Fort Dawnguard, or not initiating Awakening). This may also happen on all subsequent new games.|vn=1}} **A complete reinstall of Skyrim may fix it. {{Bug|Durak may approach and walk in circles, preventing dialogue. He may remain stuck in place indefinitely.|vn=1}} **{{pc22}} Use the console command setstage DLC1VQ01MiscObjective 10. After that, normal dialogue is possible. This option sometimes leaves the quest entry blank in your journal, however. An alternative option is to move Durak to you using the following: prid xx015c16 then moveto player. He then seems to start the quest normally. {{Bug|If you have a bounty in Riften, the members of the Dawnguard may be hostile, upon meeting, preventing joining. To avoid this, take care of the bounty before entering Dayspring Canyon.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Even after you finish the quest, [[Skyrim:Vigilants of Stendarr|Vigilants of Stendarr]] will still act as if the Hall of the Vigilant is still active and [[Skyrim:Keeper Carcette|Keeper Carcette]] is alive, even though the Hall has been destroyed and Keeper Carcette is dead.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Introduction |id=DLC1VQ00 |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Find out about the Dawnguard}} |!|Dawnguard|DLC1VQ01MiscObjective |10||I've learned of a group of vampire hunters known as the Dawnguard. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]] or [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]].
# Kill the boss [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] in its lair.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
You can talk to [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]] or [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]] to receive this quest. They will explain either:
*''"A bunch of feral vampires are running wild, upsetting the mortals. When the prey is riled, it makes things difficult for us. Go cull the brutish beasts before the problem gets out of hand."''
*''"A cadre of lesser beasts has become a nuisance, taking too bold an approach to their feeding. The herd is becoming distressed, which makes it more difficult for us to slip in and out undetected. It is time to cull the weak."''

They will then mark a random location from a list of possible locations:
{{LinkList|Bloodlet Throne|Broken Fang Cave|Haemar's Shame|Mara's Eye Pond|Moldering Ruins|Movarth's Lair|Pinemoon Cave|Potema's Catacombs|Redwater Den|Shriekwind Bastion}}

You will be directed to kill the leveled vampire boss that is near the end of one of these locations.  Upon return, you are rewarded three [[Skyrim:Potion of Blood|Potions of Blood]] with a chance of 25% or a radiant leveled enchanted item otherwise (a circlet, necklace, ring, a piece of heavy armor, a piece of light armor or a weapon). You'll be told one of the following lines:
*''"Good job. At first you may pity the thin-bloods. But after disposing of a few, you realize they aren't worth the worry."''
*''"You have done well. It may seem cruel that we hold our thin-blooded kin in low esteem. But our needs must come before theirs."''

==Notes== 
*This is a repeatable quest.
