[[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]], [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]] |Image=SR-quest-Dragonborn.jpg |ImgDesc=''"Well, here we are. This is [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]]."'' |ID=DLC2MQ01/DLC2WE09/DLC2CultistAmbush |description=Travel to the island of [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]] to find out what's happening there. }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Survive the [[Skyrim:Cultist|cultist]] attack and find a [[Skyrim:Cultists' Orders|note]] on one of the bodies. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Gjalund Salt-Sage|Gjalund Salt-Sage]] at the [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] docks for passage to [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. # Travel to Solstheim onboard the ''[[Skyrim:Northern Maiden|Northern Maiden]]''. # Ask the townsfolk of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] about someone named [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]]. #* ''(Optional)'' Investigate the shrine situated at the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]]. # Reach the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A False Dragonborn=== Once you have completed [[Skyrim:The Way of the Voice|The Way of the Voice]], you will be approached by a pair of hostile [[Skyrim:Cultist|cultists]] at the first city or town you enter. These cultists will question you, ''"You there! You're the one they call Dragonborn?"'' You have several dialogue options with which to respond: [[File:SR-quest-Dragonborn 02.jpg|thumbnail|right|''"You there! You're the one they call Dragonborn?"'']] {|class=wikitable !Player Response !! Cultists' Response |- |'''"Yes, I am Dragonborn."''' || ''"Your lies fall on deaf ears, Deceiver. The True Dragonborn comes... You are but his shadow."'' |- |'''"The Greybeards seem to think so."''' || ''"Then it is too late. The lie has already taken root in the hearts of men. So we shall expose them to the falseness in their hearts by tearing out yours, Deceiver!"'' |- |'''"I don't know what you're talking about."''' || ''"Your lies fall on deaf ears, Deceiver! We know you are the False Dragonborn! You shall not stand in the way of the true Dragonborn's return. He comes soon, and we shall offer him your heart!"'' |- |} No matter what dialogue option you choose, however, the response will always end with the cultists' saying: ''"When Lord Miraak appears all shall bear witness. None shall stand to oppose him!"'' You also have the option to walk away from the cultists. Doing so will cause them to taunt you: ''"You cannot escape the truth. You cannot escape the True Dragonborn! When Lord Miraak appears all shall bear witness. None will stand to oppose him!"'' Whether you engage in dialogue or walk away, the cultists will attack you. Once they lie dead, search them for the [[Skyrim:Cultists' Orders|cultists' orders]]. This now initiates the actual quest and directs you to speak with [[Skyrim:Gjalund Salt-Sage|Gjalund Salt-Sage]] at the [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] docks about passage into [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. ===The ''Northern Maiden''=== [[File:SR-quest-Dragonborn 03.jpg|thumbnail|right|''"If you're looking for passage to Solstheim, you won't find a finer vessel than the Northern Maiden."'']] Once you arrive at the docks, head over to a boat called the ''[[Skyrim:Northern Maiden|Northern Maiden]]'' and speak with [[Skyrim:Gjalund Salt-Sage|Gjalund Salt-Sage]] about passage to Solstheim aboard his vessel. You will have different dialogue options with Gjalund depending on your status with the cultists. If you have not yet encountered the cultists, continue reading onward (see [[#Notes|notes]] for further information). However, if you have encountered them, skip to [[#Finding Answers|Finding Answers]] section below. Approaching Gjalund, he will proudly state, ''"If you're looking for passage to Solstheim, you won't find a finer vessel than the Northern Maiden."'' From this you can choose to either ask how much the fare is (250 gold) or to further inquire about the island. If you choose to question him about Solstheim, he will exclaim ''"Surprised you've never heard of it. It's an island northeast of here. Has a small dark elf town called Raven Rock and a handful of [[Skyrim:Nord|Nords]] living in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. People don't usually sail over there unless they have a particular reason. It can be a pretty rough place."'' Once you pay the fare, he will tell you ''"You've got yourself a ship. We'll cast off immediately."'' If you change your mind, he will sternly say ''"Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind."'' ===Finding Answers=== * '''Note: This section refers to dialogue options if you have previously encountered the cultists.''' Having already encountered the cultists, approaching Gjalund will have a somewhat different response: ''"If you're looking for passage to Solstheim, too bad. I'm not going back there anymore."'' From this point onward you have several dialogue options to choose from. If you choose to ask him if he's the captain, he will suspiciously confirm ''"Sure. Yeah. That's me. Why? Who sent you?"'' Stating that you were attacked by the cultists, he will exclaim ''"Now hold on! That wasn't my fault... I didn't know they were going to attack anybody. I don't even know how I got here."'' Further questioning him will lead him to tell you ''"It's hard to explain... I remember those people with the masks coming on board, then... Next thing I remember, I was here and they were gone. That's not right, losing whole days like that. There's been something strange going on there for a while, but after this... I'm done. I'm not going back to Solstheim."'' If you try to convince him otherwise, he will object ''"Have you been listening to me? I'm not going back there."'' You can also inquire about Solstheim, to which he will answer ''"Surprised you've never heard of it. It's an island northeast of here. Has a small dark elf town called Raven Rock and a handful of Nords living in Skaal Village. But I'm not going back there. There's something wrong about that place."'' Leaving the conversation and approaching him again, you will be able to tell Gjalund again that you need a passage into Solstheim, to which he will respond ''"I already told you, I'm not going back to Solstheim."'' However, now you have several dialogue options available at your disposal: {|class=wikitable |- !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=20%|Reaction |- |I'll pay you double your usual rate. (Give 500 gold)||colspan=4|'''Passed''': ''"Well... a man's got to make a living, after all. Fine. We'll cast off immediately."''
'''Failed''': ''"That's a tempting offer... when you actually have the gold, I might be willing to consider it."''||'''Passed''': Passage to Solstheim.
'''Failed''': Back to dialogue options. |- |You owe me. Those cultists you brought here tried to kill me. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': ''"Alright, you have a point. Taking you back to find out who sent them is the least I can do. Besides, maybe you can put a stop to whatever's going on over there. I owe them a bit of payback myself."''
'''Failed''': ''"Look, I'm sorry about your troubles, but I've got to look out for myself. I'm not going to risk it."''||'''Passed''': Passage to Solstheim.

The answer isn't going to be any different later though."''||Ends dialogue. |} After setting sail, you will arrive off the coast of Solstheim and a short cutscene will play as the boat docks in Raven Rock. Gjalund will comment, ''"Well, here we are. This is Raven Rock. Can't say I'm all that glad to see it again. Good luck. Maybe you can figure out what's going on around here."'' The ''Northern Maiden'' will then arrive into port shortly afterward. {{NewLine}} ===An Outlander on Solstheim=== [[File:SR-quest-Dragonborn 04.jpg|thumbnail|right|''"I don't recognize you, so I'll assume this is your first visit to Raven Rock, outlander. State your intentions."'']] Upon arrival at the docks of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] on Solstheim, if you have never been here before, you will be approached by [[Skyrim:Adril Arano|Adril Arano]], the Second Councilor of Raven Rock. At this first meeting he sternly greets you with, ''"I don't recognize you, so I'll assume this is your first visit to Raven Rock, outlander. State your intentions." '' Depending on quest actions, you are given two or three options to reply to him. If you have already started the quest, you can question him if he knows someone named Miraak, to which he will reply, ''"Miraak... I... I'm not sure that I do."'' Further questioning him, he will respond ''"I... I'm unsure. I swear I know the name, but cannot place it."'' Pressing him further about the issue, he will then reveal, ''"I don't think so. I'm not... The name has something to do with the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]], I think. But I'm not sure what."'' This now gives you the optional objective to investigate the shrine. Regardless of which, Adril will then depart the conversation by saying ''"Just remember, Raven Rock is sovereign territory of House Redoran. This is Morrowind, not Skyrim. While you're here you will be expected to abide by our laws."'' The location of the Earth Stone is almost directly west of the docks, a short distance away from the settlement of Raven Rock. However, visiting the stone itself is purely an optional objective and is not necessary in order to advance through the quest. {{NewLine}} ===The Earth Stone=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :'''''"Here in his shrine, that they have forgotten. Here do we toil, that we might remember. By night we reclaim, what by day was stolen. Far from ourselves, he grows ever near to us. Our eyes once were blinded, now through him do we see. Our hands once were idle, now through them does he speak. And when the world shall listen, and when the world shall see, and when the world remembers, that world will cease to be."''''' |} {{Multiple Images |align=center |direction=horizontal |width=175 |image1=SR-quest-Dragonborn 05.jpg |image2=SR-quest-Dragonborn 06.jpg |image3=SR-quest-Dragonborn 07.jpg }} [[File:SR-quest-Dragonborn 08.jpg|thumbnail|right|''"You there... You don't seem to be in quite the same state as the others here. Very interesting. May I ask what it is you're doing here?"'']] Upon arrival at the stone, you will notice several of the inhabitants of Raven Rock alongside some of the [[Skyrim:Redoran Guard|Redoran guards]] working on what appears to be a mysterious shrine surrounding the stone. Walk toward the shrine and you will be approached by [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]], a Telvanni wizard, and you may ask him about what is happening. He will either remark: ''"You there... You don't seem to be in quite the same state as the others here. Very interesting. May I ask what it is you're doing here?"'', or simply ask you what brings you to Raven Rock. When you explain to Neloth that you are searching for Miraak, he will exclaim: ''"Miraak... Miraak... It sounds familiar, and yet I can't quite place... Oh. Wait, I recall. But that makes very little sense. Miraak's been dead for thousands of years."'' Inquire about the meaning of this and he will answer: ''"I'm not sure, but it is fascinating, isn't it? Perhaps it has some relation to what's going on here. Quite unexpected. I'm afraid I can't give you any answers. But there are ruins of an ancient temple of Miraak's toward the center of the island. If I were you, I'd look there."'' This will now direct you towards the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]] to investigate further about the cultist attack. You may also choose to further question Neloth. Asking what exactly they are building, he will reply: ''"Building something, clearly. And yet they don't seem to have much to say about it. I'm very interested to find out what happens when they finish."'' If you also question him as to stopping the workers, he will exclaim: ''"Certainly not! Doing so would interfere with whatever is going on, and I would be unable to see how this all turns out."'' {{NewLine}} ===Temple of Miraak=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :'''''"Here in my temple, here in my shrine, that you have forgotten. Here do you toil, that you might remember. Here you reclaim, what faithless minds have stolen. Far from yourself, I grow ever nearer to you. Your eyes once were blinded, now through me do you see. Your hands once were idle, now through them do I speak. And when the world shall listen, and when the world shall see, and when the world remembers, that world will cease to be."''''' |} {{Multiple Images |align=center |direction=horizontal |width=175 |image1=SR-quest-Dragonborn 10.jpg |image2=SR-quest-Dragonborn 11.jpg |image3=SR-quest-Dragonborn 12.jpg }} [[File:SR-quest-Dragonborn 09.jpg|thumbnail|right|Dragon skeletons litter the pathway leading up to the temple.]] If you choose not to visit the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]], you can speak with various citizens of Raven Rock about Miraak. You will realize that most citizens recognize the name, but are uncertain why, just like [[Skyrim:Adril Arano|Adril]]. Some will again mention the Earth Stone, while others will mention the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]]. Once you've been told about the location of the temple, a new objective marker will lead you there. In order to reach the temple, head east from Raven Rock, towards the center of [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. As you approach the exterior of the temple, you'll see skeletons of several [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]] littering the pathway leading up to the temple. As you climb up the stairs and further to the temple, you'll see many of Miraak's thralls working to rebuild it. They will also be chanting, as were the thralls at the Earth Stone. None of the enthralled people will attack you, but some [[Skyrim:Cultist|cultists]] will appear and become aggressive if you wait outside of the temple too long. Once you reach the center of the exterior portion of the Temple of Miraak, near the Tree Stone, this quest will be complete, and the [[Skyrim:The Temple of Miraak|next quest]] will begin automatically. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is unlocked during this quest if you have not yet visited Solstheim: * {{Achievement|Outlander}} ==Notes== * If you choose to travel to Solstheim before encountering the cultists, you may be attacked by cultists on the island later on, and can find the note on one of their bodies there. However the quest will not be named in your journal upon arrival, and you may miss out on certain dialogue options with various NPCs on Solstheim. * Alternatively, you may travel to the Temple of Miraak and speak to Frea, starting the next quest. * Anytime you sleep on Solstheim you may be transported to one of the [[Skyrim:All-Maker Stones|All-Maker Stones]]. This will continue until the stones have been purged during [[Skyrim:Cleansing the Stones|Cleansing the Stones]]. **This may include the Tree Stone at the Temple of Miraak, which thus completes this quest and starts the next one. * If you activate the Earth Stone during this quest, Neloth will comment about you being ensnared under Miraak's influence. * If you have already started [[Skyrim:From the Ashes|From the Ashes]], Neloth may not appear at the Earth Stone. * The boat ride scene upon arriving into Raven Rock for the first time is not included in [[Skyrim:Skyrim VR|Skyrim VR]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You might not be transported to Solstheim if you attempt to do so when over-encumbered.|UDBP|1.0.1}} {{Bug|The bodies of the Cultists that initially attack you may never disappear, even if they are raised and subsequently become ash piles.|UDBP|2.0.1}} **{{pc22}}To remove a body, open the [[Skyrim:Console|console]], click on the body to be removed, and use the disable command. {{Bug|The quest may not start when killing the [[Skyrim:Cultist|cultists]] or reading their [[Skyrim:Cultists' Orders|orders]].|dlc=DB|confirmed=1}} **Load a previous save, go past the cultists to trigger their dialogue, then skip it. Before they finish their words and become hostile, quickly enter a nearby room. The quest can trigger normally after you enter the room, or after you reload this autosave. {{Bug|Captain Gjalund may not speak to you, making it impossible to get to Solstheim.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} In the console, select Captain Gjalund, then type disable followed by enable. **Save the game, exit, and re-load. {{Bug|Captain Gjalund speaks but does not give options to travel to Solstheim after reading cultist' orders. Skyrim:Deathbrand (quest).wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked= }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=Reading ''[[Skyrim:Deathbrand (book)|Deathbrand]]'' |Reward=[[Skyrim:Deathbrand Armor|Deathbrand armor]], [[Skyrim:Bloodscythe|Bloodscythe]] and [[Skyrim:Soulrender|Soulrender]], a minimum of 6400 gold |Loc=[[Skyrim:Haknir's Shoal|Haknir's Shoal]], [[Skyrim:Gyldenhul Barrow|Gyldenhul Barrow]] |Image=SR-place-Gyldenhul Barrow.jpg |ImgDesc=The resting place of the King of Ghosts |description=Find the treasure of [[Skyrim:Haknir Death-Brand|Haknir Death-Brand]]. |ID=DLC2dunHaknirTreasureQST / DLC2dunHaknirTreasureQSTMisc |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |ReqItem=[[Skyrim:Ancient Nordic Pickaxe|Ancient Nordic Pickaxe]] |ReqLevel=36 |SuggLevel=40 }} [[Category:Skyrim-Dragonborn-Quests-Miscellaneous]] == Quick Walkthrough == '''Note:''' You must be level 36 before you can start this quest. # (''Optional'') Read ''[[Skyrim:Deathbrand (book)|Deathbrand]]''. # Find the [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Treasure Map|treasure map]]. # Locate the four ancient chests containing the pieces of [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Armor|Deathbrand armor]]. # Explore [[Skyrim:Gyldenhul Barrow|Gyldenhul Barrow]]. # Defeat [[Skyrim:Haknir Death-Brand|Haknir Death-Brand]] and his crew. == Detailed Walkthrough == === Tale of Treasure === [[Lore:Haknir Death-Brand|Haknir Death-Brand]] was known for rages and fits of madness, and he delighted in torture and murder for its own sake. He was said to have lived an unnaturally long life, and displayed a terrible scar on his face known as "the Deathbrand", which no man could look upon without flinching. Due to the terrible scar, some thought of him as a Daedra while others spoke of a pact he made with [[Skyrim:Mehrunes_Dagon|Mehrunes Dagon]], calling the scar a seal between him and the Prince of Destruction. Before his death, he told his crew that none were worthy to be his successor or have his treasure. He placed a curse on his [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Armor|armor]] and his scimitars, [[Skyrim:Bloodscythe|Bloodscythe]] and [[Skyrim:Soulrender|Soulrender]]. He commanded a crewman to bury his armor in four separate locations on Solstheim, each marked by a [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Treasure Map|map]], before sealing him in his tomb at Gyldenhul Barrow along with all his treasure. This story was written down by a [[Lore:House_Redoran|House Redoran]] scribe and ended up as the book ''[[Skyrim:Deathbrand (book)|Deathbrand]]''. Once you have reached level 36, reading the book will start the miscellaneous objective to find Haknir's treasure. There are a total of eleven copies of the book on Solstheim. Please see [[#Deathbrand Locations|this section]] for a complete list of locations. It is also possible to initiate the quest by asking about the latest rumors from [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] at the Retching Netch, who will mark the site on your map upon inquiring. [[File:SR-quest-Deathbrand (quest) 02.jpg|thumb|''"Boss said to bring you back or bring back your corpse."'']]Additionally, you may overhear an [[Skyrim:World_Interactions#Arguing_about_Haknir|argument]] in the wilderness between a female [[Skyrim:Pirate|pirate]] and a male [[Skyrim:Pirate Mage|pirate mage]]: :'''Pirate''': ''"I told him 'no' once already."'' :'''Pirate Mage''': ''"We've got work to do."'' :'''Pirate''': ''"I'm not chasing that map. It's a fool's errand. I'm done. Leave me alone."'' :'''Pirate Mage''': ''"Boss said to bring you back or bring back your corpse."'' :'''Pirate''': ''"Is that so? Well, you'll never get that treasure now!"'' :'''Pirate Mage''': ''"Time to die!"'' After their argument, they will attack each other over the discussed treasure. If you stand aside during their fight, the pirate may lose the battle, and you can loot a copy of the book from her corpse. === The Silent Scream === According to the book, [[Skyrim:Garuk Windrime|Garuk Windrime]] and the rest of the crew arrived on a shoal in northern Solstheim, where they started digging the hole for the first of the four iron-bound chests. The same night, Garuk's heart was filled with greed; he opened the chest, took out the helm within and placed it on his head... and then began to scream. Although it remains unclear what happened to Garuk, it is said that his scream can still be heard on that same shoal, on moonlit nights. [[File:SR-quest-Deathbrand (quest) 03.jpg|thumb|right|''"I told you. Just where the map said it would be."'']] After reading the book, a map marker will point you towards [[Skyrim:Haknir's Shoal|Haknir's Shoal]], a small campsite along the coast in northeastern Solstheim. Travel to the camp and you will find it inhabited by [[Skyrim:Pirate|pirates]] and their [[Skyrim:Pirate Captain|captain]]. If you manage to sneak up on the camp, you can overhear their conversation: :'''Pirate''': ''"See? I told you. Just where the map said it would be."'' :'''Captain''': ''"We don't even know what's inside. And besides, there's... the curse."'' :'''Pirate''': ''"Don't tell me you believe that rot! Well, as soon as Jorn gets back, you'll see. You'll see."'' From here, it is possible to kill the pirate captain and his followers or simply pickpocket the captain and steal the [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Treasure Map|Deathbrand Treasure Map]] he is carrying. Once you have obtained the treasure map, the quest will initiate. Search the camp for the half-buried [[Skyrim:Containers#Ancient Chest|ancient chest]] and pick the expert-leveled lock. Inside, you will find the [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Helm|Deathbrand Helm]], the same helm worn by Garuk Windrime, although the rumors of his scream on moonlit nights turn out to be highly exaggerated. === The Treasure Hunt === With one of the four chests found, three remain. Take a good look at the [[:File:SR-icon-misc-Deathbrand Treasure Map.png|treasure map]], and it becomes clear that Haknir's crew followed orders and placed them as far apart as possible. Note that you will have no map markers and will receive no quest updates until you have claimed the contents of all four chests. {{NewLine}} {{SkyrimBox/Start|main-color=#FBEFD5|text-color=black}} {{Showhide/Start|Quick Access to Treasure Map →}} [[File:SR-icon-misc-Deathbrand Treasure Map.png|center]] {{Showhide/End}} ====Tel Mithryn (Southeast)==== Travel to the home of [[Lore:Telvanni|Telvanni]] wizard [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] and find the river west of the [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|settlement]]. Where the river flows into the [[Lore:Sea of Ghosts|Sea of Ghosts]], a family of [[Skyrim:Netch|netch]] floats around. To the northeast of the netch family are several boulders in a pile, and three [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]] will attack as you get close. Search the area for the ancient chest ([[:File:SR-place-TelMithryn AncientChestLocation.jpg|screenshot]]) and notice that two [[Skyrim:Treasure Hunter (dead)#Dragonborn|treasure hunters]] beat you to it, but paid with their lives. Pick the expert-leveled lock on the chest and claim the [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Boots|Deathbrand Boots]]. ====Raven Rock (Southwest)==== [[File:SR-quest-Deathbrand (quest) 04.jpg|thumb|right|''"We... we actually found it!"'']] Southwest of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] is the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]]. Head to the stone and proceed in a north-northwestern direction until you reach a small pine forest, with a family of netch floating around above the water nearby. As you get closer, you will see a [[Skyrim:Reaver|reaver]] and a [[Skyrim:Reaver Lord|reaver lord]] discussing the chest they just dug up: :'''Reaver''': ''"I can't believe it. We... we actually found it!"'' :'''Reaver Lord''': ''"Well, what are you waiting for? Go ahead and open it."'' :'''Reaver''': ''"No, no, I couldn't. ...You open it."'' :'''Reaver Lord''': ''"Maybe... we should think about this some more."'' When they discover you, they will obviously be hostile. Deal with them both and locate the ancient chest ([[:File:SR-place-EarthStone AncientChestLocation.jpg|screenshot]]), pick the adept-leveled lock and claim the [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Armor|Deathbrand Armor]]. ====Bristleback Cave (Northwest)==== The hidden dock, [[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]], is located at the foot of the icy mountains of northwestern Solstheim. A small ways southwest of the dock is a small camp inhabited by [[Skyrim:Riekling|rieklings]] guarding the entrance to [[Skyrim:Bristleback Cave|Bristleback Cave]]. Proceed south along the shore and you will find a tidal pool with some [[Skyrim:Mud Crab|mud crabs]] and the ancient chest ([[:File:SR-place-BrokenTuskMine AncientChestLocation.jpg|screenshot]]). Pick the adept-leveled lock on the chest and claim the [[Skyrim:Deathbrand Gauntlets|Deathbrand Gauntlets]].{{SkyrimBox/End}} === A Cursed Trove === In whichever Deathbrand Armor chest (above) you open last, you will find the [[Skyrim:Gyldenhul Barrow Key|Gyldenhul Barrow Key]], and the quest will update. The map marker will now point you towards the [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]], [[Skyrim:Gyldenhul Barrow|Gyldenhul Barrow]]. [[File:SR-quest-Deathbrand (quest) 05.jpg|thumb|left|80 piles of gold]] [[File:SR-quest-Deathbrand (quest) 06.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Haknir Death-Brand|The King of Ghosts]]]] Gyldenhul Barrow is located on [[Skyrim:Horker Island|Horker Island]], east of [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. It is guarded by a few patrolling reavers. There is a Quicksilver Ore Vein slightly to the northeast of the entrance. The door has a master-level lock on it, but the key you found will open it. Inside, you will find a dead [[Skyrim:Adventurer#Adventurer16|Adventurer]] carrying a [[Skyrim:Torn Note (Dragonborn)|note]] detailing how his search for treasure ended in the small barrow. He had to barricade himself inside, waiting for a group of bandits to disappear from outside the ruin. In the meantime, he noticed a small draft from behind one of the two [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] deposits, although his [[Skyrim:Pickaxe|pickaxe]] was unable to break them down. Approach the western stalhrim deposit and use your [[Skyrim:Ancient Nordic Pickaxe|ancient Nordic pickaxe]] to tear it down. Behind it is a narrow tunnel leading further into the ruin. Unlock the door and enter a wide tunnel filled to the brim with [[Skyrim:Gold|piles of gold]]—a total of 80 piles, each worth between 80 and 120 gold, along with several pieces of jewelry, chests, and other valuables. However, as you start to loot the place, a portcullis will fall behind you, so the only way is onward. When you have claimed the huge treasure from the room, proceed to the southern door and unlock it with the key. Head down the tunnel until you reach a large chamber with the skeletal remains of [[Skyrim:Haknir Death-Brand|Haknir Death-Brand]]. Next to the skeleton lies the legendary scimitar [[Skyrim:Bloodscythe|Bloodscythe]]. Once you claim it, Haknir Death-Brand's ghost will appear and attack you, then teleport away after he loses about 20% health. Members of [[Skyrim:Haknir's Crew|his crew]] appear to fight you, including [[Skyrim:Garuk Windrime|Garuk Windrime]] and [[Skyrim:Thalin Ebonhand|Thalin Ebonhand]]. As you kill some of them off, Haknir Death-Brand will spawn again, and the cycle will repeat until he is dead. Once defeated you'll attain another unique scimitar named [[Skyrim:Soulrender|Soulrender]]. It has an added effect when dual-wielded with Bloodscythe. ==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Order of the Crypt===
[[File:SR-quest-Crypt of the Heart.jpg|thumb|right|A lone flower marks the site of the ghostly apparitions]]
This quest will automatically begin upon installing the [[Skyrim:Spell Knight Armor|Spell Knight Armor]] [[SR:Creation Club|Creation]]. You will be directed to visit the [[SR:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] in [[SR:Markarth|Markarth]] to seek out rumors that might have crossed the border from [[Lore:High Rock|High Rock]]. Once at the inn, your quest marker will direct you to a guest room containing a book named ''[[SR:Crypt of the Heart - Draft|Crypt of the Heart - Draft]]''. Reading it will reveal the story of the Order of the Crypt, a knightly order from [[Lore:Shornhelm|Shornhelm]], and the tragic tale of a knight named [[SR:Simon Rodayne|Simon Rodayne]] who fell in love with (or was tricked by) a witch of the [[Lore:Beldama Wyrd|Beldama Wyrd]] named [[SR:Daenella|Daenella]]. Their relationship brought the order into conflict with the witches, driving the coven further and further east. It is said that Simon's ghost haunts the banks of the [[SR:Karth River|Karth River]], below his hilltop tomb. 

You will then be directed to investigate these ghost sightings by travelling to a bridge that crosses the Karth River just next to [[SR:Reachcliff Secret Entrance|Reachcliff Secret Entrance]]. On this bridge, you will find a lone [[SR:Red Mountain Flower|red mountain flower]]; when approached, a [[SR:Ghost Knight|Ghost Knight]] will appear behind you and will wander off to the south, towards [[SR:Dushnikh Yal|Dushnikh Yal]].

Follow the ghost as it makes its way up the slope. It will guide you to a grave west of Dushnikh Yal, which is surrounded by three hostile [[SR:Forsworn|Forsworn]]. Kill the attackers and loot the [[SR:Forsworn Shaman|Forsworn Shaman]]'s body. She will be carrying a ''[[SR:Forsworn Shaman's Note|Forsworn Shaman's Note]]'', which you must read to progress the quest. It reveals that the Beldama Wyrd has come to [[SR:The Reach|the Reach]] in search of Daenella in order to punish her for her betrayal. They have taken Simon's heart from his grave and have brought it to [[SR:Karthspire Camp|Karthspire Camp]] to defile it. Surrounding the grave, you will find the bodies of two [[SR:Knight of the Crypt|Knights of the Crypt]] who had been sent to the Reach to track down and kill the Beldama witches. If you wish, you can loot their bodies for a full set of [[SR:Iron Spell Knight Armor|Iron Spell Knight Armor]] and [[SR:Steel Spell Knight Armor|Steel Spell Knight Armor]].
{{NewLine}}
[[File:SR-quest-Crypt of the Heart 03.jpg|thumb|right|Daenella and her lover's heart]]
===A Stolen Heart===
Journey to [[SR:Karthspire Camp|Karthspire Camp]] and prepare for a fight; the campsite is swarming with Forsworn, and with this Creation installed you will have to deal with the added threat of [[SR:Beldama Witch|Beldama Witch]]es and a [[SR:Hagraven|hagraven]] called the [[SR:Beldama Ward Mother|Beldama Ward Mother]]. They are located on the eastern side of the camp.

Once you've subdued the many enemies at the campsite, approach the sacrificial altar where the Beldama witches are found. On it, you will find the corpse of Daenella, who had been captured by the witches and killed with the knowledge that the Ward Mother planned to corrupt her beloved's heart and return it to his grave tainted, damning his soul for eternity. Sure enough, you will find a [[SR:Corrupted Human Heart|Corrupted Human Heart]] on a pedestal in front of the altar. Take it and return to the knight's grave.
{{NewLine}}
===A Choice===
[[File:SR-quest-Crypt of the Heart 04.jpg|thumb|left|Lovers reunited]][[File:SR-quest-Crypt of the Heart 05.jpg|thumb|right|A set of ebony armor is your reward]]
Once you have the heart, you will be instructed to return it to the knight's grave, with the optional step of first purifying the heart of corruption.

If you choose to place the corrupted heart within the grave, the corrupted spirit of Simon Rodayne will appear and attack you for damning his soul. He wields a [[SR:Bound Sword|bound sword]] in combat. Once you banish the ghost, you will be directed to loot his grave for a full set of enchanted [[SR:Ebony Spell Knight Armor|Ebony Spell Knight Armor]] in order to complete the quest. This set has enchantments focused on offense (see [[Skyrim:Spell Knight Armor Items#Ebony Spell Knight Armor|Spell Knight Armor items]]).

If you instead wish to purify his heart, you must first activate the [[SR:Shrine of Mara|Shrine of Mara]] found at his tomb. Once this is done, place [[SR:Simon Rodayne's Heart|Simon Rodayne's Heart]] within his grave. This will cause a brief apparition of Simon and Daenella, finally reunited in death. The ghostly lovers will then disappear, and in their place a full set of enchanted Ebony Spell Knight Armor will materialize above the grave. This set has enchantments focused on defense. Take the armor to complete the quest.

Regardless of which option you choose, you will now be able to craft Spell Knight armor from [[SR:Iron|iron]], [[SR:Steel|steel]], and [[SR:Ebony|ebony]] at any [[SR:Forge|forge]], provided you have the necessary skill perks.
{{NewLine}}
==Notes==
*The name of this quest (and the related book) is a reference to the [[Lore:Crypt of Hearts|Crypt of Hearts]], which the Order of the Crypt is sworn to protect.
*Once the Crypt of the Heart-Draft is read at Silver-Blood Inn you can head straight to the gravesite of Simon Rodayne circumventing the bridge ghost.
*The Beldama coven can be attacked directly without going through Karthspire Camp by heading southwest from [[Skyrim:Soljund%27s_Sinkhole|Soljund's Sinkhole]] and approaching the altar from above.
*At Karthspire Camp, the dead giant on the altar and the giant's toe will be absent during this quest, replaced by Daenella and the Corrupted Human Heart. 
{{NewLine}}

==Bugs==

*The quest may mark as completed after picking up three of the armor pieces, making it impossible to pick up the fourth.

==Quick Walkthrough==

#Travel to the [[Skyrim:Unmarked Places The Pale#Fishing_Hut|shack]] west of Dawnstar.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Crustacean Extermination 02.jpg|right|thumb|Swarm of frenzied mudcrabs]]
This quest can be started after [[Skyrim:No Contest|No Contest]] has been completed by talking to Viriya:
:'''Know of anyone in need of fishing work around Skyrim?'''
:''"Maybe you can help me. You're headed to Dawnstar. It's all in this note. This won't be easy, but that's why I'm sending you. Think you can handle it?"''
:'''I'm always up for one of your crab dilemmas.''' / '''Just point me toward something with claws, and I'll make it dead.'''
:''"Thanks."''

Either option leads to the same outcome. Viriya will hand you a [[Skyrim:Letter on Mudcrab Attacks|letter]] that mentions multiple accounts of fishermen being attacked near a small shack on the shore west of Dawnstar by a swarm of mudcrabs. Travel to the shack, west of Dawnstar to investigate. Once you arrive at the shack [[Skyrim:Frenzied Mudcrab|frenzied mudcrabs]] will begin to swarm you, kill all twelve of them. 

Once you have killed all the mudcrabs, investigate the body of [[Skyrim:Seviur|Seviur]] to find his [[Skyrim:Seviur's Journal|journal]]. Read the journal and you will discover that Seviur was using pacification magic and necromancy on mudcrabs which started to fail, until eventually the mudcrabs turned on him in a frenzy. You can then return to Viriya to speak to her:
:'''The mudcrabs have been slain. They were driven into a fury by a necromancer.'''
:''"We sure show them, eh? Thanks for your part in all that."''
:'''Seviur drew them to the coast using magic, but he lost control over them.'''
:''"I understand. I've come to rely on you. There's something I want you to have. It was my father's. It would be my honor if you carried it. May the gods keep you."''
:'''This Alik'ri rod is fit for a master fisherman. Thank you, Viriya.'''
:''"Stay sharp out there."''

You will be rewarded with an [[Skyrim:Alik'ri Fishing Rod|Alik'ri Fishing Rod]] and the ability to craft the rod.

MQ201RecoverGearMISC |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] in [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]]. # Meet [[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and give him any equipment you want smuggled into the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Embassy|embassy]]. # Meet Delphine at the stables, wear the [[Skyrim:Party Clothes|party clothes]] and hop in the carriage for a ride to the embassy. # At the embassy, create a diversion and slip away from the party with Malborn. # Recover Thalmor intelligence files from the ambassador's office. # Go down to the dungeon and recover the rest of the documents. # Obtain the key to the trapdoor and escape. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Diplomatic Immunity=== ====The Thalmor==== [[File:SR-quest-Diplomatic Immunity 02.jpg|thumb|Malborn inside the Winking Skeever]] Travel to Riverwood. If you choose to travel with Delphine, and come close to her, she will stop and explain the complex background story about the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]] and how the [[Lore:Aldmeri Dominion|Aldmeri Dominion]] wiped out all Blades during the Great War. While her memory of past events seems checkered at best, she at least provides some background information behind her hatred towards the Thalmor and a valid reason on why she suspects them for being responsible for the dragon attacks. Due to a travel [[#Bugs|bug]], it is best to chat with Delphine at the beginning of her trip, then stop by the [[Skyrim:Braidwood Inn|Braidwood Inn]] and rest, giving her time to travel alone. She has no special commentary at waypoints in this direction. Delphine will appear at [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] in Whiterun and fuss at the Dragonborn for not meeting her in Riverwood. Once back in the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]], she will head down to the secret basement and reveal that she has a plan. {{Showhide/Start|Delphine's dialogue}} '''Delphine''': "''I figured out how we're going to get you into the Thalmor Embassy.''" :'''You're not coming?''' :'''That didn't take long.''' :'''Why not just fight our way in?''' {{Showhide/End|Delphine's dialogue}} Thalmor Ambassador [[Skyrim:Elenwen|Elenwen]] often throws parties for the upper-class citizens of Skyrim. You are to meet a "man on the inside", [[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]], who will help you to the best of his abilities. He will meet you at the [[Skyrim:The Winking Skeever|Winking Skeever]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. In the meantime, Delphine will work on getting you a formal invitation to the party. Travel to Solitude and see Malborn. ====The Wood Elf==== According to Delphine, the Thalmor killed Malborn's entire family back in [[Lore:Valenwood|Valenwood]], giving him plenty of good reason to help you out. You will find him inside the Winking Skeever, trying to keep a low profile. He will be quite surprised that she picked you for such a dangerous infiltration job, but will explain the situation. You are to carefully choose some equipment that he can smuggle into the embassy, preferably stealth-based, and he advises you not to try to bring anything yourself. When you're ready, hand him your preferred equipment. Don't forget to give him lockpicks if you want to access locked containers in the Embassy. After you close the menu, he will get up and leave. Delphine will now be waiting for you at [[Skyrim:Solitude Stables|Solitude Stables]], just southwest of Solitude. Once you arrive, she will ensure that everything went smoothly with Malborn and will then hand you an [[Skyrim:Invitation to Elenwen's Reception|official invitation]] along with a set of [[Skyrim:Party Clothes|party clothes]] and [[Skyrim:Party Boots|boots]] to look the part. After you have changed she will take your remaining equipment and you will automatically board the carriage to the Thalmor Embassy. ====High-Class Party==== [[File:SR-place-Thalmor_Embassy.jpg|thumb|left|The Thalmor Embassy]] [[File:SR-quest-Diplomatic_Immunity_03.jpg|thumb|right|''"I am Elenwen, the Thalmor Ambassador to Skyrim."'']] The [[Skyrim:Carriage Driver|carriage driver]] will drop you off in the courtyard of the embassy and you will be greeted by the drunken ramblings of a [[Skyrim:Redguard|Redguard]] named [[Skyrim:Razelan|Razelan]], apparently a high-ranking officer in the [[Lore:East Empire Company|East Empire Company]]. As you approach the entrance, a [[Skyrim:Thalmor Soldier|Thalmor Soldier]] will ask for your invitation, so show it and go inside. Once you enter, party host Elenwen will be quick to seek you out and ask too many questions. Luckily, your friend Malborn is standing right behind her and will soon interrupt the embarrassing conversation and point Elenwen's attention elsewhere. Talk to Malborn, who will brief you; you are to create a scene so he can unlock the back door unnoticed. Look around the room and check out the guests. When asking around, you will quickly notice that the guests are either hateful Thalmor or high-ranked denizens of Skyrim who only participate in the party for personal benefit. With the exception of the hostess [[Skyrim:Elenwen|Elenwen]], the drunken [[Skyrim:Razelan|Razelan]], the servant [[Skyrim:Brelas|Brelas]] and the bard [[Skyrim:Illdi|Illdi]] (or [[Skyrim:Grete|Grete]] if Illdi is dead ), the guests are often randomized or determined from your previous actions before even starting the quest. You can quickly create the distraction by talking to [[Skyrim:Erikur|Erikur]]. Listen to his speech, then wait for him to harass Brelas. After he is finished, walk back to him and offer to talk to her in his stead. He will be very grateful. Regardless of what you say to Brelas, when you return to [[Skyrim:Erikur|Erikur]] tell him, "Yes. She said she can sneak you up to her quarters right now". He will then immediately go to her and begin to accost her, drawing the attention of the guards. Quickly return to Malborn and proceed to the kitchen. There are no persuasion checks required for this and his disposition towards you does not affect the dialogue. Brelas will later end up in a dungeon cell, but can be liberated. Alternatively, giving a bottle of [[Skyrim:Cyrodilic Brandy|Cyrodilic Brandy]] (which you can obtain from Malborn) to Razelan, whom you previously met outside, will make him inclined to create a disruption on your behalf if you request it of him. {{NewLine}} {{Showhide/Start|Party Conversations}} In this randomly determined conversation, Elenwen will politely ask the guests if they're liking the party. I don't understand why everyone... never mind. {{Showhide/End}} |} {{SkyrimBox/End}} ====Infiltration==== In the kitchen, the [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]] cook [[Skyrim:Tsavani|Tsavani]] will complain about Malborn bringing a stranger into the kitchens, at least until Malborn reminds her of her secret [[Skyrim:Moon Sugar|Moon Sugar]] addiction. Malborn will then lead you into a room where you can receive the items you asked him to smuggle in. '''Tsavani''': ''"Who comes, Malborn? You know I don't like strange smells in my kitchen."''
'''Malborn''': ''"A guest, feeling ill. Leave the poor wretch be."''
'''Tsavani''': ''"A guest? In the kitchens? You know this is against the rules..."''
'''Malborn''': ''"Rules, is it, Tsavani? I didn't realize that eating Moon Sugar was permitted. Perhaps I should ask the Ambassador..."''
'''Tsavani''': ''"Tss! Get out of here, I saw nothing."'' Talking to Tsavani after that will only cause her to say: ''"Go. Out. Before I change my mind."'' If you take too long to retrieve your equipment, Malborn will say things like ''"Hurry it up. I've got to get back before I'm missed."'', ''"Come on. If someone misses me at the party, we're both dead."'', and ''"I need to lock the door behind you or the patrols might notice something's wrong."'' You should now be fully prepared for battle, and if not, then for stealth. If you are not, it is probably a good idea to re-open an earlier save and re-start the mission, as the Thalmor Wizards [[Skyrim:Conjure Storm Atronach|summon hostile]] [[Skyrim:Daedra%23Storm_Atronach|Storm Atronachs]], and you should be prepared enough to kill their mages or them. As soon as you exit through the door, Malborn will lock the kitchen area behind you and you are on your own, with the objective to find dragon-related intelligence. In the first hallway, you can eavesdrop on a conversation between two Thalmor Guards, hinting that Delphine may be wrong about the Thalmor: '''Guard #1''': ''"Did you see those robes march in this morning? Who're they with? More of the Emissary's treaty enforcers?"''
'''Guard #2''': ''"No. They're high mages, just in from Alinor. I guess Herself is finally getting worried about all the dragon attacks."''
'''Guard #1''': ''"Ah, good. I've been wondering how we were supposed to defend this place from a dragon."''
'''Guard #2''': ''"If a dragon does show up, maybe we'll get lucky and it will eat the mages first. Might give us enough time to kill it."''
'''Guard #1''': ''"Ha. I'd like to see those arrogant bastards taken down a notch. Always looking down their noses at us lowly footsloggers."'' After a bit of mean-spirited laughter, one of the guards will say, ''"Well, we'd better get back to our rounds."'' and they will both return to their duties, unfortunately in the room you will have to pass through. Note that the full set of Thalmor clothes in the adjacent room was supposed to make you harder to detect, but due to a [[#Bugs|bug]], the clothes don't work: the desired effect was set to the [[Skyrim:Hooded_Thalmor_Robes|Hooded Thalmor Robes]] but ''not'' the (''un''-hooded) [[Skyrim:Thalmor Robes|Thalmor Robes]] actually placed there. You can claim a set of hooded robes from the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Wizard|Thalmor wizard]] in the upstairs area from the first room, but chances are he will detect you and call upon the two guards from downstairs. Regardless, you can choose between two strategies; either take the stealthy approach, with or without the hooded robes, or go on a rampage and kill everybody. =====Hooded Thalmor Robes Method===== If you want to use the [[Skyrim:Hooded Thalmor Robes|Hooded Thalmor Robes]], as intended by the developers, either acquire some from the random [[Skyrim:Thalmor#Justiciars|Justiciars]] found in the wilderness, or aim to kill the wizard on the first floor. After you don the robes, you will be undercover if you're an elf, can walk past the guards (at a distance) if you are human, or will be immediately exposed if you are Khajiit or Argonian. {{Showhide/Start|Table}} {| class="wikitable" width="90%" ! If disguised as a Thalmor Wizard, you may dismiss the guard standing outside the Solar with a high enough speech check (if you cannot pass the speech check however, he'll notice that you're an intruder and everybody in the courtyard will turn hostile). Note that once you reach Elenwen's Solar, the patrolling guard, as well as Rulindil, are scripted to see through your disguise, regardless of race. This method is possible with a reasonably high Illusion skill (over 50) as other races by using Calm spells. It does not work for any other guards during this mission, and once you are inside the Solar, the guards will attack you on sight.
{{Showhide/Start|Speech check dialogue}} '''Thalmor Wizard''': "''Why aren't you at your post, Justiciar?''"
:'''Emissary Elenwen was asking for you inside. (Persuade)''' :'''Yes sir. Sorry sir.''' If the speech check is passed, he will respond: '''Thalmor Wizard''': "''Why didn't you say so? Take over my post. Make sure nobody enters the Solar.'' {{Showhide/End|Speech check dialogue}} ====Enter the Solar==== The first room contains the two talkative guards, with the Thalmor wizard patrolling the second floor. Right after their conversation ends, they will both turn their back to the door and return to their positions, giving you a chance to sneak upstairs and attempt to claim the robes by killing the wizard quietly. If not, you will have to take out the two guards and the wizard, and pick one of the two available doors leading to the outside courtyard. The area is patrolled by three Thalmor soldiers with another wizard standing guard near the front door to your target destination, the Solar of Elenwen. If you wear the hooded robes, the guards will not notice you, but the wizard cannot generally be avoided and will see through your disguise. To enter the Solar, you have a few options. The most straightforward is to fight them all. You can avoid the fight by using [[Skyrim:Calm|Calm]], or by using [[Skyrim:Fury|Fury]] on one of the guards and then running in while they're busy with each other. Stealthy characters can fire arrows to distract the guards and pull the wizard away from the door. The door wizard occasionally looks to his left, leaving open an opportunity on his right for sneaking and invisible characters to get through the door before fully detected. Once the guards are dealt with and the way to the Solar is clear, enter [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneak mode]] and head in. ====The Informant==== Once you get inside Elenwen's Solar, the true face of the Thalmor will start to show, although not in the way Delphine expected. When the door closes behind you, you should hide behind the plant in the southwestern corner and eavesdrop on the conversation between the Thalmor torturer [[Skyrim:Rulindil|Rulindil]] and his informant [[Skyrim:Gissur|Gissur]] in the neighboring room. The conversation centers on a prisoner named Etienne and an unnamed old man: [[File:SR-quest-Diplomatic_Immunity_04.jpg|thumb|right|''"He knows where that old man is you're looking for..."'']] '''Gissur''': ''"But, I need that money! I earned it. I have my own expenses you know..."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"Silence! Do not presume, Gissur. You are most useful, but do not presume. We have other informants who are less... offensive."''
'''Gissur''': ''"But no one else has brought you such valuable information, have they? Etienne, he's talked, hasn't he? He knows where that old man is you're looking for, he told me himself."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"You'll get the rest of your money when we confirm his story. As agreed."''
'''Gissur''': ''"So he has talked! I knew it!"''
'''Rulindil''': ''"Everyone talks, in the end. Now, I have work to do. Leave me to it, if you ever want to see the rest of your payment."''
'''Gissur''': ''"Can I... I could help you. He'd talk to me. He trusts me."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"You'd like to come downstairs with me, is that it, Gissur? Shall we loose his bonds and put you in a cell together? You can ask him anything you like, and see how he answers."''
'''Gissur''': ''"No, no. I'll... I'll wait outside."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"That would probably be best. Now get out!"'' While an insulted Gissur obeys orders and leaves the building, Rulindil will head downstairs and enter the dungeon, leaving the patrolling soldier alone with you. You can either sneak past him or kill him, as your objective is the chest in the northwestern corner. Open the chest and obtain the [[Skyrim:Interrogation Chamber Key|interrogation chamber key]], Thalmor dossiers on [[Skyrim:Thalmor Dossier: Delphine|Delphine]] and [[Skyrim:Thalmor_Dossier: Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]], and the revealing document ''[[Skyrim:Dragon Investigation: Current Status|Dragon Investigation: Current Status]]'', which proves the Thalmor are investigating the dragon attacks as well, with Rulindil in charge of interrogating a suspect in the cells. ====Torture Session==== Go down the stairs and enter the dungeon, where you will arrive at a balcony overlooking a bloodstained torture room and a number of cells. If used as a distraction, [[Skyrim:Brelas|Brelas]] will be there too. If he wasn't killed in the previous room, Rulindil will be seated at the desk, while a Thalmor Soldier will do the dirty work and torture [[Skyrim:Etienne Rarnis|Etienne Rarnis]] while Rulindil asks a series of questions: [[File:SR-quest-Diplomatic_Immunity_05.jpg|thumb|right|''"I don't know his name."'']] [[File:SR-quest-Diplomatic_Immunity_06.jpg|thumb|right|''"And where can we find this nameless old man?"'']] '''Etienne''': ''"Stop. Please. I don't know anything else. Don't you think I'd have told you already?"''
'''Soldier''': ''"Silence. You know the rules. Do not speak unless spoken to. Master Rulindil will ask the questions."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"Let's begin again."''
'''Etienne''': ''"No... for pity's sake... I've already told you everything..."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"You know the rules."''
'''Etienne''': ''"Noooooo!!!"''
'''Rulindil''': ''"Start at the beginning, as usual. If you persist in this stubbornness I'll have..."''
'''Etienne''': ''"No, wait! I was just... catching my breath... why wouldn't I tell you again? I don't even know anything... There's an old man. He lives in Riften. He could be this Esbern you're looking for, but I don't know. He's old and seemed kind of crazy. That's all I know."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"And his name is...?"''
'''Etienne''': ''"I don't know his name. Like I've told already a hundred- Ahhhh!"''
'''Rulindil''': ''"You know the rules. Just answer the questions. And where can we find this nameless old man?"''
'''Etienne''': ''"Like I said, I don't know! I've seen him down in the Ratway. Maybe he lives down there, but I don't know for sure."''
'''Rulindil''': ''"That will be all for now. I must say I continue to be disappointed in your lack of cooperation. I hope next time you will do better."''
'''Etienne''': ''"What else do you want from me? I've already told you everything. Listen, if you let me go I can take you to Riften, show you where- Gaaaaah!!!"''
'''Soldier''': ''"Silence, prisoner!"'' [[File:SR-quest-Diplomatic_Immunity_07.jpg|thumb|right|Rulindil attacks.]] With that last punch, Etienne finally loses consciousness and the Thalmor will leave him alone. Rulindil will stay behind his desk while the Thalmor Soldier will start patrolling the area. Your objectives are in the chest right next to Rulindil and in the soldier's possession. Two more soldiers will enter as soon as you advance the quest. Also, if you've gotten [[Skyrim:Brelas|Brelas]] in trouble, she is imprisoned nearby. You can rescue her too (this not recommended due to a [[#Bugs|bug]]). As such, the best way to proceed is to kill Rulindil and his accomplice. Rulindil is a powerful wizard with countless spells at his disposal. Depending on your skill set, you may choose head-on combat or stealth assassination. Sneaking up on them with a dagger is one option. Using a [[Skyrim:Crossbow|crossbow]] and two vials of [[Skyrim:Paralysis Poison|Paralysis Poison]] is another. Rulindil carries a wide array of items, such as spell tomes, poisons, and enchanted jewelry. Be sure to collect them. Now is a good time to save the game, if you want [[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]] to survive the next section and give you an [[Skyrim:Find the Thalmor Assassin|optional quest]] later on. ====Escape the Embassy==== Enter Etienne's cell and tell him that you are here to help. Cut him loose and ask him if he knows anything of importance; he will then tell you about [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] and the quest will update. You can also ignore Etienne and look in the chest by the back wall to the right of his cell, which contains a book titled ''[[Skyrim:Thalmor Dossier: Esbern|Thalmor Dossier: Esbern]]''; if you read it, the quest will also update. When that happens, quickly run up the eastern set of stairs (or better read it there), where you will find Malborn, now exposed for his treachery, and two Thalmor Soldiers. '''Thalmor Soldier''': ''"Listen up, spy! You're trapped in here, and we have your accomplice. Surrender immediately or you both die."''
'''Malborn''': ''"Never mind, I'm dead already-"''
'''Thalmor Soldier''': ''"Silence, traitor! Move. Slowly."'' They will kill him on the spot if you let them, so kill both of them quickly and don't hit Malborn. After the battle, search the corpses for the [[Skyrim:Trap Door Key|trap door key]] (or pickpocket the key without combat) and return to Etienne who will be waiting near the trap door, or just go to the trap door. This will also be your last chance to free Brelas if you involved her in your distraction by speaking to Erikur. You will now have up to three followers, completely unable to fight, but unlock the trap door and enter [[Skyrim:Reeking Cave|Reeking Cave]]. Down there, a troll resides, so run ahead of the fugitives and kill it before they even notice it (as they will try to fight it and get killed in the process). If you had a follower when you spoke to Delphine at the stables, he or she will probably enter the cave at this point from the other side, and help to kill the troll. You can also just run through because trying to kill a big troll with your weak followers in the way is really hard without getting them killed. Lastly, locate the tunnel with a dead conjurer, the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Before the Ages of Man|Before the Ages of Man]]'' and an [[Skyrim:Unusual_Gem|Unusual Gem]]. Exiting the cave will start the unnamed miscellaneous quest with the objective ''[[#Recover your equipment|Recover your equipment]]'', then prepare to deliver some surprising news to Delphine back in Riverwood. In the secret basement underneath the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]], Delphine will anxiously await your return. When you tell her that the Thalmor have nothing to do with the dragon attacks, she will be quite surprised and ask for elaboration. When you tell her that they're looking for someone named Esbern, she will be shocked: ''"Esbern? He's alive? I thought the Thalmor must have got him years ago. That crazy old man... Figures the Thalmor would be on his trail, though, if they were trying to find out what's going on with the dragons."'' It turns out Esbern is a former [[Skyrim:Blades|Blade]], just like Delphine, and that it makes perfect sense for the Thalmor to blame him for the dragons. When you tell her about Esbern's supposed location in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], she will immediately task you with tracking him down before the Thalmor do. She will then give you a secret phrase to gain Esbern's trust, the Diplomatic Immunity quest will end, and the next quest, [[Skyrim:A Cornered Rat|A Cornered Rat]], will begin. ===Recover your equipment=== Remember to claim all your belongings from Delphine's chest before leaving for Riften to complete the miscellaneous quest. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|Diplomatic Immunity (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== * During the quest, [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] can be seen resurrecting [[Skyrim:Vuljotnaak|Vuljotnaak]] at a dragon burial mound south of [[Skyrim:Broken_Fang_Cave|Broken Fang Cave]]. * Although Malborn tells you not to bring anything else with you to the embassy, you can bring any [[Skyrim:Quest Items|quest items]] with you, as they cannot be removed from your inventory manually. ** With the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on, you can summon the [[Skyrim:Dremora Butler|Dremora Butler]] and gain early equipment that way as well. * Even if you are seen wearing [[Skyrim:Fine Clothes|fine clothes]] and [[Skyrim:Fine Boots|fine boots]], Delphine will still say ''"You can't go to a party at the Thalmor Embassy dressed like that."'' * The carriage driver who brings you to the embassy will bring you there for free. * Once you arrive at the embassy, you won't be able to draw weapons, cast spells, or shout until you exit the kitchen. Fast travel will also be disabled until you exit the Reeking Cave. * Malborn and the two guards are not present until you read [[Skyrim:Thalmor_Dossier: Esbern|Thalmor Dossier: Esbern]] or interrogate [[Skyrim:Etienne_Rarnis|Etienne Rarnis]] or release then ask Etienne Rarnis. * If you use Ondolemar as a distraction during this quest and then finish the quest [[Skyrim:Search and Seizure|Search and Seizure]] for him afterwards, his disposition towards you will rise from -2 to +1. * If you have a bottle of [[Skyrim:Colovian Brandy|Colovian Bandy]] in your inventory and ask Brelas or Malborn for a drink, they will refuse to give you another one. ** There is an exception to this: if you get a bottle of Colovian Brandy and then give it to Razelan, you'll be able to ask Brelas or Malborn for a drink one more time. * Anyone escaping with you will run toward Solitude after exiting Reeking Cave, eventually end up near the [[Skyrim:Dainty Sload|Dainty Sload]] and vanish if not killed by a hostile random encounter. Their deaths can also be avoided by fast-traveling once you are outside Reeking Cave.
