Skyrim:Repentance.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=74.171.155.22 |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=74.171.155.22 |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]]{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Illia|Illia]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Staff of Hag's Wrath|Staff of Hag's Wrath]], Illia as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Illia|Illia]]) |Prev= |Conc= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Darklight Tower|Darklight Tower]] |Image=SR-quest-Repentance.jpg |ImgDesc=In the heat of Repentance |description=Help [[Skyrim:Illia|Illia]] prevent her mother [[Skyrim:Silvia|Silvia]] from transforming into a [[Skyrim:Hagraven|hagraven]]. |ID=dunDarklightQST |Icon= |SuggLevel=8 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Help [[Skyrim:Illia|Illia]] reach the top of [[Skyrim:Darklight Tower|Darklight Tower]]. #Defeat [[Skyrim:Silvia|Silvia]] on the top of Darklight Tower. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A View to a Kill=== [[File:SR-quest-Repentance_03.jpg|thumb|right|The standoff]] While travelling southwest of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], you may come across the ominous [[Skyrim:Darklight Tower|Darklight Tower]]. The guards in Riften are concerned about the place, stating: ''"There's a foul presence coming from Darklight Tower... Some say the place is home to necromancers."'' When you enter the tower, you will be witness to a murder; an [[Skyrim:Imperial|Imperial]] [[Skyrim:CombatMageElemental|elemental mage]] has killed a witch. Seeing you, the mage, [[Skyrim:Illia|Illia]], tries to explain. Illia is near desperate, trying to escape the depravity of the coven within the tower. She was tasked with locating a human sacrifice so that her mother, [[Skyrim:Silvia|Silvia]], can conduct a ritual to become a [[Skyrim:Hagraven|hagraven]]. Illia takes responsibility for the horrific things she has done in the tower, but makes a stand against taking an innocent life. She asks you to help her stop her mother's vile plan. ===Witch Hunt=== [[File:SR-quest-Repentance_02.jpg|thumb|right|Hagraven duel]] If you agree to help her, Illia will start ascending the stairs, but will typically wait for you to catch up. On each level of the tower you'll encounter a [[Skyrim:Witch|witch]] or [[Skyrim:Hag|hag]] and an assortment of creatures such as [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]], [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]], or [[Skyrim:Troll|trolls]]. Despite being casters, witches and hags are very weak and Illia, unlike them, is a very capable [[Skyrim:Frost Damage|frost]] mage. Battling through to the third floor, you may notice a locked door requiring a [[Skyrim:Darklight Tower Closet Key|key]] on the way up. Illia has this key, and it can be pickpocketed, however, it's probably not worth the effort to pickpocket her or kill her for this, as the room only contains a cupboard with several potions. Once the quest is over, you can take Illia's key freely if you ask her to be a follower. Stopping at a portcullis, Illia warns of a hagraven ahead. Pulling the lever will open the gate and allow you to slay the hagraven, as well as any other creatures on this level. A copy of the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:2920, Sun's Dawn, v2|2920, Sun's Dawn, v2]]'' is on the table by the hagraven's tent. Continue into [[Skyrim:Darklight Chambers|Darklight Chambers]], killing the witches. Here you will come to a master-locked door. Illia says that one of the hagravens carries the [[Skyrim:Darklight Tower Key|key]]. She then hopefully asks if you can pick the lock. If you decide to retrieve the key from the hagraven, Illia will wait at the door for your return. The hagraven you are looking for is in the room off the corridor to the east, accompanied by a hag. Once you have the locked door open, Illia will resume the ascent to the top of the tower. You will meet more hags and creatures on your way up, as well as a copy of the [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Mystery of Talara, v3|Mystery of Talara, v3]]'' on a table on one of the landings. ===The Demise of Silvia=== [[File:SR-quest-Repentance_04.jpg|thumb|right|A daughter's betrayal]] Once you reach the top, Illia explains that her mother is just on the other side of a closed door; and Illia has a plan. She's going to present you to her mother as the sacrifice and while her mother is preparing, you and Illia can kill her mother together. While a difficult decision, Illia seems resolute. She would rather her mother die at her hands than have her turn into a monster. Open the door to an open area where Silvia has prepared the ritual. Illia will begin the charade and Silvia will ask you to sit on a chair in order for the ritual to begin. At this point you can either outright kill Silvia or trust that Illia isn't merely playing you for a fool and sit in the chair. If you do sit in the chair, Silvia will begin the ritual and Illia will make good on her promise to stop her. Silvia is fairly tough, compared to the residents of the tower, but no match for you and Illia combined. Once Silvia's path has ended, Illia will ask for no sympathy; she plans to leave this all behind. Illia thanks you and allows you to keep her mother's [[Skyrim:Staff of Hag's Wrath|Staff of Hag's Wrath]] as payment for your help. You can ask Illia if she would like to come with you and she seems eager at the chance to, ''"do some good for a change"''. She will then be your [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]]. Before leaving, be sure to pick up the Destruction skill book ''[[Skyrim:Horror of Castle Xyr|Horror of Castle Xyr]]'', sitting atop the table next to the tent. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If Silvia is killed before Illia initiates a conversation, Illia will start the conversation regardless and waits indefinitely for a response unless you go sit in the chair (at which point she simply turns and leaves and will not agree to join you).|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} This can be fixed by prid 0004B47C, moveto player, resurrect 1 and finally enable. {{Bug|If you pick the lock from the top instead and enter via Darklight Chambers, you can fight your way down to Darklight Tower. In there, however, you will eventually come to a gate you can't open from that side. The only way is to turn back, while killing some monsters that have respawned. Upon re-entering Darklight Chambers, Illia will suddenly be at your side (even if you've never met her) and the game will treat you as if you were mid-quest.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} The quest can still be completed the normal way, but if you want to be there from the beginning, set the stage to 0 (setstage dunDarkLightQST 0) and re-enter from the bottom floor (Darklight Tower) instead. If you entered from the top you probably already killed Silvia as well; to fix that, see the previous point. {{Bug|If you go through the stages, go through the door to where the initiation is to start, and a hagraven and a hag in Illia's Mother's place Illia will continue into battle alone killing both of them. If you encounter this Silvia will not appear, not starting the initiation process. Illia will then return to the top door and not offer any options, leaving the quest unfinished.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} This can be fixed by prid 0004B47C, enable. Silvia will appear and act hostile but will not initiate combat. Once you attack, Illia will join the fight and the quest will be marked as completed once Silvia is dead. ** If this happens, an earlier save must be loaded to complete the quest, before entering Darklight Tower. First, find a way to the top of the tower on the Skyrim map. The gate will be barred, but you can go over it. Kill the hag and hagraven. Return to the bottom of the tower and enter. Proceed normally, and when you reach the top with Illia, her mother will be there. {{Bug|This quest was erroneously set up in the story manager, which can cause it to restart itself unexpectedly. In addition, the quest has an unnecessary "allow repeat stages" flag which further exaggerates the problem. It ALSO has multiple shutdown stages selected, which doesn't work.|USLEEP|3.0.6}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. She was supposed to obtain a sacrifice for her mother to perform an evil ritual, but rebelled. Illia wants me to help her get to the top of the tower so she can stop her mother. {{Quest Objective|10|Help Illia reach the top of Darklight Tower}} |20||I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. At the top of the tower, Illia told me her plan. She planned to present me as the sacrifice to her mother to gain the element of surprise. |25||{{Quest Objective|20|Defeat Illia's mother at the top of Darklight Tower}} |35||{{Quest Objective|20|Defeat Illia's mother at the top of Darklight Tower}} |40|fin|I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]] {{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver= |Reward=[[Skyrim:Hevnoraak (item)|Hevnoraak]], [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak's Staff|Hevnoraak's Staff]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Aura_Whisper|Aura Whisper]] shout. |Disp= |Rep= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Valthume|Valthume]] |Image=SR-quest-Evil in Waiting 02.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Valthume|Valthume]] |description=Seal away an [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak (creature)|ancient evil]]. |ID=dunValthumeQST |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |SuggLevel=24 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Enter [[Skyrim:Valthume|Valthume]] and speak to the ghost named [[Skyrim:Valdar|Valdar]]. # Collect the [[Skyrim:Opaque_Vessel|vessels]] from each of Hevnoraak's [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] minions. # Kill the [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|Dragon Priest]] [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak (creature)|Hevnoraak]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Forgotten Ruin=== [[File:SR-quest-Evil_in_Waiting.jpg|thumb|right|''"Leave, stranger. Evil stirs in this place."'']] The [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]] of [[Skyrim:Valthume|Valthume]] lies southeast of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] at the end of the path that leads southeast from [[Skyrim:Dushnikh Yal|Dushnikh Yal]]. No citizens will ever mention the ruin, although the Greybeards may detect a "whisper of a [[Skyrim:The Words of Power|word]]" from the location, as there is a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|Word Wall]] in the ruin. They can point you in the right direction. When you arrive there will be no enemies guarding the exterior door leading into the side of the great mountain, but there is a possibility of a troll encounter, so be on guard. Enter [[Skyrim:Valthume Vestibule|Valthume Vestibule]] and you will immediately be sought out by a ghost named [[Skyrim:Valdar|Valdar]] who will provide a warning: ''"Leave, stranger. Evil stirs in this place. I fear for the security of the very land if it should break free."'' If you ask for more details, the ghost will elaborate on the danger that lurks within: ''"We stand at the tomb of Hevnoraak, who has been dead for many generations. I fear, however, that his return may be at hand."'' Valdar reveals that he stayed behind to constrain the power of the [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|Dragon Priest]] [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak (creature)|Hevnoraak]], but that his own strength is fading away. Due to this weakness, he needs a champion to find three vessels scattered around the large ruin; their combined power can help vanquish Hevnoraak, thus saving the land of Skyrim from his vengeance. Accept the challenge and Valdar will open a gate in the back of the vestibule leading to the real ruin of Valthume. He will then sit down on his throne atop his own skeleton, and you can gather some more information on the threat waiting to break out of his prison: ''"Hevnoraak planned his resurrection obsessively before dying. My duty in life and in death is to make sure he stays in this tomb for eternity."'' Apparently, Valthume was a former den of dragon worshippers, with Hevnoraak as their leader: ''"He had a way of enthralling people and built up a loyal army of followers. Good men fell under his spell and were forever twisted. Made... evil. After that, fear was enough to keep them in line. He could torture and humiliate them and they would not rebel. Even in death, they serve him still."'' ===Valthume=== [[File:SR-quest-Evil in Waiting 03.jpg|thumb|right|''"Even in death, they serve him still."'']] While the exterior of the ruin only consists of a single door, the ruin of Valthume is incredibly large and far from linear; make sure to keep an eye on the map markers and prepare for a fairly long trek to gather all three vessels. The first chamber is huge, with no enemies in sight. Hevnoraak's sarcophagus stands in the middle of the room, sealed shut, with his throne strategically placed in the background. You can do nothing here now, so locate the southern stairway and jump over the [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] to avoid the corresponding [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|battering ram]] around the corner. Proceed forward and dispose of the [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] enemies. The door to the south is sealed shut from the other side, so go through the tunnel to the east. Before long, you will stand in a huge chamber, clearly an area for offerings, which is inhabited by two leveled draugr. The overhanging ledges provide an opportunity for ranged attacks. Claim some loot in a hidden room above the altar, by jumping to the side balcony, then jump again to the corner balcony, and then jump yet again to reach the altar. then jump down and open the chest on the floor. There is a [[Skyrim:Trap Door|trap door]] that will net you a fight against four [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] and a draugr carrying the [[Skyrim:Valthume Cellar Key|key]] to escape the trap, but little else. Instead, take the southern tunnel and open the door to your right for the [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Withershins|Withershins]]''. You will pass a tantalizing expert-locked door, however it leads only to the aforementioned pit containing the spiders. Return to the tunnel and make your way through several fire traps and beware of the four pressure plates triggering [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|darts]]. The room contains two exits, both of them closed, so pull the handle near the eastern stone wall and watch it lower. Behind you, the metal gate will disappear as well, but ignore it for now and choose the eastern path. Before long, you will be attacked by a boss-leveled draugr protecting the first of the [[Skyrim:Opaque Vessel|opaque vessels]]. After the battle, claim the vessel and the quest will update with a new map marker. Backtrack to the previous room and follow the path unveiled behind the metal gate. The next chamber is divided into two levels, and several draugr will welcome you with open hostility as you enter. Dispose of them, cross the bridge and [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|unlock]] the door on the other side for some minor loot and useful potions. The room to the northeast on the lower level contains a handle that opens a tunnel leading to a room you glimpsed earlier filled with some minor loot. Return to the two-leveled chamber and locate the eastern door, leading to the next zone, Valthume Catacombs. ===The Catacombs=== [[File:SR-quest-Evil in Waiting 04.jpg|thumb|right|The Catacombs]] The first chamber of the catacombs features a chest in plain sight; when you open it, the attached [[Skyrim:Tension Cable|tension cable]] will cause a [[Skyrim:Giant Frostbite Spider|giant frostbite spider]] to be released from above, along with several regular arachnids. Locate the eastern gate, pull the handle, and approach the catacomb area. Battle your way through the undead enemies and watch out for the pressure plate on the floor. Locate the gate in the northwestern part of the area and pull the chain in the alcove behind you. Face another leveled draugr and claim the second [[Skyrim:Opaque Vessel|vessel]] from the pedestal. Before leaving, get rid of the [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]] on the small pedestals, for an easier exploration later. Locate the other exit from the catacombs and pass by the holes in the wall, now peaceful without the trapped soul gems. More catacombs await in the following area, guarded by even more draugr enemies, be also sure to watch out for a pressure plate and [[Skyrim:Traps#Spike_Wall|spike wall]] trap. Make your way to the gate and pull the chain. As you explore the next huge chamber, more enemies will burst out of their sarcophagi, so fight them, then find the stairs and walk down to the level below. Continue through the western path to an iron door, open it, and fight three frostbite spiders guarding the [[Skyrim:Iron Claw|iron claw]]. As you lift the claw from the pedestal, the four [[Skyrim:Flamethrower Statues|flamethrower statues]] will all shoot at you, so head to the [[Skyrim:Traps#Puzzle Door|puzzle door]] and turn the rings as depicted on the iron claw: '''Dragon—Hawk—Wolf'''. Activate the keyhole and the gate will open, allowing access to the final room. The vessel is guarded by a boss-leveled draugr along with several leveled draugr, so prepare for the tough battle and claim the last [[Skyrim:Opaque Vessel|opaque vessel]]. When you take it, the nearby iron gate will open and provide access to a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] with a word for the [[Skyrim:Aura_Whisper|Aura Whisper]] shout, along with a boss-leveled chest. It is time to return the three vessels to [[Skyrim:Valdar|Valdar]], so find the western gate for a quick shortcut back to Valthume. Raise the door bar and you will find Valdar waiting for you in the throne room. ===Hevnoraak=== [[File:SR-quest-Evil in Waiting 05.jpg|thumb|right|''"Fools! You will not hold me here any longer, Valdar!"'']] When you return to Valdar with the three vessels, Valdar will congratulate you and explain their original purpose. The dragon priest used them to extract his blood, his goal being to resurrect himself after death to become an exceedingly powerful lich. Your task is to empty the vessels, thus making it impossible for the priest to regain his formidable powers. The ghost will point you towards the sconce in front of the throne, so head up there and fill the sconce with the blood from the vessels. The ritual also requires you to sit in the throne, so take a seat and witness Valdar's resurrection of the weakened Hevnoraak. As the ritual is completed, the dragon priest will burst out of his coffin and yell: ''"Fools! You will not hold me here any longer, Valdar!"'' Valdar will immediately seek shelter, and it is up to you to fight the powerful dragon priest. He will use [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak's Staff|his staff]] to cast walls of lightning towards you, which create a lasting [[Skyrim:Shock Damage|shock damage]] effect. Dodge the powerful attack and corner the priest, then dispose of him as quickly as possible. When all is said and done, claim his staff and loot his [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak (item)|dragon priest mask]] and a huge amount of gold from his remains. Valdar will thank you wholeheartedly, not only for saving Skyrim, but also for freeing him from his eternal duty as guardian inside Valthume. The ghost will then disappear and the quest will end. ==Notes== * The bars in front of the word wall are removed as a result of you "reaching over" the ''pedestal'' of the third vessel to pick it up, not the acquisition of the vessel itself. As a result, if the vessel is sent flying during combat the word wall will seem to be unreachable and bugged. To fix it and lower the spikes, just jump over the pedestal. * All the chains and handles for doors are right next to or just before them. You should be able to locate them easily. *As you approach the area around [[Skyrim:Valthume|Valthume]], you will experience short, strong earthquakes. These earthquakes are not related to the quest, but are rather attributable to the ruins of [[Skyrim:Arkngthamz|Arkngthamz]] in the mountains nearby. The earthquakes will stop once you've entered the Dwemer ruin and begin the quest [[Skyrim:Lost to the Ages|Lost to the Ages]]. * Valthume has a large number of filled urns and burial jars, which makes it worthwhile to complete the [[Skyrim:No Stone Unturned|No Stone Unturned]] quest before going there. == Bugs == {{Bug|If the dragon claw door does not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The spikes blocking the word wall may be reactivated by dragon shouts or objects hitting the opaque vessel's pedestal. This can leave you trapped.|confirmed=1}} ** Use a ranged shout like Unrelenting Force on the pedestal holding the opaque vessel. {{Bug|In some cases, an opaque vessel may be forced through a wall, such as by blasts or shouts. This can leave the vessel unobtainable.|confirmed=0}} ** Call the console commands "player.removeitem 8d770 1" then "player.removeitem 3e6bb 1" then "player.removeitem 3e6bc 1" to remove all existing vessels since it's hard to find which one(s) you're missing. ** Call the console commands "player.additem 8d770 1" then "player.additem 3e6bb 1" then "player.additem 3e6bc 1" to add each vessel to your inventory. ** Call the console command "setstage dunValthumeQST 10" to advance the quest. Valdar will now accept your progress and prepare for the ritual. {{Bug|If the opaque vessel is knocked down from the pedestal, the spikes blocking the word wall can be activated by placing an item on it if jumping over does not work.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Walking just west of Valthume the game will freeze. Noted about were the juniper tree is located on the western road.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Hevnoraak may not emerge from his coffin on completing the ritual.|vn=1}} ** Call the console commands "prid 4CF61" and then "enable". ** He can be forced out with a rune spell (like Fire Rune) or a Shout (like Unrelenting Force or Marked For Death) cast at his coffin. {{Bug|After defeating Hevnoraak, the quest may not disappear from your quest list.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|When Hevnoraak emerges from his coffin, his hitbox may be faulty; arrows fly through his torso as if nothing was there. Aiming at his knees and lower legs may result in a hit, but arrows can phase through these parts of his body occasionally, too. Area-of-effect magic (such as Fireball) and melee attacks don't seem to be affected.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes the ghost of Valdar will not approach the player upon entering the tomb.|confirmed=0}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |3||A spirit known as Valdar has asked me to collect three vessels in Valthume to defeat the Dragon Priest Hevnoraak. {{Quest Objective|5|Collect the Vessels (/3)}} |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Perform the ritual with Valdar}} |15||Valdar has asked me to collect three vessels in Valthume to defeat the Dragon Priest Hevnoraak. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Find [[Skyrim:Melka|Melka]] imprisoned in [[Skyrim:Blind Cliff Cave|Blind Cliff Cave]].
#Protect her from [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] as you travel through the tower.
#Kill [[Skyrim:Petra|Petra]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Hagraven in Need===
Upon entering [[Skyrim:Blind Cliff Bastion|Blind Cliff Bastion]] you will see the hagraven [[Skyrim:Melka|Melka]] in a cage. As you approach her, she will ask you to free her and help her reclaim her tower from another hagraven, [[Skyrim:Petra|Petra]]. To release Melka, pull the chain near the cage. After leaving the cage she will then lead you through her tower. The first room displays a central stone slab adorned with three handles; Melka will tell you that the middle one is the correct one to use. Pull the handle and go through the gate it opens. Follow the short path into a room inhabited by a [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]]. There will then be a gate with a tunnel full of [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|swinging blades]]. Melka will mention a lever that will stop the blades: she will then pull a handle on the floor that lowers a section of a wall, revealing another lever to do just that.

===Reclaiming the Tower===
Move through the tunnel and go up the stairs. After the stairs you will pass a section of wall that moves away when the nearby handle is pulled. Through the newly cleared section of wall are some ingots and a chest. The next room has an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], and is referred to by Melka as her "parlor". Follow the path past the quicksilver ore. The next room contains Petra and two Forsworn. Killing them and Petra will result in Melka rewarding you with the unique staff, [[Skyrim:Eye of Melka|Eye of Melka]]. If Melka died anywhere along the way you can simply loot the staff from her corpse.

==Notes==
*You can also just kill Melka for the staff, but you will still have the objective to kill Petra and you will have lost your guide.
*If you run ahead of Melka (or she gets stuck somewhere and halts long enough), it is possible to kill Petra, complete the quest, leave the dungeon, and not obtain the staff by talking to Melka and demanding a reward.  Though rare, this can result in a bug where Melka randomly shows up wherever you are to talk to you, as the quest objective of her being scripted by her AI package to move to you, force-greet and engage in dialogue (dunBlindCliffForceGreetAndRewardPlayer) has not been completed.

==Bugs==

Word for the [[Skyrim:Storm Call|Storm Call]] shout |Disp= |Rep= |Prev= |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Forelhost|Forelhost]] |Image=SR-quest-Siege on the Dragon Cult.jpg |ImgDesc=Siege on the Dragon Cult |description= Enter the ruins of [[Skyrim:Forelhost|Forelhost]] and defeat [[Skyrim:Rahgot (creature)|Rahgot]] to recover his mask for [[Skyrim:Captain Valmir|Captain Valmir]]. |ID=dunForelhostQST |Icon= |SuggLevel=24 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Captain Valmir|Captain Valmir]] to begin the quest. # Enter the ruins of [[Skyrim:Forelhost|Forelhost]]. # (Optional) Find the [[Skyrim:Skorm Snow-Strider's Journal|journal]] of Skorm Snow-Strider. # Make your way through the first zone into the Crypt. # Either pick the lock on the well or find the key, then move on to the Refectory. # Travel through the Refectory, find the glass claw and locate the [[Skyrim:Traps#Puzzle Door|puzzle door]]. # Use the claw to enter and defeat [[Skyrim:Rahgot (creature)|Rahgot]]. # Return to Valmir with the mask. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-place-Forelhost.jpg|thumb|right|Valmir's camp sits in the ruins of Forelhost]] When you enter the courtyard of Forelhost for the first time, [[Skyrim:Captain Valmir|Captain Valmir]] will call to you. When the two of you get close enough, he'll initiate a conversation. He will claim he has been sent there by military forces in an attempt to recover a powerful artifact for the war effort. He asks for your help, since he cannot do it alone. According to him, this was the last stronghold of the Dragon Cult back in the First Era, and the commander's mask was allegedly an extremely powerful artifact. He requests that you enter the ruin and retrieve the item. He also mentions that the military general who stormed the fortress to wipe out the cult supposedly left his journal here, so finding it might provide some more information. ===Forelhost Stronghold=== Shortly after entering the zone, you'll begin encountering ghosts of the cultists. They must be defeated or avoided to proceed. Work your way around to get behind the portcullis that is down, and you'll be able to enter the crypts. ''[[Skyrim:Skorm Snow-Strider's Journal|Skorm Snow-Strider's Journal]]'' is found along this path. It recounts that when they took the fortress, the defenders had collapsed the entry and all killed themselves, leaving the ghosts to haunt the place. The well was locked and poisoned, and with the losses suffered from the poisoned water, Skorm decided not to search for the key in the crypts, simply choosing to leave the survivors sealed within. ===Forelhost Crypt=== Once in the crypt, make your way to the well. If you can pick the lock, do so, and move on down; otherwise turn right instead and head through the crypt tunnels to the far end, where you'll find the [[Skyrim:Forelhost Well Key|key]]. Then head back to the well. After going down the well, follow the tunnels on to the Refectory. You will find a potion on top of a [[Skyrim:Weight Sensitive Plate|stand]] with [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart]] holes behind it - you can drop a wooden plate or something similar on the ground, pick up the potion, and use the plate/object to stop the darts. ===Forelhost Refectory=== Once in the Refectory, move through and find the [[Skyrim:Glass Claw|glass dragon claw]], which you'll need to open the [[Skyrim:Puzzle Door|puzzle door]] later. Continue on to the door. From top (outer ring) to bottom (inner ring), the solution is: '''Fox—Owl—Snake'''. You'll need to defeat the dragon priest [[Skyrim:Rahgot (creature)|Rahgot]] and four leveled draugr. Afterwards, loot Rahgot's body. He'll have the [[Skyrim:Rahgot (item)|mask]], a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest Staff (Rahgot)|dragon priest staff]], and the [[Skyrim:Forelhost Balcony Key|key]] to the battlements. ===Battlements=== Head out onto the battlements to reach a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]], and learn a word for the [[Skyrim:Storm Call|Storm Call]] shout. After visiting the word wall move near the inside of the battlements; you'll see Captain Valmir talking to an enemy soldier. The objective to return to Valmir remains, so drop down. You'll find that Valmir has now dressed in the armor of the opposing side, to convince this other soldier to do the same job he sent you to do! He's an impostor! Defeat both Valmir and the enemy soldier to conclude the quest. If you wish, loot ''[[Skyrim:Valmir's Orders|Valmir's Orders]]'' to discover that he was actually an agent (strongly implied, but not explicitly stated, to be [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]]) who was sent to retrieve the mask and return to [[Skyrim:Labyrinthian|Labyrinthian]] with it (presumably to use the mask on the matching pedestal in [[Skyrim:Bromjunaar Sanctuary|Bromjunaar Sanctuary]]). ==Notes== * It is possible to ignore Valmir at the beginning of the quest (by ending conversation before agreeing to take the quest) and pickpocket the key to the ruins from him. You'll get an entry in your journal about his quest only when you reach the battlements and overhear his conversation with the second NPC. * It is also possible to kill Valmir immediately after arriving at this location but before going into the ruins. You can then loot his body for the scrap of paper revealing his treachery. * Version 1.3.3 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] delays the conversation between Valmir and the soldier until you're on the ground in the same area with them. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If the puzzle door does not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Captain Valmir may attack you on sight.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you pickpocket the key and proceed to get the mask, after stepping outside, the quest will initiate with the objective to kill Captain Valmir. The soldier attacks but Valmir does not; you will gain a bounty for killing him but the quest does not complete.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If the claw is knocked off the pedestal before you pick it up, the metal gate may not lower.|confirmed=1}} **Dragging an item back onto the pedestal and removing it again will trigger the gate. {{Bug|If you find the Refectory Library gate is raised you cannot proceed.|confirmed=1}} **Leave the area and then return, the gates should be open. {{Bug|Multiple masks may be found on Rahgot's body.|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|Just before you enter the ruin, Valmir will mistakenly refer to finding a staff instead of the mask.|UDBP|2.0.4|trackerid=14181}} {{Bug|If you Switch sides during the civil War Valmir will wear the first selected faction uniform. And may not be able to talk to the player.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his Mask. A journal left by Skorm Snow-Strider may reveal a way past the collapsed areas. {{Quest Objective|10|(Optional) Find Skorm Snow-Strider's journal}} {{Quest Objective|50|Obtain Rahgot's mask}} |20||I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his Mask. I have found the journal of Skorm Snow-Strider, which may reveal how to bypass the collapsed areas. |26||{{Quest Objective|30|(Optional) Find the key to the well in the Catacombs {{Quest Comment|if Valmir not killed}}}} |40||I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his Mask. I can reach the blocked off areas of the stronghold through the well. |50||I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his Mask. |60||I have defeated the Dragon Priest, Rahgot, and taken his Mask. [[Skyrim:In My Time Of Need|In My Time Of Need]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]], The [[Skyrim:Western_Watchtower|Western Watchtower]] outside Whiterun |Image=SR-quest-Dragon Rising 05.jpg |ImgDesc=Dragon attack at the Western Watchtower! |description=Investigate a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] sighting near [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. |ID=MQ104 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf]]. #Meet [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]] near the [[Skyrim:Western Watchtower|Western Watchtower]]. #Kill [[Skyrim:Mirmulnir|Mirmulnir]], a dragon. #(Optional) Use your new Shout power. #Report back to Jarl Balgruuf. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Dragon Rising.jpg|thumb|right|Irileth rallying the guards]] ===Talk to Jarl Balgruuf=== Shortly after you return the Dragonstone to [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar]], Irileth will approach to inform him that there has been a sighting of a dragon at Whiterun's [[Skyrim:Western_Watchtower|Western Watchtower]] not far west of the city. Irileth will then ask Farengar and you to meet with Jarl Balgruuf. Follow them there, where a somewhat unnerved [[Skyrim:Whiterun_Guard|Whiterun guard]] will recount seeing a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] flying over the watchtower. Balgruuf will ask you to accompany [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]], as she goes to investigate and, if necessary, do battle. She will recruit several Whiterun Guards along the way. ===Meet Irileth near the Western Watchtower=== [[File:SR-quest-Dragon Rising 02.jpg|thumb|left|''"No! Get back! It's still here somewhere! Hroki and Tor just got grabbed when they tried to make a run for it!"'']]Follow Irileth to the [[Skyrim:Guard Barracks (Gate)|Guard Barracks]] just inside the city gates. After she delivers a speech to rally her soldiers, follow them west towards the tower. You will gather near the road close to the watchtower to find the watchtower burned and smoking, evidently signs of a recent attack by a dragon. After a short talk, Irileth will give orders to search for survivors. On the north side of the tower, on or around the ramp leading to the interior, you will encounter the lone surviving Whiterun Guard, stammering about what he's just experienced. Shortly after hearing this, you will hear several warnings that the dragon has returned. Irileth will advise taking cover against the dragon's attacks and to ''"make every arrow count"''. ===Kill the Dragon=== The dragon, [[Skyrim:Mirmulnir|Mirmulnir]], will approach from the south and will immediately begin attacking the group. Use [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon combat strategies]] during the battle. He will land, fight, and then fly off after losing about a quarter of his health. Once further wounded, he will remain on the ground. While at a level of around 20 or lower, Mirmulnir will be a dragon that uses fire attacks, is resistant to [[Skyrim:Fire_Damage|fire damage]], and is weak against [[Skyrim:Frost_Damage|frost damage]]. Ranged weapons, frost or shock attacks, and melee weapons will be effective choices. If you play this quest at higher levels, Mirmulnir may attack with [[Skyrim:Frost_Breath|frost]]. When in the air, the dragon will use [[Skyrim:Dragon_Shouts|shouts]], typically [[Skyrim:Fire_Breath|Fire Breath]], against you, the others, and any other living creature who may happen to be in the area. Dragons are indiscriminate in their attacks, so the presence of multiple targets should relieve you of some of the onslaught. He may also use the somewhat more powerful [[Skyrim:Fireball|Fireball]] shout. When his attention is focused elsewhere, attack with a ranged weapon or spell. If he begins to aim his face toward you while in the air, seek cover to shield you against the powerful shout that will ensue. If you get inside the watchtower, or near its door, you can effectively use its walls for this, and then step back out, or use a window or doorway to counter-attack when his shout has dissipated. When on the ground, Mirmulnir uses both physical and magic attacks. If facing you from a moderate distance, he will use his Thu'um (shouts) against you, as long as you are in his line of sight. When up-close, he will attack frontally with his jaws. If you are behind him, he will beat his tail on the ground, trying to hit you. Both of these types of attacks deal heavy physical damage. [[File:SR-quest-Dragon Rising 03.jpg|thumb|right|Mirmulnir approaches]]The dragon's wing attacks, while very strong, are the least powerful of his physical attacks. When the dragon is in the air, attack at every safe opportunity until he is forced to land. When he's on the ground, the best approach is from the side. Irileth is also useful in this fight. As an [[Skyrim:Essential_NPCs|essential character]] in the game, she can be weakened but not killed in the attacks. Once killed, Mirmulnir will explode in flames, and then release his soul in a blast of energy. As the [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dovahkiin]] (or "Dragonborn"), the dragon's soul will enter your body, automatically unlocking the first word of the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting_Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout, which you learned previously during the [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow quest]]. After witnessing you consume the dragon's soul, a nearby guard will engage you in dialogue and exclaim that you are Dragonborn. Some of the other surviving guards will express their skepticism. Irileth will discard the notion as a myth and order you to report back to the jarl. One guard will remark that if you are Dragonborn, you can shout, and ask if you've tried. You can use your shout at this time, completing the optional quest objective, or leave them wondering. Search the dragon's body, taking [[Skyrim:Dragon_Bone|dragon bones]] and [[Skyrim:Dragon_Scales|dragon scales]] along with other loot. These can be used to forge and improve [[Skyrim:Dragon_Armor|dragonbone and dragonscale armor and weapons]]{{DG}} once your [[SR:Smithing|Smithing skills]] are highly advanced. In the lengthy intervening period, you can sell these valuable items. Search in and around the tower for any loot you can take from dead guards. ===Report Back to Jarl Balgruuf=== As you make your way back to Whiterun (note that the Dragonsreach marker will vanish temporarily during this quest), you should hear thundering voices boom out ''"DOVAHKIIN!"'', reverberate across the sky. Return to Dragonsreach and report to Jarl Balgruuf. He will ask you to recount events at the watchtower and then conclude that the voices were the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]], ''"masters of the way of the Voice"'', summoning you to their secluded mountain peak residence at [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]. The jarl will inform you that the greybeards can teach you to use your gift. The jarl advises you to travel to the Greybeards immediately, as their summons is a ''"great honor"''. During your exchange with the jarl, his brother Hrongar will counsel confidence in you as the Dragonborn, in a calm debate with [[Skyrim:Proventus Avenicci|Proventus Avenicci]], the jarl's [[Skyrim:Steward|Steward]], who openly expresses suspicion and skepticism toward you. For your assistance in slaying the dragon, the jarl will appoint you [[Skyrim:Thane|Thane]] of Whiterun, which entitles you to a personal [[Skyrim:Housecarl|housecarl]], [[Skyrim:Lydia|Lydia]]. She will reside at Dragonsreach until you purchase [[SR:Breezehome|Breezehome]], at which point she will move in with you. Balgruuf will also reward you with the Axe of Whiterun as your symbol of office. The axe is a leveled weapon that carries a random [[Skyrim:Enchantments#Weapon_Effects|enchantment effect]]. Lydia will greet you if you head toward the front door of Dragonsreach, at which point you can make her a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] by telling her that you need her help. ===Achievement=== After Mirmulnir is killed, you will earn: * {{achievement|Dragon Soul (achievement)}} ==Notes== * This quest was originally tied to the [[Skyrim:Civil War|civil war]], and would've had two versions, similar to [[Skyrim:The Jagged Crown|The Jagged Crown]]. That quest was originally known internally as MQ103, and still has a lot of leftovers related to this earlier placement. The main differences being that it was to part of the Main Questline (MQ) instead of the Civil War quests (CW), and that it would've been the prerequisite to unlocking dragon spawns, as this quest would've followed it, as it stayed MQ104. MQ104A would've been the Legion version, with MQ104B being the Stormcloak version. Both versions have numerous leftovers still in the files, and the finalized quest reuses markers, AI packages, and dialogue from both. The Stormcloak version would've seen you investigate reports of a dragon attack on [[Skyrim:Fort Amol|Fort Amol]] alongside an NPC referred to only as "Sifnar", while the Legion version would've seen you travel with [[Skyrim:Captain Metilius|Captain Metilius]] to investigate similar sightings at [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]]. Both versions would've also had nameless troops aid you and the designated commander. * [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]] or [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] player characters will enjoy an advantage in the dragon fight, depending on whether Mirmulnir uses fire or frost attacks. If Mirmulnir uses fire breath, Dunmer characters will take only half damage due to their racial fire resistance. If Mirmulnir uses frost attacks, Nords will instead have this advantage. If Mirmulnir is using frost damage (which occurs when the player is between levels 18 and 26), the Nord guards fighting alongside the player will be more resistant to his damage, allowing them to last longer and help the player more. If Mirmulnir uses fire damage (which occurs when the player is either above level 26 or below level 18), Irileth will gain this advantage instead. * One of the guards in the Western Watchtower mentions Hroki and Tor, two men who were stationed there before Mirmulnir apparently grabbed and ate them. Once you defeat Mirmulnir, you can find a partial Whiterun Guard's Armor set on his corpse, and it's more than likely the remains of one of them; it's unknown what happened to the other one. Coincidentally, there is a [[Skyrim:Hroki|Hroki]] who lives in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], though it's unlikely that Hroki would have survived, and the two are most likely unrelated, anyway. * You can hide in the tower and let the guards take care of the dragon. Because Irileth is essential, they will always win. However, casualties will be high. * If you have a [[Skyrim:Bows|bow]] or [[Skyrim:Crossbow|crossbow]]{{DG}} in your inventory, you can use Mirmulnir as target practice to improve your [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]] skill. Likewise, you can use [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] spells in the same manner. * Once Mirmulnir is dead, other [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]] will begin appearing in Skyrim, except between the end of [[Skyrim:The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller]] and the completion of [[Skyrim:A Blade in the Dark|A Blade in the Dark]]. * Before you start this quest, Western Watchtower will be an unmarked location and appear destroyed, though guards will be there, and there will be no fire. * You don't need to wait for Balgruuf to make his speech before going to fight Mirmulnir. You can take a look in the Jarl's inventory and reload to generate an axe with a different enchantment. If you don't already possess one, a weapon that carries a [[SR:Fire Damage|fire damage]] effect may be especially helpful if you plan to soon proceed to the next quest in the main quest line, The Way of the Voice. * After defeating Mirmulnir, you will be unable to fast travel directly to Dragonsreach, as its map marker will be temporarily removed. The Whiterun city gates will still be available for fast travel. However, if you open the map quickly enough, you can still fast travel to Dragonsreach. * If you don't return to Whiterun, the Greybeards will call you if you approach High Hrothgar. After 24 hours, they will call you no matter where you are, provided you're outdoors. The main quest line will progress normally, though Dragon Rising will remain in your quest log until you speak to Balgruuf. ** If you DO return to Whiterun immediately, the Greybeards will call you shortly after you get there. * You must finish this quest before Message to Whiterun can be completed, regardless of who you sided with (the [[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Imperial)|Imperials]] or the [[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Stormcloaks]]). * Very rarely, a guard can pull out a horn and blow it to summon reinforcements. * Absorbing [[Skyrim:Vulthuryol|Vulthuryol]]'s dragon soul in Blackreach will have the same effect as absorbing Mirmulnir's, if you fight Vulthuryol first. * This quest is the only time [[Skyrim:Whiterun Guard|Whiterun Guards]] will be seen wearing [[Skyrim:Hide Helmet|hide helmets]], [[Skyrim:Leather Helmet|leather helmets]], and [[Skyrim:Scaled Helmet|scaled helmets]], instead of their [[Skyrim:Whiterun Guard's Helmet|Whiterun Guard's Helmets]]. It is also one of the few times you'll see them armed with [[Skyrim:Iron|iron]] and/or [[Skyrim:Steel|steel]] weaponry, instead of their standard [[Skyrim:Imperial Sword|imperial swords]] and [[Skyrim:Whiterun Guard's Shield|Whiterun Guard's Shields]]. If any die during the assault, fresh ones will replace them, potentially allowing you to collect a full set of [[Skyrim:Whiterun Guard's Armor|Whiterun Guard's Armor]]. * During the assault with Mirmulnir, several [[Skyrim:Burnt Corpse|burnt corpses]] can be found in the courtyard east the Western Watchtower. Inside, a strange [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] cube is being studied by [[Skyrim:Septimus Signus|Septimus Signus]]. He claims the "heart of a God," "heart of you and me," is located inside. He asks you to help him see through the cube. To do so, he plans to use the power of an [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll|Elder Scroll]]. However, he does not possess the knowledge to use the Elder Scroll. To help him, you must travel to the Dwemer ruin [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand]] and charge the Lexicon. He gives you two items: *[[Skyrim:Attunement Sphere|Attunement Sphere]] *[[Skyrim:Blank Lexicon|Blank Lexicon]] ===Alftand=== Be prepared: Alftand is an extensive Dwemer ruin occupied by [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] and Dwemer constructs, including [[Skyrim:Dwarven_Centurion|Centurions]]. Once there, travel through the ruin, following your destination marker, until you reach Blackreach, a massive underground cavern below Alftand. Alternatively, if you do not feel your level or equipment are sufficient to penetrate Alftand, it is actually unnecessary to do so; [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]] and [[Skyrim:Raldbthar|Raldbthar]] both access Blackreach as long as the player has an Attunement Sphere, and both are faster and easier than Alftand. A more complete walkthrough can be found on the Alftand and [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]] pages. At this point you will have access to a [[Skyrim:Great Lift at Alftand|Dwemer lift]] for quick travel between Blackreach and the surface, in case you want to make a trip back to town before delving further underground. When you are ready, follow the quest marker through Blackreach until you reach your destination, The [[Skyrim:Tower of Mzark|Tower of Mzark]]. Inside, you will find the Oculory, a large Dwemer machine that occupies the last room of the Tower. Go up the curving stairs along either wall to find a control panel with a stand that has a slot for the Lexicon. Place the Lexicon atop the stand to activate the machine's control panel. To decipher the code, press the second button from the right four times, pausing between each pressing to allow the Oculory to complete its realignment. This will cause the Lexicon to open and the third button from the right be revealed. Now press the third button twice, which will align the lenses such that they direct shafts of light onto the round, green windows of the Oculory, and also uncover the far left button. Finally, press the far left button once and watch as the Oculory reaches its correct alignment, revealing the Elder Scroll. Take the now-completed [[Skyrim:Runed Lexicon|Runed Lexicon]] from the stand, then go to the center of the Oculory and retrieve the Elder Scroll from its cradle for the concurrent quest [[Skyrim:Elder Knowledge|Elder Knowledge]]. Once you have both the Elder Scroll and the Lexicon, return to Septimus Signus at his outpost. ===Daedric Prince of the Unknown=== {{Quote Box|style=float:none; max-width:100%; margin-left:0|To continue past this point, you must be level 15 or higher. If you aren't level 15 yet, giving Septimus the Lexicon will result in him dismissing you; then, you must wait until a courier delivers a [[Skyrim:Letter from Septimus Signus|letter]] from him to continue.}} Once you have returned to the outpost, talk to Septimus again. He'll read the Lexicon and tell you he searched for it with the help of the Daedric Prince of Knowledge, [[Skyrim:Hermaeus Mora|Hermaeus Mora]]. He tells you to harvest the blood of the mer races in Tamriel. Head for the outside of the cave. You will see a [[Skyrim:Wretched Abyss|Wretched Abyss]] that has the talk option. Talk to the abyss, and you will learn that the voice coming from the abyss is that of Hermaeus Mora. He claims that Septimus is a good follower, but after he discovers how to unlock the Dwemer box he will have outlived his usefulness. He will then tell you that you should take Septimus's place, which you can agree to or disagree. Neither choice will affect the outcome of the quest. Hermaeus Mora wishes for you to speak with him again after you have completed Septimus's task. ===Blood Harvest=== In order to harvest blood, you need to search the corpse of someone of the appropriate race while the [[Skyrim:Essence Extractor|Essence Extractor]] is in your inventory. The five races whose blood you need to harvest are [[Skyrim:High Elf|Altmer]], [[Skyrim:Wood Elf|Bosmer]], [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]], [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]], and [[Skyrim:Orsimer|Orsimer]]. You don't necessarily have to go slaughtering elves to satisfy the quest as there are many corpses of each race to be found around Skyrim; the pages detailing locations for each race are [[Skyrim:High Elf (NPC)|High Elf]], [[Skyrim:Dark Elf (dead)|Dark Elf]], [[Skyrim:Wood Elf (dead)|Wood Elf]], and [[Skyrim:Orc (dead)|Orc]], while a list of Falmer infested locations can be found [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Falmer Hives|here]]. There is also a list of [[Skyrim:Bandit (dead)|dead bandits]] of all races to be considered. encampments]] |} ===Returning to Septimus=== [[File:SR-item-Oghma_Infinium.jpg|right|thumb|The Oghma Infinium]] Upon acquiring different blood samples, you will be prompted to return to Septimus Signus's Outpost. Give the blood samples to Septimus and wait for him to open the cube. Following him inside will reveal, much to the surprise of the delusional quest giver, that it was not the "Heart of a God" that was stored inside the cube, but rather a book. His surprise is cut short as his usefulness to Hermaeus Mora has been outlived and he is promptly disposed of in a flash of light. It is revealed that the book on a pedestal is actually the ''[[Skyrim:Oghma_Infinium|Oghma Infinium]]''. Hermaeus Mora will greet you again, calling you his champion. You can reply with "What now?" or "I am not your champion, monster." Again, there are no consequences to the completion of this quest with either choice. Through conversation with the Daedric prince, you learn that it was sealed here for a reason, so that no more of its dangerous knowledge could be shared with the world of mortals—something that Hermaeus Mora wishes undone. At this point, the quest is complete. Reading the book will reveal some of the knowledge hidden within. Specifically, you can choose from three different paths: magic, shadow, or might, and receive +5 permanent points in the following skills, depending on the choice: :'''The Path of Might:''' Archery, Block, Heavy Armor, One-handed, Smithing, Two-handed :'''The Path of Shadow:''' Alchemy, Light Armor, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Sneak, Speech :'''The Path of Magic:''' Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Enchanting, Illusion, Restoration ==Notes== *You will automatically start this quest during the course of [[Skyrim:Elder Knowledge|Elder Knowledge]] or [[Skyrim:Scroll Scouting|Scroll Scouting]]{{DG}} if you have not already started it, as the Elder Scroll is required for both the main questline and for the Dawnguard core questline. This quest does not have to be completed in order to complete either questline, however. *After opening the cube, leaving [[Skyrim:Septimus Signus's Outpost|Septimus Signus's Outpost]] and letting the cell respawn will cause the dwemer puzzle door to close permanently, potentially locking in the Oghma Infinium. *You don't have to access [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]] through [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand]], as it's also possible to reach it through the two other linked Dwemer ruins, [[Skyrim:Raldbthar|Raldbthar]] and [[Skyrim: Mzinchaleft| Mzinchaleft]], by using the sphere given by Septimus on the apparatus at the end of these dungeons. *The "Heart of a God" to which Septimus refers is actually the [[Lore:Heart of Lorkhan|Heart of Lorkhan]]. However, there is no Heart inside the chamber. *The retrieved Elder Scroll can be sold to [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] in the College of Winterhold's Arcanaeum for 2000 gold. However, do not do so until you have completed [[Skyrim:Alduin's Bane|Alduin's Bane]], as it is essential to the main quest. If ''[[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]]'' is installed, the Elder Scroll is also needed to complete its [[Skyrim:Dawnguard_Quests#Main_Quests|main questline]], though you can buy it back from Urag if you have already sold it to him. *If you give the lexicon to Septimus before reaching level 15, it may be necessary to wait for a [[Skyrim:Letter from Septimus Signus|letter]] from him to arrive via courier. Simply returning to him when you reach that level will not work. *Corpses fed on while in Beast Form or with the [[Skyrim:Ring of Namira|Ring of Namira]] cannot be harvested for blood. Avoid feeding on the named elven corpses inside Alftand as you will have to find samples in other, potentially far apart, locations. However, if ''Dawnguard'' is installed, you may be able to harvest corpses while in Beast Form, as long as you have advanced far enough in the quest to have been given the extractor. *You can keep the Oghma Infinium after use by dropping it before exiting the inventory upon its initial use, however, it will only be a book, and will not grant the bonuses again. Otherwise it will disappear after you use it. *If ''[[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]]'' is installed, Hermaeus Mora will not be represented as a large purple shape. Instead, he is shown as the tentacled form seen during the quests of the DLC. If you have completed the ''Dragonborn'' quest line before speaking to Mora in this quest, he will use unique dialogue referring to the events of ''Dragonborn''. *You can't harvest your own blood if your character is elven. **You also can't harvest the blood of any of the [[Skyrim:Snow Elf|Snow Elves]] encountered in the ''Dawnguard'' quest line. *As of version 2.0.1 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]], this quest appears to have lost several properties due to unknown causes, possibly from bad official patches that have since been undone. Entering Solitude by the main gate for the first time will trigger an execution, as hinted by the guard outside.  The man fated to die is [[Skyrim:Roggvir|Roggvir]], a former friend of [[Skyrim:Sorex Vinius|Sorex Vinius]] and a 'traitor to the Empire'.  Talking to Sorex after the execution will open up discussion about the leaders of Solitude; continuing the conversation will end with him asking you to bring a delivery of [[Skyrim:Stros M'Kai Rum|Stros M'Kai Rum]] to one of those leaders, [[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]].  Falk resides in the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] and is nearly always found by [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair's]] side in the main room.  Upon delivering the rum, he will thank you and reward you with a leveled amount of gold to complete the quest.

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Dreamshadow |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Dreamshadow |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Olda|Olda]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] |Reward=Leveled gold or [[Skyrim:Block|Block]] training |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Olda|Olda]])

=1 ([[Skyrim:Horgeir|Horgeir]]) |Image=SR-quest-Dragon's Breath Mead 02.jpg |Imgdesc=The fed-up wife |description=Retrieve the [[SR:Dragon's Breath Mead (item)|Dragon's Breath Mead]] and give it to either [[Skyrim:Olda|Olda]] or [[SR:Horgeir|Horgeir]]. |ID=FreeformDragonBridge01 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Olda|Olda]] in [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]]. # Find [[Skyrim:Dragon's Breath Mead (item)|Dragon's Breath Mead]]. # Give the mead to Olda or [[Skyrim:Horgeir|Horgeir]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Intervention=== [[Skyrim:Olda|Olda]] lives in [[Skyrim:Dragon_Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] with her husband, [[Skyrim:Horgeir|Horgeir]], who owns the local lumber mill. You will find Olda at [[Skyrim:Horgeir's House|Horgeir's House]]. If you talk to her about her husband, she will complain to you: ''"He promised me, swore on his ancestors, that he'd give up the mead. And what do I find out? He's been stashing drink in a cave nearby. He even has some [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolves]] guarding it. I swear, I should just cut out his tongue. That would be the end of it."'' If you are willing to help get her husband's stash for her, she will only ask you to bring her the bottle of [[Skyrim:Dragon's_Breath_Mead_(item)|Dragon's Breath Mead]], Horgeir's favorite. [[File:SR-quest-Dragon's Breath Mead.jpg|thumb|The secret stash]] ===Dragon's Breath Mead=== Take the road down the hill. Before the bridge go right, past the mill, and across the river. Head west on a rough trail and you will encounter some wolves, and possibly a bear, along the way. At the end of the trail, you will find an overhanging rock guarded by three wolves. Beneath the rock is a crate holding the Dragon's Breath Mead along with one bottle of [[Skyrim:Alto Wine|alto wine]], six bottles of [[Skyrim:Nord Mead|Nord mead]] and two bottles of [[Skyrim:Wine|wine]]. You are free to take every beverage there. ===For Your Trouble=== Return to Olda and give her the mead. She will reward you with some gold, saying: ''"If my Horgeir doesn't give up the mead this time, I'll hit him over the head with it."'' You may instead choose to tell everything to Horgeir and return his favorite mead to him. He will regard you as a real friend and show you "how to block a punch that might be coming from some angry spouse". You will gain a one-point boost to your [[Skyrim:Block|Block]] skill. However, if you choose to help Horgeir, you will fail this quest. ==Notes== * Although it says "steal", picking up the mead does not count as stealing. * An [[Skyrim:Iron|iron ore vein]] is to the north of some ruins along the path. * If you can't get Olda to initiate the quest, merely taking Horgeir's hooch from its hiding place will do so. * Although the rest of the booze is already there, Horgeir's Dragon's Breath Mead will only spawn in the hiding location when the quest is initiated. * After completing the quest, if you side with Olda, Horgeir will no longer buy chopped wood from you. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The Dragon Breath Mead may fall through and go underneath the ground.|confirmed=1}} ** A possible fix involves using a ranged magic spell or a rune spell, such as Ice Spike, Thunderbolt, or Fire Rune to dislodge the bottle so that it can be picked up. ** If it has fallen between the ground and wooden trough, the small space between them admits an Elven Dagger which the player can use to hit the bottle closer to the wall for retrieval. To do so, drop the dagger and grab hold of it, then move it underneath and push it toward the bottle. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Steal the Dragon's Breath Mead for Olda}} |15||{{Quest Objective|20|Bring the Dragon's Breath Mead to Olda}} |missing=20, 25, 300 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Lisbet's Missing Shipment.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Dwarfmp |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors/Radiant |Giver=[[Skyrim:Lisbet|Lisbet]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Arnleif and Sons Trading Company|Arnleif and Sons Trading Company]] |Reward=Leveled [[Skyrim:Gold|Gold]] |Difficulty=Medium |Image=SR-quest-Lisbet's Missing Shipment.jpg |Imgdesc=''"You aren't for hire, are you?"'' |description=Retrieve a missing Dibella Statue for a struggling store. |ID=FreeformMarkarthE |radiant=yes |Disp= =2 ([[Skyrim:Lisbet|Lisbet]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Lisbet|Lisbet]]. # Retrieve [[Skyrim:Lisbet's Dibella Statue|Lisbet's Dibella Statue]]. # Return to Lisbet. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===An Empty Store=== Near the market in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] is the general goods store, [[Skyrim:Arnleif and Sons Trading Company|Arnleif and Sons Trading Company]], where the proprietor [[Skyrim:Lisbet|Lisbet]] is struggling to keep her business afloat. Not only did she lose her husband, Gunnar, in a [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] attack, she also lost dozens of shipments to the Forsworn, including a precious, specially-made Statue of Dibella. She believes this statue would put the store back on its feet. When you speak with her, she is ashamed of the state of her shop and will then ask you a question: ''"You aren't for hire, are you? A sellsword? I'll pay you if you can recover that statuette from the Forsworn."'' Accept the task and she will promise you a great sum of gold for your efforts and the quest will be added to your journal. ===The Statue of Dibella=== Once you have accepted Lisbet's request, your map marker will point you towards one of eight possible Forsworn hideouts, where you will find the [[Skyrim:Lisbet's Dibella Statue|Lisbet's Dibella Statue]] in the location's boss chest: {| class=wikitable ! Possible Locations |- | {{LinkList|Broken Tower Redoubt|Bruca's Leap Redoubt|Deepwood Redoubt|Dragon Bridge Overlook|Druadach Redoubt|Hag Rock Redoubt|Red Eagle Redoubt|Serpent's Bluff Redoubt}} |} Once you have claimed the statue, return to Lisbet in her store. When presented with the item, she is overjoyed, saying: ''"Ah, there it is! This little gold delight is going to keep us afloat for a while. Thank you. Here's something for your hard work."'' She will then hand you a leveled amount of gold as a reward. === Reward === {| ! style="text-align:center"| |- | {{SRLeveledReward|Large}} |} ==Notes== *Oddly, you may be able to buy the statue back from her for ''less'' than your reward at any level. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you retrieve the statue after the completion of this quest, it will become stuck in your inventory as a quest item.|USKP|2.0.5}} {{Bug|You are prevented from starting this quest if you've already killed all enemies in the Forsworn camp before talking to Lisbet.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Enter setstage FreeformMarkarthE 12 to skip forward in the quest. {{Bug|In case Lisbet is killed before completing the quest, both statue and objective will get stuck.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Enter setstage FreeformMarkarthE 20 to manually complete the quest: you will receive the reward, and the statue will be removed from your inventory. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve Lisbet's shipment from }} |15||{{Quest Objective|15|Bring the Dibella Statue to Lisbet}} |missing=12, 20 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

=-1 ([[Skyrim:Lynly_Star-Sung|Lynly Star-Sung]]) if you intimidate her }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Sibbi Black-Briar|Sibbi Black-Briar]] in [[Skyrim:Riften_Jail|Riften Jail]]. # Locate [[Skyrim:Svidi|Svidi]] and talk to her. # Tell Sibbi the truth or lie to him. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Murderer in the Jail?=== [[File:SR-quest-The Lover's Requital 02.jpg|thumb|right|Sibbi is planning to take action!]] If you enter the [[Skyrim:Riften Jail|Riften Jail]], you will come across [[Skyrim:Sibbi Black-Briar|Sibbi Black-Briar]] residing in one of the jail cells. You may ask him how he ended up in jail, he will respond with: ''"Look, we all have our flaws; mine is that women can't get enough of me. So I had this little affair going on while I was betrothed to a beautiful girl named Svidi. Well, she finds out and she tells her brother, Wulfur. Then her brother attacks me with a knife... I mean, I had to defend myself"'' Now, he is very angry about that girl. ''"I'd do anything to have that whore's head on a platter."'' All he needs to know is where she is. If you can help him find his fiancee, he promises you'll be well compensated. You may ask him for more information about Svidi. He will respond with: ''"She was a young woman... buxom, with long flowing black hair. She used to sing the most lovely songs to me when we were courting. I've never heard a voice so beautiful. All that talent will go to waste when I'm finished with her."'' ===A Bard in the Inn?=== According to Sibbi's description, you may find such a woman in the [[Skyrim:Vilemyr_Inn|Vilemyr Inn]] in [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]]. Now, she is a [[Skyrim:Bard|bard]] under the name of [[Skyrim:Lynly_Star-Sung|Lynly Star-Sung]]. You may tell her that you know she is Svidi, she will initially deny it. ''"No, I'm sorry. You must have me mistaken for someone else. I've never even heard that name before."'' You can now choose to persuade or intimidate her with your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skills. {|class=wikitable width="100%" |- !width=27%|Option !Dialogue !width=20%|Reaction |- |rowspan=2|You have nothing to fear from me. '''(Persuade)''' |style="background:palegreen;"|'''Passed''': Please, I beg you, don't tell Sibbi where I am. He'll kill me! |style="background:palegreen;"|'''Passed''': Return to Sibbi |- |style="background:coral;"|'''Failed''': I'm sorry, I don't know what you're talking about. |style="background:coral;"|'''Failed''': Nothing |- |rowspan=2|Stop lying or I'll beat it out of you! '''(Intimidate)''' |style="background:palegreen;"|'''Passed''': Please, I beg you, don't tell Sibbi where I am. He'll kill me! |style="background:palegreen;"|'''Passed''': Return to Sibbi |- |style="background:coral;"|'''Failed''': I've been hurt worse before. |style="background:coral;"|'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Never mind. My mistake. |I should say so. I'd be careful in the future before you confront someone without all of the facts!||Nothing |} If you are successful she will continue: ''"Sibbi's been spreading lies about me, you must hear me out."'' You may ask Svidi to tell you her side of the story, she will reply with: ''"Sibbi and I were to be married. We were supposed to be happy together forever. Then I found that wretched poetry from [[Skyrim:Svana_Far-Shield|Svana]]. When I confronted Sibbi about it, he threatened to kill me. I was scared so I told my brother Wulfur. He went to talk to Sibbi for me and... and... Sibbi killed him. My brother wasn't even armed! When I heard what Sibbi did, I fled. Now you've found me, and you're going to tell him where I am."'' ===A Choice in Your Hand=== Return to Sibbi and tell him you have got some information about Svidi. He will be very glad. ''"Good, good. Just point me in the right direction and I'll do the rest."'' At this point, you will have to make a decision: tell him the truth or lie to him. {|class=wikitable width="100%" !width=27%|Option !Dialogue |- | She's in Ivarstead using the name Lynly.||Ivarstead? So close to Riften? She's an even bigger fool than I thought. |- | She's made her way east into Morrowind.||So, the whore thinks the Black-Briar reach ends at the border of Skyrim, eh? She'll soon discover her mistake. |- | Never mind. I was mistaken.||You idiot. You came all the way down here for that? |} Whichever option you choose between the first two, Svidi will not be killed, and Sibbi will give you his [[Skyrim:Keys#Sibbi's_Stash_Key|key]] to a long chest found in the basement (at the bottom of the stairs) of the [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Meadery|Black-Briar Meadery]] in Riften, saying ''"You've done me a great service, my friend. Allow me to compensate you for the information."'' The chest will always contain one random weapon, two poisons, and some gold, along with the [[Skyrim:Prowler's Profit|Prowler's Profit]] gems, if applicable. Sibbi's gratitude will also allow you to take any low-value items from the meadery. == Notes == * Sibbi's chest is non-respawning, so its contents will be determined on your first visit to the meadery and won't change after that. == Bugs == {{Bug|Despite the fact that Sibbi says that Lynly Star-Sung has dark hair, her hair is blonde instead.|USKP|1.2.3|Lynly now has black hair to comply with Sibbi's description.}} {{Bug|Killing Lynly will fail the quest, despite Sibbi having dialogue afterwards for when you do. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Dinya Balu|Dinya Balu]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Warmth of Mara===
Talk to [[Skyrim:Dinya Balu|Dinya Balu]] after [[Skyrim:The Book of Love|The Book of Love]] quest and you will be able to provide her with some additional assistance. She will tell you ''"[[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] is drowning in a sea of sin and wickedness and it's my personal mission to let everyone know that the warmth of Mara can see them through."'' Now, she needs a messenger to bring Mara's words to these poor souls by distributing some missives. Then, she will give you twenty ''[[Skyrim:The Warmth of Mara|The Warmth of Mara]]'' bulletins to give out to the citizens of Riften. You will need to hand out all twenty to complete the quest. Before you start the work, you may ask Dinya for some tips on who might accept the bulletins. She will tell you ''"Almost anyone in Riften is in dire need of those missives."'' However, it would be wise to keep away from [[Skyrim:Mistveil Keep|Mistveil Keep]] and the city guards.

There are a total of thirty-seven people that will accept the missives. You can talk to them ''"Here, brother/sister. Blessings of Mara upon you."'' Although their reactions vary widely, they will always accept them.

==Notes==
* After you've delivered the 20 missives and return to Dinya Balu, you'll be presented with a dialogue option that says you've run out of missives and require more. If you select this option instead of saying you've delivered them all, Dinya will praise your diligence and give you 5 more missives, which can optionally be passed out. When you deliver each of these "extra" missives, the "Completed" quest update notification will reappear, along with the (total/20) count (i.e. 25/20 after you've delivered the last one). However, if you return to Dinya after delivering the extra missives and tell her you've delivered them all, the dialogue and reward will be identical to what you would have received had you not delivered the extra ones. While it doesn't hurt you to do this, there's no actual benefit. Furthermore, you may or may not be given the "extra" option again; some players report seeing this happen while others report that they only got the option once. It appears as though an additional reward may have been intended but was never actually implemented.

He can usually be found at his stall at the market, or in a cell in the [[Skyrim:Riften Jail|Riften Jail]] if you've helped [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] frame him for theft. As a [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]], he has an oddly [[Skyrim:Argonian|Argonian]] name (such as [[Skyrim:Beem-Ja|Beem-Ja]], [[Skyrim:Gulum-Ei|Gulum-Ei]], [[Skyrim:Talen-Jei|Talen-Jei]]). In fact, he was raised Argonian. ''"I ended up orphaned then taken in by a kindly Argonian family in [[Lore:Black Marsh|Black Marsh]]."'' He hopes one day to find out what happened to him and he has got one clue. When he was found by his Argonian father, he was wrapped in a blanket bearing the symbol of [[Lore:House Telvanni|House Telvanni]], one of the great houses in [[Lore:Morrowind|Morrowind]] long ago. He'd like you to keep an eye on anything that might provide him with the answers he is looking for in your travels. If you ask him why was he searching in Skyrim, he will tell you something about a matron who had served for House Telvanni and remind you to investigate a ship named "[[Skyrim:Wreck of The Pride of Tel Vos|The Pride of Tel Vos]]". Travel to the northeast coast of Skyrim and you can find the wreck of The Pride of Tel Vos. A group of three [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] have a camp here. However, you can hide yourself from them easily. You can also choose to wipe them out and take their treasures. In the northern half of the ship at the waterline, you can find a waterlogged chest containing the item you need: [[Skyrim:Lymdrenn Tenvanni's Journal|Lymdrenn Tenvanni's Journal]]. This journal would be the key to the answers Brand-Shei is looking for. Return to Brand-Shei and give the book to him. He will be very excited. ''"Yes... yes. This is it! I don't know how you found this stranger, but you've obviously succeeded where I had failed."'' Then he will offer you the key to his strongbox under his stand in the marketplace. You are free to take anything inside, including some [[Skyrim:Gems|gems]], [[Skyrim:Potions|potions]], and a random novice level [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] [[Skyrim:Spell_Tomes|spell tome]]. ==Notes== *This quest can be completed by finding the journal in the wreck first, then talking to Brand-Shei afterward. *Since the lockbox's contents are leveled, the [[Skyrim:Prowler's Profit|Prowler's Profit]] perk will give you more value. *After completion of this quest, some items in Haelga's Bunkhouse will be free to take, as this is Brand-Shei's residence at the start of the game. == Bugs == {{Bug|Brand-Shei's journal may not appear in the chest, even when the quest marker points to it.}} **{{pc22}}This can be fixed using the console command setstage FreeFormRiften08 30. {{Bug|If Brand-Shei's still in Jail when player try to give his journal, his dialogue might stuck on "This City is Corrupt, etc.}} **{{pc22}}Try to wait until Brand-Shei's get out from Jail, or **{{pc22}}If you using PC, use console to fix this glitch. (1) Prid 19ddc, then (2) Say e829b {{Bug|Brand-Shei's dialogue topic about the mystery of his birth no longer makes sense after you give him his journal during this quest.|USKP|2.1.2|A condition check has been added to make that topic unavailable when this quest is finished.}} {{Bug|Although unconfirmed, it's likely that the name of the journal's author, Lymdrenn Te'''n'''vanni, is misspelled and should be Te'''l'''vanni.|USKP|1.0}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Locate a clue about Brand-Shei's past}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Return to Brand-Shei}} |missing=0, 10, 200, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

He explains that he was attacked by [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggans]] living in the cave and needs immediate medical attention or he'll die from the spriggan's curse. He'll ask for your help to avenge his friends by killing the creatures. ===Vengeance=== Valdr will offer to help you clear the caves. He uses a bow and becomes [[SR:Protected NPCs|protected]] if he follows you inside the cave. If you don't want to risk him dying, you can offer to clear the cave alone. Wandering off and returning again with him as a companion will produce the same action, though without scripted or any other comments now. One way or another, quest objective stays the same in your diary. * It might be advisable to accept Valdr's help if you are doing this quest at a low level, as spriggans and bears are some of the toughest enemies for low-level players. * Valdr's Lucky Dagger is one of the better weapons in the game at low levels, particularly for assassin-type characters who value burst damage.
