==Quick Walkthrough==
#Clear [[Skyrim:Red Eagle Redoubt|Red Eagle Redoubt]].
#Climb to the top of [[Skyrim:Sundered Towers|Sundered Towers]].
#Kill the Forsworn Leader and retrieve the sword [[Skyrim:Red Eagle's Fury|Red Eagle's Fury]].
#Go to [[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn|Rebel's Cairn]].
#Place Red Eagle's Fury into the holder to open the door.
#Kill [[Skyrim:Red Eagle|Red Eagle]].
#Retrieve sword that is now called [[Skyrim:Red Eagle's Bane|Red Eagle's Bane]] with different stats.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This quest starts when reading the book ''[[Skyrim:The Legend of Red Eagle|The Legend of Red Eagle]]'', and is found in the Miscellaneous section of your journal. The first waypoint leads to [[Skyrim:Red Eagle Redoubt|Red Eagle Redoubt]], an outdoor encampment with a couple Forsworn and some minor loot. Next head into the cave [[Skyrim:Red Eagle Ascent|Red Eagle Ascent]]. There's not much to speak of in here, just a handful of Forsworn, a few easily-avoided traps, and some alchemy ingredients in various places. At the end of the cave you'll exit back out into Skyrim through an exit marked [[Skyrim:Red Eagle Redoubt|Red Eagle Redoubt]] (not the same door through which you entered). Head up the stairs to your right and kill all of the Forsworn along the way. Note that once the stairs end there is a sizable camp to the left with a [[Skyrim:Forge|forge]], an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], an adept-locked chest, and the [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] [[Skyrim:Reality & Other Falsehoods|Reality & Other Falsehoods]]. To the east of the camp (to the right as you reach the top of the stairs) is the large stone structure [[Skyrim:Sundered Towers|Sundered Towers]]. The structure is actually the personal encampment for the [[Skyrim:Forsworn Briarheart|Forsworn Briarheart]], who you find seated at a throne as you approach. Kill him in order to retrieve [[Skyrim:Red Eagle's Fury|Red Eagle's Fury]]. The quest will auto-update and ask you to unlock the secret of Red Eagle's Tomb. There's a [[Skyrim:Red_Eagle's_Rite|journal]] on the altar near the Forsworn Briarheart with details on what you have to do, as well as a nearby chest. Don't forget to grab the key off of the [[Skyrim:Forsworn Briarheart|Forsworn Briarheart]]'s body.

Head back across the throne and up the wooden stairs to a master-locked door, which unlocks with the key you just found. Follow the path up the tower (there are no enemies nearby) and use the pullchain to lower a drawbridge you need to cross to reach your next destination. Once you cross the bridge, you can loot some items here, and go downstairs to a door. You exit the tower facing east. You can see ruins to the north, which are empty but do provide a nice view. The next destination is [[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn|Rebel's Cairn]], to the southeast. Rebel's Cairn is not the tower you can see in the distance to the southeast; that tower is [[Skyrim:Bleakwind Bluff|Bleakwind Bluff]], which you may want to discover if you haven't already. Rebel's Cairn is located before you reach that tower.

===Inside Rebel's Cairn===
[[File:SR-interior-Rebel's Cairn 02.jpg|thumb|right|Red Eagle's Tomb]]
Upon entering Rebel's Cairn you will find a good amount of fungus-type alchemy ingredients (some of which you may need to use [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] to access), a dead adventurer, an iron ore vein, and an altar with a weapon slot. Activate the weapon slot to insert [[Skyrim:Red Eagle's Fury|Red Eagle's Fury]], which will open the way ahead into [[Skyrim:Red Eagle|Red Eagle]]'s tomb and the next phase of the quest. The top of the first flight of stairs here triggers a trio of skeletons and Red Eagle himself to rise. If you are sneaking, it seems that the skeletons sometimes turn on Red Eagle himself, so it may pay to initially stay out of sight and take some pot shots at Red Eagle while he dismisses the skeletons. Take them out how you see fit, although do note that Red Eagle can raise the skeletons, so you might want to take him out first (the skeletons are actually summons; after a while they may collapse on their own). You can also head around to the far right or left behind some spiked sticks to give you some cover from Red Eagle (while still leaving you room to attack him).

Once defeated, Red Eagle will drop a [[Skyrim:Honed_Ancient_Nord_Greatsword_of_Burning|honed ancient Nord greatsword of burning]]. A chest behind Red Eagle's coffin contains some loot. Head back out to the first chamber and grab Red Eagle's Fury, which is now [[Skyrim:Red Eagle's Bane|Red Eagle's Bane]].

==Notes==
*If Red Eagle's Fury is removed from the pedestal after Red Eagle is awakened but before he is killed, it will not become Red Eagle's Bane.
*If Red Eagle's Bane is removed from the pedestal, the door closes so be sure to remove all the loot from the tomb if you intend to sell the sword.
*The final quest area does not provide an easy exit back to the beginning. Thus, if you typically travel with a horse, you'll need to walk all the way back to [[Skyrim:Red Eagle Redoubt|Red Eagle Redoubt]] to retrieve your horse if you are over-encumbered.
*When you activate the pedestal, the model for an [[Skyrim:Ancient Nord Greatsword|ancient Nord greatsword]] is placed inside instead.

At this point, it is unknown whether this happens because of the quest reassignment or a normal bug. The swords are able to be dropped, sold, or stored after you use one to open the secret passage to complete the quest.|vn=1}}

{{Featured Article}}{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]] {{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=Entering the [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]], [[Skyrim:Frostflow Abyss|Frostflow Abyss]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Sailor's Repose|Sailor's Repose]] |Image=SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_06.jpg |Imgdesc=What happened in [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]]? |description=Uncover the tragic events inside [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]]. |ID=dunFrostflowAbyssQST |Difficulty=Medium |SuggLevel=18 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Enter the [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]]. #Investigate the lighthouse living areas and read the family's journals. #Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Mani's Cellar Key|cellar key]] from the burial urn on the mantle. #Search for the remaining family members in [[Skyrim:Frostflow Abyss|Frostflow Abyss]]. #Kill the family's attackers. #Take [[Skyrim:Habd's Remains|Habd's remains]] to the lighthouse brazier. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Frostflow Lighthouse=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :
'''''We finally did it. We bought the lighthouse. I thought Habd was just making idle promises all these years, what husband doesn't want to promise their wife the two moons from the sky, but I didn't think we'd actually manage to get it! Now if I could only find where we put everything.'''''
|} [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss.jpg|thumb|right|When you least expect it]] On the snowy tundra between [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]] and [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] stands [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]], a remote building overlooking the [[Skyrim:Sea of Ghosts|Sea of Ghosts]]. It has been abandoned until recently, when a [[Skyrim:Redguard|Redguard]] couple, Habd and [[Skyrim:Ramati|Ramati]], finally managed to realize their dream of purchasing it, planning to spend their silver years in the lighthouse. The couple brought their two grown children, [[Skyrim:Sudi|Sudi]] and [[Skyrim:Mani|Mani]], hoping that eventually they'd decide to stay with their parents. Both children hated the place, but the parents kept hoping they would just stay in the lighthouse for a few years before venturing out into the world on their own. As you approach the lighthouse, a dead [[Skyrim:Horse|horse]] will block your path, hinting that something went terribly wrong inside. As you enter you will be met with the sight of a dead body lying in the center of the main chamber. A broken table and the bloodstained remains of a [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]], primitively killed with a [[Skyrim:Woodcutter's Axe|woodcutter's axe]], are near the fireplace. The quest will immediately initiate and some strange scratching noises will appear from somewhere below. The dead body turns out to be the mother of the family, [[Skyrim:Ramati|Ramati]], impaled by a [[Skyrim:Falmer War Axe|Falmer war axe]]. She carries her husband's [[Skyrim:Habd's Journal|journal]]; read through it and you will discover what happened to Ramati and how Habd managed to kill the chaurus before venturing into the cellar for his children. ===The Scratching Sounds=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :
'''''Oh gods poor Ramati. It must have come out of the cellar. I'm going down there and locking the door behind me to make sure they don't escape. I don't know if I'll make it out, but I have to save my family!'''''
|} [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_02.jpg|thumb|right|The mantle]] From Habd's journal, it is clear that the intruders are located downstairs, but the cellar door is locked, so ignore the scratching sounds and investigate a bit further. Start in the northeastern bedroom where Habd and Ramati's double bed is positioned in the center of the room. On the end table sits [[Skyrim:Ramati's Journal|Ramati's journal]] so read through it for some more observations and a few clues. Head into the neighboring room to the northwest, belonging to [[Skyrim:Mani|Mani]] and [[Skyrim:Sudi|Sudi]], and follow the trail of blood to Mani's bed. Underneath the bed is a [[Skyrim:Containers#Knapsack|knapsack]] with a [[Skyrim:Mani's Letter|letter]] where he claims not to be responsible for the odd noises coming from the basement, and how he will leave the lighthouse as soon as Habd returns from his venture into town. On a table in the same room is Sudi's [[Skyrim:Sudi's Journal|journal]]. Read through the last section of the journal and compare it to the last section of Ramati's journal, and you will know where the cellar key is hidden. Head to the fireplace and investigate the burial urn sitting on the mantle. It contains the [[Skyrim:Mani's Cellar Key|cellar key]] so grab it and loot the lighthouse for valuables, including a copy of the [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Mystery of Talara, v 2|Mystery of Talara, v2]]'' in the parents' bedroom. Finally approach the cellar door and prepare for a very long trek into the depths beneath the lighthouse, where you will find out what happened to the other family members, Sudi, Mani, and Habd. Head down the stairs and avoid the [[Skyrim:Bear Trap|bear traps]] laid out by Habd in an attempt to stop the supposed skeevers. Follow the trail of blood down to a snowy chamber where two [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]] will attack, effectively solving the mystery of the scratching sounds. Dispose of them both and keep an eye on the blood in the snow. Halfway through the room, the trail stops, and in front of you is a knocked-over set of shelves. Where the shelves used to stand is a huge hole in the stone wall. Proceed into the tunnel behind the wall and enter [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse#Frostflow Abyss|Frostflow Abyss]]. ===The Blind Dead=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :
'''''I don't know how long we've been down here. Father came down to find us, but those things captured him as well. I asked him if he'd seen Mother or Mani, but I don't know if he could even hear me. One of those big bugs bit him when he tried to get free and now he's feverish. '''''
|} [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_05.jpg|thumb|left|Mani]] [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_03.jpg|thumb|right|Sudi]] Head down the slope and discover the recognizable tents usually inhabited by the [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]]. Before long, a Falmer will attack, along with another chaurus. The trail of blood starts again here, leading towards a plateau between the tents. Here, you can find the remains of [[Skyrim:Mani|Mani]], skewered by a [[Skyrim:Falmer Sword|Falmer sword]] and roasting on two fires, obviously on his way to become the meal for the inhabitants of the crypt. Locate the gate to the southeast and head up the slope for another battle against a Falmer and a chaurus. Take the narrow tunnel to the southeast and beware the [[Skyrim:Tripwire|tripwire]] triggering the [[Skyrim:Slicer|slicer]] in the ceiling. Before long you will land in a nest filled with cobwebs and inhabited by a Falmer and two [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]]. Kill them all and proceed through the southwestern tunnel until you reach another chamber, divided into two levels, with a patrolling Falmer on the ledge above, and another on the ground. Fight them both and investigate the cage along the western wall. In there, you will find [[Skyrim:Sudi|Sudi]] lying dead in a pool of her own blood. A [[Skyrim:Scrawled page|scrawled page]] is nearby, detailing how far her father managed to get into the cave before he was finally overpowered by the poisonous inhabitants. Sadly, a [[Skyrim:Bloodstained note|bloodstained note]] in her hand explains how she was able to commit suicide before she suffered the same fate as her father, explaining the blood and the [[Skyrim:Iron Dagger|iron dagger]] sticking out of her wrist. {{NewLeft}} ===Entering the Nest=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :
'''''They took Father. There had been some others they brought down but they led them off and all we heard were the screams and now Father is gone too. I don't know where he was hiding it, but I think I know why he left me this dagger.'''''
|} [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_08.jpg|thumb|left|The blind dead]] [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_04.jpg|thumb|right|The Reaper]] Locate the slope to the southeast and proceed to the area above and fight any remaining Falmer. The only available path is located to the west and marks a point of no return, as you will be unable to get back up. When you drop down, kill the chaurus and examine the Falmer tent for a couple of useful healing potions. Then head forward through the tunnel until you reach yet another point of no return, a large chamber filled with several chaurus enemies, spitting poison at you while you slowly climb down to the bottom using the stones sticking out of the wall. The room is flooded with water and all of the walls are covered in egg sacks filled with [[Skyrim:Chaurus Eggs|chaurus eggs]]. A total of four chaurus will attack. Kill them and proceed through the tunnel to the northwest until you find yourself in another huge chamber filled with eggs and more chaurus. With the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]] DLC there are four chaurus cocoons, the third from the left will contain a [[Skyrim:Chaurus Hunter Fledgling|chaurus hunter fledgling]]. Locate another slope and another narrow tunnel in the northeastern corner, leading to even more egg sacks, more chaurus, two more chaurus cocoons (with one releasing another chaurus hunter fledgling as you approach) and more fights. As the amount of egg sacks slowly increases and covers the surroundings, prepare for the final battle in the northeastern chamber where a huge [[Skyrim:Chaurus Reaper|chaurus reaper]] resides, sitting on an island surrounded by egg sacks. Pick the fight with the giant chaurus and keep an eye on your health at all times, as several smaller chaurus will join their leader. Once the reaper is dead, the quest will end, although you still haven't found the head of the family, Habd. Open up the chaurus reaper and you will find [[Skyrim:Habd's Remains|Habd's remains]] inside, along with his [[Skyrim:Habd's Lighthouse Key|lighthouse key]]. Claim the key and the remains, head up the slope and loot the boss-leveled Falmer chest, then head through the narrow northeastern tunnel until you fall down in the very first chamber of the crypt. ===Last Wishes=== {|cellpadding="10" cellspacing="10" width="95%" |- |style="border: dotted 1px black"| :
'''''I know they think their father will live forever, but I see his age creeping into his eyes.
He made me promise again that when he died I would put his bones in the lighthouse fire so he could look out over the ocean forever.'''''
|} [[File:SR-quest-Frostflow_Abyss_07.jpg|thumb|right|Forever at peace]] Head northwest and you will be back in Frostflow Lighthouse, with only one thing to do for the family of Redguards, namely to follow Habd's last wishes, as written in his wife's journal. Unlock the wooden door adjacent to the cellar door and travel all the way up to a ladder that leads to the very top of the lighthouse, with the impressive view described by Sudi in her journal. Habd's key will unlock the chest up there, so claim another reward and then head up the wooden ladder to the lighthouse brazier and activate it. Habd's remains will then be placed in the brazier, fulfilling his last wishes, to look out over the ocean forever. This gesture earns you the [[Skyrim:Sailor's Repose|Sailor's Repose]], a permanent effect causing all [[Skyrim:Restoration#Spells|healing spells]] to cure 10% more. ==Notes== * If you practice [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]], the Frostflow Abyss is an incredible source of [[Skyrim:Chaurus Eggs|Chaurus Eggs]], with 525 guaranteed samples (516 from egg sacs and 9 hand-placed). As well as [[Skyrim:Glowing Mushroom|Glowing Mushrooms]], with 96 guaranteed samples. * Using the [[Skyrim:Animal Allegiance|Animal Allegiance]] shout makes this quest incredibly easy to complete since it will cause every [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]] in range (including [[Skyrim:Chaurus Reaper|chaurus reapers]]) to become harmless and attack other chaurus that remain hostile to you. Any chaurus under the effect of Animal Allegiance can also easily be killed with sneak attacks. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you clear Frostflow Abyss before the quest is started, you won't be able to actually finish the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Using the console and typing setstage dunFrostflowAbyssQST 90 may complete this quest and remove it from your Miscellaneous Quests. {{Bug|On approaching the lighthouse, some followers may refer to it as a cave, saying ''"Hmm. Caves. Wonder what's below."''|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Followers won't go past chaurus gates in the cave.|confirmed=1}} ** Bumping them (running into them to push them in a direction) or the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout to push them past the gates works. Also, closing and re-opening the gates often gets followers to try again and to go through. {{Bug|The quest's Sailor's Repose reward has an incorrect taper duration set, in addition to also having an incorrect magnitude set. Its abilities are applied by perk and the effect entries are merely to make it show up in the UI when you get it.|USKP|2.0.3}} {{Bug|The quest may break if you pick the lock on the basement door before you've been given the notification that the quest is active.|USSEP|4.3.2|The door will now require the key in order to proceed so that the quest doesn't completely break.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |5||{{Quest Objective|5|Find the source of the murders in Frostflow Lighthouse}} |100|fin| |missing=0, 7, 10, 20, 21, 22, 90, 95 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Mistwatch (quest).wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Bwross |checkedBy=Arcanearcher |reward=Bwross |rewardChecked=Arcanearcher }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]]{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Christer|Christer]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Mistwatch|Mistwatch]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Fjola's Wedding Band|Fjola's Wedding Band]] |Image=SR-quest-Mistwatch.jpg |Imgdesc=A view of a dragon flying above Mistwatch |ReqItem=[[Skyrim:Mistwatch Key|Mistwatch Key]], [[Skyrim:Fjola's Wedding Band|Fjola's Wedding Band]] |description=Help [[Skyrim:Christer|Christer]] locate his kidnapped wife [[Skyrim:Fjola|Fjola]]. |ID=dunMistwatchQST |Difficulty=Easy |SuggLevel=6 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Enter [[Skyrim:Mistwatch|Mistwatch]] and deal with the [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] outside. #Drop the drawbridge and enter Mistwatch North Tower. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Christer|Christer]] and agree to help him find his kidnapped [[Skyrim:Fjola|wife]]. #Proceed through the tower to the Mistwatch Lower Balcony. #Enter the Mistwatch West Tower. #Proceed through the tower to the Mistwatch Upper Balcony. #Enter the Mistwatch East Tower. #Deal with the bandit leader. #Return to Christer. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===North Mistwatch Tower=== [[File:SR-quest-Mistwatch 02.jpg|right|thumb|Drawbridge lever to access the Northern Tower.]] Once you have breached the outer region of Mistwatch, find a lever located on the first level above ground. This will lower the bridge to enter the North tower. Once inside you will encounter a Nord named [[Skyrim:Christer|Christer]]. Speaking with him and accepting his request will initiate the quest. Entering the North Tower through any other entrance makes [[Skyrim:Christer|Christer]] inaccessible, as the room he is in requires the key he is holding to enter from the other side (see Notes at the end of the page for details). As you speak to him he will tell you that his wife [[Skyrim:Fjola|Fjola]] is missing and believes she is being held here. According to his story the [[Skyrim:Mistwatch Bandit|Mistwatch bandits]] started kidnapping and ransoming people around the time of her disappearance. He has managed to sneak in past the initial guards in the courtyard, but can't make it any further. That he hasn't been contacted by the bandits despite their ransom motives foreshadows a situation in which you will have to make a difficult decision should you choose to accept his quest. If you accept he will provide the [[Skyrim:Mistwatch Key|key]] that is needed to unlock the gate leading to the rest of the tower. Past the locked door will be two leveled bandits and the ladder exit to the lower balcony. ===West Mistwatch Tower=== [[File:SR-quest-Mistwatch 03.jpg|right|thumb|Trap door access to Mistwatch from the cliffs above.]] The West Mistwatch Tower has four leveled bandits who will ambush you immediately upon entry. There is a chest to the left of the first unlocked cell containing a dead [[Skyrim:Imperial (dead)|Imperial]], but this isn't Fjola. A [[Skyrim:Note (Mistwatch)|note]] on the table next to the cell provides some insight into the situation. There are two bottles of Ale next to a lantern with a Long Taffy Treat on one table. You will find several beds scattered throughout the lower tier of the tower, as well as one more table with two bottles of Ale but nothing more of interest. Moving up the first flight of stairs you will encounter a table with a quiver of Dwarven Arrows next to a few drums and some food items. A final table with a kettle and an iron dagger marks the entry way to the Higher Balcony. ===East Mistwatch Tower=== [[File:SR-npc-Fjola.jpg|right|thumb|The bandit leader approaches.]] The East Mistwatch Tower is through the upper balcony. Unlocking its door requires the Mistwatch Key given to you by Christer. Inside is a single room and only one person—a [[Skyrim:Bandit Leader|Bandit Leader]]. Instead of attacking, she will start talking to you, revealing that she is in fact Fjola. She was never kidnapped and the kidnappings only started happening after she disappeared because they were her idea. She will explain that she couldn't take her life anymore and quickly joined and whipped these bandits into shape when she returned to [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]]. She still holds some sort of love for Christer and doesn't want him harmed, but doesn't want him in her life anymore. You will be presented with two options. Don't forget to pick up a copy of the [[Skyrim:Heavy Armor|Heavy Armor]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Hallgerd's Tale|Hallgerd's Tale]]'' from Fjola's dresser in her sleeping quarters, located just beyond where she approaches you in the east tower before leaving to make your decision. ====Kill the Bandit Leader==== One choice is to kill Fjola. You don't even have to hear Fjola's story. By killing her you are left with only a hint of her true identity given by [[Skyrim:Fjola's Wedding Band|the wedding band]] found on her corpse. At this point you need to return to [[Skyrim:Christer|Christer]] and tell him the bad news. If you do this, your only option will be to tell him that you killed Fjola because she attacked you, in which case he will become enraged and attempt to take revenge for her death. It is possible to yield to Christer once he attacks, and he then becomes non-hostile again, and you then have the conversation options as if you were tricking him. ====Trick Christer into Leaving==== The other choice is to agree to lie to Christer and get him to leave. Fjola gives you her wedding band as proof to present to Christer and tells you to keep it once he has left. You can tell Christer either that Fjola is dead or you only found her ring. Either way he is relieved, gives the ring back to you as reward, and takes off to start living again. You can complete the quest by telling Fjola that you have convinced Christer to leave — which only requires going a short distance up the stairs, because Fjola has followed you down into North Mistwatch Tower. She'll promise to return the favor one day in the future and the quest will end (including marking Mistwatch as cleared on your map). ==Notes== * If Christer dies at any point before the quest is completed, it becomes impossible to finish the quest. * If you drop down onto the roof of Mistwatch from the mountains at the rear, and work down through the towers instead of up, you cannot open the final door before reaching Christer, because the Mistwatch key can only be obtained from Christer. To proceed, you will need to go back out through the trapdoor at the top of the North Tower, jump down, and re-enter the North Tower through the main door. With the key you will then be able to go back up and enter the East Mistwatch Tower to complete the quest. ** It is possible to obtain a copy of the Mistwatch key without speaking to Christer if you have the [[Skyrim:Lockpicking#Skill_Perks | Wax Key]] perk and unlock any of the master-locked entrances. After obtaining the key, if you speak to Fjola without speaking to Christer, the quest will proceed as if you had. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you kill Fjola after talking to her and obtaining her wedding band, then talk to her husband, the game will then update the quest to talk to Fjola again. However, since Fjola is dead, you cannot talk to her, and therefore can no longer complete the miscellaneous quest.|USKP|2.0.5}} **{{pc22}}However, you can use the console to bring Fjola back and finish the quest. In console, type prid 000430B5, moveto player, and resurrect 1 then talk to her. {{Bug|If you choose to tell Christer that you did not find Fjola, her corpse might spawn in the first hall left of Christer. The quest is then impossible to complete.|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|If you decide to kill Christer, upon killing him, the quest will complete. If you then return to Fjola, she still says ''"I didn't expect to see you again. What became of my doting husband?"''.|USKP|2.0.5}} {{Bug|Despite promising you gold, Christer never gives you any, regardless of how you complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes when you speak to Christer he will only have generic comments and not offer you the quest. Attempting the following command lines to manually fix it does not appear to work: setstage to 5, 10, or 11, disable/enable, and resetAI.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |11||{{Quest Objective|11|Search Mistwatch for Fjola}} |75||{{Quest Objective|75|Return to Christer}} |80||{{Quest Objective|75|Return to Christer}} |90||{{Quest Objective|85|Report back to Fjola}} |100|fin| |missing=0, 5, 10, 70, 85, 89, 95 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Find the sarcophagus.
# Retrieve [[Skyrim:Saerek's Skull Key|Saerek's Skull Key]].
# Retrieve [[Skyrim:Torsten's Skull Key|Torsten's Skull Key]].
# Open the sarcophagus. 
# Kill [[Skyrim:Otar the Mad|Otar the Mad]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Two Heroes, Two Keys===
According to [[Skyrim:The Secrets of Ragnvald|legend]], the ancient ruin of [[Skyrim:Ragnvald|Ragnvald]] was once populated by [[Skyrim:Nord|Nords]] and ruled by a fearsome chieftain named Otar. At some point, Otar went mad due to evil voices within his head and turned into a servant of the ancient [[SR:Dragon|dragons]], causing havoc and leading to dark times in Ragnvald. Eventually, the Nords decided to stop Otar and sent in two champions, Torsten and Saerek. Although they couldn't destroy him, they managed to seal him off inside the ruin, using separate keys to ensure he never escaped from his containment. Ragnvald has long since been abandoned, but the [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] [[SR:Guards|guards]] are aware of the dangers lurking within, and will rightfully warn you about the place: ''"There's an evil to the north, friend, and its name is Ragnvald. A tomb like so many in [[Lore:Skyrim|Skyrim]], where the dead have found no peace."''

===Ragnvald===
Straight north of [[Skyrim:Salvius Farm|Salvius Farm]], an unmarked path will start in the middle of nowhere, leading directly to the huge exterior area of Ragnvald. The ruin is only guarded by two [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] enemies, but the area is otherwise devoid of life and sound. Following the building on the southwest side of the entrance all the way to the back will lead to a dead bandit and a coin purse.  Enter Ragnvald Temple through the main gate and proceed through the nearly destroyed first chamber with a dead draugr on a table. Take the only available path downwards and keep an eye out for helpful potions and minor loot along the way. The path will eventually lead to a large, complex chamber guarded by three leveled draugr. Fight them and proceed in a western direction until you face an odd-looking sarcophagus in front of a set of stairs leading to a sealed area. Touch one of the empty slots and read the inscription. The quest will trigger at this point and add map markers to the two items needed, located in different zones within Ragnvald.

=== The Two Guardians ===
As told in the [[#Two Heroes, Two Keys|legend]], the next step is to claim [[Skyrim:Saerek's Skull Key|Saerek's Skull Key]] and [[Skyrim:Torsten's Skull Key|Torsten's Skull Key]] from the heroes that managed to seal off Otar the Mad back in ancient times. The two guardians still protect the keys with their lives, and you will have to fight both of them to complete this quest. Check the map markers for doors leading in two different directions and choose which zone to enter first, [[Skyrim:Ragnvald Canal|Ragnvald Canal]] or [[Skyrim:Ragnvald Crypts|Ragnvald Crypts]].
{{Quest Fork
|titleL=Ragnvald Canal
|titleR=Ragnvald Crypts
|imageL=SR-quest-Ragnvald (quest) 05.jpg
|imageR=SR-quest-Ragnvald (quest) 02.jpg
|captionL=Guardian Torsten
|captionR=Guardian Saerek
|textL=
The door opens to a huge water-filled room guarded by three leveled draugr enemies. Follow the stream as it bends, making sure to surface in the alcove halfway through for a boss-leveled chest behind a door, but beware of the hidden [[Skyrim:Flamethrower_Statues|flamethrower trap]] activated when you touch the door; it can be deactivated by pulling the nearby handle. Proceed west and head up the bridge where a small crack in the woodworks will allow you to proceed forward. Follow the path until you reach a large open area, with [[Skyrim:Torsten's Skull Key|Torsten's Skull Key]] on a pedestal. Claim the skull, which will cause [[Skyrim:Guardian Torsten|Guardian Torsten]] to burst out of his sarcophagus, along with two leveled draugr. Finish the fight, examine the room for loot, then return to the pedestal and cross the bridge leading east. This is a shortcut back to Ragnvald Temple, although you will have to traverse a hallway full of [[Skyrim:Swinging_Blades|swinging blade traps]].
|textR=
Head down the wooden bridge and fight the lonely draugr guarding the first room. Two paths leads south, both of them ending in the same chamber, although the one on the left is filled with traps triggered by [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plates]]. In the crypts, a total of five draugr will awaken from their slumber and attack. In the next chamber is an [[Skyrim:Oil_Slicks|oil slick]] which can be used to damage the enemies that inhabit it. Examine the alcove for the [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Mystery_of_Talara,_v_2|Mystery of Talara, v2]]'' in front of the booby-trapped minor loot chest, then head up the stairs to the north. You will emerge on the level above, with free access to [[Skyrim:Saerek's Skull Key|Saerek's Skull Key]] on an alcove to the east. As soon as you take it, [[Skyrim:Guardian Saerek|Guardian Saerek]] will burst forth, accompanied by two draugr from the alcoves above. Defeat the guardians and backtrack west over the bridge, a quick shortcut back to Ragnvald Temple.}}

===Otar the Mad===
[[File:SR-quest-Ragnvald_(quest)_04.jpg|thumb|right|Otar the Mad]]
With both Skull Keys in your possession, return to the sealed sarcophagus in the western part of Ragnvald Temple and insert them into the empty slots. The locks will then disappear, and before long, [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|Dragon Priest]] [[Skyrim:Otar the Mad|Otar the Mad]] will emerge. Otar uses [[Skyrim:Shock Damage|shock]] as his primary weapon. He tends to summon a [[Skyrim:Storm Atronach|storm atronach]] in the beginning of the fight, and he also uses the unique [[Skyrim:Staff of the Storm Wall|Staff of the Storm Wall]] with very high Shock damage. Otar will rarely follow you if you stay away from him, but he will bombard you with his staff that casts [[Skyrim:Wall of Storms|Wall of Storms]]. The [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout is ineffective against him. He can prove to be a challenging enemy to face, especially at low levels.

After the battle, it is time for your reward. From Otar's corpse, claim his valuable staff, the [[Skyrim:Dragon_Priest_Mask|Dragon Priest Mask]] [[Skyrim:Otar|Otar]] with [[Skyrim:Resist_Shock|resist shock]], [[ Skyrim:Resist_Fire|fire]] and [[Skyrim:Resist_Frost|frost]] enchantments, along with a huge amount of gold. In the chamber behind the sarcophagus, the boss-leveled chest holds even more gold, while the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] in the back of the chamber provides a word for the [[Skyrim:Kyne's Peace|Kyne's Peace]] shout. When all is said and done, reclaim the two Skull Keys from the sarcophagus, as they can be sold for a high price, and exit Ragnvald the way you came.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Investigate [[Skyrim:Sleeping Tree Cave|Sleeping Tree Cave]].
# Search [[Skyrim:Ulag|Ulag's]] corpse for [[Skyrim:Ysolda's Message|Ysolda's Message]].
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Ysolda|Ysolda]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Travel to [[Skyrim:Sleeping Tree Camp|Sleeping Tree Camp]] and find the cave inside the camp, northwest of the [[Lore:Sleeping Tree|Sleeping Tree]]. Enter the cave and start your investigation. It would be a wise choice to leave the [[Skyrim:Giant|giants]] and their herd [[Skyrim:Mammoth|mammoths]] in peace, especially if you are low level. Move swiftly and enter the cave before they turn hostile to you.

[[Skyrim:Ulag|Ulag's]] corpse can be found on a stone inside the cave with a giant wandering nearby. Search his body, where you'll find Ysolda's Message and a sample of [[Skyrim:Sleeping Tree Sap|Sleeping Tree Sap]]. If you don't want to fight the giant, get out of the cave with the message as quickly as possible. After reading the message, you'll get an idea about what caused Ulag's death. There was an arrangement between Ysolda and Ulag for purchase of the sap, which Ulag would obtain from the Sleeping Tree. Unfortunately, he risked the wrath of the giants one too many times, and ended up paying with his life.

Travel to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and speak to Ysolda about the note you found. Ysolda will quickly realize what happened and offer you the same arrangement she had with Ulag, 150 gold for each sample of sap you bring to her. She'll be satisfied with the deal and remind you ''"Be sure to bring any more Sleeping Tree Sap you find to me."'' You may also ask her for more information about the Sleeping Tree itself.

==Notes==
* [[Skyrim:Patch#Version 1.5|The Official Skyrim Patch 1.5]] makes Ysolda essential (to alleviate issues with the [[Skyrim:A Night To Remember|A Night To Remember]] quest, though it also prevents you from accidentally failing this quest as well).

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=ThuumofReason |rewardChecked=Roger }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Dagur|Dagur]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]], [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], [[Skyrim:Hob's Fall Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]] |Reward=None |Prev=[[Skyrim:A Few Words with You|A Few Words with You]] (for [[Skyrim:Haran|Haran]]) |Image=SR-quest-Drowned Sorrows.jpg |Imgdesc=[[Skyrim:Ranmir|Ranmir]] drowning his sorrows |description=Find [[Skyrim:Isabelle Rolaine|Isabelle]], [[SR:Ranmir|Ranmir's]] lost love. |ID=FreeformWinterholdC |SuggLevel=8 }} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Non-Journal Quests]] ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note''': This quest does not appear in your journal. # Speak with [[Skyrim:Haran|Haran]] and deal with [[Skyrim:Ranmir|Ranmir's]] debt. # Speak with Dagur about Ranmir. # Speak to Ranmir and then Haran again to learn that [[Skyrim:Isabelle Rolaine|Isabelle]] went to see [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Talk to Vex in the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]]. # Find Isabelle Rolaine in [[Skyrim:Hob's_Fall_Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]]. # Return to Ranmir with [[Skyrim:Isabelle's Letter|her note]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Great Collapse=== Ever since the [[Lore:Great Collapse|Great Collapse]], the once prosperous town of [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]] has been in a state of disarray, with only a few inhabitants left. The only remaining merchant, [[Skyrim:Birna|Birna]], and her brother [[Skyrim:Ranmir|Ranmir]] have both felt the agony in the wake of the Collapse, as most of the townsfolk are long gone, providing little income for the family store. When you visit Winterhold for the first time, you will witness an [[Skyrim:Yngol's Barrow#Birna's Odd Investment|argument]] between the two in the middle of the street, and they will continue inside local inn [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|The Frozen Hearth]]: [[File:SR-quest-Drowned_Sorrows_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Please, come home. Just... Just come home."'']] '''Birna''': ''"Please, come home. Just... Just come home."''
'''Ranmir''': ''"Can't. Got at least two rounds to go. Why don't you go... sell something."''
'''Birna''': ''"Why? Because I'd rather be here trying to keep my only brother from drinking himself to death."''
'''Ranmir''': ''"Ha! Drink ain't gonna kill me. Not today, anyway."'' While Birna keeps her store open for nobody, Ranmir proceeds to down mead around the clock inside the Frozen Hearth, seemingly falling apart, much to the dismay of the innkeeper, [[Skyrim:Dagur|Dagur]] and waitress [[Skyrim:Haran|Haran]]. When listening in on their conversations, however, it becomes apparent that there may be another reason Ranmir became the town drunk: '''Haran''': ''"How long are we going to let Ranmir drink himself into a stupor? When will enough be enough?"''
'''Dagur''': ''"As long as he keeps paying, I suppose. He keeps to himself, and isn't hurting anyone."''
'''Haran''': ''"Are you so sure of that? I think Birna might disagree with you."''
'''Dagur''': ''"It's not my place to get involved in their family's business, remember? You're the one that told me to stay out of it."'' ===The Concerned Innkeeper=== [[File:SR-quest-Drowned_Sorrows_03.jpg|thumb|right|''"How long are we going to let Ranmir drink himself into a stupor?"'']] After helping Ranmir [[Skyrim:A Few Words with You#Haran and Ranmir|pay his debts]] to Haran, concerned innkeeper Dagur will have a new dialogue option, namely asking if there is anything to do around the inn. Dagur will then tell you about the very reason Ranmir became the town drunk: ''"Listen, we're friends, right? I wondered if I could ask a favor of you. It's about Ranmir. Don't get me wrong, I don't have a problem with him being here all the time. He mostly keeps to himself, and so far he's been able to pay. I just hate to see what's happened to him. He hasn't always been like this, you know. Drunk, I mean."'' He then proceeds to tell you about Ranmir's broken heart: ''"Oh, he was a different person. Happy, outgoing... Like anyone who's in love. See, Ranmir was involved with a pretty young woman named Isabelle Rolaine. The two of them were very happy together, I thought. One day, she just disappeared. Ranmir was convinced she'd run off with someone else, leaving him behind. He turned to drinking, and what's left of him is what you see here every day."'' He then reasons that if Isabelle could be found, Ranmir could get some peace of mind and get his act back together. When asked about Isabelle, Ranmir will get overly insulted, saying: ''"Don't you... Don't you say that name to me. Don't you dare. Ever."'' Luckily, the equally concerned Haran has a bit of information on Isabelle's whereabouts, although she will hint that Isabelle is hanging out with a bad crowd: ''"It's none of your business. Those aren't folks you want to get tangled up with."'' She will then explain the danger: ''"One night Ranmir was in here like always, drinking himself to death. When I told him there was no more Honningbrew, that he'd drank it all, he got angry. He ranted at me, how I didn't know what he's been through, how Isabelle broke his heart when she ran off with some thief named Vex..."'' ===Vex=== If you are a member of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], you already know master infiltrator [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]]. She can always be found hanging out at the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]]. If you have completed [[Skyrim:Taking Care of Business|Taking Care of Business]], she will even talk to you, and you will have the option to ask her about Isabelle Rolaine. When confronted with the name Ranmir, she will get exasperated: ''"Not him again. He came nosing around Riften a while back, making a lot of noise about me. He was... persuaded to leave before he found me. Funny, I'd have thought she would've gone back to him by now."'' Once she reveals she knew Isabelle, she will say: ''"She came through a while ago, wanted to know where she could get her hands on something valuable. Anything, really. I told her it was a bad idea, that she wasn't cut out for what'd be necessary, but she wouldn't hear it. So I gave her some advice, pointed her towards {{sic|Hobs|Hob's|description=missing apostrophe}} Fall Cave and that was that."'' ===Drowned Sorrows=== [[File:SR-quest-Drowned_Sorrows_04.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Isabelle Rolaine|Isabelle Rolaine]]]] [[Skyrim:Hob's Fall Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]] is a small cave between [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] and Ranmir's hometown, Winterhold. According to Vex, Isabelle went there to seek out treasure from the residing [[Skyrim:Warlock|warlocks]], but never made it far. As you approach the cave, stains of blood will lead to the entrance and right inside, you will find Isabelle leaning against a rock, dead. Examine her body and you will find [[Skyrim:Isabelle's Letter|her letter]], her own full explanation for leaving her beloved Ranmir behind and seeking a fortune in a remote cave: ''"I know it's been hard on you, on both of us, struggling to survive. I hate to see the look in your eyes every time you think about how little the two of us have, and I know you're too proud to ever say anything. So I'm going to make it all better."'' Return to Ranmir and hand him the letter and watch while he reads it: ''"Don't you go pulling my leg. Give it here. This... This is really from her, isn't it? Did she really run off and do this? For me? By the Eight. She's dead, isn't she? And it's all my fault. I... I have some thinking to do. Thank you for this."'' Ranmir will then leave the Frozen Hearth, and vanish. ==Notes== *The note is not marked as a quest item, and can be dropped like any normal item. This quest can become impossible to complete if you lose track of the note. *If you enter Hob's Fall Cave before getting this quest, Isabelle's body is not there yet. *It is not necessary to speak to Ranmir or Vex. Once the quest is started the body appears in the cave. *There are several radiant quests that may use this cave. They can all be done simultaneously. *Ranmir disappears from the game after the quest (once you visit Winterhold exterior). *The Unofficial Patch adds objectives to this quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If Ranmir dies while this quest is running, it will appear to proceed normally except that you'll never be able to complete it. The last objective will be displayed with no map marker.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Use the following series of console commands to resurrect Ranmir and finish the quest: :::{{Pre|width=auto|prid 1c18b moveto player resurrect}} {{Bug|The quest marker on your map may not show up, nor will it appear anywhere in your journal. Despite this, the quest itself will still be very much active once you talk to Haran.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes Isabelle's body can be found in Hob's Fall Cave before getting the quest, but she doesn't have a note yet.|vn=1}} {{Bug|Isabelle may be found in the cave without any clothes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Birna|Birna's]] dialogue after the end of Drowned Sorrows doesn't change to mention that [[Skyrim:Ranmir|Ranmir]] is gone.|USKP|2.0.0}} {{Bug|Isabelle's Letter isn't marked as a quest item for Drowned Sorrows, which can cause the quest to become permanently stuck if the letter is lost before the quest is finished.|USSEP|4.1.1|The letter is now marked as a quest item until the quest is finished.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |allmissing=1 |missing=0, 10, 20, 30, 40 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:The Savior of Selveni Nethri.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=75.84.209.125 |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Dungeon Quests]] {{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Selveni Nethri|Selveni Nethri]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Southfringe Sanctum|Southfringe Sanctum]] |Reward=None |Image=SR-quest-The Savior of Selveni Nethri.jpg |Imgdesc=''"Please, cut me down!"'' |description=Help a necromancer escape from [[Skyrim:Southfringe Sanctum|Southfringe Sanctum]]. |ID=dunSouthfringeQST |SuggLevel=6 }}{{#addtotrail:Dungeon Quests|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Find [[Skyrim:Selveni Nethri|Selveni Nethri]] trapped in webs in [[Skyrim:Southfringe Sanctum|Southfringe Sanctum]] and cut her down. # Help her escape the cave. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Caught in a Web=== When exploring [[Skyrim:Southfringe Sanctum|Southfringe Sanctum]] you will find a [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]] [[Skyrim:CombatMageConjurer|conjurer]] named [[Skyrim:Selveni Nethri|Selveni Nethri]] trapped in a spider's web. Obviously she is frantic to escape and pleads with you to cut her down. ===A Cursed Necromancer=== Apparently Selveni's dealings as a necromancer resulted in her daughter being taken from her and sent to the [[Skyrim:Honorhall Orphanage|orphanage]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. Selveni had gone to Riften to see if she could get her daughter out, but learned her daughter had already been moved. When she returned to the coven, [[Skyrim:Bashnag|Bashnag]] accused her of trying to sell him out to the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]]. She was cursed and chased off. Because of the curse she has been weakened and can't cast a spell to save her life. She isn't able to escape the Sanctum until the way out is safe, and she is desperate to locate her missing daughter. ===Clear the Way=== You have probably already faced the many resident [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] on your way in. While it isn't necessary to kill Bashnag and all his fellow [[Skyrim:Spellsword (NPC)|spellswords]] to ensure her safety, the quest will fail if Selveni dies before escaping. Let her know when the way out is clear. She will thank you and move along the path in the spider area to get out of the cave by herself. When she has exited the cave, the quest will be completed. There is no follow-up to this quest, as Selveni's daughter does not appear anywhere in Skyrim and Selveni herself disappears for good once she is out of your sight. ==Notes== *There are numerous internal references that show many changes to this quest. Originally, it took place in [[Skyrim:Boulderfall Cave|Boulderfall Cave]] (which is also referred to as Boulderfall ''Pass''), and Selveni was to be a [[Skyrim:Werewolf|werewolf]], rather than a necromancer. ** An unused message internally known as dunSouthfringeQuestObjective also refers to this, it reads: ''"Help {{sic|Selvani|Selveni}} Nethri escape Boulderfall Pass."'' The name of this particular message "'''Pack Animals'''", might've originally been the name of the quest (as it isn't actually named in the final game's files), and seemingly referred to Selveni's lycanthropy. ==Bugs== {{Bug|She may refuse to move after being cut down.|confirmed=1}} **Try talking to her until she moves. This might continue past any meaningful conversation, but she should eventually move. {{Bug|In many cases, Selveni can get stuck near the entrance.|confirmed=1}} Some things that can be tried to unstick her are: **Talk to her. **Use your equipment, spell, or shout to get her unstuck, such as [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]], a [[Skyrim:Paralyze (effect)|Paralysis]] spell, or blocks. **Use the wait feature for one hour. **Leaving and reentering the location may also work. In that case, she will disappear from the cave, and the journal will update the quest as completed. You may be forced to go back to [[Skyrim:Southfringe Sanctum|Southfringe Sanctum]] after a long time roaming other places to solve this quest with this method, though. **Hitting her with an arrow may also help push her towards the entrance. However, do not use a powerful bow and arrow combination or you will risk killing her. {{Bug|Selveni may even escape but the quest journal indicates that it never completed.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|This quest is set up as a Miscellaneous quest but increments the Side Quests achievement when it isn't supposed to.|USKP|2.0.6}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |100|fin| |200|fail| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|1|Help Selveni Nethri escape the cave.}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 10, 15, 50 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Dragon Hunting.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Neondrmr |checkedBy= |reward=RobinHood70 |rewardChecked= }} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]] {{Quest Header |Giver=[[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]], random Dragon Lair |Prev=[[Skyrim:Rebuilding the Blades|Rebuilding the Blades]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Dragon Research|Dragon Research]] |Image=SR-quest-Dragon Hunting.jpg |Imgdesc=''"Die, dragon!"'' |description=Kill a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] at its [[Skyrim:Dragon Lairs|lair]]. |ID=FreeformSkyHavenTempleB }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Ask [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] about dragon lairs. # Meet the [[SR:Blades|Blades]] at the given location. # Slay the [[SR:Dragon|dragon]]. # Return to Esbern. ==Detailed Walkthrough== This is a [[Skyrim:Radiant|radiant]] quest and can be completed any number of times in a number of different locations. This quest only becomes available once the quests [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]] and [[Skyrim:Rebuilding the Blades|Rebuilding the Blades]] are complete. If the quest [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|Paarthurnax]] is active this quest cannot be received until it is completed. In [[SR:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]], talk to [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] to see if he has discovered the location of a [[SR:Dragon|dragon's]] lair. If he has, he'll tell you that his research has uncovered a location, and will offer to send the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]] to meet you there. If you accept, the quest begins: a location is marked on the your map, and an entry is added to the Miscellaneous quests to "Kill the Dragon in ". Travel to the given location. The Blades recruited during Rebuilding the Blades will be waiting nearby. Once you arrive they will charge the lair, attacking the dragon. If you attack the dragon without having triggered the charge of the Blades, the attack will trigger the charge. Once the dragon is slain, the Blades will return to Sky Haven Temple, leaving you to loot the dragon and collect any nearby treasure. Return to Sky Haven Temple and tell Esbern the dragon is slain. This will end the quest but it is possible to repeat the quest if desired. ==Notes== *This can be a useful tool for finding some [[SR:Word Wall|word walls]] if [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]] will no longer provide the information after killing [[SR:Paarthurnax_(dragon)|Paarthurnax]]. *Blades who do not live at Sky Haven Temple will not appear to help you fight the dragon. This includes Blades whom you have [[Skyrim:Marriage|married]] and moved to one of your homes, and Blades whom you have made a [[Skyrim:Personal Steward|steward]]{{HF}} of a Hearthfire house. However, after you kill the dragon, they may sometimes move to Sky Haven Temple. They will eventually return to their proper homes. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Killing a dragon (in particular, if you've begun [[sr:Rebuilding_the_Blades|Rebuilding the Blades]] but have not started this quest yet) may sometimes add the "Return to Esbern" task to your quest log, but Esbern will not complete the quest for you.|USKP|1.2.5}} **{{Pc22}} You can use the console to finish the quest by entering setStage FreeformSkyHavenTempleB 100. {{Bug|Sometimes, upon starting the quest, the quest marker will show that the dragon is in a different, unreachable location.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} This can be fixed with the console by entering setStage FreeformSkyHavenTempleB 20. {{Bug|Sometimes Esbern won't give you a dragon to hunt.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Kill the Dragon in }} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Return to Esbern}} |missing=5, 15, 25, 100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

Skyrim:Destroying the Dawnguard.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=PrometheusTheElf |checkedBy= |reward=PrometheusTheElf |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Volkihar Vampire Clan}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Icon=SR-qico-Dawnguard Vampires.png |Giver=[[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]] or [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dayspring Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]], [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] |Reward=3 [[Skyrim:Potion of Blood|Potions of Blood]] (25%) or a leveled item (75%) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Kindred Judgment|Kindred Judgment]] (Vampire Side only) |Next= |Image=SR-place-Fort Dawnguard.jpg |Imgdesc=The Hunters become the Prey |description=Kill the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]] leaders. |ID=DLC1RV10 |Difficulty=Hard }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]] or [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]]. # Kill the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]] leaders at [[Skyrim:Fort_Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]]. # Return to Garan or Fura. ==Detailed Walkthrough== After completing [[Skyrim:Kindred Judgment|Kindred Judgment]], [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]] or [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]] in [[Skyrim:Volkihar_Keep|Volkihar Keep]] may offer this quest. You will be asked to kill the leaders of the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]] to "avoid an all-out war". Upon nearing [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]] in [[Skyrim:Dayspring_Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]], several Dawnguard members will turn hostile and attack you. Make your way into the fort. It is best to try and kill the leaders as stealthily as possible because in groups they can be difficult to defeat. [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] also uses a powerful spell called [[Skyrim:Stendarr's Aura|Stendarr's Aura]] that will drain your health if you come into melee range, but only if you are a vampire. Once you have defeated the leaders of the Dawnguard, return to Garan or Fura for your reward. He or she will congratulate you on killing the leaders of the Dawnguard, but comment that the Dawnguard will still remain active even with its leaders dead. == Notes == *All NPCs within Fort Dawnguard must be eliminated in order to complete this mission. There are eight in total: [[Skyrim:Agmaer|Agmaer]], [[Skyrim:Beleval|Beleval]], [[Skyrim:Celann|Celann]], [[Skyrim:Durak|Durak]], [[Skyrim:Florentius_Baenius|Florentius Baenius]], [[Skyrim:Gunmar|Gunmar]], [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]], and [[Skyrim:Sorine_Jurard|Sorine Jurard]]. *It is not required that you kill the Dawnguard members patrolling outside the Fort. [[Skyrim:Sceolang|Sceolang]] and [[Skyrim:Bran|Bran]] also don't need to be killed. *During this quest, Isran, Sorine Jurard, Florentius Baenius, and Gunmar are no longer considered essential and can be killed. *The Dawnguard members will be unaware of your presence at first, but once they're alerted, they will immediately attack on sight due to you being a Vampire Lord. This is despite the fact that Isran met you during [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (quest)|Dawnguard]] and sent you to [[Skyrim:Dimhollow Crypt|Dimhollow Crypt]] during [[Skyrim:Awakening|Awakening]], indicating he must have assumed that you became a vampire yourself, forcing him to rebuild the order alone. *You can use [[Skyrim:Calm|Calm]] or [[Skyrim:Pacify (spell)|Pacify]] on [[Skyrim:Sorine_Jurard|Sorine Jurard]] and [[Skyrim:Florentius Baenius|Florentius Baenius]] to buy the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard_Magic#Restoration_Spells|new Restoration spells]] and [[Skyrim:Bolt|bolts]] from them. This can be repeated until they are killed. ==Bugs== {{bug|Both Garan and Fura refer to Fort Dawnguard being in the Reach, when it's actually in the Rift.|UDGP|1.1.3|dlc=DG}} {{bug|The bodies of the Dawnguard members are never cleaned up once this quest is finished.|UDGP|2.1.1}} {{bug|Celann may have 15 crossbows on his corpse, which is clearly an error as it was a copypasta matching the amount of steel bolts he's given.|USSEP|4.3.7}} {{bug|Isran's "essential" flag might not get removed, meaning he can't be killed.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **Use the setstage DLC1RV10 100 or setstage DLC1VQ01MiscObjective 250 console command to bypass this. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10|| has sent me to destroy the Dawnguard leaders at Dayspring Canyon. {{Quest Objective|10|Kill the Dawnguard Leaders}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Return to }} |255|fin| sent me to Dayspring Canyon where I destroyed the Dawnguard leaders. }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]

Find another in the hand of the skeleton in the open coffin next to it, then search the closed coffin on the lowest shelf on the other side of the main entrance. # Read the [[Skyrim:Arch Necromancer's Final Instructions|final instructions]]. # Place the four Dreamer's Greater Soul Gems in the Soul Gem Holders. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Dreams of the Dead 02.jpg|right|thumb|Naara's body and journal]] Begin by approaching Mara's Eye Pond, which is southwest of Windhelm. By the water's edge, built into the side of a mountain, is a wooden door to Gallows Hall which the player can enter. As you approach the wooden door on the first floor of Gallows Hall, it will be slammed shut, the room will fill with a mist, and objects in the room will start to fly around. You will need to read [[Skyrim:Naara's Journal|Naara's journal]], which can be found next to [[SR:Naara|her body]], alongside three [[Skyrim:Naara's Plea|notes]]. The journal will mention that the map in the center of the room is a good place to start. Go to the map to find that there is a [[Skyrim:Arch Necromancer's First Clue|clue]] placed on top of it. Interact with the torches on the walls of the room based on the clue, which each torch given the name of a place in Skyrim, which will prevent any errors with trying to align cities and towns with the circle of sconces. The solution is as follows: #Morthal #Falkreath #Nightgate Inn #Fort Dunstad [[File:SR-quest-Dreams of the Dead 03.jpg|right|thumb|Pray to the shrine]] The mist will then dissipate and any flying objects will fall to the ground. Pick up the [[Skyrim:Staff of Worms|Staff of Worms]] and use it on the skeleton mage corpse lying within an open coffin in the eastern part of the room. Once resurrected, the skeleton mage can be searched to find the [[Skyrim:Arch Necromancer's Key|Arch Necromancer's key]]. This will unlock the safe next to the arcane enchanter. The safe contains the [[Skyrim:Bloodworm Helm|Bloodworm Helm]], random leveled treasure and the [[Skyrim:Arch Necromancer's Second Clue|second clue]]. Look for a small, white statue to Vaermina on the perimeter of the room and interact with it to pray. After praying, go to sleep in the bedroll* that is in the center of the room (see Notes). Once you wake up, the purple mist will reappear, there will be blurring at the edges of the screen and you will have to search the coffins in the room for three [[Skyrim:Dreamer's Greater Soul Gem|Dreamer's Greater Soul Gems]]. Two of them are within closed coffins and one is being held by a skeleton in an open casket. After picking up the third Soul Gem, the player will find themselves back at the altar in the middle of the room, and they should read the Arch Necromancer's [[Skyrim:Arch Necromancer's Final Instructions|final instructions]] that is upon it. Pick up the soul gem that is near Naara's corpse and head towards the table in the center of the room. Place all four soul gems (the three found in the dream, plus the one just now obtained) into the soul gems on the holders and activate the center of the altar. This will transform all four Greater Soul Gems into Black Soul Gems. With this, the quest will conclude. ==Notes== * Even if using Survival Mode{{CC|Survival Mode}}, you can pray at the Shrine of Vaermina for free. * Naara cannot be resurrected, even with the Staff of Worms. * Using the staff on the hooded skeleton is considered an assault. * You can use the Altar of the Revenant again and again after completing the quest, turning 4 filled or empty Greater or Grand Soul Gems into empty Black Soul Gems, and there does not appear to be a limit to this beyond the number of greater or grand soul gems you can get hold of. Given the scarcity of monsters with actual Grand-level souls, compared to the sheer number of available human or elven enemies that require a Black soul gem (Bandits, Necromancers, Conjurers, enemy civil war soldiers, Thalmor Justiciars, Dark Brotherhood victims, any non-essential NPC that you find particularly obnoxious, and so on), this is a good way to get a huge number of Black Soul Gems to fill easily. * Placing the soul gems in the holders will place Greater Soul Gems, in preference, before Grand Soul Gems. Gems without souls are prioritized over gems with souls. The resulting Black Soul Gems will be empty, regardless of the state of the original gem. * Sleeping during the second part of the quest ''will'' activate the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] quest, [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|With Friends Like These...]], so if you are trying to avoid doing that quest at this point in time, it is recommended to either do this quest before [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood#Joining|activating the Dark Brotherhood questline]], or if you've already activated it, then to wait to start this quest until you are ready to complete the Dark Brotherhood one (you will not be able to leave this quest once it's triggered). This is important because per [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood#Destroying the Dark Brotherhood|the Dark Brotherhood article]], the With Friends Like These... quest "will be your only opportunity to attack the Dark Brotherhood" if you ultimately decide you want to destroy them instead of joining them. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You can take the soul gem from the skeleton's hand before it's time and therefore be unable to finish the quest. On the PC, you could try setstage ccRMSSSE001_Quest 100, and if you were short by one soul gem continue with player.additem FE03BD09 1. ==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Another Escapee===
Speak to [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]] (or [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] if you have completed [[Skyrim:The Silver Hand|The Silver Hand]]) in [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]], who will give you a quest to kill an escaped [[Skyrim:Criminal|criminal]] in any of the nine holds.

The table below displays the different job descriptions for each possible hold: 
{| class=wikitable
!Hold
!Job Description

! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]]}}
| ''"It sounds like Eastmarch is too busy with their war to keep their own prisoners in line. One of them's escaped, and you're going to find that coward."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:The Reach|The Reach]]}}
| ''"The braggarts in the Reach always claim that no prisoner escapes their mine. What you don't hear about are the ones who break off from escorts on the way to Markarth."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]]}}

! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:The Pale|The Pale]]}}

===Find that Coward===
You will have to travel to the hold and search for the criminal (your quest marker will point to them). The criminal is constantly moving which will make it harder to fast travel to them. You can engage in dialogue with the criminal but after doing so they will become hostile. At this point, you can kill them without incurring a bounty. After this has been completed, return to the quest giver, who will give you a reward and comment, ''"Bit by bit, we bring honor to this land. And you've brought honor to the Companions. More importantly, some gold."''

===Reward===
{{SRCompanionsRadiantReward}}

==Notes==
* Once you have completed [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]], this quest is available indefinitely.
* The line for [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]], which references the [[Skyrim:Civil War|civil war]], doesn't change if you complete the civil war storyline.
* If guards witness the escaped criminal being hostile towards you, they will engage the criminal in combat. The quest giver will still give you credit for the kill, though.
* The quest giver may get the escaped criminal's gender wrong. For example, they may say ''"This man is known to be dangerous."'' only for your target to be a woman, or vice-versa.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]] or [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] at [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]].
# Travel to the randomly-determined location
# Retrieve the heirloom from the location's boss chest.
# Return the heirloom to Skjor or Vilkas for your reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Family Heirloom===
When you tell Skjor (or Vilkas) you are looking for work, he will say: ''"We have a bit of a sensitive matter this time. A wealthy family has... misplaced one of their heirlooms."'' or ''"Just in time. I was worried I'd have to do this myself. Some rich folk had a trinket stolen and they want us to get it back."'' He will then provide some information on the kind of place you need to go and what you are up against:
{| class=wikitable
!Enemy Type
!Job Description
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Bandit|Bandits]]}}
| ''"I tell you this province is losing its grip. The bandits become more brazen every day."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]]}}
| ''"Some don't even believe they exist, but the Falmer can be devious. Tunneling into homes, stealing off with valuables."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]]}}
| ''"Those hill people who call themselves 'the Forsworn' show no mercy."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Giant|Giant]]}}
| ''"Giants don't usually cause problems like this, but these ones are stirred up for some reason.."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Vampire|Vampire]]}}
| ''"The rumors say the culprits are vampires. I try not to listen to swaggle like that, but figured you should know."''
|-
! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Warlock|Warlocks]]}}
| ''"Of course, it's a group of wizards they're pointing their fingers at. Who knows what they want it for, but we want it back."''
|}

===The Location===
The stolen item is randomly determined, from a list that includes all standard unenchanted [[Skyrim:weapons|weapons]] in the game.  You are never told the name of the family who lost the item, only the hold in which they live.

[[File:SR-place-Snowpoint_Beacon.jpg|thumb|right|A [[Skyrim:Snowpoint Beacon|fort]] inhabited by [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]]]]
The target location is randomly chosen from 76 possible locations, amounting to a large fraction of the [[Skyrim:Dungeons|dungeons]] that contain boss chests.  The location will be limited to holds that you have previously visited, so early in the game you may only receive destinations within Whiterun Hold, but later in the game there are many more possible destinations.  Possible types of locations are: 
* A [[Skyrim:Bandit|Bandit]] Camp or Bandit-Occupied Fort: 23 possible locations ([[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Bandit Camps|Bandit Camps category]])
* A [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] Hive: 12 possible locations ([[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Falmer Hives|Falmer Hives category]])
* A [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] Camp: 7 possible locations ([[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Forsworn Camps|Forsworn Camps category]])
* A [[Skyrim:Giant|Giant]] Camp: 12 possible locations  ([[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Giant Camps|Giant Camps category]])
* A [[Skyrim:Vampire|Vampire]] Lair: 8 possible locations  ([[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Vampire Lairs|Vampire Lairs category]])
* A [[Skyrim:Warlock|Warlock]] Lair: 15 possible locations ([[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Warlock Lairs|Warlock Lairs category]])
(Note that the provided categories list all locations with the given type of occupant, including locations that do ''not'' have a boss chest and therefore cannot be possible destinations for this quest).

===Find the Heirloom===
At the chosen location, the item will always be found in the boss chest, which is typically at the end of the dungeon and guarded by a boss-level monster.  To complete the quest, all that you need to do is retrieve the item — although in the process of exploring the dungeon you may end up collecting other loot and killing various enemies.  Once you have the heirloom, return to the quest-giver (Skjor or Vilkas) and obtain your reward and three different responses: ''"Give it here. They've asked for the utmost discretion on this matter, so I'll make sure it gets to them. Here's your share of their reward."'', ''"And it looks undamaged. They'll be pleased, I'm sure. And we're pleased with their money."'' or ''"Nice work with this one. You make us all proud."''
