It can be found just across the bridge south of Ivarstead, traveling southeast up the nearby hill. It is between Geirmund's Hall and Honeystrand Cave. Here you can find and loot the body of an [[SR:Arena Fan|Arena Fan]] to obtain the ''[[SR:Arena Fan's Note|Arena Fan's Note]]'', as well as a copy of ''[[SR:The Crimson Dirks, v8|The Crimson Dirks, v8]]''. The book tells the tale of [[SR:Urgnok|Urgnok]], a former member of a gang of outlaws known as the [[SR:Crimson Dirks|Crimson Dirks]], who left his life of crime and ascended to the rank of Bloodletter in the [[Lore:Imperial City|Imperial City]] Arena before being forced to flee north to Skyrim. The quest will start upon reading the fan's note which reveals that the fan attempted to meet with this ex-combatant before his untimely death. Urgnok is apparently fighting in the local underground pits and didn't take kindly to being tracked down. The note states that he was recently spotted living at the [[SR:Ruins of Bthalft|Ruins of Bthalft]], a [[SR:Bandit|bandit]] camp to the south. Travel to Bthalft and you will find Urgnok living among the bandits. He will be easy to spot due to his full set of Dwarven Mail armor. Urgnok is hostile and will attack you on sight; kill him and take his armor to complete the quest. Once the quest is complete, Dwarven Mail items will begin to appear in leveled lists, meaning you will begin to find it as random loot or being worn by enemies. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * Dwarven Mail uses the same model as Dwarven armor in ''[[Blades:Blades|Blades]]''. *This is the heaviest Light Armor in the game. *The Ruins of Bthalft are also known as the location of the Aetherium Forge. ==Bugs== {{bug|The Arena Fan's corpse may despawn if you take too long to head to his camp.|Confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} This can be remedied by typing help "Arena Fan" 0 into the console. ==Quick Walkthrough==

# Obtain 18 pieces of firewood, 20 nails, 4 iron fittings and a lock.

# Wait 24 hours.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Soon after completion of [[Skyrim:Wave Breaker|Wave Breaker]], a courier will deliver you yet another [[SR:Letter from Viriya|letter]]. It's from Viriya. In her hiatus, she has decided to leave the Riften Fishery and run a Mudcrab merchant stall within the Riften "Grand Plaza." The objective is to bring her building materials for the stall. She needs: 18 pieces of Firewood, 20 Nails, 4 Iron Fittings and a Lock. Bring all the gathered items to her:

:'''Here's everything you'll need to build a stall in the plaza.'''
:''"By the Gods. I don't even know what to say."''
:'''I'll stop by the plaza tomorrow once you've gotten everything set up.'''

Wait for 24 hours. After that time goes by visit her new market stall in the Plaza. She'll thank you for helping her with her dream job and will commence to give you an enchanted amulet named [[Skyrim:Viriya's Charm|Viriya's Charm]]:
:'''Look's like you're all set up.'''
:''"It would seem so. I wanted to give you this, a token of my appreciation. Thanks, good luck out there."''

This ends the Fishing questline. Fishing radiant quests can still be done for [[Skyrim:Swims-In-Deep-Water|Swims-In-Deep-Water]] afterwards. These include the quests for: [[Skyrim:Further Study|Further Study]], [[Skyrim:Rubbish Retrieval|Rubbish Retrieval]] and [[Skyrim:Stocking Up|Stocking Up]].

==Notes==
*Once Viriya becomes a merchant, she will have 150 gold. You cannot invest with her, but her shop benefits from the [[Skyrim:Master Trader|Master Trader]] perk.

Skyrim:Finn's Lute.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=multiple |rewardChecked=Roger }}{{#addtotrail:[[Skyrim:Favors|Favors]]|separator=': '}}{{About|the quest|the item|Finn's Lute (item)}} {{Quest Header |type=Bards College |Giver=[[Skyrim:Inge Six Fingers|Inge Six Fingers]] |Reward=+1 point to all [[Skyrim:Stealth|Stealth]] skills |Disp==1 ([[Skyrim:Inge Six Fingers|Inge Six Fingers]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Stony Creek Cave|Stony Creek Cave]] |Image=SR-quest-Finn's Lute.jpg |ImgDesc=Finn's Lute |description=Return an invaluable [[Skyrim:Finn's Lute (item)|lute]] to [[Skyrim:Inge Six Fingers|Inge Six Fingers]]. |ID=BardsCollegeLute |Icon= |SuggLevel=6 }} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]] [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous-Favors]] ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Inge Six Fingers|Inge Six Fingers]]. # Locate [[Skyrim:Finn's Lute (item)|Finn's Lute]] in [[Skyrim:Stony Creek Cave|Stony Creek Cave]]. # Return for your reward of a 1-point increase to all [[Skyrim:Stealth|Stealth]] skills. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Unique Lute=== Right after the Burning of [[Skyrim:Olaf_One-Eye|King Olaf]] ends the quest [[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]], talking to the otherwise authoritarian [[Skyrim:Inge Six Fingers|Inge Six Fingers]] will be somewhat wistful. When asked, she will tell you that a year ago, thieves broke into the College and stole her most precious item: the very first eight course lute ever created, namely [[Skyrim:Finn's Lute (item)|Finn's Lute]]. As the Dean of Lute, Inge has been devastated ever since, but recently learned the location of the thieves, specifically [[Skyrim:Stony Creek Cave|Stony Creek Cave]], a cave in southeastern [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]]. ===Stony Creek Cave=== A small pond hides the entrance to the cave, complete with a dock and a boat. Upon entering, the sight of a waterfall and a dead Breton hanging from a tree trunk hints at things to come. Follow the only available path upstream and fight the expected [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] trying to protect their treasure. When the path splits in two, head right and beware of the [[Skyrim:Swinging Mace|swinging mace]] trap right before the chamber with the bandit leader. Pick the fight and search the body for ''[[Skyrim:Treasure Map X|Treasure Map X]]'', then look around the area for interesting items, including a copy of the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Mystery of Talara, Part_4|Mystery of Talara, Part 4]]'', an [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|unusual gem]], along with a few ingredients and an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]]. Finally, open the chest and claim the lute and some valuable loot. ===An Unexpected Lesson=== Before exiting the cave, it is possible to investigate the rest of the cave which will net you another fight against a bandit, along with a locked treasure chest, two [[Skyrim:Moonstone Ore Vein|moonstone veins]] and a waterfall hiding a shortcut from [[Skyrim:Kagrenzel|Kagrenzel]]. Exit the mine the way you came and return to the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]]. Back at the College, Inge Six Fingers will be overwhelmed with joy. As she is unable to pay what the lute is worth, she will instead teach you a few tricks she has picked up over the years, and raise each of your [[Skyrim:Stealth|Stealth]] skills by one point. This includes [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]], [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]], [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|Lockpicking]], [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pickpocket]], [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]], and [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After you turn in the quest, the lute will remain in your inventory, still marked as a quest item.|OSP|1.4}} **{{Pc22}} You can remove the quest item using the Console and the following console code: Player.removeitem 000DABAB 1 {{Bug|Finding the lute before the quest is assigned may result in the lute being stuck your inventory as a quest item even after finding Inge Six Fingers and telling her you have found it.|USKP|1.2.1}} {{Bug|Finding the lute early may also result the quest objective becoming stuck in your journal, even after returning the lute and receiving your reward.|USKP|1.2.1}} **To resolve this, click on the "I've found Finn's Lute" option in dialogue when you speak to Inge, rather than the "Why are you sad?" option. It works out just as if you had accepted the quest and then found it. **{{pc22}} Alternatively, you can use the console code setstage BardsCollegeLute 40 after accepting the quest, which will update it to telling you to give Inge the lute, allowing the quest to proceed as normal. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Journal Hidden|Thieves {{sic|stolen|stole}} Finn's Lute from the Bards College over a year ago. Inge Six-Fingers has asked me to recover the lute from their stronghold.}} {{Quest Objective|20|Find Finn's Lute}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Give Finn's Lute to Inge}} |200|fin| |missing=0, 15 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

The Jarl lives at the [[Skyrim:Jarl's Longhouse (Falkreath)|Jarl's Longhouse]] in [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. ==Quick Walkthrough== # Befriend the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. # Assist three people of [[Skyrim:Falkreath Hold|Falkreath Hold]]. # Return to the Jarl for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Thane of Falkreath.jpeg|thumb|left|The invitation from the Jarl{{HF|1}}]] This is an umbrella quest for several other quests that must be completed if you wish to become Thane of Falkreath. In order to receive it, you must first aid the current Jarl of Falkreath. If Siddgeir is Jarl, the previous quest will usually be to [[Skyrim:Kill the Bandit Leader (Jarl)|kill a Bandit Leader]]; however, if he was ousted from Falkreath during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] and reinstated following [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Neugrad|The Battle for Fort Neugrad]], that is sufficient to begin this quest. If Dengeir is Jarl, whether he was installed via [[Skyrim:Rescue from Fort Neugrad|Rescue from Fort Neugrad]] or [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], then the completion of that quest is sufficient to fulfill the prerequisite. Once you have completed the prerequisite, speak with the jarl again and he will ask you to [[Skyrim:Making Friends and Influencing People|assist the people of Falkreath hold]] three times in order to become Thane. This can be difficult as there are only a limited number of quests in the hold and the quest givers are non-essential, which could result in their death and irrevocable loss of potential quests. ==Radiant Options==
This is a radiant quest that you can receive from either [[Skyrim:Korir|Korir]] or [[Skyrim:Kraldar|Kraldar]], whichever is the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Winterhold (region)|Winterhold]]. The jarl lives at the [[Skyrim:Jarl's Longhouse (Winterhold)|Jarl's Longhouse]] in [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]].

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Befriend the Jarl of Winterhold.
# Assist three people of Winterhold.
# Return to the jarl for your reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This is an umbrella quest for several other quests that must be completed to become Thane of Winterhold. In order to receive this quest you must first aid the current jarl. If the jarl is Korir, then you must usually [[Skyrim:Dungeon Delving (Jarl - Caves)|Retrieve the Helm of Winterhold]] for him first; however, if he was ousted from Winterhold during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] and reinstated following [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Kastav|The Battle for Fort Kastav]], that is sufficient to begin this quest. If the jarl is Kraldar, whether he was installed via [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] or [[Skyrim:Rescue from Fort Kastav|Rescue from Fort Kastav]], then the completion of that quest is sufficient to fulfill the prerequisite.

Once you have completed the prerequisite, speak with the jarl again and he will ask you to [[Skyrim:Making Friends and Influencing People|assist the people of the hold]]. You must assist three people in the hold, usually by completing [[Skyrim:Favors|favor quests]] for them. Note that many of the quest givers are non-essential NPCs, so their deaths would result in a loss of potential quests to complete. If they die after you assist them, they still count towards your Thane status. You can also befriend merchants if you have the [[Skyrim:Investor|Investor]] perk by investing in their stores.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Approach an Orc stronghold.
# Speak with a member of the stronghold.
# Speak with a guard in the stronghold, if not the same person as the previous step.
# Retrieve [[Skyrim:The Forgemaster's Fingers (item)|the Forgemaster's Fingers]].
# Return the Forgemaster's Fingers to the chief of that stronghold.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
When you first approach any [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc stronghold]], a guard may stop you and tell you that the stronghold is exclusively for Orcs and that no outsiders will be permitted inside. As the other Orcs in the stronghold will tell you that you are not welcome, you must find an Orc guard in order to trigger the quest. If you ask the guard how they can be persuaded to grant you access, they will tell you to reclaim an item: [[Skyrim:The Forgemaster's Fingers (item)|the Forgemaster's Fingers]]. This item, which grants the wielder a +12 bonus to [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]], can be retrieved from a randomly determined location.

When you return and give the Forgemaster's Fingers to the chief, you will be permitted to enter all strongholds and will be named [[Skyrim:Blood-Kin|Blood-Kin]] of the Orcs.

==Radiant Options==
This is a [[SR:Radiant|radiant]] quest that you can receive from an Orc living in any [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc stronghold]] except [[Skyrim:Largashbur|Largashbur]]. You will be asked to bring the item back to that stronghold's chief. The location of the quest item is randomly determined based upon the quest-giver's hold (see table below for specific options).

==Notes==
* This quest's main purpose is to provide the [[Skyrim:Blood-Kin|Blood-Kin]] trait to players who don't already have it. As such, the quest generally can't be obtained by Orc players, or by players who have already become Blood-Kin through other quests.
* If this quest is active, other quests with grateful Orcs will not name you [[Skyrim:Blood-Kin|Blood-Kin]] as part of the reward.
* This quest cannot be unlocked in Largashbur due to that stronghold's unique quest, [[Skyrim:The Cursed Tribe|The Cursed Tribe]], taking priority. Completing the Cursed Tribe quest will also make you Blood-Kin, although this is not explicitly mentioned at any point during the quest itself.
* After completion of this quest, the Forgemaster's Fingers will not remain with the chief you gave them to, but instead will be placed into the inventory of the Orc who first gave you the quest, from whom you can pickpocket them back.

Skyrim:Flight or Fight.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Br3admax |reward=DragonFire |rewardChecked=Socratides }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Grosta|Grosta]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Heartwood Mill|Heartwood Mill]], [[Skyrim:Broken Helm Hollow|Broken Helm Hollow]] |Reward=Random enchanted weapon |Image=SR-quest-Flight_or_Fight.jpg |Imgdesc=A lonely woman |description=Help [[Skyrim:Grosta|Grosta]] at [[Skyrim:Heartwood Mill|Heartwood Mill]] locate her missing husband. |ID=FreeformHeartwoodMill |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Grosta|Grosta]]) |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Grosta|Grosta]] about her missing husband. # Locate [[Skyrim:Leifnarr|Leifnarr]] in [[Skyrim:Broken Helm Hollow|Broken Helm Hollow]]. # Return to Grosta for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Angry Wife=== [[Skyrim:Heartwood Mill|Heartwood Mill]], a remote lumber mill located where [[Skyrim:Lake Honrich|Lake Honrich]] turns into [[Skyrim:Treva River|Treva River]], seems less busy than other mills with only [[Skyrim:Grosta|Grosta]] working the mill and her son [[Skyrim:Gralnach|Gralnach]] fooling around on and off the road. If you talk to Gralnach, he will explain his father disappeared without a trace and left him and his mother alone with a mill to run. Talking to Grosta will reveal her suspicion that [[Skyrim:Leifnarr|Leifnarr]] ran off with another woman and that she can't run the mill by herself. She then explains how Leifnarr left to trade wood and grain with some merchants near the Morrowind border, specifically a place called [[Skyrim:Broken Helm Hollow|Broken Helm Hollow]], and will mark the place on your map. ===Merchants from Morrowind=== [[File:SR-quest-Flight_or_Fight_02.jpg|thumb|Right|A murdered husband]] When you arrive at Broken Helm Hollow, it quickly becomes evident that Leifnarr was set up, as two leveled [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] will guard the cave entrance. Dispose of them both and head inside then proceed down the narrow tunnel and into the main area of the dungeon. There, you will encounter two more leveled bandits around the fire, as well as the bandit chief who resides up the southeastern slope. The boss chest is unlocked, but beware the corresponding [[Skyrim:Traps#Swinging_Mace|swinging mace]] trap. Locate and read the [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-handed]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Battle of Sancre Tor|Battle Of Sancre Tor]]'', then find the pull chain straight south from the first set of bedrolls. Pull the chain and watch the rock wall disappear. Inside lies the dead body of Grosta's husband with an arrow through his chest. The room also consists of several severed limbs and blood spatters, along with a random [[Skyrim:Spell Tomes|spell tome]] and a weapons rack with lower level equipment. Activate the body to get the quest update, then leave the cave. ===The Grieving Widow=== Once you travel back to Heartwood Mill, you will have no choice but to tell Grosta she is now a widow, which will make her regret her suspicions about Leifnarr being unfaithful to her. For bringing her closure at last, Grosta will reward you with a leveled enchanted weapon, and her thanks. As a result of her friendship, you are now allowed to take the limited supplies from her house without penalty. You may also [[Skyrim:Cutting_Lumber|cut lumber]] freely at her mill for your [[Skyrim:Construction|player-built]] house, if you have [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] installed. ==Notes== * Although she expresses sorrow when you tell her of her husband's death, Grosta's ordinary dialogue does not change and she continues to say that all men are pigs after this quest has been completed. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Leifnarr's body is unnamed, identified only by the generic title of "[[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]]".|USKP|1.0}} {{Bug|There are two ways to begin this quest, and one of them breaks the quest. If you talk to Grosta and agree to help find her husband Leifnarr, the quest will activate stage 10 and then stage 20 once you find his corpse, allowing successful completion of the quest. But if you find the corpse first without talking to Grosta, the quest will activate stage 15, "Report Leifnarr's Death to his family", but no dialogue option will be added to Grosta to allow you to do so and there will be no map marker to tell you where to find her. There are a few workarounds:|USKP|1.0}} **{{Pc22}} Enter SetStage FreeformHeartwoodMill 20 into the console. This will set quest stage to "Find Leifnarr" and allow you to reactivate Leifnarr's corpse. You may then complete the quest normally. **{{Pc22}} Enter CompleteAllObjectives FreeformHeartwoodMill into the console. This forces the quest to be completed. **Killing Grosta will fail the quest and thus remove it from your journal. {{Bug|If Leifnarr's body is activated after completing the quest, the quest will restart in the breaking way shown above with stages 10 and 15 set to one and the other stages set to zero. |USKP|1.0}} **Absent the patch, the quest can be completed repeatedly by forcing the stages 20 and 30 to completion using console commands. (SetStage FreeformHeartwoodMill 20 and SetStage FreeformHeartwoodMill 30) The player will be rewarded each time with a weapon having a random enchantment. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |15||{{Quest Objective|5|Report Leifnarr's death to his family}} |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Find Leifnarr}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Return to Grosta}} |200|fin| |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

[[Skyrim:Ingun's Supply Chest Key|Ingun's Supply Chest Key]] |Image=SR-quest-Few and Far Between.jpg |Imgdesc=Ingun practicing |description=Help [[Skyrim:Ingun Black-Briar|Ingun]] restock [[Skyrim:Elgrim|Elgrim]]'s rare ingredients. |ID=FreeformRiften04 |SuggLevel=10 |Difficulty=Easy |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Ingun Black-Briar|Ingun Black-Briar]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Ingun Black-Briar|Ingun Black-Briar]]. # Gather 20 [[Skyrim:Deathbell|Deathbells]], 20 [[Skyrim:Nirnroot|Nirnroot]] and 20 [[Skyrim:Nightshade|Nightshade]]. # Return them to Ingun. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Black Sheep=== Ingun Black-Briar has fallen far from the Black-Briar tree. Instead of learning the family business with her brother, [[Skyrim:Sibbi Black-Briar|Sibbi]], she can be found devising alchemical recipes in [[Skyrim:Elgrim's Elixirs|Elgrim's Elixirs]]. The quality of her experiments seem to indicate a dark nature in this well-to-do girl, as she will allude to when speaking to her. Indeed, the ingredients she has depleted from [[Skyrim:Elgrim|Elgrim's]] stores are used to make some very powerful poisons. ===Helping Out=== Whether you speak to Ingun in Elgrim's Elixirs or find her walking through Riften, rouse her from her musings and ask her if she is an alchemist. She will reply: ''"I'm aspiring to earn that title, yes. However, the road ahead is paved with loose cobbles and deadly pitfalls. Master Elgrim says I'm a natural; that I have a unique talent. But I fear his approval masks his intolerance for my mistakes. My errant formulas have cost Master Elgrim a fortune in ingredients; some of which are almost irreplaceable."'' You are a helpful sort, so ask: "What sort of ingredients do you need?" Ingun will tell you: ''"To restore Master Elgrim's supply I would need 20 deathbell, 20 nightshade and 20 nirnroot. Am I sensing that you may be interested in gathering these rare ingredients for me?"'' Answer in the affirmative. Ingun will be pleased: ''"That means more time for my experiments and less time in the field. Much appreciated."'' ===Notable Harvest Locations=== Ingun needs you to hunt down 20 Deathbells, 20 Nirnroot, and 20 Nightshade. {| class=wikitable width=100% ![[Skyrim:Deathbell|Deathbell]] | Grows in the salt marshes of [[Skyrim:Hjaalmarch|Hjaalmarch]] and [[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]], including a number of specimens in both [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]] and [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. Planted specimens can be found in the [[Skyrim:Honeyside|Honeyside]] and [[Skyrim:Alchemist's Shack|Alchemist's Shack]] gardens, as well as [[Skyrim:Shalidor's Maze|Shalidor's Maze]] in [[Skyrim:Labyrinthian|Labyrinthian]]. They also grow near each city's [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead|Hall of the Dead]] or graveyard. Finally, you can cultivate this plant, if you have a garden or farm. |- ![[Skyrim:Nirnroot|Nirnroot]] |Grows near water anywhere. You can collect 9 samples from [[Skyrim:Sarethi Farm|Sarethi Farm]], which is close to Riften. See [[:File:SR-Skyrim-Map-Nirnroot.png|the Nirnroot distribution map]] to find the closest samples. |- ![[Skyrim:Nightshade|Nightshade]] |Grows in places of death. Check the cemeteries at [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], and [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. Also check [[Skyrim:Hamvir's Rest|Hamvir's Rest]] and outside the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]] west of Falkreath. Finally, you can cultivate this plant, if you have a garden or farm. |} ===Reward=== Ingun will reward you with leveled amount of gold (listed in the table below) for each set of ingredients brought to her. {{SRLeveledReward|small}} After you have delivered and been paid for all three samples, it will behoove you to see what else you can procure from her. Hint to her: "That was the last of the ingredients." To which she will reply: ''"Yes, Master Elgrim will be pleased I've restored his stock of these rare ingredients. I feel I owe a bit more than some meaningless coin for all your diligence. Here, this key unlocks my supply chest at Elgrim's Elixirs. Feel free to take what you need from time to time. I'll be refilling it once every few days or so."'' The chest is found in the back of Elgrim's Elixirs, and she will restock it with 2 - 5 random leveled potions every few days. She will also remind you of this each time you exit conversation with her as she will say: ''"Don't forget to check to check your supply chest from time to time."'' The chest will require the key Ingun gave you each time it resets. ==Notes== * It is possible to give the items to [[Skyrim:Ingun Black-Briar|Ingun Black-Briar]] then quickly exit out of the conversation and enter the item menu then drop the items. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Marise Aravel|Marise Aravel]].
# Find five [[Skyrim:Ice Wraith Teeth|ice wraith teeth]].
# Return to Marise.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Wander around [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] and you can find [[Skyrim:Marise Aravel|Marise Aravel]] and her food store at the market. She will introduce her food to you with pride: ''"My food is the best in all of Skyrim; always as fresh as the day it was collected."'' If you ask her the reason for this, she will tell you she picked up a trick from a butcher in [[Lore:Elinhir|Elinhir]], a small town over the border in [[Lore:Hammerfell|Hammerfell]]. Grinding up [[Skyrim:Ice Wraith Teeth|ice wraith teeth]] and using it as a preservative is the key to keeping everything fresh. Then she will ask you to bring five of the teeth to her to replenish her supply. If you ask her where to find ice wraiths, she will warn you of potential danger before suggesting that you travel to [[Skyrim:Ancient's Ascent|Ancient's Ascent]].  She will also add a marker for the location to your map.

You may buy ice wraith teeth from [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] shops, most of which have a 21% chance of carrying 1-4 samples. Five samples can be found in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Attainment|Hall of Attainment]] or [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr Living Quarters|Jorrvaskr Living Quarters]] and four in [[Skyrim:The White Hall|the White Hall]]. If you prefer to hunt some ice wraiths, you may be able to find them in the wilderness of [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. You can find ice wraiths in the following locations, although for Forsaken Cave, the path to High Hrothgar, and Tolvald's Cave it will depend on the Dragonborn's character level whether you find ice wraiths or different creatures:
* [[Skyrim:Ancient's Ascent|Ancient's Ascent]], recommended location, actually in [[Skyrim:Bonechill Passage|Bonechill Passage]]
* [[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]], outside by the entrance and in the natural cave area just inside
* [[Skyrim:The Midden|The Midden]], down the steps, past the skeleton sunk into the floor, in the icy room (does not respawn)
* [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]], the path to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]
* [[Skyrim:Tolvald's Cave|Tolvald's Cave]], outside by the entrance and in the first part of the first zone
* [[Skyrim:Weynon Stones|Weynon Stones]], two ice wraiths will ambush you there

Once you have the ice wraith teeth, return to Marise. She will be quite happy: ''"Perfect, just perfect! These should help keep my stock fresh for quite a while."'' She will reward you with an apprentice-level [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] [[Skyrim:Spell Tomes|spell tome]] (either [[Skyrim:Magelight|Magelight]] or [[Skyrim:Stoneflesh|Stoneflesh]]) and five [[Skyrim:Pheasant Breast|pheasant breasts]].  The spell tome is selected when you give Marise the ice wraith teeth, so if you save beforehand, you can reload until you get your preference.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Madesi|Madesi]] in his stall in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]].
# Gather one [[Skyrim:Mammoth Tusk|mammoth tusk]], one [[Skyrim:Gold Ore|gold ore]], and two [[Skyrim:Flawless Sapphire|flawless sapphires]].
# Return to Madesi.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Ringmaker 02.jpg|thumb|right|All the necessary components]]
Speak with [[Skyrim:Madesi|Madesi]] and ask him about his [[Skyrim:Jewelry|jewelry]]. You will learn that he is running low on supplies due to heavy [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandit]] presence on the roads and needs help gathering some components. He requires two [[Skyrim:Flawless Sapphire|flawless sapphires]], one [[Skyrim:Mammoth Tusk|mammoth tusk]], and one piece of [[Skyrim:Gold Ore|gold ore]].

Flawless sapphires, like all [[Skyrim:Gems|gems]], can be randomly found or [[Skyrim:Mining|mined]]. One guaranteed sample can be stolen from the shelves in the Inner Sanctum of the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]] in Markarth.

Mammoth tusks can be looted from slain [[Skyrim:Mammoth|mammoths]], as well as bought from [[Skyrim:Hunter|hunters]] and certain merchants. Three guaranteed samples can be found in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]'s [[Skyrim:The Arcanaeum|Arcanaeum]]; eight guaranteed samples can be found in [[Skyrim:Halted Stream Camp|Halted Stream Camp]]. The closest one is in [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Meadery|Black-Briar Meadery]], where it can be stolen from the shelves of a cupboard in [[Skyrim:Indaryn|Indaryn]]'s bedroom.

Gold ore can be found randomly in containers or in buildings, but an easy place to find some gold veins is in [[Skyrim:Kolskeggr Mine|Kolskeggr Mine]]. There's also [[Skyrim:Lost Prospect Mine|Lost Prospect Mine]]; while the latter is closer, it doesn't have as many veins as Kolskeggr Mine.  Alternately, one can just use [[Skyrim:Transmute Mineral Ore|the Transmute spell]] to turn one Iron Ore into one Gold Ore.

You can return the items to Madesi as you find them, or all at once. He will give you 100 gold for each item returned (i.e., 200 for the two sapphires). Once you've returned them all, ask Madesi if he needs anything else and he will thank you with a leveled necklace.
{{NewLine}}

==Notes==
* Completing this quest counts towards your eligibility for becoming [[Skyrim:Thane of the Rift|Thane of the Rift]].
* On a purely money-making basis, this quest is a financial loss.  Even at the lowest speech level, you can sell flawless sapphires (including to Madesi himself) for more then the quest reward of 100 per sapphire.  At higher speech levels, you can sell a mammoth tusk for more than 100 gold.  Purchasing the items for this quest will make the money loss even worse.
* Madesi will accept stolen goods in fulfillment of this quest, which may be useful if you are trying to avoid dealing with [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Fences|fences]] or spending a perk point on the [[Skyrim:Speech#Fence|fence perk]].
* You cannot toggle the objective in your journal for individual items; doing so will instead toggle all 3 items at once or the remaining two if you delivered one.
* [[Skyrim:Halted Stream Camp|Halted Stream Camp]] is the location of a [[Skyrim:Bounty:_Bandit_Boss|bounty quest]], possible location of a [[Skyrim:Dungeon_Delving_(Bandits)|Dungeon Delving]] quest from [[Skyrim:Amren|Amren]], and possible location of the [[Skyrim:Amulet of the Moon|Amulet of the Moon]] quest, making it easy to complete multiple quests at once if you choose to find your mammoth tusk there.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[Skyrim:Avrusa Sarethi|Avrusa Sarethi]] needs a large amount of [[Skyrim:Jazbay Grapes|jazbay grapes]] in order to cultivate [[Skyrim:Nirnroot|nirnroots]]. She's running low and unable to search out the ingredient herself, as she is preoccupied with her energetic sister and farm chores. She asks you to hunt down twenty grapes for her current nirnroot crop. As Avrusa notes, jazbay grapes are somewhat hard to come by. The plants are indigenous to the volcanic tundra region of [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]], and while desolate, the tundra is fairly easy to traverse with a few lesser [[Skyrim:Animals|animals]] and non-hostile [[Skyrim:Giant|giants]].  

There are a few locations where it can be found in greater quantities than usual. Along with the quantities available, they are:
* 49 around [[Skyrim:Steamcrag Camp|Steamcrag Camp]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 47 around [[Skyrim:Witchmist Grove|Witchmist Grove]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 35 around [[Skyrim:Eldergleam Sanctuary|Eldergleam Sanctuary]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 33 around [[Skyrim:The Atronach Stone|the Atronach Stone]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 31 around [[Skyrim:Bonestrewn Crest|Bonestrewn Crest]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 26 around [[Skyrim:Kynesgrove|Kynesgrove]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]]), especially along the road heading southeast
* 25 around [[Skyrim:Mistwatch|Mistwatch]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 24 around [[Skyrim:Broken Limb Camp|Broken Limb Camp]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 23 around [[Skyrim:Cronvangr Cave|Cronvangr Cave]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])
* 22 around [[Skyrim:Riverside Shack|Riverside Shack]] ([[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]])

Once you have collected twenty samples, head back to Avrusa who will thank you for your aid and reward you with five random potions. You can return to [[Skyrim:Sarethi_Farm|Sarethi Farm]] periodically to harvest [[Skyrim:Nirnroot|Nirnroot]] and [[Skyrim:Crimson_Nirnroot|Crimson Nirnroot]].

Patch]].}} ==Walkthrough== If you talk to one of the quest givers, they will have one or more dialogue options to sell them crops — one for each sellable crop that you currently have in your inventory. Each quest giver accepts specific crops that are grown on that farm, as listed in the above table. Several crops besides wheat are included in the quest. The "quest" consists of selecting one of the dialogue options, thus selling crops to the farmer. The implication is that you are being paid for harvesting crops from the farm, but in reality gathering or harvesting the crops is irrelevant. The farmers will accept vegetables from any source — those on the farm that they had previously harvested, ones that you found deep in an ancient tomb, ones that you pickpocketed from the farmer, or ones that you stole from the farm's kitchen table. In short, "Sell Vegetables" would be a more appropriate title than "Gather Wheat". There are several key differences between selling crops to farmers for this quest and selling crops to normal [[Skyrim:merchants|merchants]]: * Farmers always take all samples of the specified crop that are in your inventory. If you want to sell only a portion of your crops, store that portion elsewhere before talking to the farmer, then pick it back up when you're done. * Farmers will purchase any stolen samples. * The amount purchased is not limited by the farmer's available gold. * The farmers always pay you the base value of the crops, regardless of your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill and perks. This is the only way for low-level characters to receive money for various vegetables that cost 1 gold. * You never gain any Speech experience for the sale. After harvesting, crops will regrow when the farm [[Skyrim:Dungeons#Respawning|respawns]] after ten days. The reward for completing this "quest" is however much money you earn for the sale of your collected vegetables. This is not leveled, as it is the base value of the crops that is being used. Thus, your "reward" depends upon number of crops and the type of crop sold. ==Notes== * This quest does not have any stages or objectives. * This quest can be repeated indefinitely. * You cannot sell crops to either resident of [[Skyrim:Loreius Farm|Loreius Farm]], despite them also being farmers. * Money you earn from gathering crops is fixed and is not affected by your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill. This makes the quest one of the few ways to [[Skyrim:Making Money|make money]] without increasing any skills, which will help control your level. This is useful when wanting to [[Skyrim:Trainers|train]] in a certain skill as many times as possible. It is also one of the few ways to earn money without doing any questing, merchanting, or crafting. * Because this is a favor quest which affects the quest giver's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the [[Skyrim:Thane|thane]] quest for the quest giver's hold. * There is no one in the game that will buy carrots, green and red apples, and tomatoes, most likely because they don't exist as an actual plant (such as potatoes) in the game world in the base game. ** In the [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] add-on, you can plant and grow wheat, cabbage, potatoes, leeks, gourds, and carrots in a [[Skyrim:Greenhouse|greenhouse or garden]] of your [[Skyrim:Construction|player-built property]], and you can sell the wheat, cabbage, potatoes, leeks, and gourds to the people listed above. Unfortunately, there still is no one who will buy carrots off of you, and you also cannot plant nirnroot. * Selling wheat to [[SR:Tulvur|Tulvur]] at [[SR:Hollyfrost Farm|Hollyfrost Farm]] allows you to take low-value items freely from the [[SR:House of Clan Cruel-Sea|House of Clan Cruel-Sea]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Selling crops to Katla will allow you to ride the horses at [[Skyrim:Solitude Stables|Solitude Stables]] for free, due to her being in the same ownership faction as the stablemaster.|USKP|2.1.2|This has been adjusted to set ownership correctly.}}

== Walkthrough==
If you talk to one of the quest givers, they will offer to pay you for any ore you mine.  Each quest-giver will only accept a single type of ore, as listed in the above table. You can also mine ore without talking to a quest giver, and either sell them the ore later or use the ore yourself (e.g., by [[Skyrim:Smelter|smelting]] it).  For most ores you are paid its standard base value, with the exception of Iron Ore, for which you receive 7 gold instead of 2 gold.  The amount you are paid is fixed, and does not depend upon your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill or perks. All ore of the specified type will be purchased.

Information on how and where to mine is provided at [[Skyrim:Mining|Mining]].

== Achievements ==
An [[Skyrim:Achievements|Achievement]] is related to mining ore:
* {{achievement|Hard Worker|link=1}}
** To obtain this achievement you do not need to sell the ore, or even talk to any of the quest givers.  Simply activating an ore vein is sufficient.

==Notes==
* This quest does not have any stages or objectives.
* This quest can be repeated indefinitely.
* The dialogue option to sell the ore only appears if you have the specified type of ore in your inventory.
* The quest giver will buy all the ore of the specified type that you are carrying, so if you want to save any, you must remove it from your inventory first.
* Money you earn from mining ore is fixed, and if the ore is sold through direct dialogue rather than the merchant screen, is not affected by your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill. This makes the quest one of the few ways to [[Skyrim:Making Money|make money]] without increasing any skills, which will help control your level. This is useful when wanting to [[Skyrim:Trainers|train]] in a certain skill as many times as possible. It is also one of the few ways to earn money without doing any questing, merchanting, or crafting.
* Completing this quest at Redbelly Mine will raise your favor with the owner, Grogmar, and he will make you [[Skyrim:Blood-Kin|blood-kin to the Orcs]] as a result.
* Because this is a favor quest which affects the quest giver's disposition, it will count towards the "Help the People" part of the [[Skyrim:Thane|thane]] quest for the quest giver's hold.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
Talk to [[Skyrim:Wulf Wild-Blood|Wulf Wild-Blood]] in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. He will ask you to find his brother, [[Skyrim:Torkild|Torkild]]. Torkild will appear randomly while wandering Solstheim. While speaking with him, he will turn into a [[Skyrim:Werebear|werebear]] and you will be forced to kill him. Afterward, search his body and take the [[Skyrim:Torkild's Letter to Wulf|letter to Wulf]] from him. 

Return to Wulf Wild-Blood in Skaal Village and give him the letter. He will thank you, and give you a one point skill boost to several [[Skyrim:Combat|combat]] skills: [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]], [[Skyrim:Block|Block]], [[Skyrim:Heavy Armor|Heavy Armor]], and [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]].

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
=== Hunt for Jelly ===
The residing apothecary and [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] trainer in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], [[Skyrim:Milore Ienth|Milore Ienth]], sells a wide variety of exotic ingredients, all of which she grows and harvests herself. However, due to the harsh terrain and the dangers outside the [[Skyrim:The Bulwark|Bulwark]], she has problems gathering [[Skyrim:Netch Jelly|netch jelly]]. Tell her you are willing to help and she will immediately promise you a reward if you bring back five samples.

The netch jelly samples are dropped by the peaceful, but potentially dangerous, [[Skyrim:Netch|netch]] that can be found all over [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. If you have started (or completed) the quest [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]] you can gather the only two harvested samples of jelly in Solstheim, specifically deep within [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]], on an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]]. However, you will either need to visit an apothecary or go netch-hunting for the rest of the samples. The table below shows all fixed locations of the netch, which often reside in familial groups:

She lives in the [[Skyrim:Abandoned Building|abandoned building]] and can be found browsing the market every day between 8am and 8pm. She has fallen on hard times since [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]] closed and has spent all of her fortune made in the mine on drinking [[Skyrim:Sujamma|Sujamma]] and abusing [[Skyrim:Skooma|Skooma]]. When you get near her, she will remark: ''"Don't pity me. And don't look at me like that. I know what I am."'' You can then ask her why you should pity her and she will explain: ''"Doesn't everyone pity the hopeless? Look at me... I'm no better than a beggar."'' She then proceeds to explain that she drank her entire fortune away at [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|The Retching Netch]], or that she used to. When asked what happened she will explain: ''"That fetcher Geldis won't even allow me inside. Said I was bad for business. If I want to spend my last bag of coins getting drunk, that's my business. What does he care?"'' === The Concerned Innkeeper === Enter the Retching Netch, locate innkeeper [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] and ask him why Bralsa was banned from drinking at his inn. His explanation will reveal that he did it out of concern: ''"Have you seen the poor girl? She's a mess. She used to be richer than Councilor Morvayn and she's spending it all drowning her sorrow. As much as I love making coin, I can't watch her do that anymore. I won't."'' You can then choose between three options. You will need a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill level of at least 50 to persuade him. {|class=wikitable |- !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | She has a right to do what she pleases. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': I suppose you're right. If she wants to spend her life at the bottom of an ale mug, it's her right. Tell her she'll welcome back anytime.
'''Failed''': No, sorry. It isn't right.||'''Passed''': Return to Bralsa
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Let her back in, or you answer to me! '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Okay, okay. There's no need to get violent. If Bralsa wants to come back, she's welcome here... I swear.
'''Failed''': I'm not afraid of you. She's not coming in here, and that's that.||'''Passed''': Return to Bralsa
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Maybe this will change your mind. '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Well, there's morals, and then there's money. In this case, money wins. Tell Bralsa she's welcome here anytime.
'''Failed''': It's going to take more than that to change my mind.||'''Passed''': Return to Bralsa
'''Failed''': Nothing |} === Back to the Drink === Once you have convinced the concerned innkeeper to let Bralsa drink again, return to her and tell her the great news. She will be quite sarcastic in her response: ''"Well then, I suppose I'm off to do what I do best. Here. This was something I carried around in happier times. Maybe you can find a use for it."'' She will then hand you an enchanted weapon of the best possible quality as a reward. After that, Bralsa can be found at the Retching Netch every day between 6pm and 10pm, doing what she does best. == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Convince Geldis Sadri to admit Bralsa Drel to the inn}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Tell Bralsa Drel she's welcome at the Retching Netch}} |200|fin| |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Pantea's Flute.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Roger }}{{#addtotrail:[[Skyrim:Favors|Favors]]|separator=': '}} {{About|the quest|the item|Pantea's Flute (item)}} {{Quest Header |type=Bards College |Giver=[[Skyrim:Pantea Ateia|Pantea Ateia]] |Reward=+1 to all [[Skyrim:Magic Overview|Magic]] skills |Disp==1 ([[Skyrim:Pantea Ateia|Pantea Ateia]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]], [[Skyrim:Hob's Fall Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]] |Image=SR-item-Pantea's Flute.jpg |ImgDesc=Pantea's Flute |description=Find a missing [[Skyrim:Pantea's Flute (item)|flute]] for [[Skyrim:Pantea Ateia|Pantea]]. |ID=BardsCollegeFlute |Icon= |SuggLevel=8 }} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]][[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous-Favors]] ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Pantea Ateia|Pantea]] at the Bards College. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Hob's Fall Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]] and find her missing [[Skyrim:Pantea's Flute (item)|flute]]. # Return to Pantea for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Talking to Pantea=== When the Fire Festival marks the end of the [[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]] quest, talking to Pantea will bring up the topic of a flute: ''"That damn fool! I should {{sic|ring|wring}} her neck!"'' When asked to elaborate she will explain about a foolish student, [[Skyrim:Larina|Larina]], who stole [[Skyrim:Pantea's Flute (item)|Pantea's flute]] and sold it to a [[Skyrim:Necromancer|necromancer]], who believed in Larina's story about the flute being able to make the dead dance. Pantea is understandably upset as the flute has been passed down through seventeen generations, so she asks you to retrieve it for her – right away. ===Hob's Fall Cave=== A map marker will now point you towards [[Skyrim:Hob's Fall Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]], a necromancer den northeast of [[Skyrim:Frostflow Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]] in the [[Skyrim:Winterhold (region)|Winterhold]] region. While the cave itself seems straightforward, it has quite a few secrets worth exploring, so enter and take a look around. The ledge overlooking the first room is where you will return after a successful trek, so locate the icy path to the left and make your way through the tunnels and fight the hostile necromancers guarding the desk with a [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gem]] and a treasure chest. Proceed forward until you reach a suspension bridge. Look over the edge and notice the necromancer camp deep down below, with an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] and several bedrolls. Use the ledges to jump down for a surprise attack, then loot the camp for a rare [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|unusual gem]] and a copy of the [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Exodus|The Exodus]]''. ===Finding the Flute=== Head back up, using the path to get back on track, and then fight the necromancers guarding the next room. Examine the [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] for a copy of the [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Enchanter's Primer|Enchanter's Primer]]'', then activate the pull chain and either dodge or destroy the [[Skyrim:Spellcaster Trap|spellcaster traps]]. The final room is guarded by three necromancers and contains the chest with the flute, a [[Skyrim:Black Soul Gem|black soul gem]], and a locked cage containing a dead body. After taking the flute, jump down from the ledge and exit the cave the way you came in. Back in the Bards College, Pantea will be overwhelmed with joy and will teach you a few tricks she learned while playing for the Winterhold wizards, specifically a one-point boost to all your [[Skyrim:Magic Overview|Magic]] skills, including [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]], [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]], [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]], [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]], [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]], and [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]]. ==Notes== * [[Skyrim:Isabelle Rolaine|Isabelle Rolaine]]'s corpse is found at the entrance of the cave if you have started the quest [[Skyrim:Drowned Sorrows|Drowned Sorrows]]. * Hob's Fall Cave might be selected as the location for the [[Skyrim:Helm of Winterhold|Helm of Winterhold]] from the quest [[Skyrim:Dungeon Delving (Jarl - Caves)|Dungeon Delving]]. If this is the case, then it will be in the same chest as the flute. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The flute can be found before the quest is given, meaning the marker to turn the quest in never appears, nor will Pantea even offer the quest.|OSP|1.4}} **{{Pc22}} PC players can use this console command to advance the quest: setstage bardscollegeflute 40 {{Bug|After you turn in the quest, the flute will remain in your inventory, still marked as a quest item.|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} **{{Pc22}} PC players can remove the quest item using the following console code: Player.removeitem 000DABA7 1 {{Bug|It's possible that you can turn in the flute to Pantea but the quest won't complete.|USKP|1.2}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Find Pantea's Flute}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Return Pantea's Flute}} |200|fin| |missing=0, 15 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Rjorn's Drum.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=72.171.0.147 |checkedBy=Krusty |reward=multiple |rewardChecked=Roger }}{{#addtotrail:[[Skyrim:Favors|Favors]]|separator=': '}}{{About|the quest|the item|Rjorn's Drum (item)}}{{Quest Header |type=Bards College |Giver= [[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]] |Reward=+1 to all [[Skyrim:Combat|Combat]] skills |Disp==1 ([[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]]) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]], [[Skyrim:Halldir's Cairn|Halldir's Cairn]] |Image=SR-place-Halldir's Cairn.jpg |ImgDesc=What happened in [[Skyrim:Halldir's Cairn|Halldir's Cairn]]? |description= Retrieve a [[Skyrim:Quest Items#Rjorn's Drum|drum]] for [[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]]. |ID=BardsCollegeDrum |Icon= |SuggLevel=6 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous]][[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Miscellaneous-Favors]] ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]]. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Halldir's Cairn|Halldir's Cairn]]. # Retrieve [[Skyrim:Rjorn's Drum (item)|Rjorn's Drum]]. # Return to Giraud Gemane. ==Detailed Walkthrough== === The Dean of History === Once you have completed the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]] initiation quest [[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]], the Dean of History, [[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]], will start saying: ''"They found it! They actually found it!"'' When asked what 'they' found, he will explain: ''"Rjorn's drum! Nobody knows where he died, and therefore where his drum might be. Halldir was the missing link. Rjorn entered Halldir's Cairn in secret, and presumably died there. Now all I need to do is find someone to get it. Wait. You. You could do it. I need you to get me that drum."'' He then proceeds to explain why the drum is worth going through the trouble, as Rjorn was the most famous battle drummer of the second age and the drum itself was used at half a dozen famous battles. He finishes with: ''"Rjorn was always looking for new stories to tell. It seems he was writing a lay about Halldir when he vanished. That was the missing clue."'' Although the task sounds quite dangerous, Giraud will then resume to his usual routine while it is up to you to track down the drum. === Halldir's Cairn === [[File:SR-quest-Rjorn's_Drum_02.jpg|thumb|right|Three dead bodies and a beam of energy]] [[Skyrim:Halldir's Cairn|Halldir's Cairn]] is a cave, located a small ways southwest of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. Upon entering, it becomes obvious that something is very wrong in the cave, as you will find the bodies of three dead bandits, [[Skyrim:Agrius|Agrius]], [[Skyrim:Vidgrod|Vidgrod]], and [[Skyrim:Raen|Raen]]. The three bodies lie around a huge beam of blue light that shoots into a hole in the ceiling, and the various skeletal remains suggest that the position of the dead bandits are not coincidental. Nearby are the three bed rolls, while a pedestal conveniently holds the [[Skyrim:Key to Halldir's Crypt|key to Halldir's crypt]] along with a [[Skyrim:Agrius's Journal|journal]] written by Agrius, detailing the last days of the three bandits: '''''"Never thought I'd see the day we were run out of the [[Skyrim:Knifepoint Ridge|Knifepoint Gang]]. Least the storm should cover our tracks. Vidgrod, Raen, and I took shelter in a cave for the night. Looks like there's an old ruin here. Least there are no Draugr around."''''' Unlock the iron door to the southwest and head up the spiral staircase. Pick up the various [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]] along the way and head west at the intersection. As you approach the wooden door, two [[Skyrim:Undead#Ghost|ghosts]] will attack you, so dispose of them and unlock the door. === Tombs of the Undead === You will enter some catacombs, with another ghost getting up from a throne as you approach. Head up the western set of stairs, past the [[Skyrim:Bone Chimes|bone chimes]], to another tomb, where [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] enemies will start to rise from their graves, along with more ghosts. A pedestal holds a useful copy of the spell tome [[Skyrim:Raise Zombie|Raise Zombie]], while the handle to raise the iron bars is found behind the throne. '''''"Something's wrong. Raen hasn't said a word since she woke up this morning, just keeps staring off into space. Vidgrod isn't much better. They sick? Not like any illness I ever heard of. I'd just walk out on them, but I can't seem to get up the nerve. I feel like something's holding me back. What is this place?"''''' The next chamber contains a puzzle with [[Skyrim:Rune_Totems|rune totems]] so clear the area of undead and consider picking the lock on the door to the southeast for a locked chest with minor loot. The puzzle is quite simple; the rotating symbols can be found on the pillar in the center of the chamber and need to match the symbols on the wall opposite them. Once all three are positioned correctly, pull the lever and watch the stone wall to the north disappear. Two more ghosts await in the next area and, while you can proceed up the stairs to the north, the western path has a [[Skyrim:Tripwire|tripwire]] triggering a [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|battering ram]] from the ceiling. At the dead end is a chest set up with a [[Skyrim:Tension_Cable|tension cable]] that will release the [[Skyrim:Flamethrower_Statues|flamethrower statue]], so approach with caution. Take the stairs to the north until you reach your final destination, the chamber of Halldir: === Halldir === '''''"We're not alone. I can hear him now. Someone, speaking in my mind. Old. Powerful. Halldir, that's the name. He wants something from us. Needs us to stay for the magic to work. I tried to run, can't. Just like them."''''' [[File:SR-quest-Rjorn's Drum 04.jpg|thumb|right|The powerful draugr, Halldir]] The chamber is where the blue beam of light ends and as you approach, a powerful draugr, [[Skyrim:Halldir|Halldir]], will be immersed in it. He is a leveled draugr caster with several [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] spells. He'll begin to speak in an ancient [[Skyrim:Nord|Nordic]] tongue as you start to take away his health. At about 66% health, he will disappear and split into three different elemental versions of himself. All three are casters and are spread out enough to make this part rather difficult; as such, [[Skyrim:Resist Magic|magic resistance]] is recommended. The cold and fire casters are close to the room's entrance, while the lightning version sits apart. Focus on taking out the fire one first as his fire spells will cause massive burst damage. The cold one should be next, as he can severely reduce your movement speed. Finally, take out the lightning version of Halldir, and his ghost should materialize in the very center of the blue beam, obviously living off the souls of the three dead bandits below and before them, Rjorn. His ghost is not particularly powerful but carries the unique [[Skyrim:Halldir's Staff|Halldir's Staff]] with a [[Skyrim:Pacify_(effect)|Pacify]] enchantment, so dispose of the draugr quickly. After the battle, the blue beam of light will disappear and everything goes quiet. You will now have free access to the boss chest, where [[Skyrim:Rjorn's Drum_(item)|Rjorn's Drum]] is hidden, along with a huge amount of valuable loot. Lastly, open the trap door in the middle and follow in the footsteps of Agrius, Vidgrod, and Raen - and legendary battle drummer Rjorn: '''''"Raen jumped first. Onto the cairn. That's what Master wants - blood, sacrifice, power to live again. His magic, I can feel it pulsing in my blood. He's draining us. We'll serve him soon, our bodies, our souls. Just like the others. They're waiting. It's my turn."''''' === Return with the Drum === Return to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and find Giraud Gemane. When you show him the drum he will be overwhelmed with joy: ''"At last! I have searched for this drum for 20 years. The college treasury is a bit thin right now. But I can show you some tricks I learned from my days with the army."'' He will then raise all your [[Skyrim:Combat|Combat]] skills by one point in return. This includes [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]], [[Skyrim:Block|Block]], [[Skyrim:Heavy Armor|Heavy Armor]], [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]], [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]], and [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-handed]]. {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * It is possible to sneak in slowly and kill Halldir using a sufficiently powerful bow attack just as the draugr-form appears. This will bypass the fight with Halldir and his clones. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After you turn in the quest, the drum will remain in your inventory, still marked as a quest item.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|If Giraud Gemane dies before receiving the drum, it will remain in your inventory as a quest item.}} **{{pc22}}The drum can be removed from your inventory with the console command player.removeitem daba9 1. {{Bug|If you find the drum before activating the quest, it will not be marked as completed even after returning the drum.|USKP|1.2}} **{{pc22}}On PC, you can prevent this by typing SetStage BardsCollegeDrum 40 before returning the drum. {{Bug|After killing Halldir, if he dropped his staff, you can get two copies by looting his remains and picking it up off the floor (either order).|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|The pillars for the rune totem puzzle may not move when activated.}} {{Bug|In Skyrim Special Edition, instead of splitting himself into three clones, Halldir sometimes just disappears. The player is left locked in the room with the drum but no staff and no way of opening the exit.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Journal Hidden|Giraud Gemane of the Bards College has found a clue to the location of the legendary drum of Rjorn. He's asked me to go to Halldir's Cairn and retrieve it.}} {{Quest Objective|20|Find Rjorn's Drum}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Give Rjorn's Drum to Giraud}} |200|fin| |missing=0, 15 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Travel to a [[SR:Stables|stables]].
#Purchase a map and book for 250 gold.
#''(Optional)'' Track down and [[Skyrim:Horses#Tamable_HorsesCC|tame]] all seven wild horses.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Horse Tamer===
Upon reading ''[[Skyrim:Soran's Journal|Soran's Journal]]'' located on [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub's]] desk in [[Skyrim:The Arcanaeum|the Arcanaeum]], this quest will automatically begin and will direct you to the nearest [[SR:Stables|stables]].{{vn|how is this selected?}} You will need to speak with the hostler, i.e. the NPC who sells [[SR:Horse|horse]]s. (NOTE: I received the opportunity at the Whiterun Stables in a new game to buy the map without performing any of the actions previously outlined.) You will be presented with the option to purchase a wild horse map for 250 gold. You will receive both a [[Skyrim:Map of Wild Horses|Map of Wild Horses]] and a book called ''[[Skyrim:Wild Horse Notes|Wild Horse Notes]]''. In conjunction with reading the book, the map can be examined in your inventory in order to locate seven [[SR:Wild Horse|wild horses]].

Upon making this purchase, this quest will conclude. However, you will then receive seven miscellaneous objectives tasking you with locating and [[Skyrim:Horses#Tamable_HorsesCC|taming]] every wild horse. The objectives themselves are rather useless as they do not provide a map marker for the individual horses. Instead, you will need to use the map and book to travel to the approximate location and search for the horse. The book itself advises that [[Skyrim:Detect Life (spell)|Detect Life]] will be useful in carrying out this task. Note that wild horses will flee if you get too close, so it may help to sneak up on them.

To tame a wild horse, you must remain mounted on the horse while it bucks. It has a chance to ragdoll you when bucking, which will force you to chase down the fleeing horse once you get back on your feet. [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneaking]] can help prevent the horse from fleeing too far. Once mounted for a sufficient length of time, the horse becomes an owned mount. If you switch to a different mount, it will slowly make its way back to the location you originally found it.

===Find and tame the Black Horse===
This horse can be found northwest of [[SR:Falkreath|Falkreath]], just south of the map marker for [[SR:Evergreen Grove|Evergreen Grove]]. The book refers to nearby ruins, the ruins in question being Cracked Tusk Keep. This location is close to a [[SR:Necromancer|necromancer]]'s ritual site, and the resident necromancer might interrupt the taming process if you get too close.

===Find and tame the Chestnut Horse===
This horse can be found east of [[SR:Helgen|Helgen]], along the path leading towards [[SR:Falkreath Stormcloak Camp|Falkreath Stormcloak Camp]]. It's off of the north side of the road, just under halfway from Helgen to the Falkreath Stormcloak Camp.

===Find and tame the Dapple Brown Horse===
This horse can be found in the forest south of [[SR:Solitude Sawmill|Solitude Sawmill]], across the river but before you reach the [[SR:Dragon Mound|dragon mound]]. This can obviously be a dangerous place to tame a horse if the [[SR:Dragon|dragon]] is still nearby.

===Find and tame the Grey Spotted Horse===
This horse can be found up the hill to the north of [[SR:Salvius Farm|Salvius Farm]], directly east of the [[Skyrim:Markarth Stables|Markarth Stables]]. Beware the nearby [[SR:Sabre Cat|sabre cat]]s who will attack you and the horse if you get too close.

===Find and tame the Pale Mare===
This horse can be found among a group of snowy pines just south of [[SR:Yngol Barrow|Yngol Barrow]].

===Find and tame the Red Horse===
This horse can be found on the plains of [[SR:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun Hold]], northwest of [[SR:Whiterun Stables|Whiterun Stables]]. It is a very easy mount to locate and tame, particularly at the start of the game.

===Find and tame the White Spotted Horse===
This horse can be found directly west of [[SR:Stony Creek Cave|Stony Creek Cave]], west of the road, on a green cliff overlooking the volcanic tundra below.

==Notes==
*Each wild horse can be [[Skyrim:Horses#Horse_NamingCC|named]] and [[Skyrim:Horses#SaddlesCC|saddled]], which are two other mechanics added by this Creation. To do this, you must visit a stable with the horse as your active mount.
*Horses on even slight inclines will sometimes throw you further than expected, possibly causing significant damage or killing you.
*Wild horses will return to where you tamed them if you change to a different horse.

Skyrim:Salty Sea-Dogs.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=RobinHood70 |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }} {{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors/Radiant |Giver=[[Skyrim:Captain Wayfinder|Captain Wayfinder]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]], [[#Radiant Options|Radiant]] |Reward=[[#Reward|Leveled Gold]] |Image=SR-quest-Salty Sea-Dogs.jpg |Imgdesc=Captain Wayfinder and his crew |description=Find some [[Skyrim:Fine-Cut Void Salts|void salts]] for an inexperienced [[Skyrim:Captain Wayfinder|sea captain]]. |ID=FreeformShipsDawnstar |radiant=yes |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Captain Wayfinder|Captain Wayfinder]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[Skyrim:Captain Wayfinder|Captain Wayfinder]] on his ship at the dock in [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]]. #Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Fine-Cut Void Salts|salts]] from the given location. #Return to Captain Wayfinder and receive your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Captain Wayfinder=== In central Dawnstar, you will find the ship [[Skyrim:The Sea Squall|The Sea Squall]] permanently docked, with inexperienced sailor [[Skyrim:Captain Wayfinder|Captain Wayfinder]] and his team of disrespectful crewmembers wandering around on deck. Talk to Wayfinder and ask him about the ship and he will provide a bit of background information on his questionable status as captain. He will also hint at problems with his latest shipment, some [[Skyrim:Fine-Cut Void Salts|fine-cut void salts]] from the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] that have gone missing. When asked what happened to the salts he will reveal: ''"Sailors are what happened to them. They got drunk and ended up losing the merchandise in some cave. If you're not afraid of little exploring, I'll pay good gold to get those salts."'' ===Find the Salts=== At this point, it is no longer possible to reject the favor and a map marker will point towards one of eight radiant locations. '''Possible locations''': {{LinkList|Brood Cavern|Clearspring Tarn|Forsaken Cave|Harmugstahl|Hillgrund's Tomb|Rebel's Cairn|Swindler's Den|Yngvild|sep= • |ns_base=Skyrim}} Travel to the selected location and locate the fine-cut void salts in the boss-leveled chest, then head back to Dawnstar and the Sea Squall. When you hand him the salts, a grateful Captain Wayfinder will hand you a leveled amount of gold, with his thanks: ''"That's the first bit of good news I've had since I set sail a year ago. Here's your cut."'' ===Reward=== {{SRLeveledReward|large}} ==Notes== * In the ''[[Books:The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima Official Game Guide]]'', this quest is referred to as '''Salt of the Seas'''. *The fine-cut void salts that you are asked to find are actually just regular [[Skyrim:Void Salts|void salts]], except it is a unique sample of the salts that have been given a different name. * All eight samples of fine-cut void salts spawn in the possible locations when you first visit Dawnstar. Finding them will not start the quest and only the sample indicated after speaking to Wayfinder will function as a quest item and net you the reward. * If the game decides to send you to a location where you already found the salts, and you still have the original sample in your inventory, a new sample will spawn at the location, but you will miss out on the map marker. * If you find any of the samples before starting the quest, the fine-cut version can be consumed like normal void salts. **Trying to consume the salts selected for the quest results in the rather rare error message "You cannot eat quest items." ==Bugs== {{Bug|The fine-cut void salts may stay in your inventory after receiving the payment and finishing the quest. This often happens if you have regular [[sr:Void Salts|void salts]] in your inventory (or if you carry another sample of the fine-cut version) when you return to Captain Wayfinder. They are no longer a quest item.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|It's possible to run across a second batch of fine-cut void salts in another location. If you've already completed the quest, you can turn them in again for another reward.|USKP|1.0}} {{Bug|If you find a sample of Fine-Cut Void Salts prior to obtaining the quest, it will automatically put the quest in your Miscellaneous log. If you then speak to Captain Wayfinder and pick any topic other than, "I have the Fine-Cut Void Salts", he will finish his dialogue and then never speak to you again, making it impossible to finish the quest. This can sometimes be fixed by using the console command setstage freeformshipsDawnstar 20. When it works, this ends the quest and removes the fine-cut void salts from your inventory.|USKP|2.0.9}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Find the Fine-Cut Void Salts for Wayfinder}} |15||{{Quest Objective|15|Bring the Fine-Cut Void Salts to Wayfinder}} |20|fin| |missing=200 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Find the Thalmor Assassin.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]] |Reward=[[#Reward|Leveled gold]] |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] |Image=SR-npc-Malborn 05.jpg |ImgDesc=Malborn is down on his luck |description=The [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] are after [[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]]. Help him get to safety. |ID=MQ201Malborn |Icon= }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]] after the quest [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]]. # Locate the [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Ri'saad|Ri'saad]]. # Kill the assassin. # Return to Malborn. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===An Old Friend=== If you manage to get [[Skyrim:Malborn|Malborn]] out of the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Embassy|Thalmor Embassy]] alive during [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], after the end of that quest, he will run all the way to [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] seeking shelter in the [[Skyrim:New Gnisis Cornerclub|New Gnisis Cornerclub]], a [[Lore:Dunmer|Dunmer]] tavern located in the Gray Quarter. If you used [[Skyrim:Brelas|Brelas]] as a distraction during that quest, she will be nearby (see [[#Bugs|Bugs]]). Upon your next visit anywhere near the city of [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] a hidden timer of 1 in-game day starts, so be sure to receive and complete this quest fast. Approaching Malborn in the New Gnisis Corneclub will have him explain his situation: due to his treachery, he is obviously blacklisted by the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] so he has decided to flee to [[Lore:Morrowind|Morrowind]]; however, every time he tries to sneak out of Windhelm, he sees a suspicious [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]] outside the gates. Convinced that the Thalmor have sent an assassin to kill him, and still blaming you and [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] for putting him in a tight spot, the scared Malborn is now stuck in the Cornerclub and will request your assistance to get him to safety. [[File:SR-npc-J'datharr.jpg|thumb|right|An assassin waits for his prey outside Windhelm]] ===A Stranger in Their Midst=== Malborn will not provide a description of the alleged Khajiit assassin, saying only that he is standing outside the city gates. Your map marker will disappear when you exit Windhelm, so cross the bridge and make your way to the [[Skyrim:Windhelm Stables|Windhelm Stables]] where [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders#Ma'dran's Caravan|Ma'dran's Khajiit caravan]] usually camps (it may or may not be there, depending on its schedule). If the hidden timer hasn't run out yet, instead of Ma'dran's group, [[Skyrim:Ri'saad|Ri'saad]] and [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders#Ri'saad's Caravan|his caravan members]] will be there, way off course from their usual route. In any case there will always be at least one Khajiit named [[Skyrim:J'datharr|J'datharr]] present, who stands apart from any others. To unmask the real assassin, speak to the caravan Khajiits. A specific dialogue cue will appear when you speak to Ri'saad: :'''I'm looking for a Khajiit... might be a Thalmor spy.''' ::''"Ah. You must mean that one over there. He's not one of us. Thalmor filth, eh? Giving all Khajiit a bad name."'' Doing so will allow you to confront the stranger in dialogue. When approached, J'datharr will initially try to brush you off, but upon hearing that you have a message from Malborn, he'll reply with: ''"Malborn? Ah... very good. I think we understand each other"'' and become hostile. The Khajiiti caravanners will not intervene on either side, so it's a simple duel to the death. After the fight, you can loot his body to find [[Skyrim:J'datharr's Note|J'datharr's Note]], obviously written by the Thalmor. Lastly, return to New Gnisis Cornerclub to tell Malborn the good news. He will be grateful and reward you with some of the gold he stole from the Thalmor. He will then leave Windhelm, running towards the safety of Morrowind; after passing [[Skyrim:Refugees' Rest|Refugees' Rest]], he disappears from the game and the quest will be complete. If Brelas was at the Cornerclub with him, she will also flee to Morrowind and disappear from the game. ===Reward=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; margin:0.5em 0;" ! Levels !! Reward |- |1-5 || 50 |- |6-10 || 100 |- |11-15 || 150 |- |16-20 || 200 |- |21+ || 250 |} ==Notes== * If you used [[Skyrim:Brelas|Brelas]] as a distraction during [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], whether or not you freed her from the dungeon, she will join Malborn in Windhelm (see [[#Bugs|Bugs]]), and also accompany him to Morrowind. However, no-one will acknowledge her presence, nor will she gain any new dialogue. * After freeing Malborn during [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], Ri'saad and his caravan will move near [[SKyrim:Windhelm Stables|Windhelm Stables]]. They resume their usual schedule when the hidden timer runs out or when the assassin is dead. * The 1 in-game day timer is triggered by the player arriving anywhere near Windhelm after Malborn flees during [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]]. ** {{Pc22}} To check the 1 in-game day timer you can use the console command sqs MQ201Malborn: if Stage 110: 0 you still have time, if Stage 110: 1 it has run-out. * After killing the assassin, to avoid script conflict, it is safe to wait 24 in-game hours to make sure the hidden timer runs out before telling Malborn the assassin is dead. * Immediately after learning of the assassin's death, Malborn (and Brelas if present) leaves the city. He will run all the way to [[Skyrim:Refugees' Rest|Refugees' Rest]], and get disabled from the game once reaching the podium with the [[Skyrim:Decree of Monument|Decree of Monument]]. ** As weak characters, they are high risk for dying from an animal or bandit attack on their run toward Morrowind. To prevent this, either accompany and defend them, or clear the animal and bandit attack spawn points along the route prior to informing Malborn that the assassin is dealt with. Waiting/fast traveling also lets the game safely disable them. * If Malborn dies (even after receiving the reward) before he is disabled, the quest will fail. * According to the Creation Kit, there was supposed to be a way for you to betray Malborn by telling him there was no assassin, letting him believe it was safe for him to flee to Morrowind only to find his killer waiting for him just outside the city's stables. This option didn't make it to the final version of the game. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you freed Brelas from the Thalmor Embassy Dungeon during [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], after arriving in Windhelm she runs over to the left of [[Skyrim:Candlehearth Hall|Candlehearth Hall]] and vanishes, rather than going to [[Skyrim:New Gnisis Cornerclub|New Gnisis Cornerclub]].|USKP|2.0.8}} {{Bug|If you miss speaking to Ri'saad before the 1 in-game day timer runs out, he will return to his usual route and the final dialogue with the assassin cannot be unlocked, preventing the quest from progressing.|confirmed=1}} ** If you manage to move Ri'saad near [[Skyrim:Windhelm Stables|Windhelm Stables]] (for example by making him follow you, casting a [[Skyrim:Frenzy (effect)#Spells|frenzy spell]] on him and [[Skyrim:Pacify (effect)|pacifying]] him afterwards) his dialogue option will reappear. ** Killing J'datharr will advance the quest. If you don't want to just attack him in cold blood, cast a [[Skyrim:Frenzy (effect)#Spells|frenzy spell]] on him; even if his level is too high to be affected, he will turn hostile, allowing you to kill him and continue the quest. This skips two Stages but won't cause any script conflict. **{{Pc22}} The console command setstage MQ201Malborn 30 will place a quest marker on the assassin and allow you to talk to him. After picking ''"Malborn has a message for you."'' he will turn hostile and you can kill him normally. {{Bug|J'datharr carries a nameless object. When dropped, it turns into a large red square with a pink exclamation mark inside it and cannot be picked back up. This is due to the item lacking a world model; the item is actually a world item internally known as HelgenCandleLight01NS, a light source to be specific. It is unknown why he possesses this, but it could be due to him needing a light source for his torch holding animation.|USKP|1.2|He now has a normal torch item in its stead.|trackerid=274}} {{Bug|{{Pc22}} If you have the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] installed, it moves dialogue from Ri'saad to [[Skyrim:Ma'dran|Ma'dran]] (and related [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders|caravans]]). This change is not listed in [https://www.afkmods.com/Unofficial%20Skyrim%20Legendary%20Edition%20Patch%20Version%20History.html USLEEP's changelog] nor in [https://www.afkmods.com/Unofficial%20Skyrim%20Special%20Edition%20Patch%20Version%20History.html USSEP's changelog].}}{{vn|does it happen with USLEEP too?|section=It is always Ri'saad}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Journal Hidden|I met Malborn hiding out in Windhelm. He thinks there's a Thalmor assassin on his trail, a Khajiit, waiting for him outside the city. I promised I'd take care of this assassin, if there really is one.}} {{Quest Objective|10|Find the Thalmor assassin}} |100||{{Journal Hidden|I met Malborn hiding out in Windhelm. I killed the Thalmor assassin who was on his trail. I should let him know it's safe for him to leave Windhelm.}} {{Quest Objective|20|Tell Malborn the assassin is dead}} |150|fin| |missing=0, 10, 15, 30, 50, 80, 110, 200, 300 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}
