{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Dreamshadow |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Eddie the head |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Ondolemar|Ondolemar]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] |Reward=Leveled gold |Image=SR-quest-Search and Seizure.jpg |Imgdesc=Ondolemar is ready to root out all Talos worship in Markarth. |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Ondolemar|Ondolemar]])
=-1 ([[Skyrim:Ogmund|Ogmund]]) |description=Find evidence of a [[Lore:Talos|Talos]] [[Skyrim:Ogmund|worshipper]] for the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]]. |ID=FreeformMarkarthM }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Ondolemar|Ondolemar]]. #Steal [[Skyrim:Ogmund|Ogmund]]'s [[Skyrim:Ogmund's Amulet of Talos|Amulet of Talos]] from [[Skyrim:Ogmund's House|his house]]. #Return to Ondolemar. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Thalmor's Task=== Ondolemar is a [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] [[Skyrim:Thalmor Justiciar|Justiciar]] living in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. You can find him pacing in front of the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]]'s throne room in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]], accompanied by two [[Skyrim:Thalmor Soldier|Thalmor Soldiers]]. Talk to him and he will tell you his duty in Markarth. ''"I was sent here to lead the Thalmor's interests in this corner of Skyrim. It's my mission to root out all [[Lore:Talos|Talos]] worship in this city."'' As a member of the Thalmor, he doesn't recognize Talos as a god and thinks Talos does not deserve to have a place in their pantheon. In his opinion, citizens of the [[Lore:Empire|Empire]] have a responsibility to cease their heretical worship. Then he will pay some attention to you. ''"You're awfully inquisitive, aren't you? I like that. Perhaps you'd care to solve a little problem I'm having?"'' He knows that [[Skyrim:Ogmund|Ogmund]] the skald, an old and respected man, worships Talos in his home, but the jarl has been reluctant to have him arrested. Ondolemar wants you to break in to [[Skyrim:Ogmund's House|Ogmund's home]] and find evidence for him. ===To Catch a Bard=== Ogmund's house is just above the market stalls. You may need to pick a novice-level lock and get into his house. There is a chest in the north part of the house holding [[Skyrim:Ogmund's Amulet of Talos|Ogmund's Amulet of Talos]]. This is the evidence Ondolemar requires. Steal the amulet and leave the house quietly. If you run into the authorities, do not resist arrest and make the guards turn hostile to you, as Ondolemar will attack you as well, and it will be impossible for you to talk to him during the fight. Pay your fine and the amulet won't be removed from your inventory. ===Reward=== Bring the amulet to Ondolemar. He believes it will be all he needs to have Ogmund taken care of. He graciously thanks you for your assistance and rewards you with leveled gold. {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Notes== * If the Reach is given to the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] in [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] or conquered for them after [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Sungard (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Sungard]], this quest becomes unavailable, as Ondolemar will no longer be present. Likewise, killing Ogmund before the quest will also render it permanently unavailable. * If the Stormcloaks capture Markarth while this quest is in progress or if you kill Ogmund, you will fail it immediately. * Completing this quest will also grant you access to the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Headquarters|Thalmor Headquarters]] without it being considered as trespassing if you enter, and taking anything from there will no longer count as theft. * Completion of this quest and a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill of 50 or better are required to convince Ondolemar to provide a distraction for you in [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]]. * After this quest, using [[SR:Ondolemar|Ondolemar]] as a distraction during [[SR:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]] will cause his disposition toward you to fall to -2. Doing Diplomatic Immunity first and then finishing this quest will cause his disposition toward you rise to +1. * Although Ondolemar is a member of the Thalmor, and technically not a citizen of the Reach as he's only posted in Understone Keep, helping him via this quest still counts towards helping people of the Reach if you're working on becoming [[Skyrim:Thane of the Reach|Thane of the Reach]]. * An option to bring the amulet to Ogmund was apparently planned, and is available in the code, but there is no dialogue that allows for it. Quest stage 25 appears to be related to this, as setting it with console commands will mark the quest completed and sets Ogmund and Ondolemar's relationship to you to 1 and -1, respectively. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Ogmund is supposed to go to the stocks in Understone Keep once you bring the amulet to Ondolemar, but due to a scripting bug, fails to do so.|USKP|2.0.1|trackerid=14139}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Find evidence of Ogmund's Talos worship}} |15||{{Quest Objective|15|Bring Ogmund's Amulet of Talos to Ondolemar}} |missing=20, 25, 200 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

He will respond: :''"You have learned so much already, Dragonborn. Growing your gift too quickly would be dangerous. But there are many Words of Power in Skyrim, carved in the Dragon tongue. Even from here, we can feel the Thu'um resonate from them. Finding these lost Words would be a sufficient test, to temper your abilities with experience. Ask when you are ready to search."'' Thereafter, you can ask him whether the Greybeards have located any words of power. He has two possible replies: :''"There is only silence right now. Perhaps later we will hear one of the lost Words."'' :''"We have felt the whisper of a Word. Give me your map, and I will show you where its echo can be found."'' The latter response will cause the location of the word wall to be marked on your map, and you will be given a new quest objective. This quest can be repeated multiple times, and it can also be active simultaneously with the other word wall quest, [[Skyrim:Shout - learn about word wall|Shout - learn about word wall]]. Both quests can even point you to the same location as the other. However, if you choose to [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|kill]] [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|Paarthurnax]] for the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]], this quest is no longer available. ==Notes== *If you have ''[[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]]'' installed, Arngeir won't help you learn any Words of Power on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If sent to [[Skyrim:Arcwind_Point|Arcwind Point]], finding the word wall may not mark the quest as completed in your journal. Arcwind Point may be given as a destination even when the word wall has already been found, preventing progress in the quest.|UDGP|1.1a|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Using the command SetStage FreeFormHighHrothgarA 20 will end the quest and allow you to acquire another quest normally. Setting Arcwind Point as cleared via SetLocationCleared fd685 1 will prevent getting sent there again. {{Bug|If you learn a word from a different word wall from the one that Arngeir points you to before visiting the quest-marked one, the test may be prematurely logged complete. For instance, after being directed to [[Skyrim:Shearpoint|Shearpoint]] by Arngeir, visiting [[Skyrim:Lost_Tongue_Overlook|Lost Tongue Overlook]] instead can complete the quest. This is another possible solution for the Arcwind Point bug mentioned above.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Find the Word of Power in }} |missing=20 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

[[fr:Skyrim:Premières leçons]] {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= |Reward=Membership,
[[Skyrim:Lesser Ward|Lesser Ward]] spell |Disp=0→1 ([[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]]) |Rep= |Next=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] |Image=SR-quest-First Lessons.jpg |ImgDesc=Faralda at the entrance bridge |description=Join the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]]. |ID=MG01 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Approach the bridge to [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]]. # Prove your ability ''or'' persuade her, provided you have a high enough Speech skill. # Cross the bridge and enter the courtyard. # (Optional) Speak to [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]]. # Enter the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Elements|Hall of the Elements]]. # Listen to [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]]'s lecture and participate. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Entrance Exam=== Before heading to [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]] to start this quest, you may want to check whether you have enough [[Skyrim:Magicka|magicka]] to complete the quest's first challenge—you may need as much as 135 magicka. With the [[Skyrim:Novice Hood|novice hood]] found in [[Skyrim:Helgen Keep|Helgen Keep]] during [[Skyrim:Unbound|Unbound]], even new level-one characters will have 130 magicka. If you do not have other [[Skyrim:Fortify Magicka|Fortify Magicka]] apparel or potions, one option available to everyone is to visit the [[Skyrim:Temple of the Divines|Temple of the Divines]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and activate the shrine of Julianos to obtain 25 more magicka from the [[Skyrim:Blessing of Julianos|Blessing of Julianos]]. If you have the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on installed, you may choose the power [[Skyrim:Secret of Arcana|Secret of Arcana]] from the black book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Filament and Filigree (quest)|Filament and Filigree]]'' and all your spells will cost no magicka for 30 seconds. Once in Winterhold, follow the main road west through town, and approach the prominent bridge connecting the town to the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. Standing at the approach of the bridge is [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]]. She will ask you about your intentions and what you expect to find on entering the college. Several options would be available for you. {|class=wikitable |- !width=36%|Option !Dialogue |- | I want to use the power of ice and fire to destroy any who oppose me.||I see. That power certainly exists, I assure you. Wield it faithfully, and few can withstand you. |- | I desire to bend the will of those around me.||Yes, the school of Illusion can be quite influential. Kings have risen to power because of it, and empires have been razed with it. |- | I want to unravel the mysteries of Aetherius.||Ah, the immortal plane. It is said to be the source of all magic. This is a noble goal, indeed. |- | I seek the knowledge of the Elder Scrolls.{{intnote|†|†}}||Do you? It is true there are some here who have spent years studying the accumulated knowledge of the scrolls. But what you seek does not come easily, and can destroy those without a strong will. |- | I just wanted to see what it looks like inside.||Ha! Humor is often in short supply here. But I sense that perhaps you're after more than just that. |} {{note|†|†|Only available during the quests [[Skyrim:Elder Knowledge|Elder Knowledge]] and [[Skyrim:Scroll Scouting|Scroll Scouting]]{{DG}} or if you have completed those quests without speaking to Faralda previously.}} Regardless of the dialogue options you choose, she will ultimately decide that you need a lesson and will say that you must take a small test to show that you have some degree of skill with magic. If you agree, she will randomly select one spell from any one of the five schools of magic for you to cast. This may be: * Casting a [[Skyrim:Firebolt|Firebolt]] at the eye-shaped seal next to her. * [[Skyrim:Conjure Flame Atronach|Conjuring a Flame Atronach]] on the seal. * Casting [[Skyrim:Fear (spell)|Fear]] at the seal. * Casting [[Skyrim:Healing Hands|Healing Hands]] on her. * Casting [[Skyrim:Magelight|Magelight]] at the seal. If you do not have the spell she asks of you, she will offer to teach it to you for 30 gold. This is an easy and cheap way to learn any one of the above spells. You must cast the spell at the circular impression in the floor behind her. Casting the spell in any other location will not progress the quest. However, if she asks you to conjure a Flame Atronach, and you already have a Flame Thrall summoned, simply exiting the conversation and speaking to her again will successfully progress the dialogue. Alternatively, you can attempt to persuade her and avoid this test. In order to persuade her, you will need a Speech skill of 100 (70 with the [[Skyrim:Persuasion|Persuasion]] perk) or the [[Skyrim:Amulet of Articulation|Amulet of Articulation]]. If you are on the quest Elder Knowledge you can also mention that you are [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dragonborn]]. She will then ask to see a [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]]. Either of these will get you in without needing to cast a spell. Regardless of which path you take, Faralda will allow you across the bridge and direct you to [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]]. ===College Orientation Day=== After you speak to Mirabelle Ervine, she will want to give you a tour of the facilities. Before that, however, she will give you three items to wear (although wearing them is not mandatory for membership): a Novice Hood (+30 to Magicka), a Novice Robes of Destruction (-12% to Destruction Spell Magicka Cost, Magicka regenerates 50% faster) and College Boots (unenchanted). As you follow her around the college, she will point and explain the few areas and what their purpose is. She will lead you to your new quarters, which is an Apprentice room in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Attainment|Hall of Attainment]], a circular chamber with five rooms total. One room is assigned to each of the apprentices, and one to Tolfdir. Your room is the first on the right, and includes a bed, several furniture containers, and some starting items such as a few [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]]. The furniture containers (wardrobes, end tables, and drawer) are safe for storage, but the food barrels respawn and are unsafe. === Join the Lecture === [[File:SR-quest-First Lessons 02.jpg|thumb|''"Welcome, welcome! We were just beginning. Please, stay and listen."'']] Upon completing the tour, Mirabelle will ask you to join Tolfdir's lecture in the lecture hall. Tolfdir will begin the lesson, addressing you and three of your peers. The other students will badger the professor to teach them a practical application of magic instead of lecturing about the importance of mitigating the damages. Eventually, Tolfdir will ask you what you think. Whatever your response, Tolfdir will ask you to perform a [[Skyrim:Ward (spells)|Ward spell]]. If you do not have this spell, he will give it to you freely. You will be asked to cast the spell and fend off his attack with it. After you successfully defend yourself from one of his fire balls, the quest is finished, and Tolfdir will suggest a [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|school field trip]] and you are off on the next quest. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked during this quest, when Faralda allows you across the bridge: * {{achievement|1=Gatekeeper (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *You can buy the [[Skyrim:Healing Hands|Healing Hands]], [[Skyrim:Magelight|Magelight]], [[Skyrim:Fear (spell)|Fear]], [[Skyrim:Conjure Flame Atronach|Conjure Flame Atronach]], or [[Skyrim:Firebolt|Firebolt]] spell from Faralda (depending on which is required for your test) for cheaper than the tome is offered in stores. If you want to purchase a specific spell cheaply, you can save before initiating the quest and reload to try again. You will also learn the [[Skyrim:Restoration Spells|Lesser Ward]] spell while listening to [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]]. *If one of the three students die by any means, Tolfdir will cancel the ward training and immediately start the next quest. *Without enough Magicka or spent Perks in Restoration, it may be difficult for some characters to maintain a Ward long enough for Tolfdir to even throw a firebolt. This can be bypassed by using Fortify Magicka potions, or more efficiently, either the [[Skyrim:Spellbreaker|Spellbreaker]] shield or the [[Skyrim:Staff of Hasedoki (item)|Staff of Hasedoki]] and their respective Ward effects. *Several of the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)#Optional Quests|college's optional quests]] become available once First Lessons has been started, namely [[Skyrim:Out of Balance|Out of Balance]], [[Skyrim:Enchanting Pick-Up|Enchanting Pick-Up]], and [[Skyrim:Restocking Soul Gems|Restocking Soul Gems]], [[Skyrim:Fetch me that Book!|Fetch me that Book!]], and [[Skyrim:Shalidor's Insights|Shalidor's Insights]]. Another quest, [[Skyrim:Filling Soul Gems|Filling Soul Gems]], was supposed to be available following First Lessons, but was left unfinished and cannot be started. Most of the other optional quests do not become available until after the next quest, [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]], has been completed. *If you want to skip the tour, you can talk to Mirabelle Ervine and select the 'I was told to come see you' dialogue, then tell her 'I'm not ready to start the tour yet' and simply go into the Hall of Elements. The quest will progress normally once you start listening to Tolfdir's lecture. *At the end of the lecture in this quest, Tolfdir's relationship with you is upgraded to friend. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you step in front of Faralda as she casts the spells during the walk up to the college, it will show up as a light spell on your character and will never light the podium.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If interrupted during the tour (such as by a dragon), Mirabelle Ervine will not continue, saying only "after I have finished showing you the grounds we can talk". However, if you proceed to the Hall of Elements, Tolfdir will begin his lecture and you can complete the quest as if you had finished the tour. Mirabelle seems to return to normal behavior after this point.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you miss the first chance to defend yourself from Tolfdir's fireball, he may not throw another one at you, stalling the quest indefinitely.|confirmed=1}} ** Tolfdir will start firing the spell at you but will immediately stop. This can be solved by simply moving around for a bit on the spot, then start casting the Lesser Ward spell again. ** It can also be solved by killing one of the students, running away to someplace outside of Winterhold, then paying up the 1000 gold bounty to the guards. That way Tolfdir will skip the training part, and start the [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] quest. {{Bug|If you dismiss a follower during the demonstration of wards there is a chance that the entire class and any faculty present will attack the follower. Since an essential follower stands up after kneeling for a bit, this results in a loop without a sufficient delay to continue the lesson.|confirmed=1}} **Permanently killing the follower or reloading a previous save will successfully address this issue. **If you cast 'calm' on your follower, they will stop attacking Tolfdir and the students and you can then rehire them. {{Bug|Mirabelle can end up talking to herself if the scene between her and Ancano is interrupted.|USKP|1.3.1}} {{Bug|Oddly, since the [[Skyrim:Jarl's Longhouse (Winterhold)|Jarl's Longhouse]] is marked as being owned by the Winterhold crime faction, once you finish the quest, you will have helped someone in the hold, allowing you take things from the longhouse without it being considered theft.|USKP|2.1.3|A new faction was created specifically for the residents of the longhouse in order to set ownership correctly.|trackerid=19319}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've found the College of Winterhold, where mages study the arcane arts in Skyrim. If I want to learn more about magic, I'll need to join their ranks. {{Quest Objective|10|Join the College of Winterhold}} |20||In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting a Magelight spell.. {{Quest Objective|20|Cast a Mage Light spell}} |21||In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by summoning a Flame Atronach. {{Quest Objective|21|Summon a Flame Atronach}} |22||In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting a Firebolt spell. {{Quest Objective|22|Cast a Firebolt spell}} |23||In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting a Fear spell. {{Quest Objective|23|Cast a Fear Spell}} |24||In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting Healing Hands on Nirya at the entrance to the College. {{Quest Objective|24|Cast a Healing Hands spell}} |30||I've been allowed to join the College of Winterhold, and need to find Mirablle Ervine for a tour of the grounds. {{Quest Objective|30|Report to Mirabelle Ervine}} |40||I have joined the College of Winterhold. Mirabelle Ervine has agreed to show me around in order to become familiar with the grounds. {{Quest Objective|40|Tour the College of Winterhold}} |50||I have joined the College of Winterhold, and after a tour of the grounds need to find Tolfdir, who looks after the new Apprentices. {{Quest Objective|50|Listen to Tolfdir}} |200|fin|After joining the College of Winterhold and speaking with Tolfdir, I've learned a bit about wards and will be accompanying some of the others on an expedition. |missing=0, 3 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]]|Up=[[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]]}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Taarie|Taarie]].
#Put on [[Skyrim:Radiant Raiment Fine Clothes|Radiant Raiment Fine Clothes]].
#Introduce [[Skyrim:Radiant Raiment|Radiant Raiment]] to [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]].
#Return to Taarie.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===You're Going to Wear ''That''?===
If you meet up with [[Skyrim:Taarie|Taarie]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], she will comment on your outfit: ''"If you're heading to the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]], you might want to rethink that outfit."'' You may ask her for some suggestions on what to wear to meet the jarl. Taarie's abrasive attitude toward you will change immediately. She will regard your meeting in the Blue Palace as an opportunity to introduce [[Skyrim:Radiant Raiment|Radiant Raiment]] to [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]]. Taarie offers to pay you to wear one of Radiant Raiment's outfits when you speak to the jarl. She'll let you keep the clothes as well.
You may be skeptical of Taarie's sudden wellspring of good will; maybe she wants to make you look silly in front of the jarl. Taarie assures you that you cannot possibly look any sillier than you do right now, so go ahead and accept the offer.
 
===Does This Make My Rear-End Look Big?===
The [[Skyrim:Radiant Raiment Fine Clothes|Radiant Raiment Fine Clothes]] are added to your inventory with instructions from Taarie: ''"Try to get Elisif's opinion on it and if she likes it mention it's from Radiant Raiment."'' Equip the clothes and go speak with Elisif. Depending on your business at the Blue Palace, the conversation starter about your apparel can seem awkward. Yet, Elisif has an eye for fashion, even in the midst of turmoil. You may ask for her opinion on your outfit and she will tell you, ''"It's quite fetching actually. The craftsmanship is excellent."'' Tell her it was made by Radiant Raiment. She will be glad to put in a request for a few dresses quite soon.

===A Job Well Done===
Return to Taarie and tell her that Elisif loved the outfit and that she'll be placing an order soon. Taarie will be quite happy with the result: ''"That's wonderful. You've done us a great service."'' You can keep the outfit as she promised and she will also give you some gold for your trouble.
{{SRLeveledReward|small}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to your fellow inmates.
# Ask [[Skyrim:Grisvar the Unlucky|Grisvar the Unlucky]] for his spare [[Skyrim:Shiv (item)|shiv]].
# Obtain a bottle of [[Skyrim:Skooma|Skooma]].
# Swap the Skooma for Grisvar's spare shiv.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===So what are you in for?===
Before throwing you into [[Skyrim:Cidhna Mine|Cidhna Mine]], the guards were careful enough to remove all of your equipment, leaving weapon-based characters at a distinct disadvantage. If you chat to your fellow inmates, however, you will learn that [[Skyrim:Grisvar the Unlucky|Grisvar the Unlucky]] has a spare weapon, and might be willing to let you have it.

===If you want to get ahead, get a shiv===
Grisvar admits to having an extra [[sr:Shiv (item)|shiv]] but isn't keen to part with it. He is something of a [[Skyrim:Skooma|Skooma]] addict, and has heard that [[Skyrim:Duach|Duach]] has got a bottle of the good stuff. Grisvar claims to be "shaking just thinking about it", and wants you to obtain the bottle for him.

===Distilled Pleasure===
Grisvar isn't as discerning as his request makes him seem, and will accept any bottle of Skooma. Several of the mine's inmates possess bottles of Skooma but Duach is often to be found on his own, making it easier to pick his pockets or kill him quietly. You can also try to pass a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] check with Duach or beat him in a brawl to make him hand over his bottle. However you obtain the Skooma, take it back to Grisvar.

===Forlorn hope===
The Skooma is warmly received, and Grisvar gladly hands over his spare shiv. He asks you to promise you won't ever use it on him - and it's perhaps just as well that no option to accept the promise is offered.

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Minor Edits |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Nephele |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Wilhelm|Wilhelm]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Sapphire Dragon Claw|Sapphire Dragon Claw]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Kyne's Peace|Kyne's Peace]] shout |Image=SR-quest-Lifting_the_Shroud.jpg |Imgdesc=Could the barrow really be haunted? |description=Investigate the haunted [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|barrow]] outside of [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]]. |ID=FreeformIvarstead01 |SuggLevel=6 |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Wilhelm|Wilhelm]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Offer to investigate [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]] after [[Skyrim:Wilhelm|Wilhelm]] complains it might be haunted. # Explore the barrow and track down the "ghost." # Take [[Skyrim:Wyndelius Gatharian|Wyndelius]]' [[Skyrim:Wyndelius's Journal|diary]] to Wilhelm for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Haunted Barrow=== When visiting [[Skyrim:Vilemyr Inn|Vilemyr Inn]] in [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]] you may overhear the innkeeper, [[Skyrim:Wilhelm|Wilhelm]], warning [[Skyrim:Lynly Star-Sung|Lynly Star-Sung]] about a ghost in the nearby barrow. If you are intrigued and like a good ghost story, Wilhelm will inform you that [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]], an ancient Nord crypt just outside of town, is haunted and warns you away from it as well. When pressed further, Wilhelm will confess to seeing the spirit and complain that the haunting is harming his business. If you volunteer to investigate the haunting, Wilhelm will think you daft and tell you of [[Skyrim:Wyndelius Gatharian|Wyndelius Gatharian]], an adventurer who went to explore the barrow a year ago. Screams were heard in the night, and the adventurer was never seen again. Alternatively, you can go directly to the barrow without speaking to Wilhelm beforehand. ===Ghost Hunting=== Enter the barrow. At the first intersection, you might see Wyndelius' ghost through a locked gate to your right, asking you to leave. The first part of the barrow has no enemies, only several traps that you must navigate through. Head left to a room with four levers and pull the two middle levers (the ones closest to the door) to open the two metal gates. The right side lever triggers an arrow trap. In the next room, to the right is an apprentice-locked door. Directly behind it is a pressure plate that activates a spike trap. It is, however, nowhere near the pressure plate so walking slowly over it will leave you unharmed. Beyond the spike trap is a booby-trapped chest. Moving back, pull the chain to open the next gate and continue on. There is a spike trap here too, but once again moving slowly over it will work. Eventually, behind an unlocked door, you will find Wyndelius. ===Philter of the Phantom=== Wyndelius will attack you on sight, unless he is sleeping, which allows you to perform a sneak attack or a stealthy inspection of the room. If you kill him, his ruse is revealed; he is not a ghost at all, and his spectral appearance was due to a potion called [[Skyrim:Philter of the Phantom|Philter of the Phantom]]. On the table you will find his [[Skyrim:Wyndelius's Journal|journal]], which explains why he pretended to be a ghost. However, killing Wyndelius is not necessary to complete the quest; you need only recover the journal. Take the journal to Wilhelm and, in exchange, he will reward you with the [[Skyrim:Sapphire Dragon Claw|sapphire dragon claw]], the very item Wyndelius gave his sanity and life to possess. The claw is needed to explore the rest of the barrow, which contains a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] with a part of [[Skyrim:Kyne's Peace|Kyne's Peace]] shout. ==Notes== * The claw will be marked as a quest item until the player clears the barrow. * If the barrow is left alone long enough to reset, Wyndelius' body will remain dead while replenishing a new bottle of Philter of the Phantom. * If you pick up the journal before speaking to Wilhelm, you'll instead be given the option to say "Actually, you need to take a look at this." and give him the journal. The quest will still proceed as normal. * After you finish the quest, Wilhelm will occasionally say ''"Now that our "ghost" has been unmasked, I hope we see more visitors in town than just the occasional pilgrim."'' when you talk to him. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If the puzzle door does not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The sapphire dragon claw may still be marked as a quest item after you finish the quest, which prevents you from removing it from your inventory.}} ** Re-visiting Shroud Hearth Barrow after it has respawned, and clearing it again, may remove the quest item marking from the claw. {{Bug|If [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] is used during the fight with Wyndelius, his journal may be knocked off the table and impossible to find, making the quest impossible to complete. Obtaining the journal and the claw through [[Skyrim:Console|console commands]] will not make the quest continue, and the quest will remain unfinished even if you clear the entire barrow.}} {{Bug|Even after you finish the quest and solve the mystery of the ghost, Wilhelm and Lynly will still engage in conversation and act if the ghost still exists, causing him to tell her to stay away from the barrow.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Investigate Shroud Hearth Barrow}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Bring Wyndelius's Journal to Wilhelm}} |200|fin| |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Damn Bears===
[[Skyrim:Temba Wide-Arm|Temba Wide-Arm]] really does not like [[Skyrim:Bear|bears]]. She is a [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] woman who has sunk all of her money into a mill in [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]]. Even in passing you will hear her complaining to anyone within earshot how the bears are running her business into the ground. If you stop to chat she will explain that bears are ruining the trees by scratching up the trunks, rendering them useless as lumber. She is sorely in need of help with the bear problem and offers payment if you bring her ten bear pelts, thus thinning out the bear population. 
===Filling the Order===
Temba will accept any combination of [[Skyrim:Bear Pelt|bear pelts]], [[Skyrim:Cave Bear Pelt|cave bear pelts]], or [[Skyrim:Snow Bear Pelt|snow bear pelts]]; it doesn't matter to her as long as they are ursidae.

There are two bear dens in the vicinity of Ivarstead: [[Skyrim:Honeystrand Cave|Honeystrand Cave]] to the south past the river, and [[Skyrim:Pinepeak Cavern|Pinepeak Cavern]] to the north near the steps leading up to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]. There are also a number of bear pelts in [[Skyrim:Broken Oar Grotto|Broken Oar Grotto]], a cave north of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. [[Skyrim:Giant|Giants]] frequently carry bear pelts, and you can also buy bear pelts from general goods [[Skyrim:Merchants|merchants]], [[Skyrim:Merchant#Khajiit Traders|Khajiit caravans]], and [[Skyrim:Hunter|hunters]] in the wild.

Once you bring the ten pelts to her she will be surprised that you came through for her and will reward you with a random leveled enchanted war axe.

In the center of the room sits a small statue in the form of a gauntlet. On the table nearby there will be a [[Skyrim:Investigator's Key|key]] and an [[Skyrim:Midden Incident Report|incident report]] which describes a failed summoning ritual and four rings. ===Ornamental Rings=== [[File:SR-quest-Forgotten_Names_02.jpg|thumb|left|Once all rings are placed on the gauntlet...]] Following the clues in the report, the player can find the needed rings in a master-locked chest located in the [[Skyrim:The Arcanaeum|Arcanaeum]]. The lock can be picked, or simply opened with the key, in order to obtain the four ornamental rings: [[Skyrim:Pithi's Ornamental Ring|Pithi's Ring]], [[Skyrim:Treoy's Ornamental Ring|Treoy's Ring]], [[Skyrim:Balwen's Ornamental Ring|Balwen's Ring]], and [[Skyrim:Katarina's Ornamental Ring|Katarina's Ring]]. Note that the rings are owned, and removing them from the chest is considered stealing and any mages in the library (including [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]]) will attack if they see you take the contents of the chest. To reduce your risk of detection, you can either wait until Urag retires to his room at night, or enter the library immediately after finishing "[[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|The Eye of Magnus]]", as he won't be there right away. If you are the Arch-Mage and steal the rings, and get caught, they may not necessarily attack you, but the rings will be removed from you and you may not ever be able to get them back. Once you have obtained the rings, return to the gauntlet in the Midden Dark. Place the rings on the gauntlet by activating each finger as follows: {{ListFix| *Index Finger: Katarina's Ring *Middle Finger: Treoy's Ring *Ring Finger: Balwen's Ring *Little Finger: Pithi's Ring. }} {{NewLine}} ===The Summoning=== [[File:SR-quest-Forgotten_Names_03.jpg|thumb|left|... Velehk Sain will be summoned.]] [[File:SR-quest-Forgotten_Names_Booty.jpg|thumb|right|Velehk Sain's treasure]] Once all four rings are placed on the appropriate fingers, the fingers will curl into a fist, and a [[Skyrim:Dremora|Dremora]] pirate named [[Skyrim:Velehk Sain|Velehk Sain]] will be summoned. He will bargain with you for his release, offering treasure from his pirating days in exchange. You can choose out of two options: {{ListFix| * '''Release:''' If you release him, he will vanish and you will receive ''[[Skyrim:Velehk Sain's Treasure Map|Velehk Sain's Treasure Map]]''. The map leads to a hidden stash of treasure (leveled general treasure), located west-northwest of Winterhold, and north of Saarthal, on a peninsula with a statue of Talos. Note that there are several statues of Talos in the surrounding area; the one you need is the one where the statue is at the very apex of the small island. {{Map Link|Velehk Sain's Locker}}. The treasure is magically hidden and will only reveal itself if Velehk is released. The treasure is conjured by your proximity, so you will not see it from a distance. * '''Kill:''' You can opt to kill him and loot his corpse for two [[Skyrim:scimitar|scimitars]], a [[Skyrim:Daedra Heart|daedra heart]], [[Skyrim:Hammerfell Garb|Hammerfell garb]], and [[Skyrim:Redguard Boots|Redguard boots]]. }} {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * Script notes attached to this quest indicate that at one point, you were meant to put the souls of the students to rest, and could've spoken to them through soul gems. These script notes include ''"player has put all the souls to rest. except for Treoy"'', ''"player has put 3/4 souls to rest. Neccessary stage?''", and ''"player has spoken to Treoy's Gem"''. There is also a reference to a "Massive Soul Gem" in the same script. **The script also makes reference to a fifth deceased student, named "'''Herotus'''", who isn't mentioned anywhere besides this script. **A script, as well as the internal name of his ring, refers to Pithi as "'''Pithiken'''". * Unlike other quest items, the rings ''can'' be removed from your inventory. [[Skyrim:Velehk Sain|Velehk Sain]] cannot be summoned without the rings, so you should be careful not to misplace them. * The rings are ornamental only and as such cannot be worn by you: they will be stored with miscellaneous items in your inventory, instead of apparel. * If you are quick enough and have a strong enough weapon (as Velehk has much less health than regular dremora), you can release him, get the map, and then kill him as he disappears. His body will vanish before it can be looted. However, if you exit the conversation after you pick the option to release him and before you get the map, you can kill him quickly enough for his body to be looted. **It is, however, possible to pickpocket [[Skyrim:Velehk Sain|Velehk Sain]] for his weapons and armor (though not the [[Skyrim:Daedra Heart|Daedra Heart]], obviously) with the [[Skyrim:Misdirection|Misdirection]] and [[Skyrim:Perfect Touch|Perfect Touch]] perks. Simply kneel behind the spot where he appears, go through the dialogue as if you're going to let him go, and leave the conversation immediately after you select "Velehk Sain I release you." Then, pickpocket him for all available items. This will cause a glitch however which makes him start all the dialogue over again. Go through and release him once again, then claim the treasure. * The game doesn't trigger the treasure to appear as soon as you select the "Velehk Sain, I release you" dialogue option. Instead, the trigger is at the end of the dialogue line, after Sain says "See you on the other side, mortal". The implication of this is that if you're pressing the activate button to skip through the dialogue more quickly, you can actually cause the game to not trigger the treasure to appear. If you're electing to take the deal, allow Sain to speak instead of skipping through the dialogue to ensure you get the treasure. * The [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] spells [[Skyrim:Banish Daedra|Banish Daedra]] and [[Skyrim:Expel Daedra|Expel Daedra]] don't send Velehk Sain back to Oblivion; they drain his health instead. * Once the gauntlet summons Velehk and you decide his fate, the rings that were placed on it cannot be removed, so you can't take them back for either keepsakes or selling them. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you kill Velehk Sain, his body is never properly cleaned up because his death never shuts down the quest.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|The rings might disappear if you store them in a chest, even if it's considered a safe container. The rings can also disappear from your inventory if looted before level 50. They may reappear in your inventory after attaining this level. |confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |allmissing=1 |missing=0, 10, 40, 50, 75, 80, 100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

===Unknown Book, Vol. I===
Between the Wayshrine of Learning and the Wayshrine of Sight. If you are approaching the book from the Wayshrine of Sight, simply head southwest until you come across a path in the middle of a ridge. At the top there will be several [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|Frostbite Spiders]]. Head down the other side. Among the ruins to the right there will be a skeleton clutching a chest. The book is next to the chest. If you are approaching from the Wayshrine of Learning, go to your right along the frozen lake and you will see the ruins.

===Unknown Book, Vol. II===
Most easily accessed with the [[Skyrim:Emerald Paragon|Emerald Paragon]], which is located on the body of a [[Skyrim:Frost_Giant|Frost Giant]] in the [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] village. Once you have the Emerald Paragon, travel to the [[Skyrim:Forgotten_Vale#Paragon_Platform|Paragon Platform]] (detailed directions to the platform are on its page) and place the Emerald Paragon in the Paragon Socket. A portal will open to the [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale Overlook|Forgotten Vale Overlook]]. Turn to your right (north) and make your way down the rocky river. The book is a short way down, just after the two broken pillars. It is next to the chest on the right-hand edge of the waterfall, by another broken pillar. You can also jump from the Inner Sanctum Balcony to the south and make your way along the cliffs. Make sure you have at least 450 health, or use [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]], to survive the jump.

===Unknown Book, Vol. III===
South, near the [[Skyrim:Glacial_Crevice|Glacial Crevice]]. Travel upriver, toward the entrance of Glacial Crevice, but do not enter. At the fence entrance, turn around to face North. You will see two rock pathways. One on the right, that leads up along the mountain side and one on the left that goes over the river. Take the rock bridge pathway on the left that crosses the river and continue to cross over one more rock bridge. You will reach a fork, to the left is a Falmer bridge (made of [[Skyrim:Chaurus Chitin|chitin]]) and to the right is a rocky pathway leading up into the mountains. Take the Falmer bridge to the left. Upon crossing the Falmer bridge, turn right to cross another rock bridge going down towards an Eastern lone Falmer tent. The book will be inside on a table.

===Unknown Book, Vol. IV===
This book is on the table in the last hut before entering the tunnel leading to the Shrine of Radiance (the last Shrine after exiting the Glacial Crevice). There's a fire brazier outside the entrance to the tunnel and the hut is elevated directly above it.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
=== A Precious Heirloom ===
The biggest bookstore in [[Lore:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]] is called [[Oblivion:First Edition|First Edition]] and is located in the [[Oblivion:Market District|Market District]] of the capital of Cyrodiil, the [[Oblivion:Imperial City|Imperial City]]. The bookstore is famous for its various limited editions of numerous rare books and also delivers to citizens outside of Cyrodiil, for example to [[Skyrim:Cindiri Arano|Cindiri Arano]] in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]]. Once you have [[Skyrim:Cleansing the Stones|freed Cindiri]] from [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]]'s spell, she will greet you with: ''"You look able enough to venture outside of town. Perhaps you could help me recover something precious that was lost?"'' When asked to elaborate she will explain that she had an important folio rebound at the First Edition bookstore. Unfortunately, the folio never made its way back to Raven Rock. When you ask her if it was aboard a ship she will say: ''"Yes, the "Strident Squall" or something like that. The damn thing sunk right off the coast of Solstheim. Can you imagine?"'' She then explains that one of the sailors managed to crawl back to Raven Rock and tell the [[Skyrim:Redoran Guard|guards]] about the wreckage. When you offer to locate the folio for her, she will be grateful and even refer to it as a 'precious heirloom' to the family. 

=== The Strident Squall ===
You will not receive a map marker, nor will any citizens help you find the wreck. However, the [[Skyrim:Wreck of the Strident Squall|Wreck of the Strident Squall]] is clearly visible on your map, at the southeastern tip of Solstheim. Travel to the wreck and fight five leveled [[Skyrim:Reaver|reavers]], including a Reaver Lord; one sits on a chair on the ground while the remaining four will shoot at you from the deck. When the coast is clear examine the ship for several valuable items, including an East Empire Company strongbox containing an [[Skyrim:East Empire Pendant|East Empire Pendant]] on some shelves below deck. Go behind the stairs you came down on and turn so that they are on your right. There will be a chest slightly to the right of a large hole in the hull which contains the folio, a [[Skyrim:Lusty Argonian Maid Folio|special edition]] of the naughty tome ''[[Skyrim:The Lusty Argonian Maid|The Lusty Argonian Maid]]''. 

Return to Raven Rock and locate Cindiri Arano. When you hand her the missing folio she will be ecstatic: ''"You have no idea what this means to me... to my family. Reclamations bless you! Well, you've certainly proven your worth around here to me. Please, accept this gift as a token of my appreciation!"'' She will then hand you the reward, a leveled and enchanted ring, necklace, or circlet.

== Notes ==
* If you find the folio at the shipwreck before initiating the quest, you can simply speak to her, return it, and receive your reward all at once.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Lost Ruin===
[[File:SR-place-Vardnknd.jpg|thumb|right|Find the lost Dwemer ruins of Vardnknd]]
This quest will be added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Forgotten Seasons|Forgotten Seasons]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. You will be directed to [[SR:Runoff Caverns|Runoff Caverns]], an undiscovered cave far south of [[SR:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]] which will already be marked on your map. The cave has an unassuming entrance located just west of [[SR:Lost Valley Redoubt|Lost Valley Redoubt]]; you will know you have arrived once you see the torso of a broken [[SR:Dwarven Horse|Dwarven Horse]]. Activating this strange relic will begin a separate quest called [[Skyrim:The Dwarven Horse|The Dwarven Horse]] to reassemble the construct, which can be done in tandem with this quest.

Head inside the dungeon and you will quickly notice that these natural caverns actually contain a large [[SR:Dwarven Ruins|Dwarven ruin]]. You will soon come to a massive central chamber where a group of deceased [[SR:Mercenary|mercenaries]] had set up camp. A [[SR:Mercenary's Note|note]] in one of the tents will provide some context for this failed expedition; the dead mercs were hired by a mage who headed deeper into the ruins, leaving them to guard the entrance. Clearly they were overwhelmed by the [[SR:Dwarven Spider|Dwarven spiders]] patrolling the cavern, and the drawbridge spanning the chasm has unfortunately been raised, blocking your progress. Your only option is to descend to the floor of the cavern, fighting your way through hostile automatons until you come to a side passage. This path will eventually lead you up and around to the other side of the cavern, where you will begin to encounter hostile mercenaries who are still very much alive.

Before you continue on deeper into the ruins, it is advisable to drop the lever lowering the drawbridge, allowing for easy access back to the entrance camp without having to trudge back through the side passages each time. With this done, continue on until you come to the entrance of Vardnknd. You will likely hear this entrance before you see it, as it is surrounded by stormclouds and lightning strikes. The lightning ''will'' hit you if you tarry, so move swiftly onward.

===A Mage on a Mission===
Once you've entered the ruins proper, you will find yourself in Vardnknd Gallery, a central hub area for the dungeon. You will be greeted by a scene of chaos, as lightning strikes and hostile mercenaries fill the entire chamber. You will play witness to the death of the mage [[SR:Elberon|Elberon]] by one such lightning strike. He is the leader of this expedition, and as his [[Skyrim:Elberon's Journal|journal]] reveals he has entered the ruins in an attempt to shut down the Weather Witch contained within. These rare devices have the ability to control the weather, and this particular one threatens to throw the entirety of Skyrim into chaos due to malfunction. Deal with the hostile mercenaries, then locate and read his journal to progress the quest. You will also be directed to loot Elberon's body as part of another separate quest called [[SR:The Dwarven Crown|The Dwarven Crown]], which again can be done concurrently with this one.

The journal also advises you to read Elberon's account of his previous expedition to the ruins, titled ''[[SR:Forgotten Seasons, v1|Forgotten Seasons, v1]]''. A copy can be found on his desk and provides a guide on how to navigate the rest of the dungeon, and you will need to read same to progress the quest. In short, you will need to recover three [[SR:Vardnknd Conduit Gem|Vardnknd Conduit Gem]]s from separate sections of the ruins in order to turn off the Weather Witch and face the final boss. These can be recovered in any order you like, as the entrance to all four areas are located in Vardnknd Gallery.

===Autumn Harvest===
The [[Skyrim:Runoff Caverns#Autumn's Bells|Autumn's Bells]] section of the dungeon consists of what looks to be an underground farm, tended by dangerous Dwarven automatons. Travel down the entrance hallway (which will eventually open out into the agricultural fields) until you find a dead mercenary carrying a ''[[Skyrim:Note on Autumn|Note on Autumn]]'' explaining how to reach the gem in this section. The objective here is to harvest strange magical wheat that grows in the fields all across the chamber, and place one of each type in six corresponding depository containers to unlock the treasure room containing the gem. You only need to harvest at least one sample of each of the six types of wheat ([[Skyrim:Blue Luminous Wheat|Blue Luminous]], [[Skyrim:Glowing Red Wheat|Glowing Red]], [[Skyrim:Off-Color Wheat|Off-Color]], [[Skyrim:Orange-Encrusted Wheat|Orange-Encrusted]], [[Skyrim:Sickly Green Wheat|Sickly Green]], and [[Skyrim:White Molded Wheat|White Molded]]), and you can harvest an infinite amount of weightless wheat from a single plant. Once you have deposited wheat in all the containers, the treasure room will open and you will be free to disable this section's conduit gem.

If you are doing the other two quests, Autumn's Bells also contains all the necessary parts to repair the [[Skyrim:The Dwarven Horse|Dwarven horse]], as well as one of the masks needed for the Crown quest.
[[File:SR-item-Dwarven Drone Fly.jpg|thumb|left|A helpful drone]]

===Spriggan Hunting===
The Spring's Symphony section of the dungeon is filled with [[SR:Spriggan|spriggan]]s and animals, always a dangerous combination due to spriggans' ability to turn normally passive animals hostile. This part of the ruins is a basic dungeon crawl, although impassable vines will be blocking your way forward. You will again need to locate the body of a dead mercenary to read the ''[[SR:Note on Spring|Note on Spring]]'', which explains that you need to kill the [[SR:Blooming Spriggan|Blooming Spriggan]]s specifically in order to get past the vines. Certain corridors are also filled with a green miasma which causes poison damage. You will eventually be confronted by a boss-level [[SR:Blooming Spriggan Matron|Blooming Spriggan Matron]] carrying the Vardnknd Spring Key, needed later. You then jump down a drop to the Conduit Control Gem and activate it. There is a shortcut to return to the entrance from there.

Other treasures of note include another mask for the Crown quest and a tiny [[SR:Dwarven Drone Fly|Dwarven Drone Fly]].

The Mask of Spring is at the end of the hallway through the door near the beginning of the Spring's Symphony section. It requires the Matron's key, which means you'll have to reenter this section after completing it. 

The Dwarven Drone Fly is near the end of the dungeon beside a chest and a chair, shortly before the drop to disable the conduit. The fly can be picked up and used as a companion. It will only follow you for short intervals at a time, but while active it will grant you poison resistance and increased stamina, which can be useful for navigating the sections of this zone containing toxic green gas.

===Shall I compare thee?===
The Summer's Chords section of the dungeon is entirely flooded with lava, requiring you to walk along piping and narrow bridges so as not to fall to your doom. Just inside the entrance, a mercenary who carries the ''[[Skyrim:Note_on_Summer|Note on Summer]]'' lies dead next to a Spider Control Rod and a lever. Pulling the lever will spawn a non-hostile, friendly [[SR:Repair Spider|Repair Spider]].  As explained by the note, in order to disable the conduit here, you need to direct the repair spider to several "service waypoints" throughout the section. These are small metal pads which glow yellow when activated by the spider. In order to move the spider, you will need to take and equip the nearby [[Skyrim:Spider Control Rod (Forgotten Seasons)|Spider Control Rod]], which functions identically to a [[Skyrim:Spider Control Rod|similar rod]] found in [[Skyrim:Calcelmo's Laboratory|Calcelmo's Laboratory]]: aim it at where you want the spider to go. Unfortunately, your way is impeded by several [[SR:Flame Atronach|flame atronach]]s who can attack the spider, as well as traps which can also kill the spider if you aren't careful about its positioning. If the spider dies for any reason, go back to the entrance and use the switch to spawn another one. Once all the waypoints are activated, the conduit shuts down; there is no conduit gem to obtain here, nor any hidden loot.

Note: In the first hallway to the right after obtaining the spider there is a locked chest, in the hallway to the left with a small downward ramp, repair spider may get "stuck"; in order to move on, kill the repair spider and return to get a new one. There is also a chest behind the last waypoint.

===Diving Lessons===
The Winter's Chimes section initially appears to be a snowy exterior area. You will walk in to a scene of gore as the bodies of dead mercenaries fall from above, having been slaughtered by the icy inhabitants of this area. The first of these mercenaries lies dead at the threshold between the entryway and the first of many vertical chambers in this section, which is climbed with a spiraling ramp; the mercenary carries the ''[[Skyrim:Note_on_Winter|Note on Winter]]'', and two waterbreathing potions lie beside him. Make your way up the ramp and face off against the [[Skyrim:Frosted Dwarven Spider|Frosted Dwarven Spiders]], which use frost attacks rather than the usual lightning. As you ascend, you will soon realize that this section is actually one large chamber caught in an eternal artificial blizzard. The remainder of this section continues to be just as vertical as the starting area, requiring you to leap into half-frozen pools of water before ascending again. In addition to the spiders, beware [[SR:Frost Atronach|Frost Atronach]]s and [[SR:Ice Wraith|Ice Wraith]]s as you navigate the level. Once you reach the summit, you can grab the conduit gem and leave.

The real challenge from this level is designed around the [[SR:Cold|Cold]] mechanic in the [[SR:Survival Mode|Survival Mode]] Creation, which is affected by icy water and exposure to the elements. Followers cannot accompany you here, forcing you to deal with any enemies using your own skills or conjured helpers. This section also contains a mask for the Crown quest, well-hidden and guarded by a powerful [[SR:Frosted Dwarven Centurion|Frosted Dwarven Centurion]].
[[File:SR-creature-The Sky Orchestrator.jpg|thumb|right|Shut down the Weather Witch]]

===Face the Sky Orchestrator===
Once you have deactivated all four conduits, you will return to the Vardnknd Gallery hub area only to find it once again occupied by hostile mercenaries. Beware, as they spawn alongside [[SR:Elberon's Apprentice|Elberon's Apprentice]], a very angry mage seeking to avenge his master's death. Once you've dealt with the competition, you will have to approach the west side of the Gallery, towards a door located on a ledge above. As you get nearer, stairs will rise to give you access to the door above (see [[#Bugs|bugs]]). This leads to Vardnknd Skykiller Gallery, a chamber containing the final boss: [[SR:The Sky Orchestrator|the Sky Orchestrator]], a giant dwarven spider.

The Sky Orchestrator can be a challenging fight and possesses several stages. Initially the Orchestrator will enter frost mode and deal AoE frost damage. This will then switch to fire mode, at which point the Orchestrator will be doing fire damage and summoning [[SR:Enraged Spriggan|Enraged Spriggan]]s. Finally, it will enter lightning mode and deal significant shock damage until it is destroyed. Loot its remains for the [[SR:Ward of the Seasons|Ward of the Seasons]], a unique Dwarven cuirass.

With the final boss destroyed, you will be rewarded at long last with ''[[SR:Turn of the Seasons|Turn of the Seasons]]'', a book which you can consume to obtain a new [[Skyrim:Powers#Abilities|Power]]. This constant-effect ability grants the following buffs, depending on the weather:
*[[Skyrim:Fortify Barter|Fortify Barter]], 10pts when it rains
*[[Skyrim:Regenerate Stamina|Regenerate Stamina]], 5% if you are wearing a full [[SR:Light Armor|Light Armor]] set in clear or sunny weather
*10% more critical damage with [[SR:Bows|Bows]] when overcast
*[[Skyrim:Armor (effect)|Armor]], 10pts if you are wearing a full [[SR:Heavy Armor|Heavy Armor]] set when it is snowing

Using the lift in Skykiller Gallery will bring you right back to the entrance of Runoff Caverns, allowing for a swift exit. Congratulations!

*There are a few of the rare Yellow Mountain Flowers outside the entrance to the Spring's Symphony zone.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Speak to [[Skyrim:Swims-In-Deep-Water|Swims-In-Deep-Water]]:
:'''I'm ready for the next fishing challenge.'''
:''"Of course. It's all in this note."''
:'''I'll return with these rare catches soon.''' / '''This looks like it'll be a real challenge. I'll do my best.'''
:''"My thanks to you."''

He will then hand you a [[Skyrim:List of Rare Fish|list of rare fish]] to catch
*[[Skyrim:Angelfish|Angelfish]] - Angelfish are rare and can only be caught when fishing with an Alik'r Fishing Rod in temperate lakes. Two guaranteed Angelfish can be found in a pool within [[Skyrim:Ancestor_Glade|Ancestor Glade]] and can be caught without a fishing rod. 
*[[Skyrim:Angler|Angler]] - Can only be caught in freezing waters while using the Argonian Fishing Rod. A lone Angler can be found at [[SR:Pilgrim's Trench|Pilgrim's Trench]] in a small rocky cove on the ocean floor (there are clams to the left and right of the mouth of the cove, and more on top of it), just to the west of the sunken ships, no fishing necessary. This is found in the Food section of Items.
*[[Skyrim:Lyretail Anthias|Lyretail Anthias]]- Can only be caught in temperate streams while using an Alik'r fishing rod. Three guaranteed Lyretails can be found in the waters of [[Skyrim:Evergreen Grove|Evergreen Grove]].
*[[Skyrim:Scorpion Fish|Scorpion Fish]] - Can only be caught in underground fishing spots while using the Argonian Fishing Rod. They can also be found in [[Skyrim:Darkfall Cave|Darkfall Cave]]. This is found in the Food section of Items.

Return to Swims:
:'''It wasn't easy, but here are the fish you asked for.'''
:''"You are like my brood to me. Here. A token."''
:'''Are there any more fishing challenges you can give me?'''
:''"You've already learned all I can teach you."''
He will then reward you with the [[Skyrim:Fang of Haynekhtnamet|Fang of Haynekhtnamet]].

==Bugs==
Sometimes the fish you can pick up (not caught by fishing) mentioned above aren't there. If this happens, you can zone and zone back to get them to spawn. (For Ancestor Glade, leave the cave and zone back in. For Pilgrim's Trench, zone into nearby Ysgramor's Tomb and back out.)

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Only Show In Town===
[[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]] is a dedicated [[Skyrim:Court Wizard|court wizard]] serving [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf the Greater]] at [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. Most of his time is spent studying and advising the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] on the current [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] threat.
However, he does have time to assist the locals in town. If you ask him if he is the only wizard in town, he will acknowledge that while, technically, he is alone in his craft, the town also holds other practitioners. And, since he's on the subject, he remembers he has some [[Skyrim:Farengar's Frost Salt|frost salts]] he'd promised to pick up for local alchemist [[Skyrim:Arcadia|Arcadia]], the proprietor of [[Skyrim:Arcadia's Cauldron|Arcadia's Cauldron]]. He asks if you wouldn't mind delivering the frost salts; Arcadia will surely compensate you for them. When you tell him you will help him out, he will respond with a disparaging remark, but will hand you the frost salts, a quest item not to be dropped. 

===He'll Never Know What Hit Him===
Head to Arcadia's Cauldron and enter during regular business hours, specifically between 8am and 8pm, or even when she strolls around the main trading room in the evening; as always, she will claim you have a fatal [[Skyrim:Disease|disease]] in hopes you will buy one of her potions, but will be grateful for the salts. She then reveals she needs the salts for a love elixir meant for the unsuspecting Farengar, and will then hand you three [[Skyrim:Potions|potions]] as compensation. Additionally, as you have now earned her [[Skyrim:Disposition|friendship]], almost all the various [[Skyrim:Ingredients|ingredients]] and potions in her shop are free to take.

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Talk to Calcelmo in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]].
#Kill [[Skyrim:Nimhe|Nimhe]], a giant [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spider]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Scholar===
Calcelmo, an accomplished scholar and author, is the owner and curator of the private [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Dwemer museum]] and the associated [[Skyrim:Nchuand-Zel#Nchuand-Zel Excavation Site|Nchuand-Zel]] archaeological dig site. Should you wish to enter either of these locales, you must go through Calcelmo. He spends his time at the [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] set up across the underground river from the entrance to the Nchuand-Zel excavation site. Talk to him about his work, and he will inform you that he has been placed in charge of curating artifacts extracted from Nchuand-Zel, an ancient [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] castle located deep within the mountain behind Understone Keep. He mentions his excavation efforts being thwarted by the presence of Nimhe, a giant frostbite spider that is blocking the entrance to Nchuand-Zel. He asks you to kill the spider in exchange for access to both his Dwemer museum and the site itself. If you agree, he will give you the [[Skyrim:Key to Nchuand-Zel|key to Nchuand-Zel]].

===Nchuand-Zel===

The entrance to the Nchuand-Zel excavation site is a large metal door at the top of a short flight of stairs directly across the stone bridge from where Calcelmo's arcane enchanter is set up. Once inside, you will encounter a set of two square rooms connected to each other, with staircases on all sides of each room. All staircases are blocked by crumbled stone except the one at the far left, which provides access to the excavation site. After proceeding through a short passage, you will descend into an area which is still under excavation (mostly dirt and wooden scaffolding), and encounter two or three frostbite spiders. After killing these, you will proceed a little deeper into the excavation area, where you will come across a seemingly dead end, with webs on part of the wall. Look closely and you will see that some of the webbing is blocking a passage. Cut through the webs to provide access to the passage, which leads to a room with a raised stone walkway with stairs at the opposite end, covered with spider webs. If you look up, you will see the large webbed hole in the ceiling through which Nimhe will descend once you approach.

===Cleaning House===
Dispatching of Nimhe may prove difficult within the tight quarters, since there is very little room to maneuver in order to pull back from her attacks. An option is to retreat back down the corridor from which you came and attack Nimhe with ranged weapons or spells, as she cannot fit in the passage. Once the deed is done, search through more webbing at the top of the stone walkway to find the body of [[Skyrim:Alethius|Alethius]], and clues leading to [[Skyrim:The Lost Expedition|another quest]] within Nchuand-Zel.

Once you inform Calcelmo of the giant spider's demise he will award you the [[Skyrim:Dwemer Museum Key|Dwemer Museum key]], allowing access at any time. Following the completion of this quest, the various Dwemer metal parts on the two tables near Calcelmo and his nephew may now be taken without consequence.

==Notes==
* Despite access to Nchuand-Zel being promised by Calcelmo as a reward for this quest, the area may be accessed, and thus Nimhe encountered, beforehand by picking the lock on the excavation site door.
* You can access Nchuand-Zel without killing Nimhe, but this may prove rather difficult, as her large body blocks a good deal of the rather small antechamber preceding the entrance.
* This quest can be done in conjunction with the quests "[[Skyrim:Hard Answers|Hard Answers]]" and "[[Skyrim:If I had a Hammer|If I had a Hammer]]{{CC|Stendarr's Hammer}}" to allow legal entry to the Dwemer Museum but not to [[Skyrim:Calcelmo's Laboratory|Calcelmo's Laboratory]], further beyond.

Skyrim:Supply and Demand.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=The Silencer |checkedBy= |reward=The Silencer |rewardChecked= }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=Reading the note, [[Skyrim:Shipment's Ready|Shipment's Ready]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Riften Warehouse|Riften Warehouse]], [[Skyrim:Cragslane Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Raid|The Raid]] |Reward=Enchanted Weapon |Image=SR-interior-Cragslane Cavern 03.jpg |Imgdesc=The Skooma Dealer |description=Clear [[Skyrim:Cragslane Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]] for the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. |ID=FreeformRiften01 |Disp= =3 ([[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]) if you helped 5 people of Riften |SuggLevel=6 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Read the [[Skyrim:Shipment's Ready|note]] you were required to find to finish the [[Skyrim: The Raid|previous quest]]. # Report to the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Visit and clear the [[Skyrim:Cragslane_Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]]. # Return to the Jarl of Riften. == Detailed Walkthrough == === Locate The Suppliers === After you have read the [[Skyrim:Shipment's Ready|letter]] you will need to return to the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]]. When you tell her that you have discovered the location of the [[Skyrim:Skooma|skooma]] traders, she will ask that they ''"be destroyed once and for all"'', and entice you with the prospect of a title in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. This prompts an update of the quest to find the cave. The cave is north of Riften, and northeast of [[Skyrim:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]]. There is a single [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandit]] and two [[Skyrim:Pit Wolf|pit wolves]] outside the cave. The wolves should be inside the two level-locked cages, but are sometimes found roaming the small camp. === Disruption === [[File:SR-interior-Cragslane Cavern.jpg|thumb|Cragslane Cavern Guard]][[File:SR-interior-Cragslane Cavern 02.jpg|thumb|The wolf pit of Cragslane Cavern]] Enter the cave to find a bandit standing guard near a lit lantern; after you ignore the warnings, or get too close, you will be attacked. Further down the tunnel and around the corner is the main gathering room of the suppliers. There are three [[Skyrim:Gambler|gamblers]], a [[Skyrim:Barkeep|barkeep]], and a pit wolf in the first part, and a bandit, and two pit wolves locked in cages, in the second part. Loot the barkeep for the [[Skyrim:Craglane Chest Key|{{Sic|Craglane|Cragslane|nolink=1}} chest key]], and the second bandit for the [[Skyrim:Craglane Dog Cage Key|{{Sic|Craglane|Cragslane|nolink=1}} dog cage key]]. Go behind the bar in the northwestern corner to find a leveled {{hover|Craglane chest key|apprentice-locked}} chest, a bowl of [[Skyrim:Moon Sugar|moon sugar]], two bottles of skooma, and a copy of the [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|Lockpicking]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:The Wolf Queen, v1|The Wolf Queen, v1]]''. The second part of the cave contains another leveled {{hover|Craglane chest key|apprentice-locked}} chest with a [[Skyrim:Bear Trap|bear trap]] in front of it, the two {{hover|Craglane dog cage key|apprentice-locked}} wolf cages, and spread over the preparation area, a few [[Skyrim:Ingredients|ingredients]], a bowl of moon sugar and seven bottles of skooma. There is also a set of [[Skyrim:Miner's Clothes|miner's clothes]], which are rare to find lying loose. === A Reward Well Earned === After two quests involving two fights, one of which descends into a large brawl, you have well earned a reward. Return to the jarl and she will reward you with a random enchanted weapon, and express her gratefulness, ''"Your continued efforts have been of great benefit to the people of Riften."'' Additionally, if [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]] is jarl, then following the eradication of the bandits in [[Skyrim:Cragslane Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]], she will send her people to gather any remaining merchandise because ''"We can't have that substance falling into the wrong hands now, can we?"'' She will also reward you with some gold, stating that ''"this should suffice as your cut of the... or rather, a reward for your actions."'' == Notes == * Every person in the cave must die by the player's hand for the quest to progress. All the wolves, however, can be spared. * The rewarded weapon's enchantment and type are both random. * This is the third of three quests that are required to unlock the option to become [[Skyrim:I Done Got Thaned!|Thane of Riften]] for the Jarl of Riften. There are additional requirements noted on that quest's page. == Bugs == {{Bug|If [[Skyrim:Cragslane Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]] has been cleared before receiving the quest, you will need to go to more trouble to complete it.|OSP|1.9}} **When this occurs, you need to clear the cavern three times in order for the quest to complete. You need to kill a total of seven bandits to "disrupt the operation", but only the three bandits respawn after you have cleared it. Travel far away and wait thirty days for the cavern to reset. Return and kill the bandits three times to get a total of seven. **{{pc22}} You can use the console command player.setstage FreeformRiften01 40 to advance to the next quest stage. **{{pc22}} An alternative workaround is to repeatedly resurrect one of the dead bandits via console until you have a total of seven dead NPCs. **Another workaround is to repeatedly resurrect one of the dead bandits via [[Skyrim:Dead Thrall|Dead Thrall]] until you have a total of seven dead NPCs.{{vn}} {{Bug|If you exit the cave during the fight and reenter, the quest may not advance.|confirmed=1}} **Sometimes after you buy the house the jarl still won't have the quest finishing dialogue.{{vn}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Report skooma source to Jarl of Riften}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Find the skooma dealers in Cragslane Cavern}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Disrupt the skooma operation}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Report to the Jarl of Riften}} |200|fin|{{Quest Comment|Completing quest and starting quest [[Skyrim:I Done Got Thaned!|I Done Got Thaned!]]}} }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:The Raid|The Raid]]}}

===A Proper Setting===

If you offer to help, he will tell you he needs three [[Skyrim:Flawless Amethyst|flawless amethysts]]. There are nine guaranteed gems found in eight different locations. Starting at level 12, you may also buy them from merchants at a base cost of 180 gold, find them as random loot, or get them randomly while mining. When you return to Talen-Jei with the gems, he will thank you, and reward you with a random leveled potion.
