Skyrim:Grimsever's Return.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver= [[Skyrim:Mjoll the Lioness |Mjoll the Lioness]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]] |Reward=Mjoll the Lioness as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] |Image=SR-quest-Grimsever's Return.jpg |ReqLevel=14 |Imgdesc=Mjoll's sword and shield resting on a blood-stained stone table |description=Recover [[Skyrim:Mjoll the Lioness|Mjoll]]'s beloved sword, [[Skyrim:Grimsever|Grimsever]], from [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]]. |ID=FreeformRiften09 |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Mjoll the Lioness |Mjoll the Lioness]]) |SuggLevel=16 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[SR:Mjoll the Lioness|Mjoll the Lioness]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Find [[SR:Grimsever|Grimsever]] in the Dwemer ruins of [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]]. # Return to Mjoll. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Mjoll the Lioness=== [[Skyrim:Mjoll the Lioness|Mjoll the Lioness]] lives in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] where she spends her time speaking out against the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] and talking to her faithful follower [[Skyrim:Aerin|Aerin]] about the evils in the world. Acting on her convictions, she has taken on the responsibility of patrolling the town, which she does every day; from 9am she can be found in the Market, at noon she will be inside [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|The Bee and Barb]], and from 6pm she patrols the streets of Riften until midnight. Once you reach level 14, however, Mjoll will have more on her mind than just the Thieves Guild. In her younger days, she traveled and adventured all over [[Lore:Tamriel|Tamriel]] but lost her favorite blade [[Skyrim:Grimsever|Grimsever]] when she ventured into the ancient [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] ruin of [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]]. The dangers of the ruin nearly took her life as well, so she retired from adventuring and settled down in Riften. She admits that she feels defenseless without her blade and has a hard time finding a replacement. You can then offer to help her and, while she will refer to it as a 'fool's errand', she will also let you undertake the task, adding a map marker for Mzinchaleft. === Mzinchaleft=== [[File:SR-place-Mzinchaleft.jpg|thumb|right|Mzinchaleft]] Mzinchaleft is a large Dwemer ruin located in the snowy tundra east of [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]], northwest of the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Vigilant|Hall of the Vigilant]]. [[Skyrim:Bandit|Bandits]] now inhabit the first zones of the ruin and you will encounter up to six of them guarding the entrance. Fight them, locate the door and prepare for a very long dungeon crawl. Once inside, head down the first two slopes and fight the two bandits residing near the campfire. Proceed through the tunnels until you reach a room with two bandits and a cauldron. Dispose of them and claim some minor loot from the chest. At the intersection, kill the bandit and claim [[Skyrim: Maluril's Room Key|Maluril's Room Key]] from his body, then use it to unlock the gate. During the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] quest [[Skyrim:Kill Maluril|Kill Maluril]], the quarters behind the door will be occupied by [[Skyrim:Maluril|Maluril]] but, during this quest you will find them empty. Read through the [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:A Dance in Fire, v7|A Dance in Fire, v7]]'' then backtrack to the intersection and proceed in a southern direction. In the next chamber you will witness two [[Skyrim:Dwarven Sphere|Dwarven spheres]] dispose of some bandits before coming after you. Fight them all and keep heading south, following the path as it twists and turns, and disposing of the various automatons along the way. Before long, you will reach an area with a handle and two gates, and several more handles behind the gates. Pull the only available handle and the gate to the east will open. Pull the new handle and the gate to the south will open. Pull the new handle and backtrack to the previous handle and pull it again. Go into a newly opened chamber to the south and pull the handle. Head south yet again and pull the handle, then backtrack to the previous handle and pull it again. Return to the very first handle and pull it. This opens the two gates to the southeast, giving you access to a valve. You'll find an unlocked chest and a master-locked chest in the room with the valve. Activate the valve and the path will now be clear and provide access to the next zone, [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft Depths|Mzinchaleft Depths]]. ===The Depths=== When the elevator brings you down into the Mzinchaleft Depths, the first thing you will notice is a dead [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] and the recognizable sound of a [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]] on the other side of the locked door. The door hides a very large multi-leveled chamber filled with Falmer enemies and plenty of secret areas, so make sure to raid every corner before leaving through the door to the east. Two Falmer enemies wait in the next chamber, so dispose of them and proceed forward, into a tunnel-like system with more Falmer. Watch out for a [[Skyrim:Traps#Tripwire|tripwire]] triggering a [[Skyrim:Traps#Claw|claw trap]] as you enter the next room and fight even more Falmer and a chaurus. The tents contain minor loot and a dead [[Skyrim:Bandit_(dead)#Orc_Male|bandit]]. Find the tunnel to the north and open a gate to another huge chamber with a fountain in the middle. Fight the inevitable Falmer enemies and head up the bridge to the north. At the top, fight another Falmer and locate the button and activate it. This will open the path in the southwestern part of the chamber. More Falmer wait on the other side, including a boss, so finish them off and head up the stairs to the north and the entrance to the third and final zone, [[Skyrim: Mzinchaleft Gatehouse|Mzinchaleft Gatehouse]]. ===Grimsever=== In the Gatehouse, you will only have to go around the corner before you will encounter the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Centurion|Dwarven Centurion]] that nearly killed Mjoll the Lioness back in the day. It will attack right away and will be accompanied by a [[Skyrim:Dwarven Sphere|Dwarven Sphere]]. After the battle, locate [[Skyrim:Grimsever|Grimsever]], which is lying on a table. Find the boss-leveled chest behind bars to the north and pull the nearby handle to gain access. Lastly, if you have the [[Skyrim: Attunement_Sphere|attunement sphere]], you can gain access to [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]] from here. When all is said and done, open the western door and activate the handle to be brought back outside, emerging from an alternate entrance west of the main entrance. Back in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] you will find Mjoll patrolling [[#Mjoll the Lioness|as usual]]. When you hand her the blade, she will be overly impressed: ''"Astonishing. To think you actually were able to reach it and yet return to tell the tale. Rarely in my travels have I encountered those who possess skills equal to your own. I see I still have much to learn. If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time."'' Alternatively, if you told her of your hopes to join the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], she will instead say: ''"When you told me of your intent to join the Thieves Guild, I honestly didn't think we'd have much to speak about ever again. Yet here you are with my weapon that you could have easily sold or kept for yourself. Forgive me for my hasty opinion of you, I see that I was wrong and that there's much I can learn from you. If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time."'' Either way, she will then be available as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] and a potential candidate for [[Skyrim:Marriage|marriage]]. ==Notes== * [[Skyrim:Grimsever|Grimsever]] cannot currently be found in [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]] before Grimsever's Return has been triggered. Contrary to older versions of the game, entering or clearing [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]] beforehand does not cause the sword to spawn. Its usual location will remain empty until the quest has been triggered. {{Bug|Grimsever is a one-handed Glass Sword though Mjoll is more proficient in two-handed weapons.|USKP|1.2.3|Grimsever is now a Glass Greatsword to match her skills better.}} * After completing the quest, Mjoll will be available as a follower, at which point you can "trade" inventory with her and take Grimsever back. Any smithing upgrades made to Grimsever before giving it back to Mjoll will be lost, though you can upgrade it again. * If you are already level 14 or above when you first interact with Mjoll, you must also gain another level after your initial conversation and return to her before the dialogue option to begin this quest becomes available. * The boss fight presents a considerable challenge for a level 14 character, but you don't actually have to defeat the Centurion to get Grimsever. You can make a run for it, pick up the sword on the fly and head straight for the exit. * You will need to level up via skill increases to or beyond level 9 for the quest to be eligible to start. You cannot be console-commanded to an arbitrarily high level and start the quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If Mzinchaleft has already been discovered or cleared before Grimsever's Return is started, or you exceed the level requirement the quest may fail to trigger, with its aliases remaining empty.|confirmed=1}} :*{{pc22}} If the quest cannot otherwise be started, it can be bypassed with the [[Skyrim:Console|console]]. Use setstage FreeformRiften09 200 to mark the quest as complete, then prid 00019DF7 to select Mjoll and setrelationshiprank 00000014 1 to set her relationship with the player to Friend. Finally, use additem 00053379 1 to give Mjoll a copy of Grimsever. This reproduces the quest's relevant rewards, allowing Mjoll to be recruited or married normally. {{Bug|Mjoll might not give you the quest to retrieve Grimsever despite fulfilling the above criteria, and Grimsever may not appear in the Mzinchaleft Gatehouse as stated above.|confirmed=1}} :*{{pc22}} You may use the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] to make her your friend with player.setrelationshiprank 00019DF7 4, allowing you to recruit her as a follower. After using her as a follower for a few days, she may give you the quest, and Grimsever should spawn. :*{{pc22}} You can use the console code player.additem 00053379 1 to give yourself the sword, then talk with her and give it to her. This may result in two copies of Grimsever being present in the game. :*{{pc22}} An internal conflict with the first scripted conversation between Mjoll and Aerin about "another run-in with the Thieves Guild" upon entering Riften means that you must level up -after- the scripted conversation has occurred (to level 14 or later) before Mjoll will offer the Grimsever quest. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Locate Grimsever}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Return to Mjoll}} |200|fin| |missing=10, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
If you walk near [[Skyrim:Wujeeta|Wujeeta]], she will cry about losing her job and beg for help. Talk to her, and she will reveal that she has an addiction to [[Skyrim:Skooma|skooma]] and that she wants to cure herself. She will ask for a healing potion in order to heal herself. If you probe further she will mention where she got the skooma from, ''"I got mine off of a [[Skyrim:Red Wave|merchant ship]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]"'', which ties in with another [[Skyrim:The Dainty Sload|quest]].

You have three options: agree to give her a potion, agree to find one for her, or refuse to help. If you refuse to give her a potion, the option remains to agree to give her one. If you agree to give her a potion, the lowest type of standard healing potion (e.g. [[Skyrim:Potion of Minor Healing|Potion of Minor Healing]]) in your inventory will be removed, and she will reward you with a leveled unenchanted ring while thanking you, ''"Your kindness will never be forgotten"''.

Dialogue is closed at this point and the first part of the [[Skyrim:The Raid|next quest]] is immediately added to the miscellaneous quests.

==Notes==
* Healing spells do not work and she does not recognize crafted healing potions. She can only take a standard healing potion.
* This is the first of three quests that are required to unlock the option to become [[Skyrim:I Done Got Thaned!|Thane of the Rift]] for [[Skyrim:Laila Law-Giver|Laila Law-Giver]] or [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]]. There are additional requirements noted on that quest's page.
* Raising Wujeeta's disposition with this quest will allow you to freely take items from the fish barrels inside Riften Fishery and around the nearby fishing boats.

Wylandriah's items can be acquired in any order. To find the spoon, go to Ivarstead and enter Fellstar Farm's house. Wylandriah's satchel is sitting on a table. To find the soul gem, go to The White Phial in the market in Windhelm. There are two barrels under the staircase; Wylandriah's satchel is on top of the barrel closest to the door. To find the orichalcum ingot, go to The Frozen Hearth in Winterhold right across from the [[Skyrim:Jarl's Longhouse (Winterhold)|jarl's longhouse]]. Wylandriah's satchel is on the bookshelf with the [[Skyrim:Elves Ear|elves ear]] plants next to [[Skyrim:Nelacar|Nelacar]]'s room. Return to Wylandriah with the items and she will give you several random [[Skyrim:Scrolls|scrolls]] as a reward, but will have no recollection of actually setting you on the task.

==Notes==
* The orichalcum ingot is a special quest version found only in her satchel, but not named like the other two items.
* Fellstar Farm is locked during the day, so you may want to enter at night if you don't want to risk getting caught trespassing. Or, if you are trying to maintain a good character, you can wait until the family stops working in the garden. Then, one by one, they will enter the house. The mother is the last one to enter the house. After she enters, the house becomes unlocked, and you can enter the house without trespassing.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|If you pick up one of the items before engaging in the quest, Wylandriah may not ask this favor. Finding all three should trigger an update and allow them to be turned in though.|USKP|2.0.4}}
{{Bug|Wylandriah's Soul Gem is fillable, and despite being a quest item it can be used to recharge enchanted weapons. Using the gem to recharge enchanted weapons will consume the gem thus making the quest impossible to complete.|USKP|1.0|Wylandriah's Soul Gem has been changed to be non-fillable.}}
{{Bug|In some cases the items will not show up when you search the satchels, making the quest impossible to complete.|confirmed=1}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Speak with [[Skyrim:Hafjorg|Hafjorg]].
# Obtain an unusual [[Skyrim:Quest Items#Quicksilver Ore|quicksilver ore]] sample from [[Skyrim:Filnjar|Filnjar]].
# Return the ore sample to Hafjorg.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Helping out===
Should you find yourself in [[Skyrim:Elgrim's Elixirs|Elgrim's Elixirs]], commiserate with [[Skyrim:Hafjorg|Hafjorg]] about how much she has to do at the shop. She will tell you that caring for her husband, [[Skyrim:Elgrim|Elgrim]], is holding her back from getting things done; specifically running an errand to [[Skyrim:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]] to retrieve an unusual ore sample. Offer to fetch it for her:
:'''You've got your hands full, eh?'''
:''"I swear, if I wasn't around, Elgrim would forget to eat his meals. How we make any coin at all is beyond me. In fact, I need to arrange for someone to pick up an ore sample for me in Shor's Stone... goodness knows Elgrim won't lift a finger to do it."'' Telling her that you could get it for her will have her say, 
:'''I could get it for you.'''
:''"You would? Oh, that would be wonderful. Speak to Filnjar in Shor's Stone. He's got some sort of ore sample he wants us to identify and was willing to pay us well for it."'' 

===Shor's Stone===
[[File:SR-icon-ore-Quicksilver Ore.png|right|thumb|Sample of quicksilver]]
In Shor's Stone, seek out [[Skyrim:Filnjar|Filnjar]] at his home and smithy. Let him know you are there for the ore, and after some derisive comments about Elgrim, he hands over a sample of quicksilver. He explains that he needs Elgrim to examine this particular piece as its discovery coincided with a strange invasion of [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] in [[Skyrim:Redbelly Mine|Redbelly mine]]:
:'''I'm here for Elgrim's ore sample.'''
:''"It's about time; I sent them a letter weeks ago. That [[Skyrim:Elgrim|Elgrim]]... he'd forget his own pants if his wife didn't help him dress. Here you go. Tell Hafjorg that she can chip off whatever she thinks is a fair trade for their time."'' 
:'''What's so special about this ore?'''
:''"Redbelly is supposed to be nothing but an iron mine. Been working it for years. Then right before the spiders had moved in, we found that chunk of ore. Never seen anything like it. I want to know what I'm dealing with before I start tearing it out of the ground."''

===Four Potions===
Bring the sample to Hafjorg. She makes a sarcastic comment about her husband's busy schedule, but had him make you four leveled [[Skyrim:Skills|skill]] potions to compensate you for your travel:
:'''I've brought the ore sample from Filnjar.'''
:''"Thank you. I'll be sure to get Elgrim to examine this as soon as his... busy schedule allows. Here, I had him make you a few things for all that travel."'

==Notes==
* The [[Skyrim:Quest Items#Quicksilver Ore|ore sample]] is a special variety of [[Skyrim:Quicksilver Ore|quicksilver ore]]; it cannot be used for [[Skyrim:Smelter|smelting]].
* Although Filnjar has apparently been waiting for a courier for some time, the quest can only be started through Hafjorg.
* While it is implied that the special ore is in some way related to the appearance of the spiders at the mine, this is never addressed or brought up again in any other quests.

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=The Silencer |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=The Silencer |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Wujeeta|Wujeeta]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] |Reward=None |Prev=[[Skyrim:Helping_Hand|Helping Hand]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Supply_and_Demand|Supply and Demand]] |Image=SR-quest-The_Raid.jpg |Imgdesc=Discover a cache of moon sugar and skooma while investigating. |description=Help the [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] to uncover and stop the illegal [[Skyrim:Skooma|skooma]] trade in town. |ID=FreeformRiften20 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Wujeeta|Wujeeta]] after completing the [[Skyrim:Helping_Hand|Helping Hand]] quest. # Report to the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] about the presence of a [[Skyrim:Skooma|skooma]] dealer in town. # "Deal" with [[Skyrim:Sarthis Idren|Sarthis Idren]], and find evidence to locate his sources. # Return to the jarl with the evidence. ==Detailed Walkthrough== === Illegal Trade === After completing the [[Skyrim:Helping_Hand|Helping Hand]] quest, you can ask [[Skyrim:Wujeeta|Wujeeta]] where she obtained her [[Skyrim:Skooma|skooma]]. She is not forthcoming with the details, however you can pass an easy-level [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to persuade her to tell you the truth. {|class=wikitable width="100%" !width=25%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=20%|Reaction |- | I think you owe me one. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Okay, okay, I'll tell you.
'''Failed''': It's not worth dying over.||'''Passed''': Reveal the supplier
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Here, does this help? '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Okay, okay, I'll tell you.
'''Failed''': It's got nothing to do with the coin... this is my life we're talking about.||'''Passed''': Reveal the supplier
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | And who says I won't? '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Okay, okay, I'll tell you.
'''Failed''': You can't threaten me any worse than they have!||'''Passed''': Reveal the supplier
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Okay, never mind.||colspan=4|Thank you.||Nothing |} At last, she will reveal her supplier as [[Skyrim:Sarthis Idren|Sarthis Idren]] and his base as [[Skyrim:Riften Warehouse|Riften Warehouse]]. She explains that the warehouse is always locked and that only the jarl has a key. The next step is to report the presence of a skooma dealer to the jarl. The current jarl in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] will acknowledge Sarthis and his illegal operations. However, the dealer has informants in the town guard because he disappears every time they raid the warehouse. Perhaps, an outsider may be able to surprise Sarthis in the warehouse, and ''"'convince' him to close down his operation"''. If you accept the mission, you will be given the [[Skyrim:Riften Warehouse Key|Riften Warehouse Key]] to unlock the warehouse. === The Raid === The warehouse is located at the southern end of Riften's docks. [[Skyrim:Orini Dral|Orini Dral]] is patrolling the warehouse, and will immediately spot you. Sarthis is in the basement and will come rushing upstairs to aid his bodyguard. Orini is a modest opponent, but Sarthis can prove a difficult opponent to defeat. When they are dead, loot Sarthis' body for [[Skyrim:Sarthis's Key|his key]]. Descend the stairs in the northeastern corner, turn around and use the key to unlock the door. On the shelves there are five bowls of [[Skyrim:Moon Sugar|moon sugar]] and six bottles of skooma. On the table there is another bowl of moon sugar and two bottles of skooma. Inside Sarthis' satchel there is a [[Skyrim:Shipment's Ready|note]] with information regarding Sarthis' sources. Make sure to read the note to advance the quest. === It's Not Over Yet === Return to the jarl with the evidence and news of Sarthis' demise. The jarl will be grateful, saying, ''"It's nice to receive good news for a change"'', but will ask you to continue the crusade, which starts the [[Skyrim:Supply and Demand|next quest]]. == Notes == * If Wujeeta dies before you report the skooma dealer to the jarl, you will fail the quest, making it impossible to become thane of the Rift regardless of who the jarl is. * If Sarthis is killed by anyone other than you, you will fail the quest. The key and the note can still be obtained, but no relevant dialogue option will be available from the jarl to proceed. * If you manage to sneak past or Calm Orini, you can spare his life. Only Sarthis has to die for the quest to progress. * This is the second of three required quests that are required to unlock the option to become [[Skyrim:I Done Got Thaned!|Thane of the Rift]]. There are additional requirements noted on that quest page. * The penultimate objective, "Recover skooma source information", will only register as completed if you read the note, unlike most other objectives of this type which only require you to take a note. * Despite [[Skyrim:Laila Law-Giver|Laila Law-Giver]] telling you to deal with Sarthis 'discreetly', stealth is not required to succeed in the quest. == Bugs == {{Bug|Even though you were given a key by the jarl, and it is occupied by enemies, you will be considered to be trespassing in the warehouse. If you have a follower they will react as such.|USKP|1.3.2}} ** Due to an engine limitation (see [https://afktrack.afkmods.com/index.php?a=issues&i=19602 this discussion]), the player will still incur an increment in their "Trespasses" stat after reading the note. ** There is a way to enter without it counting as trespassing. When you open the door, before you enter, immediately open the menu and make a fast travel. You will see that you will still enter the warehouse. Then load the game that was saved by making the fast travel. You will be in front of the door but now it will be open. Turn into a werewolf and access the warehouse. It will no longer count as trespassing. ** If your follower insists on reporting you for stealing the note, you will need to exit the warehouse to ask them to wait. {{Bug|The quest marker may be stuck at "Recover skooma source information" and point to the apothecary's satchel, even after you have killed Sarthis yourself and taken the Shipment's Ready note.|confirmed=1}} ** Reading the note should advance the quest as normal. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Identify Riften's skooma dealer}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Report Sarthis Idren to the Jarl of Riften}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Enter Riften Warehouse}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Eliminate Sarthis Idren}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Recover skooma source information}} |200|fin|{{Quest Comment|Starts [[Skyrim:Supply and Demand|Supply and Demand]]}} |missing=250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Helping_Hand|Helping Hand]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Supply_and_Demand|Supply and Demand]]}}

Skyrim:Stabilized.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=124.171.204.182 |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |addtrail=Favors |Giver=[[Skyrim:Shadr|Shadr]] |Loc=Riften |Reward=Leveled gold or a leveled [[Skyrim:Potion of Brief Invisibility|Potion of Invisibility]] |Image=SR-quest-Stabilized.jpg |Imgdesc=Sapphire demands Shadr pay his debts |description=Help [[Skyrim:Shadr|Shadr]] clear his debt with [[Skyrim:Sapphire (person)|Sapphire]]. |Difficulty=Easy |SuggLevel=Any |ID=FreeformRiften22 |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Shadr|Shadr]]) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Observe the conversation between [[Skyrim:Sapphire (person)|Sapphire]] and [[Skyrim:Shadr|Shadr]]. # Speak with Shadr. # Speak with Sapphire and either [[Skyrim:Speech#Skill Usage|pay or persuade]] her to clear the debt. # Return to Shadr. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Feeling Blue=== Upon your initial entry to [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], a conversation will take place between [[Skyrim:Sapphire (person)|Sapphire]], a member of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], and [[Skyrim:Shadr|Shadr]]. She is berating him for not paying his debt, to which he replies that he couldn't because his shipment was attacked. Sapphire alludes to the fact that she was behind it, but doesn't forgive his debt and demands that he pay it. She then walks off towards [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|The Bee and Barb]]. Shadr is usually on the bridge near the north entry gate (either standing or sitting on the bench), and when you talk to him he will explain his situation. You may then offer to assist him. ===Dealing with Sapphire=== When you speak with Sapphire you have a number of options for rectifying the situation: :'''If you are not a member of the Thieves Guild:''' You are presented with the options of [[Skyrim:Speech#Skill Usage|persuading]] Sapphire to clear the debt or paying it yourself. :'''If you are a member of the Thieves Guild:''' You will be presented with the option to be cut in for a leveled amount of gold, or make her forget the debt. Both options are related to threatening to expose her scheme to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]]. :'''If you are the Guildmaster:''' Sapphire will apologize about the scam and claim that she was going to talk with [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin]] about cutting the guild into the deal. You can either tell her to forget about the debt or split the take with her. If you accept the cut-in, you still need to return to Shadr to complete the quest. ===Reward=== If you were successful in having Sapphire erase the debt, return to Shadr who is grateful and gives you a leveled [[Skyrim:Potion of Brief Invisibility|potion of invisibility]]. This will also increase Shadr's [[Skyrim:Disposition|disposition]] towards you, meaning that you may be able to take items from the [[Skyrim:Riften Stables|Riften Stables]], including borrowing a [[Skyrim:Horses|horse]]. If you take Sapphire's offer, whether as a Thieves Guild member or the guildmaster, your cut will be a leveled amount of gold. {{SRLeveledReward|small|title=Payoff}} ==Bugs== {{Bug|Sapphire has speech options, but none of them perform the proper checks to see if you could succeed. This makes persuading her always succeed by default, no matter what level your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill is.|USKP|2.0.4|trackerid=15507}} {{Bug|In order to successfully intimidate Sapphire into dropping the debt, you need a Speech level which is unattainable by normal means, as the game setting value for intimidation of foolhardy NPCs is out of balance with the other settings.|USKP|2.1.2|trackerid=19173}} {{Bug|Completing this quest will allow you to ride the horses at [[Skyrim:Riften Stables|Riften Stables]] for free, due to the horses being owned by the stables faction specifically. It is unrealistic that a small favor like this should earn you free access to horses worth 1,000 gold.|USKP|2.1.2|trackerid=19062|The ownership of the horses was changed to just Hofgrir, rather than the faction, preventing this issue.}} {{Bug|Sapphire may not talk to you during this quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Opening up the console and using the command resetquest freeformriften22 followed by setstage freeformriften22 10 re-enables the quest trigger dialogue with Shadr. Don't simply reject helping him (as it triggers the bug) and just talk to Sapphire as usual and the quest will proceed as normal. If you do want to reject helping Shadr (and forfeit the quest reward), you will need to use stopquest freeformriften22 to get Sapphire to leave the Bee and Barb and move to [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon - Cistern|The Ragged Flagon]]. {{Bug|Telling Shadr you won't help him still pays you the reward and counts toward the Thane quest even though it shouldn't.|USKP|2.0.5|A script variable to prevent that from happening was missing and out-of-date.}} {{Bug|The quest may not shut down properly if you refuse to help Shadr with his debt.|USLEEP|3.0.1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|10|Speak to Sapphire about Shadr's debt}} |30||{{Quest Objective|20|Return to Shadr}} |missing=10, 200, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

ability to buy spell tome [[SR:Ash_Shell|Ash Shell]], [[SR:Ash_Rune|Ash Rune]], [[SR:Bound_Dagger|Bound Dagger]], [[SR:Conjure_Ash_Guardian|Conjure Ash Guardian]] from [[SR:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]] |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]]) |Loc=[[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]] |Image=SR-quest-From the Ashes.jpg |ImgDesc=Talvas Fathryon has accidentally summoned an ash guardian |ID=DLC2TTF1 |description= Help [[Skyrim:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]] by killing an [[Skyrim:Ash Guardian|ash guardian]]. |prereq=Main Dragonborn quest not running or you've been pointed towards Miraak's temple }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Enter [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]] and go up to the main floor. # (Optional) Talk to [[Skyrim:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]] as you exit Tel Mithryn. # Kill the [[Skyrim:Ash Guardian|ash guardian]] near the tower. # Return to Talvas Fathryon for your reward. == Detailed Walkthrough == [[File:SR-npc-Talvas Fathryon 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"It's on your head if something goes wrong."'']] When you arrive in Tel Mithryn, you'll find [[Skyrim:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]] and [[Skyrim:Varona Nelas|Varona Nelas]] in the middle of an argument. Talvas is attempting to summon an [[Skyrim:Ash Guardian|ash guardian]], but is having no luck. Enter the [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|main tower]] of Tel Mithryn, go up to the main floor, then go back outside. As soon as you leave, you'll see Talvas' summoning has finally worked. He'll run to you in a panic: the ash guardian he got is hostile! You'll have several reply options. However, even if you tell him to clean up his own mess it's no use: the quest will start and the enemy nearby will disable fast travel. Head down the stipe of the mushroom and confront the ash guardian out in front of Tel Mithryn. Be prepared for a tough fight at lower levels: this creature is level 30 and spews ash at long range that is also wide-arcing. Once the wayward summon is defeated, you'll have to talk to Talvas again. He's fled into Neloth's tower, so go find him. ''"What a relief,"'' he says once you have reported in. ''"I don't have any gold I can pay you with, but I can give you this staff."'' He will then prove true to his word and present you with a [[Skyrim:Staves|staff]]. In addition, you can now purchase the spell tome for Conjure Ash Guardian from him and recruit him as a follower. == Notes == * You must go up to the main floor of Tel Mithryn to advance this quest—merely entering and exiting the tower does not work. * You don't have to speak with Talvas when he's summoned the Ash Guardian. You can, for example, fast travel away and when you come back, you can kill the Ash Guardian without ever speaking with Talvas. * The Ash Guardian does not leave any remains behind after its death. * If you traded with Talvas outside, you will have to wait for him to restock his inventory before the Conjure Ash Guardian spell book becomes available. * If the Ash Guardian hasn't yet been destroyed, you can tell Neloth "Talvas summoned an Ash Guardian outside." Neloth will reply ''"What? That fool. His incompetence made this mess. Let's see how he decides to clean it up."'' * If your [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] skill is at least 65, Talvas gives you your choice of a random staff or the spell tome for Conjure Ash Guardian. * If you have a follower with you when the quest has begun, they may kill the Ash Guardian while you and Talvas are talking to each other. You should be able to talk to him immediately after that to get your reward. == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |100:3||{{Quest Objective|100|Destroy the Ash Guardian}} |^||Talvas has asked me to destroy an Ash Guardian that is running amok on the Tel Mithryn grounds. |^||I've encountered an Ash Guardian that is running amok on the Tel Mithryn grounds. |200||{{Quest Objective|100|Destroy the Ash Guardian}} {{Quest Objective|200|Talk to Talvas}} |300|fin|I destroyed the Ash Guardian that Talvas had accidentally summoned. He was quite grateful. |missing=5, 7, 10, 30, 50, 310, 320, 400 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

Skyrim:Hired Muscle.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Alfwyn |rewardChecked= }}{{Quest Header |type=Companions |addtrail=Radiant |Giver=[[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] |Reward=Leveled Gold |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Take Up Arms|Take Up Arms]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] |Image=SR-npc-Sven.jpg |ImgDesc=''"I just need you to go out there, look tough, and scare this milk drinker into submission."'' |description=Fulfill a contract for the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] to bring a citizen back in line. |ID=CR04 |radiant=yes |Icon=SR-qico-Companions.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to the assigned target. # Brawl with them to send a message, but don't kill them. # Return to [[SR:Farkas|Farkas]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== :''Note: it is best to complete this quest as soon as possible after receiving it, because many of the quest targets can possibly die (either through random or scripted events), at which point it becomes impossible to ever complete the quest or take any other jobs for the Companions.'' Farkas will send you to rough up one of over 400 different NPCs, encompassing nearly every citizen in Skyrim. The NPC will be located in a hold that you have previously visited, so early in the game you may only be given NPCs living in Whiterun Hold, but later in the game there are many more possible options. The NPC may live in a city, town, or a remote settlement. Once you have traveled to the target's location, talk to them and select the dialogue option to [[SR:brawl|brawl]] with them. It is best to start the brawl in an area with as few other NPCs as possible. In particular, it is best to have any [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] wait in a different room. You may not use any weapons, magic, or shouts during a brawl (but using spells such as [[Skyrim:Fear (spell)|Fear]] or [[Skyrim:Oakflesh|Oakflesh]] before the fight is permissible). If anyone else becomes hostile as a result of your brawling, you should be able to run to a guard and yield, clearing any hostility. If you kill the target, you will still complete the quest. The quest is marked as "Failed" in your quest journal, but it is no longer active, and you will be allowed to pursue other jobs in the Companions questline. Farkas will not be pleased, and you will receive a decreased amount of gold for your reward. Return to Farkas for a gold reward. ===Reward=== {{SRCompanionsRadiantReward}} ==Notes== {{Dragonborn Radiant Location Note}} *If your target is someone you can [[Skyrim:Fight! Fight!|fight for money]], you can collect a reward from them after the fight, even if you've already won a bet with them previously. *If your target is someone you can brawl for another quest (such as [[Skyrim:Mikael|Mikael]]), winning a brawl will complete the objective for both quests simultaneously. *There is a silent Intimidate check against the target as part of the quest's startup conditions. If it succeeds, you won't get the quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When you should "Return to Farkas", he doesn't give you the option to complete the quest.}} **Check whether you have quests from other Companions Council members and try completing those first. E.g. "Stealing Plans" from Aela will hinder you from completing "Hired Muscle". {{Bug|If one of the targets dies before you get the quest, you can no longer finish the quest or take any other jobs.}} ** You can reload a save before taking the contract. **{{Pc22}} Type Setstage cr04 20 into the console. {{Bug|Some targets reside in locations that require you to trespass. In these cases, your target's dialogue will constantly loop ''"You're not supposed to be in here"'' and not allow you to initiate the brawl, rendering the quest impossible to complete correctly.}} **Assault the target and then run to a non-trespassing location out in public, where the target will follow you. You can then yield by sheathing weapons, calm the target by using the [[Skyrim:Voice of the Emperor|Voice of the Emperor]] power, pay the fine for assault, or go to jail and hurry back to the target. **{{Pc22}} Use the console commands prid and your target's RefID, then movetoplayer to move the target to you, and the brawl can be initiated without committing a crime. **You may clear the quest from your active quest list by killing the target and thus failing the quest. After killing the target, return to Farkas and he will give you a lesser amount of gold for your payment before allowing you to take another job. {{Bug|It is also possible to get a target that has disappeared from the game. For instance, [[Skyrim:Atar|Atar]] after you have convinced him to leave.}} {{Bug|Farkas may be selected as the target of the quest, which will result in the game telling you to leave and then re-enter Jorrvaskr in an unending loop.}} {{vn|Is this true?}} **{{Pc22}} Typing Setstage cr04 20 into the console will allow you to skip the intimidation step and complete the quest. {{Bug|If the quest target doesn't have conversation topics then there will be no option to start a brawl and the quest won't be completeable.}} {{Bug| If you wear the Ebony Mail, have a companion, a dragon decides to attack the settlement, and the settlement is in the Whiterun hold the target can end up dead, and the guards will become hostile, and continue to attack you.
