{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Likelolwhat |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Likelolwhat }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Nightingale Blade|Nightingale Blade]] |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Speaking With Silence|Speaking with Silence]] |Next=[[Skyrim:The Pursuit|The Pursuit]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] |Image=SR-quest-Hard Answers.jpg |ImgDesc=The Falmer language inscribed on a tablet |description=Help translate [[Skyrim:Gallus's Encoded Journal|Gallus's journal]]. |ID=TG06 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[Skyrim:Enthir|Enthir]] at [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|The Frozen Hearth]] or [[Skyrim:Hall of Attainment|Hall of Attainment]]. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]] in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]]. #Enter the [[Skyrim:Dwemer Museum|Dwemer Museum]]. #Copy the Falmer Translation Guide. #Bring the copy of the Guide to Enthir. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] in The Frozen Hearth. ==Detailed Walkthrough== First go speak with [[Skyrim:Enthir|Enthir]] at [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|The Frozen Hearth]] in [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. After speaking with Enthir, you'll be directed to the wizard [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]] at [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. : ''Note:'' There is a [[SR:Hard Answers#Bugs|bug]] that prevents you from talking to Enthir if you have started but not completed the quests [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] or [[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|The Eye of Magnus]], as Enthir believes Winterhold to be in danger and will continually repeat ''"This is going to be terrible for business."'' ===Calcelmo, the Wizard=== You can find Calcelmo overseeing the excavation site in Understone Keep. He's not happy to be disturbed and no matter what you choose to do, will not be interested in helping you translate the journal—at best, he will grant you access to his museum. You have several options on how to proceed: *You can go straight to the museum and pick the lock. **Using this method causes the guards in the museum to be hostile, and as they are city guards you will incur a bounty if you kill them. *You can simply steal his key, which should be right next to him on the table. **This option will cause the guards to be hostile, unless you are successfully hidden. *If you ask to visit the archaeological site, you will be asked to kill [[Skyrim:Nimhe|Nimhe]] (a giant frostbite spider). After you have done this task you will be given the key to the museum, and can walk past the city guards without sneaking. *Solving Calcelmo's love problems during [[Skyrim:The Book of Love|The Book of Love]] will add additional dialogue where he will hand over the key to the museum, and allow you passage (the guard at the door will still tell you you can't enter, but the guards in the museum won't bother you). * If you can pass a hard [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]], you can persuade him to give you the key to the museum. {|class=wikitable width="100%" !width=26%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=12%|Reaction |- | Even after slaying your troublesome spider?||colspan=4|I've already provided you a key to the museum. You should consider it an honor. Few are allowed to browse my collection. I'm sorry, but that's as far as my generosity extends.||No progress |- | Even after everything I did for you and Faleen?||colspan=4|Well, I'm not blind to the fact that you've been instrumental in improving my affairs of the heart. If you wish, you may enter my tower to view the museum section, but I'm afraid the laboratories are still off limits. That's the best I can offer.||No progress |- | But I'm a great admirer of your work. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': What kind of a mentor would I be if I denied a potential student a glimpse at his master's ingenuity! Here, this key will provide access to my museum. Feel free to browse for as long as you wish. However, I must insist that my laboratory remains strictly off limits.
'''Failed''': While I appreciate the sentiment, I still have to decline. Being an admirer, I'm sure you can appreciate the need to keep my research a secret.||'''Passed''': Get the key
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | What will it cost to change your mind? '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Failed''': I'm not certain how many scholars you're accustomed to dealing with, but I can assure you that personal wealth is our lowest priority.||'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Grant me access or you'll regret it. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Failed''': Do you realize that at a snap of my fingers I can bring the entire Markarth city guard to my defense? You best rethink this course of action or you may find yourself on the executioner's block.||'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Forget it. Maybe I'll come back later.||colspan=4|Very well. Perhaps when my research is complete, I'll feel more comfortable discussing my findings with you.||Nothing |} ===Enter the Museum=== Whatever you chose to do, it's clear you're going to have to break into Calcelmo's laboratory in order to retrieve the Falmer Translation Guide, so head for the Dwemer Museum. There are a lot of random Dwemer artifacts and books in the museum, but most notably, there is a gate on the south side protecting a room containing an [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|Unusual Gem]]—the gem is located on a table to your right as you enter the first room on the left. Make your way to the far end of the museum to find the entrance to Calcelmo's Laboratory. As you enter the lab, you can find the [[Skyrim:Spider Control Rod|Spider Control Rod]] in the room to the left, which you can use to help clear out the guards ahead (note that the rod only works in the lab). There are two types of guards in the museum and laboratory: [[Skyrim:Markarth City Guard|Markarth City guards]] and Calcelmo's personal guards. The city guards here will not be hostile (provided you didn't pick the Museum lock), but Calcelmo's personal guards in the lab will confront you if they spot you, no matter what (though they will not give you a bounty if they are harmed). It's possible to sneak past all the guards in the lab without any combat, but you can also employ the various traps around the lab to dispatch them quickly. Whatever you choose, make your way to the end of the laboratory. As you make your way through, beware the hall with the poison gas; your health will drain rapidly until you reach the other side, and it is not possible to prevent the damage with poison resistances, even with items such as [[Skyrim:Hevnoraak (item)|Hevnoraak]]. Putting 40 pounds of weight (either the body of a dead guard or a heavy item such as [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armor|Dwarven armor]]) on the pressure plate at either end of the hall will depress the plate and stop the gas from spreading, allowing you to comfortably loot the corpses. You can also [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] and not suffer the poison for the duration of the shout (though be warned, this may alert nearby guards). The poison gas hall can be avoided entirely by taking a different higher route eastwards. At the end of the lab, you'll find [[Skyrim:Aicantar|Aicantar]]'s study, where Calcelmo's nephew is busy with his research. Activating the trap here will send Aicantar into a panic and he and his guards will make a run for it (or you can just sneak past him). Near the exit, you can find the [[Skyrim:Dwemer Puzzle Cube|Dwemer Puzzle Cube]] for [[Skyrim:The Litany of Larceny|The Litany of Larceny]] quest. Exit out onto the Wizard's Balcony and head up the stairs to the right into Calcelmo's Tower. In the tower, follow the hall to the left to find a room with a desk. Beyond the room is the Falmer Translation Guide, which turns out to be a massive stone tablet. There's no way you're taking the whole thing back to Enthir, so grab a piece of charcoal and paper from the previous room and use them to create a rubbing of the tablet. ===Return to Enthir=== After you copy the text, two [[Skyrim:Wizards' Guard|Wizards' Guards]], [[Skyrim:Captain Aquilius|Captain Aquilius]], and Aicantar will enter the tower to hunt you down. You may fight them if you wish, but you can also simply sneak past them after they split up. Distracting the remaining guard with an arrow is a good way to aid a stealthy approach. For the quickest escape, look towards the exit from the tablet and you'll notice a small ledge on either side of the wall over the door. Move from behind the tablet onto the platform to your left, then jump onto the little "chimney" at the end of the platform. From there, you can jump onto the small ledge and proceed directly to the door. Once outside, a waypoint will indicate your exit route: simply hug the right wall of the balcony to find a gap leading to a small cliffside path, terminating at a waterfall. Carefully jump into the pool at the base of the waterfall to complete your escape. It's also possible to "climb" down from the balcony by looking left and down when you reach the waterfall—there will be a path of sorts where you can make very small drops to multiple rocks (you can use Become Ethereal to avoid damage with either method). Alternatively, you can retrace your steps back through the museum and exit the keep the same way you came in. Once you've escaped, return to Winterhold, where Karliah and Enthir are waiting in the cellar of the Frozen Hearth. Enthir will use the rubbing of Calcelmo's tablet to translate Gallus's journal, confirming that [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer]] used the Guild's funds and desecrated the [[Skyrim:Twilight Sepulcher|Twilight Sepulcher]], the secret shrine to [[Skyrim:Nocturnal|Nocturnal]] that the [[Skyrim:Nightingales|Nightingales]] are sworn to protect. Karliah will also give you the [[Skyrim:Nightingale Blade|Nightingale Blade]] as a token of appreciation, and ask that you meet her at [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|the Ragged Flagon]]. After talking with Enthir and Karliah, the quest ends and [[Skyrim:The Pursuit|The Pursuit]] begins. : ''Note:'' Completing this quest will lock the back door from [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]'s graveyard to [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon - Cistern|The Ragged Flagon - Cistern]] until later in the next quest. ==Guild Trinket== The trinket in this quest is the [[Skyrim:Dwemer Puzzle Cube|Dwemer Puzzle Cube]]. It can be found in the Calcelmo's Laboratory zone, in the room where [[Skyrim:Aicantar|Aicantar]] is reading. The Cube is on a table to the right, after going past Aicantar's table but before the door to the balcony. Once you've collected the trinket, it can be returned to Delvin Mallory for some leveled gold. ==Notes== * After successfully creating the rubbing, just before the guards storm the laboratory, [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] to the platform across from the level with the stone tablet. Casting [[Skyrim:Invisibility (spell)|Invisibility]] here, or using a potion, enables you to scale the scaffolding all the way over their heads, eliminating the need to sneak around or fight them. You have to do this quickly, within a second or two of them entering or they might notice where you are. * The highest level version of the Nightingale Blade is untemperable (levels 46+), making the level 36-45 blade the best version. However, all versions lack a [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]] perk, so they will quickly fall behind other swords when you start tempering. * If you kill [[Skyrim:Aicantar|Aicantar]] prior to creating the rubbing, he will not arrive alongside the guards and the captain. Instead, there will be one extra guard in his place. * [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]] reveals at least one NPC who could conceivably translate the Falmer language, but doesn't add a way to ask him to do so. * The ''[[Books:The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima Official Game Guide]]'' states that you receive [[Skyrim:Gallus's Journal|Gallus's Journal]] upon quest completion. However, this is incorrect, and said item cannot be obtained under normal circumstances. ==Bugs== {{Bug|It is possible to obtain two copies of the museum key. If you proceed with the bribe/persuade dialogue options, Calcelmo will give you the first key. However, this doesn't disable the dialogue about killing Nimhe, which allows you to receive another key upon completion.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|You can exit the dialogue right after Persuade speech check before advancing quest stage. Therefore it can be repeated for leveling Speech up.}} {{Bug|Picking up the museum key after the quest has finished restarts the quest.|OSP|1.5}} {{Bug|The quest item flag on [[Skyrim:Gallus's Encoded Journal|Gallus's Encoded Journal]] is not cleared on completion of the quest, leaving it permanently stuck in your inventory.|OSP|1.9}} **{{Pc22}} Enter the [[Skyrim:Console|console command]] player.removeitem CEDA6 1 after completing the quest. {{Bug|Enthir may be stuck saying ''"This is going to be terrible for business"'' if the quests [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] or [[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|The Eye of Magnus]] are active. Both of these quests may have to be completed in order to talk to him.|confirmed=1}} **Another possible solution is to leave and wait for normal store hours when Enthir opens for business. **Sometimes leaving the building and reentering will get his correct dialogue running. His dialogue changing to a store (fence) shows his script has been completed and he is out of the picture for this quest. {{Bug|In Calcelmo's Lab, there may be a Markarth city guard who gives you a bounty regardless of your standing towards the Reach faction. All talk options except going to prison or fighting fail. The only way you will be able to get rid of this bounty is by gaining another bounty in another city and going to jail.|confirmed=1}} **A possible workaround is to sneak into the room with the guard and use a bow to kill him. Even if he is running towards you, it seems if you kill him before he starts his formal dialogue, the bounty is not added and you can play on as normal. **Another possible workaround is to remain hidden and kill the guard by activating the traps. {{Bug|Calcelmo's Tower is supposed to unlock during this quest but doesn't.|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|Karliah sometimes returns to Snow Veil Sanctum without giving you the following quest.|USKP|1.0}} **This seems to have to do with having Mercer's plans in your inventory. This is an important quest item for the next quest and the quest fails to load as long as this item is in your inventory. You should drop the plans somewhere and retrieve them when you want to finish The Pursuit. Use command Startquest TG07 then Set stage TG07 0 to start and add the quest to the journal while keeping Mercer's plan, when they're "quest items" and it doesn't allow you to get rid of them. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Karliah believes the only proof that could expose Mercer's treachery can be found within the pages of Gallus's journal which she recovered from Snow Veil Sanctum. Unfortunately, the journal is written in some sort of code that needs to be deciphered. Our only hope is Enthir, one of Karliah and Gallus's former acquaintances who is a wizard at the College of Winterhold. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak with Enthir}} |20||Enthir has informed me that Gallus's Journal is written in Falmer. He's directed me to seek out Calcelmo, the Court Wizard in Markarth who is the foremost authority on them in hopes of obtaining a translation. {{Quest Objective|20|Speak with Calcelmo}} |25||{{Quest Objective|25|Gain entry to Calcelmo's Museum}} {{Quest Objective|27|(Optional) Obtain the key to Calcelmo's Museum}} |30||Calcelmo has proven to be extremely stubborn and refuses to allow me access to his materials regarding the Falmer language. I'm left with little choice other than taking matters into my own hands and stealing his notes. {{Quest Objective|30|Obtain Calcelmo's Falmer Translating Guide}} |40||Calcelmo's "notes" on the Falmer language are actually derived from a massive stone slab in his tower! It will be impossible to bring this item to Enthir to have him translate Gallus's Journal. I'll have to discover a way to make the information more portable. {{Quest Objective|40|Duplicate the writing on Calcelmo's Stone}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Return to Enthir}} |60||{{Quest Objective|60|Speak to Enthir}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Speak to Karliah}} |200|fin|After Enthir successfully translated Gallus's journal, I've discovered that Mercer's motivations transcended simple greed or murder. As a member of the Nightingales, Mercer was tasked with guarding a place called The Twilight Sepulcher, the Temple of Nocturnal. According to Gallus, he defiled the temple and betrayed the Thieves Guild. Karliah insists we bring this information to Brynjolf immediately. |missing=0, 27, 55 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Speaking With Silence|Speaking With Silence]]|Next=[[Skyrim:The Pursuit|The Pursuit]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Quests|Thieves Guild]]}}

Skyrim:Good Intentions.wikitext: [[fr:Skyrim:Les meilleures intentions]]{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=WalB |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Mage's Circlet|Mage's Circlet]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Revealing the Unseen|Revealing the Unseen]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]], [[Skyrim:The Midden|The Midden]] |Image=SR-quest-Good Intentions.jpg |ImgDesc=Quaranir waiting to speak with you |description=Find and consult the [[Skyrim:Augur_of_Dunlain|Augur of Dunlain]]. |ID=MG04 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak with [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]]. #Listen to Tolfdir. #Follow [[Skyrim:Ancano|Ancano]]. #Speak with [[Skyrim:Quaranir|Quaranir]]. #Find the [[Skyrim:Augur of Dunlain|Augur of Dunlain]]. #Report to [[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Savos Aren]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===An Orb Worth Noting=== [[File:SR-quest-Good Intentions 02.jpg|thumb|Quaranir freezing time to speak with you]] After your conversation with Urag gro-Shub about the newly recovered books, the librarian suggests you speak with Tolfdir about the findings. Tolfdir can be found in the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Elements|Hall of the Elements]], in deep rumination about the orb from [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]], or [[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|the Eye of Magnus]]. Let him know about your findings and he will begin to discuss the Eye with you. He will explain how the markings seem to be unique, as they do not appear to be [[Lore:Aldmeris|Elven]], [[Lore:Daedric_Alphabet|Daedric]], or [[Lore:Ayleid Language|Ayleid]]. Ancano will interrupt Tolfdir's musings and demand that you follow him to meet a mysterious visitor who has asked to speak with you. ===A Moment in Time=== Follow Ancano to the Arch-Mage's quarters and you will meet Quaranir, another representative from the [[Skyrim:Psijic Order|Psijic Order.]] Quaranir will freeze time in order to speak privately with you. He will explain that you must prevent anyone from using the Eye of Magnus, as he fears the consequences its misuse will bring. He will suggest that you seek out the Augur of Dunlain within the College, who may be able to give you better guidance. Quaranir will then unfreeze time and leave, confusing Savos and angering Ancano. Speaking to the various mages about the Augur will lead you to either Tolfdir or [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]] for more information. Tolfdir will tell you about the Augur immediately, but you must pass an easy-level [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to convince Mirabelle. Either way, you will learn that the Augur is a former student at the College, but something befell him as a result of his own ambitions. He can now be found in [[Skyrim:The Midden|The Midden]] in his altered state. [[File:SR-quest-Good Intentions 03.jpg|thumb|left|The Augur of Dunlain]] ===The Unearthing=== You can access the Midden from a trap door in the northern corner of the courtyard or by the stairwell in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Countenance|Hall of Countenance]]. Making your way to the Augur of Dunlain is relatively easy; you will likely encounter a few [[Skyrim:Ice Wraith|ice wraiths]] and [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]], along with a small number of [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] and [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]]. Proceed into [[Skyrim:The Midden#The Midden Dark|The Midden Dark]] and continue until you reach a locked door. When you approach it, the Augur will warn you from the other side that your efforts will only end in disappointment. The door will then open. ===The Augur=== The Augur will inform you that others (including Ancano) have previously sought information about the Eye of Magnus without realizing the dangers it poses. While the Augur speaks only of disaster for the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]], he seems encouraged by your path and offers to help you further. He will then inform you that you will need the [[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]] to avert the disaster the Psijics warned you about, and urges you to share this information with [[Skyrim:Savos_Aren|Savos Aren]]. ===More than a Mere Apprentice=== Speak to Savos and inform him of the Augur's message. It takes a bit of convincing to get Savos motivated and interested in this turn of events. Eventually, he will direct you to Mirabelle Ervine for more information on the Staff and then give you the [[Skyrim:Mage's Circlet|Mage's Circlet]], impressed with your performance thus far. ==Notes== * After Quaranir freezes time but before you speak to him you can steal any item in the Arch-Mage's Quarters without acquiring a bounty. * If you follow Quaranir out of the College after he freezes time in the Arch-Mage's Quarters, he will walk through Winterhold and enter [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|The Frozen Hearth]]. * After you receive the objective to "Report to Savos Aren", [[Skyrim:Atronach Forge Recipe|Atronach Forge Recipe]]s will begin to appear in random loot. * When the Eye of Magnus appears in the Hall of the Elements, there is an option to "Activate Eye of Magnus" when you point your crosshairs over it in close proximity, but doing so has no effect. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When you enter the Arch-Mage's Quarters and go upstairs, time may stop yet Quaranir is not there, and you're stuck forever.|USKP|2.0.7}} ** {{Pc22}} Open the console and manually advance the quest by entering setstage MG04 40. ** {{Pc22}} Using the console command prid 0002BA3D and then moveto player, will move him to the College, and the quest should proceed normally. {{Bug|When the quest begins, you may be able to use the door linking the Arcaneum to the Arch-Mage's Quarters, even though the Arch-Mage's Quarters is supposed to be off-limits at that point. Entering prior to being told to go there by Ancano will freeze out the quest, requiring you to exit the game via the console.|USKP|2.0.7}} {{Bug|You may not get the next quest "Revealing the Unseen" after completing the quest. This appears to be permanent and cannot be fixed by reloading. As the quest does not load, Mirabelle will have normal dialogue and the quest is impossible to begin.|USKP|2.0.9}} {{Bug|When talking to Ancano after talking to Tolfdir, you may get locked in dialogue with him permanently, preventing you from doing anything.}} ** {{Pc22}} Open the console and manually advance the quest by entering setstage MG04 30. {{Bug|Ancano may not open the door to the Arch-Mage's Quarters and lead you there.}} ** {{Pc22}} Open the console command and manually advance the quest stage by entering setstage MG04 30. The quest marker above Ancano's head should disappear. The door to the Arch-Mage's Quarters should be unlocked. You are now free to talk to Quaranir and continue the storyline. {{Bug|The Augur of Dunlain may be unable to speak his expected lines if you go to the Midden before asking where he is. This is due to a set of bad conditions on the quest script.|USSEP|4.2.8}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Urag has asked me to mention the Night of Tears book to Tolfdir. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak with Tolfdir}} |15||I've mentioned the Night of Tears book to Tolfdir, who seems distracted by the orb from Saarthal, and has some additional thoughts about it. {{Quest Objective|15|Listen to Tolfdir}} |20||While discussing the Saarthal orb with Tolfdir, Ancano interrupted and insisted I follow him. {{Quest Objective|20|Follow Ancano}} |30||Ancano interrupted my conversation with Tolfdir to insist that I speak with someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order, who is waiting in the Arch-Mage's quarters in the College. {{Quest Objective|30|Speak with Quaranir}} |40||I've been led to the Arch-Mage's quarters by Ancano, who was insistent that I speak to someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order. The monk, named Quaranir, has informed me that the "Eye of Magnus" is dangerous and that to learn how to deal with it, I need to speak with The Augur of Dunlain within the College. I should ask my fellow members where to find him. {{Quest Objective|40|Find the Augur of Dunlain}} |45||I've been led to the Arch-Mage's quarters by Ancano, who was insistent that I speak to someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order. The monk, named Quaranir, has informed me that the "Eye of Magnus" is dangerous and that to learn how to deal with it, I need to speak with The Augur of Dunlain within the College. He can be found in the Midden, beneath the College. |50||After speaking with Quaranir from the Psijic Order and being warned of the danger of keeping the Eye of Magnus at the College, I sought out and talked to the Augur of Dunlain, who lives in the Midden underneath the College. The Augur told me that I'll need to find the Staff of Magnus, and to give that information to my superiors immediately. {{Quest Objective|50|Report to Savos Aren}} |200|fin|After speaking privately with a monk from the Psijic Order, I have been warned that the "Eye of Magnus" is potentially dangerous and must be dealt with. After consulting with the Augur of Dunlain beneath the College, I have brought word to the Arch-Mage that the Staff of Magnus needs to be located. |missing=0, 60 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Revealing the Unseen|Revealing the Unseen]]|Up=[[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]]}}

Skyrim:Hitting the Books.wikitext: [[fr:Skyrim:Les livres perdus]]{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Savos Aren]] |Reward=[[#Rewards|Skill books]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Good Intentions|Good Intentions]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep|Fellglow Keep]] |Image=SR-quest-Hitting_the_Books.jpg |ImgDesc=Urag gro-Shub giving directions on how to learn more about the orb |description=Find the books needed to identify the artifact found in [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]]. |ID=MG03 |SuggLevel=8 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Speak with [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]]. # Make your way through [[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep|Fellglow Keep]]. # ''(Optional):'' Free [[Skyrim:Orthorn|Orthorn]]. # Find the three stolen books. # Return the books to the College. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===The Arcanaeum=== After the discovery of the mysterious Orb in the depths of [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]], a puzzled [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] decides to send you back alone to alert Arch-Mage [[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Savos Aren]]. Aren turns out to be quite uninterested in the whole affair. You will then be given the quest and prompted to go speak to [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]], who then sends you along to librarian [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] to research the subject. Locate Urag, who can usually be found behind his desk inside the [[Skyrim:The_Arcanaeum|Arcanaeum]] where he functions as the librarian and keeps a close eye on the College's huge collection of ancient tomes. After warning you about touching any of the books in the library, the old Orc will mention that there may be relevant information in one of three tomes which are no longer in his possession. They were 'borrowed' by an Apprentice named [[Skyrim:Orthorn|Orthorn]] who recently, due to a dispute with the College, joined a group of renegade mages in [[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep|Fellglow Keep]]. Urag can do nothing for you without the books, and says you'll have to find Orthorn to retrieve the books so the research of the Orb can begin. On your way out the door you may be approached by [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]] who tells you that the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] visitor, [[Skyrim:Ancano|Ancano]], wants a word with you. If you do not see Faralda, Ancano will actively seek you out and ask you questions about what was found in Saarthal. During this discussion you can choose to provoke him or not, but he will always get the answer he seeks. Proceed out the door and prepare for Fellglow Keep. ===The Dungeons=== Fellglow Keep is a large fort located between [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. When you arrive it becomes clear that the residing mages are far from friendly as you will be attacked by two elemental mages and a [[Skyrim:Flame Atronach|flame atronach]]. Dispose of them and locate the entrance to [[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep Dungeons|Fellglow Keep Dungeons]]. Upon entering, head down the stairs and follow the path as it twists and turns. The second flooded room is guarded by another hostile mage who has been experimenting with [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] and will send them after you with the words: ''"Ah, a test subject! Go, my pets! Attack!"'' Fight the spiders and the mage, then proceed southeast and beware of the [[Skyrim:Traps#Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] triggering a [[Skyrim:Traps#Dart Trap|dart trap]] along the way. Before long, you will arrive in a room filled with cages containing some very unusual prisoners, specifically leveled [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampires]]. You can use the four handles to release them, or pick their cell locks, and they will cause havoc in the next room before leaving the dungeon peacefully. The next room reveals that several experiments were conducted on vampires as bodies are everywhere. Locate the northeastern tunnel and listen to the sound of [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolves]] howling. In the next room are more cages and another hostile mage, seemingly another experiment chamber. Dispose of the mage and inspect the cages. Apart from the wolves, you will also find the renegade mage [[Skyrim:Orthorn|Orthorn]], seemingly imprisoned by the mages he thought of as friends. ===Orthorn=== [[File:SR-quest-Hitting the Books 03.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Orthorn|Orthorn]] in action]] As it turns out, Orthorn was imprisoned as yet another test subject by the mages, despite the fact that he came to Fellglow Keep to help them. You can choose to comfort him by saying Savos Aren sent you to rescue him, or you can simply be honest and say you are there solely for the books. In both cases, Orthorn will offer to help clear out the dungeon and find the missing books, so decide if you want him to tag along. Pull the lever in the middle and he will be released from the cage. He will proceed to explain that the books were taken by someone known as [[Skyrim:The Caller|The Caller]]. If you accept his help you will have to put up with his comments for the rest of a very long trip, although he is a powerful [[Skyrim:Conjurer|conjurer]] and wields a [[Skyrim:Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]] spell. If you decline, he will head out of the dungeon peacefully. Regardless of your choice, he is disabled later on and disappears from the game. Unfortunately, the nearby door leading to [[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep|Fellglow Keep]] is locked (key required), so you will have to take the long path. Go through the wooden door and make your way through the trashed tunnels. The next chamber has three fire mages training destruction spells on a living [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] in a cage, so be on your guard when they notice you. You can find a copy of [[Skyrim:The_Legend_of_Red_Eagle|The Legend of Red Eagle]] on the table in the middle of the room. Take the northern path and you will reach the undercroft, which is guarded by [[Skyrim:Necromancer|necromancers]]. There is a pedestal with a copy of ''[[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Raise Zombie|Spell Tome: Raise Zombie]]'' just before the stairs leading to the next zone, Fellglow Keep. ===Fellglow Keep=== There is a small table at the end of the hallway before the stairs that has a coin purse and an easily missed [[Skyrim:Soul_Gems|Black Soul Gem]] behind a book. The first chamber of Fellglow Keep is guarded by a [[Skyrim:Conjurer|conjurer]] and an ice mage and has the [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Doors of Oblivion|The Doors of Oblivion]]'' on a pedestal. Open the eastern door and fight the patrolling necromancer, then proceed through the chambers and fight all the enemies in the room with multiple paths. A locked door (key required) leads outside while the eastern door leads to the sleeping quarters and more enemies. Check all the shelves for rare books, then head up the stairs. The room to the west holds an [[Skyrim:Unusual_Gem|Unusual Gem]] so make sure to pick it up. Take the adjacent path and head upstairs to a room filled with shelves and the [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:A Hypothetical Treachery|A Hypothetical Treachery]]'' on a table. Proceed forward and make sure to check behind the closed doors for some extra loot. One of the doors is locked but pick the lock and find a [[Skyrim:Shrines#Shrine of Julianos|shrine]] to [[Lore:Julianos|Julianos]] and a wealth of ingredients. Open the wooden door to the north and start climbing the tower. Before long you will reach the Fellglow Ritual Chamber and an encounter with [[Skyrim:The Caller|the Caller]]. ===The Caller=== [[File:SR-quest-Hitting the Books 02.jpg|thumb|The Caller waiting in the ritual chamber]] You arrive in the ritual chamber right away and the Caller awaits you, right in the center. She will, however, remain calm and greet you: ''"So, you're the one who barged into my home and laid waste to my projects. How nice to meet you."'' You will have two dialogue options to choose from; either ask her who she is or ask for the three books. The first option will make her respond, ''"Names no longer matter. You may refer to me as The Caller. Now, do you have a reason for making such a mess?"'' When you ask her for the books she will be disappointed: ''"So you're just one of Aren's lackeys? That's disappointing. You show real promise. You come here, kill my assistants, disrupt my work... You've annoyed me, so I don't think I'll be giving you anything."'' At this point it is actually possible to persuade her to let you have the books. Alternatively, if you brought Orthorn along with you, you can negotiate with her for the books. She will then say, ''"An arrangement? After you've destroyed so much? Fine. Leave me the elf. You may go with your books."'' You have to walk up to the Caller and start a conversation. Agree to her conditions, then pick up the book. If you simply pick up a book without doing this she will attack you. If you didn't bring Orthorn, she will say, ''"I'm afraid you don't have anything worth trading."'' Dispose of her and claim the three books (two of the books are behind the Caller on pedestals; lifting either will spawn a Flame or Frost Atronach, depending on your level). If Orthorn is still there, you can have a brief conversation with him which he ends with: ''"You'll be going back to the College, then? I, uhh... I think perhaps I'll wait a bit before venturing there myself. Let this whole thing blow over, you know. Give certain parties a chance to forget what I may have done. Still, you've gotten me out of that cage, and I won't forget it. Thank you again, and good luck to you."'' Find the exit and leave Fellglow Keep. You may still need to kill the Caller to obtain the key to the exit. ===Night of Tears=== When you arrive back at the College, you will find that [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] has returned from Saarthal and placed the Orb in the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Elements|Hall of the Elements]]. Head into the Arcanaeum and locate Urag gro-Shub. Out of the three books, ''[[Skyrim:Night of Tears|Night of Tears]]'', ''[[Skyrim:The Last King of the Ayleids|The Last King of the Ayleids]]'', and ''[[Skyrim:Fragment: On Artaeum|Fragment: On Artaeum]]'', he will be particularly interested in the first one, as it has some interesting implications. The quest ends with him handing you a bunch of books as reward (see [[#Rewards|this section]]) and asks you to speak to Tolfdir. The next quest, [[Skyrim:Good Intentions|Good Intentions]], will then start. ==Rewards== Upon returning the books to Urag gro-Shub, he will give you several [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill books]], one for each school of magic. The books are: * [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]]: ''[[Skyrim:Daughter of the Niben|Daughter of the Niben]]'' * [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]]: ''[[Skyrim:2920, Hearth Fire, v9|2920, Hearth Fire, v9]]'' * [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]]: ''[[Skyrim:Response to Bero's Speech|Response to Bero's Speech]]'' * [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]]: ''[[Skyrim:Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments|Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments]]'' * [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]]: ''[[Skyrim:The Black Arts On Trial|The Black Arts On Trial]]'' * [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]]: ''[[Skyrim:Racial Phylogeny|Racial Phylogeny]]'' ==Notes== * At stage 60 of this quest, the Eye of Magnus is invisibly moved from [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]] to the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Elements|Hall of the Elements]]. [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] also returns to the College at this time, allowing you to start [[Skyrim:Tolfdir the Absent-Minded|his quest]]. * There is another book called ''[[Skyrim:Last King of the Ayleids|Last King of the Ayleids]]''. You need to find ''[[Skyrim:The Last King of the Ayleids|'''The''' Last King of the Ayleids]]''. The text is the same, but the other book will not work for this quest. * Even if you didn't kill anyone by sneaking through the dungeons, the Caller will still blame you with the same dialogue. * While the Caller will not accept a dead Orthorn in exchange for the books, it is possible to trick her into accepting the deal even if he dies. If Orthorn's corpse is reanimated prior to entering the Ritual Chamber, he will follow the player in as normal, and the quest can proceed as if he is still alive. * Using the "Persuade" option when speaking with the Caller while Orthorn is accompanying you results in the same outcome as trading him for the books. He will return to his cell, and approaching or interacting with him will be met with "How could you just leave me here?" ==Bugs== {{Bug|This quest can fail to start in case Ancano is not enabled and you've not spoken to him.}} **{{pc22}}To solve this open the console and enter prid 1E7D8 and enter enable. He should be in the Hall of the Elements. Talk to him and when you're done open the console and enter setstage mg03 0. The quest should now start. {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]] was originally supposed to play a part in this quest, at stage 10 and 20 specifically. For unknown reasons, she was skipped and Tolfdir now asks you to go directly to Savos Aren from Saarthal. However, the in-game text still describes the original journal intro including Mirabelle Ervine.|USKP|2.1.3}} {{Bug|The College students are supposed to gather next to the Eye of Magnus and play out a scene. Unfortunately, due to issues with the scene trigger, this would never happen because the trigger would be encountered prior to this portion of the quest being reached since the trigger box has no conditions and would become disabled upon first entering the Hall of the Elements.|USLEEP|3.0.9}} {{Bug|Once you clear the fort, trying to enter it again will cause a crash. This can happen even during the quest if you try to backtrack from the Ritual Chamber. If you are on the quest just leave by the exit to the exterior in the chamber.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} To avoid this, enter coc FellglowKeep03 in the console to move to the Ritual Chamber, complete the quest, and use the console again to exit the keep (coc WinterholdExterior01). {{Bug|There is a possibility that the stairway leading up to the Caller's room in Fellglow Keep is blocked off with boulders, and the door leading up to her room is removed.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Enter coc FellglowKeep03 in the console to bypass the boulders. {{Bug|If you collect the books before talking to Orthorn he may not recognize it when you free him. Messing with the levers can eventually trigger a quest update for him being freed.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If Orthorn is killed before reaching the Caller and she accepts your "Persuade" offer, the door to the exit may remain locked with a "Requires Key" status.|confirmed=1}} **Killing the Caller will allow you to obtain the key from her corpse. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||With Tolfdir still occupied in Saarthal, I need to speak to Mirabelle Ervine to find out about researching the discovery in Saarthal. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak with Mirabelle Ervine}} |20||Since Tolfdir is not available, I've been asked by Mirabelle Ervine to look into information on the object we found in Saarthal by talking to Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum. {{Quest Objective|20|Speak with Urag gro-Shub}} |30||I've been asked to find more information on the object found in Saarthal. Urag suggested that useful books may have been stolen from the Arcanaeum by {{sic|Othorn|Orthorn}}, a former Apprentice at the College. His last known location was Fellglow Keep. {{Quest Objective|30|Find the stolen books (/3)}} |50||In attempting to track down books that may have information about Saarthal, I've been exploring Fellglow Keep and have located Orthorn, the former apprentice who stole the books in the first place. He's now a prisoner, and has begged me to free him. {{Quest Objective|50|(Optional) Free Orthorn}} |55||I've freed Orthorn from Fellglow Keep, and he has offered to help me find the books I'm looking for. |60||I was asked to find books that may have information about the object discovered in Saarthal, and traveled to Fellglow Keep to retrieve them from Orthorn, a former Apprentice at the College. I've found the books and now need to see them returned to the College. {{Quest Objective|60|Return the books}} |200|fin|I've returned to the College with the books from Fellglow Keep. One of the books, "Night of Tears", has some information about Saarthal that Urag found very interesting. |missing=0 }} Stages 10 and 20 are unused. {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Good Intentions|Good Intentions]]|Up=[[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]]}}

Skyrim:Hail Sithis!.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=[[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]] |Reward=20,000 gold, [[Skyrim:Dawnstar Sanctuary|Dawnstar Sanctuary]] |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Death Incarnate|Death Incarnate]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...|Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...]], [[Skyrim:The Dark Brotherhood Forever|The Dark Brotherhood Forever]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] docks, [[Skyrim:The Katariah|The Katariah]] |Image=SR-quest-Hail_Sithis!.jpg |ImgDesc=Alone with the Emperor at last... |description=One of the biggest [[Skyrim:Emperor Titus Mede II (real)|contracts]] in [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Brotherhood]] history is yours to fulfill. |ID=DB11 |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Travel to Whiterun and talk to [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre|Amaund Motierre]]. #Knowing the true Emperor's location, travel to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]'s docks. #''(Optional)'' Kill [[Skyrim:Commander Maro|Commander Maro]]. #Board [[Skyrim:The Katariah|The Katariah]]. #Kill [[Skyrim:Emperor Titus Mede II (real)|Emperor Titus Mede II]]. #Return to Amaund to learn the location of the dead drop. #''(Optional)'' Kill Amaund Motierre to fulfill the Emperor's dying wish. #Travel to [[Skyrim:Volunruud|Volunruud]] to collect your reward. #Return to [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] at the [[Skyrim:Dawnstar Sanctuary|Dawnstar Sanctuary]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Time to Settle the Score=== Despite the devastation wrought on the Dark Brotherhood, the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]] wants you to finish your contract and kill the Emperor, [[Skyrim:Emperor Titus Mede II (real)|Titus Mede II]]. The real Emperor's whereabouts are unknown, so travel to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and find [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre|Amaund Motierre]] in his room at [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]]. Amaund will reveal that the true Emperor is on board his ship, [[Skyrim:The Katariah|The Katariah]], near [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]'s docks. Amaund will also inform you that [[Skyrim:Commander Maro|Commander Maro]] is outside the [[Skyrim:East Empire Company Warehouse|East Empire Company Warehouse]] at the docks, should you wish to exact revenge. Go to the East Empire Company Warehouse, near Solitude. Commander Maro will be standing on the dock. If you approach him, he will be startled by your appearance and proceed to attack. This will allow you to kill him without incurring a bounty, and the nearby guards may even assist you if you allow Maro to make the first strike. Alternatively, kill Maro from a distance or sneak up to him and kill him stealthily. It's worth noting that Maro has his own faction, so any bounty you incur when attacking him will be lost on his death. You can, if you wish, ignore Maro completely and move on to the next objective. ===Bringing Down an Empire=== [[File:SR-place-The Katariah.jpg|thumb|right|The Katariah]] The next target is the true Emperor, aboard his ship The Katariah, moored out to the north of the city in a channel called the Solitude Inlet. Security has been relaxed somewhat, as the [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus|Penitus Oculatus]] believes that the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] has been completely eradicated. Nonetheless, many bodyguards are still present on the ship. Access the ship underwater by using the anchor to climb aboard. On board the ship are sailors and [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Agent|Penitus Oculatus Agent]]s, both of which are relatively weak and easy to defeat. You can fight your way through the ship or simply sneak through, as few guards will be patrolling the hallways and can all be picked off quite easily, though some will attack with both sword and shock spells. You will not earn a bounty for killing or being seen by anyone on board. You can also traverse the upper deck, which contains many guards. A unique sword, [[Skyrim:Windshear|Windshear]], can be found at the very end of the bowsprit - the slanted mast at the ship's bow. ''[[Skyrim:King|King]]'', a [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-handed]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]], can be found next to the throne, on the highest part of the ship's deck. [[Skyrim:Captain Avidius|Captain Avidius]] and [[Skyrim:Lieutenant Salvarus|Lieutenant Salvarus]] are also present on the ship, both in their individual private quarters, and are somewhat tougher than the other guards. They both carry a [[Skyrim:Katariah Master Key|Katariah Master Key]], which will open all doors on the ship, including the Emperor's Quarters. There is another master key on a hook in the captain's quarters, just to the side of the door. ===An Honorable Man=== Enter the Emperor's Quarters. Whether you came in sneaking or not, the Emperor will greet you straight away, as he has been expecting you. He will acknowledge that it is his destiny to die by your hand, and will not fight you. He asks, however, for you to listen for a moment before killing him. You can, if you want, kill the Emperor instantly, or hear what he has to say. The Emperor simply asks that you consider killing the person who masterminded his assassination, as he feels that his intentions could be malevolent. After slaying the Emperor and finally completing this arduous contract, take a look around his quarters. There are some rare books lying about and some very expensive gems and jewelry behind a locked door, which can be opened with the key the Emperor holds. The unique [[Skyrim:Gilded Wristguards|Gilded Wristguards]] and an extra set of the [[Skyrim:Emperor's Robes|Emperor's Robes]] are also to be found. There is even a [[Skyrim:Brief History of the Empire, v2|book on the third era]], which tells about [[Lore:Katariah|Empress Katariah]], after whom the ship was named. ===A Hard-Earned Reward=== Use the Emperor's key to exit the ship and return to Whiterun to speak to Amaund. He will reveal that the money for the contract is in a dead drop inside the cavern where you first met, in [[Skyrim:Volunruud|Volunruud]]. After informing Amaund of the Emperor's death, you may speak to him again to say that you have unfinished business with him, but he does not comprehend what you mean by your cryptic words and will not attack you. You may kill him if you wish to fulfill the Emperor's last wish. If you do, a surprised Amaund's last words will be, ''"But... we had a deal..."'' Amaund's corpse can be looted for a significant amount of gems. However, if you do not wish to kill Amaund, the gems may be easily pickpocketed from him. Go to Volunruud and the chamber where you first met Amaund. Inside, you will find a normal chest and an urn containing 20,000 gold. Return to the [[Skyrim:Dawnstar Sanctuary|Dawnstar Sanctuary]] and speak to [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] about the gold, and he will ask how much money you received. You can choose to lie to him, but you keep the entire reward regardless of the option you choose. [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] will point out that [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] could assist in using the gold to restore the sanctuary. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest: * {{achievement|Hail Sithis! (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *The weapons found on the ship are level-dependent, with a chance of rare items being found. ==Bugs== {{Bug|In the room with the alchemy lab, both a Penitus Oculatus guard and a sailor appear dead in their bed. This appears to be deliberate, as both their references have the '''"Starts Dead"''' box checked. However, due to their placement, they may end up clipping through their beds and end up either half-buried in them or clip completely through them, ending underneath.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you approach Maro for the first time after killing the Emperor, but before turning the quest in, he'll ignore you and neither attack nor talk.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes, jumping on a table against the wall in the Emperor's chambers will cause you to fall through the ship into the water.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Depending on how you kill him (such as with certain spells) the Emperor might end up getting stuck outside the wall of the cabin and you will be unable to loot him.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes, on approaching Amaund Motierre in the Bannered Mare the first time, he will act as if he has already given you the information, and the only dialogue options will be the ones for after the Emperor has been killed. The quest marker will be stuck on him with no way to proceed.}} **{{Pc22}}Advance the quest by entering in the console setstage DB11 15. {{Bug|If the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] capture Solitude, the [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus Outpost|Penitus Oculatus Outpost]] will remain active in [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]], which can result in Penitus Oculatus agents and [[Skyrim:Stormcloak Soldier|Stormcloak soldiers]] engaging each other in combat.|USKP|2.0.6|If this quest and the [[Skyrim:Civil War|Civil War]] questline for the Stormcloaks are finished, the Penitus Oculatus Outpost will be cleared out.}} {{Bug|The combat taunts from the guards on the ship may be the ones used against dragons or other targets, rather than you.|USKP|4.3.4|They weren't checking to see if the target was in the Dark Brotherhood.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |5||The Night Mother has spoken to me once again. The true Emperor must be assassinated - the contract with Amaund Motierre must be completed. {{Quest Objective|5|Talk to Nazir}} |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Amaund Motierre}} |15||{{Quest Objective|15|Board the Katariah}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Kill the Emperor!}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|(Optional) Kill Commander Maro}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Report to Amaund Motierre}} |60||{{Quest Objective|60|Retrieve the payment}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|(Optional) Kill Amaund Motierre}} |80||{{Quest Objective|80|Report to Nazir}} |200|fin|The Emperor has been assassinated. The Dark Brotherhood will, once more, be feared and respected the world over. |missing=0, 1, 2, 3, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...|Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...]], [[Skyrim:The Dark Brotherhood Forever|The Dark Brotherhood Forever]]|Up=[[SR:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]|Prev=[[Skyrim:Death Incarnate|Death Incarnate]]}}

7 new [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] |Disp= =3 ([[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]], [[Skyrim:Athis|Athis]], [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]], [[Skyrim:Njada Stonearm|Njada Stonearm]], [[Skyrim:Ria|Ria]], [[Skyrim:Torvar|Torvar]], and [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]]) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Purity of Revenge|Purity of Revenge]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]] |Image=SR-quest-Glory of the Dead.jpg |ImgDesc=The Companions and the citizens of Whiterun bid their goodbyes to Kodlak |description=Cure [[Skyrim:Kodlak_Whitemane|Kodlak]]'s spirit and become Harbinger of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]]. |ID=C06 |Icon=SR-qico-Companions.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Have [[Skyrim:Eorlund Gray-Mane|Eorlund Gray-Mane]] mend [[Skyrim:Wuuthrad|Wuuthrad]]. # Return Wuuthrad to [[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]]. # Make your way through the tomb. # Meet [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak]]. # Fight one final [[Skyrim:Kodlak's Wolf Spirit‎|spirit]]. # Release Kodlak. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Funeral=== [[File:SR-quest-Glory of the Dead 06.jpg|thumb|right]] After the events of [[Skyrim:Purity of Revenge|Purity of Revenge]], [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] will run towards the [[Skyrim:Skyforge|Skyforge]] to participate in the late Harbinger [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]]'s funeral. The ceremony is to be held near [[Skyrim:Eorlund Gray-Mane|Eorlund Gray-Mane]]'s smithy. All of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] will be present, along with the Jarl, steward and the local [[Skyrim:Danica Pure-Spring|priestess of Kynareth]]. Kodlak is placed above the forge, and the ceremony ends with [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] lighting the fire, symbolizing a final goodbye: :'''Eorlund:''' ''"Who will start?"'' :'''Aela:''' ''"I'll do it. Before the ancient flame..."'' :'''Everyone:''' ''"We grieve."'' :'''Eorlund:''' ''"At this loss..."'' :'''Everyone:''' ''"We weep."'' :'''Vilkas:''' ''"For the fallen..."'' :'''Everyone:''' ''"We shout."'' :'''Farkas:''' ''"And for ourselves..."'' :'''Everyone:''' ''"We take our leave."'' After the ritual, Eorlund will seek you out, asking for the fragments of [[Skyrim:Wuuthrad|Wuuthrad]] and Kodlak's secret fragment from his chambers. Retrieve the fragment from the end table in his room. [[Skyrim:Kodlak's Journal|Kodlak's Journal]], also in the end table, offers some insights on him and his visions. Return to Eorlund with the fragment. When he accepts it, he will inform you that your Shield-Siblings have gone to [[Skyrim:The Underforge|the Underforge]] for a gathering and suggests you join them: :''' :''"Thank you. Your Shield-Siblings have withdrawn to the Underforge. I think they're waiting for you."'' {{NewLine}} === Wuuthrad Finally Returned!=== [[File:SR-quest-Glory of the Dead 05.jpg|thumb|right|''"Just because something is, doesn't mean it must be."'']] In the Underforge you will find the three members of the [[Skyrim:The Circle|Circle]], [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]], Vilkas and Aela, talking around the blood fountain, all of them frustrated and discouraged. They all know that Kodlak died without being granted his only wish, namely to be freed of his lycanthropy so he could spend his afterlife in [[Lore:Sovngarde|Sovngarde]]. While they know of a way to cleanse his soul, it requires them to enter the [[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]] and perform a ceremony: '''Vilkas''': ''"The old man had one wish before he died. And he didn't get it. It's as simple as that."''
'''Aela''': ''"Being moon-born is not so much of a curse as you might think, Vilkas."''
'''Vilkas''': ''"That's fine for you. But he wanted to be clean. He wanted to meet Ysgramor and know the glories of Sovngarde. But all that was taken from him."''
'''Aela''': ''"And you avenged him."''
'''Farkas''': ''"Kodlak did not care for vengeance."''
'''Vilkas''': ''"No, Farkas, he didn't. And that's not what this is about. We should be honoring Kodlak, no matter our own thoughts on the blood."''
'''Aela''': ''"You're right. It's what he wanted, and he deserved to have it."''
'''Vilkas''': ''"Kodlak used to speak of a way to cleanse his soul, even in death. You know the legends of the Tomb of Ysgramor."''
'''Aela''': ''"There the souls of the Harbingers will heed the call of northern steel. We can't even enter the tomb without Wuuthrad, and it's in pieces, like it has been for a thousand years."'' At this point, Eorlund Gray-Mane enters with the repaired [[Skyrim:Wuuthrad|Wuuthrad]] on his back: '''Eorlund''': ''"And dragons were just stories. And the elves once ruled Skyrim. Just because something is, doesn't mean it must be. The blade is a weapon. A tool. Tools are meant to be broken. And repaired."''
'''Vilkas''': ''"Is that? Did you repair the blade?"''
'''Eorlund''': ''"This is the first time I've had all the pieces, thanks to our Shield-Brother/Shield-Sister here. "The flames of a hero can reforge the shattered." The flames of Kodlak shall fuel the rebirth of Wuuthrad. And now it will take you to meet him once more."'' He will then address you personally: :''"As the one who bore the fragments, I think you should be the one to carry Wuuthrad into battle."'' He will then hand you the weapon and speak to the other members: :''"The rest of you, prepare to journey to the Tomb of Ysgramor. For Kodlak."'' Your allies will then take off towards the legendary [[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]]. ===Ghosts of the Companions=== [[File:SR-quest-Glory of the Dead 02.jpg|thumb|right|The Ysgramor statue]] [[File:SR-quest-Glory of the Dead 03.jpg|thumb|right|A final request from [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak]]]] [[File:SR-quest-Glory of the Dead 04.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Sovngarde_(place)|Sovngarde]] awaits.]] As soon as you enter the tomb, Vilkas will approach and warn you about the dangers that lie ahead. He also says he will take no part in the task, as he has too much grief in his heart. Activate the Ysgramor statue, which will take Wuuthrad from your inventory, and place it on the statue to lower the wall. You may reclaim Wuuthrad by activating the statue again, and the wall will remain open. Followed by Aela the Huntress and Farkas, two skeevers greet you as you head north into the tomb. Continue down, and follow the path around until you are heading west into the next chamber with several [[Skyrim:Companion Ghost|Companion ghosts]] who taunt and warn of your impending death. They attack with Ancient Nord Bows, Swords, and Battle Axes, but their loot will disappear quickly if not searched immediately. Now head south until you enter a large room, with more tombs encircling a pond. Here one or two more ghostly apparitions test your courage before moving deeper into the tomb. Going west up the small stairs past the tombs, you encounter a spider web to the south that must be broken through to continue. It is here that Farkas reveals that, ''"Ever since [[Skyrim:Dustman's Cairn|Dustman's Cairn]], the big crawly ones are my weakness"''. Consequently, he will proceed no further and instead runs back to join Vilkas at the statue. With Aela the Huntress as your only ally now, hack your way through the spider webs and face a Giant Frostbite spider, and many poison-spitting [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]]. Follow the stairs down past the white caps into the next area. Two more companion ghosts await you, and after finishing them off, search the [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] laid out on the tables for valuables, and a potion of stamina beside the wrapped body. Be sure to search the draugr skeletons in their tombs for leveled weapons and armor. Heading east up the small stairs, open the next iron door and you'll enter an area with draugr tombs to your right, but a closed gate to your left. Activating the pedestal will open the closed gate. Enter this chamber heading north, where four more ghosts await shooting arrows, and wielding both one and two-handed weapons. Dispose of them, and find the [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Legendary Sancre Tor|The Legendary Sancre Tor]]'' in the center of the room next to the burial urns. Up the stone stairs and through this final iron door. ===The Trip to Sovngarde=== You will find the ghost of Kodlak Whitemane warming his hands near the Flame of the Harbinger. After explaining that the room is, in fact, swarming with the ghosts of his predecessors, whom you can't see, he will ask you if you still own the [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch Head| Glenmoril Witch heads]]. He will then ask you to toss one into the Flame, in an attempt to cure him of his werewolf curse. After doing so, Kodlak's [[Skyrim:Kodlak's Wolf Spirit|wolf spirit]] will be released and immediately attack. After the battle, Kodlak will thank you and name you the new leader of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]]. He will then travel to Sovngarde and finally find his peace, completing the quest. ===Harbinger of the Companions=== You can now speak to Aela, who will recognize your new position and tell you she is going to stay in the tomb for a while longer, for further studies. If you linger there, Vilkas and Farkas will arrive and also say they want to stay. All three will then become available as [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]]. You can cure yourself of [[Skyrim:Werewolf|lycanthropy]] before you leave the tomb if you wish. If you don't, you will be required to [[Skyrim:Purity|cure two other Companions]] of their lycanthropy before you will again have the option to do so. Consider that choosing to remain a werewolf is the only way to access the quest [[Skyrim:Totems of Hircine|Totems of Hircine]], which grants unique abilities you may use while in beast form. You may come back to cure your lycanthropy later. To cure yourself now, throw another Glenmoril Witch head into the fire. Your wolf spirit will emerge. Kill it to rid yourself of being a werewolf permanently. If Aela, Vilkas or Farkas are around, they will aid in the fight. After you've finished, continue up the spiral wooden stairs and locate the chest on the northeastern ledge to claim the [[Skyrim:Shield of Ysgramor|Shield of Ysgramor]], along with some other valuable loot, then exit through the nearby door by activating a chain. Go up the stairs, and through another short hallway before arriving at another wall with a chain. Pulling the chain opens the wall to the first chamber in the tomb as well as the wall on the opposite side. Before leaving the tomb, you can take Wuuthrad from Ysgramor's statue if you didn't earlier. Exit the tomb through the Western (W) passageway, which was previously inaccessible. Follow the set of stairs outside up the mountain to discover a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] which teaches part of the [[Skyrim:Animal Allegiance|Animal Allegiance]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]]. Directly north (to the right) of the word wall is a gold ore vein. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest and finish the questline: * {{achievement|Glory of the Dead (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== * Once the funeral ceremony has begun, you won't be able to use the Skyforge until the quest is finished. * Once the quest is finished, everything in the Harbinger's room at Jorrvaskr becomes free to take. * Aela and Farkas, as quest-specific followers, behave differently than "permanent" followers: :* Neither of them will enter sneak mode when you do, and when either can see you, the sneak eye remains open. :* If you get too close to them while sneaking, they will yell ''"Stay away from me!"'' as if you were going to pickpocket them. :* Accidentally attacking either of them might turn them hostile. * Aela, Farkas, (and Vilkas after he speaks to you at the entry) will only repeat ''"For Kodlak!"'' during the quest, and won't have any dialogue options, including skill training. * You can bring any other follower with you and they will help clear the tomb. However, at the final fight they may ignore Kodlak's wolf spirit as if it were invisible to them. If you choose to cure yourself, they will fight your released spirit normally. * The ghosts' remains cannot be looted and will disappear immediately. * It's possible to pickpocket the ghosts' armor and weapons with the [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Perfect Touch]] perk before they engage in combat or after casting [[Skyrim:Pacify_(spell)|Pacify]] on them. :* All ghosts wear a full set of [[Skyrim:Skyforge#Forging|Ancient Nord Armor]] and wield one of the various [[Skyrim:Specialty_Gear#Draugr_Equipment|Ancient Nord weapons]]. * The first time you talk to Eorlund after the quest, he will tell you about a strange change he has observed with the Skyforge: ''"You know, since Kodlak's funeral the Skyforge feels more... awake. It's always been said that the souls of the heroes of old are what give Skyforge steel its strength. But I think the forge knows the greatness of Kodlak's soul. I can't really explain, but it feels like it's... young. I'll wager it could now forge metal the likes of which hasn't been seen since eras long forgotten. I'm eager to try."'' * Although Farkas, Vilkas, and Aela are presumably supposed to lose their essential statuses after this quest, they remain essential even then. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The quest may not start if you are in combat with Eorlund Gray-Mane|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} ** {{Pc22}} To start the quest, first select Eorlund and enter kill in the console, followed by enter setstage C06 0 and finally resurrect. {{Bug|Kodlak's ghost may not appear when entering the final chamber.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Using the console command setstage C06 60 will allow you to put the witch's head in the fire, at which point Kodlak's wolf spirit will appear. After defeating the spirit, Kodlak may still not appear, at which point the console command setstage C06 200 will end the quest as usual, with Aela exclaiming that she heard Kodlak pronounce you leader. {{Bug|If you leave the Underforge while the circle is talking after the funeral, the dialogue may not continue when you return.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you follow the Circle members heading to Ysgramor's Tomb after Wuuthrad has been assembled, the group may eventually get stuck running back and forth between Dawnstar and the mountain range about halfway towards Driftshade Refuge.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If Eorlund isn't around: Go to the Skyforge and execute the following commands (note that player.placeatme does not work): "prid 1A683" then "resurrect" then "moveto player". Talk to him to continue the mission.}} {{Bug|If enough time has passed since [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]]'s death in [[Skyrim:The Silver Hand|The Silver Hand]] to allow his body to be deleted, this quest may not start.|USKP|2.0.6|Bethesda mistakenly included a mandatory alias for Skjor despite the fact that he's killed off before the questline gets this far. His alias is now marked as optional to allow the quest to start.}} {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] may be seen using the Skyforge while Kodlak's funeral scene is underway.|USSEP|4.2.6|Her AI package will now disable sandbox behavior until you retrieve the final Wuuthrad fragment from Kodlak's room after Eorlund asks you to retrieve it.}} {{Bug|Kodlak's corpse may be seen without his Wolf Armor equipped during the funeral scene.|USSEP|4.2.6}} {{Bug|If you leave during the funeral and then begin the Battle for Whiterun, the funeral may be over when you return, and you won't be able to continue the quest.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I should attend the funeral of {{sic|Kodak Whitman|Kodlak Whitemane}}, the late Harbinger of the Companions. {{Quest Objective|10|Attend Kodlak's funeral}} |15||Eorlund needs the fragments of Wuuthrad to prepare them for remounting in Jorrvaskr. {{Quest Objective|15|Give the fragments of Wuuthrad to Eorlund}} |17||{{Quest Objective|17|Retrieve Kodlak's fragment}} |18||{{Quest Objective|18|Give the final fragment to Eorlund}} |20||As a member of the Circle, I need to convene in the Underforge to determine the next steps for the Companions following the death of {{sic|Kodak Whitman|Kodlak Whitemane}}. {{Quest Objective|20|Meet the Circle}} |30||The Companions believe there is a way to cleanse Kodlak's soul of the taint of the beast. We're going to the ancient Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the ceremony. {{Quest Objective|30|Go to Ysgramor's Tomb with the Circle}} |35||{{Quest Objective|35|Return Wuuthrad to Ysgramor}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Get to the burial chamber}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Speak to Kodlak}} |60||{{Quest Objective|60|Put witch head into fire}} |65||{{Quest Objective|65|Defeat the wolf spirit}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Speak to Kodlak}} |200|fin|I helped grant Kodlak Whitemane the glory of Sovngarde, and took his place as Harbinger of the Companions. |missing=0, 1 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Purity of Revenge|Purity of Revenge]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Companions#Quests|Companions]]}}

==Walkthrough==
Hide and Seek is an [[Skyrim:Activities#Interactions|activity]] that can be played with children in Skyrim. Once you have agreed to play with a child, all of the children in the area will run and hide; you must find them all to complete the quest. Most of the children will hide behind buildings or in shadowy areas, but they should all be relatively easy to find. If you have not found the children after a certain amount of time, the quest will end automatically.
Hide and Seek has no purpose other than for roleplaying, although it could be used to help level [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]]. No rewards are given.

If you have [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] loaded, children you have adopted will also occasionally ask you to play with them. This version of the game only involves that one child.

==Notes==
*Games are only playable from 8am until 9pm.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===You're In the Army Now===
After successfully clearing the [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] from [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]], your usefulness has been proven to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]]. Your oath has been sworn; you are officially an Imperial soldier and protector of the Empire. It's time you look the part. [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] tells you to go to [[Skyrim:Beirand|Beirand]], the [[Skyrim:Solitude Blacksmith|smith]], to get outfitted with your own [[Skyrim:Imperial Armor|Imperial armor]]. Talk to Beirand and choose your preferred weight:
{| class=wikitable

When you are properly outfitted, Beirand will admonish you: ''"Now, that's it. One free outfit per soldier. You lose that, or get it banged up, you'll need to pay like everyone else."''

==Notes==
* It is not possible to do this quest if you first join the legion by giving the [[Skyrim:Jagged Crown|Jagged Crown]] to General Tullius.
* Note that the Medium option contains one heavy armor piece (shield) and the rest are light armor pieces.
* Although Beirand tells you that you'll need to pay if you lose or damage the Imperial armor set he gave you, you can forge a new set yourself.
** [[Skyrim:Patch|Official Skyrim Patch]] 1.9 makes it possible to forge Imperial Light Armor.
* After the completion of this quest, Beirand is no longer [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs#Beirund|essential]].
* Beirand's inventory will carry less items after this quest.{{vn}}

He has located the whereabouts of a [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]] masquerading as a common citizen, and wants you to track him down and dispose of him. Your target would be a [[Skyrim:Traveling Bard|Traveling Bard]], [[Skyrim:Traveling Pilgrim|Traveling Pilgrim]], or [[Skyrim:Visiting Advisor|Visiting Advisor]] (see [[#Bugs|Bugs]]) at a radiant city or town. This can include [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] if [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] is installed. However, as the law is unaware of the danger, you will be treated as a criminal if you're caught. Travel to your destination and identify your target. If you talk to him and expose him as a vampire, he will initially deny it. ''"I beg your pardon, sir/ma'am. I don't know what you're getting at, but whatever it is, it's not appreciated."'' You can then either attempt to [[Skyrim:Sneak|stealthily]] dispose of him, or try to convince him to follow you, which allows you to lead him to a secluded location for elimination. To do this, you will need to pass a speech check requiring a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] level of at least 75 (Persuasion) or 50 (Intimidate): {|class=wikitable |- !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=20%|Reaction |- | Come with me. '''(Persuade)''' * I'll take you to the monster you're hunting. '''(Persuade)''' |colspan=4|'''Passed''': Monster? What monster? Don't know what {{sic|you're|your}} game is, but I'll humor for a moment. Lead the way. Take me to this "monster" of yours. But I'm warning you, do anything funny, and you'll regret it.
'''Failed''': What are you talking about? I don't know anything about any monsters.||'''Passed''': Make the target follow you
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Follow me, or you'll regret it. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Settle down. No need for threats. Lead the way. But I'm warning you, I'm not afraid to fight you if I have to.
'''Failed''': I'm no so easily coerced. I've got my eye on you. Try anything, and you will be the one who regrets it.||'''Passed''': Make the target follow you
'''Failed''': Nothing |} Once you return to Gunmar with the good news, he will reward you with a leveled enchanted item and note his satisfaction: ''"Very good. That's one less monster we need to worry about. Though there's plenty more where he came from. Be ever watchful."'' ==Notes== *Attacking the vampire before he is hostile and killing him will increase your murder count statistic in your journal, regardless if you are detected or receive a bounty. One way to avoid this is to cast a [[Skyrim:Frenzy (spell)|Frenzy]] spell on him first if he is low enough level to be affected. You can alternatively kill him as a [[Skyrim:Werewolf|werewolf]], or if [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] is installed, use the [[Skyrim:Bend Will|Bend Will]] shout to command a dragon to kill him. *{{DB|par=1}} If your quest arrow does not appear, your target may be on Solstheim. Traveling to Solstheim will make the arrow appear in the relevant location. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Sometimes after killing the target without being seen, a single nearby Hold guard will become hostile. Ensure any followers are waiting in a structure or a good distance away from combat to avoid any bounties.|dlc=DG|UDGP|2.0.2}} {{Bug|It is not considered a crime to attack the disguised vampire despite being warned by Gunmar that it would be if you're caught.|USLEEP|3.0.7}} {{Bug|Sometimes the vampire will spawn inside of a buyable house meaning they cannot be reached unless it has been purchased.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Gunmar has sent me to . The vampire's friend will be a notable of a random city (though not a [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]]). Once you've found the friend, you will need to extract some information about the vampire's location by either [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|pickpocketing]] the letter they are carrying, or pass a speech check (you'll require a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill of at least 50). {|class=wikitable width="100%" !width=36%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | Make this easier for you, tell me what I want to know.
