Skyrim:Halbarn Favor Quest.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Velyanthe |rewardChecked= }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Miscellaneous|link3=Miscellaneous Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Halbarn Iron-Fur|Halbarn Iron-Fur]] |Reward=Leveled gold |Disp= 0→1 ([[Skyrim:Halbarn Iron-Fur|Halbarn Iron-Fur]]) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Retaking Thirsk|Retaking Thirsk]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Thirsk Mead Hall|Thirsk Mead Hall]] |Image=SR-quest-Halbarn Favor Quest.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Halbarn Iron-Fur|Halbarn Iron-Fur]] near his smelly forge |description=Find some crafting materials for [[Skyrim:Halbarn Iron-Fur|Halbarn Iron-Fur]]. |ID=DLC2ThirskFFHalbarn |Icon= }} == Quick Walkthrough == #Talk to [[Skyrim:Halbarn Iron-Fur|Halbarn Iron-Fur]] in [[Skyrim:Thirsk Mead Hall|Thirsk Mead Hall]]. #Find ten [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] samples and fifteen [[Skyrim:Ebony Ingot|ebony ingots]]. #Give the items to Halbarn and collect your reward. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===After the Attack=== Once the quest [[Skyrim:Retaking Thirsk|Retaking Thirsk]] has been completed, the [[Lore:Nord|Nord]] warriors of [[Lore:Thirsk|Thirsk]] move back into [[Skyrim:Thirsk Mead Hall|Thirsk Mead Hall]]. However, during their lengthy exile in [[Skyrim:Bujold's Retreat|Bujold's Retreat]], the invading [[Skyrim:Riekling|Rieklings]] turned the hall upside down, with much cleanup to be done. The blacksmith of the hall, [[Skyrim:Halbarn Iron-Fur|Halbarn Iron-Fur]], found his forge filled with slop and had to request assistance from [[Skyrim:Elmus|Elmus]] to clean it up. Despite the terrible smell coming from the flames, he is still able to do some work, although he has more problems: ''"Cleaning out the forge was the easy part. But those blasted rieklings made off with most of my materials. And I can't forge air. You tend to wander around, don't you? If you come across any stalhrim or ebony in your travels, bring them back to old Halbarn. Help each other out."'' This starts the quest and adds an objective to your journal. You will have to gather ten samples of [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] and fifteen [[Skyrim:Ebony|ebony]] ingots for Halbarn. Note that you will have to keep count yourself, as the quest will not update. ===Stalhrim=== [[File:SR-quest-Halbarn Favor Quest 02.jpg|thumb|right|The [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source|Stalhrim Source]]]] [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|Stalhrim]] can only be found on [[Lore:Solstheim|Solstheim]], in stalhrim deposits. They can only be mined using an [[Skyrim:Ancient Nordic Pickaxe|ancient Nordic pickaxe]], the reward for completing the quest [[Skyrim:An Axe to Find|An Axe To Find]]. Alternatively, you can buy one from [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|Baldor Iron-Shaper]] in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. Baldor is also the only merchant that will sell you stalhrim, although he never sells more than four (75% chance each), so you will need to find some stalhrim deposits as well. The very best source for collecting stalhrim is the [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source|Stalhrim Source]], a landmark in northwestern Solstheim. If you have completed the quest [[Skyrim:A New Source of Stalhrim|A New Source of Stalhrim]], the deposit will be marked on your map. It is located south of [[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]] and east of [[Skyrim:Bristleback Cave|Bristleback Cave]] and [[Skyrim:Broken Tusk Mine|Broken Tusk Mine]]. With the ancient Nordic pickaxe in hand, take the trip to the Stalhrim Source, and start mining. You can gather thirty pieces of stalhrim there. For other sources, see [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|this article]]. ===Ebony Ingots=== [[File:SR-quest-Halbarn Favor Quest 03.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]]]] With only seven fixed [[Skyrim:Ebony|ebony]] ingots in the entire game, you will be forced to do some mining and smelting to retrieve the requested amount. Two ebony ores are used to smelt one ebony ingot, meaning you will need at least thirty ebony ores. If you are level 27 or above, there is a chance that blacksmiths and general goods merchants will sell you ores and/or ingots, and an additional chance of looting ores from [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]], but mining is probably the easiest method to achieve your goal. There are two options available. You can travel back to Skyrim and find the biggest source of ebony ore in the game, namely [[Skyrim:Gloombound Mine|Gloombound Mine]] in the [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc stronghold]] of [[Skyrim:Narzulbur|Narzulbur]]. With sixteen ore veins, the mine will net you 48 ebony ores, for a total of 24 ingots, which is more than enough to satisfy Halbarn. However, it is also possible to avoid the trip to Skyrim and stay on Solstheim. If you have completed the quest [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]], thus helping the townsfolk of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], the local [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]] will be reopened and new ore veins discovered. This makes the mine the second best source for ebony ore in the game, with a total of nine ore veins, and after some smelting, thirteen ebony ingots. You can also travel to [[Skyrim:Northshore Landing|Northshore Landing]] and find the ebony ore vein a few feet south of the abandoned shack where [[Skyrim:Old Salty|Old Salty]] resides, and travel to the landmark [[Skyrim:Horker Island|Horker Island]] where the named [[Skyrim:Horker|horker]], [[Skyrim:Lord Tusk|Lord Tusk]], lives. Head to the northeastern shore of the island, where a boat has sunken completely, head west up the beach until you reach the ebony vein next to the cliff wall. Mine your ore and smelt it until you have the fifteen ebony ingots for Halbarn. ===The Reward=== When you have gathered all the items, return to Thirsk Mead Hall and Halbarn. Hand him the materials and he will hand you a [[Skyrim:Leveled_Lists#Gold_Rewards|medium amount of leveled gold]] and be quite happy: ''"Just in time, too. Kuvar was starting to give me some grief about his new armor. This will do the trick nicely. You come back if you ever want some fancier armor yourself, now."'' {{NewLine}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Bring 10 Stalhrim Ore and 15 Ebony Ingots to Halbarn}} |200|fin| |205|fail| |missing=0, 100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} == Bugs == {{Bug|The dialogue to start the quest may not appear after finishing [[Skyrim:Retaking Thirsk|Retaking Thirsk]].}} **{{pc22}} To fix this, enter the command: setstage DLC2ThirskFFHalbarn 0 {{Bug|The objective text says "Stalhrim Ore" even though Stalhrim is enchanted ice, not metal.|USSEP|4.1.1|The objective text is changed from "Bring 10 Stalhrim Ore and 15 Ebony Ingots to Halbarn" to "Bring 10 Stalhrim and 15 Ebony Ingots to Halbarn".}}

When asked how the hunt is going, she will tell you about an idea she had to prevent future [[Skyrim:Riekling|Riekling]] attacks: ''"To tell you the truth, I've been a little distracted. I've got this... idea. I want to ring the whole hall with their little spears. Mocking us, from the past. Making us work harder. Fight better. The only problem is, I'm going to need a lot of spears. A lot. So, if you could find a bunch of them for me, that would make it easier on me."'' After this speech, the quest will start right away. You will need a total of 50 [[Skyrim:Riekling Spear|riekling spears]] so she can decorate the hall. ===Find the Spears=== Riekling spears are the preferred ranged weapon used by rieklings all over [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. The spears can be picked up from the ground once they have been thrown or, alternatively, can be found on the bodies of defeated rieklings (chance of up to 8 spears on all "missile" variants). Note that you will have to keep track of the amount of riekling spears in your inventory yourself, as the game will not even alert you when you reach the required amount of 50 spears. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Elynea Mothren|Elynea Mothren]] |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Reward=Two [[#Reward|leveled potions of well-being]] |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]], [[Skyrim:Headwaters of Harstrad|Headwaters of Harstrad]] |Image=SR-quest-Healing a House.jpg |ImgDesc=The withered part of Tel Mithryn tower |ID=DLC2TTF2 |description=Help [[Skyrim:Elynea Mothren|Elynea Mothren]] repair the tower of [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]]. |SuggLevel=25 |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Elynea Mothren|Elynea Mothren]]) }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Talk to [[Skyrim:Elynea Mothren|Elynea Mothren]] in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]]. # Find three [[Skyrim:Taproot|taproots]] and bring them to the [[Skyrim:Headwaters of Harstrad|Headwaters of Harstrad]]. # Return to Elynea and plant the taproots in the tower of Tel Mithryn. # Receive your reward from Elynea. == Detailed Walkthrough == === Elynea Mothren === The founder of [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]], the eccentric and bossy [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] is rumored to be a nightmare to work for. When you visit [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn Apothecary|the apothecary]] you will find an unhappy proprietor, [[Skyrim:Elynea Mothren|Elynea Mothren]], wandering around badmouthing Neloth: ''"That ash eating wizard is always on me about his tower. It's not my damn fault the thing withered overnight."'' She then explains the problem. Apparently, something went wrong inside [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|the tower]] and Neloth wants it fixed right away and will have no qualms firing Elenya if that can speed things up. When asked what she needs she will say: ''"Three [[Skyrim:Taproot|taproots]] soaked in the headwaters of the Harstrad river. I'm an old woman. I can't possibly make that trip. It's way too dangerous. If you get some taproots, I'll pay you to dip them in the headwaters and bring them to me."'' ===Hunting for Taproot=== A map marker for the Headwaters of Harstrad will be added once you talk to Elynea, but two taproots can be acquired there, so you only need one. On Solstheim, taproots can be found in the following locations: * Elynea herself may have some (15% chance). * Two samples are found near the [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|Alchemy Lab]] inside [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]] in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]]. * There are three samples inside [[Skyrim:Ienth Farm|Ienth Farm]] in Raven Rock. * On an unmarked island north of [[Skyrim:Frossel|Frossel]] you will find three [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggans]], all of them carrying taproot. Once you have at least one taproot, travel to the headwaters, which are hidden between [[Skyrim:Benkongerike|Benkongerike]] and the [[Skyrim:Wind Stone|Wind Stone]]. '''Note''': A bug fix in the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] allows spriggans to have either taproots or [[Skyrim:Spriggan Sap|spriggan sap]], so neither the headwaters nor the unmarked island are guaranteed locations of taproot. ===Headwaters of Harstrad=== [[File:SR-quest-Healing a House 02.jpg|thumb|right|A Spriggan Matron in Harstrad Cave]] The Headwaters of Harstrad is a small landmark and consists of a waterfall that empties into a small lake. There will be a [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggan]] of some type here, either alive and on the shore near the lake, or dead and floating around in the lake. Kill the spriggan if needed, claim the taproot from the body, then dive headfirst into the waterfall and enter the hidden cave [[Skyrim:Harstrad Cave|Harstrad Cave]]. Once inside, you will immediately be attacked by another spriggan, so dispose of it and claim the taproot if you need it. After the battle, the Headwaters will activate so follow the map marker and soak three taproots in the water. Before you leave, make sure to search the boss-leveled chest for some extra goodies, then return to Tel Mithryn. ===Healing a House=== [[File:SR-quest-Healing a House 03.jpg|thumb|right|The new room in Tel Mithryn]] Back in the apothecary, Elynea Mothren will be quite happy when you tell her the mission is accomplished. Hand her the three soaked taproots and she will, surprisingly, keep two samples for herself, saying: ''"I'll just keep two of them for myself. No need for Neloth to know. Take that last taproot and plant it into the wall of the withered house."'' Head over to the [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|tower]] where Neloth will wander around and complain as always. Find the withered area in the northwestern part of the laboratory and plant the taproot in it. Return to Elynea Mothren for a reaction and a small reward: ''"Good. Now maybe Neloth will get off my back about it. I suppose you think you should get paid for helping an old woman. Here. Take these. I'll sell you more if you come back later."'' She will then hand you two [[#Reward|leveled potions of well-being]]. You are also free to take most of the ingredients displayed in her shop for free. Lastly, pay a visit to the tower where Neloth has built an entire new room, a testing area for [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggans]], complete with two trapped spriggans in cages. Back in the apothecary, Elynea will also have [[Skyrim:Hunting and Gathering|a new job]] for you. ===Reward=== {| class="wikitable" ! Level ! == Detailed Walkthrough ==
If you ask Neloth if he needs help with his research, he may ask to buy a Heart Stone from you.  If you have one on you, you can simply sell it to him.  Otherwise, they can be mined from [[Skyrim:Heart Stone Deposit|deposits]] nearby.  He will reward you with 250 gold.

== Notes ==
*This quest is radiant, and may be completed multiple times, particularly at low levels.

Skyrim:Hrodulf's Madness.wikitext:
{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= |Reward= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Hrodulf's House|Hrodulf's House]] |Image=SR-quest-Hrodulf's Madness.jpg |ImgDesc=Unwanted [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|visitors]] outside [[Skyrim:Hrodulf's House|Hrodulf's House]] |description=Uncover the secret of [[Skyrim:Hrodulf's House|Hrodulf's House]]. |ID=DLC2dunHrodulf |Icon= |ReqLevel= |SuggLevel= }}[[Category:Skyrim-Dragonborn-Quests-Non-Journal Quests]] ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note''': This quest does not appear in your journal (see [[#Quest Stages|this section]] for details). # Investigate [[Skyrim:Hrodulf's House|Hrodulf's House]]. # Fight the [[Skyrim:Reaver|reavers]] in the cellar. # Uncover the secret behind the bookshelf. # Find out what happened to [[Skyrim:Hrodulf|Hrodulf]] and [[Skyrim:Bjornolfr|Bjornolfr]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Hrodulf's House=== On the hill between [[Skyrim:Fort Frostmoth|Fort Frostmoth]] and the [[Skyrim:Wreck of the Strident Squall|Wreck of the Strident Squall]] lies the charred remains of a shack called [[Skyrim:Hrodulf's House|Hrodulf's House]]. Not much is left of the original interior and the house is seemingly uninhabited and partly covered in ash. When you approach the premises, two [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]] will rise from the ashes and attack. Dispose of them and look around for some minor loot in a chest, an East Empire Company strongbox holding a [[Skyrim:East Empire Pendant|pendant]] for the quest [[Skyrim:Pain in the Necklace|Pain in the Necklace]], and finally, a trap door leading to a secret underground basement. ===The Reavers=== [[File:SR-quest-Hrodulf's Madness 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Listen to this one!"'']] Downstairs, you will find a much more comfortable room, complete with a table, bookshelves, and food, but also some unwanted visitors, specifically two [[Skyrim:Reaver|reavers]] hiding from the ash spawn you just confronted upstairs. You will land in a safe spot behind a corner, so you can overhear the conversation: '''Reaver #1''': ''"Listen to this one! 'My nights have been impossible to bear without you. I beg of you: Please depart that blasted isle and return to Solitude at once!'"''
'''Reaver #2''': ''"Ha ha ha! No more! What a fool."''
'''Reaver #1''': ''"Do you think he's the one we left in the tunnel?"''
'''Reaver #2''': ''"Who cares? Nords all look the same to me."''
'''Reaver #1''': ''"Ha! Wait... Did you hear that? Sounds like those Ash Spawn are back."''
'''Reaver #2''': ''"Well, at least if the other Nord returns, they'll take care of him."'' After the conversation, the reavers will start walking towards you and the trapdoor, so expose yourself and battle them both. Once they are dead, investigate the table and read the [[Skyrim:Letter (Dragonborn)|letter]] that amused them so much. ===Follow the Clues=== The letter is from a [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] citizen named [[Skyrim:Bjornolfr|Bjornolfr]] and is addressed to his lover, [[Skyrim:Hrodulf|Hrodulf]]. In the letter Bjornolfr shows great concern about the welfare of Hrodulf, and encourages him to leave [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]] and return to Solitude. Look around the room and locate [[Skyrim:Hrodulf's Journal|Hrodulf's journal]] on the crate to the north. Read through it and learn about the growing madness of newcomer Hrodulf who moved into the house, only to be obsessed with a strange rumbling from the basement, in his own words, ''"a calling from the depths"''. As his madness escalated, Hrodulf went to town and bought various tools for digging, and apparently broke down a wall behind one of the bookshelves, obsessed with solving the mystery about the voices from beyond. Before the journal turns into the ramblings of a madman, Hrodulf shows concern about Bjornolfr and the possibility that he would travel to Solstheim and seek out Hrodulf in his house. Hrodulf, however, is nowhere to be found in the basement and you will have no choice but to investigate the bookshelves and find the one you can push aside. ===Fire From the Deep=== [[File:SR-quest-Hrodulf's Madness 03.jpg|thumb|right|What lies beneath]] Behind the bookshelf is the tunnel created by Hrodulf in his desperate attempt to uncover the secret in his basement. The noises from below can be heard clearly, and as you delve underground, a small chamber reveals several [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] machines, all of them still functioning and pumping. Lying on the ground is Bjornolfr, who obviously found the journal and went down there looking for his lover, but found the two reavers instead. On his body you will find a [[Skyrim:Bloodstained Letter|bloodstained letter]], Hrodulf's cryptic plea to Bjornolfr to stay away from the house. The chamber itself contains various dwemer artifacts, three [[Skyrim:Dwarven Metal Ingot|dwarven metal ingots]], two dwemer chests, one of them boss-leveled, and some gold coins scattered around. Hrodulf, however, is still missing and nothing will point you to his location. On the coast south of Hrodulf's house, you will find a canoe and a [[Skyrim:Burnt Spriggan|burnt spriggan]] standing over the corpse of Hrodulf, and some rare [[Skyrim:Ores_and_Ingots#Scrap_Metal|scrap metal]] (a Broken Iron War Axe Head and Handle). He seemingly realized his madness and tried to escape Solstheim in the canoe, but his life instead ended at the hands of a wilderness creature, having caused the death of his lover through his obsession with the strange voices. ==Notes== *The cause of madness that came from the Dwarven machinery was likely Dwemer [[Lore:Tonal Architecture|tonal architecture]]. Depending on the usage, machines such as Dwarven tonal resonators can induce a deep calmness, profound pleasure, or paranoia and terror, with the latter being what Hrodulf experienced. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Sometimes Hrodulf's body may despawn. This may be caused by his body falling through the ground.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Hrodulf's Madness |allmissing=1 |missing=10 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Mission from the Emperor===
[[File:SR-quest-Gift of Kynareth 02.jpg|thumb|right|The letter in Castle Dour]]
Head to [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] in [[SR:Solitude|Solitude]] to intercept a letter from the Emperor. The [[Skyrim:Letter to General Tullius|''Letter to General Tullius'']] can be found on the ground floor of Castle Dour in the room to the north of [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius's]] map room. You are only required to read the letter to start the quest; taking it counts as theft, so be sure that you are not seen if you decide to take it with you. The letter reveals that the [[Skyrim:Lord's Mail (item)|Lord's Mail]], a legendary [[SR:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] artifact, has been stolen by a band of [[Skyrim:Alik'r Mercenary|Alik'r mercenaries]] who were last seen south of [[Skyrim:Fort Greymoor|Fort Greymoor]] in [[SR:Whiterun Hold|Whiterun Hold]].

The Alik'r camp is actually located southeast of Fort Greymoor, and is home to two generic Alik'r mercenaries led by [[SR:Majid the Mad|Majid the Mad]]. Taking on all three at once can be a tough fight, so prepare accordingly. Once the mercenaries lie dead, recover the [[Skyrim:Key to Alik'r Mercenary Chest|Key to Alik'r Mercenary Chest]] from Majid's body and use it to open the nearby chest. Inside, you will find a [[Skyrim:Lord's Mail (Cursed)|cursed version]] of the Lord's Mail along with a set of instructions titled ''[[Skyrim:Majid - Please Read|Majid - Please Read]]''. The note warns that the cursed armor should not be worn; indeed, if you equip it you will be subjected to a constant 50-point reduction to your Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

===Blessing of Kynareth===
In order to remove the curse from the Lord's Mail, you will need to seek the blessing of its mythic creator, [[Lore:Kynareth|Kynareth]]. This will necessitate a return to Solitude to visit the [[SR:Shrine of Kynareth|Shrine of Kynareth]] in the [[Skyrim:Temple of the Divines|Temple of the Divines]]. Upon activating the shrine, you will be informed that ''"The Lord's Mail has been cleansed"''. This concludes the quest and rewards you with a set of [[Skyrim:Heavy Armor (item)|heavy]] [[SR:Ebony|ebony]] armor with [[Skyrim:Resist Poison|poison resistance]], [[Skyrim:Resist Magic|magic resistance]], as well as a unique area effect that inflicts 5 points of [[Skyrim:Absorb Health|health absorbance]] per second on nearby opponents. For the purpose of the [[Skyrim:Heavy Armor#Matching Set|''Matching Set'']] perk, it counts as [[Skyrim:Imperial Armor#Imperial Armor|Imperial armor]].

==Notes==
* For historical information on the Lord's Mail, see the [[Lore:Lord's Mail|lore article]].
* The Alik'r mercenaries wear unique Redguard clothing items.
* If playing on Survival Mode, you will need to disable Survival Mode in order to complete the quest and get the Lord's Mail. The easiest way is to disable Survival mode outside of the temple then re-enable it once you've cleansed the armor. For some reason, it won't work when you have to pay to use the shrine.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
While investigating the first Saints camp for [[SR:Balance of Power|Balance of Power]], you will slay the [[Skyrim:Saints Bandit Leader|Saints Bandit Leader]]. In his corpse is a note called ''[[Skyrim:Notes on the Blacksmith|Notes on the Blacksmith]]'', which gives details about the blacksmith Joften and his ability to forge Golden & Dark equipment. However, it would appear the bandits lost patience with Joften, who became increasingly insane, and ended up killing him. His notes, however, are hidden and would likely reveal his secrets. The only hint given was that as a child, Joften used to play in the area around [[Skyrim:Half-Moon Mill|Half-Moon Mill]], so the bandits had intended to investigate there. 

Head to Half-Moon Mill and search under the bridge to find a chest containing ''[[Skyrim:Joften's Notes|Joften's Notes]]'' as well as other loot. Reading the journal will complete the quest and allow you to craft Golden/Dark equipment once you have the Daedric Smithing perk.

The chest and the note will be there regardless of whether the quest has been started, so if the player did not loot the note that starts the quest and the Saints Bandit Leader's corpse despawned, they can still learn Golden and Dark smithing.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
You must await a courier's delivery when you reach level 10, likely within a hold capital, and read [[SR:Warrior's Challenge|the note]] given to you. It will direct you to [[Skyrim:Hendraheim (place)|Hendraheim]], an ancient Nordic warrior's hall marked on your map, which can be yours if you prove your worth in battle to the current owner. The hall is just north of [[SR:Bilegulch Mine|Bilegulch Mine]] and southwest of [[SR:Fort Sungard|Fort Sungard]]. The climb is quite steep if approaching directly from the north, so it's advisable to approach from the Sungard side (climb the slope to the east, passing the Bilegulch Dragon Mound as you go, and circle around from the rear of the house to reach the front). 

Once you arrive at the property, you will meet a rather unassuming Nord woman called [[SR:Eydvina Shield-Hearth|Eydvina Shield-Hearth]] sweeping the stables. She is responsible for the challenge you have received, and will gear up for battle after a brief conversation. Kill her to claim the [[SR:Key to Hendraheim|key]] to the property. On her corpse you will also find a [[SR:Eydvina's Note|note]] explaining her motivation for seeking a warrior's death in order to enter [[SR:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]].

Head inside the house to complete the quest and investigate your new [[Skyrim:Houses|player home]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Once you've reached level 32, head to a settlement and a [[SR:Courier|courier]] will deliver the ''[[SR:Letter from Tyra Blood-Fire|Letter from Tyra Blood-Fire]]''. It is addressed to you personally, from a notorious leader of a bandit gang named [[SR:Tyra Blood-Fire|Tyra Blood-Fire]]. Her gang has disbanded, and she now seeks the judgment of the Divines to atone for her past crimes. She believes that facing you in combat is the only way to receive this divine judgment, but first you must prove your character to her.

The letter instructs you to go to the docks in [[SR:Windhelm|Windhelm]] and give alms to a local [[SR:Beggar (person)|beggar]]. He sits on a mat down the end of the docks, near the [[Skyrim:East Empire Company (place)|East Empire Company offices]]. You will have the option to give him 1 gold, 100 gold, some [[SR:wine|wine]], some [[SR:bread|bread]], or to give him nothing and pray for his prosperity. Your choice is irrelevant, as you will be given the opportunity to face Tyra no matter which option you choose.

With this done, you will be directed to a [[Skyrim:Shrines#Shrine_of_Talos|shrine of Talos]] southwest of Windhelm, at the top of a small mountain overlooking the bridge next to the [[SR:Windhelm Stables|stables]] {{Map Link|x=128799|y=24553|zoom=17}}. Tyra is praying there, and as promised she will be hostile upon your approach. She is a dangerous enemy, as she possesses a full set of [[Skyrim:Ebony Plate Armor|Ebony Plate Armor]] bearing powerful enchantments and dual wields two [[SR:Ebony Sword|ebony sword]]s in combat. Defeat her and loot her corpse for the valuable enchanted set of armor; with this quest completed, you will begin to find Ebony Plate items as random loot throughout Skyrim. You can also loot her for a single [[SR:Ruby|ruby]], a copy of ''[[SR:The Crimson Dirks, v1|The Crimson Dirks, v1]]'' explaining her origins, and a letter titled ''[[SR:To (Player)|To (Player)]]''. The contents of this final letter is dependent on the choice you made when speaking with the beggar.
{{NewLine}}

The letter received has 5 different middle parts.

Prayer for the Beggar - "You chose to pray for the beggar, putting your faith in the Divines. After all, maybe it isn't food or water people need, but hope in something greater than themselves. But the world is not a place where hope alone will save you. My advice to you is to seize your destiny. Don't wait for an idle god. Then you'll be a worthy judge and executioner for your enemies, just as you were for me."

Give 1 gold - "You gave the beggar a single septim. I like the amount. you did what you could without placing a burden on yourself. and yet, on its own a single piece does nothing for him. It's only when the entire town does their part, each one placing a septim, that the beggar has enough to eat. So my advice to you is to remember the value of company. Whether you're a bandit or a hero, no one can do it alone. You have to work together, one gold piece at a time, to do what needs to be done."

Give 100 Gold - "You gave the beggar a full purse of gold. You're someone who goes above and beyond, putting the lives of others above your own. But not even a thousand septims can save the life of every man, woman, and child. So my advice to you is to not fall victim to your kindness. There are people like me who will take advantage of it. And there are times when you'll have to make a hard decision for the greater gain. Save who you can, but do what you must."

Give Bread - "You gave the beggar bread, a choice I agree with. Gold can be wasted. Wine can be a poison. But a meal can never be squandered. Perhaps if I had been given a similar gift, my life would have been different. As such, I deem you a worthy judge. Hopefully you will be a swift executioner. Either way, I thank you."

Give Wine - "You gave the beggar wine. It'll help him forget his troubles; give him a reprieve. But such gifts can quickly sour. Come morning, the beggar may regret your choice, or worse yet, he might repeat it. So my advice to you is to view every action in its entirety. Only then can you make your choices with clear eyes."

==Notes==
*When giving the beggar alms, wines include [[SR:Food#Alto Wine|Alto Wine]], [[SR:Food#Argonian Bloodwine|Argonian Bloodwine]]{{HF}}, [[SR:Food#Spiced Wine|Spiced Wine]], [[SR:Food#Surilie Brothers Wine|Surilie Brothers Wine]]{{HF}}, [[SR:Food#Wine|Wine]].

It can be found on a table in the first room on the right on the lower floors of the temple. You will then have to travel to [[Skyrim:Fahlbtharz|Fahlbtharz]] and enter the Forge. Inside you will find [[Skyrim:Hand Kenro Hlan|Hand Kenro Hlan]], he will be hostile and you will have to kill him. Once he is dealt with, search his body to find a [[Skyrim:Hand Kenro's Note|note]], unenchanted weapon, [[Skyrim:Kenro's Helmet|Kenro's Helmet]] and [[Skyrim:Kenro's Robes|Kenro's Robes]]. Picking up these items will also start [[Skyrim:Trueflame (quest)|Trueflame (quest)]]. You will then need to head to [[Skyrim:Ashfall's Tear|Ashfall's Tear]], once inside you will find a ALMSIVI puzzle. The correct order for the stone pillars is {{DaedricFont|ASV}}. If you decide to wear Kenro's helmet and robes and infiltrate the temple ranks, the ordinators at the door will not be hostile, however, if you are not wearing these, they will attack on sight. ===Joining the Heretics=== If you disguise yourself, you can peacefully talk to [[Skyrim:Matriarch Drevlan|Matriarch Drevlan]] and either persuade or prove yourself by fighting Almalexia's Hands: :'''I'm actually not one of your followers. But I'd still like to join your ranks.''' :''"You expect me to believe that?"'' ::'''I could prove my loyalty by praying to the Goddess. (Persuade).''' ::''"Okay, okay, you've talked me into it."'' ::'''If I bested your warriors in combat, it would show the Goddess favors me.''' ::''"How can I argue with that?"'' If you manage to persuade her you will have to pray at the nearby Shrine of Almalexia next to the large statue at the temple entrance. Doing so acts as praying at any other shrine, curing diseases and replacing any active blessing with Almalexia's Blessing. This blessing grants +10 to the Heavy Armor skill and +10% damage with One-Handed weapons for 8 hours. Once you've prayed at the shrine, you've joined the heretics and can continue on to the next stage of the quest. If you want to prove yourself through combat, you will have to fight [[Skyrim:Hand Kydren Indobar|Hand Kydren Indobar]] until he submits, then [[Skyrim:Hand Ethra Mavandas|Hand Ethra Mavandas]], [[Skyrim:Watchman Sindras|Watchman Sindras]] and finally [[Skyrim:Vesparth the Toe|Vesparth the Toe]]. After this you will need to speak to Drevlan again: :'''I've won the combat trial. I trust this means I have her favor?''' :''"The deed is done. We need speak of it no longer."'' After this point, you are now accepted. You are free to switch back to your other apparel if you want. Speak to Drevlan again to continue. :'''I await the Goddess' command. Her word is our law.''' :''"You speak the truth."'' ::'''Does the Goddess have a task for me?''' ::''"Of course. It's all in this note."'' She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Masks of the Tribunal|note]] detailing your task and the location of the other masks. Reading the note will begin three quests: *{{Quest Link|Her Word Against Theirs}} *{{Quest Link|Buyer Beware}} *{{Quest Link|Careless Curation}} [[File:SR-quest-Ghosts of the Tribunal 03.jpg|Ash zombies|right|thumb]] Once you return to the temple you will have to clear out the ash zombies that are attacking the temple, once they are dealt with you will need to speak to the Matriarch: {{huh}} She will reward you with the [[Skyrim:Tribunal Armory Key|Tribunal Armory Key]], ability to craft [[SR:Her Hand Armor Set|Her Hand Armor Set]] and [[SR:Chitin#Indoril_Armor|Indoril Armor Set]] is also gained, it requires [[SR:Elven#Elven_Smithing|Elven Smithing]] perk. {{NewLine}} ===Destroying the Heretics=== If you decide to destroy the heretics, you can disguise yourself still in order to speak to Matriarch Drevlan, or you can just deal with them the traditional way. If you choose the traditional way, you will have to first fight the two [[Skyrim:Ordinator|ordinators]] that guard the first door into the temple. You will then have to fight everyone gathered in the ritual room past the statue. There is a narrow straight tunnel before the room. It is possible to fight everyone in the room one on one at this choke point. You will still be able to complete the other Ghost of the Tribunal Quests by looting the bodies for notes. There is no key to the armory however and this prevents you from obtaining Skullcrusher. The other cases are unlocked however. You will still have to fight the Ash Zombies and if you return to Ashfall Tear after that, you will find the Reclamation Priest with three Redoran Guards investigating the scene while sadly saying "Almsivi" to themselves. They will ask what you want but no dialogue will be available. You will have all four masks, not replicas, but they have no associated magical qualities. ==Notes== *Disposition with heretics can be elevated in 3 ways, either finishing three tasks, or combating against 4 potential followers, or persuading Matriarch Drevlan and receiving Almalexia blessing, followers will become available as soon as their disposition toward you are elevated. *3 ways above can lead to complete "(Optional) Earn the Matriarch's trust and join the temple heretics", then you can equip whatever armor instead of [[SR:Ghosts_of_the_Tribunal_Items#Unique_Apparel|Kenro's Helmet and Robes]] ==Bugs== *If you choose to duel the 4 combatants and you have an active follower with you, they will sometimes aggro onto your follower (the follower will not retaliate due to the duel). Once the 4 duels have been won and you speak to Matriarch Drevlan to progress the quest, your follower will attack the 4 combatants, turning all of the heretics hostile and preventing you from siding with them. It is not possible to dismiss your follower after you initiate the first duel. Some potential fixes are: ** Reload a previous save from before initiating the first duel, then dismiss your follower. ** Kill your follower. ** Exit the cave without speaking to Matriarch Drevlan, then do a quest that force-replaces your current active follower (unconfirmed if this works). ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||There's been plenty of upheaval in Solstheim since the eruption of the Red Mountain, both politically and religiously. Go inside and up to the second floor. In one of the corners find a dresser with ''[[Skyrim:Guard's Dossier: Antonius|Guard's Dossier: Antonius]]'' atop of it. Once it has been read, the quest will begin. The next destination is [[Skyrim:Cragslane Cavern|Cragslane Cavern]] located just off the road between Riften and Windhelm, North of Shor's Stone and West of Ansilvund. The entrance has a Bouncer and a couple of Pit wolves in cages. Defeat them and go inside. Further in find the Pit Wolf fighting arena. Fight off the various titled foes before finding the corpse of [[SR:Antonius|Antonius]]. Loot his body to find ''[[SR:Antonius' Note|Antonius' Note]]'' and read it. It indicates that as a gambler he incurred some debts and sold his unique armor to a collector in Riften. Next head back to Riften and visit the Bee and Barb tavern. Once inside, look for a patron named [[SR:Armor Collector|Armor Collector]]. There are a few options at this point which all result in the same outcome. You can attempt to persuade or intimidate her into "leaving the city's protection" or purchase the armor from her. If you convince her to leave Riften, you can try to kill or pickpocket her for the armor once she is outside the city. ==Notes== *[[SR:Armor Collector|Armor Collector]] carries [[SR:Orders (Orcish Scaled)|Orders]] that can be pickpocketed. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've heard stories of former bandits living as fugitives across Tamriel. Just inside, another reveler is drinking and dancing. Proceed down the hallway to the [[Skyrim:Waiter|waiter]]. No matter what you say, the outcome will be the same; with him handing you a [[Skyrim:Dinner Menu|dinner menu]] ({{Nowrap|Version 1}}) and directing you and the other guests to your seats. Sit down at the table, in a place of honor across from the door. Once you sit down, read the note on your plate named [[Skyrim:Please Read Aloud|Please Read Aloud]] to gain some insight into this mysterious dinner party and proceed with the quest. After you read the last page of the letter, the waiter will approach [[Skyrim:Galtius|Galtius]] across from you and bite him from behind, killing him. As the other guests rise from their seats in a panic, the bard in the room, the waiter, and two gargoyles will attack. Deal with them, and be careful of the waiter: his lightning attacks are strong enough to one-shot lower-level players. [[Skyrim:Resist Magic|Resist magic]] gear and [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] might help. Once all the vampires and their stone minions are dead, speak with the "survivor." Some of the other guests may have survived your battle but the one to speak with is the Orc [[Skyrim:Durian|Durian]], who is revealed to be a member of the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard_(faction)|Dawnguard]]: :'''The vampires are all dead. And the will says the house belongs to me.''' :''"Very good. But you've created a debt between us. Here. Take this. We are even now."'' He will then hand you a leveled amount of gold but no [[Skyrim:Bloodchill Manor Key|key]], and you will become the official owner of the manor. This completes the quest. The doors along the entry hallway will open and you can begin using your new base. If there are any surviving guests besides Durian, they will return to sit at the dinner table amidst the carnage. Once you leave and reenter the cave, all of the bodies and debris will be cleaned up (including the vampiric bard near the entrance, which was presumably dispatched by Durian on your way into dinner), any surviving guests will have left, and the dinner table will be cleared out of the trophy room to allow your unimpeded access. ===Player as a Vampire=== If the player is a [[Skyrim:Vampirism|vampire]], things play out a little differently. When you arrive at the manor, pass through the guests and speak to the [[Skyrim:Waiter|waiter]] at the end of the hall. After choosing one of four options, the waiter will give a generic response and hand you the [[Skyrim:Dinner Menu|dinner menu]] ({{Nowrap|Version 2}}). He will then turn and lead you to the banquet table. Once there, sit and read through the feast note [[Skyrim:Please Read Aloud|Please Read Aloud]]. After doing so you are instructed to begin the feast, by drinking the blood of the already enthralled [[Skyrim:Parven|Parven]]. At that point, the waiter will approach [[Skyrim:Galtius|Galtius]] and bite him from behind, killing him. After Galtius's death Parven will also terminate and the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]] will enter the building, initiating battle. After disposing of the Dawnguard and the remaining guests, speak to the waiter once more. :'''The Dawnguard and the nobles are dead.''' :''It would seem so.'' :'''The note seemed to imply the last survivor would get the house.''' :''I'm so glad you succeeded. Here. Please take this for your trouble.'' At this point the waiter will give you the [[Skyrim:Bloodchill Manor Key|key]] to the manor and some leveled gold, completing the quest. Three more dialogue options are given; all will end the conversation. The doors along the entry hallway are now open for use, and when you leave and reenter the cavern all of the destruction from your fight will be cleared away. == Notes == * After the attack in the non-vampire version, Durian is renamed Dawnguard even if the player has not started the Dawnguard quest line. * It is significantly easier to complete the quest as a Vampire, especially at lower levels, as the vampires are very threatening spellcasters and the gargoyles in the dining hall will also come to life and attack the player if they are not a vampire. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You may receive a radiant quest from the Companions to intimidate the waiter, if you brawl the waiter and don't kill him, the quest will softlock, as your player will be unable to move when re-entering Bloodchill Cavern.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you attack and kill the bard, waiter, and gargoyles before reading the note, the quest will still complete properly, but you will be left unable to move if you then read the note at any point after.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you start the fight and leave Bloodchill Cavern before finishing the fight, the doors will be closed and the gargoyles will not respond to any action, making the quest impossible to complete.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}}To fix this bug, use the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command setstage ccEEJSSE005_Quest 100. **This bug can also be fixed by attacking the person outside, which skips to the vampire attack and causes the door to open. However, the gargoyles will remain unresponsive. **If playing on consoles, a work around exists. Abilities with a large area of effect such as Kyne's Peace can be used to aggro the Waiter behind the locked doors. When leaving the cave, any aggressive vampires should appear outside with you after a small delay, making it possible to kill them. The disguised Dawnguard member will now reward you, completing the quest, and unlocking all the previously locked doors of the manor. {{Bug|After the quest is complete, the ''Dinner Invitation'' when read in your inventory may now be a blank sheet of paper.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||In Skyrim, personal news and letters are often delivered by courier. If I head to a major hold, I might find something addressed to me. {{Quest Objective|10|Await news from a courier}} |20||During my travels through Skyrim, I ran into a courier who had a letter addressed to me. I should read it to find out who sent it and why. {{Quest Objective|20|Read the Dinner Invitation}} |30||I received a letter from a courier mentioning a {{sic|banquest|banquet}} feast is happening at a large manor south of Frostflow Lighthouse. I should visit the hall and attend the festivities. {{Quest Objective|30|Attend the {{sic|banquest|banquet}} feast}} |40||I received a letter from a courier mentioning a {{sic|banquest|banquet}} feast is happening at a large manor south of Frostflow Lighthouse. I arrived at the home and found an array of guests at the door. {{Quest Objective|40|Speak to the Waiter}} |50||I received a letter from a courier mentioning a {{sic|banquest|banquet}} feast is happening at a large manor south of Frostflow Lighthouse. I arrived at the home and spoke to the waiter, who gave me a menu. {{Quest Objective|50|Travel to the banquet table}} {{Quest Objective|50|Take a seat at the feast table}} {{Quest Objective|50|Read the feast note}} {{Quest Objective|50|Begin the feast}} |60||I received a letter from a courier mentioning a {{sic|banquest|banquet}} feast is happening at a large manor south of Frostflow Lighthouse. I'm ready for the next fishing challenge.''' :''"Of course. It's all in this note."'' :'''Alright. I'll be back with the fish.''' He then hands you a [[Skyrim:List of Arctic Fish|list of arctic fish]], which tells you that you need to catch: *[[Skyrim:Angler Larvae|Angler Larvae]] - You will need to use the Alik'ri rod. Multiple are guaranteed to spawn in [[SR:Pilgrim's Trench|Pilgrim's Trench]] on the ocean floor. *[[Skyrim:Arctic Char|Arctic Char]] - Use the Argonian rod at an Arctic spot. Can also be found at [[SR:Hela's Folly|Hela's Folly]], [[SR:Orphan's Tear|Orphan's Tear]] (within the sunken deck) and Pilgrim's Trench. *[[Skyrim:Arctic Grayling|Arctic Grayling]] - Use the Argonian rod at an Arctic spot. *[[Skyrim:Cod|Cod]] - Use the Argonian rod at an Arctic spot. Can also be found outside [[SR:Anga's Mill|Anga's Mill]] and outside [[SR:Bronze Water Cave|Bronze Water Cave]]. You can also optionally pickup a copy of [[Skyrim:Fishing Mastery, v3|Fishing Mastery, v3]] from the shelf in the backroom. Once you have the fish required return to Swims: :'''Here are the fish you asked for.''' :''"It has done a good thing. It will take this gift as a token of gratitude."'' He will then reward you with 300 gold. ==Notes== *[[Skyrim:Crustacean_Extermination|Crustacean Extermination]] is the prerequisite of this task, as it will reward you [[Skyrim:Fishing_Items#Alik.27ri_Fishing_Rod|Alik'ri Fishing Rod]]. **It is not required to wait for the Courier to deliver the letter. Upon completion of Crustacean Extermination, you can head straight to Swims-In-Deep-Water and immediately request the next quest. If the Courier was already headed your way, this will make him behave as if he already delivered the letter to you. ==Bugs== {{Bug|This quest may attempt to remove a courier note from his container even if it isn't present because the quests were done in a different order.|USSEP|4.3.4}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |4||I received a letter from Swims-In-Deep-Water about fishing challenges. I should see what it has to say. |6||Swims-In-Deep-Water is ready to resume my fishing challenges. I should speak with him when I return to the Riften Fishery. |10||Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch. |20||The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water has tasked me with catching are commonly found in the freezing waters of Skyrim's snow-capped landscapes. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. I can consult the third volume of Fishing Mastery to learn more about my quarry. |21||I have read the third volume of Fishing Mastery. All of the fish I need to catch to complete the challenge can be caught at fishing spots wherever there is freezing water near snow and ice. The docks of Windhelm, the water near Dawnstar, and the small lake near Nightgate Inn were mentioned as places I could try casting my line. |200|fin|I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. |missing=0}} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

Doing so will allow you to speak with the normally hostile [[SR:Matriarch Drevlan|Matriarch Drevlan]]. Offer to serve the Goddess Almalexia, and Drevlan will give you this quest along with [[SR:Buyer Beware|Buyer Beware]] and [[SR:Careless Curation|Careless Curation]]. These quests are all optional and can be completed in any order, although you must do them if you intend to remain aligned with the [[SR:Tribunal Temple|Tribunal Temple]]. For this quest, you will be instructed to speak with [[SR:Priest Drureth|Priest Drureth]]. He can be found in one of the side rooms within the temple in Ashfall's Tear. He will hand you a transcribed ''[[SR:Propaganda Letter|Propaganda Letter]]'' which will need to be translated from the original [[Lore:Daedric Alphabet|Daedric text]] before it can be distributed. ===Information Campaign=== [[File:SR-quest-Her Word Against Theirs 02.jpg|thumb|right|The Raven Rock Temple would be very interested in knowing about this letter]] Return to Raven Rock with the untranslated letter and speak with [[SR:Aphia Velothi|Aphia Velothi]]. She is a former Temple priestess and will agree to secretly translate the text of the letter. If you have not yet encountered Aphia, she can initially be found just inside the entrance to [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]]. It will take her two hours to translate the document. When all three tasks are completed, she will give you the quest [[SR:Ashen Heart|Ashen Heart]]. ===Reward=== The outcome of this quest depends on whether you chose to distribute the propaganda or alert the New Temple authorities, there're 4 circumstances in total, either no upgraded Ashfall's Tear, level 1 upgraded Ashfall's Tear, level 2, level 3. If you chose to distribute the material to the public, you will return to Ashfall's Tear to find a number of new occupants. These new converts will have cleaned the temple's living areas, replacing the destroyed furnishings previously found there, all planters are now sprouting plants. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Head to [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] and speak with [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]].
#Speak with [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Joining===
Proceed to [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] and enter the [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]]. If this is your first time in the palace, then Jarl [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] and his lieutenant, [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]], will have a long conversation concerning the war. Speak with Ulfric, who recognizes you from [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]] and will direct you to speak with his lieutenant. Galmar will ask you why you want to join, then tell you that to prove yourself worthy of joining the Stormcloaks, you must travel to the [[Skyrim:Serpentstone Isle|Serpentstone Isle]] and defeat an [[Skyrim:Ice Wraith#Ice Wraith|Ice Wraith]]. If you are below level 20, he will also give you an [[Skyrim:Elixir of Resist Cold|Elixir of Resist Cold]] and three [[Skyrim:Ice Wraith Bane|Ice Wraith Banes]], both of which can be incredibly helpful on this quest if you are at a low level.

===Test Your Mettle===
[[File:SR-place-Serpentstone Isle.jpg|thumb|right|Serpentstone Isle will be your proving grounds]]
Travel to the Serpentstone Isle, located far north of Windhelm. Once you're there, kill the Ice Wraith. Using a fire spell or adding the Ice Wraith Bane to your weapon will make the fight easier. Remember to use the resist frost potion before you engage if you need it. You can also find the Serpent Stone while there.

===The Victorious Return===
Travel back to the Palace of Kings to speak with Galmar. When you return, Galmar and Ulfric will be discussing your next mission for the Stormcloaks. Galmar will express his surprise at seeing you return and ask you to take the Stormcloak oath:

:''"I do swear my blood and honor to the service of Ulfric Stormcloak..."''
:''"...Jarl of Windhelm and true High King of Skyrim."''
:''"As Talos is my witness, may this oath bind me to death and beyond..."''
:''"...even to my lord as to my fellow brothers and sisters in arms."''
:''"All hail the Stormcloaks, the true sons and daughters of Skyrim!"''

Repeat the oath as Galmar says it and he will reward you with Fur Boots, a Stormcloak Cuirass, Fur Gauntlets and a Hide Helmet. 

===Reward===
Upon completion of the quest and repeating the oath you will be awarded the following:
*Hide Helmet
*Fur Gauntlets
*Stormcloak Cuirass
*Fur Boots
"You're a Stormcloak now, you ought to look the part. "--Galmar Stone-Fist

===Achievements===
One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest:
* {{achievement|Taking Sides}}

==Notes==
* [[Skyrim:Joining the Legion|Joining the Legion]] and [[Skyrim:Joining the Stormcloaks|Joining the Stormcloaks]] are mutually exclusive quests: completing one automatically fails the other (if it was started or the prerequisite miscellaneous quest was started).
* [[File:Flag Germany.png|22px]] The German version of the quest name is "So jung und schon bei den Sturmmänteln?", which is a take-off of the German translation of Princess Leia's famous Star Wars quote to Luke, "Aren't you a little short for a Stormtrooper?" The word "Sturmmänteln" (Stormcloak) is substituted for the original "Sturmtruppen", however.

CW01A |Icon=SR-qico-Imperial Legion.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Go to [[SR:Solitude|Solitude]]. # Speak to [[SR:General Tullius|General Tullius]]. # Speak to [[SR:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]]. # Clear out bandits from [[SR:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]]. # Return to Legate Rikke. # Take the [[SR:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] oath. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Imperial Introductions=== [[File:SR-quest-Reunification_of_Skyrim.jpg|thumb|right|''"I'm telling you, Ulfric's planning an attack on Whiterun."'']] Anytime after escaping [[SKyrim:Helgen|Helgen]] during [[Skyrim:Unbound|Unbound]], anyone you meet with ties with the Imperial Legion (like [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]]) will encourage you to travel to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] to enlist. This will start the miscellaneous quest [[Skyrim:Imperial Introductions|Imperial Introductions]]. In particular, some of them will specify to talk to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]]. When you enter, you will witness her trying to convince an ill-informed [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] that [[Skyrim:Nord|Nords]] will follow their traditions, even in a time when loyalty is tested. Apparently, rebel leader [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] is preparing to attack [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] so the two strategists have their hands full. After the scene, if you try to speak to Legate Rikke, General Tullius will approach you. He will recall you from Helgen and, by any of your dialogue options, point you towards Legate Rikke for putting someone as resourceful as you to good use. Rikke will commend you for surviving the destruction of Helgen and tell you that she has arranged a small test of your skills before you're allowed to join the Legion. When asked which test she will explain: ''"The kind that evaluates your usefulness during... duress. I'm sending you to clear out Fort Hraagstad. If you survive, you'll pass. If you die, then I'll have no further use for your corpse."''. She will then explain that the Legion will set up a garrison at [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]] but that the place has been overrun with [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] and needs to be cleared. She will not take no for an answer and will just angrily say: ''"What's the matter, soldier? I gave you an order. I want that fort, and I want it now. Move it!"''. This will complete the miscellaneous quest Imperial Introductions and start [[Skyrim:Joining the Legion|Joining the Legion]]. If you have already visited Fort Hraggstad and cleared it, she will be quite surprised: ''"Is that so? I was right about you."''. This will complete Imperial Introductions and start [[Skyrim:Joining the Legion|Joining the Legion]] with the [[#The Oath|first stages]] completed. ===Joining the Legion=== ====Prove Your Usefulness==== The fort is located near the [[Skyrim:Thalmor_Embassy|Thalmor Embassy]], west of Solitude in the snowy terrain past [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]]. Once there, a number of bandits will attack you on sight. The fort has archers, atop towers, so approach with caution. Once the exterior area is clear, locate the entrance to the fort and enter. It consists of two interior zones: the main zone and the prison, both of them accessible from separate entrances in the courtyard. In the prison, two bandits await you in the first room, with another guarding the area downstairs. In the main zone, two bandits and their chief will ambush you upon entering. You can find a copy of the [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]], ''[[Skyrim:The Gold Ribbon of Merit|The Gold Ribbon of Merit]]'' upstairs. When all is said and done return to Legate Rikke in Solitude. ====The Oath==== [[File:SR-quest-Joining the Legion 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Long live the Emperor! Long live the Empire!"'']] Upon your next enter in the castle, Legate Rikke and Tullius will once again be debating, this time about the [[Skyrim:Jagged Crown|Jagged Crown]]. Tullius will once again show a lack of respect for Nordic tradition. After the scene, Rikke will approach you and will be pleased to see your success, complimenting you on a job well done: ''"Welcome back, soldier. I'm glad you made it in one piece. I'll send men to garrison the fort right away. You did well. I'm impressed. But before we go any further, it's time for you to officially join the Legion."''. General Tullius will then approach you to take the oath binding you to the service of the emperor and the Legion. Repeat the oath after him: :''"Upon my honor I do swear undying loyalty to the Emperor{{hover|Mention of Titus Mede II is omitted if you have already killed him for the Dark Brotherhood|, Titus Mede II}}..."'' :''"...and unwavering obedience to the officers of his great Empire."'' :''"May those above judge me, and those below take me, if I fail in my duty."'' :''"Long live the Emperor! Long live the Empire!"'' Tullius will then welcome you to the Legion and send you to the castle's blacksmith, [[Skyrim:Beirand|Beirand]], starting the miscellaneous quest [[Skyrim:Get Outfitted|Get Outfitted]], who will provide you with a set of [[Skyrim:Imperial Armor|Imperial armor]]. You may choose heavy, medium, or light Imperial armor. Once Tullius has sent you towards Beirand the quest ends and the next one starts, your first assignment for the Empire as an [[Skyrim:Imperial_Legion#Ranks|Auxiliary]] of the Imperial Legion, [[Skyrim:The Jagged Crown (Imperial)|The Jagged Crown]]. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: *{{achievement|Taking Sides}} ==Notes== * [[Skyrim:Joining the Legion|Joining the Legion]] and [[Skyrim:Joining the Stormcloaks|Joining the Stormcloaks]] are mutually exclusive quests: completing one automatically fails the other (if it was started or the prerequisite miscellaneous quest was started). * You can still join the Imperial Legion after completing the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]. The oath you take upon joining omits "Titus Mede II", but he'll still say "Long Live the Emperor!" * Even though Legate Rikke says she will send troops to garrison the fort straight away if you return to Fort Hraggstad before speaking to her Imperial soldiers will already be present. Because you have not taken the Imperial oath yet you will be trespassing if you enter the buildings and you will get attacked if you do not leave. * If you clear [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]] before starting this quest, [[SKyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] will have different dialogue, surprised by your go-ahead. Nevertheless it won't affect the course of the quest. * After completion of this quest, random spawned groups of [[Skyrim:Stormcloak Soldier|Stormcloak Soldiers]] may attack you and you will no longer be welcome in Stormcloak [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks#Camps|camps]] or [[Skyrim:Military Forts#Civil War Forts|forts]]. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]] is not the first [[Skyrim:Military Forts#Civil War Forts|Civil War Fort]] you clear, after clearing it of [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]], even during this quest, soldiers will never garrison and enemies respawn instead. This is due to a hidden quest not ending after clearing the first Civil War Fort. See this [[Skyrim talk:Fort Hraggstad|talk]] section for info.|USKP|1.2.7}} **{{Pc22}}The console command resetquest CWFortObserver can be used to reset the hidden quest, then clear the fort again. Repeat this for every Civil War Fort you want to be garrisoned. {{Bug|You may encounter a bug/message "No Active Quest" or when you get closer to the fort the quest arrow may just disappear. Go ahead and clear out all the bandits around and in the prison first. Then, head to the main zone. The quest arrow will then reappear and point to the chief bandit. You can then properly clear out the fort and complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|One or more bandits may be in a completely different part of Skyrim.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Imperial Introductions |id=CW00A |1||{{Quest Comment|Heard from anyone Imperial Legion relatad}} {{Quest Objective|1|Join the Imperial Legion}} |7||{{Quest Comment|Spoken to Legate Rikke, approached by General Tullius}} {{Quest Objective|1|Join the Imperial Legion}} |10||{{Quest Comment|Spoken directly to General Tullius}} {{Quest Objective|1|Join the Imperial Legion}} |!|Joining the Legion|CW01A |1||In order to prove myself to Legate Rikke, I am to clear out the bandits living at Fort Hraggstad. {{Quest Objective|1|Clear out Fort Hraggstad}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Report to Legate Rikke}} |160||{{Quest Objective|160|Take the oath}} |200|fin| |999|fail| |missing= **CW00A: 0, 2, 5. **CW01A: 0, 150 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===First Steps===
Once you have level 100 (see [[#Bugs|bugs]]) in the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] skill, travel to the [[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(place)|College of Winterhold]]. Once there, find [[Skyrim:Drevis Neloren|Drevis Neloren]]. Ask him if you can learn anything more about Illusion magic. He will give you a spell, [[Skyrim:Vision of the Tenth Eye|Vision of the Tenth Eye]], and ask you to find four [[Skyrim:Master Illusion Text|Master Illusion texts]]. You can only see these books for a thirty second period each time you cast the vision spell.

===Hidden Books===
# The [[Skyrim:Master Illusion Text (2)|first book]] is on a table in [[Skyrim:the Arcanaeum|the Arcanaeum]]. It is in the west on the outer ring. It appears on the same table as the book ''[[Skyrim:The Legend of Red Eagle|The Legend of Red Eagle]]''.
# The [[Skyrim:Master Illusion Text (3)|second book]] can be found in the [[Skyrim:Hall_of_Attainment|Hall of Attainment]]. On the landing of the upper level, at the top of the stairs, it lies on the second step on the landing.
# The [[Skyrim:Master Illusion Text (1)|third book]] is on a barrel in the upstairs storeroom of the [[Skyrim:Hall_of_Countenance|Hall of Countenance]]. This is the room opposite of the room with the [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanters|Arcane Enchanter]].
# The [[Skyrim:Master Illusion Text (4)|last book]] is down in [[Skyrim:The_Midden|The Midden]], on a table next to the [[Skyrim:Atronach Forge|Atronach Forge]].

===Return to Drevis Neloren===
Give all the books to [[Skyrim:Drevis Neloren|Drevis Neloren]] and he will give you the master-level Illusion spell tome [[Skyrim:Hysteria|Hysteria]]. You can then also buy the other three master-level tomes from him: [[Skyrim:Call to Arms|Call to Arms]], [[Skyrim:Harmony|Harmony]], and [[Skyrim:Mayhem|Mayhem]].

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Obtain the [[Skyrim:J'zargo's Flame Cloak Scroll|scrolls]] from [[Skyrim:J'zargo|J'zargo]].
#Use the scrolls to kill at least three undead enemies.
#Return to J'zargo with your results.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Simple Request===
If you attended [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir's]] [[Skyrim:First Lessons|lecture]] when you joined the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]] you may have run into a conceited [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]] named [[Skyrim:J'zargo|J'zargo]]. J'zargo is ambitious and after your adventures [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|under Saarthal]], he tries to ingratiate himself and ask for your assistance: ''"J'zargo has seen that Tolfdir likes you. You must be very skilled with magic, yes? J'zargo is working hard, but cannot do it alone. Can you help with this?"'' It seems he has developed a new [[Skyrim:Destruction|Destruction]] [[Skyrim:J'zargo's Flame Cloak Scroll|scroll]] that is especially effective against the [[Skyrim:Undead|undead]]. J'zargo will give you ten scrolls and send you on your way with instructions to report back on their efficacy.

===The Scrolls vs. The Undead===
Candidates for J'zargo's scrolls are [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]], [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]], [[Skyrim:Ghost|ghosts]] and [[Skyrim:Zombie|zombies]], any of which can be encountered in Skyrim's numerous [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|barrows, tombs or ruins]]. Undead may also be encountered in [[Skyrim:The Midden|The Midden]], allowing convenient completion of this quest without travel if the quest has been accepted before the first venture down there. Otherwise, the Halls of the Dead in Whiterun and Solitude are also home to a sufficient number of easily accessible, weak undead. Just be sure to order your followers to wait outside, as they may kill the undead before you, or be harmed by the scrolls.

To complete the quest, you will need to destroy three undead enemies while employing the scrolls. A quest marker will appear with each undead killed while under the effects of J'zargo's Flame Cloak. Undead do not need to be killed by the scrolls' damage; dying of other weapon or spell damage while under the effects of the scroll will satisfy the quest conditions. However, undead that are killed indirectly by the explosions of other undead do not count. If you use up all ten scrolls without killing three undead enemies, the quest will fail.

===A Slight Oversight===
The scrolls inflict ten points of fire damage per second for thirty seconds. Enemies on fire take extra damage. However, to accomplish this, J'zargo's cloak causes a massive explosion making the scrolls as harmful to you and your allies as to the undead, so ask your [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] to stay behind when you test the scrolls, as the damage may kill them or turn them hostile. The scrolls can kill instantly if you are weakened with low reserves or health. Also, be wary of using a scroll when dealing with multiple undead enemies, as the multiplied effects of the ensuing explosions can be extremely damaging.

===A Job "Well Done"===
Return to J'zargo after you have killed three undead to report the unfortunate side-effect. Knowing J'zargo and his ambitious intentions, you can ask him about the dubious nature of this experiment and your involvement in it. He will assure you that he meant you no harm, and was quite unsure of the effects the scrolls would have on the wielder. Upon finishing the quest you may keep the remaining scrolls and he will be accessible as a follower.

==Notes==
* The scrolls also work on [[Skyrim:Undead|undead]] that you have [[Skyrim:Reanimate|reanimated]] or [[Skyrim:Dawnguard Magic#Conjuration Spells|conjured]] yourself. This does not work on reanimated animals or non-enemy humanoids. 
* The scroll must actually damage the undead for the quest to register the kill, activating the scroll from a distance and killing the enemy by other means won't work.
* Activating a scroll near a draugr sarcophagus will trigger the draugr to come out.
* Activating a scroll near most followers will cause them to either retaliate or leave your service, sometimes resulting in a bounty even if you are within a dungeon. 
* The active effect "J'zargo's Flame Cloak" is listed as a harmful effect, presumably because the explosion it causes damages you as well as your enemy. You can counteract this by using the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout to take advantage of the explosion without receiving damage.
* It is suggested not to give the scrolls to a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] to carry, as they will spam the fireballs at any enemy regardless of if they're undead or not. This is doubly important if you have not yet completed the quest as there is no way to obtain more copies of the scroll.
* The required kills need to be done one at a time. Killing 3 undead enemies simultaneously (e.g. the 3 skeletons in Whiterun's Hall of the Dead, all killed with a single activation of the scrolls' effect) will only credit you with 1 kill.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]].
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Olfrid Battle-Born|Olfrid Battle-Born]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] for the details.
# Steal the incriminating [[Skyrim:Letter from Solitude|letter]].
# Forge the prison registry.
# Tell Olfrid the job has been done.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Special Job===
Once you have completed five Thieves Guild extra jobs in the city of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Delvin_Mallory|Delvin]] at the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]] will have a "special job" for you. Delvin explains that he has received word from [[Skyrim:Olfrid_Battle-Born|Olfrid Battle-Born]], a wealthy [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] living in Whiterun, with a unique request. Travel to Whiterun and speak to Olfrid, who explains that "Arn", one of his old war buddies wanted for murder in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], has been arrested for drunkenness in Whiterun. In order to save his friend from the executioner's block, he wants to set Arn up with a new identity. To accomplish this he asks you to steal a [[Skyrim:Letter from Solitude|letter]] warning of Arn's true crime and then change Arn's name on the Whiterun prison registry. With these done the guards will be permanently off the trail and Arn will be given a prompt release. Olfrid warns you the job will not be easy; both items are located in [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]]: the letter is in the jarl's chambers and the registry is on the steward's desk.

===Rename the Prisoner===
The jarl's chambers are always accessible, but your status with the jarl determines whether you can simply walk off with the letter in his room or if you must steal it. If you do not have a standing relationship with the jarl, the guards will be on alert, so you will want to [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneak]] through the rooms. Closing the chamber doors before taking the letter and altering the prison ledger minimizes your chances of being caught. 

===The Payoff===
Olfrid is grateful that his friend will only have to spend a few days in jail for his drunkenness instead of facing an executioner's axe for murder, and gives you a random enchanted ring as a reward.

Report back to Delvin for your pay. Delvin will inform you that Olfrid has ''"pledged the full support of the Battle-Born clan to the Thieves Guild"'', and that a new merchant has set up shop in the Flagon.

==Notes==
* After completing this quest, three [[Skyrim:Thief Cache|Thief Cache]] barrels will appear around Whiterun.
* Although Olfrid's friend, Arn, is supposed to be in Whiterun jail for drunken behavior, he is nowhere to be found in [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach#Zone 4: Dragonsreach Dungeon|Dragonsreach Dungeon]], or anywhere in the game for that matter.
** Even the ''[[Books:The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima Official Game Guide]]'' lists Arn as an NPC present here, and states that: ''"A man named Arn is imprisoned in this location, but only after you undertake Thieves Guild City Influence Quest; Imitation Amnesty."'' Implying that Arn was indeed meant to appear in-person at one point.
