Skyrim:Ill Met By Moonlight.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Chezburgar |rewardChecked=Dragon Guard }}{{Trail2|Quests|Daedric|link2=Daedric Quests}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Mathies|Mathies]] or [[Skyrim:Sinding|Sinding]] |Reward= [[Skyrim:Savior's Hide|Savior's Hide]] and/or [[Skyrim:Ring of Hircine|Ring of Hircine]] (see [[#Multiple Rewards|Multiple Rewards]]) |Disp= |Prev= |Loc= [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], [[Skyrim:Bloated Man's Grotto|Bloated Man's Grotto]] |Image=SR-quest-Ill_Met_By_Moonlight.jpg |ImgDesc=Meeting Sinding at the Grotto |description=Participate in the Daedric Prince [[Skyrim:Hircine|Hircine]]'s Great Hunt. |ID=DA05 |Icon=SR-qico-Daedric.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #''(Optional)'' Speak to [[Skyrim:Mathies|Mathies]], the father of the slain child in [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. #Talk to [[Skyrim:Sinding|Sinding]] in [[Skyrim:Falkreath Jail|Falkreath Jail]]. #Hunt down the [[Skyrim:White Stag|White Stag]]. #Accept [[Skyrim:Hircine|Hircine]]'s challenge. #Face Sinding inside [[Skyrim:Bloated Man's Grotto|Bloated Man's Grotto]] and make a choice. #Speak with Hircine. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Falkreath=== [[File:SR-npc-Runil_03.jpg|thumb|right|The burial of Lavinia]] A plethora of battles have taken place in [[Skyrim:Falkreath Hold|Falkreath Hold]] throughout the eras, and the bloodshed has taken its toll on the small hold capital of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. The town has the questionable honor of hosting the largest graveyard in all of Skyrim, and the few resident merchants and innkeepers have named their shops or taverns in honor of the numerous deceased warriors. But while the ongoing [[Skyrim:Civil War|civil war]] keeps its distance for the time being, Falkreath still experiences its share of death, as evidenced by a visit to the graveyard. On your first visit (between 6 in the morning and 10 in the evening), the town priest, [[Skyrim:Runil|Runil]], is busy saying the last rites for little Lavinia, the only daughter of local farmers [[Skyrim:Mathies|Mathies]] and [[Skyrim:Indara Caerellia|Indara Caerellia]]: ''"The god Arkay was once like us, bound to winding mortality. But he willingly gave up this existence that we might better understand the vagaries of life and death. It is through the ebb and flow of this cosmic tide that we find renewal and, in the end, peace. May the spirit of Lavinia and all those who have left this world and its suffering know the beloved serenity of Aetherius... and may we one day rejoin them in eternity."'' After the sad ceremony, the three will go their separate ways. ===Sinding=== Locate the grieving father, Mathies, who can usually be found working his crops behind [[Skyrim:Corpselight Farm|Corpselight Farm]]. When asked about his tragedy he will tell you that his nine-year-old, Lavinia, was ripped apart by a laborer named [[Skyrim:Sinding|Sinding]], now rotting in jail for his deed. The quest will begin and Mathies' last words will be: ''"What could drive a man to do something like this?"'' In Falkreath, the [[Skyrim:Falkreath Jail|jail]] is built in the basement of [[Skyrim:Falkreath Barracks|Falkreath Barracks]]. Sinding, the alleged killer, sits in the northeastern cell waiting for his death sentence. When you get close he will approach the bars and you can ask him directly if he killed the little girl: ''"Believe me, it wasn't anything I ever intended to do. I just... lost control. I tried to tell them, but none of them believe me. It's all on account of this blasted ring."'' ===The Ring of Hircine=== [[File:SR-npc-Sinding_02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Sinding|Sinding]] escapes]] Sinding will then show you the [[Skyrim:Ring of Hircine|Ring of Hircine]] and reveal that he is secretly a [[Skyrim:Werewolves|werewolf]] who stole the ring from the Daedric Prince of the Hunt in an attempt to control his transformations. In retaliation, Hircine cursed the ring and Sinding's plan backfired; he transformed at the worst possible time, in front of the little girl who never stood a chance. However, Sinding has a plan: ''"I've been looking for a way to appease Hircine. There is a certain beast in these lands. Large, majestic. It's said that Hircine will commune with whoever slays it. I tracked it into these woods, but then had my... accident with the child. I want to beg his forgiveness. Give him back the ring. But while I'm stuck in here, the beast wanders free."'' You can now offer to bring the ring to Hircine, and Sinding will gladly accept: ''"Oh my. You would do this for me? Here, take it. I don't want anything to do with this wretched thing anymore. Seek out the beast. He wanders these woods. Bring him down and... well, the Lord of the Hunt should smile on you. I wish you luck, but should leave here while I still have my skin. Should our paths cross again, I will remember your kindness. Farewell."'' Without the Ring of Hircine, Sinding will then transform right in front of you and claw his way to the ceiling of the cell where he disappears. When you are ready to leave, the patrolling guard may approach you and notice: ''"You... you were talking to that murderous savage. And then he escaped. What are you hiding?"'' {{Example Table | '''NOTE''': If you are a lycanthrope, the ring will cause you to randomly transform into your beast form, which may cause a significant bounty if triggered at the wrong time. If you are not infected, the ring's only effect will be to take up your finger slot. }} ===Hunting the White Stag=== [[File:SR-quest-Ill_Met_By_Moonlight_3.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Skyrim:White Stag|White Stag]]]] [[File:SR-quest-Ill_Met_By_Moonlight_4.jpg|thumb|right|The [[Skyrim:Aspect of Hircine|Aspect of Hircine]] appears]] The great beast turns out to be a unique deer named [[Skyrim:White Stag|White Stag]] and can be found in an unmarked clearing east of Falkreath, usually drinking water from a small pond. If you are spotted, the stag will usually howl, then set off at a running pace up the mountain. Do your best to catch up with it, or make effective use of your long-range weapons to hit it. Once you've killed it, the [[Skyrim:Aspect of Hircine|Aspect of Hircine]] will emerge from the dead stag, talking to you: ''"I am the spirit of the hunt, just one glimpse of the glorious stalker that your kind calls Hircine."'' Naturally, as a Daedric Prince, Hircine will have a few extra tricks up his sleeve and will not simply take the ring you offer. Instead he will ask a favor: ''"I may consider it. But you must first do a service for my glory. The one who stole it has fled to what he thinks is his sanctuary. Just as a bear climbs a tree to escape the hunt, but only ends up trapping himself. Seek out this rogue shifter. Tear the skin from his body, and make it an offering to me."'' At this point, you can accept or decline, but it will make little difference; you are to travel to [[Skyrim:Bloated Man's Grotto|Bloated Man's Grotto]], or someone else will do it for you. ===Bloated Man's Grotto=== Bloated Man's Grotto is a small cave between Falkreath and [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], normally inhabited by [[Skyrim:Bear|bears]] and [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggans]]. When you arrive during the quest, however, you will find that the Great Hunt is underway and the Bloodmoon dominates the sky. You will encounter the remains of a small hunting party, with three of the members, [[Skyrim:Batum gra-Bar|Batum gra-Bar]], [[Skyrim:Ma'tasarr|Ma'tasarr]] and [[Skyrim:Hoddreid|Hoddreid]], already dead. A fourth member, [[Skyrim:J'Kier|J'Kier]], is still alive, but fatally wounded. When you approach him, he will say: ''"The prey is strong. Stronger than the hunters. But more will come. Bring him down, for the glories of Lord Hircine."'' The wounded Khajiit will then drop dead. Loot the corpses and a locked chest behind the camp. There is also a chest in the small 'lake' where the waterfall is. After looting the chests, follow the northern path until Sinding appears on a rock above. He will be confused as to why you are there to hunt him down: ''"I can't stop you if that's what you want to do. Hircine is too powerful. But if you spare me, I can be a powerful ally to you. And I would promise to never return to civilized life. I know now that I can't live among people."'' He will then wait for your response, and your decision will not only affect the reward, it may also affect your achievements. {{NewLine}} {{Quest Fork |imageL=SR-quest-Ill Met By Moonlight 6.jpg |imageR=SR-quest-Ill Met By Moonlight 5.jpg |captionL=Hunted down |captionR=Hunter vs Hunter |titleL=Hircine's Will |titleR=Help Sinding |textL= If you choose to follow Hircine's will, you will have no choice but to challenge Sinding, who will respect your decision: ''"So be it."'' After that, he will jump down from the ledge, and you must hunt him down. At this point, several hunters will spawn in the cave, all of them under oath to the Daedric Prince, and they will all go for Sinding. Make your way up the stairs to the northeast and pass through the small ruin. There is another locked chest shortly after the 'bone alarm' doorway, on the player's right. As you make your way down in a western direction, you will stumble upon the bodies of several dead hunters, all of them too weak to kill Sinding. When you reach a small streamlet, Sinding should be finished with the hunters and will come rushing towards you. You will have no choice but to pick the fight and slay him. Activate the dead body and claim his [[Skyrim:Sinding's Skin|skin]], and the [[Skyrim:Aspect of Hircine|Aspect of Hircine]], a ghostly version of Sinding himself, will manifest before you, saying: ''"You've done well, hunter."'' When told that you did as commanded, he will respond: ''"And found my favor. That skin will serve you well, child. Look more closely at it. My glories shall protect you from all this world's grievances. Good hunting."'' He will then remove the [[Skyrim:Cursed Ring of Hircine|cursed ring]], and change Sinding's skin to the reward, the unique [[Skyrim:Savior's Hide|Savior's Hide]]. * Savior's Hide is the only light cuirass in the game with a resist magic enchantment, and one of only two armors. (The other armor is the [[SR:Lord's Mail (item)|Lord's Mail]]{{CC|Lord's Mail}}) |textR= If you choose to go against Hircine's will and spare Sinding, he will gratefully thank you and encourage you to hunt with him. Find the northeastern stairway, and join Sinding on the cliff. As you move forward, not forgetting to loot the chest on your right, you will encounter the first two hunters, [[Skyrim:Rissing|Rissing]] and [[Skyrim:Tsrasuna|Tsrasuna]], both of them hostile. Defeat them and be careful not to hit Sinding, or he will turn hostile as well. Keep moving forward and face another wave of hunters, including [[Skyrim:Torkild the Fearsome|Torkild the Fearsome]], [[Skyrim:Yar gro-Gatuk|Yar gro-Gatuk]] and [[Skyrim:Eriana|Eriana]]. Follow the path back to the campsite where three more hunters, [[Skyrim:Ra'kheran|Ra'kheran]], [[Skyrim:Heratar|Heratar]] and [[Skyrim:Ahjisi|Ahjisi]], will attack you and Sinding. When all the hunters are dead, approach Sinding: ''"Thank you for your help. I will make my home here, away from anyone I might hurt."'' This will end the quest, with no reward. However, when you exit the grotto, you will encounter the [[Skyrim:Aspect of Hircine|Aspect of Hircine]] once again, as you failed to follow his wishes. Two options are available, and will both lead to the same conclusion: ''"By bringing down my other Hunters, you turned the chase inside out. And they were no base prey. You continue to amuse and impress. Go forth, with my blessing."'' He will then remove the curse from the [[Skyrim:Ring of Hircine|Ring of Hircine]] and let you keep it as a reward. * The Ring of Hircine allows werewolves to transform an unlimited number of times per day.}} {{NewLine}} ====Multiple Rewards==== {{Example Table|width=100% | '''NOTE:''' It is possible to obtain both rewards, and both rings, although it goes against the intended mission design. Please click the show button for tips and tricks, and remember to save your game before attempting: {{Showhide/Start|Tips and Tricks →}} '''MULTIPLE REWARDS'''
It is possible to obtain both the Ring of Hircine and the Savior's Hide. To do so: # After joining the hunt, talk to Sinding and choose to spare his life. # Help Sinding kill all of the hunters. '''Make sure to save your game at this point!''' # Talk to Sinding after all hunters are dead. This completes the quest. Afterward, leaving the cave will cause Hircine to appear and award you the Ring of Hircine. # Even after completing the quest, Sinding can still be killed and skinned, allowing you to receive the Savior's Hide from Hircine as well. # Therefore, Sinding can be killed either before or after leaving the cave. Once the quest is complete, he will begin moving away from the area, which can make him difficult to locate if you leave the cave first. (suggest Detect Creature spell). It has been reported that this method occasionally fails. If you are unable to skin Sinding, reload the save made after killing the hunters and try killing him under different circumstances—for example, before or after leaving the cave, while Sinding is inside or outside the cave, or selecting the "Exit" conversation dialogue option. '''BOTH RINGS'''
Immediately after talking to Sinding and completing the quest, the Cursed Ring of Hircine will still remain in your inventory and can be unequipped. Both leaving the cave and skinning Sinding will independently trigger a Hircine event that removes the Cursed Ring from your inventory. Therefore, if you want to keep it, place it in chest or give it to follower before triggering either event. {{Showhide/End}} }} ==Notes== * This quest depicts a [[Lore:Great Hunt|Great Hunt]], a type of sporting event often associated with Hircine. A Great Hunt also occurs in [[Battlespire:Level 5|Battlespire]], [[Bloodmoon:Hircine's Hunt|Bloodmoon]], and [[Online:The Great Hunt|ESO]]. * This quest will completely alter Bloated Man's Grotto, but it will reset to its non-quest form one in-game month after the death of Sinding if you don't enter it during that time. It's recommended to visit Bloated Man's Grotto before doing this quest if you want to loot [[Skyrim:Bolar's Oathblade|Bolar's Oathblade]] without killing Sinding. **{{Pc22}} If you chose to save Sinding, the grotto can be reverted to its non-quest form by opening the console and entering the codes prid 95586 and disable. * Entering Bloated Man's Grotto during the quest will adjust the in-game time to 11pm, unless you enter the location between 7pm and 2am. ** If the first case is true, you may lose your [[Skyrim:Sleeping|rested]] bonus, even if you sleep right before entering the cave. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Travel to the [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] harbor.

# Report back to [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] and claim your reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Make your way to the [[Skyrim:East Empire Company Warehouse|East Empire Company Warehouse]], just outside of [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], and then board the ship the [[Skyrim:Red Wave|Red Wave]]. Even though boarding the ship is considered trespassing, the "guards" (crew members) will not actually confront you if they see you. All they will do is say "you're not supposed to be here" and then leave you alone. [[Skyrim:Safia|Safia]] can be found in the middle deck of the ship, walking around switching chairs every few minutes or eating. 

Note that two of the Red Wave's crew members are considered essential and thus cannot be killed and will continue fighting a little after you "defeat" them, which also gives you bounty. Therefore, it is best to avoid any combat with the crew.

You may have the following conversation with Safia:
{|class=wikitable
!width=200px|Topic
!Dialogue
|-
|''"I represent the Dark..."''||''"The Dark Brotherhood? Yeah, yeah, yeah. You think this is the first contract I've had on my life? I'm a pirate, sweetie. Assassination attempts are an occupational hazard. Now, shall we?"''
|-
|''"You face the Dread Lord..."''||''"Sithis? Let me guess: "In the Void!" By the gods, you Dark Brotherhood are a predictable lot, aren't you? Okay, here's how this works. You try to assassinate me, and I kill you. Horribly. I have done this dance before, you know."'' 		
|-
|''(Remain Silent)''||''"Ah, I see. The old Dark Brotherhood "silent intimidation" treatment. Oh, I know who you are. Don't be so surprised. You ain't the first assassin sent to kill me. Won't be the last. Now let's get this over with."''
|}

Each dialogue option causes her to initiate combat, thus allowing you to kill her without gaining a bounty. Her crew will also fail to defend her if she initiates combat. 

After the kill, report back to [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] for some leveled gold as a reward:
:''"You haven't faced that pirate captain yet, have you? Safia? I only ask because you're still alive..."''
:'''Safia is dead.'''
:''"By Sithis, now I am truly impressed! To kill a pirate captain, on her own ship no less? Simply masterful! You've not only earned your payment, but my respect as well. And believe me, friend - that does not come easily. I'm afraid that concludes our business. You have exhausted all available additional contracts. But I'm sure you've got plenty to keep you busy right about now, hmm?"''

== Detailed Walkthrough ==

===Get the Contract===
When [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] hands you the quest, he will not only reveal the target's location to be the ancient Dwarven ruin of [[Skyrim:Mzinchaleft|Mzinchaleft]], he will also provide a bit of fair warning of [[Skyrim:Maluril|Maluril]]: ''"He's dangerous. Very dangerous. A rogue Dark Elf mage doing research into Dwarven artifacts should be both respected... and feared. Just not by you."'' Leave Nazir and travel to Mzinchaleft, in the tundra southwest of [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]].

===Mzinchaleft===
The exterior is guarded by up to six leveled [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] so dispose of them and head inside. The ruin consists of three zones, but your target is in the first zone, so there will be nothing but leveled bandit enemies to face. Make your way through the tunnels and fight the opposition. After the second chamber, you will encounter an intersection and a locked door to the north. The bandit guarding the door holds the [[Skyrim:Maluril's Room Key|key]], so do what you have to do to claim it. Unlock the door and enter Maluril's Room where you will encounter a surprisingly peaceful [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]] obviously not looking for trouble. 

You can now talk to him and choose between three different options, but even if his responses will be hostile, he will not attack you, nor will he summon any enemies to fight you. You will have no other option but to kill him in cold blood; he uses a [[Skyrim:Staff of Firebolts|Staff of Firebolts]].

Before leaving, read through the [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill book ''[[Skyrim: A_Dance_in_Fire,_v7|A Dance in Fire, v7]]''. Additionally, ''[[Skyrim:Maluril's Journal|Maluril's Journal]]'' can be found on the table, providing some insight into who ordered his demise.

===Reward===
Return to Nazir in the sanctuary and tell him the good news. He will be quite satisfied and will comment: ''"I hope the elf didn't give you too much trouble. I once got set on fire by a sorcerer. Nasty business, that. But I digress. Here's your payment."'' He then hands you the reward, a leveled amount of gold.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
After speaking to [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]], you are told to locate and assassinate a target known as [[Skyrim:Agnis|Agnis]]. She can be found inside the keep of [[Skyrim:Fort_Greymoor|Fort Greymoor]] which is west of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. The fort is initially garrisoned by bandits, whom you can either sneak past or kill. However if you have advanced far enough in the civil war quest line (beyond the [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun|Battle for Whiterun]]), it is garrisoned by soldiers of whichever faction controls Whiterun - ''your'' faction, that is, making the assassination much easier. Either way, Agnis is easily found inside the keep and, having only a dagger and some modest clothing for protection, is equally easy to kill.

If you approach Agnis before you kill her, you will receive three dialogue options; you will only be able to choose one as you cannot initiate conversation with her again. Note that none of these dialogue options will cause her to become hostile.

After the kill, report back to Nazir for a leveled gold as a reward.

== Notes ==
* When receiving payment for the finished job, [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] will say ''"Infiltrating an occupied fort and making it out in one piece is nothing to joke about. Well done."'', but his voice dialogue actually says ''"Infiltrating an occupied '''military''' fort and making it out in one piece is nothing to joke about. Well done."''
* Certainly with the Unofficial Skyrim Patch (Legendary or Special Edition) installed, and maybe without it: If you clear the fort of bandits without harming Agnis, but without having taken sides in the Civil War, it will be re-garrisoned with Imperials, since Jarl Balgruuf opposes the Stormcloaks. These Imperials will be neutral (and thus non-hostile) to an unaligned player, just as they would to a pro-Imperial one (i.e. one who has brought the Jagged Crown to General Tullius, even if the Battle of Whiterun has not yet taken place): the only way to face a hostile garrison is if the player has cleared the fort of bandits, then subsequently sided with the Stormcloaks (by bringing the Jagged Crown to Ulfric instead) and then decides to go in and murder Agnis *before* the Battle of Whiterun - for instance, if they bring Ulfric's axe to Balgruuf and then visit Fort Greymoor while Balgruuf is still in charge of Whiterun, before returning to Ulfric and starting the battle quest.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Get your orders from [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
When you receive this contract from Nazir, he says Anoriath is a hunter who hunts on the plains outside Whiterun. However, prolonged stalking reveals that he does not in fact leave the city. During the day he works at his stall in the market, and at night he retires to [[SR:The Drunken Huntsman|The Drunken Huntsman]], which is run by his brother, to sleep. Your best bet to take him out without a bounty is to either shoot him during the day from a remote spot such as Jorrvaskr, or to sneak into his bedroom at night and slit his throat. However, both are very difficult to do without incurring a bounty, so plan for this.

As third option; when Anoriath is working his stall, go straight behind him and climb the rock until you reach the walls corner. Time an Illusion Frenzy or one-shot bow attack properly (meaning no guards patrolling the road to your left when facing Anoriath), and you will incur no bounty.

Alternatively, like most other assassination targets, you have the option to talk to Anoriath, which gives you three dialogue choices, one of which will turn Anoriath hostile, allowing you to kill him anywhere without fear of incurring a bounty (except if you initiate conversation outside, say at his stall, and then he retreats somewhere inside, like The Bannered Mare, in which case, he will cease to be hostile and it will be considered murder to kill him then). You can only pick one as you will not be able to initiate conversation again.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This is a very simple assassination. Lurbuk is not known to ever leave the [[Skyrim:Moorside Inn|Moorside Inn]] and can easily be picked off with an arrow when he isn't performing. The difficulty lies in the fact that whatever you tell him, he will never turn hostile and attack, which would potentially increase the chances of earning a bounty, no matter what you say to him.

[[File:SR-quest-Kill Lurbuk 02.jpg|Silence the merrymaker|thumb|right]]
If you are having difficulty killing Lurbuk in the common room, you can wait until he either sits in the corner of his room or goes to sleep late at night. There should be no one else in the room, so a single sneak attack should be enough to eliminate him silently. It is also possible to wait until he's sitting in the common room, and then sneak into the room across from him, facing his back. From this position it can be safe to shoot him with an arrow, and as long as the arrow used can take him out with one blow, it will still be a stealthy kill. You can also rent a bed from the innkeeper. When she leaves to show you to your room, you can kill Lurbuk without her witnessing the kill. A creative, albeit risky, way to get the job done is to cast a Frenzy spell on him. Provided that you are not seen or heard, the effect will cause everyone in the inn to see Lurbuk as a hostile, attacking and killing him for you.

Another way to kill him is similar to the bow and arrow method above. Sneak into the room across from him and wait until you are hidden. Once hidden, release an offensive Shout (fire breath, frost breath, etc.) towards Lurbuk. This should do the trick since one Shout should be sufficient in killing him. 

Note: invisibility helps with sneaking and hiding in the room across from Lurbuk.

Like most assassination targets, you may choose to have a conversation with Lurbuk before killing him:

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Hern is a fairly easy kill, even if he is a vampire. He is usually with his wife in Half-Moon Mill's only home. They can both be killed with any weapons—as long as Hern dies, the mission completes. During the day, you'll find him outside, hanging out on a bridge. You can sneak into a shack next to the bridge and attack him safely with a ranged attack from an open window. His wife usually won't notice if it's a one-hit kill. You could also wait until morning for his wife to leave for the lumber. She always leaves before him, presenting a window where he can be found alone inside the house. If you have [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] installed, and her disposition is high enough for her to give you free lumber, you can ask her for free lumber when they are together inside the house; she will go outside to supervise your cutting of logs, and you will be alone with Hern. Also when they are entering or leaving the house if you engage Hern in conversation and hold him behind you can then sneak attack and kill him after Hert leaves the area.

Alternatively, like most other assassination targets, you have the option to talk to Hern which gives you three dialogue choices, two of which will turn Hern hostile.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Simply travel to [[Skyrim:Anga's Mill|Anga's Mill]] and walk to the camp just up the road from the mill to the west. Kill [[Skyrim:Ennodius Papius|Ennodius Papius]], who is staying at the camp. He is far away enough to not attract any attention from patrolling guards or lumberjacks at the mill. During the day he is usually found around the water or his campfire; at night he'll be asleep in the tent. He will panic and flee on attack, but will not go far. Any incurred bounty while attacking him will revert on his death.

Alternatively, like most other assassination targets, you have the option to talk to Ennodius which gives you three dialogue choices, all of which will either turn Ennodius hostile (allowing you to kill him without fear of incurring a bounty) or run away in fear if your level is high enough.

=== Reward ===
Return to the sanctuary and speak with Nazir, who will comment, ''"How went your meeting with Ennodius Papius? Did you prove his paranoia legitimate?"'' and rewards you with leveled gold.
{{SRLeveledReward|small}}

==Notes==
*The target does not spawn prior to acquiring this quest. Completing this quest has no repercussions on other quests.
*There is a skeleton floating face down in the water behind his tent, a bit to the west, with a small amount of gold. Continuing west to the cliff, there is a quicksilver ingot under the water, and at the end, a locked strongbox in some debris under the cliff edge.
*Ennodius is a foe of [[SR:Kodrir|Kodrir]], who may [[Skyrim:An enemy's gratitude|reward you]] for his death ([[Skyrim:Radiant|radiant]]).

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Get the contract from [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]].
# Travel to [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]].
# Assassinate [[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]].
# Report back to Nazir to collect your reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Get the Contract===
Right after your [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|initiation]] into the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]], guild leader [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] will confess that no "real" jobs are available at the moment and that you should talk to [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] for smaller contract work. Nazir will give three targets to you at the same time, so you are free to pick what order you do them in. On [[Skyrim:Narfi|Narfi]], he will comment that ''"He's a hapless beggar living in some ruins just outside the village of [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]]. Easy even for you."''

===Kill a Beggar===
Make your way to Ivarstead, the small settlement at the foot of the [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]], and locate Narfi. Due to the roaming creek separating Narfi's worn-out house from the rest of Ivarstead, there are no watchful eyes from the Ivarstead guards, and as such, you can kill him in any manner you want. The easiest method is to kill him in his sleep; he goes to bed at 4am, so take advantage of the darkness and sneak into the cabin right after that time and dispose of the beggar. Note that the sawmill across the lake gets busy right after 7am, so don't wait too long. 

If you speak to Narfi before you kill him, you are given three dialogue options; you may only pick one as the conversation ends and you can't speak to him again.

{|class=wikitable

|''"Your pathetic existence has come to an end, Narfi."''||''"Oh... Oh no... Please, please... I ain't never harmed no one... Old Narfi just wants to be left alone..."''
|-
|''"Beg! Beg for your miserable life!"''||''"No! Oh, by the gods, please no!"''

Narfi won't defend himself as a result of any of these dialogue options, so if you are seen killing him, you cannot avoid a bounty.

===Reward===
Once Narfi is dead, travel back to the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|sanctuary]] and receive your reward of leveled gold from [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]], who will also comment, ''"Congratulations. You slaughtered an emaciated beggar in cold blood. You are truly an opponent to be feared."''
{{SRLeveledReward|small}}

* As soon as you accept the contract from Nazir, you will be unable to complete the [[Skyrim:Ivarstead#Miscellaneous Quests|miscellaneous]] Ivarstead quest [[Skyrim:The Straw that Broke|The Straw that Broke]].
* It's quite possible for Narfi to have already died by the time you would normally get this contract quest. If this is the case, then the contract will just be skipped entirely.

[[Skyrim:Honorhall_Orphanage|Honorhall Orphanage]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] |Image=SR-quest-Innocence Lost.jpg |ImgDesc=Aventus Aretino calls upon mysterious forces for help |description=Help an orphaned [[Skyrim:Aventus Aretino|child]] avoid being returned to a sadistic [[Skyrim:Grelod the Kind|caretaker]]. |ID=DB01 |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Aventus Aretino|Aventus Aretino]] inside the [[Skyrim:Aretino Residence|Aretino Residence]] in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. # Kill [[Skyrim:Grelod the Kind|Grelod the Kind]] in the [[Skyrim:Honorhall Orphanage|Honorhall Orphanage]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Return to Aventus for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-place-Aretino Residence.jpg|thumb|left|The Aretino Residence in Windhelm]] ===Initiating the Quest=== It seems a strange boy named [[Skyrim:Aventus Aretino|Aventus Aretino]] is all the talk in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. By asking around town you will likely hear that Aventus is attempting to perform the [[Lore:A Kiss, Sweet Mother|Black Sacrament]], a ritual designed to summon a [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] assassin. Once this topic arises in a dialogue, the objective ''"Talk to Aventus Aretino"'' will appear in your journal as a miscellaneous quest. Speaking to the children at [[Skyrim:Honorhall Orphanage|Honorhall Orphanage]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] will also lead you to Aventus' door. ===Aventus Aretino=== [[File:SR-npc-Grelod-the Kind 03.jpg|thumb|right|Aventus's fury is revealed]] You will find Aventus in the [[Skyrim:Aretino Residence|Aretino Residence]] in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. If entering Windhelm through the main gate, immediately turn right and proceed up the stairs. Continue straight ahead, passing the house on your left, and turn left around its far corner. You should now be heading north, with the house on your left and a crumbling stone wall on your right. The Aretino Residence is a short distance ahead. If this is your first visit to the area, [[Skyrim:Idesa Sadri|Idesa Sadri]] will be outside Aventus' house trying to dissuade [[Skyrim:Grimvar Cruel-Sea|Grimvar Cruel-Sea]] from playing with poor Aventus, warning him that, ''"...Aventus Aretino walks a dark path"''. You can ask Idesa for more information, and she'll tell you that Aventus' mother recently died, and is performing the Black Sacrament to contact the Dark Brotherhood. She will, however, admit that she doesn't know why he's doing it. If you have previously entered the house without the objective in your journal, it will be added at this point. To speak with Aventus, [[Skyrim:Lockpicking#Skill_Usage|pick the lock]] on the door where you will discover Aventus performing the Black Sacrament, chanting over and over again. He is so engrossed in the ritual that he fails to notice you. When you speak to him, he will be overjoyed and mistake you for the assassin he was trying to summon, ''"I did the Black Sacrament, over and over. With the body, and the... the things. And then you came! An assassin from the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]!"'' He will tell you about his mother's death and that afterward he was sent to Honorhall Orphanage in Riften, where he was subjected to the cruelties of its headmistress, [[Skyrim:Grelod the Kind|Grelod the Kind]]. He escaped the orphanage and returned to his home where he set about performing the Sacrament to get his revenge and to ensure that neither he or his friends will have to suffer any more. He expects you to kill Grelod, further stating, ''"She's a monster."'' You can ask for further details, but whatever the course of your conversation with him, it will conclude with your journal advancing the Innocence Lost quest. He will also ask you not to harm [[Skyrim:Constance Michel|Constance Michel]], Grelod's servant, because she was kind to him and the other orphans. ===Grelod The Dead=== [[File:SR-npc-Grelod the Kind 02.jpg|thumb|right|Grelod tells the orphans they aren't going anywhere]] Travel to Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. Here Grelod the Kind is a cruel tyrant, verbally abusing her charges, ''"Nobody needs you, nobody wants you"'', and that her nickname is a term of endearment that she has bestowed on herself and imposed on the children. Killing Grelod does not constitute a crime so you may kill her in whatever fashion you see fit, however attacking any of the children or Constance is a crime. Whatever manner you choose will be successful as she only has one point of health. While Constance runs about in a panic once Grelod dies, the orphans will come to gloat over the body, expressing reactions ranging from philosophical reflection, ''"Kill one person, and you can solve so many problems. I wonder at the possibilities"'', to simple joy, ''"Hurrah! Hurrah!"'' If spoken to, each of the children will share one or more thoughts and feelings about her death. Return to Windhelm and speak to Aventus. He will greet the news with happiness and show his gratitude by giving you a [[Skyrim:Aretino Family Heirloom|family heirloom]], which is ''"Supposed to be sort of valuable"'', however the dinner plate is only worth 100 gold. This quest counts as a favor quest for Aventus, who is a citizen of Eastmarch. === Alternate Path === If you have killed Grelod prior to starting the quest, then when you speak with Aventus for the first time you can tell him that you killed her. He will state that ''"I knew the Dark Brotherhood was good... just not that good! You killed the old hag before I even asked!"'' There are no negative consequences to the quest and the reward is the same. ==Notes== * If you revisit the orphanage after completing the quest, the children will make general comments about things being better with Grelod gone. Guards in the city will also make similar comments about the latter. * After killing her, guards may say ''"Been a murder, over in Riften. Some old lady who runs an orphanage. Those poor children must be heartbroken."'' Guards in Riften may also suggest some suspicion toward you with ''"That old woman who runs the orphanage has been murdered. Say, didn't I see you coming out of there...?"'' * [[Skyrim:Followers|Followers]] with a morality value of 3 won't kill Grelod if you order them to do so. Although Grelod is cruel and killing her doesn't result in a bounty, she is classified as an "innocent" or non-hostile NPC until attacked, making her death a "crime" in the eyes of the follower's programming. The fact that Grelod has only 1 health point adds to that reasoning. * After the quest, Aventus will always view you as his savior regardless if you [[Skyrim:With Friends Like These...|join]] or [[Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!|eliminate]] the Dark Brotherhood. * Finishing the quest will prevent further [[Skyrim:World Interactions#Dark Brotherhood Assassin Sent to Kill the Player|assassination attempts against you]], regardless if you join or eliminate the Dark Brotherhood. * After Grelod is killed, Constance Michel will run around in a panic. She will remain in this state even if you return days or weeks later, only returning to normal once Innocence Lost has been completed by speaking to Aventus Aretino. ** If you have installed [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]], Constance will assume ownership of the orphanage once the quest is finished and allow you to [[Skyrim:Adoption|adopt children]] from there. You'll get a [[Skyrim:Consider Adoption|letter]] from her as well. ** If you don't have Hearthfire installed, Constance will continue to run around in a panic after the quest is finished, even if you return days or weeks later. *** You cannot adopt Aventus after this quest, regardless if you have Hearthfire installed or not. * If you bring [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]{{DG}} to Aretino's house before the quest has begun, she and Aventus may perform the Black Sacrament together. ** If you bring her there during or after quest, she will still attempt to perform the ritual by herself. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Although you will note in your journal that Aventus can return to the orphanage at the completion of the quest, he never does so. If you talk to him right after killing Grelod, he will say ''"I'll give them some time to clean up the mess."''|USKP|1.2.3}} {{Bug|After completing the quest, the ritual mess that's still sitting in Aretino's house won't be cleaned up.|USKP|1.2.4|The ritual items will be removed the next time the house resets.}} {{Bug|The fix from Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3 created another bug. Although Aventus now returns to Honorhall Orphanage after completion of the quest with Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3, he doesn't sleep there.|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|The fix from Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3 created a third bug. Although Aventus now returns to Honorhall Orphanage after completion of the quest with Unofficial Skyrim Patch 1.2.3, he can sometimes be found stuck trying to navigate his way to the city because [[Skyrim:Fort Greenwall|Fort Greenwall]] may not yet be cleared when he leaves Windhelm.|USSEP|4.0.7}} {{Bug|Even if you kill Grelod in another room, her body may teleport to the main room upon death.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name= |id=DB01Objective |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Aventus Aretino}} |200|fin| |!|Innocence Lost|DB01 |5||I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Blackdove86 |rewardChecked=Panguin38 }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Alik'r Warrior|Alik'r Warrior]]s |Reward=500 Gold |Disp= 0→1 ([[Skyrim:Kematu|Kematu]]) if helping him |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Swindler's Den|Swindler's Den]], [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach Dungeon|Dragonsreach]], [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] |Image=SR-quest-In My Time Of Need.jpg |ImgDesc=The [[Skyrim:Alik'r Warrior|Alik'r Warriors]] are interrogating [[Skyrim:Redguard|Redguard]] women all over Skyrim |description=Find a [[Skyrim:Saadia|Redguard woman]] who is on the run from [[Lore:Taneth|her past]]. |ID=MS08 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Get the quest from the [[Skyrim:Alik'r Warrior|Alik'r Warriors]] in Whiterun. #Find [[Skyrim:Saadia|Saadia]] at [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]]. #Speak with her or report her to the Alik'r in [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. #Kill [[Skyrim:Kematu|Kematu]] or lure Saadia to the stables. #Collect your reward from Kematu or Saadia. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Wanted Woman=== Outside the Holds, you may come across Alik'r Warriors interrogating a [[Skyrim:Redguard Woman|Redguard woman]] in the Skyrim wilderness. After [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]] informs the jarl about the dragon attacking the [[Skyrim:Western Watchtower|Western Watchtower]] during [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]], you may return to Whiterun and observe an argument between Whiterun guards and Alik'r Warriors regarding their presence in the hold. Speak with the warriors to start the quest. '''Guard''': ''"Look, you've already been told you're not allowed here. Turn around and go back the way you came."''
'''Alik'r''': ''"We're causing no trouble. All we ask is to look for her."''
'''Guard''': ''"I don't care what you're doing, after what happened you're lucky I don't toss you in jail. Now get lost."''
'''Alik'r''': ''"We will be back. This is not over."'' One of the warriors will then approach you, tell you that they're looking for a Redguard woman who may be in Whiterun. He will also tell you that since they're not welcome in Whiterun, they'll be in [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. ===Finding the Missing Woman=== Go to [[Skyrim:The_Bannered_Mare|The Bannered Mare]]. The Redguard is a woman named [[Skyrim:Saadia|Saadia]]. There will be a new dialogue option to tell her that some Alik'r warriors are looking for a Redguard woman. She will ask to speak to you privately. Follow her upstairs to her room, where she will draw her dagger on you, being suspicious of you - however, she quickly calms down. She explains that her real name is Iman, and that she is a noble of House Suda in Hammerfell. According to her, the Alik'r are assassins sent by the Aldmeri Dominion to deport her back to Hammerfell for an execution, as she spoke out against the Aldmeri Dominion. She asks you to help her get rid of the threat, and points you to the Dragonsreach Dungeon where one of the Alik'r warriors were captured. It is up to you to pass judgment and choose who to help during the quest. At this point, you can make a choice: * Speak to the Alik'r warriors in [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]] and tell them of Saadia's location. * Follow Saadia's instructions in order to help her. There are other alternative routes (see [[Skyrim:In My Time Of Need#Alternative Routes|below]]) that allow you to reap even greater rewards. ===Defend a Helpless Dissident...=== If you decide to help Saadia, go into the dungeon of [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] and speak with an [[Skyrim:Alik'r Warrior|Alik'r Warrior]] that was captured. Talking to him reveals that he was caught sneaking into Whiterun and was captured. As a result, the other Alik'r have abandoned him, and he agrees to tell you where Kematu and the other Alik'r are hiding on the condition that you pay his fine of 100 gold. Talking to him again before paying his fine will allow you to say the following - however this may cause a bug (see [[Skyrim:In My Time Of Need#Bugs|bugs]]): :'''Let's talk about how we can help each other.''' :''"You buy my way out of here, and I'll tell you what you want to know."'' The same dialogue will occur after you pay his fine, but there will be an option to tell him you have paid his fine. However, talking to him a second time before paying his fine may cause a bug (see [[Skyrim:In_My_Time_Of_Need#Bugs|bugs]]). You will have to bribe the guard to set him free. Picking a guard's pocket (or murdering a guard in the jail) for the key to Whiterun's jail cells will unlock his cell - however, he will fail to register this, and insist that you bribe a guard. When you do, the guard will say ''"Done. Convince him to stay out of the city while you're at it."'' After paying 100 gold to a guard, the prisoner will tell you that the leader of the Alik'r is in a cave west of Whiterun called [[Skyrim:Swindler's_Den|Swindler's Den]]. If you hang around the Dragonsreach dungeon after the prisoner gives you the information, he will tell one of the guards that his fine has been paid, but the guard won't take him seriously. '''Prisoner''': ''"Guard! My fine's been paid, now set me free!"''
'''Guard''': ''"Sorry, my ears aren't so good. You say somethin'?"''
'''Prisoner''': ''"I said my fine has been paid! Now let me out!"''
'''Guard''': ''"Right, right... Oh, look at that. I seem to have lost my keys. Might take me a while to find them. You just sit tight. I'll get around to it eventually."''
'''Prisoner''': ''"Curse you!"'' If you have already cleared out Swindler's Den, a new dialogue option will appear when speaking with Saadia, revealing to her that you already know where the Alik'r are and allowing you to skip this part of the quest. ====Swindler's Den==== [[File:SR-npc-Kematu.jpg|thumb|right|Kematu, the Alik'r leader]] Upon reaching [[Skyrim:Swindler's Den|Swindler's Den]], you will find that it's full of bandits. Two bandits in the first room will discuss the Alik'r warriors hiding in the treasure room. '''Bandit 1''': ''"I'm not sure I like these Alik'r warriors hiding out here. They seem like trouble."''
'''Bandit 2''': ''"Keep it to yourself. They're not paying us to talk. They'll be gone as soon as they've found whoever they're looking for. And we'll have all the more coin."'' Make your way through the network of tunnels until you reach a passage flooded with water with a waterfall at the end. When you approach the waterfall, the Alik'r leader [[Skyrim:Kematu|Kematu]] will say: :''"Alik'r, hold! You've proven your strength, warrior. Let's avoid any more bloodshed. I think you and I have some things to talk about."'' If you run past the waterfall when Kematu tells you avoid any more bloodshed, he will say this when you approach him: :''"Stay your hand, warrior! It's no secret why you're here and you have proven your skill in combat. Let us talk a moment, and no one else needs to die. I think we can all profit from the situation in which we find ourselves. My men will not attack you, if you will lower your weapons."'' As soon as you walk through the waterfall, Kematu should initiate conversation. If he doesn't, you can approach Kematu and talk to him manually. He explains that unlike what Saadia suggested, the Alik'r are not assassins. He claims that Saadia is wanted by the noble houses of Hammerfell for treason, for selling the city of Taneth out to the Aldmeri Dominion during the Great War. He asks you to help him bring her to justice, by leading her to the Whiterun Stables under the pretense that the Alik'r are coming for her, where he will be waiting to take her into custody. If you still wish to help Saadia, telling Kematu at any point during the dialogue that you still intend to kill him will cause Kematu and his men to become hostile after telling you that he had hoped you would see reason. Fighting the host of Alik'r warriors can be made easier by using the bear traps at the mouth of the winding path that leads into the cave where Kematu awaits. The warriors get hung up in the path, allowing the traps to be reset. Success is facilitated by focusing on your high-offense attack while retreating. Once your stamina or magic is depleted, turn and run for the traps, being careful to jump over them as you pass. It is also possible to simply exit the conversation with Kematu (or tell him that you will help lure Saadia away), sneak into the room just ahead, and snipe all the warriors with your bow. Once the Alik'r are dead, loot Kematu's corpse for scimitars and bonus gold, then return to Saadia in the Bannered Mare for your reward. ===...Or Bring a Traitor to Justice=== [[File:SR-quest-In My Time of Need 02.jpg|thumb|right|Saadia and Kematu at Whiterun Stables]] If you decide to help the Alik'r capture Saadia, Kematu or the Redguards with whom you spoke in Rorikstead will ask you to lure her to the [[Skyrim:Whiterun_Stables|stables outside of Whiterun]]. Go back and talk to Saadia in The Bannered Mare, where you can lie to her, telling her that the Alik'r are coming for her, and that a horse is waiting for her at the Whiterun Stables. Once Saadia gets to the stables, she and Kematu will have a brief exchange before Kematu will use a paralysis spell on her. Talk to him for your reward. '''Kematu''': ''"We meet at last, my dear lady."''
'''Saadia''': ''"What is this? What have you done?"''
'''Kematu''': ''"Oh, come now. You didn't really expect to manipulate people forever, did you? Your luck had to run out sometime."'' ===Alternative Routes=== While Kematu and Saadia are talking at the stables, you can still kill Kematu before he casts the spell on Saadia. This will get you the reward from Saadia and the 100 gold that Kematu is carrying, without having to fight the rest of the Alik'r. Saadia will be annoyed that you didn't warn her of what you were going to do, but she will thank you nonetheless. Alternatively, allow Kematu to cast the spell on Saadia and collect the 500 gold reward, thus ending the quest, then kill Kematu to undo the spell on Saadia. At this point, Saadia will be hostile right away, so use a [[Skyrim:Calm|Calm]] spell on her, then talk to her, and she will give you the 500 gold reward for killing Kematu. You can then loot Kematu's body to get 100 gold, [[Skyrim:Hammerfell Garb|Hammerfell Garb]] and [[Skyrim:Redguard Boots|Redguard Boots]], and two [[Skyrim:Scimitar|scimitars]]. Once the Calm spell ends, Saadia will become hostile again - this is a permanent state, so even if you leave the area, she will attack the next time you meet her. This is not a problem, as Saadia is not essential, and killing her will not give you a bounty. Looting her will give you gold and jewels. Both characters will be dead, but you will have gained 1100 gold, as well as random jewels, scimitars, and their clothing. ==Notes== *The ''[[Books:The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima Official Game Guide]]'' refers to the band of Alik'r warriors as the "Alik'r Coterie". *The Alik'r prisoner will never actually be set free, even if you pay his fine. If you retrieve the key, either by stealing it from a guard or killing one for it, unlocking the prisoner's cell does not result in anything noteworthy. He will just act as if jailed normally. *According to the game scripts, Saadia was meant to follow until you reach Whiterun Stables but for some reason the AI package was put as escort. *It is entirely possible to kill Saadia, as she is not essential. If you do so, her urn will show up in Whiterun's Hall of the Dead. However, if you merely turn her over to Kematu, there will be no urn in the Hall of the Dead, as the quest's script 'disables' her rather than killing her. *Killing Kematu or his guards before starting the quest will count as murder. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you do not directly kill Kematu (i.e., Frenzy or Fury on him or the Alik'r), the quest will be stuck on "Kill or talk to Kematu". See [[#Quest Stages|Quest Stages]] and skip to step 160 to progress the quest.|OSP}} {{Bug|If you kill the Alik'r warriors in the Swindler's Den, two Alik'r warriors will sometimes end up constantly appearing in Whiterun by the entrance.|USKP|1.1}} {{Bug|If you kill the Alik'r warriors in the Swindler's Den, encounters where Alik'r warriors harass a Redguard woman may still occur.|USKP|1.1}} {{Bug|After you hand Saadia to Kematu, sometimes Kematu and the Alik'r keep staying in Swindler's Den. No more conversation options are possible and the dungeon cannot be cleared.|confirmed=1|USKP}} **{{Pc22}} Entering SetLocationCleared 00018EE2 1 into the console also resets the dungeon. {{Bug|The cell where the Alik'r Warrior gets sent to cannot be unlocked.|USKP|1.2.4|The door will now open with the Whiterun Jail Key like all the others.}} {{Bug|It is possible for NPCs who aren't guards to run the scene when talking to the Alik'r prisoner due to poor conditions on the alias check.|USKP|2.1.2}} {{Bug|Entering Swindler's Den without talking to the Alik'r Prisoner may result in the objective to talk to the prisoner never being removed from your journal.|USLEEP|3.0.10}} **{{Pc22}} Entering setpqv MS08 DungeonFound_var 0 into the console before talking to Saadia also clears the objective correctly. {{Bug|If you speak to Kematu you'll be offered a topic that prompts "Why are you after Saadia?". This option is incorrectly assigned to him when it was instead meant to be assigned to the 2 Alik'r Warriors you initially meet if you tell them you know where to find Saadia.|USSEP|4.3.2}} {{Bug|If you choose to betray Kematu after escorting Saadia to the stables, the quest log may fail to register "Speak with Saadia" as complete no matter if you talk to her soon after defeating Kematu or once she is back to The Bannered Mare, although the game will consider the quest as finished.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Using the alternative route mentioned above, sometimes killing Kematu after he casts the paralyze spell on Saadia will not cause her to turn hostile but will still allow you to report that the Alik'r have been taken care of, hence getting both rewards.|vn=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes if you enter conversation with the jailed Alik'r warrior a second time before speaking to the guards to pay his fine, his next dialogue option will come up early. Despite entering the new line of conversation, he will not give you the required information and your quest will not update. Paying his fine will not progress the dialogue further at this point.|confirmed=1}} ** You can reload a save to fix this, or bypass this step and go to Swindler's Den directly. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||A group of men calling themselves the Alik'r are looking for a Redguard woman in Whiterun. {{Quest Objective|10|Find the Redguard woman}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Speak with Saadia|21|Inform the Alik'r of Saadia's location}} |25||The barmaid at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun is apparently a fugitive noble from Hammerfell. She claims that she is on the run from assassins sent by rival houses in her homeland and needs someone to stop them before they find her. {{Quest Objective|25|Talk to the Alik'r Prisoner|26|Inform the Alik'r of Saadia's location}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Find a way to enter the Alik'r hideout}} |75||{{Quest Objective|75|Enter the Alik'r hideout}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Kill Kematu}} |101||{{Quest Objective|101|Kill Kematu or talk to him}} |125||{{Quest Objective|125|Kill Kematu OR Convince Saadia to meet Kematu}} |130||{{Quest Objective|100|Kill Kematu}} |150||{{Quest Objective|100|Kill Kematu}} |160||{{Quest Objective|160|Return to Saadia}} |175||The leader of the so-called "assassins" I've been asked to eliminate claims that Saadia betrayed her people to the Dominion and they are here to bring her to justice. I've agreed to lead her into an ambush at the Whiterun stables. {{Quest Objective|175|Lead Saadia to the Whiterun Stables}} |190|| setstage MS08 |199||{{Quest Objective|199|Speak with Saadia}} |200|fin|I've helped Saadia escape the clutches of the Alik'r sent after her. With their leader defeated, she believes the rest of them will scatter, affording her some much-needed safety for now. |201|fin|After making arrangements with Kematu, I've delivered Saadia to him. He assures me that she will be taken back to Hammerfell alive, though after that her fate is no longer in his hands. |300|fail| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|130|Kill Kematu}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Mulsivaas |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Side Quests}}{{Quest Header |Giver=[[SR:Jiub|Soul of Jiub]] |Loc=[[SR:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Locket of Saint Jiub|Locket of Saint Jiub]], ''[[Skyrim:Saint Jiub's Opus|Saint Jiub's Opus]]'' |Prev= |Next= |Image=SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint.jpg |Imgdesc=Jiub pacing around his campfire in the Soul Cairn |description=Collect the ten missing pages of [[SR:Jiub|Saint Jiub]]'s Opus. |ID=DLC1VQSaint |SuggLevel=13 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Jiub|Jiub]] or start collecting pages. # Collect all ten pages. # Return to Jiub. ==Detailed Walkthrough== You may have come across a few pages floating around during your regular [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]] tasks. Jiub is located in the Boneyard side of the Soul Cairn to the southeast. Talk to Jiub at any time to receive the quest, and return all ten pages to him when you have them. In return, he will give you the [[Skyrim:Locket of Saint Jiub|Locket of Saint Jiub]] and a complete copy of ''[[Skyrim:Saint Jiub's Opus|Saint Jiub's Opus]]''. {|class="wikitable" valign="middle" !width=8%|Page !!colspan=2|Location |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 1)|Page One]]
{{ID|xx014010}}||At the massive wall that divides Soul Cairn roughly in half, find the opening near its center. Staying on the entrance (staircase) side, turn right, southeast, until you reach a staircase going up into the wall. Go up the stairs and the page will be right in front of you. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 02.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 2)|Page Two]]
{{ID|xx014011}}||To the left of the entrance to the Boneyard (where [[SR:Valerica|Valerica]] is) will be a small building with a broken [[SR:Word Wall|Word Wall]] and a chest. Durnehviir may be sitting on the Word Wall. The page is right on the ground next to the chest. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 03.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 3)|Page Three]]
{{ID|xx014012}}||Before going through the opening in the wall dividing Soul Cairn, turn left and you will immediately see a small tower. It consists of only one chamber with a chest. Exit the chamber on the other side and you will find a small building with an Ideal Master. Go up the stairs and you will find the page next to the chest on top of the building. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 04.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 4)|Page Four]]
{{ID|xx014013}}||Stand at the entrance to the boneyard facing towards Valerica. Turn right and follow the outside of the Boneyard wall until you reach a building. Head up the stairs and turn left to go up another set of stairs to a chest. The page is next to the chest. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 05.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 5)|Page Five]]
{{ID|xx014014}}||South of where Jiub is sitting at his campfire there is a raised stone floor with an energy well in the middle. Page five is on the floor by the well next to some assorted soul gems and other treasure. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 06.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 6)|Page Six]]
{{ID|xx014015}}||From the entrance to the Soul Cairn, follow the path past the building where page eight is found (see below), and enter the second building on the right, a small tower with a Soul Well outside. The page is inside next to a chest in a corner. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 07.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 7)|Page Seven]]
{{ID|xx014016}}||From where you found page four, head due east to the edge of the map and up some stairs up to a platform to find the Spell Tome: Conjure Mistman on a pedestal. Page seven and a bag of coins are on the ground at the base of the pedestal. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 08.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 8)|Page Eight]]
{{ID|xx014017}}||When you first enter the Soul Cairn, go into the building on the right. It requires you to shoot a projectile (spell or arrow) through the green orbs to enter. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 09.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 9)|Page Nine]]
{{ID|xx014018}}||Head west from the entrance to the Boneyard (Valerica's location) until you hit a building with one of the Ideal Masters above it. Take a right (towards north) to find another Ideal Master above an even bigger building. There are several chests in this building which is a small maze, but continue until you reach the glowing symbol on the floor: a teleporting device. Stand on it to go up to the roof. The page will be next to the chest at the top of the building directly under the gem. This chest is also the one that contains the soul gem to restore you if you entered the Soul Cairn as a mortal. There are no stairs to get back down so you have to jump. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 10.jpg|frameless|175px]] |- |[[Skyrim:Jiub's Opus (Page 10)|Page Ten]]
{{ID|xx014019}}||Go through the dividing wall. On your right a short way there is [[Skyrim:Morven Stroud|Morven Stroud]] sitting. The page is on a barrel next to him. |width=1px style="padding:0"|[[File:SR-quest-Impatience of a Saint 11.jpg|frameless|175px]] |} ==Map== {{Map Markers Setup|width=750}} {{Map Markers|image=SR-map-Soul Cairn.jpg|label=Page Locations|markers= {{Image Mark|180|610|label=Portal|position=right|mark=Yellow_pog.png}} {{Image Mark|682|415|label=Jiub|position=right|mark=Yellow_pog.png}} {{Image Mark|388|502|label=1}} {{Image Mark|515|210|label=2}} {{Image Mark|245|420|label=3}} {{Image Mark|665|220|label=4}} {{Image Mark|680|470|label=5}} {{Image Mark|298|530|label=6}} {{Image Mark|835|250|label=7}} {{Image Mark|255|570|label=8}} {{Image Mark|320|185|label=9}} {{Image Mark|415|455|label=10}} }} {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * It is not necessary for you to obtain this quest for the pages to appear; they can be gathered first before speaking to Jiub. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The ninth page may or may not appear.|dlc=DG|confirmed=1}} ** Try attacking near the page's spot with a weapon or spell. This should cause the page to be knocked down to the ground floor of the maze, directly beneath the archway and make it retrievable. Sometimes you cannot see it downstairs as it is glued to the ceiling. ** Using explosive shouts or spells with a large area of effect, such as [[Skyrim:Fireball|Fireball]], can dislodge the page. {{Bug|Occasionally the sixth page will not appear in its location.|dlc=DG|confirmed=1}} ** Leaving and reentering the Soul Cairn has been known to resolve this issue. {{Bug|If one of the inhabitants of the Soul Cairn (Boneman, Mistman, or Wrathman) is killed near any of the pages, the ashes may collect on the page, making it unobtainable.|dlc=DG|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Open the console and click on the ash pile, then use disable to remove it. ** Explosive spells such as a tripped ward or Firestorm will dislodge it, though multiple castings may be necessary. The page will fly off randomly, so save first in case it goes somewhere you can't find. ** Summoning a Boneman, Mistman, or Wrathman and killing the summon by the spot the original was killed may cause the page to reappear. {{Bug|If you leave the Soul Cairn without completing this quest, your game may start to crash randomly.|dlc=DG|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Return to the Soul Cairn then open the console and type setstage DLC1VQSaint 200. This completes the quest and resolves the crashing issues. {{Bug|Even though you've collected all ten pages, some of them may not count towards the total, leaving the quest impossible to finish.|dlc=DG}} ** {{Pc22}}Open the console and type set DLC1VQSaintCount to 10 or setstage DLC1VQSaint 30 to fix this issue. {{Bug|The tenth page can be stuck just below the lid of the barrel and might not show up.|dlc=DG|confirmed=1}} ** Open the console, select the barrel and type disable. Close the console, pick up the page then open console again and type enable to return the barrel back. ** Using explosive shouts or spells with a large area of effect, such as [[Skyrim:Fireball|Fireball]], can dislodge the page. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||While exploring the Soul Cairn, I've come across the soul of a strange Dunmer named Jiub. He claims to be writing the second volume of his life's story but lacks the notes from his first in order to complete it. He's asked for my help in locating the pages which are likely spread across the entire Soul Cairn... quite a daunting task. {{Quest Objective|10|Find pages from Saint Jiub's Opus (/10)}} |30||I've located all of the notes that Jiub lost when he arrived in the Soul Cairn. I should return them to him when I get the chance. {{Quest Objective|20|Return to Jiub}} |200|fin|I've returned all of Jiub's lost notes to the poor soul. He presented me with {{sic|an an|an|description=duplicate word}} amulet and a pristine copy of his first volume in appreciation for my efforts. |missing=0, 10 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Walkthrough==
If someone you were [[Skyrim:Disposition|friends]] with has died, they will leave you a sum of [[Skyrim:Gold|gold]] in their will. A [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] will approach you and say, ''"I've got a letter and a lot of gold. Something about it being your inheritance? Oh, and... sorry for your loss."'' He will hand over a random amount of gold and a [[Skyrim:Letter of Inheritance|letter of inheritance]] from the court of the [[Skyrim:Holds|hold]] that the person lived in.

===Reward===
The base reward is 100 gold multiplied by your [[Skyrim:Disposition#Relationship Rank|relationship rank]] with the victim. A fixed 10% tax is then applied.

==Notes==
* This quest does not appear in your journal.
* Sometimes your friend can be a generic NPC, such as an Arch Necromancer.
* Sometimes the note comes within mere minutes after the person has died.
* It is possible to receive inheritance from people that you have killed yourself.
* If you raise a friendly NPC with the master conjuration spell Dead Thrall, you may receive their inheritance after they are killed in combat, regardless of whether you have received it before.
* Rich victims were intended to have a base reward of 1000 gold, but no NPCs in the game are flagged as rich. Similarly, the tax applied can vary, but nothing ever alters its value from its default of 10%.

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Legoless |rewardChecked= }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests/Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Ralis Sedarys|Ralis Sedarys]] |Reward=Relics of [[Skyrim:Ahzidal (creature)|Ahzidal]],
[[Skyrim:Ralis Sedarys|Ralis Sedarys]] as a follower (if spared)
Word for the [[Skyrim:Cyclone|Cyclone]] shout |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Ralis Sedarys|Ralis Sedarys]], if left alive) |Prev= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Kolbjorn Barrow|Kolbjorn Barrow]] |Image=SR-quest-Unearthed.jpg |ImgDesc=Ahzidal, the embittered destroyer |description=Assist [[Skyrim:Ralis Sedarys|Ralis Sedarys]] in his search for the relics of [[Skyrim:Ahzidal (creature)|Ahzidal]] in [[Skyrim:Kolbjorn Barrow|Kolbjorn Barrow]]. |ID=DLC2dunKolbjornQST/DLC2dunKolbjornMiscQST |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |SuggLevel=30 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # ''(Optional)'' Read ''[[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Descent|Ahzidal's Descent]]''. # Investigate [[Skyrim:Kolbjorn Barrow|Kolbjorn Barrow]] and speak to [[Skyrim:Ralis Sedarys|Ralis Sedarys]]. # Agree to help Ralis fund his excavation by donating 1,000 gold and wait for a message from him. # Visit Kolbjorn Barrow and defeat the [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]. # Find a way deeper into the barrow, and then speak to Ralis again. # Donate 2,000 gold to fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow and wait for another message from Ralis. # Return to Kolbjorn Barrow, clear the draugr, and search for missing [[Skyrim:Miner|miners]]. # Speak to Ralis, fund 3,000 gold to his excavation, and await another message. # Return to Kolbjorn Barrow and clear the draugr. # Speak to Ralis, fund 5,000 gold to his excavation, and await another message. # Return to Kolbjorn Barrow and locate Ralis. # Defeat [[Skyrim:Ahzidal (creature)|Ahzidal]] and confront Ralis; decide what to do with him. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Strange Partnership=== Just northeast of the [[Skyrim:Old Attius Farm|Old Attius Farm]] is [[Skyrim:Kolbjorn Barrow|Kolbjorn Barrow]]. Outside Kolbjorn Barrow is a lone Dunmer named [[Skyrim:Ralis Sedarys|Ralis Sedarys]]. Go up and talk to him and he'll explain that he is a treasure hunter and has come with news that he has located a treasure in the barrow, but he cannot afford to excavate it alone and requests a donation of 1,000 gold, with a promise of a share of any treasure discovered. ===First Visit=== A few days after you give him the money, a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] will give you [[Skyrim:Letter from Ralis Sedarys|a note]] about the barrow. Head off over to the barrow, and Ralis will explain that the [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] have been disturbed, and they have killed all the [[Skyrim:Miner|miners]]. He asks you to go in and kill the draugr and then find a way further into the barrow. After you have killed the draugr, take the [[Skyrim:Skull (Dragonborn)|Skull]] off the altar to open the next area, Go into the next room and pick up the [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking|Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking]]. (If the skull has been knocked off the pressure plate on the altar during the fight it must be lifted back onto the plinth and removed once more, or you can "walk" onto it and off by getting on the altar). Go back and talk to Ralis. He'll then ask for 2,000 gold to hire some more miners. ===Second Visit=== Several days afterward you'll get [[Skyrim:Letter from Ralis Sedarys 2|another note]] asking you to come back to the barrow. There are more draugr and two of the miners are missing. He asks that you locate the [[Skyrim:Bradyn|missing]] [[Skyrim:Mireli|miners]] and to kill the remaining draugr. Before you get to Mireli, there is a gate with 4 handles arranged vertically to the right of the gate. Do not pull the third (from the top), as it releases a dart trap. Pull the switches in the following order: first, second, fourth, first. In the last section of the mine near the corpse of Mireli is a handle (near the floor on the other side of the wall with candles, a soul gem and coins) that can be turned to reveal a secret room where [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy|Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy]] can be found. Note that although you will hear the sounds of a nearby [[SR:Word Wall|word wall]], it will not be accessible until a later visit. Ralis now wants 3,000 gold to hire some mercenaries. ===Third Visit=== You will receive a [[Skyrim:Letter from Ralis Sedarys 3|third letter]] a few days later, asking you to return to the barrow. When the courier delivers the letter, he will tell you ''"Another letter from Ralis. He's starting to scare me a little"'', a portent of things to come. Ralis will tell a similar story as last time: that there are yet more draugr, and that this time they have killed all the [[Skyrim:Kolbjorn Guard|mercenaries]] that he hired. Enter the barrow and kill the draugr. To access [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding|Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding]], pull the chain to the right of the iron doors that lead to the staircase into the newly excavated section, then backtrack around the corner where they will be sitting on a pedestal that was previously unavailable. Then, head down the stairs, avoiding the trap, and kill the new draugr. When you reach the open chamber, you must ensure all the pressure plates are lit for the gate to open and reach [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana|Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana]]. (The [[Skyrim:Sneak#Light Foot|Light Foot]] perk does not prevent you from lighting the pressure plates.) The timing is a bit tight; if you can't get it, using [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] seems to work, or you can run along the joint between two rows of tiles, depressing both rows at once, for a total of three runs across the grid. You can also circumvent the puzzle entirely with [[Skyrim:Telekinesis|Telekinesis]]. A pit filled with deep water surrounds the plinth that the ring is on. At the bottom you can find a coin purse, a burial urn and a leveled battleaxe. Once you're done here, head up the stairs and back out of the barrow to talk to Ralis who now wants 5,000 more gold. He will then send you [[Skyrim:Letter from Ralis Sedarys 4|one last note]], which simply reads "You're needed." ===A Poor Investment=== When you get the final note, return to the barrow and look for clues at the camp, then head into the barrow and clear it out. You are finally able to reach the word wall which teaches a word for the [[Skyrim:Cyclone|Cyclone]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]]. On reaching the room with all the pressure plates on the floor, follow the passage to the left. A gate will close behind you will have to fight three draugr. The gate blocking access to [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution|Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution]] can be opened by rotating the two animal totem pillars until the whale symbols are facing you, then pulling the lever on the floor. Rotate the two animal totem pillars until the eagle symbols are facing you and pull the lever on the floor again to open the gate you came in, and the gate over the spiral staircase. At the bottom of the staircase, the gate blocking access to [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Helm of Vision|Ahzidal's Helm of Vision]] can be opened by rotating the two animal totem pillars until the snake symbols are facing you, then pulling the chain next to the door. There is a giant pool of oil encompassing almost the entire room, so it is recommended that you intentionally ignite it safely from the staircase as pulling the chain with an incorrect pillar arrangement will cause several [[Skyrim:Flame Spout Trap|flame spout trap]]s to blast the area in front of the gate. Removing the helm from its pedestal will activate another flame spout trap that is aimed back towards the gate. You may use Telekinesis again, but the flame jet will still travel far enough to ignite the oil. There is a [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|Stalhrim]] source to the left of the helm chamber. After battling several leveled draugr, you will eventually find Ralis completing the ritual to awaken a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] named [[Skyrim:Ahzidal (creature)|Ahzidal]]. Defeat Ahzidal, loot his eponymous [[Skyrim:Ahzidal (item)|mask]], then speak to Ralis, who will explain that he was under a spell. You can then choose to kill him or let him live, in which case he will become available as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]]. If you kill him, you may loot [[Skyrim:Hoarfrost|Hoarfrost]], a unique ancient Nordic pickaxe, from his corpse. You can also take it from him if you spare him. You can find the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Filament and Filigree (book)|Filament and Filigree]]'' at the end of the exit tunnel. ==Notes== * In total you will require 11,000 gold to complete the excavation. * The time between each investment and the next courier message is three full days (72 hours). * If you visit between messages, there will be miners and possibly guards working. They have generic dialogue reflecting the current state of the quest. * Throughout the quest, a series of [[Skyrim:The Journal of Ralis Sedarys|journals]] can be found, giving insight into Ralis' state of mind. Take care when reading them as the disappearance of the camp will not occur if you take his journals from the camp prior to the final condition. They may also be stuck in your inventory permanently if you do so. The disappearance condition is that ''Filament and Filigree'' is read and [[SR:Ahzidal (item)|Ahzidal]] is obtained, the two actions' order doesn't matter. *You can find Ahzidal's unique heavy armor set and rings: ** [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking|Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking]] are available after the first phase of digging. ** [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy|Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy]] may be found after the second phase. ** [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding|Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding]] and [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana|Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana]] can be acquired after the third phase. ** [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution|Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution]] and [[Skyrim:Ahzidal's Helm of Vision|Ahzidal's Helm of Vision]] become available after the fourth phase. * The Ring of Arcana may not be on its plinth when you get to it—[[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shouts]] from the draugr in the adjacent chamber can knock it into the pit of water. If this occurs, equipping the [[Skyrim:Telekinesis|Telekinesis]] spell can help you locate it (due to its longer range compared to the standard cursor). * You may hear the chanting of the nearby word wall after the second phase has occurred, but you won't be able to access it until the fourth phase. You might be able to access it during the third phase if you stand close enough to the wall. * The grate that opens to allow you to descend to meet Ahzidal on your final visit is controlled by the familiar pillars and is well-marked. The eagles on the opposite wall must be set on the corresponding pillars. * The iron gate blocking the pedestal that holds Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution is not so obvious, however. As you enter the room, on the walls to either side there will be pull chains just to the right of an arch-way. If you pull the chains, this will activate rotating doors which will reveal that behind the arch-ways are two more pillars, each with the sign of the fish. The pillars behind the chairs need to be matched to these to open the gate and obtain the armor. Setting both pillars to the Eagle (and activating the lever) will open the door downstairs. The pillars here perform an uncharacteristic double-duty by opening two separate portals. * The fastest way to complete this quest would be to commit a murder, and serve the jail time rather than pay a bounty. This will cause seven in game days to pass each time, allowing quick completion. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Ralis may hire the miners, but never get anywhere with them - despite the passage of days (or even months), the courier never arrives, and when you check the dig site, they haven't reached the entrance.|confirmed=1}} ** Check the site once, talk to Ralis, then sleep in a bed on Solstheim for 24 or 48 hours.
