== Quick Walkthrough ==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] in the [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|Retching Netch]].
# Distribute ten jars of [[Skyrim:Sadri's Sujamma|Sadri's Sujamma]] to citizens of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]].
# Return to Sadri at the Retching Netch to receive your reward.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
=== A New Mixture ===
In the center of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] is the only inn in town, [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|the Retching Netch]]. The proprietor is [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] and he can be found on his spot behind the bar around the clock. Talk to him and ask about the specialty of the house and he will proudly answer, ''"The finest sujamma to cross your lips, friend. My own personal formula that I call "Sadri's Sujamma." In fact, I've just added some new ingredients to the mixture that I think makes it taste better than ever. All I need to do is get the word out that it's ready and they'll flock here for it."'' Offer to help him spread the word about the new mixture and he will hand you ten samples of [[Skyrim:Sadri's Sujamma|Sadri's Sujamma]]. You are now supposed to find ten thirsty citizens that will try out the new drink in town.

=== Reward ===
Once you have distributed all ten samples of the sujamma, return to Geldis Sadri and tell him the good news. He will be happy about the publicity and say, ''"Perfect! All that's left now is to go ahead and wait for the patrons to come in. As promised, here's a little something for yourself."'' He will then hand you a leveled amount of gold as reward, finishing the quest.

== Notes ==
* If you wait 24 in-game hours after an NPC accepts a sample of the sujamma, you can give them another sample which adds to your total count.
* There are 13 possible people who will accept sujamma. Two of them are from the Severin family, whom you may have to kill as part of a quest; Drovas will be unavailable after [[Skyrim:Reluctant Steward|Reluctant Steward]]; and Bralsa Drel will be unavailable until you complete another quest, but there will still always be the other 10 possibilities unless one or more of them are killed by other means.
* Unlike other quest items, Sadri's Sujamma is disposable. Make sure to keep them in your inventory while moving your belongings to chests.
* If you drop all of your bottles of Sadri's Sujamma before giving them to 10 people, you can ask him for more, and he will give you 2 more bottles. You can do this as many times as you like until you give 10 people the sujamma.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-In A Pinch.jpg|right|thumb|Mudcrab pool]][[File:SR-quest-In A Pinch 02.jpg|right|thumb|The previous hire]]
This quest will begin while you are doing [[Skyrim:Angler Acquaintances|Angler Acquaintances]], with you talking to [[Skyrim:Viriya|Viriya]]:
:''"The waiting... the insufferable waiting."''
:'''What's wrong?'''
:''"Here. I want you to have this. Don't ask. Just take it."''

She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Bounty: Juvenile Mudcrab|bounty]] for a juvenile mudcrab that she wants to study. The bounty points you in the direction of west of [[Skyrim:Broken Fang Cave|Broken Fang Cave]]. After reading the bounty, speak to Viriya:
:'''I see. You hired someone to catch a juvenile mudcrab, but they never returned.'''
:''"It would seem so."''
:'''I wouldn't mind taking over the bounty.'''
:''"Thanks. Good luck out there."''

You can either catch a juvenile mudcrab from a fishing spot with a normal rod, or you can head to the southeast of [[Skyrim:Gjukar's Monument|Gjukar's Monument]], where there is a shallow pool.  Above the pool underneath a rocky outcropping is a dead [[Skyrim:Adventurer|adventurer]] who has a [[Skyrim:Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and a copy of the [[Skyrim:Bounty: Juvenile Mudcrab|bounty]].  The pool itself contains the remains of a colossal mudcrab, a handful of hostile mudcrabs, and a juvenile mudcrab.  Either defeat or ignore the hostile mudcrabs, then find and take the juvenile mudcrab within the crook of the giant mudcrab's outstretched arm.

Once you obtain the juvenile mudcrab, head back to Riften to hand it over to Viriya:
:'''I managed to find a juvenile mudcrab for you to study. Here you go.'''
:''"Thanks. Couldn't have done that without you. I'm grateful for your efforts. Here, take this."''

Viriya will reward you with 100 gold and a key to the Riften Fishery so that you can enter at any time. The juvenile mudcrab that you give her will be found as a mudcrab called [[Skyrim:Snippy|Snippy]] after this quest.

Skyrim:In the Shadows.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy= |checkedBy= |reward=Panguin38 |rewardChecked= }}{{CC Header|Bow of Shadows}}{{Trail2|Bow of Shadows|Quests|nocat=1}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Giver=[[Skyrim:Proventus Avenicci|Proventus Avenicci]] or [[SR:Brill|Brill]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Silent_Moons_Camp|Silent Moons Camp]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Bow of Shadows (item)|Bow of Shadows]] and [[#Reward|Leveled Gold]] |Image=SR-place-Dragonsreach.jpg |Imgdesc=Dragonsreach |description=Save the Jarl of Whiterun from an assassination plot. |ID=ccBGSSSE038_Quest |Mod=[[Skyrim:Bow of Shadows|Bow of Shadows]] }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]][[Category:Skyrim-Bow of Shadows]][[Category:Skyrim-Creation Club-Quests]] ==Quick Walkthrough== #Read the [[Skyrim:Steward's Note|Steward's Note]]. #Take the ledger copy at Arcadia's Cauldron. #Read the Business Ledger Copy. #Investigate the Hall of the Dead. #Check the stables. #Investigate the Silent Moons Camp. #Find the Assassin on the upper floor of Dragonsreach when the Jarl is unoccupied. #Retrieve the Bow of Shadows. #Speak to the Jarl's Steward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===An Assassination Plot=== Talk to the current [[Skyrim:Steward|steward]] of Whiterun (typically either [[Skyrim:Proventus Avenicci|Proventus Avenicci]] or [[Skyrim:Brill|Brill]]) and ask if he has anything for you. He will hand you a note, explaining that he is concerned of an assassination plot on [[Skyrim:Jarls|the Jarl of Whiterun]] from an anonymous informer. He dare not tell it to you out loud due to the Jarl already having plenty on his plate, as well as the fact that he is unsure of its credibility. The steward would like you to visit [[Skyrim:Arcadia's Cauldron|Arcadia's Cauldron]] and look through their business ledger to spot any suspicious purchases; to this end he has asked [[Skyrim:Arcadia|Arcadia]] to leave you a copy to peruse. ===Suspicious Purchases=== Head to Arcadia's Cauldron and you will find the business ledger on the counter. Unlike [[Skyrim:The_Numbers_Job|the typical business ledgers]], this one you can pick up; do so and look through it to find that two people - a Priest of Arkay and a Nord Stable Boy - have made purchases of poisons. Time to investigate and look at their motives for doing so. ====The Hall of the Dead==== Enter the Hall of the Dead and then the Whiterun Catacombs; note that if you have not entered this location before there will be hostile [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]] in this area - either kill or avoid them. Once you enter, descend down the flight of stairs to your left and you will find a dead skeever, a block of cheese, the poison in question and a note, explaining that the poison had been applied to the cheese in an attempt to rid the place of the skeever infestation. ====Whiterun Stables==== Exit Whiterun proper and down the path to the stables, where you will find a dead Nord behind a haystack of the leftmost stall. Beside him will be a [[Skyrim:Leveled Items#Lunar Weapons|lunar steel weapon]]. Loot the Nord and find upon him a note as well as a [[Skyrim:Detect Life (spell)|spell tome of Detect Life]]; like before, read the note and find that the Nord has been posing as a stable boy. The note also states that he was supposed to meet a Dark Elf at this location instead of at [[Skyrim:Silent Moons Camp|Silent Moons Camp]] and the spell tome was to help the Nord in locating him as the Dark Elf snuck up on him the last time, though he was apparently unable to get the spell working. ===Off to Silent Moons Camp=== Now that you have your next destination, make your way to Silent Moons Camp. Your objective is at the very back, so if you are so inclined you may opt to go around and hop over the wall, but whichever way you choose, a journal of an assassin will be lying on a table just outside the room containing the [[Skyrim:Forge#Lunar Forge|Lunar Forge]]. Again, pick it up and read it, finding largely ramblings but an important detail: the author of this book shall be waiting on the second floor of Dragonsreach, waiting for an opportune time to strike and kill the Jarl. ===Back Where We Started=== Return to Dragonsreach and head up the stairs on the right of the main hall to the second floor, then turn around and make your way out onto the balcony. The area looks clear, but once you reach the end you will find the Dark Elf assassin in question, who had been hiding under a cloak of [[Skyrim:Invisibility (effect)|invisibility]]; at this point he will become hostile and attack you. (You may also cast Detect Life to locate him if you have learned it from the spell tome you should have obtained earlier, however as he will cease to be invisible once you get close it is not necessary.) He is quite decently armed and can pose a fatal threat if you're of lower level, but luckily you have allies who will help if you lure him downstairs. ''Note:'' Rather uniquely, the assassin is marked as [[Skyrim:Protected NPCs|protected]], which means he cannot be killed by other NPCs and the killing blow must be dealt by the player. The assassin will not appear if the Jarl is occupied, and will not appear if you haven't started the quest [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]]. The Jarl is considered occupied when the following quest stages are active: *[[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]] - Stage 10: When Jarl Balgruuf is showing you to [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar]]. *[[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] - Stages 10, 12, 13, 15, 20, 110, 120, 130, 150: During the scenes inside Dragonsreach at the beginning of the quest and after the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]] summon you to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]. *[[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]] - Stages 25, 27 - When persuading the Jarl about to trap [[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]] in Dragonsreach. *At any point during [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun|Battle for Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], or [[Skyrim:Battle for Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]]. Once the assassin is dead, loot his corpse and find the Bow of Shadows. Speak to the steward again and gain a monetary reward. ===Reward=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! Level !! Gold |- |1-9 || 500 |- |10-19 || 750 |- |20-29 || 1000 |- |30-39 || 1250 |- |40+ || 1500 |} ==Notes== *The foray into Silent Moons Camp is a chance to pick up the six Lunar Iron/Steel weapon variants. *The deceased Nord in the Stable carries the Detect Life spell tome which is a good chance to pick it up early on. Detect Life can help level Alteration quickly and is otherwise hard to obtain. ==Bugs== {{bug| If you finish [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]], [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]], [[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun|Battle for Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]] or [[Skyrim:Battle for Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]] and the Jarl is not occupied, the assassin does not appear.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} This can be resolved using console commands to manually advance the quest. Using: prid FExxx82F, kill, setstage ccBGSSSE038_Quest 80, openactorcontainer 1 This will kill the Assassin, update the quest so that he is dead, and allow the player to loot his inventory to take the Bow, which advances the quest once more so that you can talk to the Steward and collect the reward, ending the quest. You can use player.additem FExxx807 1 to get the Bow of Shadows ** {{Pc22}} Alternatively, using the console command prid FExxx82f and then enable or placeatme FExxx808 may allow the assassin to spawn in correctly, letting the player kill them normally and finish the quest as intended. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |0||With the death of King Torygg, it seems not even the Jarls are safe in Skyrim, and security comes at a premium. Given the need for capable warriors, I should speak with the steward and see if he has any work for me. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak to the Jarl's Steward}} |10||In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job. {{Quest Objective|20|Read the Steward's Note}} |20||In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job. Reading the note, it seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. The steward wants me to visit the local alchemist and check if anyone has purchased any poisons. {{Quest Objective|30|Take the ledger copy at Arcadia's Cauldron}} |30||It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. I should read it to see if anyone has recently purchased any poisons. {{Quest Objective|40|Read the Business Ledger Copy}} |40||It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. A priest at the Hall of the Dead, and a stable boy. {{Quest Objective|50|Investigate the Hall of the Dead}} {{Quest Objective|60|Check the stables}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Investigate the Silent Moons Camp}} |60||At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. I should find him and take him out before he can carry through with the plot. {{Quest Objective|80|Find the Assassin on the upper floor of Dragonsreach when the Jarl is unoccupied}} |80||At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. =-2 ([[Skyrim:Lami|Lami]] if Alva is killed) |Loc=[[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]], [[Skyrim:Movarth's Lair|Movarth's Lair]] |Image=SR-quest-Laid_to_Rest.jpg |ImgDesc=The ghost of [[Skyrim:Helgi's Ghost|Helgi]] |description=Investigate a tragic house fire, and discover an insidious plot against the town. |ID=MS14 |Icon= |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Find the burned down house. # Learn about the house fire from a [[Skyrim:Morthal_Guard|local guard]], the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]], or [[Skyrim:Jonna|innkeeper]]. # After learning about the fire, talk to the Jarl of [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]]. # Visit the house and find a lead. # After dark, defeat [[SR:Laelette the Vampire|Laelette the Vampire]], and tell [[SR:Thonnir|Thonnir]] about his wife. # Follow up on the lead and learn who set the fire. # Visit the culprit's home and obtain evidence of a plot against the town. # Report your findings to the jarl and be tasked with eliminating the threat. # Lead a group of townspeople in the defense of Morthal. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===This Fire Burns=== Just about everyone around town will be gossiping about [[Skyrim:Hroggar|Hroggar]]'s house that recently burned down, with his wife and daughter inside. Since Hroggar shacked up with [[Skyrim:Alva|Alva]] the very next day, many townspeople suspect foul play. Once you've found the charred ruins of the house, next to [[Skyrim:Highmoon_Hall|Highmoon Hall]], you can take your inquiry straight to the jarl, who will ask for your help in this matter: to sift through the ashes others are afraid to touch. Alternatively, after discovering the house, but before seeing the jarl, a [[Skyrim:Morthal Guard|guard]] will approach you, asking for help, and initiating the quest. Similarly, visiting [[Skyrim:Jonna|Jonna]] at [[Skyrim:Moorside Inn|Moorside Inn]] before visiting the jarl will also set you on your way. In any case, another search of the burned house will rouse the ghost of [[Skyrim:Helgi's Ghost|Helgi]], Hroggar's daughter. She describes dying in the fire. Even though she is a ghost, she is still a little girl. Agree to play hide-and-seek after dark with her, and in return she will reveal who set the fire. She also tells you that the game will begin at nighttime, so the other player in the game can join you. When you ask about this other player, Helgi becomes fearful, saying the other is close and may hear her. Then, she challenges you ''"If you can find me first, I can tell you"'', and promptly disappears. ===Hide and Seek with a Ghost=== At this point, though it is not indicated with a quest marker, you have the option of going to the jarl to tell her you saw the ghost of Helgi. If you tell Jonna first about the spirit, she will direct you to the jarl to tell your tale. Speaking to the jarl will give you some insight into the game and direct you to the grave where Helgi was buried. You can also tell Hroggar that you saw Helgi's ghost and he will respond with chilling indifference. You will receive a quest marker indicating where to "find Helgi in the dark". Wait until nightfall to find Helgi "hiding" in her grave in a small plot behind the house. It's a short distance away, up and to the right, marked with cairns. Someone else will also be there, prepared to fight once they see you. ===I've Been Expecting You...=== [[File:SR-npc-Laelette the Vampire 02.jpg|right|thumb|Laelette attacks]] When you arrive, Thonnir's missing wife [[Skyrim:Laelette the Vampire|Laelette]] is already there. Defeat Laelette and activate Helgi's spirit. She will be pleased that you won the game and found her before Laelette. She will then tell you the heart-wrenching story of how an unwilling Laelette was forced to burn the house. Laelette, in an effort to save the child, attempted to turn her into a vampire, but Helgi was too far gone from the fire and perished. She will then tell you that she is tired and wants to sleep. Meanwhile, Laelette's husband, [[Skyrim:Thonnir|Thonnir]], arrives at Helgi's grave, distraught at finding Laelette dead. Speak to Thonnir and he will tell you that he thought Laelette had left him to join the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|resistance]]. Ask him if there was anything strange going on before she left and he tells you that his wife had begun spending a lot of time with Alva, and was supposed to have met her on the night she disappeared. Alva claimed that Laelette never showed up. Here you inform the grieving husband your deductions about what really went on that night the women were to have met. Thonnir is incensed at the idea that Alva may be a vampire; he refuses to believe you and reiterates that you have no proof of Alva's undead status. A new quest directive invites you to investigate Alva. ===The Detective=== Break into [[Skyrim:Alva's_House|Alva's house]] across town, where Hroggar is now living as well. Hroggar will be immediately hostile if he is in the house when you arrive. If you break in during the day, Hroggar will not be there, though Alva will be—sleeping in her coffin. If you break in at night, Alva will most likely be outside of the house, and the coffin will be empty but for her journal. Whichever time of day you break in, make your way into the basement to discover Alva's coffin and [[Skyrim:Alva's Journal|her journal]]. If Alva is in her coffin when you visit, you will need to deal with her, but her demise is not necessary to advance the quest. Read the journal to discover how all the events unfolded, including how she was turned by the master vampire [[Skyrim:Movarth Piquine|Movarth]], the plot to enslave the townspeople of Morthal for their blood, and the beginnings of your investigation. Take Alva's journal back to Highmoon Hall and the jarl will reward you with a small sum of leveled gold. She then asks one more favor: travel to Movarth's Lair and eliminate the threat. She has gathered a small group of townspeople, led by Thonnir, to travel with you. ===To Movarth's Lair=== [[File:SR-quest-Laid to Rest 02.jpg‎|thumb|The agitated mob who, as it turns out, is not 100% prepared to fight a centuries-old master vampire]] Thonnir, enraged by the events that took his wife's life, leads the charge whether you're ready or not. Once the party arrives at the lair, however, everyone but Thonnir flees in terror. Thonnir offers you a choice of whether he accompanies you or not. He's essential, so he won't die, but he can't hold his own well, and you don't require his assistance to advance the quest. Whatever you choose, enter the one-zone lair and dispatch the vampire thralls and Movarth. Movarth is a [[Skyrim:Vampire#Vampire Bosses|vampire boss]] that can regenerate health, and is generally pretty tough. If you didn't take care of Alva in her own house, she will be in the lair, and possibly aid you in killing the other vampires. You can then kill her yourself if you'd like, though this may result in a bounty if Thonnir sees you do it (this sometimes can occur even if he's outside). ===Return to the Jarl of Morthal=== As you leave the lair, Helgi's ghost will appear and thank you for avenging her mother's death. Return to Morthal and the jarl will reward you with a leveled amount of gold and the jarl's increased disposition towards you. ===Reward=== {| class="hiddentable" | First payout: {{SRLeveledReward|small}} | style="padding-left:1em" | Second payout: {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} |} If you have the ''[[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]]'' add-on installed, you'll also be able to purchase the deed to [[Skyrim:Windstad Manor|Windstad Manor]] following the completion of this quest. ==Notes== *If you cast [[Skyrim:Clairvoyance (spell)|Clairvoyance]] before finding Helgi's grave, it will prematurely lead you out of town to Movarth's Lair. *Alva's journal will only appear after the objective to investigate her house is set. It won't be in her coffin unless you've talked to Thonnir about her. *Although you need to tell Thonnir about Laelette, you will never be given the option to tell [[Skyrim:Virkmund|their son Virkmund]] what happened to her. Thonnir also never tells him, and Virkmund's post-quest dialogue doesn't change at all. *If you break into Alva's house during either night or day, right after taking her journal, you may see her rushing towards Movarth's Lair (usually she starts from the inn). Afterwards her dead body might be seen within the lair —she is killed by Movarth if the two meet. *If Hroggar dies before the quest starts, the quest will still proceed as normal. *Thonnir, as a follower, will refuse to stop following you before reaching Movarth's Lair. (His presence will also remove any bonus damage from sneak attacks if he can see you.) However, when you and the mob are near Movarth's Lair, you can speak to Thonnir and the mob (except Thonnir) goes home. Then Thonnir can also be asked to stop following you. *You can inform both Alva and Hroggar of your findings at two points in the investigation, being the first encounter with Helgi and Laelette's death, resulting in two very different reactions. While Alva will be intrigued by the revelation that she's the town's suspect and evidence points toward her, Hroggar will be largely uncaring and ultimately express his unwavering support of Alva at the mention of his daughter's ghost. He buys into the story that Laelette said goodbye to only Alva before leaving town, regardless of the evidence contradicting that. **Although never confirmed, Thonnir's reluctance to believe Alva had anything to do with Laelette's vampirism possibly suggests that Alva had enthralled him to an extent as well. * Inside of Thonnir's House, there's a miscellaneous item known as [[Skyrim:Michaela's Flagon|Michaela's Flagon]], internally known as MS14FlagonA. Similarly, in Jorgen and Lami's House, there's a wine known as [[Skyrim:Food#Jessica's_Wine|Jessica's Wine]] to be found, internally known as MS14WineAltoA. Their internal names tie these items to this quest, but it is unknown what their relevance would have been. The names of their apparent owners aren't tied to any existing NPCs either, used or otherwise. * If you recruit [[Skyrim:Benor|Benor]] as a follower during the quest, he will still join the mob. He will rejoin you after the scene outside Movarth's Lair. If you enter Movarth's Lair before talking to the mob outside, he won't follow you in unless you exit and talk to them. If Benor hasn't been recruited by then, you can still do so once the mob retreats. ==Bugs== ===Before killing Laelette=== {{Bug|Idgrod may tell you that need to "find evidence about the accusation against Alva" prior to you reaching that point in the quest, including immediately after receiving the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Laelette can be found before dusk, where she would normally spawn, above the burnt house. She doesn't have anything interesting to say.|confirmed=1}} *{{Bug|She can even be visible and invulnerable to any kind of damage, although she can turn hostile if targeted by magic or arrows, at least in the Special Edition}} {{Bug|In very rare cases, when playing "hide and seek" with Helgi, you may not fight Laelette because she will be killed by unknown causes. This does not stop or hinder the quest though.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|When playing "hide and seek" with Helgi, Laelette may not be at the coffin. When activating Helgi's coffin, you will still hear her say ''"Make Laelette go away"'' though. Laelette can be found on the cliffside just above the coffin, completely unresponsive and temporarily invulnerable. She may also be wandering Morthal, and hostile.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|You can tell Alva that people thought Hroggar burned his house down for her even though there is no logical reason for you to know that yet.|USKP|1.2}} ===Before taking the journal to the Jarl=== {{Bug|Speaking to [[Skyrim:Thonnir|Thonnir]] after killing Laelette, but before examining Helgi's coffin, prevents you from doing so afterwards and prevents the ghost of [[Skyrim:Helgi's Ghost|Helgi]] from appearing. Seemingly though, the quest can still be completed once all other stages are done, and you will still receive your reward from the jarl.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Hroggar may not be hostile when you enter Alva's house at night. However, if you talk to him, he will still yell about how he won't let you hurt Alva.|USKP|2.0.6}} {{Bug|Alva may erroneously teleport herself to Movarth's Lair if she is in her coffin when you read her journal, potentially causing her to disappear right in front of you, which obviously breaks immersion.|USLEEP|3.0.8}} ===After taking the journal to the Jarl=== {{Bug|If you ignore the mob and go to the cave without talking to anyone they will still follow you there. Skyrim:Lights Out!.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=ThuumofReason |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Jaree-Ra|Jaree-Ra]] |Reward=Random loot |Disp= |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], [[Skyrim:Solitude Lighthouse|Solitude Lighthouse]], [[Skyrim:Wreck of the Icerunner|Wreck of the Icerunner]], [[Skyrim:Broken Oar Grotto|Broken Oar Grotto]] |Image=SR-quest-Lights Out!.jpg |ImgDesc=Extinguish the fire! |description=Help run a [[Skyrim:The Icerunner|cargo ship]] aground. |ID=MS07 |SuggLevel=6 |Difficulty=Easy or Medium }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Jaree-Ra|Jaree-Ra]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. # Extinguish the beacon of the [[Skyrim:Solitude Lighthouse|Solitude Lighthouse]]. # Return to Jaree-Ra. # Head to the [[Skyrim:Wreck of the Icerunner|Wreck of the Icerunner]]. # Deal with the [[Skyrim:Blackblood Marauder|Blackblood Marauders]]. # Clear [[Skyrim:Broken Oar Grotto|Broken Oar Grotto]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Lights Out! 02.jpg|thumb|right|Jaree-Ra waiting for you at the docks]] ===A Quiet Word=== In [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], find an Argonian named [[Skyrim:Jaree-Ra|Jaree-Ra]] leaning against a wall under the stairs closest to the gate. Speak to him, and he asks how you would like making some gold. He then (if you indicate interest) tasks you to put out the fire in the [[Skyrim:Solitude Lighthouse|Solitude Lighthouse]]. A ship called the Icerunner is due to soon come into port, and without the lighthouse fire to guide it, it will crash on the rocks. This leaves it open to be plundered. Jaree-Ra assures you that the men aboard won't be harmed, and 'may even be grateful for the daring rescue we'll perform'. After you agree to snuff the fire, he tells you to meet him again by the Solitude docks. He also warns you to not speak with him beforehand, lest you arouse suspicion. ===Professional Wrecking=== Head northeast to the Lighthouse. There should be no guards in the building, although you may see [[Skyrim:Ma'zaka|Ma'zaka]]. Once you make it to the top, activate the fire to put it out. Then travel back to the [[Skyrim:East_Empire_Company_Warehouse|Eastern Empire Company Warehouse]] and find Jaree-Ra. He will tell you that the ship never made it to port, and to go and find the wreck on the north coast (it will be marked on your map). He says his sister [[Skyrim:Deeja|Deeja]] is already aboard, and is waiting for your arrival. ===Plunder Away!=== At the wreck of the Icerunner, you have two ways to proceed. The [[Skyrim:Blackblood Marauder|Blackblood Marauders]] will not be aggressive when you arrive and you can simply visit Deeja for your "reward". Or, you can begin slaying marauders. # If you decide to fight the marauders, simply kill everyone in sight; there are no Imperial officers or ship's crew left alive so you won't need to worry about bounty. Make your way to Deeja, kill her, and loot the [[Skyrim:Note From Jaree-Ra|note from Jaree-Ra]] that will start the next part of the quest. At this point, skip to the [[#Broken Oars, Broken Promises|Broken Oars, Broken Promises]] part of the walkthrough. # If you decide to visit Deeja, one of the Blackblood Marauders will stop you and explain that Deeja is on board the ship, two levels down. A possible bug here means the gangway to walk onto the ship doesn't always appear ''(see Bugs)''. Around the boat are various containers, mostly food items, with some locked Novice-level chests. The things washed up on shore, as well as on the ship, are regarded as the Blackblood's haul, so taking any of these counts as stealing. Despite Jaree-Ra's words, the sailors aboard are all dead. [[Skyrim:Deeja|Deeja]] is waiting down in the ship's hold. She will tell you that she was expecting you, and that you'll get what you deserve. Speak to her, and she will explain that the plunder has already been moved, and that you need to be 'taken care of'. She will then turn hostile and attack; kill her, and then loot the body, retrieving a note from Jaree-Ra which explains that the plunder is at [[Skyrim:Broken Oar Grotto|Broken Oar Grotto]], and that Deeja should kill you once you've arrived. The rest of the Marauders will now turn hostile too; fight your way back to the top deck and make your escape. ===Broken Oars, Broken Promises=== Once free of the ship, head to Broken Oar Grotto. In the cave is a network of scaffolding and wreckage. There are two Marauders at the top of the scaffold to the right. You can hear their conversation if you sneak up on them: '''Marauder #1''': ''"You've been here for a while, right? What was it like back when we could still make runs out to the coast?"''
'''Marauder #2''': ''"Well, before that cave-in sealed our ships in here we could loot any size ship we wanted."''
'''Marauder #1''': ''"Where did you keep all that loot? I've been here almost a year and haven't seen any of it."''
'''Marauder #2''': ''"The Captain has it locked away in that drowned ship by his quarters. He says it's "to keep it safe" but I know he's just keeping it for himself."''
'''Marauder #1''': ''"If only we could get our hands on that treasure. We could get out of here and never look back."''
'''Marauder #2''': ''"Maybe. For now just lay low and do your job. I have a feeling we'll be rid of the Captain soon..."'' Once at the top of the scaffold, take care of the two Marauders, then follow the path up the slope. Continue along the ledge until you see the drawbridge, and take out the Marauder guarding it. Pull the lever to release the bridge and cross to the next ledge. The battle ahead will be quite tough, so it's a good idea to save beforehand. You have two options to continue: ====Follow the Left Path==== Heading down the left-hand walkway (which is free of Marauders) will lead you around the cave and will end on a ledge overlooking the ship where Jaree-Ra is hiding. You can pick some of the enemies off from this spot with a bow or ranged magic; if not, release the drawbridge and continue across to the ship and deal with Jaree-Ra and his gang. ====Into the Cave==== Going into the cave on the right will bring you into the Marauder's living area, where there are two enemies but also loot. The cave comes out at roughly the same place as the walkway, but shows a path upwards towards the cave roof. A Marauder is keeping watch near the top of this path, so take care of him before proceeding to the peak. From here you have a good vantage point over the ship, and can take out more of the Marauders with arrows before they can reach you. Be aware that the path continues down to the ship on the other side, and that Marauders can easily run up behind you if you aren't careful. Defeat the marauders and kill Jaree-Ra. After Jaree-Ra is dead, loot his body and the nearby chest for a large amount of gold and various gems. The quest completes once you kill him. Additional loot can be found in the Icerunner Chest, which is located on the top deck of the shipwreck in the water. ==Notes== * If you have already cleared out Broken Oar Grotto previously, the inhabitants will not have respawned, and you only need to deal with Jaree-Ra. * Should you sneak up undetected to Jaree-Ra and engage in conversation with him at the end of the quest, you will only get an ellipsis to respond. This is because there is actually no player dialogue response present at all in the game files, so the game fills the blank space with the ellipsis. * This quest originally had a scenario where you could help [[Skyrim:Ma'zaka|Ma'zaka]] and [[Skyrim:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]] get rid of the Blackblood Marauders. In this scenario, Aldis would help you defeat the marauders at the Wreck of the Icerunner. The dialogue branch MS07DeejaBleedout and related dialogue for Aldis show that Deeja could be killed, but also spared. If she was spared, Aldis would make sure she got locked up. It's unknown what would've transpired afterwards. {{Bug|Once you extinguish the fire at the Solitude Lighthouse, the lighthouse will never be re-lit.|USLEEP|3.0.4}} ==Bugs== {{Bug|The gangway to climb aboard the Wreck of the Icerunner does not appear, making it impossible to get aboard the ship from the water.|confirmed=1}} ** Reloading or fast traveling to another place and then back again may fix this. You can also jump from the scaffolding to the prow of the ship. {{Bug|Deeja's corpse may disappear, making it impossible to get the note to continue the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If Captain Hargar falls into the water he will sometimes swim through the cave wall and disappear, this has no effect on the quest but makes the cave unclearable.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|It is possible that when you loot Deeja's body for the note about Jaree-Ra's whereabouts that the quest does not update and so will not add a quest marker.|confirmed=1}} ** Grabbing the note and placing it in your inventory, then reading the note may trigger the quest update. ** If you simply travel to Broken Oar Grotto, find Jaree-Ra and kill him, the quest will be complete without all the objectives being completed. {{Bug|The quest that provides the tavern rumor about Jaree-Ra having a job for you is never terminated once this quest has begun.|USLEEP|3.0.3}} {{Bug|Despite Deeja and Jaree-Ra's hostility, they still count as "friends" after their deception is revealed. With our blood and our steel we will take back our home."'' |description=Drive the Imperials from Skyrim. |ID=CWObj |Icon=SR-qico-Stormcloaks.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== Liberate each of Skyrim's [[Skyrim:Holds|Holds]] (depending upon your choices during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]]): #Liberate [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. #Liberate [[Skyrim:The Reach|The Reach]]. #Liberate [[Skyrim:Hjaalmarch|Hjaalmarch]]. #Liberate [[Skyrim:The Pale|The Pale]]. #Liberate [[Skyrim:Winterhold (region)|Winterhold]]. #Liberate [[Skyrim:The Rift|The Rift]]. #Liberate [[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Quest Options=== This quest governs the overall progress of the [[Skyrim:Civil War|Civil War]] for the Stormcloaks. It is completed by doing a series of other quests that are assigned to you as the Liberation of Skyrim progresses. The overall goal of the quest is to conquer each hold of Skyrim, one at a time, by taking control of the [[Skyrim:Military Forts|military fort]] for each hold. The holds to be conquered are altered by negotiations during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], and therefore there are many possible ways to complete this quest. * Without doing Season Unending, only the Imperial-controlled holds in the following table need to be conquered. * The Stormcloak-controlled holds only need to be conquered if given to the Imperials during Season Unending. * The Imperial-controlled holds will not need to be conquered if taken from the Imperials during Season Unending. * Also, if you do Season Unending, then this quest will be put on hold until you have completed the main quest. when you complete the quest [[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]] during the [[Skyrim:Main Quest|Main Quest]], any hold (other than Haafingar) that you have previously been tasked with liberating is immediately transferred to Stormcloak control. All remaining quests for that hold are skipped, and you need to return to Windhelm to receive the next assignment from Ulfric. ===General Information=== In order to receive the next hold that needs to be liberated, you always start by talking to [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric]] at the [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]] in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. Ulfric will acknowledge any progress you have made so far, including possibly giving you a new [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks#Titles|title]] and/or reward. He will then tell you which hold needs to be conquered next, along with some explanation for why that hold is the next priority. The next step is to travel to the Stormcloak Camp located in the targeted hold. The location of the camp has been added to your map, but normally it is an undiscovered location, meaning that you cannot fast travel to the camp. Once in the camp, you need to find [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]], who is found in the main tent of the camp, poring over an updated map of the war's progress. Selecting the topic "Reporting in" causes Galmar to assign you a specific quest that needs to be completed. In almost all cases, one required quest is "The Battle for ". The underlying quest for this battle is always the same, but is simply [[Skyrim:Radiant|radiantly]] assigned to the [[Skyrim:Military Forts|military fort]] protecting the appropriate hold. In each case, you need to travel to the fort and help kill all Imperial soldiers present in the fort; your screen will update regularly with the fraction of soldiers who still need to be killed. ===Falkreath=== :''Falkreath Hold does not need to be liberated if it was given to the Stormcloaks during Season Unending'' Your first assignment in the Liberation of Skyrim is normally to liberate [[Skyrim:Falkreath Hold|Falkreath Hold]]. In addition to telling you have free rein to kill [[Skyrim:Imperial|Imperials]] as you see fit, Ulfric tells you to report to [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] at the hidden [[Skyrim:Falkreath Stormcloak Camp|Stormcloak camp]]. The only quest that needs to be completed in Falkreath Hold is [[Skyrim:Rescue from Fort Neugrad|Rescue from Fort Neugrad]]. ===The Reach=== :''The Reach does not need to be liberated if it was given to the Stormcloaks during Season Unending'' After you complete Rescue from Fort Neugrad, your journal will tell you to return to Ulfric, so head back to Windhelm and enter the Palace of the Kings. Talk to Ulfric and he will congratulate you, and give you the title "Bone Breaker" and a leveled weapon as well as the permission to buy a house in Windhelm. He will then tell you to head to the [[Skyrim:Reach Stormcloak Camp|Stormcloaks camp in the reach]]. Go to the camp, and enter the large tent and report in to Galmar, he says that the steward in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] is secretly a [[Lore:Talos|Talos]] worshipper and you might be able to find some proof and then "convince" him to help the Stormcloaks. This starts the [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)|Compelling Tribute]] quest. After completing Compelling Tribute, head back to Galmar, who will thank you and give you some leveled gold. Then report in to him and he will tell you that you are going to [[Skyrim:Fort Sungard|Fort Sungard]], to take over it, he will tell you to go and meet the men preparing for the attack. This will start the next quest [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Sungard (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Sungard]]. ===Hjaalmarch=== :''Hjaalmarch does not need to be liberated if it was given to the Stormcloaks during Season Unending'' After completing The Battle for Fort Sungard, return to Ulfric in Windhelm and speak to him. Ulfric thanks you for liberating the reach, and then gives you your new title of "Snow-Hammer" (unless you completed Season Unending) and a leveled shield. He then tells you to go to the [[Skyrim:Hjaalmarch Stormcloak Camp|Hjaalmarch Stormcloak Camp]]. Head to the camp and report in to Galmar as usual, he will tell you that you have to deliver some false orders to the imperial legate in [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]], but first you will have to get some orders to be forged. He says the inns at [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]] and [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] are frequent stops for imperial couriers. This starts the next quest [[Skyrim:A False Front (Stormcloaks)|A False Front]]. After Completing A False Front, return to Galmar at the Hjaalmarch camp and report in. He will congratulate you give you some leveled gold, he will then tell you to meet the men preparing to attack [[Skyrim:Fort Snowhawk|Fort Snowhawk]] and to take it over, this will start the quest [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Snowhawk (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Snowhawk]]. ===The Pale=== :''The Pale only needs to be liberated if it was given to the Imperials during Season Unending'' Ulfric will Give you the title "Snow-Hammer" and a leveled shield. He will tell you to go to the [[Skyrim:Pale Stormcloak Camp|Pale Stormcloak Camp]] to help reclaim The Pale, and he will tell you not to forget it's your fault the Imperials have control of The Pale. Head to the camp and speak to Galmar. Galmar will tell you to meet the Stormcloaks preparing for a attack on [[Skyrim:Fort Dunstad|Fort Dunstad]]. This starts [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Dunstad (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Dunstad]]. ===The Rift=== :''The Rift only needs to be liberated if it was given to the Imperials during Season Unending'' Go to Windhelm and speak to Ulfric, he will tell you to go to their [[Skyrim:Rift Stormcloak Camp|Camp]] in The Rift and tells you that he holds you responsible for the situation. Head to the camp and speak to Galmar. He will tell you to meet the Stormcloaks preparing to attack [[Skyrim:Fort Greenwall|Fort Greenwall]]. This starts [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Greenwall (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Greenwall]]. ===Winterhold=== :''Winterhold only needs to be liberated if it was given to the Imperials during Season Unending'' Go to Windhelm and speak to Ulfric, he will tell you that while it may not have seemed that bad to give it up, he now has to waste troops on getting it back. He then sends you to the [[Skyrim:Winterhold Stormcloak Camp|Winterhold Stormcloak Camp]]. Head to the camp and speak with Galmar. He will tell you to meet the Stormcloaks preparing to attack [[Skyrim:Fort Kastav|Fort Kastav]]. This starts [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Kastav|The Battle for Fort Kastav]]. ===Haafingar=== After completing the previous quests, return to the Palace of Kings in Windhelm and report your success to Ulfric. He will congratulate you and declare you [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks#Titles|"Stormblade"]]. He will give you a leveled Cuirass and a full suit of Stormcloak officer armor. He will then tell you that the Stormcloaks will take [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] soon, and that you should report to the [[Skyrim:Haafingar Stormcloak Camp|Haafingar Stormcloak Camp]] for further orders. Once you arrive, find Galmar as usual and report in, he will tell you to meet the soldiers preparing to attack [[Skyrim:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]] and to take the fort, this will start the quest [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Hraggstad|The Battle for Fort Hraggstad]]. After completing The Battle for Fort Hraggstad, return to Galmar at the camp for further orders, he will simply tell you that the Stormcloaks are taking the capital, and tell you to meet the brothers staging for the final attack. The [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]] will initiate. After the [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], Ulfric will give you a leveled sword (even if you didn't kill [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]]) and then ask you to stand at his side while he gives a speech to the men. Whether or not you accept, he will ask you to at least walk out with him. If you decide not to participate in the speech, Ulfric will go directly to thanking the soldiers. In the speech Ulfric will mention you, if you participate?? <-->then go on to thanking the soldiers for all that they have done. He will then declare that he cannot accept the title of high king, until the moot declares him such. A soldier will then yell, "What about Jarl [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif]]?" Ulfric will then ask her if she will forsake the Empire and swear loyalty to him. Elisif agrees, and Ulfric announces that she will remain Jarl of Solitude. After the speech Ulfric will turn to Galmar and ask how he did, and after some talking Ulfric will thank you and leave with Galmar. ==Notes== *This quest and [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]] are different radiant versions of the same quest. However, Liberation of Skyrim has more options because you may have been on either the Imperial or Stormcloak side during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]]. == Bugs == {{Bug|Sometimes you cannot say ''"Reporting in."'' to Galmar at the Stormcloak camps and therefore cannot advance the quest.|confirmed=1}} ** Simply reload a previous save. If that doesn't work, attack him until he collapses, then sheathe your weapons. This may work, although you will get a bounty. ***After attacking Galmar Stone-Fist, he may start attacking you on sight and cannot be spoken to. ** Move to another location, rest/wait until the camp respawns (10 days) and return. See [[Skyrim:Respawning]]. ** By using "SetKeywordDataForLocation 16772 CWOwner 2" will force the dialogue to appear ** Entering Pelagia Farm can sometimes fix the issue **{{pc22}} Entering this code into the console fixes this glitch and causes the dialogue option to immediately appear: movetoqt CWObj ** {{Pc22}} Open the console and write setstage CWMission04 10 to begin the Falkreath quest. ** Starting [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] may make this issue unsolvable. {{Bug|Sometimes when trying to report to Ulfric Stormcloak, you are unable to talk to him and can't advance further in the quest.|confirmed=1}} **If this occurs immediately following the Battle for Whiterun, try the bug fixes [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)#Incomplete Bug|there]] first, as they will typically fix this quest along with other issues. ** Move to another location, rest/wait until the Palace of the kings respawns (10 days) and return. See [[Skyrim:Respawning]]. **{{Pc22}} Use the console to select Ulfric (or use prid 1b131), then disable and enable him. **{{Pc22}} Use the console command SetKeywordDataForLocation 16772 CWOwner 2. **{{Pc22}} Failing all of the above, you can use the console command setstage CW 4 to skip the dialogue and move on to the next stage of the quest. {{Bug|After the quest has been completed and Ulfric has given his final speech, Elisif may not be available in the Blue Palace. If you have a quest that has her as its target, the target will appear on the world map in Whiterun hold, but pathfinding will indicate that she is in Solitude. This blocks several quests from working properly.|vn=1}} **Completing [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|Bound Until Death]] after this quest moves Elisif to the Blue Palace. {{bug|The "Liberate Haafinger" and "Report to Ulfric Stormcloak" objectives will not be marked as completed in the quest log once the quest is complete.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Ulfric was intended to be unwilling to start the attack on Solitude if the Emperor is visiting Skyrim. ''"We're ready to march on Solitude, but the Emperor's visiting! The goddamned Emperor! And, as much as I'd like to kill the man myself, we can't risk an all out war with the Empire. We'll bide our time for now..."'' However, this will not function because it reacts to [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|Bound Until Death]] rather than [[Skyrim:To Kill an Empire|To Kill an Empire]]. This won't cause a conflict, as Galmar's failsafe works properly with the correct reference.}} ==Quest Stages== Only stages and objectives relevant to the Liberation of Skyrim (rather than Reunification of Skyrim) are included in the table. {{Journal Entries |name= |1||I will help Ulfric Stormcloak liberate Skyrim from Imperial control. |||{{Quest Comment|Displayed as needed}} {{Quest Objective|1002|Report to Ulfric Stormcloak}} |||{{Quest Comment|Displayed as each hold becomes the new target}} {{Quest Objective|102|Liberate Haafingar}} {{Quest Objective|202|Liberate the Reach}} {{Quest Objective|302|Liberate Hjaalmarch}} {{Quest Objective|402|Liberate Whiterun Hold}} {{Quest Objective|502|Liberate Falkreath Hold}} {{Quest Objective|602|Liberate the Pale}} {{Quest Objective|702|Liberate Winterhold Hold}} {{Quest Objective|902|Liberate the Rift}} |255|fin|We have won the war by taking Solitude and killing General Tullius, and have liberated Skyrim from Imperial control. }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Locate the Assassin of Old.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=[[Skyrim:Olava the Feeble|Olava the Feeble]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Ancient Shrouded Armor|Ancient Shrouded Armor]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Breaching Security|Breaching Security]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Deepwood Redoubt|Deepwood Redoubt]], [[Skyrim:Hag's End|Hag's End]] |Image=SR-quest-Locate the Assassin of Old.jpg |ImgDesc=The Assassin of Old |description=Find the Dark Brotherhood [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Assassin|Assassin]]. |ID=DBOlavaReadingMiscObjective, DBOlavaReadingTreasureObjective |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png |SuggLevel=14 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak with [[Skyrim:Olava the Feeble|Olava the Feeble]]. #Travel to [[Skyrim:Deepwood Redoubt|Deepwood Redoubt]]. #Make your way to [[Skyrim:Hag's End|Hag's End]]. #Discover a [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Assassin|Dark Brotherhood Assassin]] behind a hidden wall. #(Optional) Defeat the [[Skyrim:Monsters#Hagraven|hagraven]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Reading=== Upon successful completion of the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]] quest [[Skyrim:Breaching Security|Breaching Security]], [[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]] will hand you [[Skyrim:Olava's Token|Olava's Token]] as a special bonus, if you managed to slay [[Skyrim:Gaius Maro|Gaius Maro]] in any hold capital. According to Gabriella, this is an opportunity not to be missed, so travel to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and locate the elderly seer [[Skyrim:Olava the Feeble|Olava the Feeble]]. She can usually be found relaxing on her porch behind [[Skyrim:Breezehome|Breezehome]]. Show her the token and a surprised Olava will immediately realize why you are there and will then reluctantly provide a reading of your future. Along with some predictions about the Brotherhood, Olava will suddenly see a potential for adventure and wealth, a place hidden behind [[Skyrim:Deepwood Redoubt|Deepwood Redoubt]], namely [[Skyrim:Hag's End|Hag's End]]. The last resting place for an assassin of old, his fortunes are yours to take. A map marker will be added and an exhausted Olava will send you away. ===Deepwood Redoubt=== Like most other ruins in [[Skyrim:The Reach|The Reach]], Deepwood Redoubt is crawling with [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] enemies, so clear the exterior and enter. Watch out for the [[Skyrim:Traps#:Dart Trap|dart trap]] right after the first catacomb, then dodge the archery attacks from the Forsworn enemies overlooking the first chamber. Explore the stony steps to the right of the first set of stairs to find a dead adventurer and a locked chest. Move quickly through the southwestern tunnel, or an enemy may trigger the [[Skyrim:Traps#Swinging Blades|swinging blades]] trap. Proceed to the first room and avoid the [[Skyrim:Traps#Elemental_Rune|elemental runes]] on the floor. Taking the path to the right will lead to a pair of rooms with an Arcane Enchanter in one, and a Forsworn enemy in the other. A [[Skyrim:Deepwood Redoubt Key|Deepwood Redoubt Key]] is carried by the Forsworn, which unlocks the southeastern door in the room with the runes. Another trap awaits, so avoid the [[Skyrim:Traps#Pressure Plate|pressure plate]], kill the last Forsworn enemy and enter [[Skyrim:Deepwood Vale|Deepwood Vale]] through the door. ===Deepwood Vale=== As suggested by the name, Deepwood Vale is an isolated outdoor valley, and can only be accessed through the previous cave. Follow the path down to the bridge and then if not attacked drop into the river and follow it right to an apprentice-locked chest and a Nirnroot at the end of the river. Also there is a sneaky master-locked side-door entrance at the base of the Southern right-hand side tower. After the unavoidable fight against another wave of Forsworn, explore the area for some minor loot inside the southern and northern towers, and a hidden area on top of the waterfall including an expert-locked chest and a pair of fixed [[Skyrim:Predator's Grace|Predator's Grace]] boots. There is also Quicksilver ore vein here. Finally, locate the entrance to [[Skyrim:Hag's End|Hag's End]] and enter. ===Hag's End Horror=== Immediately after opening the first iron door, you will encounter several hostile [[Skyrim:Witch|witches]], along with a [[Skyrim:Monsters#Hagraven|hagraven]]. As soon as you attempt to fight the hagraven, she'll teleport herself deeper into the dungeon unless you kill her first, so there is not much to do but pick up the chase. Look to your left as you enter the room for an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] and a [[Skyrim:Scrolls#Fire_Damage|Scroll of Firebolt]]. Watch out for several traps in the tunnel ahead, then enter the next room for your second encounter with the hagraven and a few witches. Pick the fight, watch the hagraven disappear, then locate the handle behind the throne on the left hand side to lower the stone wall. Your target, the corpse of a [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Assassin|Dark Brotherhood Assassin]], is hidden behind the wall. He is clad in a complete, unique set of [[Skyrim:Ancient Shrouded Armor|Ancient Shrouded Armor]], and by his side is an unlocked chest with leveled gold and loot. When you are done, locate the lever to lower the bridge. ===Finishing the Hag=== Although optional, you may continue on to clear the ruin. Cross the bridge and check the left room for a [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spider]] and the quest-related book ''[[Skyrim:The Legend of Red Eagle|The Legend of Red Eagle]]''. This room also contains a copy of the [[Skyrim:Hag's End Key|Hag's End Key]] which is easily missed on a small shelf to the right of the fireplace. This key unlocks the master-locked gate ahead, which contains a locked, trapped chest. Activate the nearby handle which will elevate three sets of gates and shoot spikes out of the wall. The hagraven is back in the next room, along with two witches and a huge [[Skyrim:Traps#Oil_Slicks/Oil_Lanterns|pool of oil]]. Dispose of the witches, attack the hagraven until she disappears, and pull the chain. This will close the path behind you, but open up for progress on the eastern wall. The next chamber is empty, but contains a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] for part of the [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] shout. Finally, open the door for your final encounter with the hagraven, and your additional rewards. You will find yourself at the very top of Deepwood Vale, with the hagraven waiting for you on a ledge. When you approach the nearby shrine, two leveled creatures will appear and attack. If you managed to kill her before she teleported, her corpse will appear on the ledge and no creatures will attack. Fight the opponents while dodging the [[Skyrim:Destruction|destruction]] spells from the hagraven. Use caution here as you could easily fall to the lower level and have to re-enter the door and work your way back up to the ledge. If you didn't grab the key from the Frostbite Spider room, the hagraven carries another copy. The unique dagger [[Skyrim:Bloodthorn|Bloodthorn]] can be found on the altar, and a boss-leveled chest sits to the left of the door you last came through. ==Notes== * The switch which lowers the stone wall to reveal the Assassin of Old will not appear on the wall behind the throne until you have received Olava's reading. * You can keep Olava's Token if you drop it or put it in a container while she is still talking. * It's possible to climb your way to the altar and pickup Bloodthorn before you enter Hag's End - from the secret area above the waterfall, work your way around the rocks. * The hagraven's teleportation is scripted, and will always occur if you attempt to attack it using any means. However, it is possible to kill the hagraven before she teleports if wielding Mehrunes' Razor. If you manage to kill her before she teleports, she will appear dead at the top of Deepwood Vale. * You can get the reading from Olava the Feeble at any time after completing Breaching Security, but the predictions will remain the same - even if you have completed the Dark Brotherhood questline and they have already happened. * It is possible to obtain the Ancient Shrouded Armor without Olava's token if you've destroyed the Dark Brotherhood. Take [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] with you into Hag's End and during the fight with the first set of witches, she will resurrect the body of the [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood_Assassin|Dark Brotherhood Assassin]], who will join you. When he turns to ash, loot the ash pile for the entire set of Ancient Shrouded Armor. Another option without Serana is to have [[Skyrim:The_Ritual_Stone|the Ritual Stone]] activated. In the room where the second encounter with the hagraven occurs, stand as close as possible to the stone wall behind the throne and active the power of The Ritual Stone. Exit the area and the corpse of the Dark Brotherhood Assassin will be reanimated and following you. Kill him and to loot the armor from the remains. Another version that doesn't require a Standing Stone power is simply to glitch through the sealed door via a plate pressed up against it and running against it or using Whirlwind Sprint. Once inside, grab his armor and the loot in the chest and then glitch back out via the same plate method. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The Ancient Shrouded Cowl disappears and causes baldness when equipped by Khajiit or Argonians. The character's neck is also left glitched when the cowl is unequipped no matter what other head wear is used afterwards. After saving and restarting, the odd neck problem goes away.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|When wearing the cowl as a Khajiit or Argonian, a second helm can also be equipped at the same time for combined effects.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|The assassin is not immune to reanimation, which can potentially cause this quest to break if his corpse is cleaned up.|USKP|2.0.2}} {{Bug|On reaching the hidden room behind the throne the quest is completed, the assassin's corpse might not be present.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} You can summon a living version of the assassin to get his armor with player.placeatme 0009d761 He will attack you though. {{Bug|Clearing out Hag's End and then starting this quest may cause the Dark Brotherhood Assassin's corpse to disappear.|USSEP|4.3.7}} {{Bug|The Ancient Shrouded Armor set can reappear on the body of The Assassin of Old if you reanimate him after changing location.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The Word Wall may not trigger once you approach. See [[Skyrim_talk:Slow_Time#Second_word_wall_teaching_third_word|this discussion]] on the shout's page for details and possible workarounds.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Olava's Token may not be removed from your inventory after the reading.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Receive a Reading|id=DBOlavaReadingMiscObjective |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Receive a reading from Olava the Feeble}} |200|fin| |!|{{LABELNAME}}|DBOlavaReadingTreasureObjective |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Locate the assassin of old}} |200|fin| |missing=0, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Ability to cure Serana (Dawnguard Side only) |SuggItem=[[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:Touching the Sky|Touching the Sky]] |Next=None (Dawnguard Side Only)
[[Skyrim:Destroying the Dawnguard|Destroying the Dawnguard]] (Vampire Side only) |Image=SR-quest-Kindred Judgment.jpg |Imgdesc=Lord Harkon using the full extent of his power |description=Confront [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]]. |ID=DLC1VQ08 |Difficulty=Hard (Vampire Side only)
Very Hard (Dawnguard Side only) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]. # Confront [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Harkon]] with [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]]. # Slay Harkon. ==Detailed Walkthrough== '''Vampire Side:''' After obtaining [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]], [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] tells you that it is time to confront her father. Head back to [[Skyrim:Volkihar_Keep|Volkihar Keep]]. Once inside, it is not possible to initiate dialogue with any of the other vampires, who will instead direct you to [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]]. He can be found upstairs in the Volkihar Cathedral, where he awaits you and Serana in his [[Skyrim:Vampire_Lord|Vampire Lord]] form. When you confront Lord Harkon, he will begin by insulting you for your disloyalty towards him. When Serana tells him that she will not let herself be sacrificed and that you are on her side, Lord Harkon will give recognition to your persuasive abilities by saying that ''"This dragon has fangs"''. He makes a final insult to [[Skyrim:Valerica|Valerica]], and chides Serana for becoming more like her mother. At this point, Lord Harkon will demand that you give him Auriel's Bow. If you refuse to give it to him, he will attack you. Likewise, if you give him the bow, he will betray you and attack. Because both dialogue options end in him attacking you, it is not recommended to give him Auriel's Bow, as it can be very useful during the battle. '''Dawnguard Side:''' The Dawnguard side of this quest is much like the Vampire side, except that after acquiring the bow, Serana will tell you to head back to [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]]. Once at [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]], talk to Isran, who will gather the rest of the Dawnguard. If you chose to become a vampire in order to gain access to the [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]], Isran will refuse to speak with you until you have been [[Skyrim:Vampirism#Curing Vampirism|cured]]. After a short speech, everyone will head out to [[Skyrim:Castle Volkihar|Castle Volkihar]]. Once you arrive there, the Dawnguard, including one [[Skyrim:Armored Troll|armored troll]], will start the attack on the castle, beginning with four vampires ([[Skyrim:Rargal Thrallmaster|Rargal Thrallmaster]], [[Skyrim:Modhna|Modhna]], [[Skyrim:Namasur|Namasur]], and [[Skyrim:Stalf|Stalf]]), a few [[Skyrim:Gargoyle|Gargoyles]] and one [[Skyrim:Garmr|Death hound]] who defend the outdoor approach to the castle. When they have been defeated, you will then lead the charge into Castle Volkihar, fighting the remaining vampires ([[Skyrim:Hestla|Hestla]], [[Skyrim:Salonia Caelia|Salonia Caelia]], [[Skyrim:Fura Bloodmouth|Fura Bloodmouth]], [[Skyrim:Orthjolf|Orthjolf]], [[Skyrim:Vingalmo|Vingalmo]], [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]], [[Skyrim:Ronthil|Ronthil]], and [[Skyrim:Feran Sadri|Feran Sadri]]) and the other [[Skyrim:CuSith|Death Hound]]. After all the vampires have been killed, follow Isran to a gated off doorway with a pull chain to the right of it. Pull it to raise the portcullis, then head up the steps and through the doors into the Volkihar Cathedral, where you will find [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]]. Alternatively, you can ignore the vampires inside the castle and go directly to the Cathedral. The conversation with Lord Harkon on the Dawnguard side is somewhat different than the conversation on the Vampire side, mainly in the tone of the conversation and in Lord Harkon's dialogue with the player. Instead of insulting the player for their lack of loyalty, [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]] will admit that it was only a matter of time before [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] would one day return with hatred in her heart. He then questions the player's allegiance to Serana by asking if she and [[Skyrim:Valerica|Valerica]] are next after dealing with him. No matter what dialogue options you choose, [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]] will eventually demand that you give him [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]], where you are faced with the same choice. Giving him Auriel's Bow is not recommended for the same reasons listed above. It might be a good idea to time your assault against Castle Volkihar so that it occurs during the day so you can take advantage of [[Skyrim:Sunhallowed Arrow|Sunhallowed Arrows]] used on the sun to help take down the vampires who attack outside. To make sure the assault takes place during the day, you can travel to a nearby location (example: [[Skyrim:Icewater Jetty|Icewater Jetty]]), wait until morning (if you arrive there at night), and continue to the castle from there. If you have the [[Skyrim:Clear Skies|Clear Skies]] shout, you can use it to clear away the clouds and snow to make the vampires who attack outside easier to eliminate. ===Fighting Lord Harkon=== [[File:SR-quest-Kindred Judgment 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"No... Serana... your own father...."'']] Fighting Lord Harkon is the same regardless of whether you are a vampire or a member of the Dawnguard. If you are not prepared, Lord Harkon can be a difficult opponent to defeat. If you gave him Auriel's Bow, then you will be at a slight disadvantage. As soon as he exits dialogue with you, Lord Harkon will immediately summon [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]] and [[Skyrim:Gargoyle|gargoyles]] to kill you, and will continue to do so throughout the fight. However, Serana is quite capable of handling them on her own, which leaves you to focus solely on Lord Harkon. Lord Harkon will continuously move throughout the room, firing Vampiric Drain at you and will frequently turn into a swarm of bats. As you deplete his health, Lord Harkon will turn into a swarm of bats and will materialize at the altar. As he hovers over the altar, he will create an impregnable shield of Blood Magic until he regains his health. If you have Auriel's Bow, equip it and fire at the shield, which will destroy it. Try not to waste Sunhallowed arrows during this fight, as Lord Harkon will do this repeatedly, and any arrow fired from Auriel's Bow will penetrate the shield. When his health is low, he will begin to frequently turn into mist; simply follow him until he re-materializes. Once the killing blow is struck, Lord Harkon will turn into a swarm of bats and materialize by the altar one final time, where he makes a final cry to his daughter's betrayal, and then melts into a pile of red ash. Alternatively, at the beginning of the battle, you will be free to move around when Lord Harkon is speaking to Serana, and you can even slay him outright with high enough sneak-attack damage. Again, Lord Harkon will turn materialize by the altar one final time, where he makes a final cry to his daughter's betrayal, and then melts into a pile of red ash. After the battle is over, [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]] (if you are a vampire) or [[Skyrim:Isran|Isran]] (if you are a member of the Dawnguard) will enter the room, and will commend you for defeating Lord Harkon. He will then explain that there will be a new beginning for the Volkihar vampires or the Dawnguard, thus completing the Dawnguard questline. Serana will tell you that she will stay at Castle Volkihar or Fort Dawnguard, but will accompany you on your travels should you ask her. === Aftermath === *While you do not corrupt [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]] bringing it to its full potential, you can still use it to block out the sun once per day with [[Skyrim:Bloodcursed Elven Arrow|Bloodcursed Elven Arrows]]. While the sun is blocked out, you will not suffer from any of the penalties of sun damage during the day. After one day, the sun will return and you will need to shoot it again. Bloodcursed arrows are necessary for this function. *A dialogue option with Serana will open up that allows you to turn Elven arrows into Bloodcursed arrows. *The blacksmith associated with your chosen faction will stock an additional 200 Elven arrows, which you can convert into Sunhallowed or Bloodcursed arrows. *Certain Volkihar Clan or Dawnguard side quests will become available. *If you sided with the vampires, Garan Marethi will ask you if you want him to restore the entrance to the courtyard the next time you talk to him. The repair is free, and will be complete the next time you enter the keep. *On the Vampire side, you will be new owner of the castle, and will now be able to take everything for free without being flagged for theft. *On the Dawnguard side, you can ask Serana to transform you into a Vampire Lord or convince her to give up her vampirism. *On Lord Harkon's body you will find one of the sets of [[Skyrim:Vampire_Royal_Armor|Vampire Royal Armor]] and [[Skyrim:Harkon's Sword|Harkon's Sword]], a unique katana. If you gave him Auriel's Bow, you can retrieve it from there as well. *If you return to the Soul Cairn, [[Skyrim:Valerica|Valerica]] will be amazed at Harkon's defeat and return to Castle Volkihar. She will return to her lab, where she will restock it, and offer potions and ingredients for free. She will also give you advice on how to survive if you return to the Soul Cairn. The garden in the courtyard will be upgraded as well. Unfortunately, she won't provide blood for Bloodcursed Elven Arrows. *[[Skyrim:World Interactions|Random encounters]] with members from the opposing faction in hold capitals and the wilderness will be less frequent. Random vampire attacks on settlements will only occur during an eclipse. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|Kindred Judgement|descr=no}} ==Notes== *Killing Lord Harkon is necessary regardless of which faction you side with. *During the battle, the music normally heard when battling [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragons]] will play. If you let the battle go on long enough, one or two tracks of ordinary battle music will play, before being replaced again by Dragon music. *If completed for the Dawnguard, everything in Volkihar Keep will still be labeled as owned and thus stolen if taken. Everyone's corpses, except for Harkon's, will never despawn, even those outside. *It is possible, if the Sneak skill is high enough and with high enough sneak attack damage, to kill Harkon during his dialogue with Serana without any major combat. *If you dual-cast [[Skyrim:Pacify|Pacify]] on the vampires during the Dawnguard version with the [[Skyrim:Master of the Mind|Master of the Mind]] perk active, they won't lower their weapons/spells, but will instead tell you to present Auriel's Bow to Lord Harkon, as if you sided with them. Unfortunately, you won't be able to buy [[Skyrim:Heal Undead|Heal Undead]] from [[Skyrim:Ronthil|Ronthil]] this way. *The Dawnguard version of this quest may appear to freeze when Isran is summoning everybody: they will all stay there in a circle and apparently do nothing. This happens because one of the Dawnguard members has been relocated in some way (such as acting as steward{{HF}} at a homestead), and they are traveling to their spot in the circle. Isran will not start his speech until they arrive; waiting for several hours will allow the missing Dawnguard member to arrive to the meeting more quickly, which will then proceed as intended. *Isran's speech after killing Lord Harkon will mention that the Dawnguard will now dedicate itself to protecting Auriel's Bow, but he never asks for it, and there is no way to give it to him. *Isran's disposition towards Serana will change over the course of the questline, displaying some decently scripted character development. When Serana first arrives in Fort Dawnguard Isran refers to her as an "it" rather than a person, and refuses to even refer to her by her name. This attitude seems to cast Isran in a dark light initially, as the conversation takes place between the player and the other involved characters together in a bloody torture room in Fort Dawnguard. In this quest, when Isran questions whether Serana will be able to commit patricide for the greater good, not only does he refer to her by her actual name, but he even uses the pronouns "she" and "her", suggesting that he has grown to respect Serana for her personal sacrifices made for their cause. With Harkon's defeat at the end of the quest, Isran will completely change his tone and express sincere gratitude towards her. He will even allow her to stay in Fort Dawnguard even if you do not take her as a follower, regardless of her vampire status. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Isran may not give his speech to begin the Dawnguard side of this quest. This is usually caused by the members of the Dawnguard failing to assemble. Taking a Dawnguard member as a follower and leaving them somewhere (or having them join the Blades), or Florentius wandering off or not making it back to the Keep after recruiting him are the most common reasons.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **Waiting usually fixes this. You may need to wait 24 hours or longer for everyone to show up, but sometimes waiting in 1-hour increments a few times will allow the speech to proceed even though the missing members are still missing. {{Bug|You may be unable to enter Volkihar Keep despite the gate being up and the door unlocked. This may be due to having earlier trouble with [[Skyrim:Bloodline|Bloodline]] and having used a work-around to progress forward in that quest.}} **{{Pc22}} Use the command player.moveto 02003ba8. This will place you inside the keep in a room with a fireplace, with a door that opens to the upstairs level of the main hall where Isran should be found fighting. {{Bug|When Lord Harkon's health is reduced to zero, he may become invincible, forcing you to reload a previous save from before entering Volkihar Cathedral to begin the fight again.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **Save the game and move your character, then reload the game. When it has been reloaded, Harkon's death scene will play. **If that doesn't work, try disabling and re-enabling the Actor through the CC. Make sure you've already saved the game prior to that. It usually results in one ultimate death blow needed to finally bring him down and initiate the death sequence. {{Bug|Sometimes Lord Harkon will not take any damage from any attacks. Reloading a previous save will fix this. Saving before entering the final room of Castle Volkihar is recommended.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|If in stealth mode and unseen by Harkon during his dialogue with Serana, instead of speaking to you he will simply pause. Since you cannot leave the cathedral, the game will essentially be frozen. If you attack, you won't get the dialogue options, but the battle will play out normally.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|It is best to avoid using dragon shouts during the final battle. All sorts of bugs and collisions can occur, and on the PC, it may freeze or crash to desktop. When transitioning into bat form, hitting Harkon with Unrelenting Force may blast him into the scenery.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|If his script is already buggy and you work at it long enough, it is possible to summon [[Skyrim:Durnehviir (dragon)|Durnehviir]] into Volkihar Cathedral during the final battle.
