Skyrim:Liar's Retreat (quest).wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked= }} {{Quest Header |Giver= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Liar's Retreat|Liar's Retreat]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:The Longhammer|The Longhammer]] |Image=SR-quest-Liar's Retreat.jpg |Imgdesc=Invasion of the [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] |description=Retrieve [[Skyrim:The Longhammer|the Longhammer]] from a fallen [[Skyrim:Rahd|bandit]]. |ID=dunLiarsRetreatQST |SuggLevel=18 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note''': This quest does not appear in your journal. # Investigate what happened at [[Skyrim:Liar's Retreat|Liar's Retreat]]. # Discover the [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] nest. # Find [[Skyrim:Rahd|Rahd]] and claim his [[Skyrim:The Longhammer|Longhammer]]. # Take the blame for the Falmer attack. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Falmer Invasion=== [[File:SR-quest-Liar's Retreat 02.jpg|thumb|right|This party is over]] Liar's Retreat is a remote [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandit]] cave in the mountains between [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]] and [[Skyrim:Cliffside Retreat|Cliffside Retreat]], a long distance southwest from [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. The peaceful exterior resembles a normal bandit hideout, but as you enter you will quickly realize that the human inhabitants got more than they bargained for when they moved in. From a small pedestal near the entrance door, you will witness several intruding [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] battling the bandits, and emerging victorious. After passing over the bloodbath, you'll find more dead bandits everywhere, suggesting that you might best prepare yourself for a huge wave of attacking Falmer as you slowly crawl down to a homemade tavern, now soaked in blood. Fight all the Falmer and take a look around; the deceased bartender lies behind the bar, wearing the semi-rare [[Skyrim:Clothing#000d191f|tavern clothes]], and a slaughtered bandit [[Skyrim:Bard|bard]] poignantly clutches his [[Skyrim:Lute|lute]]. Take the northwestern exit and start investigating the private chambers; a cowardly bandit has barricaded the southernmost room and guards some minor loot there from within. The next blood-soaked room contains more dead bodies, while the third room holds a locked chest containing more minor loot. Head east and you will find yourself in the kitchen behind the bar, where plenty of ingredients and potions can be gathered. Backtrack a bit and notice the hole in the wall leading into a Falmer den—the Falmer seemingly broke through at this point to ambush the bandits. ===Claim the Longhammer=== [[File:SR-quest-Liar's Retreat 03.jpg|thumb|right|A [[Skyrim:Rahd|sacrifice]] for the [[Skyrim:Chaurus Reaper|reaper]]]] Head into the bluish-tinted tunnel and step over yet another dead bandit. Before long, cobwebs will cover all the walls and a [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spider]] will attack, along with another Falmer. Proceed through the tunnels until you reach a lit [[Skyrim:Torch|torch]] on the ground. As you approach the next chamber, a few Falmer guarding some imprisoned bandits will attack. In the panic, the bandits will escape from the pens, kill their captors, and then turn on you. Proceed through the northern tunnel and follow it as it bends. You will arrive in a chamber filled with Dwemer architecture and machinery, now used for human sacrifices by the Falmer. You will face a [[Skyrim:Chaurus Reaper|chaurus reaper]] and two Falmer enemies. After the battle, examine the area for some minor treasure, then head to the sacrificial altar in the middle where you will find [[Skyrim:Rahd|Rahd]], a dead [[Skyrim:Breton|Breton]], lying next to [[Skyrim:The Longhammer|The Longhammer]], one of the most powerful unique weapons in the game. Claim it and leave the same way you came. As you travel back through Liar's Retreat, more frostbite spiders will spawn in the spider nest, so be wary. When you return to the tavern area just before the entrance, a group of [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] will enter from outside to be shocked at the grisly scene. The bandit chief will call out to the fallen Rahd with the words: ''"Hey, Longhammer, set us up with a round of... what in Oblivion happened in here?"'' When the bandits discover you, they will assume you were responsible for the massacre, and attack immediately. == Quick Walkthrough ==
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] about finding more [[Skyrim:Black Book (book)|Black Book]]s.
#Go to the dungeon where the book is located.
#Find the book in the dungeon.
#Read the book and obtain its knowledge.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
===Neloth===
[[File:SR-npc-Neloth 07.jpg|thumb|right|''"Now, it's only a rumor of a whisper of a conjecture."'']]
After completing the quest [[Skyrim:The Gardener of Men|The Gardener of Men]], Tel Mithryn master wizard [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] will ask you several questions regarding your encounter with [[Skyrim:Hermaeus Mora|Hermaeus Mora]]. If you have yet to locate any [[Skyrim:Black Book (book)|Black Books]], Neloth will finish his interrogation with an offer: ''"Now all that's left are these Black Books, waiting for another ambitious fool to be lured into Hermaeus Mora's clutches. Speaking of which... I think I've located another book, if you're interested. Here, let me show you."'' This will immediately start Lost Knowledge, a quest divided into three parts, but only if you have yet to discover the Black Books hidden in [[Skyrim:White Ridge Barrow|White Ridge Barrow]], [[Skyrim:Benkongerike|Benkongerike]], and [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]].

If you miss out on his first offer the first time, you can ask him if he has found other Black Books, to which the wizard will respond: ''"Yes. Hermaeus Mora is devious, but then so am I. Now, it's only a rumor of a whisper of a conjecture. But I think this is the place. Now, hurry. That book might contain the final secrets of Xarxes, for all we know."'' Every time you return to Neloth with a Black Book, he will make a copy and let you keep the original. The reward will always be a leveled amount of gold, and his special thanks: ''"Excellent! I'll just make a copy for myself. It's far too dangerous to carry the real book around. Of course, I'm sure you can handle yourself. Of course you can. Of course. Now, take this for your efforts, and we'll call the matter closed."''

===White Ridge Barrow===
[[File:SR-quest-Lost Knowledge 03.jpg|thumb|left|[[Skyrim:White Ridge Barrow|White Ridge Barrow]]]]
[[Skyrim:White Ridge Barrow|White Ridge Barrow]] is an ancient [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]] located in the snowy tundra of northern [[Lore:Solstheim|Solstheim]], straight south from the [[Skyrim:Mortrag Peak|Mortrag Peak]] landmark. Upon entering, you will find two bed rolls and two  [[Skyrim:Reaver|reavers]] lying in a pool of their own blood. Activate the door bar and open the wooden door and another dead reaver will fall into the room. Proceed down the tunnel and find more dead reavers, along with two dead [[Skyrim:Albino Spider|albino spiders]]. Follow the circular path to the west and head down the spiral staircase. You will encounter more spiders, both albino and [[Skyrim:Flame Cloaked Spider (creature)|flame cloaked spiders]] in what is seemingly a giant spider nest. Locate the woodworks to the east and a strange-looking [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandit]], with a spider attached to the neck, will attack. Jump down into the room below and consider the northern path for a bit of extra loot and a fight against a boss-leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]. Head north and fight yet another spider-infused bandit. Follow the northwestern tunnel and fight the spiders on your way. You will pass a chamber with two [[Skyrim:Ruby Geode|ruby geodes]] and a [[Skyrim:Heart Stone Deposit|heart stone deposit]] and then reach the door to the next zone, [[Skyrim:White Ridge Sanctum|White Ridge Sanctum]].

The Sanctum kicks off with two dead draugr, and, behind the door, a huge chamber with several [[Skyrim:Jumping Flame Spider (creature)|jumping flame spiders]] along with even more odd bandits with spiders attached to the neck. You will also encounter [[Skyrim:Merilar Rendas|Merilar Rendas]], a hostile sorceress who will throw jumping flame spiders at you. Defeat her and investigate her body for some really useful items, including her [[Skyrim:Merilar's Journal|journal]], telling the tale of how she slowly turned insane on her [[Skyrim:Servos Rendas|brother]], thinking he would take credit for discovering the spiders. She also carries a [[Skyrim:Merilar's Cage Door Key|cage door key]]. Claim the key and locate the wooden stairs to the northeast. The room ahead is filled with spiders, so dispose of them and head up to the cage and unlock it. Inside, you will find Servos Rendas dead, carrying his journal. It describes how he, along with Merilar, discovered the mind-controlling spiders and how Merilar slowly went insane from the fumes caused by the experiments. The cell also hold the [[Skyrim:Spider Experiment Notes|spider experiment notes]], with Servos' detailed recipes from creating special spiders from albino spiders, along with the device needed to create spiders (please see [[Skyrim:Imbuing Chamber|this article]] for details). The cage key also fits in the lock of the cobweb-covered door to the north, where you will find no less than four spider-controlled bandits behind a barricaded door, all of them obviously experimental subjects. 
[[File:SR-quest-Lost Knowledge 04.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Dukaan (creature)|Dukaan]]]]
Return to the chamber where you met Merilar Rendas and head south. Remove the spider web and proceed through the tunnel into a huge chamber where the chanting from a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] can be found. As you approach the wall, the dragon priest [[Skyrim:Dukaan (creature)|Dukaan]] will burst out of his sarcophagus and attack. He uses a unique spell called [[Skyrim:Frost Stream|Frost Stream]] and regular [[Skyrim:Frost Cloak|Frost Cloak]] spells and can be a tough opponent. After the battle, claim his [[Skyrim:Dukaan (item)|mask]] and a boss-leveled amount of gold and go to the word wall and get a word for the [[Skyrim:Cyclone|Cyclone]] shout and claim the contents of the boss chest. Lastly, a pedestal holds the target of the quest, the black book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Sallow Regent (book)|The Sallow Regent]]''. Reading it will start the [[Skyrim:Black Book: The Sallow Regent (quest)|black book quest]].

Once you return from the realm of [[Lore:Hermaeus_Mora|Hermaeus Mora]], head back to the chamber with the caged and deceased Servos Rendas and follow the path leading northeast from the cage. You will come across a ladder and a locked trap door. Use the cage key to open it and you will emerge outside, in a small shack a good ways south of the initial entrance to White Ridge Barrow. Lastly, head back to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] for your reward and the next task, a trip to [[Skyrim:Benkongerike|Benkongerike]].

===Benkongerike===
[[File:SR-quest-Lost Knowledge 05.jpg|thumb|left|[[Skyrim:Benkongerike|Benkongerike]]]]
[[Skyrim:Benkongerike|Benkongerike]] is an icy [[Skyrim:Caves|cave]] southeast of [[Skyrim:Saering's Watch|Saering's Watch]]. The exterior decorations reveal that the cave is inhabited by [[Skyrim:Riekling|rieklings]]. Enter the cave and head down the slope and keep an eye out for a narrow tunnel to the right, leading to a locked chest with some minor loot. Before long you will arrive in a huge chamber where four rieklings will attack. Dispose of them and proceed in a southwestern direction where you will encounter a [[Skyrim:Bristleback|bristleback]] and a riekling firing at you from a small tower. Take the southern tunnel and follow it until you reach a camp with three rieklings. Proceed forward and defeat two rieklings bursting out of [[Skyrim:Riekling Barrel|barrels]] and locate the tunnel leading northeast and beware of the three [[Skyrim:Tripwire|tripwires]] triggering [[Skyrim:Claw|claw traps]].

At this point you will arrive in a huge chamber, complete with an entire riekling village built upon pillars connected with hanging bridges. You will be attacked by numerous rieklings here so fight your way through them and stay on the bridges. Falling down can damage you, but will net you some additional treasure. After traversing the bridges, find the tunnel leading east. The surroundings will now resemble an ancient Nordic ruin, although three rieklings will burst out of their barrels and attack. After the battle, help yourself to some useful potions on the shelves, then enter [[Skyrim:Benkongerike Great Hall|Benkongerike Great Hall]].
[[File:SR-quest-Lost Knowledge 06.jpg|thumb|right|Rieklings on bristlebacks]]
The Great Hall starts with an empty room with some common books on shelves and a riekling tent filled to the brink with copies of both volumes of ''[[Skyrim:The Lusty Argonian Maid|The Lusty Argonian Maid]]''. Among the pile, there is a copy of the [[Skyrim:Telekinesis|''Spell Tome: Telekinesis'']]. Take the wooden spiral staircase upstairs and follow the corridor leading north. Behind the locked door is a boss-leveled chest, the [[Skyrim:Benkongerike Key|Benkongerike key]] on a pedestal, and a rare copy of ''[[Skyrim:Dragon_Language:_Myth_no_More|Dragon Language: Myth no More]]'' on another pedestal. Take the path leading east until you reach a huge chamber filled with woodworks with several rieklings roaming around, some of them on the ground floor, others on the bridges above. You will also encounter a riekling riding a bristleback. Search the chamber for some treasure, including a [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] deposit, and head south towards the gate and a [[Skyrim:Rune Totems|rune totem puzzle]]. Three of the rotating symbols have the correct symbol above them, so turn them appropriately. The last one (to the left of the gate) has no symbol, but the correct [[Skyrim:Puzzle_Totems|symbol]] is the whale. Head inside to a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] with a word for the [[Skyrim:Cyclone|Cyclone]] shout and some boss-leveled treasure from the chest. Lastly, head east through the narrow tunnel until you land in a small room with the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (book)|Untold Legends]]''. Pick up the book and you will start the [[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (quest)|Black Book quest]]. Once you have the book in your possession, find the door leading back to Benkongerike and return to Neloth for your reward and your next task, a trip through [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]].

===Raven Rock Mine===
The third and final Black Book, ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: The Winds of Change (book)|The Winds of Change]]'', is found in the depths of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Mine|Raven Rock Mine]]. However, you will have to complete the quest [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]] to gain access to the book. Please see that article for a complete walkthrough.

==Notes==
*This quest can be active at the same time as the radiant [[Skyrim:Black Book (quest)|Black Book quest]].
*As with [[Skyrim:The_Words_of_Power|Find the Word of Power]], Lost Knowledge will not point you to every available Black Book. Several more exist throughout Solstheim that are quest-locked, such as the books located in [[Skyrim:Kolbjorn_Barrow|Kolbjorn Barrow]] and the [[Skyrim:Temple_of_Miraak|Temple of Miraak]].

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Go to [[SR:New Gnisis Cornerclub|New Gnisis Cornerclub]] and read the ''[[SR:Lost Caravan Guard's Note|Lost Caravan Guard's Note]]''.
#Locate the lost caravan north of [[SR:Bronze Water Cave|Bronze Water Cave]] and read the ''[[SR:Carriage Driver's Note|Carriage Driver's Note]]''.
#Locate the lost caravan east of [[SR:Loreius Farm|Loreius Farm]] and read the ''[[SR:Seedy Guard's Note|Seedy Guard's Note]]''.
#Enter [[SR:Whiterun|Whiterun]]'s [[SR:Hall of the Dead (Whiterun)|Hall of the Dead]] and read the ''[[SR:Caravan Captain's Note|Caravan Captain's Note]]''.
#Locate the final caravan northwest of [[SR:Peak's Shade Tower|Peak's Shade Tower]] and read ''[[SR:Velyne's Letter|Velyne's Letter]]''.
#Loot the [[SR:Attunement Crystal|Attunement Crystal]] and journey to [[SR:Sightless Pit|Sightless Pit]].
#Explore Sightless Pit and use the Attunement Crystal to unlock the entrance to the Sightless Vault near the dungeon exit.
#Solve the steam valve puzzles and defeat [[SR:The Messenger|the Messenger]] to claim [[SR:Sunder|Sunder]] and [[SR:Wraithguard|Wraithguard]] as your own.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Letters from the Red Year===
Upon installing the [[Skyrim:Sunder & Wraithguard|Sunder & Wraithguard]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]], you will be directed to the [[SR:New Gnisis Cornerclub|New Gnisis Cornerclub]] in [[SR:Windhelm|Windhelm]] in relation to a trove of old refugee letters from the [[Lore:Red Year|Red Year]] which have recently been uncovered. On the bar top is a ''[[SR:Lost Caravan Guard's Note|Lost Caravan Guard's Note]]'', which can be freely taken. Reading this note will reveal that a highly secretive smuggling operation had been organized to transport some unknown cargo through Skyrim, using the refugees fleeing [[Lore:Morrowind|Morrowind]] as cover. Several decoy caravans were employed to transport this cargo, each with a code name based on the [[Lore:Great Houses|Great Houses]] of Morrowind.

The author of this letter was part of the Telvanni caravan, and was reportedly carrying the cargo towards the [[SR:Nightgate Inn|Nightgate Inn]]. The destroyed remains of this caravan are half-buried in snow along the road between Windhelm and the inn, just north of the entrance to [[SR:Bronze Water Cave|Bronze Water Cave]]. Several destroyed [[SR:Dwarven Automatons|Dwarven automatons]] surround the carriage, along with the skeletons of the unfortunate caravaneers. Unfortunately, the elusive cargo is nowhere to be found, although there is a ''[[SR:Carriage Driver's Note|Carriage Driver's Note]]'' in an "Old Caravan Chest" at the wreckage. The author of this note complains of attacks from Dwarven automatons as well as "singing" coming from the cargo. It also reveals that the items were handed off to the Sadras caravan, which was heading for [[SR:Whiterun|Whiterun]].

(If [[Skyrim:Saints & Seducers|Saints and Seducers]]{{CC}} is also installed, the first caravan is located right next to [[Skyrim:Svarig|Svarig's]] Dark Seducer camp and can be discovered before starting this quest. Reading the Carriage Driver's Note without going to the cornerclub will start the quest and direct you to the next caravan with no context.) 

The next ruined caravan is just off the road east of [[SR:Loreius Farm|Loreius Farm]]. You will be greeted by a familiar scene of Dwarven machines and skeletal corpses. One such skeleton can be found holding the ''[[SR:Seedy Guard's Note|Seedy Guard's Note]]'', which reveals that the cargo had been handed over to the Indoril caravan and that its captain was planning to stop by the [[SR:Hall of the Dead (Whiterun)|Hall of the Dead]] in Whiterun. Be sure to loot the nearby Old Caravan Chest for valuables, then make your way to Whiterun.

===The Plot Thickens===
You will need to enter the Whiterun Catacombs once you arrive at the Hall of the Dead. This area is infested with low level undead [[SR:Skeleton|skeleton]]s. Down the first set of stairs, you will find the ''[[SR:Caravan Captain's Note|Caravan Captain's Note]]'' atop a low-lying table. According to the note, the surviving caravans took a detour towards [[SR:Falkreath|Falkreath]] to avoid any further Dwemer attacks. You will find their remains at a ruined campsite in the woods northwest of [[SR:Peak's Shade Tower|Peak's Shade Tower]]. One of the skeletons is in fact the body of Velyne, a member of the Hlaalu caravan and seemingly one of the masterminds behind this venture. ''[[SR:Velyne's Letter|Velyne's Letter]]'' at last reveals that the secretive cargo is actually [[SR:Sunder|Sunder]] and [[SR:Wraithguard|Wraithguard]], and that the Dwemer automaton attacks are the result of a fail-safe system implemented by [[Lore:Kagrenac|Kagrenac]] to prevent his Tools from ever leaving Morrowind. The Dwemer created a Tamriel-wide network of drones which would track down and retrieve the Tools if they were taken out of Morrowind, and would then deposit them in a vault until a Tonal Architect could come and retrieve them. Seeking to put a stop to the attacks, some of the caravan captains betrayed their employers and handed Sunder and Wraithguard over to the drones. Velyne learned of this, and managed to track the items to a vault located in [[SR:Sightless Pit|Sightless Pit]]. She obtained a [[SR:Attunement Crystal|Attunement Crystal]] to unseal this vault, but evidently died before an expedition could ever be organized. Take the crystal from her skeleton and be sure to loot the Old Caravan Chest before you leave.

[[File:SR-quest-Legends Lost 02.jpg|Use the Attunement Crystal to unlock the Sightless Vault|left|thumb]][[File:SR-quest-Legends Lost 03.jpg|Steam will need to be restored to both valve systems|right|thumb]][[File:SR-item-Wraithguard and Sunder.jpg|The Tools|right|thumb]]

===Hidden Depository===
Sightless Pit is a [[SR:Falmer|Falmer]]-infested dungeon in the snowy wastes southwest of [[SR:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. Unlike most dungeons in the game, the entrance to Sightless Pit is one-way, meaning you will need to fight your way through the entire complex in order to escape. See the [[Skyrim:Sightless Pit#Walkthrough|dungeon walkthrough]] for more information. Your goal is to reach the final zone, [[Skyrim:Sightless Pit#Abandoned Cave|Abandoned Cave]]. A new door has been added by this Creation, to the right of the lift as you enter the zone. Place the Attunement Crystal on the Dwarven Pedestal to unseal the entrance to the Sightless Vault. This is a new area added by the Creation and consists of a large central room with two side areas. Sunder and Wraithguard are locked behind gates in the center of the room and cannot be reached.

To begin unlocking the gates, you must first activate a Vault Release Valve at the back of the room. You must then solve two steam valve puzzles in the two side rooms, which will involve activating each valve several times until the steam travels in the right direction. Your goal is to direct the steam in the direction of the next valve, until you reach the end of the piping and your journal updates. You will need to fight two [[SR:Dwarven Spider|Dwarven Spider]]s and two [[SR:Dwarven Sphere|Dwarven Sphere]]s respectively after you solve each room. With this done, the door near the original Vault Release Valve will open and an extremely powerful ebony-colored [[SR:Dwarven Centurion|Dwarven Centurion]] named [[SR:The Messenger|the Messenger]] will emerge.

Once you defeat this final guardian, the gates will swing open and Sunder and Wraithguard are yours to claim. On its own, Sunder does 5 points of frost, fire, and shock damage each and 15 points of damage to stamina and magicka. With Wraithguard equipped, Sunder becomes a powerful weapon, although unlike its [[MW:Sunder|initial appearance]] in [[MW:Morrowind|''Morrowind'']] it will not kill you if you equip the weapon without wearing Wraithguard. Wraithguard also provides 10% resistance to shock, fire, frost, magic, disease, and poison when worn. If you've already completed [[SR:Arniel's Endeavor|Arniel's Endeavor]], you will have come into possession of [[SR:Keening|Keening]], another of Kagrenac's Tools. Keening is also empowered if wielded while Wraithguard is equipped, and it can be dual wielded along with Sunder. Before you depart, make sure you loot the chest in the room where the Messenger emerged from.

Skyrim:Shalidor's Insights.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=JR |checkedBy= |reward=75.106.138.23 |rewardChecked= }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)|Radiant}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[SR:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] |Reward=Three identical [[SR:Shalidor's Insights: Alteration|"Shalidor's Insights" scrolls]] or a magic skill boost |Disp= |Rep= |Prev= |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[SR:The Arcanaeum|The Arcanaeum]], various dungeons |Image=SR-quest-Shalidor's_Insights.jpg |ImgDesc=Shalidor's Insights |description=Discover the writings of Shalidor and benefit from his wisdom. |ID=MGR21 |Icon= |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Urag_gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]]. # Travel to the indicated location and retrieve [[Skyrim:Shalidor's Insights (book)|Shalidor's Insights]]. # Return to Urag gro-Shub. ==Detailed Walkthrough== Talk to [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] and ask him if there are any special books he's looking for. He will tell you that he's looking for a book Arch-Mage Shalidor wrote so he can translate his writings. The book can be located in the boss-level chest of any [[Skyrim:Dungeons|dungeon]] in the game including ones added in [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]] and [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]], meaning that your destination is randomly selected from over 140 possible dungeons. For specific details about the target location, see its place page; details about any possible conflicts with other quests are also provided there. The book is in the dungeon's boss chest, normally located at the end of the dungeon. Return to [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] and return the book. He will say that it will take about a day to translate the writings. The quest will complete at this point and clear from your journal, although you will have written that you still need to return to Urag after the book has been translated. Wait for at least 24 hours, and when you return Urag will tell you he's finished translating the text. He will give you three identical copies of one of several possible [[Skyrim:Shalidor's Insights: Alteration|"Shalidor's Insights" scrolls]], or will pass on any knowledge gained from the writings in the form of a one-point skill increase to any magic skill other than Enchanting. ==Notes== *Which scrolls or skill boost you earn is decided when you hand over [[Skyrim:Shalidor's Insights (book)|Shalidor's Insights]] to [[SR:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]]. It is possible to obtain the reward you prefer by saving before giving him the book and reloading the save until the desired reward is obtained. *If the quest marker points to [[Skyrim:Druadach Redoubt|Druadach Redoubt]], it is possible to complete this quest very easily by doing the Forsworn chain in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], as this is where Madanach has his base of operations. All of the Forsworn in this area are friendly if you completed [[Skyrim:No One Escapes Cidhna Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]], as long as you sided with the Forsworn in the mine. * The quest may point to a number of locations which cannot be accessed without completing certain other actions. You may wish to avoid clashes by reloading the game and getting another location. Following is a list of locations and the actions needed to be undertaken to complete this quest: **[[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn|Rebel's Cairn]]: partial completion of [[Skyrim:Find Red Eagle's sword|Find Red Eagle's Sword]] / [[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn (quest)|Rebel's Cairn]]. **[[Skyrim:Snow Veil Sanctum|Snow Veil Sanctum]]: complete [[Skyrim:Speaking With Silence|Speaking With Silence]]. The quest marker may also point to the back door, but you still must complete Speaking with Silence. **[[Skyrim:The Katariah|The Katariah]]: complete [[Skyrim:Hail Sithis!|Hail Sithis!]] This location is the most common reason why the quest marker does not appear. (This is addressed by version 1.2 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]]; the Katariah can no longer be chosen as a target location for this quest.) **[[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]]: complete [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]]. {{Dragonborn Radiant Location Note}} **One of these locations can be [[Skyrim:Nchardak|Nchardak]], which means you would need to do [[Skyrim:The Path of Knowledge|The Path of Knowledge]] to complete this side quest. ==Bugs== {{bug|If the quest marker points to [[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]] and you have previously defeated Vokun, the book will be in an inaccessible area in the back of Vokun's Throne Room.|USKP|1.2.5}} ** Vokun's Throne Room may be accessed by utilizing a follower to open the gate blocking the player from the antechamber exit above the first room. This is accomplished by bringing a follower after clearing out the entire dungeon (clearing out the dungeon may be necessary), climbing up the pile the rubble, in the first room, besides Anska, and using Whirlwind Sprint to access the walkway leading to the exit from the antechamber. The follower will run through the dungeon and eventually appear on the other side of the gate. The follower can then be instructed to pull the chain, thereby opening the gate and permitting the player into Vokun's Throne Room. Unconfirmed on PC. ** {{Pc22}} This can be made reachable using [[Skyrim:Console|console]] commands, either to resurrect Vokun and kill him again (select the body, not his ashes) or to simply pass through one of the closed gates (use 'tcl' to turn clipping on and off). {{bug|If the quest [[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]] is active when this quest sends you to [[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep|Fellglow Keep]], the "insights" may be missing.|confirmed=1}} ** To fix this you can type in console sqv mgr21, look for a line REF 'Book'->"(x), x is id you need, then jump and open console again midair so the book won't fall under ground, type in console prid x where x is id you got previously, and last type moveto player. Look for a book on ground. {{bug|When you return to ask Urag if he has translated the writings, he may not give you any reward.|confirmed=1}} {{bug|If you have started [[Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!]] and cannot find the quest marker for Shalidor's insights on either Skyrim or Solstheim the questline is permanently broken without console commands (because the book is on the nonexistent ship Katariah). |confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} Type sqv mgr21 into the console. Search for Ref 'Book'-> (x) where x is the Book Ref ID code. Type Prid x and press enter. Then type moveto player. The book should fall on the floor in front of you. Remember to do this in a private location because picking up the book will be classified as stealing. {{bug|Urag repeats the lengthy introduction to this quest every time it starts because the tracker variable resets each time.|USKP|1.3.2}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Urag gro-Shub is looking for writings by the Arch-Mage Shalidor, so that he can translate them into something useful for the College. He's asked that I attempt to find another copy for him. {{Quest Objective|10|Find Shalidor's writings}} |20||I've managed to find the writings of the Arch-Mage Shalidor that Urag gro-Shub was looking for. I should take them to him at the Arcanaeum so that he can translate them. {{Quest Objective|20|Talk to Urag}} |200|fin|Urag gro-Shub asked me to bring him more of the writings of the Arch-Mage Shalidor. I was able to find another copy, and have brought it to him. He will translate it as soon as he's able, and then we'll see what we can learn from it. }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Soon after [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer]] has agreed to let you into the Guild, [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] will instruct you to talk to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] and [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] to learn more about the Guild and to [[Skyrim:Tonilia|Tonilia]] to get yourself equipped.

Vex isn't the friendliest of types, but she will warm to you if you demonstrate some backbone and stand up to her browbeating. She'll make it clear she expects you to follow orders and warns you that being a thief isn't easy at all. She'll also be very honest with you: the Guild isn't doing great. She brushes it off as simple bad luck and mocks Delvin for thinking some sort of curse is to blame.

Unlike Vex, Delvin will talk you down if you try to be smug around him. He will also prompt you to take on extra jobs because he too admits the Guild isn't what it used to be. He thinks someone is very upset with the Guild and has cursed it with misfortune. However, he doesn't plan on sulking and tells you he's going to spit in the curse's face and turn things around.

Your last stop is Tonilia, Delvin's personal lookout. She won't be impressed if you try to act tough, but she'll nonetheless provide you with a full set of [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild Armor|Thieves Guild armor]].

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked= }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Bards College]] {{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Viarmo|Viarmo]] |Reward=Leveled gold, Bards College membership,
Solitude Fire Festival restored,
Word for the [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] shout |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Viarmo|Viarmo]])
=1 ([[Skyrim:Jorn|Jorn]])
=1 ([[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]]) |Next=[[Skyrim:Finn's Lute|Finn's Lute]], [[Skyrim:Pantea's Flute|Pantea's Flute]], and [[Skyrim:Rjorn's Drum|Rjorn's Drum]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]], [[Skyrim:Dead Men's Respite|Dead Men's Respite]], [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] |Image=SR-quest-Tending the Flames 04.jpg |ImgDesc=The secret of [[Skyrim:Dead Men's Respite|Dead Men's Respite]] |description=Unveil the truth about a deceitful [[Skyrim:Olaf One-Eye|King]] and become a member of the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]]. |ID=MS05 |Icon= |SuggLevel=6 }}{{#addtotrail:Bards College|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Locate the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]]. # Learn about the Festival and [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Jarl Elisif the Fair]]'s plan to cancel it. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Dead Men's Respite|Dead Men's Respite]] to receive a missing Verse. # Return to the Bards College and pay a visit to the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]]. # Participate in the Festival. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Burning of King Olaf=== All over Skyrim, the [[Skyrim:Bard|Bards]] performing at the various inns and taverns will point you towards the [[Skyrim:Bards College|Bards College]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. When you enter the building, you will be greeted by Headmaster [[Skyrim:Viarmo|Viarmo]]; he will explain a bit about the college and will proceed to hand you a task as part of your application to join. He explains that the ancient college ritual The Burning of King Olaf has been canceled due to the recent assassination of [[Skyrim:High_King_Torygg|High King Torygg]]. The grieving widow, the recently appointed Jarl of Solitude, [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]] reasons that burning a King in effigy is distasteful at this time and wants the festival shut down. The Festival itself is centuries old and is, according to Viarmo, held to celebrate Solitude and the heroic acts of the mythical King Olaf who apparently slew Numinex, a fearsome dragon who terrorized Skyrim during the First Era. ===The Poetic Edda=== To ease the mind of Elisif and thus save the Festival, Viarmo wants to recite King Olaf's Verse, originally a part of the Poetic Edda, but lost for thousands of years. The Poetic Edda is a living history of Skyrim, written by each bard studying at the College and as such, a precious item. King Olaf's Verse was [[Skyrim:Svaknir|Svaknir]]'s contribution to the Edda and dared to question the heroic acts of King Olaf, the very King to whom the Festival is held. Because of the Verse, King Olaf sentenced Svaknir to death and all copies of the Verse burned. The residing Dean of History, [[Skyrim:Giraud Gemane|Giraud Gemane]], suspects that the lost Verse can be found inside [[Skyrim: Dead Men's Respite|Dead Men's Respite]], which he also believes to be the burial tomb for King Olaf himself. === Dead Men's Respite=== [[File:SR-quest-Tending the Flames 02.jpg|thumb|right|Locating the lost verse]] The ancient barrow is located in the mountains southwest of [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]] and you will, immediately upon entering, notice a strange ghost wave at you, then disappear through the sealed entrance to the north. Pick up the [[Skyrim:Ruby Dragon Claw|Ruby Dragon Claw]] from the table, which will cause four of the previously dead [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] enemies to reanimate and attack (you can kill them by sneak-attacking them before taking the claw), but will also raise the gate and allow you to follow the ghost. It soon becomes clear that the ghost shows you the correct path, so follow it and pull the chain at the dead end. The next area is a maze-like tomb where you will have to pull several chains to open up different areas. Use your map to your advantage and make sure to access the easternmost room for a copy of the [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Buying Game|The Buying Game]]'', guarded by a well-placed [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|Battering Ram]]. Watch out for several draugr and [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] and continue north. Beware of the pressure plate at the foot of the stairs, which will release a [[Skyrim:Flame Spout Trap|flame trap]]. Fight the spiders in the next room, loot the shelves for some potions and soul gems then pull the chain, which will open the grating in the floor and reveal a watery pit. Take the jump and proceed forward to a chamber with several enemies, including an archer on the ledge above. Proceed to the level above and open the gate, which will trigger several [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|swinging blade]] traps (at the bottom-right corner of the gate you will find a trigger for the trap, which you can remove by picking the adept lock), so cross the bridge carefully and pull the chain to make them stop. Go up another level and open the huge door. ===The Executed Bard=== At the end of the next tunnel, use the Arcane Enchanter if you must, then turn around and watch your ghostly guide disappear through another doorway to the right. Due to a magical seal the door ahead of you is blocked, so make your way through the doorway to the right and through another set of catacombs to fight the residing draugr. The locked door hides a master-locked treasure chest, with a boss-leveled amount of gold. In the next chamber, the gate will shut behind you and five draugr will attack. After the battle, explore the southeastern room for a chest, but beware of the [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart trap]] protecting it. Pull the chain and head down the path. Activate the handle and watch the rock wall lower and behold the sight of the ghost sitting next to the mummified corpse of [[Skyrim:Svaknir|Svaknir]], the Bard executed for questioning the King in ancient times. You cannot interact with the ghost, but the corpse still holds the forbidden [[Skyrim:King_Olaf's_Verse|Verse]], so claim it and learn the truth behind the annual Festival in Solitude. As soon as you take the Verse, the ghost disappears and you will have no choice but to backtrack through the Catacombs. ===Confront the King=== On your way back, you will encounter the Ghost of Svaknir near the magically sealed door. He will turn towards the door, break the barrier, and run headfirst into the Chamber. Follow Svaknir to a Nordic [[Skyrim:Traps#Puzzle Door|puzzle door]]; it is finally time to investigate the [[Skyrim:Ruby Dragon Claw|Ruby Dragon Claw]] you found when you initially entered the barrow, so take an extra look and you will find the symbols '''Wolf—Hawk—Wolf''', so adjust the corresponding images for the three rings on the door, then insert the claw in the keyhole. Proceed forward and equip yourself for a lengthy battle. In the final chamber, the ghost of Svaknir will stand in the middle of a small pond, surrounded by draugr all seated on thrones. There are twenty-one on the ground floor, and an additional four on the ledge in the other end of the room. Everything seems quiet, until you get close to the ghost. He will then shout out: [[File:SR-quest-Tending_the_Flames_05.jpg|thumb|right|Svaknir and King Olaf One-Eye fighting]] :: '''''Olaf! It is time!''''' His words will make the entire room tremble and the first wave of draugr enemies will rise from their thrones. Eleven out of the twenty-one draugr on the ground floor will attack, ten of them will remain seated and unmoving. As a ghost, Svaknir is immortal and will pick up the fight, so you can do your best to help him out, or simply hide and wait for him to win. When all eleven enemies are slain, Svaknir will shout: ::'''''Arise, Olaf! My vengeance is at hand!''''' This will make the four draugr on the ledge rise and attack, so once again help Svaknir get his revenge. These draugr are all higher level than the first ones, but Svaknir will once again prove his skills and help you defeat them. When they are dead, he will finally shout out: ''"Olaf!"'' This will finally cause [[Skyrim:King Olaf One-Eye|Olaf One-Eye]] himself to burst out of his coffin screaming: ''"Insolent Bard. Die!"'' He will then attack the both of you, so do your best to avoid his attacks and beware of his ability to disarm you. He can be a tough opponent, but will eventually fall to the ground and die. The tormented soul of Svaknir will finally be set free; he will head to the nearby door, pull out his lute and disappear in a ray of light. Loot Olaf's corpse for a leveled weapon and the key to his treasury, then examine the wall behind his coffin to learn a [[Skyrim:Word of Power|word]] of [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]]. Unlock the treasury door and examine the area for considerable loot, then pull the lever and make your way out of the barrow. ===A Bit of Improvising=== Back in the College, Viarmo will be overwhelmed with joy when you hand him the Verse, but will soon be disappointed. He complains about the quality of the rhymes themselves, and, even worse, that some of the writing is unreadable due to age. He will, however, accept a suggestion about making the missing parts up, simply to save the Festival. The next step will involve him reciting the poem and you making up the missing parts. Reading the book ''[[Skyrim:Olaf_and_the_Dragon|Olaf and the Dragon]]'', found in the upstairs library, will give more background about the deceitful King. Although there is no correct version, how much the court likes what you make up will affect your reward. The persuade options in particular will be very well received at court. Once Viarmo is convinced that the Verse is worth reciting to the Jarl, he will leave the College and head towards the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]], inviting you along. Each choice gives you the listed number of points (the higher the number, the better the verse is received). The total of the two choices determines your reward. '''Choice #1''' #Olaf found him asleep. ''(2 points)'' #Olaf made a deal with Numinex. ''(1 point)'' #Olaf was Numinex. A dragon in human form! (Persuade) ''(3 points, requires Speech 25)'' '''Choice #2''' (Note: There are multiple [[#Bugs|bugs]] with this choice.) #Olaf ordered disguised troops to attack Solitude? ''(3 points)'' #He convinced Solitude to attack Winterhold. ''(1 point)'' #He sacked it and used magic to blame Solitude. ''(2 points)'' #Olaf sacked it in dragon form! (Persuade) ''(4 points, only available if Persuade was used in Choice #1, requires Speech 50)'' '''Rewards''' {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:right; margin:0.5em 0;" ! rowspan=2 | Levels !! colspan=4 | Total Points |- ! 2 !! 3-4 !! 5-6 !! 7+ |- | style="text-align:center;" | 1-9 || 250 || 400 || 500 || 750 |- | style="text-align:center;" | 10-19 || 400 || 600 || 750 || 1,000 |- | style="text-align:center;" | 20-29 || 500 || 800 || 1,000 || 1,250 |- | style="text-align:center;" | 30-39 || 600 || 1,000 || 1,250 || 1,500 |- | style="text-align:center;" | 40+ || 750 || 1,200 || 1,500 || 1,800 |} ===Truth be Told=== In the Blue Palace, you will find Viarmo in the lobby, waiting for his audition with Jarl Elisif the Fair. Ask him if he's ready and follow him up the stairs, then watch while he recites the embarrassing truth about the legendary King Olaf to the Court.
The verse: [[File:SR-quest-Tending the Flames.jpg|thumb|right|''"O, Olaf, our subjugator, the one-eyed betrayer"'']] ''O, Olaf, our subjugator, the one-eyed betrayer;''
''death-dealing demon and dragon-killing King.''
''Your legend is lies, lurid and false;''
''your cunning capture of Numinex, a con for the ages.''
''No shouting match between dragon and man, no fire or fury did this battle entail.''
'''(Olaf found Numinex asleep)''': ''Olaf captured a fast-sleeping dragon, a mighty feat which the meek would not fail.''
'''(Olaf made a deal with Numinex)''': ''Olaf struck a deal to make himself king, Numinex let go though none tell that tale.''
'''(Olaf was Numinex. A dragon in human form!)''': ''Olaf was Numinex in human form, on moonless nights he would spread wings and sail.'' ''Olaf grabbed power, by promise and threat;''
''From Falkreath to Winterhold, they fell to their knees;''
''But Solitude stood strong, Skyrim's truest protectors.''
''Olaf's vengeance was instant, inspired and wicked.''
{{SkyrimBox|The "convinced Solitude to attack" and "sacked it in dragon form" options are both bugged, causing the "disguised troops" line to be read instead. See the [[#Bugs|bugs]] section for more detail.|style=float:right; width:25%; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;}}'''(Olaf ordered disguised troops to attack Solitude)''': ''Olaf gave orders, Winterhold disguises. An attack on Solitude total destruction to follow. His men dressed up and then went out to fight, but they reversed Olaf's orders much to Winterhold's sorrow.''
'''(Olaf convinced Solitude to attack)''': ''Olaf sent word to Solitude's Jarl, cajoling and mocking and begging for a fight. From Winterhold Olaf had sent every message, upon attack he was nowhere in sight.''
'''(Olaf sacked Winterhold and used magic to blame Solitude)''': ''Because Solitude would not soon bend knee, Olaf would hurt them while his status accrued. He sacked Winterhold his only true ally, and used magic bold to blame Solitude.''
'''(Olaf sacked it in dragon form!)''': ''Because Solitude would not soon bend knee, Olaf would hurt them while his status accrued. He sacked Winterhold in dragonform, and bent their minds to blame Solitude.''
''So ends the story of Olaf the liar, a thief and a scoundrel we of Solitude commit to the fire.''
''In Solitude bards train for their service, they also gather each year and burn a King who deserves it.'' At the conclusion of the verse, Elisif will admit that Olaf was indeed a thief and a scoundrel and that the Festival is a celebration of Solitude and a condemnation of false Kings. She will reinstate the Festival and promise Viarmo a decent reward for the College. Viarmo will then turn to you and express his gratitude, even if he still will not promote you to Bard; you will have to wait until the Festival, when he will declare you a Bard in front of all College members. ===The Burning of a False King=== [[File:SR-quest-Tending the Flames 06.jpg|thumb|left|''"With the lighting of the effigy..."'']] [[File:SR-quest-Tending the Flames 03.jpg|thumb|right|Citizens cheering the burning King]] He then tells you to seek out [[Skyrim:Jorn|Jorn]] and tell him to finish the preparations for the Festival. He will then leave Blue Palace and you are free to decide when to start the festival. Back in the College, Jorn will be excited about the news and will start right away, with a request to meet him after dark, and then the festival will be on. Wait around until 8pm then approach him again. He will then lead you around the College, to the courtyard where every member of the College is gathered, along with several residents and the resident Bards from the local inns. Talk to [[Skyrim:Bendt|Bendt]], [[Skyrim:Sorex Vinius|Sorex Vinius]], or [[Skyrim:Evette San|Evette San]] for free snacks, then watch and listen as Viarmo sets the effigy on fire and declares you the newest addition to the Bards College. All guests will applaud and Viarmo himself will seek you out and explain that several College professors will have jobs for you and that the burning of the King will now be a weekly event. Finally, he will hand you your reward, a leveled amount of gold, and leave you alone with the burning King Olaf. After you finish the quest, guards in all 9 Holds will recognize you as a bard. Solitude Guards will also recognize you as the one who restored the Fire Festival. {{NewLeft}} ==Festival Reactions== The following Solitude residents and Bards College members will be present at the Festival: {|class="wikitable" !Name !! {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Quintus_Navale|Quintus Navale]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:The White Phial (item)|The White Phial]] |Disp= =1 (Quintus Navale) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The White Phial (quest)|The White Phial]]
[[Skyrim:The Throat of the World|The Throat of the World]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:The White Phial (place)|The White Phial]], [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]], [[Skyrim:Stonehill_Bluff|Stonehill Bluff]] |Image=SR-quest-The White Phial 03.jpg |ImgDesc=The White Phial |description=Acquire the materials necessary to repair the [[Skyrim:The White Phial (item)|White Phial]]. |ID=MS12b |Icon= }} ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note''': This quest can only be started after gaining full access to the [[Skyrim:Throat_of_the_World|Throat of the World]] during the quest of the [[Skyrim:The_Throat_of_the_World|same name]]. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Quintus_Navale|Quintus Navale]] about repairing the White Phial. # Find the items required. # Return to Quintus Navale. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===One Last Attempt=== [[File:SR-npc-Nurelion_04.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Nurelion|Nurelion]] on his deathbed]] A few days after the [[Skyrim:The White Phial (quest)|failed attempt]] to help the alchemist [[Skyrim:Nurelion|Nurelion]] realize his life's ambition (so long as you have unlocked the top of the [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]] by completing the [[Skyrim:The Throat of the World|similarly named quest]]), a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] will seek you out with a [[Skyrim:Letter from Quintus Navale|letter from Quintus Navale]] (Nurelion's assistant) who has grave news, and seeks your help. Head to Windhelm and locate [[Skyrim:The White Phial (place)|The White Phial]] in the market district. In there, Nurelion will still be in his bed, coughing and slowly dying. Quintus, however, will be more than ready to explain what is needed to repair the Phial: ''"I have some thoughts. There are three crucial elements. Some may be easier to find than others. On the top of the Throat of the World is a patch of Unmelting Snow. No heat can touch it. Then we need the tusk of a mammoth, ground to a fine powder as only the giants know how. The final step is tricky. It requires the briar heart from a Forsworn of the Reach. If you can bring me these materials, the Phial can again be made whole."'' ===Gathering the Items=== Although he claims not to be as skilled as his master, Quintus will provide quite a bit of information on each of the items to explain why they are needed for his plan to repair the Phial: {| class="wikitable" width="100%" ! Item ! Description |- ! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Mammoth Tusk Powder|Mammoth Tusk Powder]] [[File:SR-icon-misc-MammothTuskPowder.png|50px]]}} | ''"The ivory produced by those beasts is as hard as iron. But the giants have found ways to make it yield. They're able to grind it down so fine that it can be infused into the lattice of packed snow. The finished material has the delicate nature of fresh powder snow, but the strength of the hardest steel."'' |- ! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Unmelting Snow|Unmelting Snow]] [[File:SR-icon-misc-UnmeltingSnow.png|50px]]}} | ''"On top of the Throat of the World is a patch of snow that's never melted. They say the Greybeards taught it to ignore the sun, and heat simply washes over it. The original Phial was made from this snow. We'll only need a small bit for the repairs."'' |- ! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Briar Heart|Briar Heart]] [[File:SR-icon-ingredient-Briar_Heart.png|50px]]}} | ''"The final tempering of the Phial was performed with a type of old magic that's been lost since the Dragon War. The nearest modern incarnation of it is the strange rituals practiced by the Forsworn. With the heart of one of their Briar Warriors, I can lock the Phial's magic into its physical form. It's difficult to explain to the layman -- forgive me if I begin waxing alchemic."'' |} [[File:SR-quest-Repairing the Phial.jpg|thumb|right|Repairing the Phial]] [[File:SR-quest-Repairing_the_Phial_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Master, look. It's the Phial."'']] The rather unremarkable patch of Unmelting Snow can be found at the [[Skyrim:Throat_of_the_World|Throat of The World]]. Mammoth Tusk Powder is in a large vat beside the giants at [[Skyrim:Stonehill_Bluff|Stonehill Bluff]], and it is possible to pick up the powder without aggravating the giants. Note that the Mammoth Tusk Powder is different from the alchemy ingredient [[Skyrim:Powdered Mammoth Tusk|Powdered Mammoth Tusk]]. A Briar Heart can be acquired from a dead [[Skyrim:Forsworn Briarheart|Forsworn Briarheart]] and can be obtained from multiple Forsworn camps; one will be marked on your map. ===Repairing the Phial=== When you return to Quintus with the three items, he will be relieved: ''"Thank the gods. I'll get to work on the Phial straight away."'' He will then leave his spot behind the counter and get to work at the [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] in the corner. Once he is finished repairing the Phial, he will head upstairs, eager to show his master what he has accomplished: '''Quintus''': ''"Master, look. It's the Phial."''
'''Nurelion''': ''"What? How?"''
'''Quintus''': ''"It doesn't matter. Look, it's refilling with your tonic as we speak."''
'''Nurelion''': ''"Marvelous."'' Nurelion will then die peacefully and Quintus will turn around and express his gratitude: ''"He is gone. But thanks to you, he died knowing his life's work was not in vain."'' When you say you are sorry to hear that old Nurelion is dead, he will respond: ''"As am I. You acted very nobly in helping my master realize his life's work. Thank you for that. As for myself, I've always been content to simply be an alchemist. I fear keeping the Phial would just remind me of Nurelion's obsession, and how it consumed him. Here, keep it. You are as much a part of its legend now as [[Skyrim:Curalmil|Curalmil]] was. I hope it brings you the happiness that my master desired."'' ===The Reward=== You have a number of options for which kind of liquid the Phial will be able to regenerate: * I'd like it to have the power of healing. ([[Skyrim:Restore Health|restore health]] for 100 points) * I want to resist the forces of magic. (20% [[Skyrim:Resist Magic|resist magic]] for 60 seconds) * I want to be tougher in battle. (+20 [[Skyrim:Fortify Stamina|stamina]] for 300 seconds) * I want to strengthen my magical skills. (+20 [[Skyrim:Fortify Magicka|magicka]] for 300 seconds) * I want to deal more damage in battle. (+50% to [[Skyrim:Fortify One-handed|one-handed]] damage for 60 seconds) * I want to be better hidden in the shadows. (20% [[Skyrim:Fortify Sneak|harder to detect]] for 60 seconds) You will be given [[Skyrim:The White Phial (item)|The White Phial]], which functions as a potion of the nature you chose. Drinking it moves it to the Miscellaneous section of your items menu as The White Phial (Empty). It refills after 24 hours. Attempting to use the empty phial duplicates it, but only one phial will fill after the time has passed. ==Notes== * Nurelion's dead body will disappear after some time. You can find his remains inside the coffin in the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Windhelm)|Hall of the Dead]]. * After Nurelion is dead, many of the contents of his store will be free for the taking, including many useful ingredients. You can also loot his key to the shop. * If you are on an assignment for the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] involving The White Phial (the shop), complete it and turn it in prior to completing this quest. Nurelion's passing at the end of the quest, though not caused by you, will still trigger you to fail the job for "killing". * It is possible to reach the peak of the Throat of the World early, by using a horse to climb the mountain; however, doing so will not let you start this quest early - you have to advance the main questline in order to get the letter from Quintus Navale. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The courier may fail to deliver the note from Quintus even after you've gained access to the Throat of the World, making this quest unavailable.|USKP|2.0.0}} **{{pc22}}This bug is likely to occur if you have killed the Forsworn leader of Red Eagle Redoubt before (probably during [[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn (quest)|find Red Eagle's sword]]). If so, use the following [[Skyrim:Console|console]] commands: prid 2c9a0 and resurrect 1 to resurrect him. Wait a few real-world minutes then fast travel to any major city and the courier should show up. If the courier still fails to appear, try the command setstage MS12b 10. {{Bug|The courier bearing Quintus' letter may fail to arrive and instead loiter at [[Skyrim:Sarethi Farm|Sarethi Farm]]. Traveling there and speaking to him may start the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}}You may be able to find the courier by using the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command player.moveto 39fb7 to move yourself to him. {{Bug|After you have started the quest, when you pick up a briar heart, the quest may not update, and no option to turn it in will appear when talking to Quintus. This can be caused by already having a briar heart in your inventory when you start this quest.|OSP|1.4.15}} Note that this recurs in Skyrim Special Edition and appears not to be fixed by the Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch (4.1.0) ** Keep the briar heart in your inventory, collect the other two ingredients and use the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command: setstage MS12b 60. {{Bug|The quest may not start if you already have unmelting snow, mammoth tusk powder, or a briar heart in your inventory when attempting to talk to Quintus.|OSP|1.4.15}} {{Bug|If you finish the quest with more than one briar heart in your inventory, the remaining hearts will still be marked as quest items, making them impossible to drop or store.|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} {{Bug|If you already have a briar heart in your inventory before starting the quest, it will not be given to Quintus at the end of the quest; it will not be marked as a quest item immediately, but any briar hearts retrieved later on will become a quest item.|USKP|2.0.1}} **{{pc22}} If you don't want to install the unofficial patch, you can manually reset all of the items' ''quest item'' status through the console command resetquest MS12b, followed by completequest MS12b. {{Bug|Sometimes talking to Quintus will not update the quest, and trying to talk to him again will yield a result of "this person is busy".|vn=1}} **{{pc22}}Use the setstage console command to advance the quest. {{Bug|When you return to Quintus with all three ingredients, there may be no dialogue option to turn them in, meaning you are stuck with an uncompleted quest, the three quest items, and no White Phial.|USKP|2.0.0}} ** This may happen because the [[Skyrim:Mammoth Tusk Powder|Mammoth Tusk Powder]] was not marked as a quest item, allowing you to drop or store it before you brought it to Quintus. If you stored it, retrieve it and talk to Quintus again. ** This can also happen if you've used the briar heart in a potion. Find or buy another and the quest will continue. **{{Pc22}} If you can't retrieve it, you can manually spawn it by using the console command player.additem 6bc10 1. {{Bug|If you have initiated the quest to [[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn (quest)|find Red Eagle's sword]], the same Forsworn Briarheart might be the target of both quests. It will carry both Red Eagle's sword and a briar heart. However, even if you pick up both, it will only complete the Red Eagle quest. You will need to find a different Forsworn camp to complete the briar heart part of this quest.|USKP|2.0.0|An alias on this quest was requiring him to be alive. NOTE: "50" is the objective number NOT the quest stage! {{Bug|It is possible to receive more than one White Phial from Quintus if, after choosing what type of solution you want in the Phial, you quit the conversation and re-initiate it.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After Quintus Navale shows him the Phial, Nurelion suddenly stands up and acts like he's dying, and you can't finish the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}}You can avoid this happening by removing his essential status before Quintus shows him the Phial. Skyrim:Tolfdir the Absent-Minded.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Nephele |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Nephele |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Non-Journal Quests]]{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)|Favors}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] |Reward=30 gold, a [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|Soul Gem]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] |ReqItem=[[Skyrim:Tolfdir's Alembic|Tolfdir's Alembic]] |Difficulty=Easy |Image=SR-item-Tolfdir's Alembic.jpg |ImgDesc=Tolfdir's Alembic |description=Help [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] find his missing [[Skyrim:Tolfdir's Alembic|alembic]]. |ID=MGR01 |Icon= }}{{#addtotrail:Radiant|separator=' / '}} ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note:''' This quest does not appear in your journal. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]]. #Hunt down his missing [[Skyrim:Tolfdir's Alembic|alembic]] in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College]]. #Return to Tolfdir. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Good Old Tolfdir=== Tolfdir is an elderly mage and professor at the College of Winterhold and one of the first people encountered at the college. When you have completed [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] and have begun [[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]] Tolfdir will be residing at the college. If you run across him looking confused, ask him if he needs help. ===Tolfdir's Alembic=== Embarrassed, Tolfdir will admit to misplacing his [[Skyrim:Tolfdir's Alembic|alembic]]. And, while he could indeed use a different one, he has a strange sentimental attachment to this particular piece of equipment. Help the professor out by finding this lost item. The alembic will appear in one of three randomly-selected locations in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Countenance|Hall of Countenance]]: * On the top floor: in the northern room, on top of a barrel to the right of the central dining bench. * On the top floor: underneath the left display case in the enchanting room. * On the bottom floor: on a crate in the eastern room, with the big barrel in it. However, even without the quest being activated, you will run across the alembic numerous times in your wanderings about the college. Simply return the alembic to Tolfdir when you speak to him, and earn the reward each time. Tolfdir will give you thirty gold and an empty petty, lesser or common soul gem for returning his misplaced property. ==Notes== * Finding Tolfdir's Alembic before triggering the quest will not change the quest dialogue or outcome; you can simply start the quest and give the alembic to Tolfdir to receive your reward. * Unlike previous titles where alembics were a major part of [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]], this is the only individual alembic that can be found in the base [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]] game. The [[Skyrim:Farming|Farming]] creation adds a second one in the basement of [[Skyrim:Goldenhills Plantation|Goldenhills Plantation]]. All other alembics in the game are permanently attached to alchemy stations. * Sometimes, the alembic will get dislodged from its normal location, possibly falling behind other objects or onto the ground nearby. * Version 1.0 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] adds journal objectives to this quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Tolfdir may offer the dialogue option that initiates the quest after it has already been completed. Selecting this option will re-add the quest to your journal, but the Alembic will not respawn, leaving the objective permanently stuck in your journal.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Entering the console command player.additem "00026c31" 1 to give yourself a second alembic will allow you to complete the quest by speaking to Tolfdir as normal. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Journal Hidden|;player has accepted quest}} |200|fin| |missing=20 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Loud and Clear.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=SerCenKing |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] |Reward=[[#Reaping the Rewards|Leveled gold]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Taking Care of Business|Taking Care of Business]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Meet the Family|Meet the Family]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Dampened Spirits|Dampened Spirits]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Goldenglow Estate|Goldenglow Estate]] |Image=SR-quest-Loud and Clear.jpg |ImgDesc=Burning beehives at Goldenglow Estate |description=Send a message to a former [[Skyrim:Thieves_Guild_(faction)|Thieves Guild]] client. |ID=TG02 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]]. #''(Optional)'' Speak to [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]]. #''(Optional)'' Enter using the sewer. #Proceed to [[Skyrim:Goldenglow Estate|Goldenglow Estate]]. #''(Optional)'' Obtain the key to Aringoth's safe. #Burn three bee hives. #Open [[Skyrim:Aringoth|Aringoth]]'s safe. #Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Goldenglow Bill of Sale (safe)|Goldenglow Bill of Sale]]. #Return to Brynjolf. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Sweeter than Golden Honey=== Once [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer]] has allowed you into the Guild, he'll challenge you with a new job. [[SR:Goldenglow Estate|Goldenglow Estate]] was once the Guild's sweetest deal. The Guild made sure that the honey flowed constantly to [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]]'s [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Meadery|meadery]] by keeping the workforce in line and scaring off potential competitors. In return it was allowed to extort huge sums of money from [[Skyrim:Aringoth|Aringoth]], the owner. However, the shipments have suddenly ceased and when [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] was sent to investigate she found an army of mercenaries. Maven isn't pleased and it's your job to teach Aringoth a lesson by burning down three bee hives and clearing out his safe. Before leaving, pay Vex a visit and she will tell you about a secret sewer entrance on the northwest side which will make it significantly easier to enter unseen. ===As Loud as an Angry Beehive...=== Your first objective is to burn the beehives, which you can reach in two ways. The simplest route is to wade ashore on the northernmost island, dispatch the numerous mercenaries protecting the estate and then burn the hives. A stealthier solution is to wait until dusk, swim to the rocky outcrop to the west of the beehives and then clamber ashore, hidden by a small wooden wall. [[File:SR-quest-Loud and Clear 03.jpg|thumb|right|The secret sewer entrance leading into the estate]] To set the beehives on fire you can use a [[Skyrim:Torch|torch]], the [[Skyrim:Fire_Breath|Fire Breath]] Shout, or a [[Skyrim:Fire_Damage#Spells|fire-based spell]]; simply standing next to a hive with a torch or spell equipped will suffice. A rapid execution is important as three mercenaries will come rushing to investigate, so quickly burn the three southernmost beehives and then retreat behind the wall. Jump back into the lake and circle around to the northern island. Be careful not to burn more than three beehives, or you will forfeit your gold reward. ===...and as Silent as a Skeever=== Wade ashore underneath the wooden platform on the northwestern end of the island and dive into the sewer grate nearby. The sewer is only inhabited by a few [[Skyrim:Skeever#Skeever|skeevers]], three of which can be taken out by using an oil slick and some fire. About half-way through is an adept-lock cell where you'll find the [[SR:Pickpocket|Pickpocket]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Guide to Better Thieving|Guide to Better Thieving]]''. After leaving that room continue down the corridor and you will find a ladder back to the surface. Climb it and you will resurface next to the back entrance of the estate, which has an expert level lock and lands you in a more favorable location than the front door. Alternatively, you can sneak your way to the front door, which is unlocked, or take out the mercenaries and enter through either door. ===Breaking and Entering=== [[File:SR-item-Queen Bee Statue.jpg|thumb|left|The Queen Bee Statue in Aringoth's quarters]] Inside the estate you will find numerous mercenaries which you can either kill or sneak around. You should eventually arrive at a corridor patrolled by a mercenary while two more sit at a table. Avoid them by sneaking into the nearby dining room and you'll find yourself in front of a gate leading to the basement and a ladder leading to the second floor. Heading upstairs will earn you more loot and you'll be able to take the safe's key off [[Skyrim:Aringoth|Aringoth]]. The first mercenary can be avoided by slipping into a room on the left, traversing it and then moving down the corridor hugging the wall and using a wardrobe to screen you. In the last room, slowly sneak behind the back of a mercenary sitting at a table and pick open the door. Here you will find Aringoth and you can retrieve the safe key by either pickpocketing him, killing him or persuading him to hand it over. You must pass a hard-level [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to persuade Aringoth and, if you fail, he will attack you, alerting the nearby mercenary. There is also a [[SR:Queen Bee Statue|Queen Bee Statue]] on the nightstand next to the bed which can be sold to [[SR:Delvin Mallory|Delvin]]. {{NewLeft}} ===Sweep the Safe=== [[File:SR-quest-Loud and Clear 02.jpg|thumb|right|The safe containing Aringoth's riches]] Whether or not you have the key, unlock the metal gate once the mercenary patrolling the corridor has turned around and enter the basement. Sneak past or dispose of two mercenaries in the first room. Using a spell to set fire to the oil puddle leading up to his chair can aid you with dispatching the last mercenary. If you wish to remain undetected, sneak to the dark corner behind him, shoot an arrow down the corridor and slip away when he charges off to investigate. Alternatively, [[Skyrim:Invisibility (effect)|invisibility]] or the [[SR:Dragon Shouts|dragon shout]] [[Skyrim:Throw Voice|Throw Voice]] will also work. Pick the safe or open it with its key and retrieve the [[SR:Goldenglow Bill of Sale (safe)|Goldenglow Bill of Sale]] and some gold. Before you leave, loot the nearby chest and scoop up some gold purses. A gate will lead you back into the sewers, so exit them and swim away to the shore. ===Reaping the Rewards=== Head back to the guild and talk to Brynjolf. As long as you've completed the job to the letter, he'll be very pleased and reward you with a leveled amount of gold, as detailed below. If you burn more than three beehives, you will not get a reward, with Brynjolf saying, ''"You've made a mess of things and Maven's furious. I told you not to burn more than three of the hives! I've smoothed things over with her for now, but you can forget your cut."'' Either way, he'll also point you to Maven Black-Briar, who has requested you for a special job. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! Levels !! Reward |- |1-5 || 50 |- |6-10 || 100 |- |11-15 || 200 |- |16-20 || 300 |- |21-26 || 400 |- |27-31 || 500 |- |32-36 || 600 |- |37-41 || 700 |- |42+ || 800 |} {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * After speaking with Mercer, three [[Skyrim:Thief Cache|Thief Cache]] barrels will appear around Riften. * If [[Skyrim:Dragon_Rising|Dragon Rising]] has been completed, a leveled [[Skyrim:Dragon|Dragon]] may attack the estate and mercenaries during the mission. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When trying to burn the hives at Goldenglow Estate with a torch or a single-shot fire spell (like Firebolt and Fireball), the hive may not catch on fire the first time and may require that you hit it multiple times before it starts to burn. This may cause Brynjolf to act as if you had burned more than three hives, however, and result in you not getting paid even though you only burned three.|confirmed=1}} **To avoid this, try using the Flames spell as it seems to work more effectively. **You can also alter Brynjolf's reaction by entering the following console command: SetPapyrusQuestVar TG02 pTG02QuestFailure_var 0 before talking to him. {{Bug|If you break into [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]] before this quest is finished, [[Skyrim:Dampened Spirits|Dampened Spirits]] will not become available.|OSP|1.4|However, if this bug has already been triggered on a prior version to Patch 1.4, then the quest will remain unavailable on that save file even with the patch installed.}} {{Bug|If you don't ask Brynjolf why [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]] is requesting a meeting once this quest is finished, [[Skyrim:Dampened Spirits|Dampened Spirits]] will not become available. Also Brynjolf will not speak to you, saying only that he has "important tasks to be doing".|OSP|1.4}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Brynjolf is taking me to meet the leader of the organization he represents. He says more work and significantly more coin could be available if I join their ranks. {{Quest Objective|10|Follow Brynjolf}} |20||Thanks to Brynjolf's support, I've been welcomed into the Thieves Guild by its Guild Master, Mercer Frey. I'm eager to receive my first task and prove that his recommendation wasn't in vain. {{Quest Objective|20|Listen to Mercer Frey}} |30||My first task as a member of the Thieves Guild involves a honey operation located just outside of Riften called Goldenglow Estate. My actions there are in direct response to the owner's sudden silence and lack of cooperation with the Thieves Guild and Maven-Black-Briar, one of the Guild's most important clients. {{Quest Objective|30|Talk to Brynjolf}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Burn three bee hives (/3)}} {{Quest Objective|50|Clear out Aringoth's safe}} |45||{{Quest Objective|45|(Optional) Speak to Vex about Goldenglow Estate}} |50||{{Quest Objective|60|Return to Brynjolf}} |||{{Quest Comment|Displayed after asking Vex for tips; can be displayed either at stage 45 or 50}} {{Quest Objective|47|(Optional) Enter Goldenglow using sewer}} |200|fin|I've completed my task at Goldenglow Estate and discovered the owner's sudden lack of cooperation with the Guild was leveraged by an anonymous buyer of that very same location. Why this buyer purchased Goldenglow and is showing animosity towards the Guild is a mystery for the moment. |||{{Quest Comment|Displayed upon entering Goldenglow Estate main floor; can be displayed at any point during the quest, even before being told to go there}} {{Quest Objective|48|(Optional) Obtain the key to Aringoth's safe}} |missing=0, 15, 35 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Taking Care of Business|Taking Care of Business]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Dampened Spirits|Dampened Spirits]]|Conc=[[Skyrim:Meet the Family|Meet the Family]]}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]].
#Receive  Ulfric's War Axe.
#Go to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and give the axe to Jarl [[Skyrim:Balgruuf_the_Greater|Balgruuf the Greater]].
#Wait for Balgruuf's reply.
#Return to Ulfric.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Gift for a Jarl===
[[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] has decided that it's time to make [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun's]] Jarl [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Balgruuf the Greater]] pick a side. Ulfric hopes to avoid bloodshed in Whiterun, so he'll give you an axe (''Ulfric's War Axe'') and tell you to deliver it to Balgruuf. He has no further message for you to take, as he says that the axe is a gesture between two warriors who understand each other and that Balgruuf will know its meaning.

===Making Up His Mind===
When you speak to Jarl Balgruuf, tell him you have a message from Ulfric. Balgruuf will take the axe, but whether or not the quest proceeds depends on if you've already finished [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] (and its prerequisite quests [[Skyrim:Before the Storm|Before the Storm]] and [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]]). If you've already done Dragon Rising then the quest will continue normally; otherwise Balgruuf will hold on to the axe and postpone making a decision about it until Dragon Rising is complete.

With the time having come to give Ulfric an answer, Balgruuf will discuss the matter with his steward [[Skyrim:Proventus Avenicci|Proventus Avenicci]] and his housecarl [[Skyrim:Irileth|Irileth]]. Balgruuf will state that he's not entirely happy with Imperial policy, but ultimately he'll decide to side with the Empire. He'll give the axe back to you and begin drafting a letter to negotiate with the [[Skyrim:Imperial_Legion|Imperial Legion]] about garrisoning some of their troops in Whiterun.

===The Die is Cast===
Go back to Windhelm and return the axe to Ulfric. He'll be disappointed in Balgruuf's decision, but [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar]] will welcome it; he's ready for battle and eager to launch the assault. After a short conversation, Ulfric will issue orders that initiate the next quest: [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun]].

==Notes==
*If you are on [[Skyrim:The World-Eater's Eyrie|The World-Eater's Eyrie]] quest and [[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]] is still in Dragonsreach, you will not be able to deliver the axe to Jarl Balgruuf.
*If you have not completed [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]] and [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]], you will not be able to deliver the axe to Jarl Balgruuf.
*Completing this quest places Whiterun under siege and makes the city in its normal state unavailable to you until the completion of [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun]].
