{{Featured Article}} {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Alpha Kenny Buddy |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Alpha Kenny Buddy }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Tharstan|Tharstan]] |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Reward=1000 gold pieces
All three words of [[Skyrim:Battle Fury|Battle Fury]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:A New Source of Stalhrim|A New Source of Stalhrim]] |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]], [[Skyrim:Vahlok's Tomb|Vahlok's Tomb]] |Image=SR-interior-Vahlok's Tomb.jpg |ImgDesc=The main chamber of [[Skyrim:Vahlok's Tomb|Vahlok's Tomb]] |ID=DLC2SV01 |description=Travel to [[Skyrim:Vahlok's Tomb|Vahlok's Tomb]] and defeat [[Skyrim:Vahlok the Jailor|Vahlok the Jailor]]. |SuggLevel=30 |notrail=1 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Talk to [[Skyrim:Tharstan|Tharstan]] in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]]. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Vahlok's Tomb|Vahlok's Tomb]] and talk to Tharstan again. # Explore Vahlok's Tomb and find the main burial chamber. # Defeat [[Skyrim:Vahlok the Jailor|Vahlok the Jailor]] and return to Tharstan. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===Tharstan=== [[File:SR-quest-Lost Legacy.jpg|thumb|right|Tharstan packing for the trip]] The small settlement of [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] is inhabited by [[Skyrim:Nord|Nords]] living life the old way, with their own culture and religion, especially the worship of the [[Lore:All-Maker|All-Maker]]. These welcoming and hospitable people let an [[Skyrim:Elder|elderly]] historian and author named [[Skyrim:Tharstan|Tharstan]] live in the village so he could study and document the ancient [[Lore:Skaal|Skaal]] traditions. Using what he learned of Skaal culture, Tharstan wrote ''[[Skyrim:Children of the All-Maker|Children of the All-Maker]]'', and the next book is nearly finished. He also married the Skaal leader [[Skyrim:Fanari Strong-Voice|Fanari Strong-Voice]] and now lives in the largest building in town, the [[Skyrim:Greathall|Greathall]]. After your heroic rescue of [[Skyrim:Baldor Iron-Shaper|Baldor Iron-Shaper]] during the quest [[Skyrim:A New Source of Stalhrim|A New Source of Stalhrim]], Tharstan will decide that you are the right person for a task he has in mind, and will actively seek you out when you next visit the village. As it turns out, Tharstan is not only interested in Skaal traditions, but is equally interested in the many ancient ruins scattered all over [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]], claiming to know most of them well enough to draw a detailed map from memory. However, his recent discovery has left him quite nervous about exploring by himself, so he wants you to accompany him as backup. According to Tharstan, a new passage was unveiled during an earthquake caused by the eruption of [[Lore:Red Mountain|Red Mountain]]. The passage revealed the entrance to [[Skyrim:Vahlok's Tomb|Vahlok's Tomb]]. When you agree to go with him, Tharstan will run off to his temporary home, the Greathall, to pack for the trip, hoping you will meet him there as soon as possible. {{NewLine}} ===A Tomb Uncovered=== [[File:SR-quest-Lost Legacy 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"A sacrifice will bring you closer to that which you seek."'']] Vahlok's Tomb is located south-southeast from [[Skyrim:Thirsk Mead Hall|Thirsk Mead Hall]], directly east from [[Skyrim:Kagrumez|Kagrumez]]. Be sure to stock up on potions and have your best weapons on hand, then take the trip to the tomb. You will find the entrance located at the end of the passage caused by the earthquake. Head down the first tunnel and you will find Tharstan waiting for you. His fascination with the tomb is immediately apparent: ''"Remarkable, isn't it? This tomb has been hidden for... well, who knows how long. Many centuries, I would think."'' He will then proceed to offer you the first task: ''"There are some sealed doors up ahead. Perhaps you can figure out how to get them open."'' He will then guide you down a set of stairs and keep talking: ''"I've had a look around and the only interesting thing I've found is this inscription here, and a switch below it."'' When he arrives at the inscription and the switch he will continue: ''"Now, I'm not sure if you can read the dragon language, but this seems to be a riddle of some sort. 'A sacrifice will bring you closer to that which you seek.' I wonder what it means."'' When you examine the room it soon becomes clear what needs to be done: dead [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] are scattered all around a gigantic burning hole in the floor, with only a grate to keep you from falling down. As per Tharstan's hint, drag (by holding down the "[[Skyrim:Controls#Activate|Activate]]" button) one of the dead draugr onto the grate, then head back up on the podium and activate the handle underneath the inscription. This causes the grate to open and drop the draugr into the flames, acting as the sacrifice needed. While the draugr burns, two entrances in the room will open, one to the north and one to the south. There is a chest in the water west of the cage along with two potions. Jump down in the water from the ledge nearby. {{NewLine}} {{Quest Fork |titleL=Southern Gate |titleR=Northern Gate |imageL=SR-quest-Lost Legacy 03.jpg |imageR=SR-quest-Lost Legacy 04.jpg |imageR2=SR-npc-Tharstan 02.jpg |captionL=''"Perhaps they are connected somehow?"'' |captionR=''"Continue along the path, don't tread where you've been.."'' |captionR2=''"This writing refers to a guardian who inspired both men and dragons."'' |textL=Head down the southern tunnel and open the iron door. This opens a path through the catacombs, where four leveled draugr enemies will rise and attack. If you are not carrying arrows, pick up a few from the draugr archer in this area; you will need them to solve a puzzle later. Head up the stairs to the east and activate the chain. When the door opens, you and Tharstan will arrive in a puzzle room with three pillars surrounding a large central pillar with different colored symbols. Tharstan will immediately head up to a plaque and start reading: ''"Hm... three pillars. Other than that plaque, there doesn't seem to be anything else worthy of note. Let's see what the inscription says. 'All men must die, often by their own means.' Sounds rather grim, if you ask me."'' He will then wander around the room, mumbling: ''"They also have glowing stones of some kind at the top. They look vaguely similar to drawings I've seen of objects called Impact Stones."'' To solve the puzzle, position yourself behind one of the three pillars and perform different attacks, related to the weapons placed on pedestals near the central pillar. Going counter clockwise from the plaque, use a melee attack for pillar one, an archery attack for pillar two, and a magic attack for pillar three. When all three pillars have been activated, the door to the north will open and provide access to the final chamber. Here, two draugr enemies will burst out of their sarcophagi, along with a boss-leveled draugr. After the battle, Tharstan will come rushing in and start to study the chamber, saying: ''"These runes have faded a bit, but I believe I can translate the inscription. The writing describes a guardian who defeated someone named Miraak. In fact, if I'm reading this correctly, it says that Miraak was a traitor. Most interesting."'' Once he is done, he will start looking for an exit, so make sure you loot the boss for the left part of the [[Skyrim:Amethyst Claw, Left Half|Amethyst Claw]] and approach the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] for a word for the dragon shout [[Skyrim:Battle Fury|Battle Fury]]. When you are finished, locate the open sarcophagus and follow the narrow tunnels back to the central chamber. |textR=Head down the northern tunnel and unlock the minor loot chest in the alcove for a bit of treasure. Tharstan suspects that this room contains another puzzle: ''"I expect there's another riddle in here, along with a puzzle. 'Continue along the path, don't tread where you've been..' Interesting..."'' He will then look at the odd stone path in the center of the room and conclude: ''"Well, I'm pretty sure about two things. One, the riddle is most likely referring to these flat square stones. And two, I'm not going anywhere near them."'' With these words, he will find a safe spot and let you handle the rest. The puzzle is quite simple: just go from one square stone to the next, without ever touching one of them twice. Once all nine squares have been pressed down, the way to the final room will open. In there, four draugr enemies and a boss-leveled draugr will immediately attack you while Tharstan runs to safety. After the battle, the old scholar will return to the room and start his studies, saying ''"Look! Here's another wall with dragon language inscriptions on it! Let's find out what's written here. This writing refers to a guardian who inspired both men and dragons. I wonder if the guardian was himself a man or a dragon?"'' Loot the boss for the right half of the [[Skyrim:Amethyst Claw, Right Half|Amethyst Claw]] and approach the word wall for a word for the dragon shout Battle Fury. Lastly, locate the open sarcophagus to the south and follow the narrow tunnels to a chain that, when activated, lowers a stone wall and provides a very quick shortcut back to the central chamber.}} ===The Amethyst Claw=== With the two parts of the Amethyst Claw in hand, it is time to unlock the odd cage in the central chamber. Insert the corresponding claws in the keyholes on each side of the stairs leading to the cage. When the cage opens, your elderly sidekick will jump into the cage and translate the plaque: ''"Here's another riddle. 'Stay your course. To idle is to die.' Well, at least it's straightforward. There appears to be a switch of some kind here. I'll just stand over here while you flip that switch. I'm sure everything will be fine."'' Flip the switch, and several magical platforms will start to emerge and disappear all over the watery area in the chamber, leading to an entrance far away. You will have to follow the platforms while they are present and be on the next platform before the former disappears. When you make it to the other side, the magical platforms will turn into a bridge and Tharstan will be able to join you. ===A Bridge Too Far=== [[File:SR-quest-Lost Legacy 05.jpg|thumb|right|''"I'm glad these platforms appear once you finish them."'']] Head through the corridor and face the next challenge: a gigantic chamber flooded with water and several [[Skyrim:Corrupted Shade|corrupted shades]] lurking below. The drop is a very long one, but luckily a handle is present to create more magical bridges. Activate the handle and follow the bridge as it appears and disappears, landing you on a small alcove. Once again, the platforms will become permanent once you traversed them once, so Tharstan will soon follow, commenting on everything. Yet another magical bridge awaits, and its platforms disappear even faster than before. The last bridge leads to a huge iron door to the north. If you fall down you will not only suffer damage from the fall, but will have to deal with the corrupted shades and locate one of the various shortcuts back to the bridges above. After the last bridge, Tharstan will open the gate leading to the ruins' Hall of Stories, excited as always: ''"Ah, the Hall of Stories. These are found in many ancient Nord tombs. There must be hundreds of years of history etched in these walls. Too bad they seem to be too damaged to read."'' He will then consider the [[Skyrim:Traps#Puzzle Door|puzzle door]]: ''"Hmm...looks like it needs some sort of key. Maybe those half claws you found would fit in here if you put them together?"'' Naturally, he is correct, but the right combination is nowhere to be seen on the claw, so you will have to pay attention to Tharstan as he deciphers the writings on the walls: ''"Perhaps there's enough undamaged text in these etchings to tell us the combination. Ah, yes, here's something. The first one has to do with a breeze, or maybe it's wind. The second one mentions the {{sic|description=extra word|the}} night sky, and the moon. And the third has something to do with fire. It also seems to mention scales."'' He will then ask you to figure out the combination from these small tips. Turn the rings on the door to '''Eagle—Wolf—Dragon''' (In descending order, Eagle on the top, Dragon on the bottom) and insert the amethyst claw in the keyhole. {{NewLine}} ===Vahlok the Jailor=== [[File:SR-quest-Lost Legacy 06.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Vahlok the Jailor|Vahlok the Jailor]]]] The puzzle door will lower to reveal a long staircase leading up to a chain that opens the way to the final chamber. The chamber itself is essentially one big trap, as almost all the tiles on the floor are [[Skyrim:Flame Spout Trap|flame spout traps]]. [[Skyrim:Resist Fire|Fire resistance]] and [[Skyrim:Ward (spells)|Ward]] spells can be extremely useful here, so make sure you prepare before entering. You will not make it far into the room before the legendary dragon priest [[Skyrim:Vahlok the Jailor|Vahlok the Jailor]] bursts out of his sarcophagus and starts to throw high-level fire spells at you, so do your best to fight him and avoid the fire. After the battle, old Tharstan will once again come out of hiding and start studying the word wall: ''"Hmm, here's another mention of the guardian. I can only assume that this is the guardian's tomb we are standing in now. It says that he was loyal, and his reward was an honorable death. Quite fascinating."'' Speak to Tharstan and he will further comment: ''"How amazing! A real Dragon Priest! In all my years as a historian, I never thought I'd see anything like that. I suppose that was Vahlok. He must have had this entire place built for him so that he could maintain his vigil, even beyond death."'' He will then reward you with 1000 gold and tell you that he will stay in the tomb a while longer, for further studying. Before leaving, make sure to loot the remains of Vahlok for a hefty amount of gold and search his boss-leveled chest. Learn the third and final word for the Battle Fury shout, then backtrack all the way to the entrance. == Notes == * The book ''[[Skyrim:The Guardian and the Traitor|The Guardian and the Traitor]]'' details how Vahlok battled the traitor [[Lore:Miraak|Miraak]] back in ancient times, only to see him taken away by [[Skyrim:Hermaeus Mora|Hermaeus Mora]] seconds before defeating him. * If you attempt to read one of the engraved tablets before [[Skyrim:Tharstan|Tharstan]] interprets it for you, you will get a message that you can't understand it. After he reads each one, activating the tablet will show you the text that he read. * It is possible for either you or Tharstan to fall into the fire pit and become stuck. This does not solve the puzzle, and since it does not cause damage, it can cause you to become permanently stuck, and so should be avoided. == Bugs == {{Bug|If the puzzle door does not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Tharstan may fall off the magical bridge.|confirmed=1}} **You can fix this by jumping down and opening the way for him to come back up. **{{pc22}}Tharstan can be transported directly to the player's location via the console commands prid xx018FD0 and moveto player. {{Bug|If Tharstan gets stuck and you reach the puzzle door ahead of him, or if he reaches the puzzle door and you're not with him, he will deliver his speech with the door hints, whether or not you're able to hear it, and he will never repeat it.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The entrance to the tomb may still be covered when you arrive. If this occurs, fast traveling to the Skaal village and back seems to fix the issue.|confirmed=0}} {{Bug|If you activate the handle to start the first bridge before Tharstan reads the inscription, you won't be able to decrypt it.}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||I met Tharstan, a historian living in the Skaal village who discovered the recently-unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested. {{Quest Objective|10|Travel to Vahlok's Tomb}} |20||I met Tharstan, a historian living in the Skaal village who discovered the recently-unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested. {{Quest Objective|20|Talk to Tharstan}} |30||I arrived at the old tomb to find Tharstan waiting for me. He was eager to start exploring the place, and he asked me to lead the way. First, I need to figure out how to open the doors in the main chamber. Once that's done, we can explore the tunnels beyond. {{Quest Objective|30|Explore Vahlok's Tomb}} |40||I met Tharstan, a Nord from the Skaal village who discovered an old Draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. After we discovered a pair of Word Walls, as well as two pieces of an ancient claw, we gained entry into a sealed chamber. Tharstan's translations suggest that we'll find a Dragon Priest's sarcophagus nearby. {{Quest Objective|40|Find the main burial chamber}} |45||{{Quest Objective|45|Defeat Vahlok}} |50||I met Tharstan, a Nord from the Skaal village who discovered an old Draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. Inside, we found the tomb of a Dragon Priest left behind long ago to guard against a traitor from his own order. {{Quest Objective|50|Talk to Tharstan}} |200|fin|I met a historian named Tharstan in Skaal village and he hired me to help him explore an old tomb he'd discovered. Skyrim:Mightier than the Sword.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy= |checkedBy= |reward= |rewardChecked= }}{{CC Header|Alternative Armors - Dwarven Plate}}{{Trail2|Alternative Armors - Dwarven Plate|Quests|nocat=1}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Giver=''[[Skyrim:Looter's Note|Looter's Note]]'', [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]], [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]], [[Skyrim:Reachwind Eyrie|Reachwind Eyrie]] |Reward= |Prev= |Next= |Image=SR-place-Reachwind Eyrie.jpg |Imgdesc=Reachwind Eyrie |description=Track down some Dwarven loot and beat the competition. |ID=ccBGSSSE061_Quest |Mod=[[Skyrim:Alternative Armors - Dwarven Plate|Alternative Armors - Dwarven Plate]] }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]][[Category:Skyrim-Alternative Armors - Dwarven Plate]][[Category:Skyrim-Creation Club-Quests]] ==Quick Walkthrough== #Read [[SR:Looter's Note|Looter's Note]] in [[SR:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] of Markarth #Search the tower at [[SR:Reachwind Eyrie|Reachwind Eyrie]]. #Pick up the leftover loot. ==Detailed Walkthrough== This quest can be started by heading to the [[SR:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] within [[SR:Markarth|Markarth]]. Go inside and find the ''[[Skyrim:Looter's Note|Looter's Note]]'' left by a patron upon the bar counter. Now head to [[SR:Reachwind Eyrie|Reachwind Eyrie]], a Dwemer tower southeast of Markarth and northeast of [[SR:Dushnikh Yal|Dushnikh Yal]]. Upon arrival, three [[SR:Looter|Looter]]s will begin attacking. Go inside the tower and go up the steps. At the top will be the body of dead Dark Elf named [[Skyrim:Casival|Casival]]. Loot him to find a copy of ''[[Skyrim:The_Crimson_Dirks,_v9|The Crimson Dirks, v9]]''. On the table and ground you will find the two pieces of [[Skyrim:Dwarven#Dwarven_Plate_Armor|Dwarven Plate Armor]] and ''[[Skyrim:Casival's Note|Casival's Note]]''. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The Looter's note may be clipped into the bar.}} **Using a spell that has knockback seems to work. For example, Fire Storm, Elemental Burst and Fireball may work. The illusion spell Harmony also works if you do not want to kill the patrons or make them hostile to you. {{Bug|If you have already visited Reachwind Eyrie and picked up the Dwarvern Plate armor, you will not be able to complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Dropping it back in Reachwind Eyrie before activating the quest prevents this. **If you have already activated the quest, are in Reachwind Eyrie, and the Armor is now marked as a quest item try the console command: drop xx027800 1 (where xx is the load order - usually fe) then pick up the armor. **Re-acquiring the Dwarven Plate armor in Reachwind Eyrie, through a trade can also fix the quest. **{{pc22}}If you've already sold the Dwarven Plate Armor or the above suggestions do not work, you can force completion by using the console command: SetStage ccBGSSSE061_quest 1000 **Once completed the Dwarven Plate Boots will no longer be marked as quest items. {{Bug|Looters and bandit around and in the Reachwind Eyrie may not spawn upon reaching the area or heading into the tower making it impossible to complete the quest.}} {{Bug|The two quest armor pieces have strange weight behaviors. At one lb. under max weight, picking up the Plate Armor caused no apparent change in weight carried. Picking up the Boots caused the weight from the Armor to be "noticed", but despite now being 44 lbs. overweight, movement speed was unaffected.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Inns across Skyrim are typically a good place to find work. Should I find myself in Markarth, I should stop by the Silver-Blood Inn and see if I can't come across any news or rumors. {{Quest Objective|10|Investigate the Silver-Blood Inn for rumors}} |20||Inns across Skyrim are typically a good place to find work. I found a note left by a patron at the Silver-Blood Inn that mentions some decent loot might be found at Reachwind Eyrie to the south. {{Quest Objective|20|Search the tower at Reachwind Eyrie}} |30||Inns across Skyrim are typically a good place to find work. I found a note left by a patron at the Silver-Blood Inn that mentioned some decent loot might be found at Reachwind Eyrie to the south. When I arrived, I was attacked by three looters. At the top of the tower, I found the body of a bandit. {{Quest Objective|30|Pick up the leftover loot}} |1000|fin|Inns across Skyrim are typically a good place to find work. I found a note left by a patron at the Silver-Blood Inn that mentioned some decent loot might be found at Reachwind Eyrie to the south. When I arrived, I was attacked by three looters. At the top of the tower, I found the body of a bandit and pieces of Dwarven Plate armor. |missing=40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

Skyrim:Onmund's Request.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=DragonFire |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)|Favors|link3=Favors|Radiant}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Onmund|Onmund]] |Reward=Onmund's friendship and availability as follower/spouse |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Onmund|Onmund]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] |Conc= |ReqItem=[[Skyrim:Grand Staff of Charming|Grand Staff of Charming]] |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] |Image=SR-quest-Onmund's Request.jpg |ImgDesc=Onmund's Amulet |description=Help [[Skyrim:Onmund|Onmund]] negotiate the return of a family amulet from [[Skyrim:Enthir|Enthir]]. |ID=MGRAppOnmund01 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png |Radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak with [[Skyrim:Onmund|Onmund]]. # Speak with [[Skyrim:Enthir|Enthir]]. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Grand Staff of Charming|Grand Staff of Charming]] from a random location. # Return the staff to Enthir. # Return the amulet to Onmund. ==Detailed Walkthrough== By now, you will have gotten to know [[Skyrim:Onmund|Onmund]], the friendly and singular [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] at the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. He has traded his family amulet to [[Skyrim:Enthir|Enthir]] but now regrets his decision. Onmund will not tell you what he traded the amulet for, but asks for your help in getting his property back. Speak with Enthir about this. Enthir offers you a deal: he will trade the amulet if you retrieve the [[Skyrim:Grand Staff of Charming|Grand Staff of Charming]] from a certain location. The randomly selected location will usually include a boss-level caster foe guarding a chest containing the staff. To complete the quest, retrieve the staff and return it to Enthir, who will in turn give you Onmund's amulet. Return the amulet to Onmund who will be grateful. The only reward for completing the quest is Onmund's friendship; once you return his amulet, he becomes available as a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]], as well as a potential candidate for [[Skyrim:Marriage|marriage]]. Possible staff locations are: {{#local:sep|
}}{{Hold List |eastmarch= {{LinkList|Ansilvund|Cragwallow Slope|Mara's Eye Pond|Morvunskar}} |falkreath= {{LinkList|Bloodlet Throne|Brittleshin Pass|Falkreath Watchtower|Haemar's Shame|Ilinalta's Deep|Shriekwind Bastion|Southfringe Sanctum|Sunderstone Gorge}} |haafingar= {{LinkList|Northwatch Keep|Pinemoon Cave|Potema's Catacombs|Wolfskull Cave}} |hjaalmarch={{LinkList|Movarth's Lair}} |reach= {{LinkList|Harmugstahl}} |rift= {{LinkList|Boulderfall Cave|[[Skyrim:Redwater Den|Redwater Den]]{{DG}}}} |whiterun= {{LinkList|Broken Fang Cave|Fellglow Keep|[[Skyrim:Moldering Ruins|Moldering Ruins]]{{DG}}}} |winterhold={{LinkList|Hob's Fall Cave|Yngvild}} }} ==Notes== * With a sufficiently high [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill or the [[Skyrim:Amulet of Articulation|Amulet of Articulation]], Enthir can be persuaded to just return the amulet. * Onmund's Amulet might be a different material, depending on the level you do this quest: such as a plain gold necklace, a silver emerald necklace, etc. * It is possible to keep the Grand Staff of Charming for yourself by placing it on a weapon rack before returning to Enthir to trade it in for Onmund's Amulet. After obtaining the amulet, you can safely retrieve the staff from the weapon rack and do as you please with it. * Unlike a few other (not College of Winterhold affiliated) quests which NPCs ask you to retrieve jewelry, you cannot take back Onmund's Amulet from him once you turn it in, via any means (pickpocketing, etc.). It vanishes from the game as soon as you hand it over to him. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You cannot speak to Enthir about the quest if [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] quest is active.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If the staff is found before starting the quest, it will have weight, and cannot be removed from your inventory. The quest will not show an icon on the map and dialogue options are not available to return the staff to Enthir. To fix these issues, equip the staff, and activate a weapon rack. An icon will then appear, hinting to pick up the staff. Picking up the staff will update the quest journal, directing you to return the staff to Enthir.|OSP|1.4}} **This does not always work on Xbox One; even using the weapon rack trick will not fix the problem. **{{pc22}} The console command setstage MGRAppOnmund01 30 will allow you to advance. Also, if you successfully persuade Enthir to give back the amulet and complete the quest, the staff is no longer considered a quest item and can be dropped/stored/sold normally. ** If the quest has been taken, equip the staff, open console and type player.drop 00029B91 1. The staff will be dropped, and the quest continues as normal. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Onmund has asked me to help him get an amulet with sentimental value back from Enthir. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak with Enthir}} |20||Enthir insists that Onmund sold him the amulet in question, and he will not go back on a trade. If, however, I can recover a particular staff for Enthir, he'll give me the amulet. I'll need to search for the staff. {{Quest Objective|20|Find the staff for Enthir}} |30||I have found the staff that Enthir wanted, and need to deliver it to him so that he'll exchange it for Onmund's amulet. {{Quest Objective|30|Deliver the staff to Enthir}} |40||Enthir agreed to return Onmund's amulet to him, and has given it to me. I need to make sure it gets back to Onmund. {{Quest Objective|40|Deliver the amulet to Onmund}} |200|fin|Onmund is grateful that I was able to deal with Enthir and return his amulet. |255|fail| }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:No Stone Unturned.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= Quest received upon finding the first "Unusual Gem". |Reward=[[Skyrim:Prowler's_Profit|Prowler's Profit]] |Loc= [[Skyrim:Skyrim (place)|Skyrim]] |Image=SR-item-Crown_of_Barenziah.jpg |ImgDesc=The Crown of Barenziah restored |description=Find the [[Skyrim:Unusual_Gem|24 gems]] to restore the Crown of Barenziah. |ID=TGCrownMisc, TGCrown |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |SuggLevel=18 (for the final part) }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Find one of the 24 "[[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|Unusual Gem]]s" scattered throughout Skyrim. # Become a full member of the Thieves Guild (if not one already). # Have the gem appraised by [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] at [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Collect the remaining stones of a full set and return to Vex. # Retrieve the Crown of Barenziah and return to Vex. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-No Stone Unturned.jpg|thumb|right|An Unusual Gem]] ===What Do We Have Here?=== In your travels about Skyrim, you will come upon an ornate jewel (one of twenty-four spread across Skyrim) called an [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem#Unusual Gem|Unusual Gem]]. Subsequent actions after you acquire one of these gems depends on your membership status with the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]]. ====Not a Member of the Thieves Guild==== If you are not a member of the Thieves Guild, picking up the first Unusual Gem you encounter will activate the miscellaneous quest objective: ''"Bring the Unusual Gem to an appraiser"''. Depending on your past travels and interactions, following your objective marker will likely take you to [[Skyrim:Maul|Maul]], a [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] [[Skyrim:CombatThief|thief]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. If you have not yet spoken with Maul, he will seek you out with some unsolicited advice. After the conversation, ask him what he knows about the gem. He will tell you that you need to show it to [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] of the Thieves Guild, to find out what the gem is worth. Maul will also tell you that to get to Vex, you must first become a member of the Thieves Guild. If you press for information on the guild, you will be told to find [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] in Riften's marketplace. You can find him as suggested, or in the [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|Bee and Barb]] at night. Talking to him will activate the quest [[Skyrim:A Chance Arrangement|A Chance Arrangement]], which is the first step towards becoming a member of the Guild. Once you have access to [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]], seek out Vex for her appraisal of the gem. She will tell you that it is one of twenty-four stones that were pried from the [[Skyrim:Crown_of_Barenziah#Crown_of_Barenziah|crown]] of [[Lore:Barenziah|Queen Barenziah]] by a thief in an attempt to cover his tracks, and that only the complete set of twenty-four stones would be worth anything. If Maul does not tell you to find Brynjolf, you can seek him out yourself. ====Already a Member of the Thieves Guild==== If you are a full member of the Thieves Guild when you pick up the first stone, the quest is immediately activated with the objective: ''"Bring the Unusual Gem to Vex in the Thieves Guild"''. Find Vex in The Ragged Flagon. She will tell you that it is one of twenty-four stones that were pried from the crown of Queen Barenziah by a thief in an attempt to cover his tracks. She will further inform you that the stone is worthless on its own, but that if you can find the other twenty-three, the collection would be worth a substantial sum. ===Finding the Gems=== After showing the Unusual Gem to Vex, the gems are renamed "Stones of Barenziah," and will appear as such in your inventory when in your possession. You must now find all twenty-four stones. You'll need to complete some other tasks before you have access to all locations where the gems are to be found: * Begin the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood questline]] or start the [[Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!|Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!]] quest. * Purchase [[Skyrim:Proudspire Manor|Proudspire Manor]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. (25,000 gold) * Join the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]] by completing [[Skyrim:First Lessons|First Lessons]]. You must also start [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] and progress at least to the point where Tolfdir tells you to speak with the Arch-Mage; until this point, the Arch-Mage's Quarters are locked behind an inaccessible door. Aside from those, most other gems can actually be obtained at any point in the game. Many are located in places that you will be sent to during other quests, so you may want to consider getting the stone concurrently with the quest. The stones are located in the following places: {| class="wikitable sortable striped" ! Location !class=unsortable| Notes !Related Quest !RefID |- | [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] ([[:File:SR-place-WhiterunCatacombs StoneLocation.jpg|image]]) | [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Whiterun)|Hall of the Dead]] ([[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]). Inside the Catacombs; go down the left stairs and it will be to your left, next to a skeleton. | [[Skyrim:Andurs' Arkay Amulet|Andurs' Arkay Amulet]] | {{ID|0007f956}} |- | [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]† ([[:File:SR-place-Dragonsreach StoneLocation.jpg|image]]) | [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]], the Jarl's bedroom, on the right-hand end table. | [[Skyrim:Imitation Amnesty|Imitation Amnesty]] | {{ID|0007f95d}} |- | [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]† ([[:File:SR-place-Jorrvaskr StoneLocation.jpg|image]]) | [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]]'s living quarters, on the bookshelf in Kodlak's room. | [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]] | {{ID|0007f923}} |- | [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]† ([[:File:SR-place-BluePalace StoneLocation.jpg|image]]) | [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]], Jarl's bedroom, right side of the bed on top of the wardrobe. | | {{ID|0007f926}} |- | [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] ([[:File:SR-place-ProudspireManor (before) StoneLocation.jpg|image]]/
[[:File:SR-place-ProudspireManor (after) StoneLocation.jpg|image]]) | [[Skyrim:Proudspire Manor|Proudspire Manor]]. You must first purchase the house for a hefty sum of 25,000 coins. The stone is found on the top floor in the master bedroom, on top of the wardrobe behind the door. (It's there with or without the bedroom upgrade.) | [[Skyrim:The Man Who Cried Wolf|The Man Who Cried Wolf]] and [[Skyrim:Elisif's Tribute|Elisif's Tribute]] | {{ID|0007fb3a}} |- | [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]† ([[:File:SR-place-MistveilKeep StoneLocation.jpg|image]]) | [[Skyrim:Mistveil Keep|Mistveil Keep]], Jarl's bedroom. Go up the stairs and through the locked center door. ===Recovering the Crown=== [[File:SR-quest-No_Stone_Unturned2.jpg|thumb|Find the Crown within Tolvald's Cave]] Show Vex the full set of Stones, and she will have you travel to [[Skyrim:Tolvald's Cave|Tolvald's Cave]] to retrieve the Crown of Barenziah. The cave is three layers deep, and crawling with Falmer, so be sure to prepare yourself. When approaching the crown, three hostile Dunmer Ghosts will appear and attack. After returning with the Crown, you will receive the permanent effect [[Skyrim:Gems#Prowler's Profit|Prowler's Profit]], which significantly increases the chance of finding gems in randomized containers. ==Notes== *If you enter Tolvald's Cave without having spoken to Vex about having all the gems, the area where the crown is found will be blocked off by rubble. This will cause you to have to return to Vex and then travel all the way through the cave again to find the crown. *The gems that will be marked as stolen may say "steal" instead of "take" when acquiring them; in this case, they will still be marked as stolen and if you're caught taking them, you will be reported. This has been partially modified in the [[Skyrim:Special Edition|Special Edition]]; see [[#Bugs|bugs]] for details. *If your game is prior to [[Skyrim:Patch|Patch]] 1.4 and you haven't recovered the stone from within the [[Skyrim:Thalmor Embassy|Thalmor Embassy]], there are multiple workarounds detailed on the location page. *There are no quest markers for the stones, so unless you intend to find all the stones by chance, it may be best to print out a list of their locations and cross each one off as you find it. *It is impossible to remove this quest from your list without joining the Thieves Guild; if you don't want to do that, you may be better off ignoring any Unusual Gems you come across, as they have no other use in the game and cannot be removed from your inventory without Vex. *The stone in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary is not generated by the game until either of the related quest lines is started. *Text in the game code suggests that you were originally supposed to see Tonilia about the gems. The dialogue about buying the gems would have made much more sense in that context. *Unlike loose gems (such as amethysts, rubies, etc.), the Stones are immovable where they are placed in the environment, so you don't have to worry about them getting knocked off and lost in the game world. *With the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on, the draugrs in each blue ice deposit at the [[Skyrim:Stalhrim Source|Stalhrim Source]] and all other blue [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|Stalhrim]] deposits on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]] will have up to 5 gems, usually of flawless quality once the quest is finished. *Version 2.0.9 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] removes the objective to "Become a full member of the Thieves Guild" from your journal once you speak to Vex about the unusual gems. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you gather all 24 stones before getting Vex to identify them it won't advance to the stage where you need to turn them back in to her and your journal will still say to recover the gems (24/24).|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} **{{Pc22}} To fix this, type these console commands: setobjectivecompleted TGCrown 20 1, followed by setstage TGCrown 30. {{Bug|The ''Prowler's Profit'' may not appear in the Active Effects menu, but it should still be in effect.|USKP|1.3.0}} {{Bug|Although the prompt to collect the Unusual Gems says "take" in the [[Skyrim:Special Edition|Special Edition]], NPCs may still report you if you're caught and you'll get a [[Skyrim:Crime|bounty]] for theft if that is the case.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The activator script for the Unusual Gems generates a script error and is unable to trigger the theft alarm due to a bad use of linked references.}} {{Bug|Once you've learned that these ''Unusual Gems'' are actually ''Stones of Barenziah'' any new stones will no longer stack in your inventory, previously collected stones will stack when presented to Vex however.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Repeatedly pressing the activate button while picking up a Stone may shortcut this quest. Your inventory will only increase by one Stone, but your quest progress will increase by more than one, allowing you to return to Vex and move onto recovering the Crown before visiting all 24 Stone locations. This is most easily performed with all the words of Slow Time.|confirmed=1}} **You can also repeatedly and quickly press the activate button while slowly approaching a gem; this will work if you haven't yet learned a word for the Slow Time shout or haven't yet reached the stage in the main questline where you can learn shouts. {{Bug|Sometimes the gems that are supposed to be in [[Skyrim:Fellglow Keep|Fellglow Keep]] and [[Skyrim:Pinewatch|Pinewatch]] Sanctuary don't appear and will prevent progress with the quest.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Type the following three commands into the console for a workaround: set TGCrownGemsFound to 24; set TGCrownGemsTotal to 24; setstage TGCrown 30. This will not update the journal entry with the correct number of gems found but it will unlock Vex's dialogue to proceed with the quest. {{Bug|The finished crown has 25 stones in it, even though only 24 exist. When found without the stones, all 25 of the crown's slots are empty.|USKP|2.0.6}} {{Bug|The [[Skyrim: Dunmer_Ghost|Dunmer Ghosts]] in [[Skyrim:Tolvald's_Cave|Tolvald's Cave]] may become hostile to each other due to an improper faction setup.|USKP|2.1.0}} {{Bug|There's a chance only a single male [[Skyrim: Dunmer_Ghost|Dunmer Ghost]] shows up by the crown and that it's not hostile. He can also be pickpocketed for an [[Skyrim:Elven_Shield|Elven Shield]].|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|If you've angered Maul, he will not speak with you about the Unusual Gem, even though he's the quest target.|confirmed=1}} ** As noted in the text, this can be bypassed by simply joining the Thieves Guild and ignoring Maul. {{Bug|You may collect all 24 stones but the journal entry may say you have 23 and only 23 may show in your inventory.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=No Stone Unturned Misc Handler |id=TGCrownMisc |10||{{Journal Hidden|I've found an unusual gem which seems to exhibit magical properties. Your journal will inform you that you must find [[Skyrim:Madanach|Madanach]], also known as the King in Rags, to help clear your name. Head through the gate, walk down the wooden platform, and talk to miner [[Skyrim:Uraccen|Uraccen]] who is sitting by the fire. Uraccen will say that you won't be able to speak with Madanach unless you can get past his bodyguard [[Skyrim:Borkul the Beast|Borkul the Beast]]. Uraccen can entertain you with a story of one of Borkul's exploits before you go speak with him. Borkul is guarding one of the three gates in this room. When you ask him to see Madanach, he tells you that the toll for entry is a [[Skyrim:Shiv|shiv]]. As alternatives to his request, you can brawl with him, intimidate or persuade him, or pickpocket the key from him. {{NewLeft}} {| class="wikitable" !width=20%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | I don't have a shiv.||colspan=4|Then find one. If you want to keep the shiv, then you can still attempt the alternatives to completing Borkul's request. You can pickpocket an additional bottle of [[Skyrim:skooma|skooma]] from [[Skyrim:Duach|Duach]] and bribe Borkul with it. Alternately, you can also start a battle with the Forsworn prisoners (attack anyone but Grisvar). This locks you into killing Madanach, as he becomes hostile. This fight can be difficult; you have no armor, no enchantments, and your only non-conjured weapons are pickaxes and possibly shivs, though you can still use any magic or powers that you may possess. Once you've won, loot the key off Borkul's body and proceed to kill Madanach per the next section. {{NewLeft}} ===The King in Rags=== [[File:SR-quest-No One Escapes Cidhna Mine 02.jpg|thumb|right|Planning to escape]] Once you get past the Orc, you will see Madanach sitting at a desk. He will direct some disparaging remarks at you regarding your predicament, and ask you what you want. Here, you can take one of two paths: take your revenge, or find your answers. If you seek revenge, you can kill Madanach here (or at any time) and then escape on your own. If you want a fair fight, you can tell him you plan to kill him; otherwise, just attack him. Attacking him will make all of the other prisoners hostile (except Grisvar), but as long as they are out of range, they will not rush in to join the fight. Search Madanach's body for a key and a [[Skyrim:Madanach's Note|note]], then unlock the gate and exit the prison. If you seek answers instead, Madanach will direct you to [[Skyrim:Braig|Braig]], another prisoner, to hear his story of injustice. After you have convinced Braig to tell his story, return to Madanach. You will see a different side of Madanach, and the horrors that drive his purpose. He tells you he wants to return to the war and will help you escape as well, but only if you prove your loyalty to him by killing Grisvar the Unlucky. If you gave your shiv to Borkul, you can get a new one from Madanach at this point. Find Grisvar and kill him. If you tell him that, ''"Madanach says hello"'', Grisvar will eventually become hostile and the other inmates will attack him. Once he's dead, return to Madanach, who will declare you an honorary member of the Forsworn and lead the prisoners to the escape tunnel. ===Escape=== [[File:SR-quest-No One Escapes Cidhna Mine 03.jpg|thumb|left|Fighting for freedom]] After a short speech, follow Madanach and the Forsworn through the tunnel to [[Skyrim:Markarth Ruins|Markarth Ruins]]. You will encounter a pair of [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]], then one or two [[Skyrim:Dwarven Sphere|Dwarven Sphere]]s as you make your way through the ruins. If you're on your own, you can sneak off the bridge onto the floor below, as fighting alone will be quite difficult without any of your normal equipment. Once past the automatons, continue through the ruins until you reach a short tunnel that leads to a door to Markarth. Thonar will return your equipment and give you the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Family Ring|Silver-Blood Family Ring]] if you are on your own and have killed Madanach when you exit the gates. If you sided with Madanach, a Forsworn woman named [[Skyrim:Kaie|Kaie]] will be there to return your confiscated goods and give you the [[Skyrim:Armor of the Old Gods|Armor]], [[Skyrim:Boots of the Old Gods|Boots]], [[Skyrim:Gauntlets of the Old Gods|Gauntlets]], and [[Skyrim:Helmet of the Old Gods|Helmet of the Old Gods]]. The Forsworn will all equip their own gear and run out. When you follow them through the door, you will emerge into a standoff between the Forsworn and [[Skyrim:Thonar Silver-Blood|Thonar Silver-Blood]], accompanied by a [[Skyrim:Markarth City Guard|Markarth City guard]]. After a short conversation, Madanach and the Forsworn will attack and kill Thonar, then fight their way through the rest of the city guard to the gates. Note that some of the townsfolk may be hostile to the Forsworn and can be killed during the breakout. Once outside the city walls, Madanach and any remaining Forsworn will then run to [[Skyrim:Druadach Redoubt|Druadach Redoubt]] where they will take up permanent residence. Madanach's Forsworn at Druadach Redoubt will remain friendly to you if you sided with him, although all other encampments will still be hostile. No matter which approach you used, you will be pardoned. {{NewLeft}} ==Reactions== The following Markarth residents will react once the quest is finished, with different comments depending on if you helped Madanach and his men escape or killed Madanach and escaped alone: {| class="wikitable" !Name !Dialogue (sided with Madanach) !Dialogue (killed Madanach) |- |[[Skyrim:Hathrasil|Hathrasil]] |''"You escaped Cidhna Mine? Thank you."'' |} ==Notes== * Ironically, Cidhna Mine is escaped through a large, extremely visible hole in the wall that leads straight to Markarth. The Markarth guards, however, seem to be fairly aware of it, since the path exits out right into the hands of the owner of the mine himself, accompanied by guards, who were waiting. * During the quest, the veins in the mine don't produce silver ore, regardless of how long they are mined, and unlike other veins, the mining animation proceeds forever. * With the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] add-on, you can summon the [[Skyrim:Dremora Butler|Dremora Butler]] and gain early equipment that way as well. * It is possible to obtain both the Armor of the Old Gods and the Silver-Blood Family Ring. ** Side with Madanach and stall him in the escape tunnels after receiving the Armor of the Old Gods. When the other Forsworn run outside, you can kill him and loot his key. Head outside and kill the other Forsworn, then return to Madanach's corpse in order to get his note. You can then exit the ruins again and talk to Thonar in order to receive the ring. ** You can also attack and kill the Forsworn while still in the tunnels. Once you exit, [[Skyrim:Thonar Silver-Blood|Thonar]] will give you the Silver-Blood Family Ring. If Thonar does not approach you to initiate dialogue and give you the ring, the quest may not progress as intended. To fix that, go back to the ruin, then exit to Markarth again. This should trigger Thonar’s approach and allow the quest to finish. * It is possible to escape the mine after completing the related quest. Usually, the body of Grisvar the Unlucky still remains, so if you keep Borkul's and Madanach's keys you can return through the escape route used in the above mission, plant the keys (and some items to help in combat) on the body and escape. ** You'll still be considered a prisoner if you escape this way, and sound effects that are triggered when you pick up or equip items, may not play. Certain quest items found in containers, such as [[Skyrim:Balmora Blue|Balmora Blue]], may also fail to spawn. * This quest counts towards the [[Skyrim:Sideways|Sideways]] [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] regardless of whether you choose to help or kill Madanach. ** Escaping from Cidhna Mine during this quest does '''not''' add to your "Jail Escapes" statistic, nor will it grant you the [[Skyrim:Wanted#Achievements|Wanted]] achievement. It '''does''', however, add to your "Times Jailed" statistic. * You can smuggle your equipment into the jail in advance either by pets, reverse-pickpocketing [[Skyrim:Urzoga gra-Shugurz|Urzoga gra-Shugurz]], or with the [[Skyrim:Powers#Secret Servant|Secret Servant]] acquired from the [[Skyrim:Black Book (book)|Black Book]] ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Untold Legends (book)|Untold Legends]]''. * Escaping with Madanach and his followers can lead to the unintended deaths of several non-essential NPCs as you make your way through Markarth itself. ** You can skip to the end of the quest and avoid the potential massacre completely by fast traveling away from Markarth once you've escaped the ruins. You'll need to do this quickly and/or stealthily, before the city guards can become hostile to you and thereby prevent you from fast traveling; you can still complete the quest later by speaking to Madanach after he gets out of the city. ** Alternatively, wait until midnight before heading out, when most citizens will be indoors and away from the fight. ** [[Skyrim:Vigilant Tyranus|Vigilant Tyranus]], required for the quest [[Skyrim:The House of Horrors|The House of Horrors]], will never sleep and is always present on the streets of Markarth before his quest is started. He will thus attempt to attack the Forsworn, and as he is essential but weak, he can get stuck in a fight and thus cause the battle to last much longer than necessary. It is advised to begin his quest in order to remove him from the streets. * The inhabitants of Cidhna Mine are all scripted to die if you decide to kill Madanach in his cell and escape from the mine alone. * If you kill Madanach in his cell and then immediately return to the main area of the mine, the other prisoners will be hostile towards you and attack on sight. * The [[Skyrim:Markarth Ruins|Markarth Ruins]] remain accessible after this quest; however you cannot sneak back into the mine this way as the way back into Madanach's cell is closed off. * If you side with Madanach, he gives you all your non-quest items at the exit of the ruin. You will receive all your quest items '''''after''''' Madanach has finished his dialogue with Thonar and started fighting. If you side with Thonar, he gives you all your items at once after the conversation with him is finished. ** When your inventory is returned to you, it will include any stolen items that you were carrying when you began the quest. This is unlike going to jail normally, where the guards [[Skyrim:Crime#Stolen Items|permanently confiscate your stolen items]] and do not give them back at the end of your sentence. ** Once either Madanach or Thonar returns your items to you, the residents of Markarth will act as if you sided with that person in dialogue, regardless of whether or not you killed them after receiving your items. * Despite being members of the Forsworn, Borkul the Beast, Braig, Duach, Grisvar the Unlucky, Kaie, Madanach, Odvan, and Uraccen don't belong to the Forsworn Faction in the game's files. This is because the Forsworn Faction is flagged to immediately be hostile to you at all times. Instead, they belong to the Cidhna Mine Prisoner Faction, and if you side with Madanach, the surviving members are later assigned to the Druadach Redoubt Faction. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you are doing one of [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin's]] and/or [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex's]] [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Special Job Quests|special jobs]], and you trigger this quest before you report back to them, you will be told you failed the Thieves Guild quest when you return to them, because you were arrested.|OSP|vn=1}} {{Bug|Killing the guards in the mine before starting this quest can potentially block quest progression.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|Borkul the Beast cannot be intimidated due to the confidence level bug.|USKP|2.0.5|His confidence value has been lowered one notch to "Brave" instead of "Foolhardy"}} {{Bug|During the quest, Urzoga was supposed to respond differently when you ask about when you will be released; however, the quest stages are set up incorrectly, so the line will never be heard: ''"You won't. The Jarl has ordered a life sentence for you. Get comfortable in the dark, 'cause you'll never see the sun again."''|USKP|2.0.2}} {{Bug|Any of the prisoners killed may not get their bodies removed correctly due to their alias in the DialogueCidhnaMine quest not getting cleared.|USKP|2.0.9}} {{Bug|Some of the Forsworn in Cidhna Mine are not properly killed when siding with Thonar due to still being locked in protected aliases.|USKP|3.0.7}} {{Bug|If you start the process to escape Cidhna Mine but turn on Madanach while in the ruins, the control quest MS02EscapeMadanachEnding is never terminated, which results in Thonar hanging around outside the ruins indefinitely.|USLEEP|3.0.7}} ** To fix this, enter setstage MS02EscapeMadanachEnding 100 {{Bug|Thonar's arrival outside the ruins could be delayed due to a control quest checking for the wrong location starting up. The delay was sometimes significant enough that he could be missed entirely and leave the quest stuck.|USSEP|4.1.3}} {{Bug|Getting thrown into Cidhna Mine may disable all sound effects for picking up items or transferring them between inventories. This should turn back to normal after the quest is completed, but can persist even after completion.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you kill Madanach and escape by yourself, Thonar may attack you on sight. Due to him still being marked as essential at this point, you won't be able to kill him.|confirmed=1}} **To fix this, either cast a [[Skyrim:Calm|Calm]] spell on him, or leave the location for 24 and return to the escape exit point. Thonar should be calm and ready to talk. {{Bug|You are able to smuggle outside weapons into the prison during the quest. To do this, you must [[Skyrim:Controls|hotkey]] the equipment before entering the Shrine of Talos. While none of the items will show up in your inventory, they will still appear in the hotkey menu, and can be equipped. However, this only works with quest items, and they may disappear completely afterwards, potentially breaking any of the item-related quests, such as [[Skyrim:Alduin's Bane|Alduin's Bane]] or [[Skyrim:Rebel's Cairn (quest)|Rebel's Cairn]].}} {{Bug|{{ps22}} On [[Skyrim:Skyrim VR|PSVR]] only, the summer 2018 patch (1.4.40.0.8) broke this quest; after submitting to the guards and agreeing to go to jail, you will end up with a black screen almost immediately. You will still hear some audio for a short time, but very quickly you will be unable to bring-up the in-game menu (for Save/Load/Quit), click any buttons or choose any actions, or hear any sounds. Your only option will be to system-close the application.}} ** The bug occurs while [[Skyrim:Urzoga gra-Shugurz|Urzoga gra-Shugurz]] is speaking to you. If you load an old save and kill her before starting the quest, the bug should not be triggered, although due to another bug, killing her might lead to you not being able to escape the prison. ** If you own the game on disk, delete your installation, then re-install the game, but don't apply any patches. Play the game; after you've exited the cell, it should work to save the game, apply all patches, then continue playing. {{Bug|While the generic Forsworn at [[Skyrim:Druadach Redoubt|Druadach Redoubt]] may be non-hostile to you if you side with Madanach, they will still attack animals or other special followers you have with you on sight. This applies to all dogs (including [[Skyrim:Barbas|Barbas]]), the [[Skyrim:Dremora Butler|Dremora Butler]], and any pets added by Creations, such as the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armored Mudcrab (creature)|Dwarven Armored Mudcrab]] and [[Skyrim:Nix-Hound (creature)|Nix-Hound]]. This is due to these followers not being added to the "[[Skyrim:DruadachRedoubtFaction|DruadachRedoubtFaction]]", unlike the player and other humanoid followers.}} **{{pc22}} Adding them to the [[SR:DruadachRedoubtFaction|DruadachRedoubtFaction]] faction (RefID E3609) will fix this problem. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |5||I'm imprisoned inside Cidhna Mine, framed for Eltrys' murder. I have to find Madanach, the King in Rags, and clear my name. {{Quest Objective|10|Ask a prisoner about Madanach}} |10||{{Quest Objective|20|Get past Borkul the Beast}} |25||{{Quest Objective|25|Talk to Madanach}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Hear Braig's story}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Return to Madanach}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Kill Grisvar the Unlucky}} |60||{{Quest Objective|60|Return to Madanach}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Follow Madanach}} |100|fin|I have helped Madanach escape Cidhna Mine, and he and his Forsworn have taken credit for all my past crime, clearing my name in the Reach. |200||{{Quest Objective|150|Kill Madanach}} |210||{{Quest Objective|200|Search Madanach's body}} |220||{{Quest Objective|210|Read Madanach's note}} |230||{{Quest Objective|220|Escape Cidhna Mine}} |250|fin|Thonar Silver-Blood has granted me a pardon for killing Madanach. My name has now been cleared in the Reach. |missing=0, 20, 55, 75, 77, 80 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Sheeprin |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{About|the quest|the dragon|Paarthurnax (dragon)}} {{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=[[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] or [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]] |Reward=Free access to Sky Haven Temple restored |Disp= =3 ([[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]])
=3 ([[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]])
=-2 ([[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]]) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[SR:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]], [[SR:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]] |Image=SR-quest-Paarthurnax (quest).jpg |ImgDesc=Paarthurnax in combat |description=Deal with a [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|potential threat]]. |ID=MQPaarthurnax |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #(Optional) Talk to [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] or [[Skyrim:Delphine|Delphine]]. #Kill [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|Paarthurnax]]. #Return to Esbern or Delphine. #Tell them Paarthurnax is dead. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Initiating the Quest=== This quest may initiate in two ways: * '''At your discretion:''' After you complete [[Skyrim:Alduin's Bane|Alduin's Bane]] and defeat the World-Eater in combat, you may consult with Esbern to learn of [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin's]] whereabouts. This begins the quest. * '''Automatically:''' If you have not yet spoken with Esbern or Delphine at [[Skyrim:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]], when the [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] conference is held, Delphine will approach you and start the quest automatically. Delphine does require you to give a reply. She issues a demand and says you two have nothing to talk about until you have carried out the deed, even though talking to her is still possible. ===The Stakeholders=== Delphine and Esbern have discovered that Paarthurnax is the Master of the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]] and an ancient enemy of the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]]. You can argue in Paarthurnax's defense, but both will reiterate the war crimes and atrocities committed by Paarthurnax. They will also claim that Paarthurnax helped Alduin enslave mortal ancestors and committed atrocities that were so severe, they are still remembered thousands of years later. In addition, Delphine thinks that Paarthurnax's betrayal of Alduin actually makes him worse, because it could mean that he might betray the Dragonborn in turn. They will tell you that their oaths as Blades prevents them from giving you any further help until you kill Paarthurnax. If you go to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]] and tell [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]] that the Blades want Paarthurnax dead, he will tell you that Paarthurnax supported Alduin because all dragons were in league with Alduin at first, and that Paarthurnax could not help it. He will go on to say that Paarthurnax did eventually rebel against Alduin, and was instrumental in Alduin's first demise. You are given the option to tell him that Paarthurnax must die, that you are going to spare the dragon, or that you don't know what your decision will be. This will affect the conversation between Delphine and Arngeir if you are forced to negotiate a treaty in Season Unending. Alternatively, you can go to Paarthurnax at [[Skyrim:The Throat of the World|the Throat of the World]] and talk to him there. He acknowledges that all dragons thirst for dominance and that the Dragonborn shares this thirst, though he believes that he has overcome this predisposition through the sheer power of will and that he can be trusted. ===The Choice=== You do not need to give an explicit reply. If you choose not to carry out Delphine's order to kill Paarthurnax, the game withdraws this quest after the main questline is completed. It disappears from your quest log without any notice. Paarthurnax is an easy foe for those who are leveled sufficiently, comparable to the average [[Skyrim:Frost Dragon|Frost dragon]]. You will receive a dragon soul and the usual set of [[Skyrim:Dragon Bone|dragon bones]] and [[Skyrim:Dragon Scales|dragon scales]] upon defeating him. Killing Paarthurnax will enrage Arngeir; if you return to [[SR:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]], he will angrily lecture you on your decision and even go so far as to threaten violence if you do not leave. After this, the other Greybeards will also fail to acknowledge you. On the other hand, the Blades will talk to you again. *'''If Paarthurnax dies:''' **Arngeir retracts the Greybeards' hospitality, and it is no longer possible to ask him for the locations of [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word walls]]. **Paarthurnax will no longer be around to provide meditation bonuses to certain [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shouts]]. If you already have a bonus, it will not go away; you will just be unable to change it. **Taking anything from High Hrothgar will count as stealing once again. **The Blades will welcome you once again and support you on Dragon Hunting missions. **An extra cutscene involving Paarthurnax after Alduin's defeat will be absent. *'''If Paarthurnax lives:''' **Arngeir will still disclose the location of word walls. **Paarthurnax will still provide meditation bonuses for shout words. **Paarthurnax will appear for an extra cutscene after Alduin's defeat, wherein he details his plans to rein in the dragons and teach them to live peacefully, following the [[Lore:Way of the Voice|Way of the Voice]]. This does not make gameplay any different — some will attack, and some won't, unless you attack them. After this, the quest will disappear from the journal. **Taking anything from Sky Haven Temple will count as stealing. **Removing items from some containers in the [[Skyrim:Sleeping Giant Inn|Sleeping Giant Inn]] will count as stealing, and you will lose access to the free bed there. **If you have not brought three people to the Blades already, Delphine's recruitment quest will remain uncompleted, or will become unavailable if you have not started it. However, it is entirely possible to recruit three followers for Delphine before being given the quest to kill Paarthurnax. **If you have not already obtained the [[Skyrim:Esbern's Potion|potion]] from [[Skyrim:Dragon Research|Esbern's Dragon Research]], you will be unable to do so. In order to get the potion, you must do so between the quest [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]] and reading the Elder Scroll step of Alduin's Bane. **If you want the [[Skyrim:Dragonslayer's Blessing|Dragonslayer's Blessing]], you'll be unable to get it. In order to get the blessing, you must do so between the quest Alduin's Wall and reading the Elder Scroll step of Alduin's Bane. **The only real consequence of ''not'' killing him is no longer having dialogue with both Delphine and Esbern, and thus no longer having the option to go on Dragon Hunts with your recruited Blades. They still, however, act like regular companions - but of course, can only accompany you one at a time, like any other companion, rather than all three at once on a specific dragon-hunt. ==Reward== The Blades do not reward you upon your return after killing Paarthurnax. Most of the gains come from the varied loot you find when searching Paarthurnax upon his death. ==Notes== *Because Delphine and Esbern are always essential characters and cannot die it is not possible to kill them to protect Paarthurnax. However, it is not necessary. *While you can implicitly decline this quest and make it disappear from your active quests, you may still kill Paarthurnax at any later time. The quest will reappear in your journal and can be completed normally. *{{pc22}}If you accidentally killed Paarthurnax without creating a backup save but still want to talk to the Greybeards, try the following commands in the console and Arngeir will talk to you as if you were just back from killing Alduin: **prid 3C57D resurrect will resurrect Paarthurnax **resetQuest MQPaarthurnax will reset the quest that asked you to kill Paarthurnax *If you speak to Arngeir after finishing the quest, he will be furious and say ''"This is how you repay our trust? Paarthurnax's trust? His noble spirit... the wisdom of ages... his deep understanding of our existence... all gone, and for what? A mindless vendetta urged on you by a cabal of [[Lore:Akavir|Akaviri]] barbarians! Begone, before even my philosophy is tested beyond the breaking point. We are men of peace, and you are not."'' Talking to Arngeir after that will cause him to only say ''"We have nothing to say to each other. Paarthurnax's murder is beyond my powers of forgiveness."'' ==Bugs== {{Bug|It is unclear why, but Paarthurnax's health will sometimes regenerate, making it impossible to kill him. At what point in the game the regeneration begins and ends remains to be determined.|confirmed=1}} **It is possible to bypass this bug by attacking Paarthurnax with [[Skyrim:Mehrunes_Razor|Mehrunes' Razor]]. **Fast traveling away and back when Paarthurnax's health meter is empty may trigger Paarthurnax's death. **Ordering a follower to attack Paarthurnax may circumvent this bug. {{Bug|Often, Delphine will still allow you to recruit followers even after you have been told to kill Paarthurnax. Therefore, it is perfectly possible to complete that quest and not kill him.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you trigger the quest to kill Paarthurnax after completing [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (quest)|Sovngarde]], the quest will be permanently stuck in your journal unless you kill Paarthurnax.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Even after killing Paarthurnax the miscellaneous quest "Talk to Esbern" may remain stuck in your journal.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|It is possible that after killing Paarthurnax, you will be unable to turn the quest in to Delphine, even though the quest arrow is pointing above her. If this happens, use the console to type: setstage MQPaarthurnax 100}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||Delphine and Esbern have discovered that Paarthurnax was one of Alduin's chief allies during the ancient Dragon War. They refuse to give me any more help until I kill Paarthurnax. {{Quest Objective|10|Kill Paarthurnax}} |50||Delphine and Esbern have discovered that Paarthurnax was one of Alduin's chief allies during the ancient Dragon War. I killed him, as they requested. {{Quest Objective|20|Talk to Delphine}} |100|fin| |missing=10, 15, 30, 150 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}
