[[SR:Hall of Countenance|Hall of Countenance]] |Image=SR-quest-Out_of_Balance.jpg |ImgDesc=The focal point in the center courtyard of the College of Winterhold |description=Purify the focus points for magical energy around the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. |ID=MGR02 |Icon= }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Travel to each of the focal points around the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. # Activate them with the [[Skyrim:Mystic Tuning Gloves|Mystic Tuning Gloves]] equipped. # Return to [[Skyrim:Drevis Neloren|Neloren]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Fine Tuning=== [[Skyrim:Drevis Neloren|Drevis Neloren]] can be found in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Countenance|Hall of Countenance]] at the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. Ask him if there is any College business that you can assist with and he will answer, ''"There may be a matter in which your... skills... could be useful. The various points of focus for magic energies around the College have become polluted, and need cleansing. The magical energies underneath the college still require purification. Your assistance would be most useful."'' When you agree to help, Drevis will provide you with the [[Skyrim:Mystic Tuning Gloves|mystic tuning gloves]] and let you know what needs to be done: ''"...These specially enchanted gloves will allow you to delve directly into the focal points for these energies. Go to each focal point and remove whatever impurities you may find there. Return the gloves to me when you have finished. Please exercise caution. This is not a procedure without possible... consequences."'' ===Purification=== The three magical focal points associated with this quest are the large, blue, fountains of energy found around the College. One is outside in the main College courtyard, one in the Hall of Countenance and another in the [[Skyrim:Hall of Attainment|Hall of Attainment]]. In order to begin equip the mystic tuning gloves to receive the Activate Mystic Focal Point prompt when you approach each font. Despite Drevis' warning, the purification process is quite simple with no real consequence associated. ===Reward=== Once all three focal points have been purified, return to Drevis. When you tell him that the focal points have been cleansed, he will respond ''"Yes, they have. I can feel the difference already. But of course, I'm far more in tune with these sorts of things than most. Thank you. I appreciate your assistance."'' Your reward for completion of each location is random [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]] and/or temporary [[Skyrim:Regenerate Magicka|Regenerate Magicka]] effects (see [[#Bugs|bugs]] section). == Notes == {{Bug|Drevis is meant to give you the quest more than once if you talk to him again later, but due to erroneous scripting, this does not always happen.|USKP|1.3.2|trackerid=12181}} * Based on the game data, it appears that five points were originally intended, but only three were implemented in the final game. One of the additional points would have been a pillar at the base of the first ramp coming down from the college; the other one has no location assigned. In addition, one of the possible effects would have been to spawn a creature, however this is also unimplemented. * It is possible to save scum each focal point into yielding a grand soul gem. * You can usually cleanse a focal point twice by clicking the activate key/button repeatedly, for two rewards at each location. * You can pickpocket the Mystic Tuning Gloves off of Neloren immediately after finishing the quest. However, they will be marked as quest items if you do so, meaning that it will be impossible to remove them from your inventory afterwards. == Bugs == {{Bug|When cleansing the foci, either or both of two different bugged two-hour boosts to magicka regeneration may be placed on you. In your Active Effects list, they appear as "Fortify Magicka"; one with a nominal drain effect, the other with a nominal fortify effect. These boosts appear to stack. Some players have reported that they remain much longer than two hours.|USKP|1.3.1}} ** {{Pc22}} If you installed Dawnguard, you can use dispelallspells to dispel all active effects on you except enchanted equipment. {{Bug|The magicka regeneration may actually give you unlimited magicka for a time.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|A dragon attack on the College of Winterhold may disrupt this quest and not register the foci as cleansed. Simply kill the dragon and return to all focal points and reactivate as necessary.|vn=1}} {{Bug|The gloves may not appear in your inventory, even with attempts to add them using console commands.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Journal Hidden|Drevis Neloren has asked for my help in purifying the focus points for magical energy around the College. I've been given special Tuning gloves that I'll need to wear in order to cleanse the focal points. Drevis has warned that there may be side-effects to performing this task.}} {{Quest Objective|10|Cleanse the focal points for magical energies around the College}} |20||{{Journal Hidden|I've finished cleansing the focal points around the College, and should take the gloves back to Drevis.}} {{Quest Objective|20|Return to Drevis Neloren}} |200|fin|{{Journal Hidden|I've successfully helped Drevis by cleansing the focal points around the College.}} |255|fail| |missing=0 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Stub|Quest}}

Skyrim:Mourning Never Comes.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=[[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] |Reward=Leveled gold and [[Skyrim:Muiri's Ring|Muiri's Ring]] (if optional task is completed), otherwise 100 gold |Disp=0→1 ([[Skyrim:Muiri|Muiri]] if optional task is completed) |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Kill Narfi|Kill Narfi]], [[Skyrim:Kill Beitild|Kill Beitild]], or [[Skyrim:Kill Ennodius Papius|Kill Ennodius Papius]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Whispers in the Dark|Whispers in the Dark]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]], [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], [[Skyrim:Raldbthar|Raldbthar]] |Image=SR-quest-Mourning Never Comes.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Muiri|Muiri]] pulls the strings |description=Help [[Skyrim:Muiri|Muiri]] get her revenge. |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png |ID=DB03 |SuggLevel=12 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[Skyrim:Muiri|Muiri]]. #''(Optional)'' Kill [[Skyrim:Nilsine Shatter-Shield|Nilsine Shatter-Shield]]. #Travel to [[Skyrim:Raldbthar|Raldbthar]] and kill [[Skyrim:Alain Dufont|Alain Dufont]]. #Return to Muiri for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Let the Mourning Begin=== After completing at least one of [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]]'s contracts, returning to the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] will trigger a scene where a seemingly annoyed [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] reluctantly welcomes [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]] to the hideout. As Nazir will deny you any rewards before you speak to Astrid, let the conversation finish and then wait for her to approach you. She will hand you the first real job for the Brotherhood: [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] resident [[Skyrim:Muiri|Muiri]] wants an ex-lover killed. Astrid asks you to show professionalism and explains that you can keep the entire reward, as this is your first contract. In Markarth, Muiri will be at work in [[Skyrim:The Hag's Cure|The Hag's Cure]] during the day and hanging out in the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] in the evening. Approach her and witness her surprise that the Dark Brotherhood actually still exists and that the [[Lore:Black Sacrament|Sacrament]] worked. She then explains the story of how she was once a very close friend of the [[Skyrim:House of Clan Shatter-Shield|Shatter-Shield family]] in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] until she met womanizer [[Skyrim:Alain Dufont|Alain Dufont]]. Alain managed to seduce her but, as it turned out, used her to get close to the Shatter-Shield family and rob them blind. The love affair ended with Muiri being kicked out in the cold by the family and Dufont abandoning her, eventually rejoining his bandit colleagues inside [[Skyrim:Raldbthar|Raldbthar]]. Muiri understandably wants Alain dead, but will make a second request once you arrive, promising to raise the reward if carried out. Muiri wants [[Skyrim:Nilsine Shatter-Shield|Nilsine Shatter-Shield]] assassinated as well, as an act of revenge on the family. Recently the Shatter-Shield family lost youngest daughter Friga to a [[Skyrim:Blood on the Ice|serial killer]] and their mourning process was part of Dufont's plan and the very reason he seduced Muiri. The family held Muiri responsible and refused to talk to her ever again. Muiri now reasons they may see just how wrong it was to kick her out if their only remaining daughter dies. You automatically accept the task, but it is optional. Asking her for elaboration will net you two samples of poisonous [[Skyrim:Lotus Extract|lotus extract]], which may come in handy. ===Nilsine=== :''Note: If you have yet to trigger the quest [[Skyrim:Blood on the Ice|Blood on the Ice]], do so before killing Nilsine Shatter-Shield. See [[Skyrim:Blood on the Ice#How to Start the Quest|this section]] for details. If there is a dead woman lying near the Windhelm Hall of the Dead, then Blood on the Ice has been triggered.'' Windhelm's citizens know of the tragedy that recently hit the wealthy Shatter-Shield family and will often talk about the serial killer's first victim, Friga Shatter-Shield. When speaking to the grieving parents, [[Skyrim:Tova Shatter-Shield|Tova]] and [[Skyrim:Torbjorn Shatter-Shield|Torbjorn]], both will express great sadness, especially Tova. Unaware that Muiri plans her revenge, the family, including your target Nilsine Shatter-Shield, tries to move on in life. Nilsine roams around town all day long: browsing the market in the morning, standing near her sister's now-abandoned house, [[Skyrim:Hjerim|Hjerim]], in the afternoon, and spending her evenings inside the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Windhelm)|Hall of the Dead]] on weekdays and in the [[Skyrim:Temple of Talos|Temple of Talos]] on weekends. It is not possible to trigger her anger during conversation, so a stealthy kill when she is alone in the evening is preferable. When the deed is done, move on to the real target, [[Skyrim:Alain Dufont|Alain Dufont]], or return to Muiri in Markarth. Killing Nilsine will cause her already bereaved mother, Tova, to commit suicide in their clan home in Windhelm. ===Raldbthar=== [[File:SR-quest-Mourning Never Comes 02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Alain Dufont|Alain Dufont]] and one of his guards]] Raldbthar is a Dwemer ruin located on the snowy mountainside east of [[Skyrim:Korvanjund|Korvanjund]], past [[Skyrim:Shearpoint|Shearpoint]]. It is one of the three entrances to [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]]. The target, however, has taken up residence in the first zone, so the trek will not be long. A few bandit enemies patrol near the entrance, so dispose of them, enter the ruin, and fight another bandit inside. Near the first intersection, the inhabitants have been creative with one of the ancient fire traps and a [[Skyrim:Skeever|charred skeever]] will slowly cook when it activates. The path straight ahead is hindered by said fire trap and a leveled lock. For a better chance of a surprise attack, take the eastern tunnel and kill a few bandits along the way. Down the last set of stairs is where [[Skyrim:Alain Dufont|Alain Dufont]] resides, so consider entering [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneak]] mode as you descend. There's a group of three bandits in the chamber and a fourth bandit hidden behind the southern gate. There is an [[Skyrim:Traps#Oil Slicks.2FOil Lanterns|oil slick]] on the ground that you may take advantage of by using a fire spell to roast the opposition, the unarmored Alain included. Fighting them normally is also an option, but beware of Alain's weapon of choice, the unique and enchanted warhammer [[Skyrim:Aegisbane|Aegisbane]]. When Alain is dead, the quest will update. Return to Muiri or, if you have yet to optionally kill Nilsine and still wish to do so, head to Windhelm. ===Reward=== When you return to Muiri in Markarth, she will show no remorse whatsoever and will hand you gold for taking care of her ex-lover. If you chose to kill Nilsine Shatter-Shield, you will receive a leveled amount of gold and the unique [[Skyrim:Muiri's Ring|Muiri's Ring]] which boosts the strength of potions by 15%. Otherwise, you will only receive 100 gold. Completing the optional objective will also allow you to [[Skyrim:Marriage|marry]] Muiri. Back in the Sanctuary, Astrid will thank you for a job well done and proceed to show greater paranoia concerning [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]] and his insanity. She will finish the quest by asking you to do her a favor, starting the next quest [[Skyrim:Whispers in the Dark|Whispers in the Dark]]. ==Notes== * This quest was originally meant to play out quite differently. Instead of being found in Raldbthar, Alain Dufont was meant to be present in a jail cell inside of the Windhelm Barracks. Early dialogue for Muiri shows that the original objective for the quest was just to kill Alain, while the optional objective was to kill him during a Pit match in the unused Windhelm arena, in which he would've been an opponent. The role Nilsine would've played, if any, is unknown. * If you haven't already received the [[Skyrim:Attunement Sphere|Attunement Sphere]] and [[Skyrim:Blank Lexicon|Blank Lexicon]] from [[Skyrim:Septimus Signus|Septimus Signus]], it is convenient to do so before killing Dufont. By doing so you can complete your quest objective, obtain entry to [[Skyrim:Blackreach|Blackreach]], and also obtain one of the [[Skyrim:Aetherium Shard|Aetherium Shards]] without having to make multiple trips through [[Skyrim:Raldbthar|Raldbthar]]. * In the room with Alain Dufont and the two bandits, two [[Skyrim:Dwemer Ballista|Dwemer ballistae]] aim down from the ledge above. The one on the right is aimed at Alain, while the one on the left is aimed at the bandits. * If you have already killed Alain before first meeting Muiri, then you cannot get the optional quest to kill Nilsine. **{{Pc22}} After receiving the initial quest from Astrid, use the console command setstage DB03 30 to add the objective to kill Nilsine and setstage DB03 40 to add the objective to return to Muiri with news of Alain's death. Return to Muiri and she should give you the optional reward as well. ==Bugs== {{Bug|As soon as the quest is initiated, you can talk to Nilsine and tell her you have been sent by Muiri, even though that is not yet the case.|USKP|2.0.5}} {{Bug|Alain Dufont's initial dialogue cuts off before you are allowed to give a response and he enters combat before he's supposed to.|USSEP|4.2.7|It was incorrectly set as a goodbye response, and the script never should have been added to it.}} {{Bug|It is possible that, after the first set of contracts, Cicero never shows up at the Falkreath Sanctuary, so no further quests will be available.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} This can be fixed by using the console command Setstage to complete all the stages of Mourning Never Comes and to start Whispers in the Dark until asked to eavesdrop on Cicero. **{{Pc22}} It can also be fixed by using the console command Setstage to set the stage of this quest to 5 while outside the sanctuary. After doing that, entering the sanctuary will trigger the scene with Cicero having arrived. After the discussion with Astrid and the others, Astrid will speak to the player and hand over the contract for Muiri. **{{Pc22}} If you killed Alain Dufont before starting this quest, he can be resurrected by the console commands prid 000d2aff and resurrect. Entering the Falkreath Sanctuary afterward should trigger Cicero's arrival. {{Bug|If Nilsine dies before the quest is started, no matter the cause, Muiri will reward you her ring as if you killed Nilsine. After the quest, Tova will commit suicide and Torbjorn will mention their deaths as usual.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |5||{{Quest Objective|5|Speak with Astrid}} |10||Astrid has given me my first major contract. I am to contact Muiri, the apothecary's assistant in The Hag's Cure, in Markarth. Muiri has apparently performed the Black Sacrament, and is trying to contact the Dark Brotherhood. {{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Muiri}} |20||Muiri wants me to kill the bandit leader Alain Dufont, who is holed up with his gang of cutthroats in the dwarven ruin of Raldbthar. If Dufont dies, the contract will be completed, but Muiri will pay me some kind of bonus if I also eliminate Nilsine Shatter-Shield, in Windhelm. {{Quest Objective|20|Kill Alain Dufont}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|(Optional) Kill Nilsine Shatter-Shield}} |40||Alain Dufont is dead. I must now return to Markarth, and tell Muiri the deed is complete. {{Quest Objective|40|Talk to Muiri}} |50||I have spoken to Muiri, and been paid for the assassination of Alain Dufont. I must now report back to Astrid at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. {{Quest Objective|50|Report back to Astrid}} |200|fin|After contacting Muiri, the apothecary's assistant at the Hag's Cure in Markarth, I learned that she wished to hire the Dark Brotherhood to kill a slanderous ex-lover. I killed the man, the bandit leader Alain Dufont, and was rewarded for the contract. |missing=0, 25, 31, 35, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:Whispers in the Dark|Whispers in the Dark]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]|Prev=[[Skyrim:Kill Narfi|Kill Narfi]], [[Skyrim:Kill Beitild|Kill Beitild]], or [[Skyrim:Kill Ennodius Papius|Kill Ennodius Papius]]}}

0→1 ([[Skyrim:Avulstein Gray-Mane|Avulstein Gray-Mane]]) |SuggLevel=12 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Learn of the ongoing feud in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. # Talk to [[SR:Fralia Gray-Mane|Fralia Gray-Mane]] or [[Skyrim:Avulstein Gray-Mane|Avulstein Gray-Mane]]. # Obtain [[Skyrim:Imperial Missive (Battle-Born)|evidence]] of [[Skyrim:Thorald Gray-Mane|Thorald]]'s fate. # ''Optional:'' Recruit Avulstein Gray-Mane as a follower. # Journey to [[Skyrim:Northwatch Keep|Northwatch Keep]] and rescue Thorald from his [[Skyrim:Thalmor|abductors]]. # Return to [[Skyrim:Fralia Gray-Mane|Fralia Gray-Mane]] for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===An Ongoing Feud=== [[File:SR-quest-Missing In Action 8.jpg|thumb|right|A confrontation in the streets]]While in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], you will likely overhear an argument between [[Skyrim:Fralia Gray-Mane|Fralia Gray-Mane]] and two Battle-Borns, [[Skyrim:Idolaf Battle-Born|Idolaf]] and [[Skyrim:Olfrid Battle-Born|Olfrid]], by her stall in the market. :'''Olfrid''': ''"Foolish old woman! You know nothing! Nothing of our struggles, our suffering!"'' :'''Fralia''': ''"Nothing? And what of my son? Hmm? What of [[Skyrim:Thorald Gray-Mane|Thorald]]? Is he nothing? So don't talk to me about suffering!"'' :'''Idolaf''': ''"Your son chose his side, and he chose poorly. And now he's gone. Such is the way of war. The sooner you accept his loss, the better."'' :'''Fralia''': ''"I will never accept his death! My son still lives. I feel it in my heart. So tell me, Battle-Borns, where is he? Where are you holding my Thorald?"'' :'''Olfrid''': ''"Do you believe this old hag? "Holding him"? Why I've got him in my cellar. He's my prisoner. Face it, cow! Your stupid son is dead! He died a [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloak]] traitor. And you... you best keep your mouth shut before you suffer the same."'' :'''Idolaf''': ''"Come on, father. There's nothing more to be said here."'' If you talk to Idolaf or Olfrid about the argument they will explain about how the Battle-Borns and Gray-Manes had been friends once, but because of the ongoing [[Skyrim:Civil War|civil war]] the families have had a falling out due to them taking opposing sides. After the argument is over proceed to talk to Fralia; she will say that [[Skyrim:Thorald Gray-Mane|Thorald]] isn't dead and when asked how she can be so sure of that fact will comment that it isn't safe to talk there and will ask you to meet her in her house later if you want to help. ====House Gray-Mane==== [[File:SR-quest-Missing In Action 6.jpg|thumb|right|Avulstein Gray-Mane]] Head up the hill and enter [[Skyrim:House Gray-Mane|House Gray-Mane]] where an armed man will rush at you, but Fralia calls out for him to stop; he is her son, [[Skyrim:Avulstein Gray-Mane|Avulstein Gray-Mane]], who has been hiding in the house for fear of being arrested by the Imperials if discovered. '''Fralia''': ''"Welcome to our home."''
'''Avulstein''': ''"Mother, what's the meaning of this? Who have you brought into our home?"''
'''Fralia''': ''"Avulstein, put that down! He's/She's here to help us find Thorald!"''
'''Avulstein''': ''"How do we know he's/she's not spying for the Battle-Born? This was foolish! We can't trust anyone! Who knows what they'll do if they find me here."''
'''Fralia''': ''"I can't take any more of this. No weapons, please. Let's just talk."''
'''Avulstein''': ''"All right, mother."''
He tells you more of the story and what he wants done: ''"I know that Thorald's not dead. I just know it. The [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] have him, and are keeping him somewhere. But I don't know where. Those damned Battle-Borns... they know something. They're hiding it. They practically taunt us with it. They must have some sort of proof! There's got to be something in that house of theirs. I just know it. I don't dare leave the house myself. So I need your help."'' ===Missing In Action=== [[File:SR-quest-Missing In Action 2.jpg|thumb|right|The Battle-Borns' secret]] To find out what really happened to Thorald, you'll need to get your hands on an [[Skyrim:Imperial Missive (Battle-Born)|imperial missive]] in the possession of the Battle-Borns. There are three alternative ways to do so, each of which leverages a [[Skyrim:Stealth|stealth]] skill: [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|Lockpicking]], [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pickpocketing]] and [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]]. *'''Lockpicking method''': You have to trespass in the [[Skyrim:House of Clan Battle-Born|Battle-Borns' house]] to retrieve the missive. It is located on the ground floor in a small office adjoining a bedroom; it is on the left from the front door. The office door is locked and there is no key for it; the key that can be pickpocketed from Battle-Born family members only opens the exterior doors. To simplify the task you can gain free access to the house by raising a resident's disposition, for example by helping [[Skyrim:Lars Battle-Born|Lars Battle-Born]] with his [[Skyrim:Bullying Braith|bullying problem]], answering "Battle-Born" to your Idolaf's first ever greeting or by [[Skyrim:Gather Wheat|selling crops]] to [[Skyrim:Alfhild Battle-Born|Alfhild Battle-Born]]. The lock to the office door must be picked anyway, although sometimes a Battle-Born will have been in that room and left the door wide open. *'''Pickpocket method''': [[Skyrim:Jon Battle-Born|Jon Battle-Born]] carries a [[Skyrim:Letter from Olfina|love letter]] from [[Skyrim:Olfina Gray-Mane|Olfina Gray-Mane]]. Pickpocket it from him, then talk to him about Thorald. He'll initially refuse to say much, but with the letter you can blackmail him into retrieving the missive and meeting you at the Talos statue to hand it over to you. *'''Speech method''': The quickest way is to pass a hard [[Skyrim:Persuade|persuasion]] check ([[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] level 75) with [[Skyrim:Idolaf Battle-Born|Idolaf Battle-Born]]. He'll tell you that the Gray-Manes are better off believing Thorald to be dead than knowing the truth. He once tried to look into the situation through his Legion contacts, as Thorald was once his friend, but was cut short. However he managed to find out that the [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] detain him at [[Skyrim:Northwatch Keep|Northwatch Keep]], a place people don't ever come back from. He will finally give you the missive as proof of his story. With the missive in your hands you may return to the Gray-Manes' to share what you discovered. If the door is locked, wait until [[Skyrim:Eorlund Gray-Mane|Eorlund]] returns home at 9pm. Once you're inside, speak with [[Skyrim:Avulstein_Gray-Mane|Avulstein]], who will propose to round up some men ([[Skyrim:Geirlund|Geirlund]] and [[Skyrim:Vidrald|Vidrald]]) to assault the fortress; you can agree to meet him there or tell him to stay put and let you handle it yourself. After making your decision, it's on to Northwatch Keep. ===Prisoner of War=== Northwatch Keep is occupied by [[Skyrim:Thalmor#Generic Thalmor NPCs|Thalmor Guards]], who will all turn hostile if you ignore the warnings to stay away. If you talk to the [[Skyrim:Northwatch Guard|guard]] at the front entrance, you will have an option to ask for the release of Thorald. The guard will respond with, ''"Are you joking? Even if we had a prisoner by that name, the only way he'd be released is by order of the Imperial Legion."'' You can travel to [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and talk to [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]], who will deny the request: ''"The Thalmor? Do you have any idea what you're asking? I'm sorry, that's just not possible. It would cause far too many problems."'' The peaceful method of solving the quest is [[#Bugs|incomplete]], however, and cannot be pursued further. Once the diplomatic approach fails, return to Northwatch Keep and consider your remaining options. {{Quest Fork |imageL=SR-quest-Missing In Action 7.jpg |imageR=SR-quest-Missing In Action 5.jpg |captionL=Avoid the patrols |captionR=The garrison |titleL=Stealth |titleR=Assault |textL= To sneak in, enter the grounds through the back gate in the northeast section of the compound, then look to the right and pick the master-level door. Once inside, head down the stairs. Around the corner is a [[Skyrim:Thalmor#Thalmor Soldiers|guard]] and an [[Skyrim:Northwatch Archer|archer]]; one is patrolling while the other is sitting at a small table. They must be killed to safely escort Thorald out, and if you can do so quickly and quietly you should be able to prevent the guard in the next room from responding. Moving past the next guard and into the far room you will find the [[Skyrim:Northwatch Interrogator|Northwatch Interrogator]], who must also be killed to safely release Thorald. You won't need his [[Skyrim:Northwatch Keep Key|Northwatch Keep key]] since you already unlocked the back door, but be sure to help yourself to the contents of the treasure chest. Speak to Thorald and he will be released from his shackles after a few moments to follow you, stopping to pick up a weapon along the way. Even though Thorald does not sneak, you can still slip by the previous guard who should still be oblivious to the jail break if you haven't made a lot of noise. |textR= This is definitely the more profitable method, as the Thalmor soldiers at Northwatch will be equipped with leveled (steel, elven, glass) weapons and armor. If you opted to bring Avulstein with you, it is likely that Vidrald will die, and Geirlund is level 1 and essentially doomed. They wear leveled heavy and light armor respectively and carry leveled weapons. The haul taken from the dead Thalmor troops will be worth far more than your actual reward, and there's so much good loot available that you may wish to bring a follower to help you carry it all even if that's not normally your style. If you chose to let Avulstein come, then he and two mercenaries will be waiting for you behind some rocks near the fort; go talk to him and they'll begin their attack. There are four Northwatch guards patrolling the grounds and three Northwatch archers patrolling the walkways above who will all turn hostile when you enter the grounds. The fort is pretty straightforward once you're inside; just press on ahead and kill every elf in sight. You'll pass through a mess hall with a bar where you can find a copy of the [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:2920, Morning Star, v1|2920, Morning Star, v1]]'', and further on down in a small room on the bottom floor of a big room you can find a Thalmor mage carrying the [[Skyrim:Northwatch Captain's Key|Northwatch captain's key]] and the [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Legendary Sancre Tor|The Legendary Sancre Tor]]''. As usual, keep an eye out for treasure chests along the way.}} ====The Interrogator==== [[File:SR-quest-Missing In Action 3.jpg|thumb|right|The Northwatch Interrogator]] Near the end of the dungeon you'll reach a T-shaped intersection; to the left is the interrogation chamber where Thorald is being held, to the right is a cell block beyond which is the exit door. There are also racks of weapons in this area. Head left and kill the interrogator if you haven't done so already to get the Northwatch Keep key, then loot the big treasure chest and free Thorald. Lead him up through the cell blocks to the exit (you can release the [[Skyrim:Northwatch Prisoner|prisoners]] here but they won't actually leave, though they will fight the Thalmor next door causing a distraction) and use the interrogator's key to unlock the door. ===Freedom!=== [[File:SR-quest-Missing In Action 4.jpg|thumb|left|Gray-Manes Reunited]] Once outside in a safe location, Thorald will thank you for releasing him, saying ''"I cannot thank you enough for rescuing me from this place. I suspect I'd never again see the light of day otherwise. But why would you risk your life for me, a stranger?"'' Once the details are explained he will ask you to get word to his mother and will give you a message that she should recognize. He'll then leave to join the Stormcloaks, as he doesn't feel safe in Whiterun anymore. If Avulstein is with you, they'll exchange a few words and he'll agree to follow Thorald; if not then Thorald will tell you that Avulstein should leave Whiterun too as the Thalmor will surely come looking for him (in which case Avulstein will already be gone by the time you get back to Whiterun). Return to Fralia and she'll ask you where Thorald is. After you tell her that he's not coming, she'll say ''"What? After all this, I can't even see him? How... How do I know you're telling me the truth, and not just what I want to hear?"'', giving you a chance to use the secret message '''"suffer the winter's cold wind..."''', which she completes: ''"...for it bears aloft next summer's seeds." That's my boy. So it's true, then. For now, it's enough to know that he's alive. I can find peace in that. Thank you, dear friend. You've given me back my son."'' She'll then reward you with an enchanted weapon that Eorlund had made for Thorald. If Eorlund is dead, she will instead give you 200 gold as a reward. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * The quest can be started by entering the Gray-Manes' home and talking to Avulstein, skipping the conversations with Fralia. * This quest counts towards the [[Skyrim:Sideways|Sideways]] [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] regardless of how you choose to complete it (i.e., both quest stages 200 and 201 qualify). * While Thorald and his family are aligned with the Stormcloaks, an Imperial-aligned character can complete this quest without additional difficulty. * If you befriended any of the Battle-Borns before the quest or if you do so during the quest, their dispositions with you won't fall when the quest is finished. * If you find Thorald before the relevant stage of the quest, he will simply say ''"You there! What are you doing?"'' and you will not be able to release him. * Even if Whiterun is under Stormcloak control, Thorald and Avulstein will still believe that it is not safe for them there. * Avulstein will always be disabled from the game once you return to Fralia after Thorald has been rescued, regardless of which path you choose. * If you follow Thorald after rescuing him, you will find that he will travel to the [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]] in Windhelm, although there is no further interaction between Thorald and the other Stormcloaks. * If Northwatch Keep was previously cleared and the peaceful path is chosen, the guards will not respawn and thus the peaceful path will automatically fail upon arrival at Northwatch Keep. ** {{pc22}} It is possible to continue the peaceful way using [[Skyrim:Console|console]] commands. First, use player.addfac 00039f26 0 to add yourself to the Thalmor faction, then use player.placeatme 000C07C2 to spawn a Northwatch Guard to trigger the dialogue. You may then continue as normal. {{Bug|Geirlund, unlike Vidrald, is not a leveled actor and will almost certainly die if he accompanies you.|USKP|1.3.1}} * You can ask Fralia about Avulstein and Thorald's status after the quest is finished. She will tell you that them being together again is good enough. * If you try to rescue Thorald in werewolf form, he will free himself and become hostile. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The peaceful method of completing the quest is incomplete. The [[Skyrim:Imperial Order|Imperial Order]] for Thorald's release was not finished and Tullius will simply deny the request. However, there is dialogue for granting the request (''"I can only imagine the headaches this is going to cause... Here, take this. Assuming they even honor it, you should be able to get your prisoner out."''), that was supposed to trigger if you have completed the Imperial Legion questline. The faulty parameters for the dialogue are that you need to be above or equal to rank 0 in the Imperial Legion faction, but also that the denial dialogue (which takes priority) requires you to be below rank 5 in the faction.|USKP|1.2|fixdetail=To obtain the order you must side with the Imperial Legion in the civil war questline and then speak to General Tullius. When you get to Northwatch, give the guard the orders and he will walk you to the prisoner. Once you've spoken to Thorald, the quest continues as normal. However, Thorald will not return to his family in Whiterun and will still have the same dialogue telling he is not safe in Whiterun and must fall in with the ranks of the Stormcloaks, even if you release him using this peaceful method after the Civil War is completed.}} {{Bug|After completing the quest, [[Skyrim:Northwatch Keep|Northwatch Keep]] remains uninhabited. If either of or both [[Skyrim:Geirlund|Geirlund]] and [[Skyrim:Vidrald|Vidrald]] manage to survive (given you asked them for help), they will remain outside the keep, but they will not have any unique dialogue when spoken to.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|Fralia's dialogue at the beginning of the quest may occur without either of the Battle-Borns being present.|USKP|1.3.3}} {{Bug|If you wait too long to meet her Fralia at her home after speaking to her in the market, she will not speak to you there, instead remaining stuck at the market waiting for you to talk to her. The quest will not progress at this point.|USKP|2.0.7}} {{Bug|Upon retrieving the missive and attempting to present it to Avulstein, the Gray-Mane home may be permanently locked. This may also happen before meeting Fralia in her house, and it may be caused by waiting for too long between assignments. Sneaking in, even with a pickpocketed key, will make Avulstein and Fralia hostile, telling you that you're not supposed to be there.|USKP|2.0.7|trackerid=17127}} **{{Pc22}} To fix this, use the pair of console commands Prid 1A686 and moveto player in succession to make Avulstein spawn at your location. You can then talk to him outside the house, where he won't be hostile. **If it happens before meeting Fralia in the house, you may need to advance the stage using console because she will not speak to you outside. To fix this type on console: movetoqt MS09 and you will be put inside the Gray-Mane household. ** The easiest way to fix this is first running away from him until he loses track of you and then either sleep in the bed available not far to the west or to fast travel from the location and then back again. {{Bug|If you rescue Thorald without presenting the proof to Avulstein, the quest marker for him will point to a disabled NPC. Nevertheless, you can still complete the quest by heading straight to Fralia.|USLEEP|3.0.3|trackerid=19993}} {{Bug|Two lines of dialogue were recorded for [[Skyrim:Eorlund Gray-Mane|Eorlund Gray-Mane]] for use during this quest. Unfortunately, they were mistakenly attached to stage 1000 of [[Skyrim:In My Time Of Need|In My Time Of Need]], so they can never be heard in-game:
''"We Gray-Manes got just as much to be proud of as them Battle-Borns, but you won't see us with our noses in the air."''
''"My poor Fralia thinks Thorald's still alive, but I know better."''|USLEEP|3.0.3}} {{Bug|Jon Battle-Born never takes back Olfina's letter to him if you pickpocketed it from him as a way to get the evidence.|USSEP|4.1.3}} {{Bug|This quest may set off trespass warnings when entering Fralia's house.|USSEP|4.3.2|A trigger box outside the home has been added which will enable the public flag on the cell and unlock both entrance doors so you don't have to pick either one.}} {{Bug|The Thalmor inside the keep may turn hostile even with the release order.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} It is possible to go through, type player.addfac 00039F26 0 using the console to temporarily add yourself to their faction. Once you have freed the prisoner and are out of reach, type player.addfac 00039F26 -1 to remove yourself from the Thalmor faction. **{{Pc22}} An alternative solution, if the player.addfac 00039F26 0 command above doesn't work, can be achieved by selecting a Thalmor soldier and typing setav aggression 0 in the console, although this solution can be time consuming if the player wishes to remove the aggression factor from every single Thalmor soldier. {{Bug|Thorald may just stand where he was released with his brother and they will not follow you.|confirmed=1}} ** Thorald can be forced into action by "pushing" him (walking, running, or rolling into him until he moves) away from the dungeon and down the hall toward the next room. Eventually he will begin to run on his own. ** Thorald was scripted to pick up a weapon as soon as he is free before following you out which may be the reason for his static behavior. Dropping a weapon near him may result in him picking it up and being ready to move. The weapon cannot be marked "stolen". **{{Pc22}} Players on PC may force-equip Thorald with a weapon in the console, by activating the console key then clicking on him and typing (for example) equipitem 13983 1. {{Bug|Thorald may just stand at door and not run away after exiting the building.|confirmed=1}} ** Once any nearby enemies are dealt with, talk to him to advance the quest. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Fralia Gray-Mane in Whiterun is convinced that her missing son, Thorald, is still alive and being held captive. She's asked me to visit her at her home to speak privately about the matter. {{Quest Objective|10|Meet Fralia in her home}} |20||Avulstein Gray-Mane believes his brother Thorald has been taken prisoner, and that the Battle-Borns of Whiterun have proof. I need to find it and bring to Avulstein. {{Quest Objective|20|Find evidence of Thorald's fate}} {{Quest Objective|25|Meet Jon Battle-Born at Talos' statue {{Quest Comment|if you pickpocketed Jon}}}} |30||After being convinced to help by the Gray-Mane family, I've found evidence that Thorald Gray-Mane is still alive, and is being held in Northwatch Keep. Avulstein will want to see this right away. {{Quest Objective|30|Deliver proof to Avulstein}} |40||After being convinced to help, and finding proof that he is still alive, I've offered to try and free Thorald Gray-Mane from Northwatch Keep to prevent bloodshed on either side. {{Quest Objective|40|Find a way to release Thorald from Thalmor custody}} {{Quest Objective|45|Follow the Thalmor guard}} |50||Now that I have found proof that his brother still lives, Avulstein Gray-Mane insists on assaulting Northwatch Keep to rescue Thorald. I've agreed to meet him outside the Keep to assist in the fight. {{Quest Objective|50|Meet Avulstein at Northwatch Keep}} |55||{{Quest Objective|55|Rescue Thorald from Northwatch Keep}} |60||Thorald Gray-Mane is indeed alive. Now I have to get him away from Northwatch Keep and make sure he stays safe. {{Quest Objective|60|Lead Thorald to safety}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Speak to Thorald Gray-Mane}} |110||Thorald Gray-Mane has been successfully retrieved from Northwatch Keep. Fearing for the safety of his family, he cannot return to Whiterun, and has asked me to deliver a message to his mother: "Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds." {{Quest Objective|110|Return to Fralia Gray-Mane}} |200|fin|Fralia Gray-Mane is grateful that her son Thorald is alive and well. |201|fin|Fralia Gray-Mane is grateful that her son Thorald is alive and well. |202|fail| |255|fail| |missing=0, 25 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

=1 ([[SR:Valindor|Valindor]] if he is not dead) |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Bloodstone Chalice|The Bloodstone Chalice]] |Next= |Image=SR-npc-Vingalmo.jpg |Imgdesc=Vingalmo |description=Turn the target into a [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampire]]. |ID=DLC1RV07 |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Go to the specified location. #Turn the target into a vampire. #Report back to [[Skyrim:Vingalmo|Vingalmo]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== When asking what can be done to help around [[Skyrim:Volkihar Keep|Volkihar Keep]], you may be directed to [[Skyrim:Vingalmo|Vingalmo]]. Speak to him, and he will tell you: :''"I've found a new candidate, ripe for Harkon's Gift. I'm sending you to welcome this soul into our family."'' Depending on who the target is, he will go on to say one of three things: :''"[[Skyrim:Haran|Haran]] manages the [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|inn]] in [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]]. A forsaken place under the shadow of the mages guild. She will help us keep an eye on the mages."'' :''"[[Skyrim:Valindor|Valindor]] of [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] has his ears in places that we'd love to listening in. Joining our family should increase our possibilities in the south."'' :''"A [[Skyrim:Cairine|pathetic creature]] in her present condition, but the gift will embolden her. And her lowly state suits her to being our eyes and ears in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]."'' He then instructs you: :''Put her/his mind to rest, allay her/his fear through [[Skyrim:Vampire's Seduction|vampiric seduction]] and when she/he is in a pliant condition, embrace her/him and bite her/him on the neck."'' Additional questions on various subjects will be available before setting out: :'''What do you mean by allaying fear through vampiric seduction?''' ::''"Our blood grants us power to calm and relax. If you currently lack the gift, forgo feeding for a day and that power will come naturally.
Once your thrall is suitable sedated, you will be able to impart the gift without resistance."'' :'''Can't anyone become a vampire if bitten by one?''' ::''"While the blessed state of undeath can be 'accidentally' conferred - consider the brutish creatures you find wailing in dank hovels in the wild...
Only those who can trace their ancestry through Harkon's mortal {{sic|blood line|bloodline|description=extra space}} can faithfully accept the power conferred by his Vampiric blood.
And among those, it seems, only when the heavens show the correct aspects.
I have found such a soul and the stars appear cooperative."'' :'''Why am I able to bestow the gift of Harkon's blood?''' ::''"Because he himself bestowed upon you a portion of his vitality when he infused you with his own blood the night you returned with Serana.
A small measure of his blood now and forever flows through your veins."'' :'''Understood.''' ::''"When you offer the embrace, do so away from prying eyes. Our new sibling will then likely require rest while his/her blood undergoes the change. Return to me when your part is done."'' In this quest you are required to infect either Haran, Valindor, or Cairine, earning their allegiance to the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Vampire Clan|Volkihar Vampire Clan]]. Vingalmo suggests that you use [[Skyrim:Vampire's Seduction|Vampire's Seduction]] to ease the process, but biting the target while they are asleep will also work. ===Valindor=== [[Skyrim:Valindor|Valindor]] can be found in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] and starts off his day by waking up at 4am and having a long breakfast for two hours in his house. At 10pm, he returns to his house to sleep for six hours until 4am, and repeats his schedule the following day. ===Cairine=== [[Skyrim:Cairine|Cairine]] can be found in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] and spends her entire day at the Warrens. She rarely sleeps, and instead sits on the ground, making her an easy target. ===Haran=== [[Skyrim:Haran|Haran]] can be found in [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]] at the [[Skyrim:The Frozen Hearth|inn]]. At 2am, she sleeps in the inn's cellar along with her daughter, [[Skyrim:Eirid|Eirid]]. Once you have bitten your target, they will be part of the Clan. Return to [[Skyrim:Vingalmo|Vingalmo]] to complete the quest. ==Notes== *A coffin will be added to each new vampire's home, which you can then use to sleep and get the [[Skyrim:Vampiric Blood Rested|vampire rested bonus]]. The new vampires do not seem to use it, however, and will still sleep in their old beds. *Dialogue conditions in the game data suggest that it could have been possible for [[Skyrim:Orthjolf|Orthjolf]] to give this quest, but he does not. *If Vingalmo selects Valindor as the target, the door to Valindor's House will be locked if night falls while inside it. Unlocking the door will considered a crime. Just wait until 04:00 AM for the door to unlock itself. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The quest giver may ask you to infect the same person if you have done this quest before. They cannot be turned into a vampire again.|UDGP|1.1.1|dlc=DG}} **Use the console command setstage dlc1rv07 100 to move the quest to the next stage. **One fix to this bug is to kill the already infected vampire. It marks the quest as "failed" but still completes it. **Another fix is to load a previous save from before accepting the quest and try again, as they may not give the same quest. **{{Pc22}} Finish any other active quests from the vampires, then go outside the castle and save. If any of the vampires send you to Vingalmo for work, reload the save, and, while outside, enter the setstage DLC1RV07 255 in the console. This will complete the quest and give you the reward, and the questline will progress as usual. **After completing the quests for Vingalmo you can kill all targets and never receive the quest again. {{Bug|After biting the target your character may not be able to move, and you will not be able to complete the quest.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **Reload from last autosave (should be from when you walk in) and feed from sneak mode. {{Bug|You may be unable to feed on Cairine (likely due to her sitting animation).|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} One solution is to select her via the console (or by typing prid D6702) and enter the command resurrect 1 which should force her to stand temporarily, or moveto player which should move her to you and force her to stand for longer. Once you close the console, immediately use your Vampire Seduction on her and rapidly press the activation/talk button, which should then allow you to access the feed option. Optionally, you may wish to toggle nearby Garvey's detection by selecting him in the console and typing tdetect. ** To get Cairine to stand up, you can also punch her with your fists or use a weak spell in order to engage combat with her. Then you can just use Vampire Seduction. {{Bug|After your target becomes a vampire, they may never be tagged as undead, and gain access to no vampiric powers.|UDGP|1.2.1}} {{Bug|After feeding on Cairine, the quest may not update and the quest marker will continue to point at her as if you have yet to feed.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|Vingalmo may not interact with you at all, even though everyone will keep telling you to speak to him.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Vingalmo has sent me to where I am to find and bestow the Gift of Blood upon . I should first render pliant through the use of Vampire's Seduction then embrace and bite on the neck. If I currently lack the power, I should {{sic|forego|forgo}} feeding for a day as I will gain the ability. I should then return to Vingalmo while undergoes the change. {{Quest Objective|10|Turn into a vampire}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Return to Vingalmo}} |255|fin| |300|fail| |missing=50 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

You'll find that he is somewhat bitter about living and working in [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]], should you speak with him. One thing that does seem to spark his interest is the [[Skyrim:East Empire Pendant|East Empire pendants]]. The pendants were once used as employee incentives, but are no longer being produced and, as a result, are now considered a valuable collector's item. Fethis lets you know that, if you find any of these East Empire pendants in your travels throughout Solstheim, he will be glad to buy them from you for 500 gold per pendant. The pendants are located in East Empire Company strongboxes, which are locked with an expert lock and contain other valuable loot as well. ===East Empire Company Strongbox Locations=== There are 33 total locations of East Empire Company strongboxes in Solstheim, giving a profit of 16,500 gold if you can find them all. Most of the strongboxes are at locations marked on your map, but for those which are in [[Skyrim:Unmarked Places#Dragonborn|unmarked locations]], the entry for the "Location" column is the location from which it is easiest to find the strongbox. Certain strongboxes are marked as owned, which means taking from them is considered stealing, except in cases where you have raised the owner's [[Skyrim:Disposition|disposition]] high enough. {| class="wikitable striped" !width=150px|Location !! Skyrim:Old Friends.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy= |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Velyanthe }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Reward=Random leveled staff |Prev=[[Skyrim:Briarheart Necropsy|Briarheart Necropsy]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]], [[Skyrim:Highpoint Tower|Highpoint Tower]] |Image=SR-quest-Old Friends 02.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|Ash Spawn]] attack [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]] |ID=DLC2TT2 |description=Find the source of attacks on [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]]. |SuggLevel=20 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Talk to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]]. # Investigate the graveyard near Tel Mithryn using the [[Skyrim:Neloth's Ring of Tracking|Ring of Tracking]]. # Return to Neloth. # Go to [[Skyrim:Highpoint Tower|Highpoint Tower]] and kill [[Skyrim:Ildari Sarothril|Ildari Sarothril]]. # Return to Neloth for your reward. == Detailed Walkthrough == === The Ring of Tracking === [[File:SR-quest-Old Friends.jpg|thumb|right|Something is wrong at the graveyard.]] With his steward [[Skyrim:Reluctant Steward|killed]], his tower [[Skyrim:Healing a House|withered]], and several other annoyances related to [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|Ash Spawn]], master Telvanni wizard [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] finally loses his patience when three Ash Spawn attack his [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|tower]]. Once you have killed the Ash Spawn, enter the tower and talk to the wizard who will reveal it is finally time to investigate who is behind the attacks: ''"Yes. I have enemies. Legions of them back in Morrowind. However, in this case I have reason to believe it is someone in Solstheim."'' When asked if he wants the responsible persons dead, he will respond: ''"Not yet. That may come later. First I need to identify the culprit. I've enchanted this ring to find the source of the attacks. Here, take it."'' He will then hand you the [[Skyrim:Neloth's Ring of Tracking|Ring of Tracking]] and explain that you need to wear it in order for it to work. The ring was enchanted with a bit of ash from the last Ash Spawn attack and will allow you to follow the magical link back to the source of the summoned Ash Spawn. However, it has its disadvantages: ''"The link is weak, so you'll have to be within about a hundred feet of the source."'' Neloth will then order you to walk around the grounds while wearing the ring. Equip the ring and leave the tower behind. === From Beyond the Grave === Once outside, head north to the field of mushrooms and then east towards a lone evergreen tree at the shore, until you reach {{Map Link|x=81000|y=28000|map=DB|a small graveyard}} inhabited by a peaceful [[Skyrim:Netch|netch]] family. With the ring equipped, one of the coffins will have a clear bluish glow. As you approach the graveyard, the expected Ash Spawn will appear and attack, so fight it and investigate Ildari's sarcophagus. The coffin lacks a dead body, and contains a [[Skyrim:Staff of Calm|staff of calm]] and a [[Skyrim:Heart Stone|heart stone]]. Grab the stone and return to Neloth in the tower. [[File:SR-npc-Neloth 05.jpg|thumb|right|''"She lives. Seek her in Highpoint Tower."'']] If you have already played through [[Skyrim:March of the Dead|March of the Dead]], the name Ildari should be familiar, due to the [[Skyrim:Ildari's Journal|journal]] you [[Skyrim:March of the Dead#Falx Carius|found]] when you helped [[Skyrim:Captain Veleth|Captain Veleth]] with his Ash Spawn problems in [[Skyrim:Fort Frostmoth|Fort Frostmoth]]. When you hand the stone to Neloth, he will be quite surprised and reveal [[Skyrim:Ildari Sarothril|Ildari Sarothril]] to be a former apprentice of his: ''"Ildari? Then it's my own fault. She was my apprentice before Talvas. She volunteered for one of my experiments involving heart stones. It was quite annoying when she died."'' He will then elaborate on how she died: ''"My necropsies of Spriggans led me to believe that a heart stone could be implanted in a person's chest, granting them great power. I was considering replacing my heart with a heart stone. Fortunately Ildari offered to let me operate on her first. Of course this was before your [[Skyrim:Briarheart Necropsy|briarheart expedition]]. Now I know that I did the surgery all wrong."'' When you tell him that the sarcophagus was empty, he will be quick to put two and two together: ''"That's impossible. Wait... unless she didn't actually die! The heart stone could have kept her right at the edge of life and death. Could it be? Could Ildari still be alive? Could she be my nemesis? Wait a moment while I cast a more specific divination."'' Moments afterward, Neloth will cast a spell that will light up most of the tower, and will start to talk in a completely different voice, as if a spirit is talking through him: ''"She lives. Seek her in Highpoint Tower."'' Neloth will then return to normal and immediately order you to head to said tower, as he can't be bothered himself. The last thing he will say is: ''"Go rip that thrice cursed heart stone from her chest."'' ===Highpoint Tower=== [[File:SR-place-Highpoint Tower.jpg|thumb|left|[[Skyrim:Highpoint Tower|Highpoint Tower]]]] [[Skyrim:Highpoint Tower|Highpoint Tower]] is located north of Ildari's former hideout, [[Skyrim:Fort Frostmoth|Fort Frostmoth]], southeast from [[Skyrim:Brodir Grove|Brodir Grove]]. Enter the tower via a tunnel on the north side; fight the guarding Ash Spawn and head up the stairs. Once inside, head down the spiral staircase. Two stories down, you will come across a table with ''[[Skyrim:Ildari's Journal, vol. I|Ildari's Journal, vol. I]]'', where a weakened Ildari Sarothril describes how she was saved by some miners, and how she is planning her revenge on her former master back in Tel Mithryn. Continue down the stairs and head west until you reach a chamber, filled with egg sacks from various spiders. As you enter the chamber, beware of the [[Skyrim:Spellcaster_Trap|spellcaster trap]] to the north, as it can complicate your battle against the spiders considerably. Multiple paths are available here; the tunnel to the south leads to a huge spiders nest and some useful veins, while the tunnel with the spellcaster trap is the way towards your goal. At the first intersection, enter the room with the three Ash Spawn and pick the fight, then proceed to the north and remove the [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gem]] from yet another spellcaster trap. In the next chamber, a [[Skyrim:Tripwire|tripwire]] triggers some [[Skyrim:Falling Boulders|falling boulders]]. Use the [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] if needed, and beware the [[Skyrim:Elemental Rune|elemental rune]] in the center of the room. Head down the eastern path until you reach the rare sight of an elemental rune on the wall, with tunnels leading north and south. Head south until you reach a jail-like area with several cells. The table in the center of the jail has ''[[Skyrim:Ildari's Journal, vol. II|Ildari's Journal, vol. II]]'', detailing how Ildari was able to survive Neloth's operation, and how her paranoia against the very people who saved her slowly increases due to the [[Skyrim:Heart Stone|heart stone]] implemented in her chest. She also describes how she will keep a few of them as prisoners for future experiments. Before long, [[Skyrim:Niyya|Niyya]] will call to you from her cell. When you pick the lock, she will come out and thank you: ''"Thank you for rescuing me. That witch was going to kill me soon, I just know it."'' She will then tell you the background: ''"We were digging in these mines when she found us. She was hurt so bad. We took pity on her and nursed her back to health. She repaid our kindness by attacking us in the middle of the night. Those of us that didn't die were made prisoners."'' She will go on to explain how Ildari used her saviors for experiments and will angrily encourage you to make her suffer a painful death. She will then rush towards the exit, with plans to leave Solstheim for good. {{NewLeft}} ===Kill the Witch=== [[File:SR-quest-Old Friends 05.jpg|thumb|right|An [[Skyrim:Ash Guardian|Ash Guardian]] is born]] Return to the elemental rune, head north and locate the passage to the east. A wooden ramp leads down while a wooden catwalk goes forward with a crate holding meat on top. Follow the catwalk to find two orichalcum veins to mine. Return to the ramp to proceed to the next chamber. In the next chamber is a glowing [[Skyrim:Sapphire Geode|sapphire geode]] on the ground, while another can be reached by traversing up the wooden structure. There is another orichalcum ore veins on the other side of the room from the first geode and a gold ore vein near the wooden structure's ramp. Proceed forward in a northwestern direction until you reach a large chamber with a strange device in the middle. Before long, Ildari will speak from her spot above: ''"You've gone far enough. Neloth is a fool to think he could send some low life to finish me off."'' With these words, she will activate the device, creating an [[Skyrim:Ash Guardian|Ash Guardian]]. At this point, numerous Ash Spawn will emerge as well, so pick the tough battle and dispose of the Ash Guardian. With the area cleared, start traversing the woodworks to the southwest and explore the path thoroughly for some treasure and ingredients. Once you reach a ledge with a table and a random rare book, loot the shelves for various potions and other loot and read through ''[[Skyrim:Ildari's Journal, vol. III| Ildari's Journal, vol. III]]''. In this final volume, Ildari describes how she patiently started getting her vengeance on Neloth, and how she is responsible for the death of [[Skyrim:Varona Nelas|Varona Nelas]], and the withering of Tel Mithryn tower. Proceed to climb the woodworks and follow the tunnel leading southwest, killing all the Ash Spawn that emerge on the way. [[File:SR-quest-Old Friends 04.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Ildari Sarothril|Ildari Sarothril]]]] Once you reach a broken-down wall, two paths are available. The path to the northeast leads to a dead end and an open chest with some minor loot while the adjacent path leads to a wooden bridge. Cross the bridge and follow the tunnel as it twists and turns until you reach the final chamber, the lair of [[Skyrim:Ildari Sarothril|Ildari Sarothril]]. Ildari will be on the woodworks above and will have two [[Skyrim:Traps#Elemental Traps|elemental traps]] shooting at you at all times. Dodge the magical attacks and locate the entrance to the southwest and follow the path as it leads you to the second floor. Ildari will now start attacking you. She is a powerful sorceress with several spells at her disposal, although she will mainly use her [[Skyrim:Staff of Lightning Bolts|staff of lightning bolts]] to attack you. After the battle, Ildari will kneel down. With Ildari helpless, follow Neloth's orders and rip out the heart stone from her chest, forever ending her vengeful scheme. Once everything is quiet, claim a reward from the boss-leveled chest and search the shelves for jewelry, ingredients, and other loot. Activate the lever and watch the spikes disappear from the entrance to the southeast. Head up the stairs, to the very top of the tower, and pull the chain for a very quick escape route back to Solstheim. === Reward === Back in Tel Mithryn, Neloth will be happy to see the end of his nemesis and will, for once, reward you accordingly: ''"Well, well. You have proven to be a more valuable ally than I anticipated. I have a staff for you, but I would also like to make you a member of my household. A member of House Telvanni. No need to thank me. I know you are overwhelmed with gratitude."'' He will then hand you a random, leveled staff and tell you that your new membership of the household means very little for the time being, although he will promise you a bed and a chest in his tower (see [[#Bugs|bugs]]). == Notes == * Highpoint Tower is blocked by ash until this quest has been initiated. * A complete set of [[Skyrim:Skaal Boots|Skaal equipment]] can be obtained in Highpoint Tower during this quest, atop the earthen archway in the tunnel past the alchemy lab area. * If your Archery skill is good enough, you can kill Ildari while she is talking before the Ash Guardian is raised as she stands in the open on a platform beyond the summoning circle. * Ildari can be pickpocketed if you're in stealth mode when you rip her heart out. The heart will be removed once you close the menu. == Bugs == {{Bug|Even though Neloth tells you he will keep a bed and chest for you, there is not a chest specifically for you and all of the beds are still owned.|UDBP|1.0.3}} **The bed in the Steward's House is unowned from the start, although [[Skyrim:Varona Nelas|Varona Nelas]] (or later [[Skyrim:Drovas Relvi|Drovas Relvi]]) usually sleeps in it. {{Bug|Neloth may fail to cast the more specific spell to find Ildari, so the quest marker remains as "Talk to Neloth".|confirmed=1}} **Leaving and reentering Tel Mithryn may allow Neloth to cast the spell, so the quest can progress. Attacking Neloth may also work, although this will result in a bounty. **If Neloth is in the enchanting room, push/bump/shove him into the main room. {{Bug|The animation for ripping out Ildari's heart may not activate.|confirmed=1}} **Wait at least 10 seconds after you're given the prompt to rip Ildari's heart out {{Bug|The game may crash when attempting to rip out Ildari's heart.|confirmed=1}} **Save your game near Ildari as a precautionary measure. {{Bug|If you have opened Ildari's sarcophagus prior to this quest, the heart stone may not be inside it when the quest begins, preventing you from completing it.|confirmed=1}} **If you open the sarcophagus prior to the quest you will find a staff. The heart stone will be present once you have started the quest. {{Bug|The Ring of Tracking may lead you to an invisible object near Tel Mithryn instead of Ildari's sarcophagus.|confirmed=1}} **Activating the sarcophagus will continue the quest normally. {{Bug|Upon putting Ildari in Bleedout, the player is given a perk that enables the prompt to "Rip Heart Out", and that adds a multiplier of 0.01 to the magnitude of Illusion effects on the player. This persists until the perk is removed upon killing Ildari. This notably makes the [[Skyrim:Ring of Khajiit|Ring of Khajiit]] and [[Skyrim:Ring of the Wind|Ring of the Wind]] very weak.}} **The perk can be removed via player.removeperk 0403d597, it will be reacquired when Ildari is next put into Bleedout. == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |100||Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. He gave me a ring that will identify the source of the attacks. If I walk around the grounds of Tel Mithryn, I might find a clue. {{Quest Objective|100|Find the source of the attacks}} |200||Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. He gave me a ring that identified the source of the attacks as a heart stone hidden in the grave of Ildari Sarothril. {{Quest Objective|200|Talk to Neloth}} |300||Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. I discovered the source of the attacks was a heart stone hidden in Ildari Sarothril's grave. Neloth has divined that his former apprentice is still alive and seeking vengeance on him. Neloth asked me to track down and kill Ildari. {{Quest Objective|400|Kill Ildari}} |500||Neloth's former apprentice, Ildari Sarothril, was covertly attacking him. Deep under Highpoint Tower I confronted Ildari and killed her. {{Quest Objective|500|Talk to Neloth}} |600|fin| |missing=0, 5, 10, 250, 310, 400 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

[[Skyrim:Exquisite Sapphire|Exquisite Sapphire]] |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Glover Mallory|Glover Mallory]]) |Prev=Complete [[Skyrim:Meet the Family|Meet the Family]] |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag Caverns| Castle Karstaag Caverns]], [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] |Image=SR-quest-Paid in Full.jpg |ImgDesc=A blacksmith with connections |ID=DLC2TGQuest |description=Recover the [[Skyrim:Bonemold Formula|bonemold formula]] for [[Skyrim:Glover Mallory|Glover Mallory]]. |SuggLevel=6 }} == Quick Walkthrough == #Talk to [[Skyrim:Glover Mallory|Glover Mallory]]. #Travel to [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag Caverns|Castle Karstaag Caverns]]. #Recover the [[Skyrim:Bonemold Formula|bonemold formula]] from [[Skyrim:Esmond Tyne|Esmond Tyne]]. #Give Glover the formula. # (''Optional'') Reveal the truth to an [[Skyrim:Sapphire (person)|old friend]]. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===A Shadowmark in Raven Rock=== [[File:SR-quest-Meet_the_Family.jpg|thumb|right|''"So tell me... how's my brother Delvin?"'']] For members of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] back in [[Lore:Skyrim|Skyrim]], the local blacksmith of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] has a very familiar surname: Mallory. [[Skyrim:Glover Mallory|Glover Mallory]] has a [[Skyrim:Glover Mallory's House|house]] next to his smithy and to the left of the front door is a [[Skyrim:Shadowmarks (Thieves_Guild)|shadowmark]]. Approach Glover when he is working the forge between 8am and 8pm and ask about the shadowmark. He will confess his relation to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] back in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]], saying things like: ''"So tell me... how's my brother Delvin? Still spending his nights at the Ragged Flagon trying to win Vex's heart?"'' He will however also say: ''"Damn layabout never even bothers to send his own flesh and blood a letter saying how he's doing. Can you imagine?"'' In the end, he will have a Thieves Guild-related job for you: ''"Eager to make some coin, eh? That's the spirit. I'll tell you what. The Guild's got a problem out here that I've been trying to deal with for years, but haven't been able to handle. A fellow Breton who went by the name Esmond Tyne showed up on my doorstep about a fortnight ago. He noticed the shadowmarks like you did, and I thought he was one of us."'' He will then proceed to tell you what [[Skyrim:Esmond Tyne|Esmond Tyne]] stole: ''"It's my own formula for improved bonemold. Took me years to perfect."'' As for the whereabouts of Esmond, Glover only knows a bit: ''"Well, before he ran off, he was talking some nonsense about trying to fence goods to the rieklings at Castle Karstaag. I told him he was crazy to even think about talking to those vicious little buggers, but he wouldn't listen. I'd bet a fat purse of coin that he's either dead or hiding out up there."'' When you tell him you will retrieve the bonemold formula, he'll ''"make sure you're set up right"''. ===Castle Karstaag Caverns=== [[File:SR-interior-Castle Karstaag Caverns 03.jpg|thumb|right|The remains of Esmond Tyne]] [[Lore:Castle Karstaag|Castle Karstaag]] is a massive fortress of ice, located in the northwestern region of Solstheim. Your objective is the [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag Caverns| Castle Karstaag Caverns]], located at the bottom of the waterfall west of [[Skyrim:Saering's Watch|Saering's Watch]]. Enter the Caverns and head upstream. [[Skyrim:Riekling|Rieklings]] inhabit the cave and Esmond Tyne didn't make it very far in his attempt to fence goods to them. In the first huge chamber, he can be found dead with his lit lantern next to him. You can easily reach him by swimming silently, so you will never have to deal with the rieklings. Loot his corpse for the [[Skyrim:Bonemold Formula|bonemold formula]] and various leveled loot and leave the Caverns the same way you came. ===The Reward=== When you return to Glover with the formula in hand, he will not grieve over Esmond's death: ''"I told him not to head up there. Sounds like the bloody fool got what he deserved."'' He will then hand you the reward, the key to his house and basement, saying you can help yourself to whatever you find there. In fact, you can claim everything inside the house, so look around before heading down into the basement. Unlock the door and behold all the treasure, proving that Glover has been a high-esteemed Thieves Guild member and that he is very rich: [[File:SR-quest-Paid in Full 02.jpg|thumb|right|The hidden room]] {| class="vtop" | * [[Skyrim:Thief Cache|Thief Cache]] * Strong Box * [[Skyrim:Glover's Letter|Glover's Letter]] * Enchanted, leveled shield * Enchanted leveled [[Skyrim:Sword|sword]] * 3 [[Skyrim:Soul_Gems|soul gems]] * 5 different [[Skyrim:Potions#Poisons|poisons]] | * 3 different [[Skyrim:Potions|potions]] * 4 coin purses * A complete set of [[Skyrim:Blackguard's Armor|Blackguard's Armor]] * 3 bottles of [[Skyrim:Black-Briar_Reserve|Black-Briar Reserve]] * 6 bottles of [[Skyrim:Black-Briar_Mead|Black-Briar Mead]] * [[Skyrim:Lockpick|Lockpicks]] |}{{NewLine}} ===One Last Thing=== [[File:SR-quest-Paid in Full 03.jpg|thumb|right|''"I... I can't believe it."'']] Pick up [[Skyrim:Glover's Letter|Glover's Letter]] from the basement room and read through it. It solves the mystery about [[Skyrim:Sapphire (person)|Sapphire]] from [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] and reveals that Glover is her real father. It tells the tale about how he ran away from the farm where she was born, only to return fifteen years later when she had been abducted by bandits. It also reveals why Glover chose to move to Solstheim, simply because he saw her in the Thieves Guild and couldn't bear to tell her the truth. Time to tell Sapphire the truth, so travel to Riften and seek out Sapphire. Hand her the letter and she will say: ''"I... I can't believe it. All those years on the farm, and my mother never told me about any of this. Words can't even begin to describe how much I appreciate you bringing this to me. Here, take this. I used to carry it for good luck, but I think you deserve it more than I do."'' She will then hand you an [[Skyrim:Exquisite Sapphire|exquisite sapphire]], a unique item worth 5000 gold. == Notes == *You must be a member of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] to do this quest. *You need to have received your set of Thieves Guild armor from Tonilia in the Ragged Flagon, and you need to have asked both Vex and Delvin about extra work or read the book Shadowmarks by Delvin Mallory, to get the dialogue option to ask about the Shadowmark. *The contents of Glover Mallory's house [[Skyrim:Respawn|respawn]] after 10 days, making it possible to obtain several sets of the Blackguard's Armor. *If you attempt to turn in the quest to Mallory before sunrise, he may be at the nearby Earth Stone. If so, he won't begin his scripted dialogue to finish the quest, and will only have his normal non-quest dialogue options if engaged in conversation. Wait until after daybreak to approach him and he will begin talking to you to complete the quest. == Bugs == {{Bug|If the bonemold formula was found before the quest was started, Glover Mallory never asks you to retrieve it and the quest cannot be started.|vn=1}} **{{pc22}} Open the console and type setstage DLC2TGQuest 5. You should be able to ask about the Thieves Guild problem and give him the formula once he mentions it. {{Bug|All the Blackguard's Armor items will respawn when Glover Mallory's basement resets, allowing multiple copies of the set to be obtained.|UDBP|2.0.0}} {{Bug|Glover's Letter respawns along with the rest of the house, allowing you to give it to Sapphire repeatedly and receive unlimited Exquisite Sapphires, since she is not coded to respond only once to it.|fixedby=USLEEP}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Recover the Bonemold Formula for Glover Mallory}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Bring the Bonemold Formula to Glover Mallory}} |200|fin| |missing=5 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Detailed Walkthrough==
'''Note: This quest was originally added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armored Mudcrab|Dwarven Armored Mudcrab]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. With the release of the [[SR:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]], this quest no longer appears in your journal. The mudcrab can still be purchased from [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]].'''

Once you've installed the Dwarven Armored Mudcrab Creation, you will receive this quest and a [[Skyrim:Notice of Sale - Dwarven Mudcrab|notice of sale]], which directs you to talk to Calcelmo in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]].

Travel to Understone Keep in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] and meet Calcelmo in the ruins section of the keep. From him, you'll be able to purchase the [[Skyrim:Ownership Deed - Mudcrab|ownership deed]]. Once you've done so, you'll find the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armored Mudcrab (creature)|Dwarven Armored Mudcrab]] beside the arcane enchanter. You'll also receive a [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Teleport Pet Mudcrab|spell tome]] that teaches you a spell to [[Skyrim:Teleport Pet: Dwarven Mudcrab|teleport the mudcrab]] to you.

The mudcrab serves as an animal follower, with the added ability to carry items and allow you to send it to specific locations.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
'''Note: This quest was originally added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Nix-Hound|Nix-Hound]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. With the release of the [[SR:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]], this quest no longer appears in your journal. The Nix-Hound can still be acquired from Revus.'''

Once you've installed the [[Skyrim:Nix-Hound|Nix-Hound]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]], you will receive this quest and a [[Skyrim:Notice of Sale - Nix-Hound (Revus)|notice of sale]], which directs you to talk to  [[Skyrim:Revus Sarvani|Revus Sarvani]] at his camp west of [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]] on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]]. Revus is not an essential NPC, so it is possible to kill him prior to installing this Creation. If this occurs, you will instead receive a [[Skyrim:Notice of Sale - Nix-Hound (Geldis)|different notice]] directing you to [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] at [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|The Retching Netch]] in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]].

Travel to Solstheim and locate the specified NPC. Offer to purchase the nix-hound for 400 gold and you will be given a [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Teleport Pet Nix-Hound|spell tome]] that teaches you a spell to teleport the nix-hound to you. You will be directed to introduce yourself to the nearby nix-hound to complete the quest. It will now serve as an animal follower, with the added ability to carry items, provide you with random [[SR:Ingredients|ingredients]], or be sent to wait at a specific city or player house.

==Notes==
* The Nix-Hound Creation also adds enemy nix-hounds to the wilds of Solstheim.
* The pet Nix-Hound behaves identically to other [[SR:Creation Club|Creation Club]] pets, such as the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armored Mudcrab (creature)|mudcrab pet]] added by the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Armored Mudcrab|Dwarven Armored Mudcrab]] Creation.
*The Nix-Hound can be purchased by speaking directly to the Nix-Hound instead of Revus.

==Quick Walkthrough==

#Read the journal and cast a [[Skyrim:Fire Damage|fire]] spell at the seal.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This quest automatically begins upon approaching [[Skyrim:Myrwatch (place)|Myrwatch]], an undiscovered tower marked on your map. The tower is just east of [[SR:Morthal|Morthal]] and is guarded by a lone leveled [[SR:Chaurus|Chaurus]]. You will need to attempt to open the locked front entrance in order to update the quest.

The body of [[SR:Hans|Hans]] can be found nearby. Loot his body and read [[Skyrim:Hans's Journal|''Hans's Journal'']] to learn how to gain entrance to the tower. The journal provides a hint in this regard:
:''"When the eye is doused in flames, the {{sic|hair|hare}} will light the way."''
You will need to cast a [[SR:Fire Damage|fire damage]] spell at the eye-shaped seal on the ground in front of the entrance. Helpfully, Hans can also be looted for a copy of [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Flames|Spell Tome: Flames]] in case you have no fire damage spells. Once you cast the spell, the [[Skyrim:Elianora|ghostly apparition]] of a rabbit will appear (or more than likely a hare, per the hint in the journal). The apparition will proceed to hop over to the nearby magical brazier and will cause it to alight with a tower of blue energy. You will then receive a message stating that ''"The tower door was unlocked by mysterious forces."''

Head inside the tower to complete the quest and investigate your new [[Skyrim:Houses|player home]].

==Notes==
* This quest would originally be added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Myrwatch|Myrwatch]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. This was changed with the [[Skyrim:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]] update, allowing you to discover the location through natural gameplay.
**Myrwatch will still be marked on your map as an undiscovered location from the start of the game, a legacy of the original quest design.

==Quest Stages==
{{Journal Entries
|5||I've heard rumors of a mysterious tower somewhere east of Morthal. If it's abandoned, I may be able to make of use of it. When I reached the tower, I found a journal that may provide clues on how to enter it.
{{Quest Objective|5|Read Hans's journal}}
