==Quick Walkthrough==
#Obtain a piece of Nordic jewelry and read the [[SR:Certificate of Authenticity|''Certificate of Authenticity'']].
#Travel to [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]] and locate [[SR:Hugin Ice-Shaper|Hugin Ice-Shaper]] west of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]].
#Read [[SR:Hugin Ice-Shaper's Notebook|''Hugin Ice-Shaper's Notebook'']] and craft an item of Nordic jewelry to complete the quest.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Make a Purchase===
[[File:SR-icon-jewelry-Nordic Circlet.png|right|thumb|100px|Nordic circlet]][[File:SR-npc-Hugin Ice-Shaper.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Hugin Ice-Shaper]]
This quest will be added to your journal the first time you obtain a [[Skyrim:Nordic Amulet|Nordic Amulet]], [[Skyrim:Nordic Circlet|Nordic Circlet]], or [[Skyrim:Nordic Ring|Nordic Ring]]. A [[SR:Certificate of Authenticity|''Certificate of Authenticity'']] will be automatically added to your inventory, and you will be directed to read it to progress the quest.

Nordic jewelry can be found in the world as random loot. Alternatively, all general goods and jewelry merchants will have these items available for sale, so the quickest method may be to purchase a piece from them. For example, in [[SR:Riften|Riften]] you can purchase Nordic jewelry from the [[SR:Pawned Prawn|Pawned Prawn]] or from [[SR:Madesi|Madesi]]'s stall in Riften Grand Plaza. Note that these items are all relatively pricey given that they're pieces of jewelry.

Once you've obtained your first piece of Nordic jewelry, read the certificate to learn that the creator of the jewelry is a craftsman named [[SR:Hugin Ice-Shaper|Hugin Ice-Shaper]] who can be found on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]].

===Stalhrim Lapidary===
Travel to Solstheim and you will be directed to a spot west of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], in the ash wastes just north of the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]]. There you will find two hostile [[Skyrim:Reaver|reaver]]s (a melee fighter and an archer) standing over the body of Hugin. Dispense with them both and loot the melee reaver for three powerful enchanted items: a leveled [[SR:Nordic Amulet of Health|Nordic Amulet of Health]], a leveled [[SR:Nordic Circlet of Magicka|Nordic Circlet of Magicka]], and a leveled [[SR:Nordic Ring of Stamina|Nordic Ring of Stamina]]. You can then locate and read [[SR:Hugin Ice-Shaper's Notebook|''Hugin Ice-Shaper's Notebook'']] to learn how to craft Nordic jewelry.

To complete the quest, you will need to craft a piece of Nordic jewelry yourself. Be sure to grab the required components from the satchel next to the body: three samples of [[Skyrim:Stalhrim|stalhrim]] and three [[SR:Quicksilver Ingot|quicksilver ingot]]s. Head back into town and find a [[SR:Forge|forge]] in order to craft the jewelry of your choice and finish the quest.

{{NewLine}}
==Notes==
*This quest was originally added to your journal automatically upon installing the [[Skyrim:Nordic Jewelry|Nordic Jewelry]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. You would then be directed to Riften to purchase a Nordic jewelry item, although obtaining the jewelry via any other method would also progress the quest. This was changed with the [[SR:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]] update, and the quest now only starts once you have already obtained a Nordic jewelry item.
*The quest can also be started by simply approaching Hugin Ice-Shaper's corpse on Solstheim.

[[File:SR-quest-Pets of Skyrim 05.jpg|thumb|right|A trained goat is for sale in Whiterun Hold]] ===Goat for Sale=== In [[SR:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] in [[SR:Whiterun|Whiterun]], a [[Skyrim:For Sale|''For Sale'']] notice can be found at the counter. It is advertising for the sale of [[SR:Hilda|Hilda]], a trained pack [[SR:Goat|goat]] in [[SR:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. Journey to Rorikstead and locate [[SR:Halvar|Halvar]] in order to purchase the goat. Halvar is a farmhand who can be found working the field beside [[SR:Cowflop Farmhouse|Cowflop Farmhouse]]. He will sell Hilda for 200 gold, at which point it will act as your follower and can be given various orders such as instructions to wait at a specified [[SR:Cities|city]] or [[SR:Houses|player house]]. Upon purchasing Hilda, you will be prompted to read [[Skyrim:Halvar's Journal|''Halvar's Journal'']] to find out more about the goat. It can be found on Halvar's bedroll next to the field. Reading it will reveal that Halvar had come across many other tame animals in his travels, and your journal will update with objectives to track down each of them. They can be found and rescued in any order you wish. {{NewLine}} [[File:SR-quest-Pets of Skyrim 02.jpg|thumb|right|Sweet Roll stands over the body of its former master]] ===A Bosmer and His Fox=== In the forest south-southwest of [[SR:Half-Moon Mill|Half-Moon Mill]], you will come across a collared fox named [[SR:Sweet Roll (creature)|Sweet Roll]] standing over the body of a [[Skyrim:Wood Elf|Bosmer]] [[Skyrim:Thief (Pets of Skyrim)|thief]]. If you are having trouble finding it, stand beside the pile of rocks (the cairn) at the north end of the bridge and walk south; cross over the stream on foot; he is located right over the hill at about a total of 37 running steps from the cairn. A detect dead spell will show one blue and two red bodies. The thief was probably killed by [[SR:Wolf|wolves]], as evidenced by the scattered [[SR:Steel Arrow|arrows]] and the two wolf carcasses surrounding him. His body can be looted for some ill-gotten treasure as well as the [[Skyrim:Thief's Journal|''Thief's Journal'']]. Reading the journal will reveal that the fox has a penchant for [[SR:Sweet Roll|sweet rolls]] (thus the name). It will refuse to interact with you until you have a sweet roll in your inventory, at which point you can feed and tame it. Fortunately, the thief has five sweet rolls on his body. ===Alchemist Bunny=== A tame [[SR:Rabbit|rabbit]] named [[SR:Thistle (creature)|Thistle]] can be found at the abandoned [[SR:Alchemist's Shack|Alchemist's Shack]] in the mountain pass south of [[SR:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]]. The nearby [[Skyrim:Notes on Tamed Rabbit|''Notes on Tamed Rabbit'']] will reveal that Thistle enjoys [[SR:Carrot|carrots]]. A trough of carrots can be found right next to the rabbit, making it a simple matter to feed and tame it. {{NewLine}} [[File:SR-quest-Pets of Skyrim 03.jpg|thumb|right|Some vampires prefer the taste of fear, others the taste of pain]] ===The Taste of Pain=== You will be led to the hidden [[SR:Vampire|vampire]] lair within the spider-infested [[SR:Cronvangr Cave|Cronvangr Cave]] in order to obtain a pet [[SR:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spider]] named [[Skyrim:Arachnia|Arachnia]]. It has been tamed by a [[Skyrim:Vampire Naturalist|Vampire Naturalist]], who is using it to harvest vast amounts of venom for the purpose of torturing her victims before she drinks their blood. Kill the vampire and loot the [[Skyrim:Spider Cage Key|Spider Cage Key]] from her corpse in order to free Arachnia from its cage. You can also loot the [[Skyrim:Vampire Naturalist's Journal|''Vampire Naturalist's Journal'']] for some background information on her experiments. Once the cage is opened, Arachnia is yours. {{NewLine}} [[File:SR-quest-Pets of Skyrim 04.jpg|thumb|right|Free Skritch from a grisly fate]] ===A Skooma-Sucker's Dinner=== Within [[SR:The Ratway|the Ratway]] beneath [[SR:Riften|Riften]], you will come across a tame [[SR:Skeever|skeever]] named [[Skyrim:Skritch|Skritch]] found locked in a cage. You can find the body of its owner just across from the entrance to [[SR:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]]: a failed [[Skyrim:Pickpocket (person)|pickpocket]] who planned to catch skeevers for food but decided to train one instead for use as a distraction. Loot the [[Skyrim:Skeever Cage Key|Skeever Cage Key]] from his corpse and open the cage in order to rescue Skritch and claim the animal as your own. You can also read the [[Skyrim:Pickpocket's Journal|''Pickpocket's Journal'']] for optional background information. ===Pets of Skyrim=== Once you've obtained the last of the 5 pets, the quest concludes. Like other Creation Club pets, each one can obey a range of orders and each also has its own distinct attribute. Arachnia can place paralysis web traps and provide [[SR:Potent Frostbite Venom|Potent Frostbite Venom]]; Hilda can provide [[Skyrim:Jug of Milk|Jugs of Milk]]; Skritch can locate or provide [[Skyrim:Food|food]] items; Sweet Roll can locate or provide loot; and Thistle can locate plants which can be harvested for [[SR:Ingredients|ingredients]]. Some of the pets can also be equipped with an [[Skyrim:Animal Collar|Animal Collar]] or an [[Skyrim:Animal Pack|Animal Pack]], two items added by Pets of Skyrim; indeed, Hilda is already wearing a pack, and Sweet Roll a collar. The collar is simply aesthetic, but the pack provides a real benefit by increasing the pet's carrying capacity by 40. Each time you get a pet a new "Teleport: " spell appears. This can be used to retrieve your lost pet if it ever gets "misplaced". ==Bugs== {{Bug|The ''[[Skyrim:For Sale|For Sale]]'' note, ''[[Skyrim:Halvar's Journal|Halvar's Journal]]'', the ''[[Skyrim:Notes on Tamed Rabbit|Notes on Tamed Rabbit]]'', and the ''[[Skyrim:Thief's Journal|Thief's Journal]]'' all remain marked as quest items even after the quest ends, resulting in them being stuck in your inventory permanently.|confirmed=1|OSSEP|1.6.318|dlc=CC}} **{{Pc22}} This can be fixed with the console commands player.dropitem or player.removeitem where is the [[Skyrim:Form ID|ID]] of the item you want to drop from your inventory. {{Bug|If you purchase the goat from Halvar in Rorikstead before reading the ''[[Skyrim:For Sale|For Sale]]'' note, the marker directing the player to purchase the goat from Halvar may not be able to be marked as cleared.|confirmed=1|dlc=CC}} {{Bug|If you do not purchase the goat from Halvar before collecting all the other pets, the quest will still complete and the goat will be unobtainable; although the dialogue option to buy it will remain there, it will have no effect besides making you lose 200 gold.|confirmed=1|dlc=CC}} {{Bug |If you kill Sweetroll before getting the quest to tame it, it will reappear alive, and be tameable.|dlc=CC}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Find the tamed rabbit}} {{Quest Objective|20|Find the tamed skeever}} {{Quest Objective|30|Find the tamed spider}} {{Quest Objective|40|Find the tamed fox}} {{Quest Objective|50|Find Hilda the goat}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Find a treat for the rabbit}} |110||{{Quest Objective|110|Feed Thistle a carrot}} |200||{{Quest Objective|200|Find a key to the skeever cage}} |210||{{Quest Objective|210|Free Skritch from its cage}} |300||{{Quest Objective|300|Find a key to the spider cage}} |310||{{Quest Objective|310|Free Arachnia from its cage}} |400||{{Quest Objective|400|Find out more about the fox}} |410||{{Quest Objective|410|Feed Sweet Roll a sweet roll}} |500||{{Quest Objective|500|Find out more about the goat}} |510||{{Quest Objective|510|Buy Hilda from Halvar}} |1000||The journey through Skyrim can be hard and long, and I could use the companionship of a loyal animal. ==Quick Walkthrough==

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Kragrash the Vampire Hunter===
The quest starts when you read [[Skyrim:Kragrash's Letter|Kragrash's letter]] at [[Skyrim:Ironback Hideout|Ironback Hideout]], a remote bandit camp high in the mountains of [[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]]. This location can be quite difficult to reach as it only has one approach.

Defeat the [[SR:Bandit|bandit]]s camped out at the hideout and locate ''[[SR:Kragrash's Letter|Kragrash's Letter]]'' on the table inside the ruined house (it may be difficult to see). Searching the hideout, you may come across a new trapdoor beneath a tent. This trapdoor has been added by the Creation and is locked for now.
[[File:SR-quest-Night Hunter 02.jpg|thumb|right|Claim Kragrash's crossbows for yourself]]
The letter reveals that Ironback Hideout used to be occupied by an [[SR:Orc|Orc]]ish vampire hunter named Kragrash. He contracted [[SR:Vampirism|vampirism]] and subsequently became suicidal, hiking east into the mountains to watch one final sunrise before he turned. In his letter, he invites you to seek him out and claim his vampire hunting equipment.

You will need to travel to the nearby [[SR:Thalmor Embassy|Thalmor Embassy]] to find Kragrash's final resting place. To the south of the embassy's entrance, you will come upon a burnt corpse on the edge of a cliff; this is the remains of Kragrash, who apparently covered himself in [[SR:Dwarven Oil|Dwarven oil]] and ensured that he would be burnt up in the sunlight. Loot his corpse to find the [[SR:Ironback Hideout Cellar Key|Ironback Hideout Cellar Key]] which can be used on the trapdoor back at Ironback Hideout.

===Reward===
With the key, you will have the ability to enter [[SR:Ironback Hideout Cellar|Ironback Hideout Cellar]], a remarkably well-preserved base of operations containing a vault filled with vampire hunting equipment. The quest will end once you enter the cellar and you'll gain the ability to craft [[SR:Ebony Crossbow|Ebony Crossbow]] and [[SR:Elven Crossbow|Elven Crossbow]], then you are free to unlock the vault and loot everything within. A Silver sword and greatsword can be found here. Laid out on a table you will find an [[SR:Ebony Crossbow|Ebony Crossbow]], an [[SR:Elven Crossbow|Elven Crossbow]], and several [[SR:Exploding Dwarven Bolt of Fire|Exploding Dwarven Bolts of Fire]] and [[SR:Exploding Dwarven Bolt of Shock|Shock]]. These two powerful crossbows are the main reward for this quest, and can be enhanced using the nearby [[SR:Anvil|anvil]].

==Notes==
*The Enhanced variants for both crossbows can be crafted only and won't appear in merchant inventories similar to the expanded crossbows. The regular Ebony and Elven crossbows will be available for purchase from the [[Skyrim:Fletcher (place)|Fletcher]] upon their discovery.
*This is one of the few locations, which is not added by the Dawnguard DLC, where Silver weaponry can be found without progressing through the Companions questline.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Hungry Rieklings===
Travel to [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]], to a small unmarked camp along the coast north of [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]], not to be confused with the nearby camp of [[Skyrim:Haknir's Shoal|Haknir's Shoal]] on an islet to the northwest.

At the camp, you will find the body of a [[SR:Dark Elf (dead)|Dark Elf]] peddler who was apparently killed by [[Skyrim:Horker|Horker]]s. To start the quest, loot his body for the ''[[SR:Peddler's Journal|Peddler's Journal]]'', which describes his interactions with a tribe of [[Skyrim:Riekling|riekling]]s from an island to the north. The peddler was attempting to trade with the rieklings, who had mistaken his netch leather armor for food. They also made off with a book explaining how to craft netch leather armor, believing it to be a cookbook. [[Skyrim:Netch Leather|Netch leather]] is of course highly toxic, which forced the peddler to begin importing regular leather from the mainland and dyeing it to fool the rieklings and prevent their untimely deaths.

After reading the book, you will need to swim northward to the riekling camp to meet with the [[SR:Riekling Tribe Leader|Riekling Tribe Leader]]. Unlike most of their kind, the rieklings on this island are non-hostile and will allow you to approach.

===Leather Delivery===
[[File:SR-quest-More Than You Can Chew 02.jpg|thumb|left|Straight from the source]][[File:SR-book-Riekling Hunting Party Sketch.png|right|thumb|Riekling hunting party sketch|200px]]
The Tribe Leader is a riekling of few words. After a brief one-sided exchange, he will hand you a [[SR:Riekling Hunting Party Sketch|Riekling Hunting Party Sketch]], a crude drawing which identifies the location of a hunting party sent to track down a [[SR:Giant Bull Netch|Giant Bull Netch]]. At this point you will have several branching options for how to deal with the tribe.

You can attempt to pass a Very Hard [[SR:Persuade|Persuasion]] check to convince the Tribe Leader that ingesting netch leather will kill him and that he should give you the crafting book. If you can't manage to convince him, your only option if you wish to save the rieklings is to use a [[SR:Tanning Rack|tanning rack]] to create [[SR:Imitation Netch Leather|Imitation Netch Leather]], by combining regular [[SR:Leather|leather]] with [[SR:Charcoal|charcoal]] and a [[SR:Purple Mountain Flower|purple mountain flower]]. This can then be given to the Tribe Leader to progress the quest.

Alternatively, you can track down the hunting party along the coast just east of the [[Skyrim:Sun Stone|Sun Stone]]. You will arrive to find a party of rieklings engaged in battle with a family of netches (the Giant Bull Netch along with a [[SR:Giant Betty Netch|Giant Betty Netch]] and a [[Skyrim:Netch Calf|Netch Calf]]). Both sides are [[Skyrim:Protected NPCs|protected]] so it will be up to you to deliver the killing blows and decide the battle. You can kill the rieklings in order to save the netch, or you can join in and claim the [[SR:Giant Bull Netch Leather|Giant Bull Netch Leather]] for yourself. You can then deliver the leather to the Tribe Leader to progress the quest.

It is possible to obtain both the Giant Bull Netch Leather and the Imitation Netch Leather and decide which you want to give to the tribe. You can also just attack the Rieklings and loot the Tribe Leader's corpse.

Whichever choice you make, you will be rewarded with a [[SR:Key to Riekling Chest|key]] which unlocks a nearby chest containing the book ''[[SR:Crafting with Netch Leather|Crafting with Netch Leather]]'' as well as a full set of Painted Netch Leather armor. Loot the contents to complete the quest.

===Crafting with Netch Leather===
[[File:SR-quest-More Than You Can Chew 03.jpg|thumb|left|The optional chest in Fort Hraggstad]]
Although the quest completes once you loot the chest, you will be given a [[Skyrim:Miscellaneous Quests|miscellaneous objective]] to read the crafting book. Doing so will give you two further objectives: the option to either craft your own set of Netch Leather armor, or to instead track down a shipment somewhere in [[SR:Fort Hraggstad|Fort Hraggstad]].

It is advisable to search Fort Hraggstad for a full set rather than crafting your own, as the chest is located just inside the fort's main entrance and contains an additional unique item, the [[SR:Boots of Blinding Speed|Boots of Blinding Speed]]. This artifact is legendary for the extreme speed at which it allows the wearer to travel, although unfortunately it curses you with total blindness while equipped. This can be somewhat negated through the use of [[Skyrim:Night Eye (effect)|Night Eye]]. Once you've obtained a set of Netch Leather armor, both objectives will complete.
{{NewLeft}}

==Notes==
* The Boots of Blinding Speed previously appeared in [[MW:Morrowind|''TES III: Morrowind'']] and bore a similar enchantment which could likewise be negated through magical effects.
*The Painted Netch Leather Armor cannot be crafted and can only be found within the Riekling Tribe Chest. Its armor rating is higher than all the other variants.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Once a Hunter.jpg|thumb|left|Rifle through papers in the guard barracks.]][[File:SR-quest-Once a Hunter 03.jpg|thumb|right|Aesrael's camp]]
To begin this quest travel to the [[SR:Falkreath Barracks|Falkreath Barracks]]. Once there, read ''[[SR:Guard Dossier: Aesrael|Guard Dossier: Aesrael]]'' or ''[[SR:Guard's Bounty Letter Draft|Guard's Bounty Letter Draft]]'' which will grant you the quest and direct you to the forests west of [[Skyrim:Sunderstone Gorge|Sunderstone Gorge]].

Once there, locate [[SR:Aesrael|Aesrael]]'s camp. You must obtain [[SR:Aesrael's Key|Aesrael's Key]] from him, either by pickpocketing or killing him. Note that both Aesrael and his pet wolf [[SR:Dusk|Dusk]] will be hostile.

After the key is obtained, use it to open the chest near his tent, which will contain the [[SR:Elven Hunter Armor|Elven Hunter Armor]], [[SR:Elven Hunter Boots|Boots]], and [[SR:Elven Hunter Gauntlets|Gauntlets]], as well as a copy of ''[[Lore:The Crimson Dirks, v7|The Crimson Dirks, v7]]'' and some leveled loot.
{{NewLine}}

==Notes==
*The Fishing side quest [[SR:Clear-Headed|Clear-Headed]] overlaps here in the barracks.
*The location of Aesrael's camp overlaps with the final location of the [[SR:Redguard Elite Armaments|Redguard Elite Armaments]] creation that is at the entrance to Sunderstone Gorge. So his wolf "Dusk" may attack while doing that quest.
*This is the lightest armor in the game.
*After the quest is completed, pieces of Elven Hunter Armor can appear in leveled lists of loot (such as the leveled cuirass in the last chamber of [[Skyrim:Shroud_Hearth_Barrow#Shroud_Hearth_Depths|Shroud Hearth Barrow]]). It will also be added to the inventory of [[Skyrim:Blacksmith|Blacksmiths]], who will begin selling pieces of Elven Hunter Armor. In contrast to most other alternative armors, it will not appear in the crafting menu, merchant chests, or the inventory of NPCs before this.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
After reading [[SR:Svarig|Svarig]]'s journal during the quest [[Skyrim:Balance of Power|Balance of Power]], you are given a miscellaneous quest to learn more about the gang's mysterious benefactor. Following the quest marker directs you to a camp east of Svarig's camp. Under one of the tents you'll find a knapsack containing the ''[[SR:Bandit's Note on Hidden Treasure|Bandit's Note on Hidden Treasure]]'', which points you to [[SR:Crystaldrift Cave|Crystaldrift Cave]]. 

Upon entering the cave, you'll find the body of Gadnor on a stone bier, along with a small campsite. Next to the campsite is a makeshift altar to Kynareth, some minor loot, and the journal ''[[Skyrim:Gadnor's Last Wishes|Gadnor's Last Wishes]]''. The journal explains that, according to his wishes, a friend of Gadnor placed him here and placed an illusion over his beloved warhammer Nerveshatter. In order to reveal the hammer, one must place 1x amber and 1x madness ore on the brazier near Gadnor's bier.

Doing so will reveal Nerveshatter and you can claim your prize. When you do so, Seducer bandits will show up and attack you.

==Notes==
*Both amber and madness ore materials are rare, but you are guaranteed to find both if you did the quest [[Skyrim:Restoring Order|Restoring Order]]. Within [[Skyrim:Solitude Sewers|Solitude Sewers]] lies many hollowed tree stumps with a high chance to contain amber. On [[Skyrim:Thoron|Thoron]]'s desk lies a piece of madness ore. Both items can be bought from [[Skyrim:Ri'saad|Ri'saad]].
* After gaining Nerveshatter, you can take back the Amber and Madness Ore.
* Don't miss the Gadnor's Staff of Charming he holds on the rock and the Moonstone Ore Vein on the South wall half-way up the ramp.

In the Seducers Bandit Camp northwest of [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], there is a large cage with a [[Skyrim:Elytra Nymph|Demented Elytra Nymph]] pet.  Nearby is a [[Skyrim:Note on Demented Elytra Nymph|note]], as well as a [[Skyrim:Seducers Bandit's Cage Key|key]] inside of a chest.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Suicide in Haafingar===
Upon installing the [[SR:Alternative Armors - Steel Soldier|Alternative Armors - Steel Soldier]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]], you will be directed to read a [[Skyrim:Suicide at Dragon Bridge|note]] located in the [[SR:Four Shields Tavern|Four Shields Tavern]] in [[SR:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]]. Reading it, you will learn of an apparent suicide which took place at the town's eponymous Dragon Bridge. A new recruit guardsman had gone missing but a fellow guard named [[Skyrim:Aldepius|Aldepius]] claims to have seen him leap from the bridge.

You will find the [[SR:Guard (Alternative Armors - Steel Soldier)|guard]]'s body quite a ways downstream to the northeast of the bridge (though on the south bank of the river). It is just before the river meets another on their way to the bay at Solitude; about half-way between Dragon Bridge and the Solitude Sawmill. On the guard's body, you will find [[Skyrim:Guard's Note on Aldepius|a note]] that shows the dead guard suspected Aldepius of being a bandit informant rather than a stationed member of the Dragon Bridge garrison. You will need to return to town to confront Aldepius.

===Duel at the Dragon Bridge===
[[File:SR-quest-Over the Edge 02.jpg|thumb|right|Face Peladius on the bridge]]
Upon re-entering the Four Shields Tavern, you will find that Aldepius is nowhere to be found. Instead, he has left a [[Skyrim:Aldepius' Confession|confession]] at one of the tables, inviting you to face him in honorable combat at the Dragon Bridge. In it he admits that his real name is [[SR:Peladius|Peladius]] and that he is a former member of the [[SR:Crimson Dirks|Crimson Dirks]] bandit gang.

Peladius will be waiting for you on the bridge and will attack on sight, so be prepared to fight to the death. Grant him the honorable death he wishes for, and loot his body for a full set of [[Skyrim: Alternative Armors - Steel Soldier Items|enchanted steel soldier armor]]. This will complete the quest and will grant you the ability to craft this new armor for yourself.
{{NewLine}}

==Notes==
*If the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] still holds [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], the guards involved in this quest will be wearing Solitude colors. If the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] have taken the city, the guards will be wearing Stormcloak armor instead.

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Speak to an innkeeper or wait for a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]].
#Kill [[Skyrim:Erwan|Erwan]] at [[Skyrim:Traitor's Post|Traitor's Post]] and obtain ''[[Skyrim:Erwan's Journal|Erwan's Journal]]'' and the [[Skyrim:Ring of Masser|Ring of Masser]].
#Obtain the set of [[Skyrim:Daedric Mail|Daedric mail]] armor from [[Skyrim:Ma'dran|Ma'dran]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Speak to an innkeeper and ask them for work. You will be handed a note titled ''[[Skyrim:Missing Merchant (note)|Missing Merchant]]'' and the quest begins.

You learn that the jarl has put out a call for aid regarding the disappearance of a merchant, [[Skyrim:Gunther|Gunther Frost-Foot]], who was last seen in the area of [[Skyrim:Traitor's Post|Traitor's Post]] east of [[SR:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. You will be tasked to go there and investigate.

Traitor's Post, a destroyed cabin, is currently home to a gang of bandits led by a Breton female named [[Skyrim:Erwan|Erwan]]. Upon killing Erwan, you will be prompted to loot her body and read her [[Skyrim:Erwan's Journal|journal]]. Erwan, it seems, is quite disturbed, and currently considers the corpse of Gunther to be her "best friend". She mentions in passing that she sold a suit of [[Skyrim:Daedric Mail|Daedric mail]] to a Khajiit caravaner named [[Skyrim:Ma'dran|Ma'dran]], but that he should be willing to trade the armor for a ring she currently possesses. This ring is the [[Skyrim:Ring of Masser|Ring of Masser]], which you will find on Gunther's naked corpse within the cabin.

You will be prompted to track down Ma'dran, whose [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders|trade caravan]] travels between Windhelm and [[SR:Solitude|Solitude]]. You then have the choice of either trading the ring to him for a set of [[Skyrim:Daedric Mail|Daedric mail]] armor, or paying 5,000 gold for the armor. The ring has a base value of 5,211, so this is a fair trade if you don't wish to keep it. The quest will complete once you have obtained the set of armor, and you will subsequently begin to find Daedric mail items as random loot throughout the world.

==Notes==
*Regular Daedric armor starts appearing in leveled lists at level 48, but this Creation is not level-locked and can be completed by characters of any level.
**Paired with [[Skyrim:Bittercup|the Bittercup creation]] and specifically choosing [[Skyrim:The Pit (quest)|to fill the Altar of Power]], you can get a full set of Daedric armor at level one, with both normal and mail gauntlets.

Skyrim:Purity.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=RobinHood70 |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Trail2|Quests|Companions|Radiant}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] or [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] |Reward=Leveled gold |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]], [[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]] |Image=SR-quest-Purity.jpg |ImgDesc=The [[Skyrim:Wolf_Spirit|wolf spirit]] appears when the Flame is activated |description=Help a member of the Circle give up their beasthood. |ID=CR13 |Icon= |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[SR:Farkas|Farkas]] or [[SR:Vilkas|Vilkas]] about work for the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]]. # Agree to help them purify themselves. # Collect a [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch Head|Glenmoril witch head]] and travel to [[Skyrim:Ysgramor's Tomb|Ysgramor's Tomb]]. # Fight the [[Skyrim:Wolf Spirit|wolf spirit]] of [[Skyrim:Farkas's Wolf Spirit|Farkas]] or [[Skyrim:Vilkas's Wolf Spirit|Vilkas]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Melancholy Companion=== When you speak to either Farkas or Vilkas about work, the response may be a bit out of the ordinary. Each has something weighing on them, a personal matter. Play the good therapist here and ask what the trouble is. They will reveal that they have been pondering [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak's]] choice in the [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]] quest and want to follow suit: to be cured of [[Skyrim:Werewolf|lycanthropy]]. ===The Right Ingredients=== If you have a Glenmoril witch head in your inventory from your previous adventures in the [[Skyrim:Blood's Honor|Blood's Honor]] quest, the brother will urge you on to Ysgramor's Tomb. If you do not have one, the Companion is eager to procure one. Travel to [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Coven|Glenmoril Coven]] to take a head. There are five [[Skyrim:Glenmoril Witch|Glenmoril witches]] laid up in the coven. Depending on how many heads you gathered in the previous visit to the coven, harvest what you need. If you did not [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy#Curing Lycanthropy|cure yourself of lycanthropy]] in the previous quest and wish to be rid of it now, harvest a head for yourself as well. However, you will need to finish the quest by curing the active follower, before you can cure yourself. ===The Ritual=== When you have one of the heads, return to Ysgramor's tomb. As you did for Kodlak in [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]], activate the Flame of the Harbinger by tossing in the head. This will release the wolf spirit of the brother wanting to be cured. You must destroy the wolf spirit in order for him to be purged of his wolfish ways. When the spirit is destroyed, Vilkas or Farkas will describe a soothing sensation and a clear mind and thank you for your help with a leveled amount of gold. ===Reward=== {{SRCompanionsRadiantReward}} ==Bugs== {{Bug|On agreeing to rid Vilkas of his lycanthropy, he will follow you out of Jorrvaskr. The quest marker will appear on Ysgramor's Tomb but disappear after a few seconds. Vilkas will stop following you but the game will act as though he still is, which results in your not being able to take another follower or complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Have two witch's heads in your inventory and save the game before you hand over each Companion mission. When you ask for a new job and Vilkas asks you to cure him, reload your last save and ask Vilkas to join you. Inside Ysgramor's Tomb, part ways with Vilkas and then speak to him again to tell him you've finished the last mission. Ask him for more work and accept to cure his lycanthropy. He will then follow you to the font where you can throw in the witch's head and fight his wolf spirit. The game then asks you to talk to Vilkas, but you cannot. You can, however, purify yourself once this has happened by throwing another witch's head into the font and fighting your own wolf spirit. Be aware that the game still thinks Vilkas is a follower, so you will be unable to have a genuine follower once you have done this. **{{ps22}}If you lead/take Vilkas back to Jorrvaskr and go inside you can get rid of above issue with him as a permanent follower and take on another follower as normal. **Speak to Vilkas first. If he does not immediately asked to be cured, take his radiant quest then speak to him with the witch's head in your inventory. He should then ask - however you should not take it. Refuse him, and instead check to see if Farkas is offering any work. If Farkas is now offering work but only a random/radiant quest, take it and then speak to him again (once completed) with the head in your inventory. He should now ask you to help him rid his lycanthropy. Help him (Farkas) first, and then go back and help Vilkas with his personal request. ***If Farkas still will not offer any work, purity quest nor radiant quest, go and speak with Aela and do a quest for her. This will unlock Farkas' quests. **Alternatively, wait until Vilkas offers the cue dialogue of "Is there any work to be done?", but immediately close the dialogue box. Fast-travel to anywhere, then come back. Farkas should now offer the cue dialogue, and you can perform the quest with him. Repeat with Vilkas. **Do the purity quest with Farkas first. After this is done, when you return to Vilkas, do a regular quest and then pick the purity quest again. Vilkas will now follow you without a glitch. **{{pc22}} Take Vilkas to Ysgramor's Tomb as described, split ways, report the success of the last errand, and agree to help Vilkas with his wolf spirit. Instead of activating the Flame Of The Harbinger, enter quest stage 100 by using the console command setstage CR13 100. Vilkas is now cured. Repeat with Farkas, but this time, activate the Flame. **Complete a couple of random requests from Farkas and Aela, then get the [[Skyrim:Dragon_Seekers|Dragon Seekers]] quest from Vilkas. Slay the dragon with Farkas and this will resolve the follower issue. **To fix the bug, talk to Vilkas to get a regular quest. Complete the regular "looking for work" quest, then go speak to Farkas. He should now ask for help curing his lycanthropy. You should now be able to complete the quest normally. **To fix the bug alternatively, If you have the Dawnguard add-on, then complete a basic task for Vilkas and then talk to Aela. Complete tasks for her until she gives you a quest to find one of three Werewolf Totems. Aela will then accompany you on the quest for them, replacing your "invisible follower". This then allows you to complete the "Purity" quest for Farkas first, then Vilkas. {{Bug|Activating the blue fire during this quest for Farkas and Vilkas may not remove a Glenmoril Witch Head from your inventory when it did for [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak]]'s spirit during [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]].|USKP|1.2}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10|| wants to be cured of lycanthropy, and has asked me to help him. We must take a Glenmoril Witch's head to the Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the same ceremony which cured Kodlak. {{Quest Objective|10|Collect a Glenmoril Witch's head}} |15|| wants to be cured of lycanthropy, and has asked me to help him. We must take a Glenmoril Witch's head to the Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the same ceremony which cured Kodlak. {{Quest Objective|15|Cleanse of beastblood}} |17||{{Quest Objective|17|Kill 's wolf spirit}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Talk to }} |100|fin|I helped cure himself of lycanthropy. |200|fin| |missing=0, 1 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:Restoration Ritual Spell.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Bign0se |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)|Spell Rituals|link3=Spells}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Colette_Marence|Colette Marence]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Bane of the Undead|Bane of the Undead]], ability to purchase Master level [[Skyrim:Restoration Spells|Restoration spells]] and Master level [[Skyrim:Alteration Spells|Alteration spells]], due to a [[Skyrim:Restoration Ritual Spell#Bugs|bug]]. |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim: Good Intentions|Good Intentions]] |Prereq= Level 90 [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(place)|College of Winterhold]] |Image=SR-npc-Augur_of_Dunlain.jpg |ImgDesc=Augur of Dunlain |description=Find the [[Skyrim:Augur_of_Dunlain|Augur of Dunlain]] and learn more about [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] magic. |ID=MGRitual04 |Icon= |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Colette_Marence|Colette Marence]]. #Talk to [[Skyrim:Augur of Dunlain|Augur of Dunlain]]. #Pass the Augur's test. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Find the Augur of Dunlain=== Once you reach level 90 in the [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] skill and have completed [[Skyrim: Good Intentions|Good Intentions]], travel to the [[Skyrim:College_of_Winterhold_(place)|College of Winterhold]] and speak with [[Skyrim:Colette_Marence|Colette Marence]]. Ask her if you can learn anything more about Restoration magic. She will tell you to go speak with the [[Skyrim:Augur of Dunlain|Augur of Dunlain]] down in [[Skyrim:The Midden|The Midden]]. ===Pass the test=== The [[Skyrim:Augur of Dunlain|Augur of Dunlain]] will give you a test. Once you have stepped into the "light", all non-quest items will be taken from your possession. The Augur will summon one ghost, shortly followed by another, and finally a third; each will attack you with destruction spells and/or weapons. It is not possible to attack these [[Skyrim:Ghost|ghosts]]; your only goal is to keep yourself alive using Restoration magic. Alternatively, the [[Skyrim:Become_Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout will leave you invincible for most or all of the test, depending on how many words have been unlocked. If you are still alive when the test stops, you will receive your items back and the [[Skyrim:Bane_of_the_Undead|Bane of the Undead]] spell. You will also be able to buy the [[Skyrim:Guardian_Circle|Guardian Circle]] spell from [[Skyrim:Colette_Marence|Colette Marence]] the next time her inventory resets. ==Notes== * If your Sneak skill is high enough, you can simply crouch before the first ghost notices you and remain hidden for the duration of the test. * The ghosts favor [[Skyrim:Frost Damage|frost]] spells, so if you are a [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] or [[Skyrim:Vampirism|vampire]]—or better yet, both—this will be very easily accomplished. * You can take along one item (for example, a ring with double magic resist 45%) to the test by dropping the item and then holding it in the air while going to the light. * If you have completed [[Skyrim:Bound_Until_Death|Bound Until Death]] from the Dark Brotherhood quest line, you can [[Skyrim:Summon Spectral Assassin|summon]] the [[Skyrim:Spectral Assassin|Spectral Assassin]] while crouching and the test will be passed after a few seconds. * Appearance of the Guardian Circle spell upon the completion of this quest can be bugged. See [[Skyrim:Guardian Circle|Guardian Circle]] for fix. * You can give as many items as you need to your [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]], and step in to the light. Then, before the first ghost notices you, talk to your follower and trade items to retrieve them. Items with [[Skyrim:Fortify Restoration|Fortify Restoration]], [[Skyrim:Fortify Sneak|Fortify Sneak]], and/or [[Skyrim:Resist Frost|Resist Frost]] enchantments would be good choices. * Unlike other ritual quests, this one grants you the first spell directly rather than as a spell tome. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Even after you finish the quest, Colette may still not have the Guardian Circle spell for sale.|OSP|1.9}} {{Bug|After meeting the Augur of Dunlain and stepping into the light, the game may hang up.|confirmed=1}} ** Removing some of the items from your inventory before stepping into the light may help avoid the bug. {{bug|Completing this quest may cause a persistent scripting error to repeat several times a second. It appears to be unintrusive in gameplay, but it will flood Papyrus logs.|USKP|2.0.0}} **{{pc22}} By using the console, the quest can be set to an earlier stage where the faulty script does not occur: setstage MGRitual04 10. {{Bug|After you survive the test, the Augur's scripted response of ''You are worthy. The knowledge is yours'' might get stuck in a loop. However, the quest will still be marked as complete and leaving the chamber has no negative side effects.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|One or more of the hostile ghosts might linger after the test is complete. As they are ethereal, they cannot be killed, and will follow you around the Midden Dark attacking you.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Reloading a save previous to the ritual will solve this problem. {{Bug|The game will incorrectly flag the [[Skyrim:Alteration Ritual Spell|Alteration Ritual Spell]] quest as being completed, instead of the Restoration quest.|confirmed=1}} ** This causes the spell tome [[Skyrim:Mass Paralysis|Mass Paralysis]] to be available for purchase upon quest completion. ** The bug doesn't prevent the Dragonborn from completing the Alteration quest at a later date. ** Bug fixed by the Unofficial Skyrim Patch. {{Bug|Sometimes the Guardian Circle spell tome may not appear after successfully completing the quest.|confirmed=1}} ** Reloading a previous save and interacting with Colette Marence's merchant inventory prior to starting the quest seems to fix this. ** This may occur because the game incorrectly flags the Alteration ritual quest as being completed instead of the Restoration quest. You can buy the Guardian Circle spell directly after completing the quest because the game also gives her the tome directly so you wouldn't have to wait until her inventory resets, but once it does reset, the book will never appear again. **{{pc22}} You can fix this with the console command set MGRitualRestBook to 0 . {{Bug|If you successfully complete the test, the quest will complete, but you may not receive your items back (or they can remain unequipped), nor will the Augur speak with you again.|confirmed=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've asked Colette about additional training in Restoration. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Find [[SR:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]].
# Pay the fine.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This quest will automatically begin after killing another College member, provided you have already joined the College yourself. The quest description will inform you that you have been suspended from the College. It is a very short quest, requiring you only to find [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] in the College and speak to him. Tolfdir lectures you about behaviors that the College finds inappropriate, and states that he will have your suspension lifted if you pay a fine. Paying the fine results in immediate reinstatement into the College's ranks and completion of the quest.

==Notes==
* This quest may begin even if you have completed the College of Winterhold questline and became Arch-Mage.
* Murder is the only crime that will trigger this quest; lesser crimes, such as pickpocketing and theft, will not.
* The fine for the first incident is 250 gold. If you commit another crime and receive the quest again, the fine climbs to 500 gold. It increases to 750 gold for the third incident, and 1,000 gold for each incident thereafter.
** Tolfdir increases the amount of the fine according to the number of past incidents, not their severity. Therefore, as long as it's your first such incident, you can murder a non-essential member of the College and only have to pay 250 gold, one quarter of the bounty that would be charged in any hold for murder.
* Tolfdir may instead be found in [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]] if you are between starting [[Skyrim:Under Saarthal|Under Saarthal]] and finishing [[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
You get this quest for offending the [[sr:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], usually by assaulting/murdering one of their members, attempting to steal from them and getting caught or murdering someone during a guild quest. This will result in an expulsion, meaning no more training sessions or fencing services and limited conversations with guild members. To rejoin the guild, speak to [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]], who will reprimand you and demand 1,000 gold as reparations. Return when you have the money and you will be let back into the guild.

If you've been expelled for assault, you may need to wait 48 hours outside the Ragged Flagon for hostile guild members to calm down.

Skyrim:Purity of Revenge.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Companions |Giver=[[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] |Reward=None |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Blood's Honor|Blood's Honor]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]], [[Skyrim:Driftshade Refuge|Driftshade Refuge]] |Image=SR-quest-Purity of Revenge.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] and [[Skyrim:Njada Stonearm|Njada]] with [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak]]'s body |description=Retrieve the Fragments of Wuuthrad and wipe out the [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]]. |ID=C05 |Icon=SR-qico-Companions.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # With [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] as a shield brother, infiltrate the [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]]'s refuge. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Fragments of Wuuthrad|Fragments of Wuuthrad]]. # (Optional) Wipe out the [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]]. # Return to [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Revenge Served Cold=== After the death of [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]], [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] is looking for revenge. He wants to go after the [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]] for the attack on Jorrvaskr and the further affront of stealing the [[Skyrim:Fragments of Wuuthrad|fragments of Wuuthrad]]. With no questions asked, Vilkas will then act as your follower all the way to the Silver Hand hideout at [[Skyrim:Driftshade Refuge|Driftshade Refuge]], a small fort southeast of [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]]. Upon arrival at the fort, dispose of the two Silver Hand members outside, a guard at the entrance and an archer on the roof, then head inside. Vilkas will equip the helmet of his [[Skyrim:Wolf Armor|Wolf Armor]] for the duration of the assault. ===Den of the Silver Hand=== Not surprisingly, Driftshade Refuge is crawling with hostile Silver Hand members, so take advantage of your follower and kill the opposition one by one. In the two-leveled room with many boxes on the floor, make sure to search for ''[[Skyrim:An Explorer's Guide to Skyrim|An Explorer's Guide to Skyrim]]'' which will add a few map markers for later exploration. It is located on a bookshelf beneath an elk head mounted on the wall. The tunnel north of the room contains a locked door, so unlock it and wipe out yet another Silver Hand. In the next room, a set of spears blocks the entrance but the corresponding lever is easily located right next to the spears. Proceed forward and enter Driftshade Cellar. After the first turn, make sure to loot the hidden treasure chest, then follow the path and make use of the [[Skyrim:Spike Wall|Spike Wall]] trap to dispose of yet another enemy. Ignore the locked cell with the dead [[Skyrim:Werewolves|werewolf]], activate the trap again and run to the area behind it for another treasure chest. Hit the pullbar on the wall to get back out, and head forward to another room with two enemies and, hidden on a shelf, the [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The_Rear_Guard|The Rear Guard]]''. The cellar now turns into a snowy cave, and the next room is in two levels, with a Silver Hand sniper on the ledge above. Kill him and examine the cages, one of them holds a living werewolf, who will attack you if you pick the lock, the other one contains a dead [[Skyrim:Horses|horse]]. [[File:SR-quest-Purity of Revenge 02.jpg|thumb|The Fragments of Wuuthrad]] ===The Fragments of Wuuthrad=== After passing through a torture chamber, the next large chamber contains more enemies, an [[Skyrim:Apothecary's Satchel|apothecary's satchel]], a coin purse, and two potions on a bookshelf behind the fireplace. Take the only available path, leading back to an initially inaccessible part of Driftshade Refuge. The first chamber contains the three remaining members of the Silver Hand, the [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:2920, Morning Star, v1|2920, Morning Star, v1]]'', the [[Skyrim:Block|Block]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Warrior (book)|Warrior]]'', a treasure chest with considerable loot and finally, the stolen Fragments of [[Skyrim:Wuuthrad|Wuuthrad]]. Use the door to the south for an easy escape route, then return to [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]]. As soon as you arrive, [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] will inform you that you should meet up at the Skyforge and pay your respects to the deceased, but now avenged, [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Whitemane]]. This will end the quest and start the next one, [[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]]. ==Notes== *If you have a [[Skyrim:Follower|follower]] with you, Vilkas will replace that follower during this quest. Be sure to give any important equipment to your follower before entering Jorrvaskr, as Vilkas won't help if you're overencumbered, and you won't be able to trade things with him yet. *Kodlak's body cannot be interacted with or searched, as the quest script makes it uninteractable. You can, however, pick up a [[Skyrim:Steel Warhammer|steel warhammer]] found next to it. *Vilkas tells you that no one else got hurt in the Jorrvaskr assault if you ask him if anyone else was injured. However, this is clearly incorrect, as [[Skyrim:Athis|Athis]] is wounded, and [[Skyrim:Ria|Ria]] is tending to him. *It's possible that transforming into a werewolf for this mission will cause Vilkas to become hostile towards the player, thanks to a [[Skyrim:Vilkas#Bugs|bug]]. *When clearing out Driftshade Refuge, unlike [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] during "[[Skyrim:Proving Honor|Proving Honor]]" and [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] during "[[Skyrim:The Silver Hand|The Silver Hand]]", Vilkas will make no comments whatsoever, except for his standard combat dialogue. You can, however, still ask him for training in [[Skyrim:Two-handed|two-handed]] weapons. *Version 2.1.0 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] reserves Driftshade Refuge to block radiant quests until this one is finished. After that point it should switch over to regular bandits and then become available for use in standard radiant questing. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The shortcut to zoom in on the map point will not work for this quest for some people. The map point is nevertheless visible at the location specified in this article.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If Driftshade Refuge has already been cleared, this quest cannot be started normally without a workaround. Before you begin Blood's Honor, wait 30 in-game days after you have cleared Driftshade Refuge to allow that dungeon to reset (you will have to revert to a slightly earlier save to do this). This should allow Purity of Revenge to begin normally upon completion of Blood's Honor. An easy way to check if the dungeon has been reset is to check the doors--if they have all been shut, it is reset (e.g., if the formerly barred door is barred again).|USKP|1.3.0}} ** {{pc22}} The console may aid in fixing this. Click on Vilkas and use the disable and then enable commands, then use setstage c05 0 and talk to him. ** {{pc22}} Another method that has worked is to reset the interior of Driftshade Refuge by typing ResetInterior DriftshadeSanctuary01 into the console. Then go and visit Driftshade Refuge and confirm that it is reset. It should be populated with Silver Hand fighters. Do this before talking to Vilkas, and when you do speak to him the next quest may start. {{Bug|Kodlak's corpse in Jorrvaskr causes him to appear without his Wolf Armor equipped.|USKP|1.3.2}} {{Bug|The Silver Hand radiant quests are available until the last stages of Purity of Revenge, in particular if you return to Whiterun before Vilkas and speak to Aela the Huntress to get a radiant quest. Note that you can't exploit this to get a third Silver Hand radiant quest, since Aela will offer such quests only if you previously completed just one radiant quest from the Silver Hand pool.|USKP|1.3.3|Those quests are no longer available once this one begins.|trackerid=12948}} {{Bug|Fast traveling to [[Skyrim:Fort Fellhammer|Fort Fellhammer]] during this quest may automatically complete the optional objective to wipe out the Silver Hand members at Driftshade Refuge, though they may not actually be dead when you arrive.|USKP|2.0.1|The bandits at Fort Fellhammer all had a script attached to them when they never needed one.}} {{Bug|If Blood's Honor has already been completed and this quest won't begin because the [[Skyrim:Dungeon_Delving_(Jarl_-_Caves)|Helm of Winterhold]] miscellaneous quest is active, it is possible to proceed through Driftshade Refuge without killing anyone (use stealth, fear or invisibility as needed) and take the Helm of Winterhold from the chest at the end. Once the Helm is returned to the Jarl of Winterhold to complete that quest, return to [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] and Purity of Revenge will begin.}} ** {{pc22}} A possibility to start this quest is by completing the Helm of Winterhold quest by typing setstage favor158 20 into the console before talking with Vilkas. ** Should the "Retrieve the Helm of Winterhold" quest pose a repetition problem, simply go to the Jarl Korir, take the quest one more time and enter setstage favor158 20 on the console. This quest shouldn't be a problem anymore. On the console, proceed by tapping ResetInterior DriftshadeSanctuary01. Then return to Vilkas and on the console, enter setstage c05 0. {{Bug|Even after wiping out the Silver Hand, you may not be able to wait (i.e., to end your run as a werewolf) getting the message there are still enemies nearby.}} {{Bug|If Blood's Honor has already been completed and this quest won't begin, and you've tried all other possible solutions, the quest may be skipped entirely to avoid any bugs. Load a game right after accepting Blood's Honor from Kodlak, and while standing in any interior cell, type setstage c04 200, then setstage c05 200, and finally setstage c06 00 to start the next quest and attend the funeral bug-free.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Vilkas has come with me to avenge the death of Kodlak by wiping out the Silver Hand. {{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the fragments of Wuuthrad}} {{Quest Objective|11|(Optional) Wipe out the Silver Hand}} |20||Vilkas and I avenged Kodlak's death by bringing ruin to the Silver Hand. {{Quest Objective|20|Return to Jorrvaskr}} |200|fin| |missing=0, 1 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:Blood's Honor|Blood's Honor]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Companions#Quests|Companions]]}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Companions |Giver=[[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]] |Reward=A [[Skyrim:Steel Sword|Skyforge Steel]] weapon,
Word for the [[Skyrim:Fire Breath|Fire Breath]] shout |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Take Up Arms|Take Up Arms]], one [[Skyrim:Companions#Radiant Quests|radiant quest]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:The Silver Hand|The Silver Hand]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dustman's Cairn|Dustman's Cairn]], [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]] |Image=SR-quest-Proving_Honor_03.jpg |ImgDesc=A fragment of Wuuthrad in Dustman's Cairn |description=Claim a [[Skyrim:Fragment of Wuuthrad|Fragment of Wuuthrad]] from [[Skyrim:Dustman's Cairn|Dustman's Cairn]]. |ID=C01 |Icon=SR-qico-Companions.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # After completing one Radiant Quest, talk to [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]]. # Team up with [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] and travel to [[Skyrim:Dustman's Cairn|Dustman's Cairn]]. # Locate a [[Skyrim:Fragment of Wuuthrad|Fragment of Wuuthrad]]. # Participate in your own initiation. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Trial of the Whelp=== After completing one [[#Radiant Quests|radiant quest]], your job providers, [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] and [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]], will point you towards Skjor when asked for more work: ''"Skjor was looking for you, earlier."'' When asked for a reason, their response will differ. Aela will answer: ''"He didn't say, but you'd better move fast. There's probably something I could find for you to do, but best to check with him."'', while Farkas will say: ''"Don't know. He just said he needed to talk to you before you do anything else. I don't like making him angry, but there is some work for you if you want it."'' Skjor will reveal that a scholar has discovered another fragment of the legendary battleaxe, [[Skyrim:Wuuthrad|Wuuthrad]]. He asks you to retrieve it and will direct you to [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] who will serve as your Shield-Brother for the task, both helping you survive the quest and supervising you to ensure you complete the mission "honorably". When approached, Farkas becomes a temporary follower. If you already have a follower, they will return to your home or to their base location and await you there until you've completed the quest. If asked, Farkas will elaborate on the origins of Wuuthrad. Your destination is [[Skyrim:Dustman's Cairn|Dustman's Cairn]], a barrow northwest of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. You can either have him follow you all the way or ask him to meet you there. === Dustman's Cairn=== The place is crawling with [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]], so be prepared for a long trek. There is a [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Battle of Sancre Tor|The Battle of Sancre Tor]]'' in the first room. The second chamber contains an [[Skyrim:Arcane_Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] and two thrones, with the only available path blocked by a gate. Locate the northernmost room and pull the lever, which will drop another gate and trap you inside, after which the lever will break. From the other side, Farkas says he will find a way to release you, then is unexpectedly confronted by a group of [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]] members, leaving you trapped to watch the scene unfold. === Eyes on the Prey === [[File:SR-quest-Proving_Honor.jpg|thumb|right|Farkas transforming to fight the Silver Hand]] The Silver Hand turns out to be there for a reason. While you watch, Farkas will transform into a [[Skyrim:Werewolves|werewolf]] and wipe out the opposition within seconds. After opening the gate, Farkas will reveal that only certain [[Skyrim:Companions|Companion]] members are blessed with the ability. Proceed forward through the linear cave system until you reach the entrance to the second zone, Dustman's Crypt. [[File:SR-quest-Proving Honor 04.jpg|thumb|left|Farkas fighting a Frostbite Spider]]After continuing through the next door, you will cross the bridge where you can see the lower room you are headed towards. If you stand idle in this caged walkway, at least one archer will attack you from the room below. After crossing the bridge, you will go around a corner and be in a long down-sloped hallway. If you run ahead to attack the Silver Hand, or choose to follow Farkas, a few draugr will awaken from the crypts lining the walls and attack you from behind. Make your way through the crypt and fight all Silver Hand members and draugr. In the large chamber under the bridge, open the chest for the [[Skyrim:Dustman's Cairn Key|Dustman's Cairn Key]] and unlock the door to the north. A few [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeevers]] will attack in the next tunnel. When you reach an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], head east and fight the residing [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]], then head downstream using the small bridges and face the draugr. Follow the linear path through the catacombs and open the iron door. ===A Fragment and a Shout=== [[File:SR-quest-Proving_Honor_02.jpg|thumb|right|A [[Skyrim:Fire Breath|Fire Breath]] word wall]] The chamber ahead appears quiet at first, but the many sealed alcoves and coffins should hint at what to expect. Loot the many minor containers for treasure, then follow the map marker to the altar where the [[Skyrim:Fragment of Wuuthrad|Fragment of Wuuthrad]] rests. Approach the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] behind the altar to learn one of the words for the [[Skyrim:Fire Breath|Fire Breath]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|dragon shout]]. Finally, pick up the fragment and prepare as numerous draugr burst out of the coffins to attack you and Farkas. Additionally, the iron door will now be locked, preventing any strategic backtracking. After the battle, a path will open from the balcony above, so make your way to a tunnel initially inaccessible in the first zone, which will land you back near the entrance to Skyrim. ===The Initiation=== Back in Whiterun, you will find [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] waiting for you just outside [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]]. He will then lead you around the building where the entire group of Companions will be gathered. Guild head [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]] will give a short speech and welcome you to the Companions, while Farkas will swear eternal loyalty to you. You are now an official member of the Companions, but will have to complete yet another radiant quest before your next [[Skyrim:The Silver Hand|major assignment]]. You will also be able to buy [[Skyrim:Skyforge|Skyforge]] [[Skyrim:Weapons|Steel weapons]] and [[Skyrim:Wolf Armor|Wolf Armor]] from [[Skyrim:Eorlund Gray-Mane|Eorlund Gray-Mane]] from now on, and he will give you one Skyforge Steel weapon of your choice for free. You can also find Skyforge Steel weapons and Wolf Armor in the [[Skyrim:Containers#Merchant Chests|Merchant Chest]] underneath the Skyforge from here on out as well. Eorlund will comment on the Skyforge Steel weapon of your selection. You can choose between five weapon types: {|class=wikitable ! Weapon Type ! Comment |- ! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Skyforge Steel Sword|Sword]]}} | ''"A blade! Ha! Of course you can."'' |- ! {{Anchor|[[Skyrim:Skyforge Steel War Axe|War Axe]]}} | ''"Now that's a smart weapon. Light, strong, useful. Crack some skulls for me."'' |} ==Notes== * Farkas, like many other [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]], is incapable of sneaking properly. He tends to prefer charging into battle over staying in hiding, and getting him to stay in hiding may require you to retreat farther from the enemies than would be necessary if you were alone. However, if he does charge into battle, it is not necessary to follow him. Since he is an [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] character, he cannot be killed, and the outcome of the quest is not affected by how much damage he takes, or your behavior. (i.e. as long as you survive, and the objectives are achieved, when you return to Jorrvaskr, he will report that you were "honorable"). Thus, when he charges into battle, you can chose to stay in hiding, and continue making stealth attacks at your own pace. If your stealth is successful, the enemies will act as if Farkas came alone. * The draugr in the closed tombs lining the walls of the final room can be killed off before picking up the fragment, making the final battle much easier. * Two of the Silver Hand that attack while you are trapped have a short exchange regarding which Companion they have found: :'''First Silver Hand:''' ''"Which one is that?"'' :'''Second Silver Hand:''' ''"It doesn't matter. He wears that armor, he dies."'' :This is ironic, since Farkas is the only male member of the Circle who is ''not'' wearing the [[Skyrim:Wolf Armor|Wolf Armor]] of the Companions. :*{{pc22}} Version 1.2 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] changes his outfit to Wolf Armor. * If you have already learned the first two words of Fire Breath, the Word Wall may contain a word you already know. * At one point, it was intended that either Farkas or Aela could accompany you, but this was changed to Farkas only before the game was released (see [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress#Missing Dialogue|this section]] for details). * You can still do the mission with '''Aela as your follower instead of Farkas''', by using the console commands "ssq c01", "prid 1A697", and "forcerefintoalias observer". Her dialogues are fully voiced and implemented. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Eorlund refers to female Companions as "lad" instead of "lass" when asking him for a weapon.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|Farkas can be a crippling liability because of his defective class specification. Regardless of level, he has 15 Heavy Armor and 25 Two-Handed, rendering him useless at higher levels.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|When Farkas transforms into a werewolf, he drops his [[Skyrim:Skyforge Steel Greatsword|Skyforge Steel Greatsword]], and has to use a noticeably weaker iron one instead.|USKP|1.0}} ** Although you can't trade items with him yet, you can still fix this by simply putting him into command mode (target him and hold Activate until the cursor changes) then targeting the sword or a [[Skyrim:Silver_Greatsword|Silver Greatsword]] and pressing Activate again. The Skyforge Sword will do a little more damage against human enemies, but the Silver Sword will do considerably more damage against the swarms of draugr in the word wall room. ** This transformation also causes him to level up correctly in his class, increasing his health by several hundred points at higher levels: his skills will still be broken, but it does make him capable of surviving a few more hits. {{Bug|After pulling the lever and getting trapped behind the gate, the game may freeze or crash at the point when Farkas is supposed to transform into a werewolf and then free you.|confirmed=1}} ** Reloading an earlier save and entering the location again may work. **{{Pc22}} Use the [[Skyrim:Console|Console]] command disable, exit and re-enter the console, the use enable to get him unstuck. **{{Pc22}} Use the [[Skyrim:Console|Console]] command kill, followed by resurrect on Farkas to reset him can also work. ** Hitting Farkas with Unrelenting Force before triggering the lever may put him in a position where he is able to overcome the freeze. ** If you are using a mod which modifies Farkas's appearance, disabling Farkas's appearance customizations within the MCM may allow him to proceed as normal, open the gate and transform back. {{Bug|While inside the locked alcove trap, Farkas may not help you.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} This can be caused due to a Draugr being in Farkas' detect enemy range. After trapping yourself, go into the Console and enter tai, next enter tfc, exit console mode, follow the tunnel until you encounter the first Draugr, enter Console mode and click on the Draugr, enter kill 1a693, either click the Draugr again or double click on any object to clear the reference, enter tfc, enter tai, leave Console mode. Farkas should now kill the Silver Hand fighter, return to human form, and go throw the release lever. ** {{Pc22}} He may simply return to an earlier part of the dungeon and stay there, not realizing you are trapped. This seems more likely to happen if you have brought another follower with you. Reload an earlier save, return to the switch-trap alcove, and just outside of it do prid 1a693 then moveto player in the Console, then go flip the switch while he's still within visual range. He may nevertheless take some time to notice you are trapped (perhaps a minute) and trigger the werewolf scene. This tip and the above one can be combined (in reverse order), to first return him to the right area, then to trigger the werewolf scene if he just stands around or leaves again. ** Alternatively, restart outside Dustman's Cairn, leave any other followers outside, enter with Farkas, and ensure you kill all Draugr on your way to the switch-trap alcove (many are slumbering in their wall niches) and try again. Make sure Farkas is in the room with this alcove before you throw the trap switch. ** {{Pc22}} Another option is to use tcl in the Console (click first until you are highlighting nothing in the Console at all, or the command won't work) to escape the trap, and just go do the rest of the dungeon by yourself. It is the taking of the latter that triggers the fight, so you can explore and plunder the area and discover the exit tunnel before taking that item (doing so is also what locks the original entranceway). {{Bug|Farkas may not stand up from a crouching position, even if you do. You will see Farkas actually run to his correct spot. {{Bug|When returning to Whiterun and taking part in the ceremony inducting you into the Companions, the other participants in the ceremony may stop talking, causing the quest to not complete.|confirmed=1}} ** Talk to Vilkas upon your return to Jorrvaskr and have him lead you to the induction ceremony. The RefIDs for the Companions are: Farkas (0001A693), Skjor (0001A691), Aela (0001A697), Kodlak (0001A68F), Vilkas (0001A695). {{Bug|The game might get stuck after you follow Vilkas to the meeting.|confirmed=1}} **Attempting to Wait during the dialogue may allow it to complete. {{Bug|When returning to Whiterun and taking part in the ceremony inducting you into the Companions, if you have [[Skyrim:Controls|Automove]] active when the cutscene starts, you may continue to move during the cutscene.|vn=1}} {{Bug|Vilkas may not appear in front of Jorrvaskr and the game won't give you the objective Follow Vilkas.
