[[Skyrim:Silver Emerald Necklace|Silver Emerald Necklace]] (if Margret saved) |Next=[[Skyrim:No_One_Escapes_Cidhna_Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] |Image=SR-quest-The_Forsworn_Conspiracy.jpg |ImgDesc=Just an innocent observer |description=Investigate a murder in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] to discover a sinister plot surrounding the [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]]. |ID=MS01 |Difficulty=Medium }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Meet with [[Skyrim:Eltrys|Eltrys]] in the [[Skyrim:Shrine of Talos|Shrine of Talos]] after receiving his [[Skyrim:Eltrys' Note|note]]. #Find evidence about [[Skyrim:Margret|Margret]]. #''(Optional)'' Talk with [[Skyrim:Mulush gro-Shugurz|Mulush gro-Shugurz]] (near the smelter, during the day) and ask him about about Weylin and his room key. #Find evidence about [[Skyrim:Weylin|Weylin]]. #''(Optional)'' Talk with [[Skyrim:Eltrys|Eltrys]] in the [[Skyrim:Shrine of Talos|Shrine of Talos]] to get your reward. #Find evidence about [[Skyrim:Thonar Silver-Blood|Thonar]]. #Find out who "N" is. #Find evidence about [[Skyrim:Nepos the Nose|Nepos]]. #Return to the shrine. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Attack=== [[File:SR-quest-The Forsworn Conspiracy 04.jpg|thumb|left|Glory to the Forsworn!]] While walking through the open market in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], a woman named [[Skyrim:Margret|Margret]] is viciously attacked while buying jewelry. Her attacker, a [[Skyrim:Breton|Breton]] [[Skyrim:Witchblade|witchblade]] named [[Skyrim:Weylin|Weylin]], will shout ''"[[Skyrim:The Reach|The Reach]] belongs to the [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]]!"'' as he attempts to escape. If you do not step in, the guards will kill Weylin, who defiantly exclaims, ''"I die for my people."'' In the ensuing confusion, the guards are curt as they try to quell the small crowd that has gathered. If you ask about the crime and the Forsworn, they tell you that the Forsworn are nothing but a bunch of madmen, and to mind your own business. '''Kerah''': ''"A bit of jewelry for your journey home?"''
'''Margret''': ''"Oh, this pendant would look lovely on my sister."''
'''Weylin''': ''"The Reach belongs to the Forsworn!"''
'''[Weylin kills Margret and/or attacks the guards. He dies either way.]'''
'''Weylin''': ''"I die for my people."''
'''Kerah''': ''"By the Divines, the Forsworn are here in the city!"''
'''Guard''': ''"Everyone stay back. The Markarth city guard have this all under control. There are no Forsworn here."'' If you search Margret's body, take the [[Skyrim:Key to Margret's Room|key]] to her room for use later in the quest, although you will be able to acquire it later on from the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] innkeeper. It is possible to save Margret from Weylin if you're fast enough. If you do save her, she rewards you with the pendant she just purchased. (Preventing the murder will affect the course of the quest; see [[#Notes|notes]] below.) {{NewLeft}} ===The Meeting=== Shortly after the scene in the marketplace, a [[Skyrim:Breton|Breton]] [[Skyrim:Citizen (class)|citizen]] named [[Skyrim:Eltrys|Eltrys]] will approach you and ask if you saw what happened. You can chat with him for a bit about the assault, but then he will suddenly say, ''"Oh, I think you dropped this. Some kind of note. Looks important."'' If you question him about the note, he feigns innocence. The note tells you to meet him at the [[Skyrim:Shrine of Talos|Shrine of Talos]]. You can ask him how to find the shrine, and while he is still elusive, he will say: ''"Huh. Not sure. I don't worship Talos, myself. I think I heard someone mention it was underneath the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]], in the big crag in the center of the city."'' Travel to the shrine underneath the Temple of Dibella. To get there, climb the stairs at the north corner of the marketplace, follow the bridge to the left, then take the path to the left and you should see the door. Descend into the temple and speak to Eltrys, who has been looking for answers about the Forsworn attacks that have been happening in the city, ever since his father was killed by the Forsworn and that he has been trying his whole life to find out why, and why the guards do nothing about it. He pleads for your help; find out why Weylin attacked Margret and who is behind all of this. He will pay you for any information you can bring. ===Margret=== To find information on Margret, go to the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] and ask [[Skyrim:Kleppr|Kleppr]] or [[Skyrim:Frabbi|Frabbi]] about her. She apparently rented the nicest room in the inn, which is down the hall to the left of the entrance. If you did not obtain the key to Margret's room from her corpse earlier, you can receive it through dialogue with Kleppr, steal it from behind the bar (or even just simply take it freely), or just pick the lock to her door. Searching the end table in her room will yield [[Skyrim:Margret's Journal|Margret's journal]]. After reading her journal, you learn that she probably wasn't just a casual jewelry shopper, and that she has been gathering information about [[Skyrim:Thonar Silver-Blood|Thonar Silver-Blood]]. If Margret is alive, she will be sitting by the fire at the inn or standing out in the marketplace. You can persuade her to divulge her real purpose in Markarth. Apparently, Margret is an [[Skyrim:Imperial|Imperial]] spy working with [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] to investigate the [[Skyrim:The Treasury House|Treasury House]] and the Silver-Blood family. She was hoping to procure the deed to [[Skyrim:Cidhna Mine|Cidhna Mine]] for the Imperials. She is also sure that Thonar Silver-Blood arranged for her murder. After leaving the inn with your information about Margret, a Markarth City guard will try to warn you off your investigations. You can report back to Eltrys with your information about Margret for a leveled gold reward, or continue researching Weylin and Thonar before going back to Eltrys. ===Weylin=== In your investigations thus far, you have learned that Weylin worked as a smelter at Cidhna Mine and lived in [[Skyrim:The Warrens|the Warrens]]—a public house for the city's destitute. You can follow the smelter lead to the [[Skyrim:Smelter Overseer's House|Smelter Overseer's House]] to speak with [[Skyrim:Mulush gro-Shugurz|Mulush gro-Shugurz]]. However, he is reluctant to talk to you, giving you a [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] challenge, which actually results in very little information. You will find out that you need to go to the Warrens and speak with [[Skyrim:Garvey|Garvey]]. A more direct route will be to speak with Garvey, a resident of the Warrens and the keeper of the keys. Ask him about Weylin and tell him you need the [[Skyrim:Key to Weylin's Room|key]] to Weylin's room. He will only give you the key if you pass a Speech challenge to persuade, intimidate, or bribe him. {|class=wikitable width="100%" !width=22%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=17%|Reaction |- | It's important. Trust me. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Trust is hard to come by here, but all right.
'''Failed''': No. It's not. Trust me.||'''Passed''': Continue investigation
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | How about now? '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Welcome to the Warrens.
'''Failed''': No, I don't think so.||'''Passed''': Continue investigation
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | I wasn't asking. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Now don't get all upset. Here. Take it.
'''Failed''': And I wasn't stuttering. No key.||'''Passed''': Continue investigation
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Never mind, then.||colspan=4|Right.||Nothing |} If you do not receive the key, you can pick the lock on the door or pickpocket the key from Garvey. Weylin's room is to the rear of the Warrens, on the right-hand side. Enter it and look in the chest for a [[Skyrim:Weylin's Note|note]] addressed to Weylin. Read the note to learn that Weylin truly was not acting alone, and that some anonymous puppet-master named only "N" was directing Weylin's actions. You will now gain the objective "Find out who N is". When you exit the Warrens, a Breton named [[Skyrim:Dryston|Dryston]] will approach you, threatening: ''"You've been digging around where you don't belong. It's time you learned a lesson."'' You have some dialogue options, but it will come down to Dryston taking a swing at you and a [[Skyrim:brawl|brawl]] ensuing. If you attack Dryston with anything but your fists (i.e., weapons or magic), you will receive a bounty and any guards that witness the fight will attack you. Once you defeat Dryston, he will tell you, ''"I was sent by [[Skyrim:Nepos the Nose|Nepos the Nose]]. The old man hands out the orders. He told me to make sure you didn't get in the way. That's all I know, I swear!"'' This is all Dryston knows, and any attempts at further questions will just be answered with, ''"Nepos is in charge. That's all I know."'' Dryston also carries a [[Skyrim:Dryston's Note|note]] confirming it was Nepos that directed him to "rough you up". You are now directed to find out about Nepos the Nose. You can report back to Eltrys with what you have discovered about Nepos for a leveled gold reward. Eltrys will be quite surprised that Nepos may be involved, but concedes that he may be getting orders from elsewhere. From here, continue on with your investigation into Thonar. ===Thonar=== [[File:SR-quest-The Forsworn Conspiracy 02.jpg|thumb|right|For the Forsworn!]] Following Eltrys' suspicions that Thonar and [[Skyrim:The Treasury House|the Treasury House]] are involved in this conspiracy should be your next stop. When you enter the venerable financial institution, [[Skyrim:Rhiada|Rhiada]] will be at the front desk. You can ask to see Thonar, which prompts a Speech challenge, or you can just pick the lock on the door to the left of the front desk, bypassing Rhiada altogether. When you enter Thonar's room he doesn't seem alarmed to see you and you may speak to him about Margret, the Forsworn, or the guards that are harassing you. Suddenly, there is a disturbance—Thonar will call out to his wife, [[Skyrim:Betrid Silver-Blood|Betrid]], who has fallen victim to [[Skyrim:Nana Ildene|Nana Ildene]] and [[Skyrim:Donnel|Donnel]], the supposed cleaning crew for the Treasury House. Kill Nana Ildene and Donnel, and then express your sympathies to Thonar. He will curse the Forsworn, and then tell you that he has been controlling them by imprisoning their king [[Skyrim:Madanach|Madanach]]. Madanach has now become "out of control", however. The attack on Betrid can be avoided by pickpocketing [[Skyrim:Thonar's Journal|Thonar's journal]] without speaking to him. ===Nepos=== When you enter [[Skyrim:Nepos's House|Nepos's house]], his housekeeper, [[Skyrim:Uaile|Uaile]], will step in to keep you from seeing Nepos. However, she is overruled by Nepos, and he invites you in for a chat. Your dialogue choices all end with Nepos admitting that he is indeed Forsworn. When questioned further he will reveal a strong loyalty to "the King in Rags", Madanach, from whom he gets his orders. He will give you some history on Madanach's position and political views. Nepos is actually quite verbose in the matter of Madanach, which should by now be making you suspicious. As suspected, Nepos will then inform you that Uaile is actually a Forsworn agent and you won't be getting out of the house alive. Everyone in the household draws their weapons, including Nepos. After the battle, you can find Nepos's [[Skyrim:Nepos's Journal|journal]] where he pours out his remorse for his actions. You can also try to pickpocket Nepos's journal to gather the evidence secretly and avoid the fight. Lingering too long after the theft here will result in everyone becoming hostile. An [[SR:Illusion|Illusion]] [[SR:Skill Books|skill book]], ''[[SR:Mystery of Talara, Part 4|Mystery of Talara, Part 4]]'', is in Nepos's bedroom. ===Do the Time Without Doing the Crime=== [[File:SR-quest-The Forsworn Conspiracy 03.jpg|thumb|left|It's off to Cidhna Mine for you.]] Return to the shrine of Talos to report back your findings. However, when you arrive Eltrys has been slain by a group of guards, who are now lying in wait for you. ''"We warned you, but you just had to go and cause trouble. Now we have to pin all these recent murders on you. Silence witnesses. Work. Work. Work."'' '''Player''': ''"What did you do to Eltrys?"''
'''Guard''': ''"Same thing we do with all the other natives who want to change things around here. We had a nice little deal going between Thonar and Madanach until you and Eltrys started snooping around. Well, you wanted to find the man responsible for those killings? You'll have plenty of time with the King in Rags when you're in Cidhna {{sic|mine|Mine|description=lowercase letter}}."'' '''Player''': ''"You're corrupt. Thonar is paying you."''
'''Guard''': ''"We have a nice arrangement in this city, and we're not letting you get in the way. You have a problem {{sic|wth|with}} that? Take it up with Madanach. I'm sure the King in rags and his Forsworn would love to meet you. Now you're coming with us. It's a life sentence in Cidhna Mine for you."'' '''Player''': ''"Madanach is behind these killings!"''
'''Guard''': ''"You think you're the only one who knows that? We had a nice little deal going between Thonar and Madanach until you showed up. You'll have plenty of time to take it up with the King in Rags while you're serving a life sentence in Cidhna Mine."'' The guards there will now attempt to [[Skyrim:Crime#Getting Arrested|arrest]] you. You can try to resist arrest or talk your way out of it; however, you must submit to being jailed in order to advance the quest to [[Skyrim:No One Escapes Cidhna Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]]. Otherwise... Another route: if you are already a thane before starting this quest, and you pickpocketed Nepos's journal to avoid conflict; you may be able to avoid arrest and/or infamy related to finishing the quest by the following: # Go back to the shrine of Talos to meet Eltrys. # Allow the main guard there to initiate the dialogue: ## '''Guard''': "We warned you... ...Work. Work. Work." # Exit the chat before responding [press B etc]. # The guard will immediately re-engage you. ## '''Guard''': "You have committed crimes against the Jarl... how do you respond?" (Or similar dialogue depending on version). ## '''Player''': "I am the thane. I demand you release me at once", to which the guard will apologize, and give the standard response to using thaneship to avoid crimes.
# You must then ''immediately'' exit the shrine of Talos. ## If you do not immediately exit the shrine the guard (Presumably realizing his error) tries to re-engage you once again, back down the quest related options of dialogue: jail or resist only, and will immediately attack if you try to exit the dialogue any further. #Once exiting, the main guard will follow outside, but will have apparently forgotten about the whole thing once leaving the shrine; as will all of the guards around who will treat you as before the quest started /no bounty or arrest warrant. You can also re-enter the shrine of Talos with this method to loot Eltrys's body after, which will remain in place alongside the other two guards (who will have normal dialogue with you instead of trying to arrest or attack).
This route will complete [[Skyrim:The Forsworn Conspiracy|The Forsworn Conspiracy]] quest without starting [[Skyrim:No One Escapes Cidhna Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]] while keeping you free from the repercussions of finishing The Forsworn Conspiracy quest line. Using this method you will not be able to start the No One Escapes Cidhna Mine quest line.

:::''"So be it."'' ===Resisting Arrest=== If you resist arrest, several waves of guards will attack you within the shrine. If you end this combat (either by killing all guards or otherwise), any Markarth City Guard who sees you afterward will attempt to arrest you on sight for "murder and conspiracy against the city of Markarth". When you are arrested with this dialogue, you may be presented with several normally-available choices for escaping arrest (i.e. Thane status, Thieves Guild, bribery), but any choice other than going to jail or resisting arrest is rendered useless. The guards will reject any and all attempts to exonerate the Dragonborn whatever the player tells them. They will then attempt to apprehend the Dragonborn on sight. This is a gameplay script exclusive to this mission. Going to jail will still begin [[Skyrim:No One Escapes Cidhna Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]]. This arrest-on-sight status will persist permanently in Markarth until you submit to going to jail. {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * It is possible to save Margret from Weylin's attack if you act as soon as he pulls his dagger. If you attack him, he will become hostile towards you and attack you instead of Margret. Margret will reward you for saving her and you will not get a bounty on your head. This will have an effect on the information gathering stage of the quest. Using the Voice of the Emperor [[Skyrim:Imperial|Imperial]] racial ability to [[Skyrim:Pacify (effect)|pacify]] Weylin also works. ** Most methods of interrupting Weylin will count as an assault on your crimes statistics. Calm does not stop his attack like Voice of the Emperor does. A non-Imperial character looking to avoid the assault record could try a bash, which sometimes does not qualify as an assault, but this behavior is inconsistent. * If you complete the negotiations between the Empire and the Stormcloaks and you choose to give Markarth to the Stormcloaks, you will not be able to complete this quest if you began it but did not meet with Eltrys. Upon entering the Shrine of Talos, you will find Eltrys dead, but the guards will not arrest you for the murder. If you choose to go to jail, you will not be able to gain entrance to the King in Rags' cell to continue the quest. ** It appears that by handing over Markarth during the negotiations, this quest will automatically end. * It is still possible to get your reward from Eltrys after you get evidence about [[Skyrim:Nepos the Nose|Nepos]] or [[Skyrim:Thonar Silver-Blood|Thonar]], even if the guard script plays out. Eltrys will be killed after either stage, but you can obtain your reward by going to the Hall of Dead in Markarth and looting Eltrys's coffin (only after [[Skyrim:No One Escapes Cidhna Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]], or you can loot Eltrys's body before you start [[Skyrim:No One Escapes Cidhna Mine|No One Escapes Cidhna Mine]] for the reward by either killing or avoiding the scripted guards. Once No One Escapes Cidhna Mine starts, his body disappears and its remains move to the Hall of the Dead). * If Nana Ildene and Donnel die before you talk to Thonar, Betrid will die without anyone being there to kill her. She will not die if you never talk to Thonar. * Eltrys will pay you leveled gold for the first two pieces of evidence given to him, as he will be killed once either Thonar or Nepos are dealt with. * It is not necessary to complete all objectives to advance the quest to the final stage. Either after dealing with Nepos or Thonar, the final scene will trigger the next time you enter the Shrine of Talos. * It is possible to end up in Cidhna Mine and still maintain a life-time bounty of 0. To do this, kill the guards in the Shrine of Talos before they have a chance to speak. The quest will be finished, and you can loot Eltrys right away. To continue with the Cidhna Mine part, speak to a city guard. This will then grant you a bounty-free trip to Cihdna Mine. No One Escapes Cidhna Mine should start directly from there. * It is possible to keep [[Skyrim:Betrid Silver-Blood|Betrid Silver-Blood]], [[Skyrim:Nana Ildene|Nana Ildene]], [[Skyrim:Donnel|Donnel]], [[Skyrim:Nepos the Nose|Nepos]], [[Skyrim:Tynan|Tynan]], [[Skyrim:Morven|Moven]], and [[Skyrim:Uaile|Ualie]] alive after completion of this quest. After Weylin's death, you can ignore reading Eltrys' Note and this quest will not trigger. Instead, you can sneak and read or pickpocket Thonar's Journal and Nepos' Journal from their respective locations, then go to the Shrine of Talos. Doing so causes "The Forsworn Conspiracy" to start and finish at the same time. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Sergius_Turrianus|Sergius Turrianus]].
#Give him a certain amount of [[Skyrim:Soul_Gems|Soul Gems]]. Type and amount are randomly chosen.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Sergius Turrianus wants ''empty'' Soul Gems because he's almost out of stock. After giving him the requested number of the type he's asked for, he pays an amount of gold per gem. To start his next quest you must leave the current conversation and start a new one.

Rewards for each empty gem:
* 12 Gold per Petty Soul Gem
* 30 Gold per Lesser Soul Gem
* 60 Gold per Common Soul Gem
* 120 Gold per Greater Soul Gem
* 240 Gold per Grand Soul Gem

Saying that you cannot do this allows you to skip the quest and move on to the next one.

==Notes==
*This quest never appears in the journal but you can ask him all the time about his request to get to know what soul gem he wants, and how many.

Skyrim:Recipe for Disaster.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=[[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] |Reward=Leveled Gold, and potentially [[Skyrim:Nightweaver's Band|Nightweaver's Band]] |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Cure for Madness|The Cure for Madness]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:To Kill an Empire|To Kill an Empire]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], [[Skyrim:Nightgate Inn|Nightgate Inn]] |Image=SR-quest-Recipe for Disaster.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Anton Virane|Anton Virane]], the first assassination target for this quest |description=Assume the identity of the famous [[Skyrim:Balagog gro-Nolob|Gourmet]] in an effort to assassinate the Emperor. |ID=DB08 |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[Skyrim:Festus Krex|Festus Krex]]. #Find [[Skyrim:Anton Virane|Anton Virane]] and make him talk. #Kill Anton Virane. #Find [[Skyrim:Balagog gro-Nolob|Balagog gro-Nolob]] and kill him. #Take the [[Skyrim:Gourmet's Writ of Passage|invitation]] off of Balagog's corpse. #''(Optional)'' Hide Balagog's corpse. #Return to Festus Krex. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Pinch of Assault=== After [[Skyrim:The Cure for Madness|dealing with Cicero]], [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] is anxious to get back on task. She mentions something about a famous, elusive chef and a crazy scheme to impersonate him while cooking for the Emperor. She then points you to [[Skyrim:Festus Krex|Festus Krex]], who will be directing this phase of the Emperor's assassination. Festus explains that your new objective is to kill [[Skyrim:Balagog gro-Nolob|the Gourmet]] and while assuming his identity, poison the meal being prepared for the Emperor. What complicates this matter is that the Gourmet's identity is known by only a select few. Luckily, Festus has obtained an autographed copy of the Gourmet's book [[Skyrim:Uncommon Taste - Signed‎|Uncommon Taste]] owned by [[Skyrim:Anton Virane|Anton Virane]]. This suggests that Virane may know the true identity of the Gourmet. ===Carving the Cook=== Your first task is to track down Anton Virane, obtain the Gourmet's name, and kill Virane to prevent his interference in the operation. He works at [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] in the [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] kitchen. He is at first not willing to give you any information, but after some special persuasion, he will quickly reveal the name of the Gourmet: an [[Skyrim:Orc|Orc]] named [[Skyrim:Balagog gro-Nolob|Balagog gro-Nolob]]. After he reveals the name it is advisable to tell Virane that he will not be harmed or to remain silent, else he will start running around in a panic. Wait for an opportunity to present itself and kill him, preferably without any pesky witnesses present who could cause you to incur a bounty. Conversely, instead of having him remain in the crowded kitchen it may be better to scare him and have him run out to a more private place where you can kill him with no witnesses. When this is finished, it's on to the main course... You'll have a few options with Anton once he asks you if he's free to go: {|class=wikitable |- !width=30%|Topic !width=35%|Dialogue !width=15%|Response |- |'''Of course, Anton. Thank you. (Lie)'''||''"Okay. All right. Wonderful. You're welcome! I'll just be on my way, then..."''||Anton walks away |- |'''I'm afraid not. Loose ends, and all that.'''||''"No. Oh, please no..."''||Anton runs away |- |'''(Remain Silent)'''||''"So... we're done?"''||Anton walks away |} ===Just a Dash of Blood=== [[File:SR-quest-Recipe_For_Disaster_3.jpg|thumb|right|Balagog gro-Nolob, the second assassination target for this quest]] The Gourmet, Balagog gro-Nolob, can be found at the [[Skyrim:Nightgate Inn|Nightgate Inn]], either inside or outside, depending on the time of day: during the afternoon, he stands at the dock right outside the inn and gazes out over the pond, making it very easy to sneak attack him for a quick kill. After he is dead take the [[Skyrim:Gourmet's Writ of Passage|writ of passage]] from him, and simply drag his body into the pond (see Notes below) to fulfill the bonus objective. Another way to dispose of the body is to use the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout to send it into the water. At night, Balagog gro-Nolob can be found in the [[Skyrim:Nightgate Inn Cellar|Nightgate Inn Cellar]], which can be entered either from inside the inn or via a small hatch near the north exterior wall. Balagog will be asleep much of the time, but as there are no witnesses, the kill will be easy whether he is awake or not. When presented with an opportunity, kill him and take the Writ of Passage from his corpse. Make sure not to kill him in the chair that he sits in because his body may get trapped in the chair, rendering him unable to be dragged to a hiding spot. To successfully hide the body in the cellar, drag him behind the haystack or drop him into the large barrel at the end of the cellar next to the ladder. If you kill him while he cowers behind the wine barrels, this will automatically count as hiding the body. If you successfully hide the body, you will be awarded with the [[Skyrim:Nightweaver's Band|Nightweaver's Band]]. You may also have a small conversation with him: {|class=wikitable |- !width=25%|Topic !width=40%|Dialogue !width=10%|Reaction |- |''"You've served your last meal... Gourmet."''||''"Gourmet? Why I... Um... Oh dear. You're going to kill me now, aren't you?"''||Cowers behind the barrels of wine. |- |''"Soon, the Emperor will die. Murdered, by the Gourmet."''||''"What? The Emperor? But I... Oh. Oh, by the gods, no. No, you can't do this. You can't!"''||Cowers behind the barrels of wine. |- |''(Remain Silent)''||''"Yes, well. Perhaps the proprietor of this establishment can assist you. Please, you're starting to... frighten me."''||Ends conversation. |} ===No More Soup for You=== With the Writ of Passage in hand, return to the sanctuary for your reward. Astrid greets you with special news: All of the pieces are in place, and the [[Skyrim:To Kill an Empire|time is at hand]]. She instructs you to head to [[Skyrim:Castle Dour|Castle Dour]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] to fulfill your duties as Listener. ==Notes== * If Balagog drops his dagger when he is killed, it will still count as part of his body, allowing you to drag just the dagger to one of the hiding locations specified above to satisfy the bonus requirements of this quest. This is useful if you are having difficulty dragging his body. Alternatively, open his inventory and take the dagger to make his body easier to drag. * If you decapitate Balagog, you'll need to hide his head along with the rest of his corpse. * If you kill Balagog outside and drag him into the pond, the water will turn red, as if tainted with blood. * Be careful if you have the [[Skyrim:Disintegrate|Disintegrate]] perk for lightning-based magic active, or if the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn Force|Dragonborn Force]]{{DB}} enhancement for your Unrelenting Force shout is active, as they can turn Balagog's corpse into an ash pile, making it impossible to hide. * If you have the writ of passage in your inventory when you encounter [[Skyrim:Balbus|Balbus]], you can convince him that you are the Gourmet, and the star-struck Balbus will give you a collection of ingredients he has acquired to impress the Gourmet. * If you fail to hide the Gourmet's body, don't retrieve his papers, or if you spare Anton Virane, [[Skyrim:Festus Krex|Festus Krex]] will criticize you, depending on the circumstances: ** If you don't hide the Gourmet's body, Festus will be angry with you, saying ''"Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage, too, I see. So there's that. I've also received word from Markarth. It would seem Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good. But unfortunately, that inn is abuzz with the news of somebody killing one of their guests! What, hiding the body was too much for you to handle? Bah! Useless. Here's your gold. Now go see Astrid. The time to move against the Emperor has finally come. Sithis help us all."'' ** If you tell Festus that the Gourmet is dead but you don't have his papers with you, Festus will be upset, and say ''"Good. And his Writ of Passage? Oh wait, let me guess - you don't have them. Fool! Amateur! Without those papers you'll never be able to present yourself as the Gourmet! Off with you! Back to the body to retrieve them!"'' ** If the Gourmet is dead and you have the papers, but you spared Anton Virane, Festus will go on a similar rant, and say ''"Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage too, I see, so that's done. But why? Why, pray tell, have I received word that Anton Virane is still walking around Markarth, hale and healthy as the day he was born? Back to Markarth with you! Virane must be silenced! He's a potential witness, you witless dagger jabber!"'' ==Bugs== {{Bug|Balagog's corpse may be positioned in or around furniture after dying, making it impossible to drag it to a hiding place and complete the bonus objective.|confirmed=1}} :*Casting Firebolt or similar area-of-effect spells on his body may free his body from the furniture. {{Bug|When talking to Anton Virane, you can exit dialogue before telling him you are going to kill him, then restart dialogue with him and repeat the intimidation check to get additional Speech experience. This can be repeated as often as you like to level your [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] skill.|USKP|1.3.2}} {{Bug|After your conversation with Anton Virane is finished, the script may not update the quest to remove his essential status and allow you to kill him.|USKP|2.0.6}} {{Bug|Occasionally, when attempting to take the Gourmet's Writ of Passage, it will not show up in his inventory.}} **{{pc22}} You can give the Gourmet the Writ by going into the [[Skyrim:Console|console]], clicking on the Gourmet, and then entering additem 0003beb6 1. **{{pc22}} Alternatively, you can enter setstage db08 200 to complete the quest, player.additem 3beb6 1 to give yourself the Writ, then setstage db09 5 to start the next quest. {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Hadring|Hadring]]'s and [[Skyrim:Fultheim|Fultheim]]'s dialogue topics about Balagog no longer make sense after you kill him.|USKP|2.1.2|A condition check has been added so that the topic is unavailable once Balagog is dead.}} {{Bug|If you choose to "Eat" Balagog with the [[Skyrim:Ring of Namira|Ring of Namira]] equipped, it may trigger a "complete" for the bonus objective, but you may not get the bonus reward.}} {{Bug|Balagog may appear dead and naked in his room in the Nightgate Inn Cellar without the Writ of Passage, making the quest impossible to finish.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |2||I must speak with Festus Krex about my next target, the renowned chef known only as the "Gourmet." {{Quest Objective|2|Report to Festus Krex}} |4||I have been tasked with killing the Gourmet, but only one person knows the famous chef's true identity and location - a man named Anton Virane. I must get this information from Anton Virane, and then kill him. {{Quest Objective|4|Question Anton Virane}} |6||{{Quest Objective|6|Kill Anton Virane}} |10||I must kill the Gourmet, who is actually an Orc named Balagog gro-Nolob. Once he's dead, I must steal his Writ of Passage. And, if I can manage to hide the body, I'll receive a bonus. {{Quest Objective|10|Kill Balagog gro-Nolob}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Take the Writ of Passage}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Report back to Festus Krex}} |200|fin|The Gourmet is dead, and I'm now in possession of his Writ of Passage. Soon, I will take his place as chef for the Emperor... |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|15|(Optional) Drag Balagog's body to a hiding place}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:To Kill an Empire|To Kill an Empire]]|Up=[[SR:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]|Prev=[[Skyrim:The Cure for Madness|The Cure for Madness]]}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Speak to [[Skyrim:Louis Letrush|Louis Letrush]] about Frost.
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Sibbi Black-Briar|Sibbi Black-Briar]] about it.
#''(Optional)'' Tell [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]] about the plan.
#''(Optional)'' Use [[Skyrim:Keys#Sibbi's Stash Key|key to a stash of gold]] on lodge strongbox.
#Steal [[Skyrim:Frost|Frost]]'s [[Skyrim:Frost's Identity Papers|lineage papers]].
#Steal [[Skyrim:Frost|Frost]].
#Return to [[Skyrim:Louis Letrush|Louis Letrush]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===See a Man About a Horse===
When visiting the [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|Bee and Barb]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], a [[Skyrim:Breton|Breton]] [[Skyrim:Bard (class)|bard]] named [[Skyrim:Louis Letrush|Louis Letrush]] will recruit you into doing a favor for him. Apparently, Louis has purchased a valuable horse named [[Skyrim:Frost|Frost]] from [[Skyrim:Sibbi Black-Briar|Sibbi Black-Briar]]. Unfortunately, Sibbi was locked up in the [[Skyrim:Riften Jail|Riften Jail]] before the deal could be finalized. Louis asks you to discuss the situation with Sibbi in the jail, then deliver the horse and its [[Skyrim:Frost's Identity Papers|lineage papers]] to him.

===Possession is Nine-Tenths of the Law===
At the jail, bribe or persuade the guard to be allowed in.  Visit Sibbi in his cell where he explains the whole story of how he ended up in jail. He also mentions that the horse he owes to Louis is not "actually" his; in fact, it's owned by the Black-Briar estate, namely [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]]. However, Sibbi does not want to back out on the deal with Louis, so he offers you the second half of the payment owed if you steal Frost from [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Lodge|Black-Briar Lodge]]. He also directs you to where the lineage papers are at the lodge. If you're feeling put upon, you can persuade Sibbi to give you [[Skyrim:Sibbi's Stash Key|the key]] to the lodge strongbox containing two-hundred fifty gold.

===Horse Rustling at the Black-Briar Lodge===
[[File:SR-quest-Promises to Keep 02.jpg|thumb|right|Frost located at the stables]]
Make your way east of Riften to the Black-Briar Lodge. The lodge is heavily guarded, and the mercenary guards will attack on sight. The lodge doors are leveled, but can be opened using the [[Skyrim:Black-Briar Lodge Key|Black-Briar Lodge Key]] that each guard carries.

The easiest way to complete the in-lodge requirements is to kill or evade the outside mercenaries, then enter by the back door. This puts you on a level below, and mostly out of sight of, the dining room containing four mercenaries above. The reason for bothering with the upper level at all is to get the [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|unusual gem]] in the master bedroom on the upper level. If your sneaking skills are high, you can just slink into the bedroom and grab the Stone. If not, or if you just want to kill all the mercenaries, your position as you come in by the back door is perfect, forcing the guards to funnel toward you down a long narrow hall, enabling you to snipe them one by one.

To the right of the ladder in the basement is the lodge strongbox. The strongbox is master level but can be opened using Sibbi's stash key if you got it from him back at the jail. Around the corner, you will find Frost's lineage papers on a table. Take the papers and leave the lodge.

Steal the horse named Frost and follow the road away from the lodge until you get close to Louis' quest marker, then cut north to meet him. There are bandits and spiders between the road and Louis, so be prepared to fight them and protect both Louis and Frost; if either dies, the quest will fail. A few well-timed save games will serve you well in case one of them dies.
For your completion conversation with Louis, there are multiple options:
* Let him go with the horse and receive the leveled gold payment. He will then ride the horse to [[Skyrim:Whiterun Stables|Whiterun Stables]]. It is possible though to receive the payment and then immediately steal the horse; the quest will count as finished without double-crossing Louis. Note that stealing the horse will make Louis attack you.  
* [[Skyrim:Persuade|Persuade]] him to give you the horse and the payment, threatening to tell Maven about everything. If this persuade check succeeds, he will give you the money and run away.
* Tell him that if he was dead, you could keep both the money and the horse. He may attack you or run away.

The latter two will grant you Frost as a [[Skyrim:horse|horse]], although it won't appear in the statistics as a "horse owned"; still, it behaves like an owned horse (helping in fights, waiting where you leave it, and so on), and more importantly, you can mount him in front of witnesses without it being considered stealing.

(Possibly only if you have already told Maven): If you give Louis the horse, or if you blackmail him out of the money, as of the most recent patch Louis remains "essential" at this point, so you cannot cut Louis down as he flees with or without Frost (presumably this is to allow for the later encounter with him and thugs, whether they are his own thugs or Maven's). If you threaten to kill him, he may fight or he may run away, but either way he will be non-essential. (Striking him is considered an assault, but with Louis himself as the only witness, so your bounty will vanish when he dies, unless he runs far enough for someone else to witness his death.)

===Consequences===
*If you persuade Louis into letting you keep Frost, a [[Skyrim:World Interactions#Thug sent by Louis Letrush|random event]] may occur in which a [[Skyrim:Thug|thug]] appears in front of you claiming to have a "message" from Louis, and then proceeds to attack you. This event may happen more than once.
*If you kill the Black-Briar Mercenaries and take Frost but do not bring the horse to Louis, you will eventually be tracked down by Black-Briar thugs who have a bounty on you. Kill them and you will find a note instructing them to "deal with you" (and kill if necessary).
*If you tell Maven and then deliver the horse to Louis, you may [[Skyrim:World Interactions#Louis Letrush vs Thug|encounter]] a thug and Louis. The thug will kill Louis unless you intervene, and the survivor will attack you.
*If you deliver the horse to Louis without telling Maven, you may encounter a thug and Louis. Again, the thug will kill Louis unless you intervene, but he will then ignore you and walk away if you don't initiate combat.

=== Reward ===
{{SRLeveledReward|large}}

==Notes==
*The three door locks are leveled differently. The top floor is the easiest, and the bottom floor is the hardest.
*Originally, Letrush was intended to hide in [[Skyrim:The Ratway|the Ratway]] near [[Skyrim:Gian the Fist|Gian the Fist]], but stages 110 and 150 and related scenes no longer exist.
*Frost will likely die if given to Louis, as his route to Whiterun Stables passes through the bandit-occupied [[Skyrim:Fort Greenwall|Fort Greenwall]]. This can be prevented by clearing the fort beforehand, as the bandits there will be replaced by soldiers of the faction that currently controls Riften.
*Take care when traveling near Black-Briar Lodge while this quest is active. For example, fast-traveling to nearby [[Skyrim:Lost Prospect Mine|Lost Prospect Mine]] could trigger a dragon to spawn near the lodge, potentially killing Frost before you can intervene.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|Louis gets duplicated outside of Whiterun near the stables, sometimes stuck in the ground.|OSP|1.8}}
{{Bug|If you inform Maven before you have gone to the lodge and stolen the lineage papers, your quest may inexplicably update to show completion of "Steal Frost's Lineage Papers". This bug deprives you of the quest marker on the papers when you get inside Black-Briar Lodge, but you can still complete the quest as normal. Picking up the lineage papers advances the quest. If you simply cannot do without the quest marker and want to inform Maven, steal the Lineage Papers first, then tell Maven, then go back to the lodge and steal the horse (see strategy paragraph in main section, above).|USKP|1.1}}
{{Bug|After you first speak to Louis, Maven has an incongruous dialogue option to inform her about the theft, even though you have not yet spoken to Sibbi and don't yet know about the plot to steal the horse.|USKP|1.2.4}}
{{Bug|Upon meeting Louis with the horse and making the exchange, he may run off instead of mounting Frost, leaving you to take the horse. This happens when you exit his speech early after asking about your pay.|USKP|1.2.4}}
{{Bug|The basement door is missing its key setting, forcing guards to use the upper two entrances.|USSEP|4.1.8}}
{{Bug|Sometimes Louis is hostile when you are going to give him the horse and will attack you on sight. This might occur after stealing items in the house. To work around this bug, just wait for a day in the city and try again.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|Intimidating Louis into giving you Frost you will not yield [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]] experience, while persuading him does.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|If the game is saved while riding Frost and then re-loaded, it's possible Louis will appear standing in the same place where you are sitting. If you trot or gallop, Louis will likewise appear to walk or run, though remaining stuck in the same place on Frost's back.}}

He has sent scouts ahead to the fort, so meet up with them for further instructions. When you meet up with the scouts speak with [[Skyrim:Ralof|Ralof]], who will be quite happy to see you. He will tell you that they have located a cave under the lake that should lead into the fort's prison. He will ask you to sneak in, kill any Imperials you find, and then release the Stormcloak prisoners. After you have released the prisoners, head to the courtyard where he and his men will join you in fighting the Imperials. Follow the quest marker around the fort to the lake. Be careful not to get spotted by any Imperials or you will fail that objective and have to storm the fort. Once in the lake, swim down and you will see a small wrecked boat with a locked chest slightly hidden under it. Directly behind you is the entrance to the cave. === Rescue the Prisoners === The passage at the bottom of the lake will lead into the prison level of the fort, through the natural cave at the southeastern corner. Eliminate the [[Skyrim:Imperial Soldier|Imperial soldiers]] in the prison room and get a [[Skyrim:Fort Neugrad Prison Key#Fort Neugrad Prison Key|Fort Neugrad prison key]] from them (there should also be one lying on top of a chest in the same room). Open the cells and the Stormcloak soldiers will run to a chest to acquire weapons and armor. Talk to one of them and he will ask you what to do: you can tell them to wait where they are, or follow you. *To guarantee they all survive, you may instruct them to stay behind, and return to them after the fort has been taken over. If you tell them to follow you, they will participate in the upcoming battle and may die, although this doesn't seem to have an impact on the quest. === Take Over the Fort === As you leave the Fort Prison level and reach the courtyard, you will engage more Imperial Soldiers. Ralof's band will join the fray once you start the fight. After the fight, you will have to go inside the fort to eliminate the rest of the garrison. You can have Ralof follow you, or tell him to wait out in the yard. Once the Imperials and the fort commander are dead, talk to Ralof and he says that he will stay and clean up the mess. That ends the quest and starts the next stage in [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]]. == Notes == * If [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] is as [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]], this quest is one of [[Skyrim:Blood on the Ice|two]] required to become [[Skyrim:Thane of Eastmarch|Thane of Eastmarch]]. *If [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]] is given to the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] then this quest will not be given to you. *The prisoners you are sent to rescue will ignore your order if you tell them to wait. This is due to the script that handles them equipping their gear overriding the follow state variable that controls whether they're waiting or following. * Completing this quest deposes [[Skyrim:Siddgeir|Siddgeir]] as [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], and installs [[Skyrim:Dengeir of Stuhn|Dengeir of Stuhn]] in that position. Siddgeir will move to the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]]. Dengeir's personal quest [[SR:Some Light Theft|Some Light Theft]] cannot be started if he is Jarl. * If you have a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] that is capable of [[Skyrim:Reanimate|reanimating]] dead bodies with you during the assault, such as [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]], they may reanimate any Imperial soldiers that have already been killed, who must then be killed again to complete the quest. * If you kill the prisoners, that part of the quest will fail, but Ralof and his men will still join you for the battle in the courtyard. == Bugs == {{Bug|Sometimes, instead of Imperial soldiers, you will find bandits holding the Stormcloak prisoners. The prisoners will still speak the usual dialogue lines (''"The guard has the key."'') but there are neither any guards nor a key, and the prisoners may even be unresponsive once freed, hence ruining the Stormcloak questline. This bug may also happen even if the Imperial soldiers are there, but you fail to sneak into the fort.|vn=1}} ** Reload a save from before the quest was received, completely clear out the fort of all bandits, and then receive the quest from Galmar Stone-Fist. Reloading a save from after the quest is received will not fix this bug. {{Bug|You may not be able to initiate a chain of events for the mission.|vn=1}} **{{Pc22}} Using the console command movetoqt CWMission04 will teleport you into the cell of a prisoner you are supposed to rescue. Getting out of the cell will require picking the lock. {{Bug|Stormcloak soldiers may appear inside or near the fort as you approach. As fighting starts out right away, you fail the "Sneak into the fort" objective.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} To solve this, use the console command tcai and tai to turn off the combat AI and the AI globally, sneak past the fort and enter the cave. Then when loaded inside, turn both back on again. {{Bug|After freeing the prisoners, you may not be able to activate Ralof's dialogue menu. This is a problem because the task that follows freeing the prisoners entails speaking with Ralof and therefore becomes impossible.|confirmed=1}} **One possible solution is to transform into a werewolf away from the soldiers surrounding Ralof, and then kill all of the soldiers. Kastav in background to the east |description=Take [[Skyrim:Fort Kastav|Fort Kastav]] for the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] and rescue the prisoners within. |ID=CWMission04 |Icon=SR-qico-Imperial Legion.png |radiant=yes |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Report to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at [[Skyrim:Winterhold Imperial Camp|Winterhold Imperial Camp]]. # Meet the Imperial scouts near [[Skyrim:Fort Kastav|Fort Kastav]]. # Sneak into Fort Kastav. # Free the prisoners from their cells. # Clear the fort of [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloak soldiers]]. # Report back to the scout team commander. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Report to Rikke=== Report for duty to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at [[Skyrim:Winterhold Imperial Camp|Winterhold Imperial Camp]], east of Dawnstar. She will tell you to take [[Skyrim:Fort Kastav|Fort Kastav]] from the Stormcloaks. As the rebels currently hold some fellow Legionnaires in the fort's prison, you are to meet up with some scouts in the area, infiltrate the prison, release the prisoners, and then use their help to take the fort from the inside. When you agree to take the mission, the quest will initiate. Rikke will mark the scouts' location on your map (southeast of your location, about halfway to Windhelm), and you will note in your journal that your objective is to "Meet the men near Fort Kastav". You can successfully complete the quest without first sneaking inside and freeing the prisoners, but to accomplish all of the objectives as ordered, you must meet the scouts within a certain period of time, and you must avoid being detected by the rebels holding the fort before you get inside. The route you take to get there, and what you do on the way, can influence both of these contingencies. ===Meet the Scouts=== The meeting point is on a cliff to the southwest of the fort. If your route takes you next to the fort before you reach them, you are likely to be detected by a rebel sentry. While you can successfully complete the quest in this event, you will not be able to complete all the objectives according to the plan. Accordingly, if you will fast travel to a location near the fort, you may wish to select a location to the west or southwest of the fort, such as the [[Skyrim:Nightgate_Inn|Nightgate Inn]], [[Skyrim:Forsaken_Cave|Forsaken Cave]], or [[Skyrim:Fort_Dunstad|Fort Dunstad]]. This will allow you to approach the meeting point without passing the fort. {| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed" ! Detailed guide and tips: Main roads route |- | If you follow the [[Skyrim:Clairvoyance (spell)|Clairvoyance]] pathing from the camp, it will take you back into Dawnstar, then south out of town toward [[Skyrim:Fort_Dunstad|Fort Dunstad]] by the main road that lies west of town. Sometimes the pathing may not go through Dawnstar, but instead take you to the road just southwest of town. Expect a dragon attack in Dawnstar or just to its southwest. [[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 05.jpg|thumb|right|Stone pile indicating the left turn, partially visible middle-left]]Travel quite a distance on the road south from Dawnstar. Eventually, you will likely encounter a [[Skyrim:Frostbite_Spider|frostbite spider]] attack. Shortly past the site of this, watch for a pair of stone piles on your left. They may be obscured by a tree and some grass (see photo). Turn left onto the paved road that they mark. If the road takes a curve to the right and you see [[Skyrim:Fort_Dunstad|Fort Dunstad]] ahead of you, you have missed it. This road will point you due east toward [[Skyrim:Fort_Fellhammer|Fort Fellhammer]], visible a short distance ahead of you. Fort Fellhammer will likely be guarded by bandits who will detect your presence and attack as you pass—unless you successfully sneak by, sticking to the right, and following the road as it curves to the right. If you engage them, then afterwards return to the road (southwest of the fort) and proceed south. There are no significant valuables around the fort's exterior. This road will take you southwards over a low hill and then down a fairly sharp descent. Where you level out, you are likely to be pounced upon by a [[Skyrim:Snowy_Sabre_Cat|snowy sabre cat]] or other hostile animal. [[Skyrim:Ice_Wraith|Ice Wraiths]] also inhabit the general area. Before you reach [[Skyrim:Weynon Stones|Weynon Stones]], identifiable by some stone pillars just ahead, turn left (east) at a T-intersection. Although the road you will run across is generally well-maintained, the paving stones are spotty here, so you may have to look around a bit to see it. As you proceed, your compass should show the tree icon marking [[Skyrim:Shrouded_Grove|Shrouded Grove]] ahead of you. Continue onward, and as this icon flies off to the right of your compass, you will reach a major crossroads marked by a prominent signpost and known to be a favored ambush point for thieves. After dealing with any such threat, turn left (east-northeast) toward Windhelm. You will pass the [[Skyrim:Nightgate_Inn|Nightgate Inn]], on the right side of the road, and may wish to save your game in this area. At this point, you and the scouting team (of four men) are both nearing the meeting area. The scouts may meet one or more enemies, most likely including a [[Skyrim:Troll|frost troll]]. If such an attack occurs, it may happen before you arrive, while you are arriving, or just after you arrive. You may have an opportunity to intervene and reduce some or all potential fatalities among the scouts, thus giving you more allies when you eventually engage in the main battle for the fort. In any event, at least their leader will remain when you arrive, and he is all that is required. If you are unhappy with the number of scouts who end up alive, you can later reload a save from here. From the Nightgate Inn, continue east on the road. After a moderate distance, passing two roads departing up to the left, you will reach an intersection with a stone pile and a signpost marking the road to Winterhold running up to the left. This is another point at which thieves may lie in wait, or you may encounter a wanderer, such as [[Skyrim:M'aiq_the_Liar|M'aiq the Liar]]. From the signpost, turn toward your objective marker and head eastward up the hill off-road, and eventually right off a short cliff. Here you may encounter a frost troll, ice wraith, or other hostile, possibly ahead of you and to the right. If you do find enemies here, quick action—especially paralyzing or otherwise quickly incapacitating any frost troll—may help protect the lives of the scouting party. |} {| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed" ! Detailed guide and tips: "Direct" mountain trek route |- | Note that getting lost in the mountains can carry two implications for how the quest unfolds. First, if your path ends up taking you past the fort on your way to meeting the scouts (and you are seen by a Stormcloak there), the optional objective of sneaking in to release the prisoners will not appear; however, the quest can still be completed in this event: The rebels will engage you directly and the scouts will come to your assistance. Second, the scouts will not wait for you if you become delayed for too long, either because it takes you too much time to find your way, or because you are too long delayed in battles (e.g., if you near [[Skyrim:Mount_Anthor|Mount Anthor]], you will likely confront more than one of the powerful dragons who nest in the area). In such an event, the objective of sneaking into the prison will not appear, and you will go directly into battling for the fort whenever you finally arrive. [[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 06.jpg|thumb|right|Head SE from Frostflow Lighthouse.]]You needn't get lost, however. The following route can get you to your destination quickly: From the camp, turn toward the objective marker on your compass and trek cross-country on the footpath you will find in the area. You will soon encounter a rocky mountain range extending to the right (southward). If you bear to the left of this, you will pass between [[Skyrim:Frostflow_Lighthouse|Frostflow Lighthouse]] on your left and the rocky rise on the right.[[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 07.jpg|thumb|right|Turn south after passing the rock on the right.]] Once you pass over a small crest, you will see ahead of you some jagged rocks behind which lies an impassable chasm and some buildings which are part of the sprawling Dwemer ruin, [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand]]. Navigate around this by passing the rocky area on your right, then turning right (south) instead of heading across the open area between you and the jagged rocks. Proceed southward for several hundred yards, ascending several rounded hills that rise in a somewhat step-like fashion, and passing [[Skyrim:Alftand_Ruined_Tower|Alftand Ruined Tower]] to your left. [[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 08.jpg|thumb|right|Head south until you pass Alftand Ruined Tower (middle-left).]]You may encounter an [[Skyrim:Ice_Wraith|Ice Wraith]] or hostile animal in this area. You will almost certainly see a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] who nests on the mountain peak, though the dragon may or may not see you. Your objective marker should now be pointing at a tall mountain peak to the southeast. If you approach its base and then skirt around to the right (southwest) of it, you should find yourself on a mountain path that travels through [[Skyrim:Wayward_Pass|Wayward Pass]]. As you descend after Wayward Pass, be on the lookout for a path that turns to the left and heads uphill toward your objective marker. This is clearly a footpath, and not simply a clear area upon which you can climb up the mountain. This path will wind down and around, and then ends at a paved road which you can follow due east toward your marker. You may wish to save your game in this area. At this point, you and the scouting team (of four men) are both nearing the meeting area. The scouts may meet one or more enemies, most likely including a [[Skyrim:frost Troll|Frost Troll]]. If such an attack occurs, it may happen before you arrive, while you are arriving, or just after you arrive. You may have an opportunity to intervene and reduce some or all potential fatalities among the scouts, thus giving you more allies when you eventually engage in the main battle for the fort. In any event, at least their leader will remain when you arrive, and he is all that is required. If you are unhappy with the number of scouts who end up alive, you can reload from this point. Remain on the paved road, heading eastward, until you approach an intersection with a stone pile and a signpost marking the road to Winterhold running up to the left. This is another point at which thieves may lie in wait, or you may encounter a wanderer, such as [[Skyrim:M'aiq_the_Liar|M'aiq the Liar]]. From the signpost, turn toward your objective marker and head eastward up the hill off-road, and eventually right off a short cliff. Here you may encounter a frost troll, ice wraith, or other hostile, possibly ahead of you and to the right. If you do find enemies here, quick action—especially paralyzing or otherwise quickly incapacitating any frost troll—may help protect the lives of the scouting party. |} Once you approach the scouts at the meeting point, you'll find [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]] again, commanding them. The number of men under his charge can vary from three to zero, depending on how many may have been taken by the hostile creatures which infest the area. Speak to Hadvar. His plan is for you to sneak into the prison section of the fort through a grate located outside the walls. You should then find and release the prisoners, after killing the rebels guarding them. Once you release the prisoners, you are to make your way with them to the courtyard and engage the main rebel forces, at which point Hadvar and his men will also join to assist. If you tell Hadvar that you are not much for sneaking, he will say that he has faith in you, but also that if you get discovered at any point, you should run out into the courtyard and start fighting, at which point he and his scouts will come running. Hadvar will suggest waiting until nightfall before trying to sneak in. In reality, it's very easy to do this at any time. Your objective becomes to sneak into the fort through the grate. However, you can successfully complete the quest no matter how you accomplish the fundamental objectives, which are releasing the prisoners and taking over the fort by killing all the Stormcloaks (in either order). ===Sneak Into the Fort=== Stealthily enter the grate, to which your objective marker is pointing. If you are detected before entering the grate, the current objective will fail, but those of freeing the prisoners and taking the fort will become active, and you can still successfully complete the quest. Despite Rikke's and Hadvar's emphasis on sneaking into the fort. It is actually not necessary to sneak at all because there are no sentries who can see in your direction unless you stray quite far out of your way to the north while en route to the grate. Head directly east toward the grate from Hadvar's location, jumping down the cliff and proceeding toward the quest marker. As you approach the fort, while you cannot be seen, you can still be heard by a guard who is stationed just inside the wall. However, you must actually make an effort to generate enough noise to be detected. If you wish to practice your stealth skills anyway, you may wish to consider these detailed strategies: {| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed" ! Detailed strategies for sneaking in |- |[[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 02.jpg|thumb|right|Head toward the left parapet.]] Wait until evening, get into sneak mode, and remove your armor or lighten the amount you're wearing. It is safest to have any follower wait for you, but if you want to bring one, you may wish to take from them any especially heavy armor and weapons. If you do bring your follower along, at least take away any torches that they may be carrying. Followers apparently missed a lesson in stealth school, and will readily light up any torch they are carrying while sneaking at night. [[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 03.jpg|thumb|right|Stand on the first set of steps.]] If you want to be extra-cautious, you can take further steps to try to [[Skyrim:Sneak#Remaining_Undetected|remain undetected]]. From the bottom of the cliff, walk to the spottily paved road. Follow that toward the fort until the pavement appears to end (it actually turns to the north [left]). From this point, walk due east—between two flattish-top rocks toward a parapet in the wall—until you reach a few wooden steps. From those, turn to follow your objective marker to the grate. [[File:SR-quest-Rescue from Fort Kastav 04.jpg|thumb|right|Proceed to the grate (top-left).]]If you open it without being seen, the current objective will clear, and your next objective becomes to free the prisoners. |} ===Free the Prisoners=== Open the grate. Once inside, follow Hadvar's plan by killing the guards before releasing the prisoners: The prisoners are unarmed in their cells, and therefore won't be much help if released into a battle. Once the guards are dead, upon release from their cells, the liberated prisoners will equip themselves with armor and weapons from a chest on the level above. {| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed" ! A detailed strategy for freeing the prisoners |- |Having slipped in through the grate, pass through the wooden door and then proceed through the small room toward the doorway at its far side. This opens into a larger room, on the east side of which is a wooden door which may be open or closed. If you wait, one of the three Stormcloaks guarding the prisoners will walk into the room at one end of his patrol beat. If your fight with him is noisy, it may draw in a second guard from further in and below by the prison cells. Pass through the door to the east and, around the next corner. From most of the way down the stairs ahead, you may see the second guard who walks a patrol beat nearer to the prison cells. If that guard is not in sight, you can probably put an arrow in the back of the third guard, who spends most of his time sitting at a table at the very far end of the next room. He probably cannot be seen from the foot of the stairs unless you have [[Skyrim:Eagle_Eye|eagle eye]] vision. You should be able to detect a lantern burning in the distance, however, and the guard will generally be sitting just to the right of this, laterally centered through the midpoint of the door between you. This would leave you with just one more to take care of. The chest next to the guard who was sitting at the table contains the prisoners' weapons and armor. In more recent versions of the game, these items are not visible (the chest appears empty), but the prisoners will nonetheless find their items there after they are freed. |} After the three guards are dead, you can either practice some lockpicking to open the cells, or take the [[Skyrim:Fort Kastav Prison Key|Fort Kastav Prison Key]] off any of the guards or the table on the level just above the cells. Once all of the prisoners are all released, your remaining objective is to take the fort by killing the rebels in the exterior courtyard. Make sure that all four prisoners are released: The related objective should clear and you will note in your journal that retaking the fort is your next task. ===Retake the Fort=== The prisoners will equip themselves with armor and weapons and await your lead into battle. If you speak with them, however, you will have the option of ordering them to wait where they are. Lead them up and out into the courtyard and begin the attack. [[Skyrim:Hadvar|Hadvar]] and his men will join in the attack when the fighting starts. Unlike the battles at previous forts, no additional enemies will materialize during the battle, and the killed will remain where they fall for some time, giving you a chance to loot their bodies at your leisure. When all the rebels are dead, report back to Hadvar. ===Report Back to Hadvar=== Hadvar will inform you that he will remain to garrison the fort while you go to report the success. He will also lament that none of the prisoners you freed survived the battle if none of them survived. The quest will complete. If you have the underlying Reunification of Skyrim quest active, you will be directed to report back to [[Skyrim:General_Tullius|General Tullius]] at [[Skyrim:Castle_Dour|Castle Dour]] in Solitude. ===Report to General Tullius=== Your objective then becomes to report to General Tullius at Castle Dour to receive your reward, but doing so technically occurs under the overarching [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]] quest. After you have taken the fort, this quest will be complete. If you didn't flee the battle, Tullius will promote you to [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion#Ranks|Legate]] along with a leveled armor. ==Notes== *If [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]] is given to the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] then this quest will not be given to you. *The prisoners you are sent to rescue will ignore your order if you tell them to wait. This is due to the script that handles them equipping their gear overriding the follow state variable that controls whether they're waiting or following. *A Stormcloak soldier may remain on the roof of the Captain's Quarters who never becomes hostile during the battle, and does not have to be killed to complete the quest. If you go up to the roof after finishing the quest, but before you travel away from the area, the Stormcloak will warn you to leave since you are not welcome there, and may attack if you do not comply. *Completing this quest will exile [[Skyrim:Korir|Korir]] and his family to [[Skyrim:Brunwulf Free-Winter's House|Brunwulf Free-Winter's House]], and install [[Skyrim:Kraldar|Kraldar]] as [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of Winterhold. *Completing this quest will also complete the quest [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] and advance the quest [[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]] to the objective "Learn Shout to call Odahviing". *After completion of this quest, like any Civil War quest under [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]], unmarked by in-game references, you can approach Legate Rikke for a [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Gold Rewards|medium leveled gold reward]]; this is not always recommended, as entering her cell sets up the next quest in the series and, if triggered improperly, causes the missing ''"Reporting for duty."'' dialogue option (see [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim#Bugs|this]] bug section). Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her. Don't approach Rikke between quests of different holds. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When General Tullius sends you to Legate Rikke at the Winterhold Imperial Camp to begin this quest, (the "Regain Winterhold Hold" quest), she may not offer the "Reporting for duty" dialogue needed to proceed.|confirmed=1}} **The most reliable way to bypass this bug is to go to any indoor location and wait/rest for 30+ days. This allows all location cells to refresh, and the next time you travel to the Winterhold Imperial Camp, Legate Rikke will offer the "Reporting for Duty" dialogue option. **Repeatedly asking General Tullius, "How is the war going?" seems to fix the issue, and Rikke will eventually present the option. You may have to ask him each time you complete the missions, or alternatively you could try attacking her until she retaliates, then sheath your weapon and open dialogue again; this will sometimes work. **{{pc22}} You can use the [[SR:Console|console]] command setstage CWMission04 10 to start the mission. Locate [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|a Moth Priest]] for the [[Skyrim:Volkihar Vampire Clan|vampires]]. |ID=DLC1VQ03Vampire |Difficulty=Easy }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]]. # Listen to Harkon's speech. # Locate a [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Moth Priest]]. # Seduce the Moth Priest. # Report back to Lord Harkon. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Speech=== Seek out [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]] as directed by [[Skyrim:Garan Marethi|Garan Marethi]] at the end of the [[Skyrim:The Bloodstone Chalice|previous quest]]. The leader of the [[Lore:Volkihar|Volkihar]] is in his chambers, located east of the entrance to the Cathedral. Question him about wanting to speak with you, and he will let you in on his plan to end the sun's tyranny: ''"Yes, I did. When I told you that I was grateful for my daughter's safe return, I told the truth. But I did not tell you everything."'' There are two options, both of which end up at the same place. If you tell him you suspected as much, and he will respond: ''"Good. Strong instincts and a cunning mind will serve you as well as blade, spell or claw."'' If you instead ask when he plans to start trusting you, you'll be told: ''"Do not presume to tell me who I can and cannot trust. I possess the wisdom of a dozen lifetimes, and I will make my own judgements. Now be silent, and hear what I have to say."'' [[File:SR-npc-Lord Harkon 06.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]] giving his proclamation]] Now, he will speak of his plans, and your part in them. After the monologue, follow him to the balcony overlooking the main hall of [[Skyrim:Volkihar Keep|Volkihar Keep]], where he will give a speech to the other resident vampires. He will command them, and you, to find a [[Skyrim:Moth Priest|Moth Priest]], as Moth Priests are the only people able to read [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll|Elder Scrolls]]: :''"Scions of the night! Hear my words! The prophesied time is at last upon us. Soon we will claim dominion over the sun itself, and forge a new realm of eternal darkness. Now that I have reclaimed one of my Elder Scrolls, we must find a Moth Priest to read it. I have spread false rumors about the discovery of an Elder Scroll in Skyrim to lure a Moth Priest here. Now it is time to see if those efforts have borne fruit. Go forth, and search the land for rumors of a Moth Priest within our borders. Look to the cities. Speak to innkeepers, carriage drivers, anyone who would meet a traveler. Go now, and carry out this task. This is my command!"'' As Harkon said, there are two potential sources to check out: innkeepers and carriage drivers. [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] will approach you after the speech and give you another lead: the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]]. According to her, wizards always know about things people shouldn't know about. She will also request to accompany you on the trip, as she is feeling restless after being trapped underground for so long. ===In Pursuit of a Priest=== When you do as Harkon and Serana suggested and talk to the people of Skyrim, you have a few options. Carriage drivers are the easiest: all of them know immediately what you are talking about, and they are positioned outside all the major cities. You'll have to pass a [[Skyrim:Speech#Skill Usage|Speech check]] to get the information for free; otherwise it will cost you. '''Have you seen a Moth Priest?''' :''"That's one of them Imperial scholars, right? Old man with a gray robe?"'' '''That's right. You've seen him?''' :''"Might be that I have, but I can't say for sure. I got enough troubles on my mind just tryin' to scrape by out here."'' At this point you have several options: {|class=wikitable !width=25%|Option!!width=60%|Dialogue!!width=15%|Reaction |- |Please, it's very important that I find him. '''(Persuade)''' |'''Passed:''' ''"Now that I think on it, I did see your priest. He tried to hire me for a trip to Dragon Bridge, but I told him that ain't one of my stops."''
'''Failed:''' ''"Can't help you, friend. I might remember better if my pockets weren't so light."'' |rowspan=2|'''Passed:''' Obtain information
'''Failed:''' Nothing |- |Maybe this will put your mind at ease. '''(Bribe)''' |'''Passed:''' ''"Ah yes, I remember your Moth Priest now. He wanted me to take him out to Dragon Bridge, but I told him it ain't one of my stops."''
'''Failed:''' ''"An' maybe it won't."'' |- |Never mind, I'll look somewhere else. |''"Suits me just fine."'' |Nothing |} Innkeepers are another choice; however, only [[Skyrim:Corpulus Vinius|Corpulus Vinius]] or [[Skyrim:Sorex Vinius|Sorex Vinius]] at the [[Skyrim:The Winking Skeever|Winking Skeever]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]] at [[Skyrim:The Bannered Mare|The Bannered Mare]] in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] have a clue, and they require a Speech check (50) or a bribe as well. '''Heard anything about a Moth Priest passing through?''' :''"Have I heard anything? It was the talk of the city for three days straight. Ain't too often we get a visitor like that."'' '''Where is he now?''' :''"Oh, he just left a short while ago. He said he'd finished up his work and it was time to move on. That's all I can tell you. He asked me not to let anyone know where he was going. I suppose he didn't want the attention."'' At this point you have several options: {|class=wikitable !width=25%|Option!!width=60%|Dialogue!!width=15%|Reaction |- |It's important that I find him right away. '''(Persuade)''' |'''Passed:''' ''"Ah, well, in that case I'll tell you what I know. He took the road southwest out of town, and said he was going to be crossing over the Dragon Bridge. That's all that he told me. I hope it helps."''

'''Failed:''' Nothing |- |Finding that Moth Priest is worth a lot to me. '''(Bribe)''' |'''Passed:''' ''"I can see that. He said he was heading for Dragon Bridge next. I hope that helps you."''
'''Failed:''' ''"Sorry, but that Moth Priest's comings and goings are none of my business, and none of yours either."'' |- |I'll try my luck elsewhere. |''"Never much cared for folks who can't mind their own business."'' |Nothing |} It takes a bit of travel, but [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]], the librarian at the College of Winterhold will tell you there is a Moth Priest in Skyrim for free: ''"The obvious answer is to go to the Imperial City. The Moth Priests make their home in the White Gold Tower. Sometimes they go out looking for Elder Scrolls. Lucky for you, there's a Moth Priest in Skyrim right now, doing just that. He stopped in to do some research in the library, then left for [[Skyrim:Dragon_Bridge|Dragon Bridge]]. If you hurry, you might catch him there."'' He will always tell you this regardless of your standing at the College, though College quests like [[Skyrim:Containment|Containment]] and [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] can block this dialogue. Once you have arrived in Dragon Bridge, ask people '''"Know anything about a Moth Priest visiting Dragon Bridge?"''', seven people have the asking dialogue option, two of them can lead you the direction, all are listed in the below table. {| class="wikitable" !
