{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Quantheory |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Roger }}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Side Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Captain Veleth|Captain Veleth]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]], leveled gold |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]] and [[Skyrim:March of the Dead|March of the Dead]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|The Retching Netch]], [[Skyrim:Ulen Ancestral Tomb|Ulen Ancestral Tomb]], [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]], [[Skyrim:Ashfallow Citadel|Ashfallow Citadel]] |Image=SR-quest-Served Cold.jpg |ImgDesc=Who wants to kill [[Skyrim:Lleril Morvayn|Councilor Morvayn]]? |description=Save [[Skyrim:Lleril Morvayn|Councilor Morvayn]] from an assassination plot. |ID=DLC2RR02 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Next= |SuggLevel=25 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Receive a message from [[Skyrim:Captain Veleth|Captain Veleth]]. # Listen to [[Skyrim:Adril Arano|Arano]]'s concerns, and speak with [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]]. # Stake out the [[Skyrim:Ulen Ancestral Tomb|Ulen Ancestral Tomb]]. # Report back to Arano and obtain the key to [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]]. # Retrieve the evidence from the safe in Severin Manor. # Travel through [[Skyrim:Ashfallow Citadel|Ashfallow Citadel]] and kill the conspirator. # Return to Arano, and follow him to receive your reward from [[Skyrim:Lleril Morvayn|Councilor Morvayn]]. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===The Conspiracy=== Once you have completed [[Skyrim:March of the Dead|March of the Dead]] and [[Skyrim:The Final Descent|The Final Descent]], getting near [[Skyrim:Captain Veleth|Captain Veleth]] will make him apologize for bothering you once again and tell you that the Second Councilor of [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]], [[Skyrim:Adril Arano|Adril Arano]], wants to speak with you as soon as possible. He then makes it quite clear how important this task is, and when you locate Arano he will wait for you at a secure location, specifically on the road leading to the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]]. [[File:SR-quest-Served Cold 02.jpg|thumb|right|An undercover meeting]] When you talk to him he will get right to the point: ''"After everything you've already done for Raven Rock, I hate to ask for more but I can't risk [[Skyrim:Lleril Morvayn|Councilor Morvayn]] being killed."'' He will then elaborate: ''"The Ulen Family of [[Lore:House_Hlaalu|House Hlaalu]], a rival Great House, has placed a deathmark on the councilor's head."'' He then explains that Councilor Morvayn once ordered a member of House Hlaalu executed and that he suspects that there are hostile members of House Hlaalu living undercover in Raven Rock, but only that he has his suspicions and nothing else to go on. He then asks you to be his eyes and ears in Raven Rock and see what you can discover. He suggests you talk to local innkeeper of the [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|Retching Netch]], a Dunmer by the name of [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] who has quite the reputation as a gossip. When you bid Arano farewell, he will mention that Geldis has been with 'us' for a long time, so you can trust him—despite his reputation. From his spot behind the bar in the Retching Netch, Geldis will reveal that Arano has chased the Ulens for years, without any results whatsoever. He will then share his personal thoughts on what needs to be done: ''"If you want to catch those slippery slaughterfish, you need to let them come to you. There's an Ulen Ancestral Tomb near the Temple. Someone's been leaving ash yam offerings on the altar inside."'' Geldis reasons that whoever leaves ash yams in the tomb is bound to know something useful, though Arano and his team of Redoran Guards never had any luck when investigating the tomb. He then suggests that you, as an ordinary citizen, may have an advantage, and that you go to the tomb and wait around for that person to show up. ===An Unexpected Visitor=== The [[Skyrim:Ulen Ancestral Tomb|Ulen Ancestral Tomb]] will be empty when you enter. Wait around for a bit and a visitor will show up and silently pay her respects near the central grave. If you sneak up close enough to the visitor, the quest log will update and tell you to report back to Arano. When you approach her openly, she will turn around and reveal herself to be [[Skyrim:Tilisu Severin|Tilisu Severin]], saying: ''"Oh, excuse me! I didn't realize there was anyone else here."'' Ask her what she is doing there and she will answer: ''"I presume the same thing you're doing... leaving an offering for the departed."'' When you confront her with the fact that she is not a member of the Ulen family, she will brush you off with: ''"Since there aren't any Ulens left on this island, I've taken it upon myself to leave the traditional offering in their stead."'' You can choose between three options as part of your investigation: [[File:SR-quest-Served Cold 03.jpg|thumb|right|Who puts [[Skyrim:Ash Yam|ash yam]] in the tomb?]] '''You're lying. You're from House Hlaalu!'''
''"What kind of nonsense is that!? I'm simply honoring a fellow departed Dunmer, and you hurl baseless accusations at me?"'' '''Tell me why you're really here.'''
''"I'm simply honoring a fellow departed Dunmer."'' '''I'll let you get to it then.'''
''"Oh, no bother. We all have a right to be here."'' While Tilisu Severin returns to her meditation, locate Adril Arano and tell him that Tilisu may be the culprit: ''"Tilisu? Are you sure?"'' He will then ask you for evidence: ''"If Tilisu's involved in any sort of plot to harm Councilor Morvayn, I'm going to need hard evidence to prove it."'' He will, however, refuse to search [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]] himself and will then ask you to do it: ''"If you're wrong about Tilisu, things would quickly go downhill around here and the real culprits might slip away. I can't afford for that to happen."'' He'll then hand you the [[Skyrim:Severin Manor Key|key]] to Severin Manor and give you free hands to find evidence by any means necessary: ''"If you have the evidence and it places your life in peril, I would expect you to do whatever you must to keep yourself alive. Here, this key should open the front door of the manor in case they've locked it. Good luck."'' If you ask Adril to tell you more about the Severin family, he responds, ''"Tilisu is wife to the family patriarch, [[Skyrim:Vendil Severin|Vendil]]. They have a single child, a daughter named [[Skyrim:Mirri Severin|Mirri]]. They arrived here ten years ago, and have been nothing but a benefit to Raven Rock ever since."'' Adril goes on to say, ''"They're quite wealthy and they've been quite generous by sharing their fortune with the community. They've contributed coin, food, supplies... even helped repair a few of the buildings in town with their own hands."'' When you ask if there's anything unusual about them at all, Adril reveals that ''" People have mentioned it's a bit odd about how close in age Mirri appears to be to her father, but that's hardly a cause for alarm."'' He concludes with a reminder: ''"Just make sure that you find solid evidence. If I accuse them without it, I'll be the laughingstock of the colony."'' ===The Ulen Matter=== [[File:SR-quest-Served Cold 04.jpg|thumb|right|The wealthiest family in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]]]] Severin Manor is located in the western part of town, on the way to the [[Skyrim:Earth Stone|Earth Stone]]. There are two ways of dealing with the next task; either go into [[Skyrim:Sneak|sneak mode]] just prior to entering, or kick the door open. Regardless of the hour, Tilisu and Mirri Severin will be waiting inside with weapons drawn. Your target is the expert-locked safe downstairs, so either fight and kill them both to claim the key to the safe, or attempt to sneak down the stairs straight in front of you upon entering, without being detected. A potion which fortifies Sneak may help here before heading down, and there's one down the stairs to the right of the alchemy table on the shelf for the return trip. Head to the western bedroom and look for the Severin Family Safe that sits near a set of shelves to the left of the bed and either pick or unlock it. Inside is the revealing evidence, specifically ''[[Skyrim:The Ulen Matter|The Ulen Matter]]'', a letter written by family patriarch Vendil Severin, but signed by 'Vendil Ulen'. The letter clearly confirms Arano's suspicions, as it describes the plan to assassinate [[Skyrim:Lleril Morvayn|Councilor Lleril Morvayn]] as an act of revenge for the execution he ordered on a member of the Ulen family years back. Return to Arano with the letter in hand, and tell him that the Severin family is behind the conspiracy: ''"Then we finally have them! All that remains now is chasing them down, and bringing them to justice."'' Judged from the hostility you encountered back in the mansion, telling Arano you doubt they will surrender easily will make him send some help to [[Skyrim:Ashfallow Citadel|Ashfallow Citadel]], a place mentioned in the letter: ''"I'm going to send two of the best [[Skyrim:Redoran Guard|Redoran Guard]] we have to take them down. I want you to assist them any way you can."'' Although you will be given two options, Arano will not take no for an answer, so you will have to travel to the fort and help the guards out. ===Ashfallow Citadel=== [[File:SR-quest-Served Cold 05.jpg|thumb|right|The family [[Skyrim:Vendil Severin|patriarch]]]] According to Arano, Ashfallow Citadel has been abandoned for a long time, but when you arrive at the scene you will find the two Redoran Guards dead and be attacked by two [[Skyrim:Morag Tong Assassin|Morag Tong assassins]] immediately. Dispose of them and enter the half-buried ruin. The interior is almost entirely covered in ash and the very first chamber hides an [[Skyrim:East Empire Company Strongbox|East Empire Company strongbox]] on some shelves. Kill the patrolling assassin and proceed down the spiral staircase. Loot the chest here, and find the narrow tunnel leading south. Before long, you will land in the private quarters, patrolled by two assassins. The path ahead is blocked by a set of metal bars. A bookshelf in the western room contains a safe with especially valuable loot. The eastern room contains an [[Skyrim:Arcane Enchanter|arcane enchanter]] and an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], as well as a chain you need to pull to proceed. If you didn't kill her earlier, [[Skyrim:Mirri Severin|Mirri Severin]] will be waiting for you along with several assassins, so fight them all and face two more sets of metal bars blocking the path. Head into the western room and jump over five [[Skyrim:Traps#Bear Trap|bear traps]], then pull the chain. The other chain is located right next to the metal bars. Once they are removed, a third set of metal bars will block your path and the hallway will be plastered with [[Skyrim:Traps#Pressure Plate|pressure plates]] triggering [[Skyrim:Traps#Spiked Wall|spiked walls]]. Head into the western room and avoid more traps, then pull the two chains in there. With the path clear, head into the final chamber where you will find [[Skyrim:Vendil Severin|Vendil Severin]] and, if you didn't kill her earlier, [[Skyrim:Tilisu Severin|Tilisu]], both of them clad in Morag Tong armor and accompanied by two assassins. Engage them and Vendil will shout: ''"For Vilur Ulen! Long live House Hlaalu!"'' When you've defeated him, he hints that he is Vilur's son with his last words, ''"I join you in death, father..."'' When all is said and done, loot Vendil's corpse for various goodies. Note that his [[Skyrim:Vendil Ulen's Chest Key|chest key]] can't be used anywhere, but there is an unlocked chest at the back of the room. There is no quick escape route to Solstheim, so backtrack all the way to the entrance and return to Raven Rock. ===The Good News=== [[File:SR-quest-Served Cold 06.jpg|thumb|right|''"Adril... I haven't seen a smile on your face like that in a long time."'']] Back in Raven Rock, an excited Adril Arano will ask you if you tracked down Vendil. When you assure him that Vendil is no longer a threat, he will be relieved despite the two deceased guards who were slain by the Morag Tong: ''"Damn it. I was hoping to protect our people by sending them, not end up with casualties. To think that Vendil would stoop so low as to hire those fetchers... I'm glad you killed him."'' He will then ask you to follow him and rush back to [[Skyrim:Morvayn Manor|Morvayn Manor]] to deliver the good news himself. Follow him inside and witness a brief conversation between the two councilors: [[File:SR-place-Severin Manor.jpg|thumb|right|Your [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|reward]]]] '''Adril''': ''"Excuse me, Councilor Morvayn? I have some wonderful news."''
'''Lleril''': ''"Adril... I haven't seen a smile on your face like that in a long time."''
'''Adril''': ''"This visitor has single-handedly dealt with a threat that could have ended your life. Vendil, Tilisu and Mirri Severin weren't who they appeared to be. I'm afraid they were here to avenge Vilur Ulen's death."''
'''Lleril''': ''"Vendil? But he's done so much for Raven Rock... how could this be possible?"''
'''Adril''': ''"They did it to gain our confidence, councilor. They had us all fooled. I should have been more vigilant. I'm sorry."''
'''Lleril''': ''"Don't say that. It's not your fault, old friend."'' Councilor Morvayn will then ask you to step forward and receive his thanks: ''"What you've done for me... for all of Raven Rock... goes far beyond what I would have expected from a traveler to our town. For this, you have my deepest gratitude."'' He will then hand you the reward: ''"Now. I'm certain Adril was prepared to reward you appropriately for everything you've done. However, since a bit of coin hardly seems like enough... I've decided to provide something more substantial. Since the Severin family... or whoever they were...turned out to be criminals, their property is now forfeit. As Councilor, I hereby award you Severin Manor and everything contained within. You've earned your citizenship here, and I hope you'll consider staying with us as a member of our community."'' He will also hand you a leveled amount of gold, along with the right to live inside [[Skyrim:Severin Manor|Severin Manor]] and claim all its contents. This unlocks an [[Skyrim:Raven Rock Owner#Achievements|achievement]] and ends the quest. === Reward === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; margin:0.5em 0;" ! Levels !! Reward |- |1-29 || 1,500 |- |30-39 || 2,500 |- |40-49 || 5,000 |- |50-59 || 7,500 |- |60+ || 10,000 |} {{NewLine}} === Achievements === One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete the quest: * {{achievement|Raven Rock Owner|}} == Notes == * You might want to hold off on doing this quest until you've done [[Skyrim:It's All In The Taste|It's All In The Taste]]. Both Mirri and Tilisu are potential customers, and it can be difficult to find ten others without having to wait a day and go back to the same people otherwise. * When you speak to Adril after killing Vendil, even if Adril is in his usual seat right next to Morvayn, he will tell you he's taking you to see the Councilor and stand up before beginning the next conversation. * The only way to get the Severin Safe Key is to kill Mirri Severin and loot it from her corpse, or to have the Wax Key perk when picking the lock. It will not appear when pickpocketing her. * Don't bother stealing anything from Severin Manor until you complete the quest. All the objects contained within the house will lose their previous ownership once the quest is completed. Otherwise, you will have stolen objects in your inventory for nothing. * If you previously cleared Ashfallow Citadel before starting the quest, then the Morag Tong will have respawned and will need to be cleared out again during the quest. *The Ulen Matter is written to a Councilor Saldin. Who this is, and their relation to the Ulens, is never fully revealed. == Bugs == {{Bug|If you speak to Tilisu Severin to learn her identity, the quest objective "Discover the identity of the tomb's visitor" may not complete.|UDBP|2.0.3}} **Sneak up behind her and [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|pickpocket]] her. As soon as her inventory opens, the quest objective will be completed. {{Bug|If Mirri is slain in Severin Manor, her corpse may remain after the quest is complete.|UDBP|2.0.6| She was lacking a cleanup script.}} {{Bug|When you complete the quest, everything (items, chests, beds) in Severin Manor may still be marked as owned.}} {{Bug|When you complete the quest, the number of houses you own in the Stats menu may not change even though you now own it.}} {{Bug|If you kill Mirri and Tilisu in Servin Manor at night, you may be "asked to leave" Severin Manor upon finishing the quest.}} {{Bug|Upon killing Vendil Ulen in Ashfallow Citadel there is a chance of the quest not progressing further.}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||Captain Veleth told me that Adril Arano, Second Councilor of Raven Rock, wanted to speak to me immediately. Hopefully this person is either the assassin himself or can lead me to the assassin threatening Councilor Morvayn's life. {{Quest Objective|20|Wait inside Ulen Ancestral Tomb}} |40||{{Quest Objective|30|Discover the identity of the tomb's visitor {{Quest Comment|assigned after 30 in-game minutes}}}} |50||I discovered Tilisu Severin visiting the Ulen Ancestral Tomb at night. == Quick Walkthrough ==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Morwen|Morwen]] in [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]].
# Take [[Skyrim:Bera's Necklace|her mother's necklace]] to [[Skyrim:Runil|Runil]] in [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]].
# Return to Morwen.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
If you return to [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal Village]] after the quest [[Skyrim:The Fate of the Skaal|The Fate of the Skaal]], you may find [[Skyrim:Morwen|Morwen]] working near the forge. She may tell you, ''"My mother was Skaal, but she left the village and I was born in Skyrim."'' If you ask her why her mother left the village, she will tell you the whole story of her family. A trade ship from Skyrim struck ice off the coast near the village, and the Skaal took in the surviving sailors. Her mother, Bera, fell in love with one of the sailors—her father, Ulfarr—and eventually returned with him to Skyrim. However, Bera never returned to the village and died in [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]], where little Morwen was born.

If you are willing to give Morwen a hand, she will tell you that she came across a few of her mother's old things not long ago and among them was a necklace that her father gave to her mother when they were married. She believes it would be meaningful to place it upon her tombstone in Falkreath, as a symbol of her undying love and the great sacrifice she made for it. She wants you to deliver [[Skyrim:Bera's Necklace|her mother's necklace]] to the priest [[Skyrim:Runil|Runil]]. After the conversation, Bera's necklace will be added into your inventory. If you haven't talked to [[Skyrim:Gjalund Salt-Sage|Gjalund Salt-Sage]] about the passage back to Skyrim, a quest marker will appear at his location.

Travel to Falkreath and you may find Runil in Falkreath's [[Skyrim:Hall_of_the_Dead_(Falkreath)|Hall of the Dead]]. Talk to him about the request of Morwen of Skaal Village; he will recall the name. ''"I knew her parents quite well, you know. Bera and Ulfarr were good people, very much in love."'' Then he will be willing to grant her request. ''"Bera's silver necklace. It was a wedding gift and she rarely took it off. I'll be glad to oblige. What a touching gesture, to display the symbol of her devotion in such a way."'' He is sure it will bring joy to her parents as they walk in [[Lore:Aetherius|Aetherius]]. Then he will take the necklace from your inventory.

Return to Morwen in Skaal Village, and she will be grateful. ''"You've brought warmth to my heart, outsider, and I'm in your debt."'' Then she will reward you with a [[Skyrim:Nordic Carved Helmet|Nordic carved helmet]] and regard you as an ally to the Skaal. She will also become a potential [[Skyrim:Marriage|spouse]].

== Notes ==
* You can steal the necklace back from Runil after giving it to him.

'''Note: This quest was originally added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Saturalia Holiday Pack|Saturalia Holiday Pack]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. This short quest will be added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Saturalia Holiday Pack|Saturalia Holiday Pack]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. You will be directed to locate a merchant who has set up shop near [[SR:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] in advance of [[Lore:Saturalia|Saturalia]], a festival which takes place on the 25<sup>th</sup> of [[Lore:Evening Star|Evening Star]]. Note that the in-game time of year is irrelevant for the purposes of this quest.

The merchant's camp can be found just outside Dawnstar, north of the [[SR:Windward Ruins|Windward Ruins]]. It is located close to a [[SR:World Interactions|World Interaction]] spawn point which may prove problematic. The merchant is [[SR:Agrane Peryval|Agrane Peryval]], who can be found at the camp along with a tame [[SR:Reindeer|reindeer]]. Simply speak to Agrane to finish the quest; you are under no obligation to buy anything from him.

If you do choose to make a purchase, his stock includes several unique items: three sets of festive clothing ([[SR:Saturalia Boots|Saturalia Boots]], [[SR:Saturalia Clothes|Saturalia Clothes]], [[SR:Saturalia Gloves|Saturalia Gloves]]) and a [[SR:Reindeer Bill of Sale|bill of sale]] for the nearby reindeer. Once purchased, the reindeer can be used as a mount, and will return to this camp if you switch to another mount.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Find the Companions===
On your way to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], you may come across members of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]], specifically [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]], [[Skyrim:Ria|Ria]], and [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]], battling a [[Skyrim:Giant|giant]] among the sparse crops outside [[Skyrim:Pelagia Farm|Pelagia Farm]]. If you want to participate in this fight, make sure to head straight to the farm once you arrive in the vicinity of Whiterun. If you delay for even a short time, the Companions will have already defeated the giant before you can join the fray, resulting in Aela taunting you for your lack of assistance. If you delay for too long, you may miss the Companions entirely, as they will slowly walk to the main gates of Whiterun and enter the city after the battle. Note that neither of these results has any negative consequences in your dealings with the Companions. If you are present when the giant dies, Aela will actively seek you out and will, depending on the outcome of the battle, either commend or taunt your battle skills. In both cases, however, she will tell you about the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] and point you towards [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]] in [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr|Jorrvaskr]].

This quest can also be started by speaking with select [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] citizens or Jorrvaskr residents, who will suggest you go speak with Kodlak.

===Jorrvaskr===
Jorrvaskr is a legendary mead hall and the oldest building in Whiterun; it is located in the Wind District, up the eastern set of stairs from the Gildergreen. Inside the building, you will witness a friendly brawl between newcomers [[Skyrim:Athis|Athis]] and [[Skyrim:Njada Stonearm|Njada Stonearm]] while the other members cheer. The harbinger of the Companions, [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]], will most likely be in the northern room of the Living Quarters, busy talking to [[Skyrim:Vilkas|Vilkas]] about what seem to be important matters. When asked about membership, Kodlak will consider you worthy, while Vilkas will disagree. After a brief argument between the two, Kodlak will ask about your battle skills. Regardless of your answer, Kodlak will order Vilkas to escort you to the yard for a quick sparring session. Follow Vilkas to the yard and pick up the fight. Make sure not to use magic, a bound weapon, or an enchanted weapon, for if you do Vilkas will temporarily stop the session. If you only have enchanted weapons, unequip them and use your fists. Take a few swings at Vilkas and prove your worth. Once Vilkas asks you to stop, accept your status as a 'whelp' and the fact that you will run errands for now.

===A Few Errands===
Vilkas will hand you his [[Skyrim:Vilkas's Sword|sword]] for sharpening. Take it to the best smith in town, [[Skyrim:Eorlund_Gray-Mane|Eorlund Gray-Mane]], who works at the [[Skyrim:Skyforge|Skyforge]] just up the stairs from the Jorrvaskr entrance. Eorlund will briefly explain how newcomers tend to get bossed around upon joining the Companions, and will then ask for a favor. He will give you a [[Skyrim:Aela's Shield|shield]] for [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela]], who can be found talking to [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]] in the living quarters. Similar to the conversation between Kodlak and Vilkas, it becomes apparent that the Companions hide a few secrets, although none of them will share them with you at this time. When you hand Aela the shield, she will thank you for the favor and summon [[Skyrim:Farkas|Farkas]] to escort you to your new quarters, where a free bed will be available. Farkas will introduce you to a few of the other newcomers and will also offer you a job, which will be one of his radiant quests. You can choose to ignore his request, as seven different [[Skyrim:Companions#Radiant Quests|radiant quests]] will now be available from the guild members, and you must complete at least one of them before your next major assignment, [[Skyrim:Proving Honor|Proving Honor]].

===Achievements===
One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest:
* {{achievement|Take Up Arms (achievement)|descr=no}}

==Notes==
* In the living quarters, Aela and Farkas' dialogue will differ. If you met them earlier near Pelagia Farm, they will both recognize you; if you went straight to Jorrvaskr, they will just greet you like a newcomer.
* If you manage to drop Vilkas' health to zero during the test, he'll qualify your performance as "most impressive" rather than just "not bad".
* Athis and Njada Stonearm's brawl can potentially go on forever if you first enter Jorrvaskr at a high level. Going into the basement will end the fight.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|If you place [[Skyrim:Vilkas's Sword|Vilkas's sword]] on a weapon rack or plaque, the quest can still be completed by talking to Eorlund, and the sword will disappear from the rack/plaque. However, the slot the sword occupied can never be used again.|USKP|1.1}}
{{Bug|When training with Vilkas, he may spew combat taunts at you.|USKP|2.0.6|The taunts were never supposed to happen, so he is now being temporarily made a player teammate during the sparring match so that the taunts will be suppressed.}}
{{Bug|If Aela's Shield is pickpocketed off of her after you've given it to her, it will end up getting stacked with other common Steel Shields, causing the entire stack to in essence become her shield.|USSEP|4.3.4}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Riliane }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=Automatic upon entering [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]] during [[Skyrim:The World-Eater's Eyrie|The World-Eater's Eyrie]]. |Reward=None |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The World-Eater's Eyrie|The World-Eater's Eyrie]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]] |Image=SR-quest-Sovngarde.jpg |ImgDesc=Sovngarde |description=Seek out [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] within [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]]. |ID=MQ304 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Once you've entered [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]], continue down the path. # Find out how to defeat [[SR:Alduin|Alduin]]. # Gain admittance to the [[SR:Hall of Valor|Hall of Valor]]. # Talk to the heroes of Sovngarde. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-Sovngarde 02.jpg|thumb|Inside the Hall of Valor]] You are transported to a [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|misty realm]] filled with statues of [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] warriors. The mist has no noticeable effect on you and can be temporarily cleared with the [[Skyrim:Clear Skies|Clear Skies]] shout, but it quickly rematerializes. Upon continuing down the stone steps, you may be stopped by a [[Skyrim:Stormcloak Soldier (Sovngarde)|Stormcloak soldier]] who says that the mist is extremely dangerous and that you should not go into it. He died fighting the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]], and all his companions have been swallowed up by the mist, where he says [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] lurks, devouring souls. He also tells you that at the end of the valley of mist lies [[Skyrim:Hall of Valor|Shor's Hall]], where the heroes of Sovngarde gather. He begs you to allow him to follow you. True enough, Alduin will periodically swoop in and grab a fallen [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloak]] or Legion soldier in the misty valley. On the way, you may encounter historical figures such as [[Skyrim:High King Torygg|High King Torygg]] and [[Skyrim:Svaknir|Svaknir]], along with NPCs that have died in the course of the game, such as [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]], [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]], [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]], or [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]]. Once clearing the mist, you'll reach the edge and be stopped by the gate guardian, [[Skyrim:Tsun|Tsun]]. He challenges your right to enter the Hall of Valor and declares that you must prove your worth in a warrior's duel regardless of the right that you claim. The first claim 'by the right of birth' will always appear regardless of what you have done in the game, but the remaining ones can only be used if you have completed the quests of the Companions, the College of Winterhold, the Dark Brotherhood and/or the Thieves Guild, respectively. {|class=wikitable !Option !Dialogue |- |'''By the right of birth. I am Dragonborn.''' |''"Ah! It's been too long since last I faced a doom-driven hero of the dragon blood."'' |- |'''By right of glory. I lead the Companions of Jorrvaskr.''' |''"I welcome the chance to challenge the blade of Ysgramor's heir, honored shield-brother/shield-sister to Kodlak Whitemane, whom I've watched for in vain."'' |- |'''By right of Cleverness. I am Master of the College of Winterhold.''' |''"Well met, mage of Skyrim. The Nords may have forgotten their forefathers' respect for the Clever Craft, but your comrades throng this hall. Here in Shor's house we honor it still."'' |- |'''By right of blood. I Listen for the Night Mother.'''† |''"You trespass here, shadow-walker. Shor does not know you. Perhaps before the end you will earn the right to pass this way. Welcome I do not offer, but your errand I will not hinder, if my wrath you can withstand."'' |- |'''By right of plunder. I am a Nightingale of Nocturnal.'''‡ |''"Do not mistake the night-shrouded thief's stealthily-taken spoils, stolen and unearned, for a warrior's plunder, won in honorable battle. Your doom already binds you to your dark mistress, but your errand I will not hinder, if my wrath you can withstand."'' |} † Also requires [[Skyrim:Hail Sithis!|Hail Sithis!]] to be completed.
‡ Only requires [[Skyrim:Trinity Restored|Trinity Restored]] to be completed. He is fast and deals an enormous amount of damage, so if you are having trouble beating him, you can run back down the steps and into the water, as he will stand at the edge and be unable to attack you. [[Skyrim:Potions#Poisons|Poison potions]] will significantly help the battle against him and with the right potions may end the battle immediately or greatly shorten the length of the battle. Fire spells work particularly well against him, as do ranged attacks. You do not need to initiate conversation in order to earn entrance. Inside, you are greeted by [[Skyrim:Ysgramor|Ysgramor]], founder of the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] and harbinger of men, who asks you to speak to the Nord heroes of old who battled Alduin (as seen in the Elder Scroll): [[Skyrim:Gormlaith Golden-Hilt|Gormlaith Golden-Hilt]], [[Skyrim:Hakon One-Eye|Hakon One-Eye]], and [[Skyrim:Felldir the Old|Felldir the Old]]. The Hall is filled with [[Skyrim:Hero of Sovngarde|Heroes of Sovngarde]], including some very notable ones like [[Skyrim:Jurgen Windcaller|Jurgen Windcaller]], [[Skyrim:Olaf One-Eye|Olaf One-Eye]], and [[Skyrim:Ulfgar the Unending|Ulfgar the Unending]]. When you meet with the three heroes that you are directed towards, they decide to join Shouts with you to clear the mist from Sovngarde. The quest ends with you running out to join them near the misty valley. == Notes == * It is possible to jump onto a rock hanging over the waterfall and make Tsun fall to his death, or shove him off the platform with Unrelenting Force. However, he will merely respawn in front of the Hall of Valor. On your way to the hall of Valor, he may stop you on the bridge and congratulate you. * If you try to cross the bridge before Tsun grants access, you will be killed by lightning strikes. * If you try to climb down the mountain around the Hall (on either side) you will be instantly killed if you go below a certain height. * On the tables in the Hall of Valor, you can find a [[Skyrim:Roasted Ox Head|Roasted Ox Head]] and two [[Skyrim:Roasted Ox Leg|Roasted Ox Leg]]s, the only ones available in the game which you can take. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've passed through Alduin's portal into Sovngarde, the realm of Aetherius where the souls of Nord heroes go to feast and battle until the final reckoning. Now to find Alduin and defeat him once and for all. {{Quest Objective|10|Find out how to defeat Alduin}} |50||I've passed through Alduin's portal into Sovngarde, the realm of Aetherius where the souls of Nord heroes go to feast and battle until the final reckoning. Alduin has laid some kind of soul-snare across the valley of Sovngarde, a mist where he hides and feeds upon the trapped souls. My only hope is to reach the Hall of Heroes. {{Quest Objective|20|Gain admittance to the Hall of Valor}} |150||{{Quest Objective|30|Talk to the heroes of Sovngarde}} |200|fin|I've passed through Alduin's portal into Sovngarde, the realm of Aetherius where the souls of Nord heroes go to feast and battle until the final reckoning. Alduin has laid some kind of soul-snare across the valley of Sovngarde, a mist where he hides and feeds upon the trapped souls. I reached the Hall of Heroes and met Gormlaith Golden-Hilt, Hakon One-Eye, and Felldir the Old - the three heroes who I saw defeat Alduin in my vision of the past. They have been permitted by Shor, the god of the underworld, to join me in my battle against Alduin. |missing=0, 1, 5, 20, 30, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100, 105, 110, 130, 135, 140, 160, 170, 180, 300 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]]|Prev=[[Skyrim:The World-Eater's Eyrie|The World-Eater's Eyrie]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Main Quest|Main Quest]]}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=[[User:Helenaannevalentine|Helenaannevalentine]] |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=[[User:Helenaannevalentine|Helenaannevalentine]] |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]] |Reward=[[SR:Gallus's Encoded Journal|Gallus' Encoded Journal]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Disarm|Disarm]] shout |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Scoundrel's Folly|Scoundrel's Folly]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Hard Answers|Hard Answers]] |Loc=[[SR:Snow Veil Sanctum|Snow Veil Sanctum]] |Image=SR-quest-Speaking With Silence.jpg |ImgDesc=Mercer Frey waiting to track down Karliah |description=Track down the [[Skyrim:Karliah|Dunmer]] behind the Guild's misfortunes. |ID=TG05 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Meet [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]] outside [[Skyrim:Snow Veil Sanctum|Snow Veil Sanctum]]. # Enter the Sanctum with Mercer. # Find [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]]. # Speak to Karliah. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Where the End Began...=== [[File:SR-quest-Speaking_With_Silence_02.jpg|thumb|left|Mercer breaking into Snow Veil Sanctum]] Journey to [[Skyrim:Snow_Veil_Sanctum|Snow Veil Sanctum]], which is northeast of [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. When you arrive you will find an abandoned camp near the entrance along with a dead horse. Continuing onward, you will see [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]] waiting outside the ruin's entrance. As you approach, Mercer will initiate a conversation with you: ''"Good, you're finally here. I've scouted the ruins and I'm certain [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] is still inside."'' Asking if he saw Karliah, he will tell you: ''"No, I found her horse. Don't worry, I've taken care of it... she won't be using it to escape. Let's get moving, I want to catch her inside while she's distracted. Take the lead."'' If you choose to question his methods, he will sarcastically reply: ''"I'm sorry, I was under the impression I was in charge. You're leading and I'm following. Does that seem clear to you?"'' Once you finally agree with his plan, he will continue: ''"Just make certain you keep your eyes open. Karliah is as sharp as a blade. The last thing I need is you blundering into a trap and warning her that we're here."'' At this point, he will act as a [[Skyrim:Followers|temporary follower]]. Making your way towards the door to the [[SR:Snow Veil Catacombs|Snow Veil Catacombs]], you will soon realize that the door itself is locked and cannot be opened without a key. You must then wait for Mercer to open the door, and while he is opening the door, he will provide a running commentary: ''"They say that these ancient Nordic burial mounds are sometimes impenetrable. This one doesn't look too difficult. Quite simple really, I don't know what the fuss is about these locks. All it takes is a bit of know-how and a lot of skill."'' After Mercer has managed to unlock the door, he will say: ''"That should do it. After you."'' Continue inside the ruin with Mercer, who will comment about the surroundings: ''"The stench in here... this place smells of death. Be on your guard."'' Inside the ruins, you will face multiple leveled [[SR:Draugr|draugr]] as well as several [[SR:Traps|traps]] along the way. In the first room, you will find a dead draugr as well as several urns and a trapped chest. If not disarmed, opening the chest triggers draugr to awaken and attack you. Also pulling a chain located to the right side of the room will open one of the two gates containing minor loot. [[File:SR-quest-Speaking_With_Silence_03.jpg|thumb|right|A crypt rigged with bone chimes]] Continue into the next room where several more draugr lie dead on the floor. Mercer will warn you of a [[SR:Spike Wall|spike trap]] that is triggered when pulling the chain: ''"Pull the chain over there, and watch out for the spikes. Looks like Karliah reset all of the traps."'' Proceeding onward into the corridor, several sleeping draugr can be found along the way, who will awaken and attack you as you pass. There is also an adept-locked door located to the right of the corridor containing minor loot. Some [[SR:Bear Trap|bear traps]] are located along the corridor as well. As you approach a [[SR:Oil Slicks|fire trap]], Mercer will again warn you by saying: ''"There's two more of them ahead."'' Continuing along the corridor, there is a metal gate which needs to be opened. To open the gate, there is a chain located to the left in an alcove. Moving forward, an apprentice-locked door straight ahead leads to a small room which has a perch where you can take out a few of the draugr found in the next chamber. [[File:SR-quest-Speaking_With_Silence_04.jpg|thumb|left|The [[SR:Model Ship|Model Ship]] for [[SR:The Litany of Larceny|The Litany of Larceny]]]] A potion for health, magicka, and stamina are hidden behind the table on your left upon entering this room. Proceeding back you will come across a room with several [[SR:Bone Chimes|bone chimes]]. Mercer will warn: ''"Bone chimes... clever. Rigged to wake the draugr I'd bet. Don't blunder into any of them."'' Once you make it across to the other side of the room, there is a chain on the right-hand side of the metal gate. Moving onward down several flights of stairs, you will come to the large chamber seen before in the other room. Upon entering, several draugr will awaken if you haven't already taken them out. If you choose to go up the flight of stairs directly ahead of you, you will come across a room containing a [[SR:Model Ship|model ship]] which is needed for the quest [[SR:The Litany of Larceny|The Litany of Larceny]]. The ship is located on a [[SR:Weight Sensitive Plate|pedestal]], which upon removing, will trigger a fire trap surrounding it. To proceed forward, there is a flight of stairs located to the right of the chamber which leads overhead to the next zone: [[SR:Snow Veil Sanctum|Snow Veil Sanctum]]. {{NewLeft}} ===...and the Beginning Ends=== [[File:SR-quest-Speaking_With_Silence_05.jpg|thumb|left|A dragon priest guarding the word wall]] [[File:SR-quest-Speaking_With_Silence_06.jpg|thumb|right|Mercer cracking the puzzle door]] As you enter the next zone, you will encounter several leveled draugr who will awaken and attack you. Continuing along the corridor, there is a chain located to the left which opens the metal gate in front. As you proceed forward, Mercer will comment: ''"We're on the right track. She's been through here as well."'' Before the flight of stairs, you will find a leveled draugr wandering the nearby area. As you continue, you will come across a wooden double-door which leads onto another large chamber. Mercer will advise you about the door ahead: ''"That door up ahead... looks perfect for hiding an ambush. Be ready."'' Once you enter the chamber, multiple leveled draugr will awaken and begin to ambush you and Mercer. At higher levels, a [[SR:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] may spawn by the [[SR:Word Wall|word wall]] for the [[Skyrim:Disarm|Disarm]] shout. Also located in this chamber is a copy of the [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[SR:Ice and Chitin|Ice and Chitin]]'' which can be found on a table. Proceed to the left of the chamber where another metal gate is closed. The chain for this gate is located to the right of the gate itself. As you make your way along the short corridor, you will come across several more bear traps before you are confronted by a Nordic puzzle door. It is not necessary to decipher it, as Mercer will open it, providing another commentary: ''"Ah, it's one of the infamous Nordic puzzle doors. How quaint. Without the matching claw, they're normally impossible to open. And since I'm certain Karliah already did away with it, we're on our own. Fortunately, these doors have a weakness if you know how to exploit it. Quite simple, really. Karliah's close. I'm certain of it. Now let's get moving."'' Once Mercer opens the door and you step through into the next chamber, Karliah will shoot you with a poisoned arrow and the scene fades to black. In a cutscene, you lie immobile but cognizant as you witness a conversation between Karliah and Mercer, in which you learn that it was in fact Mercer who killed Gallus. [[File:SR-npc-Karliah_03.jpg|thumb|right|Mercer confronting Karliah]] '''Mercer:''' ''"Do you honestly think your arrow will reach me before my blade finds your heart?"''
'''Karliah:''' ''"Give me a reason to try."''
'''Mercer:''' ''"You're a clever girl, Karliah. Buying [[Skyrim:Goldenglow_Estate|Goldenglow Estate]] and funding [[Skyrim:Honningbrew_Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]] was inspired."''
'''Karliah:''' ''"'To ensure an enemy's defeat, you must first undermine his allies.' It was the first lesson Gallus taught us."''
'''Mercer:''' ''"You always were a quick study."''
'''Karliah:''' ''"Not quick enough, otherwise Gallus would still be alive."''
'''Mercer:''' ''"Gallus had his wealth and he had you. All he had to do was look the other way."''
'''Karliah:''' ''"Did you forget the Oath we took as Nightingales? Did you expect him to simply ignore your methods?"''
'''Mercer:''' ''"Enough of this mindless banter! Come, Karliah. It's time for you and Gallus to become reunited!"''
'''Karliah:''' ''"I'm no fool, Mercer. Crossing blades with you would be a death sentence. But I can promise the next time we meet, it will be your undoing."'' [[File:SR-npc-Karliah_04.jpg|thumb|left|Karliah tending to your wounds after Mercer's betrayal]] Karliah then disappears using an invisibility potion. Mercer will then approach you as you lie on the ground, saying aloud: ''"How interesting. It appears Gallus's history has repeated itself. Karliah has provided me with the means to be rid of you, and this ancient tomb becomes your final resting place. But do you know what intrigues me the most? The fact that this was all possible because of you. Farewell. I'll be certain to give [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] your regards."'' He will then stab you and walk away, leaving you to die in the sanctum. As you regain consciousness, you will find yourself outside of the Snow Veil Sanctum. As you get up, you will notice Karliah approaching saying, ''"Easy, easy. Don't get up so quickly. How are you feeling?"'' Exclaiming that she shot you, she will correct you: ''"No, I saved your life. My arrow was tipped with a unique paralytic poison. It slowed your heart and kept you from bleeding out. Had I intended to kill you, we wouldn't be having this conversation."'' As you ask Karliah why she saved you, she will explain: ''"My original intention was to use that arrow on Mercer, but I never had a clear shot. I made a split second decision to get you out of the way and it prevented your death."'' After a while, you will learn that she had hoped to capture Mercer alive and to bring him to justice for what he has done. Karliah will go on to say that she managed to acquire [[SR:Gallus's Encoded Journal|Gallus' encoded journal]] and asks that you travel to [[SR:Winterhold|Winterhold]] and speak to [[SR:Enthir|Enthir]] about getting its contents translated, which starts the [[SR:Hard Answers|next quest]]. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * You are unable to take any [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] or [[Skyrim:Conjure|summons]] with you into the ruins. ** You can still use any [[Skyrim:Conjuration|conjuration spells]] inside the ruins. * At any time between meeting Mercer outside Snow Veil Sanctum and triggering the cutscene, Mercer Frey will follow you on your travels as an 'unofficial' follower. Unfortunately, you can't give him orders such as ''"Wait Here"'', etc. and you can't make him carry your gear, but he is a fast, invincible killing machine. * Before going on other adventures with Mercer Frey when he joins you as a follower, you should first ''activate'' then Enter/Exit the door to the Snow Veil Catacombs. If not, he will always detect you... thus making your [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] perk bonus for kills (Backstab, Deadly Aim, Assassin's Blade) useless. * Triggering the fire traps surrounding the model ship may cause it to be thrown from the pedestal to a place where it is difficult or impossible to reach. The [[Skyrim:Telekinesis|telekinesis spell]] can be used to safely obtain the ship. * You cannot avoid being hit by Karliah's arrow, as it is a scripted event. * Unlike other Thieves Guild main quests, it is very hard, if not impossible, to remain hidden and avoid combat in this quest. Mercer is a poor infiltrator and will charge at almost every enemy he comes across, blowing your cover and spoiling the chance to deliver sneak attacks. You can't tell him to wait and the only way to keep him behind is to use paralyze spell/potions on him. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If your follower blocks Mercer's way to Snow Veil Sanctum's door, Mercer may stop and not continue to the door. You can force Mercer to start the animation to open the door by nudging him, or using [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] towards the door, or console command SetStage TG05 30.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Just prior to the puzzle-lock door is a grille door which is raised and lowered by a chain on either side. By trapping Mercer away from Karliah the quest will halt partway through the cut scene that follows after you proceed to Karliah's chamber. The only way to proceed at this point is through a reload.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Mercer will sometimes not open the puzzle-ring lock. Try waiting for an hour and walk back to the gate; it should reset and he should begin to walk slowly towards the puzzle.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}}If Mercer still won't open the claw door, while standing by the door, open the console and type SetStage TG05 50. {{Bug|If you get stuck in the puzzle-lock door in the cut-scene and you can't see Mercer talking to Karliah and she's just standing there without talking, use your wait function to wait for 2-3 hours. ==Walkthrough==
If you steal an item, the victim of the theft may subsequently send a number (generally three) of [[Skyrim:Hired Thug|hired thugs]] to hunt you down. They will casually approach you, but be ready because they will attack you after speaking to you. The thugs will be carrying a [[Skyrim:Contract (Theft)|contract]] which reveals the name of the victim who hired the thugs.

== Notes ==
* The item in question can either be stolen from a location or pickpocketed, and you do not have to be seen; an unnoticed theft can still activate the contract. Furthermore, the contract can be from someone who is related to or affiliated with the one you stole from (not the NPC themselves).
* Almost every NPC in the game can send thugs after you. <!--DO NOT START A LIST. Every NPC means every NPC, including generic, children, and hostiles.-->
* Other than stealing, killing someone may also cause a relative to send thugs after you (see [[Skyrim:Revenge, Hired Thugs|Revenge, Hired Thugs]]).

== Bugs ==

Skyrim:Speak to Degaine.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Helenaannevalentine |checkedBy=RobinHood70 |reward=Helenaannevalentine |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Quest Header |type=Miscellaneous |Giver=[[Skyrim:Kleppr|Kleppr]] or [[Skyrim:Frabbi|Frabbi]] |Reward=150 gold |Loc=[[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]], [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]] |Image=SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 02.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Degaine|Degaine]] begging in the marketplace |description=Ask a [[Skyrim:Degaine|beggar]] about money. |ID=T01Intro, T01DegaineFavor |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Difficulty=Hard }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Travel to the city of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. # Speak with [[Skyrim:Degaine|Degaine]]. # Enter the Inner Sanctum of the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]] and use [[SR:Mayhem|Mayhem]] to force all the priestesses of Dibella to attack themselves. # Steal the [[Skyrim:Statue of Dibella|statue]] and return to Degaine for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Golden Statue=== [[File:SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella.jpg|thumb|right|The Temple of Dibella]] If you speak to innkeeper [[Skyrim:Kleppr|Kleppr]] or his wife [[Skyrim:Frabbi|Frabbi]] in the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]], they will tell you about the beggar named [[Skyrim:Degaine|Degaine]]: ''"Degaine the beggar got himself kicked out of the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]]. Caused quite the ruckus."'' You will then be given the objective to speak to Degaine, who can usually be found begging near the marketplace. Upon approaching him, he will express his interest in stealing a [[Skyrim:Statue of Dibella|statue]]: ''"Aye, a whole heap of it. You see that Temple? Way up there. All them women, keeping to themselves. Won't let poor Degaine in, no. Not even for a look. But they've got a treasure in there. Gold statue, size of a child. Who knows what they use it for, but I know what I'll use it for."'' Inquire why he wants to steal the statue and he will tell you: ''"Well let's not put it like that. Wouldn't want the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] catching wind of us, eh? Nah, just creep in and have a go at taking it out. I'll be here, and pay you half of what my man in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] promised for it. You'll be helping out an old beggar, and the [[Lore:Eight Divines|Divines]] smile on that sort of thing."'' The statue itself is located within the Inner Sanctum of the temple. This makes finding the temple itself easier, but is not necessary to initiate [[Skyrim:The Heart of Dibella|The Heart of Dibella]] quest. ===The Temple of Dibella=== Upon entering the temple, you will find the priestess [[Skyrim:Senna|Senna]], who will inform you that: ''"The sisters are communing with Dibella. They can't be disturbed. You'll have to come back another time."'' In order to access the Inner Sanctum, you can either try to pick the expert-lock, or steal the [[Skyrim:Key to the Dibella Inner Sanctum|key]] from Senna. Note: Unsuccessful pickpocketing the key from her, will cause Senna to become hostile. Note that if you choose to pick the lock and are not caught by one of the priestesses, you'll have to do it twice—once to get into the Sanctum, and once to get out. If you are caught by one of the priestesses, [[Skyrim:Hamal|Hamal]] will confront you. You will then have the option to find the Sybil. If you choose not to do so, the priestesses will become hostile and attack you. If you kill them, you will be unable to complete The Heart of Dibella quest. If you successfully retrieve the statue, you can turn it over to Degaine who will hastily say: ''"Give it to me quickly, before they see us together. You've riled up the priestesses, and the guards don't take kindly to that. Here's your share. Nicely done."'' He then gives you 150 gold in exchange for the statue. At this point, in order to start The Heart of Dibella, you will have to return to the temple and deliberately get noticed. ==Notes== *The Statue of Dibella differs from the common [[Skyrim:Dibella Statue|Dibella Statues]] found throughout Skyrim. *If you speak to Degaine and then accept and complete the Heart of Dibella quest, the statue of Dibella will disappear as will the quest to steal it, from your journal. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you have the 'Speak to Degaine' task, but instead talk to Hamal inside the temple, then immediately accept and finish the quest, you won't be able to finish the 'Speak to Degaine' quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|You can be given the 'Speak to Degaine' quest a second time, and the quest won't/can't update because you have already opted to steal the Statue of Dibella.|USKP|1.0}} ** {{Pc22}} Typing SetStage T01Intro 10 and then SetObjectiveCompleted T01Intro 10 1 in the console will remove this objective from your Miscellaneous quests. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Speak to Degaine |id=T01Intro |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Speak to Degaine}} |!|Steal the statue|T01DegaineFavor |10||{{Journal Hidden|Degaine the beggar has asked me to steal a chalice from the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.}} {{Quest Objective|10|Steal the statue in the Temple of Dibella {{Quest Comment|if not already stolen}}}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Bring the statue to Degaine}} |missing= ** T01Intro: 20. ** T01DegaineFavor: 0, 100, 200 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes|ID=T01Intro}}

Skyrim:Soul Cairn Horse Quest.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Likelolwhat |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked= }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Miscellaneous}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Soul#xx002b0d|Soul]] |Prev=[[SR:Chasing Echoes|Chasing Echoes]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Soul_Cairn|Soul Cairn]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Summon_Arvak|Summon Arvak]] spell |Image=SR-quest-Soul Cairn Horse Quest.jpg |Imgdesc=[[Skyrim:Arvak's Skull|Arvak's Skull]] |description=Find [[Skyrim:Arvak|Arvak]]'s skull. |ID=DLC01SoulCairnHorseQuest2 |SuggLevel=13 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #''(Optional)'' Talk to a distraught [[Skyrim:Soul#xx002b0d|soul]]. #Find [[Skyrim:Arvak's_Skull|Arvak's skull]]. #Return to the soul. ==Detailed Walkthrough== This quest can only be started within the [[Skyrim:Soul_Cairn|Soul Cairn]]. It can be started one of two ways, either by interacting with the distraught [[Skyrim:Soul#xx002b0d|soul]] or by simply finding [[Skyrim:Arvak's_Skull|Arvak's skull]]. The soul who starts the quest can be found between where you enter and the large wall dividing the Soul Cairn. When first approaching him, you will hear him calling out to [[Skyrim:Arvak|Arvak]] in distress, yelling, ''"Arvak! Arvak, where are you? Arvak, please come back! Come back!"'' and calling his name repeatedly. If you speak to him, he'll plead with you to help find Arvak. You'll have to ask him what he's talking about, and he'll explain, ''"Arvak. My horse. We came to this horrible place together. We were attacked by monsters, so I told him to run."'' He tells you how loyal Arvak is, and that the poor creature has been running for too long. He begs you to find Arvak's skull, giving you a quest to locate it. Arvak will then begin appearing at random and briefly running in the direction of his skull before disappearing again. From the entrance to the Boneyard, where Valerica is, head directly east. You will be able to see the tower and the four ghosts surrounding it, kneeling as if in prayer. Upon approaching the skull, the souls will turn into [[SR:Mistman|mistmen]]. After dealing with them, you are free to take the skull, causing the soul of its owner to materialize nearby, a short distance away from the shrine. He will thank you considerably, saying, ''"He's such a loyal beast. Here, I'll teach you how to call him to you."'' You will now have access to the spell [[SR:Summon_Arvak|Summon Arvak]], which allows you to summon Arvak both within and outside of the Soul Cairn. Arvak's behavior is similar to a regular [[Skyrim:Horse|horse]], though he will dissipate after 60 seconds from when you summon him if you are not mounted. As you walk away from the soul, he will express deep gratitude and joy to see his horse become free of that eternal prison; telling you, ''"Goodbye, hero! Take good care of Arvak for me! Such a good horse."'' After you have spoken to [[Skyrim:Arvak|Arvak]]'s rider, or if you decide simply to go to the skull initially and you are having trouble navigating the Cairn due to the poor in-game map visibility in comparison with the map presented below, try the following procedure: Walk through the dividing wall between the two halves of the Cairn to the side containing the pentagonal building, and stand a point in front (the northernmost side) of the first ''fully intact'' gateway structure facing the southwestern barrier along the path. Check your map, and then use it to rotate your character roughly 15 degrees East of North (to the right). Your gaze should be fixed somewhere in between the southeastern most corner of the pentagonal building and the barrier of the Cairn opposing it. Walk straight in that direction, taking care (using the compass at the top of the screen) not to deviate from a straight path. The winding and discontinuous pathways beneath you are will only serve to get you lost, so ignore them. Travel in a straight line. If an obstacle comes in your way, or combat occurs and throws you off, re-orient yourself so that you are facing the same direction and are following the same line. You will find the skull just past the point where your position relative to the southeastern corner of the pentagon and the line you traversed is at a 90 degree angle. You will know that you have found this point when you are able to turn back along the same line you came on (an about face, or 180 degree rotation, looking back in the same direction you came from), then after turning 90 degrees to your right you will be directly facing the southeastern corner of the pentagonal building. A short walk past this point traveling in the same direction will put you at [[Skyrim:Arvak's Skull|Arvak's Skull]]. When you reach the skull, turn 15 degrees south of east and travel a hundred paces or so, then you will come across [[Skyrim:Arvak|Arvak]]'s rider to conclude the quest. ==Map== {{Map Markers Setup|width=750}} {{Map Markers|image=SR-map-Soul Cairn.jpg|label=Arvak's skull and rider location|markers= {{Image Mark|180|610|label=Portal|position=right|mark=Yellow_pog.png}} {{Image Mark|745|310|label=Arvak's skull|position=top|mark=Yellow_pog.png}} {{Image Mark|318|500|label=Arvak's Rider (initial)|position=right|mark=Yellow_pog.png}} {{Image Mark|770|322|label=Arvak's Rider (after)|position=bottom|mark=Yellow_pog.png}} }} {{NewLine}} ==Notes== *It is possible to complete the quest without killing the mistmen by sneaking and being undetected, taking Arvak's skull, and giving it to the soul. You can even be sneaking when speaking to the soul; the option will briefly appear as "pickpocket soul", but he will initiate dialogue with you regardless of you being completely hidden or not. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Arvak's skull is not given to the soul upon completion and is kept.|UDGP|1.1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|You may be unable to pick up Arvak's skull.|vn=1}} ** Loading a previous save and then coming back seems to fix this. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Find Arvak's skull in the Soul Cairn}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Retrieve Arvak's skull}} |150||{{Quest Objective|150|Return Arvak's skull}} |170|fin| |missing=0, 10, 15, 200, 250, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} [[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]

==Detailed Walkthrough==
'''Note: This quest, along with a [[Skyrim:Letter from Calcelmo|Letter from Calcelmo]] and the [[Skyrim:Dwemer Arrow Diagram|Dwemer Arrow Diagram]], were originally added to your inventory upon installing the [[Skyrim:Arcane Archer Pack]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. With the release of the [[Skyrim:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]], the letter and quest no longer appear. You can still acquire [[Skyrim:Soul Stealer Arrow|Soul Stealer Arrows]] and the Dwemer Arrow Diagram from [[Skyrim:Kagrumez|Kagrumez]] on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]].'''

Kagrumez is a high-level dungeon with a minimum enemy level of 25. As such, it is recommended that you prepare for a tough fight if you plan to complete this quest at a lower level. The majority of the dungeon is initially inaccessible, so you will first need to complete [[Skyrim:The Kagrumez Gauntlet|The Kagrumez Gauntlet]], a fetch quest which requires you to gather [[Skyrim:Kagrumez Resonance Gem|Kagrumez Resonance Gem]]s from all over Solstheim. You need to collect four gems in order to  unlock the final chamber in Kagrumez.

Once you have unlocked the final chamber, you can find several Soul Stealer Arrows next to the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Black Bow of Fate|Dwarven Black Bow of Fate]]. Pick up the arrows to complete the quest. You will now be able to craft Soul Stealer Arrows at any [[Skyrim:Forge|forge]].

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Meet with the mysterious author of the note.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Shortly after completing [[Skyrim:Restoring Order|Restoring Order]], you will be approached by a courier and given the note ''[[Skyrim:A Request to Meet|A Request to Meet]]''. Travel to the specified location - the coast under Solitude's Great Arch - and you'll find a Golden Saint named [[Skyrim:Staada|Staada]]. Speaking with her, you can give her the [[Skyrim:Sheogorath-Shaped Amber|Sheogorath-Shaped Amber]], the [[Skyrim:Sword of Jyggalag|Sword of Jyggalag]], or neither. 

If you choose to give her either the amber or the sword, she will give you her helmet as a reward, then disappear. Keeping both items will turn her hostile, but you can use the amber to learn a permanent summon spell for her (see [[#Notes|notes]] section). Keeping both items will also forfeit acquiring Staada's Helmet but you will still have both the Sword of Jyggalag and the Sheogorath-Shaped Amber.

==Notes==
*If you kept the Sheogorath-Shaped Amber it can be used at the [[Skyrim:Atronach Forge|Atronach Forge]]. Warning, the Sheogorath-Shaped Amber will be destroyed upon choosing one of these options. These combinations do not require the use of a [[Skyrim:Sigil Stone|Sigil Stone]]. The Staada summoned at the Forge using the Emerald will be hostile.
**Sheogorath-Shaped Amber + [[Skyrim:Emerald|Emerald]] will resummon [[Skyrim:Staada|Staada]] for another battle.
**Sheogorath-Shaped Amber + [[Skyrim:Ruined Book|Ruined Book]] + [[Skyrim:Bliss Bug Thorax|Bliss Bug Thorax]] + [[Skyrim:Sabre Cat Pelt|Sabre Cat Pelt]] will give you a spell tome to summon Staada.
**Sheogorath-Shaped Amber + Roll Of Paper + Charcoal will give you a scroll to summon Staada only once.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|It is possible to obtain infinite copies of Staada's Helmet. After choosing to give Staada the Sword of Jyggalag, you can exit the conversation and drop the sword before it is removed from your inventory. You will still receive the helmet and can pick up the sword again to repeat the glitch.|OSSEP|1.6.318|dlc=CC}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Go to the [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] [[Skyrim:Guard Barracks (Gate)|Guard Barracks]] and read the [[Skyrim:Guard's Dossier: Yakhtu gra-Orkulg|dossier]]. 
#Enter [[Skyrim:Embershard Mine|Embershard Mine]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Guard Barracks===
To start this quest go to the [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] [[Skyrim:Guard Barracks (Gate)|Guard Barracks]] and read the [[Skyrim:Guard's Dossier: Yakhtu gra-Orkulg|dossier]] which is found on a shelf in the back room.

===Embershard Mine===
Head to [[SR:Embershard Mine|Embershard Mine]] just southwest of Riverwood. Battle on through the numerous bandits (some noticeably wearing the armor) and make it to the final grand waterfall chamber. Here battle some more bandits including a Chief Bandit wearing the full set and the Orc woman [[SR:Yakhtu gra-Orkulg|Yakhtu gra-Orkulg]]. Loot her body to find [[SR:Yakhtu's Journal|Yakhtu's Journal]]. Read it to complete the quest. 

Finally loot the Bandit Chief to acquire an enchanted full set. Upon leaving the mine you'll have several sets of Orcish Plate Armor including the enchanted one.

==Notes==

#As detailed on the [[Skyrim:Embershard Mine|Embershard Mine]] page, the actual chief bandit in here is not actually designated a "Bandit Chief" by name, and appears to just a normal "Bandit", until you search his corpse and find out that he's carrying the good stuff.
#If the cave is already in a "Cleared" state when you enter it, and has not respawned normally, a few bandits including the chief will still be spawned. The chief will still drop his full enchanted set, but there is no guarantee of getting a full unenchanted set of Orcish Plate from the few bandits in the cave if it has not had time for a full respawn.
#As a result of the cave having a maximum level as well as a minimum, Yakhtu (min level 15, scales up with player) will be considerably tougher than the bandit chief she technically serves (max level 10).
#Yakhtu has a named key, which opens a locked chest of smithing supplies next to the table in the large room.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-quest-Spirits Away 02.jpg|The fishing spot|thumb|right]]
This quest can be started after [[Skyrim:Private Lessons|Private Lessons]] has been completed by talking to Viriya:
:'''Know of anyone in need of fishing work around Skyrim?'''
:''"Of course. It's all in this note."''

She will then hand you a [[Skyrim:Bounty: Lost Wares|note]], which explains that a Khajiit merchant named [[Skyrim:Ri'saad|Ri'saad]] lost some bottles of [[Skyrim:Aged Flin|Aged Flin]] in the river west of [[Skyrim:Old Hroldan Inn|Old Hroldan Inn]] and needs help retrieving them.

You will need to travel to Old Hroldan Inn and head west toward the river. When you arrive at the overturned cart, you will have to fish for three bottles of the Aged Flin.

Once you have all three bottles, travel to Ri'saad and then speak to him:
:'''Here's all of the bottles of aged flin you lost in the river.'''
:''"Excellent. And now, please accept this token of appreciation."'' 

He will then reward you with the [[Skyrim:Ring of Khajiit|Ring of Khajiit]].
