Skyrim:Taking Care of Business.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=SerCenKing, Likelolwhat |checkedBy= |reward=SerCenKing, Likelolwhat |rewardChecked= }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] membership,
Three leveled [[Skyrim:Potions|potions]] depending on quest choices |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:A Chance Arrangement|A Chance Arrangement]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] |Image=SR-quest-Taking Care of Business 02.jpg |ImgDesc=Use coercion to collect Haelga's debt |description=Collect some debts for the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]]. |ID=TG01 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] in the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]]. # Collect the debts: #* [[Skyrim:Keerava|Keerava]] #* [[Skyrim:Bersi Honey-Hand|Bersi Honey-Hand]] #* [[Skyrim:Haelga|Haelga]] # Return to Brynjolf. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===There's More Where That Came From=== [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] tells you to meet him in the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]] underneath [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] if you're interested in more lucrative operations like [[Skyrim:A Chance Arrangement|the one he arranged earlier]]. The only way to reach the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] headquarters at this point is through the [[Skyrim:The Ratway|Ratway]]. The entrance is through an inconspicuous gate on the lower level of Riften. You'll have to fight or avoid several enemies; more detail on what you'll encounter is below. {{Showhide/Start|Ratway walkthrough →}}Down some stairs and at the end of the corridor are [[Skyrim:Drahff|Drahff]] and [[Skyrim:Hewnon Black-Skeever|Hewnon Black-Skeever]], two lowlifes who will be discussing some kind of plot to undermine the Guild. They will both attack on sight. If you wish to sneak past them, keep in mind that when their conversation ends, Hewnon will crouch by the fire with his back to you, and Drahff will begin patrolling the corridor between Hewnon and the entrance. Take a right into a room with a bedroll, and then another right to a two-level room with a raised drawbridge directly across from you. The "correct" way to go about this would be to jump down to the lower level, but if you know Whirlwind Sprint, you can use it to skip the dungeon. Use the shout to get across the gap to the right of the drawbridge, where there is a small space of ledge under the railing that you can land on. You can then just jump onto and over the railing where you'll be in the last room of the dungeon. If you went to the lower level, there's also a gate to the left which can be a shortcut to the final room if you are proficient in [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|picking]] expert-level locks; if not, you'll have to take the long way around. The "scenic" route is full of traps, but there's a unique item as well. Southwest of the expert-locked gate is a short corridor ending in a brazier and a door. Opening it without disabling the [[Skyrim:Tension Cable|tension cable]] on the bottom right side will make two [[Skyrim:Spear Trap|spears]] shoot out from the wall to the left. Beyond is a room with an oil slick on the floor and a lantern above. The south door leads onward to a room with five bear traps scattered near the entrance. [[Skyrim:Gian the Fist|Gian the Fist]], who has the [[Skyrim:Gloves of the Pugilist|Gloves of the Pugilist]], is across the room and will attack on sight. Beware, as his detection level is very high; he will probably sense you and attack even if you have a high [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] skill. The gloves may be useful later during this quest if you choose to brawl anyone. There's also an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] in the alcove to the left. In the next room, go up the stairs, watching out for the pressure plate and corresponding battering ram that will hit you in the back if you're not careful. After this, a gate opens up to circular room overgrown with plants. In the center is a wood chopping block with an [[Skyrim:Iron Battleaxe|iron battleaxe]] stuck in it. Turn north again and you'll be in the last room which contains a hostile [[Skyrim:Lowlife|lowlife]] and a [[Skyrim:Skeever|skeever]]. Be sure to drop the drawbridge via the lever for future ease of access, and pick up the [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pickpocket]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Beggar (book)|Beggar]]'' from the table. The door to the Ragged Flagon is to the east. {{Showhide/End}} The Thieves Guild headquarters is rather run-down, and as you circle around the shallow pool to the bar proper, you'll overhear a conversation about the sorry state of affairs: [[File:SR-quest-Taking Care of Business 03.jpg|thumb|right|''"I wasn't certain I'd ever see you again!"'']] '''[[Skyrim:Vekel the Man|Vekel the Man]]''': ''Give it up, Brynjolf... those days are over.''
'''Brynjolf''': ''I'm telling you, this one is different...''
'''[[Skyrim:Dirge|Dirge]]''': ''We've all heard that one before, Bryn! Quit kidding yourself.''
'''Vekel''': ''It's time to face the truth, old friend. You, Vex, Mercer... you're all part of a dying breed. Things are changing!''
'''Brynjolf''': ''Dying breed, eh? Well what do you call that then!''
At this point Brynjolf will turn around and, if you are close enough, approach to say, ''"Well, well... Color me impressed lad/lass. I wasn't certain I'd ever see you again!"'' And you'll have three options. If you say that you got through the Ratway easily, he will be doubly impressed, saying, ''"Reliable and headstrong? You're turning out to be quite the prize!"'' If you claim you nearly died or point out the less-than-lovely state of the Guild, he will be annoyed, saying, ''"No risk, no reward. That's the way it goes, so you better get used to it."'' or ''"If you were expecting a palace, then maybe you're not cut out for this line of work. Our methods involve secrecy and discretion."'', respectively. In any case, he will then go on to ask if you're up to ''"handling a few deadbeats"'' for him. ''"They owe our organization some serious coin and they've decided not to pay. I want you to explain to them the error of their ways,"'' Brynjolf will explain, then tell you who they are at your inquiry: ''"Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand and Haelga. Do this right, and I can promise you a permanent place in our organization."'' After Brynjolf tells you to get going, the quest will update with the three debts to recover. You can head topside immediately (you'll have to go back through the Ratway), but it also pays to stay a bit longer and ask Brynjolf about the marks. His dialogue will reveal weaknesses to exploit for each: [[Skyrim:Keerava|Keerava]] has a soft spot for family, [[Skyrim:Bersi Honey-Hand|Bersi]] has a priceless - and fragile - urn, and [[Skyrim:Haelga|Haelga]] has her devotion to [[Lore:Dibella|Dibella]], goddess of beauty. The debts may be collected in any order you choose, but keep in mind that after you have two debtors in line, the last - whomever that may be - will cave immediately, having heard how you dealt with the others. ===Keerava's Debt=== Keerava runs [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften's]] only inn, [[Skyrim:The Bee and Barb|the Bee and Barb]], next to the market. Once inside, you'll find her behind the bar, tending to her patrons. Tell her you have a message from Brynjolf and she will say ''"I'll already told that buffoon I'm not paying you people a single coin!"'' When you say it wasn't a request, she'll be stubborn. ''"Look around you, I'm barely keeping this rathole together. The war's seen to that."'' You'll have two options now. You can either brawl with her to collect the debt, or you can try the route that Brynjolf suggested if you talked to him. Find [[Skyrim:Talen-Jei|Talen-Jei]], another [[Lore:Argonian|Argonian]] in the tavern, who is Keerava's lover. He will be suspicious of you, but if you tell him to talk some sense into her, he will say, ''"With the rumors going around about how poorly your Guild's been doing, she's become much too bold. I'm not that foolish. The last thing I want is a war with your people."'' If you ask for his cooperation, you will have it. ''"Look, I'm only telling you this because I care for her. Don't mistake this as acceptance for what you do. Keerava has some family at a farm just inside of Morrowind. If you mention you know about it, she might just listen to you. Just please, don't harm anyone. I couldn't bear the thought."'' Return to Keerava and she will give up the money, petrified with fear. If you return to Brynjolf after receiving Keerava's payment, but before finishing all three debtors, you can offer him Keerava's payment on its own, to which he will respond ''"She was the toughest of the bunch. Honestly, I'm amazed she didn't kick you out of the Bee and Barb herself."'' If Keerava is the last debtor you collect from, she will instead say, ''"Look, everything was all just a misunderstanding. I didn't mean to tell Brynjolf to go jump off the pier. You'll tell him I said sorry, yes? Take this. Every single coin I owe is there, I swear it."'' ===Bersi's Debt=== [[File:SR-quest-Taking Care of Business.jpg|thumb|right|Bersi's priceless urn]] Bersi Honey-Hand is the owner of the [[Skyrim:Pawned Prawn|Pawned Prawn]] general store, to the west of the Bee and Barb. He's usually behind the counter, with his precious Dwemer Urn sitting on a cabinet right across from him. Tell him that you have a message, and he will be disgusted. ''"Wha... what? Oh, it's one of you people. So, Brynjolf doesn't even bother to show up himself anymore, eh? What's this message?"'' The two options presented lead to different dialogue: ''"Petty threats and fist waving are not going to sway me. You people are all talk, and everyone knows it! Pay you to protect me? You can't even protect yourselves!"'' if you threaten him and ''"You're gouging me for what little coin I make and you can't even protect yourselves? Ridiculous!"'' if you say he knows what it is. The end result is the same; either walk away, or brawl. If you're not up to fisticuffs with him, though, you can always duke it out with the urn. It's across from Bersi, ready for the smashing. Take out your weapon or spell (it will take a few hits to break it, so you may not want to use a bow) and get to it. Bersi and his wife [[Skyrim:Drifa|Drifa]] will yell out as you do, but once the urn is shattered beyond repair Bersi will say ''"No! That urn was priceless!"'' Ask him if he wants you to break anything else, and he will pay you: ''"All right! I get it. I'll pay on time from now on. Just don't smash anything else. Here, take your gold and leave me in peace."'' If you return to Brynjolf after receiving Bersi's payment, but before finishing all three debtors, you can offer him Bersi's payment on its own, to which he will respond ''"I wasn't sure that he'd see the light, but I'm sure you "explained" it to him. Well done!"'' If Bersi is the last one you visit, he will say ''"Oh! There's no need for that. I know why you're here. Tell Brynjolf not to worry about it anymore. Oh! And look, I even have the payment I owed. Here, take it."'' ===Haelga's Debt=== Haelga runs the eponymous [[Skyrim:Haelga's Bunkhouse|Bunkhouse]], north of the Bee and Barb. She is dismissive of you from the get-go, saying ''"If you're looking for a room, try the Bee and Barb. This place is for the working man."'' Tell her you have a message from Brynjolf and she will say ''"What does he want now? I already explained to him that you can't get blood from a stone."'' Now you can either brawl, or come at the problem from another angle. Around the corner to the east is a set of drawers, upon which sits a golden statue of Dibella, Divine of beauty, to whom Haelga is devoted. Swipe it and go back to Haelga. Threaten to drop the statue down a well and she will crack: ''"Not Lady Dibella? No, please! I can't lose her! I get the message. Here, take your gold. I hope you choke on it!"'' If you return to Brynjolf after receiving Haelga's payment, but before finishing all three debtors, you can offer him Haelga's payment on its own, to which he will respond ''"She's as stubborn as she is beautiful, isn't she? Glad you found a way to get her to pay."'' If Haelga is last, she will be afraid: ''"I know who you are. You've been terrorizing the entire city. Please, there's no need for that here. Message understood. Here, I even have the payment!"'' ===Bring Home the Bacon=== When you return to him (once again through the Ratway), Brynjolf will have different sets of dialogue depending on whether any of the three died, and whether you still have the gold you were sent to collect. *If you don't have enough gold, and at least one is dead, whether killed by you or not: ''"You have wax in your ears? I said no one dies. We're not assassins. Well guess what... now you've inherited their debt. Don't come back to me until you have every last coin."'' *If you don't have enough gold, but everyone is alive: ''"So I've heard. Thanks to you, this should be the last time they forget to pay. One small detail though - I need all of the gold they gave you. No one skims around here. Come back when you've got every last coin."'' You will have to acquire the remainder yourself. Once you do have enough gold, you can proceed. *If one or more are dead: ''"Are you daft? I told you not kill any of them. How much clearer do you need me to be? How about the gold? Did you remember to bring it or is that too difficult an instruction as well."'' Confirm it's all there and he will continue, still angry, ''"I suppose it's not a total loss then. Let me give you a piece of advice. If you want to make some serious coin in this business you need to listen to rules. Now, on to other things."'' *If all are alive: ''"So, job's done and you even brought the gold. Best of all you did it clean. I like that. Dumping bodies and keeping the guards quiet can be expensive."'' Hand over the gold and he will say, ''"Well done. And it would seem I owe you something in return. Here you go, I think you'll find these quite useful."'' He will hand you a nice bonus of three [[Skyrim:Potions|potions]]: one [[Skyrim:Poison|poison]], one potion of fortify health, and one fortifying a random [[Skyrim:Stealth|stealth skill]]. Ask him what's next and he will continue: ''"Despite your mistakes, I see more potential in you than half the snot-nosed footpads that stumble their way into the Flagon. I'm going to put my neck on the line. We need people like you in our outfit."'' or ''"Judging from how well you handled those shopkeepers, I'd say you've done more than simply prove yourself. We need people like you in our outfit."'' Regardless, when you show interest at more gold, he will say, ''"That's the spirit! Larceny's in your blood... the telltale sign of a practiced thief. I think you'll do more than just fit in around here."'' You can ask him about the rumors - that the Guild is in dire straits - and he will be dismissive: ''"We've run into a rough patch lately, but it's nothing to be concerned about. Tell you what. You keep making us coin and I'll worry about everything else. Fair enough?"'' Reply "fair enough" and he will get the show on the road. ''"Now if there are no more questions, how about following me and I'll show you what we're all about."'' This will end Taking Care of Business and start the next quest, [[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]]. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest: * {{achievement|Taking Care of Business (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== * As soon as this quest ends, the alternate entrance in Riften's graveyard will become available, providing a direct route to the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon - Cistern|Cistern]]. * When given the chance to brawl, if you choose the non-brawling dialogue option, the debtor will refuse to speak to you afterward. Your only options to complete the quest at that point will be to use Brynjolf's suggested method, or kill them. * If broken, Bersi's urn will remain broken for the rest of the game, while Haelga's Statue of Dibella will eventually return to its original position. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If Talen-Jei dies before the quest is started, it may not start at all.|OSP|1.1|Talen-Jei is made essential.}} {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Rescue Mission|Rescue Mission]] may prevent this quest from starting properly.|OSP|1.5}} {{Bug|If Drifa has died prior to ending '''A Chance Arrangement''', this quest will not be able to start.|USKP|1.3.2}} **{{pc22}} You can use the console command setstage TG02 10 to start the quest manually. {{Bug|Bersi's prize urn can appear unbreakable.}} **Winning a brawl against him instead advances the quest, or you can also leave him as the last person, as he will comply without further intimidation. {{Bug|Sometimes this quest will complete and you will be unable to start the next one, even through console commands. This means that if you go into the Ragged Flagon Cistern, you will be trespassing and all of the thieves will turn hostile.|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} This can be fixed by using the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] command setstage TG02 10 and finishing it before entering the Cistern. **{{pc22}} If the step above doesn't work, it can be fixed by using the command setstage TG02 0 before entering the Cistern. {{Bug|If you make your follower steal Haelga's Statue of Dibella, the optional quest will not be completed.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Brynjolf has promised me more work if I'm able to locate him at a tavern called the Ragged Flagon. Judging from the dangerous nature of its location, it seems as though he's having me perform some type of initiation, but I can't be certain. {{Quest Objective|10|Locate Brynjolf at the Ragged Flagon}} |20||After successfully locating the Ragged Flagon, Brynjolf has given me a new assignment. Three business owners in Riften are proving to be a thorn in his side and I'm supposed to teach them the error of their ways. I should speak to Brynjolf about these townspeople in the event that they prove to be as stubborn as I'm expecting them to be. {{Quest Objective|20|Collect Keerava's debt}} {{Quest Objective|30|Collect Bersi Honey-Hand's debt}} {{Quest Objective|40|Collect Haelga's debt}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Return to Brynjolf}} |200|fin|I've dealt with the three troublesome business owners in Riften as Brynjolf had specified. Perhaps now that I've proven my worth to Brynjolf, I can discover more about this mysterious organization that he represents. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|21|(Optional) Use Talen-Jei to get to Keerava}} {{Quest Objective|31|(Optional) Smash Bersi's prized Dwarven Urn}} {{Quest Objective|41|(Optional) Steal Haelga's Statue of Dibella}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 12, 30, 35, 40, 42, 45, 47 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:A Chance Arrangement|A Chance Arrangement]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Thieves_Guild_(faction)#Quests|Thieves Guild]]}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked= }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] |Reward= Leveled Item, [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] is improved, [[Skyrim:Niranye|Niranye]] becomes available as a [[Skyrim:Fence (merchant)|fence]] in Windhelm |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=Five [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Special Job Quests|Thieves Guild Special Jobs]] in Windhelm |Loc= [[Skyrim:Uttering Hills Cave|Uttering Hills Cave]] |Image=SR-quest-Summerset Shadows.jpg |ImgDesc=The banner of the Summerset Shadows in Uttering Hills Cave |description=Remove a rival guild from the picture. |ID=TGTQ04 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves_Guild.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Find out the mission details from [[Skyrim:Torsten Cruel-Sea|Torsten Cruel-Sea]] in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Niranye|Niranye]]. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Uttering Hills Cave|Uttering Hills Cave]]. # Recover [[Skyrim:Fjotli's Silver Locket|Fjotli's Silver Locket]]. # Return to [[Skyrim:Torsten Cruel-Sea|Torsten Cruel-Sea]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Special Job=== Once you've completed five additional jobs in the city of [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], speak to Delvin at the Ragged Flagon to receive a 'special job'. Delvin explains that he has received word from a friend in Windhelm of a rival faction of thieves setting up shop. Travel to Windhelm and speak to Torsten Cruel-Sea. He can be found wandering both inside and outside the city walls. Talk to Torsten, and he'll tell you that the faction killed his daughter and stole her silver locket. He has already tracked down her killer and dealt swift justice, but not before learning about the formation of a new, rival Guild. Torsten wants the locket back and revenge on the people behind the murder. He'll give you a name, [[Skyrim:Niranye|Niranye]], that he prised from the murderer before killing him. She is somewhere in Windhelm. ===An Old Friend, Working for the Enemy=== During the day, Niranye is usually at her stall near [[Skyrim:The_White_Phial_(place)|The White Phial]]. In the evening, she can often be found in the [[Skyrim:New Gnisis Cornerclub|New Gnisis Cornerclub]]. Talk to her about Torsten's daughter and she'll express her sympathy over the tragedy of Fjotli's murder. To persuade Niranye to tell the truth, you must pass a [[Skyrim:Speech#Hard|hard speech check]]. {|class=wikitable |- !width=29%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=17%|Reaction |- | You might be a decent thief, but you're an awful actor. '''(Persuade)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Now, just a moment. Let's think about this... you know, discuss it like two rational people.
'''Failed''': I'm afraid I have absolutely no idea what you're speaking of.||'''Passed''': Locate the hideout
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Tell me everything or end up like Fjotli! '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Passed''': Now, just a moment. Let's think about this... you know, discuss it like two rational people.
'''Failed''': Now you're threatening me? What in the name of the Divines is wrong with you?||'''Passed''': Locate the hideout
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | I don't have time for this!||colspan=4|Think I'm defenseless? Well you're wrong!||Turn hostile |- | My mistake.||colspan=4|Next time you wish to accuse someone of a crime, I suggest you obtain proof!||Nothing |} If you cannot convince her to tell the truth, you have two options to proceed. The first option is confronting her with evidence to get her to talk. The proof is in Niranye's house, on the east side of Windhelm. There is a hidden panel to the rear of the eastern room, which leads to the basement. In the safe to the right of the shelves are the ''[[Skyrim:First Letter from Linwe|first]]'' and ''[[Skyrim:Second Letter from Linwe|second]]'' letters from [[Skyrim:Linwe|Linwe]], the Summerset Shadows leader. The second option is to tell her you've "had enough of this" (one of the dialogue choices). At this point, she becomes hostile, allowing you to kill her without accruing a bounty--nearby NPCs will even help you. You can then loot the letter from Linwe off her corpse. However, if kept alive, she becomes a fence after completing this quest, so the first option may be preferable. Either way reveals that the rival guild were not responsible for Fjotli's death, merely that they looted her body, and that their hideout is in [[Skyrim:Uttering Hills Cave|Uttering Hills Cave]]. ===Send a Message=== [[File:SR-quest-Summerset Shadows 02.jpg|thumb|right|The burning banner]] [[Skyrim:Uttering Hills Cave|Uttering Hills Cave]] is in the mountains to the west of Windhelm. Travel there, and either sneak past or kill the [[Skyrim:Summerset Shadow|Summerset Shadow]] lookouts outside. None of the generic Shadows can be looted for their armor. Inside, on the small table is a leveled poison; when the path splits there is a single Shadow patrolling each tunnel and both paths lead to the same cave. There are two Shadows warming themselves by a fire with a [[Skyrim:Cooking Pot|cooking pot]], there is a chest beside the fire, and a [[Skyrim:Corundum Ore|Corundum Ore]] vein to the west. The door leads to a circular tower room; at the bottom there is an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], and a random potion. Hanging above the lab is a dried [[Skyrim:Elves Ear|Elves Ear]] and a dried [[Skyrim:Frost Mirriam|Frost Mirriam]]. A bandit patrols between the room and the next stairs, and another one is sitting at the far end of the tunnel. There is an adept-level chest on the other side of the wall that the lab is on. The room to the right contains the Summerset Shadows banner, and when approached will give you the option of burning it, which can be done using a fire spell. Doing so will alert any remaining enemies, so leave it until after they are dead if you want to remain hidden. There is a door to either side of the banner. The room to the left contains two Shadows, one awake and one sleeping, a knapsack, and a leveled potion. The other room contains the Shadows' boss, Linwe, a bed to the left, the [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Mace Etiquette|Mace Etiquette]]'' on the shelves opposite the end of the bed, and a boss chest to the right. Linwe is instantly hostile to you and, when dead, you can loot his body for the locket, some leveled weapons, and his [[Skyrim:Linwe's Armor|armor]], [[Skyrim:Linwe's Boots|boots]], [[Skyrim:Linwe's Gloves|gloves]] and [[Skyrim:Linwe's Hood|hood]]. There is no quick way out so you must retrace your steps back outside and return to Torsten. Alternatively you can sneak all the way to Linwe and steal the Locket, staying true to the Thieves Guild code of not killing its targets, though you should be warned that Linwe has a ''very'' high detection level. After taking the locket, the quest updates as if Linwe had been killed. The game still reports the Summerset Shadows as being overthrown, even if you haven't killed anyone. Burning the banner is still possible if you have a high sneak perk. Distract Linwe and the other Summerset Shadows to stay at a distance while you burn it, and hide immediately after. ===Message Delivered=== Return to Torsten in Windhelm and return his heirloom. He'll reward you with a leveled item, and offer his support to the Guild. Report back to Delvin. He'll give you your pay, and will compliment you on your actions and point out that the added infamy you earned the guild has attracted a new merchant to [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]]. ==Notes== * In the future, you may be attacked by a Summerset Shadow, presumably in revenge. * After completing this quest, three [[Skyrim:Thief Cache|Thief Cache]] barrels will appear around Windhelm. * The banner can also be burnt by attacking it with a weapon (either ranged or melee) that has been enchanted with fire damage. Torches, on the other hand, can't be used to set the banner on fire. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The Summerset Shadows Banner may not render properly. You will see a quest arrow marking an empty spot between two pillars. Aim your fire at the location and you will still destroy the banner.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The banner looks normal when it is intact, but disappears once it is set on fire. This does not affect the quest in any way. The problem can be solved by first saving, then loading a save in a different area, and finally loading the Uttering Hills Cave save.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The optional objective to burn the banner sometimes doesn't pop up. This appears to occur if you kill Linwe before approaching the banner.|USKP|2.0.9}} **The banner may still be burned. {{Bug|Once Summerset Shadows has been completed, Uttering Hills Cave will no longer be populated by bandits but with respawning members of the Summerset Shadows. This can be a potential problem if the player has not completed quests that may require this location, such as [[Skyrim:Kill the Bandit Leader|killing Bandit leaders]].|USKP|1.3.3}} **{{pc22}} To fix this issue, use the console commands prid c5675, followed by disable. {{Bug|After accepting the quest it may not start and won't be present in the quest journal. Talking to Delvin again does not solve this, making the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild's]] upgrade quest line broken.}} **Talking directly to Torsten Cruel-Sea may continue the quest as usual. **{{pc22}} You can get the quest started by using the console command setstage tgtq04 0. {{Bug|Burning the banner may cause the game to freeze.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Torsten Cruel-Sea, a wealthy merchant residing in Windhelm, has requested assistance from the Thieves Guild. {{Quest Objective|10|Speak to Torsten Cruel-Sea}} |20||Torsten Cruel-Sea's daughter Fjotli was slain and robbed of a silver locket by a Thieves Guild hailing from Summerset Isle. Calling themselves "The Summerset Shadows," they are looking into expanding their influence in Skyrim. {{Quest Objective|20|Speak to Niranye}} |25||{{Quest Objective|30|(Optional) Discover leverage to sway Niranye}} |40||Torsten's daughter wasn't slain by the Summerset Shadows, but their leader, Linwe, has them robbing the dead of their valuables. Linwe and the rest of his guild have established a hideout in Uttering Hills Cave. {{Quest Objective|40|Travel to Uttering Hills Cave}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Recover {{sic|Fjolti's|Fjotli's}} Silver Locket}} |55||{{Quest Objective|60|(Optional) Destroy the Summerset Shadow's Banner}} |60||I've slain Linwe and obtained Fjotli's Silver Locket. This ends the presence of the Summerset Shadows in Skyrim. {{Quest Objective|70|Return to Torsten Cruel-Sea}} |200|fin|The locket has been returned to Torsten Cruel-Sea, and the Thieves Guild can now count on him as an influential ally in Windhelm. |missing=0, 30, 35, 65 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Amol.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Kimi the Elf |checkedBy= |reward=Kimi the Elf |rewardChecked=Kiz }} {{Quest Header |type=Imperial Legion |Giver=[[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] |Reward=Leveled Gold |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Rescue from Fort Kastav|Rescue from Fort Kastav]] OR [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Sungard (Imperial)|The Battle for Fort Sungard]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Reunification_of_Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]]—Umbrella quest |Next=[[Skyrim:Battle_for_Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Eastmarch Imperial Camp|Eastmarch Imperial Camp]], [[SR:Fort Amol|Fort Amol]] |Image=SR-quest-The Battle for Fort Amol.jpg |ImgDesc=Imperial Archers attacking a Stormcloak Soldier. |description=Prepare for the final assault on [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] by taking [[Skyrim:Fort Amol|Fort Amol]] for the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]]. |ID=CWFortSiegeFort |Icon=SR-qico-Imperial Legion.png |radiant=yes |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Report for duty to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at the [[Skyrim:Eastmarch Imperial Camp|Eastmarch Imperial Camp]]. #Join the Legion soldiers staging for the attack. #Clear the fort of Stormcloak rebels. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Report for Duty=== Report for duty to [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] at the [[Skyrim:Eastmarch Imperial Camp|Eastmarch Imperial Camp]], where she will give you orders to rendezvous with a group of Imperial soldiers preparing to attack [[Skyrim:Fort Amol|Fort Amol]] and to assist in the assault. ===Join the Soldiers Preparing the Assault=== Make your way to Fort Amol and meet with the group of soldiers. As you approach the group, they will begin the assault. ===Take the Fort=== Assist your fellow soldiers in clearing the fort of Stormcloak rebels while the game updates you with the percentage of enemies remaining. The battle takes place in the exterior parts of the fort only, in the courtyard and on the walls. The entrance is blocked by wooden barricades, but these can be easily brought down by melee attacks. Once you have killed all Stormcloak rebels the quest will be completed and the [[Skyrim:Reunification_of_Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]] questline will resume, prompting you to report to Legate Rikke. When you do so she will reward you with a leveled amount of gold and automatically start the next quest in the series, [[Skyrim:Battle for Windhelm|Battle for Windhelm]]. ==Notes== *After completion of this quest, like any Civil War quest under [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]], unmarked by in-game references, you can approach Legate Rikke for a [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Gold Rewards|medium leveled gold reward]]; this is not always recommended, as entering her cell sets up the next quest in the series and, if triggered improperly, causes the missing ''"Reporting for duty."'' dialogue option (see [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim#Bugs|this]] bug section). Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her. Don't approach Rikke between quests of different holds. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Occasionally you may be wrongly given a Stormcloak quest, [[Skyrim:The Battle for Fort Snowhawk (Stormcloaks)|The Battle for Fort Snowhawk]]. In this case, Imperial soldiers will not appear near the fort, making it impossible to join them. The fort is empty, making it impossible to take it. Although it may appear that necromancers took the fort before the battle, no necromancers appear either. Proceeding directly to Fort Amol and killing all of the Stormcloak soldiers there will not complete the quest either.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|When you go to Regain Eastmarch and you have to talk to Legate Rikke, sometimes you don't get the option to "Report for Duty". This disables you from continuing the quest until you can get that option. Sometimes when you go to Join the Men, you can't find them and they are not there. When you go to take Fort Amol, you can't find the Stormcloaks. This leads to the quest being unable to finish.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the command player.setstage CWFortSiegeFort 100 as it spawns the Stormcloaks and the Imperials, however make sure to do it at the Imperial rendezvous point, since the Stormcloaks will be hostile. ** Simply exiting conversation and talking to Legate Rikke again may offer the option. ** If Rikke offers dialogue other than "Report for duty", such as "Why did you join the Imperials" (or similar), select those conversations first. The "Report for duty" dialogue option may then appear. ** If a dragon attacks the Imperial Camp, this will cause all of the inhabitants (including Legate Rikke) to attack the dragon. After the dragon has been dispatched, the "Report for Duty" dialogue option will appear. ** Conjuring an atronach in the middle of camp, then killing it may also fix this. ** Not Fast Traveling to Fort Amol, but walking to the location from another combined with a reduced inventory and confirming the presence of walking Stormcloaks and interacting with them (not attacking or killing until the battle) after the Battle of Fort Sungard, again before talking to General Tullius, again before talking to Legate Rikke to start the 'Battle of Fort Amol' quest and then walking to Fort Amol has resolved the disappearing soldiers issue for some. **{{pc22}} Travel to Fort Amol and kill every necromancer. After that, sleep in one of the beds and Stormcloaks should occupy the Fort. Use movetoqt CWObj to directly teleport to Rikke. If the option doesn't show, talk to Tullius in Castle Dour by entering the following command in the console coc SolitudeCastleDour, and then go to Rikke with the previous command. ** See talk page for other possible fixes. == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |name=The Battle for Fort Amol |10||Legate Rikke has sent me to assist in taking Fort Amol from the enemy. {{Quest Objective|10|Join the men attacking Fort Amol}} |50||{{Quest Objective|100|Take over Fort Amol by defeating the enemy (% Remaining)}} |9000|fin|We have succeeded in taking Fort Amol from the enemy. |missing=0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 910, 920, 950, 1000, 2000, 9200, 9999 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

<noinclude>{{Trail|Quests}}</noinclude>
'''Thane''' is an honorary title presented by the [[Skyrim:Jarl|jarl]] of a [[Skyrim:Holds|hold]] to individuals of high esteem. The bestowed title is one of both recognition and prestige. Thanes may be chosen due to their importance to the city or for their heroic deeds. It is possible to become a thane of every hold regardless of which side in the [[Skyrim:Civil War|Civil War]] is chosen (although it is impossible to become Thane of [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]] if no side is chosen). Each jarl has their own requirements for the title and may bestow the honor on multiple people.

==Benefits of Being a Thane==
*Grants you a personal [[Skyrim:Housecarl|housecarl]] [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] (if available). 
*Grants you a symbolic weapon of the city.
*Guards will forgive any [[Skyrim:Crime#Bounties|bounty]] of less than 2000 gold (once per hold). However, a crime can be pardoned twice if a hold is captured during the civil war and the new jarl appoints the player thane.

==Becoming a Thane==
The general process for becoming a thane comes down to a relatively general formula with the exception of Whiterun, where it is initially achieved by completing the quest [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] and does not require the steps below to complete, unless you have joined the Stormcloaks and completed [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Battle for Whiterun]]. 
# You befriend the jarl through a quest or favors.
# The jarl asks you to demonstrate your value to the hold by [[Skyrim:Making Friends and Influencing People|assisting the people]] in the hold, five people in holds with major cities and three people in the other holds.
# The jarl asks you to purchase a [[Skyrim:Houses|house]] in the city if the hold is one of the five with major cities: Whiterun (Whiterun), The Rift (Riften), Eastmarch (Windhelm), Haafingar (Solitude), and The Reach (Markarth).
# The jarl grants the title of thane and all that comes with it.

If [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] is installed, then the three minor holds of Falkreath (Falkreath), Hjaalmarch (Morthal), and The Pale (Dawnstar) will also appoint a housecarl and grant the right to purchase a plot of land on which you may [[Skyrim:Construction|build your own residence]]. Your housecarl can be taken as your follower or will otherwise remain in the jarl's residence awaiting instructions. The same happens if you are granted the thaneship of Whiterun during the [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] quest. Thus, only Winterhold lacks the opportunity for the player to acquire a residence in the hold; likewise, there is no housecarl available for the player in Winterhold.

Progress made in assisting the people is dependent on disposition of citizens of the hold. Each citizen whose [[Skyrim:Disposition|disposition]] is raised to friend counts towards the objective. If you raise someone's disposition before the objective to assist the people is given, that will still be taken into account. Note that if you befriend the same citizen twice, it only counts once for the thane quest. Also, if a friend dies, you do not lose progress (usually in those cases, you will have received an [[Skyrim:Inheritance|Inheritance]].) In most cases, there is one quest for each citizen which will befriend him/her. Some citizens may have more than one quest which will befriend them. Many citizens have no specific quest available at all. A friend must be an ordinary citizen of the hold, not just living in it; members of [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders|Khajiit caravans]] and [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc strongholds]] do not count towards the total. Befriending the Jarl also doesn't count as that is a prerequisite to being given the objective.

[[Skyrim:Mjoll the Lioness|Mjoll the Lioness]] is declared by [[Skyrim:The Rift|the Rift]]'s jarl, [[Skyrim:Laila Law-Giver|Laila Law-Giver]], to be a champion of the people. Her virtue and heroic nature are extolled by Laila, but this only represents one facet of being a thane.

== Notes ==
* If the jarl that named you thane is replaced through the events of the Civil War or via [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], you will lose the title, though you can regain it by speaking to the new jarl. You do not need to complete favor tasks a second time, because the new jarl is always grateful to you for your help in installing him or her and will accept that as a favor task in itself. The only exception is the Rift, where both Maven and Laila require you to complete a [[Skyrim:Supply and Demand|non-repeatable task]] as a prerequisite for the title.
* If the jarl is replaced and you then regain your thaneship, the bounty forgiveness will reset and you will be able to use it a second time under the new jarl. As the holds of the Reach, Falkreath, Hjaalmarch, the Pale and Winterhold can change hands twice throughout the game, this theoretically allows you to clear your bounty three times in these holds. 
* It is strongly recommended that before completing the Dark Brotherhood contract to kill Helvard, you either become [[Skyrim:Thane of Falkreath|Thane of Falkreath]] first, or do Siddgeir/Dengeir's quests later to regain their grace.
*If Erikur or Bryling die, their housecarls ([[Skyrim:Melaran|Melaran]] and [[Skyrim:Irnskar Ironhand|Irnskar Ironhand]], respectively) will replace them as thanes.
*If you lose your thane status in your hold (due to the jarl that granted it being removed by the Civil War or Season Unending), then your housecarl will still call you thane but you will be unable to use your status to avoid being arrested by the guards until it is reinstated.

==Quick Walkthrough==
# You are it!
# Tag!
# Bob and weave.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
'''Tag, you're it!''' is a [[Skyrim:Activities#Interactions|game]] that can be played with the children in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]], [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]] and [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]].  With [[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]] installed, the game can be started with your [[Skyrim:Adoption|adopted children]] as well.

To play, initiate the game by offering or accepting the game from eligible children. The aim of the game is to avoid being tagged by whoever is "it". If you are it, you must try to tag someone else. The quest will update whenever "it" changes hands and quest arrows show who you can tag or who to avoid.

The game ends after 90 seconds of play and the quest is removed. This has no material benefit and is mostly just for fun.

==Notes==
*Entering a new area while playing the game will usually cause the game to end and you may have to speak to the children again to play.
*Games are only playable from 8am until 9pm.
**Adopted children can play tag at night if asked to.
*Starting a game of tag via your adopted child can cause all children in the area to play, even those who won't normally play.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|While [[Skyrim:Fjotra|Fjotra]] is following you during the quest [[Skyrim:The Heart of Dibella|The Heart of Dibella]] initiating a game of tag can cause her to play the game allowing you and other players to tag her. However, because she is following you, she won't run after or tag anyone when she becomes it.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|Children may sometimes tag dead bodies nearby. However, this won't affect the course of their game.}}
{{Bug|If you fast travel during this quest, the children may end up fast traveling with you.}}
{{Bug|Starting a game with more than 4 children present will get all children running, but only 4 of them can be tagged.}}

Speak to the leader of this force and he will agree to attack as soon as you are ready. If necessary, take a few moments to prepare and then lead the charge up the southeastern road. All Imperial forces must be eliminated. Your journal will keep track of the percentage of enemies left. While a straightforward battle beginning at the front entrance and working into the fort may be preferable for melee fighters, the fort also has several towers which are ideal for archers and ranged attacks. ===Conquering Hero=== Once the enemy is fully vanquished, head back to [[SR:Windhelm|Windhelm]] and [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]]. He bestows upon you the title of Bone-Breaker and gives you a leveled weapon in honor of this new rank. You are now also able to purchase a [[SR:Hjerim|home]] in Windhelm. Having learned that the Stormcloak-held Fort Dunstad is in need of reinforcements, she will command you to help to take the fort while it is vulnerable. She will instruct you to rendezvous with a task force of Imperial soldiers who are staging near the fort, southeast of your location. She will mark the meeting point on your map, and you will update your journal to note this objective. ===Join the Men Attacking the Fort=== {| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed" ! A Route to the Rendezvous Point |- | Walk westward out of the camp until you encounter a paved road running north-south. This can be difficult to see when visibility is poor. If you see it, turn left onto it; otherwise, head south from a short distance west of the camp, bearing to the east if necessary to navigate past obstacles. If you are following the paved road, you will pass two rocky areas to your left. There is an easily found iron ore vein in the second of these. You will soon reach another paved road. Turn left on this. After a moderate distance, the road will take you on a significant descent down the mountain. Keep your eye on the paving stones to avoid losing your way. Eventually, the pavement will end at a T-intersection with the major road running between Whiterun and Dawnstar. Turn right onto this, heading upwards again. Follow this road generally south, around a few bends alternatively to the south and east, until you come upon the task force. |} [[File:SR-quest-The Battle for Fort Dunstad (Imperial)02.jpg|thumb|left|A group of legionnaires preparing to converge on the fort]] As you approach the waiting soldiers, they will charge toward the fort. Your objective becomes to take it over from the rebels. As your team engages the Stormcloaks holding the fort, you will receive regular updates on the percentage of enemies remaining. ===Take Fort Dunstad=== The entire battle will take place in the exterior areas of the fort. If you have not yet developed an eye for distinguishing between Imperial friendlies and rebel enemies, the Stormcloaks are easily identified by their pointed helmets. The battle will comprise multiple pairs and small clusters of engagements, with both sides using melee weapons and archery attacks. These engagements occur at multiple points in the two courtyard-like areas, and along the elevated wooden platforms around the semi-perimeter. If you let them, your group will essentially take care of the battle for you. If you hang back and take the most passive approach to the fight, you may need only to restore your health once or twice when you are targeted. If you want to prioritize acquiring weapons and armor off of fallen soldiers, you should search them quickly because their bodies will disappear shortly after falling. Often, there are actually some Stormcloaks remaining (or respawning) after the battle has been formally won, which you can engage and loot. Also, if you so wish, you may kill the remaining Imperials as well in order to loot them without getting a bounty. When it's reported that all the rebels have been killed, you will have completed the objective of taking the fort and the quest itself. ===Report to General Tullius=== Your objective then becomes to report to General Tullius at Castle Dour to receive your reward, but doing so technically occurs under the overarching [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]] quest. After you have taken the fort, The Battle for Fort Dunstad will clear from your journal. If you didn't flee the battle, Tullius will promote you to [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion#Ranks|Praefect]] along with a leveled sword (see [[#Bugs|Bugs]]). ==Notes== *If [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] is given to the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] during [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] then this quest will not be given to you. *Completing this quest will exile [[Skyrim:Skald|Skald]] and his courtiers to the [[Skyrim:Palace of the Kings|Palace of the Kings]], and install [[Skyrim:Brina Merilis|Brina Merilis]] as [[Skyrim:Jarl|Jarl]] of The Pale. *After completion of this quest, like any Civil War quest under [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]], unmarked by in-game references, you can approach Legate Rikke for a [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Gold Rewards|medium leveled gold reward]]; this is not always recommended, as entering her cell sets up the next quest in the series and, if triggered improperly, causes the missing ''"Reporting for duty."'' dialogue option (see [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim#Bugs|this]] bug section). Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her. Don't approach Rikke between quests of different holds. ==Bugs== {{Bug|After the quest, [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Imperial)|Compelling Tribute]] becomes available and activates (even if it doesn't appear in your journal) upon your next load of the cell of [[Skyrim:Legate Rikke|Legate Rikke]] (usually relocated to [[Skyrim:Rift Imperial Camp|Rift Imperial Camp]]). If you do so prior to reporting to [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] (for example to get the leveled gold reward for this quest) the game activates [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Imperial)|Compelling Tribute]] incorrectly causing a [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Imperial)#Bugs|bug]] by generating and extra non-quest item copy of the [[Skyrim:Incriminating Letter (Anuriel)|incriminating letter]].}} **Avoid Rift Imperial Camp and Legate Rikke, go straight to report to General Tullius instead. Upon your next approach to Legate Rikke, [[Skyrim:Compelling Tribute (Imperial)|Complelling Tribute]] will have set up correctly. == Quick Walkthrough ==
# (Optional) Hear rumors about the [[Skyrim:Galathil|Face Sculptor]] from an innkeeper or guard.
# Find [[Skyrim:Galathil|Galathil]] in the [[Skyrim:The_Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]].
# Pay her to change your appearance.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
Any time after installing the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard add-on]], you may hear a rumor from an innkeeper or [[Skyrim:Guards|guard]] about someone new in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]: ''"People say there's someone in Riften that can... change your face. Make you look completely different. Do you believe that?"'' Your quest journal will update with the objective to locate the face sculptor. Your map will not be updated with a quest marker, but if you travel to Riften, a guard will make a negative comment about the face sculptor, conveniently providing her location: ''"Take my advice, don't listen to that talk of the "face sculptor" down in the [[Skyrim:The_Ragged_Flagon|Ragged Flagon]]. "Face butcher" is more like it from what I've heard."'' Make your way to the Ragged Flagon, located within Riften's sewer network and accessible through the [[Skyrim:The_Ratway|Ratway]]. Sitting alone on a bench is [[Skyrim:Galathil|Galathil]], the face sculptor you're seeking. 

Upon approaching her, she'll speak to you before you can say a word: ''"Hmm, I suppose I can work with your face. After all, the sculptor cannot always choose the finest clay."'' If you are a vampire, however, she will be able to tell and instead say, ''"What have you done to yourself? I can't work with you in this state, night-walker."'' You can ask her what she's talking about, or tell her you've already heard of her. Either way, she will subtly insult you, by implying that your appearance is not "artful" or referring to you as the "scum of Skyrim". She will then check to see if you are a client, asking ''"So are you here as a client? Shall I remake your face?"'' unless you are a vampire, in which case she'll tell you ''"But, my techniques only work on the living, not those that have crossed over into undeath."''

At this point, you can choose to have your appearance changed, back out, or question her qualifications. If you tell her you'll have to think about it, she'll respond, ''"Indeed. It is no small thing to submit yourself to the flesh sculptor's knife."'' and begin to read a book. You are still able to approach her again with the same options if you do this. If you question her, she'll answer defensively, telling you how experienced she is: ''"I have not always been a ragged beggar. I learned my art from the masters of the art of flesh sculpture. I studied with the Faculty of Chirurgeons in Cloudrest. I walked with the Hollow-Faced Men of Nohotogrha for three years. I count the nobility of both the Empire and the Dominion among my clients"'', and then angrily add ''"And yet, I have fallen so low that I must justify myself to a wanderer in the sewers of this backwater of the world."'' 

If you decide you would like her to change your appearance, it costs 1000 gold. If you can afford it, she'll say, ''"Hmm. Very well. Just tell me what you desire - beauty or hideous deformity, nothing is beyond my skill"'', but if you don't have enough gold, she'll be offended and dismiss you: ''"Despite my present low estate, I am no beggar. Begone until you have the coin to warrant my skills."'' 

When you pay her the gold, you will enter a screen nearly identical to the initial [[Skyrim:Character_Creation|character creation]] option from beginning your game. You can change almost all aspects of your appearance, the only exceptions being your character's race or sex. There is no limit to the amount of times you can repeat this quest. 

===Achievements===
One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest:
* {{achievement|A New You}}

== Notes ==
*Despite taking place in Riften, this quest does not count towards [[Skyrim:Thane of the Rift|Thane of the Rift]].
*Vampires cannot get their faces changed. You must [[Skyrim:Vampirism#Curing Vampirism|cure your vampirism]] in order to start this quest.
*Changing, or even overhauling, your appearance will not impair any NPC's ability to recognize you.  Therefore, it cannot be used to, for example, erase bounties or start relations over with an NPC you've fallen out of favor with by making them think you're a different person.

It is unclear whether the face sculptor can ever be used on a save that exhibits this bug, but it is possible for other saves to use the sculptor.|vn=1}}

== Quick Walkthrough ==
#Talk to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]].

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
After making your way to [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]], find and speak to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] and ask if you can help out. He will give you an extractor, and ask you to obtain an ash sample from an [[Skyrim:Ash Spawn|ash spawn]] as he is working on a spell to summon them. He will inform you that the ash sample can only be extracted from a dead ash spawn, but remains confident in your ability to "bring it about."

Find and kill any ash spawn. The wall outside [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] should have plenty of ash spawn if you haven't already completed [[Skyrim:March of the Dead|March of the Dead]]. Note that you can still extract the sample from the remains of an ash spawn killed prior to starting the quest, so if you have recently completed March of the Dead, you'll likely still be able to find their remains outside of the city walls.

Searching the corpse of an ash spawn should bring up the option to use the extractor. After using it, return to Neloth for you reward. The spell tome [[Skyrim:Conjure Ash Spawn|Conjure Ash Spawn]] should be available for sale from [[Skyrim:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]] a day or so after completion of the quest.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
[[File:SR-quest-Summoning Karstaag 02.jpg|thumb|left|Karstaag's skull in Glacial Cave]]
[[File:SR-quest-Summoning Karstaag 03.jpg|thumb|right|Karstaag's skull placed on his throne]]
The [[Skyrim:Glacial Cave|Glacial Cave]] is very simple, containing only three [[Skyrim:Riekling|Rieklings]]. [[Skyrim:Karstaag's Skull|Karstaag's skull]] is in the wall at the very back of the cave with torches around it.

After traveling to the [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag Ruins|ruins of Castle Karstaag]], there are two ways to reach the courtyard: You can either pick the master-level lock on the front gate, or take the long route through the [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag Caverns|Castle Karstaag Caverns]], a large Riekling cave. The cave crisscrosses the main cavern multiple times and there are Rieklings on every level.

Once you get to the courtyard, you will see a large throne. Place the skull here. Be prepared for a very difficult fight. Once you place the skull, back up. [[Skyrim:Karstaag|Karstaag]] will appear as a ghostly frost giant with horns and a permanent ice cloak. When he appears he will cause a massive explosion of ice that looks like a blizzard which will hang around a while and take up a large area. Karstaag fights like a regular [[Skyrim:Giant|giant]] but hits a lot harder. He can summon three [[Skyrim:Ice_Wraith|ice wraiths]] at any time in the fight and he can do it multiple times. He is a very powerful foe and can kill poorly-equipped characters rapidly.

When you defeat Karstaag, you will gain the power to [[Skyrim:Summon Karstaag|Summon Karstaag]], but only three times and only outside. You can also loot Karstaag for ten samples of [[Skyrim:Ectoplasm|ectoplasm]] and a few [[Skyrim:Soul_Gems|soul gems]].
{{NewLine}}

== Notes ==
*It is possible to summon Karstaag, leave using the front door, and then climb over the ice wall (just to the right of the door, while looking at the door) to strike at him from above. He and his summons will not be able to strike the player while standing on the ice above. Karstaag will move towards the door in pursuit of the player but he never actually exits, making him an easy long distance target. Player summons and companions will still attempt to fight Karstaag on ground level.
*It's possible for Karstaag to knock you back into the [[Skyrim:Castle Karstaag Caverns|Castle Karstaag Caverns]], resetting the fight, and thus his health.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
'''Note: This quest was originally added to your journal upon installing the [[Skyrim:Arcane Archer Pack|Arcane Archer Pack]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. With the release of the [[SR:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]], this quest no longer appears in your journal. The [[SR:Spell Tome: Telekinesis Arrows|Spell Tome]] and [[SR:Telekinesis Arrows Research Notes|Note]] added by the Creation can still be acquired from [[SR:The Arcanaeum|the Arcanaeum]] in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]], and [[Skyrim:Telekinesis Arrow|Telekinesis Arrows]] can still be crafted.'''

Once you've installed the Arcane Archer Pack Creation, you will receive this quest directing you to the College of Winterhold to learn more about a spell tome which has been uncovered. The tome in question, [[SR:Spell Tome: Telekinesis Arrows|''Spell Tome: Telekinesis Arrows'']], is held in the Arcanaeum, requiring you to first gain access to the college in order to proceed. See the [[SR:First Lessons|First Lessons]] quest walkthrough for more information on how to join the college.

Locate the spell tome on the counter in front of [[SR:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]]. Simply picking it up will advance the quest. However, you must read the tome in order to learn the related [[SR:Telekinesis Arrows|Telekinesis Arrows]] lesser power, which must be used to control the arrows. Reading the nearby [[SR:Telekinesis Arrows Research Notes|''Telekinesis Arrows Research Notes'']] will teach you how to craft [[Skyrim:Telekinesis Arrow|Telekinesis Arrow]]s, provides an introductory description of how the arrows function and completes the quest.

Winterhold]]. The ruins are usually swarming with undead [[SR:Skeleton|skeleton]]s, although these shouldn't pose much of a threat. You must locate the corpse of [[SR:Hyenril|Hyenril]], a dead mage found within one of the ruins. On the table in front of her, you will find ''[[SR:Hyenril's Journal|Hyenril's Journal]]'' along with two broken staves: the [[SR:Arm of the Moon|Arm of the Moon]] and the [[SR:Arm of the Sun|Arm of the Sun]]. Hidden beneath the table is the [[SR:Warlock's Mark|Warlock's Mark]], a mundane necklace. Reading the journal will identify these items as the property of Hyenril's former master, Ellane, who spent long years attempting to restore the two staves, which were originally created in imitation of the legendary [[Lore:Staff of Chaos|Staff of Chaos]] but were destroyed by their original creator. It will also reveal that Sigil Stones will be needed to restore the three items and unlock their true power. Take all three items to progress the quest; the Warlock's Mark is small and really can be difficult to see, so you may need to rely on your HUD pointer. ===Sunken Treasure=== [[File:SR-quest-The Arms of Chaos 02.jpg|thumb|left|Locate the master's watery grave]] In order to obtain the required Sigil Stones, you will need to track down Ellane's ring of summoning. Unfortunately, Ellane was still wearing this ring when Hyenril shipped her body back home for burial aboard a vessel called the ''Sea Stallion''. Your first stop is the [[Skyrim:East Empire Company (place)|East Empire Company offices]] in [[SR:Windhelm|Windhelm]], where you will find a letter entitled ''[[SR:Loss of the Sea Stallion|Loss of the Sea Stallion]]'' on a table next to a potion of waterbreathing. The ship apparently sank to the bottom of [[SR:Pilgrim's Trench|Pilgrim's Trench]] off the coast of Skyrim before it delivered its cargo. Head to Pilgrim's Trench and prepare for a deep dive to find Ellane's coffin, which can be found atop a rocky outcropping on the sea floor. Inside you will find a copy of ''[[SR:Final Lesson|Final Lesson]]'', ''[[SR:Master Ellane's Last Words|Master Ellane's Last Words]]'', and the [[SR:Sovereign Band|Sovereign Band]], an enchanted ring which fortifies your [[SR:Magicka|magicka]]. {{NewLeft}} ===The Guardians of the Sigil Stones=== [[File:SR-quest-The Arms of Chaos 03.jpg|thumb|right|The Daedric altar]] With the ring in hand, you will be directed to a stone Daedric summoning circle on the same island as Skytemple Ruins. You must descend from the peak where the ruins are located and go to the eastern shore of the island to find it. Approach the center of the altar and you will be given the option to summon Daedra. Once you activate it, three [[SR:Dremora|Dremora]] will appear in quick succession, with a new one being summoned each time you defeat the last: *[[SR:Dremora Sehtkynaz|Dremora Sehtkynaz]], an ice mage who can summon a [[SR:Frost Atronach|Frost Atronach]], guardian of the [[SR:Blue Sigil Stone|Blue Sigil Stone]]; *[[SR:Dremora Lyrkynaz|Dremora Lyrkynaz]], a shock mage who can summon a [[SR:Storm Atronach|Storm Atronach]], guardian of the [[SR:Green Sigil Stone|Green Sigil Stone]]; and *[[SR:Dremora Sovereign|Dremora Sovereign]], a fire-wielding warrior who can summon a [[SR:Flame Atronach|Flame Atronach]], guardian of the [[SR:Orange Sigil Stone|Orange Sigil Stone]]. Survive the encounter, then loot the bodies of the Dremora to obtain the three Sigil Stones needed to restore your items' enchantments. They also each have [[SR:Daedra Heart|Daedra Hearts]] on them. The Warlock's Mark can be reforged at any [[SR:Forge|forge or anvil]]. The Arm of the Moon and Arm of the Sun require access to a [[Skyrim:Staff Enchanter|Staff Enchanter]]; in the base game, the only one in existence is located behind a locked door in [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (tower)|Tel Mithryn]] and can only be accessed after you complete the quest [[Skyrim:Reluctant Steward|Reluctant Steward]]. You can avoid this prerequisite if you have access to a Staff Enchanter elsewhere, such as the one added by the [[SR:Myrwatch|Myrwatch]] or [[SR:Bloodchill Manor|Bloodchill Manor]] Creations. Once you have crafted the enchanted versions of all three items, the quest will complete and you will have in your possession several powerful artifacts. ==Notes== *It is possible to skip the visit to Windhelm entirely if you have already looted the coffin in Pilgrim's Trench. You will immediately be directed to summon the Dremora. *The Dremora Sovereign wields a [[SR:Daedric Sword of the Inferno|Daedric Sword of the Inferno]] at all levels, a powerful piece of equipment if you can best all three Dremora at a low level. ==Bugs== {{bug|Crafting the staffs using the Myrwatch Staff Enchanter is most beneficial, as it is bugged and grants 20 times more [[SR:Enchanting|Enchanting]] experience than it is supposed to. This is due to the Staff Enchanter in Tel Mithryn having a hidden perk (DLC2StaffEnchantingMult) that reduces the experience gained by 95%; the Staff Enchanter in Myrwatch has a different Editor ID and thus is unaffected by the perk. As a result, crafting the Arms of Chaos at Myrwatch will result in you possibly jumping more than 20 Enchanting levels.|confirmed=1}} **This bug was fixed by an [[Skyrim:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]] update to this Creation. {{Bug|When you are crafting the Arm of the Moon the message that appears says the Arm of the Sun has been completed, and vice versa.}} {{bug|The Warlock's Mark can also be glitched in the middle of the table and there seems to be no way of dislodging it.|confirmed=1}} **You can reach The Warlock's Mark by standing on the back of the table in the alcove and looking at the place it's marker is. You will have the necklace and the quest will update. **Cast the spell 'Raise Zombie' on Hyenril's corpse and lead them out of the ruins until they turn to ash.
