=1 ([[Skyrim:Camilla Valerius|Camilla Valerius]]) |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # ''(Optional)'' Find [[Skyrim:Lucan Valerius|Lucan Valerius]] at the [[Skyrim:Riverwood Trader|Riverwood Trader]] and talk to him. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Golden Claw|golden claw]] from [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (place)|Bleak Falls Barrow]]. # Find the secret of Bleak Falls Barrow. # Return the claw to Lucan. '''Note''': The events of this quest are closely related to those in the quest [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|Bleak Falls Barrow]], at times taking over important objectives. It can be triggered right after entering Riverwood, but it is recommended to follow the intended path and initiate the Bleak Falls Barrow quest in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. Otherwise, you may miss a few story-related events and details. See [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)#Notes|this section]] for details. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Stolen Ornament=== In Riverwood, you may hear concerned townsfolk talk about a recent robbery at Riverwood Trader. When you pay a visit to the store you will find proprietor Lucan Valerius and his sister [[Skyrim:Camilla Valerius|Camilla]] in the middle of a hefty argument, both of them frustrated with recent events. '''Camilla''': ''"Well one of us has to do something!"''
'''Lucan''': ''"I said no! No adventures, no theatrics, no thief-chasing!"''
'''Camilla''': ''"Well what are you going to do then, huh? Let's hear it!"''
'''Lucan''': ''"We are done talking about this. [notices you] Oh, a customer. Sorry you had to hear that."'' Talking to Camilla will not help much, while Lucan will be more informative, although puzzled: ''"Yes, we did have a bit of a... break-in. But we still have plenty to sell. Robbers were only after one thing. An ornament, solid gold. In the shape of a dragon's claw."'' If you offer to help him get the claw back, he will offer a gold reward and will then continue debating with Camilla. She will argue that you may need a pointer in the right direction and will then get up and leave. '''Lucan''': ''"Now, if you're going to get those thieves, you should head to Bleak Falls Barrow, northeast of town."''
'''Camilla''': ''"So this is your plan, Lucan?"''
'''Lucan''': ''"Yes. So now you don't have to go, do you?"''
'''Camilla''': ''"Oh really? Well I think your new helper here needs a guide."''
'''Lucan''': ''"Wh- no... I.... Oh, by the Eight, fine. But only to the edge of town!"'' Follow her outside and she will point out [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (place)|Bleak Falls Barrow]], barely visible in the distance behind [[Skyrim:Alvor and Sigrid's House|Alvor and Sigrid's House]], and lead you to the bridge northeast of town. She will provide some sparse directions, but follow her advice and pick the northwestern trail up the mountain. You can also ask Camilla for directions once you reach the bridge and she'll tell you to reach an old watchtower in the mountain and head north from there. At this point, make sure you have the [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)|concurrent quest]] in your journal. If not, you can go to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and activate it. If you don't want to go through the introduction at Riverwood Trader, go straight to Bleak Falls Barrow and you will receive the quest when you overhear two bandits in the first room. ===Retrieving the Claw=== [[File:SR-npc-Arvel the Swift 02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Cut me down before that thing gets us!"'']] When you arrive at [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Temple|Bleak Falls Temple]], you may overhear two bandits talking about a [[Skyrim:Arvel the Swift|Dark Elf]] that's gone on ahead. If you did not speak to Valerius in Riverwood, this moment serves as the start of the quest. '''Bandit 1''': ''"So, we're just supposed to stay here while Arvel runs off with that golden claw?"''
'''Bandit 2''': ''"That dark elf wants to go on ahead, let him. Better than us risking our necks."''
'''Bandit 1''': ''"What if Arvel doesn't come back? I want my share from that claw!"''
'''Bandit 2''': ''"Just shut it and keep an eye out for trouble."'' After killing these two bandits and progressing further into the barrow, you will see another bandit approaching a gate. Upon activating the lever for the gate, the bandit is killed by [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|poisonous darts]] and the gate remains closed, blocking your progress. Notice the broken piece of rock next to the lever. It has the image of a snake. Notice the [[Skyrim:Spinning Symbol|spinning symbols]] behind you to the left. These rocks must be rotated to the correct position to activate the lever. Look up to see the carvings on the wall that denote the correct sequence: ''Snake, Snake, Whale''. (The middle rock has fallen off the wall and onto the ground, hence the snake being the right solution.) Continue through the gate and descend the wooden spiral staircase to your left. Three skeevers will emerge and attack, but they shouldn't pose a problem. As you progress further, you will hear [[Skyrim:Arvel the Swift|Arvel the Swift]] calling out for help. Some webs block your path; cut through them to proceed. When you find the thief, Arvel the Swift, he will be trapped in a spider web by a [[Skyrim:Wounded Frostbite Spider|Wounded Frostbite Spider]]. Kill the spider and talk to Arvel. Arvel claims that he will give you the claw if you free him from the web. Once you free him, Arvel will flee, forcing you to pursue him deeper into the dungeon. Alternatively, if the spider is too strong for you, you can just free him from the web and pursue the fleeing Arvel. You can also retreat out of the room to recover, as the spider is too big to leave. If you overtake Arvel quickly, you can kill him yourself; otherwise, he will soon run into a group of draugr, who will likely eliminate him easily. If you protect him from the draugr, he may be killed by the [[Skyrim:Spike Wall|spike trap]] up ahead. The spike trap will reset after use, and can be activated again to help deal with the draugr. You can loot the claw and a [[Skyrim:Arvel's Journal|journal]] from Arvel's body. The journal hints that the claw is actually a key of some sort. ===Find the Secret of Bleak Falls Barrow=== [[File:SR-quest-The Golden Claw.jpg|thumb|right|The palm of your hand]] Although you have found the golden claw, you cannot return it to Lucan until you find the secret of Bleak Falls Barrow, so continue through the chambers. After a while you will find yourself in what appears to be a burial tomb and you will have to fight your way through a group of draugr. If you have not killed Arvel by the time he reaches this room, the draugr will likely kill him. Continue on until you find a [[Skyrim:Puzzle Door|puzzle door]] with three animal seals on it. The claw is the key, however it will not open the door like a regular key would. Instead, [[Skyrim:Controls#Change View|examine]] the claw in your inventory and you will see several symbols engraved in it, palm side up. Set each ring to the correct seal and open the door. From the outermost to the innermost ring, the solution is '''Bear—Moth—Owl'''. When you enter the door, follow the tunnel until you find yourself in a large, open room with waterfalls. You will see a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|Word Wall]]. When you approach it, one word will stand out, and your character will learn a Word of Power, ''[[Skyrim:Fus|Fus]]''. A level-dependent creature (at low levels a [[Skyrim:Draugr Overlord|Draugr Overlord]] and at higher levels a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|Dragon Priest]]) will then rise out of a coffin and you will have to kill it. Leave the dungeon and return to the village. To leave the dungeon, climb to the top of the stairs and activate the lever on the pedestal. There are three chests in this room where you obtain the Word of Power; one centered by the sleeping draugr is quite well seen and unlocked. The second is behind the waterfall on the left. The third has a novice lock and is located to your right behind the waterfall. To find it, go across the bridge but not up the steps leading to the wall, go right along the river path to the bigger waterfall, you will have to jump around on the large stones to the right of the waterfall to gain access to the chest. You will see the chest nesting among the rocks behind the waterfall when in third person view. ===Return the Claw=== If you return the Golden Claw, Lucan or Camilla will give you a leveled amount of gold, increase their [[Skyrim:Disposition|disposition]] toward you to "friend" (assuming you previously were not), and return the item to its home on the counter. {{SRLeveledReward|medium}} ==Robbery Reactions== Before you start the quest, the following Riverwood residents will give you a clue as to what happened to the shop: {| class="wikitable" !Name !Dialogue |- |[[Skyrim:Frodnar|Frodnar]] |''"I heard Lucan yelling the other day about a thief breaking into his store. It wasn't me, honest!"'' |- |[[Skyrim:Gerdur|Gerdur]] |''"Lucan over in the Riverwood Trader says thieves broke into his store. Strange, he says they hardly took anything."'' |- |[[Skyrim:Hilde|Hilde]] |''"Did you hear? The Riverwood Trader was robbed! Poor Lucan must be torn to pieces over it."'' |- |[[Skyrim:Lucan Valerius|Lucan Valerius]] |''"I don't know what you overheard, but the Riverwood Trader is still open. Feel free to shop."''
''"I better get back to cleaning the store. What a mess."''
''"Damn thieves. As if things weren't bad enough."'' |- |[[Skyrim:Orgnar|Orgnar]] |''"Lucan over at the Riverwood Trader had his store broken into the other night. Oddly enough, barely anything's been stolen."'' |} ==Notes== * This quest counts towards the [[Skyrim:Sideways|Sideways]] [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] regardless of whether you do the quest for Lucan or Camilla (i.e., both quest stages 100 and 110 qualify). * You cannot return the claw to Lucan until [[Skyrim:Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)#The Secret of Bleak Falls Barrow|this part of the concurrent quest]] is complete. * [[Skyrim:Riverwood Trader|The shop]] is open 24 hours if you don't finish this quest. * While guiding you to the bridge, Camilla frequently gets stuck in place. Walking a few steps exactly behind her in line with the road prevents this, and if already stopped, returning yourself to that exact position will usually make her start walking again. If all fails, just go on and leave her; she will return to Lucan and her directions are not needed for the quest. * Arvel is immune to any damage before you cut the webs he is trapped into. * If Camilla is somehow killed Lucan will exclaim how he wishes Camilla was here to see this. * If you don't return the golden claw to Lucan, it will remain a weightless quest item in the inventory, but if you display it on the claw displays of additional houses added by the Creation Club, you can remove it without returning it to Lucan. If you return it to Lucan, it will be placed on the counter and taking it will always be a steal. If you steal a golden claw, you can make the stolen tag invisible while the player is holding it or putting it in the box, but if you display it as a physical object, the stolen tag will not disappear in any way. This affects the display of the golden claw, making it fall all the time when the player re-enters the house. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If the puzzle door does not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you kill Arvel before he turns against you, then you cannot check your next objective. However, this can be fixed by reading his journal and skipping to the last step of returning it to Lucan once the dungeon is finished.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Casting any [[Skyrim:Frenzy (effect)#Spells|frenzy spell]] on the Wounded Frostbite Spider will cause Arvel to run free and begin to fight it. After it dies or the effect wears off, he will stand where he is and engage in the normal dialogue with you. You still have to go cut the webs, and after you do so, he will begin his sprint down the hall like normal.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you don't speak to Lucan before going into Bleak Falls Barrow, you may trigger a bug which will prevent you from completing the quest if you attempt to give him the claw after you have obtained it in the dungeon during the [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|related quest]]. You can fix this by loading a save from before the beginning of the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Even if you finish the quest, the chest in the first floor of the Riverwood Trader may still need to be stolen from.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10:2||Lucan Valerius in Riverwood is offering me a gold reward if I retrieve his antique Golden Claw, stolen by bandits camped in Bleak Falls Barrow. {{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the Golden Claw}} |^||Camilla Valerius in Riverwood is offering me a gold reward if I retrieve her antique Golden Claw, stolen by bandits camped in Bleak Falls Barrow. {{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the Golden Claw}} |12||I've overheard a group of bandits talking about a golden claw that they've recently stolen. Apparently, one of the bandits has taken the claw further into Bleak Falls Barrow. {{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the Golden Claw}} |15||{{Quest Objective|15|Cut Arvel down}} |35||{{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the Golden Claw}} |37||{{Quest Objective|40|Bring the claw to Lucan}} {{Quest Objective|45|Bring the claw to Camilla}} |40||{{Quest Objective|30|Find the secret of Bleak Falls Barrow}} |60||{{Quest Objective|35|Find the owner of the Golden Claw}} {{Quest Objective|40|Bring the claw to Lucan}} {{Quest Objective|45|Bring the claw to Camilla}} |100|fin|I have returned the Golden Claw to Lucan, who rewarded me for my effort. |110|fin|I have returned the Golden Claw to Camilla, who rewarded me for my effort. |200|fail|Camilla and Lucan Valerius are dead. Any chance of getting a reward from them for retrieving the golden claw died with them. |missing=5, 6, 7, 8, 13, 20, 30, 50, 250 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:The Fallen.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Likelolwhat |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=[[SR:Alduin|Alduin]] |Reward=All words of the [[Skyrim:Call Dragon|Call Dragon]] shout |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Alduin's Bane|Alduin's Bane]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|Paarthurnax]] |Next=[[Skyrim:The World-Eater's Eyrie|The World-Eater's Eyrie]] |Loc=[[SR:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]], [[SR:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]], and/or [[SR:Sky Haven Temple|Sky Haven Temple]], [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] |Image=SR-quest-The Fallen.jpg |ImgDesc=Odahviing yoked in the trap |description=Capture and interrogate [[Skyrim:Odahviing|an ally]] of [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]]. |ID=MQ301 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax_(dragon)|Paarthurnax]], [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]], ''or'' [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]]. # Talk to the Jarl of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]]. # Prepare a trap for [[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]]. # Call Odahviing to [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]]. # Weaken and trap Odahviing. # Interrogate Odahviing. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Civil War=== When you have defeated [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]], he will fly off. You must track down one of his minions to find Alduin again. Speak with [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax_(dragon)|Paarthurnax]], [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]], or [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] to proceed. When the topic is discussed, they will all tell you that [[Skyrim:Dragonsreach|Dragonsreach]] was once used to [[Skyrim:Olaf and the Dragon|capture a dragon]]. If you decide to speak with Esbern, you will start the optional quest [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|Paarthurnax]]. Go to [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and speak with the [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl of Whiterun]]. Depending on your progress in the [[Skyrim:Civil War|civil war]], there are several options for what can happen next: *If the civil war has not been settled for either side, the jarl will at first be hesitant and tell you he can't capture a dragon with the ongoing war threatening his hold. You have to get both sides to agree with a truce by speaking to both [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] and [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]]. This starts the quest [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], which will now have to be completed before you can proceed with The Fallen. *If the civil war has been settled for either the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperials]] or the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]], the jarl will allow you permission upon speaking with him. This option actually becomes possible once either side of the civil war controls at least eight of the nine Holds: if you have joined the Stormcloaks, you must have started or completed the "Liberate Haafingar" objective of [[Skyrim:Liberation of Skyrim|Liberation of Skyrim]]; and if you have joined the Imperials, you must have started or completed the "Regain Eastmarch" objective of [[Skyrim:Reunification of Skyrim|Reunification of Skyrim]]. *If you choose to complete [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|Paarthurnax]] by killing him before the peace negotiations, this will anger [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]] to the point where he refuses to talk to you. However, he will still agree to host the negotiations and talk to you only for the duration of the quest. Arngeir will comment on the loss of Paarthurnax during his standoff with the Blades. ===Dragon Captive=== After the peace treaty negotiations have been completed (see the quest [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]] for further details), you will learn that you can use a Shout to summon a dragon, as all dragon names are Words of Power. Esbern has uncovered the name of one dragon in their records, [[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]]. Upon telling you the name of the dragon, you will automatically learn a new [[Skyrim:Call Dragon|Call Dragon]] shout. If you did not have to do Season Unending, you are instead sent to [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|Paarthurnax]], who provides you with the same information as Esbern, including the same Call Dragon shout. At the moment you learn the shout, your journal is updated to reflect Season Unending as complete, even if you had never actually started that quest. Go to Dragonsreach to prepare and spring the trap with the help of [[Skyrim:Balgruuf the Greater|Jarl Balgruuf]] or [[Skyrim:Vignar_Gray-Mane|Jarl Vignar Gray-Mane]], depending on the current allegiance of Whiterun. The area you need to go is located behind the throne room and up the stairs (you can just follow the jarl). Tell the jarl you're ready, then use the Call Dragon shout by holding it down for a moment. Odahviing will appear after a short delay and attack, being curious to test your power. Fight him, and draw him closer to the doors you came in through using the shout Dragonrend. Climb the stairs that start near the doors, or simply back up towards the rear of the room, and a large wooden yoke will drop down and snap around his neck, holding him in place. You can then interrogate him and he will start talking to you. He will tell you where Alduin has gone; a former temple of the [[Lore:Dragon Cult|Dragon Cult]] called [[Skyrim:Skuldafn Temple|Skuldafn Temple]]. Interrogate him further and he will reveal to you that it is impossible to get to Skuldafn without wings, but he will take you if you release him, as he, like the other dragons, has begun to question whether Alduin is fit to lead after your earlier defeat of him. Before you accept his offer, make sure you have everything you need for a long mission, as you will not be able to leave Skuldafn until after you have completed the next three quests. You cannot take any followers with you to Skuldafn. When you are ready, talk to a guard on the upper level to release Odahviing. He will not fly away, so talk to the now-freed Odahviing for the flight to Skuldafn. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|The Fallen (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *[[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar]] may come out and talk with Odahviing while you have him in captivity, and attempt to collect samples, resulting in a rather humorous scene. * The [[Skyrim:Call_Dragon|shout]] button must be pressed for a slightly longer time than previous shouts required, to get the name of the dragon out and actually cause him to appear. * When Odahviing appears, your shout cooldown, which would normally be 300 seconds, is reset to zero. Any further shouts will be subject to the normal cooldown. * If you have a small bounty when trying to release the dragon, all the guard will say is "Wait, I know you," and no other dialogue will appear. Simply pull the release chain yourself. * If Odahviing kills the guard that is supposed to release him, just pull the chain yourself. * Do not attack Odahviing when he is trapped. He will not respond, but when he is released, he will become hostile again. * Followers may keep Odahviing busy with a skirmish where he lands, preventing him from walking into the trap. * If you have started the Stormcloaks beginning quests, but gone no further in them, you may be unable to start a conversation with Ulfric or General Tullius until you get farther along in the quest line. * At stage 50 of the quest (defeated Alduin), the quest [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (quest)|Paarthurnax]] will begin, though it will not be displayed in your journal. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Odahviing may stop moving and become invincible once you get him through the doorway.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|When Odahviing is captured, he will not talk to you. Once you get back to the Porch to summon Odahviing, Vignar will be there and the dragon will be captured properly.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|Odahviing sometimes becomes hostile after releasing him. To fix this, simply exit the Great Porch, wait a few hours inside Dragonsreach, and return to Odahviing.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After trapping Odahviing, you may fall through the ground and in turn be stuck under the map. This seems to be caused by standing under or near Odahviing when the trap is dropped into place. To fix this, simply fast travel, then come back.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Farengar will not appear if you have killed him, but the NPCs present will still register him as being there, trying to obtain a blood sample or some scales from Odahviing. The NPCs will say their dialogue for this scene, but Farengar will not be present to speak his lines.|USKP|1.2.4}} {{Bug|Odahviing will only fly around Dragonsreach and it'll be impossible to attack or interact with him.|confirmed=1}} **To solve this, exit the Great Porch, wait for 20 hours, then re-enter. **{{Pc22}} Alternatively, use the console to kill the guard, which triggers the next phase as if the dragon had done it himself. {{Bug|After the fight with Alduin, Paarthurnax might not land, making the first objective of speaking to him impossible. Instead of going to Arngeir or Esbern to progress, use Dragonrend on Paarthurnax. He will land and not attack you, allowing you to quickly complete this objective.|vn=1}} {{Bug|Vignar may ask you to negotiate a truce for the Civil War even if you have completed the Civil War questline.
