Skyrim:The Book of Love.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Chris3145 |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests/Divine |Next=[[SR:Spread the Love|Spread the Love]] |Giver=[[Skyrim:Dinya_Balu|Dinya Balu]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Agent of Mara|Agent of Mara]], [[Skyrim:Amulet of Mara|Amulet of Mara]] |Disp=0→1 (Fastred, Fastred's chosen man, Calcelmo, Faleen, Dinya) |Rep= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Temple of Mara|Temple of Mara]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]] |Image=SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Dinya Balu|Dinya Balu]] wants you to help the cause of love throughout Skyrim |description=Help the [[Skyrim:Temple of Mara|Temple of Mara]] spread the cause of love throughout Skyrim. |ID=t02 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Difficulty=Easy }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Speak to [[Skyrim:Dinya_Balu|Dinya Balu]] in the [[Skyrim:Temple of Mara|Temple of Mara]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Help [[Skyrim:Fastred|Fastred]], in [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], with her love interest. # Help [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]] with his love. # Help [[Skyrim:Ruki|Ruki]] with her love. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[Skyrim:Dinya Balu|Dinya Balu]] is a [[Skyrim:Priest|priestess]] of the [[Skyrim:Temple of Mara|Temple of Mara]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]], devoted to spreading the word and acts of the [[Lore:Divines|Divine]]. When you speak with her inside the temple, asking for Mara's blessing, she will explain that earthly services on Mara's behalf are first required. When you are ready to go forth, bearing Mara's light, Dinya explains the visions that Mara has given her, and asks you to act in Mara's name to aid those who are having trouble with their love. === Fickle Love: Fastred === [[File:SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love_02.jpg|thumb|right|Boti and Jofthor have differing opinions about their daughter's future.]] Dinya will first tell you of a young woman, confused and overwhelmed by her new found feelings. She will send you to [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]] to speak to [[Skyrim:Fastred|Fastred]], the conflicted girl. Fastred will tell you that she is in love with [[Skyrim:Bassianus Axius|Bassianus Axius]], but her parents will not let them be together; she will ask you to speak to them in that regard. Her mother, [[Skyrim:Boti|Boti]], will reveal that she is not against the relationship, and even if Fastred were to run away with Bassianus, she would do her best to handle her husband's ire. Fastred's father, [[Skyrim:Jofthor|Jofthor]], on the other hand, will make it clear that he does not want his daughter to leave town. He believes she is merely infatuated with Bassianus and will soon change her mind, just as she did with her previous interest, [[Skyrim:Klimmek|Klimmek]]. [[File:SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love_03.jpg|thumb|left|If you encourage Bassianus, he and Fastred will move to Riften.]] At this point, you can choose to talk to Bassianus, informing him of Boti's silent approval, or Klimmek, suggesting to him that he be more bold in regard to Fastred. The man you speak with will then proceed to meet with Fastred; they'll have a brief conversation which you must observe to advance the quest and ensure Mara's work is done. When the quest is completed, Bassianus will leave for Riften regardless of having favored him or not, though he will take Fastred with him if you favored him. In either case, return to Dinya Balu at the Temple of Mara to inform her of your success. {{NewLeft}} === Embers in Stone: Calcelmo and Faleen === [[File:SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love_04.jpg|thumb|right|Yngvar the Singer's poetry can melt hearts.]] While Dinya is pleased with your work in Ivarstead, there is more to do. Dinya next will send you to [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] to speak to [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]]. Calcelmo is a great Scholar of [[Lore:Markarth|Markarth]], [[Lore:Dwemer|Dwemer]] researcher, and powerful [[Skyrim:CombatMageConjurer|conjurer]], but all his worldliness and knowledge is simply undone by [[Skyrim:Faleen|Faleen]], a [[Skyrim:Redguard|Redguard]] [[Skyrim:CombatWarrior1H|warrior]] and [[Skyrim:Housecarl|housecarl]]. Speaking directly to Faleen about Calcelmo reveals that she doesn't really have much of an opinion about the scholar. To confound the issue, Calcelmo is afraid of speaking to Faleen. He doesn't know what to talk about and worries that he'll make a bad impression by raising the wrong topic. Clearly, some type of intervention is needed. Calcelmo asks you to find out more about Faleen from her friend, [[Skyrim:Yngvar the Singer|Yngvar the Singer]], who is quite the lady's man himself. He can usually be found inside the [[Skyrim:Silver-Blood Inn|Silver-Blood Inn]] during the day or in the [[Skyrim:The Treasury House|Treasury House]] at night. You can tell Yngvar that Calcelmo is interested in Faleen, or choose to keep Calcelmo's identity a secret. In either case, Yngvar will be happy for his friend and eager to help, for a price. He will offer a [[Skyrim:Love Poem|romantic poem]], ostensibly written by Calcelmo for Faleen, for two hundred gold. When you have completed the transaction, deliver the poem to Faleen. She will be touched and write Calcelmo an [[Skyrim:Faleen's Letter to Calcelmo|encouraging letter]] in response. [[File:SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love_05.jpg|thumb|left|Calcelmo and Faleen confessing their love to each other.]] Give the letter to Calcelmo and he will run off to meet her. Follow him to see them express their mutual affection in person, and the quest will complete. '''Note:''' If you complete this quest after the Stormcloaks have claimed Markarth, Faleen will have been relocated to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. This will cause Calcelmo to run all the way from Markarth to Solitude to speak to her. If that happens, fast-travel to the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] to witness their conversation and complete the quest. {{NewLeft}} === Withstanding Storms: Ruki and Fenrig === [[File:SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love_06.jpg|thumb|right|Ruki waiting at Gjukar's Monument.]] When you return, Dinya Balu will congratulate you on helping both young and seasoned love find its way. However, she has a final challenge for you; to reach beyond death to reunite a couple torn apart by war. For this Dinya will give you an [[Skyrim:Amulet of Mara|Amulet of Mara]], which you will need to have equipped in order to see the couple. You will need to travel to [[Skyrim:Gjukar's Monument|Gjukar's Monument]], a stone monument commemorating an ancient battle southeast of [[Skyrim:Rorikstead|Rorikstead]]. Here, the ghost of a woman named [[Skyrim:Ruki|Ruki]] is futilely searching the remnants of a battle that only she can see. She thinks that she is still alive and is looking for her love, [[Skyrim:Fenrig|Fenrig]]. She had word that the battle did not go well, but she has been unable to find his body. [[File:SR-quest-The_Book_of_Love_07.jpg|thumb|left|Ruki and Fenrig ascending into the sky.]] Fenrig turns out to be quite far from Gjukar's Monument; he can found a short distance directly northwest of [[Skyrim:Fort Greymoor|Fort Greymoor]], and south of the small body of water at the head of the river on the world map. Similar to his wife, he believes he is still alive and camping with the rest of Gjukar's army on the eve of the battle. His dialogue hints that he was killed in an enemy raid of the camp the night before the battle. When you give him word that Ruki has come looking for him, he will agree to follow you. Bring him back to Ruki and they will be confused, but happy to be reunited as they ascend into the sky and eventually disappear. {{NewLeft}} ===A Higher Comprehension=== Return to Dinya Balu where she will bestow Mara's blessing upon you as well as the [[Skyrim:Resist Magic|resist magic]] [[Skyrim:Powers#Abilities|active effect]], Agent of Mara. You may also keep the Amulet of Mara given to you, to aid you in [[Skyrim:Marriage|finding a spouse]]. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== * After choosing which suitor succeeds for Fastred you must follow him to her and observe the conversation between the lovers, otherwise the quest will not update and you can't receive the next quest in the chain. * If you leave the area after choosing Bassianus Axius for Fastred's companion and then return before seeing Dinya Balu, the parties involved may all act as if Fastred and Bassianus have left town together, despite still being there. * It is possible to avoid mentioning Calcelmo entirely while talking to Yngvar about the love poem, yet his name will still appear on the poem - "from Calcelmo to Faleen". * If you have completed the civil war quest line for the Imperial Legion after giving Markarth to the Stormcloaks in [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], Yngvar the Singer will be in Windhelm with the other captured Stormcloak supporters. Simply go in the Palace of the Kings and he will be at the table before the throne. * If you watch carefully as Ruki and Fenrig are lifted into the sky, you can notice that they will experience a sudden drop before becoming invisible. * Unlike the "Agent of Dibella" reward, this quest reward is listed as "Resist Magic" in Active Effects rather than "Agent of Mara". ==Bugs== {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Yngvar the Singer|Yngvar the Singer]] or [[Skyrim:Faleen|Faleen]] may not give you their respective letters, preventing you from advancing through the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]]'s dialogue about the letter for Faleen doesn't drop away properly due to checking for a nonexistent quest stage.|USKP|2.1.2}} {{Bug|[[Skyrim:Fenrig|Fenrig]] may vanish after asking you to lead the way to [[Skyrim:Ruki|Ruki]] and never reappear. If you then either fast travel or run to Ruki, she has the quest marker indicating to talk to her next, but she does not respond.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Advance the quest using the console command setstage t02 100. Another console solution is using prid 38288 and then using enable. This will bring [[Skyrim:Fenrig|Fenrig]] back and he will follow you. ** Provided no followers are with you, after speaking to Fenrig, when he responds stating: "If she's come this far from home..." exit the conversation and quickly fast travel to Ruki's location at the monument. Fenrig will have already joined your party and travel with you. Upon arrival, the scripted conversation between the two occurs and the quest updates as normal. ** If the other suggested fixes do not work for you after trying them try reloading before the quest. Speak to Ruki then when you talk to Fenrig simply allow him to finish his lines. If he seems to disappear do not panic. Just walk back to Ruki (not fast travel) and the scene when they talk and float into the air should happen normally. **Remove the amulet of Mara after speaking to Fenrig, and travel back to Ruki. If Fenrig disappears and you are unable to interact with Ruki, enter the items menu, remove the amulet and then exit the menu. The quest should update and inform you to equip the amulet and Ruki should disappear. If you then re-equip the amulet and wait a few moments, Ruki will appear again and move to interact with Fenrig, who also should have appeared nearby. {{Bug|If Ruki or Fenrig get in a fight with a dragon while they have the quest marker, they may become unresponsive.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Advance the quest using the console command setstage t02 95. ** Fast traveling away and then coming back may reset the dialogue menu, allowing you continue with the quest. {{Bug|Both Ruki and Fenrig can ascend into the sky and then fall. After that, they ascend a few feet off of the ground and stay there.|confirmed=1}} ** Simply reload the last known save before both meet to fix the issue. Waiting for one hour may also fix the problem. ** Fast travel to Riften to fix the issue. {{Bug|Picking up extra Amulets of Mara may cause you to be unable to equip the one that is given to you, which is required to progress the quest. This will prevent you from completing the quest.|confirmed=1}} ** Remove the extra Amulets from your inventory before the specific one is given to you. **{{Pc22}} PC players can use the following console commands to work around this bug: stopquest t02, then resetquest t02, and finally setstage t02 100. Return to Dinya Balu to finish the quest. **{{Pc22}} As an alternative that allows quest continuation, PC players can use the console to drop all Amulets of Mara in possession and then pick up only the quest item. If 3 or more Amulets are in possession, the non-quest Amulets will stack, allowing for easy identification of the quest Amulet. Use the command: help "amulet of mara" to get the item ID code (marked "ARMO"), then player.drop (ID) (#) where (ID) is the item ID code from the previous command, and (#) is the numeric number of Amulets of Mara possessed by the player. For example: player.drop 000C891B 3. Finally, pick up one of the Amulets of Mara and put it on, and if the proper quest Amulet has been identified the quest will resume. **Console players can have interactions with authorities. Steal a different amulet of Mara to add to you list. Then get a guard to remove your stolen goods. The reorder should put the required amulet to the top. {{Bug|If you equip the Amulet of Mara well before you first approach Gjukar's Monument, the quest marker may be floating in the air near the monument, but Ruki herself will not appear.}} **Unequipping and re-equipping the Amulet of Mara should make Ruki appear. You can then speak to her and continue as normal. {{Bug|Calcelmo and Faleen are supposed to meet for breakfast and dinner each night after their portion of this quest is completed, but don't.|USSEP|4.3.5|Their packages were not set up correctly to allow this to happen at the appropriate time.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||I've agreed to help the Temple of Mara help the cause of love throughout Skyrim. {{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Fastred}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Talk to Fastred's parents}} |25||{{Quest Objective|25|Talk to Bassianus or Klimmek}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Return to Dinya Balu}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Talk to Calcelmo}} |45||{{Quest Objective|45|Get advice from Yngvar}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Deliver poem}} |55||{{Quest Objective|55|Deliver Faleen's letter}} |70||{{Quest Objective|70|Return to Dinya Balu}} |80||{{Quest Objective|75|Put on the Amulet of Mara}} |90||{{Quest Objective|90|Find Fenrig}} |95||{{Quest Objective|95|Bring Fenrig to Ruki}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Return to Dinya Balu}} |200|fin| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|80|Talk to the long-dead lover}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Ask her for a heist job and she will ask you to retrieve a single item from a store. The item is a randomly-selected [[Skyrim:Gems|gem]] or unenchanted piece of [[Skyrim:jewelry|jewelry]] ([[Skyrim:circlet|circlet]], [[Skyrim:necklace|necklace]], or [[Skyrim:ring|ring]]); see [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Thieves Guild Lists|Leveled Lists]] for full details. It is always found in the store's strongbox, which is protected with a leveled lock. The strongbox will also contain a random amount of gold (if you have not previously looted it), which can also be stolen to supplement your quest reward. The quest can send you any one of 28 possible stores. You may be assigned the same location more than once. {{City List |markarth={{LinkList|Arnleif and Sons Trading Company|The Hag's Cure|Markarth Stables|Silver-Blood Inn|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}} |riften={{LinkList|The Bee and Barb|Elgrim's Elixirs|Haelga's Bunkhouse|Pawned Prawn|Riften Stables|The Scorched Hammer|sep=

|ns_base=Skyrim}} |windhelm={{LinkList|Candlehearth Hall|East Empire Company (place)|New Gnisis Cornerclub|Sadri's Used Wares|The White Phial (place)|Windhelm Stables|sep=

==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]] about "fishing jobs".
# [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pick]] the target's pocket to obtain the required items.
# Return to Delvin.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
After joining the Thieves Guild, Delvin Mallory will tell you that he handles all the fishing, [[Skyrim:The Numbers Job|numbers]] and [[Skyrim:The Bedlam Job|bedlam]] jobs, with "fishing" being a euphemism for [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|picking]] someone's pockets. Ask him for a "fishing" job and he will give you a target and tell you to steal a particular item from them.

The item that needs to be stolen is a randomly-selected [[Skyrim:Gems|gem]] or unenchanted piece of [[Skyrim:jewelry|jewelry]] ([[Skyrim:circlet|circlet]], [[Skyrim:necklace|necklace]], or [[Skyrim:ring|ring]]); see [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Thieves Guild Lists|Leveled Lists]] for details. When the quest is started, the item is placed in the inventory of a randomly-selected NPC. Nearly anyone in any of the five main cities can be a target. Notable exceptions include [[Skyrim:Guards|guards]], [[sr:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] members, and [[sr:Child|children]]. If [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] is installed, NPCs in [[Skyrim:Raven Rock|Raven Rock]] can also be targets.

You must not be caught and sent to jail while the quest is active, for any reason, otherwise you will fail the quest; you also cannot kill the target. Once you have retrieved the item, return to Delvin for a leveled gold reward.

==Notes==
*If the target is a possible follower, then it is possible to complete this quest without committing a crime; simply recruit the follower and remove the item from their inventory.
*Version 1.3.2 of the [[Skyrim Mod:Unofficial Skyrim Patch|Unofficial Skyrim Patch]] limits the target cities to those found in the base game.
*When giving you this job, one of Delvin's possible lines is ''"Got ourselves a freelancer thinks he can muscle in on our territory. How about you teach him some manners, eh?"'' This line can still trigger even if the target is female.
*If you get arrested in a hold which is different from the target's hold, the quest still fails. Getting arrested on Solstheim can fail this quest when the target is located on Skyrim.

==Bugs==
{{Bug|The cleanup script will take any similar item rather than the quest item. This cleanup script is run whether you are successful or canceling the job and will remove items from your inventory. Any items that are taken are permanently destroyed so it is recommended that you save and drop all items of the same type (if he wants a gold diamond necklace drop all gold diamond necklaces including custom enchanted ones). You can also work around this bug by giving all items of the same type to a follower.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|After a quest has been completed by returning the pickpocketed item to the quest giver and receiving payment, the item may remain in your inventory, shown as stolen. It may then be sold again to a fence.}}
{{Bug|There is a chance that this quest may involve stealing items from a number of people where the chance of the steal will always be 0%, no matter what Pickpocket perks or skill you have.|confirmed=1}}
** You may request to cancel the quest if this happens.
** {{pc22}} Open the console, and click the victim to select them. Type "showinventory" (to find the ID of the quest target). Type "drop <ID number of the quest object> 1". Steal the quest target after it falls to the ground.
** If you have the ''poisoned'' perk, you can reverse pickpocket a [[Skyrim:Paralyze (effect)|paralysis]] poison into the target. As the potion is coming close to wearing off, there will be a brief moment where you can pickpocket anything with 100% success, and won't get a bounty even if you're seen doing it (because the game ''thinks'' you're just corpse-looting, which always succeeds and is perfectly legal). However, you have to time your pickpocketing correctly for this to work, so you may want to save before attempting.
{{Bug|With Dragonborn installed: If you are asked to steal something from one of the crew of the Northern Maiden (the boat that runs between Windhelm and Solstheim), there is a possibility that the item will only be placed in that person's inventory at one end of the journey, and not the other. For example, thanks to there being significantly fewer people around at the Raven Rock end of the journey, it's much easier to pickpocket them there, but no use if the item's only in their pocket when you meet them at the much more highly populated Windhelm dock.}}
{{Bug|[[Skyrim:Dryston|Dryston]] can be a quest target before he actually appears in the game. If so, the quest marker will point to an empty area of Weylin's room.}}
**Either request a new job or advance [[Skyrim:The Forsworn Conspiracy|The Forsworn Conspiracy]] until Dryston appears.

[[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]] |Image=SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella.jpg |ImgDesc=The Temple of Dibella |description=Find a new [[Skyrim:Fjotra|Sybil]] for the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]]. |ID=T01 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |SuggLevel=14 |Difficulty=Hard }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Travel to the city of [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. # ''(Optional)'' Start the [[Skyrim:Speak to Degaine|Speak to Degaine]] quest. # Enter the Inner Sanctum of the [[Skyrim:Temple of Dibella|Temple of Dibella]]. # Help the priestesses of [[Lore:Dibella|Dibella]] find a new Sybil. # Travel to [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]] and learn the location of [[Skyrim:Fjotra|Fjotra]]. #*''(Optional)'' Escort [[Skyrim:Enmon|Enmon]] to [[Skyrim:Broken Tower Redoubt|Broken Tower Redoubt]]. # Rescue Fjotra from the [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]]. # Escort Fjotra back to the Temple of Dibella. # Pray at Dibella's Altar in the Temple of Dibella. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Temple of Dibella=== The temple located in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]] is dedicated to [[Lore:Dibella|Dibella]], the goddess of love, beauty, and artistry. It is maintained by several priestesses and [[Skyrim:Hamal|Hamal]]. Upon entering the temple, you will find the priestess [[Skyrim:Senna|Senna]], who will inform you that: ''"The sisters are communing with Dibella. They can't be disturbed. You'll have to come back another time."'' In order to access the Inner Sanctum, you can either try to pick the expert-lock, or steal the [[Skyrim:Key to the Dibella Inner Sanctum|key]] from Senna. Note that if you choose to pick the lock and do not accept the deal from the Priestess, you'll have to do it twice—once to get into the Sanctum, and once to get out. {{Quest Fork |imageL=SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 03.jpg |imageR=SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 04.jpg |captionL=Communing with Dibella |captionR=The [[Skyrim:Statue of Dibella|Statue of Dibella]] |titleL=Exalted Protocol of the Dibellan Sybil |titleR=Stealing the Statue of Dibella |textL= If you are caught by one of the priestesses, they will exclaim: ''"What are you doing in here? Stay where you are. The mother will deal with you."'' If you ask who their "mother" is, they will direct you to speak with [[Skyrim:Hamal|Hamal]]. She will then initiate conversation by saying: ''"And just what do you think you're doing?"'' If you tell her that you were curious about the temple, she will tell you: ''"Unfortunately for you, we don't allow men/the uninitiated into the inner sanctum."'' Hamal will then continue: ''"You have committed a breach, and must pay the penalty."'' Asking what the penalty is, she will elaborate: ''"Normally, a quick death/period of servitude. Luckily for you, there are more pressing matters. We could make an example of you, but perhaps you could be put to better use."'' Also asking what use that would be, she will explain: ''"The ceremony you so rudely interrupted was the Exalted Protocol of the Dibellan Sybil. I don't expect you to know what that means. Suffice to say that our Sybil was recently lost to us. Through the Protocol, we have seen the home of the next Sybil, to the north, in a small village pressed against the stone. If you can travel there, and retrieve our young Sybil, your transgression will be forgiven."'' |textR= If you chose to try to steal the statue for Degaine, and get caught by one of the priestesses, she will inform [[Skyrim:Hamal|Hamal]]. At this point, if you threaten them, the priestess will say: ''"If that's how you choose to end your life, so be it."'' If you allow yourself to speak with Hamal, you can tell her that you only came here for the statue. She will then reply with: ''"So be it. We gave you a choice."'' Both responses result in the priestesses becoming hostile and attacking you. Since none of them are [[Skyrim:Essential NPCs|essential]] (with the exception of Senna), they can die as a result, causing you to be unable to complete The Heart of Dibella quest. Once you have retrieved the statue, you can turn it over to Degaine who will hastily say: ''"Give it to me quickly, before they see us together. You've riled up the priestesses, and the guards don't take kindly to that. Here's your share. Nicely done."'' He then gives you 150 gold in exchange for the statue. However, if you managed to steal the statue unnoticed, you may return to the temple and purposely get noticed in order to start the quest The Heart of Dibella.}} ===Karthwasten=== [[File:SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 05.jpg|thumb|right|A distraught [[Skyrim:Enmon|Enmon]] working at the smelter]] If you choose to help the priestesses find the new Sybil, you are directed to visit [[Skyrim:Karthwasten|Karthwasten]] and locate the young girl's father, [[Skyrim:Enmon|Enmon]], who may be found working in the mine or at the smelter. If you speak to any of the local residents, they will all direct you to speak to him as well. If you tell him that you are looking for his daughter, he will retort: ''"Damn it, man/woman, are you trying to taunt us?"'' Asking him what he meant, he will explain: ''"Our daughter, [[Skyrim:Fjotra|Fjotra]], was taken from here. The [[Skyrim:Forsworn|Forsworn]] descended and... they didn't touch anything else. Just our little girl."'' Also asking where they took her, he will continue: ''"It was the Forsworn from [[Skyrim:Broken Tower Redoubt|Broken Tower]]. Never been much trouble before. What's it to you?"'' You can now respond to him in two different ways: If you tell Enmon that you just want his daughter to be safe, he will remark: ''"That's... that's good of you. If you were to save her, I would be very grateful. I don't think there's anything I could give you, though..."'' However, if you tell Enmon that Fjotra is the new Sybil of Dibella, he will say: ''"She... really? That's... I wouldn't have dreamed. Of course, we need her in Markarth, then. I'll come with you."'' If you agree that he should travel with you, he will thank you and accompany you to Broken Tower Redoubt. Note that if you take him along with you, he is a non-essential NPC, and can die. You can also tell him that he should stay, and he will reply with urgency: ''"You're... probably right. Just hurry, please. Who knows what those things are doing to her."'' You are now directed to travel to the Broken Tower Redoubt and rescue Fjotra from the Forsworn holding her captive. ===Touched by the Gods=== [[File:SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 06.jpg|thumb|right|A [[Skyrim:Forsworn Briarheart|Forsworn Briarheart]] guarding Fjotra's cell]] Making your way through the Broken Tower Redoubt, you can find Fjotra in her cell, guarded by a Forsworn Briarheart. After you have defeated the Briarheart and freed her, she will ask: ''"Are you one of them? Please don't hurt me."'' When you tell her that you are to bring her to the Temple in Markarth, she will exclaim: ''"Then it is true what they said? I am touched by the gods?"'' Her suspicions confirmed, Fjotra will then accept her title as the new Sybil of Dibella: ''"I've heard stories about the wonders of the great Temple in Markarth. But I never dreamed that I would even get to see it. I am honored to be called for this duty. Please, lead on."'' [[File:SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 07.jpg|thumb|right|A final farewell]] You must now return Fjotra to the Temple to become the new Sybil of Dibella, but you also can take a detour to Karthwasten, so Fjotra can say goodbye to her parents, Enmon and [[Skyrim:Mena|Mena]], who will give her a very heart-warming farewell: '''Enmon:''' ''"Fjotra!"''
'''Fjotra:''' ''"Father!"''
'''Enmon:''' ''"Fjotra, dear. Did they hurt you?"''
'''Fjotra:''' ''"Of course not. My spirit remains strong."''
'''Enmon:''' ''"My little girl. Always strong. Do you know where you have to go?"''
'''Fjotra:''' ''"I'm to go to the temple in Markarth. I... I'll have to leave you and mother."''
'''Enmon:''' ''"It's our honor to have you there. This man/woman is going to take you to Markarth. Are you ready?"''
'''Fjotra:''' ''"Of course."'' Afterwards, Enmon will approach and thank you: ''"Thank you for getting her back from the Forsworn. Dibella was smart to have sent you."'' You can now return to Hamal in the Temple of Dibella in Markarth to complete the quest. ===A New Sybil=== [[File:SR-quest-The Heart of Dibella 08.jpg|thumb|left|A new Sybil in the Temple of Dibella]] Upon arriving back at the temple, Hamal will be grateful for the safe return of Fjotra: ''"You... you found her? I can't believe it. Let the girl come with me and we can begin her preparation. I will send word to her family that she is in good hands. You've truly earned the Blessing of Dibella, child. Prostrate yourself before her altar, and she will bestow her gift."'' You are now directed to kneel before and then drink the blessed water, which will bestow the [[Skyrim:Agent of Dibella|Agent of Dibella]] passive ability. This grants an additional 10% physical damage against enemies of the opposite sex, and the quest will now be marked as complete. {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * Priestesses Senna, Orla, and Anwen become [[Skyrim:Marriage|marriageable]] upon completion of this quest. * If you have previously entered Broken Tower Redoubt and left the door to Fjotra's cell open, it will still be open when you return to rescue her. * During [[Skyrim:The House of Horrors|The House of Horrors]] quest for [[Skyrim:Molag Bal|Molag Bal]], [[Skyrim:Logrolf the Willful|Logrolf the Willful]] may also be held captive within Broken Tower Redoubt. If so, and if both of these quests have been started, Fjotra will be in the same prison cell as Logrolf. * Once you have completed this quest and received the ability [[Skyrim:Agent of Dibella|Agent of Dibella]], you can take almost everything inside the temple, both upstairs and in the Inner Sanctum (excluding higher value potions, poisons, jewelry, soul gems, and gems). * Originally, [[Skyrim:Speak to Degaine|Speak to Degaine]] was part of this quest. There are several stages in the quest related to it, though they're now unused. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Being caught inside the Inner Sanctum before stealing the statue may cause the priestesses to turn hostile without triggering any dialogue.}} {{Bug|The quest marker may be displayed incorrectly while at the bottom floor of Broken Tower Redoubt, instructing to go outside while inside and to go inside while outside}} {{Bug|The conclusion scene when returning the Sybil may never play, and after you receive your reward the quest may never actually finish.|USKP|2.0.0}} {{Bug|It is possible to tell Hamal you heard there was a valuable statue even if you had already stolen it previously and given it to Degaine.|USSEP|4.0.8}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |60||To appease the priestesses of Dibella, I have agreed to find the young girl who will be their next Sybil. It's been prophesied that she lives in the village of Karthwasten, to the north of Markarth. {{Quest Objective|60|Find the future Sybil of Dibella}} |70||To appease the priestesses of Dibella, I have agreed to find the young girl who will be their next Sybil. The girl must be rescued from the Forsworn who have kidnapped her. {{Quest Objective|70|Rescue Fjotra from the Forsworn}} |80||{{Quest Objective|80|Bring Fjotra to the Temple}} |100||{{Quest Objective|100|Pray at Dibella's Altar}} |200|fin|After offending the priestesses of Dibella, I paid for my offense by rescuing their new Sybil from the Forsworn. |205|fin|I stole a statue from the Temple of Dibella and sold it to the beggar Degaine. |210|fail| |missing=0, 10, 20, 30 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=JR |rewardChecked=Jak Atackka }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=Automatic after completing [[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] |Reward=Position of Arch-Mage in the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]], [[Skyrim:Archmage's Robes|Archmage's Robes]], [[Skyrim:Arch-Mage's Quarters Key|key]] to the [[Skyrim:Arch-Mage's Quarters|Arch-Mage's Quarters]]. |Disp= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Staff of Magnus|The Staff of Magnus]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Aftershock|Aftershock]] |Loc= |Image=SR-quest-The Eye of Magnus.jpg |ImgDesc=Inside the Hall of the Elements with The Eye of Magnus at the center |description=Reclaim the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College]] and contain the Eye. |ID=MG08 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Breach the barrier around the college with the [[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]]. #Confront [[Skyrim:Ancano|Ancano]] in the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Elements|Hall of the Elements]]. #Defeat Ancano with the help of the Staff of Magnus. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===All Hell Has Broken Loose=== Firstly, you'll notice that when attempting to fast travel back to the College is that it no longer has a map marker. You'll need to travel directly to the town of Winterhold, then travel on foot the rest of the way. When arriving back at the College, you will see that all is not well. [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] and the other college mages have been awaiting your return. A magical force field created by the [[Lore:Eye of Magnus|Eye of Magnus]] now surrounds the college and Tolfdir will tell you of [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle]]'s death. Looking to Tolfdir for direction, he will say, ''"You're the one with the staff, my dear/boy. If it can help us get inside the College, and reach Ancano, we'll have to hope there's a way to stop all this."'' That is your cue to equip the [[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|staff of Magnus]] and lead the charge into the College. ===The Staff and The Eye=== [[File:SR-quest-The Eye of Magnus 02.jpg|right|thumb|Tolfdir tries to stop Ancano from activating the Eye of Magnus.]] Aim the staff at the barrier and it will dissipate, allowing safe passage into the College. The quest now is to get to the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Elements|Hall of the Elements]] where Ancano is trying to activate the Eye of Magnus. Ancano will proclaim that he has the power to destroy the world at his fingertips, and that he cannot be stopped. He has become connected to the Eye at this point and absorbs more and more power from it. Tolfdir will cast a [[Skyrim:Fire Damage|fire spell]] at Ancano, but to no avail. [[File:SR-quest-The Eye of Magnus 03.jpg|right|thumb|The Eye of Magnus at full power]] Tolfdir tells you to use the staff on the Eye. It will begin to crack open, then emit a blinding flash, and you will be briefly stunned. Both Tolfdir and your follower (if you have any) will be paralyzed and remain this way until Ancano is dead. When the Eye is fully open, it will spawn [[Skyrim:Magic Anomaly|magic anomalies]] and Ancano will lose his connection with it. The Eye will emit a blinding light; after this happens, continue to use the staff on it until it fully closes again. Ancano is vulnerable at this time and he should be busy dealing with the magic anomalies. Start inflicting damage. If you take too long, Ancano may reopen the eye and become invulnerable again; in this case, simply repeat the procedure and he will eventually succumb. Tolfdir will assist in eliminating the anomalies. It is not recommended that the staff be used for battle, as it can quickly run out of charge. Fortunately, you can recharge it with the soul gems dropped by the magic anomalies, though the staff requires almost two grand soul gems' worth to fully recharge. ===The New Arch-Mage=== When Ancano is defeated, ask Tolfdir what you should do now. While he explains that he does not know how to contain the Eye, [[Skyrim:Quaranir|Quaranir]], of the [[Skyrim:Psijic Order|Psijic Order]] will appear. Quaranir will congratulate you, telling you that you have met their expectations. He will assure you that the Psijic Order will safeguard the Eye, which might otherwise destroy the College along with the rest of the world. He will observe that the world is not ready for the Eye, as Ancano just demonstrated, and declare you the new Arch-Mage of the college. Two additional members of the Psijic Order will appear, surround the Eye, and then vanish in a glow of light, taking the Eye with them. Tolfdir will then affirm that you should be the new Arch-Mage, and give you the [[Skyrim:Arch-Mage's Quarters Key|key]] to the [[Skyrim:Arch-Mage's Quarters|Arch-Mage's Quarters]] and the [[Skyrim:Archmage's Robes|Archmage's Robes]]. Everything in the Arch-Mage's Quarters becomes free to take. Tolfdir becomes the new Master Wizard as well. ==Achievements== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest and finish the questline: * {{achievement|The Eye of Magnus (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *This battle is an opportunity to farm [[Skyrim:Soul Gems|soul gems]]. Magic anomalies will spawn whenever Ancano reopens the Eye after you've closed it with the staff, which can be [[Skyrim:Soul Trap (effect)|soul-trapped]] in addition to the filled soul gems they drop when killed. Staying close to Ancano may encourage him to open the Eye sooner than if he is allowed to keep some distance while vulnerable. *Ancano's paralysis spell can be blocked by a ward before hitting Tolfdir like he taught during First Lessons. This will allow Tolfdir to assist in the battle. *It may be advantageous to keep the Staff of Magnus for the quest [[Skyrim:Aftershock|Aftershock]]; however, it is not required. *Despite what might be thought otherwise, the Magic anomalies spawned during the quest are still hostile to Ancano, despite him being the one who spawns them from the Eye in the first place. He might even choose to fight them instead of you, provided they are the closer targets. *After the quest is finished, Tolfdir and many more College members will add greetings related to your new position as Arch-Mage. ==Bugs== '''Note:''' This workaround may resolve some of the following bugs: Exit the college and fast travel to another city. Tolfdir should follow you there and you should get a quest update stating that you have defeated Ancano. Fast travel back to the college and speak with Tolfdir to complete the quest. If he doesn't arrive with you, simply wait (up to a day or two) for him to return. {{Bug|You may get to the Hall of Elements only to have Tolfdir run in and bypass the cutscene, making the staff useless. If this happens, you cannot harm Ancano in any way. This may be a scripting error caused by obtaining 2 staves from the quest before. Tolfdir may also fail to follow you into the Hall of Elements, which prevents the completion of the cutscene and the start of the fight. If this happens go through one of the side doors near the entrance, then come back in. Should that fail to help, fast travel elsewhere and return to Winterhold. You may have to use the staff to gain access to the college again. |confirmed=1}} *{{bug|It is also possible that closing and reopening the iron gate inside the hall helps, triggering Ancano's taunt and starting the sequence. This has been necessary in Skyrim VR.|vn=1}} ** {{Pc22}} If the above fails to work, disabling Tolfdir for a second might skip the sequence ahead, allowing you to attack Ancano. To do so, open the console, select Tolfdir (or type prid 1c1a1), then type disable. Now exit the console and wait for Ancanco to start his taunt. Then open the console again and enable Tolfdir again. ** To prevent Tolfdir from running into the hall and engaging Ancano prematurely, enter the hall. Make sure to save your game, ideally at the barrier before using the Staff to dissipate it. Stop at the door, move forward just enough to open the inner door and trigger Ancanos dialogue. Do NOT enter the hall, move back and stay at the doorway(to skyrim). Tolfdir should move up, say his dialogue, and trigger the fight with Ancano normally. You will know it is working if Tolfdir and any follower you have with you-are paralyzed by Ancano. At this point-move forward, use the Staff on the Eye and kill Ancano. The key is NOT to move forward with Tolfdir, but remain at the doorway, this should, hopefully, resolve the invincible Ancano problem without resort to elaborate workarounds. If this fails to work, use Unrelenting Force on Tolfdir. ** {{Pc22}} You can get rid of the additional staff by typing player.removeitem 00035369 1 in the console. ** {{Pc22}} To stop Tolfdir from running in and starting the fight prematurely, use TDetect which will stop either Ancano or Tolfdir from attacking each other, allowing the script to progress normally. TDetect can be turned back on again once the Eye of Magnus opens.` {{Bug|You may also enter to find a member of the Psijic Order already present in the hall, skipping over the cutscene between Ancano and Tolfdir, preventing Tolfdir from finishing his cutscene. This makes the quest impossible to finish. You must reload a previous save before entering the college to continue.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|You may defeat Ancano and then speak to Tolfdir. After Tofldir's scripted speech, Quaranir might not appear in the scene.|vn=1}} ** {{Pc22}} To fix this, use player.placeatme 0002ba3c in the console to make Quaranir appear. Entering the Arcanaeum and waiting for a few hours before reentering the Hall may fix this.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Tolfdir may run in and to the left, resulting in a pillar blocking his line of sight to Ancano. He never attacks and Ancano is invulnerable. Closing the gate and using Unrelenting Shout a few times will push him from behind the pillar. He will then do his dialogue and Ancano will attack. However, Tolfdir will not help until exiting and re-entering the Hall.|vn=1}} {{Bug|You can kill Ancano without having to use the staff to make him vulnerable. This means you cannot enter the College and the quest becomes unfinishable.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} To fix this, use player.equipitem 00035369 1 in the console to force-equip the staff from your inventory. ** {{Pc22}} If the above command fails, use player.additem 00035369 1 in the console to add a new staff - one that you can equip. {{Bug|After defeating Ancano and receiving the objective Talk to Tolfdir, Tolfdir may no longer be in the Hall of Elements. Reloading a previous save from before entering the Hall of Elements for the final battle may resolve this problem.|vn=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||The Staff of Magnus has been recovered, and so it's time to assault the College of Winterhold and strike down Ancano. {{Quest Objective|10|Use the Staff of Magnus to enter the College of Winterhold}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Reach the Hall of the Elements}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Defeat Ancano}} |40||Ancano has been defeated, but there's still a tremendous amount of energy coming out of the Eye of Magnus. Just do it. This gold should cover it."'' |} ==Notes== * The targets that you are supposed to murder never sleep, and almost always stay in crowded areas. Run outside the area in question while the crowd is retaliating against your follower, and then fast travel out of the hold. Your follower will fast travel with you. * All targets have 50 health. Plan your assassination tools (such as poisons and weapon choices) with this in mind. * If the recently killed target is reanimated and subsequently turned into an ash pile on their "second death", the next time they are randomly chosen as a target, both the NPC and the ash pile will appear. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Baron |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=[[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Shadowmere|Shadowmere]]
[[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]] as a follower (if spared) |Disp= =3 ([[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]] if spared) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Breaching Security|Breaching Security]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Recipe_for_Disaster|Recipe For Disaster]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dawnstar Sanctuary|Dawnstar Sanctuary]] |Image=SR-quest-The Cure for Madness.jpg |ImgDesc=Arnbjorn injured outside the Dawnstar Sanctuary |description=Confront the traitor among the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]. |ID=DB07 |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png |SuggLevel=8 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Speak to [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]]. #Find [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]]'s journal and take it to Astrid. #Behold Astrid's horse, [[Skyrim:Shadowmere|Shadowmere]]. #Travel to the abandoned Brotherhood sanctuary outside [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]]. #Choose to either kill or spare Cicero. #Return to Astrid. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Cicero=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Cure_for_Madness_02.jpg|thumb|Cicero feigning injury deep inside the Dawnstar Sanctuary]] When you return from completing the [[Skyrim:Breaching Security|Breaching Security]] contract, Gabriella will inform you that there was an incident with [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]] and directs you to discuss it with Astrid. Astrid reveals that Cicero attempted to murder her and the other members of the Dark Brotherhood, grievously wounding [[Skyrim:Veezara|Veezara]] in the process. [[Skyrim:Arnbjorn|Arnbjorn]] pursued Cicero as he fled from the sanctuary. She asks you to search Cicero's room for clues as to his whereabouts. Inside the room you find five [[Skyrim:Cicero's Journal|journals]], with the final journal indicating that Cicero might be headed for the long-abandoned [[Skyrim:Dawnstar Sanctuary|sanctuary]] outside [[Skyrim:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]]. Astrid will grant you use of her horse, [[Skyrim:Shadowmere|Shadowmere]]. Immediately outside the sanctuary he will rise from the black, bubbling liquid. Mount him if you wish, and head to Dawnstar's abandoned Brotherhood sanctuary. ===Dawnstar Sanctuary=== You will find an injured Arnbjorn outside the sanctuary. He reveals that he and Cicero seriously wounded each other before Cicero escaped into the safety of the sanctuary and instructs you to ''"just follow the blood"''. A pass phrase is needed to enter the sanctuary; it can be found in the final volume of Cicero's journal (''"Innocence, my brother"''). Once inside, Cicero will begin to speak to you, taunting, as you search for him. At this point, summon [[Skyrim:Spectral Assassin|Lucien Lachance]] for a bit more on the story. He strongly suggests that the [[Lore:Sithis|Dread Father]] would not want you to kill Cicero. While the sanctuary is abandoned, it is not unoccupied. It is inhabited by [[Skyrim:Sanctuary Guardian|ghosts]] of the previous Dark Brotherhood residents, who will attack on sight. The elusive [[Skyrim:Udefrykte|Udefrykte]] also resides in one of the sanctuary's caves; it may be advisable to simply sneak by the troll when discovered. As you make your way along, the second room is a circular chamber with another room below and a bridge. The spike trap can be avoided by avoiding the bridge and crawling along the left-hand wall; there is enough of a ledge to allow this. Across the bridge at the foot of the stairs, you will find two skill books: ''[[Skyrim:Fire and Darkness|Fire and Darkness]]'' and ''[[Skyrim:The Marksmanship Lesson|The Marksmanship Lesson]]''. ===Keeper of The Old Ways=== At the end, you will find Cicero curled up in a fetal position, apparently injured. Cicero cautions you that the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]] will not be happy if you kill him. At this point it is your choice whether to kill him or not. If you attack him he leaps to his feet, obviously unhurt, and gleefully screams ''"Haha! Behold the final trick of the Fool of Hearts! You think me near death? Haha! Think again."'' If you decide not to kill him, he returns to serve and tend to the Night Mother after you complete [[Skyrim:Hail Sithis!|Hail Sithis!]]. He will also be a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]]. Whatever your decision, the quest is now complete. Speak to Astrid to begin your next mission. ==Notes== *If you spare Cicero by leaving the Sanctuary, and then immediately re-enter, Cicero will already have disappeared. *The quest objective to "Behold Shadowmere" is numbered 666. ==Bugs== {{cleanup|needs another cleanup, or at least a few confirmed bugs}} {{Bug|If you raise Cicero from the dead before you report back to Astrid, she won't talk and you will never be able to finish the quest even if you kill your Cicero zombie. Cicero's armor will respawn on your Cicero zombie every time you go through a loading screen, meaning you can loot an infinite set of Cicero's armor.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|After you finish the quest, the blood outside of the Dawnstar Sanctuary is never cleaned up.|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|Sometimes, when you come back after completing the Breaching Security quest, Astrid will only say ''"You're back. Good. You'll want to hear this."''|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you attempt to pickpocket Cicero while he is lying on the floor and you fail, he will get up and start attacking you.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes, on Special Edition (might be Xbox only), if one of the Sanctuary Guardians walks over the tripwire that drops fire pots onto the oil (even though they can't actually trigger the tripwire), the game will freeze indefinitely.}} {{Bug|Sometimes, on Special Edition (might be Xbox only), if you fast travel back to the Falkreath Sanctuary, the black door will have despawned. You can walk through where it would be, but nothing is behind it but rocks. Fast traveling far enough out for a cell reset then fast traveling back in may fix this, but it might take a few tries.}} {{Bug|If you strike Cicero while he is saying ''"Do what you will... In the end, Sithis will judge us both"'', he will start to jump up and attack you, but then lay back down to finish his sentence, and will stay there after he finishes talking.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you attack Cicero with Lightning Bolt, he will stand up when shocked, then lie back down again, repeating this each time you shock him. He will not attack you, even after he says ''"Haha! Behold the final trick of the Fool of Hearts! You think me near death? Haha! Think again."''|confirmed=1}} ** This also appears to work with a crossbow{{DG}}. {{Bug|There is a glitch where the barred door outside Cicero's chamber will open and still show the barred door message. You may have to reenter the sanctuary if your follower does not follow you out. Once you enter, your follower will follow you once again.|vn=1}} {{Bug|On rare occasions, you will hear the animation and see the bubbles, yet Shadowmere will not appear.|confirmed=1}} **To fix this, load to a previous save, or during [[Skyrim:Death Incarnate|Death Incarnate]], coax enemies near the pool to lure Shadowmere out via his aggressiveness. You can also try fast traveling to all the stables until you see Shadowmere for a split second afterwards, and then fast travel back to the sanctuary's pool to see if he has been untrapped. **{{Pc22}} Open the console and enter prid 0009ccd8 followed by enable and then moveto player and Shadowmere should appear in the pool as normal {{Bug|Cicero's journals may fail to load when entering the sanctuary.}} **Reloading an earlier save may fix this. {{Bug|Cicero does not leave the Falkreath Sanctuary before you enter and will stand in his room with only one dialogue option to tell you about himself.}} **If Gabriella does not meet you at the entrance walk out and walk back into the Sanctuary. {{Bug|If there is a hostile creature near the sanctuary, Arnbjorn may make a spontaneous recovery and try to participate in the combat. The weapons are dropped in the same manner as any other NPC's weapon when killed. Since you only have a couple of seconds, it may be easier to tap the action button repeatedly and follow the weapon as it falls out of the ghost's hand.}} {{Bug|With the [[Skyrim:Perfect Touch|Perfect Touch]] perk, sets of [[Skyrim:Shrouded Armor|Shrouded Armor]] can be pickpocketed from the Sanctuary Guardians.}} {{Bug|{{ns22}} Beheading Cicero can cause his hood to stay attached to his body instead of his head.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Upon my return to the Sanctuary, I was informed by Gabriella that there was some kind of "incident" with Cicero. Skyrim:The Blessings of Nature.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Helenaannevalentine |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Alfwyn }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests/Divine |Giver=[[Skyrim:Danica Pure-Spring|Danica Pure-Spring]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Nettlebane|Nettlebane]], [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]] Training |Disp=Sap way: 0→1 ([[Skyrim:Danica Pure-Spring|Danica Pure-Spring]]) |Rep= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], [[Skyrim:Orphan Rock|Orphan Rock]], [[Skyrim:Eldergleam Sanctuary|Eldergleam Sanctuary]] |Image=SR-place-Eldergleam.jpg |ImgDesc=The Eldergleam |description=Restore the [[Lore:Gildergreen|Gildergreen]] for [[Skyrim:Danica Pure-Spring|Danica Pure-Spring]]. |ID=T03 |Icon=SR-qico-Miscellaneous.png |Difficulty=Easy }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Agree to help [[Skyrim:Danica Pure-Spring|Danica Pure-Spring]] restore the [[Lore:Gildergreen|Gildergreen]]. # Head to [[Skyrim:Orphan Rock|Orphan Rock]] and claim [[Skyrim:Nettlebane|Nettlebane]]. # Return to Danica, who sends you to the [[Skyrim:Eldergleam Sanctuary|Eldergleam Sanctuary]]. #* ''(Optional)'' Escort [[Skyrim:Maurice Jondrelle|Maurice Jondrelle]] to Eldergleam. # Use Nettlebane to cut through the roots, then make a choice: #* Activate Eldergleam to retrieve the [[Skyrim:Eldergleam Sap|sap]]. #* Let Maurice pray to the tree and obtain a [[Skyrim:Eldergleam Sapling|sapling]]. # Return to Danica to complete the quest. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Gildergreen=== [[File:SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature 07.jpg|thumb|right|''"It's a shame, isn't it?"'']] The only temple dedicated to [[Lore:Kynareth|Kynareth]], goddess of air, wind, and sky, is located in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and is being maintained by priestess [[Skyrim:Danica Pure-Spring|Danica Pure-Spring]]. Just outside the temple grows the [[Lore:Gildergreen|Gildergreen]], a tree planted in the earliest days of Whiterun and considered holy by worshippers of Kynareth. However, the tree was recently struck by lightning and has faded away, much to the dismay of traveling pilgrims and the citizens of Whiterun. Danica Pure-Spring, while willing to solve the problem with the sacred tree, has her hands full due to the [[Skyrim:Civil War|civil war]], so the tree is still dead. If you ask innkeeper [[Skyrim:Hulda|Hulda]] or local bard [[Skyrim:Mikael|Mikael]] for the latest gossip, they will both tell you about the state of the tree and point you towards Danica Pure-Spring. Danica sits under the tree every morning from 7am, trying to get someone to help her out; otherwise she will be in the temple tending to the sick and injured. When you talk to her, she will immediately complain about the situation, and explain what needs to be done to make it bloom again. ===Nettlebane=== [[File:SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature 04.jpg|thumb|''"You'll have to deal with the Hagravens."'']] The Gildergreen was grown from a cutting of the legendary [[Lore:Eldergleam|Eldergleam]], an ancient tree said to be thousands of years old, from before the [[Lore:Atmora|Atmora]]ns set foot in Skyrim. Danica claims that sap from the parent tree can be used to restore the Gildergreen to its former glory, but there is a catch. The Eldergleam can't be cut with a normal weapon, so you will have to deal with [[Skyrim:Hagraven|hagravens]] and claim the dagger they made to kill [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggans]], named [[Skyrim:Nettlebane|Nettlebane]]. Danica then sends you off to [[Skyrim:Orphan Rock|Orphan Rock]], a hagraven nest northeast of [[Skyrim:Helgen|Helgen]]. As you approach Orphan Rock, you will find the surrounding area protected by four residing [[Skyrim:Witch|witches]], two of them on the ground below the rock and two more witches near a camp further up the slope. They will attack you on sight and use lower-level [[Skyrim:Spells#Destruction Spells|destruction spells]] to keep you away from Orphan Rock and its unique treasure. The rock itself is accessed via a fallen-down tree stump and is protected by a single hagraven who will use fire spells on you. She can be difficult to deal with at lower levels, so it's advisable to try to kill the witches first before alerting her to your presence. Once you've disposed of the hagraven claim Nettlebane from the corpse, then loot Orphan Rock of valuables. ===An Angry Pilgrim=== Back in the [[Skyrim:Temple of Kynareth|Temple of Kynareth]], Danica has received a visit from a traveling pilgrim, namely [[Skyrim:Maurice Jondrelle|Maurice Jondrelle]] who is understandably upset about the current state of the Gildergreen and now spends his time bothering the busy priestess: [[File:SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature 08.jpg|thumb|right|''"What is it... what has happened to the Gildergreen?"'']] '''Maurice''': ''"What is it... what has happened to the Gildergreen? I have traveled long here to worship beneath its branches."''
'''Danica''': ''"It was taken by a lightning strike. Wish I had time to deal with it, but it's hard enough with all these wounded from the war."''
'''Maurice''': ''"Please, don't just let it stay like this. It's disgraceful."''
'''Danica''': ''"I really don't have time to deal with you right now. Please just let me get back to my work."''
'''Maurice''': ''"But this is supposed to be your work."'' When you show Danica the dagger you acquired from the hagraven, she will be quite surprised but will refuse to touch it, leading to her asking for another favor. You are to travel to the [[Skyrim:Eldergleam Sanctuary|Eldergleam Sanctuary]] and retrieve some of its sap. From his spot in the corner, Maurice Jondrelle will overhear the conversation and will quickly seek you out and ask if he can accompany you on the journey. He reasons that he always wanted to visit the tree of legend, so let him tag along for the ride. You can also refuse to let him tag along, but then you will miss out on some important opportunities later on. Maurice is not your average [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] and can't be given orders. Additionally, he is overly aggressive for an unarmed pilgrim and will attack any enemy you encounter, even dragons. Save your game when leaving the temple (or see [[#Notes|notes]]), then travel towards the Eldergleam Sanctuary, located near the sulphurous pools and hot springs of [[Skyrim:Eastmarch|Eastmarch]], and slightly north from [[Skyrim:Darkwater Crossing|Darkwater Crossing]]. Do your best to keep Maurice out of trouble, then enter the sanctuary. ===Eldergleam Sanctuary=== The Eldergleam Sanctuary is a large, naturally-lit cave inhabited by [[Skyrim:Asta|peaceful]] [[Skyrim:Sond (bandit)|followers]] of Kynareth and contains the legendary tree in all its glory, its roots twisting and turning across the chamber, effectively blocking the path to the tree itself. Maurice will be understandably impressed with the place but will be quite shocked when you pull out Nettlebane. Hack away at the four roots and watch them bend away from the path. When you reach the top, an important choice is to be made, as Maurice will walk up to you and accuse you of disrespecting a true miracle of Kynareth. You can either choose to hear him out, which will result in a peaceful solution – or you can choose to ignore him and use Nettlebane to extract the sap, and awaken the wrath of Kynareth. {{Quest Fork |titleL=A prayer to Kynareth |titleR=Wrath of Kynareth |imageL=SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature 05.jpg |imageR=SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature 06.jpg |imageL2=SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature 02.jpg |imageR2=SR-quest-The Blessings of Nature.jpg |captionL=[[Skyrim:Maurice Jondrelle|Maurice]] praying to the Eldergleam |captionR=[[Skyrim:Spriggan|Spriggans]] attack |captionL2=The Gildergreen Sapling |captionR2=The restored Gildergreen |textL= If you choose to listen to Maurice, he will reveal that he can solve Danica's problem without resorting to violence against the sacred tree. Agree to let him help and he will walk up to the tree, get down on his knees and pray silently to Kynareth. Moments afterward, a sapling will emerge from the ground and a happy Maurice will convince you that this is the correct solution, even if Danica will be unhappy: Danica will want to see that the true blessings of nature lie in renewal, not a slavish maintenance. Pick up the sapling and watch Maurice start a new life in the Sanctuary. Return to Danica in Whiterun, and tell her that you received a sapling instead of the sap. She will be skeptical about replacing the huge Gildergreen with a small sapling, but will eventually recognize it as the best solution. She will then finish the quest and will offer master [[Skyrim:Trainers|training]] in [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]]. The next time you visit Whiterun, the Gildergreen will be growing again (see [[#Bugs|bugs]]). |textR= If you choose to ignore Maurice, or he is not with you, you cut the tree to extract the sap. If Maurice is with you, he will stand back while you extract the sap, and will then turn hostile and attack. Whether or not Maurice is there, several [[Skyrim:Spriggan|spriggans]] will show up in the chamber, including a very powerful boss-leveled spriggan. They will usually kill the peaceful inhabitants and will obviously go directly after you. Dispose of Maurice (if he's there) and the spriggans. After the battle, receive the limited treasure from the now empty sanctuary and leave the same way you came. Back in Whiterun, Danica will be quite happy when you hand her the sap and will reward you with her services as a master level [[Skyrim:Trainers|trainer]] in [[Skyrim:Restoration|Restoration]]. This will end the quest and return the Gildergreen to its original, glorious state the next time you visit Whiterun. }} ==Notes== *The Gildergreen Sapling's burlap sack sticks up out of the ground slightly in Eldergreen Sanctuary. {{Bug|Maurice is an unusually aggressive fighter in spite of being unarmed, which puts him at a significant risk of being killed on the way to the Eldergleam Sanctuary.|USKP|1.2.2|Maurice's confidence value is lowered such that he won't be so inclined to charge into battle.}} ** Regardless of whether you have the unofficial patch installed or not, the most fail-safe way to keep Maurice alive is by simply fast-travelling to the Eldergleam Sanctuary as soon as you both leave the Temple of Kynareth. However, this requires you to have already travelled towards the Sanctuary and marked it on your map ''before'' you bring Nettlebane to the Temple. * Completing this quest counts towards the [[Skyrim:Sideways|Sideways]] [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]], regardless of whether you bring Danica the sap or the sapling (i.e., quest stages 100 and 105 both qualify). * Whiterun guards will comment after the quest is finished, regardless of whether you bring Danica the sap or the sapling (i.e., quest stages 100 and 105 both qualify). ==Bugs== {{Bug|Maurice may not initiate the conversation asking to join you on your trip to the sanctuary. Returning to the temple may trigger a scene where he asks to join you.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If Maurice does not run up to you after you have cut the last of the roots on the way, walking back down the path to him may cause him to initiate the required conversation.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you choose the sapling option, the Gildergreen in Whiterun will show the new sapling growing inside the frame of the old tree. This is because the old tree is not removed by the game. The sap option avoids this problem and allows Gildergreen to fully bloom over time.|USKP|1.0}} **{{Pc22}} This can be fixed by using the following console commands: prid 00046360 followed by disable. {{Bug|After Danica tells you to go to the Eldergleam Sanctuary, Maurice would still run his scene with her because the dialogue script evaluates his AI before stopping the scene.|USKP|2.0.9}} {{Bug|If you complete Battle for Whiterun ([[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Imperial)|Imperial]] or [[Skyrim:Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Stormcloaks]]) after doing this quest, the tree may disappear forever. Other times, it will disappear, but if you quick-save and quick-load, the tree will reappear again.|vn=1}} {{Bug|If you travel to the Sanctuary and clear out some of the roots, but then decide you'd rather have Maurice's help rather than fight the spriggans, when you return to the Temple he will confront you with the usual dialogue, except immediately afterwards he will jump to the "I had no idea you were a man of violence!" portion of the dialogue as if he were there to see you cut the roots. You will then have the conversation about what to do while still in the temple, and it will jump to "Follow Maurice" stage of the quest. He will run out of the temple and all the way to the Sanctuary. If you fast travel to the sanctuary he will already be standing next to the tree. |vn=1}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=Introduction |id=T03Intro |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Danica about the Gildergreen being destroyed}} |20|fin| |!|The Blessings of Nature|T03 |20||I've agreed to help Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, the large tree outside the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun. {{Quest Objective|20|Retrieve Nettlebane}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Bring Nettlebane to Danica}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Retrieve Eldergleam sap}} |50||{{Quest Objective|50|Follow Maurice}} |55||{{Quest Objective|55|Take sapling}} |70||{{Quest Comment|Triggers the hostile Spriggans in Eldergleam Grove}} {{Quest Objective|70|Return to Danica}} |75||{{Quest Objective|75|Return to Danica}} |100|fin|I helped Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, a large tree central to the worship of Kynareth in Skyrim. |105|fin|I brought a sapling to Whiterun that will one day be the new Gildergreen, a tree sacred to the Temple of Kynareth. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|10|Inspect the Temple of Kynareth}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=5, 200 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

If this quest is finished while Search and Seizure is active, you will fail the favor quest immediately. In addition, Ondolemar will perish. His remains will be buried in the [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Markarth)|Hall of the Dead]] in Markarth. ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you approach [[Skyrim:Igmund|Jarl Igmund]], [[Skyrim:Raerek|Raerek]], or [[Skyrim:Faleen|Faleen]] in the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] after this quest has been completed, they may attack you on sight. Since all three are essential, they cannot be killed. After the civil war has ended, they will revert back to their non-hostile behavior.|vn=1}} {{Bug|The Thalmor Soldiers who followed Ondolemar before this quest will continue to respawn in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] after the Stormcloaks take Markarth.|USKP|1.2.7}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |name=The Battle for Fort Sungard |10||Galmar Stone-Fist has sent me to assist in taking Fort Sungard from the enemy. {{Quest Objective|10|Join the men attacking Fort Sungard}} |50||{{Quest Objective|100|Take over Fort Sungard by defeating the enemy (% Remaining)}} |9000|fin|We have succeeded in taking Fort Sungard from the enemy. |missing=0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 910, 920, 950, 1000, 2000, 9200, 9999 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#After you join the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloak Rebellion]], talk to [[Skyrim:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]].
#Journey to [[Skyrim:Korvanjund|Korvanjund]].
#Meet up with Galmar and enter the ruins.
#Find your way into the tomb.
#Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Jagged Crown|Jagged Crown]].
#Return to [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Imperial Presence===
After taking the oath to join the Stormcloaks, Galmar will offer you another mission. Ask him about it and he will tell you that he knows where the Jagged Crown is, and will ask you to meet with him and his men outside the ruins of [[Skyrim:Korvanjund|Korvanjund]]. Head there and talk to [[Skyrim:Ralof|Ralof]], who will be glad to see you again. 

Galmar will tell you that there are already some Imperials patrolling the exterior of the ruins and ask if you're ready to take them on. Once you reply affirmatively, he will give a quick speech and then lead you to flank them from behind in a stealthy attack. After the Imperials are dead, Galmar and the Stormcloaks will enter the ruins after another short speech.

===Inside the Ruins===
Once inside, the men will all crouch behind a pillar that has fallen down. Galmar will tell you to attack on his signal, at which point you will charge in and eliminate all the Imperials you see. Galmar and the Stormcloaks will start moving as soon as the fight is over, leaving two soldiers behind to guard the entrance.

The next room is rather large and empty. In it, Galmar will stop at the entrance to a tunnel and mention that this would be a prime spot for an ambush. He will then tell you to find another way through the tunnel, promising to aid you once he hears fighting. This is one of the few times you need not worry about staying with the rest of the Stormcloaks, allowing you time to loot the ruins. Head up to the second floor and search for stairs. Head up the stairs and follow the path; try to stay out of sight for as long as you can. When you are detected and attacked, Galmar and the other Stormcloaks will rush in to help you. On the eastern end of this room there are more stairs, at the top of which is the [[Skyrim:Light_Armor|Light Armor]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Jornibret's_Last_Dance|Jornibret's Last Dance]]''.

Once the Imperials are dead, Galmar will move to the exit of that room and wait for you to catch up. By the edge of the wall by the cliff there is a lever; pull it and get ready for a battle. When you enter the next room, a few Imperials will attack you. Once they are dead, the men will gather around a dead draugr while Galmar explains what it is. Follow the next tunnel to the door that leads to Korvanjund Halls.

===What Was That?===
[[File:SR-quest-The Jagged Crown (Stormcloaks).jpg|thumb|right|The last of the Imperials]]
Once in Korvanjund Halls, you will find a dead Imperial lying next to a dead draugr and a few living Imperials. As you move through, you will notice a few more dead draugr. To your left, there will be a swinging blade trap with a chest behind it. Once you get past the blades, there is a lever on the floor to the left of them that lets you turn them off.

Once you go down the stairs, Galmar and the men will remark on the room you find yourself in, calling it "The Hall of Stories" and giving you some background on it. Proceed to the end, where there are two dead Imperials and a [[Skyrim:Traps#Puzzle Door|puzzle door]]. Near one of the dead Imperial's hands is the [[Skyrim:Ebony Claw|Ebony Claw]], which has the proper combination of seals engraved on it. You have to examine it in your inventory to find the proper combination: '''Fox—Moth—Dragon'''. Galmar will say that he will examine the walls to find the way through and tell you to look for a way as well. Pick up the claw, put the seals in the right combination, and then open the door.

Galmar will congratulate you, then go through the door and follow the tunnel to the next room. This room has a locked gate blocking your way, and Galmar will ask you to look for some way to open it. Look for a doorway with some stairs in it. At the top of the stairs, you will see a table to your right; there is a dagger on it. Moving the dagger causes a secret entrance to appear on the wall. In the revealed cave, there is a trapped chest. Back in the room, follow the catwalks past a wood plank bridge; there is another chest at the end of this passage. Turning around from the chest, as you leave the little alcove the chest is in, you will see a burial urn to your right. Just to the left and above the urn, there is a small handle on the rocky wall. Pulling the handle will open the gate, but also cause draugr to rise from their coffins on the lower floor, where the rest of the Stormcloaks are.

===The Crown===
[[File:SR-npc-Galmar Stone-Fist 03.jpg|thumb|right|Galmar fights for the crown]]
Once the draugr are dead, the men will go through the door to Korvanjund Crypt. Follow them through and follow the tunnel. You will arrive in a room with multiple bookcases. There are two coffins next to a seemingly dead boss-level draugr sitting on a throne. You can either run up and attack the draugr before he has a chance to attack you, which will let other draugr out of their tombs, or wait for a soldier to go up to the unmoving draugr and mention the crown it wears, at which point the coffins will burst open, revealing hostile draugr. 

After they are dead, take the crown from the corpse of the boss draugr. Galmar will tell you to take it straight to Ulfric. If you talk to him again, he will mention that he will stick around for a while to find anything useful. You are no longer required to follow the Stormcloaks. Behind the throne, there is a locked chest, a Potion of Magicka, and at the back of the room there is a [[Skyrim:Word_Wall|Word Wall]] for a word of the shout [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]]. Once you have the word, turn around to find a staircase to a tunnel that leads to Korvanjund Temple. Lift the bar off the door and open it, then turn right and head for the exit. Once outside, after descending the second set of stairs, turn around and face the campfire. Beyond the campfire there is a master-locked gate, which is securing a room containing two coin purses and a chest with some nice loot.

Head back to Windhelm and head into the Palace of Kings to give the [[Skyrim:Jagged Crown|Jagged Crown]] to [[Skyrim:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric]]. He will immediately start the next quest, [[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Stormcloaks)|Message to Whiterun]]. Alternatively, if you decide that you really want to join the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]], you can take the crown to [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] in Castle Dour in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] and ask to join the Legion. After giving him the crown, he will let you join and you will start the [[Skyrim:Message to Whiterun (Imperial)|next quest]] in the Imperial questline.

==Notes==
* The Jagged Crown can be worn at the same time as a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest Mask|dragon priest mask]] or a circlet. If you want to postpone this quest to keep the crown, there are no repercussions (as long as you don't get the 1.4 update).
* You can still switch sides by taking the crown to [[Skyrim:General Tullius|General Tullius]] and joining the Imperials. Even if the crown is given to General Tullius, the journal will still say you gave it to Galmar Stone-Fist.
* Even if you do not kill the Imperials outside Korvanjund, they will be dead once you have cleared the ruins.
