== Quick Walkthrough ==
# Acquire two [[Skyrim:Kagrumez Resonance Gem|Kagrumez Resonance Gems]].
# Go to [[Skyrim:Kagrumez|Kagrumez]].
# Kill the [[Skyrim:Reaver|reavers]] inside.
# Loot the reaver leader and find the other two gems.
# Use gems in pedestal to create three different patterns.
# Defeat the waves of enemies.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
===Acquiring Resonance Gems===
A total of five [[Skyrim:Kagrumez Resonance Gem|Kagrumez's Resonance Gems]] can be found in various locations.  You only need four, and two of them are located within Kagrumez itself, carried by the leader of the [[Skyrim:Reaver|reavers]] there.  One more can be found in a chamber in the upper northeast corner of [[Skyrim:Nchardak|Nchardak]] aqueduct ([[:File:SR-place-Nchardak ResonanceGemLocation.jpg|picture]]).  It is small and lying out in the open so beware of sending it flying when fighting the ballista guarding it. A second can be found near the [[Skyrim:Visage of Mzund|Visage of Mzund]] in [[Skyrim:Fahlbtharz|Fahlbtharz]] ([[:File:SR-place-Fahlbtharz ResonanceGemLocation.jpg|pictured]]). A third is sold by [[Skyrim:Revus Sarvani|Revus Sarvani]], who is attending the silt strider just west of [[Skyrim:Tel Mithryn (settlement)|Tel Mithryn]]. If he dies, then it can be found on his body, unless his body has been removed; it may also be pickpocketed from him. Once you have found two of the three found outside of Kagrumez, you can go and get the remaining ones there.

===The First Pattern===
When you enter the main chamber, the first thing you'll probably see after dealing with the reavers there is a console with a strange pattern and nine holes, into which you can place the gems.  To your left as you face the console, there is a locked door with a similar pattern on it, and blue dots showing you where to place the gems.  Copy the pattern, and gates will trap you while the room around you undergoes some changes.  When they come back down, you'll be facing a number of Dwarven automatons.  Kill them all, and then proceed through the now-open gate.  Inside, you'll find a chamber with a lever in front of it.  Pulling the lever opens the chamber to reveal a friendly [[Skyrim:Steadfast Dwarven Spider|Steadfast Dwarven Spider]].  If you talk to the spider, you can tell it to follow you and it will help you fight.  This follower acts as a pet, so you cannot have it along with a dog or other pet, and does not count as a summon, so you can still have one (or two with the [[Skyrim:Twin Souls|Twin Souls]] perk) in addition to the spider.

===The Second Pattern===
In this room, you'll also see another door with a pattern on it, this one requiring three gems.  Go back to the main room and copy the pattern.  Again the gates will rise as the room reorganizes, and when they come back down, you'll be facing more automatons, as well as an assortment of fire-based traps filling the room.  Kill them all again, and the traps will deactivate, and you can then go through the second door.  This room contains a similar chamber, this one containing a [[Skyrim:Steadfast Dwarven Sphere|Steadfast Dwarven Sphere]].  Like the spider, it can be made into a follower, and also counts as a pet, so you can't have the spider and sphere at the same time, or either of them along with a dog or other pet.

===The Third Pattern===
Again, you'll find another door, this one with a pattern requiring four gems.  Return to the main chamber and copy the pattern, and this time when the room reorganizes itself, there will be shallow water over most of the room, with several raised platforms above the surface.  The water is electrified, and will deal [[Skyrim:Shock Damage|Shock Damage]] if you step in it, so either jump to the platforms, use [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]], or just run through very quickly to avoid taking too much damage.  When you've killed the last round of automatons, go back through the last door and you'll be in a room with an assortment of treasures, including the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Black Bow of Fate|Dwarven Black Bow of Fate]].  A passage leads from here to the balcony overlooking the main chamber, where you can drop down and proceed to the exit.

== Notes ==
* With the [[SR:Arcane Archer Pack|Arcane Archer Pack]] [[SR:Creation Club|Creation]] installed, you will be directed to Kagrumez by the [[SR:Stealer of Souls|Stealer of Souls]] quest. The final treasure room containing the Dwarven Black Bow of Fate will also contain several [[SR:Soul Stealer Arrow|Soul Stealer Arrow]]s, making this quest a prerequisite for learning how to craft these arrows.
* There is a small area high up on the south wall of the main room that can be accessed using Whirlwind Sprint (all three words may be needed) from where you drop down after the treasure room.  There are two similar alcoves on other walls which can also be reached using Whirlwind Sprint.  There is nothing much of interest in any of them.  They are merely rooms where some of the Dwemer automatons are hiding until the doors open up, so you may be able to kill them with ranged attacks before they jump down.
*The spider and the sphere followers respawn and can be used to charge the [[Skyrim:Ebony Blade Victims|Ebony Blade]].

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Activate the Broken Dwarven Horse outside [[SR:Runoff Caverns|Runoff Caverns]].
#Enter the Autumn's Bells section of the dungeon.
#Locate the [[SR:Horse Right Front Leg|Horse Right Front Leg]] next to the dead [[SR:Mercenary|mercenary]] in the entrance hallway.
#Locate the [[SR:Horse Left Back Leg|Horse Left Back Leg]] in the main chamber, near the field of White Molded Wheat.
#Cross the bridge in the main chamber and locate the [[SR:Horse Right Back Leg|Horse Right Back Leg]] between the fields of Sickly Green Wheat and Orange-Encrusted Wheat.
#Locate the [[SR:Horse Left Front Leg|Horse Left Front Leg]] up on a pedestal along the southern wall of the main chamber.
#Place harvested samples of the six special wheat varieties in the depositors to open the chamber containing the [[SR:Conduit Control Gem|Conduit Control Gem]] and grab the [[SR:Horse Head|Horse Head]] found within.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Broken Horse===

Unlike most quests added by [[SR:Creation Club|Creation Club]], this one does not automatically begin upon installing [[Skyrim:Forgotten Seasons|Forgotten Seasons]]. Instead, you must travel to the entrance of [[SR:Runoff Caverns|Runoff Caverns]], which will already be marked on your map. Outside, you will find a "Broken Dwarven Horse", a metallic Dwarven torso lying partially submerged in a stream. Activate this object to begin the quest, which will task you with assembling the pieces to reconstruct this strange equine [[Skyrim:Dwarven Automatons|construct]].

All of the parts are in the Autumn's Bells section of Runoff Caverns, which is found deep inside, within the Dwarven ruins of Vardnknd. You will need to traverse the entirety of the Runoff Caverns section of the dungeon to reach the hub area at Vardnknd Gallery. The entrance to Autumn's Bells is in this central chamber.
[[File:SR-quest-The Dwarven Horse 02.jpg|thumb|right|The horse head sitting on a pile of gold]]
===Exploring the Ruins===
All of the Dwarven items needed to reconstruct the horse are zero weight due to being [[SR:Quest Items|quest items]], so you needn't worry about getting them back out of the ruins. They will not be marked on your map until you get close, meaning you may need to scour the area to find them all. You will need to locate five in total:
*The first part of the horse is easy to find: it is the [[SR:Horse Right Front Leg|Horse Right Front Leg]] next to the dead [[SR:Mercenary|mercenary]] in the entrance hallway of Autumn's Bells. You will likely come across this mercenary while completing the [[SR:Forgotten Seasons (quest)|Forgotten Seasons]] quest.
*The [[SR:Horse Left Back Leg|Horse Left Back Leg]] is in the main chamber, near the field of White Molded Wheat. It is on the east side of the collapsed tower (behind a chest).
*The [[SR:Horse Right Back Leg|Horse Right Back Leg]] is on the other side of the main chamber, which will necessitate crossing the bridge in the center. It's under a collapsed building to the south from the Sickly Green Wheat.
*The [[SR:Horse Left Front Leg|Horse Left Front Leg]] is up on a pedestal along the southern wall of the main chamber.
*The final piece of the horse will necessitate completing the Autumn's Bells puzzle. This can be done by harvesting samples of the six special wheat varieties found growing in the chamber and placing them in the depositors located back near the field of Glowing Red Wheat. Once all six wheat varieties have been deposited, the chamber containing the [[SR:Conduit Control Gem|Conduit Control Gem]] will be unlocked; the [[SR:Horse Head|Horse Head]] lies on a pile of gold within.

===Reward===
With all five pieces assembled, you can return to the surface and activate the broken torso once again. Doing so will create a functioning [[SR:Dwarven Horse|Dwarven Horse]], which can be ridden as a mount. It takes no damage whatsoever; you can stay mounted on it and avoid all harm.

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Enter the Vardnknd Gallery section of [[SR:Runoff Caverns|Runoff Caverns]] and retrieve the [[SR:Dwarven Crown|Dwarven Crown]] from [[SR:Elberon|Elberon]]'s body.
#Locate the [[SR:Dwarven Autumn Visage|Dwarven Autumn Visage]] in a side room the Autumn's Bells section of the dungeon.
#Locate the [[SR:Dwarven Spring Visage|Dwarven Spring Visage]] down a long side passage in the Spring's Symphony section of the dungeon.
#Locate the [[SR:Dwarven Winter Visage|Dwarven Winter Visage]] in a hidden area in the Winter's Chimes area of the dungeon, accessible by means of a sloping pipe.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Crown of Legend===
You must travel to [[SR:Runoff Caverns#Vardnknd Gallery|Vardnknd Gallery]], the second section of [[SR:Runoff Caverns|Runoff Caverns]], a dungeon which will already be marked on your map. Once you enter this section of the dungeon, a wizard named [[SR:Elberon|Elberon]] will be struck by lightning, dying instantly. This quest will then begin, prompting you to loot Elberon's corpse for his strange [[SR:Dwarven Crown|Dwarven Crown]].

Once you've obtained the Crown, you will be prompted to search for three masks which can be slotted into the headpiece. All three of these can be found within the dungeon in their corresponding areas, although they are designed to be well-hidden and therefore may take a bit of exploration to find.

===Mask of Autumn===
The [[SR:Dwarven Autumn Visage|Dwarven Autumn Visage]] is located in the [[SR:Runoff Caverns#Autumn's Bells|Autumn's Bells]] section of Runoff Caverns. Head east after entering the main chamber until you find the bridge over the ravine; after crossing the bridge, go north along the brick road and it will lead you straight to the entrance to the corridor that leads to the mask.

===Mask of Spring===
The [[SR:Dwarven Spring Visage|Dwarven Spring Visage]] is located in the [[SR:Runoff Caverns#Spring's Symphony|Spring's Symphony]] section of Runoff Caverns. It is located at the end of a side hallway accessible through a door a short way into the chamber. However, the door is locked; the key is held by the [[Skyrim:Blooming Spriggan Matron|Blooming Spriggan Matron]] boss at the end of the section. The hallway is partially filled with a green miasma, so the [[SR:Dwarven Drone Fly|Dwarven Drone Fly]] you obtain in the room on your right just before you jump out of this section might prove useful.

===Mask of Winter===
The [[SR:Dwarven Winter Visage|Dwarven Winter Visage]] is found in the [[SR:Runoff Caverns#Winter's Chimes|Winter's Chimes]] section of Runoff Caverns, in a hidden area that can be challenging to find. It is located in the second section, after you make the first jump. It is off the short hallway containing [[SR:Frosted Dwarven Spider|Frosted Dwarven Spider]]s, through a Dwarven gate that is raised above ground level. The gate must be reached by climbing up a bank of snow and a sloped Dwarven pipe (as pictured above). From the gate, you must dive into the water through a short underwater passage to access the section. Once you have navigated to the chamber containing the mask, you will be attacked by a powerful [[SR:Frosted Dwarven Centurion|Frosted Dwarven Centurion]] which uses frost attacks.

===Forging the Crown===
The masks can be worn on their own, but you can make their effects more powerful by affixing one to the crown. Take the crown, a mask, and two [[Skyrim:Leather Strip|leather strips]] to any forge or anvil, and you can craft the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Crown of Autumn|Dwarven Crown of Autumn]], the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Crown of Spring|Dwarven Crown of Spring]], or the [[Skyrim:Dwarven Crown of Winter|Dwarven Crown of Winter]]. You can only have one of these at a time, but you can swap them out with each other at a forge as often as you like, only costing you two leather strips each time.

==Notes==
*There is no Dwarven Summer Visage.

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Kill the [[Skyrim:Thief (The Gray Cowl Returns!)|thief]] in [[SR:Riften|Riften]] graveyard and read his [[Skyrim:Thief's Note|note]].
#Speak to any [[Skyrim:Beggars|beggar]] and break into the strongbox in [[SR:Bolli's House|Bolli's House]].
#Obtain the [[SR:Land Title and Deed|deed]] from [[SR:Erikur's House|Erikur's House]] and find the barrel behind [[SR:The Winking Skeever|The Winking Skeever]].
#Locate the [[SR:Silverdrift Chest Key|key]] in [[SR:Silverdrift Lair|Silverdrift Lair]] and retrieve the [[SR:Ancestral Sword of Clan Ice-Blade|Ancestral Sword of Clan Ice-Blade]].
#Bring the deed and the sword back to the Riften graveyard for your reward.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Gray Cowl===
To begin this quest, you must make your way to the [[SR:Riften|Riften]] graveyard and defend yourself from a confused [[Skyrim:Thief (The Gray Cowl Returns!)|thief]] who will attack you on sight (or, if the guards see him before you do, they may kill him and you will get the quest notification to loot his body before you ever found him). He has apparently come to the graveyard following rumors that the Gray Fox, the legendary leader of the [[SR:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], is buried there together with the [[SR:Gray Cowl of Nocturnal|Gray Cowl]], a Daedric artifact stolen from [[SR:Nocturnal|Nocturnal]] herself. Kill the thief and read the [[Skyrim:Thief's Note|note]] on his body to learn that he was an acquaintance of the previous Gray Fox, who had died and therefore passed on his Cowl. It seems this thief had the same idea as you and sought to check the grave. The note also mentions a code phrase to use on the town [[Skyrim:Beggars|beggars]]: "Shadow hide you."

Track down either [[SR:Edda|Edda]] or [[SR:Snilf|Snilf]] and say the phrase to be passed a [[Skyrim:Stranger's Note|note]] from a Stranger. This individual is offering you a job, provided you can break into the strongbox upstairs in [[SR:Bolli's House|Bolli's House]] for further instructions. You can try to [[Skyrim:Speech|Persuade]] or Intimidate his wife [[SR:Nivenor|Nivenor]] into giving you the [[SR:Nivenor's Strongbox Key|key]] by telling her a thief planted something inside, or you can just pick the lock yourself. Within, you will find a [[SR:Forged Deed|forged deed]], ''[[SR:Nivenor's Journal|Nivenor's Journal]]'', and ''[[SR:Stranger's Instructions|Stranger's Instructions]]''. You can also find a note labeled ''[[Skyrim:Requested Report|Requested Report]]'' on an end table in his house for more insight to what is happening. You will need to read the instructions to begin the next stage of the job.

===The Solitude Job===
You are instructed to take the forged deed to [[SR:Solitude|Solitude]] and break into [[SR:Erikur's House|Erikur's House]], where you will steal the real [[SR:Land Title and Deed|land title and deed]] and replace it with the fake one. However, with a little snooping around the house, you will be pointed towards a ''[[SR:Letter to Gisli|Letter to Gisli]]'', which reveals that [[SR:Gisli|Gisli]] and her associates used a young boy as a political puppet in [[Lore:Jehanna|Jehanna]] to approve land transfers as the most senior member of the Ice-Blade clan, before shipping him off to Riften. If you confront Gisli with this information, you can offer to buy the deed off her for 8,000 gold, or you can attempt to Persuade her with high [[SR:Speech|Speech]] skill, without ever needing the forged document. You can also simply pickpocket her.
[[File:SR-quest-The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal.jpg|thumb|right|A stranger in the flesh]]
Once you have the original deed in hand, head to a barrel behind [[SR:The Winking Skeever|The Winking Skeever]] for your next set of instructions. ''[[SR:Stranger's Final Instructions|Stranger's Final Instructions]]'' promises to introduce you to the Gray Fox if you enter [[SR:Silverdrift Lair|Silverdrift Lair]] and recover the [[SR:Ancestral Sword of Clan Ice-Blade|Ancestral Sword of Clan Ice-Blade]]. The sword can be found in a locked chest deep inside the dungeon. Though you can just pick open the lock, you can find the [[SR:Silverdrift Chest Key|key]] in the next room to the north on the body of a dead [[SR:Draugr|draugr]]. This corpse is distinguished by a lit lantern placed behind it, as well as two "Loot" [[Skyrim:Shadowmarks (Thieves Guild)|shadowmarks]] above it. The chest also contains a [[SR:The Sword of Clan Ice-Blade|document]] describing the sword, as well as boss-level loot. You do not have to continue exploring Silverdrift Lair.

===Meeting with a Stranger===
After you have exited the dungeon with the Ancestral Sword, you will need to return to the Riften graveyard and locate the Gray Fox's tombstone. There, you will find the ''[[SR:Stranger's Journal|Stranger's Journal]]'', revealing that the current Gray Fox is in fact the true heir of the Ice-Blade clan. After Gisli's associates poisoned his sister and endangered her orphan son, he knew he had to pass on the Cowl to someone else and return to his old life. The journal ends there, but after reading it you will be immediately confronted by none other than the [[SR:Stranger|Gray Fox]] himself. He will take the sword and the deed from your possession, granting you the [[Skyrim:Gray Cowl of Nocturnal|Gray Cowl of Nocturnal]] in return. Having passed on the mantle, the Stranger's true identity is revealed to be [[SR:Pjofr Ice-Blade|Pjofr Ice-Blade]], accompanied by his now-rescued nephew [[SR:Smaref Ice-Blade|Smaref Ice-Blade]]. On the promise that you not breathe a word of these events to anyone, Pjofr and his charge depart for Jehanna, leaving you with a powerful enchanted [[SR:Light Armor|light]] [[Skyrim:helmet|helmet]].

Just be sure not to equip the Cowl in the middle of town, as it will turn all [[Skyrim:Guards|guards]] hostile if they see you wearing it.

==Notes==
*This quest would originally begin automatically upon installing [[Skyrim:The Gray Cowl Returns!|The Gray Cowl Returns!]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. This was changed with the [[SR:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]] update.
*The thief may be attacked and killed by a patrolling guard off screen without your involvement. That makes the quest appear to start randomly by itself. In that case, just go to the graveyard and locate the body by yourself.
*Using some Thief skills such as Pickpocketing and Lockpicking will cause you to fail Optional objectives to use Speech (Bribery, Persuasion, or Intimidation) with Nivenor and Gisli. Similarly, in Silverdrift Lair, the quest objective is shown to be the chest, which you encounter before finding the relevant corpse.
*The Ancestral Sword never goes into Pjofr Ice-Blade's inventory, so you can't see if it is more powerful when equipped by its rightful owner.

#Locate the Oblivion Gate. #(Optional) Wear a set of Mythic Dawn robes. #Defeat [[Skyrim:Vonos|Vonos]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-The Cause 02.jpg|left|thumb|Ambush at the shrine]][[File:SR-quest-The Cause 03.jpg|right|thumb|The Mythic Dawn camp]] This quest will start once you reach level 46. (but actually get to level 46 don’t cheat levels. This will make the quest nearly impossible.) A courier delivers the ''[[Skyrim:Stranger's Plea|Stranger's Plea]]'' to you to read. It is a request to meet from Skorvild, an ex-Mythic Dawn cultist who turned away from the cult and needs help stopping their next nefarious plan. Travel to [[Skyrim:Shrine of Stendarr#The Two Pillars|the Two Pillars]], which is near the center of Whiterun Hold's tundra, south of Swindler's Den and northeast of Broken Fang Cave. It is close to and within sight of the Shrine of Zenithar to the west. Sadly for Skorvild, his former cult-mates will catch up with him before he can speak with you. Once you arrive at the shrine you will spot the body of [[Skyrim:Skorvild|Skorvild]], and two Mythic Dawn assassins will attack you. Once you have killed the assassins, loot their bodies for the ''[[Skyrim:Mythic Dawn Orders|Mythic Dawn Orders]]'', and then search Skorvild for his [[Skyrim:Skorvild's Journal|journal]]. You will then need to head to the Mythic Dawn Camp to investigate. The camp itself is found north of the [[Skyrim:Alchemist's Shack|Alchemist's Shack]]. The camp has three hostile [[Skyrim:Mythic Dawn Explorer|Mythic Dawn explorers]]. Once they are dispatched you can pick up the ''[[Skyrim:Excavation Leader's Journal|Excavation Leader's Journal]]''. The journal explains that the Mythic Dawn are attempting to reopen an Oblivion gate, and have been excavating across the valley to the south in the Jerall Mountains for a powerful artifact that will help them do it. {{NewLine}} ===Varlais Cavern and Rielle=== [[File:SR-interior-Rielle 10.jpg|right|thumb|Vanus and the other dead Mythic Dawn]] Travel to [[Skyrim:Varlais Cavern|Varlais Cavern]], which can be found south of [[Skyrim:Arcwind Point|Arcwind Point]]. As you enter the cavern, you will find an excavation site inside that has cracked open an entrance to the Ayleid ruins of [[Skyrim:Rielle|Rielle]]. There are [[Skyrim:Ayleid Cask|Ayleid casks]] and [[Skyrim:Ayleid Urn|urns]] that can be looted throughout the chambers. As you get deeper into the ruin, you will enter a large room with the corpses of cultists and the corpse of [[Skyrim:Janus|Janus]], there are [[Skyrim:Wight|wights]] patrolling so be prepared for a fight. After reading the journal, you will need to locate the elemental stones: *[[Skyrim:The_Cause_Items#Miscellaneous_Items|Elemental Shard - Wel]], found on the corpse of a Mythic Dawn Explorer *[[Skyrim:The_Cause_Items#Miscellaneous_Items|Elemental Shard - Sercen]], carried by a Wight Lord *[[Skyrim:The_Cause_Items#Miscellaneous_Items|Elemental Shard - Nen]], carried by a Wight Lord just before the door to [[Skyrim:Rielle#Rielle Crypt|Rielle Crypt]] *[[Skyrim:The_Cause_Items#Miscellaneous_Items|Elemental Shard - Alata]], carried by a Wight Lord in Rielle Crypt [[File:SR-quest-The Cause 04.jpg|right|thumb|The shard holders]] Once you have found all the shards, you will need to head deeper into the ruins to find the shard holders, take care to avoid the traps. When it comes to placing the elemental shards in the holders you need to place them in specific holders: *Wel goes in the '''North''' holder *Sercen goes in the '''South''' holder *Nen goes in the '''West''' holder *Alata goes in the '''East''' holder Once you have placed the shards, a secret door will open and reveal a large room with a [[Skyrim:Great Welkynd Stone|Great Welkynd Stone]]. Take the stone and [[Skyrim:Norion the Undying|Norion the Undying]], an [[Skyrim:Ayleid Lich|Ayleid Lich]] with as much power as a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|Dragon Priest]], will burst out of his coffin. Beware his minions, including two [[Skyrim:Wight|Wight]] archers who sleep in the coffins upstairs on either side of the room. Once Norion is killed you can search his body for the [[Skyrim:Staff of Ehlno Ede|Staff of Ehlno Ede]] and the [[Skyrim:Rielle Key|Rielle key]]. You will be directed to defeat Norion once you take the Great Welkynd Stone even if you have already noticed Norion and woke him with a rune spell to defeat him early. Go back to the room where you placed the four stones. At the south part of that room there is a small dead-end room where you can find a switch that opens the way out. Head back into the main area of Rielle, where you will see Vigilants of Stendarr (including Vigil Enforcers if the [[Skyrim:Vigil Enforcer Armor Set|Vigil Enforcer Armor Set]] Creation has been installed) fighting with Mythic Dawn agents. You can aid the Vigilants against the Mythic Dawn. Once you get back to the entrance of Rielle, there is a corpse of a Vigil Enforcer that has a [[Skyrim:Vigilant Enforcer's Journal|journal]], read the journal and you will find out that the location of the Oblivion gate is in [[Skyrim:Red Scar Cavern|Red Scar Cavern]]. Note: If you choose to wear Mythic Dawn Robes while exiting Rielle, the Vigilants outside will mistake you for a Mythic Dawn member and attack. If you do not wear the robes, they will let you pass. {{NewLine}} ===Red Scar Cavern=== [[File:SR-quest-The Cause 06.jpg|right|thumb|Vonos]] There is a Mythic Dawn Guard outside of the cavern that can be tricked if you wear a set of Mythic Dawn robes, if you wish to avoid fighting. This will also work on the cultists inside. Continue through the cavern and you will eventually reach a door to the [[Skyrim:Mythic Dawn Temple|Mythic Dawn Temple]]. Once inside the temple, you will see an inactive Oblivion gate, you will then have to kill [[Skyrim:Vonos|Vonos]]. Once you kill him however, the Oblivion gate will open, the quest will finish and [[Skyrim:The Consequences|The Consequences]] will begin. {{NewLine}} ==Bugs== {{Bug|The quest may start the first time you get a courier.|confirmed=1|dlc=CC}} {{Bug|Norion the Undying may be triggered before you take the Great Welkynd Stone, which allows you to kill him and prevents moving forward past objective 150. ==Quick Walkthrough==

#Inspect [[Skyrim:Vonos|Vonos]]' corpse and retrieve his journal.
#Read [[Skyrim:Vonos' Journal|Vonos' Journal]].
#Enter the Oblivion Gate.
#Defeat [[Skyrim:Valkyn Methats|Valkyn Methats]] and [[Skyrim:Valkyn Gatanas|Valkyn Gatanas]] and gather [[Skyrim:Torment|Torment]] and [[Skyrim:Scourge|Scourge]].
#Return to [[Lore:Skyrim|Skyrim]].
#Escape [[Skyrim:Red Scar Cavern|Red Scar Cavern]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
[[File:SR-interior-Red Scar Cavern.jpg|right|thumb|The portal is open]]
While delivering the killing blow to the leader of the [[Skyrim:Mythic Dawn|Mythic Dawn]], Vonos, you feel something has gone wrong. His death has triggered the opening of the Oblivion Gate. Search his body to find his journal and read it to uncover the whole story and find you've been used to become the unwitting instrument of [[Lore:Mehrunes Dagon|Mehrunes Dagon]], resulting in the final opening of the gate. Enter the [[Skyrim:Deadlands|Deadlands]] by the portal to put an end to all of this.

In the Deadlands, aside from a strange flora and Fire Atronachs, you'll come across two powerful [[Skyrim:Daedra|Daedra]] wielding equally powerful artifacts, [[SR:Valkyn Methats|Valkyn Methats]] carries [[SR:Torment|Torment]], [[SR:Valkyn Gatanas|Valkyn Gatanas]] carries [[SR:Scourge|Scourge]] and [[SR:The Cause Items#Daedric Gauntlets of Negation|Daedric Gauntlets of Negation]]. They can be found by taking either of two forks in the road where it spans the lava pools. Beware the Spiddal Sticks flanking the right-hand path where it crosses the lava, as the poison Spiddal gas is difficult to avoid here. 

Kill Valkyn Gatanas and his [[Skyrim:Daedric Horse|Daedric Horse]] (at the end of the left path) to retrieve Scourge. In one of the containers behind them is the Summon Daedric Horse spell tome. 

Kill Valkyn Methats and his Flame Atronachs (found at the end of the right path, past the Spiddal Stick "gate") to retrieve Torment. This will put a stop to the invasion. Return to Tamriel and find a way out of Red Scar Cavern. This will complete the quest.

On your return to Tamriel, the Vigilants will be raiding the cavern and battling the Mythic Dawn a second time. If you attack either faction, they will become hostile.

==Notes==
*After the quest is complete, the Oblivion Gate still remains open, allowing you to return and harvest the new flora. The surviving Vigilants will stay guarding the place to make sure nothing comes out or any Mythic Dawn comes back.

Skyrim:Totems of Hircine.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=90.222.231.175 |rewardChecked=RobinHood70 }}{{Quest Header |type=Companions |addtrail=Radiant |Giver=[[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] |Reward=A Totem of Hircine, leveled gold |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Glory of the Dead|Glory of the Dead]] |Conc= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] |Image=SR-quest-Totems of Hircine.jpg |ImgDesc=The Totem of Brotherhood in its receptacle in the Underforge |description= Journey to the given location to find a Totem of Hircine. |ID=CR12 |Icon= |Radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Travel to the indicated location on your map. # Retrieve the Totem by any means necessary. # Return to the [[Skyrim:The Underforge|Underforge]], then use one of the totem receptacles to complete the quest and receive your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Accepting the Quest=== Asking [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]], ''"Is there any work to be done?"'' will prompt her to tell you about the Totems of Hircine. She will say that she has located one and would be honored if you go with her to retrieve it. If you accept the quest, she will become your Shield-Sister and will replace your current companion. ===Retrieve the Totem of Hircine=== [[File:SR-quest-Totems of Hircine 02.jpg|thumb|right|Aela prays to the Totem]] Journey to the location given by Aela and kill the enemies lurking around. The location is [[Skyrim:Radiant|radiant]], and it can be any [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Animal Dens|animal den]], [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Vampire Lairs|vampire lair]], or [[:Category:Skyrim-Places-Warlock Lairs|warlock lair]] with a boss chest. The totem is most often found in the boss chest. Once you have the totem, Aela will approach and ask if you have it. When you tell her you do, she will tell you to bring it back to the [[Skyrim:The Underforge|Underforge]]. When you return to the Underforge, place the totem on the marked area—the quest will finish and you will receive a leveled amount of gold. You can now pray to the totem to receive a new power while in [[Skyrim:Beast Form|Beast Form]], which replaces your old one. There are three total totems, each granting a different ability in Beast Form. ===Reward=== {{SRCompanionsRadiantReward}} ==The Totems of Hircine== [[File:SR-item-Totems of Hircine.jpg|thumb|right|Left to Right: Totem of the Hunt, Totem of Fear, Totem of Brotherhood]] The totems are described in detail in the tome, ''[[Skyrim:The Totems of Hircine|The Totems of Hircine]]''. By praying to these totems, you will be given a unique ability that replaces the older Howl of Terror; it is activated by pressing the shout button while in [[Skyrim:Beast Form|beast form]]. All abilities last for 60 seconds, though the duration can be increased by 15 seconds by equipping the [[Skyrim:Ring of the Moon|Ring of the Moon]]{{DB}} before activating Beast Mode. *'''Totem of Fear''': Causes [[Skyrim:Fear (spell)|Fear]] *'''Totem of Brotherhood''': Summons 2 [[Skyrim:Pack Member|Pack Members]] *'''Totem of The Hunt''': Grants [[Skyrim:Detect Life (effect)|Detect Life]] {{NewLine}} ==Notes== {{Dragonborn Radiant Location Note}} * The location you are sent to may be an already "cleared" location, even if there are other non-cleared locations of the same type yet to be cleared or even discovered: the game does not, in this case, appear to prioritize new locations over known locations. * You can only trigger this quest if you are still a [[Skyrim:Werewolf|werewolf]]. If you have purified yourself, you are unable to do this quest. * If Whiterun is under attack, you cannot enter the [[Skyrim:The Underforge|Underforge]] until Whiterun is back to normal. It will tell you a key is needed to enter and that it cannot be lockpicked. * At the end of this quest, Aela will begin praying to the new totem in the Underforge. It is possible to ask her to follow you while she is praying; her dialogue will change, and she will allow you access to her inventory, but will not stop praying or move away from the totem. * Aela will not give these quests while she is an active follower, though she will give Animal Extermination quests. * As you and Aela recover each totem, once she tells you to return the totem to the Underforge, speaking to her will only cause her to say ''"This is not the time for talk. Let's get to the Underforge and see what this can do.''" You also won't be able to ask her for training in [[Skyrim:Archery|Archery]] until then. * If you have just dropped off a totem in the Underforge, Aela will be praying to it and only offer an Animal Extermination quest (dialogue option, ''"I'm looking for work"''). Leave the Underforge, return, then talk to Aela again. Repeat until Aela (still in prayer) offers the next totem quest (dialogue, ''"Is there any work to be done?"''). * This quest is considered by the game as 1 even if it appears 3 times in the journal (once for each totem). This means that the counter for "Quests Completed" and "The Companions Quests Completed" will permanently increase by 1 only by the end of the third quest (it appears as increased by 1 every time you complete one of the three quests, but it will drop back in a few in-game cell loadings). ==Bugs== {{Bug|Although you receive the message that she has replaced your current follower, Aela might not replace them but instead join as a secondary follower, lacking the standard follower dialogue options.}} **This bug was observed with [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] (after completion of [[Skyrim:Kindred Judgment|Kindred Judgment]] and cured of vampirism) as primary follower, so it may be due to an interaction with her unique framework. {{Bug|If you've completed [[Skyrim:A Daedra's Best Friend|A Daedra's Best Friend]], you may be taken to Haemar's Cavern and your system can lock up when entering Haemar's Shame. You won't be able to complete the quest and will have Aela as a follower, but with no dialogue options.|OSP|1.4}} *{{Bug|This also seems to happen if the totem is located in Morvunskar, and [[Skyrim:A Night To Remember|A Night To Remember]] has been completed. This can be worked around by carefully navigating around the point where the portal to the Misty Grove was placed earlier.|vn=1}} ** {{pc22}} This can be resolved by manually advancing the quest with the console command setstage cr12 20. {{Bug|Curing yourself of lycanthropy while this quest is active causes the Underforge door to become unresponsive. You cannot end the quest or get rid of Aela as a result. ** {{pc22}}You can finish the quest using the console command coc "WhiterunUnderForge" and placing the totem in its place, but Aela may stay inside, forcing you to use the command each time.|vn=1}} {{Bug|This quest may be unavailable if you marry Aela before all 3 totems are retrieved.|OSP|1.9}} {{Bug|Aela is supposed to comment on each totem you find with unique dialogue. She repeats the first one because the dialogue doesn't check the totem count variable.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|While recovering a totem located in [[Skyrim:Ansilvund|Ansilvund]], it is possible that one of the swinging axe traps may knock Aela through a hole in the map, rendering the quest un-fulfillable. Aela may reappear at a later time although the trigger is unknown. Common factors such as fast traveling and waiting are worth trying.|vn=1}} One method that has been found effective is to pray at one of the previously acquired totems. Aela may then appear at the entrance of the Underforge. {{Bug|If Aela won't give you the first totem quest, check the status of this quest with the console command sqs cr12. If both Stage 0 and Stage 1 are marked as completed (with a 1 behind the respective stage), use the console command resetquest cr12. It is recommended to do this after handing in an Animal Extermination quest but before asking for more work.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you do not complete all of the radiant quests of Aela the Huntress in the initial wave before advancing, you will be stuck doing Animal Extermination quests from her indefinitely, unable to collect the Totems of Hircine.|vn=1}} **{{Pc22}} Firstly, use the console command setstage CR12 1. Then, get an [[Skyrim:Animal Extermination (A)|Animal Extermination]] quest from Aela. Now use the console command setstage CR01 20 or setstage CR02 20 (depending on which version of the quest you're assigned), and return to Aela to finish the quest. Ask for work from her again and use the command setstage CR12 20 to complete the quest, and go to the Underforge to place the totem, which completes this quest. Repeat these steps 2 more times for the remaining 2 totems. The crucial part seems to be to Tab out of the conversation before Aela finishes her voiceline, when finishing the Animal Extermination quest. If you keep her dialogue open, she will have another Animal Extermination for you. If you close the dialogue before she finishes, she will have a dialogue for the Totems of Hircine quest. Alternatively, this can be fixed by marrying Aela, then again asking her for work after deciding on a place to live. {{vn|section=Animal Extermination}} {{Bug|If Aela is chosen as your wife, after completing a totem quest she will stay and pray at the totem and will not return home.|confirmed=1}} **{{Xbox22}} This can be fixed on Xbox 360: You need lots of healing and dual-casting master illusionist abilities. Have her as a follower, take away all her weapons and give her a cheap sword. Then punch her enough times to get her to attack you (heal yourself as needed). Go through the front exit so you are outside of Jorrvaskr... she should follow you out and continue to attack you. Lead her off a good ways at which point, Dual-cast Calm on her and immediately talk to her and have her re-join you. Test her compliance by drawing a weapon or spell (she should do likewise, not just stand there - if she doesn't draw, restart the process). Once she's drawn a weapon, fast-travel to another location. She should now act normally, and if a spouse or steward, should remain at other locations when dismissed. {{Bug|When obtaining the quest for the second totem, your quest marker may point to Jorrvaskr instead of the dungeon indicated in your quest log. The reason is that the quest item spawned on the floor in the main hall of Jorrvaskr instead of in the intended dungeon. The quest item will not be located anywhere in the dungeon indicated in the quest log.}} ** {{Pc22}} The item is located in an inaccessible cell within Jorrvaskr. By the way, this problem may also occur for another totem (e.g., the third instead of the second totem). Furthermore, the quest log may offer nothing more than the direction to go collect the totem. Anyway, to resolve this problem, open the console and type movetoqt CR12 which will move the player to a small interior unlighted cell after closing the console. The totem will be found on the ground. Pick up the totem to advance the quest. Next reopen the console and type player.moveto 1A697 and the player will now move to a position beside Aela the Huntress. She should then ask the player if he or she has the totem and the quest can now carry on as normal. {{Bug|Once you place the totems at their receptacles, praying at them may not affect you in any way.}} **Leave the Underforge then re-enter, wait 24 hours, or do another quest for Aela. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Aela has tracked one of the Totems of Hircine to , and has come with me to retrieve it. {{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the Totem of Hircine}} |20||Aela and I retrieved a Totem of Hircine from . {{Quest Objective|20|Take the Totem to the Underforge}} |200|fin| |missing=0, 1, 100 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

==Quick Walkthrough==
#Speak to [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]] and ask to investigate the dig site.
#Recover [[Skyrim:Alethius|Alethius']] note.
#Find the expedition members and recover their journals.
#Re-activate Nchuand-Zel's automated defenses.
#Speak to [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]] about the expedition.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Proceed inside [[Skyrim:Nchuand-Zel|Nchuand-Zel]] until you encounter [[Skyrim:Nimhe|Nimhe]]. After killing [[Skyrim:Nimhe|Nimhe]], head up the steps to find the dead body of [[Skyrim:Alethius|Alethius]]. Pick up the [[Skyrim:Alethius's_Notes|notes]] next to his body to begin this quest.

Burn through the webbing behind his body with fire magic to enter [[Skyrim:Nchuand-Zel|Nchuand-Zel]]. In the first hallway there is a pressure pad that activates a [[Skyrim:Spear_Trap|spear trap]]. Continuing on, you will emerge into a huge open cavern with multiple levels, with [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]] standing guard on a few of the connecting walkways. At the end of the large walkway is the entrance to Nchuand-Zel Quarters.

In this zone, you will encounter quite a number of Falmer, usually in groups. After exiting the first corridor, there will be two ways to go: downstairs or straight ahead. Proceed straight ahead first. When you reach a second set of stairs, there is an adept-locked door to the right containing random leveled loot. At the bottom of these stairs is a large group of Falmer (around 4 - 5). Proceed through these corridors until you come across a large door. To the left of this door is a small room with a bunch of Dwemer items. The door leads to a small balcony overlooking Nchuand-Zel, and also contains a chest with random leveled loot. Head back inside Nchuand-Zel Quarters.

===Nchuand-Zel Quarters===

Head back to the first set of descending stairs you encountered after coming into the Quarters and proceed down them. You will encounter more Falmer along the way. Head up some stairs, making sure to avoid the rune trap at the top, and you will notice a table to the right against a wall. On this table is ''[[Skyrim:Stromm's Diary|Stromm's Diary]]'', which you will need for the quest. After picking this up, you will be tasked to collect three other journals: [[Skyrim:Erj's_Notes|Erj's]], [[Skyrim:Krag's_Journal|Krag's]] and [[Skyrim:Staubin's_Diary|Staubin's]]. In the area to the left of this table are the actual Living Quarters, where you will find many Dwemer items, as well as beds you can sleep in. Head back out and past the table until you get to what looks to be a torture room. On the left-hand side of the doorway (as you enter the room) is a lever. Pulling it activates the spike trap on the table next to you. Now head back out to the door where you entered the Quarters from.

Backtrack a short distance until you have to turn right (which faces you towards the entrance of the zone). Instead of turning right, head to the left where a ramp will lead you to a lower level. You will notice the balcony you arrived at earlier when heading down this ramp. At the bottom, there are two ways to go. Heading left leads you to a platform a Falmer is (or was) standing on. Instead, go straight down the next ramp which will lead you to the bottom of the area. An adept level gate on your right holds a chest with random loot. Head down the path away from the gate. The path leads to a body of water, so head in and start swimming around to the left until you see another ramp (underwater) leading to a door, which leads to Nchuand-Zel Armory. Enter it. (Note: It is possible to get here by jumping off any of the bridges you have been traversing, or by jumping off the balcony from earlier).

===Nchuand-Zel Armory===

Upon entering the Armory, there are two ways to go: down the corridor or up the stairs. Head through the corridor first. Soon you will come across an adept locked gate, and upon unlocking you will have to go up some stairs. At the top of the stairs is a dead Falmer and [[Skyrim:Erj|Erj's]] body, along with his diary and a chest containing random loot. The first room to the left at the top of the stairs has nothing of interest, but the second room to the left has an expert-locked gate which leads to a chest with some random loot. Across from that gate is another expert-locked gate with a full set of [[Skyrim:Dwarven_Armor|Dwarven armor]]. Upon approaching the next gate, a Falmer appears and a [[Skyrim:Dwarven_Sphere|Dwarven Sphere]] awakens and does battle with it. The next gate has nothing of interest and after that is another corridor. The pressure plate ahead of you will activate a spear trap behind you. The next pressure plate up the stairs activates a [[Skyrim:Flame_Spout_Trap|flame spout trap]] behind you. After this, there will be two ways to go. Head right. A Falmer is keeping watch ahead of you. Just ahead of him are the stairs you saw when first entering this area (heading through the corridor instead of the steps guarantees you will avoid the traps should you stand on a pressure plate). Head back and go the other way, which brings you to a door leading to Nchuand-Zel.

Upon going through the door, you will immediately come across [[Skyrim:Krag|Krag's]] body and his journal. Head up the ramp (past an [[Skyrim:Imperial_Legion|Imperial soldier's]] corpse) which brings you to the final zone: Nchuand-Zel Control. The rocky ramp to the right of the door serves as a shortcut back to the entrance of the ruin.

===Nchuand-Zel Control===

After entering the door, continue through the corridor, encountering more Falmer along the way. A pressure plate just before the upwards ramp activates an [[Skyrim:Dart_Trap|dart trap]], so either avoid it or wait until it finishes. At the end of the corridor at the top of the ramp are two more Falmer; you will want to attack the one on the right first as it magic-based in combat. The other has both a bow and a sword. The pressure plate in the middle of this corridor activates a spike trap from the ceiling. Be careful of this if you have a follower, as he or she is likely to trigger this trap; even if your follower is essential/permanent, the spikes can kill him or her if they are still going while he/she is crouched. At the end of the corridor, turn left and you will see [[Skyrim:Staubin|Staubin's]] body and his journal, along with a damaged Dwarven Spider. Picking up the final journal grants you a new objective: Re-activate Nchuand-Zel's defenses. 

Head past the body and up the steps where you will encounter some Dwarven constructs. At first, there should only be a few Dwarven Spider Workers, but fighting them awakens a couple of Dwarven Spheres. Fighting these can draw the attention of a Falmer, if it was not defeated before the Spheres turned their focus towards you.  Continue to the end and you will reach a room with a table and a chest. On top of the table is a leveled healing potion, a Falmer Bow, and a lever. Pulling the lever completes the objective and opens up the gate behind you, so head through. Through the gate and at the end of the corridor is a chest. Now just jump off the bridge to end up back at the entrance door.

Upon exiting, you will see a Dwarven automaton fighting a Falmer. This is actually happening all throughout the ruin. Feel free to stay and join the fight, or just head up the ramp to the left and back to the entrance of Nchuand-Zel. Head back to Understone Keep and talk to Calcelmo to receive your reward and finish the quest. Your arrow may point back to the Armory at this point; see "Bugs".

=== Reward ===
{{SRLeveledReward|Large}}

==Bugs==
{{Bug|If you collect Krag's journal before you get the quest, you won't be prompted for getting Krag's journal, but you can still complete the quest.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|After pulling the lever at the end of the quest, the quest arrow may point to the armory. If it does, just head back to Calcelmo and the quest arrow should reset itself when you exit Nchuand-Zel.|confirmed=1}}
{{Bug|If you take a follower with you, that follower will not be able to take the "short cut" with you back to Nchuand-Zel's entrance after you reactivate the defenses, as NPCs cannot jump down off the ledge overlooking the exit path. The follower will run back to the upper armory door instead, trying to reach you the long way around.|USKP|1.3.2}}
**A workaround is to jump into the water and the follower will follow. It is then possible to climb the spiral ramp back to the exit level.
**Alternatively, before jumping down onto the exit path yourself, order your follower to wait at the end of the ledge. You can then use the weakest form of the Unrelenting Force shout to push your follower over the edge and onto the main path. Be careful not to use Unrelenting Force's full power or you are likely to send your follower flying into the water.
**You could also part ways with your follower before jumping off the ledge. They should be back home upon exiting.
{{Bug|You may not be able to get through the webbing behind Alethius.|confirmed=1}}
** Move the body further from the webbing and try again.
** Use concentration spells like Flames on the webbing.
{{Bug|In patched versions of the game, reading any of the journals when they are on the ground will automatically give you a copy of them. If you then choose to "Take" the journal, you will end up with two copies. The quest can still be completed as normal, and both copies can be dropped after it is completed.|USKP|1.3.2}}
{{Bug|[[Skyrim:Nimhe|Nimhe]] may respawn in the time it takes you to complete this quest and return to the excavation site; this does not affect the quest so you can just run past her.|USKP|2.0.0}}
{{Bug|After killing [[Skyrim:Nimhe|Nimhe]], you may not be able to cut through the entrance to the chambers beyond (webbing treated as solid object). You may need to launch an earlier saved game.|}}
** The game may be treating your swings as hitting Alesius' body. Try dragging him further away from the webbing or using fire spells.
{{Bug|If you happen to read and pick up any or all of the three journals before Stromm's, the game may not remember this, even though they are now in your inventory, and you will be unable to complete the quest normally: that is, without console commands.|USKP|2.0.4}}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Thornskyfiona }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]] |Reward=Leveled gold |Disp= =1 ([[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]])
=1 ([[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]]) |Next=[[Skyrim:The Wolf Queen Awakened|The Wolf Queen Awakened]], [[Skyrim:Elisif's Tribute|Elisif's Tribute]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]], [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] |Image=SR-quest-The_Man_Who_Cried_Wolf_04.jpg |ImgDesc=Welcome to [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]] |description=Investigate reports of strange happenings in [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]]. |ID=MS06Start |Icon= |Difficulty=Easy |SuggLevel=8 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Talk to [[SR:Varnius Junius|Varnius Junius]] or [[SR:Elisif the Fair|Elisif the Fair]] or [[SR:Sybille Stentor|Sybille Stentor]] or [[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]] in the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. #Travel to [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]]. #Stop the ritual to summon [[Lore:Potema|Potema]]. #Return to Falk Firebeard. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Messenger=== In [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], the [[Skyrim:Corpulus_Vinius|innkeeper]] and residing [[Skyrim:Lisette|bard]] at the [[Skyrim:The Winking Skeever|Winking Skeever]] will all tell you about a scared [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]] resident who recently arrived to ask [[Skyrim:Elisif the Fair|Jarl Elisif]] for help. They will not reveal anything else, so head to the [[Skyrim:Blue Palace|Blue Palace]], where you will witness [[Skyrim:Varnius Junius|Varnius Junius]] trying to convince Elisif that the inexplicable disappearances and strange occurrences near [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]] should be taken seriously. While Elisif tries her best to calm the near hysterical Varnius, her [[Skyrim:Sybille Stentor|court wizard]] and [[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|steward]] will both disregard the claims: [[File:SR-quest-The_Man_Who_Cried_Wolf_03.jpg|thumb|right|"''Haafingar's people will always be safe under my rule.''"]] '''Varnius''': ''"I swear to you, unnatural magics are coming from that cave! There are strange noises and lights! We need someone to investigate!"''
'''Elisif''': ''"Then we will immediately send out a legion to scour the cave and secure the town. Haafingar's people will always be safe under my rule."''
'''Varnius''': ''"Th...thank you, my Jarl thank you."''
'''Sybille''': ''"Your eminence, my scrying has suggested nothing in the area. Dragon Bridge is under imperial control. This is likely superstitious nonsense."''
'''Falk''': ''"Perhaps a more... tempered reaction... might be called for?"''
'''Elisif''': ''"Oh. Yes, of course you are right. Falk, tell [[Skyrim:Captain Aldis|Captain Aldis]] I said to assign a few extra soldiers to Dragon Bridge."''
'''Varnius''': ''"Thank you, Jarl Elisif. But about the cave..."''
'''Falk''': ''"I will have someone take care of the cave as well Varnius, you can rest easy. You're dismissed."'' After the court has acknowledged his claims, Varnius Junius will be relieved and leave the castle, unaware that nobody plans on doing anything to solve his problem. Speak to Varnius Junius or Elisif the Fair or Sybille Stentor, either will lead you to Falk Firebeard, who will admit he thinks Varnius is overreacting and that he has his hands full dealing with the recent murder of [[Skyrim:High King Torygg|High King Torygg]], the grieving Elisif, and the ongoing war. Offer to take a look at Wolfskull Cave for him, and he will gladly accept. ===Wolfskull Cave=== Wolfskull Cave is located due west of Solitude and north of the [[Skyrim:Statue_to_Meridia|Statue to Meridia]]. As you arrive, two [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]] will guard the entrance, hinting at darker things to come. Enter the cave and proceed through the first chamber. Before long, you will be attacked by hordes of leveled [[Skyrim:Necromancer|necromancers]], all keen on protecting their secret. As you progress, leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] and more skeletons will attack. In the third chamber, you will arrive at a pit, and will have no choice but jump in. Take the northern tunnel and enter [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Ruins|Wolfskull Ruins]]. [[File:SR-quest-The Man Who Cried Wolf.jpg|thumb|right|''"We summon Potema!"'']] As you enter, it quickly becomes clear that something is very wrong in the cave; blue beams of light spear across the room and chanting voices can be heard: '''[[Skyrim:Ritual Master|Ritual Master]]''': ''"Wolf Queen. Hear our call and awaken. We summon Potema!"''
'''Necromancers''': ''"We summon Potema!"''
'''Ritual Master''': ''"Long have you slept the dreamless sleep of death, Potema. No longer. Hear us Wolf Queen! We Summon You!"''
'''Necromancers''': ''"We summon Potema!"'' Take a look from the ledge and you'll notice that the blue lights all lead to the same platform, high above ground level. Backtrack a bit and locate the tunnel leading west. The chamber ahead is covered in [[Skyrim:Oil Slick|oil]], so use it to your advantage against the patrolling necromancer. ===The Wolf Queen=== Back in the main chamber, there are stairs leading further down and enemies will attack. Fight your way to ground level and enter the ruin where a set of stairs will lead back up. As you make your way upstairs, it becomes apparent that the necromancer's ritual is about to go wrong, as [[Lore:Potema|Potema]] will shout: [[File:SR-quest-The_Man_Who_Cried_Wolf_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Summoned with words. Bound by blood."'']] [[File:SR-quest-The_Man_Who_Cried_Wolf_05.jpg|thumb|right|Potema's escape]] '''Potema''': ''"Yes! Yes! Return me to this realm!"''
'''Ritual Master''': ''"As our voices summon you the blood of the innocent binds you Wolf Queen!"''
'''Necromancers''': ''"Summoned with words. Bound by blood."''
'''Potema''': ''"What! What are you doing?! You fools! You cannot bind me to your wills!"''
'''Necromancers''': ''"Summoned with words. Bound by blood."''
'''Potema''': ''"You ants don't have the power to bind me!"'' Keep going up one set of stairs after another, fighting the opposition on your way. As your reach the source of the blue light, the ritual master will speak once again: ''"Something is wrong. There is an intruder."'' As you climb the tower, an additional four necromancers will attack. At the top, you will find the ritual master busy performing the ritual to revive Potema. There is only one way to stop her. When she is dead, the blue light will disappear through a hole in the ceiling and everything will be quiet. Read the [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Refugees|The Refugees]]'' from the altar, then activate the lever to lower the drawbridge. Loot the chest on the other side and follow the path, a shortcut back to the first chamber of Wolfskull Cave. ===Falk Firebeard=== Back in the Blue Palace, busy castle steward Falk Firebeard will be curious to know whether you found anything other than [[Skyrim:Animals|wild animals]] and [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] in Wolfskull Cave. When you tell him that necromancers tried to resurrect [[Lore:Potema|Potema]], he will be shocked and will ask if you stopped them. At this point, you will have no choice but to tell him you interrupted the ritual and that it is done. He will then explain that you have done Solitude a larger service than you can imagine and reward you with a leveled amount of gold. However, Potema is far from defeated. After you level up at least once and wait a few days, a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] delivers a very concerned [[Skyrim:Letter_from_Falk_Firebeard|letter]] from Falk Firebeard, beginning the quest [[Skyrim:The Wolf Queen Awakened|The Wolf Queen Awakened]]. ==Notes== * Attacking the summoning circle will draw all enemies to you, even ones you missed at the base of the tower. * Killing the Ritual Master will unbind the Draugr and cause them to attack the Necromancers. * The voice actors for the necromancers are inconsistent with their pronunciation of Potema's name. Some pronounce it "poh-teh-ma" and others pronounce it "poh-tee-mah." * This quest is also a prerequisite for [[Skyrim:Elisif's Tribute|Elisif's Tribute]], which is required before Elisif will allow you to start the [[Skyrim:Thane of Haafingar|thane quest for Haafingar]]. * The opening conversation between Varnius and Elisif will not change even if not witnessed until after the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] have taken Solitude. Elisif will still mention Captain Aldis, who would have already disappeared from the game, and Sybille Stentor will still claim that Dragon Bridge is under Imperial control. *This quest changes the contents of [[Skyrim:Wolfskull Cave|Wolfskull Cave]] while it is active. This makes it impossible to clear Wolfskull Cave, and can also cause conflicts with any radiant quests that happen to send you to the cave, making it impossible to complete those quests. Therefore it is best to complete this quest as quickly as possible after triggering it. (See [[#Bugs|bugs]] for a workaround on clearing Wolfskull Cave). ==Bugs== {{Bug|Falk Firebeard always carries a copy of the [[Skyrim:Letter_from_Falk_Firebeard|letter]] which the [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] later gives you in order to begin [[Skyrim:The Wolf Queen Awakened|The Wolf Queen Awakened]]. It is possible to [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|pickpocket]] this letter before you even talk to Falk about Wolfskull Cave.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|In order to clear Wolfskull Cave, you must enter it before this quest is active and kill the bandit boss, who is in the ice cave section of the first zone.|USKP|2.0.4}} ** {{Pc22}} The cave can be reverted to its clearable form after the quest has been completed by opening the [[Skyrim:Console|console]] and entering the code "000ABAB7".disable. ** {{Pc22}} The cave can be manually set to "cleared" by entering the console command SetLocationCleared 000192c8 1. {{Bug|The quest may at times fail to advance to stage 15 when you enter the court, resulting in [[Skyrim:Varnius Junius|Varnius Junius]] and the rest of the court standing without interacting with each other, and when spoken to, will simply tell you not to interrupt the court. This seems to occur if any of the courtiers leave the Blue Palace before Varnius' audience begins. Jarl Elisif will leave the Blue Palace to take part in [[Skyrim:Season Unending|Season Unending]], [[Skyrim:Tending the Flames|Tending the Flames]], [[Skyrim:Battle for Solitude|Battle for Solitude]], [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|Bound Until Death]] and [[Skyrim:Diplomatic Immunity|Diplomatic Immunity]], and Erikur will also leave the palace for the latter two, so it is advisable to visit the Blue Palace before beginning any of these quests.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} You can use the console command setstage MS06Start 5 to force Varnius' audience to play out and start the quest. **{{Pc22}} Or setstage MS06Start 15 to skip just past his audience and also start the quest. **Killing [[Skyrim:Sybille Stentor|Sybille Stentor]] (the only courtier present who is not essential) also seems to remedy this. {{Bug|Sometimes the marker for miscellaneous quest "Head to the Solitude Court" isn't removed when you talk with Falk Firebeard or complete "The Man Who Cried Wolf".|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} You can use the console command setstage MS06Start 10 to deactivate the marker from miscellaneous quest. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |15||A representative from Dragon Bridge has appealed to the court in Solitude for help investigating Wolfskull Cave. Falk Firebeard is looking for someone to look into the issue. |50||A representative from Dragon Bridge has appealed to the court in Solitude for help investigating Wolfskull Cave. Falk Firebeard has asked me to clear out the cave. {{Quest Objective|50|Clear Out Wolfskull Cave}} |100||I have confronted and stopped a group of necromancers attempting to summon Potema, the Wolf Queen, in Wolfskull Cave. I should return to Falk Firebeard with the news. {{Quest Objective|100|Speak to Falk Firebeard}} |250|fin| |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|15|Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=0, 5, 10, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 83, 85, 90, 105, 110, 115 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer |Next=[[Skyrim:The Wolf Queen Awakened|The Wolf Queen Awakened]], [[Skyrim:Elisif's Tribute|Elisif's Tribute]] }}

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Nephele |checkedBy= |reward=Dwarfmp |rewardChecked=Riliane }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)|Radiant}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= [[Skyrim: Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]] |Reward=[[#Reward|Leveled Gold]] |Image=SR-quest-The Numbers Job.jpg |ImgDesc=Fiddle the figures for the Thieves Guild |description=Alter the business ledger of a store. |ID=TGRFO |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]] about numbers jobs. # Enter the requested store and alter its ledger. # Report back to Delvin. ==Detailed Walkthrough== After joining the Thieves Guild, [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] will tell you that he handles all the [[Skyrim:The Fishing Job|fishing]], numbers, and [[Skyrim:The Bedlam Job|bedlam]] jobs. Ask him for a numbers job and he will tell you to find the ledger in a specified store and fix it so that the guild's activities can go unnoticed. The Business Ledger is a large book sitting open on a table, frequently near the store's strongbox. If you look at the book, you are given the option to "Forge Numbers". This option is always available (even if The Numbers Job is inactive, or you are looking at the ledger in a different store), but it will only have an effect on the ledger specified by Delvin. The quest can send you any one of 28 possible stores. You may be assigned the same location more than once. {{City List |markarth={{LinkList|Arnleif and Sons Trading Company|The Hag's Cure|Markarth Stables|Silver-Blood Inn|sep=

{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Dwarfmp |rewardChecked=Riliane }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= |Reward=[[#Reward|Leveled Gold]] |Disp= |Rep= |Prev= |Conc= |Next= |Loc= |Image=SR-quest-The Litany of Larceny.jpg |ImgDesc=The Litany of Larceny |description=Find items for [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]] throughout the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)#Primary Quests|questline]]. |ID=TGLarceny |Icon= }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Find the [[Skyrim:Queen Bee Statue|Queen Bee Statue]] in [[Skyrim:Goldenglow Estate|Goldenglow Estate]] and bring it to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]]. # Find the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Decanter|Honningbrew Decanter]] in [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]]. # Find the [[Skyrim:East Empire Shipping Map|East Empire Shipping Map]] in the [[Skyrim:East Empire Company Warehouse|East Empire Company Warehouse]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]]. # Find the [[Skyrim:Model Ship|Model Ship]] in [[Skyrim:Snow Veil Sanctum|Snow Veil Sanctum]]. # Find the [[Skyrim:Dwemer Puzzle Cube|Dwemer Puzzle Cube]] in [[Skyrim:Calcelmo's Laboratory|Calcelmo's Laboratory]] within [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]] in [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]]. # Find the [[Skyrim:Bust of the Gray Fox|Bust of the Gray Fox]] in [[Skyrim:Riftweald Manor|Riftweald Manor]] in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. # Find the [[Skyrim:Left Eye of the Falmer|Left Eye of the Falmer]] in the Dwemer ruin [[Skyrim:Irkngthand|Irkngthand]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== During the course of the Thieves Guild questline, you may run into one of several unique items in locations relevant to the quests. Picking them up will add a miscellaneous task to take it to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]], who will pay a leveled amount of money for the item. ===The Queen Bee Statue=== [[File:SR-item-Queen Bee Statue.jpg|thumb|right|The Queen Bee Statue in Aringoth's quarters]] The first trinket that you will likely encounter is the [[Skyrim:Queen Bee Statue|Queen Bee Statue]]. It is found on a bedside table in [[Skyrim:Aringoth|Aringoth]]'s room in [[Skyrim:Goldenglow Estate|Goldenglow Estate]]. This location is visited in the Thieves Guild quest [[Skyrim:Loud and Clear|Loud and Clear]]. When picked up, a prompt will tell you to return the item to Delvin Mallory. {{NewLeft}} ===The Honningbrew Decanter=== The [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Decanter|Honningbrew Decanter]] is located in a room in the upper floor of the [[Skyrim:Honningbrew Meadery|Honningbrew Meadery]], behind the door which has an expert lock. You will most likely come across it during the quest [[Skyrim:Dampened Spirits|Dampened Spirits]]. ===The East Empire Shipping Map=== The [[Skyrim:East Empire Shipping Map|East Empire Shipping Map]] can be found on a table next to some loot in the Dockmaster's office in the [[Skyrim:East Empire Company Warehouse|East Empire Company Warehouse]]. It is easiest to acquire this during the quest [[Skyrim:Scoundrel's Folly|Scoundrel's Folly]]; if you attempt to steal it at any other point, the warehouse may be patrolled by guards, who will attack you on sight if spotted. ===The Model Ship=== The [[Skyrim:Model Ship|Model Ship]] is found on a booby-trapped pedestal in [[Skyrim:Snow Veil Catacombs|Snow Veil Catacombs]]. The pedestal is surrounded by oil, and removal of the ship causes the oil to burst into flame. It is fairly easy to grab the ship near the doorway and retreat to avoid the fire. It is also possible to shoot one of the exploding urns that fall to set off the trap; however, this causes the ship to fly away from the resulting explosion—into a wall, behind a cabinet or even into the room below—making it easy to lose. Another option is to shoot the ship away from the oil on the ground. Be aware that picking up the ship will still trigger the urns. Another option, if you know the Telekinesis spell, is to stand away from the oil and use the spell to retrieve the ship. Another option is to place an item on the pedestal, preventing the trap from activating when you take the ship. The last option would be to use the "Slow Time" shout. Go right up to the pedestal, shout, immediately grab the ship and run away from the oil. Even if you only have the first word of the shout, you will have plenty of time to watch the urns fall to the ground. Of course, you can always set the oil on fire yourself and let it burn up, then take the ship, but the urns will still injure you a bit if you stand too close. Use any flame spell (besides cloak) or the "Fire Breath" shout. You can also use whirlwind sprint, grab the ship, and immediately sprint away from the oil. You visit Snow Veil Catacombs during the quest [[Skyrim:Speaking With Silence|Speaking with Silence]]. ===The Dwemer Puzzle Cube=== The [[Skyrim:Dwemer Puzzle Cube|Dwemer Puzzle Cube]] is in [[Skyrim:Calcelmo|Calcelmo]]'s Laboratory, which is accessed via the Dwemer Museum in [[Skyrim:Understone Keep|Understone Keep]]. It is found in the large room with the Arcane Enchanter, just before moving on to the balcony. You travel through the laboratory during the quest [[Skyrim:Hard Answers|Hard Answers]]. ===The Bust of the Gray Fox=== The [[Skyrim:Bust of the Gray Fox|Bust of the Gray Fox]] is found on a table in [[Skyrim:Riftweald Manor|Riftweald Manor]] during the quest [[Skyrim:The Pursuit|The Pursuit]]. It is easy to miss as it blends perfectly with the stone behind it, but it's sitting right next to the quest objective. ===The Left Eye of the Falmer=== The [[Skyrim:Left Eye of the Falmer|Left Eye of the Falmer]] can be taken from Mercer Frey's corpse in the [[Skyrim:Irkngthand Sanctuary|Irkngthand Sanctuary]] during the quest [[Skyrim:Blindsighted|Blindsighted]]. After you turn in the Left Eye of the Falmer to Delvin, you can steal it back from its shelf in the Cistern within the Ragged Flagon, and sell it again to Tonilia to double your profit. ===Reward=== This is the amount of gold you get each time you turn in an item, except the eye with four times higher reward. The total amount of gold you can accumulate ranges from 500 to 8000 gold. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! Levels !!
