Skyrim:The World-Eater's Eyrie.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Xyzzy |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Main Quest |Giver=[[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Nahkriin (item)|Nahkriin]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Storm Call|Storm Call]] shout |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Sovngarde (quest)|Sovngarde]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Skuldafn|Skuldafn]] |Image=SR-quest-The World-Eater's Eyrie.jpg |ImgDesc=Alduin's portal to Sovngarde |description=Battle through [[Skyrim:Skuldafn|Skuldafn]] to reach [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]]'s portal to [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]]. |ID=MQ303 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Set [[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]] free. # Talk to Odahviing. # Reach Alduin's portal to [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]]. # Enter Sovngarde. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ====Preparation==== You cannot take any followers with you on the final two quests, so not only can they not fight alongside you, they cannot carry your burdens. Also, you can never come back here, so you need to take anything you want (particularly the unique items) in your one visit, making carrying space a concern. You will likely be of a high level when completing this quest, resulting in the loot being of higher quality, but better quality is penalized with higher weights. Only take the bare essentials, strip yourself of anything you don't normally use, though bear in mind you will face some tough fights, so if you rely on food or potions to heal you will need to bring enough. One set of armor, one melee weapon setup (one hand and shield, dual wield, or two handed), and one ranged weapon, should be all you carry. The [[Skyrim:Dremora Butler|Dremora Butler]]{{DB}}, [[Skyrim:Black Market|Dremora merchant]]{{DB}}, [[Skyrim:the Steed Stone|the Steed Stone]] power, and the [[Skyrim:Extra Pockets|Extra Pockets]] perk from the [[Skyrim:Pickpocket|Pickpocket]] skill can all help to provide some relief. Also consider using the Twin Souls perk from Conjuration to at least have twice as many summoned entities. The Spectral Assassin spell will work well, and Rieklings might randomly join you to combat enemies; both can respectively be unlocked from 'Bound Until Death' and 'The Chief of Thirsk Hall'. ===Set Odahviing Free === In order to free Odahviing, talk to the [[Skyrim:Whiterun Guard|Whiterun guard]] standing on the second floor (there is a stone staircase near where the jarl is standing). After a short discussion, the guard will release Odahviing for you. You can also pull the chain to release the dragon yourself without talking to the guard, which is useful if the guard is incapacitated or there is a [[Skyrim:Crime#Bounties|bounty]] on your head. Tell Odahviing you're ready to travel and he will fly you directly to [[Skyrim:Skuldafn|Skuldafn]]. ===Upon Arrival=== [[File:SR-place-Skuldafn Temple 02.jpg|thumb|right|Skuldafn overview]] Upon arriving at the Skuldafn courtyard, you'll encounter two dragons and multiple [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]]. Battle or sneak your way past them to enter the temple complex. The two Towers (North and South) have only minor loot and won't get you any closer to the Temple itself. If you have a high enough sneak skill, it is possible to sneak past all enemies, including the dragons. It is also possible, though tedious, to scale the mountain beside you as high as you can go, and jump along the mountainside until you reach the temple. At this point you can drop down and sneak through the [[Skyrim:Snowberries|snowberries]] at the base of the mountain. === Skuldafn Temple === After entering the Temple area, you come to a large chamber with draugr. Be careful of the [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart trap]] in the western pathway. Continuing leads you to the first puzzle in [[Skyrim:Skuldafn|Skuldafn]], which is used to open two doorways. The puzzle consists of three pillars, each separated by a wall, and a switch between the pillars and the doorways. Each pillar has three pictographs: '''[[Skyrim:Puzzle Totems#Totem Symbols|Eagle, Snake, and Whale]]'''. On the walls beside the two outside pillars are matching pictographs for those pillars. The west pillar is a '''Whale''' and the east is a '''Snake'''. Set the outer pillars so that the pictographs face each other (e.g., '''Snake''' faces '''Snake'''). Above each doorway are more pictographs. Above the east doorway is an '''Eagle'''. This way just leads to a treasure chest and a collapsed wall. Above the west doorway is a snake, which leads to the destination. Face the pictograph on the central pillar that matches the desired door to face north, toward the doors. Pull the lever to open door (with your back to the lever, you should see Eagle, Eagle, Eagle to open and close the dead-end door. With your back to the lever, you should see Eagle, Snake, Eagle to open and close the progressing door. You must close one door before you can open the other). The next small room is full of draugr, and the following one has multiple [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] who made good use of their webbing to block a door and cover a chest. The second puzzle room is solved by '''Whale—Snake—Eagle''' (upper level left, middle lower level, upper level right), with the solutions for the first and third shown above them and the second behind the platform. A chest can also be found behind the platform. [[SR:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] can be used from the platform to bypass the puzzle. Enter the door to go to another section of [[Skyrim:Skuldafn Temple|Skuldafn Temple]]. Take out the draugr and keep moving (there isn't much loot around). Cross the bridge (from its eastern entry to the west, seen from entrance) but be careful of the [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate trap]] at the doorway to the next room. Activating it releases a lantern that lights up the [[Skyrim:Oil Slick|oil slick]] ahead and also triggers a dart trap. Go up the staircase to meet three draugr, which can be dispatched easily with another oil slick and lantern. Pull the lever near the oil (in a small window) to open the gate on the other side of the room. Don't forget the chest (by the other window). Follow the wide tunnel, grabbing the contents of the chest on the right side. Be careful when you reach the large oil slick, as there is another lantern poised over it that will drop if you step on the pressure plate in front. It is a useful way to dispose of upcoming high-level draugr; by running away and leading him into it. You will then arrive at a [[Skyrim:Traps#Puzzle Door|puzzle door]] guarded by a leveled draugr or [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] carrying the [[Skyrim:Diamond Claw|diamond claw]] needed to open it. The combination to the door is, from top to bottom, '''Fox—Moth—Dragon'''; this can be seen by examining the claw in your inventory. The next two rooms (the first large, the next small) are basically empty except for a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]], which teaches you a word for the [[Skyrim:Storm Call|Storm Call]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]]. Also, just before the door to exit is a room to the right. There are some hidden [[Skyrim:Gems|gems]] in a pot on a shelf to the right: a flawless emerald, a ruby, and a diamond hidden by a linen wrap. === Dragon Priest === [[File:SR-quest-The World-Eater's Eyrie 02.jpg|thumb|Nahkriin guards the portal at Skuldafn, flanked by two dragons]] You will end up on a large rocky platform, above where you first entered Skuldafn. Defeat the [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] who are there to meet you, (Hint: Unrelenting Force will be useful here) and take the wooden platform ahead of you (from where you exited the Temple) to go down a small tower that has some good loot on shelves and a large chest at the bottom. Returning to the top, you may notice two dragons above you, perched on columns. This is where you need to be to finish the quest. But before you can enter Alduin's portal to [[Skyrim:Sovngarde (place)|Sovngarde]], you must get past a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] named [[Skyrim:Nahkriin (creature)|Nahkriin]]. This dragon priest can be tough if you don't take the fight to him. Additionally, if you engage the two nearby dragons at the same time, the fight can be much more difficult. However, the two dragons may not move from their perches or become hostile. When you reach the top of the stairs Nahkriin will notice you and make his way toward [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest Staff (Nahkriin)|his staff]]. It's best to start your assault immediately. He doesn't attack until he gets his staff, so get to him quickly. After Nahkriin grabs his staff, he'll turn around to face you. Be careful with this one as his staff does 50 [[Skyrim:Shock Damage|shock damage]] per second. Any [[Skyrim:Resist Shock|shock resistance]] potions or enchanted apparel you have would be useful now. He doesn't start off with full health, so if you jumped on attacking him before he grabbed his staff you should be able to dispatch him in short time. He can also be pushed off the ledge, and will fall to his death. After defeating Nahkriin, pick up his staff and [[Skyrim:Nahkriin (item)|mask]] and activate the Dragon Seal. Alternatively, you can bypass the fight by getting to the portal before Nahkriin can remove his staff. This can be achieved with the [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] shout, although you won't be able to collect his [[Skyrim:Nahkriin (item)|mask]], which will make it impossible to complete the untracked quest to collect all the dragon priest masks. ==Notes== * If this quest is active, every dragon that you encounter on the landscape while traveling will shout at you, ''"Skuldafn fen kos dinok."'' (Skuldafn will be [your] death). * Sometimes the Whiterun Guard who releases Odahviing dies in battle. It is also possible that the guard will repeat the ''"Wait... I know you"'' line instead of releasing Odahviing. In these cases, you must pull the chain yourself to release Odahviing. * If you can get between Nahkriin and his staff he won't attack you, as his focus is entirely on removing it. You can proceed to kill him though. * If you kill Nahkriin before he is able to retrieve his staff you do not need to remove and replace it; you can simply walk into the portal. * The portal begins to close as soon as the staff is taken out of the platform hole. It is possible to kill Nahkriin immediately after he takes the staff, loot him for his mask and staff, and then jump into the portal before it fully closes (thereby keeping the powerful staff). * The journal entry states that Skuldafn is in the Jerall Mountains, though it is actually in the Velothi Mountains. ==Bugs== {{Bug|When setting Odahviing free, if you talk to the guard before allowing [[Skyrim:Farengar Secret-Fire|Farengar Secret-Fire]] to complete his interactions, Odahviing will become hostile and you won't be able to talk to him.|confirmed=1}} ** {{pc22}} This can be fixed by opening the [[Skyrim:Console|console]], selecting Odahviing, and entering stopcombat. {{Bug|Balgruuf's and Irileth's last lines are barely audible.|USKP|2.1.3|They needed a sound override for you to be able to hear them better.}} {{Bug|When traveling to Skuldafn, after the loading screen, you can become stuck on a black screen.|confirmed=0}} ** {{pc22}} Load a previous save (prior to mounting Odahviing), open the console, enter cow 278dd 47 -10 to teleport into Skuldafn, then enter setstageMQ303 50. {{Bug|Near the exit to Skuldafn Temple, there is a draugr whose patrol path makes it try to walk into a wall. It will continue to do this until it dies or detects you, and will return to this position if it loses sight of you.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If the puzzle door or rotating pillars do not work, check [[Skyrim:Puzzles#Bugs|here]] for possible fixes.|confirmed=1}} ** A workaround for the second door puzzle if the rings will not move is to use [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] to get to the wooden platform and shimmy your way past the drawbridge. {{Bug|If you enter Skuldafn at a high level, Draugr with the full [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout may knock you into areas from which you can't escape, such as rubble-blocked arches and behind walls and nooks.|confirmed=0}} **Since fast travel is impossible, the only fix is to load an earlier save. **{{pc22}} You may also use the tcl console command. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||The captured dragon Odahviing has revealed that Alduin has escaped to Sovngarde, the Nord underworld, where he feeds on the souls of the dead. Quiet and neat."'' |description=Place an item as evidence inside a wealthy home. |ID=TGRDU |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png |radiant=yes }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]] in [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|The Ragged Flagon]] about shill jobs and receive the evidence. # Enter the house and put the item into the targeted chest. # Report back to Vex for your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A View to a Shill=== After you are a full member of the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]], you will want to start thieving for fun and profit. By now, you will have met [[Skyrim:Vex|Vex]]. She handles all the [[Skyrim:The Burglary Job|burglary]], shill, [[Skyrim:The Sweep Job|sweep]] and [[Skyrim:The Heist Job|heist]] jobs. In order to earn some gold and help Vex with her goal of restoring the Guild to its former glory, ask her for a shill job. She will inform you that a client has requested someone be taken out. Unlike the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]], the guild does this by planting evidence in their home and tipping off the guard. ===The Plant=== Vex will give you a stolen item that needs to be placed as evidence. The item is a randomly-selected [[Skyrim:Gems|gem]] or unenchanted piece of [[Skyrim:jewelry|jewelry]] ([[Skyrim:circlet|circlet]], [[Skyrim:necklace|necklace]], or [[Skyrim:ring|ring]]); see [[Skyrim:Leveled Lists#Thieves Guild Lists|Leveled Lists]] for full details. The item is identical to a standard item, except that "Stolen" has been added to its name. The quest can send you to any wealthy house, which amounts to twenty-nine possible houses. You may be assigned the same location more than once. {{City List |markarth={{LinkList|Nepos's House|Ogmund's House|Smelter Overseer's House|The Treasury House|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}} |riften={{LinkList|Aerin's House|Bolli's House|Marise Aravel's House|Romlyn Dreth's House|Snow-Shod Manor|Valindor's House|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}} |solitude={{LinkList|Addvar's House|Bryling's House|Evette San's House|Hall of the Dead (Solitude)|Jala's House|Vittoria Vici's House|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}} |whiterun={{LinkList|Amren's House|Carlotta Valentia's House|Heimskr's House|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}} ''(See [[#Bugs|Bugs]])''
{{LinkList|House of Clan Battle-Born|House Gray-Mane|Uthgerd's House|Ysolda's House|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}} |windhelm={{LinkList|Atheron Residence|Belyn Hlaalu's House|Brunwulf Free-Winter's House|House of Clan Cruel-Sea|House of Clan Shatter-Shield|Viola Giordano's House|sep=
|ns_base=Skyrim}}}} You need to enter the selected house undetected and find the designated chest. Open the chest and place the stolen item in it. Although there may be multiple containers in the house, only the chest indicated by your quest marker will work; if you attempt to put the stolen item into the wrong container, you will be told that you can't remove the item from your inventory. If you are sent to jail while the quest is active, for any reason, you will fail the quest. Getting caught in the house or killing anyone living in the house will also result in failing the quest. You are not responsible for tipping off the guards after placing the evidence. Once you have planted the evidence, return to Vex for a leveled gold reward. ===Reward=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! Levels !! Placing the ruby in the chest that is labeled Stolen Flawless Ruby does nothing in regards to completing the quest objective, and taking it back out simply adds it to your already existing inventory of flawless rubies. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Meet [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre|Amaund Motierre]] inside [[Skyrim:Volunruud|Volunruud]].
#Take his letter and amulet to Astrid.
#Take the amulet to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]].
#Return to Astrid with the [[Skyrim:Letter of Credit|letter of credit]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===The Prodigal Returns===
When you last left the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary, Astrid was still in turmoil regarding your sudden promotion to Listener, and the ensuing duties the role required. Once you have fulfilled any of the contracts [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]] gave you after completing [[Skyrim:Whispers in the Dark|Whispers in the Dark]] ([[Skyrim:Kill Narfi|Narfi]], [[Skyrim:Kill Beitild|Beitild]], [[Skyrim:Kill Ennodius Papius|Ennodius Papius]], [[Skyrim:Kill Hern|Hern]], [[Skyrim:Kill Lurbuk|Lurbuk]]), go back to the sanctuary. Astrid will approach you and tell you that she has finished thinking. She agrees that it would be madness to just ignore the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]]'s demands and tells you to travel to Volunruud to meet with [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre|Amaund Motierre]].
===The Stars Aligned===
When you enter Volunruud, a skeleton sits in a small alcove immediately to your left. It will attack you as you pass, so conduct a preemptive strike while it slumbers, or sneak past it. Near the skeleton are [[Skyrim:Heddic's Volunruud Notes|Heddic's Volunruud notes]]; reading them will start [[Skyrim:Silenced Tongues|Volunruud's dungeon quest]]. Completing the quest gives you a word of [[Skyrim:Aura Whisper|Aura Whisper]], a useful [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] for assassins, but the quest is not necessary to meet Motierre.
After the skeleton, the first room is straight ahead. There are three paths, but the one you want is the leftmost one. Open the door and you'll find the client waiting with [[Skyrim:Rexus|Rexus]], his bodyguard. Motierre will be impressed and a bit unnerved that you have arrived. He informs you that he has multiple targets in mind, all culminating in a shocking end--the assassination of the Emperor. The bodyguard will then give you two items: a valuable [[Skyrim:Jeweled Amulet|jeweled amulet]] "to cover expenses" and a [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre's Sealed Letter|sealed letter]] with further instructions to deliver to Astrid. Return to the sanctuary and deliver these items to Astrid.
===Back at the Sanctuary===
When you return, Astrid is anxious to know the goings-on. When you tell her of Motierre's grand design, she will be excited by the prospect of such glory for the Brotherhood and starts with preparations.  She wants to study the letter further, but in the meantime, asks you to take the amulet to [[Skyrim:Delvin Mallory|Delvin Mallory]], a [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild (faction)|Thieves Guild]] member located at the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]] in the Ratway in [[Skyrim:Riften|Riften]]. She wants the amulet appraised and sold, if Mallory is interested.

===The Wheels in Motion===
Upon inspecting the amulet, Mallory will inform you that it is a one-of-a-kind item and is only given to members of the [[Lore:Elder Council|Elder Council]]. He agrees to purchase it and hands you a [[Skyrim:Letter of Credit|letter of credit]], which is to be delivered to Astrid—as per their "standard arrangement". 

Return to Astrid with the letter. When you explain what Mallory told you about the amulet she will be delighted, musing that Motierre is probably a member of the Elder Council looking to get himself promoted. With that, she is all smiles and action; she informs you that the first step to completing the new directive will be for you to [[Skyrim:Bound Until Death|attend a wedding]] and assassinate [[Skyrim:Vittoria Vici|the bride]].

==Notes==
* If you read the letter Amaund Motierre gives you inside Volunruud before delivering it to Astrid, she will mention it in conversation after showing it to her, criticizing your actions as "sloppy". This has no effect on the quest other than the additional dialogue.
* You can directly go to Volunruud rather than speaking to Astrid first, but the quest won't start until she talks to you.
* There is a chest in Amaund's chamber within the ruins which is free to loot, containing some leveled valuables and gold.
* If you go to Amaund before getting the quest, the quest will not be altered. If you return to the Sanctuary, Astrid will simply tell you to go to Volunruud before ending the conversation.
* Asking Astrid for more details on the wedding murder will have her speaking like the civil war is still ongoing, even if you've already completed that questline.
* If you are a member of the Thieves Guild when you take the amulet to Mallory, he will ask if the assistance you need is for the guild, prompting you to say it is for the Dark Brotherhood instead.

[[Skyrim:Dragonborn (quest)|Dragonborn]] (Requires Level 25 to encounter cultists in World Encounters only) |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]] |Image=SR-quest-The Way of the Voice.jpg |ImgDesc=Master Borri teaching "Wuld" |description=Meet the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]]. |ID=MQ105 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #Go to [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]]. #Climb the 7,000 Steps. #Speak to the Greybeards at [[SR:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Ivarstead=== After you're finished in [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], you'll want to head to [[Skyrim:Ivarstead|Ivarstead]], as it is located at the foot of the 7,000 Steps leading up to [[Skyrim:High_Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]]. Once you get there and get close to the bridge, you'll hear a conversation. Talk to one of the men, [[SR:Klimmek|Klimmek]], and learn about what dangers are lurking ahead. You can take an [[Skyrim:Climb_the_Steps|optional quest]] from him to deliver supplies to the Greybeards. You may also ask people there to tell you some information about High Hrothgar: {|class="wikitable sortable" ! Name ! Response |- |'''[[Skyrim:Wilhelm|Wilhelm]]'''||''"The Greybeards are a solitary lot. I don't think they've ever ventured outside their monastery. We get the occasional pilgrim passing through here on their way to the summit, but almost all of them have returned disappointed."'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Klimmek|Klimmek]]'''||''"I've been to the monastery many times, but I've never even laid eyes on one of the Greybeards. Not that I'd care to. Being masters of the Thu'um, they could kill you by uttering a single word. Well, not that they would. They seem peaceful, but I wouldn't want to provoke them. "'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Bassianus Axius|Bassianus Axius]]'''||''"Klimmek brings food supplies up to them once every few weeks when the weather permits it. Other than that, they seem like a quiet lot. Don't really know too much about them."'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Boti|Boti]]'''||''"It's frightening living below their monastery. Sometimes I swear I can hear strange noises rolling down from up there. It sounds like thunder, but there's never any rain. What do you make of that?"'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Temba Wide-Arm|{{Nowrap|Temba Wide-Arm}}]]'''||''"The Greybeards stay away from me, and I stay away from them. Suits me just fine."'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Gwilin|Gwilin]]'''||''"Always thought it was odd that there's a layer of thick clouds covering the peak of the mountain above the monastery. Not sure what's up there, but I bet the Greybeards know."'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Jofthor|Jofthor]]'''||''"They call the path to the monastery the 7,000 Steps. Can you imagine? I'm not certain if I could even make it to the top without collapsing from exhaustion."'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Fastred|Fastred]]'''||''"The Greybeards are a strange bunch. I heard they live their entire life without uttering a single word; can you even imagine?"'' |- |'''[[Skyrim:Lynly Star-Sung|Lynly Star-Sung]]'''||''"I've always fancied a journey up the 7,000 Steps to the monastery. Anything to break the boredom of living in this town. I envy you."'' |} ===The 7,000 Steps=== When you start on the trail up, you'll run across various leveled wildlife and monsters, and a couple of pilgrims, [[Skyrim:Barknar|Barknar]] and [[Skyrim:Karita (warrior)|Karita]]. You will also find various etched stone tablets ("emblems") giving you information on the history of the [[Skyrim:dragon|dragon]]s and the [[Lore:Way of the Voice|Way of the Voice]]. There is an iron ore vein hidden near the third emblem shrine. Once the third shrine is in view climb the small hill to your right. It is at the top of the hill hidden from view of the main walking path. Shortly after the fourth emblem where you meet Karita, at a point where the steps are sandwiched between two cliffs, there is a [[Skyrim:troll|frost troll]] that will jump from the top of one cliff if it sees you (though sometimes it may be found further up the path). For low-level characters, this can be a difficult fight. It can be avoided altogether by sneaking past it at night or scaling the cliffs nearby. ====Combat Strategies==== #Frost trolls, like any other type of troll, have a weakness to fire. Thus, handy combat strategies include using weapons which have a fire enchantment, using fire-based destruction spells, and [[Skyrim:Conjure Flame Atronach|summoning a flame atronach]]. The Shout [[Skyrim:Fire Breath|Fire Breath]] could also be used, as a word for it can be gained early on in the [[Skyrim:Companions|Companions]] questline. If you are a [[Skyrim:Dark Elf|Dunmer]], your [[Skyrim:Ancestor's Wrath|Ancestors Wrath]] power will also work. #Trolls can deal a substantial amount of damage, but most of it can be avoided by tactically falling back when one sees the troll raising his arms or preparing a power attack. If you need to heal, you can sprint away; the troll will not generally outrun you. Similarly, using a shield to block the Troll's attacks can also be effective, but does depend highly on timing. #It is possible to scale the rocks just before the troll, allowing you to use ranged attacks to safely eliminate it. However, the troll may regenerate its health faster than you can damage it. Using a bow with a fire enchantment or ranged destruction spells such as [[Skyrim:Firebolt|Firebolt]] would give an advantage. #If you are careful, it can be killed by long distance arrows from the entrance to the ravine it lives in. Go into stealth mode, stand at the entrance to the ravine, all to the right, and shoot at the troll when you can just see it on top of the cliff. If done properly, the troll may shift left or right a little, but will not come after you; the x2 sneak attack bonus (x3 with the perk) should allow you to kill it quickly. However, if it falls off the cliff, this will not work anymore. #You can lure the troll up to High Hrothgar, and the [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] shout will briefly help you move faster. If the troll follows you into the monastery, the Greybeards will defeat it very quickly. #If you retreat down the stairs, [[Skyrim:Karita (warrior)|Karita]], who is meditating at the tablet, will help defeat the troll. ====Avoiding the Fight==== #It is easily possible to simply run past the Troll, as it moves rather slowly. #[[Skyrim:Nord|Nords]] can use their racial power [[Skyrim:Battle Cry|Battle Cry]] to make the troll flee for 30 seconds, giving you enough time to run to High Hrothgar. Similarly, a [[Skyrim:Wood Elf|Bosmer]] can use [[Skyrim:Command Animal|Command Animal]] to calm the troll. You can also use [[Skyrim:Animal Allegiance|Animal Allegiance]] to calm the troll. #You can use [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] at the troll, then sprint away before the stun effect wears off. #You can scale the rocks to the left of the ravine, and you'll never be detected at all. ===The Greybeards=== [[File:SR-quest-The Way of the Voice2.jpg|right|thumb|High Hrothgar]] After finally arriving at High Hrothgar, you'll be greeted by [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Master Arngeir]], who speaks to you on behalf of the other [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]] (whose voices are too powerful for conversation). After proving you are the Dragonborn by using the [[SR:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout, they welcome you to their monastery and instruct you on how to use the dragon shouts, or Thu'um. To further your training in the ways of the Thu'um, you will be taught the second word to the [[Skyrim: Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout, ''Ro'', and asked to practice it three times on [[Skyrim:Phantom Form|ethereal targets]] that the Greybeards summon. Arngeir comments on how quickly you learn, then takes you outside for the next lesson. They teach you another word for [[Skyrim: Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]]. You'll be asked to practice it by using the shout to get through the gate [[Skyrim:Borri|Master Borri]] opens before it closes. When you're finished, Arngeir will send you on the last test: retrieving [[Skyrim:the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller]]. Upon completion of this quest, you will gain access to the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn (quest)|main quest]] of the [[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]] expansion. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{achievement|The Way of the Voice (achievement)|descr=no}} == Notes == *During the quest, [[SR:Ulfric Stormcloak|Ulfric Stormcloak]] and [[SR:Galmar Stone-Fist|Galmar Stone-Fist]] have additional dialogs talking about Greybeards. *If you activate and read all ten plaques along the 7,000 Steps, you'll receive the blessing [[Skyrim:Voice of the Sky|Voice of the Sky]] that causes wildlife to neither flee nor attack you for 24 hours. *There appear to be only around 700 steps, but many may have been worn down or covered in snow over time. *If you consider steps as paces rather than stairs, there are around 2000 steps (when using the walking animation). *[[General:Todd Howard|Todd Howard]] jokingly mentioned in an interview that he would count all the steps leading up to High Hrothgar to make sure it's 7,000. *With a [[Skyrim:Horse|horse]] and a little cunning, you can skip both the long trip to Ivarstead and climbing the 7,000 Steps altogether. Starting at the [[Skyrim:Whiterun_Stormcloak_Camp|Whiterun Stormcloak Camp]], you can ride almost straight up the mountain, bypassing the dangerous creatures and the tedious long climb with only moderate difficulty. *If you bypass Ivarstead and the two pilgrims on the way up in this way, Karita will never be encountered, since she is set to disappear from the game once the player reaches High Hrothgar. Barknar will still be there at his position, on the way down, and so will Klimmek in Ivarstead, with his quest to deliver the goods. Unfortunately, the Frost Troll will also be there - although of course, fast-travelling directly from High Hrothgar avoids it (and all the above). *The shout the Greybeards use to create the attack targets for learning Ro is [[Skyrim:Phantom_Form|Fiik Lo Sah]], Mirror Deceive Phantom. It is not attainable by the player except through console codes. *When you are asked to run through the gate before it closes using your new Whirlwind Sprint shout, you can make it through the gate in time using a regular sprint. *Arngeir's dialogue about Whirlwind Sprint is slightly different if you already know a word of the shout. If you have learned part of the shout through word walls, you will receive the second or third part of the shout instead. == Bugs == {{Bug|If you enter High Hrothgar from the back door (where you perform the shout "whirlwind sprint"), the Greybeards may not congregate in the hall and the quest will not progress (stuck on "speak to Arngeir"). Exit from the front door and re-enter before speaking to [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Master Arngeir]] to progress.|USKP|1.2.4}} {{Bug|Borri doesn't speak the "Kest" word for Whirlwind Sprint when teaching you it due to the dialogue checking the wrong condition value.|USSEP|4.3.8}} {{Bug|The Greybeards may attack you after you use an Unrelenting Force on them.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you leave High Hrothgar after being presented the word ''Ro'', but before learning (absorbing) the word on the floor, you may not be able to learn the word when you return. This can also happen in very rare cases even if you do not leave (more likely to happen later in the game if you have put off doing the main quest). This can break the main quest. There is no workaround for this other than reloading a previous save from before the word is presented to you.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you interrupt Einarth while he's casting ''Ro'' on the floor by talking to him or shouting at him, it may not appear.}} ** Save and re-load the game, and he should resume the casting. {{Bug|When asked to demonstrate the Voice, the spectres may not appear.|confirmed=1}} ** Open your inventory and close it again and the spectre should appear. {{Bug|When asked to demonstrate the Voice, spectre appear endlessly without progessing to the next quest stage. Use console command ''setstage 90''.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|In demonstrating Whirlwind Sprint, [[Skyrim:Wulfgar|Master Wulfgar]] may inadvertently send himself flying off the mountain.}} {{Bug|If you interrupt Borri in the courtyard, just before, or as you are told to approach him so that he can impart his understanding of the Whirlwind Sprint shout. The quest can bug, and no matter how long you wait, or prompt him - He will just make the motion/animation movement, but he will not impart the 'understanding.' Leaving you stuck (This bug has only been reported happening when you have Serana with you. Which might be relevant as it seems to prompt her audio response as if you talked to her).}} ** The easiest way to resolve this is simply to load the autosave from when you entered the courtyard. {{Bug|It is possible to complete this quest, including successfully completing Demonstrate your "Whirlwind Sprint" Shout, while leaving Arngeir and Borri stuck in the courtyard as if you still need to demonstrate your Whirlwind Sprint Shout even though The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller has started. If you succeed in the objective to demonstrate the Whirlwind Sprint Shout but Borri uses the Shout that opens the gate again, this bug may have activated. [[Skyrim:Repairing the Phial|Repairing the Phial]] (finish [[Skyrim:The White Phial (quest)|The White Phial]] first) |Loc=[[SR:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]], [[SR:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]] |Image=SR-quest-The Throat of the World.jpg |ImgDesc=Paarthurnax |description=Receive a lesson from [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|Paarthurnax]]. |ID=MQ204 |Icon=SR-qico-Main.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|Paarthurnax]]. # Learn the Word of Power from Paarthurnax. # Use your "[[Skyrim:Fire Breath|Fire Breath]]" [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] on Paarthurnax. # Talk to Paarthurnax. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Dragonrend=== [[File:SR-npc-Arngeir 05.jpg|thumb|right|Learning the Clear Skies shout]] With the information about [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]]'s defeat learned at Sky Haven Temple, travel to [[Skyrim:High Hrothgar|High Hrothgar]] to meet with the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]]. When you arrive, you will first need to turn over the [[SR:Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|Horn of Jurgen Windcaller]] and learn the final Word for [[SR:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] [[SR:The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller|if you have not yet done so]]. Once you have, tell [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]] that you need to learn the [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|shout]] used to defeat Alduin. He will be quite shocked and ask where you learned about such a shout. While the Greybeards and the [[Skyrim:Blades|Blades]] do not have a history of cooperation, if you refuse to tell Arngeir where you came across the information, he will not help you. You can either tell him that you learned it from [[Skyrim:Alduin's Wall|Alduin's Wall]] or that you were talking to the Blades. In either case, he will be strongly offended and will be reluctant to help. Depending on your response, [[Skyrim:Einarth|Einarth]] may chastise Arngeir for his impertinence by saying, ''"Arngeir. Rek/Rok los Dovahkiin, Strundu'ul. Rek/Rok fen tinvaak [[Skyrim:Paarthurnax (dragon)|Paarthurnax]]."'' meaning, ''"Arngeir. She/He is Dovahkiin, Stormcrown. She/He will speak (with) Paarthurnax"''. Regardless, Arngeir eventually offers a hasty apology, saying the decision to help or not help you is not ultimately his. He tells you that the shout used to end Alduin's reign of terror is called [[Skyrim:Dragonrend|Dragonrend]]. However, Arngeir cannot teach it to you because he does not know it and the origins have been lost. If asked, Arngeir will explain that the shout was created during the terrifying reign of the dragons and is a shout of pure evil, embodying all the cruelty, fear, and horror of the time. If you want to learn this shout, you must speak with Paarthurnax, the leader of their order. Further questioning reveals that Paarthurnax lives in seclusion at the peak of the Throat of the World and surpasses all of the Greybeards in the [[Lore:Way of the Voice|Way of the Voice]]. Arngeir will offer to help you reach Paarthurnax and leads you out into the courtyard where you will be taught all three words of the shout [[Skyrim:Clear Skies|Clear Skies]]. You are now ready to attempt the trek up to the summit of the [[Skyrim:Throat of the World|Throat of the World]]. The path up is blocked by [[Skyrim:Traps#Magical Wind|magical winds]] dealing severe [[Skyrim:Frost Damage|frost damage]], even with [[Skyrim:Resist Frost|resist frost]] effects. Use the shout Arngeir gave you to clear away the damaging mists. ===Paarthurnax=== When you reach the summit, a dragon approaches. However, resist the urge to attack, as the dragon will land and address you: ''"Drem Yol Lok. Greetings, wunduniik. I am Paarthurnax. Who are you? What brings you to my strunmah ... my mountain?"'' After you explain your objective, Paarthurnax will respond: ''"Drem. Patience. There are formalities that must be observed, at the first meeting of two of the dov. By long tradition, the elder speaks first. Hear my Thu'um! Feel it in your bones. Match it, if you are [[Skyrim:Dovahkiin|Dovahkiin]]!"'' He will then shoot a bout of flame onto a wall and encourage you to participate in "tinvaak" (loosely translated, "conversation"). Inspect the word he left behind to learn a new Shout, and Paarthurnax will grant you his knowledge of it, saying ''"A gift, Dovahkiin. Yol. Understand Fire as the dov do. Now, show me what you can do. Greet me not as mortal, but as dovah!"'' Use this new shout on Paarthurnax. He will agree with the opinions voiced by Greybeards that "the dragonblood runs strong in you", even if you are a "joor" (mortal), and offer to answer your questions. After the formalities, ask Paarthurnax about [[Skyrim:Dragonrend|Dragonrend]]. He will admit that he was expecting this, as "Alduin and Dovahkiin return together". Though he doesn't know the shout, he believes it could be learned by returning to the beginning of the "Tiid-Ahraan", the Time-Wound on the Throat of the World. An [[Lore:Elder Scrolls|Elder Scroll]], or "Kel" is needed to activate the portal and allow you to view the first Tongues using the Thu'um to defeat Alduin. As the quest ends, the dragon admits he has no idea where to find an Elder Scroll. Your quest log suggests you talk to Arngeir or [[Skyrim:Esbern|Esbern]] for more information. ==Notes== * If you have already acquired an Elder Scroll by completing the [[Skyrim:Discerning the Transmundane|Discerning the Transmundane]] quest, Paarthurnax urges you to the Time-Wound, and the quest [[Skyrim:Alduin's Bane|Alduin's Bane]] will begin immediately. * You can use the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout to stroll through the mists except for the first cloud; passage through it requires [[Skyrim:Clear Skies|Clear Skies]]. * If you unlock the word yourself at just the right time, before Paarthurnax gives you his "understanding", he will teach you the second word for Fire Breath instead of the first (or the third if you started out knowing the second). * Paarthurnax will say that he is teaching you Yol, no matter which Word the wall actually teaches you. * You can climb to the very top without going through the temple and the barriers, though Paarthurnax will not be present. * [[Skyrim:Viinturuth|Viinturuth]] will be resurrected by [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]] once this quest is completed, at the [[Skyrim:Dragon Mounds|mound]] northwest of [[Skyrim:Anga's Mill|Anga's Mill]] and near [[Skyrim:Lake Yorgrim|Lake Yorgrim]]. * Choose the optional dialogue and say you want to learn about: :{| class="wikitable" !Word!!Translation!!Effect Name!!Description!!Notes |- !Fus |force||[[Skyrim:Force Without Effort|Force Without Effort]]||You stagger 25% less and foes stagger 25% more.||Augments power attacks and [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout. |- !Feim |fade||[[Skyrim:Eternal Spirit|Eternal Spirit]]||While Ethereal, you recover health 25% faster.||Only active and visible on Active Effects menu when using [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout. |- !Yol |fire||[[Skyrim:The Fire Within|The Fire Within]]||[[Skyrim:Fire Breath|Fire Breath]] shout deals 25% more damage.|| |} :These increase the respective shout capabilities. You can only have one active at a time. ==Bugs== {{Bug|You may be unable to learn the [[Skyrim:Clear Skies|Clear Skies]] shout.|OSP|1.9.26.0.8}} ** Reloading a save from before talking to [[Skyrim:Arngeir|Arngeir]] then following him outside immediately will usually fix the problem. Sometimes you need to watch him whisper to words on the ground to ensure they stay lit. {{Bug|If you leave before shouting Fire Breath, your shouts' cooldowns will recharge completely every few seconds. This exploit allows you to use powerful shouts very frequently, which will have an unbalancing effect on the game.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|As you talk to Paarthurnax, he may fly up high, above the mountain, and begin circling. You may continue your conversation, though you cannot hear him, so it is advised you turn subtitles on. This does not otherwise impede the progress of the quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The word wall may not activate properly. If you come back later, the word may be highlighted, but you can no longer learn the word from it.|confirmed=1}} ** {{Pc22}} In the [[Skyrim:Console|Console]], enter teachword 20e17 to unlock the first word. If you already have one or two words of Fire Breath, use 20e18 or 20e19, respectively. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Maybe the Greybeards can teach me this Shout, or at least tell me how I can learn it. {{Quest Objective|10|Talk to Arngeir}} |60||With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir knew the name of the Shout, "Dragonrend", but could not teach it to me. However, he has agreed to show me the way to reach Paarthurnax, the Greybeards' leader, who lives at the top of the Throat of the World. Arngeir says that Paarthurnax is the only one who may know this Dragonrend Shout. |70||{{Quest Objective|20|Learn the "Clear Skies" Shout}} |83||{{Quest Objective|25|Use the "Clear Skies" Shout to open the path}} |90||{{Quest Objective|30|Talk to Paarthurnax}} |100||With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir sent me to talk to Paarthurnax, who he said was the only one who might know this Dragonrend Shout. It turns out that Paarthurnax is actually a dragon. |120||{{Quest Objective|40|Learn the Word of Power from Paarthurnax}} |135||{{Quest Objective|50|Use your "Fire Breath" Shout on Paarthurnax}} |140||{{Quest Objective|60|Talk to Paarthurnax}} |200|fin|With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir sent me to talk to Paarthurnax, the Greybeards' leader, who turned out to be a dragon. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Nurelion|Nurelion]] in [[Skyrim:The White Phial (place)|The White Phial]] |Reward=5 gold, followed by 500 gold
Word for the [[Skyrim:Marked for Death|Marked for Death]] shout |Next=[[Skyrim:Repairing the Phial|Repairing the Phial]] (finish [[Skyrim:The Throat of the World|The Throat of the World]] first) |Loc=[[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]], [[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]] |Image=SR-quest-The White Phial.jpg |ImgDesc=The White Phial on a pedestal in a secret room |description=Retrieve a [[Skyrim:The White Phial (item)|legendary artifact]] to fulfill an old [[Skyrim:Nurelion|alchemist's]] wish in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]]. |ID=MS12 |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Talk to [[Skyrim:Nurelion|Nurelion]] in his [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] store. # Retrieve the White Phial from [[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]]. # Return the Phial to Nurelion. # Talk to his assistant, [[Skyrim:Quintus Navale|Quintus Navale]], for your final reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===His Last Hope=== The only [[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]] shop in [[Skyrim:Windhelm|Windhelm]] is called [[Skyrim:The White Phial (place)|The White Phial]] and is located in the market district, right next to [[Skyrim:Aval Atheron|Aval Atheron]]'s stall. When you enter you will witness a very sick and elderly proprietor, [[Skyrim:Nurelion|Nurelion]], trying to convince his assistant that he is able to make some kind of journey. The assistant, [[Skyrim:Quintus Navale|Quintus Navale]], is quite skeptical and with good reasons, as his master coughs constantly in between words: [[File:SR-quest-The_White_Phial_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"Master, you're far too old for this sort of journey."'']] '''Nurelion''': ''"I'll be fine."''
'''Quintus''': ''"Master, you're far too old for this sort of journey. We don't know what's inside..."''
'''Nurelion''': ''"I'll... I can... just..."''
'''Quintus''': ''"You see, you're not well! Have a seat and I'll fetch you some tonic."''
'''Nurelion''': ''"Bah. If there was a tonic that could help me, I would have found it by now..."'' After the discussion, Nurelion will take his place behind the counter and Quintus will walk away. Ask Nurelion what the argument was about and he will explain: ''"Just a man's life work, is all. I've finally derived the location of the White Phial, but this doting busybody won't let me get it."'' He is obviously referring to Quintus, but offer to help him find whatever he is looking for and he will provide some background information: ''"It's buried with its maker, [[Skyrim:Curalmil|Curalmil]], in a long forsaken cave to the west of here. Curalmil was a crafty one, even in death. You would need the skills of a master alchemist to reach his resting place. Luckily for you, I've already made the mixture."'' He will then hand you his [[Skyrim:Nurelion's Mixture|mixture]] and add a marker to your map. He will then explain that the White Phial is a legendary bottle, forged in the days when Skyrim was just starting its turn to ice. He then tells you he spent his entire life searching for it, in libraries and small villages, researching its location, and will explain the name of his store: ''"I even named my shop after it, hoping that it might attract anyone who had heard of it. And now it's within my grasp... but the Eight, it seems, have chosen me for their amusement.... for in my current condition, I'll never be able to lay my hands on it."'' ===The Forsaken=== [[File:SR-place-Forsaken_Cave.jpg|thumb|left|[[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]]]] The map marker leads to [[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]], a cave west of Windhelm, straight south of [[Skyrim:Alftand|Alftand]]. Enter the premises and head down the icy slope to the east. Kill the leveled [[Skyrim:Wolf|wolves]], [[Skyrim:Frost Troll|frost trolls]], or [[Skyrim:Bear|snow bears]] as you go along and open the door to the west, leading to a cave inhabited by [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr enemies]]. A tempting chest will be visible in a tunnel as you go along, but beware of the [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] triggering a [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|dart trap]] above the chest. After a while, the surroundings will change into catacombs and more draugr will be revived and attack. Fight your way through the many tunnels and keep an eye out for a copy of the [[Skyrim:Rare_Gifts#The_Mirror|quest-related]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:The Mirror|The Mirror]]'' near a locked door leading to a chest with minor loot. The large northwestern room has three [[Skyrim:Flame Spout Trap|flame sprout traps]] and a hidden chest just before the next tunnel. Beware of yet another pressure plate triggering a [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|battering ram]] and pick up some useful potions and ingots from the shelves before entering [[Skyrim:Forsaken Crypt|Forsaken Crypt]]. You enter the crypt to the sight of a large room in two levels, with an overhanging bridge above. A draugr will be patrolling a path next to another still resting just around the corner. A ranged attack can dispose of it without disturbing the other. On the second floor another draugr will be found in its sarcophagus just to the right of the bridge. Locate the narrow tunnel to the northeast and make your way upstairs. After dispatching a patrolling draugr, a pair of Ancient Nordic Boots and a hide helmet can be found on a table at the end of a passage. Around the next corner, four burial urns can be found cemented into the ground. Two more urns can be found on the ground to the right of the opening just before you reach the bridge which overlooks the room you passed through before entering the tunnel. As you cross the bridge dispatch the leveled draugr which will emerge from its sarcophagus on the right end of the platform, then claim the contents of the chest and shelves on the other side. Turn right and cross another bridge into the next room, where you will encounter two draugr and a huge [[Skyrim:Ceiling Spikes|ceiling spike]] trap located in the center. An expert-locked door will be located on the western wall leading to an unlocked chest with some minor loot. The room features two burial urns on the northern wall, and a portcullis leading to a caved in tunnel. Carefully make your way around the spike trap and pass through the iron door on the other side. Cross the gated bridge which overlooks the two lower levels you passed previously. A patrolling draugr can be sniped with a ranged weapon as it passes the corner at the end of the tunnel. Another sleeping draugr will be standing just round the corner to the right of the fire pit as you enter the room. The same situation will occur with the next corner. A final draugr wight will be sleeping in a standing position to the left hand side of the iron doorway, which opens into a [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|swinging blades]] trap on the other side. As you pass through the blades, the draugr boss [[Skyrim:Curalmil|Curalmil]] will burst out of his sarcophagus and attack, along with several leveled draugr enemies. Dispose of them all and find the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] for a word related to the [[Skyrim:Marked for Death|Marked for Death]] shout and a boss-leveled chest. Find the tunnel leading west behind the sarcophagus and place [[Skyrim:Nurelion's Mixture|Nurelion's mixture]] in the ancient bowl at the end. This lowers the stone wall in front of you and you will have free access to the final chamber which contains a variety of different alchemy ingredients, the alchemy skill book ''[[Skyrim:A Game at Dinner|A Game at Dinner]]'', and the [[Skyrim:Cracked White Phial|Cracked White Phial]]. Go back to the chamber with the word wall and turn right, where you will find an open set of iron doors leading to a staircase which will return you to [[Skyrim:Forsaken Cave|Forsaken Cave]]. As you enter the next room, activate the lever which will open the cavern wall and continue forward until you reach the tunnel leading back to Skyrim. ===The Crack in the Plan=== [[File:SR-npc-Nurelion_03.jpg|thumb|right|Time is running out...]] Back in The White Phial, Nurelion's poor health has taken yet another turn for the worse, forcing the old proprietor to sit in a chair around the clock with Quintus Navale in charge of the merchant services. Enter the private quarters upstairs and show Nurelion the cracked Phial. Understandably, this will make him quite upset: ''"This... it matches every description of the Phial that I've found in lore. But if it can't hold liquid, there's no way of knowing. How did you manage to damage it, then? This is what I get for not retrieving it myself."'' When you tell him that it was broken to begin with, he will become disparaging: ''"Figures—I doubt you have sufficient knowledge to harm the Phial even if you wanted to. Either way, this is the end of it. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm not quite in the mood to entertain guests. I trust you can show yourself out. Here's for your trouble."'' He then hands you a rather lousy reward of five gold, and then goes directly to bed, where he will stay 24 hours a day, obviously dying from his terminal illness. Attempting to speak to him after that will cause a "Nurelion is asleep and dying." message to appear on the screen, with an "OK" option directly below it. Leave him and head downstairs where Quintus will be eager to talk to you: ''"I want to thank you for your help. I know my master can be a bit short at times."'' He will then make up for his master's cheapness and hand you an additional five hundred gold, then go to watch over his master upstairs. However, there's still hope. A few days later, you will receive a [[Skyrim:Letter_from_Quintus_Navale|letter]] from Quintus, starting the quest [[Skyrim:Repairing the Phial|Repairing the Phial]]. If, however, [[Skyrim:The Throat of the World|The Throat of the World]] is not yet completed before this quest, you'll first have to finish that one before you can start Repairing the Phial. {{NewLine}} ==Notes== * If you have a Numbers Job (Thieves Guild) for the White Phial active, complete it (return to Delvin Mallory) before completing the White Phial quest, or Nurelion's death will count as killing the target and failing the quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The Phial can disappear if you leave the dungeon without taking it.|OSP|1.4}} {{Bug|At the completion of the quest, even when "asleep and dying" on his bed, you can still hear Nurelion continuing his standard dialogue about not liking loiterers and those who gawk at his goods.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|It is possible to receive double the amount that Quintus gives you as a reward from 500 to 1000 gold. Often when you finish the initial dialogue with Nurelion too quickly (without exiting during middle of the dialogue), he will repeat the same dialogue if you do not exit the second dialogue, which would result in a duplication of the 500 gold rewarded.|USKP|2.0.5}} {{Bug|Neurelion's "Must you bother me now? I've almost figured out where it is." line may still play after the quest is finished.|USSEP|4.3.9}} {{Bug|Quintus may not talk to Nurelion, making it impossible to start the next quest.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you don't enter the White Phial the first time that you enter Windhelm, it may be possible that Nurelion will be already dying in his bed when you visit him later. The quest cannot be started and his apprentice will not be available as merchant.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||The alchemist of Windhelm, Nurelion, has asked me to find the legendary White Phial for him. {{Quest Objective|10|Retrieve the White Phial}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Bring the Phial to Nurelion}} |21||{{Quest Objective|21|Speak to Quintus}} |100|fin|I retrieved the White Phial for Nurelion, but it was damaged beyond repair. His assistant, Quintus, still paid me my reward, though. |missing=0 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

Skyrim:The Wolf Queen Awakened.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=24.156.216.144 |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Quest Header |type=Side Quests |Giver=[[Skyrim:Courier|Courier]] |Reward=Leveled gold, [[Skyrim:Shield of Solitude|Shield of Solitude]] |Disp= 0→1 ([[Skyrim:Styrr|Styrr]]) |ReqLevel=10 |Prev=[[Skyrim:The Man Who Cried Wolf|The Man Who Cried Wolf]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Let Sleeping Wolves Lie|Let Sleeping Wolves Lie]] (must be installed [[Skyrim:Bone Wolf|Bone Wolf]]{{CC|Bone Wolf}}) |Loc=[[Skyrim:Blue_Palace|The Blue Palace]], [[Skyrim:Hall_of_the_Dead_(Solitude)|Hall of the Dead]] in [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], [[Skyrim:Potema%27s_Catacombs|Potema's Catacombs]] |Image=SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened.jpg |imgdesc=The Wolf Queen, awakened |description=Potema must be stopped. |ID=MS06 |Icon= |Difficulty=Very Hard }} ==Quick Walkthrough== #After receiving the letter from the courier, speak to [[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]]. #Speak to [[Skyrim:Styrr|Styrr]]. #Fight through the underground tunnels. #Defeat [[Skyrim:Queen Potema|Queen Potema and Potema's Remains]]. #Retrieve [[Skyrim:Potema's_Skull|Potema's Skull]] from the throne. #Give the remains to Styrr. #Return to Falk. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===The Unbound=== After you complete [[Skyrim:The Man Who Cried Wolf|The Man Who Cried Wolf]], you soon discover that your battle with Potema is not over. Once you have leveled up after interrupting the binding ritual, a [[Skyrim:Courier|courier]] will approach you outside of Solitude with a [[Skyrim:letter from Falk Firebeard|letter from Falk Firebeard]]. The letter warns you of an impending threat and requests that you return to Solitude. When you get there, Falk will inform you that Potema has indeed escaped. He asks you to speak with Styrr, a priest of [[Lore:Arkay|Arkay]], as he can provide you with more guidance on how to secure the threat. ===The Wolf Queen and You=== Styrr is located in Solitude's [[Skyrim:Hall of the Dead (Solitude)|Hall of the Dead]]. You should probably ask him exactly what you are getting yourself into with Potema. Potema is the granddaughter of [[Lore:Uriel Septim II|Uriel Septim II]], and former Queen of Solitude, and was quite intent on becoming Empress. A formidable necromancer, she had raised armies of dead led by [[Skyrim:Vampire|vampires]] to help her. Since she had not achieved her corporeal form during the summoning, she has fled to a place of the dead, her Catacombs. Because you were present at Potema's summoning, there is now a strange connection between the two of you, and it must be you that deals with her. To keep Potema from returning fully, you must find her remains and bring them to Styrr to be sanctified. To assist you, Styrr gives you the key to the catacombs, and the spell [[Skyrim:Turn Undead (spell)|Turn Undead]]. ===The Wolf's Den=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"You've arrived at last."'']] The entrance to the catacombs is in the [[Skyrim:Temple of the Divines|Temple of the Divines]]. When you arrive in the temple, go to the back, past the pews, and on your left will be some stairs going down. Take the stairs, and you will be confronted with a locked iron gate, which can only be unlocked using the key Styrr gave you. Through here you will see the hole one of Potema's servants created into Potema's Catacombs. The dungeon is filled with Potema's minions: leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] and vampires. The dungeon itself is very linear, and proceeding through it is a fairly simple endeavor. Upon entering, the voice of Potema calls to you: ''"You've arrived at last. The hero/heroine who prevented me from being bound returns to my fold. I have much to thank you for, little one. When you die I will raise you and you can take your place by my side."'' The iron gate that previously barred your path is opened once Potema finishes speaking. Proceed forward until you reach a room at the bottom of a set of stairs with purple flammable liquid on the floor. There is a table in the center of this room, with a copy of the [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|Lockpicking]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Surfeit of Thieves|Surfeit of Thieves]]''. [[File:SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened_03.jpg|thumb|right|A draugr rising from the water.]] You will eventually reach what seems like a dead end, but there is a lever to open the path forward. Activate the lever, and the stone wall in front of you will start to revolve. Waiting will reveal that there is a door opening barred by an iron bar gate cut out in the rotating wall. If you throw the lever at just the right moment, you can stop the revolving wheel as the gate is opening. ===Potema's Refuge=== Walking forward will bring you to a room with three additional revolving-stone doorways and three corresponding levers. Activating the first lever in line will stop and start the first revolving door, etc. Stop all three doors when the entrance is open to you, and walk forward. These rotating doors may slip over time so it's a one way trip past this point (or you can keep them spinning and run through carefully). You will come to a room with a "sleeping" draugr in a throne near the back of the room and an accompanying vampire. The vampire will approach you and speak before attacking: ''"You've come far, mortal. No doubt you seek to enter Potema's Sanctum. I can see to that. We'll need plenty of fresh corpses to rebuild her army, you see."'' The draugr will now rise from the throne. The key to Potema's Sanctum is found on the body of the vampire (another copy of the key is found on the armrest of the draugr's throne). Loot it to avoid picking the master lock to Potema's Sanctum, which is the final area of the dungeon. [[File:SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened_04.jpg|thumb|left|''"No doubt you seek to enter Potema's Sanctum."'']] ===Potema's Sanctum=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened_05.jpg|thumb|right|''"Serve me in death."'']] Proceeding forward will bring you to a room full of dead draugr, a dead vampire and a locked iron gate. Potema's voice will speak out to you: ''"Not much further. Come, little thing. Serve me in death."'' The iron gate will then unlock, and Potema will reanimate the vampire and two of the draugr in the room. Defeat them, then continue. In the hallway before the final encounter, there are two [[Skyrim:Potion of Resist Shock|resist shock]] potions on the shelf near the door. Take them; you will need them to protect yourself against Potema. You will eventually come to a room with a floating spirit and tombs scattered around the perimeter and center of the room. This is the boss fight. {{NewLeft}} ===Defeating Potema=== [[File:SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened_06.jpg|thumb|right|''"You've come far, mortal, but can you stand against my inner council? Let's see!"'']] Again, you will hear Potema's voice: ''"You've come far, mortal, but can you stand against my inner council? Let's see!"'' She will radiate bolts of electricity and rotate the bolts, dealing shock damage to those the bolts of electricity hit. It is advisable to consume potions which give you Resist Shock - such as those in the antechamber. During the fight, she will mock you, ''"Don't applaud yourself too soon, worm!"'' and spur on her minions, ''"Rip the eyes from his/her head!"''. Arrows will not affect Potema, but magic will. Potema will also release draugr from their tombs to attack you. Some of the draugr are warlocks and can summon [[Skyrim:Frost Atronach|frost atronachs]] to join the fight. After each wave of defeated draugr, Potema will reanimate some of them, and will release more draugr, as well. Each wave of draugr you defeat will make Potema weaker. Keep killing the draugr, and the spirit of Potema will eventually recede into the locked room opposite where you came in. Follow the spirit of Potema, and Potema's Ghostly Remains will appear, ready to fight you. The apparition respawns and has to be defeated several times. It can also resurrect the draugr you just killed in the last room so watch for attacks from behind. After defeating the apparition, you will see that there is a seat with a skull on it. This skull is Potema's Remains. Take Potema's Skull, and loot the chest. Inside the chest is the [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] [[Skyrim:Legend of Krately House|''Legend of Krately House'']]. Exit the room. [[File:SR-quest-The_Wolf_Queen_Awakened_07.jpg|thumb|left|Potema's Remains at her throne.]] ===The Unholy Remains=== There are only two more enemies between you and the exit at this point, two draugr, one higher level than the other. They are found seated in facing alcoves with a short pillar in the middle of the hall between them. On the pillar is a helmet or some other piece of loot. If you take this bait, the draugr awaken and attack you. You can ignore them and walk past (the object on the pillar is usually low-level), or deal with them individually. A short distance after this, you pass through a door and emerge on a mountain overlooking a docked ship in Solitude. There is an unlocked chest with random loot to your immediate left as you emerge onto the mountain ledge and a random potion to the right of the chest and a random helmet on the rock above. Travel to Solitude and go to the Hall of the Dead. There, speak with Styrr and he will gratefully accept the remains. He goes off to bless the remains, and all there is left to do now is to report to Falk Firebeard. Returning the remains will count as [[Skyrim:Thane of Haafingar|assisting the people of Haafingar]]. {{NewLeft}} ===The Shield of Solitude=== Travel to the Blue Palace and speak to Falk, where he will speak on behalf of the jarl in expressing his gratitude. Your reward is gold and the [[Skyrim:Shield of Solitude|Shield of Solitude]]. The quest concludes here. After the release of the Anniversary Edition and with the [[Skyrim:Bone Wolf|Bone Wolf]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]] installed, you will receive another [[Skyrim:Letter from Bolgeir Bearclaw|letter]] by courier once this quest has been completed. Reading this letter will trigger the next quest, [[Skyrim:Let Sleeping Wolves Lie|Let Sleeping Wolves Lie]]. ==Notes== *The [[Skyrim:Shield of Solitude|Shield of Solitude]] that is received as reward for this quest has a unique Resist Magic enchantment that can be learned through disenchantment, and can be stacked with the regular Resist Magic in double enchantments to create a single item with 45% magic resistance. *Reading Falk's note will not trigger a quest in your Journal, and no quest marker will appear, until you speak to him. However, reading the note is still a requisite for even being able to speak to him about the quest. ==Bugs== {{Bug|In order to receive the [[Skyrim:Letter from Falk Firebeard|Letter from Falk Firebeard]], you must gain a level after completing [[Skyrim:The Man Who Cried Wolf|The Man Who Cried Wolf]]. Leveling must happen away from Solitude. If you have already reached level 81, the only way to acquire the letter and activate this quest is to steal it from Falk.|OSP|1.9|The patch introduces a new feature removing the level limit, allowing potentially unlimited level-ups.}} ** {{USKP|version 1.3.1 alters the requirement to simply changing locations (i.e. leaving the Palace) after 7 in-game days. Use show USLEEPMS06StartDay and ensure it is lower than "Days Passed" statistic}} {{Bug|The courier will occasionally not appear at all to deliver the [[Skyrim:Letter from Falk Firebeard|Letter from Falk Firebeard]], regardless of how long you wait. If this occurs, complete any other action which could cause the courier to appear (for example, a different quest), and the courier will deliver the note then instead, alongside the note for the other quest. You might notice a delay in the speech when this occurs, just allow a minute or so for the conversation to time out, and the note should appear in your inventory.}} {{Bug|Falk Firebeard has the Letter from Falk Firebeard in his inventory from the start of the game. It can be pickpocketed but is then unable to be dropped as it is tagged as a quest item.|USKP|1.2}} {{Bug|The Letter from Falk Firebeard may not always be removed from your inventory at the conclusion of the quest and will remain behind as an irremovable quest item.|vn=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console command player.removeitem D91D1 1 to remove the letter. {{Bug|Backing out of conversation with Styrr too early can block quest progress.|OSP|1.5}} {{Bug|When fighting Potema's three waves of summoned draugr, all three waves may not spawn, leaving the quest stuck.|confirmed=1}} **Reloading from a previous save prior to entering the room is the only way to correct the issue. {{Bug|After defeating Potema's inner council, the door to Potema's throne might not open.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console command TCL to no-clip through the door. You will skip the Potema battle but you can complete the quest. {{Bug|The room with the draugr may not load properly. The draugr waves will load, but the room is missing visual assets. The room may be very dark and filled with green mist. Potema's lightning attack does not function. The final door may also be missing.|confirmed=1}} **Exiting the zone and re-entering should load the room assets properly. Potema will load and activate, and the final door will load. Any draugr previously killed will remain dead. {{Bug|One of the draugr may get knocked through the non-door to Potema's Remains, or be teleported there on loading a save, making it impossible to kill it and leaving the quest stuck (you can tell by the red icon on your compass behind the door).|vn=1}} ** Try conjuring a creature on the other side of the door by facing the door up close and casting the spell. **{{Pc22}} Use the console command TCL to no-clip through the door and defeat the draugr. {{Bug|If you have reanimated any of the draugr in the room, Potema's spirit will not recede through the locked door, nor will the door be opened until this very last draugr has also crumbled to the ground.|vn=1}} {{Bug|The bar on the door after you collect Potema's Remains may be unresponsive even though the door behind it opens.|confirmed=1}} **Backtrack through Potema's Sanctum and enter Potema's Refuge. Then re-enter Potema's Sanctum again. The bar should now operate normally. {{Bug|Potema's Skull may not be "active", making it impossible to pick it up and complete the quest.|confirmed=1}} **Save and reload. The skull should be near where Potema's remains have fallen (or where it would have rolled from the throne). **Using the [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] shout on the skull may fix this. {{Bug|When you take Potema's Skull, the quest marker will point you back the way you came, not through the door behind her throne.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes after defeating Potema's summoned draugr in the first room where she is encountered, her ghostly remains will not appear to fight you and you are able to take the remains and finish the quest anyway.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} You can make her appear by the command enable 00103499. {{Bug|At the end of the quest, if you back out of dialogue before [[Skyrim:Styrr|Styrr]] has said his last line, the quest may not be able to be completed.|USKP|2.0.4}} {{Bug|At the end of the quest, if you engage in dialogue with [[Skyrim:Styrr|Styrr]] before [[Skyrim:Falk Firebeard|Falk Firebeard]], the quest may not be able to be completed. |confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Using setstage ms06 150,or closing and restarting the game, then speaking to Falk, may allow the quest to advance. ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |50||Potema has been summoned from beyond the grave and is gathering power. I must enter the catacombs and prevent Potema from fully resurrecting by acquiring her bones. {{Quest Objective|100|Defeat Potema}} |125||{{Quest Objective|125|Retrieve Potema's remains}} |150||Potema has been summoned from beyond the grave.
