{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy= |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked= }}{{Trail2|Quests|Thieves Guild|link2=Thieves Guild (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Chillrend|Chillrend]] |Disp= 0→1 ([[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]]) |Prev=[[Skyrim:Hard Answers|Hard Answers]] |Conc=[[Skyrim:Vald's Debt|Vald's Debt]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Trinity Restored|Trinity Restored]] |Loc=[[SR:Riftweald Manor|Riftweald Manor]] |Image=SR-quest-The-Pursuit.jpg |ImgDesc=The bust of the Gray Fox |description=Break into [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer Frey]]'s [[Skyrim:Riftweald Manor|house]] and search for clues. |ID=TG07 |Icon=SR-qico-Thieves Guild.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Enter [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|the Ragged Flagon]] through [[Skyrim:The Ratway|the Ratway]]. # Meet [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] in the Ragged Flagon. # Speak with [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]] in the Ragged Flagon. # Go to the backyard of [[Skyrim:Riftweald Manor|Riftweald Manor]]. # ''(Optional)'' Deal with [[Skyrim:Vald|Vald]]. # Enter the house through the top door. # Go to [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer]]'s office. # Take the plans. # Return to Brynjolf. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-quest-The Pursuit 02.jpg|thumb|right|You're expected in the flagon]] ===A Thief Among Thieves=== Head to the [[Skyrim:The Ragged Flagon|Ragged Flagon]] through [[Skyrim:The Ratway|The Ratway]]. Meet [[Skyrim:Karliah|Karliah]] after entering through the door to the Ragged Flagon and follow her as she leads you to the Cistern, where [[Skyrim:Brynjolf|Brynjolf]], Delvin and Vex are waiting with knives drawn. Karliah pleads clemency and hands over the journal you translated in the previous quest as proof of her innocence. Brynjolf is shocked at the revelations contained within and determines that they must open the vault to see the truth. Follow them as they head to the vault and watch as Delvin and Brynjolf use their respective keys to open it. As soon as the doors open, Brynjolf will let out a cry of horror at seeing the place completely empty; not a single gold coin is left. While Delvin is distraught at seeing their fortune gone, Vex's reaction is more violent; she pulls her dagger out and vows to kill their treacherous Guildmaster immediately. Brynjolf manages to calm the situation and asks to talk to you after assigning the other two to keep an eye out for Mercer. Tell him everything and he'll instruct you to break into [[Skyrim:Mercer Frey|Mercer]]'s home to look for clues. However, the place is guarded by a Nord lout named [[Skyrim:Vald|Vald]] who is quite insistent on keeping people out. Brynjolf suggests you speak to Vex about him, since she was at one point intimately acquainted with Vald. Vex suggests the best course of action would be to erase [[Skyrim:Vald's Debt|Vald's debt]] with [[Skyrim:Maven Black-Briar|Maven Black-Briar]] or run him through and take what you need off his body. You must pass a hard-level [[Skyrim:Speech#Persuasion Options|Speech check]] to persuade him to give you the key. {|class=wikitable |- !width=28%|Option !colspan=4|Dialogue !width=15%|Reaction |- | I'll make it worth your while. '''(Bribe)'''||colspan=4|'''Failed''': You ain't got enough coin to make my problems go away unless ya' can talk Maven Black-Briar into letting me outta' my debt. You try and set one foot in this yard, and I'll cut it off.||Optional quest |- | I have something of yours. *Here, it's your debt with Maven. You're free. |colspan=4|Of mine? What is it? *I can't believe it! How did ya' talk her into this? Never mind, I don't care. I'm just glad I don't gotta' work for Maven anymore. Here, ya' did me a favor, I guess I owe you one. |Get the key |- | Mercer needs you in Markarth right away! '''(Persuade)''' *I'll watch it for you. |colspan=4|'''Passed''': But I can't leave here! I'm supposed to watch his house. What do I do? *Wow, sure is nice of ya'. Here, hang on to the key and don't let anyone in! '''Failed''': Oh come on, I ain't that dumb. |'''Passed''': Get the key
'''Failed''': Nothing |- | Let me in or I'll kill you. '''(Intimidate)'''||colspan=4|'''Failed''': Ha ha! That's funny. Ya' think you can take me on? Try it anytime. I've been itching for a fight.||'''Failed''': Nothing |} If you don't wish to kill Vald yourself, and don't want to pay the debt, you can sneak to the back of the house and shoot the ramp contraption. Vald will become hostile and chase after you. Lead him to the marketplace or any other area with guards and they will kill Vald. Loot his body and take the key. It is also possible to climb up the exterior of the Temple of Mara, by jumping onto the braziers and from there scaling the roof. From there, you can use Whirlwind Sprint to reach the balcony without ever interacting with Vald. ===A Plot Revealed=== Get a good vantage of the mechanism under the ramp and attack it using a ranged weapon (magic, bows, and shouts all work). The ramp will crash down, providing access to the second floor and the rest of the house. The first room is unguarded. The next has a single guard who should be facing the west wall, allowing you to sneak past easily. The stairs down are to the northwest. At the bottom, another guard will be patrolling. When you reach the bottom of the stairs, immediately face east and there will be closed doors. Head through them. On the northeastern corner to the barred front door you'll see a Suspicious Cabinet. Open it and then open the false back panel. Inside is a stairway down to the cellar, which leads to an underground system of tunnels. After avoiding the [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] by the metal gate that you see when you first enter the tunnels, make a left and head south towards a room filled with circle-shaped traps. Looking at the tiles, head south two squares, west two squares, north two squares, west two squares, and south two squares in order to avoid the traps. The hallway after the trap room has a pressure plate trap right around the corner that will launch a series of darts in front of the plate. Past this trap there is a chest on the right, which was on the other side of the metal gate at the beginning. Following the hallway, you come to a hallway filled with timed pendulum blades and [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|battering rams]]. Sprinting is a useful way to get past them. Once at the other end, head down the ramp and stop at the closed door. There is a dart trap trigger on the left side of the door. On the other side of the door are, among other things, [[Skyrim:Mercer's Plans|Mercer's plans]], a note titled [[Skyrim:Many Thanks|Many Thanks]], a copy of the [[Skyrim:Sneak|Sneak]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:The Red Kitchen Reader|The Red Kitchen Reader]]'', and [[Skyrim:Chillrend|Chillrend]] in a case. On the desk is the [[Skyrim:Bust of the Gray Fox|Bust of the Gray Fox]], which can be sold to Delvin as part of [[Skyrim:The Litany of Larceny|The Litany of Larceny]] quest. There is also a stash of jewels hidden in the bowl on Mercer's desk. Continue along the path until you reach the entrance to the Ratway Vaults. Fall down the hole (you may be attacked by some [[Skyrim:Vagrant|Vagrants]] and [[Skyrim:Lowlife|Lowlifes]] even if you had previously cleared the Ratway) and turn right to reach the Ragged Flagon. Return to Brynjolf and hand over the plans. ==Notes== *If Vald's debt has been cleared by fetching Maven her quill and you decide to go with Brynjolf's suggestion of shooting down the ramp to the second floor, Vald becomes hostile upon seeing you for "missing" the shot. * Three leveled generic bandits guard the inside of the house. However, three unique NPCs might've once been meant for this task. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]], [[Skyrim:Morokei (item)|Morokei]],
[[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Equilibrium|Spell Tome: Equilibrium]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] shout |Prev=[[Skyrim:Containment|Containment]] |Next=[[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|The Eye of Magnus]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Labyrinthian|Labyrinthian]] |Image=SR-quest-The Staff of Magnus.jpg |ImgDesc=Morokei enclosed in an energy shield, wielding the Staff of Magnus |description=Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Staff_of_Magnus|Staff of Magnus]]. |ID=MG07 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png |SuggLevel=24 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Travel to [[Skyrim:Labyrinthian|Labyrinthian]]. # Kill the dragon priest [[Skyrim:Morokei (creature)|Morokei]]. # Retrieve the [[Skyrim:Staff_of_Magnus|Staff of Magnus]]. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===To Save the College=== [[File:SR-quest-The Staff of Magnus 03.jpg|thumb|A ghostly image of Savos and his companions]] After the [[Skyrim:Containment|Containment]] quest, you must leave the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|college]] at [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine's]] behest, outfitted with the [[Skyrim:Torc of Labyrinthian|Torc of Labyrinthian]] and [[Skyrim:Savos Aren's Amulet|Savos Aren's Amulet]]. Your destination is [[Skyrim:Labyrinthian|Labyrinthian]], which will be marked on your map, where you must retrieve the [[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]] in order to contain the [[Lore:Eye of Magnus|Eye of Magnus]]. Labyrinthian sits nestled in a pass through the mountains southeast of [[Skyrim:Morthal|Morthal]]. It can be approached from the north or south end of the pass. Following the quest marker, at the top of one of the many staircases, you will arrive at the ''Ceremonial Door'', which is the entrance to the ruin's interior. Here a ghostly after-image of a younger [[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Savos Aren]] and five adventurous mages from the college, [[Skyrim:Atmah|Atmah]], [[Skyrim:Girduin|Girduin]], [[Skyrim:Takes-In-Light|Takes-In-Light]], [[Skyrim:Hafnar Ice-Fist|Hafnar Ice-Fist]] and [[Skyrim:Elvali Veren|Elvali Veren]], will appear. Apparently, the late Arch-Mage had explored the ruins before and the apparitions will replay their experience as you progress through the ruins. ===Labyrinthian=== [[File:SR-creature-Skeletal Dragon.jpg|thumb|right|The [[Skyrim:Skeletal Dragon|Skeletal Dragon]]]] The Labyrinthian indoor ruins are fairly straightforward and guarded by a number of [[Skyrim:Undead|undead]]. The entrance room is littered with skeleton corpses; at the opposite end of the room, on your right, you will find a [[Skyrim:Spell Tomes|spell tome]] on an altar. Proceed through a passage leading to a closed gate opening on a wide room. Levers on each side of the gate can be used to raise it, but it will fall down after a few seconds. A number of skeletons await beyond the gate, as well as a [[Skyrim:Skeletal Dragon|Skeletal Dragon]]. It is possible to raise the gate and shoot through the open entrance without entering. You can thus eliminate the skeletons and even the dragon before going into the room. In addition, the dragon doesn't seem to be able to fit through the gate, so if you have entered, you can retreat back through it to take cover. Loot the cavern and descend the stairs where another ghostly scene will relay the events of Girduin's death. Take a moment to read the etched tablet introducing visitors to the great city of [[Lore:Bromjunaar|Bromjunaar]], then proceed into the Labyrinthian Chasm. Opening the door, you will find twin staircases leading down. Check the alcove on the right for a hidden chest, then take the right-hand staircase down. When you emerge into the chamber you will hear Morokei's voice, resonating with glowing power, addressing you in the [[Lore:Dragon Language|dragon language]] "{{hover|Who comes to my dark kingdom?|Wo meyz wah dii vul junaar?}}". As he speaks, a large portion of your magicka will drain. As his voice subsides, a closed door is apparent. The door seems to be covered in ice, and then, as if to confirm, a [[Skyrim:Frost Spirit|frost spirit]] will emerge from the doorway. A [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] is also standing in one of the alcoves in this room. After removing the enemies, locate a [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Flames|flames spell tome]] which is in an alcove nearby. Cast a [[Skyrim:Flames|flames]] spell at the icy door to melt the ice crystals and open the door. Entering the chasm beyond, Morokei will again address you, draining your magicka: "{{hover|Cowardly men shall find no mercy here.|Nivahriin muz fent siiv nid aaz het}}". From the doorway, you will see a draugr standing below; an easy target for a ranged attack. There are several more draugr roaming this area, so be on guard. After eliminating the threat, enter the tunnel to find a door guarded by a [[Skyrim:Lightning Rune|lightning rune]]. Behind the door, another draugr is in a small room with the [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Equilibrium|Equilibrium spell tome]]. Return to the chasm and descend another level. There are several more draugr roaming this area, so be on guard. Here, the passageway will fork, with a bridge in front of you and a side passage continuing deeper into the chasm. You will hear Morokei's voice once again, this time speaking in your "guttural" language, trying to engage you in conversation. Either path, across the bridge or along the side wall, lead to the bottom of the chasm; however, the bridge features more draugr. Beyond, the cave leads to a river running through the chasm. A door at the far end of the passage leads to the next section of the ruins. Approaching the door, you hear Morokei plaintively asking for Aren. === Labyrinthian Thoroughfare === Once inside open the next gate that leads to a sunken cavern strewn with stalactites and stalagmites. Haunting this cavern is a skeleton and a draugr. Once you eliminate them, you can either open a novice-locked gate to the west, or take a passage to the north. If you open the gate take a few steps downstream and turn right. Travel through the small room and proceed onward. If you take the passage to the north, you will arrive at the same place after meeting a skeleton. As you travel through, Morokei speaks to you once again, this time taunting you as your magicka drains away. The next large room you come to is occupied by a troll. There are three barred windows providing a view of the next multi-leveled cavern. The entrance to this cavern is located to the right of these windows. In the next cavern, you will hear from Morokei goading you once again. You will battle more skeletons as you descend into the cavern. At the first landing is a bridge heading west. This leads to a small room with two trolls and a chest. Go down the second set of stairs to the lever-controlled gate. When you approach the gate, Morokei will again speak to you, this time recognizing that you are not Savos Aren. As Morokei has depleted your magicka again, wait for it to regenerate, if you wish, before opening the gate. Beyond the gate you will find skeletons and a swarm of wisps as well as a [[Skyrim:Wisp|wispmother]]. If you turn left through the gate, keep turning left and you will find 2 well-hidden flights of stairs in a corner; at the top are two skeletons (including a magic-user), an unlocked chest and a random aversion potion. You can jump over a dividing wall to kill/loot the skeletons if necessary, or just leave them be. Climb back down the stairs to ground level when you're done and proceed. Go up a short flight of stairs in the west corner and across the raised dais to a door sealed with fire. As you approach, you will hear Morokei acknowledge that your power feeds his own, and then a [[Skyrim:Fire Spirit|fire spirit]] will spawn and attack. Once the spirit is dead, cast a frost spell on the door to open it. If you do not yet have a frost spell, a [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Frostbite|Frostbite spell tome]] or ice-based scrolls can be found on a round table to the left of the door. [[File:SR-quest-The_Staff_of_Magnus_02.jpg|right|thumb|And then there were three...]] Beyond this door you will find a short passage and a gate leading into a circular room. As you enter, another vision of young Savos Aren and his companions will appear, their numbers somewhat depleted by now. The next room is guarded by a skeleton, a [[Skyrim:Spectral Warhound|Spectral Warhound]] and a ghostly [[Skyrim:Draugr Wight|draugr wight]]. Be careful as you approach; Morokei's voice invites you to your doom while draining your magicka once again. A cascade of water flows into a trap door in the floor, and there is a passage onwards. Either the trap door or the passage lead to the same room below, however, if you open the trap door and do not land on the log to break your fall or otherwise protect yourself, the fall is likely to kill you. Through this tunnel system you will meet more draugr wights. Fighting through you will find the door leading to the next zone, Labyrinthian, Tribune. === Labyrinthian, Tribune === Proceeding a short distance past the door, you will encounter two ghostly draugr wights, one of them a boss, and another spectral warhound. Around the next corner you will find a spell tome for [[Skyrim:Spell Tome: Steadfast Ward|Steadfast Ward]] on a podium. Go down the stairs and into a room with three [[Skyrim:Spellcaster Trap|spellcaster traps]] that will unleash powerful destruction spells at you. There is a frost rune on the floor midway down, and another guardian may await at the other end of the room. Next, go up a short flight of stairs to a ledge overlooking another cavern with a small pool below and another draugr. To the left is a wooden ramp up to a room and two additional spectral draugr along with some loot. To the right is a dirt path leading down to the room below. Exit the cave and at the end of the corridor you will find a skeleton shackled to a wall with a leveled dagger in its chest. To the left, an adept-locked gate leads to a few valuable items and the unique item [[Skyrim:Ancient Helmet of the Unburned|Ancient Helmet of the Unburned]]. To the right is a set of iron doors. When you approach the doors, you will see the visual phenomenon of Morokei's voice, but no voice is heard. However, your magicka will be drained again. Open the doors to see a throne facing away from you with a high-leveled draugr attended by a Spectral Warhound companion. Once the fight is over, you can approach the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] to the southwest of the throne to learn a word of the [[Skyrim:Slow Time|Slow Time]] shout. On the opposite side of the room to the word wall, you can pass through the right side of the tree to find a chest hidden behind a rock. After the throne room, you will enter a corridor with a series of columns on each side. Progress with care, as you will experience another magicka-draining effect, and activate a group of skeletons and ghostly draugr. At the opposite end of the corridor, the ghostly Savos and a diminished band of his companions lament that not all of their number have made it this far. One of them mentions a feeling that the final trial lies beyond the next door, and they vow to stick together and move forward. Open the iron door to the south. ===The battle against the Dragon Priest=== [[File:SR-quest-The Staff of Magnus 04.jpg|thumb|Two enthralled wizards holding Morokei with magic]] As you enter the large room, Morokei is completely protected by an energy shield cast by two [[Skyrim:Enthralled Wizard|enthralled wizards]]. You will soon learn that they are two of Savos' companions that were sacrificed to keep the dragon priest contained so Savos could escape. You need to remove the wizards and their casting in order to access Morokei. A variety of strategies and techniques can be used to win this encounter; suggestions and tips are below: * The mages can be targeted from the corridor leading to the room, allowing you to replenish your resources before engaging Morokei. [[Skyrim:Drainspell Bow|Drainspell Bows]] (from the ghostly draugr encountered in Labyrinthian) have been proven to be effective against the mages. You can also use the doorway to your advantage by opening and closing the doors when engaging Morokei. * The platforms around the walls of the room provide elevated positions that should provide you with an edge in the fight. It is possible to climb the wall immediately to the left and approach from above. You can sneak attack both wizards and have a good vantage point to attack Morokei. * Morokei can conjure a [[Skyrim:Storm Atronach|storm atronach]] and employs [[Skyrim:Command Daedra|Command Daedra]] and seems to prefer ranged and magical attacks, avoiding fighting at close quarters. Most of his offensive spells are [[Skyrim:Shock Damage|shock]] based, so equipping yourself with [[Skyrim:Generic Magic Apparel#Resist Shock|enchanted items]] such as [[Skyrim:Zahkriisos (item)|Zahkriisos]]'{{DB}} and [[Skyrim:Otar|Otar's masks]] or using [[Skyrim:Potions#Resist Shock|potions]] to [[Skyrim:Resist Shock|resist shock]] damage will severely hamper his attacks. * It appears that if you can back him into the small pool in the room, he cannot get out of the water, which traps him, but he can still fight back. * If you get his health down a bit, then switch to a low power constant-effect spell or staff (e.g. [[Skyrim:Staff of Sparks|Staff of Sparks]]), he'll keep his costly ward spell up constantly and deplete his own magicka. When he runs out of magicka he's powerless. * He can turn your summons against you. If he does, then you recast the summon and get a new one, he won't turn them more than once or twice. However, he cannot manipulate [[Skyrim:Flaming Familiar|Flaming Familiars]], acquired from [[Skyrim: A Scroll For Anska|protecting]] [[Skyrim:Anska|Anska]] in [[Skyrim:High Gate Ruins|High Gate Ruins]], though completing that quest requires you to confront [[Skyrim:Vokun (creature)|another]] [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]]. * At a high enough level, it is possible to summon a [[Skyrim:Conjure Dremora Lord|Dremora Lord]] against Morokei; he cannot turn Dremora as he can Atronachs. Beware Morokei's range, and note that the first rank of the ''Summoner'' [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] perk is sufficient to close the distance between platforms. * The Enthralled Wizards can be [[Skyrim:Frenzy (effect)|frenzied]] using [[Skyrim:Illusion Spells|illusion spells]] and seem to be surprisingly resilient to Morokei's attacks. They can be used to soften him up or even kill him. * [[Skyrim:Spell Absorption|Spell Absorption]] will cause Morokei's attacks to replenish your magicka rather than depleting it. * You can also call on a mage-type follower, such as [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]{{DG}} or Erandur, to drain his magicka pool with lightning spells, or have them attack head-on while you flank the dragon priest. * There are two platforms that the mages were standing on keeping Morokei imprisoned. If you stand on the higher platform, keeping a few feet from the edge so that you are between the pillars holding up the dragon head and use ranged attacks (preferably arrows poisoned with damage magicka regen) against him so that the lower half of his body is eclipsed by the small flame pits that hang over the edge, when he returns fire his lightning spells will scatter off of the surroundings leaving you completely unaffected with him under the impression that you are taking damage. If your follower is keeping him busy on the lower platform across from it so that he cannot come down the stairs this can make for a quick fight. * He can be lured down the stairs to the exit, where he may become stuck at a point next to the stairs and be unable to path to you or return ranged attacks. Once the dragon priest has been defeated, collect both [[Skyrim:Morokei (item)|Morokei's mask]] and the [[Skyrim:Staff of Magnus|Staff of Magnus]]. Your next objective will be to return to [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]]. ===Problems at Home=== Proceed through the door toward a shortcut out of Labyrinthian. Savos will again manifest, apologizing for sacrificing his companions to keep the Dragon Priest imprisoned, and swearing to seal the ruin. Unbar and open the wooden door. As you open a gate to the next room, [[Skyrim:Estormo|Estormo]], a [[Skyrim:Thalmor|Thalmor]] mage and associate of [[Skyrim:Ancano|Ancano]], will enter the room from the other side and block your path. He will tell you that he will take the Staff from you because Ancano wants it kept safe, and also wants you dead. Optionally defeat Estormo, and leave Labyrinthian. Outside, you will not be able to fast travel to the College. The nearest destination to which you can fast travel is Winterhold. Once you arrive there, enter the gate to the College. You will find [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]], along with [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]] and [[Skyrim:Arniel Gane|Arniel Gane]] battling [[Skyrim:Magic Anomaly#Magic Anomaly|magic anomalies]]. Once the anomalies are gone, speak to Tolfdir. He tells you that Ancano's power is growing, and that they cannot stop him. He ruefully hopes your trip to Labyrinthian was worth it. If you ask about Mirabelle, Tolfdir will tell you that she is dead; killed while ensuring everyone's escape from Ancano. Tolfdir asks you to lead the group inside to deal with Ancano. This completes the quest and initiates [[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|the Eye of Magnus quest]]. == Notes == *The magicka drain associated with Morokei's voice is scripted and always drains all your magicka, even if you used the Fortify Restoration exploit to create game-breaking Fortify Magicka items. It is completely unaffected by Resist Magic or Spell Absorption effects from potions or apparel. * Some of the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)#Optional Quests|optional quests]] cannot be completed while this quest is active. {{Bug|Both of the [[Skyrim:Enthralled Wizard|enthralled wizards]] in Labyrinthian Tribune are male, despite the fact that there was a female wizard remaining at the end of Savos Aren's endeavor.|USKP|1.2.4|The appearances of the wizards now match Hafnar and Atmah.}} *It is possible to bypass the part of the quest where you fight Estormo by backtracking through the dungeon instead of using the shorter exit path. The quest will progress normally after this is done. *Estormo was at one point meant to have another Thalmor agent named [[Skyrim:Unused NPCs#Muril|Muril]] with him. == Bugs == {{Bug|It is possible to receive two copies of the Staff of Magnus because a separate helper quest runs an EquipItem call on the base object instead of the alias reference.|USKP|2.0.5}} {{Bug|Estormo's low agression will cause him to accept a yield. He may also flee combat and is no longer hostile after regaining enough health.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Sometimes, the after-images of Savos and his companions will not engage in their intended dialogue, and stand still instead.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|One or more of the ghosts of Savos and his companions may be missing from their intended scenes.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|Morokei may not attack at all, simply floating towards you and not doing anything.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the prid 00086CF4 then kill [[Skyrim:Console|console commands]] to kill Morokei; the quest will advance directly to "Find the staff of Magnus". {{Bug|After killing the skeletal dragon, it will sometimes reanimate.}} {{Bug|The quest may fail to start after completing [[Skyrim:Containment|Containment]], and even trying manually start or end it with the console will not work.|confirmed=1}} ** Try completing any quest related to Labyrinthian before starting Containment mission, for some unknown reasons the quest fails to start if there is another quest with marker pointing to Labyrinthian. **{{Pc22}} Make sure that all of the NPCs in the College of Winterhold are still present and enabled; For example, you may not be able to find [[Skyrim:Arniel Gane|Arniel]] because he is disabled. In order to solve this issue, simply open the console and type prid then enable to re-enable a specific NPC. {{Bug|The loading screens for Labyrinthian were meant to stop once this quest is finished, but they never stop due to incorrect conditions governing this.|USKP|2.0.1}} {{Bug|This quest may fail to start if either [[Skyrim:Arniel Gane|Arniel Gane]] or [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]] are unavailable (killed, disabled, etc). Their parts in this quest are optional so their aliases have been marked to indicate this. The same issue can also prevent [[Skyrim:The Eye of Magnus|The Eye of Magnus]] from starting as well.|USSEP|4.2.6}} {{Bug|If you leave Labyrinthian early on and then come back, Morokei will sometimes not talk to you at all as you advance through the dungeon, but the magicka drain effect will still happen.}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||I need to retrieve the Staff of Magnus from within Labyrinthian and return with it to the College of Winterhold. Following [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]]'s instructions, travel to [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]] with the [[Skyrim:Jarrin Root|poisonous herb]] she gave you and report to head of security, [[Skyrim:Commander Maro|Commander Maro]]. Show him the [[Skyrim:Gourmet's Writ of Passage|writ]] you stole from [[Skyrim:Balagog gro-Nolob|the Gourmet]] to gain entrance to the [[Skyrim:Castle Dour, Emperor's Tower|castle]]. Maro will allow you to pass with no trouble (commenting on your clothing depending on whether or not you are wearing the chef's hat or clothes), telling you to report to the castle's chef, [[Skyrim:Gianna|Gianna]]. When Gianna greets you, she is both nervous and excited at the prospect of working with the great Gourmet. If you have yet to don your chef's hat, she will direct you to one on the shelf; you cannot begin "cooking" until you are appropriately attired. When you present yourself as the Gourmet, Gianna has unique responses depending on your race. {| class=wikitable !Race !!Response |- |[[Skyrim:High Elf|Altmer]] ||''"You're a High Elf! I... It is not necessary to poison the Emperor with the Jarrin Root, however, in order to successfully complete the quest—you may kill him any way you want. ===The Last Supper=== When the Potage is complete, follow Gianna into the dining room as she serves the food to the Emperor. Right before you go in, there is a copy of the [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments|Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments]]'' on the table to your left. The Emperor will be speaking to the [[Skyrim:Nobleman|diners]] and [[Skyrim:Noblewoman|a noblewoman]] about his [[Skyrim:Vittoria Vici|cousin's]] murder when you enter, while two [[Skyrim:Penitus Oculatus|Penitus Oculatus]] agents stand guard behind him. Gianna will serve the Emperor the meal you cooked and, regardless of the ingredients, he will compliment its amazing taste. If you added the Jarrin Root, the Emperor will soon die a rather unspectacular death. If you didn't add the poison, the Emperor and his guests will continue to slurp their soup until you assassinate him, which is easy enough since he has only 1 health point. The guards will attack you upon the Emperor's death, and Gianna will attempt to defend you before fleeing, although this may be avoided by successfully sneaking as he dies. Once the Emperor is dead, exit through the door opposite where you entered upstairs. ===Betrayal=== Once out the door it looks like you are home free. However, as you cross the bridge, you will be ambushed by Commander Maro and several of his agents. He reveals that the man you killed was a decoy. Maro explains that someone from the Dark Brotherhood betrayed you and revealed to Maro your plans to assassinate the Emperor. Maro agreed to allow the Brotherhood to continue its business in exchange for you. He then tells you that because the Dark Brotherhood killed his son he intends to go back on his word and wipe them out. He has sent his agents to attack the sanctuary already. As soon as the conversation with Maro begins, your bounty in [[Skyrim:Haafingar|Haafingar]] will be set to 1500, so the city guards will be on the lookout for you. Escape the city by following the tower's stairs to the very bottom and head to the Brotherhood Sanctuary. You cannot fast travel directly to the sanctuary, so the quickest option is to fast travel to [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]] and head west. The quest ends when you reach the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Sanctuary]]. == Notes == * The stew's name, Potage Le Magnifique, means "the magnificent soup" in French. * If you look inside the soup pot while Gianna delivers it to the Emperor, you will see an empty pot. * You will be blamed for the emperor's death even if you kill him in a stealthy way that would normally avoid incurring a bounty. * Two Penitus Oculatus Agents outside Castle Dour are never disabled after you finish the quest. * The fact that Gianna is surprised and disappointed when you present yourself as the Gourmet if you're an Orc is ironic, as the [[Skyrim:Balagog gro-Nolob|real Gourmet]] was an Orc. * In [[Skyrim:Anniversary Edition|Anniversary Edition]] or [[Skyrim:Special Edition|Special Edition]] with [[Skyrim:The Gray Cowl Returns!|The Gray Cowl Returns!]] [[Skyrim:Creation_Club|Creation]] installed. It is possible to use the [[Skyrim:Gray Cowl of Nocturnal|Gray Cowl of Nocturnal]] to avoid the bounty from the Solitude Guards. Wearing the cowl during the bridge encounter allows you to kill members of the Penitus Oculatus with no bounty. Guards are not hostile when you remove the cowl afterwards but members of the Penitus Oculatus might still remain hostile. Scripted bounty for murder goes to the Gray Cowl. When the headpiece is taken off, guards will have no suspicion on the Dragonborn. * Without Creation Club content, it's still possible to finish the quest without ever incurring any bounty (or other negative side effects), by utilizing [[SR:Glitches|glitches]]. ** After exiting the dining room, glitch [[SR:Glitches#Clipping|through]] or [[SR:Glitches#Object_Flying|over]] the wall of the bridge, to avoid triggering the encounter with Maro. After finishing the quest, plan a [[SR:Marriage|marriage]] and re-visit the bridge. Your character will get stuck around the spot where the Maro encounter would have triggered. By in-game waiting until you miss your wedding ceremony, you'll re-gain control over your character. ** This alternate method may also work {{VN|Doesn't seem to work anymore, see [[Skyrim_talk:To_Kill_an_Empire#No_Bounty|talk page]]}}: After exiting the dining room, cast a Destruction spell with a large area of effect (e.g. [[Skyrim:Fireball|Fireball]]) a couple of times in both the upper and lower doors across the bridge, and slowly walk across. You'll be stopped as if Maro was talking, but you'll quickly exit back out, not getting attacked by the Penitus Oculatus or getting the bounty. You can then easily leave. As long as you don't kill the men you won't get a bounty. You will need to leave the city by foot as the guards are scripted to be hostile, which prevents fast-travel. Killing any single Solitude guard undetected may remove the bounty. * If you wait before entering the Emperor's Tower, you can overhear a conversation between two Penitus Oculatus agents: ** '''Penitus Oculatus Agent 1''': ''"The city is crawling with [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]], and you know what? I'm still nervous."'' ** '''Penitus Oculatus Agent 2''': ''"Lazy and useless, the lot of them. They can't even keep the [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] in line. No way I trust them with the [[Skyrim:Emperor Titus Mede II|Emperor]]'s life."'' ** '''Penitus Oculatus Agent 1''': ''"You worry too much. The Emperor's never been safer. You think assassination attempts are planned overnight? We discovered the plot. End of story."'' ** '''Penitus Oculatus Agent 2''': ''"I suppose. But what about the old man? [[Skyrim:Gaius Maro|Son]] killed, [[Skyrim:Breaching Security|family name ruined]]...and he acts as if nothing even happened. Think's he's even fit for duty?"'' ** '''Penitus Oculatus Agent 1''': ''"I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that. Commander Maro is the best that the Penitus Oculatus ever produced. You should be half the man he is."'' ** '''Penitus Oculatus Agent 2''': ''"You misunderstand. Its just...I feel for him, is all. To carry a weight like that. It's got to take its toll. That happened to me, I'd be a wreck."'' * Before being confronted by Maro on the bridge, you can use [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] just before he appears to move freely while he is speaking. Attacking the guards before they turn hostile normally will cause Maro to vanish, and the guards will attack as normal. Note that you need to use all three words, otherwise you'll freeze in place like normal, and be forced to listen to Maro's speech. * If you do get a bounty, then as long as the three Penitus Oculatus men are dead, you can remove the bounty using your Thane status or Thieves Guild association (provided you have them available). However, even if you are a Thane of Haafingar, you will not be able to remove your bounty using your Thane status if Solitude is still under Imperial rule. * You should remove all items you own or want from the sanctuary before completing this quest, or they may be lost. However, the [[Skyrim:Unusual Gem|Unusual Gem]] located in Astrid's room will still be available. * Maro will have different dialogue based on your equipment when you arrive. If you are wearing a Chef's Hat or Chef's Tunic, he will say ''"Your clothes... of course... I should have realized..."'' Otherwise, he tells you ''"You are not dressed as I had expected."'' Regardless, he allows you to pass. * If you are in the form of a [[Skyrim:Werewolf|werewolf]] or [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|vampire lord]] while crossing the bridge, you'll automatically change back when Maro appears. * The room in the tower that Maro walks out from is completely empty, and does not even contain stairs or any other means of leaving it. He just appears before his speech is given, and disappears when he leaves behind the wall. You can get to it by using Whirlwind Sprint near the highest point of the bridge, though if Gaius Maro is still there, he will default to common dialogue and you cannot damage him. * After the quest, the Emperor's Tower will still be freely accessible, both from the walkway escape exit and from the front door inside the castle courtyard. However, the door to the dining hall will be permanently locked from both sides. The tower is completely abandoned after this point, so you can take what you want without consequence. Be aware that the whole place respawns, however, so it cannot be safely used as a house. * After you tell Gianna to add the jarrin root to the recipe, if you quickly enter your menu you can drop it from your inventory; this allows you to retrieve it later. The quest will continue and the Emperor will still die of poisoning. * According to the recipe that [[Skyrim:Uncommon Taste|exists]] in the game, carrots are a part of the "basic broth" that Gianna has already prepared. Yet, she will not object or even mention it if you suggest to add carrots. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Gianna may not talk to you if you are inflicted with certain diseases.|OSP|1.1}} {{Bug|This quest may not start on completion of [[Skyrim:Recipe for Disaster|Recipe for Disaster]].|confirmed=1}} **{{pc22}} Setting the stage through console does not work, as the stage always remains 0. ==Quick Walkthrough==
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]].
# Meet with Skjor at night.
# Enter the [[Skyrim:The_Underforge|Underforge]].
# Participate in the blood ritual.
# Talk to [[Skyrim:Aela_the_Huntress|Aela the Huntress]].
# Kill the [[Skyrim:Silver_Hand|werewolf hunters]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Secret Meeting===
After completing another set of radiant quests, the usual job providers will once again point you towards [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]]. Aela will say: 
''"Still eager to please. This is good. Skjor may be right about you. He has something special planned for you. Better talk to him."'', while Farkas and Vilkas will say: ''"Skjor was looking for you before. Talk to him before doing anything else."''

Skjor turns out to be less talkative than usual and will request a meeting after dark near the Underforge, a secret crypt underneath the smithy of [[Skyrim:Eorlund Gray-Mane|Eorlund Gray-Mane]]. At night, Skjor will wait for you near the secret entrance, determined to make you a [[Skyrim:The_Circle|stronger member]] of the Companions. He will then open the secret entrance and encourage you to follow.

Inside the Underforge, you will encounter [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela the Huntress]] in her lycanthropic form, standing next to an empty fountain. Skjor will introduce her as your 'forebear', and will inform you that this is to be kept secret from Harbinger [[Skyrim:Kodlak Whitemane|Kodlak Whitemane]], and will then ask if you are prepared. When you are ready, Skjor will cut open Aela's wrist, filling the fountain with her blood. Activate the fountain and receive the [[Skyrim:Beast Form|Beast Form]] power, which causes you to black out.

===Rampage===
You wake up outside the Underforge, now as a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolf]], where you will find all of Whiterun's residents are now hostile to you. If you head into the streets, citizens will flee and guards will attack you, leaving you no choice but to avoid them or kill them. Due to your beastly appearance, you will not gain a bounty for assaulting anyone. After a certain amount of time, you will black out once again.

The easiest way to avoid unwanted casualties is to simply wait a while after exiting the Underforge, as this causes your werewolf bloodlust to wear off, and the next scene to continue.

Another option is to go back into the Underforge as soon as you've transformed, and use the secret exit that leads you out of the city.

You can also simply avoid any attackers if you do not wish to kill any people in the city, you'll black out regardless of whether you killed anyone or not.

===The Silver Hand===
This time, you wake up in the middle of nowhere, with a concerned Aela looking over you. Your gear has been unequipped, but you haven't lost anything; simply re-equip to prepare for battle. Aela will congratulate you on surviving the initiation and inform you that the [[Skyrim:Silver Hand|Silver Hand]], a group of werewolf hunters, have inhabited [[Skyrim:Gallows Rock|Gallows Rock]] and will not hide the fact that they should be slaughtered right away. She also informs you that Skjor already entered the fort. From this point, Aela will act as your follower, dismissing your current follower if you have one. Head west towards the fort. A number of Silver Hand members will guard the exterior area, so dispose of them and enter the fort.

===Gallows Rock===
[[File:SR-quest-The_Silver_Hand_03.jpg|thumb|left|Aela fighting Krev the Skinner]]
[[File:SR-quest-The_Silver_Hand2.jpg|thumb|right|''"The bastards... somehow they managed to kill Skjor."'']]
The first room is a sealed-off area, so pull the chain next to the severed werewolf head and proceed forward. The fort is buzzing with enemies and werewolves in cages, both living and dead, all seemingly exposed to torture by their captors. Be on the lookout for the [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:The Importance of Where|The Importance of Where]]'' in the huge southern chamber, the [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]] skill book ''[[Skyrim:Last Scabbard of Akrash|The Last Scabbard of Akrash]]'' near the workbench, as well as several locked and unlocked chests. Aela will comment on the first dead werewolf you find, which is found next to a set of rare [[Skyrim:Torture Tools|Torture Tools]].

When you reach the northwestern chamber, Aela will rightfully warn you about Silver Hand leader [[Skyrim:Krev the Skinner|Krev the Skinner]], so be prepared. When the chamber is cleared, a worried Aela will run up onto the podium and discover the dead body of [[Skyrim:Skjor|Skjor]], obviously killed due to his lycanthropy. Once you speak with her, the quest will end and you will have to find your own way out, through the door to the northeast that was previously barred. Three new [[Skyrim:Companions#Radiant Quests|radiant quests]] are now available back in [[Skyrim:Jorrvaskr |Jorrvaskr]] and you will have to complete two of them (for Aela) before you can access the next major quest. However, if a certain amount of time has passed, you may only have to do one radiant quest to begin  [[Skyrim:Blood's Honor|Blood's Honor]].{{vn|section=Added_note}}

{{NewLeft}}

===Achievements===
One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked once you speak with [[Skyrim:Aela the Huntress|Aela]] after surviving the initiation:
* {{achievement|Blood Oath}}

==Notes==
*You don't need to wait until nightfall to meet Skjor. If you leave the Companions' compound, enter another building, and exit the building you entered, he will make his way to the entrance to the Underforge by the time you return, and the quest will continue like normal.
*If you sleep before meeting with Skjor and Aela, you will retain the effects of being Rested, Well Rested or Lover's Comfort until time expires. Your beast's blood will prevent you from getting them again unless you cure your lycanthropy after the Companions questline is completed, so do not sleep in any of the many beds in the Silver Hand base.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===A Word with Tonilia===
Once you have completed three [[Skyrim:Thieves_Guild_(faction)#Special Job Quests|reputation quests]] for the [[Skyrim:Thieves Guild_(faction)|Thieves Guild]], speak with [[Skyrim:Tonilia|Tonilia]] in the [[Skyrim:The_Ragged_Flagon|Ragged Flagon]]. Before you get a chance to say anything, she will ask you to do a favor for her. The Guild needs a reliable way to transport goods across Skyrim, and Tonilia believes the [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]] [[Skyrim: Khajiit Traders|caravans]] can be an asset in this regard - if they are willing, that is. She requests that you speak to the leader of the caravans, a Khajiit peddler named [[Skyrim:Ri'saad|Ri'saad]] about securing an alliance between the caravans and the Guild. In addition, you are to deliver a [[Skyrim:Quest_Items|satchel]] of [[Skyrim:Moon_Sugar|moon sugar]] to Ri'saad as a gift.

===Finding the Caravan===
To find Ri'saad, use the map to fast travel close to his caravan. The caravan travels between [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]] and [[Skyrim:Markarth|Markarth]], and stays outside each city for approximately two days before setting out again. Unless the caravan is camped for the night, it will move around. So, expect the target to move while you fast travel, and think about which direction it is traveling in and jump ahead. 

===A "Sweet" Deal===
After you have located the caravan, speak to Ri'saad, and tell him that you bring an offer from the Thieves Guild. This will cause the Khajiit to become thoughtful. To continue, hand him the moon sugar, which he will gratefully accept, saying that he looks forward to the partnership. Ri'saad will also comment that he and his fellow caravans will buy any stolen goods brought to them.

===Return to Tonilia===
To finish the quest, return to Tonilia. She will thank you for your help and reward you with a leveled amount of gold, as detailed below. In addition, the Khajiit [[Skyrim:Atahbah|Atahbah]], [[Skyrim:Ma'jhad|Ma'jhad]], and [[Skyrim:Zaynabi|Zaynabi]] will now fence stolen goods for you.

{{About|the quest|the location|Temple of Miraak}}{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Beezer1029 }}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn_Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=Automatic after completing [[Skyrim:Dragonborn (quest)|Dragonborn]] |Icon=SR-qico-Main 2.png |Reward=Word for the [[Skyrim:Dragon Aspect|Dragon Aspect]] shout,
The Black Book [[Skyrim:Black Book: Waking Dreams (book)|Waking Dreams]]. |Prev=[[Skyrim:Dragonborn (quest)|Dragonborn]] |Next=[[Skyrim:The Fate of the Skaal|The Fate of the Skaal]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]] |Image=SR-quest-The Temple Of Miraak.jpg |ImgDesc=[[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]] |ID=DLC2MQ02 |description= Uncover the source of [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]]'s power in the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]]. |SuggLevel=30 }} == Quick Walkthrough == # Travel to the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]]. # Find and talk to [[Skyrim:Frea|Frea]]. # Enter the temple and travel through it. # Read the Black Book ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Waking Dreams (book)|Waking Dreams]]'' at the end of the temple. == Detailed Walkthrough == ===Here in His Temple=== When you reach the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak|Temple of Miraak]] you will find that the exterior is under construction by the enthralled people of Solstheim, all of them forced by [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]] to rebuild the temple. You may also notice that you are not the only unenslaved person around, as [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|Skaal]] resident, [[Skyrim:Frea|Frea]], will be attempting to contact the mindless builders. Enter the center of the structure and the quest will begin with Frea seeking you out. She explains that she is there to either free or avenge her people, revealing that the workers are from [[Skyrim:Skaal Village|her village]]. She is also knowledgeable about the return of Miraak and will offer you companionship to help defeat him. Her assistance starts with locating the entrance to the underground Temple. Soon afterward, a gate will open and two [[Skyrim:Cultist|cultists]] will come rushing out, revealing the entrance. Dispose of them and follow Frea into the temple. ===Temple of Miraak=== [[File:SR-quest-The Temple Of Miraak 02.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Frea|Frea]] waits until the path is clear.]] Go through the first corridor and check the neighboring rooms for a few healing potions and a chest with minor loot. Proceed north until you reach a room with a [[Skyrim:Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] that triggers [[Skyrim:Dart Trap|darts]]. Two cultists will attack as well, but Frea will quickly show that she is a capable warrior and kill them on the spot. There is a restless [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] in the upright sarcophagus on the left-hand raised section in this room. There is also a dead (lootable) [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] in the sarcophagus on the right-hand side. These do not seem to emerge unless you climb onto the relevant raised section of floor. More pressure plates can be found in the next room, both of them triggering [[Skyrim:Battering Ram|battering rams]]. Avoid them and head west. Pull the lever to open the gate into what appears to be a torture-showroom, with several skeletons in cages and a throne that provides a good view of the mayhem. Frea will spot something near the throne but reckons it's impossible to reach. The task is of course left to you. Next to the broken stairs, jump onto the overturned pillar and from there, jump down to the platform and the throne. Claim the contents from the boss-leveled chest and jump back down. As you approach the bloody steps underneath the cages, a boss-leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] will break out of his sarcophagus and attack. When walking down the stairs, more cultists will show up. Finish the fights and continue forward. Activate the handle to gain access to the northeastern tunnel and fight the draugr who resides there. When you reach another pressure plate and a [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|swinging blades]] trap, you will be attacked on all sides by leveled draugr. The path now splits, but both paths will land you in the same catacombs with quick access to a huge chamber protected by yet another pressure plate triggering [[Skyrim:Flame Spout Trap|flame spouts]]. In the chamber, quite a few swinging blades will activate. Frea will order you to solve the problem, and even make herself comfortable while she waits. The blades' area of effect is easily avoided by simply hugging the walls of the chamber, though you can also just dodge them, by waiting for a second of space to pass through unarmed quickly, or by using the shouts; [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]], or [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]]. Stop the traps by activating the handle on the other side of the room and Frea will come walking up to you. Head through the door with her and face a closed iron gate. The adjacent window reveals a handle, so make your way there and activate it. There is also a chain in the room behind the gate that reveals a chamber with a chest. Behind the gate is another huge chamber, and several raised wooden bridges will fall into place when you enter. Two leveled draugr and a cultist will be waiting to the south. Dispose of them all and enter the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak Sanctum|Sanctum]]. ===Sanctum=== [[File:SR-quest-The Temple Of Miraak 03.jpg|thumb|right|The Gatekeeper attacks.]] The path ahead is quite narrow and leads onto a bridge where you will encounter at least six [[Skyrim:Skeleton|skeletons]]. Next up are several draugr bursting out of their coffins, along with more pressure plates triggering battering rams. You will now be in the chamber you just crossed on the bridge. To the right is a passage leading to a room with several potions, coin purses, and two spell tomes: an apprentice level [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] and an apprentice level [[Skyrim:Conjuration|Conjuration]] spell tome. Take what you want and return to the huge room where you will encounter more draugr and cultists. Head around the pit in the center of the room and go west. Before long, you will hear the easily recognizable chant from a [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] in the room ahead. The room contains both the word wall and a provocative trophy, hung there by Miraak as a symbol of his superiority. While Frea comments on this, go and learn the first word for the [[Skyrim:Dragon Aspect|Dragon Aspect]] shout (or the second, if you have already learned the first word in Raven Rock Mine). This will cause numerous draugr to attack, including the unique [[Skyrim:Gatekeeper|Gatekeeper]]. After the battle, search the Gatekeeper for the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak Key|temple key]] then find his sarcophagus on the western wall and unlock the door behind it. It opens to a macabre dining table, the skeletal guests still in their seats. Behind the table is a tunnel leading to a larger dining area with a kitchen behind. When you reach the kitchen, Frea will realize it is a dead end and will order you to have a look around while she backtracks to the dining area. The kitchen contains an [[Skyrim:Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]], a few potions and ingredients, and most importantly, a path in the southeastern corner leading to a handle. When activated, a hidden door in the dining area will open up. In the next chamber, Frea will hint that there may be something in there that fills in the holes in the story of [[Skyrim:Miraak (person)|Miraak]], and will head into the next room and gaze at the statues. Similar to her actions back in the trapped room, she will ask you to activate the button while she waits at a safe distance. The handle removes the grate in the floor and reveals a wooden staircase going down. Head down and follow the path to another set of stairs. Proceed through two empty rooms until you find a handle lowering the rock wall. Continue down yet more stairs and open the door. A huge chamber will be revealed, guarded by draugr and skeletons, and booby-trapped with [[Skyrim:Tripwire|tripwires]] triggering [[Skyrim:Falling Boulders|falling boulders]]. Make your way to the top and face a boss-leveled draugr, being sure to loot the chest behind his sarcophagus. Activate the chain on the southern wall and follow the serpentine path until you reach your target, a pedestal holding a [[Skyrim:Black Book (book)|Black Book]], ''[[Skyrim:Black Book: Waking Dreams (book)|Waking Dreams]]''. ===Waking Dreams=== [[File:SR-quest-The Temple Of Miraak 04.jpg|thumb|right|''"Who are you to dare set foot here?"'']] When you read the Black Book, dark tentacles will reach out of the book's pages and grab you. You will be transported to a [[Skyrim:Apocrypha (Waking Dreams)|strange realm]] just in time to see [[Skyrim:Sahrotaar|a dragon]] arrive. Nearby are a few [[Skyrim:Seeker|seekers]] standing guard and Miraak himself. You will be unable to move and can do nothing but listen to Miraak's monologue: ''"Who are you to dare set foot here? Ahh... You are Dragonborn. I can feel it. And yet..."'' At this point his dialogue will differ depending on your progress of the main quest (see [[#Notes|notes]]). After the conditional comment he will continue, ''"You have no idea of the true power a Dragonborn can wield!"'' He will then demonstrate the Dragon Aspect shout. ''"Mul... Qah Diiv! This realm is beyond you. You have no power here. And it is only a matter of time before Solstheim is also mine. I already control the minds of its people. Soon they will finish building my temple, and I can return home."'' He will then turn to the four seekers and say: ''"Send him/her back where he/she came from. He/She can await my arrival with the rest of Tamriel."'' The seekers will then shower you with magic and while you slowly lose consciousness, you can see Miraak mount the dragon and fly away. Moments later, you will be back in the [[Skyrim:Temple of Miraak Sanctum|Sanctum]] and Frea will demand an explanation. As soon as she realizes the potential danger of the situation, she will suggest that you follow her to her village and talk to her father, [[Skyrim:Storn Crag-Strider|Storn Crag-Strider]]. This ends the quest and begins the next in line, [[Skyrim:The Fate of the Skaal|The Fate of the Skaal]]. Since the Black Book is an inventory item, you may re-read it at any time, and explore it more thoroughly in Miraak's absence, all the way up to getting the second (or third) word of the Dragon Aspect shout: however you will not be able to unlock the final part of the book until the concluding part of the Main Quest, when you *must* return here. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements#Dragonborn|achievement]] is unlocked when you complete this quest: * {{Achievement|The Temple of Miraak (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== * During your encounter with Miraak his dialogue will differ, based on your progress and how many dragons you have killed. This table shows the dialogue bits and the conditions: :{|class=wikitable width=90% ! Dialogue !! Conditions |- | ''"You have done little beyond killing a few dragons."''||Fewer than 10 dragons killed |- | ''"You have defeated dragons, yes, but still..."''||Between 10 and 25 dragons killed |- |''"You have slain a great many dragons, I see. And yet..."''||Over 25 dragons killed |- |''"So you have slain Alduin... Well done. I could have slain him myself, back when I walked the earth, but I chose a different path."''||Completed [[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]] |} *When you kill the very first dragon after completing this quest, Miraak will appear and steal the soul from you, as he will 25% of the time with other dragons you kill until the Dragonborn questline is completed. His appearances are scripted, and will occur regardless of if you are in Skyrim or on Solstheim. He is unable to be attacked or interacted with, as he will appear in an ethereal state and is a "ghost". The only option when encountering him is to just let him steal the soul from you. His first appearance is ''always'' guaranteed; afterwards he will only appear 25% of the time. There is one exception in some cases for the first dragon you kill; see the notes of the next quest for details. *This quest may be started after completing [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]] by cleansing the [[Skyrim:Wind Stone|Wind Stone]], Talking to Storn afterwards will have him direct you to the temple, starting this quest and bypassing Dragonborn (quest) entirely. *If you sleep on Solstheim during Dragonborn, you may be transported to the Tree Stone at the Temple, which thus completes that quest and starts this one. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Frea may randomly appear at locations throughout the temple, and may not follow you once the next quest has begun. If you dismiss your follower, or tell them to wait outside, and re-enter the temple, she should reappear near where you found the book. This seems to happen because the script that causes her to lead you out on the next quest only activates if you speak to her near that spot.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|If you exit the temple before finishing your search, Frea's script will believe you left and therefore walk back to the entrance interior and will not follow you until you rejoin her there and pull out your weapons. She will then re-follow you back down and behave normally.|confirmed=0}} {{Bug|After reading the Black Book and being teleported to Apocrypha, Miraak may be cut off after the first line "The time comes soon when..." and you then are transported back to the Sanctum unable to move indefinitely. This can be fixed by saving in Apocrypha and then loading afterwards.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|After reading the Black Book, completing the dialogue, and leaving, Frea will say her lines and walk back to Skaal Village but will never talk to Storn and the next quest will not begin.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The variable Miraak checks when determining how many dragons you have slain is never updated by the game, resulting in him always saying, ''"You have done little beyond killing a few dragons."'' unless you have slain Alduin.|UDBP|2.0.2|The dialogue is instead determined by how many dragon souls you have absorbed.}} {{Bug|Miraak's scene (DLC2MQ02MiraakApocryphaScene) has an incorrect gender check which blocks the response line for female player characters.|USLEEP|3.0.6}} {{Bug|Frea can be asked what the Tree Stone is. Unfortunately, there is an unnecessary restriction on the topic preventing it from being accessible in an interior.|USSEP|4.3.2}} {{Bug|The two Cultists outside the Temple may never despawn once the quest is finished. They may also respawn after some time and attack you again.|USSEP|4.3.8}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |5||After freeing the Skaal from the magic controlling them, Storn, the shaman, has asked me to seek out a member of their tribe who is still missing. I need to look to the temple near the center of Solstheim to find Frea and make sure she is safe. {{Quest Objective|5|Find Frea}} |10||I've found Miraak's temple on Solstheim. He then suggests you speak to Neloth, as he may have more information about the Black Book that gave Miraak power over dragons. 

Once in Tel Mithryn, Neloth can be asked about where to find this Black Book.  (Start this conversation with him only if you are prepared to ''immediately'' follow him at the end of the conversation, to avoid a [[#before he opens the front gate at Nchardak|bug]] that stops progress.)  He replies: ''"You refer to the tomes of esoteric knowledge that old [[Skyrim:Hermaeus Mora|Hermaeus Mora]] has scattered throughout the world? What could you know of them?"''
