[[fr:Skyrim:Sous Saarthal]] {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Nephele |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Gwildor |rewardChecked=Likelolwhat }}{{Trail2|Quests|College of Winterhold|link2=College of Winterhold (faction)}} {{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver= [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] |Reward= [[Skyrim:Staff of Magelight|Staff of Magelight]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Ice Form|Ice Form]] shout |Disp= |Rep= |Prev= [[Skyrim:First Lessons|First Lessons]] |Conc= [[Skyrim:Forbidden Legend|Forbidden Legend]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]] |Loc= [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]], [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (place)|College of Winterhold]] |Image=SR-quest-Under Saarthal.jpg |ImgDesc=The secret of Saarthal |description= Uncover the mysteries beneath this ancient ruin. |ID=MG02 |Icon=SR-qico-College of Winterhold.png |SuggLevel=6 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Meet [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] and the trainees outside [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]]. # Follow Tolfdir into the ruins. # Find [[Skyrim:Arniel Gane|Arniel Gane]] and help him find some artifacts. # Use the [[Skyrim:Saarthal Amulet|Saarthal Amulet]] to escape the trap. # Follow Tolfdir deeper into the ruins. # Discover the danger within Saarthal. # Talk to the Arch-Mage and receive your reward. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Meeting at Saarthal=== This quest automatically starts at the end of [[Skyrim:First Lessons|First Lessons]], when [[Skyrim:Tolfdir|Tolfdir]] suggests that visiting the ruins of [[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]] would be an excellent opportunity to learn more about the "''various applications of magic throughout history''". Saarthal's location is added to your map (if you have not yet discovered it yourself), and Tolfdir and the other College of Winterhold students will start travelling there. They walk the entire distance, meaning that it is easily possible to travel to Saarthal more quickly than any of your companions. It takes them at least four in-game hours to make the trip, longer if they have to deal with multiple enemies (however, all of the students are given protected status at the start of the quest, meaning they are not at risk of being killed along the way). If you are trying to find them en route, they walk from the College into the town of [[Skyrim:Winterhold|Winterhold]], then turn onto a path that leads west from behind the [[Skyrim:Jarl's Longhouse (Winterhold)|Jarl's Longhouse]]. You may find it convenient to do another quest in between First Lessons and Under Saarthal, instead of waiting at the ruins for Tolfdir to show up. When Tolfdir arrives at Saarthal, you can advance the quest by selecting the dialogue option, "I'm ready. Let's go." At that point, the door to Saarthal unlocks and you can enter. You can select the "I'm ready" dialogue before Tolfdir actually gets all the way to the entrance—the dialogue option becomes available at the top of the stairs leading down into the excavation pit (at the same point where you are first told that you have discovered Saarthal). You do not need to wait for the other students before proceeding with the quest; any missing students will appear as soon as you enter Saarthal. If you choose to delay before proceeding with this quest, Tolfdir and the students will stand around outside Saarthal, indefinitely. Tolfdir will still offer services, including selling [[Skyrim:Alteration|Alteration]] spell books, without triggering the quest. ===Second Lessons=== {{Notice |This article focuses on the '''Under Saarthal''' quest, specifically how to complete all the quest objectives. For information about the dungeon itself, including locations of all loot, see '''[[Skyrim:Saarthal|Saarthal]]'''.|color=blue}} : Tolfdir will lead you and the other students into the excavation, playing the role of teacher and tour guide: :''As some of you may know, Saarthal was one of the earliest Nord settlements in Skyrim. It was also the largest. Sacked by the elves in the infamous "Night of Tears," not much is known about what happened to Saarthal. This is an exciting opportunity for us. To be able to study such an early civilization, and the magics they used...'' When questioned about the importance of Saarthal, he will also tell you that: :''We're particularly interested in the prevalence of magical seals placed on the tombs here. It's rather unlike anything we've encountered.'' In spite of Tolfdir's repeated warnings about safety, there are no enemies in the first rooms of the excavation. Each of your fellow students has a different reaction to Saarthal. [[Skyrim:Onmund|Onmund]] is the least happy of the three, repeatedly complaining about being in the burial site of his ancestors: "''There's no chance anyone in authority approved this. Our ancestors should be allowed to rest in peace.''" His concerns have evoked some sympathy from [[Skyrim:Brelyna Maryon|Brelyna]], who comments, "''To think, my ancestors destroyed the homes of Onmund's ancestors. So much bloodshed.''" As usual, [[Skyrim:J'zargo|J'zargo]] is only interested in how he might be able to profit from the expedition, "''Do you think there's treasure here? Something to make J'zargo a powerful wizard?''" Once Tolfdir has led you through the first room, he will start handing out assignments to all of his students. Your task is to help [[Skyrim:Arniel Gane|Arniel Gane]] find some artifacts: :''Ah, yes. Hmm. Well, why don't you see if you can assist Arniel Gane? He's one of our scholars, here working on cataloging our finds. I expect he'd appreciate some help in locating any additional magical artifacts here in the ruins. Any enchanted items will do; the usefulness of the enchantment is irrelevant. If you find anything, the class can look it over.'' He also has tasks for the other three students, although none of them end up having any luck completing their tasks: * For Brelyna: ''Brelyna, my dear, why don't you search for warding magics. Anything designed to keep people out. Don't interact with them, just identify them.'' ** Her subsequent response: ''I'm not seeing signs of any warding magics at all. Either they're not here, or they were removed long ago.'' * For Onmund: ''Onmund, please search that area over there. See if you notice any... residual energies. Alive or undead.'' ** His subsequent response: ''I wonder if everyone else would be so happy to rifle through the bones of their ancestors.'' * For J'zargo: ''J'zargo... what shall we have you do... Ah! Why don't you verify that we're the first ones here? Look for any amount of tampering with the tombs.'' ** His subsequent response: ''J'zargo finds nothing but dust in these ruins.'' ===The Saarthal Amulet=== [[File:SR-quest-Under Saarthal 02.jpg|thumb|right|The [[Skyrim:Saarthal Amulet|Saarthal Amulet]]]] To complete your assignment, you need to venture deeper into the ruin, into the passageways west of the second chamber, where you will find Arniel Gane engrossed in his research. When you interrupt his work, he seems less than excited about having an assistant: :''Ah, yes. You. I remember you. You're going to help? That's fine. Just... Just don't make a mess of my work. I've only looked through a portion of this section. You, uh, you can look around in the chambers just north of here. Try and be careful, all right? We don't want to damage anything.'' Although talking to Arniel doesn't give you much new information about your assignment, it does update your quest objective and, even more importantly, adds quest objective markers to each of the four items: three [[Skyrim:Enchanted Ring|Enchanted Ring]]s and one "Ancient Amulet". Finding the three rings is entirely optional and has no effect on the outcome of the quest. They are lying on the floor at three locations in the nearby passageways. Although the rings can be obtained without talking to Arniel, finding the small items without quest markers is very challenging. If you do find one of them on the floor before talking to Arniel, the quest will update and you will have markers for the other two. It is also easier to collect the rings before picking up the Ancient Amulet rather than after—once you have the amulet, your quest objectives update and you lose the quest markers pointing to the rings. At any point after finding the Ancient Amulet, you can return to Arniel Gane and give him any Enchanted Rings that you have found. He takes all the rings from you, but he is more concerned with the mess you have made than with the new artifacts, and does not give you any reward (not even a boost to his disposition). Therefore, you may prefer to instead keep the rings with their +20 [[Skyrim:Fortify Health|Fortify Health]] enchantment for yourself; they are not quest items and can be freely sold, given to a follower, or disenchanted. Or if you really want to cover all bases, you can pick up just one ring, give it to Arniel, and then pick up the other two, and keep them (Arniel won't even recognize any additional rings after you give him the first one). The only artifact that must be found to advance the quest is the Ancient Amulet. It can be found at the northernmost end of the passageways, suspended in front of a brightly-lit, arched section of the wall. You can actually pick up the Amulet at any point (before even getting the assignment from Tolfdir) if you are in a rush to advance the quest. As soon as you pick up the Amulet, a spear trap activates behind you, locking you into the small space. If Tolfdir is nearby he will suggest that you try using the amulet. In your inventory, it is listed as the [[Skyrim:Saarthal Amulet|Saarthal Amulet]] (under Apparel), and has an enchantment that reduces spell costs by 3%. More importantly, equipping the amulet will trigger a visible resonance effect in the wall where you found it, causing Tolfdir to suggest "''I wonder... what effect might your spells have?''" This is your hint: casting any targeted spell or shout at the wall while wearing the amulet collapses the wall. The [[Skyrim:Flames|Flames]] spell given to all players at the start of the game is one possible spell, but any spell or shout cast at a target will work. Collapsing the wall also lowers the barrier behind you, allowing Tolfdir to rush forward. ===The Psijic Warning=== Tolfdir is very excited about the newly-revealed sections of the ruin: "''Well, this is highly unusual. And very interesting. Why in the world would this be sealed off? What is this place?''". You soon learn, however, that other people have also observed your actions, and they are less pleased with this turn of events. Once both you and Tolfdir have made it to the small burial room at the end of the new passageway, a ghostly apparition identified as [[Skyrim:Nerien|Nerien]] appears, with dire warnings: :''Hold, mage, and listen well... Know that you have set in motion a chain of events that cannot be stopped. Judgment has not been passed, as you had no way of knowing. Judgment will be passed on your actions to come, and how you deal with the dangers ahead of you. This warning is passed to you because the [[Skyrim:Psijic Order|Psijic Order]] believes in you. You, mage, and you alone, have the potential to prevent disaster. Take great care, and know that the Order is watching.'' Nerien then vanishes, leaving you alone again with Tolfdir, who clearly did not see or hear the ghost, although he did feel "something rather strange". When you tell him what happened, he is perplexed: :''The Psijic Order? Are you quite sure about that? That's very odd. And danger ahead? Why that doesn't make any sense at all. The Psijics have no connection to these ruins. And no one's seen any of their order in a long time.'' If you ask him why the Psijic Order is contacting you, he can provide some additional information: :''I have no idea, but it's fascinating. Assuming it's true, of course. The [[Lore:Artaeum|Isle of Artaeum]] disappeared over a hundred years ago, and no one has seen them since. And yet now, suddenly, they have chosen to contact you? Why, it's intriguing! If nothing else, I'd take it as a compliment. The Psijics have only ever dealt with those they feel worthy.'' Tolfdir finishes up by suggesting that the coffins in the room should be searched. Predictably, the coffins contain two leveled [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]], who jump out and attack on Tolfdir's cue. However, the draugr also uncover the way forward, through the back of one of the coffins. The Dragonborn should then follow Tolfdir to a barred gate in a room. Tolfdir will stop and wait there and do absolutely nothing until you pull the lever and open the gate. From this point until the end of the dungeon, Saarthal is a typical Nordic ruin, containing leveled draugr enemies. There is a rotating pillar puzzle in one room; the symbol to match is above and behind each pillar. The second puzzle is like the first: match each pillar with the symbol behind it. The catch is that each of four pillars will turn as many as three of the other pillars with it, so the sequence is critical. The fastest solution is as follows; the second pillar on the left should be turned to whale first (because it turns the other three with it.) Then, the first pillar on the left should be turned to snake (that will turn the two on the right.) Next, the second pillar on the right should be turned to hawk (that one will turn the last one.) And finally, the first one on the right should be turned to whale. === The Mysterious Orb === [[File:SR-quest-Under Saarthal 04.jpg|thumb|left|''"Be bound here, Jyrik, murderer, betrayer
Condemned by your crimes against realm and lord.
May your name and your deeds be forgotten forever
And the charm which you bear be sealed by our ward."'']] [[File:SR-quest-Under Saarthal 03.jpg|thumb|right|[[Skyrim:Jyrik Gauldurson|Jyrik Gauldurson]], in his fire-resistant form]] After exploring most of the second zone of Saarthal on your own, Tolfdir will catch up with you right before you enter a large room, approaching the end of the dungeon; this effectively alerts you that the quest is resuming. At the far end of this room floats a massive spinning orb, surrounded by a swirling energy barrier. Tolfdir is immediately fascinated by the orb: :''Well now... would you look at that. I never imagined we'd find something like this. Why is this buried so far within Saarthal?'' However, he is unable to fully investigate, because approaching the orb attracts the attention of [[Skyrim:Jyrik Gauldurson|Jyrik Gauldurson]], a unique and powerful [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] who has been trapped in Saarthal for eons. Your initial attempts to damage Jyrik will inevitably fail, because he is drawing energy from the orb to make himself invincible. Once Tolfdir realizes what is happening he rushes down to the orb and works on severing the connection between Jyrik and the orb. After four seconds, Tolfdir starts to cast a lightning-like spell at the barrier surrounding the orb, which succeeds in making Jyrik vulnerable. Tolfdir spends the rest of the battle maintaining his spell, leaving you to take care of actually attacking Jyrik. Jyrik is still a challenging enemy, in part because of a rotating elemental shield. Once you have killed him, be sure to loot his corpse for the [[Skyrim:Gauldur Amulet Fragment|Gauldur Amulet Fragment]] and ''[[Skyrim:Writ of Sealing (Jyrik)|Writ of Sealing]]'', both of which are necessary for the [[Skyrim:Forbidden Legend|Forbidden Legend]] quest; if you had not previously started this quest, reading the writ or taking the amulet fragment will trigger it. The [[Skyrim:Staff of Jyrik Gauldurson|Staff of Jyrik Gauldurson]] can also be found nearby. Jyrik's death also causes the energy barrier around the orb to disappear, allowing Tolfdir to at last examine the orb more closely (and also allowing you to access a door behind the orb). When asked what he thinks it is, he replies: :''I have no idea! This is amazing. Absolutely amazing. The Arch-Mage needs to be informed immediately. He needs to see this for himself. I don't dare leave this unattended. Can you return to the College and inform [[Skyrim:Savos Aren|Savos Aren]] of this discovery? Please, hurry.'' If you ask for more specific instructions about what to tell the Arch-Mage, he suggests: :''Let him know that we've unearthed something... Well, I'm not sure. Something unique, let's say. It's clearly magical in nature, but like nothing I've ever seen before. He should be most interested.'' Take advantage of the door behind the orb to discover a shortcut back to the entrance of Saarthal—and don't miss the [[Skyrim:Ice Form|Ice Form]] [[Skyrim:Word Wall|Word Wall]] and boss chest along the way. {{NewLeft}} === Wrapping Up === Back at the College, talk to Savos Aren, whose previously inaccessible [[Skyrim:Arch-Mage's Quarters|Arch-Mage's Quarters]] have now been unlocked. His initial reaction is amusing: :''Please don't tell me that another one of the apprentices has been incinerated. I have enough to deal with right now.'' You can choose between two follow-up responses, either "''We've found something in Saarthal, and Tolfdir thinks it's important.''" or "''We found some sort of... orb. Tolfdir wanted you to see it.''" Both have the same ultimate result, although Savos seems somewhat unimpressed by the latter response. In the end, he thanks you and rewards you with a [[Skyrim:Staff of Magelight|Staff of Magelight]] (suggesting that it may come in handy if you explore any more Nordic Ruins). He also tells you to check with [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]] for any possible leads regarding the nature of the artifact, initiating the [[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]] quest. Completing this quest also has several advantageous effects. Your rank in the College of Winterhold is increased from Student (rank 0) to Apprentice (rank 1), and your disposition with Tolfdir is increased. Multiple radiant quests related to the College of Winterhold are also enabled once Under Saarthal is complete, namely [[Skyrim:Brelyna's Practice|Brelyna's Practice]], [[Skyrim:J'zargo's Experiment|J'zargo's Experiment]], and [[Skyrim:Onmund's Request|Onmund's Request]]. If you wish to start any of these quests right away, rush back to Saarthal and catch any of the four quest-givers as they start their slow walk back to the College of Winterhold. If it is night, after sleeping in your bed for one hour, they will appear in the Hall of Attainment. Otherwise, they can eventually be found around the college. Tolfdir's radiant quest, [[Skyrim:Tolfdir the Absent-Minded|Tolfdir the Absent-Minded]] is also triggered by the completion of Under Saarthal, however, to start that quest Tolfdir must also be located in the College. Since Tolfdir stays in Saarthal to continue watching over the orb, his quest can only be started when Hitting the Books is nearly complete (Tolfdir returns when, behind the scenes, the orb itself is moved to the college). ==Notes== * Tolfdir's dialogue topic leading you back to Savos Aren is bound to the death of Jyrik Gauldurson. If you raise Jyrik's corpse before speaking to Tolfdir, you will not be able to continue the quest until the effect wears off. * You may want to talk to [[Skyrim:Mirabelle Ervine|Mirabelle Ervine]] after completing the quest to learn a few additional details about the Psijic Order. She will tell you: *:''They're a very old order. Pre-dated the Imperial [[Lore:Mages Guild|Mages Guild]] by quite a bit. In fact, the Mages Guild was founded in opposition to the idea of the Psijic Order, that only an elite few should have control over magic. No one has seen or heard from them in over a hundred years now, though.'' * [[Skyrim:Ancano|Ancano]] learns that something was discovered in Saarthal, and subsequently tracks you down and interrogates you. If you have gone directly down the stairs to [[Skyrim:The Arcanaeum|The Arcanaeum]] and spoken with [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]], Ancano will stop you there. Otherwise, [[Skyrim:Faralda|Faralda]] warns you about the impending interrogation, and is concerned that you "''mind what you tell him''". (Speaking to her after Ancano has an incongruous dialogue entry.) When Ancano questions you, you don't have an opportunity to tell him anything—in fact, he does more talking than you do. *:''Something was discovered in Saarthal that was significant enough that Tolfdir sent a new member of the College, alone, to deliver word. That sounds precisely like the sort of thing that should matter to everyone. Especially me.'' *This is a prerequisite quest for completing [[Skyrim:Forbidden Legend|Forbidden Legend]] as one of the three [[Skyrim:Gauldur Amulet Fragment|Gauldur Amulet fragments]] is located in Saarthal, and this quest is the only way to unlock Saarthal. *You were [[Skyrim:Unused NPCs#Saarthal Miner|originally]] meant to find miners hired by the College to excavate the ruins here. There are six possible variants, but they were ultimately cut, possibly due to the lack of space inside Saarthal. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Although all three students are supposed to walk to Saarthal at the start of this quest, they may not all actually make the trip. However, this does not have any effect on the quest. Once you enter Saarthal with Tolfdir, the students will appear there with you.|USKP|1.1}} {{Bug|Occasionally, Tolfdir may not show up at all and the quest will be stuck because he cannot unlock Saarthal. This may be triggered by Tolfdir fighting an animal nearby and remaining at that position.|confirmed=1}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console command prid 0001C1A1 followed by moveto player to solve this issue. {{Bug|Sometimes, when you're about to fight Jyrik Gauldurson, Tolfdir won't make a remark about the orb and thus the quest won't update, but Jyrik Gauldurson will still attack.|confirmed=1}} **This can be resolved by leaving and entering again. {{Bug|Tolfdir may pick up the Staff of Jyrik Gauldurson during combat, to get it back you will have to buy it from him.|confirmed=1}} {{Bug|The gate may not open when you collapse the wall after taking the Saarthal Amulet, which makes it impossible to finish the quest.}} **This can be prevented by talking to Tolfdir before collapsing the wall. {{Bug|The door between the Saarthal Excavation and Saarthal dungeons may not open.}} **Loading an earlier save and trying again should eventually fix this. {{Bug|The quest marker will lead to the Arcanaeum instead of the Arch-Mage's Quarters while standing in the Hall of the Elements after returning from Saarthal.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |0||Tolfdir has decided to take us to investigate the ruins of Saarthal to explore the more practical uses of magic. |10||Tolfdir has asked the Apprentices to meet him at Saarthal, the site of an ongoing excavation by the College. {{Quest Objective|10|Meet Tolfdir outside Saarthal}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Follow Tolfdir}} |25||In the College excavation at Saarthal, I've been asked to assist Arniel Gane with his work uncovering the ruins. {{Quest Objective|25|Find Arniel Gane}} |30||I've been asked to assist Arniel Gane in his work at the excavation in Saarthal by collecting enchanted objects scattered around the ruins. {{Quest Objective|30|Search for magical artifacts (/4)}} |40:2||While helping in the excavation in Saarthal by gathering enchanted items, I somehow triggered some sort of trap. It has revealed an unexplored section of the ruins, and Tolfdir would like me to follow him further in. |^||While exploring the excavation in Saarthal, I somehow triggered some sort of trap. It has revealed an unexplored section of the ruins, and Tolfdir would like me to follow him further in. |50||While following Tolfdir through an unexplored section of Saarthal, a vision from the Psijic Order has suggested that something has been set in motion by the exploration of Saarthal. Tolfdir should be warned. {{Quest Objective|50|Tell Tolfdir about the vision}} |60||While in an unexplored area of Saarthal, I received a vision from someone in the Psijic Order saying there's something dangerous in Saarthal. Despite this, Tolfdir wishes to forge ahead and has asked that I follow him. {{Quest Objective|60|Follow Tolfdir}} |70||During an expedition to Saarthal, I uncovered a new section of the ruins, and was warned by a vision from someone in the Psijic Order of danger within. Despite this, Tolfdir and I have explored further and found a strange orb buried deep within Saarthal. Tolfdir has asked that I take news of the discovery to the Arch-Mage. {{Quest Objective|70|Talk to the Arch-Mage}} |200|fin|I've delivered word to the Arch-Mage that something interesting was found deep within Saarthal. |''Unknown''||{{Quest Objective|35|Use the Saarthal Amulet to escape the trap}} {{Quest Objective|40|Follow Tolfdir}} {{Quest Objective|65|Find the danger within Saarthal}} [[Category:Skyrim-SRQRP-Unknown Objectives]] |missing=11 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Prev=[[Skyrim:First Lessons|First Lessons]]|Next=[[Skyrim:Hitting the Books|Hitting the Books]]|Up=[[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)#Quests|College of Winterhold]]}}

Skyrim:Whispers in the Dark.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Beezer1029 |checkedBy= |reward=Baron |rewardChecked=Kiz }}{{Quest Header |type=Dark Brotherhood |Giver=[[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]] |Reward=None |Disp= |Rep= |Prev=[[Skyrim:Mourning Never Comes|Mourning Never Comes]] |Conc= |Next=[[Skyrim:Kill Narfi|Kill Narfi]], [[Skyrim:Kill Beitild|Kill Beitild]], [[Skyrim:Kill Ennodius Papius|Kill Ennodius Papius]], [[Skyrim:Kill Hern|Kill Hern]] and/or [[Skyrim:Kill Lurbuk|Kill Lurbuk]], followed by [[Skyrim:The Silence Has Been Broken|The Silence Has Been Broken]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]] |Image=SR-quest-Whispers in the Dark.jpg |ImgDesc=The Night Mother |description=Spy on the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]]'s [[Skyrim:Cicero|keeper]] to see if he is planning sabotage against the [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Brotherhood]]. |ID=DB04 |Icon=SR-qico-Dark Brotherhood.png }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Hide in the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]]'s coffin and listen to [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]]. # Step out and confront Cicero and [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]]. # Take contracts from [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Secret Agent=== After returning from your assassination mission in [[Skyrim:Mourning Never Comes|Mourning Never Comes]], Astrid will confide that she needs help with a matter of a somewhat more personal nature. She confesses that she is a little concerned about the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]]'s Keeper, [[Skyrim:Cicero|Cicero]]. The strange and erratic jester has been locking himself in the chamber with the Night Mother's coffin and frantically whispering to someone. Astrid fears a conspiracy and asks you to spy on Cicero to see what he is up to. However, in order to effectively eavesdrop and not be detected she asks you to hide in the coffin with the Night Mother's corpse. You can state your objections or remain silent at this strange directive, but in either case, make your way to the chamber to make yourself cozy with the Night Mother. [[File:SR-quest-Whispers in the Dark 2.jpg|right|thumb|The Night Mother speaks]] You can talk to the other Dark Brotherhood members about [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]]'s conspiracy theory. You can tell them: ''"Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero."'' They all answer differently: [[Skyrim:Arnbjorn|Arnbjorn]]: ''"She said that? If I find anyone working against my wife, or this [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Sanctuary]], I'll beat them to death with their own severed head. Of course, they'd probably already be dead... But you know what I mean!"'' [[Skyrim:Babette|Babette]]: ''"Oh! Well, I hope she doesn't suspect me. I mean, I've spoken with Cicero a bit, and he's quite charming. But I'd never go against Astrid. Never."'' [[Skyrim:Festus Krex|Festus Krex]]: ''" Ha! And would that surprise anyone? This Sanctuary's a mess. Wouldn't surprise me if somebody's talking to the fool on the sly. Making deals. And no, before you ask, it's not me. I know which side my bread is buttered on."'' [[Skyrim:Gabriella|Gabriella]]: ''"To what end? Usurping Astrid's authority as leader of the Sanctuary? Hmmm... Yes, I can see her concern. Thank you for bringing this to my attention."'' [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]]: ''"Does she? Listen, brother/sister... Astrid is my mistress, and I worship the ground she walks on. But this Cicero business has her a bit... paranoid."'' [[Skyrim:Veezara|Veezara]]: ''"You're joking. While I can understand if some family members wish to honor the [[Lore:Dark Brotherhood|Old Ways]] once more, surely no one would oppose Astrid's rule."'' There is no option for asking Cicero, as this would ruin Astrid's plan. ===Listen to Your Mother=== You will need to pick the novice lock on the [[Skyrim:Night Mother|Night Mother]]'s coffin, then step inside. The scene fades to black and you will soon hear Cicero begin to address someone. He pleads for his companion to speak, and complains that he must do all the work, but is ever obedient. Suddenly, you will see the Night Mother in the coffin with you; she begins to speak and you realize that she pities Cicero. He has been attempting to communicate with the Night Mother all along, however the Night Mother refuses to speak to Cicero because he is not the Listener. Outside the coffin, Cicero despairs of the Night Mother actually speaking to anyone, and at his failure at finding a Listener. Again, the Night Mother addresses you. She names you Listener and tasks you with traveling to [[Skyrim:Volunruud|Volunruud]] and speaking with [[Skyrim:Amaund Motierre|Amaund Motierre]]. She instructs you to tell Cicero a covert phrase: "Darkness rises when silence dies". ===Darkness Rises When Silence Dies=== The coffin opens and as you step out, a horrified Cicero demands an explanation. Tell him you are "the one", but he refuses to believe you. Tell him the signal phrase the Night Mother gave you and Cicero becomes ecstatic and dances a little jig. Astrid will burst into the room, alerted by the commotion. She comes to realize that there is no treachery or traitor, but is a little put-off by your assertion that you are now the Listener. When you explain what the Night Mother has asked of you, Astrid becomes defensive claiming, ''"I'm still the leader in this family"''. Astrid needs time to process all of this and sends you to take a contract from [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]], rather than allowing you to go to Volunruud, while she thinks about this turn of events. If you have already completed the first three contracts Nazir gave you then he will give you two new contracts, [[Skyrim:Kill Hern|Kill Hern]] and [[Skyrim:Kill Lurbuk|Kill Lurbuk]]. If you have not completed the initial contracts, then Nazir will complain that you still have contracts to complete and urge you to get on with them. In either case, this quest will complete upon speaking with Nazir. ==Notes== *Should you choose to disregard Astrid's orders and proceed to Volunruud on your own, you will be able to receive the contract but not act on it until killing at least one of the Nazir's contract targets. You must kill at least one contract target after completing this quest and then return to the sanctuary in order to start [[Skyrim:The Silence Has Been Broken|The Silence Has Been Broken]], which will start when Astrid talks to you (before you collect your pay from Nazir). ==Bugs== {{Bug|If you close the iron door you open to enter the room and enter the tomb, Cicero cannot walk into the room and attempt to speak to the Night Mother, leaving you inside the tomb in mid cut-scene.|confirmed=1}} **If you wait an hour in the coffin, Cicero will be placed in the room and the quest will go on as normal. **{{Pc22}} Open the console, enter prid 00080E17, then enter in unlock. After that, close the console and wait an hour. The quest will continue as normal after that. {{Bug|When Astrid tells you to go talk to Nazir for more side contracts, Nazir may not have any quest options available. This is possibly caused by the targets from Nazir's next contract having already been killed.|vn=1}} **{{pc22}} Entering setstage DB04 200 in the console fixes this. This will complete the Whispers in the Dark quest and allow you to get the [[Skyrim:The Silence Has Been Broken|next quest]] from Astrid. The only thing you will have missed are the two contracts Nazir gives. **Deactivate the quest while inside the Sanctuary, exit to the outside, and reactivate the quest. Proceed to follow through with the quest as normal and the bug should be fixed. **Skip straight to Volunruud and speak with Amaund Motierre to receive the quest The Silence Has Been Broken. The quest journal will not update and no dialogue options will be given but the quest can be completed via following the walkthrough. The only thing you will have missed are the two contracts Nazir gives and any dialogue.{{vn|This worked for PS3-does it work for PC and Xbox as well?}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||Astrid has heard Cicero speaking with someone, in whispered tones, in the chamber of the Night Mother. She fears they're conspiring against the Sanctuary, and wants me to eavesdrop on the conversation. I'm to sneak into the chamber, and hide in the coffin of the Night Mother. {{Quest Objective|10|Hide in the Night Mother's coffin}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Eavesdrop on Cicero}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Talk to Cicero}} |40||{{Quest Objective|40|Talk to Astrid}} |50||While eavesdropping on Cicero, I heard the voice of the Night Mother, who named me Listener. Astrid seems unsure what to believe, and needs time to process this latest development. In the meantime, I'm to see Nazir for more side contract work. {{Quest Objective|50|Receive a side contract from Nazir}} |200|fin|While eavesdropping on Cicero, I heard the voice of the Night Mother, who named me Listener. Astrid seems unsure what to believe, and it's hard to tell what effect this will ultimately have on the Sanctuary. |missing=0, 1, 255 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}} {{Quest Footer|Next=[[Skyrim:Kill Narfi|Kill Narfi]], [[Skyrim:Kill Beitild|Kill Beitild]], [[Skyrim:Kill Ennodius Papius|Kill Ennodius Papius]], [[Skyrim:Kill Hern|Kill Hern]] and/or [[Skyrim:Kill Lurbuk|Kill Lurbuk]], followed by [[Skyrim:The Silence Has Been Broken|The Silence Has Been Broken]]|Up=[[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]]|Prev=[[Skyrim:Mourning Never Comes|Mourning Never Comes]]}}

These '''tutorial''' quests provide a way to learn about the three crafting [[Skyrim:Skills|skills]] ([[Skyrim:Alchemy|Alchemy]], [[Skyrim:Enchanting|Enchanting]], [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]]). They are available from a few [[Skyrim:NPCs|NPCs]] in [[Skyrim:Riverwood|Riverwood]], [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], and [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]] near the game's starting point. The quest giver will show your character how to use the skills.

Note that you can use crafting skills without doing any of the tutorial quests, and the quests themselves do not give you any advantage in using the skills.

Skyrim:Unseen Visions.wikitext:
{{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Masteryodasarmy |checkedBy=SerCenKing |reward=Secunda |rewardChecked=SerCenKing }}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Main Quest|link3=Dawnguard Quests#Main Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |icon=SR-qico-Dawnguard_Dawnguard.png |Giver=[[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Dexion]] |Loc=[[Skyrim:Ancestor Glade|Ancestor Glade]] |Reward=None |Prev=[[Skyrim:Seeking Disclosure|Seeking Disclosure]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Touching the Sky|Touching the Sky]] |Image=SR-quest-Unseen Visions.jpg |Imgdesc=A Moth Priest's knife |description=Perform a ceremony to read the Elder Scroll. |ID=DLC1VQ06 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== {{Caution|Make a save or rely on the most recent auto-save before entering the glade as a series of scripts need to be triggered, but can easily fail. Leaving and re-entering the glade may correct some problems, but script failures can cascade, so redoing the glade from the last save is preferable. See [[#Bugs|bugs]] for more information on possible issues.}} # Find a Moth Priest's [[Skyrim:Draw Knife|draw knife]]. # Gather [[Skyrim:Canticle Bark|bark]] from a Canticle Tree. # Attract [[Skyrim:Ancestor Moth|Ancestor Moth]] Swarms. # Read the Elder Scroll. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== [[File:SR-flora-Canticle Tree.jpg|thumb|right|A Canticle Tree]] [[File:SR-creature-Ancestor Moths 02.jpg|thumb|right|Ancestor Moths surrounding the player]] ===Finding Ancestor Glade=== As instructed by [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Dexion Evicus]], your first task is to acquire a Moth Priest's [[Skyrim:Draw Knife|draw knife]] from the [[Skyrim:Ancestor Glade|Ancestor Glade]] northeast of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. Take the eastern road out of Falkreath and at the first four-way intersection you come across, head northeast. Soon after negotiating the [[Skyrim:Unmarked Places Falkreath#Bandit Bridge: Pinewatch|bandit bridge]] guarding the approach to [[Skyrim:Pinewatch|Pinewatch]], turn south onto a narrow mountain trail. After climbing for a while you will come across a bandit camp; from here press on to the southwest and continue climbing high into the mountain. The entrance to the cave is marked by a series of cairns. [[File:SR-quest-Unseen Visions 02.jpg|thumb|right|Reading the Elder Scrolls]] [[File:SR-quest-Unseen Visions 03.jpg|thumb|right|The vision]] ===Ancestor Glade=== If you told [[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] to leave you, she will be back with you once you enter the cave. Head deeper into the cave, up a ledge and across a fallen tree trunk until you emerge into a large hidden clearing. Having been initially unimpressed by the glade, Serana will now gasp in astonishment at the sight before you. Descend down the path towards the stream bisecting the carvern; in particular, make for the glowing tree on the eastern side, just by some rapids. Here you will find a ring-shaped stone with a draw knife lodged inside it. ===Using the Draw Knife=== Activate the stone to acquire the draw knife (note that from this point a gate bars your exit from the cavern) and use it on the canticle tree just to the north. Once you have obtained some bark, you will need to attract seven Ancestor Moth swarms. There are swarms moving all across the Glade, which you can attract by standing next to them for some time. As soon as you have seven swarms following you, a shaft of unnatural light will illuminate the stone knife holder. Return there and read the [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll (Blood)|Elder Scroll (Blood)]], which will actually cause you to read all three scrolls. ===Reading the Elder Scrolls=== After reading the Scrolls, you have a vision of a glowing map with lines for rivers and with two notable features glowing red: in the lower left the ram of Markarth and in the upper right the wolf of Solitude. The location of Auriel's Bow is shown by the small white symbol, similar to the Elder glyph [[File:Elder-Glyph-Special-18.jpg|x20px]], near the head of the river in the top-left quarter of the map. ===Talk To Serana=== Once the vision fades, Serana will immediately come over and ask if everything is alright. She will ask about [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]]'s location and you will be able to point her to [[Skyrim:Darkfall Cave|Darkfall Cave]] thanks to your vision, thus completing the quest. As you leave the cavern, you will be ambushed by Dawnguard Soldiers or Vampires, depending on which faction you have sided with. ==Notes== * Serana will automatically become a [[Skyrim:Followers|follower]] at the start of this quest. Your other follower is automatically dismissed upon entering Ancestor Glade. ** If you had a second follower due to the soul cairn loophole it may be possible to keep the second follower by telling them to 'wait here' while outside Ancestor Glade. You must do this before entering otherwise the second follower will be dismissed. Once the quest is completed, exit Ancestor Glade and your second follower will still be outside. Simply tell your second follower to follow you again. This does not always work. ** Another way to keep your second follower is to sprint past them or make sure they take a long route getting to Ancestor Glade. As soon as you enter whirlwind sprint through the entrance into the clearing. The point where your follower is required to part is scripted around half way down the entrance to the glade and by using the shout it can be avoided altogether. It may take a few tries, so save the game before attempting. If you succeed here the second slot will be permanent unless you dismiss Serana. Even if you can't get it to work there is another opportunity during Touching the Sky. * None of the Elder Scrolls can be removed from your inventory. ** When on the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]]'s side, it is possible to sell two Elder Scrolls to [[Skyrim:Dexion Evicus|Dexion Evicus]]. ** The [[Skyrim:Elder Scroll (Dragon)|Elder Scroll (Dragon)]] can be sold to [[Skyrim:Urag gro-Shub|Urag gro-Shub]], but only if you did not buy it back from him. *If you transform into different form (Vampire, Werewolf) while gathering moths, all existing moths will disappear around you, but will not interfere with the ongoing quest count. *Serana's RefID inside the Ancestor Glade temporarily changes to "xx00feca". It returns to normal when you exit the cave after receiving the vision. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Serana may not have entered the glade with you and is shut out behind the barred gate.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **To fix this, you can wait a couple of hours and she will appear next to you or you can reload and make sure she follows you into the cave (possibly needing to use Unrelenting Force) or while looking at the closed bars, move to the left and glitch outside of the level by walking into the wall, then jumping over to the area on the other side of the barred doorway and go back inside the level. Alternatively, you can try to give move commands to Serana by holding down the interact button while facing her until you can command her. {{Bug|After obtaining the Draw Knife, you may not be able to harvest the bark from the Canticle Trees.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|You may be able to harvest from the canticle trees, but the objective for attracting moths will never appear.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{pc22}} Use the console command SetStage DLC1VQ06 30 to set the objective to gathering moths. {{Bug|The barred gate may not shut.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|You may not be able to read the scroll.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{pc22}} Add a second copy of the Elder Scroll to your inventory with player.additem xx0118F9 1. You end up with two copies, but should be able to read the extra scroll. {{Bug|The post scroll reading attack may not occur.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} {{Bug|The gate may not reopen. This can occur if you fail to speak with Serana before approaching the gate.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **If Serana is in combat mode, kill all the enemies on the far side of the gate (which can be a challenge, since they often move out of range), then speak with her and the gate will open. **{{pc22}} Alternatively, select Serana in the console, move to the far side of the cavern from the gate, then use moveto player followed by stopcombat. This should allow you to speak to Serana and the quest will proceed normally after that. **{{pc22}} The gate can be removed by opening the console, selecting the gate with the mouse, then using the disable command. This will allow the enemies in if they're trapped on the other side, and/or allow you to escape. {{Bug|The vampire or Dawnguard attackers who get enabled are never disabled again after the quest is over. This leads to some of them respawning back in Ancestor Glade later when they aren't supposed to.|USLEEP|3.0.3}} {{Bug|Serana may not engage in dialogue after the battle.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||After discovering that Dexion has become blind, I've had to secure alternate means to decipher the Elder Scrolls and locate Auriel's Bow. It's been suggested that I might be able to read the Elder Scrolls myself if I use an ancient technique performed by the original Moth Priests. I'm now on my way to a place known as the Ancestor Glade to discover the origin of the mysterious ritual. {{Quest Objective|10|Find a Moth Priest's knife}} |20||{{Quest Objective|20|Gather bark from a Canticle Tree}} |30||{{Quest Objective|30|Attract Ancestor Moth Swarms (/7)}} |50||I've used the unusual knife to collect the bark from the Canticle Trees dotting the Ancestor Glade, which has in turn drawn Ancestor Moths to me. {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Multiple |checkedBy=SerCenKing |reward=Multiple |rewardChecked=SerCenKing }}{{About||the book|Touching the Sky (book)}}{{Mod Header|Dawnguard}}{{Trail2|Dawnguard|Quests|link2=Dawnguard Quests|Main Quest|link3=Dawnguard Quests#Main Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Serana|Serana]] |icon=SR-qico-Dawnguard_Dawnguard.png |Loc=[[Skyrim:Darkfall Cave|Darkfall Cave]], [[Skyrim:Darkfall Passage|Darkfall Passage]], [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale|Forgotten Vale]], [[Skyrim:Glacial Crevice|Glacial Crevice]], [[Skyrim:Inner Sanctum (Vale)|Inner Sanctum]] |Prev=[[Skyrim:Unseen Visions|Unseen Visions]] |Next=[[Skyrim:Kindred Judgment|Kindred Judgment]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]],
Word for the [[Skyrim:Drain Vitality|Drain Vitality]] shout |Image=SR-quest-Touching the Sky 02.jpg |Imgdesc=Serana confronts Vyrthur at the Temple of Auriel |description=Find and retrieve [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]]. |ID=DLC1VQ07 |SuggLevel=18 |Difficulty=Medium }} ==Quick Walkthrough== # Locate [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]]. # Speak to [[Skyrim:Knight-Paladin Gelebor|Gelebor]]. # Fill the [[Skyrim:Initiate's Ewer|Initiate's Ewer]]. # Kill [[Skyrim:Arch-Curate Vyrthur|Vyrthur]]. # Retrieve Auriel's Bow. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Last of the Snow Elves=== [[File:SR-quest-Touching the Sky 03.jpg|thumb|right|Serana gazing out over the Forgotten Vale]] After learning the location of [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]], travel to [[Skyrim:Darkfall Cave|Darkfall Cave]] in the far northwestern reaches of Skyrim, just south-southwest of the [[Skyrim:Orc Strongholds|Orc stronghold]] [[Skyrim:Mor Khazgur|Mor Khazgur]]. The cave is very dark, so you may wish to light your way using torches, the [[Skyrim:Vampire's Sight|Vampire's Sight]] ability, or [[Skyrim:Light|light]] spells. Follow the path, past a frostbite spider until you come to a bridge and what seems like a dead end. Once you try to cross back over the bridge, you will be forced, by either a rock trap or the bridge collapsing, into a very fast moving underground river that sends you downstream. Try to keep your head above the water, unless you have a [[Skyrim:Waterbreathing (effect)|waterbreathing]] ability. Eventually, you'll be thrown out of the current, and immediately attacked by a few [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]]. Continue along the cavernous path, until you reach a small camp with a dead Breton; a [[Skyrim:Darkfall Cave Note|note]] on her body sheds light on what happened: [[Skyrim:Frost Troll|trolls]]. From here you can either head down the path beyond the dead Breton, where after negotiating a [[Skyrim:Traps#Falling_Boulders|falling boulders trap]] you will arrive in a chamber with two frost trolls. At the far western side is a stone shrine and [[Skyrim:Knight-Paladin Gelebor |Knight-Paladin Gelebor]], one of the last two Snow Elves. Alternatively, you arrive immediately behind Gelebor by pulling the chain hidden behind the dead Breton's lean-to and taking the passage it reveals. Speak to Gelebor, and he will offer you a deal: slay his brother, [[Skyrim:Arch-Curate Vyrthur|Vyrthur]], who was corrupted by [[Skyrim:Falmer|Falmer]], and Gelebor will help you in obtaining Auriel's Bow. Vyrthur is hiding in the [[Skyrim:Inner Sanctum (Vale)|Inner Sanctum]] of the [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale|Forgotten Vale]], a gigantic outdoor elven ruin with [[Lore:Ayleid|Ayleid]]-like architecture. In order to make your way there you must fill a jug, the [[Skyrim:Initiate's Ewer|Initiate's Ewer]], with water from five wayshrines: the Wayshrines of Illumination, Learning, Radiance, Resolution, and Sight. ===Seeking Illumination=== The first wayshrine, the Wayshrine of Illumination, is in [[Skyrim:Darkfall Passage|Darkfall Passage]], which can be accessed through the portal Gelebor opens. The Portal appears in the back of the shrine-like building that Gelebor raises from the ground. It may be invisible, with no Quest Marker pointing to it, but walking to the back of the shrine wall you will be able to activate the Portal none the less (see the [[#Bugs|Bugs]] section for more info). The passage is just as dark as the cave, but is illuminated by tube worms, which look like odd pink flowers that retract into their tubes when you come near, whose faint pink light help to guide the way. Along the winding underground trek you will encounter several leveled [[Skyrim:Falmer|falmer]] and [[Skyrim:Chaurus|chaurus]]; be sure to destroy any [[Skyrim:Chaurus Cocoon|chaurus cocoons]] you come across before they have a chance to hatch. The shrine itself is in the final chamber of the passage, a radically different environment to the rest of the zone where [[Skyrim:Vale Deer|vale deer]] and [[Skyrim:Vale Sabre Cat|vale sabre cats]] inhabit a small forest. The Shrine is tended to by [[Skyrim:Prelate_Sidanyis|Prelate Sidanyis]], who will activate it for you. Fill your ewer from the font and head through the portal to the [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale|Forgotten Vale]]. ===Resolving to Learn and See=== [[File:SR-place-Wayshrine of Resolution.jpg|thumb|right|The Wayshrine of Resolution]] The second wayshrine, the Wayshrine of Sight, can be found soon after emerging from Darkfall Passage into the Forgotten Vale and is tended to by [[Skyrim:Prelate_Athring|Prelate Athring]]. It is to the north of the path that climbs up out of the entry vale through a set of stone arches, and west-northwest of the [[Skyrim:Forgotten_Vale_Cave|Forgotten Vale Cave]]. To find it, stop at the highest stone arch just before entering a narrow pass and head north along the cliff side, past a small frozen pond and several fallen trees, until you reach a [[Skyrim:Silver Ore|silver ore vein]]. Just beyond is the Wayshrine, shrouded amidst a dense layer of fog. The third shrine, the Wayshrine of Learning, is tended to by [[Skyrim:Prelate_Celegriath|Prelate Celegriath]]. To reach it, head back to the stone arches and instead press on west, negotiating a narrow pass inhabited by [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]]. Make your way down to the narrow river valley to a skeleton and the [[Skyrim:Unknown Book, Vol. I|Unknown Book, Vol. I]]; reading it will start the [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale Books Quest|Forgotten Vale Books Quest]]. Head downstream for a little while to reach the wayshrine. To reach the fourth shrine, the Wayshrine of Resolution, cross the river and make your way up the turnpike path until you reach a large, frozen lake. Beware of the two dragons, [[Skyrim:Naaslaarum|Naaslaarum]] and [[Skyrim:Voslaarum|Voslaarum]], who will attack you while you cross the lake (provided you have completed [[Skyrim:Dragon Rising|Dragon Rising]]). The wayshrine, tended to by [[Skyrim:Prelate_Nirilor|Prelate Nirilor]], is above the northwest bank of the lake. Don't forget to pick up the [[Skyrim:Drain Vitality|Drain Vitality]] [[Skyrim:Shout|dragon shout]] from the large rock jutting out from the middle of the frozen lake south of this wayshrine. ===The Long Walk to Radiance=== The fifth and final wayshrine, the Wayshrine of Radiance, is north of the Wayshrine of Resolution and is reached after a long, arduous trek through the Forgotten Vale and [[Skyrim:Glacial Crevice|Glacial Crevice]]. To reach the latter, you can press on north and negotiate a long series of Falmer encampments and bridges suspended across the cliff-faces, or alternatively head southwest from the wayshrine across the mountainside and overlooking the lake. After a short while you arrive in a hanging valley with some [[Skyrim:Moonstone Ore|moonstone ore veins]]; from here you can head down to the entrance of the Crevice. If you're looking for ''[[Skyrim:Unknown Book, Vol. III|Unknown Book, Vol. III]]'' for the [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale Books Quest|Forgotten Vale Books Quest]], you can find it in a Falmer hut a couple of bridges before reaching the Crevice entrance. The Crevice itself consists of a series of glacial chambers with icy ledges and rope bridges that ascend among a scattering of Falmer tents. Dispose of the many leveled Falmer and the odd [[Skyrim:Frost Troll|frost troll]] that occupy this zone until you once again emerge out into the Forgotten Vale. This [[Skyrim:Forgotten Vale#Falmer Fissure|final part]] of the Vale consists of a confusing maze of Falmer tents and platforms crowded within a series of narrow, twisting canyons. Pick up ''[[Skyrim:Unknown Book, Vol. IV|Unknown Book, Vol. IV]]'' from a hut in the second village just before the entrance to the tunnel which takes you to the Wayshrine of Radiance, tended to by [[Skyrim:Prelate_Edhelbor|Prelate Edhelbor]]. [[File:SR-quest-Touching the Sky.jpg|thumb|right|Vyrthur destroying Auriel's Chapel]] ===Breaching the Sanctum=== Down the path from the Wayshrine of Radiance and across a stone bridge lies the [[Skyrim:Inner Sanctum (Vale)|Inner Sanctum]]. Pour water from your Ewer into the stone basin, and the door in front of you will be bathed in green light before opening. Inside you will find a number of chambers with frozen Falmer and chaurus. Many of the Falmer hold items that can be looted, which may cause one or more of them to break out of their icy state and attack you. There is a chest tucked away in a partially hidden corner, some loose items lying about, and a number of lootable skeletons that Serana will raise during combat. Head north through the chambers, placing the Ewer on any pedestals to open the gates nearby, until you reach an icy tunnel leading to [[Skyrim:Inner Sanctum (Vale)#Auriel's Chapel|Auriel's Chapel]]. This tunnel branches to the left and doubles back leading to another chest and some more loose items. Once you enter Auriel's Chapel, jump down from the stone ledge where you emerge and you will arrive in a stone chamber full of frozen Falmer and chaurus. From this point, you will not be able to retreat but can only continue forward. Vyrthur sits on a throne at the far end of the room, behind an impenetrable claw-like barrier. Once you come near, he will come to life and commence a fierce battle: the frozen Falmer and chaurus will start unfreezing in groups, while Vyrthur periodically summons a [[Skyrim:Frost Atronach|Frost Atronach]], collapses parts of the ceiling and then hurls the broken boulders at you. Once all enemies are defeated, in a mixture of rage and panic, Vyrthur will collapse the rest of the roof on you through a huge magical explosion, commencing a cutscene during which the only action you can undertake is walking or running. You awake to Serana telling you to get up and get on the balcony. Follow her until you reach Vyrthur, who will explain that after having been forsaken to [[Skyrim:Vampirism|vampirism]] by [[Lore:Auri-El|Auri-El]], he created the [[Lore:Tyranny of the Sun|prophecy]] that [[Skyrim:Lord Harkon|Lord Harkon]] is chasing. By dousing [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]] with the blood of a Daughter of Coldharbour—Serana— Vyrthur would exact his revenge by corrupting Auri-El's influence on [[Lore:Nirn|Nirn]]. Understandably displeased, Serana will lift him by the throat but will be thrown back as Vyrthur uses magic to free himself from her grip and attacks you. Once he has been defeated, a wayshrine will appear and Gelebor will walk through it. He will be surprised that the real reason for Vyrthur's actions was vampirism rather than corruption by the Falmer and thank you by proclaiming you worthy to carry Auriel's Bow. He will also bless some [[Skyrim:Sunhallowed Elven Arrow|Sunhallowed arrows]] for you if you ask, and remain there if you wish to come back for more at any time. Retrieve Auriel's Bow from the newly-appeared wayshrine to complete the quest. ==Notes== *You may use [[Skyrim:Auriel's Bow|Auriel's Bow]] to blot out the sun. It is not permanent and will only last until 7pm (which is sunset; you can shoot out the sun again the next day, as the sun will rise at 5am). *After a wayshrine is opened, it will contain portals to three of the other four opened wayshrines, as well as to [[Skyrim:Darkfall Cave|Darkfall Cave]]. *At the end of this quest there is an opportunity to gain a second permanent follower. Right after you kill the boss, Serana will stop following you around and you can fast travel away to grab a second follower. There isn't a direct return point, but you can fast travel back to Forgotten Vale and use the portals, then run quickly back through the castle and finish the quest by speaking with the NPC waiting for you and taking Auriel's Bow. This time, your second follower slot should be permanent - though you should make sure to have two followers for 'Kindred Judgement' and any plot quests that are instanced. You can swap your other follower, but never dismiss Serana or you will lose the second slot. *If you have not killed Naaslaarum and Voslaarum it is possible for one of them to fly to the balcony and interfere in the fight with Vyrthur. They can even kill him for you. *South of the Temple balcony is a hanging valley with a waterfall pouring from it down to the frozen lake. This valley is the location that the [[Skyrim:Emerald Paragon|Emerald Paragon]] gives access to, and can be reached from the balcony by using the [[Skyrim:Become Ethereal|Become Ethereal]] shout and careful cliff walking. What's more, you can easily use [[Skyrim:Unrelenting Force|Unrelenting Force]] to shout Vyrthur down the balcony, and give him a falling death. ==Bugs== '''Note''': Nearly all of the bugs mentioned below occur because Gelebor, Serana, or Vyrthur have uncompleted scripts running. Be sure to allow any dialogue they are speaking to complete before taking further action. Also, make sure that the scripted actions with the Initiate's Ewer and the Wayshrines have completed before going on to the next wayshrine. Furthermore, when attempting the aforementioned by loading a saved game, some variables might not reset, thus rendering the attempt unaffected - shutting down Skyrim and launching it again will wipe out any residue from the memory. {{Bug|You may be able to ask Serana to wait somewhere even though this is clearly not intended in the scripting. She is supposed to refuse when you ask her to wait for the duration of this quest.|UDGP|2.0.2|This was likely due to the previous quest's script not properly delaying things before this one starts. Serana's follower settings were ending up in an unreliable state as a result.}} {{Bug|Serana may attack Gelebor immediately after you finish the first dialogue with him, ceasing quest progression.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} Using the console command killall will fix this. You will have to wait a bit, until dialogue starts between Serana and Gelebor. They will both remain in the crouched, dying position, but they will go back to normal once a new area is entered. {{Bug|Knight-Paladin Gelebor may not activate the first wayshrine.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{pc22}} Open the console and select Gelebor, enter the code disable, then enable. **{{pc22}} Sometimes Serana can get stuck in combat mode, preventing her dialogue with Gelebor. Open the console and select Serana, enter the code disable, then enable. **{{Pc22}} You can fix this problem by using the console command setstage DLC1VQ07 50. This fix will not work unless Serana is next to you when you first speak with Gelebor. Serana has extensive dialogue exchange with Gelebor which leads to him giving you the Initiate's Ewer. Without the Ewer in your inventory, advancing the quest stage to open the Wayshrine will not help you.{{VN|is this true?}} {{Bug|When you activate the first wayshrine, the portal may not appear.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} ** The portal may be invisible. Pressing the 'activate' button while standing in the back of the wayshrine may activate the invisible portal. {{Bug|When given the objective to fill the Initiates Ewer, one of the wayshrines may not give you any water making the quest impossible to complete.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} ** Reloading and visiting the wayshrines in a different order may fix this. ** If you can't get water because Skyrim thinks you are in combat, exit the cell then re-enter it. {{Bug|When you have finished collecting the ewer, and are about to pour it in the basin, it won't react and you will be stuck.|confirmed=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} If you have this problem, open the console and enter GetStage DLC1VQ07 . If it returns 132.00, that means that somehow the quest progressed past the next stage of the quest. Since you cannot go back stages, the only way to solve this problem would be to use SetStage for every stage past "Gain Entry to the Inner Sanctum" until the current stage number is above 132 (meaning SetStage DLC1VQ07 200 , completing the quest, giving you the bow, and starting the next quest). This will mean skipping quite a lot of stages, but there's no way to fix this bug at the moment without skipping. **{{Pc22}} Alternatively you can use console command coc DLC1FalmerTemple01 and SetStage 110 (assuming you are just stuck at the basin). **{{Pc22}}If coc is useless, and your queststage is 110, use the [[Skyrim:Sapphire Paragon|sapphire paragon]]. You must use console command tcl, and then you can gain entry to the Inner Sanctum (remember to use tcl again after gaining entry). Then, leave from the Inner Sanctum via the door, and Serana will be with you again. {{Bug|After confronting Arch-Curate Vyrthur and defeating the first wave of unfrozen enemies, he may not react and spawn a second wave, ceasing quest progress.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} ** Each subsequent wave will only occur after all mobilized enemies have been killed. These enemies are not the frozen ones standing about but are spawned as the waves progress, sometimes replacing the frozen variety. Sometimes they spawn inside the architecture or get stuck in odd places. If area effect spells cannot kill them, reloading a save is your only recourse. After each wave there is a pause before Vyrthur gives another rant and unleashes the next wave. Sending an arrow or two, or an area damage spell in his direction may speed things along a little. ** {{pc22}} This can also be fixed by using the command killall in the boss arena (note that both Vyrthur and Serana will be put in the bleed out state as both of them are set to essential at the moment and can't die) but this updates Vyrthur's scripts and can hopefully allow you to progress. If that's the case and Vyrthur summons the [[Skyrim:Ancient_Frost_Atronach|Ancient Frost Atronach]], immediately hit the console, click on Serana and use the command resurrect. Once you kill the Atronach, Vyrthur will do a shockwave and run to the balcony. As he reaches the balcony he will die (because he is not set to essential anymore), so just click on his corpse and resurrect him too, and that may trigger the following scene and boss fight to progress normally. {{Bug|You may be unable to kill Arch-Curate Vyrthur.|vn=1|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} If that happens use the console command killall. A message signifying the quest's completion will still turn up, though the game ceases to progress after that. Neither Serana nor Gelebor will have proper dialogue options, and the following quest, 'Kindred Judgement', does not begin.|UDGP|2.0.0|dlc=DG}} **{{Pc22}} Use the console command setstage DLC1VQ07 200 to properly complete the final 'Retrieve Auriel's Bow' objective. {{Bug|After finishing the quest, Serana might not have the dialogue to start Kindred Judgment but will allow you to use her blood to make Bloodcursed arrows.|UDGP|2.0.0|dlc=DG}} ** Completing a minor side quest before fighting Vyrthur may fix this. {{Bug|The tier 5 Ancient Frost Atronach that is generated during this quest was incorrectly set to the same record as the tier 4 alias directly before it.|USLEEP|3.0.3}} {{Bug|You can talk to Serana about helping the snow-elf priests while playing the vampire and Dawnguard sides of the quest. This is an error as the Editor ID indicates it was supposed to be exclusive to the vampire side.|USSEP|4.1.3|This was due to a missing variable check to be sure you are in fact playing for Harkon's side.}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10:2||The vision provided by the Elder Scrolls seems to indicate that Auriel's Bow may be located in a place known as Darkfall Cave. Skyrim:Volskygge (quest).wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Krusty |checkedBy=Beezer1029 |reward=Krusty |rewardChecked=Chezburgar }}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests-Non-Journal Quests]]{{Quest Header |Giver= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Volskygge|Volskygge]] |Reward=[[Skyrim:Volsung (item)|Volsung]], Word for the [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]] shout |Image=SR-place-Volskygge_03.jpg |Imgdesc=The evil of [[Skyrim:Volskygge|Volskygge]] |description=Climb your way to the [[Skyrim:Volsung (creature)|evil]] of [[Skyrim:Volskygge|Volskygge]]. |ID=dunVolskyggeQST |SuggLevel=24 }} ==Quick Walkthrough== '''Note''': This quest does not appear in your journal. #Locate [[Skyrim:Volskygge|Volskygge]]. #Fight your way through the ruin. #Defeat the [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] [[Skyrim:Volsung (creature)|Volsung]]. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===A Wall, Black as Night=== [[File:SR-place-Volskygge.jpg|thumb|right|''"It is a cursed place...!"'']] When you visit [[Skyrim:Solitude|Solitude]], the local [[Skyrim:Solitude Guard|guards]] may warn you about an ancient [[Skyrim:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]] called [[Skyrim:Volskygge|Volskygge]], saying: ''"If you must venture southwest, stay clear of Volskygge. It is a cursed place, a tomb where the dead still live...."'' Talking to experienced traveler [[Skyrim:Jawanan|Jawanan]] will net you even more information: ''"Inside, there is said to be a wall, black as night. And it speaks! In the ancient Dragon tongue!"'' If you heard about Volskygge from the guards, a map marker will be added; otherwise you will have to locate it yourself. The ruin lies far to the west of Solitude, past [[Skyrim:Dragon Bridge|Dragon Bridge]], and just south of [[Skyrim:Lost Echo Cave|Lost Echo Cave]]. Three leveled [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] guard its expansive exterior and [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] inhabit hidden, booby-trapped rooms, portending dangers to come. The ruin's large interior contains many locks and hosts myriad enemies, so carry a good supply of health potions and [[Skyrim:Lockpick|lockpicks]] or the Skeleton Key before entering. ===Volskygge=== Inside the ruin, pass through the first gate and into a throne room protected by a [[Skyrim:Traps#Dart Trap|dart trap]] and two bandits patrolling back and forth. Proceed westward through a tunnel, wary of a [[Skyrim:Traps#Pressure Plate|pressure plate]] that triggers a [[Skyrim:Traps#Spike Wall|spiked wall]] trap. Ahead stands another bandit near a locked chest that contains minor loot. The northern tunnel leads to an intersection; the path to the west from this leads to a room in which a [[Skyrim:Nord|Nord]] and an [[Skyrim:Orc|Orc]] bandit try to break into a cage (see [[#Bugs|this section]]). Fighting the bandits here is optional, although unlocking the cage leads to a handle that will lower a nearby wall and provide access to a secret room with minor loot. You will find a copy of the [[Skyrim:Lockpicking|Lockpicking]] [[Skyrim:Skill Books|skill book]] ''[[Skyrim:Surfeit of Thieves|Surfeit of Thieves]]'' on the shelves near the secret wall. From here, backtrack to the intersection and continue east into a huge dining hall littered with dead [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] through which two more bandits wander. The rooms to the north contain little of interest, so leave the area through the eastern door, but tread carefully: the dead bandit you'll see on the floor was killed by a [[Skyrim:Traps#Battering Ram|battering ram]] triggered by a pressure plate just inside. Don't meet the same fate. ===Four Totems=== [[File:SR-interior-Volskygge_02.jpg|thumb|right|''"All must be activated in order, if you wish to go home."'']] The ruin's puzzle room is situated around the corner. A huge structure in the middle of the room points to four handles, each of which must be activated in the correct order. If you fail, undead enemies will break out of the central structure and attack. If done correctly, the torches in the middle of the room will light up as each lever is pulled in the correct order. Find the pedestal supporting the book ''[[Skyrim:The Four Totems of Volskygge|The Four Totems of Volskygge]]'' and read it for the clues to the puzzle: :''The first fears all, The second fears none.'' :''The third eats what it can, Preferably number one.'' :''The fourth fears the second, But only when alone.'' :''All must be activated in order, If you wish to go home.'' The puzzle solution is: :'''Snake''' (fears all) :'''Bear''' (fears none) :'''Fox''' (eats the snake) :'''Wolf''' (fears the bear as an individual but not in packs) If done correctly, the adjacent iron gate will open, providing access to another room containing a spiral staircase, a chest and a secret passage. The passage is opened via a lever on the left of the two pillars on the northern wall, leading to a dart trap and a few minor items. Turn back and take the spiral staircase down, which leads to the next zone of the ruin, Volskygge Passages. ===Volskygge Passages=== The first few rooms of Volskygge Passages are empty, except for a [[SR:Soul Gems|soul gem]] on a pedestal and a handle that opens to a small room holding absolutely nothing (see [[#Notes|notes]]). In the third chamber, a leveled draugr lurks before an altar that holds two more soul gems and a [[Skyrim:Skeever Tail|skeever tail]]. There is also a chest with an apprentice locked [[Skyrim:Traps#Tension Cable|tension cable]] in the northeast corner of the room. After the battle, pull the handle next to the iron gate and head west, past the inactive trap door in the first chamber and a set of [[Skyrim:Traps#Swinging Blades|swinging blades]] triggered by a [[Skyrim:Traps#Pressure Plate|pressure plate]]. In the next chamber, beyond an active [[Skyrim:Traps#Trap Door|trap door]], you will find a dead bandit near a handle which provides access to yet another secret chamber in which a [[Skyrim:Potion of Ultimate Healing|potion of ultimate healing]] stands atop a [[Skyrim:Traps#Weight Sensitive Plate|weight sensitive plate]]. An adept locked chest sits in the northwest corner of the room. The trap door near the dead bandit will drop you into a tower with a broken spiral staircase and a [[Skyrim:Traps#Spike Pit|spike pit]] at the bottom. A draugr patrols the passage beyond the spike pit, and the passage leads to the southeast corner of a large room. If you did not fall down the trap door, the passage heading west contains typical draugr catacombs with an [[Skyrim:Containers#Urn|urn]] and inactive draugr on the shelves to be looted and enters the north side of the large room. Several draugr will emerge from their shelves in this room, and there is a pressure plate on the floor which triggers a spike wall. The passage to the south contains a [[Skyrim:Containers#Burial Urn|burial urn]] and an apprentice locked chest in the corner where the passage turns west. As you move forward, two more draugr will emerge. The passage will then turn north and enter a room. Two urns sit in front of the four stone pillars and impenetrable vines in the room's center. From this point, proceed with caution lest the five draugr in this room gang up on you. Up the northern stairs, a strong draugr patrols the passage. There are more urns and inactive draugr to loot in this passage along with another draugr sleeping on a shelf unless it is alerted by nearby combat. Continue north to find yet another draugr in the northern room where you will find more urns to loot and three healing potions on an altar. A pressure plate halfway up the western stairs triggers another battering ram, and another draugr waits in the passage beyond. Past this draugr, webs become more prominent, the ruins become more overgrown, and three [[Skyrim:Frostbite Spider|frostbite spiders]] wait. A couple of [[Skyrim:Containers#Web Sac|web sacs]] contain [[Skyrim:Spider Egg|spider eggs]] and [[Skyrim:Containers#Dessicated Corpse|dessicated corpses]] may yield some gold or lockpicks. Beyond a web barrier, more spiders await along with [[Skyrim:Containers#Egg Sac|egg sacs]] containing more spider eggs and another web sac and dessicated corpse. Beyond the next web barrier is a room that looks even more like a natural cavern and that contains a waterfall feeding a stream. Another frostbite spider waits here, and three more will drop from the ceiling as you enter. There are also a few more dessicated corpses and another web sac containing a skeever tail. Destroy another web barrier to enter the last part of the ruin which is less overgrown where you will find more urns and a chest with an adept locked tension cable before the passage turns south. Head south to reach a room patrolled by two more draugr. There are a few more urns here, and halfway across the room, two stone bridges cross an indoor stream. Follow the stream to its western end to find an [[Skyrim:Orichalcum Ore Vein|orichalcum ore vein]], a [[Skyrim:Specialty Gear#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], and an unlocked chest. At the southern end of the room, a wide staircase leads up to a platform where another draugr patrols. The room beyond contains a few urns and a staircase heading up and east where the boss draugr awaits in a room that contains a boss chest, two more urns, a few potions on a shelf, and a coin purse, a few loose coins, and an [[Skyrim:Weapons#Ancient Nord Bow|ancient nord bow]] on another shelf along with 12 [[Skyrim:Ancient Nord Arrow|ancient nord arrows]]. The stairs heading farther up and east lead to a door that opens onto the external area [[Skyrim:Volskygge#Volskygge Peak|Volskygge Peak]]. ===Volskygge Peak=== You will now stand atop the mountain where you initially entered. There is one emerald on each side of the statue at the foot of the stairs. Head up the stairs and approach the [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] for one of the words for [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Sprint|Whirlwind Sprint]]. As soon as you have learned the word, [[Skyrim:Volsung (creature)|Volsung]], a [[Skyrim:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] will burst from the sarcophagus behind you. A powerful foe, he uses only [[Skyrim:Frost Damage|frost attacks]] in combat. After the battle, loot his remains for his unique [[Skyrim:Volsung (item)|dragon priest mask]]. ==Notes== *This "quest" only controls the dialogue for the bandits and will automatically complete entirely within the first section (but see [[#Bugs|bugs]]). Killing Volsung is not actually part of the quest. *It's possible to reach both Volsung and the word wall by simply running up the mountain. *A [[Skyrim:Strange Gem|strange gem]] was meant to be part of the Volskygge puzzle, but never made it into the final game. ==Bugs== {{Bug|Some dialogue between the [[Skyrim:Bandit|bandits]] was supposed to add a bit more spice to the story about Volskygge. However, the quest trigger was incorrectly placed in the dining hall just before the entrance to Volskygge Passages, so the dialogue will rarely be heard.|USKP|1.3.2}} {{Bug|A second, similar bug also causes the dialogue to remain unheard.|confirmed=1|USLEEP|3.0.1|trackerid=19846}} ** Sneak through Volskygge without killing anyone until you reach the spiral staircase just before Volskygge Passages, then make your way backwards to the entrance. The dialogue will be heard normally along the way. ** Do Volskygge once, normally, and wait for it to reset. The second time through, the dialogue may be heard.{{VN|Not sure if this works, needs in-game verification.}} {|class=hiddentable | {|class=wikitable |- !Speaker!!Dialogue |- |rowspan=2|Nord||''"This is getting ridiculous. If we can't get this open soon, the boss will have our heads."'' |- |''"I can't get it open."'' |- |rowspan=3|Orc|| ''"You've been at it for five minutes. Here, let me try."'' |- |''"I think I almost got it."'' |- |''"Come on, just open."'' |} | {|class=wikitable |- !Speaker!!Dialogue |- |Male||''"Find anything worthwhile yet?"'' |- |Female||''"Can't say that I have."'' |- |Male||''"Quiet!
