Skyrim:Visit the hunters at Frostmoon Cr.wikitext: {{Cleanup-srqrp |writtenBy=Dreamshadow |checkedBy=MolagBallet |reward=Secunda |rewardChecked= }}{{Trail2|Dragonborn|Quests|link2=Dragonborn Quests|Miscellaneous|link3=Miscellaneous Quests}}[[Category:Skyrim-Quests]]{{Mod Header|Dragonborn}}{{Quest Header |notrail=1 |Giver=[[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] |Icon= |Reward= Ability to buy four [[Skyrim:Unique Items#Unique Jewelry|unique rings]] from [[Skyrim:Majni|Majni]] (if you are a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolf]]) |Prev= |Next= |Loc=[[Skyrim:Frostmoon Crag|Frostmoon Crag]] |Image=SR-quest-Visit the hunters at Frostmoon Crag.jpg |ImgDesc=What's the secret behind these hunters? |ID=DLC2dunFrostmoonQSTMisc |description=Talk to the hunters at [[Skyrim:Frostmoon Crag|Frostmoon Crag]].}} == Quick Walkthrough == # Talk to the innkeeper of [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|The Retching Netch]] in Raven Rock. # Talk to [[Skyrim:Majni|Majni]] in [[Skyrim:Frostmoon Crag|Frostmoon Crag]]. == Detailed Walkthrough == [[File:SR-quest-Visit the hunters at Frostmoon Crag 02.jpg|right|thumb|The Frostmoon Pack]] You can ask [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] in [[Skyrim:The Retching Netch|The Retching Netch]] for any recent rumors. He may tell you about a pack of [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolves]] in the mountains and advise you to talk to the hunters up at Frostmoon Crag to know more. Alternatively, you might run into a wandering hunter in the northern areas of Solstheim who will tell you about the pack at Frostmoon Crag. Although he will mention the pack to anyone, the quest will only start this way if you're a werewolf and you haven't already heard the rumors from Geldis. Travel to Frostmoon Crag and you can find four hunters there. [[Skyrim:Rakel|Rakel]] will come up to you and stop you from getting too close. ''"Hold, traveler. You have no business here."'' If you're not a werewolf, she will ask you to go away and leave them in peace. ''"We mean you no harm, but... be on your way."'' Staying around will lead her to give you some warnings. They will transform into werewolves and attack you after the last warning. If she finds the beast blood in your body, she will say ''"...Wait. You... you're one of us, aren't you? A werewolf?"'' Then she will introduce the Frostmoon Pack to you and welcome you as a brother or sister. Now, you may talk to Majni, Alpha of the Frostmoon Pack, and complete the quest. He will tell you ''"You are welcome here, so long as you respect our law."'' You can talk to the members of the pack to learn more about them. Once you have, you will be able to buy four [[Skyrim:Unique Jewelry|unique rings]] that affect your beast form from Majni. == Notes == * {{bug|If you are not a werewolf, the quest will remain in your journal unless you come back as a werewolf. If the Companions quest was completed and you cured your lycanthropy, you can go back to Aela the Huntress in Jorrvaskr and ask her: "I wish to regain the gift of beast blood".|UDBP|1.0.4|nocat=1}} **{{pc22}} Use the console command setstage DLC2dunFrostmoonQSTMisc 20 to update it and remove it from your journal. ** Attacking the hunters will also remove the quest. * If your lycanthropy is cured during the quest, Majni will no longer speak with you or sell you the rings. * The quest can also be started by a [[Skyrim:World Interactions|randomly encountered]], generic lycanthropic [[Skyrim:Hunter|hunter]] who does not turn hostile. They will initiate the following dialogue: ''"Well, now... a fellow beast-blood. Well met, friend. Not many of our kind still hunt these lands. If you ever need aid, seek out Majni's pack, up at Frostmoon Crag. They've long welcomed outsiders. Now... my prey awaits. Good hunting to you."'' ==Bugs== {{Bug|If [[Skyrim:Geldis Sadri|Geldis Sadri]] sends you to talk to the hunters here, the quest objective is not cleared when they tell you to go away.|UDBP|1.0.4}} == Quest Stages == {{Journal Entries |10||{{Quest Objective|10|Visit the hunters at Frostmoon Crag}} |11||{{Quest Objective|11|Visit the werewolves at Frostmoon Crag}} |missing=20, 30 }} {{Skyrim Quest Stages Notes}}

[[SR:Quicksilver Mine|Quicksilver Mine]]. #Kill [[SR:Fenrik|Fenrik]] and his minions to destroy the Daedric cult. ==Detailed Walkthrough== ===Missing Vigilants=== To start this quest, you must read the ''[[Skyrim:Letter to Keeper Carcette|Letter to Keeper Carcette]]'' in the [[SR:Hall of the Vigilant|Hall of the Vigilant]]. Note that this location will be destroyed once you reach level 10 or start the quest [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (quest)|Dawnguard]]. If it has been destroyed, the letter can be found on or underneath a table within the ruined building. Reading this letter will reveal that several members of the [[SR:Vigil of Stendarr|Vigil of Stendarr]] have gone missing, and a Vigilant named [[SR:Azarain|Azarain]] has decided to journey to [[SR:Dawnstar|Dawnstar]] to investigate. You must first travel to the [[SR:Windpeak Inn|Windpeak Inn]] in Dawnstar to look for clues as to Azarain's whereabouts. A [[SR:Mysterious Note (Vigil Enforcer Armor Set)|mysterious note]] in one of the rooms appears to have lured Azarain to the nearby [[SR:Windward Ruins|Windward Ruins]] outside of town. Journey there and you will find his corpse, wearing a full set of the new Vigil Veteran armor which can be looted. You must read his [[SR:Azarain's Journal|journal]] to discover that Azarain's old partner [[SR:Fenrik|Fenrik]] had come to Dawnstar to investigate rumors of a Daedric cult. Azarain had discovered that the cult uses poisoned Elven daggers to perform their killings, and he had narrowed down his investigation to three primary suspects: [[SR:Harald|Harald]], [[SR:Irine|Irine]], and [[SR:Vereth|Vereth]]. ===Follow the Clues=== Irine can be found wandering around Dawnstar, near the Windpeak Inn. Vereth can be found inside the inn. Harald is a miner and can be found working inside [[SR:Quicksilver Mine|Quicksilver Mine]] down by the docks. Your journal will suggest that you try [[SR:Pickpocket|pickpocketing]] each of them to identify which one might be a cult member. You do not need to steal anything to update the journal, and this step can be skipped entirely if you prefer. Instead, you are presented with the option of following each of the three at night to see if they will lead you to the Daedric cult. The correct person to follow is Harald, who can be found carrying an Elven dagger if you choose to pick his pocket. Wait until nighttime inside Quicksilver Mine, until all of the miners stop working. Rather than exit the mine, Harald will begin to walk deeper inside, before vanishing behind a rock wall. Sneak up behind him and activate the button on the wall to uncover a secret entrance to a large natural cavern. Irine and Vereth, meanwhile, are innocent: Irine's nocturnal wanderings take her to a shrine of Dibella a little way south of Dawnstar, while Vereth visits the lighthouse northeast of town and stands gazing out over the sea. [[File:SR-quest-Unholy Vigil 03.jpg|thumb|left|The blood altar]][[File:SR-quest-Unholy Vigil 02.jpg|thumb|right|Grim loot found within]] ===Temple to Molag Bal=== This cavern, it is revealed, has been converted into a temple to [[Lore:Molag Bal|Molag Bal]]. It contains a large central blood altar surrounded by coffins, many of which are filled with dead [[SR:Vigilant of Stendarr|Vigilants of Stendarr]]. You must kill Harald along with the vampire Fenrik and his three other [[SR:Vampire Thrall|thrall]]s. Killing all of the enemies will complete the quest, although ''[[SR:Fenrik's Journal|Fenrik's Journal]]'' goes on to explain what had happened to lead to these disappearances. It reveals that Fenrik had become infected with [[SR:Vampirism|vampirism]] and had sought a cure, which was blasphemous in the eyes of his fellow Vigilants who believe that vampires are irredeemable monstrosities. To cure his disease, Fenrik petitioned Lord Molag Bal to lift the curse, and in return Bal demanded that he sacrifice nine of his fellow Vigilants (one for each of the [[Lore:Nine Divines|Nine Divines]]). Fenrik's body can also be looted for a full set of Vigil Corrupted armor. A set of Vigil Enforcer armor can be looted from the [[Skyrim:Vigil Enforcer|corpse]] of one of the sacrificed Vigilants. Finally, a set of Vigil Silver Hand armor can be found lying on a table on the northeastern side of the cavern, next to the bloody red bones of the previous wearer. A chest is on the eastern wall, to the right of the altar. All four of the new armor sets can also be crafted at a [[SR:Forge|forge]] once you've completed this quest, provided you have the ''[[SR:Steel Smithing|Steel Smithing]]'' perk. {{NewLeft}} ==Notes== *The other two suspects will vanish from town once this quest is completed. *[[SR:Irine|Irine]] walks out from inn at 11pm to a Dibella altar south of Dawnstar; [[SR:Harald|Harald]] walks out of the inn at 1am to [[SR:Quicksilver Mine|Quicksilver Mine]]; and [[SR:Vereth|Vereth]] walks out of the inn at 2am to a tower northeast of Dawnstar and watches the view. *''[[SR:Galur Rithari's Papers|Galur Rithari's Papers]]'' can be found within the cavern, on a table to the south of the altar. This rare book was needed in [[MW:Morrowind|''Morrowind'']] to cure yourself of vampirism by performing a task for Molag Bal. *This quest originally started upon installation of the Vigil Enforcer Armor Set Creation (or upon exiting [[SR:Helgen|Helgen]] after the tutorial) and would direct you to the Hall of the Vigilant. This was changed in an update on November 11, 2021. ==Bugs== {{Bug|The Miner's Note will be stuck in your inventory forever if you loot it from Harald after killing the cultists.|confirmed=1|dlc=CC}} :*This can be avoided by looting and reading Miner's Note before completing the quest. :*{{Pc22}} Use this command to remove it: player.removeitem FE01C929 1 {{NewLine}} ==Quest Stages== {{Journal Entries |10||The Vigil of Stendarr is an order founded after the Oblivion Crisis. ==Quick Walkthrough==
#Enter [[SR:Champion's Rest|Champion's Rest]] and read the ''[[SR:Vigilant's Report|Vigilant's Report]]''.
#Explore the dungeon until you come face-to-face with [[SR:Umbra (person)|Umbra]].
#Attack Umbra when he loses his invulnerability and take the [[SR:Umbra (item)|Umbra Sword]] from his corpse.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===Ghostly Sightings===
Head to [[SR:Champion's Rest|Champion's Rest]], a [[SR:Nordic Ruins|Nordic ruin]] which has recently been uncovered in a [[SR:Silver|silver]] mine east of [[SR:Shor's Stone|Shor's Stone]]. To start the quest, find and read the ''[[SR:Vigilant's Report|Vigilant's Report]]'' from a [[SR:Vigilant of Stendarr|Vigilant of Stendarr]] who previously investigated the site after reports that the miners saw a ghost within the ruins wielding a whispering sword. The Vigilant identified the sword as [[SR:Umbra (item)|Umbra]], a sentient [[SR:Daedric Artifacts|Daedric artifact]] long thought to have been destroyed. After reading the report, you will task yourself with finding the source of this dark presence to prevent any harm befalling Shor's Stone.
[[File:SR-interior-Champion's Rest (west puzzle).jpg|thumb|left|Puzzle solution for the western chamber]][[File:SR-interior-Champion's Rest (east puzzle).jpg|thumb|right|Puzzle solution for the eastern chamber]]
After passing through the short silver mine, you will enter the Nordic ruins themselves. Several [[SR:Skeever|skeever]]s can be found in a chamber to the left; to the right, you will enter a chamber only to come face-to-face with the [[SR:Ghost (Umbra)|ghost]] himself: a purple spirit who quickly vanishes. Venture deeper inside and you will find yourself in a huge chamber surrounded by sealed [[SR:Draugr|draugr]] sarcophagi and unlit blue braziers. At the opposite end of the chamber is a doubly-locked gate. Activating the nearby levers will do nothing. You will instead need to explore the two side passages, both of which contain [[Skyrim:Puzzles#Spinning_Symbol.2FRune_Totems|spinning totem puzzles]]. 

Both side passages contain leveled draugr enemies. The totem solutions themselves are partially obscured, with one totem being almost totally hidden beneath rubble. The eastern chamber's solution is '''Snake—Hawk—Whale'''. Pull the nearby lever to activate the eastern braziers, but be careful as you will be hit by a [[SR:Dart Trap|dart trap]] if you select the wrong totems. Once one side of the chamber is lit up, you will be able to activate the corresponding lever to partially lower the gate. However, solving each puzzle will also release a wave of draugr from their tombs. The western chamber's solution is '''Snake—Snake—Whale''', but again beware that the level will activate a [[SR:Flamethrower Statues|flamethrower statue trap]], which will ignite the surrounding [[SR:Oil Slicks|oil slick]] if you haven't done so already.

With both puzzles solved, the braziers on both sides of the main chamber will be lit by a cold blue flame and you will be able to fully lower the gate. Progress further in and defeat the boss-level draugr (which may be a [[SR:Dragon Priest|dragon priest]] at higher levels) and enter the second area of the ruins, Champion's Rest Amphitheater.

===A Vile Presence===
The first section of the Amphitheater zone consists of narrow waterlogged hallways filled with various traps activated by hidden pressure plates. You will come to an open area containing [[SR:Oil Lanterns|oil lantern]]s; descend to the bottom level and continue onward into the eerie blue crypts. You will again come across the ghost as you explore this area.
[[File:SR-interior-Champion's Rest Amphitheater 02.jpg|thumb|right|Umbra awaits you in an ancient Nordic arena]]
At the end of the crypts, you will enter into a huge natural cavern featuring a rock-hewn gladiatorial arena. In the center of the arena, you will find the "ghost", who is in fact an [[SR:Ebony|ebony]]-clad [[SR:Imperial|Imperial]] warrior named [[SR:Umbra (person)|Umbra]]. He is immune to all damage while purple and translucent, but he will repeatedly summon three [[SR:Umbra's Soul Image|soul images]] to fight you, during which time he will materialize and will be vulnerable to damage. Be sure not to allow the soul images to gang up on you, as two of them use [[SR:Bound Sword|bound sword]]s and another will shoot from a distance with a [[SR:Bound Bow|bound bow]].

After a short period, Umbra will reabsorb his soul images and cast an extremely powerful area of effect [[SR:Destruction|Destruction]] spell, which includes [[SR:Frost Damage|frost]] and [[SR:Fire Damage|fire]] damage spells. Should you survive the boss fight and do enough damage to Umbra while he is not invulnerable, he will fall dead, allowing you to claim the sword as well as the [[SR:Champion's Rest Passage Key|Champion's Rest Passage Key]] granting access to his inner sanctum and a short escape route out of the dungeon. Taking the sword will end the quest.

Loot the chest in the northeast corner of the arena and make your way to the southern exit. Inside Umbra's living quarters, you will find a small camp along with a bowl full of [[SR:Skeever Tail|skeever tail]]s and a ''[[SR:Treasure Hunter's Journal|Treasure Hunter's Journal]]'' explaining how the now deceased Imperial man had ended up in the tomb and how Umbra bent him to his will until their psyches fused. A secret tunnel will lead you back to the ruin's entrance, allowing for a quick escape.

==Notes==
*The name of this quest is a reference to [[SR:Clavicus Vile|Clavicus Vile]], the creator of Umbra.
* Umbra was destroyed at the climax of [[BK:Lord of Souls|''Lord of Souls'']], the second of two novels written by Greg Keyes. This took place in {{Year|4E 48}}, over 150 years before the events of ''Skyrim''.
* The song that plays during the Umbra boss fight is "Daedra in Flight" from the [[Oblivion:Music|''Oblivion'' soundtrack]].

==Detailed Walkthrough==
This quest can be started after [[Skyrim:Crustacean Extermination|Crustacean Extermination]] has been completed by talking to Viriya:
:'''Know of anyone in need of fishing work around Skyrim?'''
:''"Of course. It's all in this note."''

She will hand you the [[Skyrim:Bounty: Fangtusk|bounty]], read it and you will learn of a monsterous horker known as Fangtusk, which has been terrorizing fishermen north of Hollyfrost Farm. 

You need to obtain an [[Skyrim:Arctic Grayling|arctic grayling]] and then head northeast of [[Skyrim:Yngol Barrow|Yngol Barrow]] to a rock by water that has two skeletons lying next to it, place the arctic grayling on the rock and Fangtusk will emerge from the icy water.

Once you have killed Fangtusk, inspect his body and you will find [[Skyrim:Vampire Dust|vampire dust]], [[Skyrim:Vampire Gloves|vampire gloves]], and a [[Skyrim:Vampiric Ring|Vampiric Ring]], suggesting Fangtusk ate a vampire.

Take this ring to the steward of Windhelm and speak to them:
:'''Fangtusk has been slain.'''
:''"It's really dead, then? It may be dead now, but... where did it come from?"''
:'''An enchanted ring in Fangtusk's gut seems to have been the source of its power.'''
:''"You've done well."''
::'''Travellers should be safe now. At least, safe from giant vampire horkers.'''
::''"Thank you. Here, this is for you."''
::'''Alright, I've held up my end of the bargain. Time to pay up.'''
::''"Thank you. Here, this is for you."''

You will then be rewarded 200 gold.

==Detailed Walkthrough==
===An Unenchanted Weapon===
Finding any of the four Dwarven Forge Gems hidden throughout Solstheim or entering the Temple in Raven Rock and stumbling upon the [[SR:Ghosts of the Tribunal (quest)|Ghosts of the Tribunal]] quest will begin this quest.

Trueflame is located in the Dwarven Forge in Fahlbtharz where [[SR:Hand Kenro Hlan|Hand Kenro Hlan]] will attack you. He is in possession of Trueflame, although it appears as an [[SR:Unenchanted Weapon|Unenchanted Weapon]] without the enchanted flames it traditionally bears. He also has a [[Skyrim:Hand Kenro's Note|note]] giving direction, and a sample of [[SR:Pyroil Tar|Pyroil Tar]] which will be needed once you have all four Gems.
   
===Fahlbtharz Forge Gem Locations===
The gems are found:

# On the body of [[Skyrim:Hand Kenro Hlan|Hand Kenro Hlan]].
# On the body of the [[SR:Buyer|buyer]] after following the [[SR:Redoran Guard|Redoran guard]] during [[SR:Buyer Beware|Buyer Beware]].
# In the armory in [[SR:Ashfall's Tear|Ashfall's Tear]].
# On the body of [[SR:Erden Relvel|Erden Relvel]] at the end of the quest [[SR:Ashen Heart|Ashen Heart]].

===Reforging the Blade of Nerevar===
With the Unenchanted Blade and all four gems in hand, you must return to Fahlbtharz Forge and place the four gems within the forge's receptacles. You will then need to apply the pyroil tar to the blade and place it in the sword slot; doing so will complete this quest and reignite the weapon with a visually impressive [[SR:Fire Damage|fire damage]] enchantment. Congratulations, you now possess [[SR:Trueflame|Trueflame]], the legendary Blade of [[Lore:Nerevar|Nerevar]].

==Notes==
You must also complete all the other related quests in order to obtain the 4 [[Skyrim:Fahlbtharz_Forge_Gem|Fahlbtharz Forge Gems]].

These quests are:

[[Skyrim:Ghosts_of_the_Tribunal_(quest)|Ghosts of the Tribunal]]

[[Skyrim:Her_Word_Against_Theirs|Her Word Against Theirs]]

[[Skyrim:Buyer_Beware|Buyer Beware]]

[[Skyrim:Careless_Curation|Careless Curation]]

[[Skyrim:Ashen_Heart|Ashen Heart]] (All previous quests must be completed to unlock the armory and the Ashen Heart quest)

The next time you sleep for any duration, you will ''"awake after a full sleep"'' to find that you have been mysteriously transported to unfamiliar surroundings. The quest can also sometimes be started after completing Aventus's quest by sleeping in any bed, even before receiving the Mysterious Note from the courier. ===Astrid's Test=== You will awaken in an [[Skyrim:Abandoned Shack|abandoned shack]] to a greeting from [[Skyrim:Astrid|Astrid]]. She will calmly inform you that your killing of Grelod the Kind has pleased the [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood|Dark Brotherhood]], but that, in doing so, you stole a contract belonging to the [[Skyrim:Night_Mother|Night Mother]], the Brotherhood's disembodied spiritual leader. Thus, you must repay your debt: ''"A life for a life"'', as Astrid explains. She will tell you that you cannot leave the room until someone dies. The unpickable door to exit the shack is locked, and Astrid has the key. You have the option of fulfilling the Night Mother's demand for a life by killing Astrid. Doing this will cause you to fail this quest and immediately start the [[Skyrim:Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!|Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!]] quest. If you don't wish to kill Astrid, the room is also occupied by three bound captives. Astrid will inform you that ''"One of these poor sods has a contract out on their life. Which one is it?"'' It is up to you to figure out which and then carry out the job. You can refuse to carry out the job, but you can't avoid killing somebody. When facing them, the captive to the left-hand side is [[Skyrim:Fultheim the Fearless|Fultheim the Fearless]], a mercenary. He claims to be unaware of anyone in particular who would want him dead, but reasons that, being a sell-sword, any number of people could hold a grudge against him. When intimidated, he also admits, ''"Maybe there were... times I got carried away? But war is war."'' The captive in the center is [[Skyrim:Alea Quintus|Alea Quintus]], a crass and abrasive mother of six who constantly and irritatingly demands to be released. She indicates that the tough attitude she has adopted to manage so many children might motivate someone to wish her dead. ''"Do some people look down on me? Have I made some enemies? You're damn right."'' The final captive, to the right-hand side, is a [[Skyrim:Khajiit|Khajiit]] named [[Skyrim:Vasha|Vasha]], who casually incriminates himself as an ''"obtainer of goods, taker of lives, and defiler of daughters."'' He is the only one of the three who remains calm in the face of imminent death, and mentions that this isn't the first time he's been ''"bagged and dragged."'' He also states that ''"If one of my enemies wouldn't pay to have me killed, I'd take it as a personal insult."'' In truth, it doesn't matter which captive(s) you choose. You won't encounter any of them again (unless you return to the shack, and even then you won't be able to learn more). If you kill one or more of them, Astrid will give you the password to the [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood_Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary's]] "The Black Door". You will then be given a [[Skyrim:Abandoned Shack Key|key]] to let yourself out of the shack. Alternatively, you can kill Astrid and loot the shack's key from her corpse. {| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed" ! Victim(s) !! Astrid's comments |- | Alea || ''"Ah, the feisty goodwife. Quite the mouth on her. Someone must have wanted her dead... right?"'' |- | Fultheim || '''"Oh ho. The whimpering Nord, eh? Yes, yes, I can see how you'd come to that conclusion. Interesting choice."'' |- | Vasha || ''"The conniving Khajiit. Cat like that was sure to have enemies. It's no wonder you chose him."'' |- | Alea and Fultheim || ''"The blubbering barbarian and the tenacious mother. Must have been one of them, right?"'' |- | Alea and Vasha || ''"Hmm. The fearless wife and mother, and the underhanded Khajiit. Had to be one of them, right? Interesting choice."'' |- | Fultheim and Vasha|| ''"The timid warrior and the sly Khajiit. Must have been one or the other, right?"'' |- | Alea, Fultheim, and Vasha || ''"Well, well, aren't we the over-achiever? Three possibilities, three victims. Must have been one of them, right? So why take chances..."'' |- | Astrid || ''"Well done..."'' |} ===Enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary=== The [[Skyrim:Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary|Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary]] is located almost due south of the Abandoned Shack, near the southern border of the province of Skyrim and just west of [[Skyrim:Falkreath|Falkreath]]. :Upon entering the Sanctuary, ''the optional [[Skyrim:Delayed_Burial|Delayed Burial]] quest will fail if you started it, or be unavailable if you have not started it.'' If you want to do this minor quest, detour to the quest location, north of [[Skyrim:Whiterun|Whiterun]], on the way to the sanctuary. When you activate the Sanctuary's entrance, The Black Door, it will ask, ''"What is the music of life?"'' Answer with the password Astrid taught you: ''"Silence, my brother"''. You will be welcomed to your new "home" and the door will open. ===Speak Again with Astrid=== Find Astrid inside. She will welcome you to the family by giving you several pieces of [[Skyrim:Shrouded_Armor|Shrouded Armor apparel]], which provide enhancements useful to assassins. (There are also several other Shrouded Armor pieces on a shelf to the right of the room.) You are a now a full member of the Dark Brotherhood, and enjoy all the [[Skyrim:Dark_Brotherhood#Advantages_to_Joining|advantages]] associated therewith. Astrid will reveal that she is currently arranging an important job to give you, and that you should, in the meantime, take care of some routine assassination contracts handled by [[Skyrim:Nazir|Nazir]]. She will encourage you to introduce yourself to your new family members and give a rundown on how the Brotherhood operates. She gives a brief history on the Brotherhood and also informs you that they have done away with all rules and policies except for one simple principle, "Respect the Family". You may also learn that the corpse of the [[Skyrim:Night_Mother|Night Mother]] is en route to the Sanctuary, though she does not know when it might arrive. She finishes by again directing you to Nazir, assigning you your next quest, [[Skyrim:Sanctuary|Sanctuary]]. ===Achievements=== One [[Skyrim:Achievements|achievement]] is unlocked at the end of this quest: * {{achievement|With Friends Like These... (achievement)|descr=no}} ==Notes== *The key required to exit the Abandoned Shack will not appear in Astrid's inventory if you attempt to pick her pocket, but will only appear in her inventory if you kill her. *The amount of time you choose to sleep just before Astrid takes you is irrelevant—no time will pass and your "Hours Slept" statistic will not be updated. After waking up in the Abandoned Shack, the [[Skyrim:Rested|Rested]] or [[Skyrim:Well Rested|Well Rested]] effect will still nevertheless be applied, unless you're a [[Skyrim:Lycanthropy|werewolf]]. *After Astrid's initial speech and before killing any of the captives, you can attempt to pickpocket her if you have the [[Skyrim:Misdirection|Misdirection]] perk. If you succeed, you can obtain a complete set of Shrouded Armor along with her [[Skyrim:Blade of Woe|Blade of Woe]]. At the end of the Brotherhood quest chain, you'll get another Blade of Woe as the reward, making it possible to dual-wield them. If you choose to spare the captives and kill Astrid instead after pickpocketing her equipment, she will be an easy kill as she obviously won't be wearing her armor or weapon. On the other hand, if your pickpocket is high enough to steal these things, you're probably powerful enough in other ways to kill her even if she was wearing them. *The rewarded Shrouded Armor consists of a set of [[Skyrim:Shrouded Armor|Armor]], [[Skyrim:Shrouded Boots|Boots]], a [[Skyrim:Shrouded Cowl|Cowl]] and a pair of [[Skyrim:Shrouded Gloves|Gloves]]. This set is marked as [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]]. *If you start this quest before receiving the Mysterious Note, it will never be sent to you. *An unused NPC with the name "[[Skyrim:Unused NPCs#Player Friend|Player Friend]]" is associated with this quest, but was not implemented in the final release of the game. Pre-release reports for Skyrim claimed that the Dark Brotherhood would make you assassinate NPCs whom your character had befriended, which this NPC's association with this quest corroborates. **In the [[Skyrim Mod:Creation Kit|Creation Kit]], earlier versions for some lines can be seen. Astrid's last line when you refuse to cooperate is normally ''"Now it's time to face the consequences of your actions. You don't leave this shack until someone dies."'', but it's shown that the earlier version actually would've said ''"Now it's time to face the consequences of your actions. So, kill a friend, then sleep, and I'll visit you once more. To finalize your repayment."'' This line also corroberates the fact you would've had to kill an NPC you had befriended. **Similarly, [[Skyrim:Babette|Babette]] would normally say: ''"There you are! Astrid's told me all about you. Heard she pulled the ole' "Choose your victim" gag with you. Ah, I love that one..."'' when meeting you for the first time in the Sanctuary, but the earlier version goes as such: ''"There you are! Astrid's told me all about you. I guess you did it, huh? You killed your friend? Trust me - you made the right decision."'' This appears to be the only other line mentioning this earlier idea. *All of the potential victims completely resist poison if you reverse-pickpocket some onto them, so they must be killed using either a weapon or spell. *The map marker for the shack is only added after either Astrid gives you the key or you kill Astrid and loot it from her corpse, unless you have already found it prior to being brought there. *No matter how you finish the quest, the Abandoned Shack will remain uninhabited, aside from the corpses of anyone you killed. *Don't store anything in the Abandoned Shack, as the building resets every 10 days. *If you choose to kill Astrid, any or all of the three captives can be untied and released after her death. *Conversely, if you kill a captive first, Astrid becomes "essential" and unkillable, so it is impossible to kill her to get the Abandoned Shack key off her. She can be knocked down, and will revert to non-hostile (and full health) when she gets up again, so you can talk to Astrid to be given the key. **Also, once one of the captives is killed, you will never be given the option to release the remaining two - not even after leaving and re-entering the Abandoned Shack: they will remain there, bound and hooded, for all time unless you choose to murder them. *If you kill one or two of the captives, you can talk to Astrid and hear one of the responses mentioned above. If you exit conversation without selecting any of the dialogue options and kill another one (or the third if you killed two before talking to her), Astrid will give a different response. Without reloading, you can hear up to three different responses this way. *If you use the [[Skyrim:Wabbajack|Wabbajack]] on any of the captives, it will still count as killing them, and the one you selected will be dead once the effect wears off. *If you cast [[SR:Clairvoyance (spell)|Clairvoyance]] inside the shack, it will always point to Vasha. This is due to the fact that the Clairvoyance spell will always target the last objective added in any given quest and should not be interpreted to mean that Vasha is the correct choice. *If you cast [[SR:Reanimate Corpse|Reanimate Corpse]] on a captive you killed, the captive will follow you inside the shack, but will disappear immediately once you exit. *If you have ''[[Skyrim:Dawnguard|Dawnguard]]'' installed, sleeping inside [[Skyrim:Dayspring Canyon|Dayspring Canyon]], [[Skyrim:Fort Dawnguard|Fort Dawnguard]], or [[Skyrim:Volkihar Keep|Castle Volkihar]] will still cause you to wake up in the Abandoned Shack. Likewise, if you have ''[[Skyrim:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]]'' installed and sleep on [[Skyrim:Solstheim|Solstheim]], or at your [[Skyrim:Construction|house]] with ''[[Skyrim:Hearthfire|Hearthfire]]'' installed, you will get the same results. You can also encounter the same results if you install [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation Club]] content, depending upon what it is. *The [[Skyrim:Blade of Woe|Blade of Woe]] and a full set of Shrouded equipment ([[Skyrim:Shrouded Armor|Shrouded Armor]], [[Skyrim:Shrouded Gloves|Shrouded Gloves]], [[Skyrim:Shrouded Boots|Shrouded Boots]], [[Skyrim:Shrouded Cowl|Shrouded Cowl]]) can be obtained by killing Astrid if you choose not to join the Brotherhood. *No matter how you finish the quest, [[Skyrim:Aventus Aretino|Aventus Aretino]] will still view you as his savior for getting rid of [[Skyrim:Grelod the Kind|Grelod the Kind]]. *Either joining the Dark Brotherhood or destroying it will prevent further [[Skyrim:World Interactions#Dark Brotherhood Assassin Sent to Kill the Player|assassination attempts against you]]. *Ironically, given the fact that they're already immobilized, all three captives are immune to [[Skyrim:Paralyze (effect)|paralysis]] effects. ==Quick Walkthrough==

==Detailed Walkthrough==
Once you reach 50 level of any [[Skyrim:Magicka|magic]] school except Enchanting, upon entering a habitable location (or exiting a building in the location) a [[Skyrim:Challenger|challenger]] may appear and challenge you to a duel. Regardless of your answer, a combat ensues.

==Notes==
* You need to open Stats screen at least once after leveling up magic to trigger this quest.
* If you try to back out of the duel rather than indulge him, any nearby [[Skyrim:Guards|guards]] will help you with your duel.
* If you do not use magic to fight the mage, he will taunt you.
* If any of your [[Skyrim:Followers|followers]] join in on the duel, he will order them to stop, explaining that it is supposed to be a one-on-one duel. This does not seem to affect the quest in any way, and companions will not abide to his demands. The same happens if other NPCs nearby are hit by his spells.
* This duel can lead to your expulsion from the [[Skyrim:College of Winterhold (faction)|College of Winterhold]]. There is a [[Skyrim:Rejoining the College|quest to rejoin]] if this happens.{{vn}}

== Quick Walkthrough ==
# Speak to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] about assisting him in his research.
# Go to a radiant location and retrieve ''[[Skyrim:Wind and Sand (book)|Wind and Sand]]''.
# Return to Neloth for your reward.

== Detailed Walkthrough ==
After completing [[Skyrim:Experimental Subject|Experimental Subject]], speak to [[Skyrim:Neloth|Neloth]] again about assisting in his research. This time, he will tell you that he is attempting to adapt Redguard magic to the island's ash. He has learned the location of a book through a source of his that would prove invaluable to his spell research. The book is ''[[Skyrim:Wind and Sand (book)|Wind and Sand]]'' and is located in a radiant location: a Dragon lair, dragon priest lair, draugr crypt, Falmer hive, Forsworn camp, hagraven nest, vampire lair, or warlock lair.

Once you have the book, return to Neloth who will excitedly declare that he can create some sort of wind spell with its contents. You will receive 250 gold, and the spell tome [[Skyrim:Whirlwind Cloak|Whirlwind Cloak]] will be made available for purchase the next time that [[Skyrim:Talvas Fathryon|Talvas Fathryon]] restocks.
